Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mit modernen ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR <item> IN it_items
                       NEXT s = s + <item>-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_sum_reduce=>ty_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 10 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 20 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 30 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 60
      msg = 'Sum should be 60' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_sum_reduce=>ty_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Sum of empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`s`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei er in jedem Schritt die Variable aktualisiert.
keywords: SUM, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer Spalte in einer internen Tabelle, aber nur für Einträge, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Iteration mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und dem `SUM`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_conditional_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_items
        iv_min_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_conditional_sum.
    rv_sum = SUM #( FOR <item> IN it_items WHERE ( id >= iv_min_id ) ( <item>-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_sum.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_sum_conditional=>ty_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 10 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 20 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 30 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 value = 40 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_conditional( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_sum( it_items = lt_items iv_min_id = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 70 "30 + 40
      msg = 'Conditional sum should be 70' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_sum_conditional=>ty_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 10 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 20 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_conditional( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_sum( it_items = lt_items iv_min_id = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Sum should be 0 when no items match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_sum_conditional=>ty_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_conditional( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_sum( it_items = lt_items iv_min_id = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `SUM`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine prägnante und funktionale Berechnung der Summe von Werten, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: SUM, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Werten in einer internen Tabelle, gruppiert nach einem bestimmten Feld, und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_grouped DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             category TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             category TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             total_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES ty_result_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_grouped_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_result_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_grouped IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_grouped_sum.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) GROUP BY ls_data-category ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).
      DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                               FOR <item> IN GROUP group_ref
                               NEXT s = s + <item>-value ).
      APPEND VALUE #( category = group_ref->category
                      total_value = lv_sum ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_group FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_sum.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_sum_grouped=>ty_data_tab.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = 'A' value = 10 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = 'B' value = 20 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = 'A' value = 30 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = 'C' value = 5 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = 'B' value = 15 ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_grouped( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_sum( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should have 3 groups' ).

    DATA(ls_result_a) = lt_result[ category = 'A' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_a-total_value
      exp = 40 "10 + 30
      msg = 'Sum for category A should be 40' ).

    DATA(ls_result_b) = lt_result[ category = 'B' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_b-total_value
      exp = 35 "20 + 15
      msg = 'Sum for category B should be 35' ).

    DATA(ls_result_c) = lt_result[ category = 'C' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_c-total_value
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Sum for category C should be 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_sum_grouped=>ty_data_tab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_grouped( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_sum( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_group.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_sum_grouped=>ty_data_tab.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = 'X' value = 100 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = 'X' value = 200 ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_grouped( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_sum( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Should have 1 group' ).

    DATA(ls_result_x) = lt_result[ category = 'X' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_x-total_value
      exp = 300
      msg = 'Sum for category X should be 300' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine effiziente und elegante Aggregation von Daten innerhalb von Gruppen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu klassischen `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Konstrukten und bietet eine bessere Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: SUM, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit Open SQL.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Aggregatfunktion `SUM` in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    SELECT SINGLE SUM( SEATSOCC )
      FROM sflights
      INTO @rv_total_passengers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_total_passengers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_passengers.
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has some data. For a robust test,
    " one might insert test data or mock the database access.
    " Here, we just check if it's not initial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_sum_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( ).

    " A simple check that it returns a non-negative value.
    " More specific assertions would require knowing the exact data in SFLIGHTS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit Open SQL.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Aggregatfunktion `SUM` in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_sum_grouped DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carrier_sum.
    TYPES ty_carrier_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_db_sum_grouped IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsocc ) AS total_passengers
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrier_sums.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_sums ) > 0 )

    " Example: Check for a specific carrier if known to exist
    " This part would be more robust with test data setup.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_sum) = lt_sums[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_lh_sum-total_passengers >= 0 )
          msg = 'LH total passengers should be non-negative' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Carrier LH not found in SFLIGHTS for testing.' ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein einfaches Interface mit einer Methode und implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` zum Definieren und `INTERFACES` in der Klasse zur Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to console/log file
    " For demo, we just simulate it.
    " cl_demo_output=>display( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_logger_implementation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_logger_implementation.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " We can't directly test the side effect of writing to console.
    " Instead, we test if the method can be called without error
    " and if the object correctly implements the interface.
    DATA(li_logger) = CAST zif_logger( lo_logger ).
    li_logger->log_message( 'Test message' ).
    " If no dump occurs, the basic implementation is considered working.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = abap_true
      msg = 'Interface method should be callable' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces definieren einen Vertrag, den Klassen implementieren können. Dies fördert die lose Kopplung und ermöglicht Polymorphie. Die Definition erfolgt mit `INTERFACE`, die Implementierung in einer Klasse mit `INTERFACES` und der Methodenname wird mit `interface~method` qualifiziert.
keywords: INTERFACE, CLASS, Object Orientation, Implementation

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie, indem Sie verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces über eine Interface-Referenz aufrufen.
hint: Erstellen Sie mehrere Klassen, die dasselbe Interface implementieren, und verwenden Sie eine Interface-Referenzvariable.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_width  TYPE decfloat16
        iv_height TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_height TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_area
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_area.
    rv_total_area = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0
                                       FOR <shape> IN it_shapes
                                       NEXT s = s + <shape>->get_area( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '10' ).
    DATA(lo_rectangle) = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_width = '5' iv_height = '4' ).

    APPEND lo_circle TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND lo_rectangle TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_shape_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_area) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_area( lt_shapes ).

    " Area of circle with radius 10: PI * 10 * 10 = 314.159...
    " Area of rectangle 5x4: 20
    " Total expected: approx 334.159
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_area
      exp = '334.15926535897932384626433832795'
      delta = '0.00000000000000000000000000001'
      msg = 'Total area should be sum of circle and rectangle areas' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_shape_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_area) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_area( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_area
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total area of empty list should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Polymorphie ermöglicht es, Objekte verschiedener Klassen, die dasselbe Interface implementieren, über eine gemeinsame Interface-Referenz zu behandeln. Dies fördert flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen. Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um die Flächen der verschiedenen Formen zu summieren.
keywords: INTERFACE, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, REDUCE, SUM

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Standardmethode (Default Method) und demonstrieren Sie deren Verwendung und Überschreibung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DEFAULT METHODS` in der Interface-Definition.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processor.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

  DEFAULT METHODS get_default_message
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processor~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  " Default method can be omitted or explicitly implemented
  " METHOD zif_processor~get_default_message.
  "   rv_message = 'Custom Default Message'.
  " ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processor~process_data.
    rv_output = |Custom Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_processor~get_default_message.
    rv_message = 'Custom Default Message from Custom Processor'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overridden_default_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_method.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_simple_processor( ).
    DATA(li_processor) = CAST zif_processor( lo_processor ).

    DATA(lv_message) = li_processor->get_default_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Default message from interface'
      msg = 'Should return the default message' ).

    DATA(lv_output) = li_processor->process_data( 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_output
      exp = 'Processed: Hello'
      msg = 'Should process data correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overridden_default_method.
    DATA(lo_custom_processor) = NEW zcl_custom_processor( ).
    DATA(li_custom_processor) = CAST zif_processor( lo_custom_processor ).

    DATA(lv_message) = li_custom_processor->get_default_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Custom Default Message from Custom Processor'
      msg = 'Should return the overridden default message' ).

    DATA(lv_output) = li_custom_processor->process_data( 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_output
      exp = 'Custom Processed: World'
      msg = 'Should process data with custom logic' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.55 führte Standardmethoden in Interfaces ein, die eine Implementierung direkt im Interface bereitstellen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code in implementierenden Klassen und ermöglicht die Erweiterung von Interfaces, ohne bestehende Implementierungen zu brechen. Klassen können die Standardimplementierung nutzen oder überschreiben.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT METHODS, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.55

CLASS zcl_data_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Interfaces und den `SUM`-Operator: Definieren Sie ein Interface für Datenquellen, die eine Summe liefern können, und implementieren Sie es in verschiedenen Klassen, die unterschiedliche Daten aggregieren.
hint: Das Interface sollte eine Methode zur Summenberechnung haben. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `SUM` in den Implementierungen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_summable_data.
  METHODS get_total_sum
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sales_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_summable_data.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_figures TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sales_figures TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sales_figures = it_sales_figures.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_summable_data~get_total_sum.
    rv_sum = SUM #( mt_sales_figures ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inventory_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_summable_data.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_item_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_item_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inventory_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_item_values = it_item_values.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_summable_data~get_total_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR value IN mt_item_values
                       NEXT s = s + value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_combined_report
      IMPORTING
        it_data_sources TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_summable_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_combined_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_combined_report.
    rv_combined_sum = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0
                                 FOR <source> IN it_data_sources
                                 NEXT total = total + <source>->get_total_sum( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combined_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sources FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combined_sum.
    DATA: lt_sales_figures TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 100 TO lt_sales_figures.
    APPEND 200 TO lt_sales_figures.

    DATA: lt_item_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 50 TO lt_item_values.
    APPEND 75 TO lt_item_values.
    APPEND 125 TO lt_item_values.

    DATA(lo_sales_data) = NEW zcl_sales_data( lt_sales_figures ).
    DATA(lo_inventory_value) = NEW zcl_inventory_value( lt_item_values ).

    DATA: lt_data_sources TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_summable_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND lo_sales_data TO lt_data_sources.
    APPEND lo_inventory_value TO lt_data_sources.

    DATA(lo_report_generator) = NEW zcl_report_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_combined_sum) = lo_report_generator->generate_combined_report( lt_data_sources ).

    " Expected: (100 + 200) + (50 + 75 + 125) = 300 + 250 = 550
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_combined_sum
      exp = 550
      msg = 'Combined sum should be 550' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sources.
    DATA: lt_data_sources TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_summable_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_report_generator) = NEW zcl_report_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_combined_sum) = lo_report_generator->generate_combined_report( lt_data_sources ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_combined_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Combined sum of empty sources should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von Interfaces in Kombination mit funktionalen Operatoren wie `SUM` und `REDUCE`. Das Interface `zif_summable_data` definiert einen gemeinsamen Vertrag für verschiedene Datenquellen, die eine Summe liefern können. Die `zcl_report_generator`-Klasse kann dann polymorph mit jeder Implementierung dieses Interfaces arbeiten, um eine Gesamtsumme zu berechnen, was die Flexibilität und Erweiterbarkeit des Systems erhöht.
keywords: INTERFACE, SUM, REDUCE, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit Konstanten und implementieren Sie es in einer Klasse, um auf diese Konstanten zuzugreifen.
hint: Konstanten in Interfaces werden mit `CONSTANTS` definiert und über `interface~constant` angesprochen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_constants.
  CONSTANTS: gc_max_value TYPE i VALUE 100,
             gc_status_ok TYPE string VALUE 'OK'.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_constant_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_constants.

    METHODS get_max_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_status_ok
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_constant_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value.
    rv_max = zif_constants~gc_max_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_ok.
    rv_status = zif_constants~gc_status_ok.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constants_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constants_access.
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_constant_consumer( ).

    DATA(lv_max) = lo_consumer->get_max_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_max
      exp = 100
      msg = 'Max value should be 100' ).

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_consumer->get_status_ok( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'OK'
      msg = 'Status OK should be ''OK''' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces können nicht nur Methoden, sondern auch Konstanten definieren. Dies ist nützlich, um globale, logisch zusammengehörige Konstanten zu gruppieren und über einen klar definierten Namensraum zugänglich zu machen. Der Zugriff erfolgt über den Interface-Namen gefolgt von der Tilde (`~`) und dem Konstanten-Namen.
keywords: INTERFACE, CONSTANTS, Object Orientation

Instructions: Verwenden Sie ein Interface, um eine Factory-Methode zu implementieren, die verschiedene Objekte basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt.
hint: Die Factory-Methode sollte eine Referenz auf das Interface zurückgeben, und die konkreten Klassen implementieren dieses Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception or return initial
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_create_object_error=>cx_sy_create_object_error.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_product_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_product_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_unknown_product FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_product_a) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_product_a->get_name( )
      exp = 'Product A'
      msg = 'Should create Product A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_product_b) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_product_b->get_name( )
      exp = 'Product B'
      msg = 'Should create Product B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_unknown_product.
    TRY.
        zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'C' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for unknown product type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = abap_true
          msg = 'Correctly caught exception for unknown product type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Muster, implementiert mit Interfaces, ermöglicht die Erstellung von Objekten, ohne die konkrete Klasse direkt zu instanziieren. Die Factory-Methode gibt eine Interface-Referenz zurück, was die Flexibilität erhöht und die Abhängigkeit von konkreten Implementierungen reduziert. Dies ist ein Kernprinzip der objektorientierten Programmierung und fördert die lose Kopplung.
keywords: INTERFACE, Factory Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Polymorphism

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate einer Liste von Zahlen mit modernen ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Iteration mit dem `SUM`-Operator und einer arithmetischen Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = SUM #( FOR number IN it_numbers ( number * number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).

    " Expected: 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 14
      msg = 'Sum of squares should be 14' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Sum of squares for empty list should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_numbers.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND -1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND -2 TO lt_numbers.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).

    " Expected: (-1)*(-1) + (-2)*(-2) = 1 + 4 = 5
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Sum of squares for negative numbers should be 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SUM`-Operator kann in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration verwendet werden, um nicht nur die Werte direkt zu summieren, sondern auch um Transformationen auf die Werte anzuwenden (hier: Quadrieren) bevor sie summiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: SUM, FOR, Math, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für Flüge, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. über einer bestimmten Flugnummer), direkt aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle mit Open SQL.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SUM(...) WHERE ...` mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_conditional_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_seats_by_flight_num
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flight_num TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_conditional_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_seats_by_flight_num.
    SELECT SINGLE SUM( seatsocc )
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate >= @iv_min_flight_num
      INTO @rv_total_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_with_condition FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_with_condition.
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has data, e.g., flights on '20250101', '20250102', etc.
    " For a robust test, one would insert specific test data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_conditional_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_sum_seats_by_flight_num( '20250101' ).

    " Assert that the sum is non-negative. More specific assertion
    " would require knowing the exact data in SFLIGHTS for '20250101' and later.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_total_seats >= 0 )
      msg = 'Total seats should be non-negative for existing flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_conditional_sum( ).
    " Use a future date unlikely to have flights
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_sum_seats_by_flight_num( '99991231' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total seats should be 0 for no matching flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes Open SQL erlaubt die Kombination von Aggregatfunktionen wie `SUM` mit `WHERE`-Klauseln in einer einzigen `SELECT SINGLE`-Anweisung. Dies ermöglicht eine effiziente Filterung und Aggregation direkt auf der Datenbank, ohne unnötige Datenübertragung an den Anwendungsserver. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist Standard in modernem ABAP.
keywords: SUM, Open SQL, Database, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (`sflights`) nach einem bestimmten Währungscode, der aus den Einkaufskonstanten (`cl_mmpur_constants`) stammt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `cl_mmpur_constants=>currency-eur`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pur_filter_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_filter_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_currency.
    DATA(lv_currency) = cl_mmpur_constants=>currency-eur. "Using a purchasing constant for currency

    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE currency = lv_currency ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_currency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_currency.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pur_filter_currency( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_currency( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should filter two entries with EUR currency'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-currency
      exp = cl_mmpur_constants=>currency-eur
      msg = 'First filtered entry should have EUR currency'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER` Expression ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern. In Kombination mit einer Konstante aus `cl_mmpur_constants` wird die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert, da keine Hardcoded-Werte verwendet werden.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Constants, cl_mmpur_constants

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Status einem 'gesperrten' Status aus den Einkaufskonstanten entspricht, und geben Sie einen entsprechenden Text zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` und `cl_mmpur_constants=>status-blocked`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pur_check_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_blocked_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_check_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_blocked_status.
    DATA(lv_blocked_status) = cl_mmpur_constants=>status-blocked. "Using a purchasing constant for blocked status

    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = lv_blocked_status THEN 'Status ist gesperrt.'
      ELSE 'Status ist nicht gesperrt.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_blocked_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unblocked_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_blocked_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pur_check_status( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_blocked_status( cl_mmpur_constants=>status-blocked ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Status ist gesperrt.'
      msg = 'Should identify blocked status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unblocked_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pur_check_status( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_blocked_status( 'OPEN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Status ist nicht gesperrt.'
      msg = 'Should identify unblocked status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von bedingter Logik, die den traditionellen `IF...ENDIF`-Blöcken vorzuziehen ist. Die Verwendung von `cl_mmpur_constants` stellt sicher, dass der Vergleichswert zentral definiert und leicht änderbar ist.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Constants, cl_mmpur_constants

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Meldung für eine Einkaufsbestellung, die den Bestelltyp und die Einkaufsorganisation aus den Einkaufskonstanten verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates und `cl_mmpur_constants=>document_type-purchase_order`, `cl_mmpur_constants=>purchasing_organization-standard`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pur_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_po_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_po_number TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_po_message.
    DATA(lv_doc_type) = cl_mmpur_constants=>document_type-purchase_order.
    DATA(lv_pur_org) = cl_mmpur_constants=>purchasing_organization-standard.

    rv_message = |Einkaufsbestellung { iv_po_number } vom Typ { lv_doc_type } für Einkaufsorganisation { lv_pur_org } wurde erstellt.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_po_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_po_message.

CLASS zcl_pur_map_material_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_type_short,
             mat_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_material_type_short.
    TYPES tt_material_type_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_type_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_type_long,
             mat_type_short TYPE string,
             mat_type_long  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_material_type_long.
    TYPES tt_material_type_long TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_type_long WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_material_types
      IMPORTING
        it_short_types TYPE tt_material_type_short
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_long_types) TYPE tt_material_type_long.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_map_material_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_material_types.
    rt_long_types = VALUE #( FOR <fs_short> IN it_short_types
                             LET lv_long_text = SWITCH string( <fs_short>-mat_type
                               WHEN cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type-raw_material THEN 'Rohmaterial'
                               WHEN cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type-finished_product THEN 'Fertigerzeugnis'
                               ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) IN
                             ( mat_type_short = <fs_short>-mat_type
                               mat_type_long  = lv_long_text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_reduce_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             mat_type TYPE string, "Fictional material type for demo
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_reduce_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lv_target_mat_type) = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type-raw_material. "Using a purchasing constant

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                               WHERE ( mat_type = lv_target_mat_type )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS manage_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_timer TYPE abap_bool
        iv_interval    TYPE i DEFAULT 1.
    METHODS is_timer_active RETURNING VALUE(rv_active) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD manage_timer.
    IF iv_start_timer = abap_true.
      IF mo_timer->running = abap_false.
        mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
        mo_timer->run( ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      IF mo_timer->running = abap_true.
        mo_timer->stop( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_timer_active.
    rv_active = mo_timer->running.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_start_stop_dynamic FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_start_stop_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_dynamic( ).

    " Start timer
    lo_cut->manage_timer( iv_start_timer = abap_true iv_interval = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->is_timer_active( )
      msg = 'Timer should be active after starting'
    ).

    " Stop timer
    lo_cut->manage_timer( iv_start_timer = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->is_timer_active( )
      msg = 'Timer should be inactive after stopping'
    ).

    " Try to stop already stopped timer (should remain inactive)
    lo_cut->manage_timer( iv_start_timer = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->is_timer_active( )
      msg = 'Timer should remain inactive'
    ).

    " Try to start already running timer (should remain active)
    lo_cut->manage_timer( iv_start_timer = abap_true iv_interval = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->is_timer_active( )
      msg = 'Timer should remain active'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->mo_timer->interval
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Interval should be updated when starting an already running timer'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_const_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_currency_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_const_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_currency_list.
    DATA(lt_currencies) = VALUE string_table(
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>currency-eur )
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>currency-usd )
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>currency-gbp )
    ).

    rv_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR currency IN lt_currencies
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |Währung: { currency }|
        ELSE |{ s }, { currency }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis von Flugbuchungen (`sflights`) für einen bestimmten Einkaufspositionstyp (fiktiv, z.B. 'Lagerposition'), der aus `cl_mmpur_constants` stammt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und `LINES` zur Zählung, kombiniert mit `cl_mmpur_constants`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pur_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             item_cat TYPE string, "Fiktiver Einkaufspositionstyp
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lv_item_category) = cl_mmpur_constants=>item_category-stock_item. "Fiktive Konstante

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE item_cat = lv_item_category ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                     FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TIMER` verwendet, um eine Liste von Aktionen (simuliert durch Strings) in einem bestimmten Intervall zu verarbeiten. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Aktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SET HANDLER`, `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_actions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_actions TYPE string_table.
    DATA mv_current_action_index TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_last_processed_action TYPE string.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS initialize_actions
      IMPORTING
        it_action_names TYPE string_table.
    METHODS start_processing
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i.
    METHODS get_last_processed_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_action) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_actions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD initialize_actions.
    mt_actions = VALUE #( FOR action IN it_action_names ( action ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_processing.
    IF mt_actions IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    IF mv_current_action_index < lines( mt_actions ).
      mv_last_processed_action = mt_actions[ mv_current_action_index + 1 ].
      mv_current_action_index = mv_current_action_index + 1.
    ELSE.
      mo_timer->stop( ). " Stop timer if all actions processed
      mv_last_processed_action = 'All actions processed'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_processed_action.
    rv_action = mv_last_processed_action.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_action_processing_simulated FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_actions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_action_processing_simulated.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_actions( ).
    DATA(lt_actions) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Action 1' ) ( 'Action 2' ) ( 'Action 3' ) ).

    lo_cut->initialize_actions( lt_actions ).
    lo_cut->start_processing( 1 ). " Interval 1 second

    " Simulate timer events
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->handle_finished.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_last_processed_action( ) exp = 'Action 1' msg = 'First action should be processed' ).

    CALL METHOD lo_cut->handle_finished.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_last_processed_action( ) exp = 'Action 2' msg = 'Second action should be processed' ).

    CALL METHOD lo_cut->handle_finished.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_last_processed_action( ) exp = 'Action 3' msg = 'Third action should be processed' ).

    CALL METHOD lo_cut->handle_finished.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_last_processed_action( ) exp = 'All actions processed' msg = 'Timer should stop and indicate completion' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->mo_timer->running msg = 'Timer should be stopped' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_actions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_actions( ).
    lo_cut->start_processing( 1 ). " Should not start if no actions
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->mo_timer->running msg = 'Timer should not start without actions' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_cut->get_last_processed_action( ) msg = 'No action should be processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung des `CL_GUI_TIMER` zur sequenziellen Verarbeitung einer Liste von Aktionen. Es kombiniert Event-Handling mit der modernen Initialisierung von internen Tabellen mittels `VALUE #( FOR ... )`. Der Timer löst in regelmäßigen Abständen ein Ereignis aus, das die nächste Aktion in der Liste verarbeitet. Der Unit Test simuliert die Timer-Ereignisse, um die korrekte Abarbeitung der Aktionen und das Stoppen des Timers zu überprüfen.
keywords: CL_GUI_TIMER, Event Handling, FOR, VALUE, Object Orientation, Sequential Processing

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String als Parameter nehmen und einen modifizierten String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method` oder `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object) EXPORTING ... IMPORTING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _uppercase_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS _reverse_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lt_methods     TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>method_table.
    DATA ls_method      TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>method_descr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_CALLER' ).
        lt_methods = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

        READ TABLE lt_methods INTO ls_method WITH KEY name = iv_method_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF ME
            EXPORTING
              iv_input = iv_input_value
            IMPORTING
              rv_output = rv_result.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_result = |Error during dynamic method call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _uppercase_string.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _reverse_string.
    rv_output = reverse( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_uppercase FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reverse FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uppercase.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_UPPERCASE_STRING' iv_input_value = 'hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLO' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reverse.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_REVERSE_STRING' iv_input_value = 'world' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'dlrow' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' iv_input_value = 'test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf, eine Kernfunktion der dynamischen Programmierung. Anstatt den Methodennamen fest zu codieren, wird er zur Laufzeit als String übergeben. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und ermöglicht es, das Verhalten einer Klasse basierend auf externen Konfigurationen oder Benutzereingaben anzupassen. Die Verwendung von `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF ME` ist eine moderne und direkte Art, dies zu erreichen, während `cl_abap_classdescr` zur Validierung der Existenz der Methode genutzt werden kann.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Method Call, cl_abap_dyn_prg, Reflection

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und die `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Anweisung.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Error: Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es erlaubt, auf Komponenten einer Struktur zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Programmen, die mit unterschiedlichen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, ohne diese fest zu codieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur (z.B. aus einer Datenbanktabelle) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` oder `cl_abap_structdescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_db_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_db_table_name ).
        lo_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          SELECT * FROM (iv_db_table_name) INTO TABLE <fs_table> UP TO 100 ROWS.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error cx_sy_table_descr_error cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_sflight_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_table IS INITIAL exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <fs_sflight_table> IS INITIAL exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( <fs_sflight_table> ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle mit einer dynamischen Struktur erstellt und füllt. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Anwendungen, die mit unbekannten Datenbanktabellen oder komplexen Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen. Die Klassen `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` ermöglichen die Beschreibung von Typen zur Laufzeit, während `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` die Instanziierung dieser dynamischen Typen erlaubt. Feld-Symbole werden verwendet, um auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle zuzugreifen und sie mit Daten zu füllen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, Reflection

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT so auf, dass sie für ein Diagramm verwendet werden können, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt. Die Ausgabe soll eine Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und der jeweiligen Fluganzahl sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_preparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_preparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrier = ls_flight-carrid
        flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_data-flights > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Example: Check if a specific carrier has a certain number of flights (requires knowing test data)
    " For robust testing, one might mock SFLIGHT or use a known small dataset.
    " Here, we just check for non-zero counts for existing carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel bereitet Daten für eine Diagrammdarstellung vor, indem es die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aggregiert. Die moderne Syntax `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ... ( ... = GROUP SIZE )` ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Dies ist eine typische Vorverarbeitung für GUI-Elemente wie Diagramme, die mit Klassen wie `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` dargestellt werden könnten. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS` ermöglicht die direkte Erstellung der Zieltabelle in einem einzigen Ausdruck.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Data Aggregation, SFLIGHT, cl_gui_chart_engine_win (conceptual)

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen String, der Informationen aus einer Struktur (z.B. SFLIGHT-Eintrag) und zusätzlichen Text enthält, unter Verwendung von String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_string_template_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_string_template_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    rv_formatted_string = |Flug { is_flight_data-carrid } { is_flight_data-connid } am { is_flight_data-fldate DATE = USER } kostet { is_flight_data-price CURRENCY = is_flight_data-currency } { is_flight_data-currency }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_template_formatter( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_string_template_formatter=>ty_sflight_info(
      carrid   = 'LH'
      connid   = '0400'

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne und sehr lesbare Art, Strings in ABAP zu konstruieren. Sie ermöglichen die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken (`{ ... }`) sowie Formatierungsoptionen (z.B. `DATE = USER`, `CURRENCY = ...`) innerhalb des Strings. Dies macht den Code deutlich kürzer und verständlicher als die traditionelle Verkettung mit `&&` oder `CONCATENATE` und ist weniger fehleranfällig.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, SFLIGHT, Formatting

CLASS zcl_table_filterer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung, und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Gruppe die Fluggesellschaft, Währung und die Summe der Preise enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_data,
             carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             currency    TYPE sflight-currency,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_agg_data.
    TYPES: tt_agg_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_agg_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE tt_agg_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid, currency = ls_flight-currency
      ( carrier     = carrid
        currency    = currency
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ( sum = sum + <member>-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = lo_cut->aggregate_flight_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated_data ) exp = 0 ).

    " Example: Check for a specific group (e.g., LH, EUR)
    DATA(ls_lh_eur) = VALUE zcl_table_aggregator=>ty_agg_data( ).
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated_data INTO ls_lh_eur WITH KEY carrier = 'LH' currency = 'EUR'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_eur-total_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " More detailed tests would involve mocking SFLIGHT data to predict exact sums.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` mit `VALUE #(...)` und `REDUCE` ist eine der leistungsfähigsten modernen ABAP-Funktionen für die Datenaggregation und -transformation. Sie ermöglicht es, komplexe Gruppierungs- und Summierungsoperationen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck durchzuführen. Dies ersetzt oft mehrere Zeilen von `LOOP AT ... ENDLOOP` mit `AT NEW`/`AT END` und temporären Variablen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht, die Lesbarkeit verbessert und die Performance steigert, da die Operationen vom ABAP-Kernel optimiert werden können.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, REDUCE, Data Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Laden Sie Daten aus SFLIGHT, filtern Sie diese nach einer Fluggesellschaft, mappen Sie die verbleibenden Einträge auf eine neue Struktur (z.B. nur Flugnummer und Datum) und geben Sie die ersten N Einträge zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT`, `FILTER`, `FOR` (für Mapping) und `UP TO N ROWS` (implizit durch `FOR` mit `COND` oder `LINES` Limitierung).
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_mapped_top_n
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_top_n   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_mapped_top_n.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrier )
      " Limit to top N entries
      WHERE sy-tabix <= iv_top_n
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_ops FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_top_n FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_ops.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_filtered_mapped_top_n( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_top_n = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_summary ) <= 5 ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      " Cannot assert carrid directly as it's not in summary structure, but we know it's LH from filter
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_top_n.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_summary_all) = lo_cut->get_filtered_mapped_top_n( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_top_n = 9999 ).
    DATA(lt_summary_two) = lo_cut->get_filtered_mapped_top_n( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_top_n = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_summary_two ) <= 2 ) ).
    IF lines( lt_summary_all ) >= 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary_two[ 1 ]-connid exp = lt_summary_all[ 1 ]-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary_two[ 2 ]-connid exp = lt_summary_all[ 2 ]-connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den funktionalen Programmierstil in ABAP durch das Verketten von Tabellenoperationen. Es kombiniert das Laden von Daten, das Filtern mit `FILTER #(...)`, das Mappen auf eine neue Struktur mit `FOR ... IN ...` und die Begrenzung der Ergebnisse auf die ersten N Einträge (`WHERE sy-tabix <= iv_top_n`) in einem einzigen, flüssigen Ausdruck. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem, lesbarem und effizientem Code, der die Datenverarbeitungsschritte klar widerspiegelt und die Notwendigkeit temporärer Tabellen oder expliziter Schleifen minimiert.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, FILTER, FOR, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT, Chaining

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird, und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (class_name)` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_object_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_action.

    METHODS create_and_execute
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_dynamic_action.
  METHODS execute
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_object_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_execute.
    DATA lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lo_dynamic_action TYPE REF TO if_dynamic_action.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        lo_dynamic_action ?= lo_dynamic_object.

        IF lo_dynamic_action IS BOUND.
          rv_result = lo_dynamic_action->execute( iv_input = iv_input_value ).
        ELSE.
          rv_result = |Error: Class '{ iv_class_name }' does not implement IF_DYNAMIC_ACTION.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_result = |Error creating object or calling method dynamically.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example class to be created dynamically
CLASS zcl_sample_dynamic_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sample_dynamic_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_dynamic_action~execute.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_object_creator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_execute(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_SAMPLE_DYNAMIC_CLASS'

  METHOD test_invalid_class.

    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_missing_interface.
    " Create a dummy class that does not implement the required interface
    CLASS zcl_dummy_no_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.

    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_dummy_no_interface IMPLEMENTATION.

    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_object_creator( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Instanziierung von Klassen und den Aufruf ihrer Methoden über eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle. Die Anweisung `CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name)` ermöglicht es, den Klassennamen zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Durch die Verwendung einer Schnittstelle (`IF_DYNAMIC_ACTION`) wird sichergestellt, dass die dynamisch erstellte Klasse eine bestimmte Methode (`EXECUTE`) implementiert, was die typsichere Interaktion mit dem dynamischen Objekt ermöglicht. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für hochflexible und erweiterbare Architekturen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE OBJECT, Interface, Reflection, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Anzahl von Spalten und Typen, die zur Laufzeit definiert werden, und fügen Sie Daten hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_custom_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE abap_type_kind,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_custom_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS add_data_to_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
        it_data_values   TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_custom_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_custom_table.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind( p_type_kind = ls_field_def-type ).
      IF ls_field_def-length > 0.
        ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind( p_type_kind = ls_field_def-type p_length = ls_field_def-length ).
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_data_to_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table>[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT it_data_values INTO DATA(lv_data_line).
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line> TO <fs_line>.

      DATA(lt_values) = cl_abap_string_utilities=>split_string( iv_string = lv_data_line iv_delimiter = ',' ).
      LOOP AT lt_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
        DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix.
        IF lv_index <= lines( lt_components ).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lt_components[ lv_index ]-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_field> = lv_value.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_custom_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_custom_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_custom_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_dyn_custom_table_creator=>tt_field_def(
      ( name = 'ID'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int4 length = 0 )

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle, bei der sowohl die Anzahl der Spalten als auch deren Typen zur Laufzeit definiert werden. Dies wird durch die Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit einer dynamisch aufgebauten Komponenten-Tabelle und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` erreicht. Anschließend werden Daten zeilenweise hinzugefügt, wobei jede Zeile dynamisch erstellt und ihre Felder über Feld-Symbole zugewiesen werden. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Datenverarbeitung, bei der die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. beim Import von CSV-Dateien mit variablen Spalten.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Reflection, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, Field-Symbols, Generic Programming
