Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `INSERT` oder `UPDATE` Operation auf einer Datenbanktabelle durch, deren Name und die zu aktualisierenden Felder zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT (db_table) FROM @(ls_data)` oder `UPDATE (db_table) SET (field1 = @value1, ...) WHERE (condition)` mit dynamischen Elementen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_db_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_field,
             name  TYPE fieldname,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_field.
    TYPES: tt_key_field TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_update_field,
             name  TYPE fieldname,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_update_field.
    TYPES: tt_update_field TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_update_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS dynamic_update
      IMPORTING
        iv_db_table_name TYPE tabname
        it_key_fields    TYPE tt_key_field
        it_update_fields TYPE tt_update_field
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_db_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_update.
    DATA lv_set_clause TYPE string.
    DATA lv_where_clause TYPE string.
    DATA lv_sql_statement TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_update_fields INTO DATA(ls_update_field).
      IF lv_set_clause IS INITIAL.
        lv_set_clause = |{ ls_update_field-name } = '{ ls_update_field-value }'|.
      ELSE.
        lv_set_clause = lv_set_clause && | , { ls_update_field-name } = '{ ls_update_field-value }'|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_key_fields INTO DATA(ls_key_field).
      IF lv_where_clause IS INITIAL.
        lv_where_clause = |{ ls_key_field-name } = '{ ls_key_field-value }'|.
      ELSE.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && | AND { ls_key_field-name } = '{ ls_key_field-value }'|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_set_clause IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_sql_statement = |UPDATE { iv_db_table_name } SET { lv_set_clause } WHERE { lv_where_clause }|.

      TRY.
          EXEC SQL.
            {lv_sql_statement}
          ENDEXEC.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            COMMIT WORK.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            ROLLBACK WORK.
            rv_success = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_insert FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_update.
    " Create a dummy table for testing or use a known test table
    " For SFLIGHT, we need to ensure an entry exists and then update it.
    " This test assumes SFLIGHT has an entry with CARRID='AA' and CONNID='0017'
    " and that we can update its PRICE.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_db_updater( ).
    DATA(lt_key) = VALUE zcl_dyn_db_updater=>tt_key_field(
      ( name = 'CARRID' value = 'AA' )
      ( name = 'CONNID' value = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_update) = VALUE zcl_dyn_db_updater=>tt_update_field(
      ( name = 'PRICE' value = '999.99' )
    ).

    " First, ensure the entry exists and get its original price
    DATA(lv_original_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_original_price WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " If not found, insert a dummy entry for testing
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 100.00 currency = 'USD' ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      lv_original_price = 100.00.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->dynamic_update( iv_db_table_name = 'SFLIGHT' it_key_fields = lt_key it_update_fields = lt_update ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Verify update
    DATA(lv_new_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_new_price WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_price exp = '999.99' ).

    " Revert change for clean test environment
    UPDATE sflight SET price = @lv_original_price WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_insert.
    " This example focuses on UPDATE, but a similar approach can be used for INSERT.
    " For INSERT, you would build an INSERT statement string and execute it.
    " Due to the complexity of dynamic INSERT with all fields, we'll keep this test focused on UPDATE.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Placeholder for INSERT test if implemented
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Ausführung von Datenbankoperationen (`UPDATE`) unter Verwendung von Native SQL (`EXEC SQL`). Der Tabellenname, die zu aktualisierenden Felder und die WHERE-Klausel werden zur Laufzeit als Strings aufgebaut. Dies bietet höchste Flexibilität für generische Datenbanktools oder Schnittstellen, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen und Update-Szenarien umgehen müssen. Es ist jedoch wichtig, die Eingaben sorgfältig zu validieren, um Sicherheitsrisiken wie SQL-Injections zu vermeiden. Die Verwendung von `COMMIT WORK` und `ROLLBACK WORK` ist entscheidend für die Transaktionssicherheit.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Native SQL, UPDATE, Database Operations, EXEC SQL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, die aus einer anderen internen Tabelle stammen, wobei die Feldzuordnung dynamisch erfolgt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für die Zieltabelle und Feld-Symbole mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die dynamische Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_field_map,
             source_field TYPE fieldname,
             target_field TYPE fieldname,
           END OF ty_target_field_map.
    TYPES: tt_target_field_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_field_map WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data      TYPE tt_source_data
        it_target_field_map TYPE tt_target_field_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamic_table.
    DATA lt_target_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_target_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.
    DATA lo_source_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_target_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_target_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Describe source structure to get field types
    lo_source_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_data[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lt_source_components) = lo_source_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Build target structure components based on mapping
    LOOP AT it_target_field_map INTO DATA(ls_map).
      DATA(ls_source_comp) = lt_source_components[ KEY name COMPONENTS source_field = ls_map-source_field ].
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_target_component-name = ls_map-target_field.
        ls_target_component-type = ls_source_comp-type.
        APPEND ls_target_component TO lt_target_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_target_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    lo_target_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_target_table TYPE HANDLE lo_target_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.

    IF <fs_target_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT it_source_data INTO DATA(ls_source_line).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_line> TYPE any.
        CREATE DATA <fs_target_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_target_table>.
        ASSIGN <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_line>.

        LOOP AT it_target_field_map INTO ls_map.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_field> TYPE any.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_map-source_field OF STRUCTURE ls_source_line TO <fs_source_field>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_map-target_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.

          IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Feldzuordnung erfolgt zeilenweise über Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für generische ETL-Prozesse (Extract, Transform, Load) oder Datenintegration, bei denen die Struktur der Quelldaten und die gewünschte Zielstruktur zur Laufzeit variieren können.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `CASE`-Anweisung, die zur Laufzeit verschiedene Aktionen basierend auf dem Wert eines dynamisch bestimmten Feldes ausführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für das dynamische Feld und eine Reihe von `IF`-Anweisungen oder eine `CASE`-Struktur, die auf den Wert des Feld-Symbols reagiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_case_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_case
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_case_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_case.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      CASE <fs_field>.
        WHEN 'A'.
          rv_result = |Action A executed for value: { is_data-value }|.
        WHEN 'B'.
          rv_result = |Action B executed for value: { is_data-value }|.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          rv_result = |Default action for type '{ <fs_field> }' with value: { is_data-value }|.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Error: Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies wird durch die Kombination von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit einem Feld-Symbol erreicht. Der Wert des Feld-Symbols wird dann in einer normalen `CASE`-Anweisung verwendet. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, die auf unterschiedliche Felder in einer Struktur reagieren müssen, ohne diese fest zu codieren, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von Konfigurationsdaten oder flexiblen Workflows.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_price IN it_flight_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_new_open_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

keywords: Open SQL, Datenbank, SELECT, DATA, Inline-Deklaration

Instructions: Greifen Sie sicher auf eine Methode oder ein Attribut eines Objekts zu, das möglicherweise initial ist, ohne einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Optional Chaining Operator `?-`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optional_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message. " Just for a dummy method

    METHODS get_message_text IMPORTING io_message_provider TYPE REF TO if_abap_behv_message OPTIONAL
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_text.
    DATA: lo_dummy_message TYPE REF TO zcl_dummy_message.
    IF io_message_provider IS BOUND.
      TRY.
          lo_dummy_message ?= io_message_provider.
          rv_message = lo_dummy_message?-get_text( ). " Optional chaining on method call
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          rv_message = 'Invalid object type'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = io_message_provider?-get_text( ). " This will return initial if io_message_provider is initial
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Dummy class to demonstrate optional chaining on methods
CLASS zcl_dummy_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS get_text RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dummy_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_message.
    " Dummy implementation
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_text.
    rv_text = 'Actual message text'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_with_bound_object FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_initial_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_bound_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_optional_chaining( ).
    DATA(lo_dummy) = NEW zcl_dummy_message( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_message_text( lo_dummy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Actual message text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_initial_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_optional_chaining( ).
    DATA: lo_initial_object TYPE REF TO if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_message_text( lo_initial_object ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_message ). " Should be initial, not cause dump
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Optional Chaining (`?-`) ermöglicht den sicheren Zugriff auf Komponenten (Attribute, Methoden) von Referenzvariablen. Wenn die Referenzvariable initial ist, wird der gesamte Ausdruck initial, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler (DUMP) zu verursachen. Dies vereinfacht die Fehlerbehandlung und macht den Code robuster.
keywords: Optional Chaining, Referenzvariable, Objektorientierung, Fehlerbehandlung

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variable einen Wert basierend auf dem Wochentag zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_type IMPORTING iv_weekday TYPE sy-wday RETURNING VALUE(rv_day_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_type.
    rv_day_type = SWITCH #( iv_weekday
      WHEN '1' THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN '2' THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN '3' THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN '4' THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN '5' THEN 'Freitag'
      ELSE 'Wochenende'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weekday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_weekend FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).
    DATA(lv_day_type) = lo_cut->get_day_type( '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_day_type exp = 'Montag' ).
    lv_day_type = lo_cut->get_day_type( '5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_day_type exp = 'Freitag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_weekend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).
    DATA(lv_day_type) = lo_cut->get_day_type( '6' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_day_type exp = 'Wochenende' ).
    lv_day_type = lo_cut->get_day_type( '7' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_day_type exp = 'Wochenende' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF` oder `CASE` Anweisungen für einfache Zuweisungen.
keywords: SWITCH, Bedingte Logik, Zuweisung, CASE

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variable einen Wert zu, wenn eine Bedingung erfüllt ist, ansonsten einen anderen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text IMPORTING iv_status TYPE char1 RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string( 
      WHEN iv_status = 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
      WHEN iv_status = 'I' THEN 'Inaktiv'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einer einzigen Zeile. Er ist eine prägnante Alternative zu `IF ... ELSE ... ENDIF` für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: COND, Bedingte Logik, Zuweisung, IF

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 7 Tage in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `+` Operator für Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_date.
    rv_future_date = sy-datum + 7.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_future_date) = lo_cut->get_future_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_future_date exp = lv_expected_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Moderne ABAP-Datumsberechnungen sind intuitiver und erlauben die direkte Addition oder Subtraktion von Tagen zu einem Datumstyp mit dem `+` oder `-` Operator, ohne Funktionsbausteine wie `DATE_CALCULATE_INTERVAL` verwenden zu müssen.
keywords: Datum, Berechnung, Addition, sy-datum

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Flugdatum vor dem aktuellen Datum liegt. Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle, die der Struktur von SFLIGHTS ähnelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_flights_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_flights_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    rt_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE TABLE rt_flights WHERE fldate < sy-datum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_old_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_old_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_del_flights_by_date=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight       TYPE zcl_del_flights_by_date=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum - 1. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.     APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0402'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum + 1. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_flights_by_date( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge übrig bleiben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate < sy-datum
      msg = 'Alter Flug sollte gelöscht sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das moderne Löschen von Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle mittels der `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE` Syntax. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_cut)`) und der direkten Zuweisung von Tabellen (`rt_flights = it_flights`) sind Merkmale von modernem ABAP, die den Code kompakter und lesbarer machen.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, WHERE, Date, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Entfernen Sie doppelte Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf den Feldern Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Flugnummer (connid).
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...` nach einer Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_del_duplicates=>tt_sflight_key,
          ls_flight       TYPE zcl_del_duplicates=>ty_sflight_key.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum + 1. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights. "Duplicate key
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0010'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_duplicates( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 eindeutige Flüge übrig bleiben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den Vergleichsfeldern zu sortieren, da die Anweisung nur direkt aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate löscht. Dies ist eine performante und gängige Praxis in modernem ABAP.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, Duplicates, ADJACENT, SORT

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die älter als ein bestimmtes Datum sind. (Hinweis: Für Testzwecke wird hier ein fiktives Datum verwendet und es wird empfohlen, dies nicht direkt auf Produktivsystemen auszuführen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_db_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_flights_before_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_db_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_before_date.
    " ACHTUNG: Dies ist ein Beispiel und sollte nicht direkt auf Produktivsystemen ausgeführt werden.
    " Für reale Szenarien sollten entsprechende Berechtigungsprüfungen und Transaktionskontrollen implementiert werden.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE fldate < @iv_date.
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_db_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_db_flights.
    DATA: lv_test_date TYPE s_date VALUE '19900101'.

    " Vorbereitung: Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind und gelöscht werden können.
    " In einem echten Unit-Test würde man hier Testdaten einfügen und nach dem Test wieder aufräumen.
    " Hier wird nur die Syntax demonstriert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_db_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_flights_before_date( lv_test_date ).

    " Da wir keine echten Daten manipulieren, können wir nur prüfen, ob die Methode aufgerufen wurde.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man die Anzahl der gelöschten Zeilen überprüfen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_deleted
      msg = 'Es sollten Zeilen gelöscht worden sein (oder 0, wenn keine vorhanden waren).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Löschen von Datenbankeinträgen erfolgt mit der `DELETE FROM ... WHERE` Anweisung. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit dem `@`-Präfix (`@iv_date`) ist ein Merkmal von Open SQL in modernem ABAP (ab 7.40), das die Lesbarkeit verbessert und SQL-Injections vorbeugt. Die Anzahl der gelöschten Zeilen wird in `sy-dbcnt` zurückgegeben.
keywords: DELETE, Database, WHERE, SFLIGHTS, Open SQL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, außer denen, die storniert wurden (angenommen, ein Feld `status` existiert und 'C' bedeutet storniert). Nutzen Sie eine funktionale Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FILTER` Expression, um unerwünschte Einträge auszuschließen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_flights.
    rt_active_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights EXCEPT status = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_flights=>tt_sflight_status,
          ls_flight       TYPE zcl_filter_flights=>ty_sflight_status.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_flight-status = 'O'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_flight-status = 'C'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0010'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_flight-status = 'O'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_active_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 aktive Flüge übrig bleiben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'O' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'O' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER` Expression (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das Erstellen einer neuen internen Tabelle, indem Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung gefiltert werden. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu manipulieren, ohne die Originaltabelle zu ändern. `EXCEPT` wird verwendet, um Zeilen auszuschließen, die der Bedingung entsprechen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Functional, New Syntax, Expression

Instructions: Löschen Sie einen spezifischen Flug aus einer internen Tabelle, wenn er existiert, basierend auf Primärschlüsselfeldern (carrid, connid, fldate).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` zur Prüfung und `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...` zum Löschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_specific_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS delete_flight_if_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        io_flights    TYPE REF TO tt_sflight_key " Tabelle wird als Referenz übergeben, um sie zu ändern
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_specific_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flight_if_exists.
    IF line_exists( io_flights->*[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      DELETE TABLE io_flights->* WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
      rv_deleted = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_deleted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_del_specific_flight=>tt_sflight_key,
          ls_flight       TYPE zcl_del_specific_flight=>ty_sflight_key.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0010'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_specific_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_flight_if_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = sy-datum io_flights = REF #( lt_test_flights ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_deleted
      msg = 'Flug sollte gelöscht worden sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_flights ) exp = 1
      msg = 'Es sollte 1 Flug übrig bleiben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( line_exists( lt_test_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ] )
      msg = 'Der spezifische Flug sollte nicht mehr existieren.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_non_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_del_specific_flight=>tt_sflight_key.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_specific_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_flight_if_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = sy-datum io_flights = REF #( lt_test_flights ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_deleted
      msg = 'Flug sollte nicht gelöscht worden sein, da er nicht existiert.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_flights ) exp = 0
      msg = 'Tabelle sollte leer bleiben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LINE_EXISTS` mit `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY`. `LINE_EXISTS` (ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine performante Möglichkeit, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle anhand ihrer Schlüssel zu prüfen. Das Löschen erfolgt dann gezielt über den Tabellenschlüssel, was effizienter ist als ein `WHERE`-Statement, wenn der Schlüssel bekannt ist. Die Übergabe der Tabelle als Referenz (`REF #( ... )`) ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der übergebenen Tabelle.

      msg = 'Erneutes Erstellen eines existierenden Verzeichnisses sollte erfolgreich sein (kein Fehler).' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cl_abap_file_utilities=>directory_exists( lv_dir_path )

explanation: Die Methode `create_directory` der `cl_abap_file_utilities` ermöglicht das Erstellen von Verzeichnissen auf dem Applikationsserver. Wenn das Verzeichnis bereits existiert, wird keine Exception geworfen, sondern der Vorgang als erfolgreich betrachtet. Dies vereinfacht die Logik, da keine vorherige Existenzprüfung notwendig ist, wenn das Ziel einfach das Vorhandensein des Verzeichnisses ist. Fehlerbehandlung ist für Berechtigungsprobleme oder ungültige Pfade wichtig.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_dir_path) = '/tmp/dir_to_delete'.

hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Elemente der internen Tabelle zu einem String zu reduzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_conns_as_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_conns_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_conns_as_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_conns_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( connid IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid ELSE s && `,` && flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( count( val = lv_result sub = ',' ) >= 0 ) msg = 'Result should contain comma-separated values' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob das Ergebnis einer Addition zweier Integer-Werte einen Überlauf für den Typ 'i' verursachen würde, bevor die Addition durchgeführt wird.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Summe mit CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES=>MAX_VAL_INT und MIN_VAL_INT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_int_overflow DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_overflow
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_overflow) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_int_overflow IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_overflow.
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_val_int.
    DATA(lv_min_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_int.

    IF iv_val1 > 0 AND iv_val2 > 0.
      IF lv_max_int - iv_val1 < iv_val2.
        rv_overflow = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_val1 < 0 AND iv_val2 < 0.
      IF lv_min_int - iv_val1 > iv_val2.
        rv_overflow = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rv_overflow = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_where_clause) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |WHERE CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }' AND CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|
      WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |WHERE CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'|

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator und CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES für einen Standard-Minimalpreis, falls kein Schwellenwert angegeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator und CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES=>MIN_VAL_DECFLOAT16 für einen sicheren Minimalwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_above_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_effective_min_price) = COND s_price(
      WHEN iv_min_price IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_min_price
      ELSE cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_decfloat16
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > lv_effective_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflight_price( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_above_price( iv_min_price = '100.00' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > '100.00' ) msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid }{ ls_flight-connid } has price { ls_flight-price } <= 100| ).
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und verketten Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Flugnummern (CONNID) zu einem String. Nutzen Sie GROUP BY und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck in einer LOOP-Anweisung und REDUCE für die String-Verkettung innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_concat_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_conns,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             conns  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrid_conns.
    TYPES tt_carrid_conns TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_conns WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_conns
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_conns) TYPE tt_carrid_conns.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_concat_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_conns.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_conns_string) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ``
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN grouped_flight-connid ELSE s && `,` && grouped_flight-connid )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_conns( carrid = ls_flight-carrid conns = lv_conns_string ) TO rt_grouped_conns.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_conns FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_conns.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_concat_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_conns( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Example: Check for 'LH' entry
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_entry-conns msg = 'LH connections string should not be empty' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( count( val = ls_lh_entry-conns sub = ',' ) >= 0 ) msg = 'LH connections should be comma-separated' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von LOOP AT ... GROUP BY mit dem REDUCE-Operator ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und aggregierte Strings zu erstellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und temporäre Tabellen durch eine kompakte, funktionale Syntax.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Processing, Concatenation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE s_price.

    " Calculate expected sum manually for a known carrier (e.g., 'LH')
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_sum WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Sum for LH should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Sum for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Die Syntax ist kompakt und gut lesbar, da die Initialisierung (`INIT`) und die Iteration (`FOR...NEXT`) direkt im Ausdruck definiert werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variable einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu, unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator für konditionelle Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_name.
    rv_carrier_name = SWITCH string(
      iv_carrid
      WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
      WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
      WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
      ELSE 'Unbekannte Fluggesellschaft'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_known_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_known_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_operator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( 'LH' ) exp = 'Lufthansa' msg = 'LH should be Lufthansa' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( 'AA' ) exp = 'American Airlines' msg = 'AA should be American Airlines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_operator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( 'XX' ) exp = 'Unbekannte Fluggesellschaft' msg = 'XX should be unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator bietet eine prägnante Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen für konditionelle Zuweisungen. Er wertet einen Ausdruck aus und gibt einen Wert zurück, der der ersten passenden `WHEN`-Bedingung entspricht. Die `ELSE`-Klausel fängt alle nicht übereinstimmenden Fälle ab. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expression, Control Flow

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Service) über den Konstruktor injiziert bekommt.

INTERFACE zif_flight_service PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_flight_description
    IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_flight_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_flight_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.

    mo_flight_service = io_flight_service.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    " Mock-Implementierung des Service für den Test
    CLASS lcl_mock_flight_service DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_flight_service.
        METHODS zif_flight_service~get_flight_description.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_flight_service IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_flight_service~get_flight_description.
        rv_description = |MOCK: Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } ist ein Testflug.|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_mock_service) = NEW lcl_mock_flight_service( ).
    DATA(lo_consumer)     = NEW zcl_flight_consumer( io_flight_service = lo_mock_service ).

    DATA(lv_details) = lo_consumer->get_formatted_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                                                  iv_connid = '001' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_details
                                        exp = 'MOCK: Flug XX 001 ist ein Testflug.'
                                        msg = 'Consumer should use the injected mock service' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konstruktor-Injektion, ein zentrales Prinzip der Dependency Injection. Der `zcl_flight_consumer` erhält seine Abhängigkeit (`zif_flight_service`) über den Konstruktor, anstatt sie selbst zu instanziieren. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, erleichtert die Testbarkeit (durch Injektion von Mock-Objekten, wie im Unit-Test gezeigt) und verbessert die Flexibilität des Designs. Das Attribut `mo_flight_service` ist `READ-ONLY`, um die Unveränderlichkeit nach der Injektion zu gewährleisten.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, Interface, Loose Coupling, Testability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV, das eine Liste von Bildern und deren Metadaten (Breite, Höhe, Format) anzeigt. Die Bilddaten sollen als XSTRING vorliegen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_fxs_image_info` zur Metadatenextraktion und `cl_salv_table` zur Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_image_metadata DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_data_alv,
             image_name TYPE string,
             width      TYPE i,
             height     TYPE i,
             format     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_data_alv.
    TYPES: tt_image_data_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_data_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_image_metadata_alv
      IMPORTING
        it_images TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_image_metadata IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_image_metadata_alv.
    DATA: lt_alv_data TYPE tt_image_data_alv.
    DATA: ls_alv_line TYPE ty_image_data_alv.
    DATA: lv_index    TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT it_images INTO DATA(lv_image_xstring).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ls_alv_line-image_name = |Image { lv_index }|.

      TRY.
          DATA(lo_image_info) = cl_fxs_image_info=>create_from_xstring( lv_image_xstring ).
          ls_alv_line-width  = lo_image_info->get_width( ).
          ls_alv_line-height = lo_image_info->get_height( ).
          ls_alv_line-format = lo_image_info->get_format( ).
        CATCH cx_fxs_image_info.
          ls_alv_line-width  = 0.
          ls_alv_line-height = 0.
          ls_alv_line-format = 'INVALID'.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_alv_line TO lt_alv_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_alv_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_alv_data
          ).
          lo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg.
          " Handle ALV exception
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alv_with_image_metadata FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_with_image_metadata.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_image_metadata( ).
    DATA: lt_test_images TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring.

    " Valid GIF
    APPEND '4749463839610100010080010000000000002C00000000010001000002024C013B' TO lt_test_images.
    " Invalid XSTRING
    APPEND '48656C6C6F20576F726C64' TO lt_test_images.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_image_metadata_alv( lt_test_images ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'ALV display with image metadata should not raise an exception' ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'ALV display with image metadata raised an unexpected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel integriert die Funktionalität von `cl_fxs_image_info` und `cl_salv_table`. Es iteriert über eine Liste von Bild-XSTRINGs, extrahiert für jedes Bild Metadaten wie Breite, Höhe und Format mit `cl_fxs_image_info` und sammelt diese in einer internen Tabelle. Diese Tabelle wird dann verwendet, um ein ALV zu erstellen und anzuzeigen, das die Bildinformationen übersichtlich darstellt. Fehlerhafte Bild-XSTRINGs werden abgefangen und als 'INVALID' markiert.
keywords: ALV, Image, Metadata, Integration, cl_fxs_image_info, cl_salv_table, XSTRING

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, die teurer als ein bestimmter Wert sind, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_expensive_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                     WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( 500 ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights are indeed more expensive than 500
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-price > 500 )
                                        msg  = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } has price { ls_flight-price } <= 500| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some flights are returned (assuming SFLIGHTS has data > 500)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights msg = 'Should return some expensive flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( 999999 ). " Very high price

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights msg = 'Should return no flights for very high price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Anstatt eine Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen zu verwenden, kann man direkt die Filterkriterien angeben. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. Die Verwendung von `USING KEY primary_key` stellt sicher, dass der Standardtabellenschlüssel für den Filter verwendet wird.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer abstrakten Methode und implementieren Sie diese in einer konkreten Unterklasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Klasse und Methode, und `REDEFINITION` in der Unterklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_desc = 'Dies ist eine abstrakte Form.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concrete_circle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_abstract_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concrete_circle.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_concrete_circle( iv_radius = '10' ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_circle->get_area( ).

    " Expected area for radius 10: PI * 10 * 10 = 314.1592653589793
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals_f( act = lv_area exp = '314.1592653589793' delta = '0.0000000000001' msg = 'Area of circle should be correct' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle->get_description( ) exp = 'Dies ist eine abstrakte Form.' msg = 'Description should be inherited' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_abstract_method_call.
    " Cannot instantiate abstract class directly
    " DATA(lo_shape) = NEW zcl_abstract_shape( ). " This would cause a syntax error

    " Test that the abstract method is correctly redefined
    DATA(lo_shape_ref) TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_shape.
    lo_shape_ref = NEW zcl_concrete_circle( iv_radius = '5' ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_shape_ref->get_area( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals_f( act = lv_area exp = '78.53981633974483' delta = '0.0000000000001' msg = 'Area via abstract reference should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Abstrakte Klassen und Methoden sind ein Eckpfeiler der objektorientierten Programmierung. Eine abstrakte Klasse (`zcl_abstract_shape`) kann nicht direkt instanziiert werden und dient als Blaupause für Unterklassen. Eine abstrakte Methode (`get_area`) hat keine Implementierung in der abstrakten Klasse und muss in jeder konkreten Unterklasse (`zcl_concrete_circle`) mit `REDEFINITION` implementiert werden. Dies erzwingt eine bestimmte Schnittstelle und Verhaltensweise für alle abgeleiteten Klassen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Abstract Class, Abstract Method, Inheritance, Redefinition, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. 'SFLIGHT').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_by_name` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error appropriately, e.g., raise exception or log
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lr_sflight_table ). " Initially empty table
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_sflight_table ).

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu und lesen Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole und die `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure    TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_component_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_component_access( ).

    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_component_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Buchungen pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer Zählvariable im inneren Loop.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_bookings TYPE i,
           END OF ty_booking_sum.
    TYPES: tt_booking_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_bookings_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_booking_sums) TYPE tt_booking_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_bookings_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_booking_sum) = VALUE ty_booking_sum( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight.
        ls_booking_sum-total_bookings = ls_booking_sum-total_bookings + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_booking_sum TO rt_booking_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und `NEXT` für die Akkumulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_comp_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_prices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_comp_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_sflight.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table>   TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>    TYPE any,
                   <fs_price>   TYPE sflight-price.

    " 1. Dynamically create an internal table of type SFLIGHT
    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Fill the dynamic table with some data
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    <fs_table> = lt_sflight_data.

    " 3. Dynamically access the PRICE component and collect values
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_price>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND <fs_price> TO rt_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden und eine bestimmte Währung haben, unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit `REDUCE` für eine effiziente und lesbare Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sum_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate_from TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_currency    TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sum_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( 
        lt_sflight WHERE fldate >= iv_fldate_from AND currency = iv_currency
      )
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price_eur >= 0 ).

    DATA(lv_total_price_xyz) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sum_price( iv_fldate_from = '20250101' iv_currency = 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_xyz exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit zwei Spalten (`CATEGORY` und `VALUE`). Füllen Sie diese mit Daten und berechnen Sie dann dynamisch die Summe der `VALUE`-Spalte, gruppiert nach `CATEGORY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie dynamische Tabellenerstellung, Feld-Symbole und `LOOP AT GROUP BY` mit dynamischem Komponentenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_dyn_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_line,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_line.
    TYPES: tt_dynamic_line TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sum_result,
             category TYPE string,
             total_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sum_result.
    TYPES: tt_sum_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sum_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_dynamic_sum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sum_results) TYPE tt_sum_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_dyn_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_sum.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table>   TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>    TYPE any,
                   <fs_category> TYPE string,
                   <fs_value>   TYPE i.

    " 1. Dynamically create an internal table
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
          ( name = 'CATEGORY' type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'STRING' ) )
          ( name = 'VALUE'    type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'I' ) )
        ).
        lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Fill the dynamic table with data
    DATA(lt_initial_data) = VALUE tt_dynamic_line(
      ( category = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( category = 'B' value = 20 )
      ( category = 'A' value = 15 )
      ( category = 'C' value = 5 )
      ( category = 'B' value = 25 )
    ).
    <fs_table> = lt_initial_data.

    " 3. Dynamically sum by category
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line> GROUP BY ( category = <fs_line>-category ).
      DATA(ls_sum_result) = VALUE ty_sum_result( category = <fs_line>-category ).
      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_line> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_sum_result-total_value = ls_sum_result-total_value + <fs_value>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_sum_result TO rt_sum_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_dyn_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INTO DATA(ls_a) WITH KEY category = 'A'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_a-total_value exp = 25 ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INTO DATA(ls_b) WITH KEY category = 'B'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_b-total_value exp = 45 ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INTO DATA(ls_c) WITH KEY category = 'C'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_c-total_value exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Kombination aus dynamischer Programmierung und Datenaggregation. solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_custom_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_def.
    TYPES: tt_component_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_custom_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE tt_component_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_custom_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_custom_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_comp_def-name
        type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_comp_def-type )
      ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_planetype DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_planetype_sum,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_planetype_sum.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_planetype IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_planetype.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-planetype.
      DATA(ls_capacity_sum) = VALUE ty_planetype_sum( planetype = ls_sflight-planetype ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight.
        ls_capacity_sum-total_capacity = ls_capacity_sum-total_capacity + ls_sflight-seatsmax.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_capacity_sum TO rt_capacity_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE #( 
      INIT free_seats TYPE i = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( seatsocc < seatsmax )
      NEXT free_seats = free_seats + ( ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Anschließend sollen alle Einträge, bei denen der `PRICE` über einem dynamisch übergebenen Schwellenwert liegt, gefiltert und die Summe dieser Preise berechnet werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie dynamische Tabellenerstellung, `FILTER` und `REDUCE` mit Feld-Symbolen für den dynamischen Zugriff auf den Preis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_filter_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_filtered_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_filter_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_filtered_sum.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table>   TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>    TYPE any,
                   <fs_price>   TYPE sflight-price.

    " 1. Dynamically create an internal table of type SFLIGHT
    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Fill the dynamic table with some data
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' price = '80.00' currency = 'GBP' )
    ).
    <fs_table> = lt_sflight_data.

    " 3. Dynamically filter and sum prices
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <fs_line> IN <fs_table>
      DO.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_price>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_price> > iv_price_threshold.
          total_price = total_price + <fs_price>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Struktur. Füllen Sie diese mit Daten und geben Sie den Inhalt der Tabelle dynamisch als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`, `CREATE DATA`, Feld-Symbole und `cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_out` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_def.
    TYPES: tt_component_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_table_as_string
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE tt_component_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_table_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_as_string.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_comp_def-name
        type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_comp_def-type )
      ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Fill with some dynamic data
    DATA(ls_line_data) = NEW data( lr_struct_descr ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dyn_line> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ls_line_data->* TO <fs_dyn_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_id>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DESCRIPTION' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_desc>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'AMOUNT' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_amount>).

    IF <fs_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_desc> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_amount> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_id> = 1.
      <fs_desc> = 'Item A'.
      <fs_amount> = '123.45'.
      APPEND <fs_dyn_line> TO <fs_table>.

      <fs_id> = 2.
      <fs_desc> = 'Item B'.
      <fs_amount> = '67.89'.
      APPEND <fs_dyn_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert table to string
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_out( ).
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      lo_conv->write( <fs_line> ).
      rv_table_content = rv_table_content && lo_conv->get_buffer( ) && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
      lo_conv->clear_buffer( ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_to_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_to_string( ).
    DATA(lt_comp_defs) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_to_string=>tt_component_def(
      ( name = 'ID' type = 'I' )
      ( name = 'DESCRIPTION' type = 'STRING' )
      ( name = 'AMOUNT' type = 'P LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_table_string exp = '67.89' ).

ENDCLASS.

Es kombiniert RTTI-Klassen, Feld-Symbole und die Konvertierungsklasse `cl_abap_conv_ce` für eine flexible und generische Datenverarbeitung.
