Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft und jedes Flugdatum die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze (`SEATSOCC`) und die maximale Kapazität (`SEATSMAX`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit mehreren Schlüsseln und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation im inneren Loop.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_multi_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
             total_max_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_multi_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      ).

      ls_summary-total_occupied_seats = REDUCE #( 
        INIT sum_occ TYPE i = 0
        FOR ls_group_sflight IN GROUP ls_sflight
        NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ls_group_sflight-seatsocc
      ).

      ls_summary-total_max_seats = REDUCE #( 
        INIT sum_max TYPE i = 0
        FOR ls_group_sflight IN GROUP ls_sflight
        NEXT sum_max = sum_max + ls_group_sflight-seatsmax
      ).

      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multi_group_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_group_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_multi_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summaries ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and a specific date exist in SFLIGHT
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-total_occupied_seats >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-total_max_seats > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-total_occupied_seats <= ls_lh_summary-total_max_seats ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die erweiterte Funktionalität von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit mehreren Gruppierungsschlüsseln. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe werden `REDUCE`-Operatoren verwendet, um mehrere Aggregationen (Summe der belegten und maximalen Sitzplätze) gleichzeitig durchzuführen, was zu einem sehr effizienten und übersichtlichen Code führt.
keywords: GROUP BY, SUM, REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, SFLIGHT, MULTI-KEY GROUPING

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    " 1. Dynamically create an internal table of type SFLIGHT
    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Fill the dynamic table with some data
    <fs_table> = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' price = '80.00' currency = 'GBP' )
    ).

    " 3. Dynamically sort the table

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Hexadezimal-String, der binäre Daten repräsentiert (z.B. '414243'), in einen XSTRING und umgekehrt. Simulieren Sie, dass dieser Hex-String aus einem Profilparameter gelesen wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce` oder direkte Zuweisung für die Konvertierung zwischen `STRING` und `XSTRING`.

CLASS zcl_hex_binary_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS hex_to_xstring IMPORTING iv_hex_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    METHODS xstring_to_hex IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring RETURNING VALUE(rv_hex_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hex_binary_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD hex_to_xstring.
    " Simulate reading from profile parameter
    DATA(lv_profile_hex) = iv_hex_string.
    rv_xstring = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_xstring_from_hex( lv_profile_hex ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD xstring_to_hex.
    rv_hex_string = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_from_xstring( iv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_hex_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hex_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hex_binary_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_test_hex) = '414243'. " 'ABC' in ASCII hex
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = '414243'X.

    DATA(lv_xstring_result) = lo_cut->hex_to_xstring( lv_test_hex ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Hex to XSTRING failed' act = lv_xstring_result exp = lv_expected_xstring ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String ausschließlich Hexadezimalzeichen (0-9, A-F, a-f) enthält. Dies könnte relevant sein, wenn ein Profilparameter einen Hex-Wert enthalten soll.

solution:
CLASS zcl_is_hex_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_hex_only IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_hex) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_hex_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_hex_only.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      rv_is_hex = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_input CO '0123456789ABCDEFabcdef'. " CO checks if string contains ONLY chars from pattern
      rv_is_hex = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_hex = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_hex_only.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_is_hex_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Valid hex string' act = lo_cut->is_hex_only( '0123456789ABCDEFabcdef' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Empty string' act = lo_cut->is_hex_only( '' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Invalid char' act = lo_cut->is_hex_only( 'GHI' ) ).

keywords: BINARY, String, Validierung, CO Operator, Hex

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der aktiven Workprozesse (Dialog, Batch, Spool, Update) basierend auf den entsprechenden Profilparametern (z.B. 'rdisp/wp_no_dia', 'rdisp/wp_no_btc'). Aggregieren Sie diese Werte.
hint: Lesen Sie mehrere Profilparameter und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_wp_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_workprocesses RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_wps) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_wp_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_workprocesses.
    DATA(lo_profile_param) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_wp_params) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'rdisp/wp_no_dia' )
      ( 'rdisp/wp_no_btc' )
      ( 'rdisp/wp_no_spo' )
      ( 'rdisp/wp_no_upd' )
    ).

    rv_total_wps = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                             FOR param_name IN lt_wp_params
                             LET lv_value = lo_profile_param->get_parameter_value( param_name )
                             IN NEXT sum = sum + COND i( WHEN lv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_value ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_total_wps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_wps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_wp_count( ).
    DATA(lv_total_wps) = lo_cut->get_total_workprocesses( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total work processes should be greater than 0' act = lv_total_wps > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code demonstriert die Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur Aggregation von Werten, die aus mehreren Profilparametern gelesen wurden. `COND` wird verwendet, um einen leeren String in 0 umzuwandeln, bevor er zur Summe addiert wird. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und moderne Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER, REDUCE, Workprozesse, Aggregation, COND

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen String (z.B. aus einem Profilparameter) als binäre Zahl interpretiert und eine Bitmaske darauf anwendet, um bestimmte Bits zu extrahieren. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als Integer zurück.
hint: Konvertieren Sie den String in einen Integer und verwenden Sie bitweise Operatoren (`BIT-AND`, `BIT-OR`, `BIT-XOR`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_bitmask DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS apply_bitmask IMPORTING iv_binary_string TYPE string
                                    iv_mask          TYPE i
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_bitmask IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_bitmask.
    DATA(lv_number) = 0.
    TRY.
        lv_number = CONV i( iv_binary_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        " Handle conversion error, e.g., set default or raise exception
        " For this example, we'll just use 0 if conversion fails.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_result = lv_number BIT-AND iv_mask.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_bitmask FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bitmask.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_bitmask( ).

    " Test case 1: 10 (binary 1010) AND 2 (binary 0010) = 2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Bitmask 1 failed' act = lo_cut->apply_bitmask( iv_binary_string = '10' iv_mask = 2 ) exp = 2 ).

    " Test case 2: 15 (binary 1111) AND 8 (binary 1000) = 8
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Bitmask 2 failed' act = lo_cut->apply_bitmask( iv_binary_string = '15' iv_mask = 8 ) exp = 8 ).

    " Test case 3: Invalid string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Invalid string should result in 0' act = lo_cut->apply_bitmask( iv_binary_string = 'ABC' iv_mask = 1 ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung konvertiert einen String in einen Integer und wendet dann den bitweisen `BIT-AND`-Operator an. Dies ist eine grundlegende Operation für die Arbeit mit binären Daten und Bitmasken. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Block um die `CONV`-Operation ist wichtig für die Robustheit, falls der Eingabestring keine gültige Zahl ist.
keywords: BINARY, Bitmaske, Bit-AND, Konvertierung, String, Integer

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strings (die jeweils eine binäre Ziffernfolge '0' oder '1' darstellen) in eine interne Tabelle von Integern konvertiert. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `CONV` und `COND` um die Strings in Integer zu konvertieren und Fehler abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_string_to_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_binary_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_integers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS convert_binary_strings IMPORTING it_binary_strings TYPE tt_binary_strings
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_integers) TYPE tt_integers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_string_to_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_binary_strings.
    rt_integers = VALUE #( FOR lv_binary_string IN it_binary_strings
                             ( COND i( WHEN lv_binary_string IS NUMERIC THEN CONV i( lv_binary_string ) ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_string_to_int( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_binary_string_to_int=>tt_binary_strings(
      ( '1' )
      ( '10' )
      ( '101' )
      ( 'invalid' )
      ( '0' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_binary_string_to_int=>tt_integers(
      ( 1 )
      ( 10 )
      ( 101 )
      ( 0 )
      ( 0 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_binary_strings( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Conversion failed' act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code nutzt einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren. Innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks wird `COND` verwendet, um bedingt zu prüfen, ob der String numerisch ist, bevor er in einen Integer konvertiert wird. Dies ist eine elegante und moderne Art, Daten zu transformieren und gleichzeitig Fehler abzufangen.
keywords: BINARY, FOR, COND, Konvertierung, Interne Tabelle, String, Integer

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Profilparameters, dessen Name dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Implementieren Sie eine Fallback-Logik, falls der Parameter nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_PARAMETER_VALUE` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH` Blocks und definieren Sie einen Standardwert im `CATCH` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_param_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_param IMPORTING iv_param_name TYPE string
                                        iv_default_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_param_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_param.
    DATA(lo_profile_param) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        rv_value = lo_profile_param->get_parameter_value( iv_param_name ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter.
        IF iv_default_value IS SUPPLIED.
          rv_value = iv_default_value.
        ELSE.
          rv_value = 'Parameter not found and no default provided'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_read FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_read.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_param_read( ).

    " Test existing parameter
    DATA(lv_existing_value) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_param( 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Existing param should return value' act = lv_existing_value ).

    " Test non-existing parameter with default
    DATA(lv_default_value) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_param( iv_param_name = 'non_existent_dynamic_param' iv_default_value = 'DEFAULT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Non-existing param with default' act = lv_default_value exp = 'DEFAULT' ).

    " Test non-existing parameter without default
    DATA(lv_no_default_value) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_param( 'another_non_existent_param' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Non-existing param without default' act = lv_no_default_value exp = 'Parameter not found and no default provided' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `TRY...CATCH` mit der Methode `GET_PARAMETER_VALUE` kann der Zugriff auf Profilparameter dynamisch und robust gestaltet werden. Falls der Parameter nicht existiert, wird eine Ausnahme abgefangen und eine Fallback-Logik (hier ein Standardwert) angewendet.
keywords: CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER, Dynamisch, TRY CATCH, Fallback, Standardwert

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Profilparametern und deren Werte als JSON-String zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie dabei die `CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER` Klasse und moderne JSON-Serialisierung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_param_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_profile_param_json,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_profile_param_json.
    TYPES tt_profile_param_json TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_profile_param_json WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_all_params_as_json RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_params_as_json.
    DATA(lo_profile_param) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_all_params) = lo_profile_param->get_all_parameters( ).

    DATA(lt_json_data) = VALUE tt_profile_param_json( FOR ls_param IN lt_all_params
                                                        ( name = ls_param-name, value = ls_param-value ) ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_abap_conv_json_writer=>create( ).
    lo_writer->write( lt_json_data ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'JSON string should start with [' act = lv_json_string CS '[' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'JSON string should contain "name"' act = lv_json_string CS '*"name"*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen XSTRING in eine interne Tabelle von einzelnen Bytes (als Integer) aufteilt. Dies ist nützlich für die detaillierte Analyse von binären Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce` oder eine Schleife mit `OFFSET` und `LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_to_bytes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_bytes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS xstring_to_byte_table IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring RETURNING VALUE(rt_bytes) TYPE tt_bytes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_to_bytes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD xstring_to_byte_table.
    DATA(lv_length) = xstrlen( iv_xstring ).
    IF lv_length = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_byte_x) = iv_xstring+(( sy-index - 1 ) * 1)(1).
      DATA(lv_byte_i) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_int_from_x( lv_byte_x ).
      APPEND lv_byte_i TO rt_bytes.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_to_bytes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xstring_to_bytes( ).

    DATA(lv_test_xstring) = '414243'X. " 'ABC' in ASCII hex (65, 66, 67)
    DATA(lt_expected_bytes) = VALUE zcl_xstring_to_bytes=>tt_bytes(
      ( 65 )
      ( 66 )
      ( 67 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result_bytes) = lo_cut->xstring_to_byte_table( lv_test_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'XSTRING to byte table failed' act = lt_result_bytes exp = lt_expected_bytes ).

    DATA(lv_empty_xstring) = ''X.
    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->xstring_to_byte_table( lv_empty_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Empty XSTRING should result in empty table' act = lt_empty_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer vorhandenen Excel-Datei (als XSTRING) und geben Sie den Inhalt der ersten Spalte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und die Methoden `load_package_data` und `get_cell_value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_first_column
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_first_column.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~load_package_data( iv_package_data = iv_xstring ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~activate_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    DO.
      DATA(lv_value) = lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 ).
      IF lv_value IS INITIAL.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_value TO rt_column_data.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_format_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_excel_format_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~create_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten' ).

    " Define styles
    DATA(lv_style_header) = lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~create_style( ).
    lv_style_header->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    DATA(lv_style_red_price) = lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~create_style( ).
    lv_style_red_price->set_font_color( 'FFFF0000' ). " ARGB format for red

    " Add header row and apply style
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'Connection' ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 3 iv_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 4 iv_value = 'Price' ).

    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell_style( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_style_id = lv_style_header->get_id( ) ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell_style( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_style_id = lv_style_header->get_id( ) ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell_style( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 3 iv_style_id = lv_style_header->get_id( ) ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell_style( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 4 iv_style_id = lv_style_header->get_id( ) ).

    " Add data rows and apply conditional style
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 iv_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_value = ls_sflight-price ).

      IF ls_sflight-price > 500.
        lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell_style( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_style_id = lv_style_red_price->get_id( ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD create_excel_with_formula.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_chart_bar_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL " For actual display

CLASS zcl_chart_bar_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_bar_chart.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    DATA: lt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_flight_count.

    ro_chart = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( container = io_container ).

    ro_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    ro_chart->set_title( 'Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    ro_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    ro_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    " Prepare data for chart engine
    DATA(lt_data_x) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_count ( ls_count-carrid ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_y) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_table( FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_count ( ls_count-count ) ).

    ro_chart->set_data_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_data_table = lt_data_y
        i_data_table_x = lt_data_x
    ).

    ro_chart->set_series_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_series_id = 1
        i_series_name = 'Flüge'
        i_series_type = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar
    ).

    " For actual display, you would call ro_chart->draw( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_line_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multi_line_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL " For actual display
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_line_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_line_chart.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price_lh TYPE s_price,
             price_aa TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY fldate.

    " Get data for two airlines (LH and AA)
    SELECT fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_lh)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' UP TO 5 ROWS.
    SELECT fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_aa)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Merge data into a single structure
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_lh INTO DATA(ls_lh).
      COLLECT VALUE ty_flight_data( fldate = ls_lh-fldate price_lh = ls_lh-price ) INTO lt_flight_data.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_aa INTO DATA(ls_aa).
      COLLECT VALUE ty_flight_data( fldate = ls_aa-fldate price_aa = ls_aa-price ) INTO lt_flight_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_chart = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( container = io_container ).
    ro_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).
    ro_chart->set_title( 'Flugpreise über Flugdaten' ).
    ro_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Flugdatum' ).
    ro_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Preis' ).

    " Prepare X-axis data (Flight Dates)
    DATA(lt_data_x) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_data IN lt_flight_data ( |{ ls_data-fldate DATE = ENVIRONMENT->O_DATE }| ) ).

    " Prepare Y-axis data for Series 1 (LH Prices)
    DATA(lt_data_y_lh) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_table( FOR ls_data IN lt_flight_data ( ls_data-price_lh ) ).
    ro_chart->set_data_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_data_table = lt_data_y_lh
        i_table_index = 1 " First data table
        i_data_table_x = lt_data_x
    ).

CLASS zcl_chart_custom_colors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_colored_bar_chart.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    DATA: lt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_flight_count UP TO 3 ROWS.

    ro_chart = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( container = io_container ).

    ro_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    ro_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft mit Farben' ).
    ro_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    ro_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    DATA(lt_data_x) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_count ( ls_count-carrid ) ).

    DATA(lv_series_id) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_count INTO DATA(ls_count).
      lv_series_id = lv_series_id + 1.
      DATA(lt_data_y) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_table( ( ls_count-count ) ).

      ro_chart->set_data_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_data_table = lt_data_y
          i_table_index = lv_series_id
          i_data_table_x = lt_data_x
      ).

      ro_chart->set_series_data(
        EXPORTING
          i_series_id = lv_series_id
          i_series_name = ls_count-carrid
          i_series_type = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar
          i_table_index = lv_series_id
      ).

      " Set custom color for each series
      CASE lv_series_id.
        WHEN 1. ro_chart->set_series_color( i_series_id = lv_series_id i_color = '0000FF' ). " Blue
        WHEN 2. ro_chart->set_series_color( i_series_id = lv_series_id i_color = '00FF00' ). " Green
        WHEN 3. ro_chart->set_series_color( i_series_id = lv_series_id i_color = 'FF0000' ). " Red
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_excel_auto_width IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_excel_auto_width.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~create_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'Airline Carrier ID' ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'Connection ID' ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Set auto width for the first column
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_column_width( iv_column = 1 iv_width = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_auto_width ).

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer Liste von Zahlen und subtrahieren Sie anschließend einen festen Wert davon. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_reduced_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_subtract_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_reduced_sum.
    rv_result = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                          FOR number IN it_numbers
                          NEXT sum = sum + number ) - iv_subtract_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_reduced_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_reduced_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_reduce_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_reduced_sum( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_subtract_value = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 45 ). " (10+20+30) - 15 = 60 - 15 = 45
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_reduce_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_reduced_sum( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_subtract_value = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -5 ). " 0 - 5 = -5

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_result = COND #( WHEN iv_initial_value > iv_threshold
                        THEN iv_initial_value - iv_subtract_val

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_free_seats) TYPE tt_flight_capacity.

CLASS zcl_itab_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_seats_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_free_seats = VALUE tt_flight_capacity(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie den Wert des letzten Elements einer internen Tabelle von der Summe der vorherigen Elemente. Behandeln Sie den Fall einer leeren oder zu kleinen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `LINE_EXISTS` oder `LINES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce_last_sub DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_minus_last
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce_last_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_minus_last.
    IF lines( it_numbers ) < 1.
      rv_result = 0. " Or raise exception, depending on requirement
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_last_value) = it_numbers[ lines( it_numbers ) ].

    rv_result = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                          FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i < lines( it_numbers )
                          NEXT sum = sum + it_numbers[ i ] ) - lv_last_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie zwei Zahlen aus einem String, der durch ein Trennzeichen getrennt ist (z.B. '100-20'), und subtrahieren Sie die zweite Zahl von der ersten. Geben Sie das Ergebnis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und `CONV` oder String-Funktionen wie `FIND` und `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_extract_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_string.
    DATA: lv_num1_str TYPE string,
          lv_num2_str TYPE string.

    SPLIT iv_input_string AT '-' INTO lv_num1_str lv_num2_str.

    DATA(lv_num1) = CONV i( lv_num1_str ).
    DATA(lv_num2) = CONV i( lv_num2_str ).

    rv_result = lv_num1 - lv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von `cl_spfl_profile_parameter` Objekten verwaltet und eine Methode bereitstellt, um den Wert eines Parameters abzurufen, wobei ein Standardwert zurückgegeben wird, falls der Parameter nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle von Objektreferenzen und den `OPTIONAL` Parameter für den Standardwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_param_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_entry,
             name  TYPE string,
             object TYPE REF TO cl_spfl_profile_parameter,
           END OF ty_param_entry.
    TYPES tt_param_entries TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_param_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY name.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_param_names TYPE string_table.

    METHODS get_parameter_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_param_name TYPE string
        iv_default_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_param_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  DATA mt_param_objects TYPE tt_param_entries.

  METHOD constructor.
    mt_param_objects = VALUE tt_param_entries(
      FOR name IN it_param_names
      ( name = name
        object = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_parameter_value.
    DATA(ls_entry) = mt_param_objects[ KEY name COMPONENTS iv_param_name DEFAULT VALUE ty_param_entry( ) ].

    IF ls_entry-object IS BOUND.
      TRY.
          rv_value = ls_entry-object->get_parameter_value( iv_param_name ).
        CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter.
          rv_value = iv_default_value.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = iv_default_value.
    ENDIF.

    IF rv_value IS INITIAL AND iv_default_value IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_value = iv_default_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen dynamisch bestimmten Wert von einem Feld, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie dabei Feldsymbole.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_subtract_val TYPE i
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    " Ensure the field symbol points to a numeric type
    IF <fs_field> IS NOT INITIAL AND <fs_field> IS NUMERIC.
      <fs_field> = <fs_field> - iv_subtract_val.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' ist nicht numerisch oder initial.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle, indem Sie Elemente entfernen, solange ein bestimmtes Element existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` und Tabellenausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_process_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data_in TYPE tt_data
        iv_id_to_remove TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data_out) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_process_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rt_data_out = it_data_in. " Copy for modification

    WHILE line_exists( rt_data_out[ id = iv_id_to_remove ] ).
      DELETE rt_data_out WHERE id = iv_id_to_remove.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_abap_const_range PUBLIC.

      between      TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
      less_equal   TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'LE',
      greater_equal TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'GE',
      contains_pattern TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'CP',

           END OF ty_sflight_data.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.

             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,

             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle durch ein Trennzeichen getrennten Wörter aus einem String, solange weitere Trennzeichen gefunden werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `FIND` und `SUBSTRING` oder String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_string_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_string_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_words.
    DATA(lv_remaining_text) = iv_text.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = 0.

    WHILE lv_remaining_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_delimiter IN lv_remaining_text MATCH OFFSET lv_offset MATCH LENGTH lv_length.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Delimiter found
        APPEND lv_remaining_text(lv_offset) TO rt_words.
        lv_remaining_text = lv_remaining_text+lv_offset+lv_length.
      ELSE. " No more delimiters, add remaining text
        APPEND lv_remaining_text TO rt_words.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_text.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
    " Remove empty strings if delimiter was at start/end or multiple delimiters
    DELETE rt_words WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Warteschlange (Queue) für Nachrichten, die Nachrichten verarbeitet, solange die Warteschlange nicht leer ist. Entfernen Sie dabei Duplikate.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` für die Verarbeitung, `READ TABLE INDEX 1` zum Lesen des ersten Elements und `DELETE` zum Entfernen. `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` kann vor der Verarbeitung verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_queue_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_message TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_messages_in TYPE tt_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_log) TYPE tt_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_queue_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_messages_in.
    SORT lt_queue ASCENDING. " Sort to make DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES work
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_queue COMPARING ALL FIELDS.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_message).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |Processing: { lv_message }| TO rt_processed_log.
        DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_date_from TYPE sflight-fldate OPTIONAL
        iv_date_to TYPE sflight-fldate OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_fldate,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             high   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_range_fldate.
    TYPES tt_range_fldate TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_fldate WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE tt_range_carrid( ).
    IF iv_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = iv_carrier ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_fldate_range) = VALUE tt_range_fldate( ).
    IF iv_date_from IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_date_to IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_fldate( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-between low = iv_date_from high = iv_date_to ) TO lt_fldate_range.
    ELSEIF iv_date_from IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_fldate( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-greater_equal low = iv_date_from ) TO lt_fldate_range.
    ELSEIF iv_date_to IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_fldate( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-less_equal low = iv_date_to ) TO lt_fldate_range.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE ( @lt_carrid_range IS INITIAL OR carrid IN @lt_carrid_range )
        AND ( @lt_fldate_range IS INITIAL OR fldate IN @lt_fldate_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl iterativ mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, solange die Zahl größer als 1 ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und eine Variable für das Produkt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input must be a non-negative number'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 1.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie die erste Zahl in einer Liste, die durch 7 teilbar ist, und beenden Sie die Suche, sobald sie gefunden wurde. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einer Bedingung, die sich ändert, sobald die Zahl gefunden wurde, und den Modulo-Operator (`MOD`).

CLASS zcl_whl_find_divisible DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_divisible_by_seven
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_find_divisible IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_divisible_by_seven.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_numbers ) AND lv_found = abap_false.
      READ TABLE it_numbers INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lv_current_number).
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_current_number MOD 7 = 0.
        rv_found_number = lv_current_number.
        lv_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugdatum (`FLDATE`) und aggregieren Sie den Gesamtpreis pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie dabei eine `RANGE`-Tabelle für die Selektion der Fluggesellschaften, die Konstanten aus einer Range-Konstanten-Schnittstelle nutzt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in Open SQL und eine `RANGE`-Tabelle für die `WHERE`-Klausel.

INTERFACE zif_abap_const_range PUBLIC.
  CONSTANTS:
    BEGIN OF sign,
      include TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
      exclude TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'E',
    END OF sign,
    BEGIN OF option,
      equal        TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ',
      between      TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
      less_equal   TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'LE',
      greater_equal TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'GE',
      contains_pattern TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'CP',
      not_contains_pattern TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'NP',
    END OF option.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_group_sflight_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflight_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE tt_range_carrid(
      FOR <carrier> IN it_carriers
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = <carrier> )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, fldate, SUM( price ) AS total_price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_grouped_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrid_range
      GROUP BY carrid, fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_working_days) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_services=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_day_of_week <> 6 AND lv_day_of_week <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        APPEND lv_current_date TO rt_working_days.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_abap_const_range PUBLIC.
  CONSTANTS:
    BEGIN OF sign,
      include TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
      exclude TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'E',
    END OF sign,
    BEGIN OF option,
      equal        TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ',
      between      TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',

CLASS zcl_range_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_all_in_range
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min    TYPE i
        iv_max    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_all_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_all_in_range.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_i,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE i,
             high   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_range_i.
    TYPES tt_range_i TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_value_range) = VALUE tt_range_i(
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-between low = iv_min high = iv_max )
    ).

    rb_all_in_range = abap_true.
    LOOP AT it_values ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
      IF NOT <fs_value> IN lt_value_range.
        rb_all_in_range = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Paginierungslogik für eine interne Tabelle mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, die Seiten abruft, solange weitere Daten verfügbar sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `OFFSET` sowie `UP TO` in Tabellenausdrücken oder `FOR` mit `FROM` und `TO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_paginated_data
      IMPORTING
        it_all_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_page_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rtt_paginated_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_paginated_data.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_total_lines) = lines( it_all_data ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_total_lines.
      DATA(lt_page) = VALUE tt_data(
        FOR ls_data IN it_all_data FROM ( lv_offset + 1 ) TO ( lv_offset + iv_page_size )
        ( ls_data )
      ).
      IF lt_page IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lt_page TO rtt_paginated_data.
      ENDIF.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_page_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_string_pattern IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) in Batches, solange noch unverarbeitete Daten vorhanden sind. Simulieren Sie eine Batch-Verarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und `FOR` mit `FROM`/`TO` oder `OFFSET`/`UP TO` für die Batch-Extraktion.

CLASS zcl_whl_batch_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_batches
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_batch_size  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rtt_processed_batches) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_batch_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_batches.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_total_lines) = lines( it_all_flights ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_total_lines.
      DATA(lt_current_batch) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
        FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights FROM ( lv_offset + 1 ) TO ( lv_offset + iv_batch_size )
        ( ls_flight )
      ).

      IF lt_current_batch IS NOT INITIAL.
        " Simulate processing the batch (e.g., add to result table)
        APPEND lt_current_batch TO rtt_processed_batches.
      ENDIF.

      lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_batch_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_flight_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS is_flight_critical
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_to_check TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_critical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_flight_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_flight_critical.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_connid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-connid,
             high   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_range_connid.
    TYPES tt_range_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Define critical carriers
    DATA(lt_critical_carriers) = VALUE tt_range_carrid(
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = 'UA' )
    ).

    " Define critical connections for a specific carrier (e.g., LH)
    DATA(lt_critical_connids_lh) = VALUE tt_range_connid(
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = '0400' )
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = '0401' )
    ).

    IF is_flight_to_check-carrid IN lt_critical_carriers.
      IF is_flight_to_check-carrid = 'LH' AND is_flight_to_check-connid IN lt_critical_connids_lh.
        rb_is_critical = abap_true.
      ELSEIF is_flight_to_check-carrid = 'UA'. " All UA flights are critical in this example
        rb_is_critical = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_event_queue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_event_base WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_event_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_event_queue TYPE tt_event_queue
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_event_queue.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_event_queue.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lo_event_ref).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            lo_event_ref->process_event( ).
            APPEND |Processed: { lo_event_ref->get_event_type( ) }| TO rt_log.
          CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
            APPEND |Error processing { lo_event_ref->get_event_type( ) }: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| TO rt_log.
        ENDTRY.
        DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_abap_const_range PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_dynamic_num_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_numeric_data.

             high   TYPE i,

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen aus einem String, solange noch Leerzeichen vorhanden sind, die entfernt werden müssen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und String-Funktionen wie `CONDENSE` oder `SHIFT LEFT/RIGHT DELETING LEADING/TRAILING SPACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_trim_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_trim_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string.
    rv_trimmed_string = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_old_string) = rv_trimmed_string.

    WHILE abap_true.
      " Remove leading spaces
      SHIFT rv_trimmed_string LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
      " Remove trailing spaces
      SHIFT rv_trimmed_string RIGHT DELETING TRAILING SPACE.

      IF rv_trimmed_string = lv_old_string.
        " No more changes, exit loop
        EXIT.
      ELSE.
        lv_old_string = rv_trimmed_string.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_multi_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_keys
      IMPORTING

        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_key
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_multi_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_keys.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_connid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-connid,
             high   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_range_connid.
    TYPES tt_range_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE tt_range_carrid(
      FOR <key> IN it_flight_keys
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = <key>-carrid )
    ).

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE tt_range_connid(
      FOR <key> IN it_flight_keys
      ( sign = zif_abap_const_range=>sign-include option = zif_abap_const_range=>option-equal low = <key>-connid )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range AND connid IN lt_connid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        it_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcatalog) TYPE slis_t_fieldcat_alv.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_fieldcatalog.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_component    TYPE abap_compdescr,
          ls_fieldcat     TYPE slis_fieldcat_alv.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
      CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
      ls_fieldcat-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_fieldcat-seltext_l = ls_component-name.
      APPEND ls_fieldcat TO rt_fieldcatalog.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. "Dummy container name for compilation

      CHANGING

        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_event_receiver->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    " In einem echten Programm würde hier ein Screen mit dem Container angezeigt.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus 'sflights' unter Verwendung des 'REDUCE'-Operators. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Gesamtpreis sein.
hint: Der 'REDUCE'-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und die Erstellung neuer Datenstrukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_total_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_prices.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_carrier_totals = REDUCE tt_carrier_total(
      INIT totals = VALUE tt_carrier_total( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET lv_index = totals[ KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-total_price
      IN
        totals = COND #( WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL
                         THEN VALUE tt_carrier_total( BASE totals ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = ls_flight-price ) )
                         ELSE VALUE tt_carrier_total( BASE totals ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = lv_index + ls_flight-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_reduce_prices( ).

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251125' price = 100 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251125' price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251125' price = 50 ) ).

    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->calculate_total_prices( ).

    READ TABLE lt_totals WITH KEY carrid = 'XX' INTO DATA(ls_xx_total).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtpreis für XX ist falsch' act = ls_xx_total-total_price exp = 300 ).

    READ TABLE lt_totals WITH KEY carrid = 'YY' INTO DATA(ls_yy_total).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtpreis für YY ist falsch' act = ls_yy_total-total_price exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'REDUCE'-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert oder eine neue Tabelle zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulationslogik anwendet. In diesem Fall wird die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft effizient berechnet, ohne explizite 'LOOP'- und 'COLLECT'-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflights, Math

Instructions: Weisen Sie Flugdaten basierend auf dem Preis eine Statusfarbe zu (z.B. grün für < 100, gelb für 100-500, rot für > 500). Verwenden Sie den 'COND'-Operator, um die Farbe zu bestimmen, die dann in einem ALV angezeigt werden könnte.
hint: Der 'COND'-Operator ermöglicht bedingte Zuweisungen in einem Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_cond_colors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             status_color TYPE lvc_t_scol,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_colors
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_colored_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_color_for_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_color) TYPE lvc_s_scol.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_cond_colors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_colors.
    rt_colored_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( ls_flight WITH status_color = get_color_for_price( ls_flight-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_color_for_price.
    rv_color = COND #( WHEN iv_price < 100 THEN VALUE lvc_s_scol( fname = 'PRICE' color = '5' ) "Grün
                       WHEN iv_price >= 100 AND iv_price <= 500 THEN VALUE lvc_s_scol( fname = 'PRICE' color = '6' ) "Gelb
                       ELSE VALUE lvc_s_scol( fname = 'PRICE' color = '7' ) ). "Rot
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_colors.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_cond_colors( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_alv_cond_colors=>tt_flight_data.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 50 ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 250 ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = 600 ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_colored) = lo_cut->assign_colors( lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_colored INTO DATA(ls_flight_1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Farbe für Preis 50 sollte grün sein' act = ls_flight_1-status_color[1]-color exp = '5' ).

    READ TABLE lt_colored INTO DATA(ls_flight_2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Farbe für Preis 250 sollte gelb sein' act = ls_flight_2-status_color[1]-color exp = '6' ).

    READ TABLE lt_colored INTO DATA(ls_flight_3) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Farbe für Preis 600 sollte rot sein' act = ls_flight_3-status_color[1]-color exp = '7' ).

explanation: Der 'COND'-Operator ist ein Ausdruck, der es ermöglicht, einen Wert basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zuzuweisen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu 'IF'-Anweisungen und macht den Code kompakter und funktionaler. Im Kontext von ALV kann dies verwendet werden, um dynamisch Farben oder andere Anzeigeattribute für Zeilen oder Zellen zu bestimmen, indem die 'status_color' Feldkatalog-Eigenschaft genutzt wird.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus 'sflights' nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis. Verwenden Sie 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY' und 'REDUCE' für die Aggregation.
hint: 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY' ist die moderne Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ls_flight_line-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_flight_line-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight_line INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_grouped_flight-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
        carrid       = lv_carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        total_price  = lv_total_price
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_grouped_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_group_by( ).

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'GR'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'GR' connid = '0001' price = 100 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'GR' connid = '0002' price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'GR' connid = '0003' price = 150 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'BL' connid = '0001' price = 50 ) ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Es sollten 2 Gruppen gefunden werden' act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'GR' INTO DATA(ls_gr_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fluganzahl für GR ist falsch' act = ls_gr_summary-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtpreis für GR ist falsch' act = ls_gr_summary-total_price exp = 450 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'BL' INTO DATA(ls_bl_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fluganzahl für BL ist falsch' act = ls_bl_summary-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtpreis für BL ist falsch' act = ls_bl_summary-total_price exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY'-Anweisung ist eine der wichtigsten Neuerungen in modernem ABAP für die Datenaggregation. Sie ermöglicht es, interne Tabellen nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und dann innerhalb jeder Gruppe weitere Operationen durchzuführen, wie hier die Berechnung von Anzahl und Summe. Dies ersetzt komplexe 'AT NEW'-Logiken und macht den Code wesentlich klarer und effizienter für die Vorbereitung von Subtotals oder aggregierten Daten für ein ALV.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, ALV

Instructions: Verwenden Sie funktionale Methodenaufrufe, um eine Währungsumrechnung für Flugpreise durchzuführen, bevor die Daten in einem ALV angezeigt werden. Die Methode soll den umgerechneten Preis zurückgeben.
hint: Funktionale Methoden können direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden, um Werte zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_functional_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_converted_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price_usd TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_converted_flight.
    TYPES: tt_converted_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_converted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_prices_for_alv
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_flights) TYPE tt_converted_flight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_usd
      IMPORTING
        iv_price   TYPE s_price
        iv_currency TYPE s_curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price_usd) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_functional_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_prices_for_alv.
    rt_converted_flights = VALUE tt_converted_flight(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid    = ls_flight-connid,
        price_usd = convert_to_usd( iv_price = ls_flight-price iv_currency = ls_flight-currency ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_to_usd.
    " Dummy-Umrechnung für Demonstrationszwecke
    CASE iv_currency.
      WHEN 'EUR'.
        rv_price_usd = iv_price * '1.10'.
      WHEN 'JPY'.
        rv_price_usd = iv_price * '0.007'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_price_usd = iv_price.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_convert_prices_for_alv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_prices_for_alv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_functional_methods( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_alv_functional_methods=>tt_flight_data.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'JL' connid = '0002' price = 10000 currency = 'JPY' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_cut->convert_prices_for_alv( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der konvertierten Flüge ist falsch' act = lines( lt_converted ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_converted INTO DATA(ls_flight_eur) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'EUR-Konvertierung ist falsch' act = ls_flight_eur-price_usd exp = '110.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_converted INTO DATA(ls_flight_usd) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'USD-Preis sollte unverändert sein' act = ls_flight_usd-price_usd exp = '200.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_converted INTO DATA(ls_flight_jpy) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'JPY-Konvertierung ist falsch' act = ls_flight_jpy-price_usd exp = '70.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Funktionale Methodenaufrufe sind ein Kernbestandteil des modernen ABAP. Sie ermöglichen es, Methoden direkt in Ausdrücken zu verwenden, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Anstatt temporäre Variablen zu deklarieren und separate Aufrufe zu tätigen, kann die Transformation von Daten (hier die Währungsumrechnung) direkt während der Befüllung einer neuen internen Tabelle erfolgen. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil und ist ideal für die Datenvorbereitung vor der ALV-Anzeige.
keywords: Functional Programming, Methods, Object Orientation, ALV, Data Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache ALV-Liste mit 'cl_salv_table' und zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus 'sflights' an. Verwenden Sie dabei die Factory-Methode und Inline-Deklaration.
hint: 'cl_salv_table=>factory' ist der moderne Weg, ein ALV zu instanziieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_salv_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_simple_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_salv_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_simple_alv.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_flights
        ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_salv_fcat_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_custom_alv.
    DATA lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(

            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Sortierung und Gruppierung für ein 'cl_salv_table' ALV. Sortieren Sie nach Fluggesellschaft und gruppieren Sie die Daten ebenfalls nach Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden 'get_sorts()' und 'get_aggregations()' des 'cl_salv_table' Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_salv_sort_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sorted_grouped_alv
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_salv_sort_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sorted_grouped_alv.
    DATA lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = it_flights
        ).

        " Sortierung hinzufügen
        DATA(lo_sorts) = lo_salv_table->get_sorts( ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CARRID' position = 1 sequence = if_salv_c_sort=>asc ).

        " Gruppierung hinzufügen (hier als Aggregation mit Zwischensumme)
        DATA(lo_aggregations) = lo_salv_table->get_aggregations( ).
        lo_aggregations->add_aggregation( columnname = 'CARRID' ).
        lo_aggregations->add_aggregation( columnname = 'PRICE' aggregation = if_salv_c_aggregation=>sum ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).

explanation: 'cl_salv_table' bietet dedizierte Objekte für die Verwaltung von Sortierungen ('cl_salv_sorts') und Aggregationen/Gruppierungen ('cl_salv_aggregations'). Durch den Zugriff auf diese Objekte und deren Methoden können Sortierkriterien und Gruppierungen (inklusive Zwischensummen) deklarativ hinzugefügt werden.   PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
