CLASS zcl_alv_gui_grid_slis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_grid.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE slis_t_fieldcat_alv,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE slis_fieldcat_alv,
          ls_layout   TYPE slis_layout_alv.

    " Feldkatalog befüllen
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-seltext_l = 'Flugnummer'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fieldcat-seltext_l = 'Flugdatum'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'.
    ls_fieldcat-seltext_l = 'Preis'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Layout-Einstellungen
    ls_layout-zebra = abap_true.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Dummy-Name für Kompilierung

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_container.

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        is_layout       = ls_layout
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_GUI_GRID_SLIS=>TY_FLIGHT_DATA'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = it_flights
    ).

    " In einem echten Programm würde hier ein Screen mit dem Container angezeigt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_aggregated_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_for_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_data.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_carrier_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid       = ls_group-carrid,
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT c = c + 1 ),
        total_price  = REDUCE s_price( INIT p = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT p = p + ls_flight-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_aggregated_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_aggregated_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_for_group_reduce( ).

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AG'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AG' connid = '0001' price = 100 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AG' connid = '0002' price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AG' connid = '0003' price = 150 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'BG' connid = '0001' price = 50 ) ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Es sollten 2 Gruppen gefunden werden' act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'AG' INTO DATA(ls_ag_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fluganzahl für AG ist falsch' act = ls_ag_summary-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtpreis für AG ist falsch' act = ls_ag_summary-total_price exp = 450 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Werte einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mithilfe des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit der Multiplikationsoperation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i(
      INIT product = 1
      FOR <item> IN it_items
      NEXT product = product * <item>-value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_calculate_product FOR TESTING.

  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_product.
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_reduce_multiply=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 2 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 3 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 4 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 24 " 2 * 3 * 4 = 24
      msg = 'Product should be 24'

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_reduce_multiply=>tt_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 1 " Initial value for product is 1
      msg = 'Product of empty table should be 1'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale Art, Schleifen zu vermeiden und den Code kompakter und lesbarer zu gestalten.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Interne Tabellen, Aggregation, Funktional

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Daten aus einer bestehenden Tabelle transformieren und dabei den FOR-Operator in Kombination mit VALUE verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ) für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_value_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input,
             id    TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_input.
    TYPES: tt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_output,
             new_id   TYPE i,
             new_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_output.
    TYPES: tt_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE tt_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR <item> IN it_input
                         ( new_id = <item>-id * 10
                           new_text = |Transformed: { <item>-text }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

      IMPORTING
        iv_day_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text_cond.
    rv_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
      WHEN iv_status = 'I' THEN 'Inaktiv'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_day_name_switch.
    rv_day_name = SWITCH string( iv_day_number
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verschieben Sie Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, aber ähnlicher Semantik, unter Verwendung des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie CORRESPONDING #( ... ) für die Datenzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id_src    TYPE i,
             name_src  TYPE string,
             value_src TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_id    TYPE i,
             target_name  TYPE string,
             target_value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

    METHODS map_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING target_id = id_src target_name = name_src target_value = value_src ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING target_id = id_src target_name = name_src target_value = value_src ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_map=>ty_source.
    ls_source-id_src = 1.
    ls_source-name_src = 'Item A'.
    ls_source-value_src = '100.50'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_map( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_value exp = '100.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_table.
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_map=>tt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id_src = 10 name_src = 'Product X' value_src = '25.99' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id_src = 20 name_src = 'Product Y' value_src = '12.34' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_map( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-target_id exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-target_name exp = 'Product Y' ).

unit_test:

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere interne Tabellen mit dem UNION-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die alle eindeutigen Einträge enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den UNION-Operator in einer Tabellenexpression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE tt_data
        it_table2 TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_tables.
    rt_combined = VALUE tt_data( it_table1 OPTIONAL
                                 FOR <entry> IN it_table2 WHERE NOT line_exists( it_table1[ key = <entry>-key ] ) ( <entry> ) ).
    " UNION-Operator ist nicht direkt für interne Tabellen verfügbar wie in SQL.
    " Dies ist eine moderne ABAP-Entsprechung für eine UNION-ähnliche Operation (ohne Duplikate).
    " Für eine echte UNION ALL würde man einfach beide Tabellen aneinanderhängen.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_tables FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_combine_tables_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_combine_tables_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_tables.
    DATA lt_table1 TYPE zcl_table_union=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'A' value = 1 ) TO lt_table1.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'B' value = 2 ) TO lt_table1.

    DATA lt_table2 TYPE zcl_table_union=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'C' value = 3 ) TO lt_table2.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'D' value = 4 ) TO lt_table2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_union( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_tables( it_table1 = lt_table1 it_table2 = lt_table2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-key exp = 'D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_combine_tables_duplicates.
    DATA lt_table1 TYPE zcl_table_union=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'A' value = 1 ) TO lt_table1.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'B' value = 2 ) TO lt_table1.

    DATA lt_table2 TYPE zcl_table_union=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'B' value = 20 ) TO lt_table2. " Duplicate key, different value
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'C' value = 3 ) TO lt_table2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_union( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_tables( it_table1 = lt_table1 it_table2 = lt_table2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ). " 'B' from table1 should be kept
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-key exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_combine_tables_empty.
    DATA lt_table1 TYPE zcl_table_union=>tt_data.
    DATA lt_table2 TYPE zcl_table_union=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'X' value = 99 ) TO lt_table2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_union( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_tables( it_table1 = lt_table1 it_table2 = lt_table2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key exp = 'X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der direkte SQL-ähnliche UNION-Operator für interne Tabellen existiert in ABAP nicht. Diese Lösung demonstriert eine moderne, funktionale Methode, um eine UNION-ähnliche Operation (ohne Duplikate) zu erreichen, indem die zweite Tabelle gefiltert und dann an die erste angehängt wird. Dies nutzt den VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit FOR und WHERE NOT LINE_EXISTS, um Duplikate basierend auf einem Schlüssel zu vermeiden.
keywords: UNION, Interne Tabellen, Kombination, Duplikate, VALUE, FOR, LINE_EXISTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR und die Methode GET_VALUE_REF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lr_data         TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lv_field_value  TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        lr_data = lo_struct_descr->get_value_ref( p_name = iv_field_name p_struct = is_data ).

        IF lr_data IS BOUND.
          ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
          rv_value = <fs_value>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        rv_value = |Fehler: { lx_rtti_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_dynamic FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_dynamic_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_read=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_data-field3 = '45.67'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_read( ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_value3) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value3 exp = '45.67' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_field_value_dynamic_invalid.
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_read=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Test'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_read( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_value msg = 'Error message should be returned for invalid field' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler' in = lv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse und Manipulation von Datentypen und -objekten zur Laufzeit. Die Verwendung von CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR und GET_VALUE_REF ist eine moderne und typsichere Methode, um auf Feldwerte zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, und ersetzt ältere, unsichere ASSIGN COMPONENT-Anweisungen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamische Programmierung, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, GET_VALUE_REF, Feld-Symbol

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Einträge einer internen Tabelle nach einem oder mehreren Schlüsselfeldern und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen mit dem GROUP BY-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( ... ) für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             region TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             product TYPE c LENGTH 20,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES: tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_region_summary,
             region TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
             product_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_region_summary.
    TYPES: tt_region_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_region_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_region
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_region_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_region.
    LOOP AT it_sales_data INTO DATA(ls_item) GROUP BY ( region = ls_item-region ) ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_group).
      DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <member> IN lr_group
        NEXT sum = sum + <member>-amount
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_region_summary(
        region = lr_group->*-region
        total_amount = lv_total_amount
        product_count = lines( lr_group )
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_sales_by_region FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_summarize_sales_by_region_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_sales_by_region.
    DATA lt_sales TYPE zcl_group_by_example=>tt_sales_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'EAST' product = 'A' amount = '100.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'WEST' product = 'B' amount = '200.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'EAST' product = 'C' amount = '150.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'WEST' product = 'D' amount = '50.00' ) TO lt_sales.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_example( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_east) = lt_summary[ region = 'EAST' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_east-total_amount exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_east-product_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_west) = lt_summary[ region = 'WEST' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_west-total_amount exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_west-product_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_sales_by_region_empty.
    DATA lt_sales TYPE zcl_group_by_example=>tt_sales_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_example( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der GROUP BY-Operator in LOOP AT-Anweisungen (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit REDUCE für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe bietet dies eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen für Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: GROUP BY, Interne Tabellen, Gruppierung, Aggregation, LOOP AT, REDUCE

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einem benutzerdefinierten Format unter Verwendung von String-Templates und eingebauten Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und Funktionen wie CONV für die Typkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_datetime
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_time TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_dt) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_datetime.
    rv_formatted_dt = |Datum: { iv_date DATE = USER } Uhrzeit: { iv_time TIME = USER }|.
    " Alternativ für spezifischere Formate:
    " DATA(lv_date_str) = |{ iv_date(4) }-{ iv_date+4(2) }-{ iv_date+6(2) }|.
    " DATA(lv_time_str) = |{ iv_time(2) }:{ iv_time+2(2) }:{ iv_time+4(2) }|.
    " rv_formatted_dt = |{ lv_date_str } { lv_time_str }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_format( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_datetime( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time ).

    " Der genaue erwartete Wert hängt von den Benutzereinstellungen ab (DATE = USER, TIME = USER).
    " Daher prüfen wir auf das Vorhandensein von Datum und Uhrzeit im String.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Datum:' in = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Uhrzeit:' in = lv_result ).

    " Für eine exakte Prüfung müsste man die Benutzerformatierung simulieren oder ein festes Format verwenden.
    " Beispiel für festes Format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS):
    DATA(lv_expected_date) = |{ lv_date(4) }-{ lv_date+4(2) }-{ lv_date+6(2) }|.
    DATA(lv_expected_time) = |{ lv_time(2) }:{ lv_time+2(2) }:{ lv_time+4(2) }|.
    DATA(lv_expected_fixed) = |Datum: { lv_expected_date } Uhrzeit: { lv_expected_time }|.

    DATA(lv_result_fixed) = |Datum: { lv_date(4) }-{ lv_date+4(2) }-{ lv_date+6(2) } Uhrzeit: { lv_time(2) }:{ lv_time+2(2) }:{ lv_time+4(2) }|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_fixed exp = lv_expected_fixed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates bieten eine flexible und lesbare Möglichkeit, Datum- und Zeitwerte in Strings zu formatieren. Die Verwendung von Formatierungsoptionen wie DATE = USER und TIME = USER ermöglicht die Anpassung an die Benutzereinstellungen, während manuelle Substring-Operationen für spezifische, feste Formate genutzt werden können. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu WRITE ... TO ... oder CONCATENATE.
keywords: Date, Time, String Templates, Formatierung, Benutzerformat

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_nested_splitter
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      EXPORTING
        eo_top_right_container    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
        eo_bottom_right_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container

        VALUE(ro_main_splitter) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_nested_splitter.
    " Haupt-Splitter (vertikal)
    ro_main_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    " Rechten Bereich des Haupt-Splitters holen
    DATA(lo_right_area) = ro_main_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " Verschachtelter Splitter (horizontal) im rechten Bereich
    DATA(lo_nested_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_right_area
      rows    = 2
      columns = 1
    ).

    " Container des verschachtelten Splitters holen
    DATA(lo_top_nested_area) = lo_nested_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_bottom_nested_area) = lo_nested_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).

    " Custom Controls in verschachtelten Bereichen platzieren
    eo_top_right_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( parent = lo_top_nested_area ).
    eo_bottom_right_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( parent = lo_bottom_nested_area ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Liste von GUI-Eigenschaftsnamen aus einer internen Tabelle und versuchen Sie, deren Werte mit `cl_gui_props_consumer` abzurufen. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für eine kompakte Verarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` für die Iteration und das Sammeln der Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_props_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_property_result,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
             error TYPE string,
           END OF ts_property_result.
    TYPES tt_property_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_property_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_multiple_gui_properties
      IMPORTING
        it_property_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_property_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multiple_gui_properties.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR name IN it_property_names
                           LET lv_value = '' lv_error = '' IN
                           ( name = name
                             value = COND string(
                                       WHEN lo_props_consumer->get_property( name ) IS NOT INITIAL THEN lo_props_consumer->get_property( name )
                                       ELSE '' )
                             error = COND string(
                                       WHEN lo_props_consumer->get_property( name ) IS INITIAL THEN 'Property not found or empty'
                                       ELSE '' )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_props_sync DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_splitter_from_props
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        iv_property_name TYPE string
        iv_default_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_splitter) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_props_sync IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_splitter_from_props.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_fixed_size) = iv_default_size.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_prop_value) = lo_props_consumer->get_property( iv_property_name ).
        IF lv_prop_value IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_fixed_size = CONV i( lv_prop_value ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Eigenschaft nicht gefunden, Standardwert wird verwendet.
    ENDTRY.

    ro_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    ro_splitter->set_column_mode(
      id    = 1
      mode  = cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_fixed
      value = lv_fixed_size
    ).
    ro_splitter->set_column_mode(
      id    = 2
      mode  = cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_variable
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Zahlen von 1 aufwärts, bis die Summe einen bestimmten Schwellenwert (z.B. 100) überschreitet. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und die `REDUCE`-Funktion für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` für die Schleifensteuerung und `REDUCE` zur akkumulativen Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_until_threshold
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_until_threshold.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = 0.
    rv_sum = 0.

    WHILE rv_sum <= iv_threshold.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number + 1.
      rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = rv_sum FOR i = 1 UP TO 1 NEXT s = s + lv_current_number ).
      IF rv_sum > iv_threshold. " Check after adding the number
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Strings (als interne Tabelle) als Warteschlange verarbeitet. Entfernen Sie in einer `WHILE`-Schleife den ersten Eintrag, verarbeiten Sie ihn (z.B. in Großbuchstaben umwandeln) und fügen Sie ihn einer Ergebnisliste hinzu, bis die Warteschlange leer ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE NOT itab IS INITIAL` und `READ TABLE ... INDEX 1` gefolgt von `DELETE itab INDEX 1`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_queue_items TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_working_queue) = it_queue_items.

    WHILE lt_working_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_working_queue INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_item).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ to_upper( lv_item ) }| TO rt_processed_items.
        DELETE TABLE lt_working_queue INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if queue is not initial, but good practice
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv.
    DATA: lo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    IF io_parent IS BOUND.
      lo_container = CAST #( io_parent ).
    ELSE.
      " In a real report, this would be linked to a screen element
      " For demo purposes, we'll just create a dummy container if not provided
      " This part cannot be executed without a screen.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " Replace with actual screen element name
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT' " Use structure name for field catalog derivation
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

    " 2. Filter using FOR and FILTER expression
    rt_filtered_sflights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_sflights

      " Dummy container for non-GUI context
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT' " Use structure name for field catalog derivation
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende Nullen aus einem String, der eine Zahl darstellt, bis keine Nullen mehr vorhanden sind oder nur noch eine Ziffer übrig ist. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'` oder `CONDENSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_remove_leading_zeros DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_zeros
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_remove_leading_zeros IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_zeros.
    rv_output = iv_input.

    WHILE rv_output IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_output(1) = '0' AND strlen( rv_output ) > 1.
      SHIFT rv_output LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF rv_output IS INITIAL.
      rv_output = '0'. " Handle case where input was all zeros
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen und aktualisieren Sie Einträge in einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, bis keine weiteren passenden Einträge gefunden werden. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die effiziente Bearbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL WHERE ...` und `CONTINUE` oder `EXIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_update_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             flag  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_entries_while_found
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_update_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_entries_while_found.
    DATA(lv_found_and_updated) = abap_true.

    WHILE lv_found_and_updated = abap_true.
      lv_found_and_updated = abap_false.

      LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>)
        WHERE flag = abap_false.
        " Update the first found entry
        <fs_data>-flag = abap_true.
        <fs_data>-value = |Updated { <fs_data>-value }|.
        lv_found_and_updated = abap_true.
        EXIT. " Exit loop to restart search from beginning
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_all_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_update_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_whl_update_itab=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' flag = abap_false )
    ).
    lo_cut->update_entries_while_found( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 'Updated A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-value exp = 'Updated B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-value exp = 'Updated C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_data[ 1 ]-flag ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_data[ 2 ]-flag ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_data[ 3 ]-flag ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_no_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_update_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_whl_update_itab=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' flag = abap_true )
    ).
    lo_cut->update_entries_while_found( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_data[ 1 ]-flag ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_some_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_update_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_whl_update_itab=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' flag = abap_true )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' flag = abap_false )
    ).
    lo_cut->update_entries_while_found( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 'Updated A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_data[ 1 ]-flag ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-value exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_data[ 2 ]-flag ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-value exp = 'Updated C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_data[ 3 ]-flag ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `WHILE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` zur iterativen Aktualisierung einer internen Tabelle. Die äußere `WHILE`-Schleife läuft, solange im vorherigen Durchlauf mindestens ein Eintrag gefunden und aktualisiert wurde. Die innere `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL WHERE ...` findet den ersten passenden Eintrag, aktualisiert ihn direkt über das `FIELD-SYMBOL` und beendet dann die innere Schleife mit `EXIT`. Dies ist effizient, da die Suche bei jedem Durchlauf von vorne beginnt und sicherstellt, dass alle potenziell zu aktualisierenden Einträge gefunden werden, auch wenn sich die Bedingungen durch die Aktualisierung ändern könnten. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Aktualisierung des `value`-Feldes verwendet.
keywords: WHILE, Internal Tables, FIELD-SYMBOLS, LOOP AT WHERE, Dynamic Update

           END OF ty_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_events IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das zeilenweise Lesen und Verarbeiten eines Protokolls (als String-Tabelle), bis ein bestimmtes Schlüsselwort gefunden wird oder das Ende erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.

CLASS zcl_whl_log_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_log_until_keyword
      IMPORTING
        it_log_lines TYPE string_table
        iv_keyword   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_log_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_log_until_keyword.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_found_keyword) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_log_lines ) AND lv_found_keyword = abap_false.
      READ TABLE it_log_lines INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lv_line).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_line TO rt_processed_lines.
        IF CONTAINS( val = lv_line sub = iv_keyword case = abap_false ).
          lv_found_keyword = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einem Zähler und einer Bedingung einen Statuswert berechnet. Die Berechnung soll in einer `WHILE`-Schleife erfolgen und `COND` sowie `SWITCH` für die Statusbestimmung nutzen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `WHILE`, `COND` und `SWITCH` für moderne Bedingungslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_status TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 initial  TYPE ty_status VALUE 'INITIAL',
                 progress TYPE ty_status VALUE 'PROGRESS',
                 warning  TYPE ty_status VALUE 'WARNING',
                 critical TYPE ty_status VALUE 'CRITICAL',
                 finished TYPE ty_status VALUE 'FINISHED',
               END OF gc_status.

    METHODS calculate_status_iteratively
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_iterations TYPE i
        iv_threshold_warn TYPE i
        iv_threshold_crit TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_status) TYPE ty_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_status_iteratively.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_status) = gc_status-initial.

    WHILE lv_counter < iv_max_iterations AND lv_current_status <> gc_status-finished.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.

      lv_current_status = SWITCH ty_status(
        lv_current_status
        WHEN gc_status-initial THEN
          COND ty_status(
            WHEN lv_counter < iv_threshold_warn THEN gc_status-progress
            WHEN lv_counter >= iv_threshold_warn THEN gc_status-warning
            ELSE gc_status-initial " Should not happen
          )
        WHEN gc_status-progress THEN
          COND ty_status(
            WHEN lv_counter < iv_threshold_warn THEN gc_status-progress
            WHEN lv_counter >= iv_threshold_warn AND lv_counter < iv_threshold_crit THEN gc_status-warning
            WHEN lv_counter >= iv_threshold_crit THEN gc_status-critical
            ELSE gc_status-progress
          )
        WHEN gc_status-warning THEN
          COND ty_status(
            WHEN lv_counter < iv_threshold_crit THEN gc_status-warning
            WHEN lv_counter >= iv_threshold_crit THEN gc_status-critical
            ELSE gc_status-warning
          )
        WHEN OTHERS THEN lv_current_status " Keep status if already critical or finished
      ).

      IF lv_counter >= iv_max_iterations.
        lv_current_status = gc_status-finished.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_final_status = lv_current_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_dyn_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    IF io_parent IS BOUND.
      lo_container = CAST #( io_parent ).
    ELSE.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container
        EXPORTING

      EXPORTING

      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcatalog_line TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Generate field catalog dynamically using FOR and COND
    lt_fieldcatalog = VALUE #( 
      FOR comp IN CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ) )->get_components( )
        LET lv_fieldname = comp-name IN
        ( COND #( 
            WHEN line_exists( it_selected_columns[ table_line = lv_fieldname ] ) THEN
              VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_fieldname coltext = lv_fieldname no_out = abap_false )
            ELSE
              VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_fieldname no_out = abap_true ) " Hide column
          ) )
    ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = it_sflights.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl `N` mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Die Fakultät von 0 ist 1.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die den Zähler herunterzählt und das Ergebnis multipliziert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 0.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             cell_style TYPE lvc_t_styl,
           END OF ty_sflight_alv.
    TYPES tt_sflight_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

      IMPORTING
        io_parent TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_cond_fmt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    IF io_parent IS BOUND.
      lo_container = CAST #( io_parent ).
    ELSE.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_sflights)
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_sflights
        ( VALUE #( 
            ls_raw
            cell_style = COND #( 
              WHEN ls_raw-price > iv_price_threshold THEN
                VALUE lvc_t_styl( ( fieldname = 'PRICE' style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_critical ) )
              ELSE
                VALUE lvc_t_styl( ) 
            )
          ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_conditional_format.
    DATA: ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layo.

    ls_layout-stylefname = 'CELL_STYLE'. " Name of the internal table field containing cell styles

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        is_layout        = ls_layout
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflights.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_remove_substring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_all_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_substring    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_remove_substring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_all_occurrences.
    rv_output_string = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_true.

    WHILE lv_found = abap_true.
      lv_found = abap_false.
      IF CONTAINS( val = rv_output_string sub = iv_substring case = abap_true ).
        rv_output_string = REPLACE( val = rv_output_string sub = iv_substring with = '' occ = 1 ).
        lv_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten eines bestimmten Typs verarbeitet. Die Verarbeitung soll in einer `WHILE`-Schleife erfolgen, die Objekte aus einer 'Puffer'-Tabelle entnimmt und verarbeitet, bis der Puffer leer ist. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Features wie `INSTANCE OF` und `CAST`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `READ TABLE INDEX 1` und `DELETE INDEX 1`. Prüfen Sie den Typ mit `INSTANCE OF` und führen Sie einen `CAST` durch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_process_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_processable.
    METHODS process_object_buffer
      IMPORTING
        it_object_buffer TYPE REF TO object_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_processable.
  METHODS process.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_process_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_processable~process.
    " Dummy implementation for demonstration
    " In a real scenario, this would contain specific object processing logic
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_object_buffer.
    DATA(lt_working_buffer) = it_object_buffer.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_working_buffer ).
      READ TABLE lt_working_buffer INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lo_object).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF lo_object IS INSTANCE OF zcl_process_objects. " Check if it's our own class instance
          TRY.
              DATA(lo_processable) = CAST if_processable( lo_object ).
              lo_processable->process( ).
              rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
            CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
              " Handle cast error if object is not actually processable
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.
        DELETE TABLE lt_working_buffer INDEX lv_index.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Enddatum einer Serie von Terminen, die in festen Intervallen (z.B. alle 7 Tage) stattfinden, beginnend mit einem Startdatum, bis eine maximale Anzahl von Terminen erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und die Datumsfunktion `cl_abap_tstmp=>add` oder `cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>add_days`.

CLASS zcl_whl_date_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_end_date_series
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_interval_days TYPE i
        iv_max_occurrences TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_end_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_date_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_end_date_series.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_occurrence_count) = 0.

    rv_end_date = iv_start_date.

    WHILE lv_occurrence_count < iv_max_occurrences.
      lv_occurrence_count = lv_occurrence_count + 1.
      IF lv_occurrence_count > 1. " Only add interval after the first occurrence
        lv_current_date = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>add_days( 
          days = iv_interval_days
          date = lv_current_date
        ).
      ENDIF.
      rv_end_date = lv_current_date.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_images_by_props.
    DATA: ls_props1 TYPE zcl_img_info_basic=>ty_image_props,
          ls_props2 TYPE zcl_img_info_basic=>ty_image_props.

    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).

    lo_image_info->get_image_info(
      EXPORTING
        iv_image_xstring = iv_image1_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ev_width         = ls_props1-width
        ev_height        = ls_props1-height
        ev_mime_type     = ls_props1-mime_type
    ).

    lo_image_info->get_image_info(
      EXPORTING
        iv_image_xstring = iv_image2_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ev_width         = ls_props2-width
        ev_height        = ls_props2-height
        ev_mime_type     = ls_props2-mime_type
    ).

    IF ls_props1-width    = ls_props2-width AND
       ls_props1-height   = ls_props2-height AND
       ls_props1-mime_type = ls_props2-mime_type.
      rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_img_error_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_image_error_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_error_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_error_info.
    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).
    TRY.
        IF iv_image_xstring IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_fxs_image_info EXPORTING textid = cx_fxs_image_info=>empty_image.
        ENDIF.
        lo_image_info->get_image_info(
          EXPORTING
            iv_image_xstring = iv_image_xstring
        ).
        rv_error_message = 'OK'.
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_image_info).
        CASE lx_image_info->textid.
          WHEN cx_fxs_image_info=>empty_image.
            rv_error_message = 'Fehler: Leeres Bild-XSTRING'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_error_message = |Fehler: Ungültiges Bildformat - { lx_image_info->get_text( ) }|.
        ENDCASE.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container und ermöglichen Sie das dynamische Hinzufügen und Entfernen von Controls (z.B. Buttons) zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` und `FREE` für die Controls und stellen Sie sicher, dass der Parent-Container korrekt gesetzt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_dynamic_controls DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_dynamic_controls_in_dock.
ENDCLASS.

DATA: go_dock_dyn_cont TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container,
      gt_buttons       TYPE TABLE OF REF TO cl_gui_button WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dock_dynamic_controls IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_controls_in_dock.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.

    MODULE pbo_9000 OUTPUT.
      IF go_dock_dyn_cont IS INITIAL.
        CREATE OBJECT go_dock_dyn_cont
          EXPORTING
            repid     = sy-repid
            dynnr     = sy-dynnr
            side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
            extension = 200.

        " Initialer Button
        DATA(lo_button) = NEW cl_gui_button(
          EXPORTING
            parent = go_dock_dyn_cont
            text   = 'Button 1'
        ).
        APPEND lo_button TO gt_buttons.
      ENDIF.
    ENDMODULE.

    MODULE pai_9000 INPUT.
      CASE sy-ucomm.
        WHEN 'ADD_BUTTON'.
          DATA(lv_button_count) = lines( gt_buttons ) + 1.
          DATA(lo_new_button) = NEW cl_gui_button(
            EXPORTING
              parent = go_dock_dyn_cont
              text   = |Button { lv_button_count }|
          ).
          APPEND lo_new_button TO gt_buttons.
          cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Wichtig für sofortige Anzeigeänderungen
        WHEN 'REMOVE_BUTTON'.
          IF gt_buttons IS NOT INITIAL.
            DELETE gt_buttons INDEX lines( gt_buttons ).
            cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
          ENDIF.
        WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANC'.
          LOOP AT gt_buttons INTO DATA(lo_btn).
            FREE lo_btn.
          ENDLOOP.
          FREE go_dock_dyn_cont.
          LEAVE PROGRAM.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDMODULE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie mehrere Felder eines Eintrags in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei die moderne Syntax für Massenupdates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @(internal_table)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_updates TYPE tt_sflight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_data.
    DATA: lv_rows_updated TYPE i.

    IF it_flight_updates IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    UPDATE sflights FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @it_flight_updates.
    lv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.

    IF lv_rows_updated = lines( it_flight_updates ).

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges in SFLIGHTS um einen bestimmten Prozentsatz unter Verwendung eines SQL-Ausdrucks direkt in der `SET`-Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE ... SET price = price * @lv_factor ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_price_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS adjust_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2 " e.g., 10.00 for 10% increase
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_price_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_price.
    DATA: lv_factor TYPE f.

    IF iv_percentage IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_factor = 1 + ( iv_percentage / 100 ).

    UPDATE sflights SET price = price * @lv_factor
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Eintrag in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in einem spezifischen Mandanten, der nicht der aktuelle Mandant ist. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Operation und sollte mit Vorsicht verwendet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... CLIENT SPECIFIED ...` und geben Sie den Zielmandanten an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_cross_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_cross_client
      IMPORTING
        iv_client   TYPE sy-mandt
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cross_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_cross_client.
    DATA: lv_old_client TYPE sy-mandt.

    " Save current client and switch to target client for the operation
    lv_old_client = sy-mandt.
    sy-mandt = iv_client.

    UPDATE sflights CLIENT SPECIFIED SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE mandt = @iv_client
        AND carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    " Restore original client
    sy-mandt = lv_old_client.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Jede Fluggesellschaft soll eine eigene Datenreihe bilden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` und konfigurieren Sie mehrere Datenreihen mit `ADD_SERIES`.
solution:
REPORT z_sflights_line_chart.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 100 AS WINDOW TITLE TEXT-001.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 100.

INITIALIZATION.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT go_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating chart' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    PERFORM display_line_chart.
  ENDIF.

FORM display_line_chart.
  DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
        lt_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_table,
        ls_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_series_table_line,
        lt_data        TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        ls_data        TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_table_line.

  " 1. Daten aggregieren: Durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum
  SELECT carrid, fldate, AVG( seatsocc ) AS avg_seatsocc, AVG( seatsmax ) AS avg_seatsmax
    FROM sflights
    WHERE carrid IN ( 'LH', 'AA' ) " Beispiel für zwei Fluggesellschaften
    GROUP BY carrid, fldate
    ORDER BY carrid, fldate
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

  " 2. Daten für das Chart-Control vorbereiten (mehrere Reihen)
  DATA(lv_current_carrid) = ''.
  LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
    IF ls_agg_data-carrid <> lv_current_carrid.
      IF NOT lt_data IS INITIAL.
        ls_data_series-name = lv_current_carrid.
        ls_data_series-data = lt_data.
        APPEND ls_data_series TO lt_data_series.
        CLEAR lt_data.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_carrid = ls_agg_data-carrid.
    ENDIF.

    ls_data-name = ls_agg_data-fldate.
    ls_data-value = COND #( WHEN ls_agg_data-avg_seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_agg_data-avg_seatsocc / ls_agg_data-avg_seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ).
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_data.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF NOT lt_data IS INITIAL.
    ls_data_series-name = lv_current_carrid.
    ls_data_series-data = lt_data.
    APPEND ls_data_series TO lt_data_series.
  ENDIF.

  " 3. Chart-Typ und Daten setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).
  go_chart->set_series_data( lt_data_series ).

  " 4. Chart-Titel und Achsenbeschriftungen setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugauslastung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Flugdatum' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Auslastung (%)' ).

  " 5. Chart anzeigen
  go_chart->draw_chart( ).
ENDFORM.

        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating chart' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    PERFORM display_chart.
  ENDIF.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'UPDATE_DATA'.
      PERFORM update_and_redraw_chart.
  ENDCASE.

FORM display_chart.
  DATA: lt_data     TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        ls_data     TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_table_line.

  " Daten aggregieren: Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft
  SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
    FROM sflights
    WHERE carrid = @p_carrid
    GROUP BY carrid
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

  LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
    ls_data-name = ls_agg_data-carrid.
    ls_data-value = ls_agg_data-num_flights.
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_data.
  ENDLOOP.

  go_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
  go_chart->set_data( lt_data ).
  go_chart->set_chart_title( |Flüge für { p_carrid }| ).
  go_chart->draw_chart( ).
ENDFORM.

FORM update_and_redraw_chart.
  " Beispiel: Eine UPDATE-Operation, die die Daten beeinflusst
  " Hier simulieren wir eine Änderung, indem wir einen neuen Flug hinzufügen
  DATA: lv_connid TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '9999',
        ld_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE sy-datum.

  DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = p_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = ld_fldate.
  INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = p_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = ld_fldate price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
  COMMIT WORK.

  " Nach der Datenänderung: Chart-Daten neu laden und Diagramm neu zeichnen
  PERFORM display_chart.
ENDFORM.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis und die Währung eines Fluges in `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle, die nur die zu aktualisierenden Felder enthält. Nutzen Sie die moderne Syntax für `UPDATE` mit `SET` und `WHERE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE sflights SET price = @ls_update-price, currency = @ls_update-currency WHERE carrid = @ls_update-carrid ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_selective_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_key_update.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_selective_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_sflight_key_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_selective_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_selective_fields.
    DATA: lv_rows_updated TYPE i.

    IF it_updates IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update).
      UPDATE sflights SET price = @ls_update-price, currency = @ls_update-currency
        WHERE carrid = @ls_update-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_update-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_update-fldate.
      lv_rows_updated = lv_rows_updated + sy-dbcnt.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_rows_updated = lines( it_updates ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Säulendiagramm, das die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt. Das Diagramm soll die Summe der maximalen Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft darstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` mit `co_type_column` und aggregieren Sie `SEATSMAX` pro `CARRID`.
solution:
REPORT z_sflights_column_chart.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 100 AS WINDOW TITLE TEXT-001.

INITIALIZATION.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'

        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.

    CREATE OBJECT go_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container

FORM display_column_chart.

  SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsmax ) AS total_seatsmax

    GROUP BY carrid
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

  go_chart->set_chart_title( 'Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft' ).

  DATA: lt_data     TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,

  " 1. Daten aggregieren: Durchschnittliche Flugdauer pro Fluggesellschaft
  " Annahme: FLTIME ist in Minuten, Umrechnung in Stunden
  SELECT carrid, AVG( fltime ) AS avg_fltime_minutes
    FROM sflights
    GROUP BY carrid
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

  go_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
  go_chart->set_data( lt_data ).

  " 4. Chart-Titel und Achsenbeschriftungen setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugdauer pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Flugdauer (Stunden)' ).

  " 5. Formatierung der Wertachse (z.B. auf zwei Dezimalstellen)
  go_chart->set_value_axis_format( format_string = '0.00' ).

  " 6. Chart anzeigen
  go_chart->draw_chart( ).

      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating chart' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    PERFORM display_stacked_chart.
  ENDIF.

FORM display_stacked_chart.
  DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
        lt_series_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_table,
        ls_series_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_series_table_line,
        lt_occupied_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        lt_free_data     TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        ls_data          TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_table_line.

  " 1. Daten aggregieren: Summe der belegten und freien Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft
  SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsocc ) AS total_seatsocc, SUM( seatsmax ) AS total_seatsmax
    FROM sflights
    GROUP BY carrid
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

  " 2. Daten für das Chart-Control vorbereiten (zwei Reihen: belegt und frei)
  LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
    ls_data-name = ls_agg_data-carrid.
    ls_data-value = ls_agg_data-total_seatsocc.
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_occupied_data.

    ls_data-name = ls_agg_data-carrid.
    ls_data-value = ls_agg_data-total_seatsmax - ls_agg_data-total_seatsocc.
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_free_data.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 3. Erste Datenreihe (belegte Sitze)
  ls_series_data-name = 'Belegte Sitze'.
  ls_series_data-data = lt_occupied_data.
  APPEND ls_series_data TO lt_series_data.

  " 4. Zweite Datenreihe (freie Sitze)
  ls_series_data-name = 'Freie Sitze'.
  ls_series_data-data = lt_free_data.
  APPEND ls_series_data TO lt_series_data.

  " 5. Chart-Typ und Daten setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_stacked_bar ).
  go_chart->set_series_data( lt_series_data ).

  " 6. Chart-Titel und Achsenbeschriftungen setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_title( 'Sitzverteilung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Anzahl Sitze' ).

  " 7. Chart anzeigen
  go_chart->draw_chart( ).
ENDFORM.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` mit `co_type_line`. Aggregieren Sie die durchschnittlichen Preise pro Flugdatum und nutzen Sie zusätzliche Markierungen oder Datenreihen für Extremwerte.
solution:
REPORT z_sflights_price_trend.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 100 AS WINDOW TITLE TEXT-001.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 100.

PARAMETERS: p_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'LH'.

INITIALIZATION.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT go_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating chart' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    PERFORM display_price_trend_chart.
  ENDIF.

FORM display_price_trend_chart.
  DATA: lt_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_table,
        ls_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_series_table_line,
        lt_avg_price_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        lt_max_price_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        lt_min_price_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        ls_data           TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_table_line.

  " 1. Daten aggregieren: Durchschnittlicher Preis pro Flugdatum
  SELECT fldate, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
    FROM sflights
    WHERE carrid = @p_carrid
    GROUP BY fldate
    ORDER BY fldate
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

  IF lt_aggregated_data IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE 'Keine Daten für die ausgewählte Fluggesellschaft gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 2. Daten für das Chart-Control vorbereiten
  DATA(lv_max_price) = -1.0.
  DATA(lv_min_price) = 999999999.0.
  DATA(lv_max_fldate) = ''.
  DATA(lv_min_fldate) = ''.

  LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
    ls_data-name = ls_agg_data-fldate.
    ls_data-value = ls_agg_data-avg_price.
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_avg_price_data.

    IF ls_agg_data-avg_price > lv_max_price.
      lv_max_price = ls_agg_data-avg_price.
      lv_max_fldate = ls_agg_data-fldate.
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_agg_data-avg_price < lv_min_price.
      lv_min_price = ls_agg_data-avg_price.
      lv_min_fldate = ls_agg_data-fldate.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 3. Datenreihen hinzufügen
  " Durchschnittspreis
  ls_series_data-name = 'Durchschnittspreis'.
  ls_series_data-data = lt_avg_price_data.
  APPEND ls_series_data TO lt_data_series.

  " Höchster Preis (als separate Reihe für Hervorhebung)
  CLEAR ls_data.
  ls_data-name = lv_max_fldate.
  ls_data-value = lv_max_price.
  APPEND ls_data TO lt_max_price_data.
  ls_series_data-name = 'Höchster Preis'.
  ls_series_data-data = lt_max_price_data.
  APPEND ls_series_data TO lt_data_series.

  " Niedrigster Preis (als separate Reihe für Hervorhebung)
  CLEAR ls_data.
  ls_data-name = lv_min_fldate.
  ls_data-value = lv_min_price.
  APPEND ls_data TO lt_min_price_data.
  ls_series_data-name = 'Niedrigster Preis'.
  ls_series_data-data = lt_min_price_data.
  APPEND ls_series_data TO lt_data_series.

  " 4. Chart-Typ und Daten setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).
  go_chart->set_series_data( lt_data_series ).

  " 5. Chart-Titel und Achsenbeschriftungen setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_title( |Preisentwicklung für { p_carrid }| ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Flugdatum' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Durchschnittspreis' ).

  " 6. Farben für die Datenreihen setzen
  go_chart->set_series_color( series_index = 1 color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_blue ). " Durchschnitt
  go_chart->set_series_color( series_index = 2 color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_red ).  " Max
  go_chart->set_series_color( series_index = 3 color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_green ). " Min

  " 7. Chart anzeigen
  go_chart->draw_chart( ).
ENDFORM.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein kombiniertes Diagramm (z.B. Balken und Linie), das die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHTS` in einem einzigen Chart darstellt. Nutzen Sie zwei Achsen für unterschiedliche Skalierungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` mit `co_type_combination` und konfigurieren Sie zwei Wertachsen (`SET_VALUE_AXIS_SCALE`).
solution:
REPORT z_sflights_combination_chart.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 100 AS WINDOW TITLE TEXT-001.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 100.

INITIALIZATION.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT go_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating chart' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    PERFORM display_combination_chart.
  ENDIF.

FORM display_combination_chart.
  DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
        lt_series_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_table,
        ls_series_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_series_table_line,
        lt_num_flights_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        lt_avg_occupancy_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table,
        ls_data             TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_table_line.

  " 1. Daten aggregieren: Anzahl Flüge und durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft
  SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights, AVG( seatsocc ) AS avg_seatsocc, AVG( seatsmax ) AS avg_seatsmax
    FROM sflights
    GROUP BY carrid
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

  " 2. Daten für das Chart-Control vorbereiten
  LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
    " Datenreihe 1: Anzahl Flüge (Balken)
    ls_data-name = ls_agg_data-carrid.
    ls_data-value = ls_agg_data-num_flights.
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_num_flights_data.

    " Datenreihe 2: Durchschnittliche Auslastung (Linie)
    ls_data-name = ls_agg_data-carrid.
    ls_data-value = COND #( WHEN ls_agg_data-avg_seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_agg_data-avg_seatsocc / ls_agg_data-avg_seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ).
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_avg_occupancy_data.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 3. Erste Datenreihe (Anzahl Flüge) als Balken
  ls_series_data-name = 'Anzahl Flüge'.
  ls_series_data-data = lt_num_flights_data.
  ls_series_data-chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_column. " Explizit Typ setzen
  ls_series_data-value_axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value. " Erste Wertachse
  APPEND ls_series_data TO lt_series_data.

  " 4. Zweite Datenreihe (Durchschnittliche Auslastung) als Linie
  ls_series_data-name = 'Durchschnittliche Auslastung'.
  ls_series_data-data = lt_avg_occupancy_data.
  ls_series_data-chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line. " Explizit Typ setzen
  ls_series_data-value_axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value_2. " Zweite Wertachse
  APPEND ls_series_data TO lt_series_data.

  " 5. Chart-Typ und Daten setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_combination ).
  go_chart->set_series_data( lt_series_data ).

  " 6. Chart-Titel und Achsenbeschriftungen setzen
  go_chart->set_chart_title( 'Flugübersicht: Flüge & Auslastung' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
  go_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value_2 title = 'Auslastung (%)' ).

  " 7. Skalierung für die zweite Wertachse setzen (z.B. 0-100 für Prozent)
  go_chart->set_value_axis_scale( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value_2 min_value = 0 max_value = 100 ).

  " 8. Chart anzeigen
  go_chart->draw_chart( ).
ENDFORM.
