Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für ein generisches "Tier" mit einer Methode `make_sound`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen, "Hund" und "Katze", die jeweils einen spezifischen Laut ausgeben. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie, indem Sie eine Liste von Tieren durchlaufen und deren `make_sound` Methode aufrufen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACES` und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING ...`. Verwenden Sie `NEW` für Instanziierung und `LOOP AT` für Polymorphie.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_animal.
  METHODS make_sound RETURNING VALUE(rv_sound) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_animal.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_animal~make_sound.
    rv_sound = 'Woof!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_animal.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_animal~make_sound.
    rv_sound = 'Meow!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_animal_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_animal_sound,
             animal_type TYPE string,
             sound       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_animal_sound.
    TYPES: tt_animal_sounds TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_animal_sound WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_animal_sounds
      IMPORTING
        it_animals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_animal
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sounds) TYPE tt_animal_sounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_animal_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_animal_sounds.
    LOOP AT it_animals INTO DATA(lo_animal).
      APPEND VALUE #( animal_type = lo_animal->get_class_name( )
                      sound       = lo_animal->make_sound( ) ) TO rt_sounds.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_animal_sounds FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_animal_sounds.
    DATA: lt_animals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_animal WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW zcl_dog( ) TO lt_animals.
    APPEND NEW zcl_cat( ) TO lt_animals.

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_animal_handler( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_handler->get_animal_sounds( lt_animals ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-sound exp = 'Woof!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-sound exp = 'Meow!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von Interfaces zur Erzielung von Polymorphie. Die `get_animal_sounds` Methode kann mit jeder Klasse arbeiten, die `zif_animal` implementiert, ohne deren konkreten Typ zu kennen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit.
keywords: INTERFACE, Polymorphie, Objektorientierung, CLASS, IMPLEMENTING, NEW, LOOP AT, VALUE

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das Interface `zif_animal` um eine Methode `get_species_info`, die eine Standardimplementierung bereitstellt. Nur spezifische Tierklassen sollen diese Methode überschreiben müssen.

INTERFACE zif_animal_v2.
  METHODS make_sound RETURNING VALUE(rv_sound) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_species_info DEFAULT IGNORE
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zif_animal_v2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_species_info.
    rv_info = 'Unknown species.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dog_v2 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_animal_v2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dog_v2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_animal_v2~make_sound.
    rv_sound = 'Woof!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_animal_v2~get_species_info.
    rv_info = 'Canine species.'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `zif_utility` mit einer statischen Methode `get_current_timestamp`, die den aktuellen Zeitstempel zurückgibt. Demonstrieren Sie den Aufruf dieser statischen Methode direkt über das Interface.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_utility.
  CLASS-METHODS get_current_timestamp RETURNING VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = zif_utility=>get_current_timestamp( ).
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_timestamp TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
            INTO DATE DATA(lv_date) TIME DATA(lv_time).
    rv_formatted_ts = |{ lv_date DATE = USER } { lv_time TIME = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie in einem Interface `zif_message_types` eine Struktur für eine Nachricht und einen Tabellentyp für eine Liste von Nachrichten. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `zcl_message_processor` und verwenden Sie die definierten Typen.

INTERFACE zif_message_types.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
           type    TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           id      TYPE sy-msgid,
           number  TYPE sy-msgno,

  METHOD zif_message_types~add_message.
    APPEND is_message TO mt_messages.

CLASS zcl_range_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Flugverbindungsnummern (`CONNID` aus `SFLIGHT`), die alle geraden Verbindungsnummern zwischen 1 und 100 einschließt. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN RANGE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN RANGE` mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung, um die geraden Zahlen zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_even_connid_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_low  TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_high TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_even_connid_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( FOR i = iv_low THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_high
                        WHERE ( i MOD 2 = 0 )
                        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = |{ i ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_connid_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_connid_in_range.
    DATA(lo_range_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_even_connids) = lo_range_creator->create_even_connid_range( ).

    IF iv_connid IN lt_even_connids.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_for_in_range.
    DATA(lo_range_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_range_creator->create_even_connid_range( iv_low = 1 iv_high = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 5 ).

CLASS zcl_complex_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_price_out_of_bounds_range
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_complex_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_price_out_of_bounds_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 1000
                        WHERE ( i MOD 100 = 0 AND i >= 200 AND i <= 800 )
                        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = i ) ).

    DATA(lo_range_creator) = NEW zcl_complex_range( ).

      rv_is_special = abap_true.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_fixed_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low  TYPE dd07l-domvalue_l,
             text TYPE dd07t-ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.

    METHODS get_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE dd01l-domname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error. " Annahme: cl_reca_ddic_doma wirft diese Ausnahme
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_fixed_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fixed_values.
    DATA: lo_domain TYPE REF TO cl_reca_ddic_doma.
    DATA: lt_dd07l TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07l.
    DATA: lt_dd07t TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07t.

    TRY.
        " Annahme: get_instance ist eine statische Methode, die eine Instanz zurückgibt
        lo_domain = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_instance( iv_domain_name ).
        " Annahme: get_fixed_values gibt DD07L-Einträge zurück
        lt_dd07l = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ).
        " Annahme: get_texts gibt DD07T-Einträge für die Domäne zurück
        lt_dd07t = lo_domain->get_texts( ).

        rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_dd07l IN lt_dd07l
                                   LET ls_dd07t = lt_dd07t[ domvalue_l = ls_dd07l-domvalue_l DEFAULT IS INITIAL ] IN
                                   ( low = ls_dd07l-domvalue_l,
                                     text = ls_dd07t-ddtext ) ).
    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle von Integern.

CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    TRY.
        rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count. " DIVIDE operator
    CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_length_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_length_calc IMPLEMENTATION.

    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error EXPORTING previous = lx_dyn_error.
    CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflights` den prozentualen Anteil ihrer Flüge an der Gesamtzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und den `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_percentage,
             carrid     TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             percentage TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_percentage.
    TYPES: tt_flight_percentages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_percentage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_percentages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_percentages) TYPE tt_flight_percentages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_percentages.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    rt_percentages = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) 
      ( carrid       = <group>-carrid
        flight_count = lines( <group> )
        percentage   = COND p( WHEN lv_total_flights > 0 THEN ( ( lines( <group> ) * 100 ) / lv_total_flights ) ELSE 0 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_percentages FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflights_scenario FOR TESTING. " Umbenannt für Klarheit
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_percentages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_percentage( ).
    DATA(lt_percentages) = lo_cut->get_flight_percentages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Percentages should not be initial if sflights has data' act = lt_percentages IS NOT INITIAL ).

    " Annahme: sflights enthält Daten, sodass die Gesamtsumme 100% ergibt
    DATA(lv_total_percentage) = REDUCE p( INIT s = 0 FOR p_entry IN lt_percentages NEXT s = s + p_entry-percentage ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total percentage should be 100' act = lv_total_percentage exp = 100.00 ).

    " Beispielprüfung für eine spezifische Fluggesellschaft (z.B. LH)
    DATA(ls_lh_percentage) = lt_percentages[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_percentage IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH percentage should not be zero' act = ls_lh_percentage-percentage IS NOT INITIAL ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflights_scenario.
    " Dieser Test würde normalerweise ein Mocking der Datenbanktabelle sflights erfordern.
    " Da dies hier nicht direkt möglich ist, wird der Test die Methode aufrufen und prüfen,
    " ob bei leeren sflights eine leere Tabelle zurückgegeben wird.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_percentage( ).
    " Um sflights als leer zu simulieren, müsste die Tabelle vor dem SELECT geleert oder gemockt werden.
    " Hier wird nur der Fall geprüft, dass die Methode bei initialer Rückgabe korrekt reagiert.
    DATA(lt_percentages) = lo_cut->get_flight_percentages( ).
    IF lt_percentages IS INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Percentages should be initial if sflights is empty' act = lt_percentages ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und dem `VALUE` Operator, um Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle zu aggregieren und prozentuale Anteile zu berechnen. Der `DIVIDE` Operator wird innerhalb einer `COND` Expression sicher verwendet, um Division durch Null zu vermeiden.

CLASS zcl_math_let_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_let_divide IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gewichteten Durchschnitt einer Liste von Werten, wobei jeder Wert ein Gewicht hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe der Produkte und die Summe der Gewichte zu bilden, und anschließend den `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_weighted_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_value,
             value  TYPE f,
             weight TYPE f,
           END OF ty_weighted_value.
    TYPES: tt_weighted_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_weighted_values TYPE tt_weighted_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_average) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_weighted_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_weighted_average.
    IF it_weighted_values IS INITIAL.
      rv_weighted_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_sums) = REDUCE ty_weighted_value(
      INIT s = VALUE ty_weighted_value( value = 0 weight = 0 )
      FOR wv IN it_weighted_values
      NEXT s = VALUE ty_weighted_value( value = s-value + ( wv-value * wv-weight )
                                        weight = s-weight + wv-weight )
    ).

    IF ls_sums-weight <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.

    rv_weighted_average = ls_sums-value / ls_sums-weight. " DIVIDE operator
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Modulo (Rest einer Division) zweier positiver ganzer Zahlen ohne den `MOD`-Operator, indem Sie Division und Truncierung verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `DIVIDE` Operator und die Funktion `TRUNC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_modulo_trunc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_modulo
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modulo) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_modulo_trunc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_modulo.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    " Modulo = Numerator - ( TRUNC(Numerator / Denominator) * Denominator )
    rv_modulo = iv_numerator - ( TRUNC( iv_numerator / iv_denominator ) * iv_denominator ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, in der jeder Wert der ursprünglichen Tabelle durch einen konstanten Divisor geteilt wird.

CLASS zcl_itab_divide_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_and_divide
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_divisor TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_divided_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

CLASS zcl_itab_divide_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.

    rt_divided_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers ( number / iv_divisor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die 'Dichte' der Festwerte einer Domäne, indem Sie die Anzahl der Festwerte durch eine theoretische maximale Anzahl (z.B. 100) teilen. Das Ergebnis soll als Prozentsatz ausgegeben werden. Nehmen Sie an, dass die Klasse `cl_reca_ddic_doma` Methoden zum Abrufen von Domäneninformationen bereitstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_instance()` und den `DIVIDE` Operator. Nutzen Sie `lines()` für die Anzahl der Festwerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_fixed_value_density DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_density
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE dd01l-domname
        iv_max_values  TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_density_percent) TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_fixed_value_density IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_density.
    DATA: lo_domain TYPE REF TO cl_reca_ddic_doma.
    DATA: lt_dd07l TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07l.
    DATA(lv_fixed_value_count) = 0.

    TRY.
        lo_domain = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_instance( iv_domain_name ).
        lt_dd07l = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ). " Annahme: Diese Methode existiert
        lv_fixed_value_count = lines( lt_dd07l ).

        IF iv_max_values <= 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
        ENDIF.

        rv_density_percent = ( lv_fixed_value_count / iv_max_values ) * 100.
    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error EXPORTING previous = lx_dyn_error.
    CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING previous = lx_arith_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid )
      ( 
        carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid,
        total_price = SUM( <fs_group>-price )

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft, aber zeige nur die Fluggesellschaften an, deren Gesamtsumme der Preise über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt (z.B. 10000).
hint: Verwende `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `HAVING` für die Filterung nach der Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sum_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_total_price_by_carrier,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_total_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_total_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_total_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_value_carriers
      IMPORTING iv_min_total_price TYPE sflight-price DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_total_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_value_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid )
      HAVING SUM( <fs_group>-price ) > iv_min_total_price
      ( 
        carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid,
        total_price = SUM( <fs_group>-price )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_high_value_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_value_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_sum_having( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_value_carriers( iv_min_total_price = 50000 ). " Use a higher threshold for better test

    " Assert that the result is not empty (assuming some carriers exceed 50000)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check if all returned carriers indeed have a total price > 50000
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-total_price > 50000 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `HAVING`-Klausel in der `FOR GROUPS OF`-Expression ermöglicht die Filterung von Gruppen *nachdem* die Aggregation (hier `SUM`) stattgefunden hat. Dies ist analog zur SQL-`HAVING`-Klausel und bietet eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, aggregierte Daten in modernem ABAP zu analysieren.
keywords: GROUP BY, SUM, HAVING, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, sflights, Post-Aggregation Filtering

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sum_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_total_price_by_carrier,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_total_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_total_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_total_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier_reduce
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_total_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier_reduce.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = REDUCE tt_total_price_by_carrier(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_total_price_by_carrier( )
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_total_price_by_carrier( BASE result
        ( carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid
          total_price = SUM( <fs_group>-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier_reduce( ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_result-total_price > 0 ).

explanation: Die Kombination von `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF` bietet eine sehr flexible und funktionale Möglichkeit, komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen. `REDUCE` iteriert über die Gruppen und baut schrittweise das Endergebnis auf, was eine hohe Kontrolle über den Aggregationsprozess ermöglicht.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( <fs_group>-seatsocc >= iv_min_passengers )
      GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid connid = <fs_group>-connid )
      ( 
        carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid,

        total_price = SUM( <fs_group>-price )

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft und erstelle eine Map, die die Fluggesellschaft als Schlüssel und die Gesamtsumme als Wert enthält.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und einer `HASHED TABLE` oder `MAP` als Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sum_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_total_price_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-price WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_total_price_map_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_total_price_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_map_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = REDUCE ty_total_price_map(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_total_price_map( )
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid )
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_total_price_map( BASE result
        ( <fs_group>-carrid = SUM( <fs_group>-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer, aber nur für die Top 3 der teuersten Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwende `FOR GROUPS OF` und `SUM` in Kombination mit `SORT` und `UP TO` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sum_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES: tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_sum_by_group
      IMPORTING iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_sum_by_group.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid connid = <fs_group>-connid )
      ( 
        carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid,
        connid      = <fs_group>-connid,
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum_price = 0
          FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP <fs_group> ASCENDING BY price
          " Sort ascending and take last N for top N, or sort descending and take first N
          " For simplicity, let's sort descending and take first N
          " This requires a temporary sorted table or a more complex REDUCE
          " A more direct approach for TOP N within groups is not directly supported by SUM() on FOR GROUPS OF
          " So, we simulate it with REDUCE and a sorted sub-selection.
          DATA(lt_sorted_group) = VALUE tt_sflight_data( FOR <item> IN GROUP <fs_group> ( <item> ) ).
          SORT lt_sorted_group BY price DESCENDING.
          FOR <fs_top_flight> IN lt_sorted_group UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
            NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_top_flight>-price
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top_n_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_n_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_sum_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_sum_by_group( iv_top_n = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    " Check if 'LH' '0400' exists and has a positive total price for its top 2 flights
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-total_price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Aggregation, bei der innerhalb jeder Gruppe nur die `N` höchsten Werte summiert werden. Dies wird durch eine Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und einer verschachtelten `REDUCE`-Expression erreicht, die die Elemente jeder Gruppe sortiert und dann die Top `N` summiert. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität und Ausdrucksstärke von modernem ABAP für komplexe Datenanalysen.
keywords: GROUP BY, SUM, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, TOP N, Internal Tables, sflights, Complex Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus Daten einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und geben Sie es als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_empty`, `create_node`, `set_value` und `display`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flights_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_empty( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_node( iv_name = 'Flights' iv_type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
    lo_xml_document->set_root( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node( iv_name = 'Flight' iv_type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      DATA(lo_carrid) = lo_xml_document->create_node( iv_name = 'Carrid' iv_type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_carrid->set_value( ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_carrid ).

      DATA(lo_connid) = lo_xml_document->create_node( iv_name = 'Connid' iv_type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_connid->set_value( ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_connid ).

      DATA(lo_fldate) = lo_xml_document->create_node( iv_name = 'Fldate' iv_type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_fldate->set_value( |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ). " Modern string template for date
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_fldate ).

      DATA(lo_price) = lo_xml_document->create_node( iv_name = 'Price' iv_type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_price->set_value( |{ ls_flight-price }| ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_price ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = lo_xml_document->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_xml.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_xml_creator=>ty_flights_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_xml_creator( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_creator->create_flights_xml( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xml msg = 'XML string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flights>' msg = 'XML should contain root node' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight>' msg = 'XML should contain Flight nodes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Carrid>LH</Carrid>' msg = 'XML should contain LH carrid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Price>250.50</Price>' msg = 'XML should contain 250.50 price' ).

Es beginnt mit einem leeren Dokument, fügt einen Root-Knoten hinzu und iteriert dann über eine interne Tabelle, um für jeden Eintrag Kindknoten zu erstellen. Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und extrahieren Sie alle Flugnummern (`connid`) von Flügen mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert, unter Verwendung von XPath.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_with_string` und `select_nodes` mit einem geeigneten XPath-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_min_price  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_flights.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lv_xpath) = |//Flight[Price > { iv_min_price }]/Connid|. " Modern string template for XPath

    DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xml_document->select_nodes( lv_xpath ).

    LOOP AT lo_node_list->get_nodes( ) INTO DATA(lo_node).
      APPEND lo_node->get_value( ) TO rt_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie einen XML-String, ändern Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges und fügen Sie ein neues Attribut zu einem Knoten hinzu. Geben Sie das modifizierte XML als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_node_by_path`, `set_value` und `set_attribute`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_connid     TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price  TYPE sflight-price
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_attribute_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).

    DATA(lv_xpath_flight) = |//Flight[Connid='{ iv_connid }']|.
    DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( lv_xpath_flight ).

    IF lo_flight_node IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_price_node) = lo_flight_node->get_node_by_path( 'Price' ).
      IF lo_price_node IS BOUND.
        lo_price_node->set_value( |{ iv_new_price }| ).
      ENDIF.

      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( iv_name = iv_attribute_name iv_value = iv_attribute_value ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_modified_xml = lo_xml_document->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Parsen eines syntaktisch inkorrekten XML-Strings mit `cl_xml_document`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahme `cx_xml_parse_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        ev_error_message = lx_parse_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_xml.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Valid XML</item></data>`.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_xml_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_handler->parse_with_error_handling(
                               iv_xml_string = lv_xml
                               EXPORTING ev_error_message = DATA(lv_error) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Valid XML should parse successfully' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_error msg = 'No error message expected for valid XML' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_xml.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Invalid XML</item>`. " Missing closing tag
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_xml_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_handler->parse_with_error_handling(
                               iv_xml_string = lv_xml
                               EXPORTING ev_error_message = DATA(lv_error) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Invalid XML should fail parsing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_error msg = 'Error message expected for invalid XML' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_error exp = 'XML' msg = 'Error message should contain "XML"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die korrekte Fehlerbehandlung beim Parsen von XML. Die Methode `create_with_string` kann die Ausnahme `cx_xml_parse_error` auslösen, wenn der Eingabe-XML-String syntaktisch inkorrekt ist. Ein `TRY...CATCH`-Block fängt diese Ausnahme ab und ermöglicht eine robuste Verarbeitung.
keywords: XML, Error Handling, Exception, cl_xml_document, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_docking_container` und betten Sie einen `cl_gui_alv_grid` ein, um Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_docking_container=>create` und `cl_gui_alv_grid=>create`. Beachten Sie, dass für die tatsächliche Anzeige ein Dynpro benötigt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_in_docking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_alv_in_docking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension = 500. " Example extension

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_docking_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT' " Use structure name for field catalog generation
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = it_flights
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_alv_grid.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_docking_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das Beispiel des `cl_gui_docking_container` um die Behandlung eines ALV-Ereignisses (z.B. Doppelklick auf eine Zeile).

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mv_last_clicked_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tt.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column.

    METHODS free_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension = 500.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_docking_container.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = it_flights
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA: ls_row_id TYPE lvc_s_row.
    DATA: ls_fcat   TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lv_value  TYPE string.

    ls_row_id-row_id = e_row.
    mo_alv_grid->get_selected_cells_id(
      EXPORTING
        i_row_id = ls_row_id
      IMPORTING
        e_col_id = DATA(ls_col_id)
    ).

    IF ls_col_id-fieldname IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv_grid->get_cell_value(
        EXPORTING
          i_row_id    = ls_row_id-row_id
          i_fieldname = 'CARRID'
        IMPORTING
          e_value     = lv_value
      ).
      mv_last_clicked_carrid = lv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_alv_grid.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_docking_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_docking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_dock_left  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_dock_right TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_textedit_left TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_textedit_right TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.

    METHODS set_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text_left  TYPE string
        iv_text_right TYPE string.

    METHODS get_text_left
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_text_right
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS free_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_docking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_dock_left
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 300.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_dock_right
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_right
        extension = 300.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit_left
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_dock_left.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit_right
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_dock_right.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_text.
    IF mo_textedit_left IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit_left->set_text_as_stream( iv_text_left ).
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_textedit_right IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit_right->set_text_as_stream( iv_text_right ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text_left.
    IF mo_textedit_left IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit_left->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING e_text_stream = rv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text_right.
    IF mo_textedit_right IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit_right->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING e_text_stream = rv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_textedit_left IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit_left->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_textedit_left.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_textedit_right IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit_right->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_textedit_right.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_dock_left IS BOUND.
      mo_dock_left->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_dock_left.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_dock_right IS BOUND.
      mo_dock_right->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_dock_right.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_docking_container` und einen `cl_gui_textedit` darin. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, um den Text aus dem Texteditor zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_text_as_stream` des `cl_gui_textedit`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_textedit          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.

    METHODS set_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string.

    METHODS get_text
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS free_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension = 400.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_docking_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING e_text_stream = rv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_textedit.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      mo_docking_container->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_docking_container` und einen `cl_gui_splitter_container` darin, um den Bereich weiter aufzuteilen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_splitter_container=>create` und betten Sie es in den Docking Container ein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_in_docking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_splitter_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_alv_top           TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_alv_bottom        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_top    TYPE zcl_alv_in_docking=>ty_sflight_tt
        it_flights_bottom TYPE zcl_alv_in_docking=>ty_sflight_tt.

    METHODS free_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_in_docking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension = 800.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter_container
      EXPORTING
        parent  = mo_docking_container
        rows    = 2
        columns = 1.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_top
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_splitter_container->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_bottom
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_splitter_container->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights.
    IF mo_alv_top IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_top->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = it_flights_top
      ).
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_alv_bottom IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_bottom->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = it_flights_bottom
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_alv_top IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_top->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_alv_top.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_alv_bottom IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_bottom->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_alv_bottom.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_splitter_container IS BOUND.
      mo_splitter_container->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_splitter_container.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      mo_docking_container->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_splitter_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_multiple_alvs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_splitter_creation.
    DATA(lo_splitter_display) = NEW zcl_splitter_in_docking( iv_repid = sy-repid iv_dynnr = sy-dynnr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_splitter_display->mo_docking_container msg = 'Docking container should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_splitter_display->mo_splitter_container msg = 'Splitter container should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_splitter_display->mo_alv_top msg = 'Top ALV should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_splitter_display->mo_alv_bottom msg = 'Bottom ALV should be created' ).
    lo_splitter_display->free_objects( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_multiple_alvs.
    DATA: lt_flights_top TYPE zcl_alv_in_docking=>ty_sflight_tt,
          lt_flights_bottom TYPE zcl_alv_in_docking=>ty_sflight_tt.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data_top)
      UP TO 1 ROWS.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data_bottom)
      SKIP 1 UP TO 1 ROWS.
    lt_flights_top = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_data_top ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) ) ).
    lt_flights_bottom = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_data_bottom ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) ) ).

    DATA(lo_splitter_display) = NEW zcl_splitter_in_docking( iv_repid = sy-repid iv_dynnr = sy-dynnr ).
    lo_splitter_display->display_flights( it_flights_top = lt_flights_top it_flights_bottom = lt_flights_bottom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_splitter_display->mo_alv_top msg = 'Top ALV should still be bound after display' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_splitter_display->mo_alv_bottom msg = 'Bottom ALV should still be bound after display' ).
    lo_splitter_display->free_objects( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung eines `cl_gui_splitter_container` innerhalb eines `cl_gui_docking_container`, um den verfügbaren Bereich weiter in mehrere Unterbereiche aufzuteilen. In jedem dieser Unterbereiche kann dann ein weiteres GUI-Control (hier zwei `cl_gui_alv_grid` Instanzen) platziert werden. Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung komplexer und gut strukturierter Benutzeroberflächen.
keywords: GUI, Splitter Container, Docking Container, Layout, Multiple Controls, cl_gui_docking_container, cl_gui_splitter_container

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

           END OF ty_sflight.

      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight

      UP TO 2 ROWS. "Limit for example

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflights pretty_print = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_struct( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"CARRIER_ID":"LH","CONNECTION":400,"FLIGHT_DATE":"2025-11-25"}`.
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->deserialize_flight_json( lv_json ).

Die Feldnamen im JSON-String müssen dabei den Feldnamen der ABAP-Struktur entsprechen (Groß-/Kleinschreibung wird standardmäßig ignoriert, aber Großbuchstaben sind Konvention).

Instructions: Erstelle eine benutzerdefinierte Klasse mit Attributen, die eine interne Tabelle enthält, und serialisiere eine Instanz dieser Klasse in einen JSON-String.
hint: Stelle sicher, dass die Attribute der Klasse öffentlich sind, damit `/ui2/cl_json` darauf zugreifen kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_complex_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_item,
             item_id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_booking_item.
    TYPES tt_booking_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA: booking_id TYPE i,
          customer_name TYPE string,
          booking_date TYPE d,
          items TYPE tt_booking_items.

    METHODS constructor FINAL
      IMPORTING
        iv_booking_id TYPE i
        iv_customer_name TYPE string
        iv_booking_date TYPE d.

    METHODS add_item FINAL
      IMPORTING
        iv_item_id TYPE i
        iv_description TYPE string
        iv_quantity TYPE i.

    METHODS serialize_to_json FINAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_complex_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->booking_id = iv_booking_id.
    me->customer_name = iv_customer_name.
    me->booking_date = iv_booking_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_item.
    APPEND VALUE ty_booking_item( item_id = iv_item_id description = iv_description quantity = iv_quantity ) TO me->items.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD serialize_to_json.
    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = me pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_complex FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_complex.
    DATA(lo_booking) = NEW zcl_json_complex_object(
      iv_booking_id = 1001
      iv_customer_name = 'Max Mustermann'
      iv_booking_date = sy-datum
    ).
    lo_booking->add_item( iv_item_id = 1 iv_description = 'Laptop' iv_quantity = 1 ).
    lo_booking->add_item( iv_item_id = 2 iv_description = 'Mouse' iv_quantity = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_booking->serialize_to_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain booking_id' substring = 'BOOKING_ID' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain customer_name' substring = 'CUSTOMER_NAME' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain items' substring = 'ITEMS' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain Laptop' substring = 'Laptop' in_string = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Serialisierung eines komplexen Objekts, das auch interne Tabellen enthält, funktioniert mit `/ui2/cl_json` nahtlos, solange die zu serialisierenden Attribute öffentlich sind. Die Klasse wird als `FINAL` deklariert, um die Objektstruktur zu fixieren.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, Object Orientation, Complex Object, Internal Tables, /ui2/cl_json, FINAL, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstelle eine einfache Utility-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die eine Berechnung durchführt, und markiere die Klasse und die Methode als `FINAL`.

CLASS zcl_math_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE. "CREATE PRIVATE for utility class
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      add_numbers FINAL
        IMPORTING
          iv_num1 TYPE i
          iv_num2 TYPE i
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_numbers.
    DATA(lv_sum) = zcl_math_utils=>add_numbers( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum should be 8' act = lv_sum exp = 8 ).

    lv_sum = zcl_math_utils=>add_numbers( iv_num1 = -10 iv_num2 = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum should be 10' act = lv_sum exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aggregiere Flugdaten (z.B. Gesamtkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft) aus `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und serialisiere das Ergebnis dann in JSON.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` um eine interne Tabelle mit aggregierten Daten zu erstellen, die dann serialisiert werden kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_reduce_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_capacity,
             carrier TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
             total_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_and_serialize FINAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_reduce_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_serialize.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. "Limit for example

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_carrier_capacity(
      INIT lt_result = VALUE tt_carrier_capacity( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_index = sy-tabix IN
      " Check if carrier already exists in result table
      DATA(ls_existing) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrier = ls_flight-carrid DEFAULT VALUE ty_carrier_capacity( ) ]
      IN
      IF ls_existing IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_capacity(
          carrier = ls_flight-carrid
          total_capacity = ls_flight-seatsmax
          total_occupied = ls_flight-seatsocc
        ) TO lt_result.
      ELSE.
        MODIFY TABLE lt_result FROM VALUE ty_carrier_capacity(
          carrier = ls_flight-carrid
          total_capacity = ls_existing-total_capacity + ls_flight-seatsmax
          total_occupied = ls_existing-total_occupied + ls_flight-seatsocc
        ) TRANSPORTING total_capacity total_occupied WHERE carrier = ls_flight-carrid.
      ENDIF.
      RESULT lt_result
    ).

    IF lt_aggregated_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_aggregated_data pretty_print = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling FINAL
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string CHANGING data = ls_data ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle the error, e.g., log it
        cl_demo_output=>display( |JSON Parse Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Catch any other potential errors
        cl_demo_output=>display( |General Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deserialisiere einen JSON-String in ein dynamisch erzeugtes Datenobjekt, wenn der genaue Typ zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.
hint: Verwende `CREATE DATA` mit `HANDLE` und `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_deserialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS deserialize_dynamic_json FINAL
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      IMPORTING iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'ZCL_JSON_DYNAMIC_DESERIALIZE=>TY_DYNAMIC_DATA'
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_deserialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_dynamic_json.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_data>.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string CHANGING data = <fs_data> ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Error creating data object: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        CLEAR ro_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |JSON Parse Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        CLEAR ro_data.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |General Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
        CLEAR ro_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) in ein XSTRING und dekomprimieren Sie ihn zurück in eine Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die interne Tabelle zuerst in ein XSTRING (z.B. mit `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_xstring_from_table`) bevor Sie `CL_ABAP_GZIP` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_table) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA(lo_gzip) = NEW cl_abap_gzip( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_table) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_xstring_from_table( it_original_table ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lo_gzip->compress_xtext(
          EXPORTING
            xtext  = lv_xstring_table
          IMPORTING
            xtext  = lv_compressed_xstring
        ).

        lo_gzip->decompress_xtext(
          EXPORTING
            xtext  = lv_compressed_xstring
          IMPORTING
            xtext  = lv_decompressed_xstring
        ).

        rt_decompressed_table = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_table_from_xstring(
                                  iv_xstring = lv_decompressed_xstring
                                  it_table_type = it_original_table ).

      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error cx_abap_conv_x2x_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_s_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

        iv_currency  TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE ty_t_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE price > iv_min_price AND currency = iv_currency ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise für Flüge einer bestimmten Währung aus der Tabelle `sflights` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator. Verwenden Sie eine lokal definierte Struktur mit `BEGIN OF` für die Zwischenergebnisse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_s_flight_price.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE ty_t_flight_price.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, currency
      FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine große Menge an Textdaten in mehreren Schritten (chunks) und dekomprimieren Sie diese wieder. Simulieren Sie dies mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `compress_chunk` und `decompress_chunk` von `CL_ABAP_GZIP` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_chunk_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_and_decompress_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_long_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_text) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_chunk_size TYPE i VALUE 100.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_chunk_data,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
             data   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_chunk_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_chunk_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_chunks.
    DATA(lo_gzip_compress) = NEW cl_abap_gzip( ).
    DATA(lo_gzip_decompress) = NEW cl_abap_gzip( ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_total) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_decompressed_total) TYPE string.

    DO.
      DATA(lv_chunk) = substring( val = iv_long_text off = ( sy-index - 1 ) * gc_chunk_size len = gc_chunk_size ).
      IF lv_chunk IS INITIAL.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_compressed_chunk) TYPE xstring.
      lo_gzip_compress->compress_chunk(
        EXPORTING
          text   = lv_chunk
        IMPORTING
          xtext  = lv_compressed_chunk
      ).
      lv_compressed_total = lv_compressed_total && lv_compressed_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    lo_gzip_compress->finish_compress(
      IMPORTING
        xtext = DATA(lv_final_compress_chunk)
    ).
    lv_compressed_total = lv_compressed_total && lv_final_compress_chunk.

    DO.
      DATA(lv_decompressed_chunk) TYPE string.
      lo_gzip_decompress->decompress_chunk(
        EXPORTING
          xtext  = lv_compressed_total
        IMPORTING
          text   = lv_decompressed_chunk
          offset = DATA(lv_offset)
      ).
      IF lv_decompressed_chunk IS INITIAL AND lv_offset = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_decompressed_total = lv_decompressed_total && lv_decompressed_chunk.
      lv_compressed_total = lv_compressed_total+lv_offset.
    ENDDO.

    lo_gzip_decompress->finish_decompress(
      IMPORTING
        text = DATA(lv_final_decompress_chunk)
    ).
    rv_decompressed_text = lv_decompressed_total && lv_final_decompress_chunk.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Komprimierung von Daten vor einer HTTP-Anfrage und die Dekompression nach einer HTTP-Antwort mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_GZIP` für die Komprimierung des Request-Bodys und die Dekompression des Response-Bodys.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_http_simulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_http_payload,
             request_data  TYPE string,
             compressed_request TYPE xstring,
             response_data TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_http_payload.

    METHODS simulate_http_transfer
      IMPORTING
        iv_request_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_payload) TYPE ty_s_http_payload.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_http_simulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_http_transfer.
    DATA(lo_gzip) = NEW cl_abap_gzip( ).

    rs_payload-request_data = iv_request_text.

    " 1. Komprimierung des Request-Bodys
    TRY.
        lo_gzip->compress_text(
          EXPORTING
            text   = iv_request_text
          IMPORTING
            xtext  = rs_payload-compressed_request
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        rs_payload-response_data = |Request Compression Error: { lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) }|.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Simulation der HTTP-Übertragung (hier: einfach den komprimierten Request als Response verwenden)
    DATA(lv_simulated_response_xstring) = rs_payload-compressed_request.

    " 3. Dekompression des Response-Bodys
    TRY.
        lo_gzip->decompress_xtext(
          EXPORTING
            xtext  = lv_simulated_response_xstring
          IMPORTING
            xtext  = DATA(lv_decompressed_xtext)
        ).
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xtext(
          EXPORTING
            xtext = lv_decompressed_xtext
          IMPORTING
            text = rs_payload-response_data
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO lx_gzip_error.
        rs_payload-response_data = |Response Decompression Error: { lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_http_simulation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_http_simulation.
    DATA(lv_original_data) = `{"user":"testuser","action":"fetchdata","params":{"id":"123"}}`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_http_simulation( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->simulate_http_transfer( lv_original_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-response_data exp = lv_original_data msg = 'Dekomprimierte Antwort sollte dem Original-Request entsprechen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-compressed_request LENGTH 0 msg = 'Komprimierter Request sollte nicht leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht, wie `CL_ABAP_GZIP` zur Optimierung der Datenübertragung in HTTP-Szenarien eingesetzt werden kann. Der Request-Body wird vor dem Senden komprimiert und der Response-Body nach dem Empfang dekomprimiert. Dies reduziert die übertragene Datenmenge und verbessert die Performance. Die Struktur `ty_s_http_payload` (mit `BEGIN OF`) kapselt die verschiedenen Datenzustände. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hier entscheidend.
keywords: GZIP, HTTP, Data Transfer, Kompression, Dekompression, CL_ABAP_GZIP, BEGIN OF, XSTRING

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine lange Log-Nachricht mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP` und dekomprimieren Sie sie zur Anzeige. Verwenden Sie eine lokal definierte Struktur mit `BEGIN OF` für die Log-Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_GZIP` für die Komprimierung und Dekompression. Definieren Sie eine Struktur für Log-Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_log_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message_id TYPE string,
             compressed_log TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_s_log_entry.
    TYPES: ty_t_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_and_retrieve_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_s_log_entry.

    METHODS decompress_log_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_log_entry TYPE ty_s_log_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_log_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_and_retrieve_log.
    DATA(lo_gzip) = NEW cl_abap_gzip( ).

    rs_log_entry-timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( ).
    rs_log_entry-message_id = 'APP_LOG_001'.

    TRY.
        lo_gzip->compress_text(
          EXPORTING
            text   = iv_message
          IMPORTING
            xtext  = rs_log_entry-compressed_log
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        rs_log_entry-compressed_log = 'Error during compression'X.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_log_entry.
    DATA(lo_gzip) = NEW cl_abap_gzip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_gzip->decompress_text(
          EXPORTING
            xtext  = is_log_entry-compressed_log
          IMPORTING
            text   = rv_decompressed_message
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        rv_decompressed_message = |Decompression Error: { lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_compression.
    DATA(lv_long_log_message) = `[2023-11-25 10:00:00] INFO: User 'JOHN.DOE' executed report 'Z_REPORT_FINANCE' with parameters 'P_BUKRS=1000, P_GJAHR=2023'. Data processed: 10000 records. Duration: 120ms. Memory used: 50MB. All operations successful. This is a very long log message to test compression.`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_log_compress( ).

    DATA(ls_compressed_log) = lo_cut->add_and_retrieve_log( lv_long_log_message ).

Bei Bedarf können die Nachrichten dann dekomprimiert und angezeigt werden. Die Struktur `ty_s_log_entry` (mit `BEGIN OF`) definiert das Format der Log-Einträge.
