             old_name  TYPE string,
             old_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_raw_data,
           ty_t_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY,

           BEGIN OF ty_s_transformed_data,
             new_identifier TYPE string,
             new_amount     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_transformed_data,

CLASS zcl_json_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).

    lo_parser->parse_json_to_data( iv_json_string = iv_json_string io_data_ref = REF #( lt_raw_data ) ).

    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR <ls_raw> IN lt_raw_data

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_string IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_string( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = 'Hello, ABAP Zip!'.
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'hello.txt'.
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->compress_string(
      iv_content  = lv_content

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Erstelle ein ZIP-Archiv, das mehrere Textdateien mit unterschiedlichen Inhalten enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` und rufen Sie `add` für jede Datei auf. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Dateiliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_compress_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_content,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_content,
           tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_content WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_multiple_files
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_multiple_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      lo_zip->add(
        EXPORTING
          i_name    = ls_file-name
          i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( ls_file-content )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zip( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_multi.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_multi( ).
    DATA(lt_files) = VALUE zcl_zip_compress_multi=>tt_file_content(
      ( name = 'file1.txt' content = 'Content of file 1' )
      ( name = 'file2.log' content = 'Log entry 1' )
      ( name = 'file3.xml' content = '<data><item>3</item></data>' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->compress_multiple_files( lt_files ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_zip_xstring
      msg = 'ZIP xstring sollte nicht initial sein'
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_read->load( lv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_extracted_files) = lo_zip_read->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_extracted_files )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Sollte drei Dateien enthalten'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_files INTO DATA(ls_original_file).
      DATA(lv_extracted_xstring) = lo_zip_read->get( ls_original_file-name ).
      DATA(lv_extracted_string) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_in( input = lv_extracted_xstring )->read( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_extracted_string
        exp = ls_original_file-content
        msg = |Inhalt von { ls_original_file-name } sollte übereinstimmen|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere alle Dateien aus einem gegebenen ZIP-Archiv (als XSTRING) und gib deren Namen und Inhalte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip=>get_files` und iterieren Sie über die Dateiliste. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Ergebnisliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_extract_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_extracted_file,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_extracted_file,
           tt_extracted_files TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_file WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_all_files
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extracted_files) TYPE tt_extracted_files
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_extract_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_zip_files) = lo_zip->get_files( ).

    rt_extracted_files = VALUE #( FOR ls_zip_file IN lt_zip_files
                                  LET lv_xcontent = lo_zip->get( ls_zip_file-name )
                                      lv_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_in( input = lv_xcontent )->read( )
                                  IN ( name = ls_zip_file-name content = lv_content ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_all FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_empty_zip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_all.
    DATA(lo_compressor) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_multi( ).
    DATA(lt_original_files) = VALUE zcl_zip_compress_multi=>tt_file_content(
      ( name = 'doc1.txt' content = 'First document content.' )
      ( name = 'report.log' content = 'Log data line 1' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_compressor->compress_multiple_files( lt_original_files ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_extract_all( ).
    DATA(lt_extracted_files) = lo_cut->extract_all_files( lv_zip_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_extracted_files )
      exp = lines( lt_original_files )
      msg = 'Anzahl der extrahierten Dateien sollte dem Original entsprechen'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_original_files INTO DATA(ls_original).
      READ TABLE lt_extracted_files INTO DATA(ls_extracted) WITH KEY name = ls_original-name.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
        act = sy-subrc
        exp = 0
        msg = |Datei { ls_original-name } nicht in der extrahierten Liste gefunden|
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_extracted-content
        exp = ls_original-content
        msg = |Inhalt von { ls_original-name } sollte übereinstimmen|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_empty_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip_empty) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_zip_xstring) = lo_zip_empty->get_zip( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_extract_all( ).
    DATA(lt_extracted_files) = lo_cut->extract_all_files( lv_empty_zip_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_extracted_files
      msg = 'Sollte eine leere Liste für ein leeres ZIP-Archiv zurückgeben'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_files` von `cl_abap_zip` liefert eine Liste aller im Archiv enthaltenen Dateien. Durch Iteration über diese Liste und den Aufruf von `get` für jede Datei können alle Inhalte extrahiert werden. Die Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `VALUE` und `LET` ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, eine neue interne Tabelle zu füllen.

Instructions: Initialisiere das Control Framework und erstelle einen Custom Container, der als Eltern für GUI-Steuerelemente dienen kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` und `cl_gui_custom_container`. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine Dynpro-Umgebung erfordert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_custom_container
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
    METHODS destroy_container
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_custom_container.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde dies aus einem PBO-Modul aufgerufen werden
    " und iv_container_name wäre der Name eines Custom Control Bereichs auf einem Screen.
    ro_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      i_container_name = iv_container_name
      i_lifetime       = cl_gui_control=>lifetime_dynpro
    ).
    " Flush ist entscheidend, um Frontend und Backend zu synchronisieren
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD destroy_container.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD io_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS = 3.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      ENDIF.
      FREE io_container.
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_destroy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_destroy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_cfw_init( ).
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'MY_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lo_container) = lo_cut->create_custom_container( lv_container_name ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = lo_container
      msg = 'Custom Container sollte erstellt werden'
    ).

    lo_cut->destroy_container( lo_container ).
    " Hinweis: assert_unbound funktioniert nicht immer zuverlässig direkt nach FREE,
    " da die Referenz erst später vom Garbage Collector freigegeben wird.
    " Die korrekte Freigabe der Ressourcen ist jedoch initiiert.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Initialisierung des Control Frameworks erfolgt implizit bei der Erstellung des ersten GUI-Steuerelements. `cl_gui_custom_container` ist die Basisklasse für Container, die auf einem Dynpro platziert werden. `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` ist entscheidend, um die Kommunikation zwischen Backend und Frontend zu synchronisieren. Die `FREE`-Methode ist für die ordnungsgemäße Freigabe von Ressourcen unerlässlich.
keywords: cl_gui_cfw, cl_gui_custom_container, GUI, Control Framework, Flush, Dynpro

Instructions: Registriere einen Event-Handler für ein hypothetisches GUI-Steuerelement-Ereignis. Dies demonstriert die Event-Behandlung im Control Framework.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_event_reg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_bsp_event_handler.
    DATA mv_event_handled TYPE abap_bool READ-ONLY.

    METHODS register_event_handler
      IMPORTING
        io_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_some_event FOR EVENT some_event OF cl_gui_control.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_event_reg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_event_handler.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde io_control ein konkretes Steuerelement sein,
    " z.B. cl_gui_alv_grid oder cl_gui_textedit.
    " Hier wird cl_gui_control als Platzhalter verwendet.
    SET HANDLER handle_some_event FOR io_control.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_some_event.
    " Dieses Event würde ausgelöst, wenn 'some_event' des Steuerelements auftritt.
    mv_event_handled = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_bsp_event_handler~on_event.
    " Implementierung für Web Dynpro / BSP, hier nicht relevant für reines CFW.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_cfw_event_reg( ).
    " Erstellen eines Dummy-Steuerelements für den Test.
    " In der Realität wäre dies ein echtes GUI-Steuerelement.
    DATA(lo_dummy_control) = NEW cl_gui_control( ).

    lo_cut->register_event_handler( lo_dummy_control ).

    " Da wir kein echtes GUI-Steuerelement haben, können wir das Event nicht auslösen.
    " Der Test prüft nur, ob die Registrierung ohne Fehler erfolgt.
    " Ein realer Test würde das Event simulieren oder in einer GUI-Umgebung laufen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lo_cut->mv_event_handled
      msg = 'Event sollte noch nicht behandelt worden sein (nicht ausgelöst)'
    ).

    " Aufräumen
    CALL METHOD lo_dummy_control->free
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    FREE lo_dummy_control.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Event-Behandlung im Control Framework basiert auf dem ABAP Objects Event-Modell. Mit `SET HANDLER` wird eine Methode einer lokalen Klasse als Event-Handler für ein bestimmtes Ereignis eines GUI-Steuerelements registriert. Dies ermöglicht eine reaktive Programmierung, bei der das Backend auf Frontend-Interaktionen reagiert.

Instructions: Demonstriere die Synchronisation des Control Frameworks zwischen Frontend und Backend mittels `flush` und die Fehlerbehandlung dabei.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_flush DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS perform_flush
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_flush IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_flush.
    TRY.
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_frontend_error INTO DATA(lx_frontend_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        MESSAGE lx_frontend_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle ein ZIP-Archiv mit einer verschachtelten Ordnerstruktur und Dateien darin.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` und geben Sie Dateinamen mit Pfadangaben an (z.B. 'folder/subfolder/file.txt').
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_nested_folders DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_entry,
             path    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_entry,
           tt_file_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_zip_with_folders
      IMPORTING
        it_file_entries TYPE tt_file_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_nested_folders IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_with_folders.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    LOOP AT it_file_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      lo_zip->add(
        EXPORTING
          i_name    = ls_entry-path
          i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( ls_entry-content )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zip( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_nested_zip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_zip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_nested_folders( ).
    DATA(lt_entries) = VALUE zcl_zip_nested_folders=>tt_file_entries(
      ( path = 'root/file1.txt' content = 'Content of file 1 in root' )
      ( path = 'root/folderA/file2.txt' content = 'Content of file 2 in folder A' )
      ( path = 'root/folderA/folderB/file3.txt' content = 'Content of file 3 in folder B' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->create_zip_with_folders( lt_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_zip_xstring
      msg = 'ZIP xstring sollte nicht initial sein'
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_read->load( lv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_extracted_files) = lo_zip_read->get_files( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_extracted_files )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Sollte drei Dateien enthalten'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_entries INTO DATA(ls_original_entry).
      DATA(lv_extracted_xstring) = lo_zip_read->get( ls_original_entry-path ).
      DATA(lv_extracted_string) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_in( input = lv_extracted_xstring )->read( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_extracted_string
        exp = ls_original_entry-content
        msg = |Inhalt von { ls_original_entry-path } sollte übereinstimmen|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `add`-Methode von `cl_abap_zip` interpretiert Pfadangaben im Dateinamen automatisch und erstellt die entsprechende Ordnerstruktur innerhalb des ZIP-Archivs. Dies ermöglicht die einfache Erstellung komplexer Archivstrukturen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Dateiliste ist eine moderne ABAP-Praxis.
keywords: cl_abap_zip, ZIP, Ordnerstruktur, Verschachtelt, Pfadangabe, VALUE

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die prüft, ob das Control Framework aktiv ist, und reagiere entsprechend.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_is_active DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_cfw_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_active) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_is_active IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_cfw_status.
    rv_is_active = cl_gui_cfw=>is_active( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cfw_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cfw_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_cfw_is_active( ).
    DATA(lv_is_active) = lo_cut->check_cfw_status( ).

    " In einer reinen Backend-Unit-Test-Umgebung ist das Control Framework normalerweise nicht aktiv.
    " Wenn ein GUI-Control erstellt wird, wird es aktiv.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_is_active
      msg = 'Control Framework sollte im Unit-Test nicht aktiv sein'
    ).

    " Optional: Erstellen eines Controls, um den Status zu ändern (nicht empfohlen für Unit-Tests)
    " DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( i_container_name = 'TEST' ).
    " lv_is_active = lo_cut->check_cfw_status( ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_active ).
    " CALL METHOD lo_container->free.
    " FREE lo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die statische Methode `cl_gui_cfw=>is_active` gibt zurück, ob das Control Framework derzeit aktiv ist. Dies ist nützlich, um Code bedingt auszuführen, der GUI-Steuerelemente verwendet, oder um zu prüfen, ob eine GUI-Umgebung verfügbar ist. In einer reinen Backend-Umgebung (wie einem Unit-Test) ist es in der Regel `FALSE`.
keywords: cl_gui_cfw, GUI, Status, is_active, Bedingte Logik

Instructions: Aktualisiere den Inhalt einer bereits im ZIP-Archiv vorhandenen Datei oder füge eine neue hinzu, falls sie nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip=>add` mit der Option `i_replace = abap_true`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_update_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_or_add_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string
        iv_new_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_update_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_or_add_file.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).

    lo_zip->add(
      EXPORTING
        i_name    = iv_filename
        i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_new_content )
        i_replace = abap_true " Wichtig: Vorhandene Datei ersetzen
    ).

    rv_updated_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zip( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_existing_file FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_new_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing_file.
    DATA(lo_initial_zip) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_string( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_content) = 'Original content'.
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'test.txt'.
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_initial_zip->compress_string( lv_initial_content, lv_filename ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_update_file( ).
    DATA(lv_new_content) = 'Updated content'.
    DATA(lv_updated_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->update_or_add_file(
      iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring
      iv_filename    = lv_filename
      iv_new_content = lv_new_content
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_read->load( lv_updated_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_extracted_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_in( input = lo_zip_read->get( lv_filename ) )->read( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_extracted_content
      exp = lv_new_content
      msg = 'Inhalt der Datei sollte aktualisiert sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_new_file.
    DATA(lo_initial_zip) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_string( ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_initial_zip->compress_string( 'dummy', 'dummy.txt' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_update_file( ).
    DATA(lv_new_filename) = 'new_file.txt'.
    DATA(lv_new_content) = 'Content of new file'.
    DATA(lv_updated_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->update_or_add_file(
      iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring
      iv_filename    = lv_new_filename
      iv_new_content = lv_new_content
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_read->load( lv_updated_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_zip_read->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_files )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Sollte zwei Dateien enthalten'
    ).

    DATA(lv_extracted_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_in( input = lo_zip_read->get( lv_new_filename ) )->read( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_extracted_content
      exp = lv_new_content
      msg = 'Inhalt der neuen Datei sollte korrekt sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `add`-Methode von `cl_abap_zip` kann nicht nur neue Dateien hinzufügen, sondern auch bestehende Dateien aktualisieren, wenn der Parameter `i_replace` auf `abap_true` gesetzt ist. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Manipulation von ZIP-Archiven, ohne sie komplett neu erstellen zu müssen.
keywords: cl_abap_zip, ZIP, Aktualisieren, Ersetzen, i_replace

Instructions: Verwende die Methode `set_application_title` des Control Frameworks, um den Titel des SAP-Fensters zu ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_cfw=>set_application_title`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_set_title DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_window_title
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_set_title IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_window_title.
    TRY.
        cl_gui_cfw=>set_application_title( iv_title ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_title FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_title.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_cfw_set_title( ).
    DATA(lv_new_title) = 'Mein neuer Fenstertitel'.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_window_title( lv_new_title ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Fenstertitel sollte erfolgreich gesetzt werden'
    ).
    " Der tatsächliche Fenstertitel kann in einem Unit-Test nicht direkt überprüft werden,
    " da kein echtes Frontend vorhanden ist. Der Test prüft nur die Ausführung ohne Fehler.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die statische Methode `cl_gui_cfw=>set_application_title` ermöglicht es, den Titel des aktuellen SAP-Fensters zu ändern. Dies ist eine nützliche Funktion, um dem Benutzer kontextbezogene Informationen im Fenstertitel anzuzeigen. Ein `flush` ist erforderlich, um die Änderung an das Frontend zu übertragen.
keywords: cl_gui_cfw, GUI, Fenstertitel, set_application_title, UI-Anpassung

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine einfache ABAP-Struktur in einen JSON-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer` und `write_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_simple_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS serialize_data
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_simple_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_data.
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer( ).
    lo_json_writer->write_data( is_data ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit geschachtelten Strukturen in einen JSON-Array.

solution:

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_nested FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_serialize_nested.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_nested_serialize( ).
    DATA(lt_orders) = VALUE zcl_json_nested_serialize=>tt_orders(

        )
      )

    ).

explanation: Die `cl_fdt_json` Klasse kann komplexe ABAP-Datenstrukturen, einschließlich geschachtelter interner Tabellen, direkt in einen validen JSON-String serialisieren. Dies vereinfacht den Datenaustausch erheblich.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen einfachen JSON-String in eine ABAP-Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create_json_reader` und `read_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_simple_deserialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS deserialize_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_simple_deserialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_data.
    DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_reader( iv_json_string ).
    lo_json_reader->read_data( CHANGING cs_data = rs_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_deserialize_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_fdt_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_simple_deserialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"ID":1,"NAME":"Test"}' .
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_data( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-name exp = 'Test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_simple_deserialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"ID":"invalid","NAME":"Test"}' . "Invalid type for ID
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = lo_cut->deserialize_data( lv_json )
      exp_class = 'CX_FDT_JSON_ERROR'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deserialisierung mit `cl_fdt_json` ist ebenfalls typsicher. Der `create_json_reader` liest den JSON-String, und `read_data` füllt die ABAP-Struktur automatisch, wobei Typkonflikte als Exception behandelt werden.
keywords: JSON, Deserialization, cl_fdt_json, Data Conversion, Error Handling

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 Zufallszahlen vom Typ Float innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs (z.B. 10.0 bis 20.0).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float=>create` und skalieren Sie das Ergebnis von `get_next`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_float_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_floats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_random_floats_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_min    TYPE f
        iv_max    TYPE f
        iv_count  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_floats) TYPE tt_floats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_float_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_floats_in_range.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_range) = iv_max - iv_min.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND ( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_range ) + iv_min TO rt_floats.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_floats_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_floats_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_float_range( ).
    DATA(lt_floats) = lo_cut->get_random_floats_in_range( iv_min = 10.0 iv_max = 20.0 iv_count = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_floats ) exp = 3 ).
    LOOP AT lt_floats INTO DATA(lv_float).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_float >= 10.0 AND lv_float < 20.0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch Skalierung des Ergebnisses von `get_next` (das im Bereich [0, 1) liegt) kann man Zufallszahlen in jedem beliebigen Float-Bereich generieren. Eine Schleife füllt eine interne Tabelle mit den gewünschten Werten.
keywords: Random, Float, Range, Math, cl_abap_random_float, Internal Tables

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Sequenz von Zufallszahlen, die bei gleichem Startwert (Seed) immer identisch ist, um Reproduzierbarkeit zu gewährleisten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float=>create` mit dem Parameter `i_seed`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_float_seeded DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_floats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_seeded_random_floats
      IMPORTING
        iv_seed   TYPE i
        iv_count  TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_floats) TYPE tt_floats.

CLASS zcl_random_float_seeded IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seeded_random_floats.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( i_seed = iv_seed ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie Flugverspätungen für Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung von Zufallszahlen. Die Verspätung soll zwischen 0 und 60 Minuten liegen.
hint: Lesen Sie `SFLIGHT`, generieren Sie Zufallszahlen und wenden Sie diese an. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_delay DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_delay,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             delay_min TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_delay,
           tt_flight_delays TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_delay WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS simulate_delays
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_delay_min TYPE i DEFAULT 60
        iv_seed          TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_delays) TYPE tt_flight_delays.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_delay IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_delays.
    DATA lo_random TYPE REF TO cl_abap_random_float.
    IF iv_seed IS SUPPLIED.
      lo_random = cl_abap_random_float=>create( i_seed = iv_seed ).
    ELSE.
      lo_random = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      UP TO 10 ROWS. "Limit for example

    rt_delays = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
                         ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
                           connid    = ls_flight-connid
                           fldate    = ls_flight-fldate
                           delay_min = CONV i( lo_random->get_next( ) * iv_max_delay_min ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen Booleschen Wert (wahr/falsch) basierend auf einer Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 70% wahr).
hint: Vergleichen Sie die generierte Zufallszahl mit der gewünschten Wahrscheinlichkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_boolean DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_boolean
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability_true TYPE f " e.g., 0.7 for 70% true
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_boolean) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_boolean IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_boolean.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    IF lo_random->get_next( ) < iv_probability_true.
      rv_boolean = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_boolean = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_boolean FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_boolean.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_boolean( ).
    DATA(lv_true_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 1000.
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->get_random_boolean( iv_probability_true = 0.7 ) = abap_true.
        lv_true_count = lv_true_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    " Assert that the count is roughly within expected range (e.g., 650-750 for 70% probability)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_true_count >= 650 AND lv_true_count <= 750 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur, die leere Felder oder Initialwerte enthält, und stellen Sie sicher, dass diese Felder nicht im resultierenden JSON-String erscheinen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer` und die Option `omit_initial_values`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_omit_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS serialize_omit_initial
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_omit_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_omit_initial.
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer( ).
    lo_json_writer->set_omit_initial_values( abap_true ).
    lo_json_writer->write_data( is_data ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_omit_initial FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_omit_initial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_omit_initial( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_json_omit_initial=>ty_data( id = 1 name = 'Test' value = '0.0' ). "Value is initial for decfloat16
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_omit_initial( ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_json
      exp = '{"ID":1,"NAME":"Test"}'
    ).

    DATA(ls_data_full) = VALUE zcl_json_omit_initial=>ty_data( id = 2 name = 'Full' value = '10.5' status = 'Active' ).
    DATA(lv_json_full) = lo_cut->serialize_omit_initial( ls_data_full ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_json_full
      exp = '{"ID":2,"NAME":"Full","VALUE":10.5,"STATUS":"Active"}'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `set_omit_initial_values` des JSON-Writers ist nützlich, um den JSON-Output zu bereinigen und nur relevante Daten zu übertragen. Felder mit Initialwerten (z.B. 0 für numerische Typen, leere Strings) werden dabei weggelassen.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, Omit Initial, cl_fdt_json, Data Filtering

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zufallszahlen vom Typ Integer innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs (z.B. 1 bis 100).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float=>create`, skalieren Sie das Ergebnis und konvertieren Sie es in einen Integer.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_integer_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_integers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_random_integers_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_min    TYPE i
        iv_max    TYPE i
        iv_count  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_integers) TYPE tt_integers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_integer_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_integers_in_range.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_range) = iv_max - iv_min + 1. " +1 to include iv_max
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND CONV i( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_range ) + iv_min TO rt_integers.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_integers_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_integers_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_integer_range( ).
    DATA(lt_integers) = lo_cut->get_random_integers_in_range( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 iv_count = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_integers ) exp = 10 ).
    LOOP AT lt_integers INTO DATA(lv_integer).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_integer >= 1 AND lv_integer <= 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von zufälligen Flugdaten (Flugnummer, Datum, Verspätung) für Testzwecke, ohne auf die `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle zuzugreifen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random_float` für numerische Werte und String-Templates für IDs. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             delay_min TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_seed   TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_flights.
    DATA lo_random TYPE REF TO cl_abap_random_float.
    IF iv_seed IS SUPPLIED.
      lo_random = cl_abap_random_float=>create( i_seed = iv_seed ).
    ELSE.
      lo_random = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                               LET lv_rand_float = lo_random->get_next( ) IN
                               ( carrid    = |AA{ CONV i( lo_random->get_next( ) * 10 ) }|
                                 connid    = CONV s_conn_id( 100 + CONV i( lo_random->get_next( ) * 900 ) )
                                 fldate    = lv_current_date + CONV i( lo_random->get_next( ) * 30 ) " Random date within next 30 days
                                 delay_min = CONV i( lv_rand_float * 120 ) ) ). " Delay up to 120 min
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_sflight_range_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES`-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschafts-IDs und filtern Sie `SFLIGHTS`.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_from_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_from_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_carrids.
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      FOR <carrid> IN it_carrids
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <carrid> )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid.

    cl_demo_output=>display( lr_carrid ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( rt_flights ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplätze für Flüge, die einer bestimmten `RANGES`-Tabelle entsprechen, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und der `RANGES`-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_seats_by_carrier_range
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_seats_by_carrier_range.
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = iv_carrid )
    ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <flight> IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid IN lr_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + <flight>-seatsocc
    ).

    cl_demo_output=>display( |Total seats for { iv_carrid } (filtered by range): { rv_total_seats }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_seats_by_carrier_range( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of seats for LH should be 250' act = lv_sum exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und einer `RANGES`-Tabelle können komplexe Aggregationen mit dynamischen Filterkriterien sehr kompakt und effizient ausgedrückt werden. `cl_demo_output` zeigt das Ergebnis.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer `RANGES`-Tabelle für die Fluggesellschaft und einer weiteren `RANGES`-Tabelle für die Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei separate `RANGES`-Tabellen in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_range_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_multi_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_pattern TYPE string
        iv_connid_low     TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_connid_high    TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_range_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_multi_range.
    DATA: lr_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid,
          lr_connid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    " Range for CARRIER (e.g., starts with pattern)
    lr_carrid = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = iv_carrid_pattern ) ).

    " Range for CONNECTION ID (e.g., between two values)
    lr_connid = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = iv_connid_low high = iv_connid_high ) ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid
        AND connid IN @lr_connid.

    cl_demo_output=>display( |Flights filtered by carrier pattern '{ iv_carrid_pattern }' and connid between { iv_connid_low } and { iv_connid_high }| ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( rt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multi_range_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_range_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_range_select( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has data for LH and AA, and connids like '0017', '0400', '0401'
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_multi_range( iv_carrid_pattern = 'L%' iv_connid_low = '0400' iv_connid_high = '0499' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for L% and 0400-0499' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights found for L% and 0400-0499' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier should start with L' act = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid CP 'L*' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connid should be between 0400 and 0499' act = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-connid GE '0400' AND ls_flight-connid LE '0499' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie mehrere `RANGES`-Tabellen gleichzeitig in der `WHERE`-Klausel eines `SELECT`-Statements verwendet werden können, um komplexe Filterbedingungen zu realisieren. Die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression wird für die einfache Befüllung der Ranges genutzt. `cl_demo_output` hilft bei der Visualisierung der gefilterten Daten.
keywords: RANGES, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, Multiple Criteria, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES`-Tabelle dynamisch, wobei Einträge nur unter bestimmten Bedingungen hinzugefügt werden, und verwenden Sie diese zum Filtern.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `COND` oder `IF` innerhalb des `VALUE`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_cond_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_carrid_status.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_active_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_statuses TYPE tt_carrid_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cond_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_active_carriers.
    DATA(lr_active_carrids) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      FOR <status> IN it_carrier_statuses
      WHERE ( <status>-is_active = abap_true )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <status>-carrid )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @lr_active_carrids.

    cl_demo_output=>display( |Active carriers in range: | ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( lr_active_carrids ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Flights for active carriers:| ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( rt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cond_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cond_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_cond_range( ).
    DATA: lt_statuses TYPE zcl_dynamic_cond_range=>tt_carrid_status.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_statuses.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' is_active = abap_false ) TO lt_statuses.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_statuses.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_active_carriers( lt_statuses ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for active carriers' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights found for active carriers' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier should be LH or UA' act = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'UA' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Carrier should not be AA' act = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FOR ... IN ... WHERE`-Syntax innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Expression, um eine `RANGES`-Tabelle bedingt zu füllen. Nur Einträge, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen (hier: `is_active = abap_true`), werden in die Range aufgenommen. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und dynamische Erstellung von Selektionskriterien. `cl_demo_output` visualisiert die erstellte Range und die gefilterten Flüge.
keywords: RANGES, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Conditional Logic, Dynamic Programming, SFLIGHTS, cl_demo_output

CLASS zcl_complex_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_data_with_complex_range
      IMPORTING
        it_all_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_data_with_complex_range.
    DATA(lr_filter) = VALUE RANGE OF i(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 10 )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 20 high = 30 )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 25 ) " Exclude 25 from the BT range
    ).

    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_all_data WHERE id IN lr_filter ).

    cl_demo_output=>display( |Complex Range:| ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( lr_filter ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Filtered Data:| ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( rt_filtered_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_complex_range_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_range_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_range_filter( ).
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_complex_range_filter=>tt_data.

    DO 50 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( id = sy-index value = |Value { sy-index }| ) TO lt_test_data.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_data_with_complex_range( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should contain 10, 20-24, 26-30' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 16 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain ID 10' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ id = 10 ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain ID 20' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ id = 20 ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should not contain ID 25' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ id = 25 ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain ID 30' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ id = 30 ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Flexibilität von `RANGES`-Tabellen, indem es verschiedene Selektionsoptionen (`EQ`, `BT`, `EXCLUDE`) kombiniert. Der `FILTER`-Operator wird verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle effizient mit dieser komplexen Range zu filtern. `cl_demo_output` hilft, die erstellte Range und die gefilterten Daten zu überprüfen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES`-Tabelle dynamisch aus einer Liste von Strings, die sowohl einzelne Werte als auch Muster enthalten können, und filtern Sie damit eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` und `COND` um die `OPTION` ('EQ' oder 'CP') basierend auf dem String-Inhalt zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_pattern_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_data_by_dynamic_patterns
      IMPORTING
        it_patterns TYPE tt_string
        it_all_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_pattern_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_data_by_dynamic_patterns.
    DATA(lr_filter) = VALUE RANGE OF string(
      FOR <pattern> IN it_patterns
      ( sign = 'I'
        option = COND string(
          WHEN <pattern> CP '*%' OR <pattern> CP '%*' THEN 'CP'
          ELSE 'EQ' )
        low = <pattern> )
    ).

    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_all_data WHERE text IN lr_filter ).

    cl_demo_output=>display( |Dynamic Pattern Range:| ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( lr_filter ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Filtered Data:| ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( rt_filtered_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_pattern_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_pattern_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_pattern_range( ).
    DATA: lt_patterns TYPE zcl_dynamic_pattern_range=>tt_string.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_pattern_range=>tt_data.

    APPEND 'Apple' TO lt_patterns.
    APPEND 'Bana*' TO lt_patterns.
    APPEND '%erry' TO lt_patterns.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Apple' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Banana' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 text = 'Cherry' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 text = 'Orange' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 5 text = 'Blueberry' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_data_by_dynamic_patterns( it_patterns = lt_patterns it_all_data = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should contain 4 items' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain Apple' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ text = 'Apple' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain Banana' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ text = 'Banana' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain Cherry' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ text = 'Cherry' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain Blueberry' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ text = 'Blueberry' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should not contain Orange' act = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered[ text = 'Orange' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene dynamische Erstellung einer `RANGES`-Tabelle. Es verwendet `FOR ... IN` und eine `COND`-Expression, um die `OPTION` ('EQ' für exakte Übereinstimmung, 'CP' für Mustervergleich) basierend auf dem Inhalt des Eingabestrings zu bestimmen. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Filterung, die sowohl feste Werte als auch Wildcard-Muster verarbeiten kann. `cl_demo_output` visualisiert die erstellte Range und die gefilterten Daten.
keywords: RANGES, Dynamic Programming, COND, FOR, FILTER, Internal Tables, cl_demo_output

solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA lt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Get carriers starting with 'LH'
    SELECT carrid FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_carriers WHERE carrid LIKE 'LH%'.

    IF lt_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @lt_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS und kategorisieren Sie den Preis direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung als 'Low', 'Medium' oder 'High' basierend auf Schwellenwerten. Nutzen Sie eine `CASE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END` direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_cat,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_price_cat.
    METHODS get_categorized_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_cat WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CASE
             WHEN price < 200 THEN 'Low'
             WHEN price >= 200 AND price < 500 THEN 'Medium'
             ELSE 'High'
           END AS price_category
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_categorization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_category( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).

    " Assuming some data exists in SFLIGHTS for testing
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      IF ls_flight-price < 200.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Low' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price >= 200 AND ls_flight-price < 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Medium' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'High' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Expression direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten auf Datenbankebene. Dies ist effizient, da die Logik direkt im SQL ausgeführt wird und keine nachträgliche Verarbeitung in ABAP erforderlich ist.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, Database Access, SQL Expression

CLASS zcl_flight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_carrier_flight_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_info.
    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_info) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_flight_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    SELECT sc~carrid, sc~carrname, COUNT(sf~carrid) AS flight_count
      FROM scarr AS sc
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflight AS sf ON sc~carrid = sf~carrid
      GROUP BY sc~carrid, sc~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_carrier_flight_count( ).
    DATA(lt_info) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flight_counts( ).

    " Assert that all carriers from SCARR are present, even if flight_count is 0
    DATA(lv_scarr_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scarr INTO @lv_scarr_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_info ) exp = lv_scarr_count ).

    " Check a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH')
    READ TABLE lt_info INTO DATA(ls_lh_info) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_info-carrname ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` ist ideal, um Daten aus zwei Tabellen zu verknüpfen, wobei alle Zeilen der linken Tabelle beibehalten werden, auch wenn keine Übereinstimmung in der rechten Tabelle gefunden wird. Die Aggregatfunktion `COUNT` wird verwendet, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln.
keywords: SELECT, JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, COUNT, Database Access

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für 'Shape' mit einer abstrakten Methode zur Berechnung der Fläche. Implementieren Sie dann zwei konkrete Unterklassen 'Circle' und 'Rectangle', die diese Methode implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Klasse und die Methode. Unterklassen müssen die abstrakte Methode überschreiben (`REDEFINITION`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: get_name ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string,
             calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS: get_name REDEFINITION,
             calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Circle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.1415926535'. " Pi approximation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat34 iv_width TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS: get_name REDEFINITION,
             calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width  = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Rectangle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shapes.
    DATA: lo_circle    TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_shape,
          lo_rectangle TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_shape.

    lo_circle = NEW zcl_concrete_circle( iv_radius = '5.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle->get_name( ) exp = 'Circle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle->calculate_area( ) exp = '78.5398163375' ). " 5*5*PI

    lo_rectangle = NEW zcl_concrete_rectangle( iv_length = '4.0' iv_width = '6.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_rectangle->get_name( ) exp = 'Rectangle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_rectangle->calculate_area( ) exp = '24.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Abstrakte Klassen und Methoden erzwingen eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle und Verhaltensweise für abgeleitete Klassen, ohne eine vollständige Implementierung in der Basisklasse bereitzustellen. Dies fördert Polymorphie und eine saubere Architektur.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Inheritance

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Abstract Factory Pattern für die Erstellung von 'Document' Objekten (z.B. 'TextDocument', 'PdfDocument'). Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Factory und konkrete Implementierungen.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Factory-Klasse mit einer abstrakten Methode zur Erzeugung von Dokumenten. Jede konkrete Factory implementiert diese Methode, um spezifische Dokumenttypen zu erzeugen.
solution:
" Interface for Document
INTERFACE zif_document PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

" Concrete Text Document
CLASS zcl_text_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_document IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

" Concrete PDF Document (simplified)
CLASS zcl_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_data = iv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

" Abstract Document Factory
CLASS zcl_abstract_doc_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_doc_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    " Simulate binary data from string input
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( iv_input ).
    ro_document = NEW zcl_pdf_document( iv_data = lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory.
    DATA: lo_text_factory TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_doc_factory,
          lo_pdf_factory  TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_doc_factory,
          lo_document     TYPE REF TO zif_document.

    lo_text_factory = NEW zcl_text_doc_factory( ).
    lo_document = lo_text_factory->create_document( 'Hello Text' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_document->get_content( ) exp = 'Hello Text' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lo_document IS INSTANCE OF zcl_text_document ) ).

    lo_pdf_factory = NEW zcl_pdf_doc_factory( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_document->get_content( ) exp = 'PDF Content (binary data not shown)' ).
