  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Abstract Factory Pattern ermöglicht die Erstellung von Familien verwandter oder abhängiger Objekte, ohne deren konkrete Klassen angeben zu müssen. Abstrakte Klassen und Interfaces sind hierbei entscheidend für die Definition der Schnittstellen und die Entkopplung der Implementierungen.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Factory Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Interface

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse 'Logger' mit einer konkreten Methode zum Formatieren von Nachrichten und einer abstrakten Methode zum Senden der formatierten Nachricht. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Unterklasse 'ConsoleLogger'.
hint: Die abstrakte Klasse kann sowohl konkrete als auch abstrakte Methoden haben. Abstrakte Methoden müssen in nicht-abstrakten Unterklassen implementiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: log ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string,
             format_message IMPORTING iv_raw_message TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_timestamp TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_message.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD mv_timestamp.
    rv_formatted_message = |{ mv_timestamp TIMESTAMP = ISO } - { iv_raw_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_logger FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log.
    DATA(lv_formatted_message) = format_message( iv_raw_message = iv_message ).
    " In a real scenario, this would write to console/sy-list
    cl_demo_output=>display( lv_formatted_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_test_message) = 'Test message for console logger'.

    " Redirect cl_demo_output for testing purposes or mock it
    " For simplicity, we'll just call it and assert on the formatted message structure
    " A real test would capture the output of cl_demo_output
    lo_logger->log( lv_test_message ).

    " Since cl_demo_output is hard to capture in a unit test, we use a placeholder assertion.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Abstrakte Klassen können eine Mischung aus vollständigen und unvollständigen Implementierungen bieten. Die konkrete Methode `format_message` bietet eine Standardfunktionalität, während `log` von Unterklassen spezifisch implementiert werden muss, um die formatierten Nachrichten zu verarbeiten.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Logging

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern für einen 'Report Generator'. Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse mit einer Template-Methode, die den Ablauf der Berichterstellung festlegt, und abstrakten Methoden für spezifische Schritte (z.B. 'get_data', 'format_data'). Erstellen Sie eine konkrete Implementierung für einen 'Simple Report'.
hint: Die Template-Methode ist eine konkrete Methode in der abstrakten Klasse, die abstrakte 'Hook'-Methoden aufruft, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_output) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS: get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table,
             format_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = get_data( ).
    rv_report_output = format_data( it_raw_data = lt_raw_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_report_generator FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: get_data REDEFINITION,
             format_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    " Simulate data retrieval
    APPEND 'Line 1: Some data' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Line 2: More data' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD format_data.
    rv_formatted_data = '--- Simple Report ---' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    LOOP AT it_raw_data INTO DATA(lv_line).
      rv_formatted_data = rv_formatted_data && lv_line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_formatted_data = rv_formatted_data && '--- End of Report ---'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simple_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simple_report.
    DATA(lo_report_gen) = NEW zcl_simple_report_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_report) = lo_report_gen->generate_report( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_report) =
      '--- Simple Report ---' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
      'Line 1: Some data' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
      'Line 2: More data' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
      '--- End of Report ---'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_report exp = lv_expected_report ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template Method Pattern definiert das Skelett eines Algorithmus in einer Operation und überlässt es den Unterklassen, bestimmte Schritte zu implementieren, ohne die Struktur des Algorithmus zu ändern. Abstrakte Methoden sind hier die 'Hooks' für die spezifischen Implementierungen.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Template Method Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Polymorphism

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategy Pattern für verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien (z.B. Addition, Subtraktion). Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für die Strategie und konkrete Implementierungen. Eine Kontextklasse soll die Strategie zur Laufzeit wechseln können.
hint: Die abstrakte Strategieklasse definiert die Schnittstelle. Konkrete Strategien implementieren diese. Die Kontextklasse hält eine Referenz auf die Strategie.
solution:
" Abstract Strategy
CLASS zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

" Concrete Addition Strategy
CLASS zcl_addition_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_addition_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Concrete Subtraction Strategy
CLASS zcl_subtraction_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtraction_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Context Class
CLASS zcl_calculator_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy.
    METHODS execute_calculation IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD execute_calculation.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_result = mo_strategy->calculate( iv_num1 = iv_num1 iv_num2 = iv_num2 ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA(lo_add_strategy) = NEW zcl_addition_strategy( ).
    DATA(lo_sub_strategy) = NEW zcl_subtraction_strategy( ).

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator_context( io_strategy = lo_add_strategy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->execute_calculation( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 5 ) exp = 15 ).

    lo_calculator->set_strategy( lo_sub_strategy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->execute_calculation( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 5 ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategy Pattern ermöglicht es, Algorithmen zur Laufzeit auszutauschen. Die abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy` definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle für alle Strategien, während die Kontextklasse `zcl_calculator_context` die Strategie dynamisch verwenden kann. Dies fördert Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Polymorphism

Instructions: Fragen Sie alle aktiven Code Inspector Prüfvarianten ab und geben Sie deren Namen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES und die Methode GET_CHECK_VARIANTS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_get_variants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_ci_variant_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scicheckvname WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_active_check_variants RETURNING VALUE(rt_variants) TYPE tt_ci_variant_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_get_variants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_check_variants.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
    TRY.
        lo_ci_query->get_check_variants(
          EXPORTING
            i_active_only = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            et_check_variants = DATA(lt_check_variants)
        ).
        rt_variants = VALUE #( FOR variant IN lt_check_variants ( variant-check_variant ) ).
      CATCH cx_ci_error INTO DATA(lx_ci_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Protokollierung oder Auslösen einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme
        MESSAGE lx_ci_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_active_variants FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_active_variants.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_get_variants( ).
    DATA(lt_variants) = lo_cut->get_active_check_variants( ).

    " Da CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES in einem einfachen Unit-Test nicht direkt gemockt werden kann,
    " prüfen wir, ob die Tabelle initial ist, wenn keine aktiven Varianten erwartet werden.
    " Für einen robusten Test würde man CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES mocken.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_variants ). " Annahme: keine Varianten im Testsystem oder Mock
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Abfrage von Code Inspector Prüfvarianten mittels der Klasse CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES. Es nutzt Inline-Deklarationen (DATA(...)) und einen VALUE-Operator, um die relevanten Variantennamen aus der zurückgegebenen Struktur in eine einfache String-Tabelle zu extrahieren. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt mit TRY...CATCH für CX_CI_ERROR.
keywords: CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES, Code Inspector, Prüfvarianten, System Introspection, Inline Deklaration, VALUE Operator, Fehlerbehandlung

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von simulierten Code Inspector Befunden nach Befunden mit hoher Priorität (z.B. Priorität '1').
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_filter_findings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_finding,
             object_name TYPE string,
             priority    TYPE i,
             message     TYPE string,
           END OF ts_finding.
    TYPES: tt_findings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_finding WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_high_priority
      IMPORTING
        it_all_findings TYPE tt_findings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_priority_findings) TYPE tt_findings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_filter_findings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_high_priority.
    rt_high_priority_findings = FILTER #( it_all_findings WHERE priority = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_high_priority FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_high_priority.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_filter_findings( ).
    DATA(lt_test_findings) = VALUE zcl_ci_filter_findings=>tt_findings(
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM1' priority = 1 message = 'High priority issue A' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM2' priority = 2 message = 'Medium priority issue B' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM3' priority = 1 message = 'High priority issue C' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM4' priority = 3 message = 'Low priority issue D' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_findings) = lo_cut->filter_high_priority( lt_test_findings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_findings ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_findings[ 1 ]-object_name exp = 'ZPROGRAM1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_findings[ 2 ]-object_name exp = 'ZPROGRAM3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ist eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ersetzt explizite LOOP-Anweisungen mit IF-Bedingungen und führt zu kürzerem, besser lesbarem Code. Hier wird er verwendet, um simulierte Code Inspector Befunde nach ihrer Priorität zu selektieren.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Code Inspector, Priorität, Moderne ABAP

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Code Inspector Befunde pro Priorität aus einer Liste von simulierten Befunden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Befunde zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_reduce_findings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_finding,
             object_name TYPE string,
             priority    TYPE i,
             message     TYPE string,
           END OF ts_finding.
    TYPES: tt_findings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_finding WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_priority_count,
             priority TYPE i,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ts_priority_count.
    TYPES: tt_priority_counts TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ts_priority_count
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY priority.

    METHODS count_findings_by_priority
      IMPORTING
        it_all_findings TYPE tt_findings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_priority_counts) TYPE tt_priority_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_reduce_findings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_findings_by_priority.
    rt_priority_counts = REDUCE #( 
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_priority_counts( )
      FOR finding IN it_all_findings
      LET current_count = counts[ KEY priority_key COMPONENTS priority = finding-priority ]-count
      IN
        VALUE #( counts ( priority = finding-priority count = current_count + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_findings_by_priority FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_findings_by_priority.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_reduce_findings( ).
    DATA(lt_test_findings) = VALUE zcl_ci_reduce_findings=>tt_findings(
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM1' priority = 1 message = 'High priority issue A' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM2' priority = 2 message = 'Medium priority issue B' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM3' priority = 1 message = 'High priority issue C' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM4' priority = 3 message = 'Low priority issue D' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROGRAM5' priority = 2 message = 'Medium priority issue E' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_findings_by_priority( lt_test_findings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ priority = 1 ]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ priority = 2 ]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ priority = 3 ]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und ausdrucksstarken Weise. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit manueller Zählung zu verwenden, wird hier der Zähler für jede Priorität direkt im Ausdruck aktualisiert. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code für Aggregationsaufgaben.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Attribut eines simulierten Code Inspector Befundes zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole oder Datenreferenzen für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_finding,
             object_name TYPE string,
             priority    TYPE i,
             message     TYPE string,
           END OF ts_finding.
    TYPES: tt_findings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_finding WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attribute_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_finding    TYPE ts_finding
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_attribute_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_attribute> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF STRUCTURE is_finding TO <fs_attribute>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_attribute_value = <fs_attribute>.
    ELSE.
      " Fehlerbehandlung: Attribut nicht gefunden
      rv_attribute_value = 'Attribute not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(ls_test_finding) = VALUE zcl_ci_dynamic_access=>ts_finding(
      object_name = 'ZPROGRAM_DYNAMIC'
      priority    = 1
      message     = 'Dynamic access test'
    ).

    DATA(lv_object_name) = lo_cut->get_attribute_dynamically(
      is_finding = ls_test_finding
      iv_attribute_name = 'OBJECT_NAME'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_object_name exp = 'ZPROGRAM_DYNAMIC' ).

    DATA(lv_priority) = lo_cut->get_attribute_dynamically(
      is_finding = ls_test_finding
      iv_attribute_name = 'PRIORITY'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_priority exp = '1' ). " Beachten: i wird zu String konvertiert

    DATA(lv_non_existent) = lo_cut->get_attribute_dynamically(
      is_finding = ls_test_finding
      iv_attribute_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_non_existent exp = 'Attribute not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten mittels FIELD-SYMBOLS. Der Name des Attributs wird zur Laufzeit übergeben. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, die mit unterschiedlichen Datenstrukturen oder Attributen arbeiten müssen, ohne diese hart zu kodieren. Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf der Priorität eines Code Inspector Befundes, ob dieser als 'kritisch', 'wichtig' oder 'informell' eingestuft werden soll, unter Verwendung des COND-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_cond_priority DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_finding,
             object_name TYPE string,
             priority    TYPE i,

    rv_category = COND string(

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine objektorientierte Struktur zur Kapselung und Verarbeitung von Code Inspector Befunden, die eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle für verschiedene Befundtypen bietet.
hint: Verwenden Sie Interfaces und Polymorphie, um eine flexible Architektur zu schaffen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_ci_finding_processor.
  METHODS process_finding
    IMPORTING
      is_finding TYPE zcl_ci_oo_processor=>ts_finding.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_ci_oo_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_finding,
             object_name TYPE string,
             priority    TYPE i,
             message     TYPE string,
             check_type  TYPE string,
           END OF ts_finding.
    TYPES: tt_findings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_finding WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_processor TYPE REF TO zif_ci_finding_processor.

    METHODS analyze_findings
      IMPORTING
        it_findings TYPE tt_findings.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_processor TYPE REF TO zif_ci_finding_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_oo_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_processor = io_processor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD analyze_findings.
    LOOP AT it_findings INTO DATA(ls_finding).
      mo_processor->process_finding( ls_finding ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_high_priority_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_ci_finding_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_high_priority_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_ci_finding_processor~process_finding.
    IF is_finding-priority = 1.
      " Logik für kritische Befunde, z.B. E-Mail senden
      cl_demo_output=>display( |Kritischer Befund: { is_finding-object_name } - { is_finding-message }| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_oo_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_oo_processing.
    DATA(lo_high_priority_handler) = NEW zcl_ci_high_priority_handler( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_ci_oo_processor( lo_high_priority_handler ).

    DATA(lt_test_findings) = VALUE zcl_ci_oo_processor=>tt_findings(
      ( object_name = 'ZPROG_OO1' priority = 1 message = 'Missing check' check_type = 'SECURITY' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROG_OO2' priority = 2 message = 'Naming convention' check_type = 'STYLE' )
      ( object_name = 'ZPROG_OO3' priority = 1 message = 'Performance issue' check_type = 'PERFORMANCE' )
    ).

    " Die Ausgabe wird in cl_demo_output gesammelt, kann hier nicht direkt geprüft werden.
    " Ein echter Test würde ein Mock-Objekt für zif_ci_finding_processor verwenden.
    lo_processor->analyze_findings( lt_test_findings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Platzhalter, da direkte Ausgabe nicht prüfbar
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine objektorientierte Herangehensweise an die Verarbeitung von Code Inspector Befunden. Durch die Verwendung eines Interfaces (ZIF_CI_FINDING_PROCESSOR) und Polymorphie kann die Logik zur Verarbeitung verschiedener Befundtypen flexibel ausgetauscht werden. Die Hauptklasse ZCL_CI_OO_PROCESSOR ist von der konkreten Implementierung der Verarbeitung entkoppelt, was die Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interfaces, Polymorphie, Code Inspector, Dependency Injection, Moderne ABAP

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS existiert und geben Sie dessen Index zurück, falls vorhanden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Tabellenausdrücke LINE_EXISTS und LINE_INDEX.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflights_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_index.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid

    IF line_exists( lt_flights[ 1 ] ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Attribute eines spezifischen Code Inspector Checks (z.B. 'S_CODE_INSPECTOR') unter Verwendung von CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode GET_CHECK_ATTRIBUTES der Klasse CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_get_check_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_check_attribute,
             attribute_name  TYPE string,
             attribute_value TYPE string,
           END OF ts_check_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_check_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_check_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attributes_for_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_check_name TYPE scicheckname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_check_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_get_check_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attributes_for_check.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
    TRY.
        lo_ci_query->get_check_attributes(
          EXPORTING
            i_check_name = iv_check_name
          IMPORTING
            et_check_attributes = DATA(lt_raw_attributes)
        ).

        rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR attr IN lt_raw_attributes
                                 ( attribute_name = attr-attribute_name
                                   attribute_value = attr-attribute_value ) ).

      CATCH cx_ci_error INTO DATA(lx_ci_error).
        MESSAGE lx_ci_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_attributes_for_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_attributes_for_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_get_check_attrs( ).
    DATA(lv_check_name) = 'S_CODE_INSPECTOR'. " Ein bekannter Code Inspector Check

    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_cut->get_attributes_for_check( lv_check_name ).

    " Da wir CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES nicht mocken können, prüfen wir auf Nicht-Initialität
    " und das Vorhandensein eines erwarteten Attributs, falls der Check existiert.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_attributes ).
    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob ein Attribut 'DESCRIPTION' existiert
    IF line_exists( lt_attributes[ attribute_name = 'DESCRIPTION' ] ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_attributes[ attribute_name = 'DESCRIPTION' ]-attribute_value ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Klasse CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES, um spezifische Attribute eines Code Inspector Checks abzufragen. Die Methode GET_CHECK_ATTRIBUTES liefert eine Tabelle mit Attributnamen und -werten. Der VALUE-Operator wird verwendet, um diese Rohdaten in eine benutzerfreundlichere Struktur zu transformieren. Dies ist entscheidend für die dynamische Analyse und Konfiguration von Code Inspector Checks.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'FLIGHT_STATUS' hinzu, die basierend auf der Flugzeit 'ON_TIME' oder 'DELAYED' anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator mit einer LET-Anweisung und COND für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_add_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_extended,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime     TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime     TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ts_flight_extended.
    TYPES: tt_flight_extended TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_extended.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_add_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_raw
                           LET lv_status = COND string(
                                             WHEN flight-arrtime > flight-deptime + 100 " Annahme: > 1h Verspätung
                                             THEN 'DELAYED'
                                             ELSE 'ON_TIME' )
                           IN ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                connid = flight-connid
                                fldate = flight-fldate
                                deptime = flight-deptime
                                arrtime = flight-arrtime
                                flight_status = lv_status ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_add_column( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_status) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights_with_status ).
    " Prüfen Sie, ob die neue Spalte gefüllt ist
    LOOP AT lt_flights_with_status INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-flight_status ).
      IF ls_flight-flight_status = 'DELAYED'.

      ELSEIF ls_flight-flight_status = 'ON_TIME'.

Mit FOR wird eine neue Tabelle aus einer bestehenden erstellt, LET ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, und COND wird für die bedingte Zuweisung des Flugstatus verwendet. Instructions: Simulieren Sie Münzwürfe, bis dreimal hintereinander 'Kopf' geworfen wird. Zählen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Würfe.

CLASS zcl_coin_flip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_coin_flip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_flips.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) min = 0 max = 1 ). " 0 = Zahl, 1 = Kopf
    DATA(lv_consecutive_heads) = 0.
    rv_total_flips = 0.

    WHILE lv_consecutive_heads < 3.
      rv_total_flips = rv_total_flips + 1.
      IF lo_random->get_next( ) = 1. " Kopf
        lv_consecutive_heads = lv_consecutive_heads + 1.
      ELSE. " Zahl
        lv_consecutive_heads = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` in einer `WHILE`-Schleife und prüfen Sie auf Duplikate.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = iv_min
      max  = iv_max
    ).

    WHILE lines( rt_numbers ) < iv_count.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      IF NOT line_exists( rt_numbers[ table_line = lv_new_number ] ).
        APPEND lv_new_number TO rt_numbers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_numbers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check for uniqueness (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(lt_unique_check) = lt_numbers.
    SORT lt_unique_check ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_check ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_random_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 65 " ASCII for 'A'
      max  = 90 " ASCII for 'Z'
    ).
    DATA(lv_char) TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    DATA(lv_index) TYPE i.

    WHILE lv_index < iv_length.
      lv_char = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->uccp( lo_random->get_next( ) ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lv_char.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches 'Zahlenraten'-Spiel. Der Computer wählt eine Zufallszahl zwischen 1 und 100. Der Spieler (simuliert durch die Methode) versucht, die Zahl zu erraten. Die Methode soll die Anzahl der Versuche zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Zielzahl und eine `WHILE`-Schleife für die Rateversuche. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Simulation der Rateversuche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_guess_number_game DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS play_game
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_attempts TYPE i DEFAULT 100 " Max attempts to prevent infinite loops in simulation
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_attempts) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_guess_number_game IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD play_game.
    DATA(lo_random_target) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 100
    ).
    DATA(lv_target_number) = lo_random_target->get_next( ).

    DATA(lo_random_guess) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) + 1 " Different seed for guesses
      min  = 1
      max  = 100
    ).

    DATA(lv_current_guess) = 0.
    rv_attempts = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_guess <> lv_target_number AND rv_attempts < iv_max_attempts.
      rv_attempts = rv_attempts + 1.
      lv_current_guess = lo_random_guess->get_next( ).
      " In a real game, feedback would be given (too high/too low)
      " For simulation, we just keep guessing randomly.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_attempts > 0 AND lv_attempts <= 200 ) ).

CLASS zcl_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 1000 ROWS ). " Limit for performance

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      " Handle case where no flights are found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_max_index
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_idx) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_idx + 1 INTO rs_flight. " +1 because table index is 1-based
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Schleife aus, solange ein Zähler kleiner als 10 ist UND eine zufällig generierte Zahl ungleich 5 ist. Zählen Sie die Iterationen.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_while DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_while IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 10
    ).
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lv_random_val) = 0.
    rv_iterations = 0.

    WHILE lv_counter < 10 AND lv_random_val <> 5.
      rv_iterations = rv_iterations + 1.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
      lv_random_val = lo_random->get_next( ).

CLASS zcl_random_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD generate_random_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data( FOR sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 1000 ROWS ).

    IF lt_all_sflights IS INITIAL.
      " No data to pick from
      RETURN.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_max_index

    DATA(lv_current_count) = 0.
    WHILE lv_current_count < iv_count.
      DATA(lv_random_idx) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_all_sflights INDEX lv_random_idx + 1 INTO DATA(ls_random_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_random_flight TO rt_flights.
        lv_current_count = lv_current_count + 1.

    ENDWHILE.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_item,
             item    TYPE string,
             weight  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_weighted_item.
    TYPES: tt_weighted_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_random_item
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_weighted_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_item) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_random_item.
    DATA(lv_total_weight) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR item IN it_items
      NEXT sum = sum + item-weight
    ).

    IF lv_total_weight = 0.
      " Handle case where total weight is zero or no items
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random_float->get_next( ) * lv_total_weight.

    DATA(lv_cumulative_weight) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      lv_cumulative_weight = lv_cumulative_weight + ls_item-weight.
      IF lv_random_value <= lv_cumulative_weight.
        rv_selected_item = ls_item-item.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen einfachen Würfelwurf (1-6) in einer `WHILE`-Schleife, bis die Summe der Würfe 21 erreicht oder überschreitet. Geben Sie die Anzahl der Würfe und die Endsumme zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Würfelwürfe und eine `WHILE`-Schleife für die Simulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_game DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_game_result,
             rolls TYPE i,
             sum   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_game_result.

    METHODS play_dice_game
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_game_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_game IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD play_dice_game.
    DATA(lo_random_dice) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 6
    ).

    rs_result-rolls = 0.
    rs_result-sum = 0.

    WHILE rs_result-sum < 21.
      rs_result-rolls = rs_result-rolls + 1.
      rs_result-sum = rs_result-sum + lo_random_dice->get_next( ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dice_game FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dice_game.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_game( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->play_dice_game( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_result-rolls > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_result-sum >= 21 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Simuliert ein Würfelspiel mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Würfelwürfe, gesteuert durch eine `WHILE`-Schleife, bis eine bestimmte Summe erreicht ist.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 10 zufälligen Datensätzen, die eine Fluggesellschaft (2 Zeichen), eine Flugnummer (4 Ziffern) und ein zufälliges Datum im aktuellen Jahr enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für Flugnummer und Datum, String-Templates für die Fluggesellschaft und `WHILE` für die Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_record,
             carrier TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             flight_num TYPE n LENGTH 4,
             flight_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_flight_record.
    TYPES: tt_flight_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_records) TYPE tt_flight_records.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_data_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) min = 65 max = 90 ). " A-Z
    DATA(lo_random_num) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) + 1 min = 1000 max = 9999 ).
    DATA(lo_random_day) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) + 2 min = 1 max = 365 ).

    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_date_base) TYPE d.
    lv_date_base = lv_current_year && '0101'. " Start of current year

    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    WHILE lv_index < iv_count.
      DATA(ls_record) TYPE ty_flight_record.
      ls_record-carrier = |{ cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->uccp( lo_random_char->get_next( ) ) }{ cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->uccp( lo_random_char->get_next( ) ) }|.
      ls_record-flight_num = lo_random_num->get_next( ).
      ls_record-flight_date = lv_date_base + lo_random_day->get_next( ) - 1. " -1 because day 1 is already 0101

      APPEND ls_record TO rt_records.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Generiert zufällige Flugdaten für eine interne Tabelle, indem `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für verschiedene Datentypen (Zeichen, Zahlen, Tage) in einer `WHILE`-Schleife verwendet wird. String-Templates werden für die Formatierung der Fluggesellschaft genutzt.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen einmaligen GUI-Timer, der nach 3 Sekunden ein Event auslöst.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TIMER` und registrieren Sie ein Event für `FINISHED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_once DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_finished.
    METHODS start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_seconds TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_once IMPLEMENTATION.
  DATA: go_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.

  METHOD start_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT go_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR go_timer.
    go_timer->interval = iv_seconds. " Seconds
    go_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_once.
    go_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    " Timer finished, now deactivate it
    go_timer->deactivate( ).
    RAISE EVENT timer_finished.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_setup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_setup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_once( ).
    " We cannot directly test the event firing in a simple unit test
    " without a full GUI environment or mocking. We test the setup.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->start_timer( 1 ). " Start for 1 second
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Timer should be created and activated' act = abap_false ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_GUI_TIMER` ermöglicht die Implementierung von zeitgesteuerten Aktionen in ABAP-GUI-Anwendungen. Durch Setzen von `INTERVAL` und `RUN_MODE` kann ein Timer einmalig oder wiederholt ausgeführt werden. Das `FINISHED`-Event wird ausgelöst, wenn der Timer abläuft.
keywords: CL_GUI_TIMER, Timer, GUI, Event Handling, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die aus einer bestehenden Tabelle nur die Flugnummern und die um 10 erhöhte Kapazität der Business Class enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die von 'FRA' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             bclcap_new TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights.
    rt_transformed = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRA' )
      ( carrid     = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid     = ls_sflight-connid
        bclcap_new = ls_sflight-bclcap + 10 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRA' bclcap = 20 ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NYC' bclcap = 10 ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRA' bclcap = 30 ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-bclcap_new exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-bclcap_new exp = 40 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT` Schleifen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Filter

  PUBLIC SECTION.

        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
                               WHEN 'A' THEN 'Geplant'

                               WHEN 'C' THEN 'Gelandet'
                               ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge von 'LH' aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in eine interne Tabelle, wobei nur die Felder übernommen werden, die in der Zielstruktur vorhanden sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ... UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_read_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_top_n  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_read_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_n_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_flights.
    " Ensure some data exists for 'LH' in SFLIGHT for testing
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_read_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should retrieve some flights' act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen in Open SQL ist seit ABAP 7.40 obligatorisch und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` füllt die interne Tabelle automatisch mit passenden Feldern, und `UP TO N ROWS` begrenzt die Anzahl der gelesenen Datensätze effizient.
keywords: Open SQL, Database Access, Host Variables, INTO CORRESPONDING, UP TO N ROWS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Business Class Kapazitäten aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_bclcap
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_bclcap) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur dynamisch zur Laufzeit, dessen Name als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und den `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Befehl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_test_data( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_reader( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen wiederholenden GUI-Timer, der alle 5 Sekunden ein Event auslöst und nach 30 Sekunden automatisch stoppt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TIMER` mit `RUN_MODE_REPEATED` und einem Zähler im Event-Handler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_repeated DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_tick.
    METHODS start_repeated_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i
        iv_total_duration_seconds TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA go_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA gv_tick_count TYPE i.
    DATA gv_max_ticks TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_repeated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_repeated_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT go_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR go_timer.
    go_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    go_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_repeated.
    gv_tick_count = 0.
    gv_max_ticks = iv_total_duration_seconds / iv_interval_seconds.
    go_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    gv_tick_count = gv_tick_count + 1.
    RAISE EVENT timer_tick.

    IF gv_tick_count >= gv_max_ticks.
      go_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_repeated_timer_setup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_repeated_timer_setup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_repeated( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->start_repeated_timer( iv_interval_seconds = 1 iv_total_duration_seconds = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Timer should be created and activated' act = abap_false ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für wiederholende Timer wird `RUN_MODE_REPEATED` verwendet. Die Logik zum Stoppen des Timers nach einer bestimmten Gesamtzeit wird im Event-Handler implementiert, indem ein Zähler hochgezählt und der Timer bei Erreichen des Limits deaktiviert wird. Dies zeigt die flexible Steuerung von GUI-Timern.
keywords: CL_GUI_TIMER, Timer, GUI, Event Handling, Repeated Timer

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Business Class Kapazität. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer Tabellenexpression.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_avg_bclcap,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             avg_bclcap TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_avg_bclcap.
    TYPES tt_flight_avg_bclcap TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avg_bclcap WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_avg_bclcap
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_avg) TYPE tt_flight_avg_bclcap.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_avg_bclcap.
    rt_grouped_avg = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid ) 
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        connid = ls_group-connid,
        avg_bclcap = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                        FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-bclcap, count = count + 1
                                        FINALLY = COND decfloat16( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0 ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_avg FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_avg.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' bclcap = 20 ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' bclcap = 30 ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' bclcap = 10 ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' bclcap = 40 ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_and_avg_bclcap( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_0400) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_0400-avg_bclcap exp = '25.0' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_0017) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_0017-avg_bclcap exp = '10.0' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_0401) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_0401-avg_bclcap exp = '40.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE #(...)` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Schleifen mit manueller Aggregation.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, VALUE

CLASS zcl_try_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        " Handle specific exception
        MESSAGE lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CLEANUP.
        " This block is always executed, regardless of exception or not
        " For demo purposes, we can log or reset something
        cl_demo_output=>display( 'Cleanup block executed.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse `ZCX_INVALID_FLIGHT_DATA` und werfen Sie diese in einer Methode, wenn ein Flugdatum ungültig ist (z.B. leer). Die Ausnahme soll dann von einem `TRY...CATCH` Block behandelt werden.
hint: Erben Sie von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_try_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RAISING

    METHODS process_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_date.
    IF iv_fldate IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
        EXPORTING
          iv_message = 'Flight date cannot be initial'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight.
    TRY.
        validate_flight_date( iv_fldate ).
        rv_status = 'Flight date is valid'.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_data INTO DATA(lx_invalid_data).
        rv_status = lx_invalid_data->mv_message.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge in `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Wenn ein Flugdatum ungültig ist, fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler, fahren Sie aber mit der Verarbeitung der restlichen Daten fort. Die Methode soll eine Tabelle mit den erfolgreich verarbeiteten Flugnummern zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb einer Schleife über eine interne Tabelle und den `FOR` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_tab_robust_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_flights_robustly
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_tab_robust_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_robustly.
    DATA lv_log_message TYPE string.

    rt_processed_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                    LET lv_log_message = '' IN
                                    ( TRY.
                                          " Simulate a date validation that might fail
                                          IF flight-fldate IS INITIAL.
                                            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
                                              EXPORTING
                                                iv_message = |Flight date for { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid } is initial|.
                                          ENDIF.
                                          " Simulate some processing
                                          " ...
                                          flight-connid
                                      CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_data INTO DATA(lx_invalid_data).
                                          lv_log_message = lx_invalid_data->mv_message.
                                          " Log the error (e.g., to a global error table or CL_DEMO_OUTPUT)
                                          cl_demo_output=>display( |Error: { lv_log_message }| ).
                                          CONTINUE. " Skip this entry, continue with next
                                  ENDTRY ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 180 ) INTO TABLE mt_sflights.

  METHOD test_robust_processing.

Fehlerhafte Einträge können abgefangen und protokolliert werden, ohne den gesamten Prozess zu unterbrechen. Der `LET` Ausdruck hilft, temporäre Variablen innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks zu definieren.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle sflights und ziehe einen festen Rabatt ab.
hint: Verwende REDUCE für die Aggregation und direkte Subtraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_discount TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_sum.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT s = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = s + <fs_sflight>-price
    ) - iv_discount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_calculate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_final_price

CLASS zcl_cond_calculate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_final_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price - COND #( 
      WHEN iv_quantity > 10 THEN iv_base_price * 0.1 " 10% discount for large quantities
      ELSE iv_base_price * 0.05 " 5% discount otherwise
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in sflights den um 10% reduzierten Flugpreis enthält.
hint: Nutze eine FOR Expression mit VALUE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_calculate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_reduced_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_calculate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_reduced_prices.
    rt_reduced_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price = ls_sflight-price * 0.9 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduced_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_calculate( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_reduced_prices( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = 90 msg = 'First price should be 90' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = 180 msg = 'Second price should be 180' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_calculate( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_reduced_prices( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die FOR-Expression in Kombination mit VALUE ermöglicht die Erstellung und Befüllung einer neuen internen Tabelle, indem über eine bestehende Tabelle iteriert und für jede Zeile eine Berechnung durchgeführt wird. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und kompakte Art der Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, INTERNAL TABLES, CALCULATE, SFLIGHTS, TABLE COMPREHENSION

Instructions: Subtrahiere einen bestimmten Wert von einem numerischen Feld in jeder Zeile einer internen Tabelle, wobei der Feldname dynamisch übergeben wird.
hint: Verwende LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL und dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_subtract_val TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        et_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_dynamic.
    et_data = it_data. " Copy for modification
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN et_data TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND ( <fs_field> TYPE P OR <fs_field> TYPE I OR <fs_field> TYPE F ).
          <fs_field> = <fs_field> - iv_subtract_val.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, und ziehe einen festen Betrag ab.
hint: Kombiniere FILTER und REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_filtered_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_date     TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_discount     TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_filtered_sum.
    rv_total = REDUCE #( 
      INIT s = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE fldate > iv_min_date )
      NEXT s = s + <fs_sflight>-price
    ) - iv_discount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_sum_with_discount FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_sum_with_discount.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230105' price = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20230110' price = 300 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_filtered_sum( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_date = '20230103' iv_discount = 50 ).
    " Flights after 20230103: 200 + 300 = 500. Discounted: 500 - 50 = 450.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 450 msg = 'Filtered sum should be 450' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_filtered_sum( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_date = '20230105' iv_discount = 20 ).
    " No flights after 20230105. Sum is 0. Discounted: 0 - 20 = -20.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = -20 msg = 'Should be -20 when no flights match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen. Zuerst werden die relevanten Zeilen gefiltert, dann wird über die gefilterten Zeilen aggregiert und das Ergebnis weiterverarbeitet.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Klasse, die eine Reihe von Berechnungen (Addition, Subtraktion, Multiplikation, Division) in einer flüssigen Schnittstelle (Method Chaining) ermöglicht.
hint: Jede Methode gibt eine Instanz der Klasse zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE f.
    METHODS add       IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calc.
    METHODS subtract  IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calc.
    METHODS multiply  IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calc.
    METHODS divide    IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calc.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_value <> 0.
      mv_result = mv_result / iv_value.
    ELSE.
      " Handle division by zero, e.g., raise exception or set error state
      " For simplicity, we'll just keep the current result or raise an exception in a real scenario.
    ENDIF.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_calculations FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_calculations.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_chained_calc( 10.0 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 5.0 )->subtract( 2.0 )->multiply( 3.0 )->divide( 2.0 )->get_result( ).
    " (10 + 5 - 2) * 3 / 2 = (13) * 3 / 2 = 39 / 2 = 19.5
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 19.5 msg = 'Chained calculation result incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_chained_calc( 10.0 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->divide( 0.0 )->get_result( ).
    " Result should remain 10.0 as division by zero is handled (no change)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10.0 msg = 'Division by zero should not change result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem Methoden so implementiert werden, dass sie die Instanz des Objekts selbst zurückgeben. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten.
keywords: OBJECT ORIENTATION, METHOD CHAINING, CALCULATE, SUBTRACT, ADD, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE, FLUENT INTERFACE

Instructions: Berechne für jede Fluggesellschaft in sflights den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis und subtrahiere einen fixen Verwaltungsbetrag.
hint: Nutze FOR mit GROUP BY und REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_admin_fee    TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        avg_price = ( REDUCE #( 
                        INIT s = 0
                        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                        NEXT s = s + <fs_group_member>-price ) / lines( GROUP ls_sflight ) ) - iv_admin_fee
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_avg_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = 150 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' price = 250 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_price_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_admin_fee = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 entries' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    " LH: (100 + 200) / 2 - 10 = 150 - 10 = 140
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-avg_price exp = 140 msg = 'LH average price incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    " AA: (150 + 250) / 2 - 10 = 200 - 10 = 190
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-avg_price exp = 190 msg = 'AA average price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_price_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_admin_fee = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF` Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren, zu aggregieren und neue Tabellen zu erstellen. Sie ermöglicht komplexe Berechnungen pro Gruppe in einem kompakten Ausdruck.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, CALCULATE, SFLIGHTS, AVERAGE, AGGREGATION

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, in der von jedem Flugpreis in sflights ein fester Betrag abgezogen wird.
hint: Nutze FOR Expression mit VALUE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS subtract_from_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_deduction    TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_prices.
    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights 
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price = ls_sflight-price - iv_deduction ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_subtracted_prices FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_subtracted_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->subtract_from_prices( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_deduction = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = 80 msg = 'First price should be 80' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = 180 msg = 'Second price should be 180' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->subtract_from_prices( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_deduction = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Ähnlich wie bei der Berechnung mit `FOR` kann diese Expression auch verwendet werden, um Werte in einer neuen Tabelle zu subtrahieren. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Transformationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, INTERNAL TABLES, SUBTRACT, SFLIGHTS, TABLE COMPREHENSION

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der eine Zahl darstellt, in einen Integer. Falls der String nicht konvertierbar ist (z.B. leer oder nicht-numerisch), soll ein Standardwert (0) verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CONV` Operator in Kombination mit einem `TRY...CATCH` Block, um Konvertierungsfehler abzufangen und einen Standardwert zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

        VALUE(rv_integer_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_int.
    TRY.
        rv_integer_value = CONV i( iv_input_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_integer_value = 0. " Standardwert bei Konvertierungsfehler
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Der `CONV` Operator ermöglicht eine explizite Typumwandlung. Durch die Kapselung in einem `TRY...CATCH` Block kann der `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` abgefangen werden, der bei einer fehlerhaften Konvertierung auftritt. Dies erlaubt es, einen robusten Standardwert zu definieren, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen.
keywords: CONV, Type Conversion, Exception Handling, String, Integer, TRY CATCH
