Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob zwei Strukturen die gleiche Anzahl und Reihenfolge von Komponenten mit kompatiblen Typen haben (strukturelle Kompatibilität).
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Komponentenlisten, die von `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` zurückgegeben werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_a,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_a.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_b,
             comp1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             comp2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_b.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_c,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_struct_c.

    METHODS are_structs_compatible
      IMPORTING
        is_data1 TYPE any
        is_data2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compatible) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_structs_compatible.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_struct_descr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components1   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_components2   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr1 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data1 ).
        lo_struct_descr2 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data2 ).

        lt_components1 = lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ).
        lt_components2 = lo_struct_descr2->get_components( ).

        IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
          rv_compatible = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
          READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) INDEX sy-tabix.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_comp1-type_descr->type_kind <> ls_comp2-type_descr->type_kind.
            rv_compatible = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          " For more strict compatibility, also compare length, decimals etc.
          " For this example, type_kind is sufficient.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_compatible = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " If either is not a structure, they are not compatible in this context
        rv_compatible = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten zwischen zwei Strukturen, die unterschiedliche Feldnamen, aber kompatible Typen und Reihenfolge haben, dynamisch.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI und Feld-Symbole, um die Werte von Quell- zu Zielstruktur zu übertragen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             text   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             key_id TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             desc   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS copy_struct_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_struct_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_source_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_target_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_source_comps   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_target_comps   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_value> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_value> TYPE any.

    CLEAR rs_target.

    TRY.
        lo_source_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source ).
        lo_target_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rs_target ).

        lt_source_comps = lo_source_descr->get_components( ).
        lt_target_comps = lo_target_descr->get_components( ).

        IF lines( lt_source_comps ) <> lines( lt_target_comps ).
          " Handle error: structures have different number of components
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_source_comps INTO DATA(ls_source_comp).
          READ TABLE lt_target_comps INTO DATA(ls_target_comp) INDEX sy-tabix.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Check for type compatibility (simplified, could be more robust)
            IF ls_source_comp-type_descr->type_kind = ls_target_comp-type_descr->type_kind.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_source_comp-name OF STRUCTURE is_source TO <fs_source_value>.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE rs_target TO <fs_target_value>.

              IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_source_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_value> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_target_value> = <fs_source_value>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch das Iterieren über die Komponenten beider Strukturen und die Zuweisung von Werten über Feld-Symbole kann eine generische Kopierfunktion implementiert werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien, wo Daten zwischen verschiedenen Systemen oder Versionen mit leicht abweichenden Datenmodellen ausgetauscht werden müssen, ohne für jede Kombination expliziten Code zu schreiben.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Werten.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Typen der Felder zu ermitteln und die `WHERE`-Klausel als String zu konstruieren, der dann in einem `FILTER` Ausdruck verwendet werden kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_selection_param,
             field_name TYPE string,
             value      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_selection_param.
    TYPES tt_selection_param TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_selection_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_params  TYPE tt_selection_param
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_first_condition TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.

    IF it_params IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_flights[ 1 ] ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT it_params INTO DATA(ls_param).
          READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = ls_param-field_name.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            IF lv_first_condition = abap_false.
              lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && ' AND '.
            ENDIF.

            CASE ls_component-type_descr->type_kind.
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
                lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_param-field_name } = '{ ls_param-value }'|.
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
                lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_param-field_name } = { ls_param-value }|.
              WHEN OTHERS.
                " Handle other types or skip
                CONTINUE.
            ENDCASE.
            lv_first_condition = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
          " This is a simplified example. Dynamic WHERE for FILTER is not directly supported
          " in this way. For true dynamic filtering, you'd typically use a LOOP AT ... WHERE
          " with dynamic conditions or a more complex RTTI-based approach to build a new table.
          " For demonstration, we'll simulate with a simple loop and check.
          DATA(lt_temp_filtered) TYPE tt_sflight.
          LOOP AT rt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
            " In a real scenario, you'd evaluate lv_where_clause here dynamically.
            " For this example, we'll hardcode a simple check based on the first param.
            READ TABLE it_params INTO DATA(ls_first_param) INDEX 1.
            IF ls_first_param IS NOT INITIAL.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_first_param-field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_value>).
              IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field_value> IS ASSIGNED.
                IF |{ <fs_field_value> }| = ls_first_param-value.
                  APPEND <fs_flight> TO lt_temp_filtered.
                ENDIF.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          rt_filtered_flights = lt_temp_filtered.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Während ABAP keine direkte Ausführung von dynamischen `WHERE`-Klauseln in `FILTER`-Ausdrücken erlaubt, kann man RTTI nutzen, um die Feldtypen zu identifizieren und dann eine Schleife mit dynamischem Feldzugriff (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`) zu verwenden, um die Filterung manuell durchzuführen. Dies ist ideal für generische Suchfunktionen oder Berichte, bei denen die Filterkriterien vom Benutzer zur Laufzeit definiert werden.

    ENDDO.

CLASS zcl_delete_db_for_all_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_key.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_delete_db_for_all_entries IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_keys.
    IF it_keys_to_delete IS NOT INITIAL.
      DELETE FROM sflight FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_keys_to_delete
        WHERE carrid = it_keys_to_delete-carrid
          AND connid = it_keys_to_delete-connid.
      rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    ELSE.
      rv_deleted_rows = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen in eine interne Tabelle eines anderen, strukturell kompatiblen Typs umwandelt, indem sie RTTI verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` zusammen mit `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_cast DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_struct,
             field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_struct.
    TYPES tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_struct WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_struct,
             comp_x TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             comp_y TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_struct.
    TYPES tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_struct WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS cast_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_target_table_type TYPE cl_abap_typedescr=>type_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_cast IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD cast_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_target_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_target_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_source_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_target_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table> ).
        lo_source_struct_descr ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_source_components = lo_source_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        lo_target_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_table_type ).
        lo_target_struct_descr ?= lo_target_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_target_components = lo_target_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        IF lines( lt_source_components ) <> lines( lt_target_components ).
          " Handle error: component count mismatch
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        CREATE DATA rt_target_table TYPE HANDLE lo_target_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rt_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.

        LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
          CREATE DATA <fs_target_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_target_table>.
          LOOP AT lt_source_components INTO DATA(ls_source_comp).
            READ TABLE lt_target_components INTO DATA(ls_target_comp) INDEX sy-tabix.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              IF ls_source_comp-type_descr->type_kind = ls_target_comp-type_descr->type_kind.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_source_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
                IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                  <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
                ENDIF.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation cx_sy_type_descr_error.
        " Handle RTTI errors
        CLEAR rt_target_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_code.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_communication_error cx_http_invalid_state cx_http_processing_error.
        rv_status_code = 0. " Indicate an error, or raise a specific exception
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request aus und parsen Sie die JSON-Antwort in eine ABAP-Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_response DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post,
             userid TYPE i,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_post.
    METHODS get_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_post) TYPE ty_post.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_response IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        IF lo_http_client->get_status_code( ) = 200.
          lv_json_string = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
            EXPORTING
              json        = lv_json_string
              pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
            CHANGING
              data        = rs_post
          ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_communication_error cx_http_invalid_state cx_http_processing_error cx_sy_json_parser_error.
        " Handle errors, e.g., log or raise specific exceptions
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine API.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client->request->set_method`, `set_cdata` und `set_header_field` zusammen mit `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_new_post,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_new_post.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_created_post,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_created_post.
    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        is_payload TYPE ty_new_post
        iv_url     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_created_post) TYPE ty_created_post.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_string TYPE string,
          lv_response_json TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_client=>co_request_method_post ).

        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_payload
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_string
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_string ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'Content-Type'
          value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        IF lo_http_client->get_status_code( ) = 201. " 201 Created
          lv_response_json = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
            EXPORTING
              json        = lv_response_json
              pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
            CHANGING
              data        = rs_created_post
          ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_communication_error cx_http_invalid_state cx_http_processing_error cx_sy_json_parser_error.
        " Handle errors
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request aus und setzen Sie einen benutzerdefinierten Header. Überprüfen Sie, ob der Header in der Antwort (falls die API ihn spiegelt) vorhanden ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lo_http_client->request->set_header_field` und `lo_http_client->response->get_cdata()` mit `FIND REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_custom_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_header_echo
      IMPORTING
        iv_url          TYPE string
        iv_header_name  TYPE string
        iv_header_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_echoed_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_custom_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_header_echo.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_response_body TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = iv_header_name
          value = iv_header_value
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        IF lo_http_client->get_status_code( ) = 200.
          lv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
          FIND REGEX iv_header_name && '"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"' IN lv_response_body SUBMATCHES rv_echoed_value.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_communication_error cx_http_invalid_state cx_http_processing_error.
        " Handle errors
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_switch_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             body        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response.
    METHODS get_dynamic_data

        iv_resource_type TYPE string

CLASS zcl_http_switch_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA(lv_base_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com'.

    DATA(lv_url) = SWITCH string( iv_resource_type
      WHEN 'posts' THEN lv_base_url && '/posts/1'
      WHEN 'todos' THEN lv_base_url && '/todos/1'
      WHEN 'users' THEN lv_base_url && '/users/1'
      ELSE lv_base_url && '/404'
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = lv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
        IF rs_response-status_code = 200.
          rs_response-body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_communication_error cx_http_invalid_state cx_http_processing_error.
        rs_response-status_code = 0.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine ungültige URL durch, um eine Kommunikationsfehler-Exception zu provozieren, und fangen Sie diese ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_http_communication_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_comm_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS test_comm_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_comm_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_comm_error.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        rv_error_message = 'No error occurred'.

      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_invalid_state cx_http_processing_error.
        rv_error_message = 'Other HTTP error occurred'.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_error) = lo_cut->test_comm_error( 'http://nonexistent.example.com:12345' ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_event.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    CLASS ltcl_event_handler DEFINITION FOR EVENTS double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_row
            e_column.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_double_click.
        DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

        " Get reference to the ALV grid instance
        DATA(lo_alv_grid) = CAST cl_gui_alv_grid( sender ).

        " Get the data from the ALV grid
        CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->get_frontend_field_catalog
          IMPORTING
            et_fieldcatalog = DATA(lt_fcat).

        CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->get_frontend_layout
          IMPORTING
            es_layout = DATA(ls_layout).

        CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->get_frontend_data
          IMPORTING
            et_outtab = DATA(lt_data_alv).

        ASSIGN lt_data_alv TO <fs_table>.
        READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX e_row INTO ls_sflight.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Flugnummer:' ls_sflight-carrid ls_sflight-connid.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_event.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
        EXPORTING
          i_parent = lo_container.

      SET HANDLER ltcl_event_handler=>on_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHT` und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einer ALV-Liste an. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Passagierzahlen zu aggregieren und eine neue interne Tabelle für die ALV-Anzeige zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_passengers,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_pass TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_passengers.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_carrier_passengers(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_passengers( )
        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ] ) IN
        IF lv_index IS INITIAL.
          APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                          total_pass = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) TO result.
        ELSE.
          result[ lv_index ]-total_pass = result[ lv_index ]-total_pass + ls_sflight-seatsocc.
        ENDIF
      ).

      IF lt_aggregated_data IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
              lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
          EXPORTING
            i_parent = lo_container.

        CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_REDUCE_SFLIGHT=>TY_CARRIER_PASSENGERS'
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = lt_aggregated_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_functional_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carrier_info.
    DATA(lt_scarr) = VALUE scarr_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr UP TO 50 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lt_scarr IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_info = VALUE string_table(
        FOR ls_scarr IN FILTER scarr_tab( lt_scarr WHERE carrid CP 'A*' )
        ( |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_scarr-carrname }, Währung: { ls_scarr-currcode }| )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie die Kurztexte für die Festwerte der Domäne 'S_CONN_ID' ab und formatieren Sie diese als eine durch Kommas getrennte Liste. Verwenden Sie `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA` und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GET_VALUES` und den `REDUCE`-Operator mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reca_domain_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_connection_id_texts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_domain_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connection_id_texts.
    DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create_by_name( 'S_CONN_ID' ).
    DATA(lt_values) = lo_domain->get_values( ).

    IF lt_values IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_text_list = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR ls_value IN lt_values
        NEXT s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_value-ddtext
          ELSE |{ s }, { ls_value-ddtext }|
        )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_toolbar_button DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_button.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    CLASS ltcl_event_handler DEFINITION FOR EVENTS toolbar OF cl_gui_alv_grid.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_toolbar FOR EVENT toolbar OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_object
            e_interactive.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_toolbar.
        DATA: ls_button TYPE stb_button.

        " Add a custom button
        CLEAR ls_button.
        ls_button-function = 'MY_BUTTON'.
        ls_button-icon     = icon_information.
        ls_button-butn_type = 0.
        ls_button-text     = 'Mein Knopf'.
        ls_button-quickinfo = 'Klicken Sie hier'.
        APPEND ls_button TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_user_command_handler DEFINITION FOR EVENTS user_command OF cl_gui_alv_grid.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_user_command FOR EVENT user_command OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_ucomm.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_user_command_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_user_command.
        IF e_ucomm = 'MY_BUTTON'.
          MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Mein Knopf wurde geklickt!'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_toolbar_button IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_button.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
        EXPORTING
          i_parent = lo_container.

      SET HANDLER ltcl_event_handler=>on_toolbar FOR mo_alv_grid.
      SET HANDLER ltcl_user_command_handler=>on_user_command FOR mo_alv_grid.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_toolbar_interactive.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_entry,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_entry.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS

CLASS zcl_sflight_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

    lt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                           ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid
                             connid = ls_raw-connid
                             fldate = ls_raw-fldate ) ).

Instructions: Gegeben eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Carrier ID, Connection ID, Price), die mit einer lokalen Struktur definiert wurde, berechnen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Flüge für einen bestimmten Carrier unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_entry,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_entry.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    lt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                           ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid
                             connid = ls_raw-connid
                             price  = ls_raw-price ) ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                         WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen String mit ungültigen Zeichen für eine bestimmte Codepage zu konvertieren und fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme ab.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahme `cx_sy_codepage_converter_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        " Convert input string to XSTRING (UTF-8)
        DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string
                            IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring ).

        " Convert XSTRING to target encoding
        DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = iv_target_encoding ).
        lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = lv_xstring
                          IMPORTING data = rv_converted_string ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_converted_string = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|. " Return error message
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    " Attempt to convert a UTF-8 string with 'ü' to a codepage that doesn't support it (e.g., '7-BIT ASCII')
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Grüße'.
    DATA(lv_target_encoding) = '4102'. " Example for a very restrictive codepage (7-bit ASCII)
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling( iv_input_string = lv_input iv_target_encoding = lv_target_encoding ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with( act = lv_result exp = 'Error:' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    lt_all_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                               ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid
                                 connid = ls_raw-connid
                                 fldate = ls_raw-fldate ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer lokalen Struktur, die Flugdaten (Carrier ID, Connection ID, Price) aus der Tabelle `sflights` repräsentiert. Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Carrier unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_entry,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_entry.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_avg_price_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE ty_carrier_avg_price_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    lt_all_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                               ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid
                                 connid = ls_raw-connid
                                 price  = ls_raw-price ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT s = 0
                                                FOR GROUP ls_group_flight IN ls_flight
                                                NEXT s = s + ls_group_flight-price ).
      DATA(lv_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      IF lv_count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                        avg_price = lv_sum_price / lv_count ) TO rt_avg_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_avg_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_price_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_avg_prices ).
    LOOP AT lt_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_avg_price).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_avg_price-avg_price > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen wie die Durchschnittsberechnung pro Gruppe auf sehr elegante und performante Weise.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer lokalen Struktur, die Flugdaten (Carrier ID, Connection ID, Flight Date) aus der Tabelle `sflights` repräsentiert. Transformieren Sie diese Tabelle in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Carrier IDs enthält, aber ohne Duplikate, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `DISTINCT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... DISTINCT` für die Transformation und Entfernung von Duplikaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_entry,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_entry.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_carrid_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_distinct_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_distinct_carriers) TYPE ty_carrid_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    lt_all_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                               ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid
                                 connid = ls_raw-connid
                                 fldate = ls_raw-fldate ) ).

    rt_distinct_carriers = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN lt_all_sflights
                                    ( carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_distinct_carriers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carriers ).
    " Check for duplicates (should not exist)
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_carriers ).
    SORT lt_carriers BY table_line.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_parse_user_locale DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_date_user_locale
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_dat_parse_user_locale IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_date_user_locale.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_parse_valid_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_parse_user_locale( ).
    DATA(lo_datfm_en) = NEW cl_abap_datfm( iv_locale = 'EN' ). " Festes Locale für vorhersagbare Testeingabe
    DATA(lv_test_date) = '20231125'.
    DATA(lv_formatted_date) = lo_datfm_en->date_to_char( lv_test_date ). " z.B. 11/25/2023

    DATA(lv_parsed_date) = lo_cut->parse_date_user_locale( lv_formatted_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_parsed_date exp = lv_test_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_parse_user_locale( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_date_string) = 'Ungültiger Datumsstring'.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwartete Ausnahme CX_ABAP_DATFM_INVALID_DATE wurde nicht ausgelöst.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_invalid_date.

    ENDTRY.

keywords: CL_ABAP_DATFM, CHAR_TO_DATE, Locale, Exception Handling, TRY...CATCH, Datum, Parsing

CLASS zcl_tst_timezone_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_timestamp_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_from_tzone TYPE timezone
        iv_to_tzone   TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_timestamp) TYPE timestampl
      RAISING
        cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_tzone.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tst_timezone_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_timestamp_timezone.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_tzone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = iv_timestamp
        iv_tzone = iv_from_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = lv_date
        ev_time  = lv_time
    ).

    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tzone_to_tstmp(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date  = lv_date
        iv_time  = lv_time
        iv_tzone = iv_to_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_tstmp = rv_converted_timestamp
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL FUNCTION` und anschließend `IF sy-subrc <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subrc_to_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_legacy_fm_with_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check. " Oder eine spezifischere Ausnahme
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subrc_to_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_legacy_fm_with_exception.
    " Beispiel für einen Legacy-Funktionsbaustein, der SY-SUBRC setzt.
    " In einer realen Situation wäre dies ein existierender FM.
    " Hier simulieren wir ihn mit einem Dummy-Aufruf.
    DATA(lv_dummy_output) = 0.
    DATA(lv_subrc) = 0.

    IF iv_input = 0.
      lv_subrc = 4. " Simulieren eines Fehlers
    ELSE.
      lv_dummy_output = iv_input * 2.
    ENDIF.

    " CALL FUNCTION 'SOME_LEGACY_FUNCTION'
    "   EXPORTING
    "     IV_INPUT = iv_input
    "   IMPORTING
    "     EV_OUTPUT = rv_output
    "   EXCEPTIONS
    "     OTHERS = 1.

    " Stattdessen:
    IF lv_subrc <> 0. " Hier würde sy-subrc stehen
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_message
                                           previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_message
                                                                           text = |Fehler im Legacy-Funktionsbaustein, SY-SUBRC: { lv_subrc }| ) ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_output = lv_dummy_output.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `SY-SUBRC` innerhalb eines `COND`-Ausdrucks, um einen Wert basierend auf dem Ergebnis eines Legacy-Funktionsbaustein-Aufrufs zu bestimmen.

CLASS zcl_subrc_in_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_from_legacy_fm
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_subrc_in_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_from_legacy_fm.
    " Simulieren eines Legacy-Funktionsbausteins, der SY-SUBRC setzt
    DATA(lv_subrc_sim) = 0.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      lv_subrc_sim = 4. " Fehler
    ELSEIF iv_input = 1.
      lv_subrc_sim = 8. " Warnung
    ENDIF.

    " CALL FUNCTION 'SOME_LEGACY_FUNCTION'
    "   EXPORTING
    "     IV_INPUT = iv_input
    "   EXCEPTIONS
    "     OTHERS = 1.

    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN lv_subrc_sim = 0 THEN 'Erfolgreich'
      WHEN lv_subrc_sim = 4 THEN 'Fehler aufgetreten'
      WHEN lv_subrc_sim = 8 THEN 'Warnung erhalten'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Legacy-Funktionsbaustein auf, der `SY-SUBRC` setzt. Wenn `SY-SUBRC` ungleich Null ist, verwenden Sie den `THROW`-Ausdruck, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_subrc_with_throw DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_with_throw
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subrc_with_throw IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_throw.
    " Simulieren eines Legacy-Funktionsbausteins, der SY-SUBRC setzt
    DATA(lv_subrc_sim) = 0.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      lv_subrc_sim = 1. " Fehlerfall
    ENDIF.

    " CALL FUNCTION 'SOME_LEGACY_FM'
    "   EXPORTING
    "     IV_VALUE = iv_value
    "   EXCEPTIONS
    "     OTHERS = 1.

    IF lv_subrc_sim <> 0 THEN
      THROW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_message
                             previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_message
                                                             text = |Fehler im Legacy-FM, SY-SUBRC: { lv_subrc_sim }| ) ).

    rv_result = iv_value * 10.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtminuten aller Termine in einer Liste, die an einem bestimmten Tag beginnen. Jeder Termin hat eine Start- und Endzeit. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax und die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TIMS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation und `CL_ABAP_TIMS` zur Berechnung der Zeitdifferenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment,
             date        TYPE d,
             start_time  TYPE t,
             end_time    TYPE t,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_appointment.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_duration.
    rv_total_minutes = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR appointment IN it_appointments WHERE ( date = iv_date )
      NEXT total = total + cl_abap_tims=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = |{ appointment-date }{ appointment-end_time }|
                                                iv_tstmp2 = |{ appointment-date }{ appointment-start_time }|
                                                iv_unit   = cl_abap_tims=>unit_minutes ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein XML-Fragment und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Attributs ('id') aus dem 'User'-Element, das für Sicherheitskonfigurationen relevant ist. Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_XML_DOCUMENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_XML_DOCUMENT` zum Laden des XML und `GET_ELEMENTS_BY_TAG_NAME` oder `FIND_NODE` in Kombination mit `GET_ATTRIBUTE_NODE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_user_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_user_id) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_user_id.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_xstring_from_string( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_node( )->get_first_child( ).
    DATA(lo_user_node) = lo_root_node->get_first_child( ). " Assuming <User> is first child of <SecurityInfo>

    IF lo_user_node IS BOUND AND lo_user_node->get_name( ) = 'User'.
      DATA(lo_id_attribute) = lo_user_node->get_attribute_node( 'id' ).
      IF lo_id_attribute IS BOUND.
        rv_user_id = lo_id_attribute->get_value( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern von Flügen enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und fügen Sie einen Präfix ('HIGH_VALUE_') hinzu, wenn der Flugstatus 'X' ist. Nutzen Sie `FOR`, `VALUE` und `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für eine kompakte Transformation mit bedingter Logik, die durch `COND` ausgedrückt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_id.
    TYPES tt_flight_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_raw_flights
                                      WHERE ( price > iv_price_threshold )
                                      ( flight_id = COND string(
                                          WHEN flight-status = 'X' THEN |HIGH_VALUE_{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
                                          ELSE |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
                                        ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_transformer=>tt_flight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '1000.00' status = '' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '1500.00' status = 'X' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = ' 500.00' status = '' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' price = '1200.00' status = '' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( it_raw_flights = lt_raw_flights iv_price_threshold = '900.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'LH-0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_id exp = 'HIGH_VALUE_AA-0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-flight_id exp = 'DL-0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_itab_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem Satz, wobei jedes Wort großgeschrieben und durch ein Leerzeichen getrennt wird, und der Satz mit einem Punkt endet. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_sentence_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_sentence
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sentence_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sentence.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN to_upper( word )
                 ELSE |{ s } { to_upper( word ) }|
               )
      FINALLY s = |{ s }.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den letzten Tag des aktuellen Monats unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die statische Methode `GET_LAST_DAY_OF_MONTH` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_last_day_of_current_month
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_last_day) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_current_month.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    rv_last_day = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_last_day_of_month( iv_date = lv_current_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_last_day FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_last_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_helper( ).
    DATA(lv_last_day) = lo_cut->get_last_day_of_current_month( ).

    " Assert that the day part of lv_last_day is the last day of the current month
    DATA(lv_current_month) = sy-datum+4(2).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum+0(4).
    DATA(lv_expected_last_day) TYPE d.

    CASE lv_current_month.
      WHEN '01' OR '03' OR '05' OR '07' OR '08' OR '10' OR '12'.
        lv_expected_last_day = |{ lv_current_year }{ lv_current_month }31|.
      WHEN '04' OR '06' OR '09' OR '11'.
        lv_expected_last_day = |{ lv_current_year }{ lv_current_month }30|.
      WHEN '02'.
        IF ( lv_current_year MOD 4 = 0 AND lv_current_year MOD 100 <> 0 ) OR lv_current_year MOD 400 = 0.
          lv_expected_last_day = |{ lv_current_year }{ lv_current_month }29|.
        ELSE.
          lv_expected_last_day = |{ lv_current_year }{ lv_current_month }28|.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_last_day exp = lv_expected_last_day ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` (ABAP 7.40+) bietet eine Vielzahl von statischen Methoden zur einfachen und robusten Bearbeitung von Datums- und Zeitangaben. `GET_LAST_DAY_OF_MONTH` ist ein Beispiel für eine solche Funktion, die komplexe manuelle Berechnungen überflüssig macht und den Code sauberer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: Date/Time, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, GET_LAST_DAY_OF_MONTH, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Baumstruktur (Simple Tree Control) mit zwei Ebenen. Die erste Ebene soll statische Knoten für 'Pakete' und 'Objekte' enthalten. Die zweite Ebene soll dynamisch die Namen von ABAP-Paketen unter 'Pakete' anzeigen, die mit 'Z' beginnen, und die Namen von Entwicklungsobjekten (z.B. Programme) unter 'Objekte'. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` zur Anzeige und `cl_pak_package_queries` oder `DDIC` Tabellen für die Daten. Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FOR` für die Knotenbefüllung.

CLASS zcl_tree_display_packages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.

    METHODS add_root_node IMPORTING iv_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS add_package_nodes IMPORTING iv_parent_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.
    METHODS add_object_nodes IMPORTING iv_parent_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_display_packages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    add_root_node( iv_key = 'PACKAGES' iv_text = 'ABAP Pakete' ).
    add_root_node( iv_key = 'OBJECTS' iv_text = 'Entwicklungsobjekte' ).

    add_package_nodes( 'PACKAGES' ).
    add_object_nodes( 'OBJECTS' ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'OBJECTS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = iv_key
      text = iv_text
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).
    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_package_nodes.
    SELECT devclass AS package_name
      FROM tdevc
      WHERE devclass LIKE 'Z%'
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_packages).

    LOOP AT lt_packages INTO DATA(ls_package).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |{ iv_parent_key }-{ ls_package-package_name }|.
      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = iv_parent_key
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = ls_package-package_name
        is_folder = abap_false
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_object_nodes.
    SELECT pgmna AS program_name
      FROM trdir
      WHERE pgmna LIKE 'Z%'
      AND subc = '1' " Executable program
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_programs).

    LOOP AT lt_programs INTO DATA(ls_program).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |{ iv_parent_key }-{ ls_program-program_name }|.
      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = iv_parent_key
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = ls_program-program_name
        is_folder = abap_false
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_recursive_packages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_recursive_tree IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container iv_root_package TYPE devclass.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.
    DATA mv_node_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.

    METHODS add_package_and_children
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
        iv_parent_key   TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_recursive_packages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_recursive_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    add_package_and_children( iv_package_name = iv_root_package ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( iv_root_package ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( iv_root_package ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_package_and_children.
    mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
    DATA(lv_current_node_key) = |NODE_{ mv_node_counter }|.

    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = lv_current_node_key
      text = iv_package_name
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).

    IF iv_parent_key IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_node-relat_node_key = iv_parent_key.
      ls_node-relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.

    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_sub_packages) = lo_package_queries->get_sub_packages(
      iv_package = iv_package_name
      iv_recursive = abap_false
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sub_packages INTO DATA(ls_sub_package).
      add_package_and_children(
        iv_package_name = ls_sub_package-package_name
        iv_parent_key   = lv_current_node_key
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie die Baumstruktur aus TRE_001, um bei einem Doppelklick auf einen Paketknoten die zugehörigen Entwicklungsobjekte in einer neuen Unterebene anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie Event-Handling für `cl_gui_simple_tree`.
hint: Implementieren Sie das Event `NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK` der Klasse `cl_gui_simple_tree` und nutzen Sie `cl_pak_package_queries` zur Laufzeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_event_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.

    METHODS add_root_node IMPORTING iv_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_simple_tree IMPORTING node_key.
    METHODS add_objects_to_package_node IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE devclass iv_parent_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.

    add_root_node( iv_key = 'PACKAGES' iv_text = 'ABAP Pakete' ).

    " Initial packages (only top level for demonstration)
    SELECT devclass AS package_name
      FROM tdevc
      WHERE devclass LIKE 'Z%'
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_packages).

    LOOP AT lt_packages INTO DATA(ls_package).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |PKG_{ ls_package-package_name }|.
      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = 'PACKAGES'
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = ls_package-package_name
        is_folder = abap_true " Mark as folder to allow expansion
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = iv_key
      text = iv_text
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).
    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    IF node_key IS INITIAL OR node_key = 'PACKAGES'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Extract package name from node_key (e.g., 'PKG_ZPACKAGE')
    DATA(lv_package_name) = substring( val = node_key off = 4 ).

    " Check if node already has children (to avoid re-fetching)
    DATA(lt_children) = mo_tree->get_children( node_key ).
    IF lines( lt_children ) > 0.
      mo_tree->toggle_node( node_key ). " Just toggle expansion
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    add_objects_to_package_node( iv_package_name = lv_package_name iv_parent_key = node_key ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ). " Add newly created nodes
    CLEAR mt_nodes. " Clear for next additions
    mo_tree->expand_node( node_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_objects_to_package_node.
    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_objects_raw) = lo_package_queries->get_objects_in_package(
      iv_package   = iv_package_name
      iv_recursive = abap_false " Only direct objects
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_objects_raw INTO DATA(ls_object).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |{ iv_parent_key }_OBJ_{ ls_object-object_name }|.
      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = iv_parent_key
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = |{ ls_object-object_name } ({ ls_object-object_type })|
        is_folder = abap_false
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_check_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    add_root_node( iv_key = 'FLIGHTS' iv_text = 'Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS)' ).

    " Get distinct carriers and their flights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
          node_key = |CARR_{ ls_flight-carrid }|
          relat_node_key = 'FLIGHTS'
          relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          text = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }|
          is_folder = abap_true
        )
      FOR ls_flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_flight (
        VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
          node_key = |FLT_{ ls_flight-carrid }_{ ls_flight_in_group-connid }_{ ls_flight_in_group-fldate }|
          relat_node_key = |CARR_{ ls_flight-carrid }|
          relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          text = |Flug { ls_flight_in_group-connid } am { ls_flight_in_group-fldate } ({ ls_flight_in_group-price } { ls_flight_in_group-currency })|
          is_folder = abap_false
        )
      )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF lt_carriers INTO TABLE mt_nodes.

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'FLIGHTS' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'FLIGHTS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = iv_key
      text = iv_text
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).
    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle ABAP-Klassen, die in einem bestimmten ABAP-Paket oder dessen Unterpaketen definiert sind und eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementieren. Geben Sie die Klassennamen zurück. Nutzen Sie `cl_pak_package_queries` und `RTTI` (Run Time Type Information) für die Schnittstellenprüfung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_objects_in_package` mit `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `is_implementing_interface`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_class_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_class_info,
             class_name TYPE seoclassnm,
             package    TYPE devclass,
           END OF ty_class_info.
    TYPES: tt_class_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_class_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_classes_implementing_intf
      IMPORTING
        iv_package      TYPE devclass
        iv_interface    TYPE seoclassnm
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_classes) TYPE tt_class_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_class_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_classes_implementing_intf.
    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).

    DATA(lt_objects_raw) = lo_package_queries->get_objects_in_package(
      iv_package   = iv_package
      iv_recursive = abap_true
      iv_object_type = 'CLAS' " Only classes
    ).

    rt_classes = VALUE #( FOR <object> IN lt_objects_raw
                          LET lv_class_name = <object>-object_name IN
                          WHERE ( lv_class_name IS NOT INITIAL AND
                                  cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( lv_class_name )->is_implementing_interface( iv_interface ) = abap_true )
                          ( class_name = lv_class_name
                            package    = <object>-package_name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_class_interface( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_classes_implementing_intf(
      iv_package   = 'SABAP_DEMOS'

    DATA(lv_found_class) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_class) WHERE class_name = 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT'.
      lv_found_class = abap_true.
      EXIT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Baumstruktur, die ABAP-Pakete anzeigt. Fügen Sie jedem Paketknoten ein Kontextmenü hinzu, das die Option 'Objekte anzeigen' bietet. Bei Auswahl dieser Option sollen die Objekte des Pakets in einem separaten Dialogfenster angezeigt werden. Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` und Event-Handling für Kontextmenüs.
hint: Implementieren Sie die Events `CONTEXT_MENU_REQUEST` und `CONTEXT_MENU_SELECTED` von `cl_gui_simple_tree`. Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` und `cl_gui_simple_tree=>add_context_menu_item`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.
    DATA mv_selected_package TYPE devclass.

    METHODS add_root_node IMPORTING iv_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_context_menu_request FOR EVENT context_menu_request OF cl_gui_simple_tree IMPORTING node_key menu.
    METHODS handle_context_menu_selected FOR EVENT context_menu_selected OF cl_gui_simple_tree IMPORTING node_key menu_function.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu_selected FOR mo_tree.

    add_root_node( iv_key = 'PACKAGES' iv_text = 'ABAP Pakete' ).

    SELECT devclass AS package_name
      FROM tdevc
      WHERE devclass LIKE 'Z%'
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_packages).

    LOOP AT lt_packages INTO DATA(ls_package).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |PKG_{ ls_package-package_name }|.
      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = 'PACKAGES'
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = ls_package-package_name
        is_folder = abap_true
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = iv_key
      text = iv_text
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).
    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    IF node_key IS INITIAL OR node_key = 'PACKAGES'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Extract package name from node_key
    mv_selected_package = substring( val = node_key off = 4 ).

    " Add menu item
    menu->add_function( fcode = 'SHOW_OBJECTS' text = 'Objekte anzeigen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_selected.
    IF menu_function = 'SHOW_OBJECTS'.
      IF mv_selected_package IS NOT INITIAL.
        " Display objects in a simple popup (e.g., using cl_demo_output)
        DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
        DATA(lt_objects_raw) = lo_package_queries->get_objects_in_package(
          iv_package   = mv_selected_package
          iv_recursive = abap_false
        ).

        DATA(lv_output) = VALUE string(
          FOR <object> IN lt_objects_raw
          ( |{ <object>-object_name } ({ <object>-object_type })| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf )
        ).

        IF lv_output IS INITIAL.
          lv_output = |Keine Objekte im Paket { mv_selected_package } gefunden.|.
        ENDIF.

        cl_demo_output=>display_data( lv_output ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_context_menu FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_context_menu.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_context_menu( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).

    lo_cut->display_tree( lo_container ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_tree ).

    " Simulate context menu request and selection (requires mocking or integration test)
    " For demonstration, we'll directly call the event handlers.
    DATA(lv_test_package_node_key) = 'PKG_SABAP_DEMOS_TUTORIAL'.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ). " Dummy menu object

    " This would typically involve inspecting the mocked menu object.

    lo_cut->handle_context_menu_selected( node_key = lv_test_package_node_key menu_function = 'SHOW_OBJECTS' ).

    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.

Die Events `CONTEXT_MENU_REQUEST` und `CONTEXT_MENU_SELECTED` werden implementiert. `CONTEXT_MENU_REQUEST` wird verwendet, um dynamisch Menüpunkte hinzuzufügen, basierend auf dem angeklickten Knoten. `CONTEXT_MENU_SELECTED` verarbeitet die Auswahl des Menüpunkts und zeigt die Objekte des Pakets in einem Popup mit `cl_demo_output` an. solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_package_programs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_package_programs IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container iv_package_name TYPE devclass.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

CLASS zcl_tree_package_programs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_package_programs.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    add_root_node( iv_key = 'PROGRAMS_ROOT' iv_text = |Programme in Paket { iv_package_name }| ).

    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_programs_raw) = lo_package_queries->get_objects_in_package(
      iv_package   = iv_package_name
      iv_recursive = abap_false
      iv_object_type = 'PROG'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_programs_raw INTO DATA(ls_program).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |PROG_{ ls_program-object_name }|.
      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = 'PROGRAMS_ROOT'
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = ls_program-object_name
        is_folder = abap_false
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'PROGRAMS_ROOT' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PROGRAMS_ROOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = iv_key
      text = iv_text
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).
    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
