Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Baumstruktur, die ABAP-Pakete anzeigt. Implementieren Sie eine Drag-and-Drop-Funktionalität, sodass ein Paketknoten auf einen anderen Paketknoten gezogen werden kann. Bei einem erfolgreichen Drop soll eine Meldung mit den beteiligten Paketen ausgegeben werden. (Hinweis: Die tatsächliche Änderung der Paketstruktur ist komplex und nicht Teil dieser Aufgabe, nur die Erkennung des D&D-Ereignisses).
hint: Implementieren Sie die Events `DRAG_DROP_REQUEST` und `DRAG_DROP_FINISH` von `cl_gui_simple_tree`. Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree=>set_drag_drop_mode`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_drag_drop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.
    DATA mv_dragged_package_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.

    METHODS add_root_node IMPORTING iv_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_drag_drop_request FOR EVENT drag_drop_request OF cl_gui_simple_tree IMPORTING node_key.
    METHODS handle_drag_drop_finish FOR EVENT drag_drop_finish OF cl_gui_simple_tree IMPORTING drag_node_key drop_node_key drop_position.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_drag_drop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_drag_drop_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_drag_drop_finish FOR mo_tree.

    mo_tree->set_drag_drop_mode( cl_gui_simple_tree=>drag_drop_mode_full ).

    add_root_node( iv_key = 'PACKAGES' iv_text = 'ABAP Pakete (Drag & Drop)' ).

    SELECT devclass AS package_name
      FROM tdevc
      WHERE devclass LIKE 'Z%'
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_packages).

    LOOP AT lt_packages INTO DATA(ls_package).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |PKG_{ ls_package-package_name }|.
      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = 'PACKAGES'
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = ls_package-package_name
        is_folder = abap_true
        drag_drop_id = 'PACKAGE_DRAG'
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = iv_key
      text = iv_text
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).
    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag_drop_request.
    mv_dragged_package_key = node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag_drop_finish.
    IF drag_node_key IS INITIAL OR drop_node_key IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_dragged_package) = substring( val = drag_node_key off = 4 ).
    DATA(lv_dropped_package) = substring( val = drop_node_key off = 4 ).

    MESSAGE |Paket '{ lv_dragged_package }' wurde auf Paket '{ lv_dropped_package }' (Position: { drop_position }) gezogen.| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Baumstruktur, die ABAP-Pakete anzeigt. Fügen Sie jedem Paketknoten ein Icon hinzu, das den Status des Pakets (z.B. 'lokal' oder 'transportierbar') visuell darstellt. Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` und `cl_pak_package_queries`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree=>add_picture` und `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_attributes` zur Bestimmung des Status.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_package_icons DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree_with_icons IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.

    METHODS add_root_node IMPORTING iv_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS get_package_icon IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE devclass RETURNING VALUE(rv_icon_id) TYPE icon_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_package_icons IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_icons.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    add_root_node( iv_key = 'PACKAGES' iv_text = 'ABAP Pakete mit Status' ).

    " Add icons to the tree's picture list
    mo_tree->add_picture( name = 'LOCAL_PACKAGE' path = icon_package_local ).
    mo_tree->add_picture( name = 'TRANSPORT_PACKAGE' path = icon_package_transport ).

    SELECT devclass AS package_name
      FROM tdevc
      WHERE devclass LIKE 'Z%'
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_packages).

    LOOP AT lt_packages INTO DATA(ls_package).
      DATA(lv_node_key) = |PKG_{ ls_package-package_name }|.
      DATA(lv_icon_id) = get_package_icon( ls_package-package_name ).

      DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        relat_node_key = 'PACKAGES'
        relat_position = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        text = ls_package-package_name
        is_folder = abap_true
        picture_id = lv_icon_id
      ).
      INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->add_nodes( mt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PACKAGES' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_data(
      node_key = iv_key
      text = iv_text
      is_folder = abap_true
      is_expanded = abap_false
    ).
    INSERT ls_node INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_package_icon.
    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_attributes) = lo_package_queries->get_package_attributes( iv_package = iv_package_name ).
        IF ls_attributes-transport_layer IS INITIAL.
          rv_icon_id = 'LOCAL_PACKAGE'.
        ELSE.
          rv_icon_id = 'TRANSPORT_PACKAGE'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_pak_package_not_found.
        rv_icon_id = ''. " No icon if package not found
      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        rv_icon_id = ''.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` ein. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Open SQL-Syntax mit Hostvariablen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT INTO ... VALUES ...` mit dem `@`-Escape-Zeichen für Hostvariablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sflight_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flight_record
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_price  TYPE sflight-price
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sflight_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_record.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                          connid = iv_connid
                          fldate = iv_fldate
                          price = iv_price
                          currency = iv_currency
                          planetype = '747'
                          seatsocc = 0
                          seatsmax = 300 ).

    INSERT INTO sflight VALUES @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_insert_flights.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_simple(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
      ( carrid = 'LH'
        connid = |{ 400 + i ALPHA = IN }|
        fldate = lv_start_date + i - 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, aber nur, wenn eine Zeile mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel noch nicht existiert. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Bedingungsprüfung und den `INSERT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` oder `TABLE_LINE` in einer `IF`-Bedingung, um die Existenz zu prüfen, bevor Sie `INSERT` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_if_not_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS insert_unique_item
      IMPORTING
        is_item TYPE ty_item
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_if_not_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_unique_item.
    IF NOT line_exists( ct_items[ id = is_item-id ] ).
      INSERT is_item INTO TABLE ct_items.
      rv_inserted = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_inserted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_unique FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_unique.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_insert_if_not_exists=>tt_item.
    DATA(ls_item1) = VALUE zcl_insert_if_not_exists=>ty_item( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ).
    DATA(ls_item2) = VALUE zcl_insert_if_not_exists=>ty_item( id = 2 name = 'Item B' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_if_not_exists( ).

    DATA(lv_inserted1) = lo_cut->insert_unique_item( EXPORTING is_item = ls_item1 CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_inserted1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lv_inserted2) = lo_cut->insert_unique_item( EXPORTING is_item = ls_item2 CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_inserted2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_insert_if_not_exists=>tt_item.
    DATA(ls_item) = VALUE zcl_insert_if_not_exists=>ty_item( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_if_not_exists( ).

    lo_cut->insert_unique_item( EXPORTING is_item = ls_item CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).
    DATA(lv_inserted_duplicate) = lo_cut->insert_unique_item( EXPORTING is_item = ls_item CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_inserted_duplicate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `line_exists` (seit ABAP 7.40) bietet eine performante und lesbare Möglichkeit, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle anhand ihres Schlüssels zu prüfen. Dies ist effizienter als eine `LOOP` oder `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfung.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, Conditional Logic, Unique Key

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie das `CL_GUI_CALENDAR`-Steuerelement und setzen Sie ein spezifisches Datum als ausgewähltes Datum. Demonstrieren Sie die moderne Objektinstanziierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW cl_gui_calendar(...)` und die Methode `SET_DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_calendar
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_calendar.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_calendar  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.

    " Create a custom container (assuming a screen with a custom control area 'CALENDAR_CONTAINER')
    " For unit test, we just instantiate the calendar, container is for actual display.
    " In a real scenario, this would be linked to a screen element.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CALENDAR_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error or skip for unit test context
    ENDIF.

    " Modern instantiation of the calendar control
    lo_calendar = NEW cl_gui_calendar( parent = lo_container ).

    " Set the date
    lo_calendar->set_date( iv_date ).

    " In a real program, you would now call CALL SCREEN or similar
    " to display the container and calendar.

    " For demonstration/unit test, we can check internal state if possible
    " (CL_GUI_CALENDAR doesn't expose selected date directly via GET_DATE without PBO/PAI cycle)
    " We'll rely on the unit test to check the method call.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_set_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calendar_init( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum.

    " Mock CL_GUI_CALENDAR to verify method call
    DATA(lo_calendar_mock) = CAST cl_gui_calendar( cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>create_mock( 'CL_GUI_CALENDAR' ) ).
    DATA(lo_container_mock) = CAST cl_gui_custom_container( cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>create_mock( 'CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER' ) ).

    " This part is tricky for GUI controls in unit tests.
    " We can't easily intercept the constructor call 'NEW cl_gui_calendar( parent = lo_container )'.
    " For a true unit test, one would typically abstract the GUI interaction.
    " For this example, we'll assume the method call to SET_DATE is the key.

    " A more robust test would involve dependency injection or a wrapper class.
    " For simplicity, we'll just call the method and assert no dump.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_calendar( iv_date = lv_test_date ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " No dump occurred" ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Instanziierung von Objekten mit `NEW` ist die moderne und bevorzugte Methode seit ABAP 7.40. Sie ist kompakter und ermöglicht die direkte Zuweisung zu einer Referenzvariablen. Für GUI-Steuerelemente ist das Unit-Testing der UI-Interaktion komplex, daher konzentriert sich der Test auf die Ausführung der Logik ohne Fehler.
keywords: CL_GUI_CALENDAR, GUI, Object Orientation, NEW, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `DATE_SELECTED`-Ereignis des `CL_GUI_CALENDAR`-Steuerelements. Der Handler soll das ausgewählte Datum verarbeiten.
hint: Definieren Sie eine `CLASS ... DEFINITION FOR EVENTS ...` und registrieren Sie den Event-Handler mit `SET HANDLER ... FOR ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS date_selected_event EXPORTING VALUE(e_date) TYPE sy-datum.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.

    METHODS handle_date_selected FOR EVENT date_selected OF cl_gui_calendar
      IMPORTING
        date.

    DATA mv_selected_date TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_date_selected FOR io_calendar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_date_selected.
    mv_selected_date = date.
    RAISE EVENT date_selected_event EXPORTING e_date = date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_calendar_mock) = CAST cl_gui_calendar( cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>create_mock( 'CL_GUI_CALENDAR' ) ).
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_calendar_event_handler( lo_calendar_mock ).

    DATA(lv_event_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_received_date) TYPE sy-datum.

    " Define a local event receiver for the custom event
    CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS receive_date_selected FOR EVENT date_selected_event OF zcl_calendar_event_handler
          IMPORTING e_date.
        DATA mv_received_date TYPE sy-datum.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD receive_date_selected.
        mv_received_date = e_date.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_receiver->receive_date_selected FOR lo_handler.

    " Simulate the event being raised by the calendar
    CALL METHOD lo_handler->handle_date_selected
      EXPORTING
        date = lv_event_date.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_handler->mv_selected_date exp = lv_event_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_receiver->mv_received_date exp = lv_event_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die ereignisgesteuerte Programmierung ist ein Kernkonzept in der GUI-Entwicklung. Die Verwendung von `FOR EVENT ... OF ...` und `SET HANDLER` ist die Standardmethode zur Implementierung von Event-Handlern. Der Unit-Test verwendet Mocking und einen lokalen Event-Receiver, um die Event-Verarbeitung zu simulieren und zu überprüfen, was eine moderne Teststrategie darstellt.
keywords: CL_GUI_CALENDAR, Events, Event Handling, SET HANDLER, Object Orientation, GUI

Instructions: Markieren Sie eine Liste von spezifischen Daten (z.B. Feiertage) im `CL_GUI_CALENDAR`-Steuerelement. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenübergabe und Schleifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SET_MARKING` und eine `FOR`-Schleife oder `REDUCE` für die Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_marking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_marked_date,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
             color TYPE i,
           END OF ty_marked_date.
    TYPES tt_marked_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_marked_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mark_dates
      IMPORTING
        io_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar
        it_dates_to_mark TYPE tt_marked_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_marking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mark_dates.
    " CL_GUI_CALENDAR->SET_MARKING expects a table of type CALENDAR_DATE_TAB
    " which is a table of CALENDAR_DATE (date, color).
    " We can use a REDUCE expression to transform our input table.

    DATA(lt_calendar_marking) = REDUCE cl_gui_calendar=>calendar_date_tab(
      INIT r = VALUE cl_gui_calendar=>calendar_date_tab( )
      FOR ls_date IN it_dates_to_mark
      APPEND VALUE #( date = ls_date-date color = ls_date-color ) TO r
    ).

    io_calendar->set_marking( lt_calendar_marking ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mark_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mark_dates.
    DATA(lo_calendar_mock) = CAST cl_gui_calendar( cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>create_mock( 'CL_GUI_CALENDAR' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calendar_marking( ).

    DATA(lt_dates) = VALUE zcl_calendar_marking=>tt_marked_dates(
      ( date = sy-datum color = 1 )
      ( date = sy-datum + 7 color = 2 )
    ).

    " We can't directly assert the internal state of the GUI control.
    " The test verifies that the method call happens without error.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->mark_dates( io_calendar = lo_calendar_mock it_dates_to_mark = lt_dates ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Method called without dump" ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression (seit ABAP 7.50) ist ideal, um eine interne Tabelle in eine andere Form zu transformieren oder zu aggregieren. Hier wird sie verwendet, um die Eingabetabelle in das vom Kalender-Steuerelement erwartete Format zu konvertieren, was eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung darstellt.

    ).

    INSERT ls_log_entry INTO TABLE mt_logged_dates.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten in eine Datenbanktabelle ein, die aus einer `SELECT`-Anweisung stammen. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Open SQL-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... FROM (SELECT ...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_select_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_from_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid_from TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_connid_to TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_inserted) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_select_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_from_select.
    DATA(lv_new_carrid) = 'ZZ'.
    DATA(lv_new_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Clean up any previous test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_new_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.

    INSERT sflight FROM ( SELECT carrid AS carrid,
                                  connid AS connid,
                                  fldate AS fldate,
                                  price AS price,
                                  currency AS currency,
                                  planetype AS planetype,
                                  seatsocc AS seatsocc,
                                  seatsmax AS seatsmax
                             FROM sflight
                            WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
                              AND connid BETWEEN @iv_connid_from AND @iv_connid_to
                              AND fldate = @sy-datum ).

    rv_rows_inserted = sy-dbcnt.

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_new_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_from_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_from_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_select_db( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid_from) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_connid_to) = '0017'.

    " Ensure there's data to select from
    DATA(ls_sflight_template) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid_from fldate = sy-datum
      price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 0 seatsmax = 300
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @ls_sflight_template.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_inserted_rows) = lo_cut->insert_from_select( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                                        iv_connid_from = lv_connid_from
                                                        iv_connid_to = lv_connid_to ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted_rows exp = 1 ).

    " Clean up original data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid_from AND fldate = @sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `INSERT ... FROM (SELECT ...)`-Befehl (seit ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das direkte Einfügen von Daten, die durch eine `SELECT`-Anweisung ermittelt wurden, in eine Datenbanktabelle. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode für Massendatenoperationen, da keine Daten erst in eine interne Tabelle geladen werden müssen.
keywords: INSERT, SELECT, Open SQL, Database, SFLIGHT, Mass Operations

CLASS zcl_insert_filtered_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Deaktivieren Sie bestimmte Daten im `CL_GUI_CALENDAR`-Steuerelement, sodass sie nicht ausgewählt werden können. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenübergabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SET_DISABLED_DATES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_disable_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS disable_specific_dates
      IMPORTING
        io_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar
        it_dates_to_disable TYPE tt_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_disable_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD disable_specific_dates.
    " CL_GUI_CALENDAR->SET_DISABLED_DATES expects a table of type CALENDAR_DATE_TAB
    " which is a table of CALENDAR_DATE (date, color). We only need the date here.
    DATA(lt_disabled_dates) = REDUCE cl_gui_calendar=>calendar_date_tab(
      INIT r = VALUE cl_gui_calendar=>calendar_date_tab( )
      FOR ls_date IN it_dates_to_disable
      APPEND VALUE #( date = ls_date color = 0 ) TO r " Color is irrelevant for disabling, but required by type
    ).

    io_calendar->set_disabled_dates( lt_disabled_dates ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calendar_disable_dates( ).

    DATA(lt_dates_to_disable) = VALUE zcl_calendar_disable_dates=>tt_dates(
      ( sy-datum )
      ( sy-datum + 1 )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->disable_specific_dates( io_calendar = lo_calendar_mock it_dates_to_disable = lt_dates_to_disable ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Method called without dump" ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaufbereitung, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen von doppelten Leerzeichen in einem String durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_replace_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_double_spaces IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_cleaned_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_regex_replace_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\s{2,}' ). " Matches two or more whitespace characters
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_cleaned_text = lo_matcher->replace( replacement = ' ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Log-Eintrag das Datum, die Uhrzeit und die Nachricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `FIND_ALL` mit Gruppen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             date    TYPE string,
             time    TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
TYPES tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_log_data IMPORTING iv_log_line TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_log_data.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s-\s(.*)$' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_log_entry-date    = lo_matcher->get_group( group = 1 ).
      rs_log_entry-time    = lo_matcher->get_group( group = 2 ).
      rs_log_entry-message = lo_matcher->get_group( group = 3 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_log FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_log( ).
    DATA(ls_entry) = lo_cut->extract_log_data( '2023-10-26 14:30:00 - User logged in successfully.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-date    exp = '2023-10-26' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-time    exp = '14:30:00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-message exp = 'User logged in successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_log( ).
    DATA(ls_entry) = lo_cut->extract_log_data( 'Invalid log format.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_entry-date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_entry-time ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_entry-message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Gruppen (`(...)`) in regulären Ausdrücken in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>GET_GROUP` ermöglicht das präzise Extrahieren spezifischer Teile eines Strings. Dies ist ideal für das Parsen strukturierter Daten aus unstrukturierten Texten.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, Groups, Parsing, Data Extraction

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit Fluginformationen (`sflights`) zu einer einzigen Tabelle, wobei Duplikate entfernt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `UNION`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

CLASS zcl_union_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS combine_flights IMPORTING it_flights1 TYPE tt_flight_key
                                      it_flights2 TYPE tt_flight_key
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_flights.
    rt_combined_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights1 UNION FOR flight IN it_flights2 ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
TYPES tt_flight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_union_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_flights_corr.
    rt_combined = VALUE #(
      FOR flight_s IN it_flights_short ( CORRESPONDING #( flight_s ) )
      UNION
      FOR flight_l IN it_flights_long ( flight_l )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie zwei `SELECT`-Anweisungen auf der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle aus und kombinieren Sie deren Ergebnisse, um eine Liste aller Flüge von 'FRA' oder nach 'JFK' zu erhalten, wobei Duplikate entfernt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ... SELECT` in Open SQL.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

CLASS zcl_sql_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sql_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_cities.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
      UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_cities( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    " Check if all results are either from FRANKFURT or to NEW YORK
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' OR ls_flight-cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for distinctness (UNION removes duplicates)
    DATA(lv_lines_before_sort) = lines( lt_flights ).
    SORT lt_flights BY carrid connid fldate.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_flights COMPARING carrid connid fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lines_before_sort exp = lines( lt_flights ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine Liste von Produktcodes. Ein gültiger Code besteht aus drei Großbuchstaben, gefolgt von einem Bindestrich und vier Ziffern (z.B. 'ABC-1234'). Ungültige Codes sollen herausgefiltert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` in Kombination mit einer `FILTER` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_filter_codes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_valid_codes IMPORTING it_product_codes TYPE string_table
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_valid_codes) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_filter_codes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_valid_codes.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '^[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}$' ).

    rt_valid_codes = FILTER #( it_product_codes USING KEY default WHERE lo_regex->match( table_line ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_codes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_codes.
    DATA(lt_input_codes) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'ABC-1234' )
      ( 'XYZ-9876' )
      ( 'AB-1234' ) " Invalid: too few letters
      ( 'ABCD-1234' ) " Invalid: too many letters
      ( 'ABC-123' ) " Invalid: too few digits
      ( 'abc-1234' ) " Invalid: lowercase letters
      ( '123-ABCD' ) " Invalid: wrong format
      ( 'DEF-5678' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_filter_codes( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_valid_codes( lt_input_codes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'ABC-1234' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'XYZ-9876' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'DEF-5678' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lt_input_codes) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_filter_codes( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_valid_codes( lt_input_codes ).

explanation: Die Kombination der `FILTER`-Expression (ABAP 7.40+) mit der `MATCH`-Methode von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Validierungsregeln. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `UNION` Operation auf zwei internen Tabellen durch, die Flugdaten enthalten. Die erste Tabelle enthält Flüge, die noch nicht gestartet sind, die zweite Tabelle enthält Flüge, die bereits gestartet sind. Kombinieren Sie diese und fügen Sie ein Feld `status` hinzu, das 'UPCOMING' oder 'DEPARTED' anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `UNION` und `VALUE` mit `COND` oder `SWITCH` für das Statusfeld.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

CLASS zcl_union_with_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS combine_flights_with_status IMPORTING it_upcoming TYPE tt_flight_raw
                                                  it_departed TYPE tt_flight_raw
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_with_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_flights_with_status.
    rt_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN it_upcoming ( VALUE ty_flight_status( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) status = 'UPCOMING' ) )
      UNION
      FOR flight IN it_departed ( VALUE ty_flight_status( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) status = 'DEPARTED' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_with_status.
    DATA: lt_upcoming TYPE tt_flight_raw,
          lt_departed TYPE tt_flight_raw.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231125' ) INTO TABLE lt_upcoming.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231124' ) INTO TABLE lt_departed.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_with_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_flights_with_status( it_upcoming = lt_upcoming it_departed = lt_departed ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-status exp = 'UPCOMING' ).

    DATA: lt_upcoming TYPE tt_flight_raw,

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231125' ) INTO TABLE lt_upcoming.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231125' ) INTO TABLE lt_departed. " Same flight in both lists

  ENDMETHOD.

Es ermöglicht nicht nur das Zusammenführen von Tabellen, sondern auch die Transformation der Daten während des Prozesses, indem neue Felder wie `status` hinzugefügt werden. Die Reihenfolge der `UNION`-Operanden kann bei Duplikaten relevant sein.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String eine gültige IP-Adresse (IPv4) enthält und extrahieren Sie diese. Wenn mehrere IPs vorhanden sind, sollen alle gefunden werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `FIND_ALL` mit Gruppen, um alle Übereinstimmungen zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_ipv4_addresses IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_ipv4_addresses) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_ipv4_addresses.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\b(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\b' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_group( group = 0 ) TO rt_ipv4_addresses.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_single_ipv4 FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_no_ipv4 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_ipv4_parts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_ipv4_addresses( 'Server IP is 192.168.1.100.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = '192.168.1.100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_ipv4_addresses( 'IPs: 10.0.0.1, 172.16.0.255 and 192.168.1.1.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = '10.0.0.1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = '172.16.0.255' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = '192.168.1.1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_ipv4_addresses( 'No IP address here.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4_parts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_ipv4_addresses( 'Invalid IPs: 256.0.0.1 or 1.2.3.400.' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FIND`-Methode des Matcher-Objekts von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` in einer `WHILE`-Schleife ermöglicht das iterative Auffinden aller Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks in einem String. Dies ist ideal, um alle gültigen IP-Adressen aus einem längeren Text zu extrahieren.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, FIND, IPv4, Data Extraction, String Processing

           END OF ty_plane_info.
TYPES tt_plane_info TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_plane_info WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

CLASS zcl_union_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_enriched_flights IMPORTING it_additional_plane_info TYPE tt_plane_info
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_plane_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_base TYPE tt_flight_base.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_base.

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR flight_s IN lt_sflights_base ( CORRESPONDING ty_plane_info( flight_s ) )
      UNION
      FOR plane_i IN it_additional_plane_info ( plane_i )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Hashtags (Wörter, die mit '#' beginnen) aus einem gegebenen Text. Hashtags dürfen nur Buchstaben, Zahlen und Unterstriche enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `FIND_ALL` mit einer `FOR` Expression, um die Ergebnisse zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_hashtags DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_hashtags IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_hashtags) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_hashtags IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_hashtags.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '#[a-zA-Z0-9_]+' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    rt_hashtags = VALUE #(
      FOR <match> IN lo_matcher->find_all( ) ( <match>-offset && <match>-length )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_hashtags( 'This is a #test.' ).

  METHOD test_multiple_hashtags.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen von Flugbuchungen (`SBOOK`), die jeweils Buchungen für verschiedene Zeiträume enthalten. Entfernen Sie Duplikate und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Zieltabelle nach Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Buchungsdatum sortiert ist.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_key,

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges Datum im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' enthält und extrahieren Sie es.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `MATCH` mit Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_date_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_date IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_date_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\b(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\b' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_date = lo_matcher->get_group( group = 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` und Buchungsdaten aus `SBOOK` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Verwenden Sie `UNION` in Open SQL, um alle relevanten Datensätze zu erhalten, die entweder Flug- oder Buchungsinformationen für die angegebene Route enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ... SELECT` und passen Sie die Spaltenauswahl an, um eine gemeinsame Struktur zu erhalten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             data_type TYPE string, " 'FLIGHT' or 'BOOKING'
             detail_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_data.
TYPES tt_flight_booking_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_sflight_sbook DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_booking_union IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                               iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_booking_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_sflight_sbook IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_booking_union.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, 'FLIGHT' AS data_type, planetype AS detail_info
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, 'BOOKING' AS data_type, bookid AS detail_info
      FROM sbook
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_sflight_sbook FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_data_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_sflight_sbook.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_sflight_sbook( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_booking_union( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_booking_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-data_type = 'FLIGHT'.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-detail_info ). " planetype should be filled
      ELSEIF ls_entry-data_type = 'BOOKING'.
        lv_booking_count = lv_booking_count + 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-detail_info ). " bookid should be filled
      ENDIF.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-connid exp = '0400' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_flight_count > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_booking_count > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_data_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_sflight_sbook( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_booking_union( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `UNION` in Open SQL (ABAP 7.40+), um Daten aus zwei verschiedenen Datenbanktabellen (`SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK`) zu kombinieren. Durch die Verwendung von Aliasnamen (`AS data_type`, `AS detail_info`) wird eine einheitliche Struktur für die Ergebnistabelle geschaffen, was die Weiterverarbeitung vereinfacht. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Technik für die Aggregation heterogener Daten.
keywords: Open SQL, UNION, SELECT, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, SBOOK, Data Aggregation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Ampelsystem, bei dem ein gegebener Status (Rot, Gelb, Grün) die nächste Aktion bestimmt. Verwenden Sie eine Enumeration für den Ampelstatus und einen konditionalen Ausdruck (COND), um eine beschreibende Aktion zurückzugeben.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Enumerationstyp für Ampelfarben und verwenden Sie COND, um die Farbe einer Aktion zuzuordnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_light_status,
             red,
             yellow,
             green,
           END OF ENUM traffic_light_status.

    METHODS get_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE traffic_light_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_action.
    rv_action = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = traffic_light_status=>red    THEN 'Stop'
      WHEN iv_status = traffic_light_status=>yellow THEN 'Prepare to stop/go'
      WHEN iv_status = traffic_light_status=>green  THEN 'Go'
      ELSE 'Unknown Status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für verschiedene Auftragsstatus (z.B. Neu, In Bearbeitung, Versandt, Geliefert, Storniert). Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Auftragsstatus entgegennimmt und einen booleschen Wert zurückgibt, der angibt, ob der Auftrag noch 'aktiv' ist (d.h. nicht geliefert oder storniert). Verwenden Sie einen SWITCH-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie SWITCH für den Enumerationswert, um den aktiven Status zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status,
             new,
             processing,
             shipped,
             delivered,
             cancelled,
           END OF ENUM order_status.

    METHODS is_order_active
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE order_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_active) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_order_active.
    rv_is_active = SWITCH abap_bool( iv_status
      WHEN order_status=>new        THEN abap_true
      WHEN order_status=>processing THEN abap_true
      WHEN order_status=>shipped    THEN abap_true
      WHEN order_status=>delivered  THEN abap_false
      WHEN order_status=>cancelled  THEN abap_false
      ELSE abap_false " Default for unknown status
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_active_statuses FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_inactive_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_active_statuses.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_order_processor( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_processor->is_order_active( zcl_order_processor=>order_status=>new ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_processor->is_order_active( zcl_order_processor=>order_status=>processing ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_processor->is_order_active( zcl_order_processor=>order_status=>shipped ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_inactive_statuses.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_order_processor( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_processor->is_order_active( zcl_order_processor=>order_status=>delivered ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_processor->is_order_active( zcl_order_processor=>order_status=>cancelled ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ENUM stellt sicher, dass nur gültige Auftragsstatus verwendet werden, was die Datenintegrität verbessert. Der SWITCH-Ausdruck bietet eine saubere und lesbare Möglichkeit, mehrere bedingte Verzweigungen basierend auf dem Enumerationswert zu behandeln, wodurch die Logik zur Bestimmung des aktiven Status sehr klar wird.
keywords: ENUMERATION, SWITCH, Object Orientation, Status Management

hint: Verwenden Sie SWITCH, um die Aggregationslogik auszuwählen, und REDUCE für die tatsächliche Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM aggregation_type,
             sum,
             average,
             minimum,
             maximum,
           END OF ENUM aggregation_type.

    METHODS aggregate_data
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_aggregation_type TYPE aggregation_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_data.
    rv_result = SWITCH decfloat16( iv_aggregation_type
      WHEN aggregation_type=>sum THEN REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num )
      WHEN aggregation_type=>average THEN
        COND decfloat16(
          WHEN lines( it_numbers ) > 0 THEN REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ) / lines( it_numbers )
          ELSE 0
        )
      WHEN aggregation_type=>minimum THEN
        COND decfloat16(
          WHEN lines( it_numbers ) > 0 THEN REDUCE decfloat16( INIT m = it_numbers[1] FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT m = nmin( m, num ) )
          ELSE 0
        )
      WHEN aggregation_type=>maximum THEN
        COND decfloat16(
          WHEN lines( it_numbers ) > 0 THEN REDUCE decfloat16( INIT m = it_numbers[1] FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT m = nmax( m, num ) )
          ELSE 0
        )
      ELSE 0
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Füllen einer internen Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen, einmal mit einer klassischen `LOOP AT` und einmal mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck. Vergleichen Sie die Performance.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime()` oder `cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time()` für die Messung und den `FOR`-Ausdruck für die moderne Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_loop_vs_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fill_table_loop
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.

    METHODS fill_table_for
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_loop_vs_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_table_loop.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      ls_data-id = sy-index.
      ls_data-value = |Value { sy-index }|.
      APPEND ls_data TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_table_for.
    rt_data = VALUE tt_data( FOR i = 1 UNTIL iv_count + 1 ( id = i value = |Value { i }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION MEDIUM.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fill_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fill_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_loop_vs_for( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 100000.

    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lt_data_loop) = lo_cut->fill_table_loop( lv_count ).
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_loop) = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    DATA(lv_start_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lt_data_for) = lo_cut->fill_table_for( lv_count ).
    DATA(lv_end_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_for) = lv_end_for - lv_start_for.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data_loop ) exp = lv_count msg = 'Loop: Incorrect number of lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data_for ) exp = lv_count msg = 'For: Incorrect number of lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data_loop exp = lt_data_for msg = 'Tables are not identical' ).

    " Optional: Log performance for manual comparison
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lv_time_for < lv_time_loop ) msg = |FOR is faster: { lv_time_for } vs { lv_time_loop }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_runtime` ermöglicht präzise Messungen der CPU-Zeit, um die Effizienz verschiedener Implementierungen zu vergleichen. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ist oft kompakter und kann in vielen Fällen auch performanter sein als klassische Schleifen.
keywords: cl_abap_runtime, FOR, LOOP, Performance, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für die Summenbildung über eine Spalte einer internen Tabelle, einmal mit `REDUCE` und einmal mit einer klassischen `LOOP` und Addition.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_reduce_vs_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_loop
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

    METHODS calculate_sum_reduce
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_reduce_vs_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_loop.
    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      rv_sum = rv_sum + ls_item-amount.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sum_reduce.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_item IN it_items NEXT s = s + ls_item-amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).

    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).

CLASS zcl_perf_filter_vs_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_loop
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

    METHODS filter_flights_filter
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_filter_vs_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_loop.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid.
        APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights_filter.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für die Prüfung, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert, einmal mit `LINE_EXISTS` und einmal mit `READ TABLE` und `SY-SUBRC`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und den `LINE_EXISTS`-Operator für die moderne Existenzprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product,
           tt_products TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS check_exists_read_table
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
        iv_id       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS check_exists_line_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
        iv_id       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_exists_read_table.
    READ TABLE it_products WITH KEY id = iv_id TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_exists_line_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_products[ id = iv_id ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION MEDIUM.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_exists_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_exists_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_line_exists( ).
    DATA: lt_test_products TYPE zcl_perf_line_exists=>tt_products.
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      INSERT VALUE zcl_perf_line_exists=>ty_product( id = sy-index name = |Product { sy-index }| ) INTO TABLE lt_test_products.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_search_id_exists) = 50000.
    DATA(lv_search_id_not_exists) = 100001.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 1000.

    DATA(lv_start_read) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lb_exists_read) = lo_cut->check_exists_read_table( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_exists ).
      lb_exists_read = lo_cut->check_exists_read_table( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_not_exists ).
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_end_read) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_read) = lv_end_read - lv_start_read.

    DATA(lv_start_line_exists) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lb_exists_line_exists) = lo_cut->check_exists_line_exists( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_exists ).
      lb_exists_line_exists = lo_cut->check_exists_line_exists( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_not_exists ).
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_end_line_exists) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_line_exists) = lv_end_line_exists - lv_start_line_exists.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_exists_read_table( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_exists ) exp = abap_true msg = 'READ TABLE: Existing ID not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_exists_read_table( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_not_exists ) exp = abap_false msg = 'READ TABLE: Non-existing ID found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_exists_line_exists( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_exists ) exp = abap_true msg = 'LINE_EXISTS: Existing ID not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_exists_line_exists( it_products = lt_test_products iv_id = lv_search_id_not_exists ) exp = abap_false msg = 'LINE_EXISTS: Non-existing ID found' ).

    " Optional: Log performance for manual comparison
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lv_time_line_exists < lv_time_read ) msg = |LINE_EXISTS is faster: { lv_time_line_exists } vs { lv_time_read }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_add_sub_months DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_add_sub_months IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Verketten von 10.000 Strings, einmal mit dem klassischen `CONCATENATE` und einmal mit String-Templates (`&&`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und String-Templates für die moderne String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS concatenate_classic
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS concatenate_template
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_classic.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE string.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      CONCATENATE rv_result 'Part' sy-index INTO rv_result.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD concatenate_template.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE string.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      rv_result = rv_result && |Part{ sy-index }|.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION MEDIUM.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_concat_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 10000.

    DATA(lv_start_classic) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_result_classic) = lo_cut->concatenate_classic( lv_count ).
    DATA(lv_end_classic) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_classic) = lv_end_classic - lv_start_classic.

    DATA(lv_start_template) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_result_template) = lo_cut->concatenate_template( lv_count ).
    DATA(lv_end_template) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_template) = lv_end_template - lv_start_template.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_classic exp = lv_result_template msg = 'Concatenated strings are not equal' ).

    " Optional: Log performance for manual comparison
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lv_time_template < lv_time_classic ) msg = |String Template is faster: { lv_time_template } vs { lv_time_classic }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`&&` oder `|...|`) bieten eine moderne, lesbare und oft performantere Alternative zur klassischen `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung für die String-Verkettung. `cl_abap_runtime` ist ideal, um diese Performance-Unterschiede zu messen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf dem Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_date` und die Methode `get_years_between` oder eine Kombination aus Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculate_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_current_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculate_age IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.
    DATA(lo_birth_date) = cl_reca_date=>create_date( iv_birth_date ).
    DATA(lo_current_date) = cl_reca_date=>create_date( iv_current_date ).

    rv_age = lo_current_date->get_years_between( lo_birth_date ).

    " Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet in the current year
    DATA(lv_birth_month_day) = iv_birth_date+4(4).
    DATA(lv_current_month_day) = iv_current_date+4(4).

    IF lv_current_month_day < lv_birth_month_day.
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Gruppieren von Daten in einer internen Tabelle, einmal mit `GROUP BY` in einer `LOOP` und einmal mit einer manuellen Gruppierung (z.B. `SORT` und `AT NEW`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und den `GROUP BY`-Ausdruck für die moderne Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_data,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_data,
           tt_sales_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_sales,
             region TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_sales,
           tt_grouped_sales TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_sales WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_by_loop
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_sales) TYPE tt_grouped_sales.

    METHODS group_by_expression
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_sales) TYPE tt_grouped_sales.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_loop.
    DATA: lt_sorted_sales TYPE tt_sales_data.
    lt_sorted_sales = it_sales_data.
    SORT lt_sorted_sales BY region.

    DATA: ls_grouped_sales TYPE ty_grouped_sales.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted_sales INTO DATA(ls_sales).
      AT NEW region.
        CLEAR ls_grouped_sales.
        ls_grouped_sales-region = ls_sales-region.
      ENDAT.
      ls_grouped_sales-total_amount = ls_grouped_sales-total_amount + ls_sales-amount.
      AT END OF region.
        APPEND ls_grouped_sales TO rt_grouped_sales.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD group_by_expression.
    rt_grouped_sales = VALUE tt_grouped_sales(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sales IN it_sales_data GROUP BY ls_sales-region ASCENDING
      ( region = ls_sales-region
        total_amount = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP NEXT s = s + <member>-amount ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION MEDIUM.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_group_by( ).
    DATA: lt_test_sales TYPE zcl_perf_group_by=>tt_sales_data.
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE zcl_perf_group_by=>ty_sales_data( region = COND #( WHEN sy-index MOD 3 = 0 THEN 'North' WHEN sy-index MOD 3 = 1 THEN 'South' ELSE 'East' ) product = |Prod{ sy-index MOD 10 }| amount = sy-index ) TO lt_test_sales.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_loop) = lo_cut->group_by_loop( lt_test_sales ).
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_loop) = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    DATA(lv_start_expression) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_expression) = lo_cut->group_by_expression( lt_test_sales ).
    DATA(lv_end_expression) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_cpu_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time_expression) = lv_end_expression - lv_start_expression.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped_loop ) exp = lines( lt_grouped_expression ) msg = 'Grouped line counts are not equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped_loop exp = lt_grouped_expression msg = 'Grouped tables are not identical' ).

    " Optional: Log performance for manual comparison
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lv_time_expression < lv_time_loop ) msg = |GROUP BY expression is faster: { lv_time_expression } vs { lv_time_loop }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Er ersetzt die oft umständliche manuelle Gruppierung mit `SORT` und `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`. `cl_abap_runtime` hilft, die Performance-Vorteile dieser modernen Syntax zu demonstrieren.
keywords: cl_abap_runtime, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Performance, REDUCE

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und lesen Sie die Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT=>CREATE_BY_URL`, `SEND`, `RECEIVE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_get_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_get_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. "Placeholder for proper error handling
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error sending HTTP request: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error receiving HTTP response: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rv_response_body = |HTTP Request Failed: { lv_error_message }|.
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        rv_response_body = |HTTP Destination Error: { lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_req_send_error INTO DATA(lx_req_send_error).
        rv_response_body = |HTTP Request Send Error: { lx_req_send_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_io_error).
        rv_response_body = |HTTP I/O Error: { lx_io_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_response_body = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
            lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe URL und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_data,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_data.

    METHODS perform_post_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        is_data TYPE ty_post_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_post_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string,
          lv_json_request TYPE string.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( EXPORTING data = is_data PRETTY_PRINT = abap_false CHANGING json = lv_json_request ).

        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error sending HTTP request: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error receiving HTTP response: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rv_response_body = |HTTP Request Failed: { lv_error_message }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_response_body = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
            lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_http_status.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error sending HTTP request: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error receiving HTTP response: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rv_status_code = -1. " Indicate a client-side error
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).

            lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request über HTTPS durch und stellen Sie sicher, dass die SSL-Verbindung korrekt gehandhabt wird.
hint: HTTPS-Verbindungen werden von `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` automatisch über die SMICM-Konfiguration und SSL-Client-PSEs verwaltet. Es ist keine explizite Code-Änderung erforderlich, aber die Systemkonfiguration ist entscheidend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_https_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_https_get_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_https_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_https_get_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        " For HTTPS, no special code is needed here, as SSL handling is configured at system level (SMICM, STRUST)
        " The client automatically uses the appropriate SSL client PSE based on the URL.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error sending HTTPS request: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error receiving HTTPS response: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rv_response_body = |HTTPS Request Failed: { lv_error_message }|.
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        rv_response_body = |HTTPS Destination Error: { lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_req_send_error INTO DATA(lx_req_send_error).
        rv_response_body = |HTTPS Request Send Error: { lx_req_send_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_io_error).
        rv_response_body = |HTTPS I/O Error: { lx_io_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_response_body = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
            lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
