hint: Verwenden Sie `RESPONSE->GET_COOKIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_read_cookies DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cookie,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_cookie,
           ty_cookies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cookie WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_get_and_read_cookies
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cookies) TYPE ty_cookies.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_read_cookies IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_get_and_read_cookies.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error sending HTTP request: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = |Error receiving HTTP response: { sy-subrc }|.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lt_raw_cookies) = lo_http_client->response->get_cookies( ).
        LOOP AT lt_raw_cookies INTO DATA(ls_raw_cookie).
          APPEND VALUE ty_cookie( name = ls_raw_cookie-name value = ls_raw_cookie-value ) TO rt_cookies.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        " Error handling, return empty table
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Error handling, return empty table
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
            lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'LH', 'UA') und verwenden Sie diese, um eine Liste von Flügen zu filtern.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Inline-Deklaration für Ranges und den `VALUE` Operator zur Initialisierung. Für die Filterung verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid IN lt_carrid_range ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_range_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Range-Tabelle wird mit dem `VALUE` Operator inline initialisiert. Der `FOR` Operator in Verbindung mit `WHERE` ermöglicht eine kompakte Filterung der internen Tabelle basierend auf der Range, ohne explizite Schleifen. Dies ist eine moderne und deklarative Art der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: RANGES, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer in eine neue Tabelle kopieren und dabei die Fluggesellschaft in Kleinbuchstaben umwandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit einer Inline-Strukturdefinition und `to_lower`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             carrier   TYPE string,
             flight_no TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_raw_flights
        ( carrier = to_lower( flight-carrid )
          flight_no = flight-connid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_raw TYPE zcl_for_transform=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_raw.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrier exp = 'lh' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_no exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrier exp = 'ua' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird jede Zeile der Quelltabelle in eine neue Struktur umgewandelt, wobei die `carrid` in Kleinbuchstaben konvertiert wird, alles in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, to_lower, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (SUMME von `seatsocc`) aus einer Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Summenwert zu reduzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight_seats.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 75 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 225 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten, unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch aus einer Struktur, dessen Feldname zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den dynamischen Komponenten-Zugriff mit `(field_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    TRY.
        rv_value = is_data-(iv_field_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Feld nicht gefunden oder Typinkompatibilität
        rv_value = 'ERROR: Feld nicht gefunden oder ungültiger Typ'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Wert 1'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 'Wert 2'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ) exp = 'Wert 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ) exp = 'Wert 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ) exp = 'ERROR: Feld nicht gefunden oder ungültiger Typ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Komponenten-Zugriff `(field_name)` ermöglicht es, auf Felder einer Struktur oder eines Objekts zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist eine mächtige Funktion für generische oder dynamische Programmieraufgaben und wird hier mit einer `TRY...CATCH` Block für Fehlerbehandlung kombiniert.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Dynamic Field Access, Structures, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt, unter Verwendung der modernen Datum- und Zeitfunktionen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Minimalwert aus einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `cl_abap_math=>min` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_min DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_minimum_value
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_value) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_min IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_minimum_value.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      " Bei leerer Tabelle wird der Initialwert von decfloat34 zurückgegeben (0).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_value = it_values[ 1 ]. " Initialisierung mit dem ersten Wert

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value) FROM 2. " Beginnt ab dem zweiten Element
      rv_min_value = cl_abap_math=>min( val1 = rv_min_value val2 = lv_value ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_minimum_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_minimum_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_min( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34( ( '10.5' ) ( '3.2' ) ( '15.0' ) ( '3.1' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_minimum_value( lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '3.1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_min( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_minimum_value( lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_min( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34( ( '42.0' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_minimum_value( lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '42.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_min( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34( ( '-5.0' ) ( '-10.0' ) ( '0.0' ) ( '-1.0' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_minimum_value( lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '-10.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_math=>min` ermöglicht den direkten Vergleich zweier Werte. In Kombination mit einer `LOOP AT ... FROM` Schleife kann so der Minimalwert einer Tabelle effizient ermittelt werden, ohne manuelle If-Abfragen und unter Nutzung der modernen Inline-Deklaration `DATA(lv_value)`.
keywords: Math, Minimum, DECFLOAT34, Internal Tables, cl_abap_math

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den natürlichen Logarithmus einer positiven Dezimalzahl. Fangen Sie eine mögliche Ausnahme ab, wenn der Eingabewert nicht positiv ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `cl_abap_math=>ln` und die Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_ln DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_natural_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_value) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Für nicht-positive Werte
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_ln IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_natural_log.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Eingabewert für den natürlichen Logarithmus muss positiv sein.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_log_value = cl_abap_math=>ln( iv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_natural_log FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_input_negative FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_natural_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_ln( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( iv_value = '2.718281828459045' ). " e
    " Assert mit einer kleinen Toleranz aufgrund von Gleitkommaungenauigkeiten
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_result exp = '1.0' delta = '0.000000000000001' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( iv_value = '1.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.0' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( iv_value = '10.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_result exp = '2.302585092994046' delta = '0.000000000000001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_ln( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
    ).
    lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( iv_value = '0.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_ln( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
    ).
    lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( iv_value = '-5.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_math=>ln` bietet eine integrierte Funktion für den natürlichen Logarithmus, die mathematische Berechnungen vereinfacht und die Genauigkeit sicherstellt. Die explizite Fehlerbehandlung für ungültige Eingaben (nicht-positive Zahlen) ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cts_read_file( ).

    DATA(lv_test_content) = 'Hello World from Test!'.

        " Temporäre Datei für den Test erstellen

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cts_get_list( ).

    DATA(lv_language) = 'E'.

          IF ls_file-file_name = lv_file2.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found1 ).

CLASS zcl_cts_write_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_language_file_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_lines     TYPE string_table
        iv_file_name TYPE string

      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io.

CLASS zcl_cts_write_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_language_file_lines.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_content) = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR <line> IN it_lines
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <line> )
        ).

        cl_cts_language_file_io=>set_file_content(
          i_file_name = iv_file_name
          i_language  = iv_language
          i_content   = lv_content
        ).
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error. " Ausnahme weiterleiten
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie den Inhalt einer sprachabhängigen Datei in eine andere sprachabhängige Datei. Beide Dateien werden im Kontext des Change and Transport Systems (CTS) verwaltet. Behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `get_file_content` und `set_file_content` von `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_copy_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_file_name TYPE string
        iv_source_language  TYPE sy-langu
        iv_target_file_name TYPE string
        iv_target_language  TYPE sy-langu
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_copy_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_language_file.
    TRY.
        " Inhalt der Quelldatei lesen
        DATA(lv_content) = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_content(
          i_file_name = iv_source_file_name
          i_language  = iv_source_language
        ).

        " Inhalt in die Zieldatei schreiben
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>set_file_content(
          i_file_name = iv_target_file_name
          i_language  = iv_target_language
          i_content   = lv_content
        ).

      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error. " Ausnahme weiterleiten
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Textanhang (z.B. eine einfache Textdatei) unter Verwendung der modernen BCS-Utility-Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BCS_UTILITIES=>SEND_MAIL` und die Parameter für Anhänge.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_mail_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_attachment,
        filename TYPE string,
        content  TYPE xstring,
        filetype TYPE string,
      END OF ty_attachment,
      tt_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
        it_attachments     TYPE tt_attachments OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_mail_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA: lt_bcs_attachments TYPE cl_bcs_utilities=>tt_bcs_attachments.

    LOOP AT it_attachments INTO DATA(ls_attachment).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        filename = ls_attachment-filename
        content  = ls_attachment-content
        filetype = ls_attachment-filetype
      ) TO lt_bcs_attachments.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        cl_bcs_utilities=>send_mail(
          i_sender_address = 'sender@example.com' " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige Absender-E-Mail
          i_recipient_address = iv_recipient_email
          i_subject = iv_subject
          i_content = iv_body
          it_attachments = lt_bcs_attachments
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine vorhandene Tabelle transformieren und dabei nur bestimmte Felder übernehmen und umbenennen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Constructor Expressions `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_orig,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_sflight_orig,
      tt_sflight_orig TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_orig WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_original_flights TYPE tt_sflight_orig
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_original_flights
      (
        airline_id  = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_num  = ls_flight-connid
        flight_date = ls_flight-fldate
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_itab_for_value=>tt_sflight_orig(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251125' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_transformed )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte übereinstimmen.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-airline_id
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Erste Zeile Airline ID sollte LH sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-flight_date
      exp = '20251201'
      msg = 'Zweite Zeile Flugdatum sollte 20251201 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und wartungsfreundlicher als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... APPEND ...` Konstrukte.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Constructor Expression, Transformation

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines numerischen Feldes in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_item,
      tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_value) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_total_value = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_item IN it_items
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_item-value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_itab_reduce=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = '10.5' )
      ( id = 2 value = '20.0' )
      ( id = 3 value = '5.5' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = '36.0'
      msg = 'Die Summe sollte 36.0 sein.'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_itab_reduce=>tt_items( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_empty_sum
      exp = '0.0'
      msg = 'Die Summe einer leeren Tabelle sollte 0.0 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein mächtiges funktionales Konstrukt, um interne Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Sie ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Schreibweise für Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Constructor Expression, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte, unter Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY`, `CATCH` und `ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division durch Null nicht erlaubt.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen, Standardwert zurückgeben
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Fehler bei Division: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_result = 0. " Standardwert im Fehlerfall
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_safe_divide FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_numbers_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_divide.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_demo( ).

    DATA(lv_result_ok) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_ok
      exp = '5.0'
      msg = '10 geteilt durch 2 sollte 5.0 sein.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_error) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_error
      exp = '0.0'
      msg = 'Division durch Null sollte 0.0 zurückgeben (Fehlerbehandlung).' " Annahme: 0.0 ist der Standardwert
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_numbers_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR' ).
    lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ist der moderne und empfohlene Weg zur Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, potenzielle Fehler abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies führt zu robusterem und wartungsfreundlicherem Code.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY...CATCH, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Werktages (Montag bis Freitag) ausgehend von einem gegebenen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik mit `+` und `CASE`.

CLASS zcl_next_working_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_working_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_working_day) TYPE d.

CLASS zcl_next_working_day IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_working_day.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_date.
    DO.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5. " Montag (1) bis Freitag (5)
        rv_next_working_day = lv_current_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung einer funktionalen Reduktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      " Fallback for demo if no data is passed, usually fetch from DB
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_db)
        UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_sflights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_db ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_sflights_agg=>tt_sflight(

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Er ersetzt Schleifen mit expliziten `COMPUTE`-Anweisungen und ist Teil des funktionalen Programmierparadigmas in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn eine Zahl positiv ist, soll ihr Wert verdoppelt werden, ansonsten soll sie halbiert werden. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator für konditionale Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_number.
    rv_result = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_number > 0 THEN iv_number * 2
      ELSE iv_number / 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_number.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_conditional_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_number( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_conditional_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_number( -8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_number.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_conditional_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_number( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art der bedingten Zuweisung, die das ältere `IF ... ENDIF` mit `COMPUTE`-Anweisungen in vielen Fällen ersetzt und den Code lesbarer macht.
keywords: COMPUTE, COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Endpreis eines Artikels, der einen Grundpreis, einen Rabattprozentsatz und eine Mehrwertsteuer (19%) hat. Verwenden Sie moderne Inline-Deklarationen und arithmetische Ausdrücke.
hint: Kombinieren Sie arithmetische Operatoren und Inline-Deklarationen für Zwischenergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_price_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_final_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_discount_percent TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_final_price.
    DATA(lv_price_after_discount) = iv_base_price * ( 1 - iv_discount_percent / 100 ).
    DATA(lv_price_with_vat) = lv_price_after_discount * '1.19'. " 19% VAT
    rv_final_price = lv_price_with_vat.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_standard_case FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_discount FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_standard_case.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_price_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_final_price( iv_base_price = '100.00' iv_discount_percent = '10.00' ).
    " 100 * (1 - 0.10) = 90
    " 90 * 1.19 = 107.10
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '107.10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_discount.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_price_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_final_price( iv_base_price = '50.00' iv_discount_percent = '0.00' ).
    " 50 * (1 - 0) = 50
    " 50 * 1.19 = 59.50
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '59.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_price.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_price_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_final_price( iv_base_price = '0.00' iv_discount_percent = '20.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lv_...)`) in Kombination mit direkten arithmetischen Ausdrücken macht den Code sehr lesbar und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit separater `COMPUTE`-Anweisungen. Dies ist ein Standardmuster in modernem ABAP für Berechnungen.
keywords: COMPUTE, Arithmetic, Inline Declaration, Expressions, Decimals

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Wert eines dynamisch übergebenen numerischen Feldes um einen bestimmten Betrag. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole für den dynamischen Zugriff und eine moderne arithmetische Zuweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und Feldsymbole in Kombination mit `+=` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increase_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_amount TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ir_data_ref->* TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Field not found or not assignable'.
    ENDIF.

    " Modern arithmetic assignment
    <fs_value> = <fs_value> + iv_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_existing_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found EXPECTING cx_sy_assign_error.
    METHODS test_initial_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_existing_field.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            value1 TYPE i VALUE 10,
            value2 TYPE i VALUE 20,
          END OF ls_data.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO ls_data.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_calc( ).
    lo_calculator->increase_field_value(
      ir_data_ref = lr_data
      iv_field_name = 'VALUE1'
      iv_amount = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value1 exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            value1 TYPE i VALUE 10,
          END OF ls_data.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO ls_data.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_calc( ).
    lo_calculator->increase_field_value(
      ir_data_ref = lr_data
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
      iv_amount = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_value.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            value1 TYPE i VALUE 0,
          END OF ls_data.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO ls_data.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_calc( ).
    lo_calculator->increase_field_value(
      ir_data_ref = lr_data
      iv_field_name = 'VALUE1'
      iv_amount = 7 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value1 exp = 7 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch auf Felder zugreift und arithmetische Operationen durchführt. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen und der `+=`-Operator sind moderne Ansätze, die `COMPUTE` in diesem Kontext ersetzen und den Code flexibler machen. Die Ausnahmebehandlung mit `RAISING` ist ebenfalls ein modernes Muster.
keywords: COMPUTE, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, Data References, Arithmetic, Exceptions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_SECRET_DATA` und `ZCL_DATA_READER`. `ZCL_SECRET_DATA` soll eine private Methode `get_secret_value` haben. `ZCL_DATA_READER` soll als Freund von `ZCL_SECRET_DATA` deklariert werden, um auf diese private Methode zugreifen zu können.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS`-Anweisung in der `DEFINITION` der Klasse, die den Zugriff gewährt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secret_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_public_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_secret_value TYPE string VALUE 'Geheimnis'.
    METHODS get_secret_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_secret) TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_data_reader. " ZCL_DATA_READER ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secret_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialisierung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_public_info.
    rv_info = 'Öffentliche Information'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_secret_value.
    rv_secret = mv_secret_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_secret_from_data
      IMPORTING
        io_secret_data TYPE REF TO zcl_secret_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_secret) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_secret_from_data.
    " Als Freund kann ZCL_DATA_READER auf die private Methode zugreifen
    rv_secret = io_secret_data->get_secret_value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_secret FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_public_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_secret.
    DATA(lo_secret_data) = NEW zcl_secret_data( ).
    DATA(lo_data_reader) = NEW zcl_data_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_secret) = lo_data_reader->read_secret_from_data( lo_secret_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_secret exp = 'Geheimnis' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_public_access.
    DATA(lo_secret_data) = NEW zcl_secret_data( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_secret_data->get_public_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Öffentliche Information' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS`-Anweisung ermöglicht einen kontrollierten Zugriff auf private und geschützte Komponenten einer Klasse, ohne die Kapselung vollständig aufzuheben. Dies ist nützlich für eng gekoppelte Klassen, die zusammenarbeiten müssen, aber nicht alle Details öffentlich machen sollen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, Private Methods

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Factory-Pattern für eine Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT`, deren Konstruktor privat ist. Die Factory-Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` soll die einzige Möglichkeit sein, Instanzen von `ZCL_PRODUCT` zu erstellen, indem sie als Freund deklariert wird.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Konstruktor der Produktklasse als `PRIVATE` und die Factory-Klasse als `FRIENDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_product_factory. " Factory ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zcl_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    " Als Freund kann die Factory den privaten Konstruktor aufrufen
    ro_product = NEW zcl_product( iv_name = iv_product_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'Mein Produkt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_product ). " Check if object was created
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Mein Produkt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `FRIENDS`-Konstrukt ist hier entscheidend, um das Factory-Pattern korrekt umzusetzen. Es stellt sicher, dass Instanzen von `ZCL_PRODUCT` nur über die `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` erstellt werden können, was die Kontrolle über die Objekterzeugung zentralisiert und die Konsistenz der Objekte gewährleistet.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Private Constructor, Design Patterns

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse `ZCL_BASE_ENTITY` mit einem geschützten Attribut `mv_id`. Erstellen Sie eine separate Klasse `ZCL_ENTITY_MANAGER`, die als Freund von `ZCL_BASE_ENTITY` deklariert wird, um direkt auf `mv_id` zugreifen und es setzen zu können, ohne dass `ZCL_ENTITY_MANAGER` von `ZCL_BASE_ENTITY` erbt.
hint: `FRIENDS` kann auch den Zugriff auf `PROTECTED` Komponenten ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_entity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_entity_manager. " Manager ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_entity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_id.
    rv_id = mv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_entity_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_entity_id
      IMPORTING
        io_entity TYPE REF TO zcl_base_entity
        iv_id TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_entity_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_entity_id.
    " Als Freund kann der Manager auf das geschützte Attribut zugreifen
    io_entity->mv_id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_protected_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_id FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_protected_id.
    DATA(lo_entity) = NEW zcl_base_entity( ).
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_entity_manager( ).
    lo_manager->set_entity_id( io_entity = lo_entity iv_id = 'ENTITY_001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_entity->get_id( ) exp = 'ENTITY_001' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_entity->get_id( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, dass `FRIENDS` nicht nur den Zugriff auf `PRIVATE`, sondern auch auf `PROTECTED` Komponenten ermöglicht. Dies kann in Szenarien nützlich sein, in denen eine Klasse die interne Verwaltung einer anderen Klasse übernehmen soll, ohne eine Vererbungsbeziehung einzugehen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Protected Members, Encapsulation

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_DATA_ACCESS`, das eine Methode `read_internal_data` deklariert. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DATA_STORAGE` mit einem privaten Attribut `mv_internal_data`. Deklarieren Sie das Interface `ZIF_DATA_ACCESS` als Freund von `ZCL_DATA_STORAGE`, sodass Klassen, die `ZIF_DATA_ACCESS` implementieren, auf `mv_internal_data` zugreifen können.
hint: Ein Interface kann als Freund deklariert werden, um allen implementierenden Klassen Zugriff zu gewähren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_access PUBLIC.
  METHODS read_internal_data
    IMPORTING
      io_data_storage TYPE REF TO zcl_data_storage
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_storage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_data TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_internal_data TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zif_data_access. " Interface ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_storage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_internal_data = iv_initial_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_access~read_internal_data.
    " Als Implementierer des Freund-Interfaces kann auf private Daten zugegriffen werden
    rv_data = io_data_storage->mv_internal_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_access.
    DATA(lo_data_storage) = NEW zcl_data_storage( 'Vertrauliche Daten' ).
    DATA(lo_data_accessor) = NEW zcl_data_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_data) = lo_data_accessor->zif_data_access~read_internal_data( lo_data_storage ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_data exp = 'Vertrauliche Daten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration eines Interfaces als Freund ermöglicht es allen Klassen, die dieses Interface implementieren, auf die privaten oder geschützten Komponenten der Freund-Klasse zuzugreifen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Gestaltung von Architekturen, bei denen eine Gruppe von Klassen auf interne Details zugreifen muss, ohne eine direkte Vererbungsbeziehung einzugehen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Interfaces, Encapsulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_CALCULATOR` mit einer privaten Methode `_add_internal`. Schreiben Sie einen ABAP Unit Test `LTCL_TEST`, der als Freund von `ZCL_CALCULATOR` deklariert wird, um die private Methode direkt testen zu können.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Testklasse als Freund der zu testenden Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_a TYPE i iv_b TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _add_internal IMPORTING iv_a TYPE i iv_b TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
    FRIENDS ltcl_test. " Testklasse ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_sum = _add_internal( iv_a = iv_a iv_b = iv_b ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _add_internal.
    rv_sum = iv_a + iv_b.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_public FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_internal FOR TESTING. " Testet die private Methode
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_public.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( iv_a = 5 iv_b = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_internal.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    " Als Freund kann die Testklasse auf die private Methode zugreifen
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->_add_internal( iv_a = 10 iv_b = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 12 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP Unit die `FOR TESTING`-Erweiterung für den Zugriff auf private/geschützte Komponenten bietet, kann `FRIENDS` eine alternative Methode sein, um Testklassen explizit Zugriff zu gewähren. Dies kann in bestimmten Szenarien nützlich sein, um die Testbarkeit von internen Implementierungsdetails zu gewährleisten.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Unit Testing, Private Methods

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Flugnummern (CONNID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_connids_as_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connids_as_string.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_db)
        UP TO 20 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_sflights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_db ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rv_connid_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid ELSE |{ s }, { flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_concat FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_SERVICE_PROVIDER` mit einer privaten Methode `_perform_service`. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_SERVICE_CONSUMER`, die eine Instanz von `ZCL_SERVICE_PROVIDER` über den Konstruktor erhält. Deklarieren Sie `ZCL_SERVICE_CONSUMER` als Freund von `ZCL_SERVICE_PROVIDER`, um die private Methode `_perform_service` direkt aufrufen zu können, ohne sie öffentlich zu machen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FRIENDS` für den Zugriff auf private Methoden in einem Dependency-Injection-Szenario.
solution:
CLASS zcl_service_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_service_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.
    METHODS _perform_service RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_service_consumer. " Consumer ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status = |Service wurde { mv_service_counter } Mal aufgerufen.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _perform_service.
    mv_service_counter = mv_service_counter + 1.
    rv_result = |Service ausgeführt. Zähler: { mv_service_counter }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_service_provider TYPE REF TO zcl_service_provider.
    METHODS consume_service RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_service_provider TYPE REF TO zcl_service_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_service_provider = io_service_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD consume_service.
    " Als Freund kann der Consumer die private Methode aufrufen
    rv_output = mo_service_provider->_perform_service( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` für die Vorselektion und `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupied_seats.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_db)
        UP TO 20 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_sflights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_db ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER zcl_sflights_avg_seats=>tt_sflight(
      it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
        NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
      rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`). Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrid_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_sums) TYPE tt_carrid_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_db)
        UP TO 20 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_sflights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_db ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats_for_carrier) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + grouped_flight-seatsocc ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_sum(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_seats = lv_total_seats_for_carrier
      ) TO rt_carrid_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_group_and_sum.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_sflights_group_sum=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 75 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 60 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 25 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_aggregator->get_total_seats_by_carrier( lt_test_data ).

    DATA(ls_aa_sum) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_sum-total_seats exp = 100 ). " 75 + 25 = 100
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_data) = VALUE zcl_sflights_group_sum=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_aggregator->get_total_seats_by_carrier( lt_empty_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_carrier.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_sflights_group_sum=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 100 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    DATA(ls_lh_sum) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_sum-total_seats exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_value_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                   FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_zerodivide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_catch_zerodivide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.

        " Alternatively, re-raise a custom exception or return a default value

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und greifen Sie auf die Details des Ausnahmeobjekts zu, um eine spezifische Fehlermeldung zu protokollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH ... INTO DATA(lx_exception)` um das Ausnahmeobjekt zu erhalten und dessen Attribute zu nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_into_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_input IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed) TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS get_last_error RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_last_error TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_into_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_input.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        rv_processed = |Input '{ iv_value }' erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        gv_last_error = |Fehler: { lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) } (Klasse: { lx_invalid_value->get_longname( ) }).|.
        rv_processed = 'Fehler bei der Verarbeitung.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other exception
        gv_last_error = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
        rv_processed = 'Unerwarteter Fehler.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_error.
    rv_error_message = gv_last_error.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Input ''Testwert'' erfolgreich verarbeitet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( zcl_catch_into_exception=>get_last_error( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_catch_into_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_input( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler bei der Verarbeitung.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( zcl_catch_into_exception=>get_last_error( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(

Dies ist entscheidend, um detaillierte Informationen über den aufgetretenen Fehler zu erhalten, wie z.B. die Fehlermeldung (`GET_TEXT`) oder die Klasse der Ausnahme (`GET_LONGNAME`), was für die Fehleranalyse und Protokollierung unerlässlich ist.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur, um Ressourcen freizugeben, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, auch bei Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation IMPORTING iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_resource_status TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    gv_resource_status = 'Ressource initialisiert.'.
    rv_status_message = 'Operation erfolgreich.'.

    TRY.
        " Simulate resource usage
        gv_resource_status = 'Ressource in Benutzung.'.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        gv_resource_status = 'Ressource nach erfolgreicher Operation.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_status_message = |Operation fehlgeschlagen: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CLEANUP.
        " This block is always executed
        gv_resource_status = 'Ressource freigegeben.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_catch_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_operation( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Operation erfolgreich.' ).
    " Check if cleanup was executed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_catch_cleanup=>gv_resource_status exp = 'Ressource freigegeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_catch_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_operation( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Operation fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
    " Check if cleanup was executed even with error
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_catch_cleanup=>gv_resource_status exp = 'Ressource freigegeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block ist essenziell für die Gewährleistung der Ressourcenfreigabe (z.B. Datenbankverbindungen, Dateihandles) in Ausnahmesituationen. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht, und stellt somit die Konsistenz des Systemzustands sicher.
keywords: CATCH, CLEANUP, Exceptions, Resource Management

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Arten von Ausnahmen (z.B. Division durch Null, ungültiger Index) abfangen und jeweils spezifisch behandeln kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke für unterschiedliche Ausnahmeklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_multiple_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation IMPORTING iv_value1 TYPE i
                                        iv_value2 TYPE i
                                        iv_index  TYPE i
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_multiple_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    DATA lv_intermediate_result TYPE i.
    DATA lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 10 TO lt_data.
    APPEND 20 TO lt_data.
    APPEND 30 TO lt_data.

    TRY.
        " Potential division by zero
        lv_intermediate_result = iv_value1 / iv_value2.
        " Potential invalid index access
        lv_intermediate_result = lt_data[ iv_index ].
        rv_result_message = |Berechnung erfolgreich: { lv_intermediate_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        rv_result_message = |Fehler: Division durch Null. { lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found INTO DATA(lx_itab_error).
        rv_result_message = |Fehler: Interner Tabellenindex ungültig. { lx_itab_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error).
        rv_result_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_catch_multiple_exceptions( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Berechnung erfolgreich: 20' ).

CLASS zcl_value_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS concatenate_words IMPORTING it_words TYPE string_table
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_value_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_words.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN it_words

                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word
                 ELSE |{ s } { word }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um eine Ausnahme abzufangen, die durch einen ungültigen Zugriff auf eine interne Tabelle mit einem Index verursacht wird, der außerhalb des gültigen Bereichs liegt.
hint: Fangen Sie die Systemausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` ab, die bei ungültigem Indexzugriff ausgelöst wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_element_at_index IMPORTING iv_index TYPE i
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_element) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_element_at_index.
    DATA lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'Element 1' TO lt_data.
    APPEND 'Element 2' TO lt_data.

    TRY.
        rv_element = lt_data[ iv_index ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_element = |Fehler: Ungültiger Index { iv_index }. { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other).
        rv_element = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in eine andere Struktur, wobei einige Felder bedingt gesetzt werden, unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `COND` innerhalb des Zielstruktur-Konstruktors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             item_id TYPE i,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
             processed_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data IMPORTING it_source_data TYPE tt_source
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_cond_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_target_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source_data
                               ( item_id = ls_source-id
                                 is_active = COND abap_bool(
                                               WHEN ls_source-status = 'ACTIVE' THEN abap_true
                                               ELSE abap_false
                                             )
                                 processed_value = COND i(
                                                     WHEN ls_source-value > 100 THEN ls_source-value / 2
                                                     ELSE ls_source-value
                                                   )
                               ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_data.
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_value_cond_transform=>tt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 status = 'ACTIVE' value = 50 ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 status = 'INACTIVE' value = 200 ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 status = 'ACTIVE' value = 150 ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_cond_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-is_active exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-processed_value exp = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-item_id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-is_active exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-processed_value exp = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-item_id exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-is_active exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-processed_value exp = 75 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Transformation von Daten zwischen verschiedenen internen Tabellenstrukturen. Bedingte Zuweisungen können direkt in den Konstruktor integriert werden, was den Code extrem kompakt, lesbar und effizient macht.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` in einer funktionalen Kette, um eine Ausnahme abzufangen, die während der Verarbeitung einer internen Tabelle auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um einen Ausdruck, der eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte, zu umschließen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_functional_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_functional_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA lv_first_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_first_value = it_data[ 1 ]-value.
        rv_result = |Erster Wert: '{ lv_first_value }' erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler in der Datenkette: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other).
        rv_result = |Unerwarteter Fehler in der Datenkette: { lx_other->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_error_chain FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle (`sflights`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element ('<Root>') und zwei Kind-Elementen ('<Item1>' und '<Item2>') unter Verwendung von `cl_xml_document`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_document` und `create_element`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lo_item_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_document( ).
        lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Root' ).
        lo_xml_document->set_root_node( lo_root_node ).

        lo_item_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Item1' ).
        lo_root_node->append_child( lo_item_node ).

        lo_item_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Item2' ).
        lo_root_node->append_child( lo_item_node ).

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).

      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).

solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_xml_and_get_value IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_node_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml_and_get_value.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_node         TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( iv_xml_string ).
        lo_node = lo_xml_document->find_node( name = 'Value' ).

        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          rv_node_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
        ELSE.
          rv_node_value = 'Node <Value> not found.'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        rv_node_value = |Error parsing XML: { lx_parse_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        rv_node_value = |Error processing XML DOM: { lx_dom_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
