Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) und serialisieren Sie es in einen String. Jede Zeile der Tabelle soll ein `<Flight>`-Element mit Kind-Elementen für `Carrid`, `Connid` und `Price` darstellen.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle und erstellen Sie für jede Zeile XML-Elemente. Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>render_2_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_from_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_xml_from_sflights IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_from_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_from_sflights.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lo_flight_node  TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lo_child_node   TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_document( ).
        lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Flights' ).
        lo_xml_document->set_root_node( lo_root_node ).

        LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lo_flight_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Flight' ).
          lo_root_node->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

          lo_child_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Carrid' ).
          lo_child_node->set_value( ls_flight-carrid ).
          lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_child_node ).

          lo_child_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Connid' ).
          lo_child_node->set_value( ls_flight-connid ).
          lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_child_node ).

          lo_child_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Price' ).
          lo_child_node->set_value( |{ ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }| ).
          lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_child_node ).
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).

      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        rv_xml_string = |Error creating XML from table: { lx_dom_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument und verwenden Sie String-Templates, um Attributwerte und Elementinhalte dynamisch zu setzen. Das Root-Element soll ein Attribut 'version' haben und ein Kind-Element 'Message' mit dynamischem Inhalt.

CLASS zcl_xml_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xml_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_templates.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lo_message_node TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lo_text_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_document( ).
        lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Data' ).
        lo_xml_document->set_root_node( lo_root_node ).

        lo_root_node->set_attribute( name = 'version' value = |1.0| ).
        lo_root_node->set_attribute( name = 'timestamp' value = |{ sy-datum } { sy-uzeit }| ).

        lo_message_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Message' ).
        lo_root_node->append_child( lo_message_node ).

        lo_text_node = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( iv_message ).
        lo_message_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).

      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        rv_xml_string = |Error creating XML with templates: { lx_dom_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer sortierten internen Tabelle (`sflights`) neue Einträge hinzu und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierung und Eindeutigkeit (falls ein eindeutiger Schlüssel definiert ist) erhalten bleibt. Demonstrieren Sie das Hinzufügen eines neuen Eintrags und eines doppelten Eintrags.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

                                       IMPORTING is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_to_sorted_table.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ct_sflights.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
        " Duplicate entry, table remains unchanged
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).
    DATA(ls_duplicate_flight) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_sorted=>ty_sflight(

CLASS zcl_itb_read_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Flugdaten enthält, und extrahieren Sie diese in eine sortierte interne Tabelle (`sflights`). Das XML enthält mehrere `<Flight>`-Elemente mit `Carrid`, `Connid`, `Fldate`, `Price` und `Currency` als Kind-Elemente.
hint: Parsen Sie das XML mit `cl_xml_document`, iterieren Sie über die `<Flight>`-Knoten und extrahieren Sie die Daten in die sortierte Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS parse_xml_to_sflights IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml_to_sflights.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lt_flight_nodes TYPE if_xml_document_node=>tt_node_list,
          ls_flight       TYPE ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( iv_xml_string ).
        lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->get_root_node( ).

        lt_flight_nodes = lo_root_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

        LOOP AT lt_flight_nodes INTO DATA(lo_flight_node).
          CLEAR ls_flight.
          ls_flight-carrid   = lo_flight_node->find_node( name = 'Carrid' )->get_value( ).
          ls_flight-connid   = lo_flight_node->find_node( name = 'Connid' )->get_value( ).
          ls_flight-fldate   = lo_flight_node->find_node( name = 'Fldate' )->get_value( ).
          ls_flight-price    = lo_flight_node->find_node( name = 'Price' )->get_value( ).
          ls_flight-currency = lo_flight_node->find_node( name = 'Currency' )->get_value( ).

          INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE rt_sflights.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " Handle parsing error
      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        " Handle DOM error
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
        " Handle duplicate key if any
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_xml) = '<Flights><Flight><Carrid>LH</Carrid><Connid>0400</Connid><Fldate>20250101</Fldate><Price>100.00</Price><Currency>EUR</Currency></Flight><Flight><Carrid>AA</Carrid><Connid>0017</Connid><Fldate>20250102</Fldate><Price>250.50</Price><Currency>USD</Currency></Flight></Flights>'.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price IMPORTING CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                  IMPORTING iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
                                  IMPORTING iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
                                  IMPORTING iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
                                  IMPORTING iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_update_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ).
    DATA(lv_tabix) = 0.

    READ TABLE ct_sflights WITH TABLE KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_key-carrid
                                                              connid = ls_key-connid
                                                              fldate = ls_key-fldate
                                                              TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_tabix = sy-tabix.
      ct_sflights[ lv_tabix ] = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ct_sflights[ lv_tabix ]
                                                  price = iv_new_price ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument mit einem Namespace und einem Element mit Präfix. Serialisieren Sie das Dokument in einen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_element_ns` und `set_namespace_declaration`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_namespace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_xml_with_namespace RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_namespace.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lo_data_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node.

    CONSTANTS: lc_namespace_uri TYPE string VALUE 'http://www.example.com/data',
               lc_prefix        TYPE string VALUE 'ex'.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_document( ).
        lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Root' ).
        lo_xml_document->set_root_node( lo_root_node ).

        lo_root_node->set_namespace_declaration( prefix = lc_prefix uri = lc_namespace_uri ).

        lo_data_node = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( name = 'Data' prefix = lc_prefix namespace_uri = lc_namespace_uri ).
        lo_data_node->set_value( 'Namespaced Content' ).
        lo_root_node->append_child( lo_data_node ).

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).

      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        rv_xml_string = |Error creating namespaced XML: { lx_dom_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_create_xml_with_namespace FOR TESTING.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Namespace declaration missing' regex = 'xmlns:ex="http://www.example.com/data"' in = lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Namespaced element missing' regex = '<ex:Data>Namespaced Content</ex:Data>' in = lv_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: cl_xml_document, XML, Namespace, Prefix, Serialization

Instructions: Löschen Sie Einträge aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle (`sflights`) basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft 'AA') unter Verwendung des `DELETE` Statements mit `WHERE`.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrid IMPORTING CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                       IMPORTING iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_sflights ).
    DELETE ct_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    rv_deleted_count = lv_initial_lines - lines( ct_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und `XSLT` (einfaches Beispiel) um ein XML-Dokument in ein anderes Format zu transformieren. Erstellen Sie ein XML und eine einfache XSLT-Transformation, die nur das Root-Element umbenennt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_xml_document` zur Erstellung des XML und `cl_xslt_processor` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_xml IMPORTING iv_input_xml TYPE string
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_output_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_xslt_processor TYPE REF TO cl_xslt_processor,
          lv_xslt_source TYPE string.

    lv_xslt_source = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
  <xsl:template match="Root">
    <TransformedRoot>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="@*|node()"/>
    </TransformedRoot>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="@*|node()">
    <xsl:copy>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="@*|node()"/>
    </xsl:copy>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>`.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( iv_input_xml ).
        lo_xslt_processor = NEW cl_xslt_processor( ).

        lo_xslt_processor->set_xml_document( lo_xml_document ).
        lo_xslt_processor->set_xslt_source( lv_xslt_source ).

        lo_xslt_processor->transform( IMPORTING stream = rv_output_xml ).

      CATCH cx_xslt_exception INTO DATA(lx_xslt_error).
        rv_output_xml = |XSLT Error: { lx_xslt_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        rv_output_xml = |XML Parse Error: { lx_parse_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        rv_output_xml = |XML DOM Error: { lx_dom_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_xslt_transform( ).
    DATA(lv_input_xml) = '<Root><Item>Value</Item></Root>'.

In ABAP wird dies durch die Klasse `cl_xslt_processor` ermöglicht, die ein XML-Dokument und ein XSLT-Stylesheet entgegennimmt und das transformierte Ergebnis liefert. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle (`sflights`) und verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck, um Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft zu zählen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP AT` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_count TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrid_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument mit Attributen für ein Element und lesen Sie diese Attribute nach dem Parsen des XML-Strings aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_attribute` zum Erstellen und `get_attributes` oder `get_attribute` zum Lesen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attributes,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attributes.
    TYPES: tt_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attributes WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_xml_with_attributes RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS read_attributes_from_xml IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_attributes.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lo_item_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_document( ).
        lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Root' ).
        lo_xml_document->set_root_node( lo_root_node ).

        lo_item_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Item' ).
        lo_item_node->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = '123' ).
        lo_item_node->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'example' ).
        lo_item_node->set_value( 'Item Content' ).
        lo_root_node->append_child( lo_item_node ).

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).

      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        rv_xml_string = |Error creating XML with attributes: { lx_dom_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_attributes_from_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_item_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_document_node,
          lt_attributes   TYPE if_xml_document_node=>tt_attribute_list,
          ls_attribute    TYPE ty_attributes.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( iv_xml_string ).
        lo_item_node = lo_xml_document->find_node( name = 'Item' ).

        IF lo_item_node IS BOUND.
          lt_attributes = lo_item_node->get_attributes( ).
          LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_xml_attribute).
            ls_attribute-name = ls_xml_attribute-name.
            ls_attribute-value = ls_xml_attribute-value.
            APPEND ls_attribute TO rt_attributes.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " Handle parsing error
      CATCH cx_xml_dom_error INTO DATA(lx_dom_error).
        " Handle DOM error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_attributes_creation_and_read FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_no_attributes FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_attributes_creation_and_read.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_attributes( ).

Dies ist wichtig für die Verarbeitung von XML-Daten, die Attribute zur Definition von Eigenschaften verwenden.

Instructions: Finde den maximalen Wert des Feldes 'price' in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (basierend auf SFLIGHT).
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE` Operator mit der Aggregationsfunktion `nmax`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price

CLASS zcl_int_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.

      FOR flight IN it_flights " Iteriere über jeden Flug in der Tabelle
      NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = flight-price ) ). " Vergleiche den aktuellen Maximalpreis mit dem Preis des aktuellen Flugs

Instructions: Finde den maximalen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (basierend auf SFLIGHT).
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE` mit `nmax`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_max_price_by_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_by_carr,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_by_carr.
    TYPES ty_max_price_by_carr_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_by_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE ty_max_price_by_carr_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_max_price_by_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_by_carrier.
    rt_max_prices = VALUE #( " Erstelle eine neue Tabelle mit den aggregierten Daten
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid " Gruppiere die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft
      ( carrid = flight-carrid " Die Fluggesellschaft der aktuellen Gruppe
        max_price = REDUCE #( " Finde den maximalen Preis innerhalb der aktuellen Gruppe
          INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
          FOR member IN GROUP flight " Iteriere über die Mitglieder der Gruppe
          NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = member-price ) ) " Finde den höchsten Preis
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_max_lh-max_price exp = '150.00' msg = 'Max price for LH should be 150.00' ).

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage.
hint: Verwende die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` und ihre Methode `CREATE_CONVERTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_codepage_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp    TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp    TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_codepage_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter(
      source_codepage = iv_source_cp
      target_codepage = iv_target_cp
    ).
    rv_converted_string = lo_converter->convert( iv_input_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_codepage_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = 'Hello, World! ÄÖÜäöüß'.
    DATA(lv_source_cp) = '4103'. " UTF-8
    DATA(lv_target_cp) = '1100'. " Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1)

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted) = lo_cut->convert_string(
          iv_input_string = lv_original
          iv_source_cp    = lv_source_cp
          iv_target_cp    = lv_target_cp
        ).
        " Zurückkonvertieren, um die Korrektheit zu überprüfen
        DATA(lv_back) = lo_cut->convert_string(
          iv_input_string = lv_converted
          iv_source_cp    = lv_target_cp
          iv_target_cp    = lv_source_cp
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_back exp = lv_original msg = 'Konvertierung und Rückkonvertierung sollten den Originalstring ergeben' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` bietet eine standardisierte und robuste Möglichkeit zur Konvertierung von Strings zwischen verschiedenen Codepages. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Verarbeitung von Textdaten, insbesondere bei der Integration mit externen Systemen oder Dateien.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, String Conversion, Codepage, Unicode

Instructions: Bestimme den höheren von zwei übergebenen Integer-Zahlen.
hint: Nutze den `COND` Operator für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_max_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_maximum
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_maximum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_max_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_maximum.
    rv_maximum = COND #( WHEN iv_num1 > iv_num2 THEN iv_num1 ELSE iv_num2 ). " Wenn iv_num1 größer ist, nimm iv_num1, sonst iv_num2
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_maximum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_max_number( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_maximum( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 5 ) exp = 10 msg = '10 sollte das Maximum sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_maximum( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 10 ) exp = 10 msg = '10 sollte das Maximum sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_maximum( iv_num1 = 7 iv_num2 = 7 ) exp = 7 msg = '7 sollte das Maximum sein' ).

explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung. Anstatt einer mehrzeiligen `IF`-Anweisung kann die Logik in einer einzigen Zeile ausgedrückt werden, was den Code moderner und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: COND, MAXIMUM, Conditional Logic, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Finde den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (basierend auf SFLIGHT), indem du die Tabelle sortierst.
hint: Sortiere die Tabelle absteigend nach dem Preis und lies den ersten Eintrag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_max_flight_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_max_flight_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = it_flights. " Kopiere die Tabelle, um die Originaltabelle nicht zu ändern
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY price DESCENDING. " Sortiere absteigend nach Preis
    READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights INDEX 1 INTO rs_flight. " Lies den ersten Eintrag (höchster Preis)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_max_flight_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_int_max_flight_sort=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' price = '250.50' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230103' price = '150.00' ) 
    ).
    DATA(ls_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_max_flight-price exp = '250.50' msg = 'Der Preis des teuersten Fluges sollte 250.50 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_max_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Die Fluggesellschaft des teuersten Fluges sollte AA sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Sortieren einer internen Tabelle und das anschließende Lesen des ersten oder letzten Eintrags ist eine einfache und oft effiziente Methode, um den maximalen oder minimalen Wert eines Feldes zu finden. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lt_sorted_flights)`) macht den Code kompakter.
keywords: SORT, READ TABLE, MAXIMUM, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein XSTRING mit einem Byte Order Mark (BOM) beginnt und entferne es gegebenenfalls.
hint: Nutze die Methode `CHECK_BOM` von `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` zur BOM-Erkennung und String-Offset-Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_bom_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_bom
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string_without_bom) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_bom_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_bom.
    DATA(lv_bom_length) = cl_abap_codepage=>check_bom( iv_input_string ). " Ermittle die Länge des BOMs
    IF lv_bom_length > 0. " Wenn ein BOM gefunden wurde
      rv_string_without_bom = iv_input_string+lv_bom_length. " Entferne das BOM durch Offset-Zugriff
    ELSE.
      rv_string_without_bom = iv_input_string. " Kein BOM, String bleibt unverändert
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_bom FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_bom.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_bom_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_string_no_bom) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source = 'Hello World'
      codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
    DATA(lv_string_with_bom) = cl_abap_codepage=>get_bom( '4103' ) && lv_string_no_bom. " Erstelle einen String mit UTF-8 BOM

    DATA(lv_result_no_bom) = lo_cut->remove_bom( lv_string_no_bom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_no_bom exp = lv_string_no_bom msg = 'String ohne BOM sollte unverändert bleiben' ).

    DATA(lv_result_with_bom) = lo_cut->remove_bom( lv_string_with_bom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_with_bom exp = lv_string_no_bom msg = 'BOM sollte erfolgreich entfernt werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE=>CHECK_BOM` ist eine moderne und zuverlässige Art, das Vorhandensein und die Länge eines Byte Order Marks in einem XSTRING zu erkennen. Der anschließende Offset-Zugriff (`+lv_bom_length`) ist eine effiziente Methode, um das BOM zu entfernen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, BOM, XSTRING, String Processing, CHECK_BOM

Instructions: Finde das späteste Abflugdatum (`fldate`) unter allen Flügen in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (basierend auf SFLIGHT).
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE` Operator mit der Aggregationsfunktion `nmax`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dt_max_fldate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latest_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dt_max_fldate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight_date.
    rv_latest_date = REDUCE #( " Initialisiere das späteste Datum mit einem 'leeren' Datum
      INIT latest_d TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '00000000'
      FOR flight IN it_flights " Iteriere über jeden Flug in der Tabelle
      NEXT latest_d = nmax( val1 = latest_d val2 = flight-fldate ) ). " Vergleiche das aktuelle späteste Datum mit dem Datum des aktuellen Flugs
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_dt_max_fldate=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230105' price = '250.50' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230103' price = '150.00' )

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode in einer Klasse, die den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis aus einer Liste von Flugobjekten findet.
hint: Definiere eine eigene Flugklasse und verwende `REDUCE` mit einem Vergleich der Objektattribute.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA price TYPE sflight-price READ-ONLY.
    DATA carrid TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price  TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->price  = iv_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_max_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_flight_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_oo_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flight_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_max_flight) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_max_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    ro_max_flight = REDUCE #( " Initialisiere mit einem leeren Referenzobjekt
      INIT max_f TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_flight
      FOR flight IN it_flights " Iteriere über die Liste der Flugobjekte
      NEXT max_f = COND #( WHEN max_f IS INITIAL OR flight->price > max_f->price THEN flight ELSE max_f ) ). " Wähle den Flug mit dem höheren Preis
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( NEW zcl_oo_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price = '150.00' ) )

CLASS zcl_str_codepage_valid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_codepage     TYPE abap_codepage

Instructions: Finde den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (basierend auf SFLIGHT) unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` um ggf. Vorselektionen zu treffen und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_max_price_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_max_price_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_filtered.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER zcl_int_max_price_filter=>ty_sflight_table(
      it_flights WHERE carrid = COND #( WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_carrid ELSE carrid ) ).

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_price_filtered FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_price_filtered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_max_price_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_int_max_price_filter=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' price = '250.50' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230103' price = '150.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20230104' price = '120.00' ) 
    ).

    " Test ohne Filter
    DATA(lv_max_all) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_all exp = '250.50' msg = 'Max Preis ohne Filter sollte 250.50 sein' ).

    " Test mit Filter auf LH
    DATA(lv_max_lh) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_lh exp = '150.00' msg = 'Max Preis für LH sollte 150.00 sein' ).

    " Test mit Filter auf AA
    DATA(lv_max_aa) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_aa exp = '250.50' msg = 'Max Preis für AA sollte 250.50 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und leistungsstarke Datenverarbeitung. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle nach bestimmten Kriterien gefiltert, und anschließend wird auf den gefilterten Daten eine Aggregation (hier das Maximum) durchgeführt. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster in ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Internal Tables, COND

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String in eine XSTRING-Repräsentation unter Angabe einer Codepage und behandle mögliche Konvertierungsfehler.

CLASS zcl_str_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS convert_string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string

      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_xstring.
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
          source   = iv_input_string
          codepage = iv_codepage
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder spezifische Reaktion
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_convert_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Teststring mit Umlauten: ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_codepage) = '4103'. " UTF-8

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_xstring(
          iv_input_string = lv_string
          iv_codepage     = lv_codepage
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xstring msg = 'XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).
        " Optional: Rückkonvertierung zur Verifizierung
        DATA(lv_back_to_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
          source   = lv_xstring
          codepage = lv_codepage
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_back_to_string exp = lv_string msg = 'Rückkonvertierung sollte Originalstring ergeben' ).
    CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_string_with_umlauts) = 'ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_codepage_ascii) = '1103'. " ASCII (kann Umlaute nicht darstellen)

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_class = 'CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR'
      ACT = >( lo_cut->convert_string_to_xstring(
                 iv_input_string = lv_string_with_umlauts
                 iv_codepage     = lv_codepage_ascii
               ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die explizite Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR` ist entscheidend, um robuste Anwendungen zu erstellen, die mit unterschiedlichen Zeichensätzen umgehen können.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, XSTRING, String Conversion, Exception Handling, CONVERT_TO

Instructions: Berechne den Maximalwert aus einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `nmax` für numerische Typen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_max_decimal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_decimal_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_maximum_decimal
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE ty_decimal_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_maximum) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_max_decimal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_maximum_decimal.
    rv_maximum = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_val TYPE decfloat34 VALUE 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT max_val = nmax( val1 = max_val val2 = number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_maximum_decimal FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_maximum_decimal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_max_decimal( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_math_max_decimal=>ty_decimal_table(
      ( '10.50' ) ( '20.75' ) ( '5.25' ) ( '20.75' ) ( '15.00' ) 
    ).
    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->get_maximum_decimal( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max exp = '20.75' msg = 'Das Maximum sollte 20.75 sein' ).

    DATA(lt_negative_numbers) = VALUE zcl_math_max_decimal=>ty_decimal_table(
      ( '-10.50' ) ( '-20.75' ) ( '-5.25' ) 
    ).
    DATA(lv_max_neg) = lo_cut->get_maximum_decimal( lt_negative_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_neg exp = '-5.25' msg = 'Das Maximum sollte -5.25 sein' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_numbers) = VALUE zcl_math_max_decimal=>ty_decimal_table( ).
    DATA(lv_max_empty) = lo_cut->get_maximum_decimal( lt_empty_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_empty exp = '0' msg = 'Das Maximum einer leeren Liste sollte 0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist vielseitig einsetzbar und eignet sich hervorragend, um den Maximalwert aus einer Liste von numerischen Werten zu ermitteln. Die Funktion `nmax` ist dabei die moderne und prägnante Art, den Vergleich durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Math, decfloat34, nmax

Instructions: Berechne das Alter einer Person basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum bis zum heutigen Datum.
hint: Nutze Datumssubtraktion und berücksichtige den Geburtstag im aktuellen Jahr.
solution:
CLASS zcl_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    rv_age = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4). " Initial year difference

    " Check if birthday has already occurred this year
    IF lv_current_date(6) < iv_birth_date(6). " Compare MMdd
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_age_after_birthday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_age_calculator( ).
    " Assume current date is 20231125
    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->calculate_age( iv_birth_date = '19900101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = sy-datum(4) - 1990 ). " Current year - 1990
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_age_before_birthday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_age_calculator( ).
    " Assume current date is 20231125
    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->calculate_age( iv_birth_date = '19901231' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = sy-datum(4) - 1990 - 1 ). " Current year - 1990 - 1
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_age_calculator( ).
    " Assume current date is 20231125
    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->calculate_age( iv_birth_date = CONV d( sy-datum(4) && sy-datum+4(4) ) ). " Birthday is today this year
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 0 ). " Age is 0 if born today
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: Date/Time, SUBTRACT, Age Calculation, Date Comparison

Instructions: Berechne die kumulative Differenz einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer `SUBTRACT`-Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_cumulative_diff
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cumulative_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cumulative_diff.
    rv_cumulative_diff = REDUCE i( INIT diff = 0
                                   FOR <item> IN it_items
                                   NEXT diff = diff - <item>-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Arbeitstage (Montag bis Freitag) zwischen zwei Daten.
hint: Iteriere durch die Tage und verwende die Funktion `WEEKDAY` oder `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` zur Wochentagsbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_date_from.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_tstmp=>weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5. " Monday (1) to Friday (5)
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_last_day_prev_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_last_day_prev_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_prev_month.
    " First day of current month

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Tage, die bis zum Ende des aktuellen Jahres verbleiben.

CLASS zcl_days_to_year_end DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_days_to_year_end IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES tt_carr_conn TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_conn WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_map_flights

CLASS zcl_filter_for_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map_flights.
    rt_result = VALUE tt_carr_conn(
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_city_from )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewerbox_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewerbox_factory IMPLEMENTATION.

        create_error   = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        others         = 5.

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT eo_ecl_viewerbox
      EXPORTING
        parent = eo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error     = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error   = 3
        lifetime_error = 4

    DATA: lo_cut              TYPE REF TO zcl_ecl_viewerbox_events,

          lo_ecl_viewerbox    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.

    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut. " Register test class as handler for local event

    ).

    " Simulate an event call (in a real scenario, this would be triggered by GUI)

    FREE OBJECT lo_ecl_viewerbox.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewerbox_js_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewerbox_js_call IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine sprachabhängige Datei für ein bestimmtes Objekt und eine bestimmte Sprache im CTS-Kontext existiert. Geben Sie 'X' zurück, wenn sie existiert, sonst ' '.

CLASS zcl_cts_file_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie einen einstelligen Statuscode (z.B. 'A', 'B', 'C') in eine lesbare Textbeschreibung um.

solution:
CLASS zcl_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_status
                               WHEN 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
                               WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blockiert'
                               WHEN 'C' THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                               ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_active_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_status_mapper( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->get_status_description( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_description exp = 'Aktiv' ).

  METHOD test_blocked_status.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und kategorisieren Sie Flüge basierend auf ihrer Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) in 'Lufthansa', 'American Airlines' oder 'Andere'. Geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit Flugnummer und der kategorisierten Fluggesellschaft zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR GROUPS` Expression, um die Tabelle zu iterieren und zu gruppieren, und eine `SWITCH` Expression zur Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             category   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_flights.
    rt_categorized_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                                      ( carrid   = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                        connid   = <fs_flight>-connid
                                        category = SWITCH string(
                                                     <fs_flight>-carrid
                                                     WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                                     WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
                                                     ELSE 'Andere' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_categorization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorization.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_categorizer( ).
    DATA(lt_categorized) = lo_cut->categorize_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_categorized ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_categorized INTO DATA(ls_cat_lh) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_lh-category exp = 'Lufthansa' ).

    READ TABLE lt_categorized INTO DATA(ls_cat_aa) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_aa-category exp = 'American Airlines' ).

    READ TABLE lt_categorized INTO DATA(ls_cat_ua) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_ua-category exp = 'Andere' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR` Expression und `SWITCH` Expression ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP` und `IF`-Strukturen.
keywords: FOR, SWITCH, Internal Tables, Transformation, sflights, CASE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein generisches Interface-Referenzobjekt akzeptiert und basierend auf dem tatsächlichen Typ des Objekts unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `CASE TYPE OF` Anweisung, um polymorphe Objekte zu behandeln.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Kreis'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Quadrat'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_info = |Typ: { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_type( ) }, Radius: { lo_circle->mv_radius }, Fläche: { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_info = |Typ: { lo_square->zif_shape~get_type( ) }, Seite: { lo_square->mv_side }, Fläche: { lo_square->zif_shape~get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_info = |Unbekannte Form: { io_shape->get_type( ) }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_circle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_square FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_circle.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5.0' ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_circle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'Kreis' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'Radius: 5.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_square.
    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '4.0' ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_square ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'Quadrat' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'Seite: 4.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` ermöglicht eine typsichere und elegante Behandlung von Polymorphie. Es erlaubt, den tatsächlichen Typ eines Referenzobjekts zur Laufzeit zu prüfen und es in den spezifischen Typ zu casten, um auf typspezifische Attribute oder Methoden zuzugreifen.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, Interface

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere für Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft. Für 'LH' und 'AA' sollen separate Summen gebildet werden, alle anderen Fluggesellschaften sollen unter 'OTHERS' zusammengefasst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR GROUPS` Expression in Kombination mit einer `SWITCH` Expression für die Gruppierung und `SUM` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_passenger_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_sum,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_sum.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_sum WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_passenger_sums) TYPE tt_passenger_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_passenger_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_passengers.
    rt_passenger_sums = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid_group = SWITCH #( <fs_flight>-carrid
                                          WHEN 'LH' THEN 'LH'
                                          WHEN 'AA' THEN 'AA'
                                          ELSE 'OTHERS' ) )
      ( carrid         = <group>-carrid_group
        total_passengers = SUM( <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben. Die neue Tabelle soll nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und die Anzahl der freien Sitze enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_available_seats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_available_seats.
    TYPES: tt_available_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_available_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_min_free TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_available_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                                   WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc >= iv_min_free )
                                   ( carrid     = <fs_flight>-carrid,
                                     connid     = <fs_flight>-connid,
                                     free_seats = <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 200. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 100. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 95.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 300. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 290. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_free = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-free_seats exp = 50 ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-free_seats exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_match.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 200. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 195. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_free = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lines( lt_filtered ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR` Expression mit der `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine deklarative Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen, kompakten Ausdruck. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu verarbeiten, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zugreift und dessen Wert basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem `SWITCH` Ausdruck zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in Kombination mit einer `SWITCH` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_as_string
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_as_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = SWITCH #( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> )->type_kind
                           WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string THEN |{ <fs_field> }|
                           WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int    THEN |{ <fs_field> }|
                           WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date   THEN |{ <fs_field> DATE = USER }|
                           ELSE 'Unbekannter Typ' ).
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_string_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_reader=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello Dynamic'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_as_string( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Hello Dynamic' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_int_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_reader=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_as_string( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_date_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_reader=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field3 = sy-datum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_as_string( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = |{ sy-datum DATE = USER }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existent_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_reader=>ty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_as_string( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus dynamischem Feldzugriff mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und der `SWITCH` Expression, die den Typ des Feldes zur Laufzeit bestimmt, demonstriert eine flexible und moderne Art, mit dynamischen Datenstrukturen umzugehen. `cl_abap_typedescr` wird für die Typanalyse verwendet.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, SWITCH, RTTI, CASE

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum in der Zukunft, Vergangenheit oder heute liegt. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Beschreibung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `SWITCH` Expression mit Vergleichsoperatoren für Datumsfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_comparator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_date_to_today
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_comparison) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_date_to_today.
    rv_comparison = SWITCH #( )
                      WHEN iv_date > sy-datum THEN 'Zukunft'
                      WHEN iv_date < sy-datum THEN 'Vergangenheit'
                      WHEN iv_date = sy-datum THEN 'Heute'
                      ELSE 'Ungültiges Datum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_past_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_today_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_comparator( ).
    DATA(lv_future_date) = sy-datum + 1.
    DATA(lv_comparison) = lo_cut->compare_date_to_today( lv_future_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_comparison exp = 'Zukunft' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_past_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_comparator( ).
    DATA(lv_past_date) = sy-datum - 1.
    DATA(lv_comparison) = lo_cut->compare_date_to_today( lv_past_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_comparison exp = 'Vergangenheit' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_today_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_comparator( ).
    DATA(lv_comparison) = lo_cut->compare_date_to_today( sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_comparison exp = 'Heute' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH` Expression ohne expliziten Operanden ermöglicht die Definition von Bedingungen direkt in den `WHEN`-Klauseln. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und lesbare Methode, um komplexe bedingte Logik zu implementieren, insbesondere bei Vergleichen von Datums- oder Zeitwerten.
keywords: SWITCH, Date/Time, Conditional Logic, Expression, CASE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String in Großbuchstaben umwandelt, es sei denn, der String beginnt mit 'no_case_'. In diesem Fall soll der String unverändert zurückgegeben werden.

CLASS zcl_case_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_upper.
    rv_output_string = COND string(
                         WHEN iv_input_string STARTS WITH 'no_case_'
                           THEN iv_input_string
                         ELSE to_upper( iv_input_string ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Carrier, Flugnummer, Datum) für spezifische Fluggesellschaften ('LH', 'AA') und befüllen Sie diese mit dem `VALUE` Operator und einer `FOR`-Schleife, die Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle liest. Verwenden Sie eine `BEGIN OF` Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF` für die Strukturdefinition und `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` für die Tabellenbefüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_db TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_db
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_db
                          WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA' )
                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) OR line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ), msg = 'Should contain LH or AA flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Befüllung interner Tabellen. Die `BEGIN OF` Syntax definiert die Struktur der Zeilen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, BEGIN OF, sflight

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer (z.B. '0017') und einem bestimmten Carrier ('LH') zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers (z.B. 'LH') aus der `sflights`-Tabelle. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights_db TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_db.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_db
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_calculate_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming there are LH flights with seatsocc > 0 in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total seats should not be zero' act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ist sehr ausdrucksstark und vermeidet explizite Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine formatierte String-Ausgabe für eine Liste von Flugdaten (Carrier, Flugnummer, Datum) unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie Backticks (`) und Platzhalter (`{ }`) für String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_flight_list
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_list.
    rv_formatted_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = `Flugliste:` & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
                                  FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT s = s && |  Carrier: { ls_flight-carrid }, Flug: { ls_flight-connid }, Datum: { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_format_flight_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_list.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_formatter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231026' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20231027' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_string) = lo_cut->format_flight_list( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_formatted_string msg = 'Formatted string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Carrier: LH, Flug: 0017' in = lv_formatted_string msg = 'Should contain LH flight info' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Carrier: AA, Flug: 0020' in = lv_formatted_string msg = 'Should contain AA flight info' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
