Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), bei denen die Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE ty_flight_table
        iv_carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE TABLE rt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_deleter=>ty_flight_table.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20230102' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_flight_deleter( ).
    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_deleter->delete_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier_id = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 flight remaining' act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Remaining flight should be LH' act = lt_result_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` Syntax ist die moderne und performante Art, Einträge aus internen Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu entfernen. Sie ist prägnanter und oft effizienter als das Schleifen über die Tabelle und das Löschen einzelner Einträge.
keywords: DELETE TABLE, WHERE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und der Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_deduplicator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE ty_flight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_deduplicator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_flights BY carrid connid. " Important for ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_deduplicator=>ty_flight_table.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20230102' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_deduplicator) = NEW zcl_flight_deduplicator( ).
    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_deduplicator->remove_adjacent_duplicates( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 unique flights' act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry carrid' act = lt_result_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry carrid' act = lt_result_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Third entry carrid' act = lt_result_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Duplikate aus einer *sortierten* internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Die `COMPARING` Klausel erlaubt die Definition der Felder, die für die Duplikatsprüfung herangezogen werden sollen. Das explizite Sortieren vor dem Löschen ist hierbei entscheidend.
keywords: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, SORT, Deduplication

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flugdaten aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Datum. (Hinweis: Für Testzwecke wird die Operation in einem `ROLLBACK WORK` gekapselt, um keine echten Daten zu verlieren).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM ... WHERE ...` für Datenbanktabellen. Denken Sie an `COMMIT WORK` oder `ROLLBACK WORK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_flight_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_sflights_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_flight_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_sflights_entry.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_db_delete FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_db_delete.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'XX',
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date    VALUE '99991231'.

    " Insert test data
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate seatsocc = 10 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = lv_fldate seatsocc = 20 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0003' fldate = lv_fldate seatsocc = 30 ) ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_db_flight_deleter( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_deleter->delete_sflights_entry( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 rows to be deleted' act = lv_deleted exp = 2 ).

    " Verify deletion
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND fldate = @lv_fldate INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 0 rows after deletion' act = lv_count exp = 0 ).

    " Rollback to clean up test data
    ROLLBACK WORK.

    " Verify rollback
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND fldate = @lv_fldate INTO @lv_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 0 rows after rollback' act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `DELETE FROM` für Datenbanktabellen mit modernen Open SQL Syntax (Hostvariablen mit `@`). Im Unit Test wird die Transaktion mit `ROLLBACK WORK` zurückgenommen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Testdaten nach dem Testlauf nicht in der Datenbank verbleiben. Dies ist entscheidend für sichere Datenbanktests.
keywords: DELETE FROM, Open SQL, Database, ROLLBACK WORK, Host Variables

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Einträge aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle, unter Verwendung von Inline-Deklaration und `UP TO N ROWS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights) UP TO 5 ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO @iv_rows ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_first_5_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_5_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_first_n_flights( iv_rows = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 5 flights' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight table should not be empty' act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration (`@DATA(lt_flights)`) und der `UP TO N ROWS` Klausel, um eine begrenzte Anzahl von Datensätzen effizient aus der Datenbank zu lesen. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und lesbare Art der Datenbeschaffung.
keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE @DATA(), UP TO N ROWS, Open SQL, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung einer `FOR` Expression mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` und `count( group_key )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result,
           ty_grouped_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE ty_flight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE ty_grouped_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                INTO DATA(group_key)
                                ( carrid = group_key-carrid
                                  num_flights = count( group_key ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>ty_flight_table.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20230103' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 groups' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA should have 2 flights' act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-num_flights exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH should have 3 flights' act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-num_flights exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Expression ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft mit `count( group_key )` ermittelt, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen haben, unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `target_structure = CORRESPONDING #( source_structure )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_struct_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             value   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_data,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             value   TYPE decfloat16,
             status  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_struct_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
    rs_target-description = is_source-name. " Manuelle Zuweisung für nicht-übereinstimmende Felder
    rs_target-status = 'A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_struct_mapper=>ty_source_data.
    ls_source-id = 1.
    ls_source-name = 'Test Item'.
    ls_source-value = '123.45'.

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_struct_mapper( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_data( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID should be copied' act = ls_target-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value should be copied' act = ls_target-value exp = '123.45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Description should be mapped from name' act = ls_target-description exp = 'Test Item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be set manually' act = ls_target-status exp = 'A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator vereinfacht die Zuweisung von Werten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit (teilweise) übereinstimmenden Feldnamen. Felder mit identischen Namen und kompatiblen Typen werden automatisch zugewiesen, während abweichende Felder manuell behandelt werden können. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code erheblich.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structure Assignment, Data Transfer, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu, z.B. 'Short Haul', 'Medium Haul', 'Long Haul' basierend auf der Flugdauer (`fltime` in `sflights`), unter Verwendung des `SWITCH` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH type( WHEN condition1 THEN value1 WHEN condition2 THEN value2 ELSE default_value )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             fltime TYPE s_fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.

    METHODS get_flight_category
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_duration
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_category.
    rv_category = SWITCH string(
      is_flight-fltime
      WHEN < 120 THEN 'Short Haul'
      WHEN < 360 THEN 'Medium Haul'
      ELSE 'Long Haul'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_categories FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_categories.
    DATA(lo_categorizer) = NEW zcl_flight_categorizer( ).
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_flight_categorizer=>ty_flight_duration.

    ls_flight-fltime = 90.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '90 min should be Short Haul' act = lo_categorizer->get_flight_category( ls_flight ) exp = 'Short Haul' ).

    ls_flight-fltime = 240.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '240 min should be Medium Haul' act = lo_categorizer->get_flight_category( ls_flight ) exp = 'Medium Haul' ).

    ls_flight-fltime = 400.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '400 min should be Long Haul' act = lo_categorizer->get_flight_category( ls_flight ) exp = 'Long Haul' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH` Operator bietet eine elegante und kompakte Möglichkeit, bedingte Zuweisungen zu implementieren, die zuvor oft mit `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF` oder `CASE...WHEN...ENDCASE` realisiert wurden. Er ist besonders nützlich, wenn ein Wert basierend auf mehreren diskreten Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming, Expressions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Nachricht, die Informationen über einen Flug (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) enthält, unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `|... { variable } ...|` und die Formatierungsoption `DATE = USER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS format_flight_message
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_message.
    rv_message = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } am { is_flight-fldate DATE = USER } ist verfügbar.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_message.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_flight_formatter=>ty_flight_info.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = '20231125'.

    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_formatter->format_flight_message( is_flight = ls_flight ).

    " Depending on user locale, date format might vary. Assert for content.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Message should contain carrier' sub = 'LH' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Message should contain connection' sub = '0400' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Message should contain date' sub = '25.11.2023' act = lv_message ). " Assuming German locale for test
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu konstruieren. Sie ermöglichen das direkte Einbetten von Variablen und Ausdrücken (`{ variable }`) sowie Formatierungsoptionen (`DATE = USER`) innerhalb des Strings, was den Code wesentlich lesbarer und wartbarer macht als die Verkettung mit `&&` oder `CONCATENATE`.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, DATE = USER, Formatting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Zeichenkette zurückgibt, und demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung der Klasse und den Methodenaufruf in einer einzigen Anweisung (Method Chaining).
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW class_name( )->method_name( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chain_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
    METHODS set_name IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chain_example.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string VALUE 'World'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chain_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |Hello, { mv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_name.
    mv_name = iv_name.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_greeting_default) = NEW zcl_chain_example( )->get_greeting( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Default greeting incorrect' act = lv_greeting_default exp = 'Hello, World!' ).

    DATA(lv_greeting_chained) = NEW zcl_chain_example( )->set_name( 'ABAP' )->get_greeting( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Chained greeting incorrect' act = lv_greeting_chained exp = 'Hello, ABAP!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `NEW` Operator ermöglicht die Inline-Instanziierung von Objekten. In Kombination mit Methoden, die eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz zurückgeben (`RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chain_example`), kann Method Chaining realisiert werden. Dies führt zu sehr flüssigem und ausdrucksstarkem Code, der mehrere Operationen in einer Zeile verkettet.
keywords: NEW, Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Inline Instantiation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode mit einem optionalen Parameter und demonstrieren Sie dessen Verwendung, sowohl mit als auch ohne Übergabe des optionalen Wertes.
hint: Verwenden Sie das Schlüsselwort `OPTIONAL` in der Methodendefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optional_param_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS greet
      IMPORTING
        iv_name    TYPE string
        iv_salutation TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_param_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD greet.
    IF iv_salutation IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_full_greeting = |{ iv_salutation } { iv_name }!|.
    ELSE.
      rv_full_greeting = |Hello { iv_name }!|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_optional_param FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_optional_param.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_optional_param_demo( ).

    " Call without optional parameter
    DATA(lv_greeting_default) = lo_demo->greet( iv_name = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Default greeting incorrect' act = lv_greeting_default exp = 'Hello World!' ).

    " Call with optional parameter
    DATA(lv_greeting_custom) = lo_demo->greet( iv_name = 'Developer' iv_salutation = 'Greetings' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Custom greeting incorrect' act = lv_greeting_custom exp = 'Greetings Developer!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Schlüsselwort `OPTIONAL` in der Methodendefinition erlaubt es, Parameter als optional zu kennzeichnen. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität von Methoden, da sie mit unterschiedlichen Parametersätzen aufgerufen werden können, ohne dass mehrere überladene Methoden implementiert werden müssen. Die Abfrage `IS SUPPLIED` prüft, ob ein optionaler Parameter tatsächlich übergeben wurde.
keywords: OPTIONAL, Methods, Object Orientation, IS SUPPLIED

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE type( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE ty_flight_table
        iv_carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier_id )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_seats.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_reducer=>ty_flight_table.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_seats( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier_id = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats for AA incorrect' act = lv_total_aa exp = 180 ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_seats( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier_id = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats for LH incorrect' act = lv_total_lh exp = 350 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Expression zusammenzufassen, inklusive Initialisierung (`INIT`) und iterativer Verarbeitung (`NEXT`).
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Expressions

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Datentyp und die Länge einer beliebigen Variablen zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_type_info,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_type_info.
    METHODS get_type_info IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any RETURNING VALUE(rs_type_info) TYPE ty_type_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_info.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    rs_type_info-type_kind = lo_descr->type_kind.
    rs_type_info-length = lo_descr->length.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_type_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_type_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_001( ).
    DATA lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'Hello'.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_turkish_upper.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18_001( ).
    " In Turkish, 'i' (dotless i) becomes 'İ' (dotted I) in uppercase.
    " 'ı' (dotted i) becomes 'I' (dotless I) in uppercase.
    " Standard ABAP 'TO UPPER' would convert 'i' to 'I' and 'ı' to 'I'.
    " cl_i18n_utils should handle this correctly.
    DATA(lv_input) = `istanbul`.
    DATA(lv_expected_tr) = `İSTANBUL`. "Dotted I
    DATA(lv_result_tr) = lo_cut->to_upper_case_locale( iv_text = lv_input iv_locale = 'TR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_tr exp = lv_expected_tr msg = 'Turkish uppercase failed for i' ).

    lv_input = `balık`. "Fish
    lv_expected_tr = `BALIK`. "Dotless I
    lv_result_tr = lo_cut->to_upper_case_locale( iv_text = lv_input iv_locale = 'TR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_tr exp = lv_expected_tr msg = 'Turkish uppercase failed for ı' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_german_upper.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18_001( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `straße`.
    DATA(lv_expected_de) = `STRASSE`. "ß becomes SS in uppercase in German
    DATA(lv_result_de) = lo_cut->to_upper_case_locale( iv_text = lv_input iv_locale = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_de exp = lv_expected_de msg = 'German uppercase failed for ß' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_i18n_utils=>to_upper_case` ermöglicht eine sprachspezifische Großschreibung, die über die einfache ASCII-Konvertierung hinausgeht und Sonderzeichen wie das deutsche 'ß' oder türkische 'i' korrekt behandelt. Die Verwendung von `COND string(...)` ist eine moderne Art, optionale Parameter zu handhaben.
keywords: I18N, Großbuchstaben, Locale, String, cl_i18n_utils

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die zwei Strings locale-sensitiv und case-insensitiv vergleicht, indem sie eine kanonische Form erzeugt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>to_upper_case` und `cl_i18n_utils=>normalize_string` (falls verfügbar oder eine ähnliche Logik) um eine vergleichbare Form zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18_004 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_strings_locale_insensitive
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
        iv_locale  TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18_004 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_strings_locale_insensitive.
    DATA(lv_locale) = COND string( WHEN iv_locale IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_locale ELSE sy-langu ).

    DATA(lv_norm_string1) = cl_i18n_utils=>to_upper_case(
      text   = iv_string1
      locale = lv_locale
    ).
    DATA(lv_norm_string2) = cl_i18n_utils=>to_upper_case(
      text   = iv_string2
      locale = lv_locale
    ).

    " For a more robust canonical form, one might also remove diacritics or normalize unicode forms.
    " cl_i18n_utils does not offer a direct 'normalize_string' for general canonicalization beyond case.
    " For this example, locale-aware uppercase is considered the canonical form for comparison.

    IF lv_norm_string1 = lv_norm_string2.
      rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen aus einem String, wobei verschiedene Arten von Leerzeichen (z.B. Non-Breaking Space) berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>is_space` in einer Schleife oder mit String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18_007 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_all_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_locale TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18_007 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_all_spaces.
    DATA(lv_locale) = COND string( WHEN iv_locale IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_locale ELSE sy-langu ).
    DATA(lt_chars) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_char_table( text = iv_text ).

    rv_cleaned_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_char_info IN lt_chars
      WHERE cl_i18n_utils=>is_space(
              char   = ls_char_info-char
              locale = lv_locale
            ) = abap_false
      NEXT s = s && ls_char_info-char
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiger numerischer Wert ist, der Tausendertrennzeichen und Dezimaltrennzeichen gemäß einer bestimmten Locale enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>is_numeric` oder eine Kombination von `is_digit` und `is_decimal_separator` / `is_grouping_separator`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18_008 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_numeric_locale
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_locale TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18_008 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_numeric_locale.
    DATA(lv_locale) = COND string( WHEN iv_locale IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_locale ELSE sy-langu ).
    " cl_i18n_utils does not have a direct 'is_numeric' for full string validation.
    " A robust implementation would involve parsing and checking against locale-specific number formats.
    " For this example, we simulate a basic check for digits, decimal, and grouping separators.
    " This is a simplified approach, a real-world scenario might use CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE or similar.

    DATA(lv_decimal_sep) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_decimal_separator( locale = lv_locale ).
    DATA(lv_grouping_sep) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_grouping_separator( locale = lv_locale ).
    DATA lv_has_decimal TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_has_sign TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    LOOP AT cl_i18n_utils=>get_char_table( text = iv_text ) INTO DATA(ls_char_info).
      DATA(lv_char) = ls_char_info-char.

      IF cl_i18n_utils=>is_digit( char = lv_char locale = lv_locale ) = abap_true.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_char = lv_decimal_sep.
        IF lv_has_decimal = abap_true. " Only one decimal separator allowed
          rv_is_numeric = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_has_decimal = abap_true.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_char = lv_grouping_sep.
        CONTINUE. " Grouping separators are allowed
      ENDIF.

      IF ( lv_char = '+' OR lv_char = '-' ) AND ls_char_info-offset = 0.
        IF lv_has_sign = abap_true. " Only one sign allowed at the beginning
          rv_is_numeric = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_has_sign = abap_true.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      " If it's none of the above, it's not a valid numeric character
      rv_is_numeric = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_is_numeric = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage  TYPE decfloat16
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_modify_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices_for_carrier.
    ct_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN ct_flights
                          ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid
                                    THEN VALUE #( ls_flight WITH price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) ) 
                                    ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen und aktualisieren Sie dann einen Status in einer anderen Tabelle basierend auf diesem Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_status.
    TYPES tt_carrier_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_status WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_and_update_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_carrier_status TYPE tt_carrier_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_update_status.
    DATA(lv_total_passengers) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).

    DATA(ls_status_update) = VALUE ty_carrier_status(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      total_passengers = lv_total_passengers
      status = COND #( WHEN lv_total_passengers > 1000 THEN 'HIGH VOLUME' ELSE 'NORMAL' )
    ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_carrier_status FROM ls_status_update.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_and_modify FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_and_modify.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_modify=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 300 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 500 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 600 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA: lt_carrier_status TYPE zcl_reduce_modify=>tt_carrier_status.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' total_passengers = 0 status = '' ) TO lt_carrier_status.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' total_passengers = 0 status = '' ) TO lt_carrier_status.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_modify( ).
    lo_cut->calculate_and_update_status(
      EXPORTING
        it_flights        = lt_flights
        iv_carrid         = 'LH'
      CHANGING
        ct_carrier_status = lt_carrier_status
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrier_status WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_result_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-total_passengers exp = 1100 ). " 200 + 300 + 600
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-status exp = 'HIGH VOLUME' ).

    lo_cut->calculate_and_update_status(
      EXPORTING
        it_flights        = lt_flights
        iv_carrid         = 'AA'
      CHANGING
        ct_carrier_status = lt_carrier_status
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_carrier_status WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_result_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-total_passengers exp = 500 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-status exp = 'NORMAL' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. In Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und `COND` für die Statusbestimmung wird der Code sehr prägnant. Die anschließende `MODIFY TABLE` Anweisung aktualisiert die Zieltabelle basierend auf dem berechneten Wert.
keywords: REDUCE, MODIFY, Internal Table, Aggregation, VALUE, COND, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine andere Methode einer Klasse aufruft, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object RECEIVING result = lr_data.
        IF lr_data IS BOUND.
          ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_result>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_result = <fs_result>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for demonstration
CLASS zcl_target_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_farewell RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_target_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_text = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_farewell.
    rv_text = 'Goodbye from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_target_class( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dynamic method!' ).

    lv_result = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'GET_FAREWELL'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Goodbye from dynamic method!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_fail.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_target_class( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Method not found or call failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für flexible Architekturen. In modernen ABAP-Anwendungen wird dies oft in Frameworks oder zur Implementierung von Plugins verwendet. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist dabei unerlässlich.
keywords: METHOD, Dynamic Call, CALL METHOD, Object Orientation, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des Tabellen-Ausdrucks `itab[ key = value ]`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_modify_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_modify_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price_expr.
    TRY.
        ct_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ]-price = iv_new_price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where line is not found, e.g., log error or insert new line
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_modify_table_expr=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.

  METHOD test_update_flight_price_not_found.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      CHANGING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.

    INSERT it_new_flights INTO TABLE ct_existing_flights
      ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) TO lt_existing_flights.

    DATA: lt_new_flights TYPE zcl_it_insert_corresponding=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) TO lt_new_flights. " Duplicate
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ) TO lt_new_flights. " New

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_corresponding( ).
    lo_cut->add_new_flights(
      EXPORTING
        it_new_flights      = lt_new_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_existing_flights = lt_existing_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_existing_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` Syntax ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, mehrere Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle einzufügen und dabei Duplikate (basierend auf dem Tabellenschlüssel) zu ignorieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn man Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zusammenführt.
keywords: MODIFY, INSERT, Internal Table, Duplicate Keys, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten nach einem bestimmten Attribut sortiert.

CLASS zcl_sort_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und lesen Sie einen Eintrag. Nutzen Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen für die Arbeitsbereiche.

solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_loop_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum_and_found) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_loop_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA(lv_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_number.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_search_value) = 3.
    READ TABLE it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_found_number) WITH KEY table_line = lv_search_value.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_sum_and_found = |Summe: { lv_sum }, Gefunden: { lv_found_number }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_sum_and_found = |Summe: { lv_sum }, { lv_search_value } nicht gefunden|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von `sflights` Datensätzen. Nutzen Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator und eine Inline-Deklaration für das Ergebnis.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lv_total) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                           FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                           NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
    rv_total_price = lv_total.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '400.50'
      msg = 'Die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise sollte 400.50 sein.' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_flights ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei die Strukturen der Tabellen teilweise übereinstimmen. Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Feldzuordnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS merge_tables RETURNING VALUE(rt_merged) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_source_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = 100 )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target_initial) = VALUE tt_target_data(
      ( id = 3 description = 'Initial C' value = 300 status = 'X' )
    ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_target_initial TO rt_merged.

    APPEND LINES OF CORRESPONDING #( lt_source ) TO rt_merged.

    " Manuelle Zuweisung für Felder, die nicht automatisch gemappt wurden
    LOOP AT rt_merged ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      IF <fs_target>-id = 1 AND <fs_target>-description IS INITIAL.
        <fs_target>-description = 'Mapped Item A'.
        <fs_target>-status = 'O'.
      ELSEIF <fs_target>-id = 2 AND <fs_target>-description IS INITIAL.
        <fs_target>-description = 'Mapped Item B'.
        <fs_target>-status = 'O'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_tables.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->merge_tables( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Zeilen in der zusammengeführten Tabelle sein.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-id exp = 3
      msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte von der initialen Tabelle stammen.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-id exp = 1
      msg = 'Zweite Zeile sollte von der Quelltabelle stammen.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-description exp = 'Mapped Item A'
      msg = 'Beschreibung für gemapptes Item A sollte korrekt sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-status exp = 'O'
      msg = 'Status für gemapptes Item A sollte O sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `APPEND LINES OF CORRESPONDING` ist eine moderne Erweiterung, die es ermöglicht, Zeilen zwischen internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen, aber teilweise übereinstimmenden Strukturen zu kopieren. Felder mit gleichem Namen werden automatisch zugewiesen. Dies reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand und macht den Code flexibler und wartbarer, wenn sich Strukturen ändern.
keywords: DATA, APPEND LINES OF, CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Structure Mapping

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'P' für geplant, 'C' für gecancelt, 'D' für durchgeführt) basierend auf einer Eingabe. Nutzen Sie dabei den `SWITCH`-Operator und eine Inline-Deklaration für das Ergebnis.

CLASS zcl_switch_status IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp. Fügen Sie dann Zeilen zu dieser dynamisch erstellten Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `APPEND LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table IMPORTING iv_table_type_name TYPE tabname
                                          RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    DATA(lr_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lr_line_descr) = lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_line_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Beispiel: Füllen mit sflight Daten, wenn der Typ sflight ist
        IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT_TAB' OR iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          DATA lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
          SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_data UP TO 2 ROWS.
          APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_data TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ELSE.
          " Generisches Füllen (hier nur ein Platzhalter)
          TRY.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp1>).
              IF <fs_comp1> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_comp1> = 'Dynamic Value 1'.
              ENDIF.
              APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
            CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
              " Handle error if component 1 does not exist or is not compatible
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight_dyn> TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_sflight_dyn>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <lt_sflight_dyn> IS INITIAL
      msg = 'Die dynamische Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( <lt_sflight_dyn> ) > 0
      msg = 'Es sollten Zeilen in der dynamischen Tabelle sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sflight_dyn>[1]-carrid exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte von sflight stammen (Beispiel).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` zur dynamischen Erstellung von internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit. `DATA()` wird hier für die Inline-Deklaration von Referenzen und Deskriptoren verwendet. `APPEND LINES OF` wird dann genutzt, um Daten aus einer statisch typisierten Tabelle in die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle zu kopieren, was die Flexibilität in generischen Programmen erhöht.
keywords: DATA, APPEND LINES OF, CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE, Dynamic Programming, RTTI

Instructions: Berechnen Sie ein Datum, das X Tage in der Zukunft liegt, basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum. Nutzen Sie dabei eine Inline-Deklaration für das Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA()` mit der Datumsarithmetik (`+`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_arithmetic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_date IMPORTING iv_days_to_add TYPE i
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_arithmetic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lv_current_date + iv_days_to_add.
    rv_future_date = lv_future_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_future_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_arithmetic( ).

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_result_plus_5) = lo_cut->get_future_date( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_plus_5 exp = lv_today + 5
      msg = 'Datum sollte 5 Tage in der Zukunft liegen.' ).

    DATA(lv_result_minus_2) = lo_cut->get_future_date( -2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_minus_2 exp = lv_today - 2

explanation: Die Datumsarithmetik in ABAP ist einfach und intuitiv. Durch die Verwendung von `+` oder `-` mit einem Integer-Wert kann man Tage zu einem Datum addieren oder subtrahieren. `DATA()` ermöglicht hier eine direkte und lesbare Inline-Deklaration des Zwischen- und Endergebnisses, was den Code sauber hält.
keywords: DATA, Date, Time, Arithmetic, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Meldungen eines bestimmten Anwendungslogs, die als Fehlertyp ('E') protokolliert wurden, und geben Sie sie aus. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` zum Lesen und `FOR` mit `WHERE` für die Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
        msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
      END OF ty_log_message.
    TYPES tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_error_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages
      RAISING
        cx_bal_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_log_handler) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( iv_log_handle ).
    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_log_handler->get_messages( ).

    rt_error_messages = VALUE #( 
      FOR <message> IN lt_all_messages
      WHERE ( msgty = 'E' )
      ( msgty = <message>-msgty
        msgid = <message>-msgid
        msgno = <message>-msgno
        msgv1 = <message>-msgv1 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_error_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_log_writer) = NEW zcl_log_creator( ). " Assuming zcl_log_creator from Example 1 exists
    DATA(lo_log_reader) = NEW zcl_log_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( )->get_log_handle( ).

    TRY.
        lo_log_writer->create_log_entry( 'Info Message' ).
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( lv_log_handle )->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Error 1'
        ).
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( lv_log_handle )->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = 'Error 2'
        ).
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( lv_log_handle )->save_log( ).

        DATA(lt_errors) = lo_log_reader->get_error_messages( lv_log_handle ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lines( lt_errors )
          exp = 2
          msg = 'Should find exactly 2 error messages'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lt_errors[ 1 ]-msgv1
          exp = 'Error 1'
          msg = 'First error message content incorrect'
        ).
      CATCH cx_bal_log INTO DATA(lx_bal_log).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_bal_log->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log` vorhandene Log-Meldungen abruft und diese dann mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Klausel filtert, um nur Fehlermeldungen zu extrahieren. Der `VALUE`-Operator wird verwendet, um die gefilterten Daten direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle zu überführen.
keywords: cl_s_aut_bal_log, Logging, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die aktuelle Daten-Temperatur für eine bestimmte Tabelle und geben Sie einen Status zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_session_temperature` und `COND` für die Statusermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_temperature_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_temperature_status,
        table_name TYPE tabname,
        temperature  TYPE string, " 'HOT', 'WARM', 'COLD', 'UNKNOWN'
      END OF ty_temperature_status.

    METHODS get_table_temperature_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status) TYPE ty_temperature_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_temperature_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_temperature_status.
    DATA(lo_temp_handler) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_temperature) = lo_temp_handler->get_temperature( iv_table_name ).

    rs_status-table_name = iv_table_name.
    rs_status-temperature = COND string(
      WHEN lv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>c_temperature_hot THEN 'HOT'
      WHEN lv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>c_temperature_warm THEN 'WARM'
      WHEN lv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>c_temperature_cold THEN 'COLD'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_temperature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_temperature.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_temperature_checker( ).
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->get_table_temperature_status( 'SFLIGHTS' ). " Using SFLIGHTS as example

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_status-table_name
      exp = 'SFLIGHTS'
      msg = 'Table name should match'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_status-temperature = 'HOT' OR
              ls_status-temperature = 'WARM' OR

      msg = 'Temperature should be a valid value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_session_temperature` zur Abfrage der Daten-Temperatur einer Tabelle, ein Feature des Data Aging. Der `COND`-Ausdruck wird verwendet, um den numerischen Temperaturwert in einen lesbaren String umzuwandeln, was eine moderne und kompakte Art der bedingten Zuweisung darstellt.

Instructions: Konkatenieren Sie eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem einzigen Satz, wobei jedes Wort durch ein Komma und ein Leerzeichen getrennt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_words
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_words.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word ELSE |{ s }, { word }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'World' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_cut->concatenate_words( lt_words ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sentence
      exp = 'Hello, World, ABAP'
      msg = 'Concatenated sentence should match expected value'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_words) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_sentence) = lo_cut->concatenate_words( lt_empty_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_empty_sentence
      exp = ''
      msg = 'Empty list should result in empty string'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle von Strings effizient zu einem einzigen String zu konkatenieren. String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine lesbare und flexible Möglichkeit, Strings zu formatieren und zu verbinden, während der `COND`-Ausdruck innerhalb von `REDUCE` die korrekte Komma-Trennung sicherstellt.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, Concatenation, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit vordefinierten Daten in einer einzigen Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        id     TYPE i,
        name   TYPE string,
        value  TYPE decfloat16,
        unused TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        id    TYPE i,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE decfloat16,
        extra TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_data_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING extra = unused ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>tt_source_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '10.5' unused = 'Ignore this' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = '20.0' unused = 'Also ignore' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_data_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_target )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Target table should have 2 entries'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id
      exp = 1
      msg = 'ID should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-name
      exp = 'Item A'
      msg = 'Name should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value
      exp = '10.5'
      msg = 'Value should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-extra
      exp = 'Ignore this'
      msg = 'Unused field should be mapped to extra'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 2 ]-extra
      exp = 'Also ignore'
      msg = 'Unused field should be mapped to extra'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist ideal, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit ähnlichen, aber nicht identischen Feldnamen zu übertragen. Er kopiert Felder automatisch, wenn die Namen übereinstimmen, und erlaubt explizite `MAPPING`-Regeln für abweichende Namen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und robuster macht.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Mapping, Structures, Internal Tables, Data Transfer

CLASS zcl_open_sql_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen einen Wert zu. Verwenden Sie eine moderne Syntax.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE count
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        flight_count = count ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_summary )
      msg = 'Summary table should not be empty'
    ).

    " Check for a specific carrier if SFLIGHTS data is known
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
          act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count
          msg = 'LH should have flights'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH carrier not found in summary' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature, um interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen durch eine deklarative und effiziente Syntax, die die Datenverarbeitung erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt verketten, um eine Reihe von Operationen durchzuführen.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass jede Methode `ME` zurückgibt, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS multiply_by IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_value.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_by.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chainable_processor( ).

    DATA(lv_final_result) = lo_processor->add_value( 5 )->multiply_by( 2 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_final_result
      exp = 13 " (5 * 2) + 3 = 13
      msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect'
    ).

    DATA(lv_initial_result) = NEW zcl_chainable_processor( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_initial_result
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Initial result should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, insbesondere bei Builder-Pattern oder sequenziellen Operationen. Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Design Patterns

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_min_price   TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_expensive_flights.
    rt_expensive_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '004' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_expensive_flights( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_min_price = '200.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should find 2 expensive flights'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = '002'
      msg = 'First expensive flight should be 002'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid
      exp = '004'
      msg = 'Second expensive flight should be 004'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft performanter als manuelle Schleifen mit `DELETE` oder `LOOP AT ... WHERE`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Filtering, Expressions

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit und geben Sie den Klassennamen zurück.

solution:

keywords: RTTI, Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_classdescr

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, actdeptime
      FROM sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL )
        AND ( connid = @iv_connid OR @iv_connid IS INITIAL )
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN lt_sflight ( 
        carrid = <fs>-carrid,
        connid = <fs>-connid,
        fldate = <fs>-fldate,
        status_text = SWITCH string( abap_true
                              WHEN <fs>-actdeptime IS INITIAL THEN 'Annulliert'
                              WHEN <fs>-actdeptime > <fs>-deptime + 15 * 60 THEN 'Verspätet' " 15 minutes in seconds
                              ELSE 'Pünktlich' )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_weight,
             quantity TYPE i,
             weight   TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 3,
             unit     TYPE c LENGTH 3,
           END OF ty_item_weight.
    TYPES: tt_item_weights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_weight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_weight
      IMPORTING
        it_item_weights TYPE tt_item_weights
        iv_target_unit  TYPE c LENGTH 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_weight) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 3.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_weight.
    rv_total_weight = REDUCE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 3(
      INIT total_weight = 0 UNIT iv_target_unit
      FOR <item> IN it_item_weights
      NEXT total_weight = CALCULATE total_weight + ( <item>-quantity * <item>-weight UNIT <item>-unit ) CONVERT TO UNIT iv_target_unit
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             duration_h  TYPE i,
             duration_m  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES: tt_flight_durations TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_durations
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_durations) TYPE tt_flight_durations.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_durations.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime
      FROM sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL )
        AND ( connid = @iv_connid OR @iv_connid IS INITIAL )
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_durations = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN lt_sflight ( 
        carrid = <fs>-carrid,
        connid = <fs>-connid,
        fldate = <fs>-fldate,
        duration_h = CALCULATE ( <fs>-arrtime - <fs>-deptime ) / 3600,
        duration_m = CALCULATE ( ( <fs>-arrtime - <fs>-deptime ) MOD 3600 ) / 60
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_distance_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_distance_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_distance.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
