CLASS zcl_weighted_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price    TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
             currency TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_products    TYPE tt_products
        iv_target_currency TYPE c LENGTH 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_average_price.
    DATA(ls_totals) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_value = 0 UNIT iv_target_currency
           total_quantity = 0
      FOR <product> IN it_products
      NEXT total_value = CALCULATE total_value + ( <product>-quantity * <product>-price UNIT <product>-currency ) CONVERT TO UNIT iv_target_currency,
           total_quantity = total_quantity + <product>-quantity
    ).

    IF ls_totals-total_quantity > 0.
      rv_avg_price = CALCULATE ls_totals-total_value / ls_totals-total_quantity UNIT iv_target_currency.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_weighted_average_price.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_weighted_avg_price( ).

    DATA(lt_test_products) = VALUE zcl_weighted_avg_price=>tt_products(
      ( quantity = 10 price = '10.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( quantity = 5  price = '20.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( quantity = 2  price = '10.00' currency = 'USD' ) " Assuming 1 USD = 0.9 EUR for simplicity in test
    ).

    DATA(lv_avg_eur) = lo_calc->get_weighted_average_price( it_products = lt_test_products iv_target_currency = 'EUR' ).
    " Expected: (10*10 + 5*20 + 2*10*0.9) / (10+5+2) = (100 + 100 + 18) / 17 = 218 / 17 = 12.8235...
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_eur exp = '12.82' ). " Rounded to 2 decimals

    DATA(lt_empty_products) = VALUE zcl_weighted_avg_price=>tt_products( ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Zahlen und kategorisieren Sie diese. Zahlen < 10 sind 'Klein', Zahlen zwischen 10 und 100 sind 'Mittel', und Zahlen > 100 sind 'Groß'. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator zur Iteration und `SWITCH` zur Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_categorized_number,
             value TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_categorized_number.
    TYPES: tt_categorized_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_categorized_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_numbers) TYPE tt_categorized_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_numbers.
    rt_categorized_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <num> IN it_numbers ( 
        value = <num>,
        category = SWITCH string( abap_true
                                  WHEN <num> < 10 THEN 'Klein'
                                  WHEN <num> >= 10 AND <num> <= 100 THEN 'Mittel'
                                  WHEN <num> > 100 THEN 'Groß'
                                  ELSE 'Unbekannt' )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cat->categorize_numbers( lt_test_numbers ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dichte eines Objekts (Masse / Volumen). Masse und Volumen können in verschiedenen Einheiten angegeben werden, die Ausgabe soll in 'KG/M3' erfolgen. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` mit `CONVERT` für die Einheitenumrechnung und Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_density_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_density
      IMPORTING
        iv_mass TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 3
        iv_mass_unit TYPE c LENGTH 3
        iv_volume TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 3
        iv_volume_unit TYPE c LENGTH 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_density) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 3.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_density_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_density.
    DATA(lv_mass_kg) = CALCULATE iv_mass UNIT iv_mass_unit CONVERT TO UNIT 'KG'.
    DATA(lv_volume_m3) = CALCULATE iv_volume UNIT iv_volume_unit CONVERT TO UNIT 'M3'.

    IF lv_volume_m3 > 0.
      rv_density = CALCULATE lv_mass_kg / lv_volume_m3 UNIT 'KG/M3'.
    ELSE.
      rv_density = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_density FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_density.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_density_calculator( ).

    " 10 KG / 2 M3 = 5 KG/M3
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_calc->calculate_density( iv_mass = '10' iv_mass_unit = 'KG' iv_volume = '2' iv_volume_unit = 'M3' )
      exp = '5.000' ).

    " 10000 G / 1000000 CM3 = 10 KG / 1 M3 = 10 KG/M3
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_calc->calculate_density( iv_mass = '10000' iv_mass_unit = 'G' iv_volume = '1000000' iv_volume_unit = 'CM3' )
      exp = '10.000' ).

    " Division by zero
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_calc->calculate_density( iv_mass = '10' iv_mass_unit = 'KG' iv_volume = '0' iv_volume_unit = 'M3' )
      exp = '0.000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CALCULATE`-Ausdruck mit `CONVERT TO UNIT` ist ideal für physikalische Berechnungen, bei denen Einheitenumrechnungen eine Rolle spielen. Er ermöglicht eine präzise und fehlerfreie Berechnung der Dichte, indem er die Einheiten vor der Division in die gewünschten Basiseinheiten umwandelt.
keywords: CALCULATE, Unit Handling, Math, Intermediate

Instructions: Exportiere Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) und Fluggesellschaften (`SCARR`) in eine XLSX-Datei mit zwei separaten Arbeitsblättern. Formatiere die Kopfzeilen beider Blätter fett.
hint: Nutze `add_sheet` mehrmals und `set_cell_style` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_multi_sheet
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'MultiSheet_Data.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_multi_sheet.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_scarr   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).

    " Sheet 1: SFLIGHT
    DATA(lo_sheet_sflight) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' ).
    lo_sheet_sflight->add_sheet_from_data( it_data = lt_sflight ).
    " Apply bold format to header row
    DATA(lo_style_bold) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_bold->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight_dummy) FROM 1 TO 1. " Get header row count
      DO sy-tfill TIMES. " Iterate through columns
        lo_sheet_sflight->set_cell_style( iv_row = 1 iv_column = sy-index iv_style = lo_style_bold ).
      ENDDO.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2: SCARR
    DATA(lo_sheet_scarr) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Carriers' ).
    lo_sheet_scarr->add_sheet_from_data( it_data = lt_scarr ).
    " Apply bold format to header row
    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr_dummy) FROM 1 TO 1. " Get header row count
      DO sy-tfill TIMES. " Iterate through columns
        lo_sheet_scarr->set_cell_style( iv_row = 1 iv_column = sy-index iv_style = lo_style_bold ).
      ENDDO.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeige eine einfache Baumstruktur der Fluggesellschaften (`SCARR`) und deren Flüge (`SFLIGHT`) in einem `cl_gui_simple_tree` Control an.
hint: Erstelle Knoten für Fluggesellschaften und Unterknoten für Flüge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflight_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflight_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          lt_scarr     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr,
          lt_sflight   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'. " Assumes a screen with a custom container named 'CONTAINER'

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      lo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = lv_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = ' '
          i_text = ls_scarr-carrname
          i_is_folder = abap_true
      ).
      DATA(lv_parent_key) = lv_node_key.

      LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        lo_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_key = lv_node_key
            i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_key
            i_text = |Flight { ls_sflight-connid } from { ls_sflight-cityfrom } to { ls_sflight-cityto }|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->set_top_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportiere `SFLIGHT` Daten in eine XLSX-Datei, aber nur für eine dynamisch ausgewählte Liste von Spalten. Nutze moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenmanipulation.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_structdescr` und Field-Symbols für dynamische Spalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dynamic,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_dynamic.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_dynamic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_dynamic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_selected_columns TYPE string_table
        iv_filename         TYPE string DEFAULT 'Dynamic_SFLIGHT.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring)   TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all.

    DATA lt_dynamic_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    " Create dynamic internal table structure based on selected columns
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflight_all ).
    DATA(lt_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
      FOR comp IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
        WHERE ( line_exists( it_selected_columns[ table_line = comp-name ] ) )
        ( comp )
    ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_type) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA lt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lo_dynamic_type).
    ASSIGN lt_dynamic_data->* TO <ft_dynamic_data>.

    " Populate dynamic internal table
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_all INTO DATA(ls_sflight_line).
      CREATE DATA DATA(ls_dynamic_line) TYPE (lo_dynamic_type).
      ASSIGN ls_dynamic_line->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight_line TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_component>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_component> = <fs_component>. " Assign value
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <ft_dynamic_data>.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Dynamic SFLIGHT' ).
    lo_sheet->add_sheet_from_data( it_data = <ft_dynamic_data> ). " Pass field symbol

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols( ).
    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_exporter->export_dynamic_columns( it_selected_columns = lt_columns ).

Instructions: Exportiere `SFLIGHT` Daten. Füge eine neue Spalte hinzu, die den Gesamtpreis (Price * Seats Occupied) berechnet, und eine Zeile am Ende, die die Summe aller Preise anzeigt.
hint: Nutze `set_cell_formula` und `add_sheet_from_data` für die Basisdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_formulas DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_calc,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             total_price TYPE s_price, " New calculated field
           END OF ty_sflight_calc.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_calc TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_calc WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_with_formulas
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'SFLIGHT_Formulas.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_formulas IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_with_formulas.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'SFLIGHT with Formulas' ).

    " Add header row manually to include 'Total Price'
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 3 iv_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 4 iv_value = 'PRICE' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 5 iv_value = 'CURRENCY' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 6 iv_value = 'SEATSOCC' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 7 iv_value = 'TOTAL_PRICE' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 iv_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 5 iv_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 6 iv_value = ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
      " Formula for Total Price: Price * Seats Occupied
      lo_sheet->set_cell_formula( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 7 iv_formula = |D{ lv_row }*F{ lv_row }| ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add total sum at the end
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 6 iv_value = 'Total:' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_formula( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 7 iv_formula = |SUM(G2:G{ lv_row - 1 })| ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING

    SET HANDLER handle_node_click FOR mo_tree. " Register event handler

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).

      ).
      DATA(lv_parent_key) = lv_node_key.

      LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_key = lv_node_key
            i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_key
            i_text = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid }: { ls_sflight-cityfrom } -> { ls_sflight-cityto }|

  METHOD export_conditional_style.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).

    " Create a style for red font
    DATA(lo_style_red) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_red->set_font_color( cl_xlsx_document=>co_color_red ).

    " Add data with conditional styling
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.

    lo_sheet->add_sheet_from_data( it_data = lt_sflight ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1. " Start from row 2 for data
      IF ls_sflight-price > 500.
        " Apply red style to the entire row for prices > 500
        DO 7 TIMES. " Assuming 7 columns in SFLIGHT for simplicity
          lo_sheet->set_cell_style( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = sy-index iv_style = lo_style_red ).
        ENDDO.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Nutze `FILTER` für die Datenvorbereitung und `delete_all_nodes` / `add_node` zum Aktualisieren des Baums.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_filtered_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_city_from TYPE s_cityname DEFAULT 'FRANKFURT'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA mt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    METHODS build_tree_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_city TYPE s_cityname OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @mt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_sflight.

    build_tree_nodes( iv_filter_city = iv_city_from ).

    mo_tree->set_top_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_tree_nodes.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    LOOP AT mt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( mt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid AND ( iv_filter_city IS INITIAL OR cityfrom = iv_filter_city ) ).

      IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL OR iv_filter_city IS INITIAL. " Show carrier if it has filtered flights or no filter is applied
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_key = lv_node_key
            i_relat_node_key = ' '
            i_text = ls_scarr-carrname
            i_is_folder = abap_true
        ).
        DATA(lv_parent_key) = lv_node_key.

        LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
          mo_tree->add_node(
            EXPORTING
              i_node_key = lv_node_key
              i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_key
              i_text = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid } von { ls_sflight-cityfrom } nach { ls_sflight-cityto }|
          ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutze `set_cell_style` mit `set_background_color` und `set_alignment` sowie `set_column_width`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_advanced_style DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_advanced_style
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'SFLIGHT_AdvancedStyle.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_advanced_style IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_advanced_style.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'SFLIGHT Advanced' ).

    " Create style for header: bold, centered, background color
    DATA(lo_style_header) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_header->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    lo_style_header->set_alignment( iv_horizontal = cl_xlsx_document=>co_align_center ).
    lo_style_header->set_background_color( cl_xlsx_document=>co_color_light_blue ).

    " Add header row manually and apply style
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflight ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_component-name ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_style( iv_row = 1 iv_column = lv_col iv_style = lo_style_header ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add data rows
    lo_sheet->add_sheet_from_data( it_data = lt_sflight iv_start_row = 2 ).

    " Auto-fit column widths
    DO lv_col - 1 TIMES.
      lo_sheet->set_column_width( iv_column = sy-index iv_width = cl_xlsx_document=>co_auto_width ).
    ENDDO.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Baumstruktur, die Fluggesellschaften und Flüge anzeigt. Nutze eine separate Hilfsklasse, um die Daten für den Baum vorzubereiten und die Knoten zu erstellen, um die Logik zu kapseln.
hint: Verwende eine Factory-Methode oder eine separate Klasse zur Datenaufbereitung und Knoten-Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_preparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key     TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text           TYPE lvc_value,
             is_folder      TYPE abap_bool,
             picture_id     TYPE i,
             tooltip        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_sflight_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_preparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_scarr     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr,
          lt_sflight   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    CONSTANTS: lc_icon_carrier TYPE i VALUE 10,
               lc_icon_flight  TYPE i VALUE 11.

    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node(
        node_key = lv_node_key
        parent_key = ' '
        text = ls_scarr-carrname
        is_folder = abap_true
        picture_id = lc_icon_carrier
        tooltip = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_scarr-carrname } ({ ls_scarr-carrid })|
      ) TO rt_tree_nodes.
      DATA(lv_parent_key) = lv_node_key.

      LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node(
          node_key = lv_node_key
          parent_key = lv_parent_key
          text = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid }: { ls_sflight-cityfrom } -> { ls_sflight-cityto }|
          picture_id = lc_icon_flight
          tooltip = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid }: { ls_sflight-cityfrom } -> { ls_sflight-cityto } am { ls_sflight-fldate }|
        ) TO rt_tree_nodes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_oo_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_oo_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_oo_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_oo_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = zcl_tree_data_preparer=>get_sflight_tree_data( ).

    LOOP AT lt_tree_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      lo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = ls_node-node_key
          i_relat_node_key = ls_node-parent_key
          i_text = ls_node-text
          i_is_folder = ls_node-is_folder
          i_picture_id = ls_node-picture_id
          i_tooltip = ls_node-tooltip
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->set_top_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Baumstruktur, die Fluggesellschaften und Flüge anzeigt. Die Daten für die Flüge sollen erst geladen werden, wenn der entsprechende Fluggesellschafts-Knoten erweitert wird (Lazy Loading).
hint: Nutze das `NODE_EXPAND` Event und `add_node` dynamisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_lazy_loading DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_lazy_loading_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA mt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    METHODS handle_node_expand FOR EVENT node_expand OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING node_key.
    METHODS add_flight_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_lazy_loading IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_lazy_loading_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER handle_node_expand FOR mo_tree.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @mt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    LOOP AT mt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = lv_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = ' '
          i_text = ls_scarr-carrname
          i_is_folder = abap_true
          i_exp_by_user = abap_true " Allow user to expand
          i_item_handle = ls_scarr-carrid " Store carrid in item_handle for later retrieval
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_top_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_expand.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = mo_tree->get_item_handle( i_node_key = node_key ).
    IF lv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      add_flight_nodes( iv_parent_key = node_key iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = iv_parent_key.
    LOOP AT mt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = lv_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = iv_parent_key
          i_text = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid }: { ls_sflight-cityfrom } -> { ls_sflight-cityto }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    mo_tree->set_top_node( i_node_key = 1 ). " Refresh tree display
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Exportiere eine kombinierte Ansicht von Fluggesellschaften (`SCARR`) und Flügen (`SFLIGHT`) in ein einziges XLSX-Arbeitsblatt. Die Daten sollen in einer hierarchischen, aber flachen Struktur dargestellt werden.
hint: Verwende `FOR` und `VALUE` um die Daten aus `SCARR` und `SFLIGHT` zu kombinieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_combined_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_data,
             level      TYPE i,
             id         TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             value1     TYPE string,
             value2     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_data.
    TYPES: tt_combined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_combined_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'Combined_SFLIGHT_SCARR.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_combined_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_combined_data.
    DATA: lt_scarr     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr,
          lt_sflight   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_combined) = VALUE tt_combined_data(
      FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr
        ( level = 1
          id = ls_scarr-carrid
          description = ls_scarr-carrname
          value1 = ls_scarr-currcode
          value2 = '' )
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid
        ( level = 2
          id = ls_sflight-connid
          description = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid }|
          value1 = |{ ls_sflight-cityfrom } -> { ls_sflight-cityto }|
          value2 = |Preis: { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency }| )
    ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Combined Data' ).
    lo_sheet->add_sheet_from_data( it_data = lt_combined ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).

Instructions: Erstelle eine Baumstruktur der Fluggesellschaften und Flüge. Füge ein Kontextmenü hinzu, das erscheint, wenn ein Knoten rechtsgeklickt wird, und eine Aktion ausführt (z.B. 'Details anzeigen').
hint: Nutze das `CONTEXT_MENU_REQUEST` Event und `cl_ctmenu`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree_with_context_menu.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA mt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    METHODS handle_context_menu_request FOR EVENT context_menu_request OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING node_key menu.
    METHODS handle_menu_select FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu
      IMPORTING fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_context_menu.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER handle_menu_select FOR ALL INSTANCES OF cl_ctmenu. " Handle menu selections globally

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @mt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    LOOP AT mt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = lv_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = ' '
          i_text = ls_scarr-carrname
          i_is_folder = abap_true
          i_item_handle = ls_scarr-carrid " Store carrid
      ).
      DATA(lv_parent_key) = lv_node_key.

      LOOP AT mt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_key = lv_node_key
            i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_key
            i_text = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid }: { ls_sflight-cityfrom } -> { ls_sflight-cityto }|
            i_item_handle = ls_sflight-connid " Store connid
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_top_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SHOW_DETAILS' text = 'Details anzeigen' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SEP' text = '-' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'EXPAND_NODE' text = 'Knoten erweitern' ).

    " Pass the node_key to the menu for later use
    menu->add_function( fcode = 'NODE_KEY_PLACEHOLDER' text = node_key ). " Hidden item to pass context

    menu->add_submenu( menu = lo_menu text = 'Aktionen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_select.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = ' '.
    " Retrieve the node_key from the menu (assuming it was passed as a hidden function)
    LOOP AT cl_ctmenu=>mt_functions INTO DATA(ls_func) WHERE fcode = 'NODE_KEY_PLACEHOLDER'.
      lv_node_key = ls_func-text.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'SHOW_DETAILS'.
        DATA(lv_node_text) = mo_tree->get_node_text( i_node_key = lv_node_key ).
        MESSAGE |Details für Knoten '{ lv_node_text }' anzeigen.| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      WHEN 'EXPAND_NODE'.
        mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = lv_node_key ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Do nothing or handle other functions
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur von `sflights` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` zur dynamischen Tabellenerstellung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Datenzugriff. Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für das Füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_sflights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
        LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
          ls_fieldcat-fieldname = ls_component-name.
          ls_fieldcat-inttype   = ls_component-type_kind.
          ls_fieldcat-intlen    = ls_component-length.
          ls_fieldcat-decimals  = ls_component-decimals.
          APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_source).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight_source>).
      CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_fieldcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fcat_entry>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_fcat_entry>-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_source> TO <fs_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_fcat_entry>-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_dynamic_table = lr_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_sflights( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = <fs_table> IS INITIAL
      msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' " Should be NOT initial
    ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_sflights_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <fs_table> ),
      exp = lv_sflights_count,
      msg = 'Dynamic table should have same number of entries as SFLIGHTS'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit mit `cl_alv_table_create`. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist entscheidend für den Zugriff auf dynamische Datenstrukturen. Die Daten werden mit einem modernen `SELECT`-Statement gefüllt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem benutzerdefinierten Feldkatalog, der nur ausgewählte Felder aus `sflights` enthält, und füllen Sie diese Tabelle.
hint: Definieren Sie den `lvc_t_fcat` manuell mit den gewünschten Feldern und verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_custom_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_custom_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_custom_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_custom_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    " 1. Define custom field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-inttype   = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Airline'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-inttype   = 'N'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Flight No.'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fieldcat-inttype   = 'D'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 8.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Flight Date'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Fill dynamic table with SFLIGHTS data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_source).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight_source>).
      CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_fieldcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fcat_entry>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_fcat_entry>-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_source> TO <fs_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_fcat_entry>-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_dynamic_table = lr_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_custom_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_custom_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_custom_fcat( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_custom_table( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = <fs_table> IS INITIAL
      msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' " Should be NOT initial
    ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_sflights_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <fs_table> ),
      exp = lv_sflights_count,
      msg = 'Dynamic table should have same number of entries as SFLIGHTS'
    ).

    " Check if the first line has the expected fields
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = <fs_field>,
        msg = 'CARRID field should be filled'
      ).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = <fs_field>,
        msg = 'CONNID field should be filled'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die dynamische Tabellenerstellung, indem ein benutzerdefinierter Feldkatalog verwendet wird. Dies ermöglicht eine präzise Kontrolle über die Struktur der zur Laufzeit erstellten Tabelle, was in flexiblen Berichten oder Schnittstellen nützlich ist.
keywords: cl_alv_table_create, Dynamic Table, Field Catalog, sflights, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit nur den Flugnummern und Abflugorten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `FILTER` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_info.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        cityfrom = flight-cityfrom ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_info( lv_carrid ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_expected_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = lv_expected_count,
      msg = 'Number of filtered flights should match'
    ).

    IF lv_expected_count > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid,
        exp = lv_carrid,
        msg = 'First entry carrid should be LH'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die moderne, deklarative Art, interne Tabellen mit `FOR` und `VALUE` zu filtern und zu transformieren, was zu kürzerem und lesbarerem Code führt.
keywords: FOR, FILTER, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der Informationen über einen Flug aus der `sflights`-Tabelle enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) zur einfachen Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_description.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_description = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } von { ls_sflight-cityfrom } nach { ls_sflight-cityto } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER } mit { ls_sflight-planetype }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_description = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der `sflights`-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT total = total + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( lv_carrid ).

    DATA(lv_expected_seats) = 0.
    SELECT seatsocc FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_seatsocc).
      lv_expected_seats = lv_expected_seats + lv_seatsocc.
    ENDSELECT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats,
      exp = lv_expected_seats,
      msg = 'Total occupied seats should match expected value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Total seats should be 0 for non-existent airline'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, prägnanten Anweisung, was die Funktionalität von Schleifen in einem deklarativen Stil ersetzt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Methodenketten (Method Chaining) in einer einfachen Klasse.
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME->` zurück, um weitere Methoden aufrufen zu können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chain_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain_demo.
    METHODS set_value2 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain_demo.
    METHODS get_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA: mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_method_chain_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum,
      exp = 30,
      msg = 'The sum should be 30 after chaining methods'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenketten) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile verkettet werden. Dies wird durch die Rückgabe der Objektinstanz (`ME->`) in jeder Setter-Methode ermöglicht.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und diese mit `TRY...CATCH` abfängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY`, `CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error` und `ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handling_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Division durch Null
        rv_result = 0. " Oder ein anderer Standardwert/Fehlercode
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_safe_divide_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_safe_divide_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_divide_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 5,
      msg = 'Division should return correct result'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_safe_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Division by zero should be handled and return 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP erfolgt über das `TRY...CATCH`-Konstrukt. Dies ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen (Exceptions) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt dass das Programm abstürzt. Hier wird `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` für arithmetische Fehler abgefangen.
keywords: TRY...CATCH, Exceptions, Error Handling, cx_sy_arithmetic_error

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Zusatz im `LOOP AT` Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result IS INITIAL,
      msg = 'Result table should not be initial' " Should be NOT initial
    ).

    " Check count for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    DATA(lv_lh_count_expected) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_lh_count_expected.

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_lh_entry-count,
        exp = lv_lh_count_expected,
        msg = 'Count for LH should match expected value'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY`-Zusatz im `LOOP AT`-Statement ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Funktion, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen, ohne manuelle Schleifen und Hilfstabellen zu benötigen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit über den Konstruktor injiziert (Constructor Injection).
hint: Verwenden Sie `IMPORTING` Parameter im `CONSTRUCTOR` und `FINAL` für die Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In einer echten Umgebung würde hier z.B. ein SY-WRITE oder ein Log-Framework verwendet.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir nur die Aktion.
    " WRITE: / iv_message. " Kann nicht im Unit Test verwendet werden
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger READ-ONLY ALIASES logger FOR zif_logger.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    mo_logger->log_message( |Processing data: { iv_data }| ).
    " ... weitere Logik ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_app_service( io_logger = lo_logger ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_service->logger,
      msg = 'Logger should be injected and not initial'
    ).

    " Da zcl_console_logger keine sichtbare Ausgabe hat, können wir nur die Instanziierung prüfen.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man ein Mock-Objekt für den Logger verwenden, um die Log-Aufrufe zu prüfen.
    lo_service->process_data( 'Testdaten' ).
    " Keine direkte Assert-Möglichkeit für den Log-Aufruf ohne Mocking-Framework.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein Entwurfsmuster der Abhängigkeitsinjektion, bei dem Abhängigkeiten einer Klasse über ihren Konstruktor bereitgestellt werden. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes. Die Verwendung von Interfaces (`zif_logger`) ist hierbei entscheidend.
keywords: Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, Object Orientation, Interface, Loose Coupling

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `ADD_DAYS` der Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_in_future
      IMPORTING
        iv_days TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_in_future.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d.

    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_date.

    rv_future_date = lv_current_date + iv_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_date_in_future FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_date_in_future.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lo_cut->get_date_in_future( 30 ).

    DATA(lv_expected_date) = lv_current_date + 30.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und deren Namen auszugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    METHODS get_struct_component_names
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_component_names.
    DATA: lr_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA: lr_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lr_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        lr_structdescr ?= lr_typedescr.

        LOOP AT lr_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_component_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error if it's not a structure or cast fails
        CLEAR rt_component_names.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FOR ... IN GROUP` für eine optimierte Verarbeitung von gruppierten Daten aus `sflights`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `FOR ... IN GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_in_group_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_grouped RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_in_group_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_grouped.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_info(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connids = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP (
                               connid = member-connid ) )
      ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_in_group FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_in_group.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_in_group_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier_grouped( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result IS INITIAL,
      msg = 'Result table should not be initial' " Should be NOT initial
    ).

    " Check for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy_subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_connids) = 0.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_connids.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lines( ls_lh_group-connids ),
        exp = lv_expected_connids,
        msg = 'Number of connids for LH should match expected value'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `FOR ... IN GROUP` ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um gruppierte Daten zu verarbeiten. Sie ermöglicht es, Aggregationen oder Transformationen auf die Elemente jeder Gruppe direkt und deklarativ anzuwenden, was die Performance und Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: FOR IN GROUP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, Performance

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle um 10%, wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, andernfalls um 5%. Die Methode soll die aktualisierte Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR` Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und den `COND` Operator für die Preisanpassung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjuster DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjuster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices.
    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   ( ls_flight WITH price = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN ls_flight-price * '1.10'
                                                                   ELSE ls_flight-price * '1.05' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_price_adjuster=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_adjusted) = lo_adjuster->adjust_prices( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_adjusted[ 1 ]-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'LH Preis sollte um 10% erhöht sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_adjusted[ 2 ]-price exp = '210.00' msg = 'UA Preis sollte um 5% erhöht sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Der `COND` Operator bietet eine kompakte Möglichkeit, bedingte Zuweisungen direkt im Ausdruck vorzunehmen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert, verglichen mit traditionellen `LOOP`s und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, VALUE, COND, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, METHOD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flügen filtert und nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zurückgibt. Die Methode soll als funktionale Methode implementiert werden.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

In Kombination mit einer `RETURNING VALUE` Methode ermöglicht dies einen funktionalen Programmierstil, bei dem die Methode eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle zurückgibt, ohne die ursprüngliche zu modifizieren. Dies fördert die Immutabilität und vereinfacht das Debugging.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen. Die Methode soll diesen aggregierten Wert zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_occupancy) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupancy.
    rv_total_occupancy = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 70 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_occupancy( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_ua) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_occupancy( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 80 msg = 'Gesamtbelegung für LH sollte 80 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_ua exp = 70 msg = 'Gesamtbelegung für UA sollte 70 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen in einem funktionalen Stil. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und ausdrucksstärker als ein traditioneller `LOOP` mit manueller Summenbildung.
keywords: REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, METHOD

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines einzelnen Fluges in `SFLIGHTS` nach dem Sperren des Datensatzes, um Race Conditions zu vermeiden. Die Methode soll einen Boolean zurückgeben, der den Erfolg der Aktualisierung anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE` und anschließend `UPDATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_single_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_single_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    " Datensatz sperren und lesen
    SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE * FROM sflights INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_sflight-price = iv_new_price.
      UPDATE sflights FROM @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Datensatz nicht gefunden oder konnte nicht gesperrt werden
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '0001'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE #( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_sflight_single_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'YY'
      iv_connid = '0001'
      iv_fldate = sy-datum
      iv_new_price = '150.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Aktualisierung sollte erfolgreich sein.' ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '150.00' msg = 'Preis sollte aktualisiert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_failure.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_sflight_single_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'ZZ' " Nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft
      iv_connid = '0001'
      iv_fldate = sy-datum
      iv_new_price = '200.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Aktualisierung sollte fehlschlagen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE` und anschließendem `UPDATE` ist der Standardweg, um einzelne Datenbankdatensätze in einer transaktionssicheren Weise zu aktualisieren. `SELECT FOR UPDATE` sperrt den Datensatz, um zu verhindern, dass andere Benutzer ihn gleichzeitig ändern, und vermeidet so Inkonsistenzen. `COMMIT WORK` und `ROLLBACK WORK` sind entscheidend für die Transaktionskontrolle.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, SELECT FOR UPDATE, TRANSACTION, METHOD, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Status (z.B. 'OK', 'WARNING', 'ERROR') basierend auf einem numerischen Eingabewert zurückgibt. Ein optionaler Parameter kann das Schwellenwertverhalten ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPTIONAL` für den Parameter und den `SWITCH` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
        iv_threshold_warning TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_threshold_error TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status.
    DATA(lv_warning_threshold) = COALESCE( iv_threshold_warning, 50 ). " Standardwert 50
    DATA(lv_error_threshold)   = COALESCE( iv_threshold_error, 80 ).   " Standardwert 80

    rv_status = SWITCH #( iv_value
                           WHEN > lv_error_threshold   THEN 'ERROR'
                           WHEN > lv_warning_threshold THEN 'WARNING'
                           ELSE 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, indem Sie ein neues Feld `flight_status` hinzufügen, das den Status des Fluges ('On Time', 'Delayed', 'Cancelled') basierend auf der verbleibenden Kapazität und einem optionalen Stornierungsflag angibt. Die Methode soll die transformierte Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die Transformation und Zuweisung des neuen Feldes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc    TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax    TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
        iv_is_cancelled TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
                                      LET lv_free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc IN
                                      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )
                                        flight_status = COND string(
                                                          WHEN iv_is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Cancelled'
                                                          WHEN lv_free_seats < 10 THEN 'Delayed'
                                                          ELSE 'On Time' )
                                      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die ein Feld in einer internen Tabelle dynamisch aktualisiert, basierend auf dem Feldnamen und dem neuen Wert. Die Methode soll die aktualisierte Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_table      TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value  TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_dynamically.
    rt_updated_table = it_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Fehlerbehandlung: Typkonvertierung fehlgeschlagen
            " Hier könnte eine Log-Nachricht oder eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einer internen Tabelle von Flügen ausführt: Filtern nach Fluggesellschaft, Sortieren nach Flugdatum und dann eine Transformation, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Verbindungsnummer zurückgibt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`, `SORT` (als separate Anweisung) und `FOR` mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_chain_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_summary.
    TYPES tt_sflight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_chained
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_sflight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_chain_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_chained.
    " 1. Filtern
    DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).

    " 2. Sortieren
    SORT lt_filtered BY fldate ASCENDING.

    " 3. Transformieren
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                            connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die `seatsocc` (belegte Sitze) in einer internen Tabelle von Flügen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer. Die Methode soll die aktualisierte Tabelle zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_it_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_occupancy_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_occupancy_in_table.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                                  ls_flight-connid = iv_connid
                                             THEN ls_flight WITH seatsocc = iv_new_seatsocc
                                             ELSE ls_flight ) )
                                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die verkettet werden können, um eine interne Tabelle von Flügen schrittweise zu bearbeiten (z.B. filtern, dann sortieren, dann transformieren). Jede Methode soll die Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
