Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `GROUP SIZE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_grouped_result,
      tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_grouped WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_grouped WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>tt_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_grouped ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Grouping, Aggregation, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Operationen (Filtern und Transformieren) auf einer internen Tabelle in einem einzigen Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` Operatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_processed_flight,
        airline_flight TYPE string,
        adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_processed_flight,
      tt_processed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_processed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_raw_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price )
      ( airline_flight = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }|
        adjusted_price = ls_flight-price * '0.9' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_ops FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_ops.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_chained_operations=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 100.00 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 250.00 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = 120.00 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = 300.00 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights( it_raw_flights = lt_raw iv_min_price = 110.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_proc).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_proc-airline_flight exp = 'LH-0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_proc-adjusted_price exp = 225.00 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_chained_operations=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 100.00 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights( it_raw_flights = lt_raw iv_min_price = 110.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_processed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` in einem einzigen `VALUE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und hochperformante Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen, indem Filterung und Transformation in einem Schritt erfolgen. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Chaining, Functional Programming, Internal Table, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften zurückgibt, und demonstrieren Sie den Aufruf dieser Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS METHODS` für die statische Methode und rufen Sie sie direkt über den Klassennamen auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_static_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS METHODS get_all_airlines
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_static_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_airlines.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_airlines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Anweisung, um die Preise zu addieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                               FOR flight IN it_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum_prices=>ty_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '250.50'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' msg = 'Summe sollte 400.50 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum_prices=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' msg = 'Summe sollte 0.00 für leere Tabelle sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Sie initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei der Wert in jedem Schritt aktualisiert wird. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `SUM`.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Summation

Instructions: Verbinden Sie alle Strings einer String-Tabelle zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch ein Komma und Leerzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und den String-Operator `&&`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string( INIT result = ``
                                            FOR s IN it_strings
                                            NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN s ELSE result && ', ' && s ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concat_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_strings.
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apfel' ) ( 'Birne' ) ( 'Kirsche' ) ).

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0.00
                             FOR flight IN it_flights
                             NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_p THEN flight-price ELSE max_p ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc, " Occupied seats
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_passengers,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_passengers.
    TYPES ty_carrier_passengers_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_passengers
                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_passengers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_carrier_passengers_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_passengers_by_carrier.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                         ( carrid = flight-carrid
                           total_passengers = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Für jede Gruppe wird dann `REDUCE` verwendet, um die `seatsocc` der Gruppenelemente zu summieren. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für Flüge, die zu einem bestimmten Zielort fliegen.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname, " Destination city
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_for_dest
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        iv_cityto  TYPE s_cityname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_for_dest.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cityto = iv_cityto ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                               FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die resultierende gefilterte Tabelle wird dann an `REDUCE` übergeben, um die Preise zu summieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge speichert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Hash-Tabelle zu füllen, wobei der Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft und der Wert die Anzahl der Flüge ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_build_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES ty_carrier_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_map) TYPE ty_carrier_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_build_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_map = REDUCE ty_carrier_map(
        INIT map = VALUE ty_carrier_map( )
        FOR flight IN it_flights
        NEXT map = VALUE ty_carrier_map( map ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                               table_line = map[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ]-table_line + 1 OPTIONAL ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_map.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_build_map=>ty_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0100'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_build_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Einträge geben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ]-table_line exp = 2 msg = 'LH sollte 2 Flüge haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ]-table_line exp = 2 msg = 'AA sollte 2 Flüge haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'BA' ]-table_line exp = 1 msg = 'BA sollte 1 Flug haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_build_map=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_build_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte leer sein für leere Tabelle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `REDUCE`, um eine Hash-Tabelle dynamisch zu füllen. Für jeden Eintrag in der Quelltabelle wird geprüft, ob der `carrid` bereits in der Ziel-Hash-Tabelle existiert. Wenn ja, wird der Zähler inkrementiert; andernfalls wird ein neuer Eintrag mit Zähler 1 hinzugefügt. Die `OPTIONAL`-Ergänzung ist entscheidend, um Fehler zu vermeiden, wenn ein Schlüssel noch nicht existiert. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Häufigkeiten zu zählen oder Daten zu gruppieren und in einer Map-Struktur zu speichern.
keywords: REDUCE, Hashed Table, Map, Data Structures, Functional Programming, VALUE, OPTIONAL

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie das Start- und Enddatum des aktuellen Geschäftsjahres für ein gegebenes Datum und eine Geschäftsjahresvariante. (Konzeptuell, da `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` eine Business Suite Klasse ist).
hint: Verwenden Sie Standard-ABAP-Datumfunktionen und logische Operatoren, um die Geschäftsjahreslogik zu simulieren. Beachten Sie, dass in einem realen Szenario `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` oder ähnliche Klassen verwendet würden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_fiscal_year DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fiscal_period,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_fiscal_period.

    METHODS get_fiscal_year_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_date    TYPE d
        iv_variant TYPE fical_year_variant " z.B. 'K1' für Kalenderjahr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_period) TYPE ty_fiscal_period.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_fiscal_year IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fiscal_year_dates.
    " Vereinfachte Logik: Annahme Kalenderjahr (K1)
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier cl_bs_period_toolset_basics verwendet werden.
    IF iv_variant = 'K1'. " Kalenderjahr
      rs_period-start_date = iv_date(4) && '0101'.
      rs_period-end_date   = iv_date(4) && '1231'.
    ELSE.
      " Für andere Varianten müsste komplexere Logik implementiert werden
      " oder die entsprechende SAP-Klasse aufgerufen werden.
      rs_period-start_date = iv_date(4) && '0101'. " Fallback
      rs_period-end_date   = iv_date(4) && '1231'. " Fallback
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob sich zwei gegebene Datumsbereiche überschneiden.
hint: Zwei Datumsbereiche überschneiden sich, wenn der Start des einen vor dem Ende des anderen liegt UND der Start des anderen vor dem Ende des ersten liegt. (Konzeptuell, da `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` eine Business Suite Klasse ist).
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_overlap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_date_range.

    METHODS check_overlap
      IMPORTING
        is_range1 TYPE ty_date_range
        is_range2 TYPE ty_date_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_overlaps) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_overlap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_overlap.
    rv_overlaps = abap_false.

    IF is_range1-start_date IS INITIAL OR is_range1-end_date IS INITIAL OR
       is_range2-start_date IS INITIAL OR is_range2-end_date IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF is_range1-start_date <= is_range2-end_date AND
       is_range2-start_date <= is_range1-end_date.
      rv_overlaps = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_overlap_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_false FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_touching FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_one_inside FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_invalid_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overlap_true.
    DATA(ls_range1) = VALUE zcl_period_overlap=>ty_date_range( start_date = '20230101' end_date = '20230131' ).
    DATA(ls_range2) = VALUE zcl_period_overlap=>ty_date_range( start_date = '20230115' end_date = '20230215' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_overlap( ).
    DATA(lv_overlaps) = lo_cut->check_overlap( is_range1 = ls_range1 is_range2 = ls_range2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_overlaps msg = 'Sollte sich überschneiden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlap_false.
    DATA(ls_range1) = VALUE zcl_period_overlap=>ty_date_range( start_date = '20230101' end_date = '20230110' ).
    DATA(ls_range2) = VALUE zcl_period_overlap=>ty_date_range( start_date = '20230112' end_date = '20230120' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_overlap( ).
    DATA(lv_overlaps) = lo_cut->check_overlap( is_range1 = ls_range1 is_range2 = ls_range2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_overlaps msg = 'Sollte sich nicht überschneiden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlap_touching.
    DATA(ls_range1) = VALUE zcl_period_overlap=>ty_date_range( start_date = '20230101' end_date = '20230110' ).
    DATA(ls_range2) = VALUE zcl_period_overlap=>ty_date_range( start_date = '20230110' end_date = '20230120' ).

Geschäftsjahresvarianten oder spezielle Kalender berücksichtigt, würde man in einem SAP-System auf Klassen wie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` zurückgreifen, die diese Komplexität kapseln.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer bedingten Inkrementierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_expensive_flights.
    rv_count = REDUCE #( INIT count = 0
                         FOR flight IN it_flights
                         NEXT count = count + COND #( WHEN flight-price > iv_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_expensive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_none_expensive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_expensive.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_conditional_count=>ty_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '250.50'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_conditional_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_expensive_flights( it_flights = lt_flights iv_threshold = '90.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 teure Flüge sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_none_expensive.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_conditional_count=>ty_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = '10.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '20.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_conditional_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_expensive_flights( it_flights = lt_flights iv_threshold = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Es sollten 0 teure Flüge sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_conditional_count=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_conditional_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_expensive_flights( it_flights = lt_flights iv_threshold = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Zähler sollte 0 für leere Tabelle sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REDUCE` für eine bedingte Zählung verwendet werden kann. Die `COND`-Anweisung innerhalb von `REDUCE` prüft, ob der Preis eines Fluges den Schwellenwert überschreitet. Wenn ja, wird 1 zum Zähler addiert, andernfalls 0. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Methode, um Elemente in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu zählen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Conditional Counting, COND

Instructions: Für jede Fluggesellschaft, berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für Flüge, deren Preis größer als 500 ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` mit `REDUCE` und einer `FILTER`-ähnlichen Logik innerhalb des `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_agg,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_agg.
    TYPES ty_carrier_agg_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_agg
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_agg_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_carrier_agg_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_filter_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_agg_passengers.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                         ( carrid = flight-carrid
                           total_passengers = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                        NEXT sum = sum + COND #( WHEN member-price > iv_price_threshold THEN member-seatsocc ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-price = '800.00'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_filter_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_agg_passengers( it_flights = lt_flights iv_price_threshold = '500.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge geben' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-total_passengers exp = 150 msg = 'LH Passagiere sollten 150 sein' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-total_passengers exp = 200 msg = 'AA Passagiere sollten 200 sein' ).

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_group_filter_sum=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_filter_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_agg_passengers( it_flights = lt_flights iv_price_threshold = '500.00' ).

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_group_filter_sum=>ty_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 150.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_filter_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_agg_passengers( it_flights = lt_flights iv_price_threshold = '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte leer sein, da keine teuren Flüge' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert fortgeschrittene funktionale Programmiertechniken: `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Zusätzlich wird innerhalb des `REDUCE` eine `COND`-Anweisung verwendet, um nur Passagiere von Flügen zu berücksichtigen, die einen bestimmten Preis-Schwellenwert überschreiten. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr komplexe Datenverarbeitung in einem einzigen, ausdrucksstarken Statement.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Grouping, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, COND

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `VALUE` um die Transformation und Filterung in einem Schritt durchzuführen.

CLASS zcl_for_transform_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Anzahl der freien Sitze über alle Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` um die Summe der freien Sitze und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe zu erhalten, und berechnen Sie dann den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_seats,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_free_seats TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_seats.
    TYPES ty_carrier_avg_seats_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_seats
                                     WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_avg_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_carrier_avg_seats_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_free_seats.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                         LET total_free_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                          FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                          NEXT sum = sum + ( member-seatsmax - member-seatsocc ) )
                             num_flights = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
                         ( carrid = flight-carrid
                           average_free_seats = COND decfloat16( WHEN num_flights > 0 THEN total_free_seats / num_flights ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 180. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 150. " 30 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50.  " 100 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 220. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200. " 20 free

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_avg_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_free_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge geben' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-average_free_seats exp = '100.00' msg = 'LH durchschnittliche freie Sitze sollten 100 sein' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-average_free_seats exp = '25.00' msg = 'AA durchschnittliche freie Sitze sollten 25 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_avg_free_seats=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_avg_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_free_seats( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte leer sein für leere Tabelle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_avg_free_seats=>ty_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. " 100 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 180. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 150. " 30 free

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_avg_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_free_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge geben' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-average_free_seats exp = '100.00' msg = 'LH durchschnittliche freie Sitze sollten 100 sein' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-average_free_seats exp = '30.00' msg = 'AA durchschnittliche freie Sitze sollten 30 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine komplexe Aggregation unter Verwendung von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit der `LET`-Anweisung. Für jede Gruppe (Fluggesellschaft) werden die gesamten freien Sitze und die Anzahl der Flüge berechnet. Anschließend wird der Durchschnitt ermittelt. Die `COND`-Anweisung verhindert eine Division durch Null. Dies ist ein sehr leistungsstarker und moderner Ansatz für komplexe Analysen von internen Tabellen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, LET, Grouping, Aggregation, Average, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String per Regex.
hint: Nutzen Sie `split` mit Regex-Objekt oder Workarounds in älteren Versionen, hier modern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex IMPORTING iv_val TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    SPLIT iv_val AT ',' INTO TABLE rt_res. "Placeholder, true regex split needs class
    " Modern ABAP doesn't have functional REGEX split built-in simply like other langs yet without classes.
    " Using standard split for demo simplicity or cl_abap_regex.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\w+' IN iv_val RESULTS DATA(res).
    LOOP AT res INTO DATA(m).
       APPEND substring( val = iv_val off = m-offset len = m-length ) TO rt_res.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen aus einem gegebenen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` oder String-Templates mit `REPLACE`.

CLASS zcl_str_remove_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_input TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, ohne Duplikate.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `DISTINCT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES ty_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE ty_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers.
    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN it_flights
                           ( carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verkette alle Strings einer internen Tabelle mit einem Komma und einem Leerzeichen als Trennzeichen (z.B. 'A, B, C').
hint: Kombiniere `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um die Verkettung effizient durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rdu_concat_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rdu_concat_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR str IN it_strings
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN str ELSE |{ s }, { str }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Apfel, Birne, Kirsche'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( lt_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Mehrere Strings korrekt verkettet' ).

    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( lt_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Einzelner String korrekt verkettet' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_empty_table.

    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = ''.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( lt_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Leere Tabelle ergibt leeren String' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieser Ansatz nutzt `REDUCE` zur iterativen String-Verkettung. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert den Akkumulator `s` als leeren String. In der `NEXT`-Klausel wird ein `COND`-Ausdruck verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob `s` noch leer ist. Ist dies der Fall, wird der aktuelle String direkt zugewiesen; andernfalls wird er mit dem Trennzeichen an den bestehenden String angehängt. String-Templates (`|...|`) sorgen für eine lesbare Formatierung.
keywords: REDUCE, String-Templates, Verkettung, Interne Tabelle, COND, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) haben.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `IF`-Bedingung oder `COND`.

CLASS zcl_rdu_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rdu_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT c = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT c = c + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Finde den höchsten Preis (PRICE) in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `IF`-Bedingung, um den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rdu_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rdu_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT max_p = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_p THEN flight-price ELSE max_p ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Sitze (SEATSMAX) pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und gib das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
         carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
         total_seats TYPE i,
       END OF ty_carrier_seats.
TYPES: tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_rdu_group_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rdu_group_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_seats = REDUCE tt_carrier_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET total_seats_for_group = REDUCE i(
                                    INIT s = 0
                                    FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                    NEXT s = s + member-seatsmax )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_seats = total_seats_for_group ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_sum_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_sum_seats_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_sum_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rdu_group_sum_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_results) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).

    DATA lt_expected_results TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
    SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsmax ) AS total_seats
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_expected_results.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_results ) exp = lines( lt_expected_results ) msg = 'Anzahl der Gruppen korrekt' ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_expected>).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_actual>)
        WITH KEY carrid = <fs_expected>-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = <fs_actual> msg = |Fluggesellschaft { <fs_expected>-carrid } gefunden| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_actual>-total_seats exp = <fs_expected>-total_seats msg = |Gesamtsitze für { <fs_expected>-carrid } korrekt| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_sum_seats_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rdu_group_sum_seats( ).
    " Temporär SFLIGHT leeren, um leere Tabelle zu simulieren
    DELETE FROM sflight.
    DATA(lt_actual_results) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_actual_results msg = 'Leere Tabelle bei leeren SFLIGHT' ).
    " Daten wiederherstellen (optional, je nach Testumgebung)
    ROLLBACK WORK. " Wenn SFLIGHT-Änderungen in einem LUW sind
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`. Es ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle und die Aggregation von Werten für jede Gruppe in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck. Die `LET`-Klausel wird verwendet, um eine Zwischenaggregation (Summe der Sitze pro Gruppe) zu definieren, die dann im `NEXT`-Ausdruck zur Konstruktion der Ergebniszeile verwendet wird. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art der Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, Gruppierung, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_rdu_filter_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rdu_filter_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = REDUCE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid(
      INIT result = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT result = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid( BASE result ( flight-connid ) ) ).

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String, der eine Währung enthält (z.B. '123.45 EUR'), in einen Dezimalwert (DEC) und extrahiere die Währungseinheit.
hint: Nutze `CONV` für die Dezimalzahl und String-Operationen für die Währungseinheit. Beachte, dass `CONV` keine implizite Währungsumrechnung durchführt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cnv_currency_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_value,
             amount   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             currency TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_currency_value.

    METHODS parse_currency_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_currency_value) TYPE ty_currency_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cnv_currency_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_currency_string.
    DATA: lv_amount_str TYPE string,
          lv_currency_unit TYPE string.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\d+\.\d+|\d+' IN iv_currency_string MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset) MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_length).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_amount_str = iv_currency_string+lv_offset(lv_length).
      lv_currency_unit = iv_currency_string+lv_offset+lv_length.
      lv_currency_unit = cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim( lv_currency_unit ).
    ENDIF.

    rs_currency_value-amount = CONV p( lv_amount_str DEFAULT 0 ).
    rs_currency_value-currency = CONV c( lv_currency_unit DEFAULT '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_flight_data PUBLIC.

  METHOD create_flight_objects.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

      INIT result = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_flight_data( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights

Instructions: Konvertiere einen Wert dynamisch in einen anderen Typ, basierend auf einem übergebenen Typnamen. Dies erfordert die Verwendung von RTTI.
hint: Nutze `CONV` in Kombination mit RTTI (z.B. `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`) und dynamischer Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cnv_dynamic_type_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_dynamic_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_value      TYPE string
        iv_target_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cnv_dynamic_type_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic_type.
    DATA: lr_data       TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_typedescr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lv_target_type_kind TYPE c.

    TRY.
        lr_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type ).
        lv_target_type_kind = lr_typedescr->type_kind.

        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_typedescr.

        CASE lv_target_type_kind.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_int> TYPE i.
            ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_int>.
            IF <fs_int> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_int> = CONV i( iv_value DEFAULT 0 ).
              rv_converted_value = CONV string( <fs_int> ).
            ENDIF.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_char> TYPE csequence.
            ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_char>.
            IF <fs_char> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_char> = CONV string( iv_value ).
              rv_converted_value = CONV string( <fs_char> ).
            ENDIF.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_num> TYPE n.
            ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_num>.
            IF <fs_num> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_num> = CONV n( iv_value DEFAULT '0' ).
              rv_converted_value = CONV string( <fs_num> ).
            ENDIF.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_p> TYPE p.
            ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_p>.
            IF <fs_p> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_p> = CONV p( iv_value DEFAULT 0 ).
              rv_converted_value = CONV string( <fs_p> ).
            ENDIF.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_converted_value = 'Unsupported Type'.
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_assign_error cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_converted_value = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entferne alle Leerzeichen aus einem gegebenen String unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN` über die Zeichen des Strings und einer `COND`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rdu_remove_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_all_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rdu_remove_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_all_spaces.
    rv_cleaned_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR char = 1 THEN char + 1 UNTIL char > strlen( iv_input_string )
      LET current_char = iv_input_string+char-1(1)
      IN
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN current_char = ` ` THEN s ELSE |{ s }{ current_char }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von Integern. Ungültige String-Einträge sollen als 0 behandelt werden.

CLASS zcl_cnv_table_string_to_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cnv_table_string_to_int IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_integers = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(

Instructions: Erstelle eine Map (Hash-Tabelle) von Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) zu der Anzahl der Flüge, die diese Fluggesellschaft an einem bestimmten Datum hat, aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die Map-Konstruktion.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_date,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         flight_date TYPE s_date,
         flight_count TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flight_count_by_date.
TYPES: tt_flight_count_by_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_date WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: ty_carrid_flight_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

CLASS zcl_rdu_map_flight_counts DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_map
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_map) TYPE ty_carrid_flight_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rdu_map_flight_counts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_map.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE fldate = @iv_fldate.

    rt_flight_map = REDUCE ty_carrid_flight_map(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrid_flight_map( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET count_for_group = REDUCE i(
                                INIT c = 0
                                FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                NEXT c = c + 1 )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_carrid_flight_map( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_flights = count_for_group ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_flight_counts_no_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_flight_counts_empty_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rdu_map_flight_counts( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    DATA lt_expected_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_date WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      WHERE fldate = @lv_fldate
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_expected_counts.

    DATA(lt_actual_map) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_map( lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_map ) exp = lines( lt_expected_counts ) msg = 'Anzahl der Einträge in der Map korrekt' ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_counts ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_expected>).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_map ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_actual_entry>)
        WITH KEY table_line = <fs_expected>-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = <fs_actual_entry> msg = |Fluggesellschaft { <fs_expected>-carrid } in Map gefunden| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_actual_entry> exp = <fs_expected>-flight_count msg = |Fluganzahl für { <fs_expected>-carrid } korrekt| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_flight_counts_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rdu_map_flight_counts( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '99991231'. " Datum ohne Flüge
    DATA(lt_actual_map) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_map( lv_fldate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_actual_map msg = 'Leere Map bei keinem Flug' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_flight_counts_empty_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rdu_map_flight_counts( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '00000000'. " Initiales Datum
    DATA(lt_actual_map) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_map( lv_fldate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_actual_map msg = 'Leere Map bei initialem Datum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` in einer sehr fortgeschrittenen Weise, um eine Hash-Tabelle (Map) zu erstellen. Es kombiniert `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` zur Gruppierung der Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und eine innere `REDUCE`-Anweisung (`LET count_for_group = REDUCE ...`) zur Zählung der Flüge pro Gruppe. Der `NEXT`-Ausdruck fügt dann die aggregierten Daten in die Ergebnis-Map ein. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster für komplexe Datenaggregationen und -transformationen.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, VALUE, HASHED TABLE, Map, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen ALV-Bericht für Flugdaten (`sflights`). Zeigen Sie die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum und die Anzahl der belegten Sitze an. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung und die ALV-Anzeige.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` für die ALV-Instanziierung und `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für die Datenbeschaffung.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                        t_data      = lt_sflights ).
          lo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen ALV-Bericht für Flugdaten (`sflights`). Formatieren Sie die Spalte 'PRICE' als Währungsfeld und die Spalte 'FLDATE' als Datum, indem Sie auf die Spaltenobjekte des ALV-Controllers zugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table->get_columns()` und dann `get_column()` für spezifische Spalten, um deren Eigenschaften zu manipulieren. Dies ist Teil des `SALV_OM_OBJECTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_column_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_formatted_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_column_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_formatted_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy_subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_data = lt_sflights ).

          DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).

          " Format 'PRICE' column as currency
          DATA(lo_column_price) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' ).
          lo_column_price->set_currency_column( 'CURRENCY' ).
          lo_column_price->set_medium_text( 'Preis' ).

          " Format 'FLDATE' column as date
          DATA(lo_column_fldate) = lo_columns->get_column( 'FLDATE' ).
          lo_column_fldate->set_medium_text( 'Flugdatum' ).
          lo_column_fldate->set_output_length( 10 ). " e.g., DD.MM.YYYY

          lo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagiere (`passengers`) für jede Kombination aus Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugnummer (`connid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `SUM`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_loop_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_pass TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_loop_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, passengers
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                        connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                              ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid     = <fs_group>-carrid
                                      connid     = <fs_group>-connid
                                      total_pass = SUM( ls_flight-passengers ) )
        TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl aller Passagiere (`passengers`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` über alle Flüge hinweg.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT passengers
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie der ALV-Toolbar einen benutzerdefinierten Button hinzu, der eine Aktion auslöst, wenn er geklickt wird. Der Button soll 'Custom Action' heißen und die Funktion 'Z_CUSTOM_ACTION' haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table->get_functions()` und `cl_salv_functions_list->add_function()`. Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für `if_salv_events_functions~function_selected`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_custom_button DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_events_functions.
    METHODS display_alv_with_button.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_button IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_button.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy_subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          mo_salv_table = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_data = lt_sflights ).

          " Get functions list and add custom button
          DATA(lo_functions) = mo_salv_table->get_functions( ).
          lo_functions->add_function( name = 'Z_CUSTOM_ACTION'
                                      text = 'Custom Action'
                                      tooltip = 'Führt eine benutzerdefinierte Aktion aus' ).
          lo_functions->set_all( abap_true ).

          " Register event handler for function selected
          DATA(lo_events_functions) = mo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
          SET HANDLER me->if_salv_events_functions~function_selected FOR lo_events_functions.

          mo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_events_functions~function_selected.
    IF e_salv_function = 'Z_CUSTOM_ACTION'.
      MESSAGE 'Benutzerdefinierte Aktion wurde ausgelöst!' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Event-Behandlung für das `LINK_CLICK`-Ereignis in einem ALV-Bericht. Wenn auf eine Zelle in der Spalte 'CARRID' geklickt wird, soll eine Meldung mit dem Wert der geklickten Zelle angezeigt werden.
hint: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für `if_salv_events_list~link_click` über `cl_salv_table->get_event_handler()`. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittener Aspekt des `SALV_OM_OBJECTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_link_click DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_events_list.
    METHODS display_alv_with_link_click.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_link_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_link_click.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy_subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          mo_salv_table = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_data = lt_sflights ).

          " Make 'CARRID' a hotspot
          DATA(lo_columns) = mo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
          DATA(lo_column_carrid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
          lo_column_carrid->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ).

          " Register event handler for link click
          DATA(lo_events_list) = mo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
          SET HANDLER me->if_salv_events_list~link_click FOR lo_events_list.

          mo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_events_list~link_click.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    READ TABLE r_salv_table->get_data_ref( )->* INDEX row_id INTO DATA(ls_flight_row).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT column_id OF STRUCTURE ls_flight_row TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
      IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        lv_carrid = <fs_value>.
        MESSAGE |Auf Fluggesellschaft { lv_carrid } geklickt!| TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_sum_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_pass TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_summary.
    METHODS display_sum_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sum_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sum_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_summary  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_summary.

    SELECT carrid, passengers
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                              ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_summary( carrid     = <fs_group>-carrid
                                      total_pass = SUM( ls_flight-passengers ) )
        TO lt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF sy_subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_data = lt_summary ).
          DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
          DATA(lo_column_total_pass) = lo_columns->get_column( 'TOTAL_PASS' ).
          lo_column_total_pass->set_medium_text( 'Gesamtpassagiere' ).

          lo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fe_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflights_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_csv_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Header-Zeile für CSV
    APPEND `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;SEATSFREE` TO lt_csv_lines.

    " Datenzeilen
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |{ ls_flight-carrid };{ ls_flight-connid };{ ls_flight-fldate };{ ls_flight-price };{ ls_flight-currency };{ ls_flight-planetype };{ ls_flight-seatsmax };{ ls_flight-seatsocc };{ ls_flight-seatsfree }| TO lt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_filepath
        filetype                = cl_gui_frontend_services=>co_filetype_asc
        codepage                = `1100` " UTF-8
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_csv_lines
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie für alle Flüge der Tabelle `sflights`, die am morgigen Tag stattfinden, einen Termin im Kalender. Der Betreff soll die Flugnummer und die Fluggesellschaft enthalten. Geben Sie die Anzahl der erstellten Termine zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT`, `LOOP AT` mit `VALUE` oder `FOR` und `cl_appointment`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_appointments_for_tomorrow_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_appointments_created) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointments_for_tomorrow_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_tomorrow TYPE d.

    lv_tomorrow = sy-datum + 1.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate = @lv_tomorrow
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_subject) = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } um { ls_flight-fltime TIME = USER }|.
      DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment(
        i_subject   = lv_subject
        i_date_from = ls_flight-fldate
        i_time_from = ls_flight-fltime
        i_date_to   = ls_flight-fldate
        i_time_to   = ls_flight-fltime + 3600 " Add 1 hour for end time
      ).
      TRY.
          lo_appointment->create( ).
          rv_appointments_created = rv_appointments_created + 1.
        CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
          " Handle error, e.g., log it
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_sflight_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_sflight_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.

    " Ensure there are flights for tomorrow in sflights for testing
    " (This might require test data setup in a real scenario)
    " For this test, we assume some flights exist or simulate.

    " Insert dummy flight for tomorrow if none exist
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = lv_tomorrow.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planety_pe = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 seatsfree = 200 fltime = '100000' ).
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_created_count) = lo_cut->create_appointments_for_tomorrow_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_created_count >= 1 ).

    " Clean up created appointments (find them by subject pattern)
    DATA(lv_search_subject) = |Flug { lv_carrid } { lv_connid } am { lv_fldate DATE = USER }*|.
    DATA: lt_appointments TYPE szatk_app_id_tab.
    cl_appointment=>get_appointments_by_subject(
      EXPORTING
        i_subject_pattern = lv_search_subject
      IMPORTING
        e_appointment_ids = lt_appointments
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_appointments INTO DATA(lv_app_id).
      DATA(lo_app_delete) = NEW cl_appointment( i_appointment_id = lv_app_id ).
      lo_app_delete->delete( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Delete dummy flight if it was inserted by the test
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Abfrage von Flugdaten aus `sflights` mit der Erstellung von Terminen. Es nutzt moderne `SELECT`-Syntax mit Hostvariablen (`@`), String-Templates für die Betreff-Erstellung und den `NEW`-Operator für `cl_appointment`. Die Schleife über die Flugdaten und die inkrementelle Zählung der erstellten Termine zeigen eine effiziente Datenverarbeitung. Der Unit-Test beinhaltet das Einfügen von Testdaten und das anschließende Aufräumen.

CLASS zcl_ranges_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ranges_basic IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGES-Tabelle, die verschiedene Selektionsoptionen (gleich, zwischen, größer/gleich, kleiner/gleich) für Flugnummern enthält, und filtern Sie SFLIGHTS.
hint: Füllen Sie die RANGES-Tabelle mit verschiedenen SIGN-, OPTION- und LOW/HIGH-Werten, z.B. 'I' 'EQ', 'I' 'BT', 'I' 'GE', 'I' 'LE'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_connid_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid_eq TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid_low TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid_high TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_connid_range.
    DATA: lt_connids TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    IF iv_connid_eq IS SUPPLIED.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = iv_connid_eq ) TO lt_connids.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_connid_low IS SUPPLIED AND iv_connid_high IS SUPPLIED.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = iv_connid_low high = iv_connid_high ) TO lt_connids.
    ELSEIF iv_connid_low IS SUPPLIED.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'GE' low = iv_connid_low ) TO lt_connids.
    ELSEIF iv_connid_high IS SUPPLIED.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'LE' low = iv_connid_high ) TO lt_connids.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE connid IN @lt_connids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_for_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_carrier_list
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_for_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_carrier_list.
    DATA(lt_carrier_ranges) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      FOR <fs_carrier> IN it_carriers
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <fs_carrier>-carrid )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrier_ranges.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    DATA(lt_local_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Initial Entry 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Initial Entry 2' )
    ).

    rt_data = VALUE #( BASE lt_local_data
      ( id = iv_id text = iv_text )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle, indem Sie einen FOR-Ausdruck mit APPEND verwenden und dabei die Daten transformieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_append_for_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             sum_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_append
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_for_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_append.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR <fs_source> IN it_source
      ( key = |{ <fs_source>-name }-{ <fs_source>-id }|
        sum_value = <fs_source>-value * 2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_append_for_expr=>tt_source_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'ItemA' value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 name = 'ItemB' value = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_and_append( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-key exp = 'ItemA-1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-sum_value exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-key exp = 'ItemB-2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-sum_value exp = 40 ).

CLASS zcl_append_filter_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität für jede Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_append_reduce_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_seat_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_reduce_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_seat_summary.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING
                           ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                             total_occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP <fs_flight> NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.
