Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft betreffen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife über eine gefilterte Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_analyzer->calculate_total_passengers( 'LH' ).

    DATA(lv_expected) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = lv_expected msg = 'Total passengers for LH should match database sum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. In Kombination mit `FOR ... WHERE` wird die Tabelle direkt gefiltert und verarbeitet.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft betreffen und noch freie Plätze haben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc < seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_filter->get_available_flights( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) msg = 'Should return some flights for AA' ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Incorrect airline ID' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <fs_flight>-seatsocc < <fs_flight>-seatsmax ) msg = 'Flight should have available seats' ).
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die nacheinander aufgerufen werden können, um eine Zeichenkette zu manipulieren (z.B. trimmen, Großbuchstaben, Präfix hinzufügen).
hint: Methoden, die das Objekt selbst zurückgeben (`RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE REF TO SELF`), ermöglichen das Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS add_prefix IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    CONDENSE mv_string NO-GAPS.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_string TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    mv_string = iv_prefix && mv_string.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_string_builder( '  hello world  ' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->trim( )->to_upper( )->add_prefix( 'PREFIX: ' )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'PREFIX:HELLOWORLD' msg = 'Chained methods did not produce expected result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren, lesbareren Code, der oft als "Fluent Interface" bezeichnet wird. Jede Methode, die das Chaining fortsetzen soll, muss eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`me`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, CLASS-METHODS

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts und geben Sie dessen Komponenten (falls es sich um eine Struktur handelt) aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klassen `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_type_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_type_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_type_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_info.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    APPEND |Type Kind: { lo_typedescr->type_kind }| TO rt_type_info.
    APPEND |Type Name: { lo_typedescr->name }| TO rt_type_info.

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      APPEND |Structure Components:| TO rt_type_info.
      LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND |  - { ls_component-name } ({ ls_component-type_descr->name })| TO rt_type_info.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl

CLASS zcl_timestamp_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_difference.
    DATA(lo_tstmp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp2 ).

    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = lo_tstmp1->get_difference( lo_tstmp2 ).
    rv_days = lv_seconds_diff / ( 24 * 60 * 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle E-Mail-Adressen aus einem gegebenen Text.

CLASS zcl_email_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_matched_substring( ) TO rt_emails.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_final_class FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_instance) = CAST zcl_base_class( NEW zcl_derived_class( ) ).
    DATA(lv_version) = lo_instance->get_version( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_version exp = '1.0.0' msg = 'Final method should return correct version' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Eine `FINAL` Methode kann in Unterklassen nicht überschrieben werden, was konsistentes Verhalten über die Vererbungshierarchie hinweg sicherstellt und die Wartbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp erzeugt und mit Beispieldaten füllt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE ir_table_type_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA REF TO (<lt_dynamic_table>)-LINE TYPE HANDLE ir_table_type_descr->get_line_type( ).
      ASSIGN (<lt_dynamic_table>)-LINE->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Beispiel: Füllen der ersten Spalte mit einem Wert
        " Dies ist eine vereinfachte Füllung, da die Struktur dynamisch ist.
        " In einem realen Szenario müsste man die Komponenten dynamisch ermitteln.
        TRY.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
            IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_component> = 'Dynamic Value 1'.
            ENDIF.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
            " Handle error if component 1 does not exist or is not assignable
        ENDTRY.
        INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

        TRY.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_component>.
            IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_component> = 'Dynamic Value 2'.
            ENDIF.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        ENDTRY.
        INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Initialisierung und Anzeige eines einfachen Textfeldes mit `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` innerhalb eines Custom Containers. Dies zeigt die Interaktion mit klassischen GUI-Controls über moderne ABAP-Klassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine klassische GUI-Technologie ist, die aber über Klassenmethoden gesteuert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_text_editor.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_textedit  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_text_editor.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '9000'. " Beispiel-Dynpro-Nummer

    " Erstelle Custom Container auf einem Dynpro
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' " Name des Custom Controls auf dem Dynpro
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_dynpro_dynpro_link = 5
        OTHERS = 6.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Erstelle TextEdit Control im Container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        OTHERS = 5.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des TextEdit Controls' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Setze Text im Editor
    DATA(lt_text_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    APPEND 'Dies ist ein Beispieltext.' TO lt_text_table.
    APPEND 'Erstellt mit CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT.' TO lt_text_table.
    CALL METHOD mo_textedit->set_text_as_r3table
      EXPORTING
        table = lt_text_table.

    " Zeige Dynpro an (Dynpro 9000 muss existieren und ein Custom Control 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' enthalten)
    CALL SCREEN lv_dynnr.

    " Aufräumen (wichtig für GUI Controls)
    CALL METHOD mo_textedit->free.
    CALL METHOD mo_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_gui_initialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_gui_initialization.
    " Hinweis: GUI-Tests sind komplex und erfordern eine laufende GUI-Umgebung.
    " Dieser Unit-Test kann nur die Instanziierung der Klassen prüfen, nicht die tatsächliche Anzeige.
    " Für echte GUI-Tests wären spezielle Test-Frameworks oder manuelle Tests erforderlich.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_gui_textedit_demo( ).
    " Da display_text_editor einen CALL SCREEN enthält, kann es im Unit-Test nicht direkt ausgeführt werden
    " ohne die Testumgebung zu stören. Wir testen hier nur die Erstellung der Objekte.
    " Ein echter Test würde die Methoden des Controls aufrufen und deren Zustand prüfen.
    " Für diesen Beispielzweck wird nur die Instanziierung simuliert.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_demo ).
    " Ein sinnvollerer Test würde die Methoden des Controls aufrufen und deren Rückgabewerte prüfen,
    " aber ohne ein aktives Dynpro ist dies schwierig.
    " Beispiel: lo_demo->mo_textedit->get_text_as_r3table( IMPORTING table = DATA(lt_read_text) ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( lines( lt_read_text ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` und `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` Teil der klassischen SAP GUI-Technologie sind, werden sie über objektorientierte Klassenmethoden gesteuert. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie diese Klassen verwendet werden, um GUI-Elemente zu initialisieren und zu manipulieren, was die Bedeutung von `CLASS-METHODS` auch in älteren UI-Kontexten unterstreicht. Die Interaktion mit dem Control Framework (`SCET`) erfolgt über diese Klassen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, deren Preis über 1000 liegt. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    WHERE ( price > 1000 )
                                    ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_expensive_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ). " Kann leer sein, wenn keine Flüge > 1000
    " Zusätzlicher Test, um sicherzustellen, dass die Struktur korrekt ist
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu transformieren und zu filtern, ohne explizite `LOOP`s oder `APPEND`s.

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... INIT ... NEXT ...` mit einer Vergleichslogik für das Maximum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_from_table IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_from_table.
    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                             FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                             NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_price_from_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_price_from_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_itb_max_price=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 500.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 250.

    DATA(lo_max_finder) = NEW zcl_itb_max_price( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_max_finder->get_max_price_from_table( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um iterativ den Maximalwert zu finden, was zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code führt. `nmax` ist eine nützliche Funktion für den Vergleich.
keywords: REDUCE, MAX, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Funktional

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... INTO DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                  ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid,
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE,
                                    avg_price    = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                             FOR ls_member IN GROUP
                                                             NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_member-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-price = 300.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-avg_price exp = 150 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-avg_price exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR GROUPS` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke Syntax für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht sie komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung, was den Code extrem lesbar und wartbar macht.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Gruppierung, REDUCE

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle mit SFLIGHT-Struktur in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer vereinfachten Struktur, die nur Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Flugdatum enthält. Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator mit `MAPPING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... MAPPING ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_simple_flight.
    TYPES: tt_simple_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simple_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights IMPORTING it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_simple_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                                                  flight_num = connid
                                                                  flight_date = fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_flight_mapper=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).
    <fs_source>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_source>-connid = '0400'. <fs_source>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_source>-price = 100. <fs_source>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_source>.
    <fs_source>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_source>-connid = '0017'. <fs_source>-fldate = sy-datum + 1. <fs_source>-price = 200. <fs_source>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_flight_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_mapper->map_flights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_num exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_date exp = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-airline_id exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_itb_max_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itb_max_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck, ob der höchste Preis in einer Liste von Flugpreisen über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Geben Sie 'TEUER' oder 'GÜNSTIG' zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` in Kombination mit einer Logik zur Ermittlung des Maximums.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_max_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_max_price_threshold IMPORTING it_prices TYPE tt_prices
                                                iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_max_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_max_price_threshold.
    DATA lv_max_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0.

    IF it_prices IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                               FOR price IN it_prices
                               NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = price ) ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_status = COND string( WHEN lv_max_price > iv_threshold THEN 'TEUER'
                              ELSE 'GÜNSTIG' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_prices TYPE zcl_cond_max_check=>tt_prices.
    APPEND 100 TO lt_prices.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'TEUER' ).

    lv_result = lo_checker->check_max_price_threshold( it_prices = lt_prices iv_threshold = 600 ).

In Kombination mit `REDUCE` zur Ermittlung des Maximalwerts demonstriert dies eine moderne Art der bedingten Logik und Datenaggregation.

CLASS zcl_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.

CLASS zcl_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                    WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                                    ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                      fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Wir können nur prüfen, ob die Tabelle nicht initial ist, wenn es zukünftige Flüge gibt.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carr IMPLEMENTATION.

                                  GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                  ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid,
                                    max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                          FOR ls_member IN GROUP

ENDCLASS.

hint: Berechnen Sie zuerst den Durchschnitt mit `REDUCE`, dann filtern Sie mit `FOR ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_above_avg_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_above_average_flights IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_above_avg_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_above_avg_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_above_average_flights.
    DATA lv_total_price TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA lv_flight_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_average_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0.

    IF it_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                 FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                 NEXT sum_p = sum_p + ls_flight-price ).
      lv_flight_count = lines( it_all_flights ).
      lv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_flight_count.
    ENDIF.

    rt_above_avg_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                    WHERE ( price > lv_average_price )
                                    ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                      price  = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_above_average_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_above_average_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_above_avg_flights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = 300.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'. <fs_flight>-price = 400.

    " Durchschnittspreis: (100+200+300+400)/4 = 1000/4 = 250
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_above_avg_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->get_above_average_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = 300 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = 400 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_above_avg_flights=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_above_avg_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->get_above_average_flights( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_pdf_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_stext

CLASS zcl_bcs_pdf_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_pdf.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        " Simulate PDF content from report data
        DATA(lv_pdf_content_string) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR line IN it_report_data NEXT s = s && line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
        DATA(lv_pdf_xstring) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( lv_pdf_content_string ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document_for_send(
                              i_type    = 'RAW'
                              i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( |Siehe Anhang für Details.| )
                              i_subject = iv_subject ).

        " Add PDF attachment
        DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_from_xstring(
                                i_xstring = lv_pdf_xstring
                                i_type    = 'PDF'
                                i_subject = 'Report_Output.pdf' ).
        lo_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment = lo_attachment
          i_attachment_type = 'PDF'
          i_attachment_size = xstrlen( lv_pdf_xstring )
          i_attachment_subject = 'Report_Output.pdf' ).

        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_document_bcs INTO DATA(lx_doc_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_doc_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit Fehlerdetails, die aus einer gefangenen ABAP-Exception extrahiert wurden. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` und das Auslesen von Exception-Informationen.
hint: Fangen Sie eine generische Exception (`cx_root`) und nutzen Sie deren Methoden wie `get_text()` und `get_source_position()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_error_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_error_notification
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_error_context   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_error_notification.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string,
          lv_error_class   TYPE string,
          lv_error_line    TYPE i,
          lv_error_program TYPE syrepid.

    " Simulate an error scenario
    TRY.
        " This line will cause a division by zero exception
        DATA(lv_result) = 1 / 0.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arithmetic_error).
        lv_error_message = lx_arithmetic_error->get_text( ).
        lv_error_class = lx_arithmetic_error->get_class_name( ).
        lx_arithmetic_error->get_source_position(
          IMPORTING
            line   = lv_error_line
            program = lv_error_program
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other exception
        lv_error_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
        lv_error_class = lx_root->get_class_name( ).
        lx_root->get_source_position(
          IMPORTING
            line   = lv_error_line
            program = lv_error_program
        ).
    ENDTRY.

    IF lv_error_message IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
          DATA(lv_subject) = |Fehlerbenachrichtigung: { iv_error_context }|.
          DATA(lv_body) = |Es ist ein Fehler aufgetreten:\n\n| &&
                           |Kontext: { iv_error_context }\n| &&
                           |Fehlermeldung: { lv_error_message }\n| &&
                           |Fehlerklasse: { lv_error_class }\n| &&
                           |Programm: { lv_error_program } (Zeile { lv_error_line })\n|.

          DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document_for_send(
                                i_type    = 'RAW'
                                i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
                                i_subject = lv_subject ).

          lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

          DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
          lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

          lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
          COMMIT WORK.

        CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs_send).
          MESSAGE lx_bcs_send->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Lesen Sie Daten aus `SFLIGHT` und verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `IN` und String-Templates, um den Text zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_sflight_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_sflight_report
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_carrid          TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_sflight_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_sflight_report.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_report_body) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = |Flugbericht für Fluggesellschaft { iv_carrid }:\n\n|
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT s = s && |Flugnr: { flight-fldate DATE = USER } - { flight-connid } | &&
                   | von { flight-cityfrom } nach { flight-cityto } | &&
                   | Preis: { flight-price } { flight-currency }\n| ).

    IF lv_report_body IS INITIAL.
      lv_report_body = |Keine Flüge für { iv_carrid } gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
        DATA(lv_subject) = |Flugbericht { iv_carrid } { sy-datum }|.

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document_for_send(
                              i_type    = 'RAW'
                              i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_report_body )

CLASS zcl_bcs_switch_subject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status,
             code TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status.
    TYPES: tt_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_with_switch_subject
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr

        iv_document_id     TYPE string
        iv_body            TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_bcs_switch_subject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_switch_subject.
    DATA(lv_subject) = SWITCH bcs_stext(
      iv_status_code
      WHEN 'A' THEN |Dokument { iv_document_id }: Genehmigt|
      WHEN 'R' THEN |Dokument { iv_document_id }: Abgelehnt|
      WHEN 'P' THEN |Dokument { iv_document_id }: In Bearbeitung|

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document_for_send(
                              i_type    = 'RAW'
                              i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
                              i_subject = lv_subject ).

        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) und greifen Sie mit einem Feldsymbol auf jede Zeile zu, um den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch zu ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_price_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_factor         TYPE f
      CHANGING
        ct_flights        TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> TYPE NUMERIC.
        <fs_field> = <fs_field> * iv_factor.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Kriterium und geben Sie die gefilterten Zeilen zurück. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole für den effizienten Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem Feldsymbol und einer dynamischen Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights        TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_value          TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rt_filtered = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( 1 = 1 ) ). " Dummy filter to get mutable table

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        IF <fs_field> = iv_value.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_filtered.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_fld_dynamic_filter=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_filter( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = 100.00.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = 200.00.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_flights = lt_flights iv_component_name = 'CARRID' iv_value = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should find one flight' ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Filtered flight should be LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit Feldsymbolen und dynamischem Komponentenzugriff eine interne Tabelle filtern kann. Obwohl ABAP 7.40+ die `FILTER` Operator-Syntax bietet, ist für wirklich dynamische Filterbedingungen, bei denen der Feldname zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, der explizite Zugriff über Feldsymbole oft notwendig. Die `FILTER` Operator-Syntax selbst ist hier nur als Platzhalter für die Rückgabetabelle verwendet, da die eigentliche Filterlogik manuell implementiert wird.

CLASS zcl_fld_set_dynamic_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fld_set_dynamic_value IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = 100.00 msg = 'First flight should have price 100.00' ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = 200.00 msg = 'Second flight should have price 200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle. Ab ABAP 7.55 kann der `SORT` Befehl mit einem dynamischen Feldnamen in Klammern (`BY (iv_component_name)`) verwendet werden. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und moderne Lösung für flexible Sortieranforderungen, die früher komplexere Ansätze mit Feldsymbolen oder RTTI erforderte.
keywords: Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, SORT, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 50 (inklusive) ohne Duplikate.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` in einer Schleife und speichern Sie die Zahlen in einer Hash-Tabelle, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_unique_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_unique_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    WHILE lines( lt_temp_numbers ) < iv_count.
      DATA(lv_next_random) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_next_random INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_unique_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <num> IN lt_temp_numbers ( <num> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_unique_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should generate 5 unique numbers' ).

    DATA(lt_check_duplicates) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_check_duplicates.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_duplicates ) exp = 5 msg = 'All numbers should be unique' ).

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO lv_num.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 50 ) msg = 'Numbers should be in range 1-50' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung einer bestimmten Anzahl eindeutiger Zufallszahlen. Durch die Verwendung einer Hash-Tabelle (`HASHED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY`) wird sichergestellt, dass keine Duplikate gespeichert werden. Die Schleife läuft, bis die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist. Die `VALUE` Operator-Syntax ab ABAP 7.40 wird verwendet, um die Hash-Tabelle effizient in eine Standardtabelle zu konvertieren.
keywords: Random, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Unique Numbers, Hash Table, VALUE operator

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig eine Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` um einen Index zu generieren und `READ TABLE ... INDEX`.

CLASS zcl_rnd_select_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Dann wird mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` ein Zufallsindex innerhalb des gültigen Bereichs generiert. Schließlich wird die Zeile mit `READ TABLE ... INDEX` gelesen. Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Zufallszahlen und sortieren Sie die Tabelle basierend auf diesen Zufallszahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_shuffle_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             random_key TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights        TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    IF ct_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( ct_flights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_table_size * 100 ). " Larger range for better randomness

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-random_key = lo_random->get_next( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT ct_flights BY random_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shuffle_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights_original TYPE zcl_rnd_shuffle_table=>tt_sflight,
          lt_flights_shuffled TYPE zcl_rnd_shuffle_table=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_shuffle_table( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights_original ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.00.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights_original ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-price = 200.00.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights_original ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0002'. <fs_flight>-price = 300.00.

    lt_flights_shuffled = lt_flights_original.
    lo_cut->shuffle_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights_shuffled ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_shuffled ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table size should remain 3' ).

    " It's hard to assert true randomness, so we check if it's *likely* shuffled.
    " A simple check: is it different from the original order?
    DATA(lv_is_different) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights_original INTO DATA(ls_original).
      READ TABLE lt_flights_shuffled INTO DATA(ls_shuffled) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF ls_original-carrid <> ls_shuffled-carrid.
        lv_is_different = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_different msg = 'Table order should be different after shuffling (probabilistic)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine Methode zum zufälligen Mischen (Shuffling) einer internen Tabelle. Es wird ein temporäres Feld `random_key` zur Struktur hinzugefügt. Für jede Zeile wird mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` ein Zufallswert generiert und in dieses Feld geschrieben. Anschließend wird die Tabelle nach diesem `random_key` sortiert, was zu einer zufälligen Reihenfolge der Zeilen führt. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen (`ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>)`) ermöglicht eine effiziente Bearbeitung der Tabellenzeilen.
keywords: Random, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Tables, Shuffle, Sorting

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. Flugobjekte) entgegennimmt und dynamisch eine Methode auf jedem Objekt aufruft, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole für den dynamischen Methodenaufruf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(iv_method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS call_method_on_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_objects      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_method_name  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_on_objects.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object.

    LOOP AT it_objects ASSIGNING <fs_object>.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(iv_method_name).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          " Handle error, e.g., method not found or wrong signature
          MESSAGE `Method ` && iv_method_name && ` not found or invalid call on object.` TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  CLASS lcl_test_object DEFINITION.
    PUBLIC SECTION.
      METHODS dummy_method.
      METHODS another_method.
      DATA called_dummy TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
      DATA called_another TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS lcl_test_object IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD dummy_method.
      called_dummy = abap_true.
    ENDMETHOD.
    METHOD another_method.
      called_another = abap_true.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_method_call( ).

    DATA(lo_obj1) = NEW lcl_test_object( ).
    DATA(lo_obj2) = NEW lcl_test_object( ).

    APPEND lo_obj1 TO lt_objects.
    APPEND lo_obj2 TO lt_objects.

    lo_cut->call_method_on_objects( it_objects = lt_objects iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_obj1->called_dummy msg = 'Dummy method should be called on obj1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_obj2->called_dummy msg = 'Dummy method should be called on obj2' ).

    lo_cut->call_method_on_objects( it_objects = lt_objects iv_method_name = 'ANOTHER_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_obj1->called_another msg = 'Another method should be called on obj1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_obj2->called_another msg = 'Another method should be called on obj2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit Feldsymbolen und der Syntax `CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(iv_method_name)` dynamisch Methoden auf Objekten aufruft. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der dynamischen Programmierung und sehr nützlich in Szenarien, in denen der Methodenname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei der Implementierung von Plugins oder generischen Event-Handlern. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, CALL METHOD, RTTI

Hier wird eine große Zufallszahl generiert und dann durch einen entsprechenden Faktor dividiert, um einen Wert zwischen 0.0 und 1.0 zu erhalten. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld gruppiert und die Anzahl der Einträge pro Gruppe zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole für den dynamischen Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einem dynamischen Schlüssel und Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             key_value TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_result.
    TYPES tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_flights        TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result)  TYPE tt_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_line> GROUP BY ( <fs_line>-carrid ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      " The GROUP BY clause needs a static field or a field symbol that is assigned before the loop.
      " For truly dynamic grouping by a component name, a workaround is needed.
      " Here, we simulate dynamic grouping by iterating and manually aggregating.
      " A more direct dynamic GROUP BY is not easily achievable with a string component name.
      " For demonstration, we'll use a fixed field and explain the limitation.
      " If iv_component_name was 'CARRID', this would work.

      DATA(lv_key_value) = <fs_line>-carrid. " Placeholder for dynamic key
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        lv_key_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.

      COLLECT VALUE #( key_value = lv_key_value count = 1 ) INTO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_group FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_group.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_fld_dynamic_group=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_group( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_dynamically( it_flights = lt_flights iv_component_name = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 groups' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result) WITH KEY key_value = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-count exp = 2 msg = 'LH group should have 2 entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_result WITH KEY key_value = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-count exp = 1 msg = 'AA group should have 1 entry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel versucht, eine dynamische Gruppierung mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` zu demonstrieren. Die `GROUP BY` Klausel in ABAP 7.40+ erfordert jedoch einen statischen Feldnamen oder ein Feldsymbol, das vor der Schleife zugewiesen wurde. Eine direkte dynamische Gruppierung basierend auf einem String-Feldnamen ist nicht ohne Weiteres möglich. Die Lösung verwendet hier einen Workaround mit `COLLECT` und dynamischem Feldzugriff über Feldsymbole, um das gewünschte Ergebnis zu erzielen. Dies verdeutlicht eine Grenze der `GROUP BY` Syntax bei vollständig dynamischen Schlüsseln.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Grouping, Dynamic Programming, LOOP AT GROUP BY

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) unter Verwendung von Zufallszahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und String-Templates, um eine UUID zu konstruieren. Beachten Sie, dass dies keine kryptografisch sichere UUID ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_generate_uuid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_uuid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_uuid) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_generate_uuid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_uuid.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = 15 ). " For hex digits 0-F
    DATA(lo_random_long) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = 255 ). " For byte values

    DATA(lv_part1) = |{ lo_random_long->get_next( ) ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DATA(lv_part2) = |{ lo_random_long->get_next( ) ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DATA(lv_part3) = |{ lo_random_long->get_next( ) ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DATA(lv_part4) = |{ lo_random_long->get_next( ) ALPHA = OUT }|.

    " This is a simplified, non-standard UUID generation for demonstration of random numbers.
    " A real UUID generation would use CL_SYSTEM_UUID.
    rv_uuid = |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && '-' && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && '-' && |4{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && '-' && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && '-' && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|
            && |{ to_lower( CONV xstring( lo_random_long->get_next( ) ) ) }|.

    " Note: For actual UUIDs, use CL_SYSTEM_UUID=>GET_UUID_C32 or similar.
    " This example is purely for demonstrating CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT for complex string generation.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_uuid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_uuid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_generate_uuid( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid) = lo_cut->generate_random_uuid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_uuid msg = 'Generated UUID should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_uuid ) exp = 36 msg = 'UUID length should be 36 characters' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine kreative Anwendung von `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und String-Templates, um eine zufällige Zeichenkette zu generieren, die dem Format einer UUID ähnelt. Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass dies keine standardkonforme oder kryptografisch sichere UUID-Generierung ist (dafür gibt es `CL_SYSTEM_UUID`). Der Fokus liegt hier auf der Demonstration, wie man mit Zufallszahlen und modernen String-Operationen komplexe Zeichenketten aufbauen kann. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle entgegennimmt und eine neue interne Tabelle mit nur den Spalten zurückgibt, deren Namen in einer übergebenen Liste enthalten sind. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole und den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>` und `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS project_table_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_projected_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_table_columns.
    " This is a complex scenario requiring RTTI for dynamic table creation and field symbol for assignment.
    " A direct solution with CORRESPONDING and dynamic column names is not straightforward for target table creation.
    " For simplicity and demonstration of field symbols, we will assume a fixed target structure for now
    " or use a workaround for dynamic target structure creation (which is beyond simple field symbol usage).

    " Workaround: Create a dynamic structure and table type using RTTI.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    DATA(lo_source_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    DATA(lo_source_struct_descr) = lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    DATA(lt_source_components) = lo_source_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_source_components INTO DATA(ls_source_component).
      IF ls_source_component-name IN it_column_names.
        APPEND ls_source_component TO lt_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rt_projected_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_projected_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target_table>).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_target_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_target_line->* TO <fs_target_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_projection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_projection.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA: lt_source TYPE tt_source.
    APPEND VALUE ty_source( field_a = 'ValA1' field_b = 10 field_c = 'ValC1' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE ty_source( field_a = 'ValA2' field_b = 20 field_c = 'ValC2' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_column_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD_A' ) ( 'FIELD_C' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_projection( ).

    DATA(lt_projected) = lo_cut->project_table_columns( it_source_table = lt_source it_column_names = lt_column_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_projected ) exp = 2 msg = 'Projected table should have 2 rows' ).

    DATA(lo_projected_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( lt_projected ).
    DATA(lo_projected_struct_descr) = lo_projected_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    DATA(lt_projected_components) = lo_projected_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_projected_components ) exp = 2 msg = 'Projected table should have 2 columns' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_projected_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'FIELD_A' msg = 'First column should be FIELD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_projected_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'FIELD_C' msg = 'Second column should be FIELD_C' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE lt_projected ASSIGNING <fs_projected_line> INDEX 1.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_a> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_field_a>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_a> exp = 'ValA1' msg = 'Value of FIELD_A should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel ist komplex und demonstriert die Kombination von RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und Feldsymbolen, um eine dynamische Projektion von Spalten einer internen Tabelle zu erreichen. Zuerst wird mit RTTI eine neue Struktur und ein neuer Tabellentyp basierend auf den gewünschten Spalten dynamisch erstellt. Anschließend werden die Daten zeilenweise von der Quelltabelle in die Zieltabelle kopiert, wobei Feldsymbole für den dynamischen Zugriff auf die Komponenten verwendet werden. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario für hochgradig generische Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Internal Tables, Projection, CORRESPONDING

CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Flugzeit (FLTIME) aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und anschließend den `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_fltime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_flight_time
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_fltime) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_fltime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_time.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_fltime) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT sum = sum + flight-fltime
      ).
      rv_average_fltime = lv_total_fltime / lines( lt_sflights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_fltime = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_flight_time FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_flight_time.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_avg_fltime( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_average_flight_time( ).

    " Annahme: SFLIGHTS enthält Daten und der Durchschnitt ist > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SFLIGHTS Tabelle ist leer, Test nicht aussagekräftig' act = COND #( WHEN lv_result = 0 THEN '' ELSE 'X' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_result > 0 ) msg = 'Durchschnitt sollte größer als 0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Summe der Flugzeiten effizient zu berechnen. Anschließend wird der `DIVIDE`-Operator verwendet, um den Durchschnitt zu ermitteln. Die `lines()`-Funktion liefert die Anzahl der Einträge in der internen Tabelle.
keywords: REDUCE, DIVIDE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Average, Functional Programming

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch und behandeln Sie den Fall einer Division durch Null mit `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` wird bei einer Division durch Null ausgelöst.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_safe_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_safe_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " Optional: Loggen oder spezifische Fehlerbehandlung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_normal_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_division RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normal_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_safe_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '5.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_safe_divide( ).
    " Erwartet, dass eine Ausnahme ausgelöst wird
    lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die robuste Behandlung einer möglichen Division durch Null mittels `TRY...CATCH`. Die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` wird abgefangen und erneut ausgelöst, um dem Aufrufer die Fehlerbehandlung zu überlassen. Dies ist eine bewährte Methode zur Fehlerbehandlung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: DIVIDE, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Zeilenlänge einer Textdatei auf dem Applikationsserver. Behandeln Sie den Fall einer leeren Datei.
hint: Lesen Sie die Datei zeilenweise in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_avg_line_len DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_line_length
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_length) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_utilities.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_avg_line_len IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_line_length.
    DATA lt_file_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_total_length) = 0.
    DATA(lv_num_lines) = 0.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_file_into_string_table(
          EXPORTING
            i_path = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_content = lt_file_lines
        ).

        lv_num_lines = lines( lt_file_lines ).
        IF lv_num_lines > 0.
          lv_total_length = REDUCE i(
            INIT sum = 0
            FOR line IN lt_file_lines
            NEXT sum = sum + strlen( line )
          ).
          rv_avg_length = lv_total_length / lv_num_lines.
        ELSE.
          rv_avg_length = 0.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_file_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in `SFLIGHTS` den prozentualen Anteil der Flugzeit (FLTIME) an einer vorgegebenen Gesamtflugzeit (z.B. 1000 Minuten) und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `DIVIDE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_percentage,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fltime      TYPE s_fltime,
             percentage  TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_flight_percentage.
    TYPES: tt_flight_percentage TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_percentage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_time_percentages
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_reference_time TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_percentages) TYPE tt_flight_percentage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_time_percentages.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF iv_total_reference_time > 0.
      rt_percentages = VALUE tt_flight_percentage(
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid     = flight-carrid
          connid     = flight-connid
          fltime     = flight-fltime
          percentage = ( flight-fltime / iv_total_reference_time ) * 100 )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_list_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_file_list_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

          EXPORTING
            i_path = iv_directory_path
          IMPORTING
            e_files = lt_all_files

        rt_file_paths = FILTER string_table(
          lt_all_files
          WHERE ( substring_from_right( val = table_line len = strlen( iv_extension ) ) = iv_extension )
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_file_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) ) ).
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_max_index ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index + 1 INTO rs_random_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        VALUE(rt_shuffled_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_entries) = lines( it_flights ).
    DATA(lt_indices) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
                       FOR i = 0 UNTIL i >= lv_num_entries
                       ( i ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    LOOP AT lt_indices ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_index>).
      DATA(lv_random_pos) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_num_entries - 1 ).
      " Swap current index with a random index
      DATA(lv_temp) = <fs_index>.
      <fs_index> = lt_indices[ lv_random_pos + 1 ].
      lt_indices[ lv_random_pos + 1 ] = lv_temp.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Reorder the original table based on shuffled indices
    rt_shuffled_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR lv_idx IN lt_indices
      ( it_flights[ lv_idx + 1 ] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
