Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Erstellen Sie einen Pool von möglichen Zahlen und wählen Sie zufällig daraus, wobei Sie die gewählten Zahlen entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR iv_min > iv_max OR iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      " Invalid input or impossible to generate unique numbers
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_pool) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
                    FOR i = iv_min THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_max
                    ( i ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_pool_size) = lines( lt_pool ).
      IF lv_pool_size = 0.
        EXIT. " No more unique numbers available
      ENDIF.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_pool_size - 1 ).
      APPEND lt_pool[ lv_random_index + 1 ] TO rt_unique_numbers.
      DELETE TABLE lt_pool INDEX lv_random_index + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA(lt_unique_check) = lt_numbers.
    SORT lt_unique_check ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_check ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check if numbers are within range
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_num min = 1 max = 20 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen Flug aus einer Liste basierend auf einer Gewichtung aus (z.B. Business Class 20%, Economy 80%).
hint: Erstellen Sie einen kumulativen Gewichtungsbereich und verwenden Sie eine Zufallszahl, um den Bereich zu treffen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_item,
             item   TYPE string,
             weight TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_weighted_item.
    TYPES tt_weighted_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_random_item
      IMPORTING
        it_weighted_items TYPE tt_weighted_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_item) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_random_item.
    IF it_weighted_items IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_weight) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0
                                              FOR item IN it_weighted_items
                                              NEXT s = s + item-weight ).

    IF lv_total_weight <= 0.
      " Handle case where total weight is zero or negative
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next_float( ) * lv_total_weight.

    DATA(lv_cumulative_weight) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_weighted_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      lv_cumulative_weight = lv_cumulative_weight + ls_item-weight.
      IF lv_random_value <= lv_cumulative_weight.
        rv_selected_item = ls_item-item.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Fallback: Should not be reached if total_weight > 0
    rv_selected_item = it_weighted_items[ 1 ]-item.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weighted_random FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_random.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random=>tt_weighted_items(
      ( item = 'Business Class' weight = '20' )
      ( item = 'Economy Class'  weight = '80' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random( ).

    DATA(lv_business_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_economy_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 1000.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_weighted_random_item( lt_items ).
      IF lv_result = 'Business Class'.
        lv_business_count = lv_business_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_result = 'Economy Class'.
        lv_economy_count = lv_economy_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_business_count + lv_economy_count exp = lv_iterations ).
    " Check if counts are roughly proportional to weights (within a margin)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_business_count > ( lv_iterations * 0.10 ) AND lv_business_count < ( lv_iterations * 0.30 ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_economy_count > ( lv_iterations * 0.70 ) AND lv_economy_count < ( lv_iterations * 0.90 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode implementiert eine gewichtete Zufallsauswahl. Sie berechnet das Gesamtgewicht und wählt dann einen zufälligen Punkt innerhalb dieses Gesamtgewichts. Durch Iteration über die Elemente und Akkumulation der Gewichte wird das Element gefunden, dessen kumulatives Gewicht den zufälligen Punkt überschreitet. `REDUCE` wird für die Summenbildung verwendet.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    " Implementierung von Methode A
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Methode A wurde aufgerufen.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    " Implementierung von Methode B
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Methode B wurde aufgerufen.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_c.
    " Implementierung von Methode C
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Methode C wurde aufgerufen.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_random_method.
    DATA(lt_methods) = VALUE string_table( ( 'METHOD_A' ) ( 'METHOD_B' ) ( 'METHOD_C' ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_methods ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_max_index ).

    rv_called_method = lt_methods[ lv_random_index + 1 ].

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (me)->(rv_called_method).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf von { rv_called_method }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie ein konzeptionelles Caching-Muster für Daten, die potenziell aus einem Enterprise Search (ESH) Cache stammen könnten. Erklären Sie die Rolle von `cl_esh_ca_check` in diesem Kontext.
hint: Implementieren Sie einen einfachen In-Memory-Cache. Erklären Sie, dass `cl_esh_ca_check` für die Überprüfung des ESH-Caches verwendet wird, der hier nicht direkt simuliert werden kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_cache DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cached_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cached_data.
    TYPES tt_cached_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_cached_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    CLASS-DATA gt_cache TYPE tt_cached_data.

    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS invalidate_cache.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _fetch_from_backend
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_cache IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    READ TABLE gt_cache INTO DATA(ls_cached_entry) WITH KEY key = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Check if cache entry is still valid (e.g., not too old)
      IF cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = sy-tstmpl tstmp2 = ls_cached_entry-timestamp ) < 3600. " 1 hour validity
        rv_value = ls_cached_entry-value.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Data not in cache or expired, fetch from backend
    rv_value = _fetch_from_backend( iv_key ).
    IF rv_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Update cache
      DATA(ls_new_entry) = VALUE ty_cached_data( key = iv_key value = rv_value timestamp = sy-tstmpl ).
      INSERT ls_new_entry INTO TABLE gt_cache.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD invalidate_cache.
    CLEAR gt_cache.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_image_url_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS extract_image_urls
      IMPORTING
        iv_html_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_image_urls) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_image_url_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_image_urls.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `https?://[^\s/$.?#].[^\s]*?\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|gif|bmp|svg)(?:\?[^\s]*)?`.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_html_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_image_urls = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( iv_html_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_image_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_image_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_with_image.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_image_extension_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_image_extension_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_image_extension.
    DATA(lv_filename_lower) = to_lower( iv_filename ).
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN lv_filename_lower ENDS WITH '.jpg' OR
           lv_filename_lower ENDS WITH '.jpeg' OR
           lv_filename_lower ENDS WITH '.png' OR
           lv_filename_lower ENDS WITH '.gif' OR
           lv_filename_lower ENDS WITH '.bmp' OR
           lv_filename_lower ENDS WITH '.svg'
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Eine interne Tabelle enthält Produktbeschreibungen. Markiere alle Einträge, deren Beschreibung auf die Verfügbarkeit eines Produktbildes hinweist (z.B. 'Bild verfügbar', 'Foto anbei', 'siehe Abbildung').
hint: Nutze eine `FOR` Expression mit `COND` und `FIND` oder `CONTAINS`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_desc,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             has_image   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_product_desc.
    TYPES tt_product_desc TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_desc WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_product_image_marker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS mark_descriptions_with_images
          IMPORTING
            it_product_descriptions TYPE tt_product_desc
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_marked_descriptions) TYPE tt_product_desc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_image_marker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mark_descriptions_with_images.
    DATA(lt_search_terms) = VALUE string_table( ( `bild verfügbar` ) ( `foto anbei` ) ( `siehe abbildung` ) ).

    rt_marked_descriptions = VALUE #( FOR ls_desc IN it_product_descriptions
                                      LET lv_desc_lower = to_lower( ls_desc-description ) IN
                                      ( id          = ls_desc-id
                                        description = ls_desc-description
                                        has_image   = COND abap_bool(
                                                        WHEN EXISTS lt_search_terms[
                                                              WHERE ( FIND( val = lv_desc_lower sub = table_line ) IS NOT INITIAL ) ]
                                                        THEN abap_true
                                                        ELSE abap_false
                                                      )
                                      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES tt_loaded_image_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_picture_manager_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_ids TYPE tt_loaded_image_ids OPTIONAL.

    METHODS is_image_loaded
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_id TYPE string
      RETURNING

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_loaded_image_ids TYPE tt_loaded_image_ids.

CLASS zcl_picture_manager_sim IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF it_initial_ids IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_loaded_image_ids = it_initial_ids.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_image_loaded.
    rv_is_loaded = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( mt_loaded_image_ids[ WHERE table_line = iv_image_id ] )
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aus einem Konfigurationsstring, der Bild-Metadaten im Format 'KEY=VALUE; KEY2=VALUE2;' enthält, extrahiere den Wert für einen bestimmten Schlüssel (z.B. 'IMAGE_SIZE'). Dieser Wert könnte dann zur dynamischen Größenanpassung eines `cl_gui_picture` verwendet werden.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit Gruppen, um Schlüssel-Wert-Paare zu extrahieren, und dann `REDUCE`.

CLASS zcl_metadata_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_from_config
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_string TYPE string
        iv_key           TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value)  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_metadata_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_from_config.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `(\w+)=(\w+);`.
    DATA(lt_matches) TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_config_string
      RESULTS lt_matches.

    rv_value = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR ls_match IN lt_matches
      LET key = ls_match-submatches[1]-`offset`(ls_match-submatches[1]-`length`)
          value = ls_match-submatches[2]-`offset`(ls_match-submatches[2]-`length`) IN
      NEXT result = COND string(
                      WHEN key = iv_key THEN value
                      ELSE result
                    )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_type_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_image_type
      IMPORTING
        it_filenames TYPE string_table
        iv_file_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_type_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_image_type.
    DATA(lv_extension_lower) = to_lower( iv_file_extension ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR filename IN it_filenames
      LET lv_filename_lower = to_lower( filename ) IN
      NEXT count = COND i(
                      WHEN lv_filename_lower ENDS WITH lv_extension_lower
                      THEN count + 1
                      ELSE count
                    )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere den Dateinamen (ohne Pfad und ohne Erweiterung) aus einer vollständigen Bild-URL. Dies ist nützlich, um den Titel eines Bildes zu erhalten, das von `cl_gui_picture` angezeigt wird.
hint: Nutze `FIND` mit `MATCH OFFSET` und `MATCH LENGTH` in Kombination mit String-Funktionen wie `reverse` und `substring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_filename_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_filename_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_filename) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_filename_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_filename_from_url.
    DATA(lv_url_reversed) = reverse( iv_image_url ).
    DATA(lv_slash_pos) = FIND( val = lv_url_reversed sub = `/` ).
    DATA(lv_dot_pos) = FIND( val = lv_url_reversed sub = `.` ).

    IF lv_slash_pos IS INITIAL AND lv_dot_pos IS INITIAL.
      rv_filename = iv_image_url.
    ELSEIF lv_slash_pos IS INITIAL.
      rv_filename = substring( val = iv_image_url len = strlen( iv_image_url ) - lv_dot_pos - 1 ).
    ELSEIF lv_dot_pos IS INITIAL OR lv_dot_pos > lv_slash_pos.
      rv_filename = substring( val = iv_image_url off = strlen( iv_image_url ) - lv_slash_pos ).
    ELSE.
      rv_filename = substring( val = iv_image_url off = strlen( iv_image_url ) - lv_slash_pos len = lv_slash_pos - lv_dot_pos - 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_image_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_image_url.
    DATA(lv_url_lower) = to_lower( iv_url ).
    DATA(lv_has_protocol) = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN lv_url_lower STARTS WITH `http://` OR lv_url_lower STARTS WITH `https://`
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).

    DATA(lv_has_image_extension) = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN lv_url_lower ENDS WITH `.jpg` OR
           lv_url_lower ENDS WITH `.jpeg` OR
           lv_url_lower ENDS WITH `.png` OR
           lv_url_lower ENDS WITH `.gif` OR
           lv_url_lower ENDS WITH `.bmp` OR
           lv_url_lower ENDS WITH `.svg`
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).

    rv_is_valid = lv_has_protocol AND lv_has_image_extension.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashtag_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

TYPES tt_keywords TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_keyword_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_any_keyword
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        it_keywords TYPE tt_keywords
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_keyword_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_any_keyword.
    DATA(lv_text_lower) = to_lower( iv_text ).

    rv_contains = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN EXISTS it_keywords[
            WHERE ( FIND( val = lv_text_lower sub = to_lower( table_line ) ) IS NOT INITIAL ) ]
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` einen QR-Code, der den Namen der Fluggesellschaft (`CARRNAME`) enthält. Sammeln Sie die generierten BMP-Daten in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` auf `SFLIGHTS` und iterieren Sie über die Ergebnisse. Nutzen Sie `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_barcode,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname    TYPE s_carrname,
             barcode_bmp TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_sflight_barcode.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_barcodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_barcode WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_sflight_qrcodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_barcodes) TYPE tt_sflight_barcodes
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_qrcodes.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    DATA: ls_sflight_barcode TYPE ty_sflight_barcode.

    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      ls_sflight_barcode-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ls_sflight_barcode-carrname = ls_sflight-carrname.
      ls_sflight_barcode-barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode_bmp(
        i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_qr_code
        i_barcode_data = ls_sflight-carrname
        i_width        = 150
        i_height       = 150
      ).
      APPEND ls_sflight_barcode TO rt_sflight_barcodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Barcode-Typen (EAN13, CODE128, QR_CODE) basierend auf einer Eingabeparameter generiert. Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für ungültige Barcode-Daten, die spezifische Fehlermeldungen zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` für die Barcode-Typen und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung. Nutzen Sie `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_flexible DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_barcode_result,
             success     TYPE abap_bool,
             message     TYPE string,
             barcode_bmp TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_barcode_result.

    METHODS generate_flexible_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_barcode_type TYPE string
        iv_barcode_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_barcode_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_flexible IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flexible_barcode.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    rs_result-success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        CASE iv_barcode_type.
          WHEN 'EAN13'.
            rs_result-barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode_bmp(
              i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_ean13
              i_barcode_data = iv_barcode_data
              i_width        = 200
              i_height       = 100
            ).
          WHEN 'CODE128'.
            rs_result-barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode_bmp(
              i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_code128
              i_barcode_data = iv_barcode_data
              i_width        = 250
              i_height       = 80
            ).
          WHEN 'QR_CODE'.
            rs_result-barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode_bmp(
              i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_qr_code
              i_barcode_data = iv_barcode_data
              i_width        = 150
              i_height       = 150
            ).
          WHEN OTHERS.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife mit `SUBSTRING` und `STRLEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_split_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_string_to_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_long_text TYPE string
        iv_max_length TYPE i DEFAULT 80
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_text_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_split_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_string_to_lines.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_long_text ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      DATA(lv_sub_length) = MIN( val1 = iv_max_length val2 = lv_length - lv_offset ).
      APPEND iv_long_text+lv_offset(lv_sub_length) TO rt_text_lines.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_sub_length.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Validierung eines Textes, der aus einem `cl_gui_textedit` Control stammt. Die Methode soll prüfen, ob der Text bestimmte Schlüsselwörter enthält und ob er eine Mindestlänge hat. Geben Sie ein `abap_bool` und eine entsprechende Nachricht zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` für Schlüsselwörter und `STRLEN` für die Länge. Nutzen Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_validation_result,
             is_valid TYPE abap_bool,
             message  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_validation_result.

    METHODS validate_text_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_validation_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_text_content.
    CONSTANTS: lc_min_length TYPE i VALUE 20.
    CONSTANTS: lc_keyword1 TYPE string VALUE 'ABAP'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_keyword2 TYPE string VALUE 'Modern'.

    rs_result = COND #( LET lv_len = strlen( iv_text ) IN
      WHEN lv_len < lc_min_length THEN
        VALUE #( is_valid = abap_false message = |Text ist zu kurz (min. { lc_min_length } Zeichen).| )
      WHEN NOT ( iv_text CS lc_keyword1 OR iv_text CS lc_keyword2 ) THEN
        VALUE #( is_valid = abap_false message = |Text muss '{ lc_keyword1 }' oder '{ lc_keyword2 }' enthalten.| )
      ELSE
        VALUE #( is_valid = abap_true message = 'Text ist gültig.' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_sflights_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_sflights.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen String bereinigt, indem sie doppelte Leerzeichen entfernt und den Text auf eine bestimmte maximale Länge kürzt. Dies simuliert eine Vorverarbeitung von Benutzereingaben aus einem `cl_gui_textedit` Control.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_and_truncate_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_text TYPE string
        iv_max_length TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_and_truncate_text.
    DATA(lv_temp_text) = iv_input_text.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    CONDENSE lv_temp_text NO-GAPS.

    " Replace multiple spaces with single space using regex
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp_text WITH ' '.

    " Truncate to max length
    rv_cleaned_text = COND string(
      WHEN strlen( lv_temp_text ) > iv_max_length THEN
        lv_temp_text(iv_max_length)
      ELSE
        lv_temp_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_alphanum_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_only_alphanum_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_textedit_alphanum_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_only_alphanum_spaces.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) in der Tabelle `sflights`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_distinct_airlines RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_airlines.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT distinct_carrids = NEW cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_set( )
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             LET carrid_str = flight-carrid IN
                             NEXT distinct_carrids->add( carrid_str )
                             FINALLY distinct_carrids->size( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse. Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die diese Ausnahme unter bestimmten Bedingungen auslöst und eine aufrufende Methode, die diese Ausnahme abfängt und eine spezifische Meldung ausgibt.

CLASS cx_custom_flight_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_custom_flight_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RAISING
        cx_custom_flight_error.
    METHODS handle_flight_processing
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight.
    IF iv_carrid = 'XX'. " Example condition to raise exception
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_custom_flight_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_custom_flight_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate some processing
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_flight_processing.
    TRY.
        process_flight( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).
        rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.
      CATCH cx_custom_flight_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler bei Flug { iv_carrid }: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine komplexe Operation durchführt, die verschiedene Ausnahmen auslösen kann (z.B. Division durch Null, ungültige Konvertierung). Fangen Sie diese Ausnahmen spezifisch ab und geben Sie für jede einen angepassten Fehler zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH` Blöcke in einer `TRY` Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_complex_calc
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE string
        iv_val2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_msg) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_complex_calc.
    DATA lv_num1 TYPE i.
    DATA lv_num2 TYPE i.
    DATA lv_calc_result TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

    TRY.
        lv_num1 = iv_val1. " May raise cx_sy_conversion_no_number
        lv_num2 = iv_val2. " May raise cx_sy_conversion_no_number

        lv_calc_result = lv_num1 / lv_num2. " May raise cx_sy_arithmetic_error

        rv_result_msg = |Berechnung erfolgreich: { lv_calc_result }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        rv_result_msg = |Fehler: Ungültiges Zahlenformat in Eingabe: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result_msg = |Fehler: Arithmetischer Fehler (z.B. Division durch Null): { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error). " Catch any other unexpected errors
        rv_result_msg = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten unter Verwendung eines REDUCE-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und die Flugpreise zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_reduce.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_reduce_flights=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_reduce_flights( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 250.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 50.

    DATA(lv_expected_total) = 400.
    DATA(lv_actual_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_total
      exp = lv_expected_total
      msg = 'Total price should be 400'
    ).

    CLEAR lt_test_flights.
    lv_actual_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_total
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum_price`) und wendet in jedem Schleifendurchlauf eine Operation an, um das Endergebnis zu berechnen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, SUM, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_assert_sum_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE ty_numbers
        iv_threshold TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_sum_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + n ).

    ASSERT ID z_sum_check CONDITION lv_sum <= iv_threshold.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_within_threshold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_exceeds_threshold FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assert_failure.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_within_threshold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_sum_threshold( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_assert_sum_threshold=>ty_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 100.

    lo_cut->process_numbers( it_numbers = lt_test_numbers iv_threshold = lv_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No assertion failure expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_exceeds_threshold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_sum_threshold( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_assert_sum_threshold=>ty_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 50.

    lo_cut->process_numbers( it_numbers = lt_test_numbers iv_threshold = lv_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Assertion failure expected but did not occur' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSERT`-Anweisung ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die defensive Programmierung. Sie stellt sicher, dass bestimmte Bedingungen zur Laufzeit erfüllt sind. Im Testmodus (ABAP Unit) führt ein fehlgeschlagenes `ASSERT` zu einer `cx_sy_assert_failure`-Exception, die im Unit-Test abgefangen werden kann, um das erwartete Verhalten zu prüfen. Außerhalb des Testmodus führt es zu einem Short Dump.
keywords: ASSERT, Defensive Programming, Error Handling, Conditional Logic, Unit Test

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch die Summe aller numerischen Felder (Typ I, P, F, DECFLOAT) in einer übergebenen Struktur berechnet, ohne die Feldnamen explizit zu kennen. Verwenden Sie RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` um die Struktur zu analysieren und die Feldwerte dynamisch zu lesen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_sum_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_numeric_fields
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_sum) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_sum_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numeric_fields.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      CASE ls_component-type_descr->type_kind.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
             cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
             cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float OR
             cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ir_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_total_sum = rv_total_sum + <fs_value>.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN OTHERS.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie zuerst die Tabelle filtern und dann die Summe bilden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die relevanten Einträge zu selektieren, und anschließend `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER ty_flights(
      it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten. Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise, nachdem Sie jeden Preis um einen bestimmten Prozentsatz erhöht haben. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer Transformation und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` um die Preise zu transformieren und dann `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_map_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_with_markup
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        iv_markup_percent TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_map_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_with_markup.
    DATA(lt_marked_up_prices) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_price(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_markup_percent / 100 ) )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR lv_price IN lt_marked_up_prices
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + lv_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie mit einer `ASSERT`-Anweisung, ob in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten mindestens ein Flug existiert, dessen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.

CLASS zcl_assert_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_high_price_flight_exists.
    ASSERT ID z_flight_price_check CONDITION LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ price > iv_price_threshold ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_decfloat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sum_decfloat IMPLEMENTATION.

      INIT sum_val = 0
      FOR lv_value IN it_values
      NEXT sum_val = sum_val + lv_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` um die Daten nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und dann die Preise innerhalb jeder Gruppe zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_sum,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_sum.
    TYPES ty_carrier_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_sums) TYPE ty_carrier_sums.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_current_carrier_sum) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_group_member>-price
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      total_price = lv_current_carrier_sum ) TO rt_carrier_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_sum.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_group_by=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_group_by( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' price = 300 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lt_actual_sums) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    DATA(lt_expected_sums) = VALUE zcl_sum_group_by=>ty_carrier_sums(
      ( carrid = 'LH' total_price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' total_price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' total_price = 300 )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_sums )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should have 3 entries for 3 carriers'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_sums INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_sums INTO DATA(ls_actual) WITH KEY carrid = ls_expected-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
        act = sy-subrc
        exp = 0
        msg = |Carrier { ls_expected-carrid } not found in actual sums|
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-total_price
        exp = ls_expected-total_price
        msg = |Total price for { ls_expected-carrid } mismatch|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_sum_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_group_by=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_group_by( ).

    DATA(lt_actual_sums) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_actual_sums )
      msg = 'Result table should be empty for empty input'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_sum_single_carrier.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_group_by=>ty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_group_by( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lt_actual_sums) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    DATA(lt_expected_sums) = VALUE zcl_sum_group_by=>ty_carrier_sums(
      ( carrid = 'LH' total_price = 300 )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_sums )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Should have 1 entry for single carrier'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_sums[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_sums[ 1 ]-total_price
      exp = 300
      msg = 'Total price for LH mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax (ABAP 7.40+) ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion zur Aggregation und Verarbeitung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe ermöglicht sie eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Summenbildung pro Gruppierungskriterium.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, SUM, Internal Tables, Grouping, REDUCE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadratzahlen einer Liste von Ganzzahlen. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer Transformation und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` um jede Zahl zu quadrieren und dann `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE ty_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_of_squares) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lt_squares) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
      ( lv_number * lv_number )
    ).

    rv_sum_of_squares = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_val = 0
      FOR lv_square IN lt_squares
      NEXT sum_val = sum_val + lv_square
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares_negative_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_sum_squares=>ty_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3. " 1 + 4 + 9 = 14
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_test_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Sum of squares should be 14'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_of_squares_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_sum_squares=>ty_numbers( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_test_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Sum of squares for empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_of_squares_negative_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_sum_squares=>ty_numbers( ( -1 ) ( -2 ) ( -3 ) ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = (-1)*(-1) + (-2)*(-2) + (-3)*(-3). " 1 + 4 + 9 = 14
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_test_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Sum of squares for negative numbers should be 14'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert erneut die Flexibilität von `FOR ... IN ...` in Kombination mit `REDUCE`. Es zeigt, wie man eine Transformation (Quadrieren) auf jedes Element einer internen Tabelle anwenden und das Ergebnis anschließend aggregieren kann, alles in einer kompakten und funktionalen Syntax.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, SUM, Internal Tables, Transformation, Math

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen in der Economy Class haben. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einer Bedingung für `seatsocc` und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_filter_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seats,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES ty_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_for_available_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flight_details
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE s_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_filter_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_for_available_seats.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER ty_flight_details(
      it_flights WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_with_free_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_with_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_filter_seats=>ty_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_filter_seats( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_test_flights. " 20 free
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = 200 seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 95 ) TO lt_test_flights. " 5 free
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 150 seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 70 ) TO lt_test_flights. " 30 free

    DATA(lv_min_free) = 15.
    DATA(lv_expected_total) = 100 + 150. " LH (20 free) + LH (30 free) = 250
    DATA(lv_actual_total) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_for_available_seats(
                               it_flights = lt_test_flights
                               iv_min_free_seats = lv_min_free
                             ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_total
      exp = lv_expected_total
      msg = 'Total price for flights with >= 15 free seats should be 250'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_no_matching_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_filter_seats=>ty_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_filter_seats( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 90 ) TO lt_test_flights. " 10 free
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = 200 seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 95 ) TO lt_test_flights. " 5 free

    DATA(lv_min_free) = 15.
    DATA(lv_expected_total) = 0.
    DATA(lv_actual_total) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_for_available_seats(
                               it_flights = lt_test_flights
                               iv_min_free_seats = lv_min_free
                             ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_total
      exp = lv_expected_total
      msg = 'Total price should be 0 for no matching flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_filter_seats=>ty_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_filter_seats( ).

    DATA(lv_min_free) = 10.
    DATA(lv_expected_total) = 0.
    DATA(lv_actual_total) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_for_available_seats(
                               it_flights = lt_test_flights
                               iv_min_free_seats = lv_min_free
                             ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_total
      exp = lv_expected_total
      msg = 'Total price for empty input table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer komplexeren Bedingung, die eine Berechnung (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) beinhaltet, um die relevanten Einträge zu selektieren. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Summe der gefilterten Preise zu bilden. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit der funktionalen Operatoren für die Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, SUM, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Übertragen Sie gleichnamige Felder von einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabellenzeile unter Verwendung von `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit `EXPANDING TABLES` für Tabellen oder iterieren Sie über die Tabelle und verwenden Sie es für jede Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corr_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_source_line,
           tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityto TYPE s_city,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_target_line,
           tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    LOOP AT it_source INTO DATA(ls_source_line).
      DATA(ls_target_line) = VALUE ty_target_line( ).
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_source_line TO ls_target_line.
      APPEND ls_target_line TO rt_target.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-cityto ). " Field not in source
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-price ). " Field not in source
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_corr_operator_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,

                  MAPPING

                    flight_num = connid
                    departure_city = cityfrom
                    flight_price = price.

    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_line>).

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus der `SFLIGHT` Datenbanktabelle und verwenden Sie dabei eine Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)`. Beachten Sie, dass `SFLIGHT` eine Mandantenabhängige Tabelle ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_into_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_into_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL.

    rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflight_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_into_table( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen ABAP-Code. Sie ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der internen Tabelle und die direkte Zuweisung der Selektionsergebnisse, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator wird hier verwendet, um sicherzustellen, dass die Felder korrekt in den Rückgabetyp gemappt werden, falls die Struktur des `SELECT`-Ergebnisses nicht exakt dem Rückgabetyp entspricht.
keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE, DATA, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT, Internal Table

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `FILTER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_table( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_table=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251125' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251126' price = '200' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20251127' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_aa ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_aa[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um interne Tabellen funktional zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die den angegebenen Kriterien entsprechen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: FILTER, Interne Tabelle, Funktionale Programmierung, WHERE, KEY

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von drei Zahlen mit einer Inline-Deklaration für das Ergebnis.

CLASS zcl_average_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_num2 TYPE i
        iv_num3 TYPE i
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_average_calc IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD test_average_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_average( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 20 iv_num3 = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20.0' ).

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` mit der Methode `FIND_ALL` und dem Regex-Muster `\d+`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+`. " Matches one or more digits
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
      pattern     = lv_pattern
      text        = iv_text
    ).
    lo_matcher->find_all( ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->get_matches( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-submatch TO rt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '123' ).

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Log-Eintrag den Zeitstempel, den Benutzernamen und die Nachricht mithilfe von benannten Erfassungsgruppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` mit benannten Erfassungsgruppen `(?P<name>...)` und `GET_SUBMATCHES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_log_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE string,
             username  TYPE string,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_log_entry IMPORTING iv_log_line TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_log_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_entry.
    " Example log line: [2023-11-25 10:30:00] User: JOHN_DOE - Message: Operation successful.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^\[(?P<timestamp>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\] User: (?P<username>\w+) - Message: (?P<message>.*)$`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
      pattern     = lv_pattern
      text        = iv_log_line
    ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lt_submatches) = lo_matcher->get_submatches( ).
      rs_log_entry-timestamp = lt_submatches[ name = 'timestamp' ]-submatch.
      rs_log_entry-username  = lt_submatches[ name = 'username' ]-submatch.
      rs_log_entry-message   = lt_submatches[ name = 'message' ]-submatch.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_parse_invalid_log_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_log_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_log_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_log_line) = '[2023-11-25 10:30:00] User: JOHN_DOE - Message: Operation successful.'.
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->parse_log_entry( lv_log_line ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-timestamp exp = '2023-11-25 10:30:00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-username  exp = 'JOHN_DOE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-message   exp = 'Operation successful.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_invalid_log_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_log_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_log_line) = 'Invalid log entry format.'.
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->parse_log_entry( lv_log_line ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_act = ls_result-timestamp ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_act = ls_result-username ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_act = ls_result-message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine IP-Adresse (IPv4) in einem String.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein komplexeres Regex-Muster mit `CL_ABAP_MATCHER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_ipv4_valid IMPORTING iv_ip_address TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_ipv4_valid.
    " Regex for IPv4 validation (simplified, not covering all edge cases like leading zeros)
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)$`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
      pattern     = lv_pattern
      text        = iv_ip_address
    ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->matches( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_ipv4 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_ipv4 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_ipv4_valid( '192.168.1.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_ipv4_valid( '10.0.0.255' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_ipv4_valid( '0.0.0.0' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_ipv4_valid( '256.0.0.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_ipv4_valid( '192.168.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_ipv4_valid( '192.168.1.1.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_ipv4_valid( 'abc.def.ghi.jkl' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Validierung komplexer Muster wie IP-Adressen ist ein Paradebeispiel für den Einsatz von regulären Ausdrücken. `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` bietet die notwendige Funktionalität, um solche Prüfungen in modernem ABAP durchzuführen.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_MATCHER, IPv4, Validierung, String Processing

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Profilparameters als Integer und geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück, falls der Parameter nicht existiert oder nicht numerisch ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_PARAMETER_VALUE` und eine `TRY...CATCH` Block für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_spfl_get_int_param DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_int_param_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_param_name TYPE string
        iv_default    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_spfl_get_int_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_int_param_with_default.
    DATA(lo_spf_param) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    DATA(lv_string_value) = ``.

    TRY.
        lv_string_value = lo_spf_param->get_parameter_value( iv_parameter_name = iv_param_name ).
        rv_value = CONV i( lv_string_value ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_parameter_error.
        rv_value = iv_default.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_value = iv_default.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_int_param_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_int_param_not_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_int_param_non_numeric FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_int_param_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_spfl_get_int_param( ).
    " Assuming 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' is typically an integer, e.g., '600'
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_int_param_with_default( iv_param_name = 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' iv_default = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_value exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_value > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_int_param_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_spfl_get_int_param( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_int_param_with_default( iv_param_name = 'non_existent_int_param' iv_default = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_int_param_non_numeric.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_spfl_get_int_param( ).
    " Assuming a parameter that might exist but has non-numeric value, or mock it.
    " For simplicity, we'll test with a known non-numeric string if it were a parameter value.
    " In a real scenario, you'd mock cl_spfl_profile_parameter to return a non-numeric string.
    " For this test, we simulate the conversion error directly.
    DATA(lv_test_param_name) = 'test/non_numeric_param'.
    " This test is tricky without mocking. Let's assume a parameter 'test/non_numeric_param' exists and has value 'ABC'
    " If we cannot guarantee such a parameter, this test might fail or need mocking.
    " For now, we rely on the CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_int_param_with_default( iv_param_name = lv_test_param_name iv_default = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_spfl_parameter_error` und `cx_sy_conversion_error` ist entscheidend, um robuste Funktionen zu erstellen, die sowohl fehlende Parameter als auch ungültige Datenformate elegant behandeln können.
keywords: CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER, GET_PARAMETER_VALUE, TRY_CATCH, Konvertierung, Integer, Fehlerbehandlung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus der globalen Tabelle `sflights` für die Fluggesellschaft 'AA' und füllen Sie diese direkt bei der Deklaration. Die neue Tabelle soll nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` Iteration und Feldmapping.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_aa_flights) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flights.
    rt_aa_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
                                ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                  connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                  fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_aa_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_aa_flights.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_flight_data_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_aa_flights) = lo_builder->get_aa_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_aa_flights ) exp = 0  operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
    LOOP AT lt_aa_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fluggesellschaft muss AA sein' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative und sehr kompakte Initialisierung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und effizienter als traditionelle `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Deklaration, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der globalen Tabelle `sflights` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und einer `INIT` Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_sflight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_lh_total) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_aa_total) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für LH und AA in sflights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH Total sollte nicht 0 sein' act = lv_lh_total exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'AA Total sollte nicht 0 sein' act = lv_aa_total exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'LH und AA Totals sollten unterschiedlich sein' act = lv_lh_total exp = lv_aa_total ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Iteratoren in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Dies ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Aggregation, sflights, Summe

Instructions: Filtern Sie die globale Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_expensive_flights IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    rt_expensive_flights = FILTER #( sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_expensive_flights( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Gefilterte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Preis muss über 500 liegen' act = ls_flight-price exp = 500 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die der angegebenen Bedingung entsprechen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Filterung

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen den Status 'High Priority' zu, wenn der Flugpreis über 1000 liegt, ansonsten 'Normal Priority'. Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator.
hint: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_priority DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_priority IMPORTING iv_price TYPE sflight-price RETURNING VALUE(rv_priority) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie eine Fluggesellschaft ('AA', 'LH', 'UA') in 'North America', 'Europe' oder 'Other'. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator.
hint: Der `SWITCH` Operator ist ideal für multiple bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrier_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_region IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid RETURNING VALUE(rv_region) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_carrier_category IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_region = SWITCH string( iv_carrid
                                WHEN 'AA' THEN 'North America'
                                WHEN 'UA' THEN 'North America'
                                WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Europe'
                                ELSE 'Other' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_category) = NEW zcl_carrier_category( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_category->get_region( 'AA' ) exp = 'North America' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_category->get_region( 'UA' ) exp = 'North America' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_category->get_region( 'LH' ) exp = 'Europe' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_INFO` mit einem Konstruktor, der `carrid` und `connid` entgegennimmt. Instanziieren Sie ein Objekt dieser Klasse und rufen Sie eine Methode auf, die die initialisierten Werte zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `NEW` Operator.

CLASS zcl_flight_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_info IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:
