Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Anhänge für ein bestimmtes Business-Objekt (z.B. `BUS2012` für Bestellungen) und einen gegebenen Objektschlüssel unter Verwendung von `cl_gos_attachment_query`. Da GOS-Objekte nicht einfach im Unit-Test erstellt werden können, soll die Methode einen Dummy-Wert zurückgeben, wenn kein echtes GOS-Objekt gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_gos_attachment_query` und ihre Methode `get_attachment_count`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attachment_count IMPORTING iv_objtype TYPE borident-objtype
                                           iv_objkey  TYPE borident-objkey
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_count.
    DATA: ls_borident TYPE borident.
    ls_borident-objtype = iv_objtype.
    ls_borident-objkey  = iv_objkey.

    TRY.
        rv_count = cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachment_count( is_object = ls_borident ).
      CATCH cx_gos_api_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Objekt nicht gefunden oder keine Berechtigung
        " Für den Testfall geben wir einen Dummy-Wert zurück, wenn kein echtes GOS-Objekt existiert.
        rv_count = -1. " Indikator für Fehler/nicht gefunden
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_attachment_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_attachment_count.
    DATA(lo_gos_util) = NEW zcl_gos_attachment_util( ).

    " Test mit einem Business-Objekt, das wahrscheinlich keine Anhänge hat (oder nicht existiert)
    DATA(lv_count_no_attachments) = lo_gos_util->get_attachment_count( iv_objtype = 'BUS2012' iv_objkey = '9999999999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sollte -1 zurückgeben, wenn keine Anhänge gefunden oder Fehler' act = lv_count_no_attachments exp = -1 ).

    " Für einen echten Test müsste man ein Business-Objekt mit bekannten Anhängen verwenden
    " oder die GOS-Klasse mocken. Hier nur ein Beispiel für die Methodensignatur.
    " DATA(lv_count_with_attachments) = lo_gos_util->get_attachment_count( iv_objtype = 'BUS2012' iv_objkey = '0000000001' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte Anhänge finden' act = lv_count_with_attachments exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_gos_attachment_query` bietet eine standardisierte API für den Zugriff auf Generic Object Services (GOS) Anhänge. Die Verwendung dieser Klasse ist der moderne Weg, um mit GOS-Funktionalitäten zu interagieren, anstatt auf ältere Funktionsbausteine zurückzugreifen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist ebenfalls ein moderner ABAP-Standard.
keywords: GOS, Attachments, cl_gos_attachment_query, Business Object, BOR

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' und der Flugnummer '001' in der globalen Tabelle `sflights` existiert. Verwenden Sie den `LINE_EXISTS` Operator.
hint: Der `LINE_EXISTS` Operator prüft die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                          iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                RETURNING VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rb_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_existence FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` und gruppieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`). Für jede Gruppe soll die Anzahl der Flüge und der durchschnittliche Preis berechnet werden. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `GROUP BY` Erweiterung der `LOOP AT` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             avg_price     TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_flight_group_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_result) = VALUE ty_flight_group_result(
                                carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                                avg_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                                      FOR <member> IN GROUP
                                                      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <member>-price ) / GROUP SIZE ).
      APPEND ls_group_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH Durchschnittspreis sollte existieren' act = ls_result-avg_price exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
    ENDLOOP.

GROUP BY` Anweisung ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Funktion in ABAP, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchzuführen. In Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` können komplexe Gruppierungs- und Aggregationslogiken sehr kompakt und effizient implementiert werden.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Feldnamen und deren Typen einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit. Demonstrieren Sie dies anhand der Struktur `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die RTTI-Klassen `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_structure IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data RETURNING VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA: lo_descr_ref TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.
    DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_descr_ref ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        lt_components = lo_descr_ref->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          lo_elem_descr ?= ls_component-type.
          APPEND VALUE ty_field_info(
                   name = ls_component-name
                   type = lo_elem_descr->get_relative_name( )
                   length = lo_elem_descr->length
                 ) TO rt_field_info.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_abap_invalid_descr_type.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. wenn ir_data keine Struktur ist
        CLEAR rt_field_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_analyze_string FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_analyze_sflight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Feldinformationen sollten nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_field_info ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

    DATA(lv_found_carrid) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_field_info INTO DATA(ls_field) WHERE name = 'CARRID'.
      lv_found_carrid = abap_true.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_field-type exp = 'C' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_field-length exp = 3 ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Feld CARRID sollte gefunden werden' act = lv_found_carrid ).

  METHOD test_analyze_string.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Typinformationen von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit dynamisch abzufragen. Die Klassen `cl_abap_typedescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_elemdescr` sind die modernen Werkzeuge dafür. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Dummy-Daten. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit Feldern aus `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table IMPORTING it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.
    DATA: lo_elem_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field>         TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Strukturdefinition dynamisch erstellen
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      TRY.
          lo_elem_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( |SFLIGHT-{ lv_field_name }| ).
          ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
          ls_component-type = lo_elem_descr.
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        CATCH cx_abap_invalid_descr_type.
          " Feld existiert nicht in SFLIGHT, überspringen oder Fehler melden
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    " 2. Interne Tabelle dynamisch erstellen
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    " 3. Tabelle mit Dummy-Daten füllen
    CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

    DO 3 TIMES.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_component-name.
            WHEN 'CARRID'. <fs_field> = |AA{ sy-index }|.
            WHEN 'CONNID'. <fs_field> = |00{ sy-index }|.
            WHEN 'FLDATE'. <fs_field> = sy-datum + sy-index.
            WHEN 'PRICE'.  <fs_field> = 100 * sy-index.
            WHEN OTHERS.   <fs_field> = |Value { sy-index }|.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_field_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_fields TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>tt_field_names.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_fields.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_fields.
    APPEND 'FLDATE' TO lt_fields.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_table( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid> exp = 'AA1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_field_list.
    DATA: lt_fields TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>tt_field_names.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_table( lt_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Bei leerer Feldliste sollte REF TO DATA initial sein' act = lr_dynamic_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Datenobjekten (Strukturen, Tabellen) zur Laufzeit ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das durch RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` sowie den `CREATE DATA` Befehl mit `TYPE HANDLE` ermöglicht wird. Dies ist unerlässlich für generische Frameworks oder Tools, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für den Status eines Auftrags (z.B. 'Neu', 'In Bearbeitung', 'Abgeschlossen', 'Storniert') und implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Text für einen gegebenen Status zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `ENUM` Syntax zur Definition und eine `CASE` Anweisung zur Status-Text-Zuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM status_type STRUCTURE status_type,
             NEW          VALUE IS INITIAL,
             IN_PROCESS   VALUE 'P',
             COMPLETED    VALUE 'C',
             CANCELLED    VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM status_type.

    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE status_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN status_type-new THEN
        rv_status_text = 'Neu'.
      WHEN status_type-in_process THEN
        rv_status_text = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN status_type-completed THEN
        rv_status_text = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN status_type-cancelled THEN
        rv_status_text = 'Storniert'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN
        rv_status_text = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_status_texts FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_status_texts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_order_status_enum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_order_status_enum=>status_type-new ) exp = 'Neu' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_order_status_enum=>status_type-in_process ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_order_status_enum=>status_type-completed ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Enumeration für Wochentage. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebener Wochentag ein Arbeitstag ist (Montag bis Freitag).
hint: Nutzen Sie die `ENUM` Definition und eine `IF` oder `CASE` Anweisung mit `WHEN` für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM weekday_type STRUCTURE weekday_type,
             MONDAY    VALUE 1,
             TUESDAY   VALUE 2,
             WEDNESDAY VALUE 3,
             THURSDAY  VALUE 4,
             FRIDAY    VALUE 5,
             SATURDAY  VALUE 6,
             SUNDAY    VALUE 7,
           END OF ENUM weekday_type.

    METHODS is_workday
      IMPORTING
        iv_day TYPE weekday_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_workday) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_workday.
    rv_is_workday = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_day >= weekday_type-monday AND iv_day <= weekday_type-friday THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_workday_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_workday_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weekday_enum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_workday( zcl_weekday_enum=>weekday_type-monday ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_workday( zcl_weekday_enum=>weekday_type-friday ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_workday( zcl_weekday_enum=>weekday_type-saturday ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_workday( zcl_weekday_enum=>weekday_type-sunday ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Enumeration `weekday_type` macht den Code lesbarer und verhindert ungültige Wochentagswerte. Die `COND` Expression ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, bedingte Zuweisungen vorzunehmen.
keywords: ENUM, Enumeration, COND, Wochentag, Arbeitstag

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) und filtern Sie diese nach einem bestimmten Flugstatus, der durch eine Enumeration repräsentiert wird. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Flugstatus und verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem Vergleich zum Enumerationswert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM flight_status_type STRUCTURE flight_status_type,
             SCHEDULED VALUE 'A',
             DELAYED   VALUE 'B',
             CANCELLED VALUE 'C',
             DEPARTED  VALUE 'D',
           END OF ENUM flight_status_type.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE flight_status_type,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_tt
        iv_status  TYPE flight_status_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_status.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE status = iv_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_enum( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter_enum=>ty_sflights_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum status = zcl_flight_filter_enum=>flight_status_type-scheduled )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum status = zcl_flight_filter_enum=>flight_status_type-delayed )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum status = zcl_flight_filter_enum=>flight_status_type-scheduled )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status( it_flights = lt_flights iv_status = zcl_flight_filter_enum=>flight_status_type-scheduled ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    lt_filtered = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status( it_flights = lt_flights iv_status = zcl_flight_filter_enum=>flight_status_type-cancelled ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung einer Enumeration für den Flugstatus erhöht die Datenkonsistenz und Lesbarkeit. Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und deklarative Methode, um interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: ENUM, Enumeration, FILTER, Interne Tabelle, Flugstatus

Instructions: Wandeln Sie einen externen String-Wert (z.B. 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW') in einen entsprechenden Enumerationswert für eine Priorität um. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `CASE` Expression.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Prioritäten und verwenden Sie `VALUE #(...)` mit `CASE` für die Zuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_priority_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_priority_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_priority.
    rv_priority = VALUE #( LET lower_string = to_upper( iv_priority_string ) IN

                             WHEN 'LOW'    THEN priority_type-low
                             WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN priority_type-medium
                             WHEN 'HIGH'   THEN priority_type-high
                             ELSE priority_type-low " Default or error handling

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Codezeilen und die Anzahl der nicht-leeren Codezeilen (ohne Kommentare) in einem gegebenen ABAP-Quellcode-String. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` um den String in Zeilen zu zerlegen und `REDUCE` um die Zeilen zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_code_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_code_stats,
             total_lines TYPE i,
             code_lines  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_code_stats.

    METHODS analyze_abap_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_code_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_code_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_abap_code.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_abap_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    rs_stats = REDUCE ty_code_stats(
      INIT total_l = 0 code_l = 0
      FOR line IN lt_lines
      NEXT
        total_l = total_l + 1
        code_l = code_l + COND i(
          WHEN line IS NOT INITIAL AND line(1) <> '*' AND NOT line CS '"' THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_code_analysis.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_code_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_abap_code) = |
* This is a comment
DATA(lv_var) = 'Hello'. " Inline comment

WRITE: / lv_var.
* Another comment
|.

    DATA(ls_stats) = lo_cut->analyze_abap_code( lv_abap_code ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_stats-total_lines exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_stats-code_lines exp = 2 ).

    lv_abap_code = |

* Comment
DATA(lv_test2) = 2.
|.
    ls_stats = lo_cut->analyze_abap_code( lv_abap_code ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_stats-total_lines exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_stats-code_lines exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators, um eine interne Tabelle von Zeilen zu aggregieren und dabei die Gesamtzeilen und die Codezeilen zu zählen. `SPLIT` und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` werden verwendet, um den Code zeilenweise zu verarbeiten. `COND` ermöglicht eine kompakte bedingte Zählung.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Methodennamen aus einem gegebenen ABAP-Klassendefinitions-String. Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` für die Mustererkennung.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein Regex-Muster, das `METHODS` gefolgt vom Methodennamen erkennt, und verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` zum Finden aller Vorkommen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_method_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_method_names
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_regex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_method_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_method_names.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = 'METHODS\s+(\w+)' ignore_case = abap_true ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_abap_code ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lv_method_name) = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      APPEND lv_method_name TO rt_method_names.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen gegebenen ABAP-Code-String, indem Sie jede Zeile um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Leerzeichen einrücken. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und String-Templates.
hint: Zerlegen Sie den Code in Zeilen, verwenden Sie `FOR` um jede Zeile zu verarbeiten und `CONCATENATE` oder String-Templates für die Einrückung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS indent_abap_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_code TYPE string
        iv_indent    TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_code) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD indent_abap_code.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_abap_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    DATA(lv_indent_string) = n_times_char( num = iv_indent char = ' ' ).

    rv_formatted_code = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR line IN lt_lines
      NEXT
        s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |
{ lv_indent_string }{ line }|
          ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ lv_indent_string }{ line }|
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD n_times_char.
    rv_result = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= num
      NEXT
        s = s && char
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_indentation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_indentation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_abap_code) = |
DATA(lv_var) = 'Test'.
WRITE: / lv_var.
|.

    DATA(lv_expected_code) = |
  DATA(lv_var) = 'Test'.
  WRITE: / lv_var.
|.

    DATA(lv_formatted_code) = lo_cut->indent_abap_code( iv_abap_code ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_code exp = lv_expected_code ).

    lv_expected_code = |
    DATA(lv_var) = 'Test'.
    WRITE: / lv_var.
|.
    lv_formatted_code = lo_cut->indent_abap_code( iv_abap_code = lv_abap_code iv_indent = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_code exp = lv_expected_code ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `SPLIT` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit String-Templates, um jede Zeile eines ABAP-Codes einzurücken. Die Hilfsmethode `n_times_char` zeigt eine kompakte Art, einen String aus wiederholten Zeichen zu erzeugen. Dies ist nützlich für die Vorbereitung von Code, der in einem `cl_gui_abapedit` Control angezeigt oder bearbeitet werden soll.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine einfache 'Syntaxprüfung' für einen ABAP-Code-String durch, indem Sie prüfen, ob bestimmte Schlüsselwörter (z.B. 'CLASS', 'METHOD', 'DATA') vorhanden sind. Geben Sie eine Liste der gefundenen Schlüsselwörter zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit `REGEX` oder `SUBSTRING` für jedes Schlüsselwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_syntax_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_keywords
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_keywords) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_syntax_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_keywords.
    DATA(lt_keywords_to_check) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'CLASS' ) ( 'METHOD' ) ( 'DATA' ) ( 'TYPES' ) ( 'INTERFACE' )
    ).

    rt_found_keywords = VALUE #( FOR keyword IN lt_keywords_to_check
                                 LET lv_pattern = |\b{ keyword }\b|
                                 IN
                                 COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 AND
                                              ( FIND REGEX lv_pattern IN iv_abap_code ) IS NOT INITIAL
                                         THEN ( keyword ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_keyword_check FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_keyword_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_syntax_check( ).
    DATA(lv_abap_code) = |
CLASS zcl_my_class DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: lv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS my_method.
ENDCLASS.
|.

    DATA(lt_found) = lo_cut->check_keywords( lv_abap_code ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_found ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_found exp = 'CLASS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_found exp = 'DATA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_found exp = 'METHOD' ).

    lv_abap_code = |
INTERFACE zif_my_interface.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data, id TYPE i, END OF ty_data.
ENDINTERFACE.
|.
    lt_found = lo_cut->check_keywords( lv_abap_code ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_found ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_found exp = 'INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_found exp = 'TYPES' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet den `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `FIND REGEX` und `COND` um effizient eine Liste von Schlüsselwörtern in einem ABAP-Code-String zu finden. Die Verwendung von `\b` im Regex-Muster stellt sicher, dass nur ganze Wörter gefunden werden. Dies simuliert eine grundlegende Syntaxprüfung, wie sie für Code, der in einem `cl_gui_abapedit` Control eingegeben wurde, nützlich sein könnte.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von ABAP-Schlüsselwörtern als String-Tabelle akzeptiert und einen ABAP-Code-String generiert, der diese Schlüsselwörter in einer `SELECT` Anweisung verwendet (z.B. für eine dynamische Query).
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um die Schlüsselwörter zu einer `SELECT` Anweisung zu verbinden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        it_fields TYPE string_table
        iv_table  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_select_statement) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lv_fields_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR field IN it_fields
      NEXT
        s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field
          ELSE |{ s }, { field }|
        )
    ).

    rv_select_statement = |
SELECT { lv_fields_string }
  FROM { iv_table }
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result).
|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Enumerationswert verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `NEW` mit `TYPE` für die dynamische Instanziierung.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und mehrere Klassen, die es implementieren. Verwenden Sie eine Enumeration, um den Typ der zu erstellenden Instanz zu steuern.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS process RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_processor_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processor~process.
    rv_result = 'Processing with A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processor~process.
    rv_result = 'Processing with B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM processor_type STRUCTURE processor_type,
             TYPE_A VALUE 'A',
             TYPE_B VALUE 'B',
           END OF ENUM processor_type.

    CLASS-METHODS create_processor
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE processor_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_processor) TYPE REF TO zif_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_processor.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN processor_type-type_a.
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_processor_a( ).
      WHEN processor_type-type_b.
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_processor_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception or return default
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_refactor IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen ABAP-Code-String in eine interne Tabelle von Zeilen aufteilt und jede Zeile mit ihrer Zeilennummer präfixiert. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` für die Zeilen und `FOR` mit `INDEX` für die Zeilennummerierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_line_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_line_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbered_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_line_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_line_numbers.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_abap_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    rt_numbered_lines = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( lt_lines )
                                 LET lv_line = lt_lines[ i ]
                                 IN
                                 |{ i ALIGN = RIGHT WIDTH = 4 }| && | { lv_line }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_numbering FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_numbering.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_line_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_abap_code) = |
DATA(lv_var) = 'Hello'.
WRITE: / lv_var.
|.

    DATA(lt_expected_lines) = VALUE zcl_abapedit_line_numbers=>string_table(
      ( '   1 DATA(lv_var) = ''Hello''.' )
      ( '   2 WRITE: / lv_var.' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_numbered_lines) = lo_cut->add_line_numbers( lv_abap_code ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbered_lines ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbered_lines[ 1 ] exp = lt_expected_lines[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbered_lines[ 2 ] exp = lt_expected_lines[ 2 ] ).

    lv_abap_code = |
REPORT ztest.
|.
    lt_expected_lines = VALUE zcl_abapedit_line_numbers=>string_table(
      ( '   1 REPORT ztest.' )
    ).
    lt_numbered_lines = lo_cut->add_line_numbers( lv_abap_code ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbered_lines ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbered_lines[ 1 ] exp = lt_expected_lines[ 1 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FOR` Operators mit einem Zähler (`i`) und String-Templates, um jede Zeile eines ABAP-Codes mit einer Zeilennummer zu präfixieren. Die `ALIGN` und `WIDTH` Optionen in String-Templates ermöglichen eine einfache Formatierung der Zeilennummer. Dies ist eine nützliche Funktion für die Anzeige von Code in einem `cl_gui_abapedit` Control, um die Lesbarkeit zu verbessern.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und addieren Sie einen festen Bonusbetrag zu jeder Summe. Bereiten Sie die Daten für eine grafische Darstellung mit `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` vor.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und den `ADD`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_by_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_bonus_amount TYPE s_price DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_flight_price_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_prices.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE tt_flight_price_by_carrid(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_price_by_carrid( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_sum_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0
                                         FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                         NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price ) " ADD operator used here
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                           total_price = lv_sum_price + iv_bonus_amount ) ) ). " ADD operator used here
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_prices( iv_bonus_amount = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Expected at least one entry' act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price should be greater than bonus' act = ls_entry-total_price > 50 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` zur Aggregation von Daten. Der `ADD`-Operator wird innerhalb des inneren `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks verwendet, um die Preise zu summieren, und dann erneut, um einen Bonusbetrag hinzuzufügen. Die so aufbereiteten Daten sind ideal für die Visualisierung in einem Chart mit `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN`.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_occupancy_data.
    TYPES tt_occupancy_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupied_seats_by_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_occupancy_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupied_seats_by_carrid.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_occupancy = REDUCE tt_occupancy_data(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_occupancy_data( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_total_occupied = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                        NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) " ADD operator used here
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                           occupied_seats = lv_total_occupied ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (`SEATSOCC` / `SEATSMAX`) und addieren Sie diese Werte, um eine Gesamtauslastungszahl zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `ADD` für die Berechnung. Die Ergebnisse können in `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` dargestellt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und `ADD` für die Berechnung der Durchschnittswerte und deren Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_occupancy_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrid_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_carrid_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_avg_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_avg_occupancy) TYPE f.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_occupancy) TYPE tt_carrid_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_occupancy_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrid.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_avg_occupancy = REDUCE tt_carrid_occupancy(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid_occupancy( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_total_seatsocc = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                        NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
          lv_total_seatsmax = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                        NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsmax )
          lv_avg_occupancy = COND f( WHEN lv_total_seatsmax > 0 THEN lv_total_seatsocc / lv_total_seatsmax ELSE 0 )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                           avg_occupancy = lv_avg_occupancy ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lt_avg_occupancy) = get_avg_occupancy_by_carrid( ).

    rv_total_avg_occupancy = REDUCE f( INIT s = 0
                                       FOR ls_entry IN lt_avg_occupancy
                                       NEXT s = s + ls_entry-avg_occupancy ). " ADD operator used here
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total average occupancy should be non-negative' act = lv_total_avg >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_occupancy_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_occupancy_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy_by_carrid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Average occupancy table should not be initial' act = lt_avg_occupancy IS NOT INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_avg_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average occupancy should be between 0 and 1' act = ls_entry-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_entry-avg_occupancy <= 1 ).
    ENDLOOP.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine komplexere Aggregation, bei der zunächst die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft mit `REDUCE` und `GROUP BY` berechnet wird. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und deren Werten füllt. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Struktur der Daten zur Laufzeit variiert, z.B. für flexible Chart-Datenquellen in `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbole (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`) für die dynamische Tabellenbearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_value,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_value.
    TYPES tt_field_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_values TYPE tt_field_value
        iv_table_type   TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHTS'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    " Get structure description of the target table type
    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type ).
        lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    " Fill table with one line for demonstration
    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
    LOOP AT it_field_values INTO DATA(ls_field_value).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_value-field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_field> = ls_field_value-field_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_field_values) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_filler=>tt_field_value(
      ( field_name = 'CARRID' field_value = 'LH' )
      ( field_name = 'CONNID' field_value = '0400' )

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INTO <ls_line> INDEX 1.

CLASS zcl_table_appender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

explanation: Die `VALUE #( BASE ... )`-Syntax ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Methode, um Einträge zu einer bestehenden internen Tabelle hinzuzufügen oder diese zu modifizieren. Sie vermeidet die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `APPEND`-Anweisung und ermöglicht eine deklarative Tabellenkonstruktion. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn Daten für die Visualisierung in `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` inkrementell aufgebaut oder aktualisiert werden.
keywords: VALUE, BASE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation, APPEND

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Instanz von `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` erstellt und grundlegende Daten für ein Liniendiagramm setzt. Die Daten sollen aus einer internen Tabelle stammen, die Flugpreise über die Zeit enthält.

CLASS zcl_chart_displayer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_chart_displayer IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und deren durchschnittlichen Preisen in einem String-Template, um eine übersichtliche Zusammenfassung zu erstellen. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und String-Templates. Die Zusammenfassung könnte als Text in einem Chart oder Bericht verwendet werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit String-Templates für dynamische Textgenerierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_summary_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrid_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrid_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_price_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_avg_prices TYPE tt_carrid_avg_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_summary_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_price_summary.
    rv_summary = |Durchschnittliche Flugpreise:\n| &&
                 REDUCE string(
                   INIT s = ``
                   FOR ls_entry IN it_avg_prices
                   NEXT s = s && |  - { ls_entry-carrid }: { ls_entry-avg_price } EUR\n| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_summary_generator( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` mit String-Templates und `FOR`-Iteratoren, um dynamisch formatierte Textzusammenfassungen zu erstellen. Anstatt Strings manuell zu verketten, wird der Text deklarativ aufgebaut, was zu sehr lesbarem und wartbarem Code führt. Solche Zusammenfassungen können als ergänzende Informationen in GUI-Anwendungen oder Berichten, die auch `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` verwenden, angezeigt werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGES-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (Carrier ID) und füllen Sie diese mit den Werten 'LH' und 'UA' unter Verwendung von FOR und VALUE.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE und FOR zur kompakten Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carrier_range RETURNING VALUE(rt_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrid_val IN 'LH', 'UA'
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = carrid_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_carrier_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_range )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Range table should contain 2 entries'
    ).

    DATA(ls_range_entry) = lt_range[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_range_entry-low
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'First entry low value should be LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'I'
      msg = 'First entry sign should be I'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_range_entry-option
      exp = 'EQ'
      msg = 'First entry option should be EQ'
    ).

    ls_range_entry = lt_range[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_range_entry-low
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Second entry low value should be UA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die RANGES-Tabelle wird hier mit der VALUE-Konstruktor-Expression und einer FOR-Iteration kompakt und deklarativ initialisiert. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zur manuellen APPEND-Schleife.
keywords: RANGES, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Declarative

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) basierend auf einer RANGES-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Verwenden Sie die FILTER-Expression in Kombination mit dem IN-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrier_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN it_carrier_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_range_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '300' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' price = '150' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrier_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_sflights(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      it_carrier_range = lt_carrier_range
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Filtered table should contain 3 entries'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'First filtered entry should be LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Second filtered entry should be UA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 3 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Third filtered entry should be LH'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FILTER-Expression ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern interner Tabellen. In Kombination mit dem IN-Operator kann eine RANGES-Tabelle direkt als Filterkriterium verwendet werden, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, Internal Tables, IN Operator, Declarative

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei RANGES-Tabellen für Fluggesellschaften, um eine neue RANGES-Tabelle zu erstellen, die alle Einträge beider Tabellen enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um die Einträge aus beiden Tabellen in einer neuen zu konsolidieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS combine_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_range1 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
        it_range2 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_ranges.
    rt_combined_range = REDUCE #( 
      INIT r = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid( )
      FOR entry IN it_range1
      APPEND entry TO r
      FOR entry IN it_range2
      APPEND entry TO r
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_ranges.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_combine( ).

    DATA(lt_range1) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_range2) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'DL' high = 'QF' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_ranges(
      it_range1 = lt_range1
      it_range2 = lt_range2
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_combined )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Combined range table should contain 4 entries'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_combined[ low = 'LH' ] )
      msg = 'LH should be in combined range'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_combined[ low = 'UA' ] )
      msg = 'UA should be in combined range'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_combined[ low = 'AA' ] )
      msg = 'AA should be in combined range'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_combined[ low = 'DL' high = 'QF' ] )
      msg = 'DL-QF should be in combined range'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die REDUCE-Expression ist ideal, um eine neue interne Tabelle (hier eine RANGES-Tabelle) aus den Elementen anderer Tabellen zu konstruieren. Die FOR-Iteratoren ermöglichen das Hinzufügen von Einträgen aus mehreren Quelltabellen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Combine, Declarative

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGES-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften, die alle eindeutigen Carrier-IDs aus der sflights-Tabelle enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT DISTINCT und FOR in Kombination mit VALUE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_from_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carrier_range RETURNING VALUE(rt_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_from_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrier_range.
    DATA: lt_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_carrids.

    rt_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrid_val IN lt_carrids
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = carrid_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_carrier_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_carrier_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_from_select( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrier_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = lines( lt_range ) > 0
      msg = 'Range table should not be empty'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_range[ low = 'LH' ] )
      msg = 'LH should be in the range'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_range[ low = 'UA' ] )
      msg = 'UA should be in the range'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine RANGES-Tabelle dynamisch aus Datenbankergebnissen füllt. Die Kombination von SELECT DISTINCT mit INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und der anschließenden VALUE-Expression mit FOR für die RANGES-Tabelle ist eine effiziente und moderne Methode.
keywords: RANGES, SELECT, Database Access, VALUE, FOR, DISTINCT

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten aus der sflights-Tabelle für eine bestimmte Menge von Fluggesellschaften, die in einer RANGES-Tabelle definiert sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie den IN-Operator direkt in der WHERE-Klausel des SELECT-Statements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_select_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_by_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_select_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_by_range.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrier_range
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflights_by_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflights_by_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_select_where( ).

    DATA(lt_carrier_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sflights_by_range( lt_carrier_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = lines( lt_sflights ) > 0
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ls_sflight-carrid IN lt_carrier_range
        msg = |Carrier { ls_sflight-carrid } not in range|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dies ist die klassische und effizienteste Art, RANGES-Tabellen in SELECT-Statements zu verwenden. Der IN-Operator in der WHERE-Klausel wird vom Datenbank-Layer optimiert und ist die bevorzugte Methode für dynamische Selektionen.
keywords: RANGES, SELECT, WHERE Clause, IN Operator, Database Access

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API durch und geben Sie den Statuscode sowie den Inhalt der Antwort zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und die Methoden `send`, `receive` und `get_cdata` des HTTP-Clients.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url        TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_status_code TYPE i
        ev_response_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        ev_status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
        ev_response_data = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check cx_http_dest_no_service.
        ev_status_code = -1.
        ev_response_data = 'Error during HTTP request'.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_request( ).
    DATA(lv_status_code) = 0.
    DATA(lv_response_data) = ``.

    " Verwenden Sie eine echte, erreichbare URL für den Test
    lo_cut->get_data_from_url(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url         = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'
      IMPORTING
        ev_status_code = lv_status_code
        ev_response_data = lv_response_data
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_code exp = 200 msg = 'Expected status code 200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_response_data msg = 'Expected response data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_request( ).
    DATA(lv_status_code) = 0.
    DATA(lv_response_data) = ``.

    " Verwenden Sie eine ungültige URL für den Fehlerfall
    lo_cut->get_data_from_url(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url         = 'http://invalid.url.example.com'
      IMPORTING
        ev_status_code = lv_status_code
        ev_response_data = lv_response_data
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_code exp = -1 msg = 'Expected error status code -1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_response_data exp = 'Error' msg = 'Expected error message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_http_client` für einen GET-Request. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_http_client)`) und die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (`lo_http_client->send()->receive()`) sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken, die den Code lesbarer und kompakter machen. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über `TRY...CATCH`.
keywords: HTTP, GET, cl_http_client, DATA, Inline Declaration, Web Service

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine API und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_http_client`, `set_cdata`, `set_header_field` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` für den Request. Für die JSON-Verarbeitung `cl_abap_unit_json` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_data,
             title TYPE string,
             body  TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_response,
             id    TYPE i,
             title TYPE string,
             body  TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_response.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        is_data        TYPE ty_post_data
        iv_url         TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_status_code TYPE i
        es_response    TYPE ty_post_response
        ev_error_msg   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_request TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " 1. JSON-Payload erstellen
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE is_data RESULT XML lv_json_request.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '<\/?(TITLE|BODY|USERID)>' IN lv_json_request WITH ''. " Remove XML tags
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '<\/?(TY_POST_DATA)>' IN lv_json_request WITH ''.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '(<\?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"\?>)' IN lv_json_request WITH ''.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\n' IN lv_json_request WITH ''.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s{2,}' IN lv_json_request WITH ' '.

        " Workaround for simple JSON serialization without external libraries
        lv_json_request = |{{"title":"{ is_data-title }","body":"{ is_data-body }","userId":{ is_data-userid }}}|.

        " 2. HTTP-Client erstellen
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
        ).

        " 3. Request-Methode auf POST setzen
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).

        " 4. Header setzen (Content-Type)
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'Content-Type'
          value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
        ).

        " 5. Payload setzen
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata(
          data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_json_request codepage = 'UTF-8' )
        ).

        " 6. Request senden und Antwort empfangen
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        ev_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        IF ev_status_code = 201. " Created
          " 7. JSON-Antwort parsen
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
            EXPORTING
              json        = lv_json_response
            CHANGING
              data        = es_response
          ).
        ELSE.
          ev_error_msg = lv_json_response.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_static_check cx_http_dest_no_service cx_abap_conv_x2x_error cx_abap_json_serializer_error.
        ev_status_code = -1.
        ev_error_msg = sy-msgv1.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Header-Felder einer HTTP-Antwort aus und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `get_header_fields` des HTTP-Response-Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_response_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_field,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header_field.
    TYPES ty_header_fields_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_response_headers
      IMPORTING
        iv_url         TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        et_headers     TYPE ty_header_fields_tt
        ev_status_code TYPE i
        ev_error_msg   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_response_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_response_headers.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lt_header_fields TYPE if_http_client=>tt_header_fields.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        ev_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).

        IF ev_status_code >= 200 AND ev_status_code < 300.
          lt_header_fields = lo_http_client->response->get_header_fields( ).
          et_headers = VALUE #( FOR <fs_header> IN lt_header_fields
                                 ( name = <fs_header>-name value = <fs_header>-value ) ).
        ELSE.
          ev_error_msg = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_static_check cx_http_dest_no_service.
        ev_status_code = -1.
        ev_error_msg = 'Error during HTTP request'.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine URL und extrahieren Sie die Query-Parameter als Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `cl_http_utility=>parse_url`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_query_params_tt TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS parse_query_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_url         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_params) TYPE ty_query_params_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_query_params.
    DATA: lv_scheme   TYPE string,
          lv_host     TYPE string,
          lv_port     TYPE string,
          lv_path     TYPE string,
          lv_query    TYPE string,
          lv_fragment TYPE string.

    cl_http_utility=>parse_url(
      EXPORTING
        url       = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        scheme    = lv_scheme
        host      = lv_host
        port      = lv_port
        path      = lv_path
        query     = lv_query
        fragment  = lv_fragment
    ).

    IF lv_query IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_query_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
      SPLIT lv_query AT '&' INTO TABLE lt_query_parts.

      rt_params = VALUE #( FOR lv_part IN lt_query_parts
                             LET lv_name  = substring_before( val = lv_part sep = '=' )
                                 lv_value = substring_after(  val = lv_part sep = '=' )
                             IN
                             ( lv_name = cl_http_utility=>url_decode( lv_value ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie nur bestimmte Felder auswählen und umbenennen, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_table_transformation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES ty_sflight_raw_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES ty_flight_summary_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE ty_sflight_raw_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transformation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
      ( airline_id   = ls_raw-carrid
        flight_num   = ls_raw-connid
        flight_date  = ls_raw-fldate
        ticket_price = ls_raw-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES ty_sflight_price_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_price_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( 0 ) " Initialwert für die Summe
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights " Iteration über die Tabelle
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ). " Aggregationslogik
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES ty_carrier_flight_count_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_data_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_flight_count_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
