Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel (Unique Key) und versuchen Sie, einen doppelten Eintrag hinzuzufügen, um den Fehler abzufangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WITH UNIQUE KEY` bei der Typdefinition und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_key_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_items_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_item
      IMPORTING
        is_item      TYPE ty_item
      EXPORTING
        ev_success   TYPE abap_bool
        ev_error_msg TYPE string.

    METHODS get_items RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE ty_items_tt.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_items TYPE ty_items_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_key_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_item.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_item INTO TABLE mt_items.
        ev_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        ev_error_msg = |Item with ID { is_item-id } already exists.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_items.
    rt_items = mt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_unique_item FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_item FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_multiple_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_key_table( ).
    DATA(ls_item) = VALUE zcl_unique_key_table=>ty_item( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_error) = ``.

    lo_cut->add_item(
      EXPORTING
        is_item      = ls_item
      IMPORTING
        ev_success   = lv_success
        ev_error_msg = lv_error
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Expected success for unique item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_error msg = 'No error expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_items() ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 item in table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_key_table( ).
    DATA(ls_item1) = VALUE zcl_unique_key_table=>ty_item( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ).
    DATA(ls_item2) = VALUE zcl_unique_key_table=>ty_item( id = 1 name = 'Item B' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_error) = ``.

    lo_cut->add_item( is_item = ls_item1 IMPORTING ev_success = lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Expected success for first item' ).

    lo_cut->add_item(
      EXPORTING
        is_item      = ls_item2
      IMPORTING
        ev_success   = lv_success
        ev_error_msg = lv_error
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Expected failure for duplicate item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_error msg = 'Expected error message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_items() ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 item in table after duplicate attempt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_items()[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Item A' msg = 'Original item should remain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_multiple_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_key_table( ).
    lo_cut->add_item( VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item 1' ) ).
    lo_cut->add_item( VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item 2' ) ).
    lo_cut->add_item( VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'Item 3' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_items() ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 items in table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration einer internen Tabelle mit `WITH UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge basierend auf dem angegebenen Schlüssel hinzugefügt werden können. Versuche, Duplikate einzufügen, führen zu einer Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key`, die mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen werden kann. Dies ist eine robuste Methode zur Sicherstellung der Datenintegrität.
keywords: DATA, Internal Tables, Unique Key, Exception Handling, cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle über einen Tabellenausdruck zu und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass die Zeile nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key ... ]` oder `itab[ index ]` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES ty_sflight_key_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_flights   TYPE ty_sflight_key_tt
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date
      EXPORTING
        es_flight    TYPE ty_sflight_key
        ev_found     TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    TRY.
        es_flight = it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid
                                                      connid = iv_connid
                                                      fldate = iv_fldate ].
        ev_found = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR es_flight.
        ev_found = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      EXPORTING
        it_flights = lt_flights
        iv_carrid  = 'LH'
        iv_connid  = '0400'
        iv_fldate  = '20251125'
      IMPORTING
        es_flight  = ls_flight
        ev_found   = lv_found
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_found msg = 'Flight should not be found in empty table' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) sind die moderne und bevorzugte Methode, um auf einzelne Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen. Sie sind kompakter und oft performanter als `READ TABLE`. Das Abfangen von `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ist entscheidend, um den Fall zu behandeln, dass keine passende Zeile gefunden wird, und so Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und behandeln Sie verschiedene HTTP-Statuscodes (z.B. 200, 401, 404) explizit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung für den Statuscode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_status_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_resource_with_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_url         TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_message     TYPE string
        ev_status_code TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_resource_with_status.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        ev_status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).

        CASE ev_status_code.
          WHEN 200.
            ev_message = 'Ressource erfolgreich abgerufen: ' && lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).
          WHEN 401.
            ev_message = 'Fehler 401: Nicht autorisiert. Bitte überprüfen Sie Ihre Anmeldeinformationen.'.
          WHEN 404.
            ev_message = 'Fehler 404: Ressource nicht gefunden.'.
          WHEN 500.
            ev_message = 'Fehler 500: Interner Serverfehler.'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            ev_message = |Unerwarteter HTTP-Statuscode: { ev_status_code } - { lo_http_client->get_cdata() }|.
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_static_check cx_http_dest_no_service.
        ev_status_code = -1.
        ev_message = 'Fehler bei der HTTP-Kommunikation'.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit einem API-Schlüssel im Header durch, um eine authentifizierte Anfrage zu simulieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>request->set_header_field` um den API-Schlüssel zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_auth_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_authenticated_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url         TYPE string
        iv_api_key     TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_status_code TYPE i
        ev_response_data TYPE string
        ev_error_msg   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_auth_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_authenticated_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
        ).

        " API-Schlüssel im Header setzen
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'X-API-Key'
          value = iv_api_key
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        ev_status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
        ev_response_data = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

        IF ev_status_code >= 400.
          ev_error_msg = ev_response_data.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_static_check cx_http_dest_no_service.
        ev_status_code = -1.
        ev_error_msg = 'Fehler bei der HTTP-Kommunikation'.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_auth_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_auth_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_auth_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_auth_request( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://api.publicapis.org/entries'. " Eine API, die möglicherweise einen Schlüssel erwartet, aber auch ohne funktioniert
    DATA(lv_api_key) = 'YOUR_VALID_API_KEY'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch einen echten/simulierten Schlüssel
    DATA(lv_status) = 0.
    DATA(lv_response) = ``.
    DATA(lv_error) = ``.

    lo_cut->fetch_authenticated_data(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url         = lv_url
        iv_api_key     = lv_api_key
      IMPORTING
        ev_status_code = lv_status
        ev_response_data = lv_response
        ev_error_msg   = lv_error
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 200 msg = 'Expected status 200 for valid key' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_response msg = 'Expected response data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_error msg = 'No error expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_auth_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_auth_request( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://api.publicapis.org/entries'.
    DATA(lv_api_key) = 'INVALID_KEY'. " Ein ungültiger Schlüssel
    DATA(lv_status) = 0.
    DATA(lv_response) = ``.
    DATA(lv_error) = ``.

    lo_cut->fetch_authenticated_data(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url         = lv_url
        iv_api_key     = lv_api_key
      IMPORTING
        ev_status_code = lv_status
        ev_response_data = lv_response
        ev_error_msg   = lv_error
    ).

    " Erwarten Sie einen Fehlerstatus (z.B. 401, 403, oder 200, wenn die API den Schlüssel ignoriert)
    " Hier wird 200 erwartet, da die Beispiel-API den Schlüssel ignoriert. Für eine echte API wäre dies 401/403.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 200 msg = 'Expected status 200 (API ignores key)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_error msg = 'No error expected from API (key ignored)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Authentifizierung über API-Schlüssel im HTTP-Header ist ein gängiges Muster. `cl_http_client=>request->set_header_field` ermöglicht das einfache Hinzufügen benutzerdefinierter Header. Dies ist eine moderne und sichere Methode, um sich gegenüber externen Diensten zu authentifizieren, ohne Anmeldeinformationen im URL zu exponieren.
keywords: HTTP, Authentication, API Key, Header, cl_http_client, Security

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Objekttypen (z.B. `cl_abap_char_utilities`, `cl_abap_unit_assert`) dynamisch erkennt und spezifische Informationen basierend auf ihrem Typ zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF` und `CAST` für die dynamische Typenprüfung zur Laufzeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_object
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_object.
    CASE TYPE OF io_object.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_char_utilities INTO DATA(lo_char_utils).
        rv_info = |Object is CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES. Linefeed: { lo_char_utils->cr_lf }|.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_unit_assert INTO DATA(lo_assert).
        rv_info = 'Object is CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT. Ready for testing.' .
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_info = |Object is of unknown type: { cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( io_object ) }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_rtti_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_rtti_processor( ).

    DATA(lo_char_utils) = NEW cl_abap_char_utilities( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lo_processor->process_object( lo_char_utils ) exp = 'CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES' ).

    DATA(lo_assert) = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lo_processor->process_object( lo_assert ) exp = 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' ).

    DATA(lo_object) = NEW object( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lo_processor->process_object( lo_object ) exp = 'unknown type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine typsichere und elegante Verarbeitung von Polymorphie zur Laufzeit. Es erlaubt, verschiedene Objekttypen in einer `CASE`-Struktur zu unterscheiden und direkt in eine spezifische Referenz zu casten (`INTO DATA(...)`), was den Code sauberer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als manuelle `CAST`-Operationen.
keywords: RTTI, CASE TYPE OF, WHEN, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, CAST

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch und fangen Sie spezifisch die Ausnahme für Division durch Null ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit `WHEN cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_quotient) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Division successful: { lv_quotient }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler bei der Division: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_valid_division FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') haben und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FILTER` oder `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_flight_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flight_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                             fldate > sy-datum )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_future_flight_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flight_sum.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_sum_lh) = lo_aggregator->get_future_flight_sum( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_sum_aa) = lo_aggregator->get_future_flight_sum( 'AA' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt LH-Flüge in der Zukunft mit Preisen > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_sum_aa ). " AA hat möglicherweise keine zukünftigen Flüge oder keine Daten
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_sum_lh ). " LH sollte zukünftige Flüge haben

    " Für einen präziseren Test müsste sflights gemockt oder Testdaten eingefügt werden.
    " Hier nur eine grundlegende Überprüfung.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten in einer funktionalen Weise. In Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel wird die Iteration und Bedingungsprüfung direkt im Ausdruck vorgenommen, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht, im Vergleich zu einer expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisung mit `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: REDUCE, WHEN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'UA') haben und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                  fldate > sy-datum )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                            connid = flight-connid,
                            fldate = flight-fldate,
                            price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_ua_flights) = lo_filter->get_future_flights( 'UA' ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_filter->get_future_flights( 'LH' ).

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf der Abflugzeit und einem optionalen Statuscode. Wenn der Statuscode 'X' ist, ist der Flug annulliert. Wenn die Abflugzeit in der Vergangenheit liegt, ist er 'Verspätet', ansonsten 'Pünktlich'.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck mit mehreren `WHEN`-Bedingungen.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_fltime   TYPE s_time
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'X' THEN 'Annulliert'
      WHEN iv_fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN iv_fldate = sy-datum AND iv_fltime < sy-uzeit THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).

    " Annulliert
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum iv_fltime = sy-uzeit iv_status_code = 'X' ) exp = 'Annulliert' ).

    " Verspätet (Datum in Vergangenheit)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum - 1 iv_fltime = '120000' ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).

    " Verspätet (Uhrzeit in Vergangenheit am aktuellen Tag)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum iv_fltime = '000000' ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).

    " Pünktlich (Zukunft)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum + 1 iv_fltime = '120000' ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).

    " Pünktlich (Aktueller Tag, Uhrzeit in Zukunft)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum iv_fltime = sy-uzeit + 1 ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

             WHEN price >= 200 AND price < 500 THEN 'Standard'
             ELSE 'Teuer'

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme in einer aufrufenden Methode ab, protokollieren Sie sie und werfen Sie dann eine andere, spezifischere Ausnahme weiter, die den ursprünglichen Fehler kontextualisiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und den `THROW`-Ausdruck im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_processing_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA original_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid           LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous         TYPE REF TO cx_root OPTIONAL
        original_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_processing_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->original_exception = original_exception.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_error
      RAISING zcx_custom_error.

    METHODS process_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING zcx_processing_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    TRY.
        trigger_error( ).
        rv_message = 'Data processed successfully.'.
      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_custom_error).
        " Protokollierung des ursprünglichen Fehlers
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Originalfehler: { lx_custom_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        " Weiterwerfen einer spezifischeren Ausnahme mit THROW
        THROW NEW zcx_processing_error( original_exception = lx_custom_error
                                        textid = zcx_processing_error=>default_text ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_exception_rethrow FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_processing_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_rethrow.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_handler->process_data( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception ZCX_PROCESSING_ERROR was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_processing_error INTO DATA(lx_processing_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_processing_error->original_exception ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( lx_processing_error->original_exception ) exp = 'ZCX_CUSTOM_ERROR' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_processing_error->get_text( ) exp = 'Fehler bei der Verarbeitung' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `THROW`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.55) ermöglicht das Weiterwerfen von Ausnahmen in einer funktionalen Syntax, was die Fehlerbehandlung in komplexen Szenarien flexibler macht. Hier wird eine generische benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme abgefangen, protokolliert und dann als eine spezifischere Ausnahme (`zcx_processing_error`) weitergeworfen, die den ursprünglichen Fehler als Attribut enthält. Dies verbessert die Nachvollziehbarkeit von Fehlern in mehrschichtigen Anwendungen.
keywords: THROW, RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY, CATCH, WHEN, Exception Handling, Custom Exception, cx_static_check

CLASS zcl_flight_data_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id

CLASS zcl_flight_data_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                          fldate > sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_aircrafts
      IMPORTING
        it_aircrafts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_aircraft WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_aircrafts.
    LOOP AT it_aircrafts INTO DATA(lo_aircraft).
      CASE TYPE OF lo_aircraft.
        WHEN TYPE zcl_passenger_aircraft INTO DATA(lo_passenger_ac).
          APPEND |Verarbeite Passagierflugzeug: { lo_passenger_ac->zif_aircraft~get_type_description() }| TO rt_processed_info.
        WHEN TYPE zcl_cargo_aircraft INTO DATA(lo_cargo_ac).
          APPEND |Verarbeite Frachtflugzeug: { lo_cargo_ac->zif_aircraft~get_type_description() }| TO rt_processed_info.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND |Verarbeite unbekanntes Flugzeug: { lo_aircraft->get_type_description() }| TO rt_processed_info.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit String-Templates (hier nicht direkt im `SWITCH`, aber für die Ausgabe nützlich) führt dies zu sehr modernem und wartbarem Code für bedingte String-Generierung.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der internen Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights. " Populate internal table for demo

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der internen Tabelle `sflights`, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden und einen Preis über einem Schwellenwert haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights. " Populate internal table for demo

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_demo( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' has flights with price > 1000
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find expensive LH flights' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Wrong airline' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Price too low' act = ls_flight-price > 1000 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_demo( ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has no flights with price > 1000000
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_price = 1000000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should find no expensive AA flights' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `DELETE itab WHERE`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der internen Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights. " Populate internal table for demo

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER und String Templates mit REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_profile_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_params RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_profile_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_params.
    DATA(lo_profile) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    DATA(lt_param_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' ) ( 'rdisp/wp_no_dia' ) ).
    DATA(lt_param_values) = VALUE #( ).

    LOOP AT lt_param_names INTO DATA(lv_name).
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_value) = lo_profile->get_parameter_value( iv_parameter_name = lv_name ).
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_name value = lv_value ) TO lt_param_values.
        CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_name value = 'N/A' ) TO lt_param_values.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_output = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR <param> IN lt_param_values
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                                |{ <param>-name }:{ <param>-value }|
                              ELSE
                                |{ s }, { <param>-name }:{ <param>-value }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 3 Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und erstellen Sie einen String, der für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Datum auflistet, getrennt durch Zeilenumbrüche.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT UP TO, REDUCE-Operator und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_flight,
            carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
            connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
            fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
          END OF ls_flight.
    DATA lt_flights LIKE TABLE OF ls_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_flights
      UP TO 3 ROWS.

    rv_summary = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR <flight> IN lt_flights
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                                |Flug { <flight>-carrid } { <flight>-connid } am { <flight>-fldate DATE = USER }|
                              ELSE
                                |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }Flug { <flight>-carrid } { <flight>-connid } am { <flight>-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_profile_param DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
             type  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_info.

    METHODS get_param_type_info RETURNING VALUE(rs_param_info) TYPE ty_param_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_profile_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_param_type_info.
    DATA(lo_profile) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    DATA(lv_param_name) = 'rdisp/max_wprun_time'.

    rs_param_info-name = lv_param_name.

    TRY.
        rs_param_info-value = lo_profile->get_parameter_value( iv_parameter_name = lv_param_name ).
        DATA(lo_data_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rs_param_info-value ).
        rs_param_info-type = lo_data_descr->type_kind.
      CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter.
        rs_param_info-value = 'Error: Parameter not found'.
        rs_param_info-type = 'N/A'.
      CATCH cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        rs_param_info-type = 'Error: Type description failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_info RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_flight_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_info.
    DATA lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflight_raw
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight_raw
                           ( carrid    = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                             connid    = <fs_sflight>-connid
                             fldate    = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                             flight_info = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }-{ <fs_sflight>-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Flugnummern (`FLDATE`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um die Liste zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_list.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_flight_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <fs_sflight>-fldate
        ELSE |{ result }, { <fs_sflight>-fldate }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Geben Sie die gesamte Flugzeile zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Struktur als `INIT`-Wert und vergleichen Sie die Preise in der `NEXT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_highest_price_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_highest_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rs_highest_flight = REDUCE sflight(
      INIT max_flight = VALUE sflight( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_flight = COND #( 
        WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > max_flight-price THEN <fs_sflight>
        ELSE max_flight
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_highest_price_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_highest_price_flight_no_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_highest_price_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(ls_expected_flight) TYPE sflight.

    " Find expected highest price flight manually for comparison
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_expected_flight
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    DATA(ls_actual_flight) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_flight( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_flight-price
      exp = ls_expected_flight-price
      msg = 'Der höchste Flugpreis sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_flight-fldate
      exp = ls_expected_flight-fldate
      msg = 'Das Flugdatum des teuersten Fluges sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_highest_price_flight_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_actual_flight) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_flight( 'XX' ). " Assuming 'XX' has no flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann, um eine komplexe Aggregation durchzuführen, die nicht nur einen skalaren Wert, sondern eine ganze Datenstruktur zurückgibt. Durch die Initialisierung mit einer leeren Struktur und die bedingte Zuweisung (`COND`) in `NEXT` wird der Flug mit dem höchsten Preis effizient ermittelt.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und speichern Sie die Flüge jeder Gesellschaft in einer separaten internen Tabelle. Das Ergebnis soll eine Hashed Table sein, deren Schlüssel die `CARRID` ist und deren Wert eine Tabelle von `sflight` ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `HASHED TABLE` als `INIT`-Wert und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = REDUCE tt_grouped_flights(
      INIT grouped_table = VALUE tt_grouped_flights( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid IN
      NEXT grouped_table = VALUE tt_grouped_flights(
        grouped_table
        ( carrid = lv_carrid
          flights = VALUE #( 
            ( LINES OF grouped_table[ KEY carrid = lv_carrid ]-flights OPTIONAL )
            ( <fs_sflight> )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    " Check if grouping worked for 'AA'
    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_grouped_flights[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_aa_group-flights
      msg = 'Flüge für AA sollten vorhanden sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_group-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'CARRID in der Gruppe sollte AA sein.'
    ).

    " Check count for a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH')
    DATA(lv_expected_lh_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_lh_count WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_grouped_flights[ KEY carrid = 'LH' OPTIONAL ].
    IF ls_lh_group IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lines( ls_lh_group-flights )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis enthält. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight
                       WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate connid
                       INITIAL SIZE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_summary = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid
      LET lv_count = lines( GROUP <fs_group> ) IN
      LET lv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                             INIT sum_p = 0
                             FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP <fs_group>
                             NEXT sum_p = sum_p + <fs_flight>-price
                           ) IN
      NEXT summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
        summaries
        ( carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid
          flight_count = lv_count
          avg_price   = COND s_price(
                          WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count
                          ELSE 0
                        )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    IF ls_aa_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_expected_count_aa) = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_sum_price_aa) = 0.
      SELECT COUNT(*) SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO (@lv_expected_count_aa, @lv_expected_sum_price_aa)
        WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count

        msg = 'Fluganzahl für AA sollte korrekt sein.'

        exp = COND s_price(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (`SCARR`), die nur die Fluggesellschaften enthält, die Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben. Die neue Tabelle soll nur die `CARRID` und `CARRNAME` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_info TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_info
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_high_price_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight
                       WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate connid
                       INITIAL SIZE 0.
    DATA: lt_scarr TYPE SORTED TABLE OF scarr
                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid
                    INITIAL SIZE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    rt_carriers = REDUCE tt_carrier_info(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_info( )
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid
      LET lv_has_high_price_flight = xsdbool(
                                       LINE_EXISTS( 
                                         FILTER #( GROUP <fs_group> WHERE price > iv_min_price )
                                       )
                                     ) IN
      IF lv_has_high_price_flight = abap_true.
        DATA(ls_scarr) = lt_scarr[ KEY primary_key carrid = <fs_group>-carrid ].
        result = VALUE tt_carrier_info(
          result
          ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid
            carrname = ls_scarr-carrname )
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_high_price_carriers_all_match FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_price_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_carr( ).

    DATA(lt_actual_carriers) = lo_cut->get_high_price_carriers( lv_min_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_actual_carriers
      msg = 'Es sollten Fluggesellschaften mit Flügen über dem Schwellenwert gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Verify a known carrier (e.g., 'AA') is in the result if it has high-price flights
    DATA(lv_aa_has_high_price) = xsdbool(
                                   LINE_EXISTS( 
                                     sflight[ carrid = 'AA' price > lv_min_price ]
                                   )
                                 ).
    IF lv_aa_has_high_price = abap_true.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = lt_actual_carriers[ carrid = 'AA' OPTIONAL ]
        msg = 'AA sollte in der Ergebnisliste sein, wenn es teure Flüge hat.'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = lt_actual_carriers[ carrid = 'AA' OPTIONAL ]
        msg = 'AA sollte NICHT in der Ergebnisliste sein, wenn es keine teuren Flüge hat.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_high_price_carriers_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_carr( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = '999999999'. " Very high price, unlikely to match

    DATA(lt_actual_carriers) = lo_cut->get_high_price_carriers( lv_min_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

      act = lines( lt_actual_carriers )
      exp = lv_expected_count
      msg = 'Alle Fluggesellschaften sollten gefunden werden, wenn der Schwellenwert 0 ist.'
    ).

Die Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` und `xsdbool` macht die Bedingungsprüfung sehr prägnant und effizient. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Ausdrücke für komplexe Datenanalysen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) eine Liste der Flugdaten (`FLDATE`) als String enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Die Liste der Flugdaten soll kommasepariert sein.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS`, `FILTER` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filtered_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_dates,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldates TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_dates.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_dates TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_dates
                              WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_fldates
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_dates) TYPE tt_carrier_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filtered_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_fldates.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight
                       WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate connid
                       INITIAL SIZE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_dates = REDUCE tt_carrier_dates(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_dates( )
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid
      LET lt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( GROUP <fs_group> WHERE fldate > iv_min_fldate ) IN
      IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(lv_fldate_list) = REDUCE string(
                                 INIT date_list = ''
                                 FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
                                 NEXT date_list = COND string(
                                   WHEN date_list IS INITIAL THEN <fs_flight>-fldate
                                   ELSE |{ date_list }, { <fs_flight>-fldate }|
                                 )
                               ).
        result = VALUE tt_carrier_dates(
          result
          ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
            fldates = lv_fldate_list )
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie ein JSON-Objekt als Payload in einem HTTP POST-Request und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url`, `set_request_body_cdata` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID OPTIONS JSON`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_request_data,
        name TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_request_data,
      BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
        status TYPE string,
        message TYPE string,
      END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        is_request_data TYPE ty_request_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response_data) TYPE ty_response_data
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_io_error
        cx_transformation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_request TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string.

    " Serialize request data to JSON
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE is_request_data = is_request_data
      RESULT XML lv_json_request
      OPTIONS json.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).

    " Deserialize JSON response
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE XML lv_json_response
      RESULT rs_response_data = rs_response_data
      OPTIONS json.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Senden Sie Binärdaten (XSTRING) als Payload in einem HTTP POST-Request, um einen Dateiupload zu simulieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_binary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS post_binary_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        ix_data TYPE xstring
        iv_filename TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_content_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'application/octet-stream'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_binary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_binary_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = iv_content_type ).
    IF iv_filename IS NOT INITIAL.
      lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Disposition' value = |attachment; filename="{ iv_filename }"| ).
    ENDIF.
    lo_http_client->request->set_xdata( ix_data ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) in einen CSV-String, wobei jede Zeile durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        price TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_csv.
    " Header row
    DATA(lv_header) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY`.

    " Data rows
    DATA(lv_data_rows) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                   |{ ls_flight-carrid };{ ls_flight-connid };{ ls_flight-fldate };{ ls_flight-price };{ ls_flight-currency }|
                 ELSE
                   |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ ls_flight-carrid };{ ls_flight-connid };{ ls_flight-fldate };{ ls_flight-price };{ ls_flight-currency }| ) ).

    IF lv_data_rows IS INITIAL.
      rv_csv_string = lv_header.
    ELSE.
      rv_csv_string = |{ lv_header }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ lv_data_rows }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-Request durch und behandeln Sie verschiedene HTTP-Statuscodes in der Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `if_http_client->response->get_status()` und `CASE` für die Statuscode-Behandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_status_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_http_response
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_http_response.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    DATA(lv_status_text) = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).

    CASE lv_status_code.
      WHEN 200.
        rv_message = |Success: { lv_status_text }|.
      WHEN 400.
        rv_message = |Client Error: Bad Request ({ lv_status_text })|.
      WHEN 404.
        rv_message = |Client Error: Not Found ({ lv_status_text })|.
      WHEN 500.
        rv_message = |Server Error: Internal Server Error ({ lv_status_text })|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = |Unexpected Status: { lv_status_code } { lv_status_text }|.
    ENDCASE.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA256-Hash-Wert von Binärdaten (XSTRING).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_digest`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sha256_hash) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create(
      EXPORTING

    lo_hasher->update( ix_data ).
    DATA(lx_hash) = lo_hasher->get_hash( ).

    rv_sha256_hash = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_converter( )->convert( lx_hash ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compressor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `MATCHES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_email_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_reg_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_email.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
      case_sensitive = abap_false
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_email ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->matches( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'user.name@domain.co.uk' ) msg = 'Valid email 2' ).

Dies ist eine saubere und wiederverwendbare Methode zur Mustererkennung.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Vor- und Nachnamen aus einem String im Format "Nachname, Vorname".
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `SEARCH` mit Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_name_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name.
    METHODS extract_name IMPORTING iv_full_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rs_name) TYPE ty_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_name_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_name.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = '^(\w+),\s*(\w+)$' " Matches 'Lastname, Firstname'
      case_sensitive = abap_false
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_full_name ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) = abap_true.
      rs_name-last_name = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_name-first_name = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_name FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_name_extractor( ).
    DATA(ls_name) = lo_cut->extract_name( 'Mustermann, Max' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_name-last_name  exp = 'Mustermann' msg = 'Last name' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_name-first_name exp = 'Max'        msg = 'First name' ).

    ls_name = lo_cut->extract_name( 'Doe, John' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_name-last_name  exp = 'Doe'        msg = 'Last name 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_name-first_name exp = 'John'       msg = 'First name 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_name_extractor( ).
    DATA(ls_name) = lo_cut->extract_name( 'Max Mustermann' ). " Wrong format
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_name-last_name  msg = 'No last name' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_name-first_name msg = 'No first name' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `MATCH` prüft nicht nur, sondern setzt auch die Submatches, die dann mit `GET_SUBMATCH` (basierend auf der Klammerung im Regex-Muster) ausgelesen werden können. Dies ist effizienter als manuelle String-Operationen.
keywords: REGEX, EXTRACT, SUBMATCH, String, CL_ABAP_REGEX

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen von doppelten Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen in einem String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_space_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS reduce_spaces IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_reduced_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_space_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_spaces.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = '\s{2,}' " Matches two or more whitespace characters
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_reduced_text = lo_matcher->replace( replacement = ` ` ). " Replace with single space
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_spaces FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_change FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_space_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->reduce_spaces( 'This   text  has   too many   spaces.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'This text has too many spaces.' msg = 'Multiple spaces reduced' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->reduce_spaces( '  Leading and trailing  ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = ' Leading and trailing ' msg = 'Leading/trailing spaces' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_change.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_space_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->reduce_spaces( 'This text has single spaces.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'This text has single spaces.' msg = 'No change needed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REPLACE`-Methode des Matchers ist ideal für das Ersetzen von Mustern. Hier wird `\s{2,}` verwendet, um zwei oder mehr aufeinanderfolgende Leerzeichen zu finden und durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen zu ersetzen.
keywords: REGEX, REPLACE, String, CL_ABAP_REGEX

Instructions: Finden Sie alle URLs (beginnend mit http:// oder https://) in einem gegebenen Text und geben Sie diese als Liste zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `FIND_ALL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_url_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_urls IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_urls) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_url_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_urls.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = 'https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?[-a-zA-Z0-9@:%._\+~#=]{1,256}\.[a-zA-Z0-9()]{1,6}\b(?:[-a-zA-Z0-9()@:%_\+.~#?&//=]*)'
      case_sensitive = abap_false
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DO.
      IF lo_matcher->find_next( ) = abap_true.
        APPEND lo_matcher->get_match( ) TO rt_urls.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das aktuelle Alter einer Person basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_RECA_DATE` für Datumsoperationen und berücksichtigen Sie den aktuellen Monat/Tag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_calculate_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age IMPORTING iv_birth_date TYPE d RETURNING VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_calculate_age IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_years_diff) = cl_reca_date=>get_difference_in_years(
      id_date1 = iv_birth_date
      id_date2 = lv_current_date
    ).

    " Check if birthday has already occurred this year
    DATA(lv_birth_month_day) = iv_birth_date+4(4). " MMdd
    DATA(lv_current_month_day) = lv_current_date+4(4). " MMdd

    IF lv_current_month_day < lv_birth_month_day.
      rv_age = lv_years_diff - 1.
    ELSE.
      rv_age = lv_years_diff.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_html_stripper IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Aktion in einem RAP Behavior Handler, um den Status einer Business-Objekt-Instanz (z.B. 'Approve' eines Reiseantrags) zu setzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_behavior_handler` als Basisklasse und `MODIFY ENTITIES OF ... IN LOCAL MODE` für die Aktionsimplementierung. Für den Unit-Test muss der RAP-Kontext simuliert werden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_rap_travel_bo.

CLASS zcl_rap_travel_bh DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_status_approved FOR BEHAVIOR OF zif_rap_travel_bo~travel IMPORTING entities FOR MODIFY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_travel_bh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_status_approved.
    " In a real RAP scenario, this would be handled by the framework
    " or a specific save sequence. Here, we simulate the modification.
    " The actual modification is done by the RAP framework after the handler.
    " We'll just return the modified entities for the unit test.
    " This is a simplification for a standalone example.
    LOOP AT entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      <fs_entity>-status = 'A'. " Approved
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_status_approved FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_status_approved.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_travel_bh( ).
    DATA: lt_travel_in TYPE TABLE FOR MODIFY zif_rap_travel_bo~travel.

    APPEND VALUE #( travel_id = '00000001' status = 'O' ) TO lt_travel_in.
    APPEND VALUE #( travel_id = '00000002' status = 'O' ) TO lt_travel_in.

    " Simulate the call from RAP framework
    lo_cut->set_status_approved(
      EXPORTING
        entities = lt_travel_in
      CHANGING
        failed   = DATA(lt_failed)
        reported = DATA(lt_reported)
    ).

    " Check if statuses are updated
    READ TABLE lt_travel_in INTO DATA(ls_travel1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_travel1-status exp = 'A' msg = 'Travel 1 status not approved' ).

    READ TABLE lt_travel_in INTO DATA(ls_travel2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_travel2-status exp = 'A' msg = 'Travel 2 status not approved' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_failed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_reported ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Implementierung einer einfachen Aktion innerhalb eines RAP Behavior Handlers. Die Syntax `FOR BEHAVIOR OF ... IMPORTING entities FOR MODIFY` ist spezifisch für RAP-Aktionen. Die Logik iteriert durch die bereitgestellten Entitäten und setzt deren Status auf 'A' (Approved). Der Unit-Test simuliert den Aufruf der Handler-Methode durch das RAP-Framework.
keywords: RAP, Behavior Handler, Action, MODIFY ENTITIES, Object Orientation, 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Validierung in einem RAP Behavior Handler, um sicherzustellen, dass das Enddatum einer Reisebuchung nicht vor dem Beginndatum liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_behavior_handler` und füllen Sie die `reported`-Struktur mit Nachrichten für ungültige Entitäten.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_rap_booking_bo.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
           booking_id TYPE /dmo/booking_id,
           begin_date TYPE /dmo/begin_date,
           end_date   TYPE /dmo/end_date,
         END OF ty_booking.
  TYPES: tt_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_rap_booking_bh DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_dates FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE zif_rap_booking_bo~booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_booking_bh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_dates.
    LOOP AT entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      IF <fs_entity>-begin_date IS NOT INITIAL AND <fs_entity>-end_date IS NOT INITIAL.
        IF <fs_entity>-end_date < <fs_entity>-begin_date.
          APPEND VALUE #( 
            booking_id = <fs_entity>-booking_id
            %msg       = NEW zcx_rap_message(
                            textid = zcx_rap_message=>end_date_before_begin_date
                            severity = if_abap_behv=>t_msg_severity-error
                          )
            %element-end_date = if_abap_behv=>mk-on
          ) TO reported-booking.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Dummy exception class for demonstration
CLASS zcx_rap_message DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF end_date_before_begin_date,
                 msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG', " Placeholder message class
                 msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '001',  " Placeholder message number
                 attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'BEGIN_DATE',
                 attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'END_DATE',
               END OF end_date_before_begin_date.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid   LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        severity TYPE if_abap_behv_message=>t_msg_severity DEFAULT if_abap_behv_message=>t_msg_severity-error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_rap_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor( textid = textid ).
    if_abap_behv_message~severity = severity.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_validate_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_booking_bh( ).
    DATA: lt_booking_in TYPE TABLE FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE zif_rap_booking_bo~booking.

    " Valid booking
    APPEND VALUE #( booking_id = '00000001' begin_date = '20230101' end_date = '20230105' ) TO lt_booking_in.
    " Invalid booking
    APPEND VALUE #( booking_id = '00000002' begin_date = '20230105' end_date = '20230101' ) TO lt_booking_in.

    " Simulate the call from RAP framework
    lo_cut->validate_dates(
      EXPORTING
        entities = lt_booking_in
      CHANGING
        failed   = DATA(lt_failed)
        reported = DATA(lt_reported)
    ).

    " Check for reported messages
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_reported-booking ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected one reported error' ).
    READ TABLE lt_reported-booking INTO DATA(ls_reported) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_reported-booking_id exp = '00000002' msg = 'Incorrect booking ID reported' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_reported-%element-end_date exp = if_abap_behv=>mk-on msg = 'End date element not marked' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_reported-%msg->if_abap_behv_message~severity exp = if_abap_behv=>t_msg_severity-error msg = 'Message severity not error' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_failed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine Validierung in RAP, die sicherstellt, dass das `end_date` einer Buchung nicht vor dem `begin_date` liegt. Die Syntax `FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE` gibt an, wann die Validierung ausgeführt wird. Ungültige Entitäten führen dazu, dass Nachrichten zur `reported`-Struktur hinzugefügt werden, die das RAP-Framework dann verwendet, um den Benutzer zu informieren. Eine Dummy-Exception-Klasse `zcx_rap_message` ist enthalten, um die RAP-Nachrichtenbehandlung zu simulieren.
keywords: RAP, Behavior Handler, Validation, REPORTED, Object Orientation, 7.50

CLASS lcl_hcmfab_employee_api IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND VALUE #( employee_id = 'E002' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Musterfrau' department = 'HR' email = 'anna.m@example.com' ) TO rt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( employee_id = 'E003' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Schmidt' department = 'IT' email = 'peter.s@example.com' ) TO rt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( employee_id = 'E004' first_name = 'Lena' last_name = 'Meier' department = 'Sales' email = 'lena.m@example.com' ) TO rt_employees.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_department_count,
         department TYPE string,
         count      TYPE i,
       END OF ty_department_count.
TYPES: tt_department_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_department_count WITH UNIQUE KEY department.

CLASS zcl_employee_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_employees_by_dept
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dept_counts) TYPE tt_department_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_employees_by_dept.
    DATA(lo_employee_api) = NEW lcl_hcmfab_employee_api( ).
    DATA(lt_all_employees) = lo_employee_api->get_all_employees( ).

    rt_dept_counts = REDUCE tt_department_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_department_count( )
      FOR ls_employee IN lt_all_employees
      LET lv_department = ls_employee-department IN
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL OR NOT line_exists( result[ department = lv_department ] )
                            THEN VALUE tt_department_count( BASE result ( department = lv_department count = 1 ) )
                            ELSE VALUE tt_department_count( BASE result ( department = lv_department count = result[ department = lv_department ]-count + 1 ) )
                          )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es zählt Mitarbeiter pro Abteilung, indem es die interne Tabelle durchläuft und ein Ergebnisobjekt (hier eine Tabelle mit Abteilungszählungen) schrittweise aufbaut. Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. Daten aus `sflights`), indem Sie mehrere funktionale Methoden verketten und Tabellenausdrücke verwenden, um Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert zu finden und deren Details zu formatieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE`, `FOR`, `FILTER` und Methodenverkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
        ( carrier_id      = ls_flight-carrid,
          connection_id   = ls_flight-connid,
          flight_date     = ls_flight-fldate,
          formatted_price = |{ ls_flight-price ALPHA = OUT } EUR| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
