CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_sflights_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_processor->get_expensive_flights( '500.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights msg = 'Expected expensive flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

      " Assuming some flights are indeed > 500.00

    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_processor->get_expensive_flights( '999999999.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights msg = 'Expected no flights for very high price' ).

Es verwendet einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um Flüge zu filtern, die einen bestimmten Mindestpreis überschreiten. Gleichzeitig werden die Daten in eine neue Struktur abgebildet und der Preis mit einem String-Template formatiert. Dies zeigt eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Standardmethodenimplementierung und konsumieren Sie es in einer Klasse, die das Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES ... DEFAULT METHODS`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.

  METHODS log_info DEFAULT VIA log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.

  METHODS log_error DEFAULT 'Error: ' && iv_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_formatted_error) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS zif_logger~log_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS zif_logger~log_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Simulate writing to a file
    DATA(lv_log_entry) = |File Log: { iv_message }|.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a file.
    WRITE: / lv_log_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_default_error_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " log_info uses default implementation via log_message
    lo_logger->zif_logger~log_info( 'This is an info message to console.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " No direct assert for WRITE, just checks execution
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
    " log_info uses default implementation via log_message, which is implemented by zcl_file_logger
    lo_logger->zif_logger~log_info( 'This is an info message to file.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " No direct assert for WRITE, just checks execution
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_default_error_log.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_error_msg) = lo_logger->zif_logger~log_error( 'Something went wrong!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_error_msg exp = 'Error: Something went wrong!' msg = 'Default error message not formatted correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `DEFAULT METHODS` in ABAP-Interfaces, einem Feature ab Version 7.50. Es ermöglicht, eine Standardimplementierung für Interface-Methoden direkt im Interface zu definieren. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code in implementierenden Klassen, wenn die Standardlogik ausreicht. Es können sowohl Methoden mit `VIA` auf andere Interface-Methoden verweisen als auch direkte Implementierungen mit String-Templates (`'Error: ' && iv_message`) bereitgestellt werden.
keywords: Interface, Default Methods, Object Orientation, 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach einem bestimmten Fluggesellschafts-ID und einer Mindestflugzeit unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_duration TYPE i " in minutes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fltime >= iv_min_duration ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_filter->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_duration = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights msg = 'Expected filtered flights for LH > 100 min' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID' ).
      " Cannot assert fltime directly as it's not in the return structure, but the filter should work.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_flights_not_found.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_filter->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_duration = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights msg = 'Expected no flights for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature ab Version 7.40, das das Filtern von internen Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht. Anstatt eine `LOOP` mit `IF`-Bedingungen zu verwenden, kann man mit `FILTER` direkt eine neue Tabelle erstellen, die nur die Elemente enthält, die den angegebenen Kriterien entsprechen. Die Verwendung von `USING KEY primary_key` ist optional, kann aber die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sflights, 7.40

CLASS zcl_conditional_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'A' THEN 'Approved'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'P' THEN 'Pending'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'R' THEN 'Rejected'
      ELSE 'Unknown Status'

  METHOD test_unknown_status.
    DATA(lo_assign) = NEW zcl_conditional_assign( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_assign->get_status_text( 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_text exp = 'Unknown Status' msg = 'Incorrect text for Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature ab Version 7.40, das eine kompakte und funktionale Möglichkeit bietet, Werte basierend auf Bedingungen zuzuweisen. Er ersetzt die traditionellen `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Konstrukte für einfache Zuweisungen und macht den Code kürzer und lesbarer. Der Typ des zurückgegebenen Wertes wird direkt nach `COND` angegeben.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `NEW`-Operator mit dem `#`-Zeichen für die Typinferenz, um ein Objekt zu instanziieren und direkt eine Methode aufzurufen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW #( )->method( )` für kompakte Objektinstanziierung und Methodenaufrufe.

INTERFACE zif_calculator.
  METHODS add
    IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS zif_calculator~add.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING

        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    " Instanziierung und Methodenaufruf in einer Zeile mit Typinferenz
    rv_sum = NEW zcl_simple_calculator( )->zif_calculator~add( iv_num1 = iv_val1 iv_num2 = iv_val2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht die Instanziierung eines Objekts und den direkten Aufruf einer seiner Methoden in einer einzigen, kompakten Zeile. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Verbindung und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier_conn
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier_conn.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE tt_flight_group(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
        GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights_by_carrier_conn FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights_by_carrier_conn.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier_conn( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped_flights msg = 'Expected grouped flights' ).

    " Example: Check for a specific group, e.g., LH 0400
    READ TABLE lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_group-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'Flight count should be greater than 0' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Group LH 0400 not found, check SFLIGHTS data' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check if all entries have a count
    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO ls_group.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_group-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'Flight count is zero for a group' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `GROUP BY`-Funktionalität innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks, einem Feature ab ABAP 7.50, um interne Tabellen zu gruppieren. Es ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten nach bestimmten Schlüsseln und die Aggregation von Gruppeninformationen (hier `GROUP SIZE` für die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe). Dies ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Konstrukten.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sflights, Grouping, 7.50

CLASS zcl_gzip_string_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gzip_string_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress.

    DATA(lv_xstring_compressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_decompressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_xstring_compressed ).

    DATA(lv_original_string) = `Dies ist ein sehr langer String, der komprimiert und dekomprimiert werden soll, um die Funktionalität der cl_abap_gzip Klasse zu demonstrieren. Es enthält viele Wiederholungen und ist daher ein guter Kandidat für die Kompression.`. 
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = lo_cut->compress_and_decompress( lv_original_string ).

Instructions: Komprimiere den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. sflights) in ein XSTRING und dekomprimiere ihn zurück in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst in einen String (z.B. JSON mit `cl_abap_sjson_writer`), komprimieren Sie dann das XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ts_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_sjson_writer=>pretty_print(
                              cl_abap_sjson_writer=>create( )->write( it_input_table )->get_output( ) ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->string_to_xstring( lv_json_string ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_compressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_decompressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_xstring_compressed ).
    DATA(lv_json_decompressed) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_decompressed ).
    cl_abap_sjson_reader=>create( lv_json_decompressed )->read( CHANGING rt_output_table = rt_output_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compress_decompress_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_decompress_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_table_compress( ).
    DATA(lt_original_sflights) TYPE zcl_gzip_table_compress=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_original_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_original_sflights IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Originaltabelle sollte Daten enthalten.' ).

    DATA(lt_decompressed_sflights) = lo_cut->compress_and_decompress_table( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_decompressed_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decompressed_sflights exp = lt_original_sflights msg = 'Dekomprimierte Tabelle sollte dem Original entsprechen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eine interne Tabelle zu komprimieren, muss sie zuerst in ein serialisierbares Format (hier JSON mittels `cl_abap_sjson_writer`) umgewandelt werden. Der resultierende String wird dann in ein XSTRING konvertiert und mit `cl_abap_gzip` komprimiert. Die Dekompression erfolgt in umgekehrter Reihenfolge, wobei `cl_abap_sjson_reader` die JSON-Daten zurück in die interne Tabelle deserialisiert. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für die Speicherung oder Übertragung von strukturierten Daten.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Internal Table, XSTRING, Serialization, JSON, cl_abap_gzip, cl_abap_sjson_writer, cl_abap_sjson_reader

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, aber nur, wenn sie eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` in Kombination mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_filtered_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ts_sflight_simple.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sflight_simple
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_sflight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_filtered_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_filtered.
    DATA(lt_filtered_data) = FILTER tt_sflight_simple( it_source_table WHERE carrid = iv_carrid_filter ).
    APPEND LINES OF lt_filtered_data TO rt_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_filtered FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_filtered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_filtered_lines( ).
    DATA(lt_source) TYPE zcl_append_filtered_lines=>tt_sflight_simple.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0402'.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->append_filtered( it_source_table = lt_source iv_carrid_filter = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Zeilen hinzugefügt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte LH sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Zweite Zeile sollte LH sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `APPEND LINES OF` ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare Syntax, um Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung in eine Zieltabelle zu kopieren. Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck erstellt eine temporäre Tabelle mit den gefilterten Daten, die dann effizient an die Zieltabelle angehängt werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, APPEND LINES OF, FILTER, Table Expressions, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Sammeln Sie Log-Einträge in einer internen Tabelle, komprimieren Sie diese in ein XSTRING und fügen Sie sie dann in eine Archivtabelle ein, die komprimierte Daten enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_gzip` und `VALUE` Operator für die Tabellenkonstruktion. `APPEND LINES OF` ist hier implizit, da die Methode eine einzelne Struktur zurückgibt, die dann in eine Archivtabelle eingefügt werden könnte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_log_archiver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ts_log_entry.
    TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_archived_log,
             archive_id TYPE i,
             compressed_data TYPE xstring,
           END OF ts_archived_log.
    TYPES: tt_archived_logs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_archived_log WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS archive_logs
      IMPORTING
        it_logs TYPE tt_log_entries
        iv_archive_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_archived_log) TYPE ts_archived_log.

    METHODS retrieve_logs
      IMPORTING
        is_archived_log TYPE ts_archived_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_logs) TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_log_archiver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD archive_logs.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_sjson_writer=>pretty_print(
                              cl_abap_sjson_writer=>create( )->write( it_logs )->get_output( ) ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->string_to_xstring( lv_json_string ).
    rs_archived_log = VALUE #( archive_id = iv_archive_id
                               compressed_data = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD retrieve_logs.
    DATA(lv_xstring_decompressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( is_archived_log-compressed_data ).
    DATA(lv_json_decompressed) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_decompressed ).
    cl_abap_sjson_reader=>create( lv_json_decompressed )->read( CHANGING rt_logs = rt_logs ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_archiving FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_archiving.
    DATA(lo_archiver) = NEW zcl_gzip_log_archiver( ).
    DATA(lt_logs_to_archive) TYPE zcl_gzip_log_archiver=>tt_log_entries.
    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = sy-tstmpl seconds = -3600 ) message = 'Log entry 1' ) TO lt_logs_to_archive.
    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = sy-tstmpl message = 'Log entry 2' ) TO lt_logs_to_archive.

    DATA(ls_archived_data) = lo_archiver->archive_logs( it_logs = lt_logs_to_archive iv_archive_id = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_archived_data-compressed_data msg = 'Komprimierte Daten sollten nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_archived_data-archive_id exp = 1 msg = 'Archiv-ID sollte korrekt sein.' ).

    DATA(lt_retrieved_logs) = lo_archiver->retrieve_logs( ls_archived_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_retrieved_logs ) exp = lines( lt_logs_to_archive ) msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte nach Dekompression gleich sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_retrieved_logs exp = lt_logs_to_archive msg = 'Dekomprimierte Logs sollten den Original-Logs entsprechen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen realistischen Anwendungsfall für `cl_abap_gzip` in Kombination mit internen Tabellen. Log-Einträge werden gesammelt, in JSON serialisiert, komprimiert und in einer Struktur abgelegt. Die `VALUE`-Operator-Syntax wird verwendet, um die Archivstruktur kompakt zu füllen. Die `APPEND LINES OF` ist hier implizit, da die `archive_logs` Methode eine einzelne Struktur zurückgibt, die dann in eine Archivtabelle eingefügt werden könnte.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Internal Tables, Logging, XSTRING, Serialization, VALUE, cl_abap_gzip, cl_abap_sjson_writer

Instructions: Komprimiere einen String mit einem dynamisch bestimmten Kompressionslevel.
hint: Die `compress_xstring` Methode von `cl_abap_gzip` erlaubt die Angabe eines Kompressionslevels (1-9).
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_dynamic_level DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_with_level
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_compression_level TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS decompress_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_dynamic_level IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_with_level.
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->string_to_xstring( iv_input_string ).
    IF iv_compression_level IS SUPPLIED AND iv_compression_level BETWEEN 1 AND 9.
      rv_compressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring(
                                data = lv_xstring_input
                                level = iv_compression_level ).
    ELSE.
      rv_compressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_xstring.
    DATA(lv_xstring_decompressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( iv_compressed_xstring ).
    rv_decompressed_string = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_decompressed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_dynamic_level( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = `Ein wiederholter Text für die Kompression. Ein wiederholter Text für die Kompression.`. 

    " Test with default level
    DATA(lv_compressed_default) = lo_cut->compress_with_level( lv_original_string ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_default) = lo_cut->decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_default ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decompressed_default exp = lv_original_string msg = 'Default Kompression sollte korrekt sein.' ).

    " Test with level 1 (fastest)
    DATA(lv_compressed_level1) = lo_cut->compress_with_level( iv_input_string = lv_original_string iv_compression_level = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_level1) = lo_cut->decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_level1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decompressed_level1 exp = lv_original_string msg = 'Kompression Level 1 sollte korrekt sein.' ).

    " Test with level 9 (best compression)
    DATA(lv_compressed_level9) = lo_cut->compress_with_level( iv_input_string = lv_original_string iv_compression_level = 9 ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_level9) = lo_cut->decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_level9 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decompressed_level9 exp = lv_original_string msg = 'Kompression Level 9 sollte korrekt sein.' ).

    " Assert that different levels produce different compressed sizes (usually)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = xstrlen( lv_compressed_level1 ) exp = xstrlen( lv_compressed_level9 ) msg = 'Verschiedene Kompressionslevel sollten unterschiedliche Größen ergeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `compress_xstring` Methode von `cl_abap_gzip` erlaubt die Angabe eines Kompressionslevels (1-9). Dies ermöglicht eine dynamische Anpassung der Kompressionsstärke je nach Anforderung an Geschwindigkeit oder Dateigröße. Die optionale Parameterübergabe ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das die Flexibilität der Methode erhöht.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Dynamic, Parameters, Compression Level, cl_abap_gzip

Instructions: Gegeben sind mehrere XSTRINGs, die jeweils komprimierte Daten einer internen Tabelle enthalten. Dekomprimiere alle und füge die Inhalte in eine einzige Zieltabelle zusammen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife und `APPEND LINES OF` nach jeder Dekompression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_multi_decompress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ts_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS decompress_multiple_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_compressed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_table) TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    METHODS compress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_multi_decompress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_multiple_tables.
    LOOP AT it_compressed_data INTO DATA(lv_compressed_xstring).
      DATA(lv_xstring_decompressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).
      DATA(lv_json_decompressed) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_decompressed ).
      DATA(lt_temp_table) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
      cl_abap_sjson_reader=>create( lv_json_decompressed )->read( CHANGING rt_combined_table = lt_temp_table ).
      APPEND LINES OF lt_temp_table TO rt_combined_table.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compress_table.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_sjson_writer=>pretty_print(
                              cl_abap_sjson_writer=>create( )->write( it_input_table )->get_output( ) ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->string_to_xstring( lv_json_string ).
    rv_compressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus mehreren internen Tabellen in eine Zieltabelle, indem Sie `APPEND LINES OF` in einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck verwenden.
hint: `REDUCE` kann eine neue Tabelle aufbauen und dabei `APPEND LINES OF` nutzen, um Zeilen aus verschiedenen Quellen zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_append_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ts_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE tt_data
        it_table2 TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_append_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_tables.
    rt_aggregated_table = REDUCE tt_data(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_data( )
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_table1
      APPEND VALUE #( id = <fs_data>-id value = <fs_data>-value ) TO result
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_table2
      APPEND VALUE #( id = <fs_data>-id value = <fs_data>-value ) TO result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_append_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_source,
             id    TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_for_append_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_append.
    rt_target_table = VALUE tt_target(
      FOR ls_source IN it_source_table
      ( new_id = ls_source-id * 10
        upper_text = to_upper( ls_source-text ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere eine große interne Tabelle mit `cl_abap_gzip` und messe die Zeitersparnis im Vergleich zur unkomprimierten Übertragung (simuliert).
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET RUN TIME` für die Messung und `cl_abap_gzip` für die Kompression. Serialisieren Sie die Tabelle zu JSON.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_performance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_perf,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ts_sflight_perf.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_perf TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_perf WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_compression_impact
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_perf
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_performance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_compression_impact.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_duration_uncompressed TYPE i,
          lv_duration_compressed TYPE i.

    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_sjson_writer=>pretty_print(
                              cl_abap_sjson_writer=>create( )->write( it_data )->get_output( ) ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_uncompressed) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->string_to_xstring( lv_json_string ).

    " Simulate uncompressed transfer
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start_time.
    DATA(lv_dummy_uncompressed) = lv_xstring_uncompressed.
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end_time.
    lv_duration_uncompressed = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Compress and simulate transfer
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start_time.
    DATA(lv_xstring_compressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_uncompressed ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_compressed) = lv_xstring_compressed.
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end_time.
    lv_duration_compressed = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE TABLE OF string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_results> TYPE TABLE OF string.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO <lt_results>.

    APPEND |Unkomprimierte Größe: { xstrlen( lv_xstring_uncompressed ) } Bytes| TO <lt_results>.
    APPEND |Komprimierte Größe: { xstrlen( lv_xstring_compressed ) } Bytes| TO <lt_results>.
    APPEND |Dauer unkomprimiert (simuliert): { lv_duration_uncompressed } Mikrosekunden| TO <lt_results>.
    APPEND |Dauer komprimiert (simuliert): { lv_duration_compressed } Mikrosekunden| TO <lt_results>.
    APPEND |Kompressionseffizienz: { ( 1 - ( xstrlen( lv_xstring_compressed ) / xstrlen( lv_xstring_uncompressed ) ) ) * 100 } %| TO <lt_results>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compression_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compression_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_performance( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_gzip_performance=>tt_sflight_perf.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency planetype seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sflights IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Testdaten sollten vorhanden sein.' ).

    DATA(lr_results) = lo_cut->measure_compression_impact( lt_sflights ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_results> TYPE TABLE OF string.
    ASSIGN lr_results->* TO <lt_results>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <lt_results> IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Ergebnisse sollten nicht leer sein.' ).

    LOOP AT <lt_results> INTO DATA(lv_line).
      " Output results for manual inspection or more detailed assertion
      " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true msg = lv_line ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Example assertion: compressed size should be smaller than uncompressed
    DATA(lv_uncompressed_size_line) = <lt_results>[ 1 ].
    DATA(lv_compressed_size_line) = <lt_results>[ 2 ].

    DATA(lv_uncompressed_size) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_compressed_size) TYPE i.

    FIND REGEX `\d+` IN lv_uncompressed_size_line SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_uncomp_str).
    lv_uncompressed_size = lv_uncomp_str.

    FIND REGEX `\d+` IN lv_compressed_size_line SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_comp_str).
    lv_compressed_size = lv_comp_str.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less( act = lv_compressed_size exp = lv_uncompressed_size msg = 'Komprimierte Daten sollten kleiner sein als unkomprimierte.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die potenzielle Performance-Verbesserung durch Datenkompression mit `cl_abap_gzip`. Durch die Messung der Laufzeit für die (simulierte) Übertragung von unkomprimierten und komprimierten Daten kann der Vorteil der Kompression quantifiziert werden. Die Serialisierung der Tabelle zu JSON ist hierbei ein notwendiger Zwischenschritt. Die Verwendung von `GET RUN TIME` ist eine präzise Methode zur Messung von Code-Abschnitten.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Performance, Internal Tables, XSTRING, JSON, GET RUN TIME, cl_abap_gzip

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->append_unique( it_source_table = lt_source it_initial_target = lt_initial ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 eindeutige Zeilen in der kombinierten Tabelle sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ key = 'A' ]-value exp = 'Initial A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ key = 'B' ]-value exp = 'Initial B' msg = 'Initialer Wert für B sollte beibehalten werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ key = 'C' ]-value exp = 'Source C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um Duplikate beim Anhängen von Zeilen zu vermeiden, kann eine `HASHED TABLE` oder `SORTED TABLE` mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel verwendet werden. Die `INSERT ... INTO TABLE`-Anweisung versucht, die Zeile einzufügen; wenn ein Eintrag mit demselben Schlüssel bereits existiert, wird der Einfügevorgang ignoriert, was Duplikate effektiv verhindert. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um eindeutige Datensätze zu aggregieren.
keywords: Internal Tables, APPEND LINES OF, HASHED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, INSERT, Duplicates

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, ungültige XSTRING-Daten mit `cl_abap_gzip` zu dekomprimieren und fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme `cx_sy_zip_error` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_corrupt_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_xstring_decompressed) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( iv_corrupt_xstring ).
        rv_decompressed_string = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_decompressed ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        MESSAGE lx_zip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_zip_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_decompress_corrupt_data FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_decompress_corrupt_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_corrupt_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE '0000000000000000'. " Ungültige GZIP-Daten

    " Erwartung: Eine Ausnahme vom Typ cx_sy_zip_error wird ausgelöst
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      EXPORTING
        class = 'CX_SY_ZIP_ERROR'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->decompress_with_error_handling( lv_corrupt_xstring ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Es sollte eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zip_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Ausnahme CX_SY_ZIP_ERROR wurde korrekt abgefangen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Umgang mit komprimierten Daten ist eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung unerlässlich. `cl_abap_gzip` löst die Ausnahme `cx_sy_zip_error` aus, wenn versucht wird, ungültige oder beschädigte GZIP-Daten zu dekomprimieren. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht es, solche Fehler elegant abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies ist ein Best Practice für die Entwicklung stabiler Anwendungen.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Error Handling, Exception, TRY CATCH, cx_sy_zip_error, cl_abap_gzip

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle an eine Zieltabelle an, aber nur die ersten N Zeilen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `UP TO N ROWS` oder `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_top_n_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_limited,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_sflight_limited.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_limited TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_limited WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_top_n_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sflight_limited
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_top_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_sflight_limited.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_top_n_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_top_n_filtered.
    DATA(lt_filtered_and_limited) = VALUE tt_sflight_limited(
      FOR ls_entry IN it_source_table
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid_filter )
      ( ls_entry ) UP TO iv_top_n ROWS ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_filtered_and_limited TO rt_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_top_n FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_top_n.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_top_n_filtered( ).
    DATA(lt_source) TYPE zcl_append_top_n_filtered=>tt_sflight_limited.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0404' fldate = '20250104' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->append_top_n_filtered( it_source_table = lt_source iv_carrid_filter = 'LH' iv_top_n = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten genau 2 Zeilen hinzugefügt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination des `FOR`-Operators mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung und der `UP TO N ROWS`-Klausel innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktorausdrucks ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Art, Daten aus internen Tabellen zu filtern und zu begrenzen. Dies ermöglicht es, nur die relevantesten Einträge zu extrahieren und effizient an eine Zieltabelle anzuhängen, ohne unnötige Daten zu verarbeiten.
keywords: Internal Tables, APPEND LINES OF, FOR, WHERE, UP TO N ROWS, Filtering, VALUE

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (PRICE) für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Anweisung mit dem `MAX`-Operator, um den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_price = 0
                             FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                             NEXT max_price = nmax( max_price, <fs_flight>-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = 1111.00 ). " Annahme: 1111.00 ist der höchste Preis für LH in SFLIGHTS

    lv_max_price = lo_cut->get_max_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = 422.00 ). " Annahme: 422.00 ist der höchste Preis für AA in SFLIGHTS
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Der `nmax`-Operator wird verwendet, um den Maximalwert zwischen dem aktuellen `max_price` und dem `price` des aktuellen Fluges zu bestimmen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen und temporären Variablen.
keywords: MAXIMUM, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS enthält und zusätzlich eine fortlaufende Zeilennummer (1-basiert) für jeden Eintrag. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `INDEX INTO` in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_indexed,
             index TYPE i,
             sflight TYPE sflight,
           END OF ty_flight_indexed.
    TYPES: tt_flight_indexed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_indexed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_indexed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_indexed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_indexed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_indexed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_entry IN lt_sflights INDEX INTO idx
                                  ( index = idx,
                                    sflight = flight_entry ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_indexed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_indexed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_enum_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_indexed_flights) = lo_cut->get_indexed_flights( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_indexed_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_indexed_flights[ 1 ]-sflight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    IF lines( lt_indexed_flights ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_indexed_flights[ lines( lt_indexed_flights ) ]-index exp = lines( lt_indexed_flights ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Konstruktor in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `INDEX INTO` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle, wobei jedem Eintrag automatisch ein Index zugewiesen wird. Dies ist eine sehr lesbare und effiziente Methode, um Daten zu transformieren und zu nummerieren.
keywords: ENUMERATION, FOR, INDEX INTO, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die zwei Ganzzahlen entgegennimmt und die größere der beiden Zahlen zurückgibt.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Enumeration-Typ für die Zustände einer Ampel (ROT, GELB, GRÜN) und implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den nächsten Zustand basierend auf dem aktuellen Zustand zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES ENUM` für die Definition des Enumeration-Typs und `SWITCH` für die Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_light_state,
             red   VALUE IS INITIAL,
             yellow,
             green,
           END OF ENUM traffic_light_state.

    METHODS get_next_state
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_state TYPE traffic_light_state
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_state) TYPE traffic_light_state.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_state.
    rv_next_state = SWITCH #( iv_current_state
                               WHEN traffic_light_state-red    THEN traffic_light_state-green
                               WHEN traffic_light_state-green  THEN traffic_light_state-yellow
                               WHEN traffic_light_state-yellow THEN traffic_light_state-red
                               ELSE traffic_light_state-red ). " Default or error state
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_next_state FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_next_state.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_traffic_light( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_next_state( zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_state-red )    exp = zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_state-green ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_next_state( zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_state-green )  exp = zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_state-yellow ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_next_state( zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_state-yellow ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_state-red ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50+ ermöglicht die Definition von echten Enumeration-Typen mit `TYPES ENUM`, was die Lesbarkeit und Typsicherheit von Code, der mit festen Wertemengen arbeitet, erheblich verbessert. Die `SWITCH`-Anweisung bietet eine elegante und kompakte Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik basierend auf den Enumerationswerten zu implementieren.
keywords: ENUMERATION, TYPES ENUM, SWITCH, Object Orientation, Data Types

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das späteste Flugdatum (FLDATE) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugverbindung (CONNID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `nmax`-Operator für Datumsfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_latest_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latest_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight_date.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rv_latest_date = REDUCE #( INIT latest_date = sy-datum
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT latest_date = nmax( latest_date, <fs_flight>-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_latest_flight_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_date( ).
    DATA(lv_latest_date) = lo_cut->get_latest_flight_date( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    " Annahme: '20250101' ist das späteste Datum für LH 0400 in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_latest_date exp = '20250101' ).

    lv_latest_date = lo_cut->get_latest_flight_date( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

explanation: Ähnlich wie bei numerischen Werten kann `REDUCE` mit `nmax` auch für Datumsfelder verwendet werden, um das späteste Datum in einer internen Tabelle zu finden. Die Initialisierung mit `sy-datum` stellt sicher, dass ein gültiger Startwert für den Vergleich vorhanden ist. Dies ist eine prägnante und moderne Art der Datumsaggregation.
keywords: MAXIMUM, REDUCE, Date/Time, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Nehmen Sie eine Liste von Strings und erstellen Sie eine neue Liste, in der jeder String mit seinem 1-basierten Index als Präfix versehen ist (z.B. '1: Erster String', '2: Zweiter String').

Instructions: Finden Sie den gesamten Flugdatensatz aus SFLIGHTS, der den höchsten Flugpreis (PRICE) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugverbindung (CONNID) aufweist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um den Eintrag mit dem maximalen Preis zu finden, indem Sie die Struktur selbst als Akkumulator verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_flight_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_flight_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rs_flight = REDUCE #( INIT max_flight = VALUE sflight( )
                           FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                           NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > max_flight-price THEN <fs_flight> ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_flight_entry( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
    " Annahme: Der höchste Preis für LH 0400 ist 1111.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = 1111.00 ).

    ls_flight = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = 422.00 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einem konditionalen Ausdruck (`COND`). Anstatt nur einen skalaren Wert zu aggregieren, wird hier eine gesamte Struktur (`sflight`) als Akkumulator verwendet. In jedem Schritt wird geprüft, ob der aktuelle Flug einen höheren Preis hat als der bisherige `max_flight`. Wenn ja, wird der aktuelle Flug zum neuen `max_flight`, ansonsten bleibt der alte `max_flight` erhalten. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und effiziente Methode, um den Eintrag mit dem Maximalwert zu finden.
keywords: MAXIMUM, REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige Struktur als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die die Namen und Werte aller Felder dieser Struktur enthält. Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Enumeration von Feldern.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) und `LOOP AT COMPONENTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_fields
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_fields.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <fs_data> IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ) => check_and_cast( cl_abap_structdescr=>get_type_descr( <fs_data> ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->components INTO DATA(ls_component_descr).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component_descr-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_field_info( name = ls_component_descr-name
                                    value = |{ <fs_component> }| ) TO rt_field_info.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus SFLIGHTS, die die höchste Anzahl an Flügen hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Schleife, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln, und dann `REDUCE` mit `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flights_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_with_most_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flights_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_with_most_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_carrier_count,
            carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
            count  TYPE i,
          END OF ls_carrier_count.
    DATA: lt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    lt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = <carrier_group>-carrid,
                                   count = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    DATA(ls_max_carrier_count) = REDUCE #( INIT max_entry = VALUE ls_carrier_count( )
                                           FOR <fs_entry> IN lt_carrier_counts
                                           NEXT max_entry = COND #( WHEN <fs_entry>-count > max_entry-count THEN <fs_entry> ELSE max_entry ) ).

    rv_carrid = ls_max_carrier_count-carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_carrier_with_most_flights( ).

    " Annahme: 'LH' hat die meisten Flüge in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Zuerst werden die Flüge nach `CARRID` gruppiert, und für jede Gruppe wird die Anzahl der Flüge (`GROUP SIZE`) ermittelt. Das Ergebnis ist eine Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und deren Fluganzahl. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um den Eintrag mit der höchsten Fluganzahl zu finden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Aggregationen und Maximum-Suchen auf gruppierten Daten durchzuführen.
keywords: MAXIMUM, GROUPING, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tab` unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einem initialen Wert für Summe und Zähler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
           count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
      FOR  ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
           count     = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flights_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_avg_flights_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT AVG( price )
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO @rv_average_price.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_average_price = 0. " Handle case where no flights are found

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tab` und speichere die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flights_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_grouped_average
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_averages) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flights_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_grouped_average.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid_group).
      DATA(lv_average_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
             count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
        FOR  ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP lv_carrid_group
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_grouped_flight-price
             count     = count + 1
        FINALLY
          IF count > 0.
            sum_price / count.
          ELSE.
            0.
          ENDIF
      ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid_group-carrid average_price = lv_average_price ) TO rt_grouped_averages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_average.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_avg_flights_group=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flights_group( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_averages) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_average( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_grouped_averages ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Gruppen (Fluggesellschaften) gefunden werden.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped_averages INTO DATA(ls_lh_avg) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_avg-average_price,
      exp = '150.00',
      msg = 'Der Durchschnittspreis für LH sollte 150.00 sein.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped_averages INTO DATA(ls_aa_avg) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_avg-average_price,
      exp = '200.00',
      msg = 'Der Durchschnittspreis für AA sollte 200.00 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_avg_flights_group=>tt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flights_group( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_averages) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_average( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_grouped_averages,
      msg = 'Für eine leere Eingabetabelle sollte die Ergebnistabelle leer sein.'
    ).

explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` (ab ABAP 7.40) und `REDUCE` (ab ABAP 7.40) innerhalb der Schleife ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Berechnung von Aggregatwerten pro Gruppe. Der `FINALLY`-Block in `REDUCE` ist ab ABAP 7.50 verfügbar und erlaubt die Definition des Rückgabewerts nach der Iteration, was hier ideal für die Division ist.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tab` unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE` in einem Ausdruck.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR` zum Iterieren und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR  ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_flights ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_compare_usage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_memory_increase_bytes) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_mem_compare_usage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_memory_after_fill.
    DATA(lv_memory_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_used_memory( ).

    DATA(lt_large_table) TYPE tt_data.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( field1 = |Entry { sy-index }|
                      field2 = |Value { sy-index * 10 }|
                      field3 = |Text { sy-index * 100 }| ) TO lt_large_table.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_memory_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_used_memory( ).

    rv_memory_increase_bytes = lv_memory_after - lv_memory_before.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überwache den Speicherverbrauch während einer Schleife und gib eine Warnung aus, wenn ein Schwellenwert überschritten wird.
hint: Verwende `GET_USED_MEMORY` innerhalb der Schleife und eine `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_threshold_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS monitor_memory_usage
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i
        iv_threshold  TYPE i " in bytes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_threshold_exceeded) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_threshold_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD monitor_memory_usage.
    DATA: lt_temp_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_initial_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_used_memory( ).

    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      APPEND |Data entry { sy-index }| TO lt_temp_data.
      IF sy-index MOD 100 = 0. " Check every 100 iterations
        DATA(lv_current_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_used_memory( ).
        IF ( lv_current_memory - lv_initial_memory ) > iv_threshold.
          rv_threshold_exceeded = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_threshold_exceeded = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_threshold_monitor( ).
    " Set a low threshold and many iterations to ensure it's exceeded

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exceeded,

CLASS zcl_mem_time_measure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_measurement_result,
             runtime_microseconds TYPE i,
             memory_increase_bytes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_measurement_result.

    METHODS measure_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_measurement_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_time_measure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_operation.
    DATA(lv_memory_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_used_memory( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_before) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    DATA(lt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND |Entry { sy-index }| TO lt_data.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_runtime_after) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_memory_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_used_memory( ).

    rs_result-runtime_microseconds = lv_runtime_after - lv_runtime_before.
    rs_result-memory_increase_bytes = lv_memory_after - lv_memory_before.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tab` unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE` mit einem `COND` Ausdruck für bedingte Aggregation.
hint: Nutze `COND` innerhalb von `REDUCE` um nur bestimmte Flüge zu berücksichtigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_cond_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price_cond
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_cond_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price_cond.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
           count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
      FOR  ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-currency = iv_currency THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 )
           count     = count + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-currency = iv_currency THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (ähnlich SFLIGHT) und lesen Sie einen Eintrag effizient mittels Schlüsselzugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORTED TABLE` für die Deklaration und `READ TABLE WITH KEY` für den effizienten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Price should match' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und transformieren Sie diese in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                             ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                               connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer sortierten Flugtabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data_sorted( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                                                    ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
                                                    ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '210.00' msg = 'Total price for LH should be 210.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_no_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data_sorted( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '0.00' msg = 'Total price for non-existing carrid should be 0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum_price`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei er in jedem Schritt die Variable aktualisiert. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge vor der Aggregation.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, WHERE

                                                    ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight should be LH' ).

    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data_sorted( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA_HOLDER` mit privaten Attributen. Implementieren Sie eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_DEBUGGER`, die auf diese privaten Attribute zugreifen kann, um sie zu inspizieren und zu protokollieren, ohne öffentliche Getter zu verwenden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_holder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

           END OF ty_flight_info.

      IMPORTING
        is_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info.

    DATA ms_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_holder IMPLEMENTATION.

    ms_flight_info = is_flight_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_debugger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        io_flight_holder TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_data_holder
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_debugger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_flight_data.
    rv_log_string = |Flight: { io_flight_holder->ms_flight_info-carrid }-{ io_flight_holder->ms_flight_info-connid }, Status: { io_flight_holder->ms_flight_info-status }|.
