Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer sortierten Flugtabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index, falls vorhanden, unter Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die funktionalen Ausdrücke `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit `KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate  TYPE s_date
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists  TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index   TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    ev_exists = xsdbool( LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ KEY primary_key
                                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                                          connid = iv_connid
                                                          fldate = iv_fldate ] ) ).
    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = LINE_INDEX( it_flights[ KEY primary_key
                                          WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                                connid = iv_connid
                                                fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                                                    ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                                                    ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' ) ).

Bei sortierten Tabellen erfolgt der Zugriff über den Schlüssel sehr effizient. `xsdbool` konvertiert den Wahrheitswert in `abap_bool`.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_no_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_no_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      rv_count = rv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugdaten in eine sortierte Tabelle ein und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierung und die Eindeutigkeit der Schlüssel erhalten bleiben. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass ein Eintrag bereits existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` für sortierte Tabellen. Der System-Returncode `sy-subrc` zeigt an, ob der Eintrag erfolgreich eingefügt wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_flight_safely
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight_safely.
    INSERT is_flight INTO TABLE mt_flights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_flight_safely( ls_new_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_all_flights( ) ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_all_flights( )[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Table should remain sorted' ).

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_flight_safely( ls_duplicate_flight ).

explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` wird automatisch die Sortierung beibehalten und Duplikate (basierend auf dem Schlüssel) werden abgelehnt. Der `sy-subrc` nach dem `INSERT`-Befehl gibt an, ob der Vorgang erfolgreich war (0) oder ob ein Duplikat gefunden wurde (4). Dies ermöglicht eine robuste Datenverwaltung.

Instructions: Löschen Sie einen bestimmten Flug aus einer sortierten Flugtabelle mittels Schlüsselzugriff.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS delete_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flight.
    DELETE TABLE mt_flights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                                         connid = iv_connid
                                         fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse `ZCL_BASE_FLIGHT_INFO` und eine abgeleitete Klasse `ZCL_DETAILED_FLIGHT_INFO`. Implementieren Sie eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_INSPECTOR`, die private Attribute beider Klassen inspizieren kann, auch wenn sie nur einen Referenz auf die Basisklasse erhält, unter Verwendung von RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FRIENDS` für den Zugriff und RTTI (`CAST`) zur dynamischen Typumwandlung, um auf spezifische Attribute der abgeleiteten Klasse zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_flight_info DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    FRIENDS zcl_flight_inspector.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_flight_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid.
    rv_carrid = mv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_detailed_flight_info DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_flight_info PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.

    METHODS get_connid RETURNING VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.

    FRIENDS zcl_flight_inspector.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_detailed_flight_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_connid.
    rv_connid = mv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS inspect_flight
      IMPORTING
        io_flight_ref TYPE REF TO zcl_base_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_details) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD inspect_flight.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
          lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.

    lv_carrid = io_flight_ref->mv_carrid.

    IF io_flight_ref IS INSTANCE OF zcl_detailed_flight_info.
      DATA(lo_detailed_flight) = CAST zcl_detailed_flight_info( io_flight_ref ).
      lv_connid = lo_detailed_flight->mv_connid.
      rv_details = |Carrier: { lv_carrid }, Connection: { lv_connid } (Detailed)|.
    ELSE.
      rv_details = |Carrier: { lv_carrid } (Base)|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer sortierten Flugtabelle unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators mit `CONDENSE` und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` in Kombination mit `CONDENSE` und `CORRESPONDING` für eine kompakte Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(lv_old_lines) = lines( mt_flights ).

    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
                           ( CONDENSE #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                             ls_flight-connid = iv_connid AND
                                             ls_flight-fldate = iv_fldate
                                         THEN CORRESPONDING ty_flight_data( ls_flight EXCEPT price ) WITH price = iv_new_price
                                         ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).

    IF lines( mt_flights ) = lv_old_lines.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_update( ).
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_new_price = '130.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated exp = abap_true msg = 'Existing flight should be updated' ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_all_flights( )[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '130.00' msg = 'Price should be updated to 130.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_flight.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_update( ).
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_new_price = '500.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated exp = abap_true msg = 'No update should occur for non-existing flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_all_flights( ) ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table size should remain 3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Tabellenmanipulation mit `FOR`, `CONDENSE` und `CORRESPONDING`. Der `FOR`-Operator iteriert über die Tabelle. `CONDENSE` wird hier verwendet, um eine bedingte Zuweisung zu ermöglichen: Wenn die Schlüssel übereinstimmen, wird `CORRESPONDING` verwendet, um die Zeile zu kopieren und nur den Preis zu aktualisieren; andernfalls wird die ursprüngliche Zeile beibehalten. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Tabellen zu aktualisieren.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, CONDENSE, CORRESPONDING, Functional Programming, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_MONITOR` mit einem privaten Event. Implementieren Sie eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_ALERT_HANDLER`, die sich für dieses private Event registrieren und darauf reagieren kann, ohne dass das Event öffentlich ist.
hint: Deklarieren Sie das Event als `PRIVATE` und die Event-Handler-Klasse als `FRIENDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_alert.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    EVENTS flight_status_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_message) TYPE string.

    FRIENDS zcl_flight_alert_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_alert.
    RAISE EVENT flight_status_changed EXPORTING iv_message = 'Flight status critical!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_alert_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_for_alerts
      IMPORTING
        io_monitor TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_monitor.

    METHODS handle_flight_status_change FOR EVENT flight_status_changed OF zcl_flight_monitor
      IMPORTING
        iv_message.

    METHODS get_last_alert_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_alert_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_alert_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_for_alerts.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_flight_status_change FOR io_monitor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_flight_status_change.
    mv_last_alert_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_alert_message.
    rv_message = mv_last_alert_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_private_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_monitor) = NEW zcl_flight_monitor( ).
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_flight_alert_handler( ).

    lo_handler->register_for_alerts( lo_monitor ).

    lo_monitor->trigger_alert( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_handler->get_last_alert_message( ) exp = 'Flight status critical!' msg = 'Handler should receive private event message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `FRIENDS` für die Implementierung eines privaten Event-Mechanismus verwendet werden kann. Das Event `flight_status_changed` ist in `ZCL_FLIGHT_MONITOR` als `PRIVATE` deklariert. Nur die Freundesklasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_ALERT_HANDLER` kann sich für dieses Event registrieren und darauf reagieren. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr enge Kopplung und kontrollierte Kommunikation zwischen spezifischen Klassen, ohne die Event-Schnittstelle öffentlich zu machen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Events, Private Events, Event Handling, Object Orientation

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_has_attachments.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Liste der verfügbaren GOS-Dienste für ein Business-Objekt, um nur solche Dienste anzuzeigen, die 'Anlage' im Text enthalten, unter Verwendung von funktionalen Programmierkonzepten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_manager=>GET_SERVICE_LIST` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_filter_services DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_service_texts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_gos_services
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_service_texts) TYPE tt_service_texts
      RAISING
        cx_gos_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_services IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_gos_services.
    DATA(lv_object_id) = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    DATA(lo_gos_manager) = NEW cl_gos_manager(
      i_object_type = 'BUS2038'

    DATA(lt_service_list) = lo_gos_manager->get_service_list( ).

    rt_filtered_service_texts = VALUE #( FOR ls_service IN FILTER #( lt_service_list USING text = '*Anlage*' ) ( ls_service-text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus einer bestehenden Flugtabelle enthält, wobei die Flugnummern um ein Präfix ergänzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Schleife mit einem VALUE-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES tt_flight_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_prefixed TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES tt_flight_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights          TYPE tt_flight_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_flight_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                connid_prefixed = |FL-{ ls_flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights_in TYPE zcl_it_for_value=>tt_flight_in.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights_in ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights_in ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_flights_in ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_transformed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first-connid_prefixed exp = 'FL-0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Konstruktor ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen zu transformieren oder neu zu füllen. String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen eine einfache und flexible Formatierung von Strings.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, Transformation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ...`
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights          TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_group_by=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich leistungsfähiger und lesbarer als manuelle Gruppierungen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, LOOP, Aggregation

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle zu, indem Sie einen Tabellenausdruck mit einem Schlüssel verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ KEY name = value ]-field`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_text_by_id
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        iv_id         TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_by_id.
    rv_text = it_data[ id = iv_id ]-text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_text_by_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_text_by_id_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_text_by_id.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_it_table_expression=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag 1' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Eintrag 2' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_text_by_id( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_text exp = 'Eintrag 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_text_by_id_not_found.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_it_table_expression=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag 1' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_table_expression( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_text_by_id( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 99 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_itab_line_not_found' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_itab_line_not_found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ key ]`) bieten einen direkten und sehr performanten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle, insbesondere wenn ein eindeutiger Schlüssel definiert ist. Sie sind eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE`.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expression, Key Access, Performance

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer Liste von Flügen unter Verwendung eines REDUCE-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights          TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_reduce=>tt_flight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_empty.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_reduce=>tt_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Zeile auszudrücken, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flügen, um nur die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten, unter Verwendung eines FILTER-Ausdrucks.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator, um Daten zwischen zwei internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Zeilentypen, aber übereinstimmenden Feldnamen, zu verschieben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `itab_target = CORRESPONDING #( itab_source )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source          TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING name = name amount = amount EXCEPT id ).
    " Alternatively, if all fields with same name should be mapped:
    " rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
    " For demo, we explicitly map and exclude 'id' as it's not in target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_it_corresponding=>tt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item A' amount = '10.50' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item B' amount = '20.00' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first-amount exp = '10.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_first-status ). " Status should be initial as it's not in source
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ermöglicht das einfache und effiziente Verschieben von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, deren Feldnamen übereinstimmen. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code für manuelle Zuweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, insbesondere bei komplexen Datentypen.
keywords: Internal Tables, CORRESPONDING, Data Transfer, Mapping

CLASS zcl_get_param_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_get_param_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_param_details.
    DATA(lo_profile_param) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).

        rs_details-values = lx_error->get_text( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toggle_button_toolbar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_toggle_button_toolbar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_toolbar.
    ro_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( parent = io_container ).

        fcode = 'TOGGLE_VIEW'

        quickinfo = 'Ansicht ein/aus'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und geben Sie diese mit `cl_demo_output` aus.

CLASS zcl_demo_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
        cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>display( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` und den Modulo-Operator (`MOD`).

CLASS zcl_demo_cond_output DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_number IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS display_check_result IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_cond_output IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_number.
    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN iv_number MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'Gerade'
      ELSE 'Ungerade' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_check_result.
    DATA(lv_result) = check_number( iv_number = iv_number ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Die Zahl { iv_number } ist { lv_result }.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität (`seatsmax`) für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_demo_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
    METHODS display_total_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_total_seats.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = calculate_total_seats( ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Gesamtzahl der Sitze für LH-Flüge: { lv_total_seats }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_demo_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( ).
    " We can't know the exact sum without querying the DB, but we can check if it's not initial.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_seats msg = 'Total seats should not be zero' ).
    " For a more robust test, one would mock sflight or use a known dataset.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_demo_reduce_sum( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_total_seats( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Display method call should not raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Display method call raised an unexpected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine generische Eingabe (`any`) akzeptiert und basierend auf ihrem elementaren Typ (z.B. `C`, `N`, `I`, `F`, `STRING`) eine spezifische Aktion ausführt (z.B. Länge ausgeben, Wert verdoppeln). Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data( )` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung auf `type_kind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_action_by_type IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action_by_type.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ) ).

    CASE lo_elem_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Typ CHAR: Wert '{ iv_data }', Länge: { lo_elem_descr->length }| ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Typ NUMC: Wert '{ iv_data }', Länge: { lo_elem_descr->length }| ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        DATA(lv_int_val) = CAST i( iv_data ).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Typ INT: Wert { lv_int_val }, Verdoppelt: { lv_int_val * 2 }| ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
        DATA(lv_float_val) = CAST f( iv_data ).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Typ FLOAT: Wert { lv_float_val }, Verdoppelt: { lv_float_val * 2 }| ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Typ STRING: Wert '{ iv_data }', Länge: { lo_elem_descr->length }| ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Unbekannter elementarer Typ: { lo_elem_descr->type_name }| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen mit `carrid = 'AA'` und `connid = '0017'`, extrahieren Sie nur `fldate` und `price`, und geben Sie die Ergebnisse mit `cl_demo_output` in einer Methodenkette aus.

CLASS zcl_demo_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
    METHODS display_filtered_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight )
      ( ls_sflight ) ).

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' )
      ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        price  = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_filtered_flights.
    get_filtered_flights( )->cl_demo_output=>display( ). " Method chaining
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach `carrid` und `connid`. Geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und die Anzahl der Flüge in dieser Gruppe mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `cl_demo_output`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_demo_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight UP TO 20 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>begin_section( 'Gruppierte Flüge' ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      cl_demo_output=>write(
        |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_group_key-carrid }, Flugnummer: { ls_group_key-connid }, Anzahl Flüge: { lv_count }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>end_section( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Wert eines beliebigen elementaren Typs in einen String konvertiert. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr` und `cl_demo_output` zur Anzeige des konvertierten Wertes und des ursprünglichen Typs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung auf `type_kind` für typspezifische Konvertierung oder String-Templates für generische Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_string IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS display_converted_value IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_string.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ) ).

    CASE lo_elem_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        rv_string = iv_data.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        rv_string = |{ CAST i( iv_data ) }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
        rv_string = |{ CAST f( iv_data ) }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
        rv_string = |{ CAST p( iv_data ) }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat.
        rv_string = |{ CAST decfloat34( iv_data ) }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
        rv_string = |{ CAST d( iv_data ) DATE = USER }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
        rv_string = |{ CAST t( iv_data ) TIME = USER }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_string = 'Konvertierung nicht unterstützt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_converted_value.
    DATA(lv_converted_string) = convert_to_string( iv_data ).
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ) ).
    cl_demo_output=>display(
      |Originaltyp: { lo_elem_descr->type_name }, Konvertierter Wert: '{ lv_converted_string }'|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (`price`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`LH`).

CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine neue interne Tabelle mit den Werten von zwei dynamisch angegebenen Spalten zurückgibt. Dies ist nützlich, um flexible Daten für `cl_gui_chart_engine` vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_chart_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_chart_point,
             key_value   TYPE string,
             data_value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_generic_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_generic_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_generic_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_chart_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_key_field    TYPE string
        iv_data_field   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_generic_chart_points
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type. " For invalid field names
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_chart_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_chart_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_key_field>   TYPE any,
                   <fs_data_field>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_key_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_key_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Handle error: key field not found
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type
          EXPORTING
            text = |Key field '{ iv_key_field }' not found.|.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_data_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_data_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Handle error: data field not found
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type
          EXPORTING
            text = |Data field '{ iv_data_field }' not found.|.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE ty_generic_chart_point(
        key_value  = |{ <fs_key_field> }| " Implicit MOVE and conversion
        data_value = <fs_data_field>    " Implicit MOVE and conversion
      ) TO rt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id    TYPE i,

           END OF ty_test_data.

    METHODS test_get_dynamic_chart_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field_name FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dynamic_chart_data.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE tt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( id = 1 value = '10.5' ) TO lt_source_data.

hint: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis zuerst und filtern Sie dann die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_above_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_above_average_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_above_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_average_price.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
                                     FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_all_flights
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).

    DATA(lv_average_price) = COND s_price(
                                 WHEN lines( lt_all_flights ) > 0
                                 THEN lv_total_price / lines( lt_all_flights )
                                 ELSE 0 ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE price > lv_average_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflights_source,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflights_source.

             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,

CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_source_data).

CLASS zcl_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        max_price   = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0 TYPE s_price
                                 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                 NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = <fs_group_member>-price ) ) " Use nmax for numeric max
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_base64 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS process_string_base64
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string

        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.

CLASS zcl_bin_base64 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string_base64.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                            iv_string = iv_input_string
                            iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lv_base64_encoded) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>base64_encode( lv_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_xstring_decoded) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>base64_decode( lv_base64_encoded ).

    rv_output_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                            iv_xstring = lv_xstring_decoded
                            iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener XSTRING gültige Bilddaten enthält und bestimmen Sie den MIME-Typ des Bildes (z.B. 'image/jpeg', 'image/png').
hint: Die Methode `get_image_info` von `cl_fxs_image_info` liefert auch den MIME-Typ. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist wichtig.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_validation_result,
             is_valid  TYPE abap_bool,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             error_msg TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_validation_result.

    METHODS validate_image
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_image_validation_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_image.
    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).
    TRY.
        lo_image_info->get_image_info(
          EXPORTING
            i_image_xstring = iv_image_xstring
          IMPORTING
            e_mime_type     = rs_result-mime_type ).
        rs_result-is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_image_info).
        rs_result-is_valid = abap_false.
        rs_result-error_msg = lx_image_info->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_image FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_image FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_image.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_img_validation( ).
    " Minimal 1x1 transparent GIF (hex representation)
    DATA(lv_gif_xstring) = '47494638396101000100800000FFFFFF00000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_validator->validate_image( lv_gif_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result-is_valid
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Gültiges Bild sollte als gültig erkannt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result-mime_type
      exp = 'image/gif'
      msg = 'MIME-Typ sollte image/gif sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_image.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_img_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) = '0000000000000000'. "Not a valid image

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_validator->validate_image( lv_invalid_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result-is_valid
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Ungültiges Bild sollte als ungültig erkannt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_result-error_msg
      msg = 'Fehlermeldung sollte vorhanden sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Methode `get_image_info` löst eine Exception vom Typ `cx_fxs_image_info` aus, wenn die übergebenen Daten kein gültiges Bild darstellen. Dies wird mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen, um den Validierungsstatus und eine Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben. Die Struktur `ty_image_validation_result` und die Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Elemente.
keywords: Image, Validation, MIME Type, XSTRING, cl_fxs_image_info, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugverbindungen aus `sflights` enthält, deren `CARRID` 'LH' ist und deren `PRICE` über 1000 liegt. Die neue Tabelle soll nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `PRICE` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND price > 1000 )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        price  = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    " Setup dummy data for sflights if not available or for isolated testing
    " For this example, we assume sflights contains data.
    " In a real scenario, you might mock the database access.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Assert that at least one flight is found (assuming LH flights > 1000 exist)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result ) = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten gefilterte Flüge gefunden werden.' ).

    " Assert specific conditions for a found entry (example)
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_first_flight-price > 1000 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und zu mappen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge, und die nachfolgende Klammer definiert die Struktur der neuen Zeilen. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND` Konstrukte.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, FILTER, Mapping, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Nachricht, die den Flug `LH 400` mit einem Preis von `1234.56 EUR` und der Information, ob der Flug verfügbar ist (`true`/`false`), anzeigt. Nutzen Sie String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit `|...|` und `COND` für die Verfügbarkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_price     TYPE s_price
        iv_available TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_message.
    rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } kostet { iv_price , currency = 'EUR' } und ist |
               && |{ COND string( WHEN iv_available = abap_true THEN 'verfügbar' ELSE 'nicht verfügbar' ) }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_message.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_str_template( ).

    DATA(lv_message_available) = lo_creator->create_flight_message(
      iv_carrid    = 'LH'
      iv_connid    = '400'
      iv_price     = '1234.56'
      iv_available = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message_available
      exp = 'Flug LH 400 kostet 1.234,56 EUR und ist verfügbar.' ).

    DATA(lv_message_not_available) = lo_creator->create_flight_message(
      iv_carrid    = 'AA'
      iv_connid    = '001'
      iv_price     = '500.00'
      iv_available = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message_not_available
      exp = 'Flug AA 001 kostet 500,00 EUR und ist nicht verfügbar.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen eine intuitive und lesbare Formatierung von Zeichenketten. Variablen und Ausdrücke können direkt eingebettet werden. Der `COND`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um basierend auf einer Bedingung einen passenden Text für die Verfügbarkeit zu wählen, was den Code sehr kompakt macht.
keywords: String Templates, COND, String Processing, Formatting

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine einfache Schnittstelle für einen Logger und implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse. Eine weitere Klasse soll diesen Logger per Konstruktor-Injektion erhalten und verwenden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle `IF_LOGGER` und eine implementierende Klasse `CL_CONSOLE_LOGGER`. Nutzen Sie `NEW` zur Instanziierung und Übergabe im Konstruktor.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In einer echten Anwendung würde hier auf die Konsole oder ein Log geschrieben.
    " WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.

    METHODS perform_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->zif_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_action.
    zif_logger~log_message( 'Aktion wird ausgeführt...' ).
    " ... weitere Logik ...
    zif_logger~log_message( 'Aktion abgeschlossen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_app_service( io_logger = lo_logger ).

    " In einem echten Test würde man hier einen Mock-Logger injizieren
    " und überprüfen, ob die log_message-Methode aufgerufen wurde.
    " Da dies ein einfacher Konsolen-Logger ist, prüfen wir nur die Instanziierung.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_service
      msg = 'Service-Objekt sollte instanziiert sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_service->zif_logger
      msg = 'Logger sollte injiziert sein.' ).

    " Aufruf der Methode, die den Logger verwendet
    lo_service->perform_action( ).

    " Keine direkte Assert-Möglichkeit für den Konsolen-Output hier,
    " aber der Test stellt sicher, dass der Code ohne Dump läuft.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert Konstruktor-Injektion, ein wichtiges Prinzip der Objektorientierung und des Dependency Inversion Principle. Die Klasse `zcl_app_service` ist nicht direkt von `zcl_console_logger` abhängig, sondern von der Schnittstelle `zif_logger`. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und Testbarkeit des Codes. Der `NEW`-Operator wird für die Instanziierung verwendet.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interfaces, Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, NEW

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für den `CARRID` 'AA'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    " Setup dummy data for sflights if not available or for isolated testing
    " For this example, we assume sflights contains data.
    " In a real scenario, you might mock the database access.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_math_reduce( ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices 100, 200, 300 in sflights
    " For a robust test, insert dummy data into a local temporary table or mock.
    " Here, we'll assume a known sum for 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = '600.00'. " Example: 100 + 200 + 300

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_expected_price
      msg = 'Die berechnete Summe sollte dem erwarteten Wert entsprechen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen wie Summen, Minima, Maxima oder das Zusammenführen von Daten. Sie initialisiert eine Ergebnisvariable (`sum_price`) und iteriert über eine interne Tabelle, wobei die Ergebnisvariable in jedem Schritt aktualisiert wird. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Schleifen mit expliziten `SUM`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Status-Text zu, basierend auf einem numerischen Status-Code (1='Neu', 2='In Bearbeitung', 3='Abgeschlossen', sonst 'Unbekannt'). Demonstrieren Sie dies sowohl mit `COND` als auch mit `SWITCH`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` und `SWITCH` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_status_text_switch
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text_cond.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Neu'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 3 THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_text_switch.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string( iv_status_code
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Neu'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cond_expression FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_switch_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cond_expression.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_cond( 1 ) exp = 'Neu' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_cond( 2 ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_cond( 3 ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_cond( 99 ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_switch_expression.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_switch( 1 ) exp = 'Neu' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_switch( 2 ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_switch( 3 ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_text_switch( 99 ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COND` und `SWITCH` sind Ausdrücke, die eine bedingte Zuweisung von Werten ermöglichen. `COND` ist flexibler und kann beliebige Bedingungen prüfen, während `SWITCH` für den Vergleich eines einzelnen Werts mit mehreren Konstanten optimiert ist. Beide bieten eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu langen `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF` oder `CASE...WHEN...ENDCASE` Konstrukten, wenn es um die Zuweisung eines einzelnen Werts geht.
keywords: COND, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle ein, die nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE` und `PRICE` enthält. Nutzen Sie die moderne Open SQL Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_raw).

    " Wenn die Struktur der Zieltabelle identisch ist, kann man direkt INTO TABLE @DATA(rt_flight_summaries) verwenden.
    " Hier demonstrieren wir CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE für den Fall, dass die Strukturen abweichen könnten.
    rt_flight_summaries = CORRESPONDING #( lt_flights_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summaries.
    " Setup dummy data for sflights if not available or for isolated testing
    " For this example, we assume sflights contains data.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sql_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_reader->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result ) = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten Flugzusammenfassungen gefunden werden.' ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Open SQL Syntax erlaubt Inline-Deklarationen (`@DATA(...)`) direkt in der `INTO`-Klausel, was den Code kürzer und die Variablendeklaration näher an ihrer Verwendung hält. Der `@`-Escape-Charakter ist für Host-Variablen obligatorisch. `CORRESPONDING #` ist ein weiterer moderner Operator, der es erlaubt, Daten zwischen internen Tabellen mit (teilweise) übereinstimmenden Strukturen einfach zu kopieren, ohne explizit Felder zu mappen.
keywords: Open SQL, SELECT, INTO TABLE, DATA, CORRESPONDING, sflights

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf einen Eintrag einer internen Tabelle mittels Tabellen-Expression zu und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key_field = value ]` und `DEFAULT` für den Fehlerfall.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    " Dummy-Daten für den Test
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251225' price = '1234.56' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251226' price = '500.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    rs_flight = VALUE #( lt_flights[ carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ] DEFAULT THROW cx_sy_itab_line_not_found( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_found_entry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_not_found_entry FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_found_entry.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_itb_table_expr( ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_itb_table_expr=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_accessor->get_flight_details( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '1234.56' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_found_entry.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_itb_table_expr( ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_itb_table_expr=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '999' ).

    " Erwartet, dass eine Exception ausgelöst wird
    lo_accessor->get_flight_details( ls_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found wurde nicht ausgelöst.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellen-Expressions (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf Schlüsselwerten. Der `DEFAULT`-Zusatz ist eine moderne Erweiterung, um das Verhalten zu steuern, wenn kein Eintrag gefunden wird. Hier wird eine Exception ausgelöst, was eine saubere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht. Alternativ könnte man einen Initialwert zuweisen. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Art des Tabellenzugriffs.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, DEFAULT, Exception Handling, VALUE
