Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string. " Return as string for generic use
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name INTO DATA(ls_component).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE iv_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existent_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_s_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_read_field( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_field_value( iv_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_field_value( iv_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CONNID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existent_field.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_s_flight( carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_read_field( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( iv_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Feldwerte einer Struktur zur Laufzeit ist ein Kernfeature der dynamischen Programmierung. Mittels `cl_abap_structdescr` wird die Struktur analysiert, um die Existenz des Feldes zu prüfen. Der eigentliche Zugriff erfolgt dann über `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`, was einen typsicheren, dynamischen Zugriff ermöglicht. Der Wert wird generisch als String zurückgegeben.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamischer Zugriff, Feld-Symbol, Struktur, Wert lesen

Instructions: Setzen Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch in einer Struktur, dessen Name und neuer Wert zur Laufzeit bekannt sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) für den dynamischen Zugriff und die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_set_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE any.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_set_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( cs_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name INTO DATA(ls_component).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Attempt to assign, conversion might be needed for non-string types
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle conversion error if new_value cannot be converted to field type
            " For simplicity, we ignore it here, but in real code, it should be handled.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_field_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_non_existent_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_field_with_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_field_value.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_s_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_set_field( ).
    lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_new_value = 'UA' CHANGING cs_data = ls_flight ).
    lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'CONNID' iv_new_value = '007' CHANGING cs_data = ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '007' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_non_existent_field.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_s_flight( carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(ls_original_flight) = ls_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_set_field( ).
    lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_new_value = 'XYZ' CHANGING cs_data = ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = ls_original_flight-carrid ). " Should remain unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_field_with_conversion_error.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             number TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_s_data( number = 10 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_set_field( ).
    " Attempt to set an integer field with a non-numeric string
    lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'NUMBER' iv_new_value = 'ABC' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-number exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das dynamische Setzen von Feldwerten ist eine Erweiterung des dynamischen Lesens. Nach der Identifizierung des Feldes über `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` wird der neue Wert dem Feld-Symbol zugewiesen. Es ist wichtig, potenzielle Konvertierungsfehler zu beachten, wenn der neue Wert nicht zum Typ des Zielfeldes passt. Ein `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error` ist hier ratsam, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamischer Zugriff, Feld-Symbol, Struktur, Wert setzen

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strukturen dynamisch Feld für Feld und ermitteln Sie, ob sie identisch sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und Feld-Symbole, um die Werte jedes Feldes zu vergleichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_data1 TYPE any
        is_data2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr1) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr2) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_data2 ).

    " First, check if structures have the same type
    IF lo_struct_descr1->get_relative_name( ) <> lo_struct_descr2->get_relative_name( ).
      rb_are_equal = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ).
    rb_are_equal = abap_true. " Assume equal until proven otherwise

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_data1 TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_data2 TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).

      IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
        IF <fs_field1> <> <fs_field2>.
          rb_are_equal = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if types are identical, but good for robustness
        rb_are_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst wird der Zeilentyp der gewünschten Tabelle aus einer vorhandenen Datenreferenz mit `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` ermittelt. Dieser Typ-Deskriptor wird dann an `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` übergeben, um einen Tabellentyp-Deskriptor zu erzeugen. Schließlich wird mit `CREATE DATA ... TYPE HANDLE` eine Datenreferenz auf die dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle erzeugt. Dies ist ideal für generische Datenverarbeitungsschichten.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_char_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_char_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_char) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_char_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_char_field.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name INTO DATA(ls_component).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type_descr ).
      IF lo_elem_descr->get_type_kind( ) = lo_elem_descr->typekind_char.
        rb_is_char = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Um den elementaren Typ eines Feldes dynamisch zu überprüfen, wird nach dem Abrufen der Komponenteninformationen über `cl_abap_structdescr` der `type_descr` des Feldes zu `cl_abap_elemdescr` gecastet. Dessen Methode `get_type_kind` liefert den Typ-Kind-Wert (z.B. `typekind_char` für Character-Typen), was eine präzise dynamische Typüberprüfung ermöglicht. Dies ist nützlich für generische Validierungen oder Formatierungen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Länge eines Character-Feldes in einer Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_length`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_char_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_char_field_length
      IMPORTING
        iv_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_char_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_char_field_length.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name INTO DATA(ls_component).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type_descr ).
      IF lo_elem_descr->get_type_kind( ) = lo_elem_descr->typekind_char.
        rv_length = lo_elem_descr->get_length( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den MIME-Typ eines Bildes aus einem XSTRING.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fxs_image_info` und die Methode `get_image_info` (indirekt über das Format).
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_mime_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_image_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_mime_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_mime_type.
    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).
    DATA(lv_format) TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lo_image_info->get_image_info(
          EXPORTING
            i_image_xstring = iv_image_xstring
          IMPORTING
            e_format        = lv_format
        ).
        CASE lv_format.
          WHEN 'JPG'.
            rv_mime_type = 'image/jpeg'.
          WHEN 'PNG'.
            rv_mime_type = 'image/png'.
          WHEN 'GIF'.
            rv_mime_type = 'image/gif'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_mime_type = 'application/octet-stream'. " Generic binary
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_error.
        rv_mime_type = 'application/octet-stream'. " Default for invalid or unknown
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_mime_type_png FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_get_mime_type_invalid FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_img_mime_type( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_image_mime_type( lv_valid_png_xstring ) exp = 'image/png' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_mime_type_jpeg.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_mime_type_invalid.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_img_mime_type( ).

explanation: Der MIME-Typ eines Bildes ist für Web-Anwendungen und die korrekte Übertragung von Bilddaten unerlässlich. Obwohl `cl_fxs_image_info` den MIME-Typ nicht direkt liefert, kann das ermittelte Bildformat (`e_format`) verwendet werden, um den entsprechenden MIME-Typ zuzuordnen. Dies ist eine gängige Praxis, um Bilddaten korrekt zu identifizieren und zu verarbeiten.
keywords: Bildverarbeitung, XSTRING, MIME-Typ, Format, Web

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Dateigröße (in Bytes) eines Bildes, das als XSTRING vorliegt, und kombinieren Sie diese mit den Dimensionen.

CLASS zcl_img_size_dims DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_img_size_dims IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_size_and_dims.
    rs_full_info-size_bytes = xstrlen( iv_image_xstring ).

        lo_image_info->get_image_info(
          EXPORTING

            e_height        = rs_full_info-height
            e_format        = rs_full_info-format
        ).
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_error.
        " Dimensions and format will remain initial if error occurs
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit eines LOOP AT über eine interne Tabelle mit cl_abap_runtime, um alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu zählen.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_as_usec() und eine LOOP AT Schleife mit WHERE Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_loop_at DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_loop_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_loop_at IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_loop_performance.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_as_usec( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_runtime_us = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_as_usec( ) - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_performance_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-planetype = 'A320'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-planetype = 'B747'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-planetype = 'A321'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_loop_at( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_loop_performance( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'Runtime should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_as_usec() ermöglicht eine präzise Messung der Ausführungszeit von Code-Blöcken. Die LOOP AT ... WHERE Syntax ist eine effiziente Methode, um über interne Tabellen zu iterieren und dabei nur relevante Einträge zu verarbeiten.
keywords: cl_abap_runtime, LOOP AT, Performance, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus sflights nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und REDUCE.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT itab GROUP BY und den REDUCE Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_sum,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_sum.
    TYPES tt_passenger_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_passenger_sums) TYPE tt_passenger_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      rt_passenger_sums = VALUE #( BASE rt_passenger_sums ( 
          carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
          total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                       FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                       NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsocc ) 
      ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_reduce.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 75 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_sum) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_sum-total_passengers exp = 225 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_sum) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_sum-total_passengers exp = 350 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Tabellenzeilen direkt während der Iteration. In Kombination mit dem REDUCE Operator kann man Aggregationen (hier die Summe der Passagiere) für jede Gruppe sehr kompakt und lesbar formulieren. Der VALUE Operator wird verwendet, um die Ergebniszeilen direkt in die Zieltabelle einzufügen.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von 'LH' (Lufthansa) enthält und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, unter Verwendung eines FOR Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR Ausdruck mit einer WHERE Klausel und sy-datum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_lh_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_lh_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND fldate > sy-datum )
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_filter_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_filter_map.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum - 1 planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum + 1 planetype = 'A321' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum + 2 planetype = 'B747' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum + 3 planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_lh_flights( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR Ausdruck in Kombination mit VALUE ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen. Die WHERE Klausel innerhalb des FOR Ausdrucks dient als Filter, wodurch eine separate LOOP AT Schleife mit IF Bedingungen vermieden wird. Dies führt zu kürzerem und besser lesbarem Code.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Mapping

Instructions: Deklarieren und initialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten für zwei Flüge direkt mit dem VALUE Operator.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Flugstatus ('X' für storniert, 'O' für pünktlich, 'D' für verspätet) einen beschreibenden Text zurückgibt, unter Verwendung von SWITCH oder COND.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH Ausdruck für mehrere Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status
                               WHEN 'X' THEN 'Flug storniert'
                               WHEN 'O' THEN 'Flug pünktlich'
                               WHEN 'D' THEN 'Flug verspätet'
                               ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_switch_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_switch_expression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'X' ) exp = 'Flug storniert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'O' ) exp = 'Flug pünktlich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'D' ) exp = 'Flug verspätet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'Z' ) exp = 'Unbekannter Status' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: SWITCH Ausdrücke bieten eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu verschachtelten IF-ELSEIF-ENDIF Anweisungen oder CASE Anweisungen, wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: SWITCH, COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf einen Flugdatensatz in einer internen Tabelle zu, indem Sie die Flugnummer als Schlüssel verwenden (Table Expression).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Syntax itab[ key_field = value ].
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_expression FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_expression_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_unit_assert_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_expression.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_expression_not_found.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flight_details( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_itab_line_not_found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Table Expressions ermöglichen den direkten, deklarativen Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle mittels Schlüssel oder Index. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und leistungsstarke Alternative zu READ TABLE und führt zu deutlich lesbarerem Code. Bei nicht gefundenen Zeilen wird eine Ausnahme (cx_sy_itab_line_not_found) ausgelöst.
keywords: Table Expression, Internal Tables, Direct Access, READ TABLE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Klasse und rufen Sie mehrere Methoden in einer Kette auf, um eine Konfiguration zu setzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den NEW Operator und Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining).
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_param1 IMPORTING iv_param TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS set_param2 IMPORTING iv_param TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_config RETURNING VALUE(rv_config) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    mv_param1 = iv_param.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    mv_param2 = iv_param.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config.
    rv_config = |Param1: { mv_param1 }, Param2: { mv_param2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_config) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( )->set_param1( 'Value A' )->set_param2( 'Value B' )->get_config( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_config exp = 'Param1: Value A, Param2: Value B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der NEW Operator ermöglicht die Inline-Erstellung von Objekten. Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung kombiniert werden. Dies ist möglich, wenn jede Methode eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (ME) zurückgibt.
keywords: NEW, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Inline Object Creation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten, unter Verwendung des FILTER Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_operator.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER Operator bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu LOOP AT ... WHERE und dem Sammeln der Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle, was zu kürzerem und performanterem Code führt.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit gleichem Namen übernommen werden, unter Verwendung des CORRESPONDING Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie MOVE-CORRESPONDING oder den CORRESPONDING Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
             field_d TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_operator.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
             field_d TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    DATA ls_source TYPE ty_source.
    ls_source-field_a = 'Alpha'.
    ls_source-field_b = 123.
    ls_source-field_c = 'Charlie'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_op( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_b exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_c exp = 'Charlie' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_d ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING Operator (oder MOVE-CORRESPONDING) ermöglicht die einfache und typsichere Übertragung von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen und kompatiblen Typen berücksichtigt werden. Die moderne Syntax mit CORRESPONDING #( source ) ist kompakter und kann auch für Tabellen verwendet werden.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Transfer, Structures, Internal Tables

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE Operator, um den höchsten Wert eines Feldes (z.B. 'seatsocc' aus sflights) in einer internen Tabelle zu finden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE Operator mit einer Vergleichslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_occupied_seats.
    rv_max_seats = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc( INIT max_val = 0
                                            FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                            NEXT max_val = nmax( val1 = max_val val2 = ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_max FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_max.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 250 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max( ).
    DATA(lv_max_seats) = lo_cut->get_max_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_seats exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um den maximalen Wert eines Feldes zu finden, indem in jeder Iteration der aktuelle Maximalwert mit dem Wert der aktuellen Zeile verglichen wird. Dies ist eine funktionale und kompakte Alternative zu einer expliziten LOOP AT Schleife mit einer Hilfsvariable.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Max Value

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten aus sflights, wobei die Spalten dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR und Feld-Symbole für dynamische Tabellen und Spalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_fieldnames TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      CASE lv_fieldname.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          ls_component-name = 'CARRID'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( 3 ).
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_n( 4 ).
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          ls_component-name = 'FLDATE'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    SELECT (it_fieldnames) FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <fs_table> UP TO 10 ROWS.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA lt_fields TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_fields.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_fields.
    APPEND 'FLDATE' TO lt_fields.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_sflight_table( it_fieldnames = lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) > 0 ) ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_carrid> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_carrid> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP ermöglicht es, Strukturen und Tabellen zur Laufzeit zu definieren. Hier wird CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle mit Spalten zu erstellen, deren Namen und Typen zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Dies ist nützlich für generische Berichte oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die Datenstruktur nicht im Voraus bekannt ist. Die SELECT (it_fieldnames) Syntax ermöglicht das dynamische Auswählen von Spalten aus der Datenbank.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, Field-Symbols, SELECT dynamic

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und modifizieren Sie Zeilen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, unter Verwendung von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und einer Inline-Deklaration für das Feld-Symbol.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>) WHERE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE status IS INITIAL.
      <fs_flight>-status = 'O'. "Set status to 'On Time' if not set
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_assign_modify FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_assign_modify.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_flight_status.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = '' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' status = 'X' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' status = '' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assign_modify( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_status( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_flights[ 1 ]-status exp = 'O' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_flights[ 2 ]-status exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_flights[ 3 ]-status exp = 'O' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von LOOP AT mit ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>) und einer WHERE-Klausel ist die effizienteste Methode, um Zeilen einer internen Tabelle direkt zu modifizieren, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Die Inline-Deklaration des Feld-Symbols (<fs_line>) macht den Code kürzer und lesbarer, da keine separate Deklaration des Feld-Symbols erforderlich ist.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING, Field-Symbols, Internal Tables, Modify

Instructions: Verbinden Sie zwei Zeichenketten mit einem Leerzeichen dazwischen unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Operator `&&` für String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_part1 TYPE string
        iv_part2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_result = |{ iv_part1 } { iv_part2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_template_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( iv_part1 = 'Hallo' iv_part2 = 'Welt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hallo Welt' ).

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem einzigen Satz, wobei die Wörter durch Leerzeichen getrennt sind, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um die Wörter zu verbinden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_words
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_words.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word ELSE |{ s } { word }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Dies' ) ( 'ist' ) ( 'ein' ) ( 'Satz' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_words( lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Dies ist ein Satz' ).

    lt_words = VALUE string_table( ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->aggregate_words( lt_words ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein benutzerdefiniertes Ereignis definiert und auslöst, um das Konzept eines Timers zu simulieren. Eine andere Klasse soll dieses Ereignis abonnieren und darauf reagieren.
hint: Definieren Sie ein `EVENT` in der Timer-Klasse und verwenden Sie `RAISE EVENT` zum Auslösen. Abonnieren Sie mit `SET HANDLER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_simulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_finished EXPORTING VALUE(iv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS start_simulation
      IMPORTING
        iv_duration TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_simulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_simulation.
    " In a real GUI scenario, cl_gui_timer would raise an event after iv_duration.
    " Here, we simulate it directly.
    WAIT UP TO iv_duration SECONDS. " Simulate work/delay
    RAISE EVENT timer_finished EXPORTING iv_message = |Timer finished after { iv_duration } seconds.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished
      FOR EVENT timer_finished OF zcl_timer_simulator
      IMPORTING
        iv_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_last_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_event_simulation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_event_simulation.
    DATA(lo_timer) = NEW zcl_timer_simulator( ).
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_timer_handler( ).

    SET HANDLER lo_handler->handle_timer_finished FOR lo_timer.

    lo_timer->start_simulation( 1 ). " Simulate a 1-second timer

    " The event is raised synchronously in this simulation,
    " so the handler should have been called immediately.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_handler->mv_last_message
      exp = 'Timer finished after 1 seconds.'
      msg = 'Handler should have received the timer finished message.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl `cl_gui_timer` selbst ein GUI-Control ist, kann das Prinzip der Ereignisbehandlung, das es nutzt, mit diesen modernen Sprachkonstrukten simuliert und getestet werden. CLASS zcl_read_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_read_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_read_sflights( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Zeichenkette aus einer Liste von Komponenten zusammenfügt, wobei die Komponenten und ein Trennzeichen als Parameter übergeben werden. Nutzen Sie dabei `REDUCE` und String-Templates.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE string_table
        iv_delimiter  TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_actual_delimiter) = COND string( WHEN iv_delimiter IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_delimiter ELSE | | ).

    rv_result = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR component IN it_components
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN component ELSE |{ s }{ lv_actual_delimiter }{ component }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sign_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_xml_signature.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->verify_signature(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
        ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error. " Re-raise for unit test to catch
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

          <SignedInfo>

            <SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1"/>
            <Reference URI="">
              <Transforms>
                <Transform Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#enveloped-signature"/>
                <Transform Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315"/>
              </Transforms>

              <X509Certificate>dummy_certificate_value=</X509Certificate>
            </X509Data>
          </KeyInfo>
        </Signature>
      </Data>'
      CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_sign_verify( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->verify_xml_signature( lv_signed_xml_xstr ).
        " This assertion might fail if no valid cryptographic setup exists for the dummy signature.
        " For a real test, ensure the dummy XML is actually verifiable or mock cl_secxml_helper.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true ).

            <SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1"/>

                <Transform Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315"/>
              </Transforms>
              <DigestMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#sha1"/>

Instructions: Verschlüsseln Sie einen spezifischen Teil eines XML-Dokuments und entschlüsseln Sie ihn anschließend wieder, um die Vertraulichkeit der Daten zu gewährleisten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_SECXML_HELPER` für die Methoden `encrypt_element` und `decrypt_element` unter Angabe eines XPath und eines Schlüsselnamens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_encrypt_decrypt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS encrypt_xml_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
        iv_xpath    TYPE string
        iv_key_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_encrypted_xml) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_secxml_error.

    METHODS decrypt_xml_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_encrypted_xml TYPE xstring
        iv_key_name      TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decrypted_xml) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_secxml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_encrypt_decrypt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encrypt_xml_element.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->encrypt_element(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
            iv_xpath        = iv_xpath
            iv_key_name     = iv_key_name
        ).
        rv_encrypted_xml = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decrypt_xml_element.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring( iv_encrypted_xml ).

    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->decrypt_element(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
            iv_key_name     = iv_key_name
        ).
        rv_decrypted_xml = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_encrypt_decrypt FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_encrypt_decrypt.
    DATA(lv_original_xml_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Root><SensitiveData>Secret</SensitiveData><OtherData>Public</OtherData></Root>'
      CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    DATA(lv_xpath) = '/Root/SensitiveData'.
    DATA(lv_key_name) = 'DUMMY_KEY_FOR_TEST'. " This key must exist in STRUST for real encryption

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_encrypt_decrypt( ).
    DATA(lv_encrypted_xml) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_decrypted_xml) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lv_encrypted_xml = lo_cut->encrypt_xml_element(
          iv_xml_data = lv_original_xml_xstr
          iv_xpath    = lv_xpath
          iv_key_name = lv_key_name
        ).
        " Assert that the encrypted XML is different from original and contains encrypted data markers
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_encrypted_xml exp = lv_original_xml_xstr ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'EncryptedData' in = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_encrypted_xml ) ).

        lv_decrypted_xml = lo_cut->decrypt_xml_element(
          iv_encrypted_xml = lv_encrypted_xml
          iv_key_name      = lv_key_name
        ).
        " Assert that decrypted XML matches original
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decrypted_xml exp = lv_original_xml_xstr ).

      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        " If the key doesn't exist in STRUST, encryption/decryption will fail.
        " For a unit test, we might expect this if STRUST isn't set up. 
        " In a real system, ensure the key is configured.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Encryption/Decryption failed: { lx_secxml_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring` und `get_xstring` ist effizient für die Handhabung von XML-Daten als `xstring`.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie ein XML-Dokument basierend auf dem Wert eines bestimmten Attributs im Wurzelelement. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Fallunterscheidung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `iXML` zum Parsen des XML und eine `SWITCH`-Expression für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_cond_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_xml_by_attribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_attribute  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sax_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_cond_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_xml_by_attribute.
    DATA(lo_ixml_factory) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml_factory->create_parser( stream_type = if_ixml_stream_type=>string ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_ixml_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    lo_parser->set_stream( lo_istream ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml_factory->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    IF lo_parser->parse( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sax_parse_error( text = 'XML parsing failed' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_root_element) = lo_document->get_root_element( ).
    DATA(lv_attr_value) = lo_root_element->get_attribute( iv_attribute ).

    rv_result = SWITCH #( lv_attr_value
                          WHEN 'TypeA' THEN 'Processed as Type A'
                          WHEN 'TypeB' THEN 'Processed as Type B'
                          WHEN 'TypeC' THEN 'Processed as Type C'
                          ELSE 'Unknown Type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie dynamisch Werte aus XML-Knoten, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen (z.B. einen bestimmten Namen haben und eine Mindestlänge des Wertes aufweisen). Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Konstrukte wie `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `iXML` zum Traversieren des XML-Baums und `FOR` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `COND` für die Filterung und Transformation der Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_dynamic_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES: tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_nodes_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_node_name  TYPE string
        iv_min_length TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extracted_data) TYPE tt_node_data
      RAISING
        cx_sax_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_dynamic_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_nodes_conditionally.
    DATA(lo_ixml_factory) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml_factory->create_parser( stream_type = if_ixml_stream_type=>string ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_ixml_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    lo_parser->set_stream( lo_istream ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml_factory->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    IF lo_parser->parse( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sax_parse_error( text = 'XML parsing failed' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_all_nodes) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_ixml_node WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_node_iterator) = lo_document->create_iterator( ).
    DATA(lo_node) TYPE REF TO if_ixml_node.

    LOOP AT lo_node_iterator INTO lo_node.
      APPEND lo_node TO lt_all_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_extracted_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR node IN lt_all_nodes
      WHERE ( node->get_type( ) = if_ixml_node=>co_node_element AND node->get_name( ) = iv_node_name )
      LET node_value = node->get_value( ) IN
      ( COND #( WHEN iv_min_length IS INITIAL OR strlen( node_value ) >= iv_min_length
                THEN VALUE ty_node_data( name = node->get_name( ) value = node_value )
                ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( ) ) " This THROW is a trick to filter out non-matching COND branches
      )
    ). 
    " The THROW in COND is used here to effectively filter out elements that don't meet the length criteria.
    " If the COND's WHEN clause is false, the THROW prevents the element from being added to the target table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_with_min_length FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_extract_without_min_length FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_no_matching_nodes FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_parse_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_with_min_length.
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Item>Short</Item><Data>LongerValue</Data><Item>AnotherShort</Item></Root>'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_dynamic_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_nodes_conditionally( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_node_name = 'Data' iv_min_length = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 'LongerValue' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_without_min_length.
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Item>Short</Item><Data>LongerValue</Data><Item>AnotherShort</Item></Root>'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_dynamic_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_nodes_conditionally( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_node_name = 'Item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 'Short' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value exp = 'AnotherShort' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_nodes.
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Item>Short</Item></Root>'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_dynamic_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_nodes_conditionally( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_node_name = 'NonExistent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_error.
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<InvalidXML'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_dynamic_extract( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->extract_nodes_conditionally( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_node_name = 'Data' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sax_parse_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sax_parse_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_sax_parse_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt moderne ABAP-Konstrukte wie `FOR` und `COND` in Kombination mit der `iXML`-Bibliothek, um XML-Knoten dynamisch zu extrahieren und zu filtern. Die `FOR`-Iteration mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und die `COND`-Expression innerhalb der Wertzuweisung ermöglichen eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert. Der `THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( )` innerhalb von `COND` ist ein idiomatische Weg, um Elemente zu filtern, die die Bedingung nicht erfüllen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für XML-Sicherheitsoperationen, die verschiedene Arten von `CX_SECXML_ERROR`-Ausnahmen differenziert behandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit mehreren `WHEN` -Klauseln, um spezifische Unterklassen von `CX_SECXML_ERROR` abzufangen und entsprechend zu reagieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_sec_err_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_security_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
        iv_operation TYPE string " e.g., 'VERIFY', 'ENCRYPT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sec_err_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_security_operation.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    TRY.
        CASE iv_operation.
          WHEN 'VERIFY'.
            lo_secxml_helper->verify_signature( io_xml_document = lo_xml_document ).
            rv_status_message = 'XML-Signatur erfolgreich verifiziert.'.
          WHEN 'ENCRYPT'.
            " Dummy encryption for demonstration, requires key setup
            lo_secxml_helper->encrypt_element( io_xml_document = lo_xml_document iv_xpath = '/Root/Data' iv_key_name = 'DUMMY_KEY' ).
            rv_status_message = 'XML-Element erfolgreich verschlüsselt.'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_status_message = 'Unbekannte Operation angefordert.'.
            RETURN.
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_secxml_error_signature_invalid INTO DATA(lx_sig_invalid).
        rv_status_message = |Fehler: Ungültige XML-Signatur: { lx_sig_invalid->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_secxml_error_key_not_found INTO DATA(lx_key_not_found).
        rv_status_message = |Fehler: Schlüssel nicht gefunden: { lx_key_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        rv_status_message = |Allgemeiner Sicherheitsfehler: { lx_secxml_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine kanonische Transformation auf einem XML-Dokument durch. Dies ist oft ein Vorbereitungsschritt für die Signaturerstellung oder -verifikation.

CLASS zcl_xml_canonicalize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS canonicalize_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_canonical_xml) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_secxml_error.

CLASS zcl_xml_canonicalize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD canonicalize_xml.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->canonicalize_xml(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
          RECEIVING
            rx_canonical_xml = rv_canonical_xml
        ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_secxml_error for invalid XML' ).

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie Daten aus einem XML-Dokument mithilfe von XPath und wenden Sie anschließend eine bedingte Logik (`WHEN`) auf die extrahierten Werte an, um sie zu kategorisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `iXML` für XPath-Abfragen und eine `CASE`-Anweisung oder `SWITCH`-Expression für die Kategorisierung der Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS categorize_xpath_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sax_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_xpath_value.
    DATA(lo_ixml_factory) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml_factory->create_parser( stream_type = if_ixml_stream_type=>string ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_ixml_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    lo_parser->set_stream( lo_istream ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml_factory->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    IF lo_parser->parse( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sax_parse_error( text = 'XML parsing failed' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_xpath_processor) = lo_ixml_factory->create_xpath_processor( lo_document ).
    DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xpath_processor->select_nodes( iv_xpath ).

    IF lo_node_list IS INITIAL OR lo_node_list->get_length( ) = 0.
      rv_category = 'No Value Found'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_first_node) = lo_node_list->get_item( 0 ).
    DATA(lv_node_value) = lo_first_node->get_value( ).

    rv_category = SWITCH #( lv_node_value
                            WHEN 'High' THEN 'Priority: High'
                            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Priority: Medium'
                            WHEN 'Low' THEN 'Priority: Low'
                            ELSE 'Priority: Undefined' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sign_create IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).

    DATA(lv_original_xml_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_original_xml CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_key_name) = 'DUMMY_SIGNING_KEY'. " This key must exist in STRUST for real signature creation

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_sign_create( ).
    DATA(lv_signed_xml_xstr) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lv_signed_xml_xstr = lo_cut->create_xml_signature( iv_xml_data = lv_original_xml_xstr iv_key_name = lv_key_name ).
        DATA(lv_signed_xml_str) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_signed_xml_xstr ).

        " Assert that the XML now contains a Signature element
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '<Signature' in = lv_signed_xml_str ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '</Signature>' in = lv_signed_xml_str ).

      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        " If the key doesn't exist in STRUST, signature creation will fail.
        " For a unit test, we might expect this if STRUST isn't set up.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Signature creation failed: { lx_secxml_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lv_original_xml_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Data><Value>Important Info</Value></Data>'
      CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_sign_create( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_xml_signature( iv_xml_data = lv_original_xml_xstr iv_key_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_KEY' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_secxml_error_key_not_found' ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error_key_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_secxml_error_key_not_found' ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Caught generic cx_secxml_error, expected specific key_not_found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine policy-basierte XML-Validierung, bei der unterschiedliche Validierungsregeln basierend auf dem Inhalt eines XML-Elements angewendet werden. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Regelanwendung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `iXML` zum Parsen und Extrahieren von Werten. Nutzen Sie dann `CASE` oder `SWITCH` mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Anwendung von Validierungslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_policy_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_xml_by_policy
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_validation_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sax_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_policy_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_xml_by_policy.
    DATA(lo_ixml_factory) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml_factory->create_parser( stream_type = if_ixml_stream_type=>string ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_ixml_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    lo_parser->set_stream( lo_istream ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml_factory->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    IF lo_parser->parse( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sax_parse_error( text = 'XML parsing failed' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_xpath_processor) = lo_ixml_factory->create_xpath_processor( lo_document ).
    DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xpath_processor->select_nodes( '/Document/Type' ).
    DATA(lv_document_type) = COND string( WHEN lo_node_list IS NOT INITIAL AND lo_node_list->get_length( ) > 0
                                        THEN lo_node_list->get_item( 0 )->get_value( )
                                        ELSE 'UNKNOWN' ).

    rv_validation_result = CASE lv_document_type.
                             WHEN 'Invoice' THEN
                               " Simulate invoice specific validation
                               DATA(lo_amount_node) = lo_xpath_processor->select_single_node( '/Document/Amount' ).
                               IF lo_amount_node IS NOT INITIAL AND lo_amount_node->get_value( ) > 0.
                                 rv_validation_result = 'Invoice valid: Amount present and positive.'.
                               ELSE.
                                 rv_validation_result = 'Invoice invalid: Amount missing or not positive.'.
                               ENDIF.
                             WHEN 'Order' THEN
                               " Simulate order specific validation
                               DATA(lo_item_count_node) = lo_xpath_processor->select_single_node( '/Document/ItemCount' ).
                               IF lo_item_count_node IS NOT INITIAL AND lo_item_count_node->get_value( ) > 0.
                                 rv_validation_result = 'Order valid: ItemCount present and positive.'.
                               ELSE.
                                 rv_validation_result = 'Order invalid: ItemCount missing or not positive.'.
                               ENDIF.
                             WHEN OTHERS THEN
                               rv_validation_result = 'Validation skipped: Unknown document type.'.
                           ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_extracted_field,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
             type  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_extracted_field.
    TYPES: tt_extracted_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_and_convert_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fields) TYPE tt_extracted_fields
      RAISING
        cx_sax_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_cond_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_and_convert_conditionally.
    DATA(lo_ixml_factory) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml_factory->create_parser( stream_type = if_ixml_stream_type=>string ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_ixml_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    lo_parser->set_stream( lo_istream ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml_factory->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    IF lo_parser->parse( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sax_parse_error( text = 'XML parsing failed' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_root) = lo_document->get_root_element( ).
    DATA(lo_children) = lo_root->get_children( ).
    DATA(lo_node) TYPE REF TO if_ixml_node.

    LOOP AT lo_children INTO lo_node.
      IF lo_node->get_type( ) = if_ixml_node=>co_node_element.
        DATA(lv_node_name) = lo_node->get_name( ).
        DATA(lv_node_value) = lo_node->get_value( ).
        DATA(lv_converted_value) TYPE string.
        DATA(lv_data_type) TYPE string.

        CASE lv_node_name.
          WHEN 'Amount'.
            lv_converted_value = |{ CONV decfloat34( lv_node_value ) DEFAULT 0.00 }|.
            lv_data_type = 'DECIMAL'.
          WHEN 'Date'.
            lv_converted_value = |{ CONV d( lv_node_value ) DEFAULT '00000000' DATE = ISO }|.
            lv_data_type = 'DATE'.
          WHEN 'Status'.
            lv_converted_value = SWITCH #( lv_node_value
                                          WHEN '1' THEN 'Active'
                                          WHEN '0' THEN 'Inactive'
                                          ELSE 'Unknown' ).
            lv_data_type = 'STATUS_TEXT'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            lv_converted_value = lv_node_value.
            lv_data_type = 'STRING'.
        ENDCASE.

        APPEND VALUE ty_extracted_field( name = lv_node_name value = lv_converted_value type = lv_data_type ) TO rt_fields.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_digest_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_xml_digest.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->calculate_digest(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
            iv_xpath        = iv_xpath
          RECEIVING
            rx_digest_value = rv_digest_value
        ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_digest_calculation.
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Data>Value1</Data><Other>Value2</Other></Root>'.
    DATA(lv_xml_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_xml CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_digest_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_digest) = lo_cut->calculate_xml_digest( iv_xml_data = lv_xml_xstr iv_xpath = '/Root/Data' ).

    " The actual digest value depends on the canonicalization and hashing algorithm.
    " For a real test, compare against a pre-calculated digest.
    " Here, we just assert it's not initial.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_digest ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_digest_change_detection.
    DATA(lv_xml_original) = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Data>OriginalValue</Data></Root>'.
    DATA(lv_xml_changed) = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Data>ChangedValue</Data></Root>'.
    DATA(lv_xml_original_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_xml_original CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_xml_changed_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_xml_changed CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_digest_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_digest_original) = lo_cut->calculate_xml_digest( iv_xml_data = lv_xml_original_xstr iv_xpath = '/Root/Data' ).
    DATA(lv_digest_changed) = lo_cut->calculate_xml_digest( iv_xml_data = lv_xml_changed_xstr iv_xpath = '/Root/Data' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_digest_original exp = lv_digest_changed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_secxml_error for invalid XPath' ).

CLASS zcl_xml_sign_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

            iv_property_id  = iv_property_id
            iv_property_value = iv_property_value

        rv_xml_with_props = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.

        lo_secxml_helper->create_signature(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
            iv_key_name     = iv_key_name
        ).

        " Then add the external reference
        lo_secxml_helper->add_reference(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
            iv_uri          = iv_uri
        ).
        rv_xml_with_ref = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
