Instructions: Validieren Sie eine XML-Signatur unter Berücksichtigung einer benutzerdefinierten Validierungsrichtlinie, die bestimmte Bedingungen für die Signaturprüfung festlegt. Nutzen Sie `CL_SECXML_HELPER` und bedingte Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `verify_signature` und implementieren Sie eine zusätzliche Prüfung der Signaturdetails (z.B. Zertifikatsaussteller) mit `CASE` oder `SWITCH` nach der technischen Verifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_sign_policy_val DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_signature_with_policy
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
        iv_expected_issuer TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_secxml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sign_policy_val IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_signature_with_policy.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    TRY.
        " Step 1: Perform technical XML signature verification
        lo_secxml_helper->verify_signature(
          EXPORTING
            io_xml_document = lo_xml_document
        ).

        " Step 2: Implement policy-based validation
        IF iv_expected_issuer IS NOT INITIAL.
          DATA(lv_issuer) = lo_secxml_helper->get_certificate_issuer( io_xml_document = lo_xml_document ).
          IF lv_issuer <> iv_expected_issuer.
            RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_secxml_error( text = 'Policy violation: Unexpected certificate issuer.' ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        rv_is_valid = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Flügen, die mehr als 200 freie Plätze haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i DEFAULT 200
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc, seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsfree > iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( 250 ).

    " Assert that all returned flights have more than 250 free seats
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = <fs_flight>-seatsfree > 250
        msg = |Flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } has { <fs_flight>-seatsfree } free seats, expected > 250.|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some flights are returned (assuming SFLIGHTS has data)

      reverse = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und die Anzahl der freien Sitze (`SEATSFREE`) aus `SFLIGHTS` enthält, aber nur für Flüge mit mehr als 100 freien Sitzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( seatsfree > iv_min_free_seats )
                            ( carrid = flight-carrid
                              seatsfree = flight-seatsfree ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf die Anzahl der freien Sitze eines bestimmten Fluges (`CARRID` 'LH', `CONNID` '0400', `FLDATE` '19950228') in der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle zu. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke `[]` mit `DEFAULT` Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_free_seats_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seatsfree) TYPE sflight-seatsfree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_seats_for_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rv_seatsfree = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid
                                    connid = iv_connid
                                    fldate = iv_fldate ]-seatsfree.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sflights_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                  flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von `SFLIGHTS` in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer ähnlichen, aber nicht identischen Struktur, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES: tt_flight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_short_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_short_flights) TYPE tt_flight_short.

CLASS zcl_sflights_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_short_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_short_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_short_flights( ).

    " Assert that some results are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result ) = 0
      msg = 'No short flights found, check SFLIGHTS data.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    " Assert that a specific field (e.g., carrid) is copied correctly
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_original_flight) = VALUE sflight( ).
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_original_flight WHERE carrid = ls_first_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_first_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_first_flight-fldate.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_first_flight-seatsfree
        exp = ls_original_flight-seatsfree
        msg = 'Seatsfree not copied correctly by CORRESPONDING.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ermöglicht das einfache und effiziente Kopieren von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen, aber teilweise übereinstimmenden Strukturen. Er erspart das manuelle Zuweisen einzelner Felder und ist besonders nützlich, wenn viele Felder den gleichen Namen haben.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Structure Assignment, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und einem Status ('Full' wenn `SEATSFREE` < 10, 'Available' sonst) für Flüge mit mehr als 50 freien Sitzen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i DEFAULT 50
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-seatsfree > iv_min_free_seats )
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                  status = COND string( WHEN flight-seatsfree < 10 THEN 'Full' ELSE 'Available' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_distinct_top DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

ROWS` im `VALUE` Operator ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Methode, um eine bestimmte Anzahl eindeutiger Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle zu extrahieren. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (angenommen mit einem `UTCLONG`-Feld) basierend auf einem `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempelbereich.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `UTCLONG`-Vergleiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_utclong,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             utclong_created TYPE utclong, " Assuming a UTCLONG field for creation timestamp
           END OF ty_sflight_utclong.
    TYPES tt_sflight_utclong TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_utclong WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_utclong
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_utclong
        iv_utclong_from TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong_to   TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_utclong.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_utclong.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE
                                      utclong_created >= iv_utclong_from AND
                                      utclong_created <= iv_utclong_to ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_filter( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_utclong_filter=>tt_sflight_utclong.

    " Populate dummy data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231025' utclong_created = '20231025100000000000' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20231026' utclong_created = '20231026110000000000' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20231027' utclong_created = '20231027120000000000' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_utclong_from) = '20231026000000000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_to)   = '20231026235959999999'.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_utclong(
      it_flights      = lt_flights
      iv_utclong_from = lv_utclong_from
      iv_utclong_to   = lv_utclong_to
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered count mismatch' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered flight mismatch' act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den frühesten und spätesten `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel aus einer Liste.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `UTCLONG`-Vergleichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_min_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_utclong TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF utclong WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_utclong_range,
             min_utclong TYPE utclong,
             max_utclong TYPE utclong,
           END OF ty_utclong_range.

    METHODS get_min_max_utclong
      IMPORTING
        it_utclongs TYPE tt_utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_range) TYPE ty_utclong_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_min_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_max_utclong.
    IF it_utclongs IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_range-min_utclong = REDUCE utclong(
      INIT r = it_utclongs[ 1 ]
      FOR <utclong> IN it_utclongs
      NEXT r = COND utclong( WHEN <utclong> < r THEN <utclong> ELSE r ) ).

    rs_range-max_utclong = REDUCE utclong(
      INIT r = it_utclongs[ 1 ]
      FOR <utclong> IN it_utclongs
      NEXT r = COND utclong( WHEN <utclong> > r THEN <utclong> ELSE r ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_min_max_utclong FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_max_utclong.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_min_max( ).
    DATA lt_utclongs TYPE zcl_utclong_min_max=>tt_utclong.

    APPEND '20231126100000000000' TO lt_utclongs.
    APPEND '20231126110000000000' TO lt_utclongs.
    APPEND '20231126090000000000' TO lt_utclongs.

    DATA(ls_range) = lo_cut->get_min_max_utclong( lt_utclongs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Min UTCLONG mismatch' act = ls_range-min_utclong exp = '20231126090000000000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max UTCLONG mismatch' act = ls_range-max_utclong exp = '20231126110000000000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um den minimalen und maximalen `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel aus einer internen Tabelle zu finden. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, anstatt explizite Schleifen zu verwenden.
keywords: UTCLONG, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Min, Max, Aggregation, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempeln für jeden Tag eines Monats.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `cl_abap_utclong=>add()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_month_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_utclong TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF utclong WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_utclongs_for_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_year  TYPE syear
        iv_month TYPE sy-monat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_utclongs) TYPE tt_utclong.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_month_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_utclongs_for_month.
    DATA(lv_first_day_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month( iv_year = iv_year iv_month = iv_month ).
    DATA(lv_last_day_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_last_day_of_month( iv_year = iv_year iv_month = iv_month ).
    DATA(lv_days_in_month) = lv_last_day_date - lv_first_day_date + 1.

    DATA(lv_start_utclong) = cl_abap_utclong=>timestamp_to_utclong( date = lv_first_day_date time = '000000' ).

    rt_utclongs = VALUE tt_utclong(
      FOR i = 0 UNTIL i >= lv_days_in_month
      ( cl_abap_utclong=>add( utclong = lv_start_utclong value = i unit = cl_abap_utclong=>unit_days ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of days in November 2023 mismatch' act = lines( lt_utclongs ) exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First day UTCLONG mismatch' act = lt_utclongs[ 1 ] exp = '20231101000000000000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last day UTCLONG mismatch' act = lt_utclongs[ 30 ] exp = '20231130000000000000' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced,
           tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Assert that all dates in the original sflight table are indeed in the future
    DATA: lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_future_flight).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_all WITH KEY carrid = ls_future_flight-carrid connid = ls_future_flight-connid INTO DATA(ls_original_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = ls_original_flight msg = 'Flight should exist in original data' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_original_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) msg = 'Flight date must be in the future' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks filtert die Einträge effizient, bevor die neue Tabelle konstruiert wird.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Filter, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_passengers) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( ).

    DATA: lt_sflights_orig TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_orig UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_orig INTO DATA(ls_sflight_orig).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_sflight_orig-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_passengers exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Total passengers should match manual sum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationsaufgaben wie das Summieren, Zählen oder das Finden von Min/Max-Werten in internen Tabellen. Er bietet eine funktionale und lesbare Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, sflights

Instructions: Geben Sie basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze eines Fluges (sflight-seatsocc) einen Status-String zurück: 'Full' (>90%), 'Almost Full' (>70%), 'Available' (<=70%). Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck mit mehreren `WHEN`-Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                                              ELSE ( iv_seatsocc / iv_seatsmax ) * 100 ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > 90 THEN 'Full'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > 70 THEN 'Almost Full'
      ELSE 'Available'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 95 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 75 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Almost Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 50 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Available' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 0 iv_seatsmax = 0 ) exp = 'Available' ). " Edge case
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF`-Konstrukten, besonders wenn es darum geht, einen Wert zu initialisieren oder zurückzugeben.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Expression, IF, ELSE

Instructions: Geben Sie basierend auf dem `carrid` eines Fluges den vollen Namen der Fluggesellschaft zurück. Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck für mehrere Fallunterscheidungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrier_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_name.
    rv_carrier_name = SWITCH string( iv_carrid
                                    WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                    WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
                                    WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
                                    ELSE 'Unknown Carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( 'LH' ) exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( 'AA' ) exp = 'American Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( 'UA' ) exp = 'United Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( 'XX' ) exp = 'Unknown Carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine elegante und prägnante Möglichkeit, einen Wert basierend auf mehreren diskreten Fällen zu bestimmen. Er ist eine verbesserte Alternative zu `CASE...WHEN...ENDCASE`-Konstrukten, insbesondere wenn der Rückgabewert direkt zugewiesen werden soll.
keywords: Conditional Logic, SWITCH, Expression, CASE, WHEN

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Flugnummer und ein Flugdatum im Konstruktor entgegennimmt und diese intern speichert. Demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung mit dem `NEW`-Operator und Parameterübergabe.

CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
    mv_fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    rs_flight_details = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_flight) = NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_connid = lv_connid iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

explanation: Der `NEW`-Operator ermöglicht die direkte Instanziierung von Objekten und die gleichzeitige Übergabe von Parametern an den Konstruktor. Dies fördert die Dependency Injection und macht den Code sauberer und testbarer, da Objekte mit ihren Abhängigkeiten direkt erstellt werden können.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` und verwenden Sie dabei die Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_itab_decl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key,
           tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_itab_decl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
    rt_sflights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_itab_decl( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_sflights msg = 'Internal table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_sflights ) <= 10 ) msg = 'Table should contain at most 10 entries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration von Datenobjekten (hier `DATA(lt_sflights)`) direkt in der `INTO TABLE`-Klausel eines `SELECT`-Statements ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion, die den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht, da die explizite Deklaration der internen Tabelle vor dem `SELECT` entfällt.
keywords: Internal Tables, Inline Declaration, SELECT, DATA

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in einer internen Tabelle, der einem bestimmten Kriterium entspricht (z.B. `carrid = 'LH'`), und geben Sie ihn zurück. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `TABLE_LINE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` zur Prüfung und `TABLE_LINE` zum Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple,
           tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_flight_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_simple
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight_by_carrier.
    IF line_exists( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid ] ).
      rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_first_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_line_ops=>tt_sflight_simple,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_itab_line_ops=>ty_sflight_simple.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0001'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_line_ops( ).
    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_first_flight_not_found.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_line_ops=>tt_sflight_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_line_ops( ).
    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_found_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und der direkte Tabellenzeilenzugriff mit `itab[ key = value ]` (auch bekannt als `TABLE_LINE` oder Tabellen-Ausdruck) sind moderne und effiziente Wege, um auf einzelne Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen. `LINE_EXISTS` verhindert dabei einen Laufzeitfehler, falls die Zeile nicht gefunden wird.
keywords: Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, TABLE_LINE, Read Table

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Verify some known carriers if sflight has data
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'LH should have flights' ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_aa_count-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'AA should have flights' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion zur Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten direkt im Loop zu gruppieren und Aggregationsfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` zu nutzen, was den Code für solche Szenarien erheblich vereinfacht und effizienter macht als manuelle Gruppierungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, Aggregation, LOOP, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache ABAP-Klasse `ZCL_APPOINTMENT` zur Verwaltung von Terminen. Die Klasse soll private Attribute für Datum, Uhrzeit und Beschreibung haben und öffentliche Methoden zum Setzen und Abrufen dieser Werte bereitstellen. Demonstrieren Sie die Kapselung von Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für Attribute und `PUBLIC SECTION` für Methoden. Verwenden Sie `GET` und `SET` Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_time TYPE t
        iv_description TYPE string.

    METHODS get_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d.
    METHODS get_time RETURNING VALUE(rv_time) TYPE t.
    METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_date IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d.
    METHODS set_time IMPORTING iv_time TYPE t.
    METHODS set_description IMPORTING iv_description TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_date TYPE d.
    DATA mv_time TYPE t.
    DATA mv_description TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_date = iv_date.
    me->mv_time = iv_time.
    me->mv_description = iv_description.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_date.
    rv_date = me->mv_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_time.
    rv_time = me->mv_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = me->mv_description.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_date.
    me->mv_date = iv_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_time.
    me->mv_time = iv_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_description.
    me->mv_description = iv_description.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_appointment_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_appointment_set_get FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_appointment_creation.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_description) = 'Meeting with client'.

    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW zcl_appointment(
      iv_date = lv_date
      iv_time = lv_time
      iv_description = lv_description
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_appointment->get_date()
      exp = lv_date
      msg = 'Date should match constructor input'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_appointment->get_time()
      exp = lv_time
      msg = 'Time should match constructor input'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_appointment->get_description()
      exp = lv_description
      msg = 'Description should match constructor input'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_appointment_set_get.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW zcl_appointment(
      iv_date = sy-datum
      iv_time = sy-uzeit
      iv_description = 'Initial description'
    ).

    DATA(lv_new_date) = sy-datum + 1.
    DATA(lv_new_time) = '100000'.
    DATA(lv_new_description) = 'Updated meeting'.

    lo_appointment->set_date( lv_new_date ).
    lo_appointment->set_time( lv_new_time ).
    lo_appointment->set_description( lv_new_description ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_appointment->get_date()
      exp = lv_new_date
      msg = 'Date should be updated'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_appointment->get_time()
      exp = lv_new_time
      msg = 'Time should be updated'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_appointment->get_description()
      exp = lv_new_description
      msg = 'Description should be updated'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Kapselung in ABAP-Objekten. Private Attribute (`mv_date`, `mv_time`, `mv_description`) sind nur innerhalb der Klasse zugänglich, während öffentliche Methoden (`get_...`, `set_...`) die kontrollierte Interaktion von außen ermöglichen. Der `CONSTRUCTOR` erlaubt die Initialisierung bei der Objekterstellung, was zu saubererem Code führt. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für die Deklaration ist eine moderne Kurzform.
keywords: Object Orientation, Class, Private Section, Public Section, Encapsulation, Constructor, DATA

Instructions: Erweitern Sie die `ZCL_APPOINTMENT` Klasse um eine 'Fluent Interface'-Fähigkeit, sodass Setter-Methoden das Objekt selbst zurückgeben und somit Methodenaufrufe verkettet werden können.
hint: Lassen Sie die Setter-Methoden `ME` als `TYPE REF TO` die eigene Klasse zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_fluent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d OPTIONAL
        iv_time TYPE t OPTIONAL
        iv_description TYPE string OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d.
    METHODS get_time RETURNING VALUE(rv_time) TYPE t.
    METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_date IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent.
    METHODS set_time IMPORTING iv_time TYPE t RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent.
    METHODS set_description IMPORTING iv_description TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_date TYPE d.
    DATA mv_time TYPE t.
    DATA mv_description TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_fluent IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_date = iv_date.
    me->mv_time = iv_time.
    me->mv_description = iv_description.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_date.
    rv_date = me->mv_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_time.
    rv_time = me->mv_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = me->mv_description.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_date.
    me->mv_date = iv_date.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_time.
    me->mv_time = iv_time.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_description.
    me->mv_description = iv_description.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_interface.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum + 2.
    DATA(lv_time) = '140000'.
    DATA(lv_description) = 'Project Review'.

    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( )->set_date( lv_date
                                                      )->set_time( lv_time
                                                      )->set_description( lv_description ).

      act = lo_appointment->get_time()
      exp = lv_time

    ).

explanation: Das 'Fluent Interface'-Muster ermöglicht es, mehrere Setter-Methoden in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes verbessert. Jede Setter-Methode gibt dabei eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurück. Dies ist ein modernes Designmuster, das oft in externen Bibliotheken zu finden ist und die API-Nutzung intuitiver macht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Method Chaining, RETURNING VALUE, ME

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von `ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FLUENT` Objekten. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Beschreibungen dieser Termine enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR`-Iteration in Verbindung mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             date TYPE d,
             time TYPE t,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.
    TYPES: tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_appointment_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_descriptions
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_descriptions) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_descriptions.
    rt_descriptions = VALUE #( FOR <ls_appointment> IN it_appointments
                               ( <ls_appointment>->get_description() ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_descriptions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_descriptions.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_appointment_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_appointments) = zcl_appointment_processor=>tt_appointment_objects( ).

    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_description = 'Meeting A' ) TO lt_appointments.

CLASS zcl_appointment_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_appointment_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_appointment_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_duration.
    rv_total_minutes = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                 FOR <ls_appointment> IN it_appointments
                                 NEXT sum = sum + <ls_appointment>->get_duration_minutes() ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULER` mit Methoden zum Hinzufügen, Abrufen und Löschen von Terminen. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `ZCL_APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` für die Definition und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING ...` für die Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_appointment_scheduler PUBLIC.
  TYPES: tt_appointment_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS add_appointment
    IMPORTING
      io_appointment TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent.

  METHODS get_all_appointments
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_objects.

  METHODS delete_appointment
    IMPORTING
      iv_description TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_deleted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_appointment_scheduler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_appointment_scheduler.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_appointments TYPE zif_appointment_scheduler=>tt_appointment_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_scheduler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_appointment_scheduler~add_appointment.
    APPEND io_appointment TO mt_appointments.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_appointment_scheduler~get_all_appointments.
    rt_appointments = mt_appointments.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_appointment_scheduler~delete_appointment.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( mt_appointments ).
    DELETE mt_appointments WHERE get_description() = iv_description.
    IF lines( mt_appointments ) < lv_initial_lines.
      rv_deleted = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_deleted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_scheduler) = NEW zcl_appointment_scheduler( ).

    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_description = 'Daily Standup' ).
    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_description = 'Client Call' ).

    li_scheduler->add_appointment( lo_app2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_apps ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 appointments' ).

    DATA(lv_deleted) = li_scheduler->delete_appointment( 'Daily Standup' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_deleted msg = 'Daily Standup should be deleted' ).

    lt_all_apps = li_scheduler->get_all_appointments().

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_all_apps[ 1 ]->get_description() exp = 'Client Call' msg = 'Remaining appointment should be Client Call' ).

    lv_deleted = li_scheduler->delete_appointment( 'Non-existent' ).

explanation: Interfaces (`INTERFACE`) definieren einen Vertrag für Klassen, ohne eine Implementierung vorzugeben. Eine Klasse, die ein Interface implementiert (`IMPLEMENTING`), muss alle im Interface definierten Methoden bereitstellen. Dies fördert die lose Kopplung und ermöglicht Polymorphie, da Objekte unterschiedlicher Klassen über ein gemeinsames Interface angesprochen werden können. Die Verwendung von `CAST` zur Typumwandlung auf das Interface ist hierbei ein gängiges Muster.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Implementation, Polymorphism, Loose Coupling, CAST

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Erstellung eines Objekts und den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode der `ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FLUENT` Klasse basierend auf einem String-Namen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE` und `CALL METHOD` mit `NAME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS invoke_appointment_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_description TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invoke_appointment_method.
    DATA lo_appointment TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lv_description TYPE string.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_appointment TYPE (iv_class_name).

        IF iv_method_name = 'SET_DESCRIPTION'.
          lv_description = iv_description.
          CALL METHOD lo_appointment->(iv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              iv_description = lv_description.
          rv_result = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' called successfully with '{ lv_description }'.|.
        ELSEIF iv_method_name = 'GET_DESCRIPTION'.
          CALL METHOD lo_appointment->(iv_method_name)
            RECEIVING
              rv_description = lv_description.
          rv_result = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' called successfully. Result: '{ lv_description }'.|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' not supported for dynamic invocation in this example.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Class '{ iv_class_name }' could not be created.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' could not be called dynamically.|.
      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_result = |An unexpected error occurred during dynamic invocation.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_class_name) = 'ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FLUENT'.
    DATA(lv_test_description) = 'Dynamic Test Appointment'.

    DATA(lv_set_result) = lo_invoker->invoke_appointment_method(
      iv_class_name = lv_class_name
      iv_method_name = 'SET_DESCRIPTION'
      iv_description = lv_test_description
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( SUBSTRING = 'called successfully' ACT = lv_set_result MSG = 'SET_DESCRIPTION should be called successfully' ).

    " Note: This example has a limitation. The object created in SET_DESCRIPTION is local to that call.
    " To properly test GET_DESCRIPTION on the *same* object, the invoker class would need to manage object instances.
    " For simplicity, we'll assume a new object for GET_DESCRIPTION for this test, or modify the invoker to return the object.
    " For this example, we'll just test the method call itself.
    DATA(lv_get_result) = lo_invoker->invoke_appointment_method(
      iv_class_name = lv_class_name
      iv_method_name = 'GET_DESCRIPTION'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( SUBSTRING = 'called successfully' ACT = lv_get_result MSG = 'GET_DESCRIPTION should be called successfully' ).
    " A more robust test would involve passing the object reference back or using a singleton pattern.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_invalid_class.
    DATA(lo_invoker) = NEW zcl_dynamic_invoker( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_invoker->invoke_appointment_method(
      iv_class_name = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
      iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( SUBSTRING = 'Error: Class' ACT = lv_result MSG = 'Should handle invalid class name' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_unsupported_method.
    DATA(lo_invoker) = NEW zcl_dynamic_invoker( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_invoker->invoke_appointment_method(
      iv_class_name = 'ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FLUENT'
      iv_method_name = 'UNSUPPORTED_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( SUBSTRING = 'not supported' ACT = lv_result MSG = 'Should handle unsupported method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung in ABAP ermöglicht es, Objekte zur Laufzeit zu erstellen (`CREATE OBJECT TYPE (variable)`) und Methoden dynamisch aufzurufen (`CALL METHOD (object_ref)->(method_name)`). Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn der Methodenname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Es erfordert jedoch sorgfältige Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`, da Typ- und Methodenfehler erst zur Laufzeit auftreten. Die Verwendung von String-Templates für Fehlermeldungen verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE OBJECT, CALL METHOD, TRY CATCH, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein Termin 'dringend' ist. Ein Termin gilt als dringend, wenn er innerhalb der nächsten 24 Stunden stattfindet. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Bedingungsprüfung.
hint: Vergleichen Sie das Termindatum und die Uhrzeit mit dem aktuellen Systemdatum und der Systemuhrzeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_urgent
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_urgent) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_urgent.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = sy-tstmp.
    DATA(lv_appointment_timestamp) = io_appointment->get_date() && io_appointment->get_time().

    " Calculate timestamp for 24 hours from now
    DATA(lv_24h_future_timestamp) = lv_current_timestamp + ( 24 * 3600 ).

    IF lv_appointment_timestamp > lv_current_timestamp AND
       lv_appointment_timestamp <= lv_24h_future_timestamp.
      rv_is_urgent = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_urgent = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Bedingungsprüfung verwendet moderne ABAP-Syntax, indem sie Zeitstempel (`sy-tstmp`) für präzise Vergleiche von Datum und Uhrzeit nutzt. Die Verkettung von Datum und Uhrzeit (`&&`) zu einem String und die Addition von Sekunden zu einem Zeitstempel sind effiziente Wege, um Zeitintervalle zu berechnen. Die `IF...ELSE` Struktur ist klar und leicht verständlich.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von `ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FLUENT` Objekten nach ihrem Datum und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Termine pro Datum. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_appointment_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_appointment_fluent WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointments_by_date,
             appointment_date TYPE d,
             count TYPE i,
             appointments TYPE tt_appointment_objects,
           END OF ty_appointments_by_date.
    TYPES: tt_appointments_by_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointments_by_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments_by_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    rt_grouped_appointments = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <group_line> IN it_all_appointments
                                       GROUP BY ( appointment_date = <group_line>->get_date() )
                                       ASCENDING
                                       ( appointment_date = <group_line>->get_date()
                                         count = GROUP SIZE
                                         appointments = VALUE #( FOR <member> IN GROUP <group_line>
                                                                  ( <member> ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_appointments_by_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_appointments_by_date.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_appointment_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = zcl_appointment_grouper=>tt_appointment_objects( ).

    DATA(lv_date1) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_date2) = sy-datum + 1.

    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_date = lv_date1 iv_description = 'App 1' ) TO lt_all_appointments.
    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_date = lv_date2 iv_description = 'App 2' ) TO lt_all_appointments.
    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_date = lv_date1 iv_description = 'App 3' ) TO lt_all_appointments.
    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_date = lv_date2 iv_description = 'App 4' ) TO lt_all_appointments.
    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_fluent( iv_date = lv_date1 iv_description = 'App 5' ) TO lt_all_appointments.

    DATA(lt_grouped_apps) = lo_grouper->group_appointments_by_date( lt_all_appointments ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped_apps ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 groups' ).

    DATA(ls_group1) = lt_grouped_apps[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group1-appointment_date exp = lv_date1 msg = 'First group date should be lv_date1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group1-count exp = 3 msg = 'First group count should be 3' ).

    DATA(ls_group2) = lt_grouped_apps[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group2-appointment_date exp = lv_date2 msg = 'Second group date should be lv_date2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group2-count exp = 2 msg = 'Second group count should be 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` Expression ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature ab ABAP 7.50 für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung von Gruppen und die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb dieser Gruppen, ohne explizite `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` oder manuelle Hash-Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, und `FOR ... IN GROUP` erlaubt die Iteration über die Elemente einer Gruppe. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FACTORY`, die statische Methoden zur Erstellung von `ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FLUENT` Objekten bereitstellt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von statischen Methoden und der `FINAL` Eigenschaft für Klassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` für statische Methoden und `FINAL` in der Klassendefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_default_appointment FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_custom_appointment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_default_appointment.
    DATA(lo_default_appointment) = zcl_appointment_factory=>create_default_appointment().

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_default_appointment msg = 'Default appointment should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_default_appointment->get_description() exp = 'Default Appointment' msg = 'Default description should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_default_appointment->get_date() exp = sy-datum msg = 'Default date should be current date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_custom_appointment.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum + 3.
    DATA(lv_time) = '113000'.
    DATA(lv_description) = 'Custom Project Sync'.
    DATA(lv_duration) = 45.

    DATA(lo_custom_appointment) = zcl_appointment_factory=>create_custom_appointment(
      iv_date = lv_date
      iv_time = lv_time
      iv_description = lv_description
      iv_duration_minutes = lv_duration
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_custom_appointment msg = 'Custom appointment should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_custom_appointment->get_date() exp = lv_date msg = 'Custom date should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_custom_appointment->get_time() exp = lv_time msg = 'Custom time should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_custom_appointment->get_description() exp = lv_description msg = 'Custom description should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_custom_appointment->get_duration_minutes() exp = lv_duration msg = 'Custom duration should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Statische Methoden (`CLASS-METHODS`) gehören zur Klasse selbst und nicht zu einer Instanz. Sie können direkt über den Klassennamen aufgerufen werden (`ZCL_APPOINTMENT_FACTORY=>create_...`). Dies ist ideal für Factory-Methoden, die Objekte erstellen, ohne dass eine Instanz der Factory-Klasse benötigt wird. Die `FINAL` Eigenschaft in der Klassendefinition verhindert, dass die Klasse beerbt wird, was die Stabilität und Vorhersehbarkeit des Designs erhöht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Static Methods, Factory Pattern, CLASS-METHODS, FINAL, NEW

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS filter_and_map
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        price  = ls_flight-price ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight`.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight

        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflight_modify_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS create_modified_flights
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_sflight_modify_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_modified_flights.
    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight EXCEPT currency ) currency = 'EUR' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUP` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_count TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrid.
    rt_carrid_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid)
      ( carrid = lv_carrid,
        flight_count = REDUCE #( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_003 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid

        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

CLASS zcl_htb_003 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_modified_flights.
    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )
        planetype = 'MODIFIED' " Beispielmodifikation
        seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc + 10 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer Hashed Table (z.B. Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: `REDUCE` kann eine Hashed Table als Akkumulator verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_005 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_seats_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_005 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_seats_by_carrier.
    rt_aggregated_seats = REDUCE tt_carrier_seats_hashed(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats_hashed( )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      LET ls_existing = result[ OPTIONAL KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] IN
      result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats_hashed(
        result
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          total_seats_occ = ls_flight-seatsocc + ls_existing-total_seats_occ )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_005( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_htb_005=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 300 seatsmax = 400 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 250 seatsmax = 400 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_seats_by_carrier( lt_initial_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_aggregated )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 aggregated entries'
    ).

    DATA(ls_lh_seats) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_seats-total_seats_occ
      exp = 220 " 100 + 120
      msg = 'Total seats for LH incorrect'
    ).

    DATA(ls_aa_seats) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_seats-total_seats_occ
      exp = 550 " 300 + 250
      msg = 'Total seats for AA incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Aggregation von Daten. Durch die Verwendung einer Hashed Table als Akkumulator (`result`) und den `OPTIONAL KEY` Zugriff können Einträge effizient aktualisiert oder neu hinzugefügt werden, was zu einer performanten und lesbaren Lösung führt.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen numerischen Statuscode in eine lesbare Textbeschreibung umwandelt, unter Verwendung einer `CASE`-Anweisung.

CLASS zcl_cas_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_cas_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status_code.

      WHEN 2.
        rv_description = 'Wird bearbeitet'.
      WHEN 3.
        rv_description = 'Fehler aufgetreten'.
      WHEN OTHERS.

    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cas_002 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cas_002 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discount_level.
    rv_discount_level = COND string(
      WHEN iv_total_amount >= 10000 THEN 'Platinum'
      WHEN iv_total_amount >= 5000  THEN 'Gold'
      WHEN iv_total_amount >= 1000  THEN 'Silver'
      ELSE 'Bronze'
    ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Wert eines Feldes und optional weiteren Bedingungen einen komplexeren Wert zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator.
hint: `DATA(result) = SWITCH #( field WHEN value1 THEN result1 WHEN value2 THEN result2 ELSE default_result )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cas_003 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_delivery_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_region TYPE string
        iv_priority TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_delivery_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cas_003 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_delivery_time.
    rv_delivery_days = SWITCH i(
      iv_region
      WHEN 'EU' THEN
        SWITCH i(
          iv_priority
          WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1
          WHEN 'STANDARD' THEN 3
          ELSE 5
        )
      WHEN 'US' THEN
        SWITCH i(
          iv_priority
          WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
          WHEN 'STANDARD' THEN 4
          ELSE 6
        )
      ELSE 7 " Default for other regions
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_006 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config.
    TYPES: tt_config_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_config WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS get_config_value
      IMPORTING
        it_config_table TYPE tt_config_hashed

        iv_default      TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_htb_006 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_config_value.
    rv_value = COND string(
      WHEN line_exists( it_config_table[ key = iv_key ] )
      THEN it_config_table[ key = iv_key ]-value
      ELSE iv_default
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Hashed Table nach mehreren Kriterien und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Hashed Table. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.

CLASS zcl_htb_007 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE i

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_007 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc >= iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie Einträge in einer Hashed Table basierend auf Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Aktualisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `MODIFY TABLE` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_008 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_update_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             new_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_update_data.
    TYPES: tt_update_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_update_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights_from_table
      IMPORTING
        io_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        it_updates TYPE tt_update_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_008 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_from_table.
    ro_updated_flights = io_flights.

    LOOP AT it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update).
      MODIFY TABLE ro_updated_flights FROM CORRESPONDING #( ls_update EXCEPT new_seatsocc )
        TRANSPORTING seatsocc
        WHERE carrid = ls_update-carrid AND connid = ls_update-connid AND fldate = ls_update-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fallbehandlung: Eintrag nicht gefunden oder Schlüssel nicht eindeutig
        " Hier könnte man z.B. einen neuen Eintrag hinzufügen oder einen Fehler loggen
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Rohliste von ArchiveLink-Dokumentinformationen (z.B. von einer `cl_alink_connection` Abfrage) in eine strukturierte interne Tabelle, die nur die Dokument-ID und den Ersteller enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_alink_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_doc,
             doc_id     TYPE string,
             doc_type   TYPE string,
             created_by TYPE string,
             size_kb    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_doc.
    TYPES tt_raw_docs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_doc WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simplified_doc,
             document_id TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_alink_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_docs.
    rt_simplified_docs = VALUE tt_simplified_docs(
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_docs

          creator     = ls_raw-created_by )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der aktiven ArchiveLink-Verknüpfungen in einer Liste von simulierten Verknüpfungsstatus-Objekten. Eine Verknüpfung gilt als aktiv, wenn ihr Status 'ACTIVE' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_link_status,
             link_id TYPE string,
             status  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_link_status.
    TYPES tt_link_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_link_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_active_links
      IMPORTING
        it_link_data TYPE tt_link_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_active_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_active_links.
    rv_active_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_link IN it_link_data
      WHERE ( status = 'ACTIVE' )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Methode zum Abrufen von ArchiveLink-Dokumenten, die mögliche Fehler (z.B. 'Dokument nicht gefunden') mit `TRY...CATCH` abfängt und eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen zu behandeln und den Programmfluss zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_exception_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_document_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_exception_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_document_data.
    IF iv_doc_id = 'INVALID'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_message.
    ENDIF.
    rv_data = |Data for document { iv_doc_id }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_robust_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_document_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_robust_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_document_safely.
    TRY.
        rv_result = zcl_alink_exception_mock=>get_document_data( iv_doc_id ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler beim Abrufen des Dokuments { iv_doc_id }: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_alink_document_processor PUBLIC.
  METHODS process_document IMPORTING iv_doc_id TYPE string.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_alink_document_processor.

    cl_demo_output=>write( |Processing JPG image: { iv_doc_id }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_doc_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_document
      IMPORTING
        io_document_processor TYPE REF TO zif_alink_document_processor
        iv_doc_id             TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_doc_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_document.
    CASE TYPE OF io_document_processor.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_alink_doc_pdf.
        io_document_processor->process_document( iv_doc_id ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( 'Specific PDF logic applied.' ).
      WHEN TYPE zcl_alink_doc_jpg.
        io_document_processor->process_document( iv_doc_id ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( 'Specific JPG logic applied.' ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Unknown document type for { iv_doc_id }. Generic processing.| ).
        io_document_processor->process_document( iv_doc_id ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
