Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von ArchiveLink-Dokumenten nach ihrem Ersteller und zählen Sie die Dokumente pro Ersteller. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_document,
             doc_id     TYPE string,
             doc_type   TYPE string,
             created_by TYPE string,
           END OF ty_document.
    TYPES tt_documents TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_document WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_creator_count,
             creator TYPE string,
             count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_creator_count.
    TYPES tt_creator_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_creator_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_by_creator
      IMPORTING
        it_documents TYPE tt_documents
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_creator_counts) TYPE tt_creator_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_creator.
    rt_creator_counts = VALUE tt_creator_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_doc IN it_documents GROUP BY ( creator = ls_doc-created_by ) ASCENDING
      ( creator = ls_doc-created_by
        count   = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR ls_group_doc IN GROUP ls_doc NEXT c = c + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_creator FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_creator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alink_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_docs) = VALUE zcl_alink_grouping=>tt_documents(
      ( doc_id = 'D1' doc_type = 'PDF' created_by = 'USERA' )
      ( doc_id = 'D2' doc_type = 'JPG' created_by = 'USERB' )
      ( doc_id = 'D3' doc_type = 'PDF' created_by = 'USERA' )
      ( doc_id = 'D4' doc_type = 'TXT' created_by = 'USERC' )
      ( doc_id = 'D5' doc_type = 'PDF' created_by = 'USERB' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_by_creator( lt_docs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-creator exp = 'USERA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-creator exp = 'USERB' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-creator exp = 'USERC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_by_creator( lt_docs ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode einer simulierten `cl_alink_connection` Klasse aufruft, basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen. Dies demonstriert dynamische Programmierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_last_called_method TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_get_documents.
    METHODS simulate_create_link.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name).
        mv_last_called_method = iv_method_name.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call.
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Fehler: Methode '{ iv_method_name }' nicht gefunden oder nicht aufrufbar.| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_get_documents.
    cl_demo_output=>write( 'Simulating get_documents from cl_alink_connection.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_create_link.
    cl_demo_output=>write( 'Simulating create_link for ArchiveLink Verknüpfung.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alink_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'SIMULATE_GET_DOCUMENTS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_last_called_method exp = 'SIMULATE_GET_DOCUMENTS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_call_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alink_dynamic_caller( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->mv_last_called_method ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe mit `CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)` ermöglichen es, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn die aufzurufende Logik flexibel sein muss, z.B. bei der Interaktion mit einer `cl_alink_connection` API, deren Methoden dynamisch ausgewählt werden.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Reflection, ArchiveLink, cl_alink_connection

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen und Dezimalzahlen) aus einer gegebenen Zeichenkette.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_all_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+(\.\d+)?`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_matched_substring( ) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_parse_log IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Pattern: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS] [LEVEL] Message text
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\] \[(\w+)\] (.*)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_log_entry-timestamp = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_log_entry-level     = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_log_entry-message   = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle URLs (beginnend mit `http://` oder `https://`) in einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CREATE_MATCHER` mit einer Schleife, um alle Treffer zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_find_urls DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_urls
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_urls) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_find_urls IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_urls.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?[-a-zA-Z0-9@:%._\+~#=]{1,256}\.[a-zA-Z0-9()]{1,6}\b(?:[-a-zA-Z0-9()@:%_\+.~#?&//=]*)`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_matched_substring( ) TO rt_urls.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_find_urls( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Visit SAP at https://www.sap.com or check out my blog http://myblog.example.org/page.html?id=123.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'https://www.sap.com' ) ( 'http://myblog.example.org/page.html?id=123' ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->find_all_urls( lv_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_actual ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Extraktion komplexer Muster wie URLs aus einem Text. Die Kombination aus `CL_ABAP_REGEX`, `CREATE_MATCHER` und einer `WHILE`-Schleife mit `MATCH` ist die Standardmethode, um alle nicht-überlappenden Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks zu finden.

CLASS zcl_reg_password_validator IMPLEMENTATION.

    " At least 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, 1 special char
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.<>\/?]).{8,}$`.

    rv_is_strong = lo_regex->match( text = iv_password ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften, die in einer internen Tabelle vorliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES IN` für eine effiziente Massenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_all,
             mandt  TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_all.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_all WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_all.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT *
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae=>tt_carrid(
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flights found for carriers' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
        IF ls_flight-carrid = ls_carrier-carrid.
          lv_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found exp = abap_true msg = 'Flight from unexpected carrier found' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist eine leistungsstarke Technik, um mehrere Datenbankzugriffe zu einem einzigen zusammenzufassen, was die Performance erheblich verbessert. Die moderne Syntax mit `@` für Hostvariablen ist obligatorisch.
keywords: SELECT, FOR ALL ENTRIES, Database Access, Performance

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Top 5 der teuersten Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, sortiert nach Preis absteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UP TO N ROWS` und `ORDER BY` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_top5 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

ENDCLASS.

      FROM sflight

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Die Kombination von `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS` ist eine effiziente Methode, um nur eine begrenzte Anzahl von sortierten Datensätzen direkt aus der Datenbank abzurufen, was die Datenübertragung und -verarbeitung minimiert.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, Database Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine neue interne Tabelle mit vordefinierten Werten und zusätzlichen Werten aus einem Parameter erstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator, um interne Tabellen inline zu initialisieren und zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS build_table IMPORTING it_additional_items TYPE tt_items OPTIONAL RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_table.
    rt_combined_items = VALUE #(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Banana' )
    ).
    IF it_additional_items IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND LINES OF it_additional_items TO rt_combined_items.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_build_table_no_add FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_build_table_with_add FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_table_no_add.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_table_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_builder->build_table( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of items without additional' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Apple' msg = 'First item incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_build_table_with_add.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_table_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_additional) = VALUE zcl_table_builder=>tt_items(
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cherry' )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Date' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_builder->build_table( lt_additional ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 4 msg = 'Incorrect number of items with additional' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 3 ]-name exp = 'Cherry' msg = 'Third item incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von internen Tabellen und Strukturen. Dies ist Teil des modernen ABAP-Ansatzes, der die Notwendigkeit von `APPEND` in Schleifen oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` reduziert.
keywords: VALUE, Internal Tables, Initialization, Functional Programming

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie die Tabellen SFLIGHT und SCARR, um Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft abzurufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_flight_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_carrier_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_with_carrier_name( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No joined flight data found' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrname msg = 'Carrier name is empty for a flight' ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `INNER JOIN` direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung ist der bevorzugte Weg, um Daten aus mehreren Datenbanktabellen zu kombinieren. Dies ist effizienter als das Lesen in separate interne Tabellen und das anschließende Verknüpfen im ABAP-Programm.
keywords: SELECT, JOIN, Database Access, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine neue interne Tabelle mit den Quadraten der Zahlen aus einer Eingabetabelle generiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Iterationsausdrücke `FOR` und den `VALUE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_squares IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rt_squares) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_squares.
    rt_squares = VALUE #( FOR <lv_num> IN it_numbers ( <lv_num> * <lv_num> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_squares FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_squares_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_squares.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_table( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_math_table=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_math->get_squares( lt_input ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_math_table=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 4 ) ( 9 ) ( 16 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output exp = lt_expected msg = 'Square calculation failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_squares_empty.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_table( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_math_table=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_math->get_squares( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_output msg = 'Output should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist ein Kernstück des modernen ABAP-Programmierstils, der Schleifen und explizite `APPEND`-Anweisungen oft überflüssig macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Iteration

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)` und `AVG()` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carrier_statistics RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_statistics FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_statistics.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_sflight_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_analyzer->get_carrier_statistics( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_stats msg = 'No carrier statistics found' ).
    READ TABLE lt_stats INTO DATA(ls_aa_stats) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_aa_stats-flight_count msg = 'Flight count for AA is initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_aa_stats-avg_price msg = 'Average price for AA is initial' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `GROUP BY` mit Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT` und `AVG` ermöglicht es, zusammenfassende Daten direkt aus der Datenbank abzurufen. Dies ist wesentlich effizienter, als alle Daten zu lesen und die Aggregation im ABAP-Programm durchzuführen.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, Aggregate Functions, Database Access, Statistics

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_price_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <ls_flight> IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + <ls_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_price_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_price_reducer=>tt_flight_price(
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' price = '50.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' msg = 'Total price calculation failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_price_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_price_reducer=>tt_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT und SCARR, wobei Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck verwenden, um den Status des Flugpreises (günstig, normal, teuer) zu bestimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_price_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_price_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CASE
             WHEN price < 100 THEN 'Günstig'
             WHEN price >= 100 AND price < 500 THEN 'Normal'
             ELSE 'Teuer'
           END AS status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_price_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_price_status.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_case( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_with_price_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flight data found' ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price < 100.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Günstig' msg = 'Status for cheap flight incorrect' ).
      ELSE IF ls_flight-price >= 100 AND ls_flight-price < 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Normal' msg = 'Status for normal flight incorrect' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Teuer' msg = 'Status for expensive flight incorrect' ).
      ENDIF.
      EXIT. " Check only first entry for brevity
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CASE`-Ausdrücken direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste ermöglicht es, komplexe Logik zur Datenklassifizierung oder -transformation direkt in der Datenbank auszuführen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing im ABAP-Programm und verbessert die Performance.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, Database Access, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für eine deklarative Filterung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      it_all_flights
      USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_input iv_carrier = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_output INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Filtered flight has wrong carrier' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_flights_no_match.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_input iv_carrier = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_output msg = 'Output should be empty for no match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_flights_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_input iv_carrier = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_output msg = 'Output should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft effizienter als explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `WHERE`-Bedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Filtering

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse von zwei `SELECT`-Anweisungen (z.B. Flüge von 'AA' und Flüge von 'LH') in einer einzigen Ergebnismenge.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION` Operator in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_union.
    TYPES: tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_combined_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_union( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No combined flight data found' ).

    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ELSE IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected carrier found in combined results' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_aa_count > 0 ) msg = 'No AA flights found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_lh_count > 0 ) msg = 'No LH flights found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name nur als String bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_method IMPORTING io_object     TYPE REF TO object
                                          iv_method_name TYPE string
                                          iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS test_method_with_param IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS test_method_no_param RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_method.
    DATA: lv_method_name TYPE string VALUE iv_method_name.
    DATA: lv_param_value TYPE string VALUE iv_param_value.
    DATA: lv_result      TYPE string.

    TRY.
        IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
          CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF io_object
            EXPORTING
              iv_input = lv_param_value
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = lv_result.
        ELSE.
          CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF io_object
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = lv_result.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = lv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_with_param.
    rv_output = |Input was: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_no_param.
    rv_output = 'No parameter method called'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_numeric DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS is_numeric IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_numeric IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_numeric.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    DATA(lo_datadescr) = CAST cl_abap_datadescr( lo_typedescr ).
    IF lo_datadescr->type_kind = cl_abap_datadescr=>typekind_num OR
       lo_datadescr->type_kind = cl_abap_datadescr=>typekind_int OR
       lo_datadescr->type_kind = cl_abap_datadescr=>typekind_packed OR
       lo_datadescr->type_kind = cl_abap_datadescr=>typekind_float OR
       lo_datadescr->type_kind = cl_abap_datadescr=>typekind_decfloat.
      rb_is_numeric = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_numeric = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für einen bestimmten Carrier (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT mit Hilfe von REDUCE.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_sum_price.

    " Insert test data into SFLIGHT if necessary, or use existing data
    " For example, if 'LH' has flights with prices 100 and 200:
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Incorrect total price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Hier wird die Summe der Flugpreise für einen bestimmten Carrier berechnet, ohne explizite LOOP-Anweisungen. Die INIT-Klausel initialisiert die Summe, und die FOR-Schleife iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei die WHERE-Klausel eine Filterung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Flugverbindungs-IDs (CONNID) für einen gegebenen Carrier (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT mit REDUCE und String Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE in Kombination mit String Templates zur dynamischen String-Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_connid_list_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_list_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_connid_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <fs_flight>-connid
        ELSE |{ result }, { <fs_flight>-connid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_concat_connid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_connid( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_list) = '0001, 0002'. " Example, adjust based on SFLIGHT data for 'AA'

    " Ensure test data exists for 'AA' with CONNID '0001' and '0002'
    " If not, insert or use a carrier with known data.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_connids) WHERE carrid = 'AA' ORDER BY connid.
    lv_expected_list = REDUCE string( INIT r = '' FOR c IN lt_connids NEXT r = COND string( WHEN r IS INITIAL THEN c-connid ELSE |{ r }, { c-connid }| ) ).

    DATA(lv_actual_list) = lo_cut->get_connid_list_for_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_list exp = lv_expected_list msg = 'Incorrect concatenated list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt REDUCE, um eine Liste von Flugverbindungs-IDs zu einem einzigen String zu verketten. Die COND-Expression innerhalb von NEXT sorgt dafür, dass das erste Element ohne vorangehendes Komma hinzugefügt wird. String Templates (|...|) bieten eine moderne und lesbare Syntax für die String-Formatierung.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, Concatenation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Finden Sie mit REDUCE den Flug (CARRID, CONNID) mit dem höchsten Preis aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um einen Strukturwert zu akkumulieren und den höchsten Preis zu verfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_info) TYPE ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rs_flight_info = REDUCE #( INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_flight_info( price = 0 )
                                FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
                                NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > max_flight-price
                                                          THEN VALUE ty_flight_info( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                                                                     connid = <fs_flight>-connid
                                                                                     price  = <fs_flight>-price )
                                                          ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA ls_expected_flight TYPE zcl_reduce_max_price=>ty_flight_info.

    " Determine expected max flight from SFLIGHT data
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_expected_flight ORDER BY price DESCENDING.

    DATA(ls_actual_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_flight-carrid exp = ls_expected_flight-carrid msg = 'Incorrect carrier' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_flight-connid exp = ls_expected_flight-connid msg = 'Incorrect connection' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_flight-price exp = ls_expected_flight-price msg = 'Incorrect price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von REDUCE, um eine Struktur zu akkumulieren, die den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis speichert. Die INIT-Klausel initialisiert die Struktur, und die COND-Expression in NEXT aktualisiert sie nur, wenn ein Flug mit einem höheren Preis gefunden wird. Dies ist eine elegante Methode, um Min/Max-Werte in komplexen Strukturen zu finden.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Max, Structure, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Zählen Sie mit REDUCE die Anzahl der eindeutigen Carrier (CARRID) in der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE in Kombination mit einem Hash-Set (oder einer ähnlichen Struktur) zur Speicherung eindeutiger Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_distinct_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT distinct_carriers = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT distinct_carriers = INSERT <fs_flight>-carrid INTO TABLE distinct_carriers
      THEN lines( distinct_carriers )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_distinct_carriers( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.

    " Calculate expected count using standard SQL
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT carrid ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_count.

    DATA(lv_actual_count) = lo_cut->count_distinct_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_count exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'Incorrect distinct carrier count' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie REDUCE verwendet werden kann, um eindeutige Elemente zu zählen. Es initialisiert eine HASHED TABLE, fügt jeden Carrier hinzu und gibt am Ende die Anzahl der Zeilen in dieser Tabelle zurück. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Distinct-Werte zu ermitteln, ohne eine separate Schleife und eine temporäre Tabelle zu verwenden.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Hashed Table, Distinct, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen in einen formatierten String wie 'Item 1: 10, Item 2: 20' mit REDUCE und String Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um einen String schrittweise aufzubauen, und String Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_format_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_number_list
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_format_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_number_list.
    rv_formatted_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
           index = 0
      FOR <fs_number> IN it_numbers
      NEXT index = index + 1,
           result = COND string(
             WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |Item { index }: { <fs_number> }|
             ELSE |{ result }, Item { index }: { <fs_number> }|
           )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_format_list( ).
    DATA lt_test_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i VALUE #( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Item 1: 10, Item 2: 20, Item 3: 30'.

    DATA(lv_actual_string) = lo_cut->format_number_list( lt_test_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_string exp = lv_expected_string msg = 'Incorrect formatted string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Vielseitigkeit von REDUCE, indem es nicht nur einen Akkumulator (result) verwendet, sondern auch eine zusätzliche Variable (index) initialisiert und aktualisiert. Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung eines formatierten Strings aus einer Liste von Zahlen, wobei String Templates für die dynamische Textgenerierung genutzt werden.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, Transformation, Index

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von UTF-8 in die Codepage ISO-8859-1 (Latin-1) und umgekehrt mit CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden CONVERT_TO und CONVERT_FROM der Klasse CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_latin1
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latin1_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS convert_latin1_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_latin1_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_latin1.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    rv_latin1_xstring = lo_codepage->convert_to( iv_utf8_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_latin1_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    rv_utf8_string = lo_codepage->convert_from( iv_latin1_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_codepage_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_codepage_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_conversion( ).
    DATA(lv_original_utf8) = 'Grüße aus München!'. " Contains special characters

    " Convert UTF-8 to Latin-1
    DATA(lv_latin1_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_latin1( lv_original_utf8 ).

    " Convert Latin-1 back to UTF-8
    DATA(lv_converted_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_latin1_to_utf8( lv_latin1_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_utf8 exp = lv_original_utf8 msg = 'Conversion roundtrip failed' ).

    " Test with a string that might lose information if not handled correctly
    DATA(lv_utf8_with_euro) = 'Preis: 100 €'.
    DATA(lv_latin1_euro_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_latin1( lv_utf8_with_euro ).
    " Note: Euro symbol might not be representable in ISO-8859-1, so direct comparison might fail if character is lost.
    " For this test, we assume a character that is representable or check for expected loss.
    " A more robust test would check for expected replacement characters or exceptions.
    DATA(lv_converted_euro_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_latin1_to_utf8( lv_latin1_euro_xstring ).
    " For ISO-8859-1, '€' is not directly supported. It might be replaced by '?' or similar.
    " A proper test would check for the expected replacement or an exception.
    " For simplicity, let's assume a character that works or accept potential loss for demonstration.
    " If '€' is converted to '?', then the assertion should reflect that.
    " For now, let's stick to 'Grüße' which works.

    DATA(lv_original_simple) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_latin1_simple_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_latin1( lv_original_simple ).
    DATA(lv_converted_simple) = lo_cut->convert_latin1_to_utf8( lv_latin1_simple_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_simple exp = lv_original_simple msg = 'Simple conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE bietet eine standardisierte und robuste Möglichkeit zur Codepage-Konvertierung in ABAP. Durch die Verwendung von CREATE_BY_EXTERNAL_NAME kann dynamisch eine Codepage-Instanz erstellt werden, die dann mit CONVERT_TO und CONVERT_FROM Strings zwischen verschiedenen Codepages umwandelt. Dies ist entscheidend für die Interaktion mit externen Systemen oder Dateien, die unterschiedliche Zeichensätze verwenden.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Codepage, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, Conversion, XSTRING

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String in einer bestimmten Codepage (z.B. UTF-8) gültig ist, ohne eine Konvertierung durchzuführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode CHECK_VALID der Klasse CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_in_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_string    TYPE string
        iv_codepage  TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_in_codepage.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( iv_codepage ).
    TRY.
        lo_codepage->check_valid( iv_string ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_codepage_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_codepage_validation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_validation( ).

    " Valid UTF-8 string
    DATA(lv_valid_utf8) = 'Hallo Welt! ÄÖÜäöüß'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_in_codepage( iv_string = lv_valid_utf8 iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Valid UTF-8 string failed' ).

    " Invalid Latin-1 string (contains characters not in Latin-1)
    " To simulate an invalid Latin-1 string, we need to create one that contains characters
    " that are valid in UTF-8 but not in ISO-8859-1. For example, a character from a different script.
    " ABAP strings are internally UTF-16, so we need to be careful how we define 'invalid'.
    " A simpler approach is to check if a UTF-8 string is valid in a more restricted codepage.
    DATA(lv_utf8_with_euro) = 'Preis: 100 €'. " Euro symbol is not in ISO-8859-1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_in_codepage( iv_string = lv_utf8_with_euro iv_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Invalid Latin-1 string failed' ).

    DATA(lv_simple_string) = 'ABC'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_in_codepage( iv_string = lv_simple_string iv_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Simple Latin-1 string failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode CHECK_VALID der Klasse CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE ermöglicht die Überprüfung, ob ein String ohne Datenverlust in eine bestimmte Codepage konvertiert werden kann. Dies ist nützlich, um potenzielle Konvertierungsfehler frühzeitig zu erkennen, bevor eine tatsächliche Konvertierung versucht wird. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über die Ausnahme CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Codepage, Validation, UTF-8, Exception Handling

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung bei einer Codepage-Konvertierung, wenn der Quellstring Zeichen enthält, die in der Zielcodepage nicht darstellbar sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Ausnahme CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( iv_target_codepage ).
    TRY.
        rv_converted_xstring = lo_codepage->convert_to( iv_source_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        " Log the error, raise a custom exception, or handle it gracefully
        " For this example, we re-raise the original exception.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_codepage_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_string_with_unrepresentable_char) = 'Test mit einem Euro-Symbol: €'. " Euro symbol not in ISO-8859-1

    " Expecting an exception
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = `lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling( iv_source_string = lv_string_with_unrepresentable_char iv_target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' )`
                                        exp = 'CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_string) = 'Hallo Welt!'.
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( 'ISO-8859-1' )->convert_to( lv_valid_string ).

    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling( iv_source_string = lv_valid_string iv_target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring msg = 'Successful conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Fehlerbehandlung bei Codepage-Konvertierungen ist entscheidend, um Datenverluste oder Programmabbrüche zu vermeiden. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Ausnahme CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION abgefangen und behandelt werden kann, wenn ein Zeichen im Quellstring nicht in der Zielcodepage darstellbar ist. Dies ermöglicht eine robuste Programmierung, die auf solche Szenarien reagieren kann.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle und wenden Sie die Konvertierung auf jedes Element an. Nutzen Sie VALUE und FOR für eine funktionale Herangehensweise.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_table_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS convert_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_xstrings) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_table_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table.
    DATA(lo_source_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( iv_source_codepage ).
    DATA(lo_target_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( iv_target_codepage ).

    rt_target_xstrings = VALUE #( FOR ls_string IN it_source_strings
                                  ( lo_target_codepage->convert_to(
                                      lo_source_codepage->convert_from( lo_source_codepage->convert_to( ls_string ) )
                                    ) ) ).
    " The above line is a bit convoluted for demonstration. A more direct approach for string -> xstring is:
    " rt_target_xstrings = VALUE #( FOR ls_string IN it_source_strings
    "                               ( lo_target_codepage->convert_to( ls_string ) ) ).
    " However, if the input is already in a specific codepage (e.g., XSTRING), then convert_from is needed.
    " For string (UTF-16) to XSTRING (target codepage):
    rt_target_xstrings = VALUE #( FOR ls_string IN it_source_strings
                                  ( lo_target_codepage->convert_to( ls_string ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_table_conv( ).
    DATA lt_source_strings TYPE zcl_codepage_table_conv=>tt_strings VALUE #( ( 'Hallo' ) ( 'Grüße' ) ( 'Welt' ) ).
    DATA(lv_source_codepage) = 'UTF-8'.
    DATA(lv_target_codepage) = 'ISO-8859-1'.

    DATA(lo_target_codepage_helper) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( lv_target_codepage ).
    DATA lt_expected_xstrings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND lo_target_codepage_helper->convert_to( 'Hallo' ) TO lt_expected_xstrings.
    APPEND lo_target_codepage_helper->convert_to( 'Grüße' ) TO lt_expected_xstrings.
    APPEND lo_target_codepage_helper->convert_to( 'Welt' ) TO lt_expected_xstrings.

    DATA(lt_actual_xstrings) = lo_cut->convert_string_table( it_source_strings = lt_source_strings
                                                              iv_source_codepage = lv_source_codepage
                                                              iv_target_codepage = lv_target_codepage ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_xstrings exp = lt_expected_xstrings msg = 'Table conversion failed' ).

    " Test with an unrepresentable character to trigger exception
    DATA lt_error_strings TYPE zcl_codepage_table_conv=>tt_strings VALUE #( ( 'Test' ) ( '€uro' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = `lo_cut->convert_string_table( it_source_strings = lt_error_strings iv_source_codepage = 'UTF-8' iv_target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' )`
                                        exp = 'CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine interne Tabelle von Strings effizient von einer Codepage in eine andere konvertiert werden kann. Die Verwendung von VALUE #( FOR ... ) ermöglicht eine funktionale Transformation der Tabelle, wobei jede String-Konvertierung mit CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE durchgeführt wird. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, Tabellenoperationen durchzuführen.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Internal Tables, Conversion, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Codepage eines gegebenen XSTRING (binären) Inhalts mit CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, falls die Codepage unbekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode GUESS_CODEPAGE der Klasse CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_guess DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS guess_codepage_from_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_codepage_name) TYPE abap_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_guess IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD guess_codepage_from_xstring.
    TRY.
        rv_codepage_name = cl_abap_codepage=>guess_codepage(
          xstring = iv_xstring
          check_valid = abap_true " Optional: Check validity after guessing
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        " If guessing fails or is invalid, return a default or raise an error
        rv_codepage_name = 'UNKNOWN'. " Or handle as appropriate
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_guess_codepage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_guess_codepage.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_guess( ).

    " Test with a known UTF-8 XSTRING
    DATA(lv_utf8_string) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lo_utf8_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = lo_utf8_codepage->convert_to( lv_utf8_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->guess_codepage_from_xstring( lv_utf8_xstring ) exp = 'UTF-8' msg = 'UTF-8 guess failed' ).

    " Test with a known ISO-8859-1 XSTRING
    DATA(lv_latin1_string) = 'Grüße'.
    DATA(lo_latin1_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    DATA(lv_latin1_xstring) = lo_latin1_codepage->convert_to( lv_latin1_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->guess_codepage_from_xstring( lv_latin1_xstring ) exp = 'ISO-8859-1' msg = 'ISO-8859-1 guess failed' ).

    " Test with an empty XSTRING (might return default or raise error depending on implementation)
    DATA(lv_empty_xstring) = X''.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->guess_codepage_from_xstring( lv_empty_xstring ) exp = 'UNKNOWN' msg = 'Empty xstring guess failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode GUESS_CODEPAGE ist besonders nützlich, wenn binäre Daten (XSTRING) empfangen werden, deren ursprüngliche Codepage unbekannt ist. Sie versucht, die Codepage anhand des Inhalts zu erraten. Die Option CHECK_VALID kann verwendet werden, um die Gültigkeit der geratenen Codepage zu überprüfen. Dies ist wichtig für die korrekte Interpretation von externen Daten.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Codepage Detection, XSTRING, GUESS_CODEPAGE

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und berechnen Sie die Summe dieser gefilterten Flüge mit REDUCE.
hint: Kombinieren Sie REDUCE mit einer WHERE-Klausel, die eine Bedingung für den Preis enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filtered_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_of_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filtered_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_of_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
                                WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filtered_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = 500.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.

    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_sum WHERE price > lv_min_price.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_sum_of_expensive_flights( lv_min_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Incorrect sum of expensive flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von REDUCE mit einer WHERE-Klausel, um eine Aggregation auf einer gefilterten Untermenge einer internen Tabelle durchzuführen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode, um komplexe Filter- und Aggregationslogik in einer einzigen Anweisung zu implementieren.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Filter, Sum, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie mit REDUCE eine Map (Hash-Tabelle), die für jeden Carrier (CARRID) die Anzahl seiner Flüge (CONNID) aus SFLIGHT speichert.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um eine HASHED TABLE zu füllen, wobei der Schlüssel der CARRID und der Wert die Anzahl der Flüge ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_carrier_flight_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count,
           tt_carrier_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_carrier_flight_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE tt_carrier_count(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_carrier_count(
      )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT counts = VALUE tt_carrier_count(
        FOR <fs_entry> IN counts
        ( <fs_entry> )
        ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
          count  = counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid ]-count + 1 OPTIONAL )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carrier_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_carrier_flight_count( ).
    DATA lt_expected_counts TYPE zcl_reduce_carrier_flight_count=>tt_carrier_count.

    " Calculate expected counts using standard SQL aggregation
    SELECT carrid, COUNT( * ) AS count FROM sflight GROUP BY carrid INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sql_counts).
    lt_expected_counts = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sql> IN lt_sql_counts ( <fs_sql> ) ).

    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_counts ) exp = lines( lt_expected_counts ) msg = 'Incorrect number of carriers' ).
    LOOP AT lt_expected_counts INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      DATA(ls_actual) = lt_actual_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = ls_expected-carrid ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-count exp = ls_expected-count msg = |Incorrect count for carrier { ls_expected-carrid }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von REDUCE, um eine HASHED TABLE zu erstellen, die als Zähler für jeden Carrier dient. Die NEXT-Klausel verwendet eine Kombination aus FOR und OPTIONAL, um bestehende Einträge zu aktualisieren oder neue hinzuzufügen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und funktionale Art, Aggregationen in einer Map-ähnlichen Struktur durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, Hashed Table, Grouping, SFLIGHT, Map

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in eine XSTRING-Repräsentation unter Verwendung einer spezifischen Codepage und geben Sie die Länge des resultierenden XSTRING zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie CONVERT_TO und die Funktion XSTRLEN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_xstring_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_xstring_length_in_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_string    TYPE string
        iv_codepage  TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_xstring_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_xstring_length_in_codepage.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( iv_codepage ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_codepage->convert_to( iv_string ).
    rv_length = xstrlen( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_xstring_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_xstring_length( ).

    " Test with UTF-8
    DATA(lv_utf8_string) = 'ABCÄÖÜ'.
    " Expected length for 'ABCÄÖÜ' in UTF-8: A,B,C (1 byte each), Ä,Ö,Ü (2 bytes each) = 3 + 6 = 9 bytes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_xstring_length_in_codepage( iv_string = lv_utf8_string iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ) exp = 9 msg = 'UTF-8 length incorrect' ).

    " Test with ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_latin1_string) = 'ABCÄÖÜ'.
    " Expected length for 'ABCÄÖÜ' in ISO-8859-1: A,B,C,Ä,Ö,Ü (1 byte each) = 6 bytes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_xstring_length_in_codepage( iv_string = lv_latin1_string iv_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' ) exp = 6 msg = 'ISO-8859-1 length incorrect' ).

    " Test with empty string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_xstring_length_in_codepage( iv_string = '' iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ) exp = 0 msg = 'Empty string length incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Länge eines Strings in seiner binären Repräsentation für eine bestimmte Codepage ermittelt werden kann. Dies ist wichtig, wenn mit binären Daten gearbeitet wird, z.B. beim Schreiben in Dateien oder bei der Kommunikation über Schnittstellen, wo die genaue Byte-Länge entscheidend ist. Die Funktion XSTRLEN liefert die Länge des XSTRING in Bytes.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, XSTRING, Length, XSTRLEN, Codepage

CLASS zcl_sflight_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats.
    SELECT SINGLE
      CASE WHEN seatsmax IS NOT NULL THEN seatsmax ELSE 0 END AS max_seats
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @rv_max_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den neuesten Flugdatensatz für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS. Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `ORDER BY` und `UP TO 1 ROWS`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT SINGLE`, `ORDER BY DESCENDING` und `UP TO 1 ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_latest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_latest_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_latest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING, fltime DESCENDING
      INTO @rs_sflight
      UP TO 1 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_latest_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_latest_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_latest( ).
    DATA(ls_latest_flight) = lo_cut->get_latest_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_latest_flight-fldate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_latest_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Verify it's indeed the latest (simple check, more robust would involve mocking DB or more data)
    DATA(lv_fldate_check) = ls_latest_flight-fldate.
    DATA(lv_fltime_check) = ls_latest_flight-fltime.

    SELECT MAX( fldate ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @DATA(lv_max_fldate).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_latest_flight-fldate exp = lv_max_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `ORDER BY ... DESCENDING` und `UP TO 1 ROWS` ist die effizienteste Methode, um den 'neuesten' oder 'ersten' Datensatz nach einer bestimmten Sortierreihenfolge zu erhalten. `SELECT SINGLE` ist hier nicht ausreichend, da es keinen Sortierbefehl impliziert und einen beliebigen Datensatz zurückgeben könnte, wenn mehrere die `WHERE`-Bedingung erfüllen.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, ORDER BY, UP TO 1 ROWS, SFLIGHTS, Latest Record

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in SFLIGHTS existiert, ohne Daten zu lesen. Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `UP TO 1 ROWS` und `COUNT(*)`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE COUNT(*)` mit `UP TO 1 ROWS` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE COUNT(*) FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      UP TO 1 ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP POST Handler, der einen JSON-Body empfängt, diesen parst und eine Bestätigung mit einem Wert aus dem JSON zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_server->request->get_cdata()` für den Request-Body und `cl_abap_json=>deserialize` zum Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request)  = cl_http_server=>server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = cl_http_server=>server->response.
    DATA: lv_json_input TYPE string,
          ls_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_data> TYPE any.

    lv_json_input = lo_request->get_cdata( ).

    TRY.
        cl_abap_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json_input CHANGING data = ls_data ).
        ASSIGN ls_data->* TO <ls_data>.

        DATA(lv_value) = 'N/A'.
        IF <ls_data> IS BOUND AND <ls_data> IS NOT INITIAL.
          " Assuming JSON structure like { "message": "..." }
          TRY.
              DATA(lt_components) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_data> )->get_components( ).
              LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp) WHERE name = 'MESSAGE'.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'MESSAGE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_message>).
                IF <lv_message> IS ASSIGNED.
                  lv_value = <lv_message>.
                END IF.
                EXIT.
              ENDLOOP.
            CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
              " Handle if not a structure
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_response_text) = |Received JSON with message: { lv_value }|.
        lo_response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_response_text ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        lo_response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Error parsing JSON: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_handle_json_post FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_handle_invalid_json_post FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_handle_json_post.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_json_post( ).
    DATA(lo_request)  = CAST if_http_request( NEW cl_http_request( ) ).
    DATA(lo_response) = CAST if_http_response( NEW cl_http_response( ) ).

    DATA(lv_json_payload) = '{"message": "Test Message from Client"}'.
    lo_request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).
    lo_request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).

    cl_http_server=>server = NEW cl_http_server( ).
    cl_http_server=>server->request  = lo_request.
    cl_http_server=>server->response = lo_response.

    lo_cut->if_http_extension~handle_request( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_cdata( ) exp = 'Received JSON with message: Test Message from Client' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_status( ) exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_handle_invalid_json_post.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_json_post( ).
    DATA(lo_request)  = CAST if_http_request( NEW cl_http_request( ) ).
    DATA(lo_response) = CAST if_http_response( NEW cl_http_response( ) ).

    DATA(lv_json_payload) = '{"message": "Test Message from Client"'. " Invalid JSON
    lo_request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).
    lo_request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).

    cl_http_server=>server = NEW cl_http_server( ).
    cl_http_server=>server->request  = lo_request.
    cl_http_server=>server->response = lo_response.

    lo_cut->if_http_extension~handle_request( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error parsing JSON' act = lo_response->get_cdata( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_status( ) exp = 400 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `get_cdata()` liest den gesamten Request-Body als String. `cl_abap_json=>deserialize` ist die Standardklasse zum Parsen von JSON-Strings in ABAP-Datenstrukturen. Die dynamische Zuweisung mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `cl_abap_structdescr` ist notwendig, da die Struktur des JSON-Inputs zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt sein kann.
keywords: cl_http_server, IF_HTTP_EXTENSION, HTTP POST, JSON, cl_abap_json, Deserialize

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in eine Struktur und prüfen Sie, ob der Datensatz gefunden wurde. Nutzen Sie `IF sy-subrc = 0`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA(...)` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_check_found DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_and_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_check_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_and_check.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Leiten Sie eine HTTP-Anfrage auf eine andere URL um (HTTP 302 Found).

CLASS zcl_http_redirect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_redirect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_response) = cl_http_server=>server->response.
    DATA(lv_redirect_url) = 'https://www.sap.com'.

    lo_response->set_status( code = 302 reason = 'Found' ).
    lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Location' value = lv_redirect_url ).
    lo_response->set_cdata( |Redirecting to { lv_redirect_url }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_request)  = CAST if_http_request( NEW cl_http_request( ) ).
    DATA(lo_response) = CAST if_http_response( NEW cl_http_response( ) ).

    cl_http_server=>server = NEW cl_http_server( ).
    cl_http_server=>server->request  = lo_request.
    cl_http_server=>server->response = lo_response.

    lo_cut->if_http_extension~handle_request( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_status( ) exp = 302 ).

explanation: Eine HTTP-Umleitung wird durch Setzen des Statuscodes auf `302 Found` (oder andere 3xx-Codes) und das Hinzufügen eines `Location`-Headers mit der Ziel-URL erreicht. Der Browser des Clients folgt dann automatisch dieser neuen URL.
keywords: cl_http_server, IF_HTTP_EXTENSION, HTTP Redirect, Location Header, HTTP Status 302

hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit Akkumulator-Variablen für Summe und Zähler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_items IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_sum_count) = REDUCE #( " Moderne Syntax für Aggregation
      INIT sum   = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
           count = 0
      FOR  item IN it_items
      NEXT sum   = sum + item-value
           count = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_sum_count-count > 0.
      rv_average = ls_sum_count-sum / ls_sum_count-count.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
