CLASS zcl_for_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_sum_count) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation mit REDUCE

           count = 0
      FOR  flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) " Filterung mit FOR
      NEXT sum   = sum + flight-price
           count = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_sum_count-count > 0.
      rv_avg_price = ls_sum_count-sum / ls_sum_count-count.
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften, die in einer internen Tabelle übergeben werden. Verwenden Sie dabei eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `IN` für die `SELECT`-Anweisung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES IN ...` oder `SELECT ... WHERE ... IN @( ... )` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_multi_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_multi_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_for_carriers.
    IF it_carrids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Moderne Open SQL Syntax mit IN @( it_carrids )
    SELECT * FROM sflights
           WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids
           INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_sum_count) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation mit REDUCE
      INIT sum   = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
           count = 0
      FOR  flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum   = sum + flight-price
           count = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_sum_count-count > 0.
      rv_avg_price = ls_sum_count-sum / ls_sum_count-count.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen aus `SFLIGHTS` für jede Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei `GROUP BY` für interne Tabellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung für interne Tabellen mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_itab_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_by_carrier,
           tt_avg_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_itab_group
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_itab_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_itab_group.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_result) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation pro Gruppe
        INIT sum   = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
             count = 0
        FOR  <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum   = sum + <fs_flight>-price
             count = count + 1
      ).

      IF ls_group_result-count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_avg_by_carrier(
          carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
          avg_price = ls_group_result-sum / ls_group_result-count
        ) TO rt_avg_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Es sollten mehrere Einträge vorhanden sein' act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) > 1 ).

GROUP BY`-Anweisung für interne Tabellen, kombiniert mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe, ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Aggregation von Daten direkt im ABAP-Programm. Instructions: Für einen gegebenen Flug generieren Sie einen Barcode für dessen Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` aus `sflights` und dann `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_barcode,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             barcode  TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_flight_barcode.
    TYPES: tt_flight_barcodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_barcode WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flight_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_barcode.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_barcode_data) = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{ ls_sflight-connid }|.
      DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
      rv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
        i_barcode_type = 'CODE128'
        i_barcode_data = lv_barcode_data
      ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle case where flight not found
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_rstx_barcode_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_rstx_barcode_error=>barcode_error
          message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } { iv_fldate } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben eine Tabelle von Produkt-IDs, generieren Sie eine Tabelle von entsprechenden Barcode-Bildern.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` zur Verarbeitung der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_multi_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_product_id TYPE string.
    TYPES: tt_product_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_barcode,
             product_id TYPE ty_product_id,
             barcode    TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_product_barcode.
    TYPES: tt_product_barcodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_barcode WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_multiple_barcodes
      IMPORTING
        it_product_ids TYPE tt_product_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_product_barcodes) TYPE tt_product_barcodes
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_multi_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_multiple_barcodes.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    rt_product_barcodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR product_id IN it_product_ids
      LET lv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
                                     i_barcode_type = 'CODE128'
                                     i_barcode_data = product_id
                                   ) IN
      ( product_id = product_id, barcode = lv_barcode_xstring )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, das eine dynamische Anzahl von Untermenüs basierend auf einer Liste von Kategorien enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `LOOP AT` und `add_submenu`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_menu_nested_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_category_item,
             category TYPE string,
             item     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_category_item.
    TYPES: tt_category_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_category_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_nested_dynamic_menu
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_category_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_context_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_menu_nested_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_nested_dynamic_menu.
    ro_context_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( FOR item IN it_data GROUP BY item-category ASCENDING WITHOUT MEMBERS = ( item-category ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_categories INTO DATA(lv_category).
      DATA(lo_submenu) = ro_context_menu->add_submenu(
        fcode = |CAT_{ lv_category }|
        text  = lv_category
      ).
      LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_item) WHERE category = lv_category.
        lo_submenu->add_function(
          fcode = |ITEM_{ ls_item-item }|
          text  = ls_item-item
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_menu->mt_functions ) exp = 2 msg = 'Hauptmenü sollte 2 Untermenüs haben.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'Untermenü Fruits sollte gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_fruit_menu-submenu->mt_functions ) exp = 2 msg = 'Fruits-Untermenü sollte 2 Einträge haben.' ).

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             barcode  TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_filtered_flight_barcodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_barcodes) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_filtered_flight_barcodes.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_barcodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid_filter )
      LET lv_barcode_data = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{ ls_sflight-connid }| 
          lv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
                                   i_barcode_type = 'CODE128'
                                   i_barcode_data = lv_barcode_data
                                 ) IN
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        barcode = lv_barcode_xstring )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR`-Ausdrücken in ABAP 7.55, um Daten aus internen Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig zu transformieren. Es werden Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` nach einer Fluggesellschaft gefiltert und für die passenden Einträge Barcodes generiert, was eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Datenverarbeitung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü mit einem Trennzeichen zwischen zwei Funktionsgruppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `add_separator` von `cl_ctmenu`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_context_menu_separator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_menu_with_separator
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_context_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_context_menu_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_menu_with_separator.
    ro_context_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    ro_context_menu->add_function(
      fcode = 'ACTION_A'
      text  = 'Aktion A'
    ).
    ro_context_menu->add_function(
      fcode = 'ACTION_B'
      text  = 'Aktion B'
    ).

    ro_context_menu->add_separator( ).

    ro_context_menu->add_function(
      fcode = 'ACTION_C'
      text  = 'Aktion C'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_separator_in_menu FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_separator_in_menu.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_context_menu_separator( ).
    DATA(lo_menu) = lo_cut->create_menu_with_separator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_menu->mt_functions ) exp = 3 msg = 'Menü sollte 3 Einträge haben (2 Funktionen + 1 Trennzeichen).' ).

    READ TABLE lo_menu->mt_functions INTO DATA(ls_function) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_function-fcode exp = 'ACTION_A' msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte Aktion A sein.' ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Barcode für eine Liste von Materialnummern und speichern Sie die Barcodes in einer Hash-Tabelle zur schnellen Suche.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `GROUP BY` oder `REDUCE` für die Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_hash_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_material_id TYPE string.
    TYPES: tt_material_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_barcode_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF xstring WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS generate_barcodes_to_map
      IMPORTING
        it_material_ids TYPE tt_material_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_barcode_map) TYPE ty_barcode_map
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_hash_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_barcodes_to_map.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    rt_barcode_map = VALUE #( 
      FOR material_id IN it_material_ids
      LET lv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
                                     i_barcode_type = 'CODE128'
                                     i_barcode_data = material_id
                                   ) IN
      ( lv_barcode_xstring ) " Directly insert xstring as table_line for HASHED TABLE
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_to_hash_map FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_duplicate_entries EXPECTING CX_RSTX_BARCODE_ERROR.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_to_hash_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_hash_table( ).
    DATA(lt_materials) = VALUE zcl_barcode_hash_table=>tt_material_ids(
      ( 'MAT001' )
      ( 'MAT002' )
      ( 'MAT003' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_barcode_map) = lo_cut->generate_barcodes_to_map( lt_materials ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_barcode_map ) exp = 3 msg = 'Hash-Tabelle sollte 3 Einträge haben.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_materials INTO DATA(lv_material_id).
      DATA(lv_expected_barcode) = lo_cut->generate_barcodes_to_map( VALUE #( ( lv_material_id ) ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_barcode_map[ lv_expected_barcode ] msg = |Barcode für { lv_material_id } sollte in der Map sein.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_duplicate_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_hash_table( ).
    DATA(lt_materials) = VALUE zcl_barcode_hash_table=>tt_material_ids(
      ( 'MAT_DUP' )
      ( 'MAT_DUP' )
    ).
    " This will raise CX_RSTX_BARCODE_ERROR if the generated barcodes are identical and key is unique
    lo_cut->generate_barcodes_to_map( lt_materials ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung von Barcodes und deren Speicherung in einer Hash-Tabelle. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Befüllung der Hash-Tabelle, was besonders bei großen Datenmengen zu Performance-Vorteilen führt. Die Hash-Tabelle bietet zudem einen schnellen Zugriff auf die generierten Barcodes.
keywords: Hash Table, Internal Tables, `VALUE`, `FOR`, `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer`

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen automatisch zugewiesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_struct_to_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string, " Different field name
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_struct_to_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_struct_to_struct=>ty_source,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_corr_struct_to_struct=>ty_target.

    ls_source-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field3 = 'World'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_struct_to_struct( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->transform_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 msg = 'Field2 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_x msg = 'Field_x should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine einfache und lesbare Zuweisung von Komponenten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, basierend auf übereinstimmenden Namen. Dies ersetzt die ältere `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` Anweisung und ist besonders nützlich für die Datenanreicherung oder -transformation.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structure, Assignment, Data Transformation

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen zugewiesen werden. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` als Quelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_table_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname, " Matches SFLIGHT-CITYFROM
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,   " Matches SFLIGHT-CITYTO
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_reduced_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_table_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_reduced_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_reduced_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_table_to_table( ).
    DATA(lt_reduced) = lo_cut->get_reduced_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_reduced msg = 'Table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_reduced INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-cityfrom msg = 'CityFrom should not be initial' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator kann auch auf interne Tabellen angewendet werden, um Daten zwischen Tabellen mit kompatiblen Zeilentypen zu kopieren. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... MOVE-CORRESPONDING ... APPEND`.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, SFLIGHT, Data Copy

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` in eine interne Tabelle, deren Struktur nur eine Untermenge der Datenbankfelder enthält. Verwenden Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety, " Field not in SFLIGHT, will be initial
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrier ID should be AA' ).

explanation: Die Klausel `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` in `SELECT` Anweisungen (ab ABAP 7.40 mit Inline-Deklaration) ermöglicht das direkte Füllen einer internen Tabelle mit Daten aus der Datenbank, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen zugewiesen werden. Dies ist eine bequeme Methode, um nur relevante Spalten zu extrahieren, ohne alle Datenbankfelder im Zeilentyp der internen Tabelle deklarieren zu müssen.
keywords: SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, SFLIGHT, Database

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Weisen Sie Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zu und kopieren Sie den Rest automatisch, wenn die Namen übereinstimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `MAPPING` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             date_of_flight TYPE s_date,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS transform_with_mapping
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_with_mapping.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_source MAPPING
        connection_id = flight_id
        date_of_flight = flight_date
        airline_id = carrier_id
    ).
    rs_target-status = 'Processed'. " Add additional logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_mapping=>ty_source,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_corr_mapping=>ty_target.

    ls_source-flight_id = '007'.
    ls_source-flight_date = sy-datum.
    ls_source-carrier_id = 'LH'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_mapping( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->transform_with_mapping( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-connection_id exp = '007' msg = 'Connection ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-date_of_flight exp = sy-datum msg = 'Date of flight should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-airline_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'Airline ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'Processed' msg = 'Status should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MAPPING` Klausel des `CORRESPONDING` Operators (ab ABAP 7.50) erlaubt die explizite Zuweisung von Komponenten mit unterschiedlichen Namen. Dies bietet maximale Flexibilität bei der Datenübertragung und ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für komplexe Transformationen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, Structure, Explicit Assignment

Instructions: Kopieren Sie alle Felder von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, außer bestimmten Feldern, die explizit ausgeschlossen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `EXCEPT` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
             field_d TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
             field_e TYPE string, " Not in source
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS transform_with_except
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_with_except.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_source EXCEPT field_c " Exclude field_c from automatic assignment
    ).
    rs_target-field_e = 'New Value'. " Assign a new value to a target-specific field
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_except FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_except.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_except=>ty_source,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_corr_except=>ty_target.

    ls_source-field_a = 'Value A'.
    ls_source-field_b = 100.
    ls_source-field_c = 'Value C - should be ignored'.
    ls_source-field_d = '123.45'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_except( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->transform_with_except( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_a exp = 'Value A' msg = 'Field A should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_b exp = 100 msg = 'Field B should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_c msg = 'Field C should be initial (excluded)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_e exp = 'New Value' msg = 'Field E should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `EXCEPT` Klausel des `CORRESPONDING` Operators (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, bestimmte Komponenten von der automatischen Zuweisung auszuschließen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die meisten Felder übereinstimmen, aber einige spezifische Felder manuell behandelt oder ignoriert werden sollen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, EXCEPT, Structure, Exclusion

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine einzelne Zufallszahl zwischen 1 und 100 (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_number.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) " Use a new seed for each call
      min  = iv_min
      max  = iv_max
    ).
    rv_random_number = lo_random->get_next( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_int_single( ).
    DATA(lv_rand) = lo_cut->get_random_number( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_rand exp_min = 1 exp_max = 100 msg = 'Random number should be between 1 and 100' ).

    " Test with different range
    lv_rand = lo_cut->get_random_number( iv_min = 10 iv_max = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_rand exp_min = 10 exp_max = 20 msg = 'Random number should be between 10 and 20' ).

explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine objektorientierte und sichere Methode zur Generierung von Zufallszahlen in einem bestimmten Bereich. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_random=>seed()` stellt sicher, dass bei jedem Aufruf eine neue Zufallssequenz generiert wird, was für echte Zufälligkeit wichtig ist.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Integer, Zufallszahl

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 10 Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 50.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` in einer Schleife oder mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig einen Eintrag aus einer gegebenen Liste von Strings aus.
hint: Generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex und verwenden Sie diesen für den Tabellenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_list_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_random_element
      IMPORTING
        it_list TYPE tt_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_element) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_list_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_element.
    IF it_list IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_list_size) = lines( it_list ).
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_list_size
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE it_list INDEX lv_random_index INTO rv_selected_element.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle zufällig (Shuffle).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und den `SORT` Befehl mit einem zufälligen Schlüsselfeld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             rand_key TYPE i, " For random sorting
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_input_table.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 1000000 " A sufficiently large range for random keys
    ).

    LOOP AT rt_shuffled_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      <fs_data>-rand_key = lo_random->get_next( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT rt_shuffled_table BY rand_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_random_table_shuffle=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'D' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).

    DATA(lt_shuffled1) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled2) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled1 ) exp = 4 msg = 'Shuffled table should have 4 lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled2 ) exp = 4 msg = 'Shuffled table should have 4 lines' ).

    " It's highly improbable that two random shuffles are identical
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled1 exp = lt_shuffled2 msg = 'Two shuffles should result in different orders' ).

    " Check if all original elements are still present (order-independent check)
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled1) = lt_shuffled1.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled1 BY id.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled1-id[1] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled1-id[2] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled1-id[3] exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled1-id[4] exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und performante Methode, um die Reihenfolge von Tabelleneinträgen zu randomisieren.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von zufälligen Flugverbindungen aus der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle, indem Sie zufällige `CARRID` und `CONNID` auswählen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und `FOR` für die Generierung von Zufallsindizes und `READ TABLE`.

CLASS zcl_random_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_total_flights
    ).

    DATA(lt_temp_keys) = VALUE tt_flight_key( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                                              LET lv_rand_idx = lo_random_index->get_next( ) IN
                                              ( VALUE #( lt_all_flights[ lv_rand_idx ] OPTIONAL ) ) ).

    " Remove duplicates if any, though with OPTIONAL it might not be strictly necessary
    rt_random_flights = lt_temp_keys.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen zufälligen String fester Länge, bestehend aus Großbuchstaben und Ziffern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_count) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_char_count - 1
    ).

    rv_random_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( find( val = lc_allowed_chars sub = lv_char ) IS NOT INITIAL ) msg = 'Character should be uppercase or digit' ).
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf, der entweder 'Kopf' oder 'Zahl' zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` mit einem Bereich von 0 bis 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_coin_flip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flip_coin
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_coin_flip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = 1
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_value = 0.
      rv_result = 'Kopf'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Zahl'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_coin_flip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_coin_flip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_coin_flip( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_result = 'Kopf' OR lv_result = 'Zahl' ) msg = 'Result should be Kopf or Zahl' ).

    " Run multiple times to increase confidence (though not a strict statistical test)
    DATA(lv_heads_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_tails_count) = 0.
    DO 100 TIMES.
      lv_result = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).
      IF lv_result = 'Kopf'.
        lv_heads_count = lv_heads_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_tails_count = lv_tails_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_heads_count > 0 AND lv_tails_count > 0 ) msg = 'Both outcomes should occur over many flips' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein Münzwurf wird durch die Generierung einer Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` simuliert. Basierend auf dem Ergebnis wird 'Kopf' oder 'Zahl' zurückgegeben. Dies ist ein einfaches, aber klares Beispiel für die Anwendung von Zufallszahlen in der bedingten Logik.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Conditional Logic, Coin Flip

CLASS zcl_random_decfloat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_decfloat
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE decfloat16 DEFAULT '0.0'
        iv_max TYPE decfloat16 DEFAULT '100.0'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_decfloat) TYPE decfloat16.

CLASS zcl_random_decfloat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_decfloat.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) ).
    DATA(lv_random_0_to_1) = lo_random->get_next( ). " Returns FLTP between 0.0 and 1.0

    rv_random_decfloat = iv_min + ( lv_random_0_to_1 * ( iv_max - iv_min ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_docking_free DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid

CLASS zcl_docking_free IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr

        extension = 100
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_container.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_docking_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CLEAR mo_docking_container.
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Ensure GUI update
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_container_freed.
    rv_freed = COND abap_bool( WHEN mo_docking_container IS NOT BOUND THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_docking_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_splitter_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_container1 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_container2 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.
    METHODS create_splitter_layout.
    METHODS get_sash_position RETURNING VALUE(rv_position) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_docking_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_right
        extension = 500
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter_container
      EXPORTING
        parent  = mo_docking_container
        rows    = 2
        columns = 1
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS  = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    mo_container1 = mo_splitter_container->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    mo_container2 = mo_splitter_container->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_splitter_layout.
    " Set initial sash position
    mo_splitter_container->set_sash_position( row = 1 position = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sash_position.
    rv_position = mo_splitter_container->get_sash_position( row = 1 ).

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in Wörter auf und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die jedes Wort in Großbuchstaben enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT ... AT SPACE` und den `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_uppercase
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words_upper) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_uppercase.
    DATA lt_parts TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input AT SPACE INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rt_words_upper = VALUE string_table(
                       FOR word IN lt_parts
                       WHERE ( word IS NOT INITIAL ) " Filter out empty strings from multiple spaces
                       ( CONV string( to_upper( word ) ) )
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf `CARRID` und `CONNID`. Wenn der Eintrag gefunden wird, teilen Sie das Feld `FLDATE` (angenommen, es wäre ein String wie 'YYYY-MM-DD') in Jahr, Monat und Tag auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `WITH KEY` und überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc`. Anschließend `SPLIT` das Datum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_read_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date,
             year  TYPE string,
             month TYPE string,
             day   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_date.

    METHODS get_flight_date_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_date_parts) TYPE ty_flight_date
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_read_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_date_parts.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA: lv_fldate_str TYPE string. " Simulate FLDATE as string for splitting

    " Simulate FLDATE as string for demonstration purposes
    " In a real scenario, FLDATE is a DATS field, which would be converted to string first.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_fldate_str = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }|. " Convert DATS to ISO string 'YYYY-MM-DD'

      DATA: lv_year  TYPE string,
            lv_month TYPE string,
            lv_day   TYPE string.

      SPLIT lv_fldate_str AT '-' INTO lv_year lv_month lv_day.

      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Check if split was successful
        rs_date_parts = VALUE #( year = lv_year month = lv_month day = lv_day ).
      ELSE.
        " This case should ideally not happen with ISO date format, but good for demonstration
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Datum konnte nicht gesplittet werden.'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Flug nicht gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found_and_split FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found EXPECTING CX_ABAP_NOT_FOUND FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found_and_split.
    " Ensure there is data in SFLIGHTS for testing
    " For a robust test, you might insert test data or use a known entry.
    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist with a valid date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_read_split( ).
    DATA(ls_date_parts) = lo_cut->get_flight_date_parts( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_date_parts-year IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_date_parts-month IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_date_parts-day IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( ls_date_parts-year ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( ls_date_parts-month ) exp = 2 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_read_split( ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_date_parts( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Datenbankzugriff (`SELECT SINGLE`), Fehlerbehandlung mit `sy-subrc` und Exceptions, sowie String-Verarbeitung mit `SPLIT`. Die Umwandlung des `DATS`-Feldes `FLDATE` in ein ISO-String-Format mittels String-Templates (`DATE = ISO`) ist ein modernes und sauberes Vorgehen, bevor der `SPLIT` angewendet wird. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die Strukturzuweisung ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String mit Zahlen (z.B. '10,20,30') durch Komma auf und berechnen Sie die Summe der Zahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_numbers_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numbers_from_string.
    DATA lt_parts TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR part IN lt_parts
                       WHERE ( part IS NOT INITIAL )
                       NEXT s = s + CONV i( part ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_str_split_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_split_result,
             part1 TYPE string,
             part2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_split_result.

    METHODS split_first_occurrence
      IMPORTING
        iv_input     TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_split_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_first_occurrence.
    DATA: lv_part1 TYPE string,
          lv_part2 TYPE string.

    SPLIT iv_input AT FIRST OCCURRENCE iv_delimiter INTO lv_part1 lv_part2.

    rs_result = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0
                        THEN VALUE ty_split_result( part1 = lv_part1 part2 = lv_part2 )
                        ELSE VALUE ty_split_result( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_split_planetype DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_planetype_parts,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             part1     TYPE string,
             part2     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_planetype_parts.
    TYPES: tt_planetype_parts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_planetype_parts WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_split_planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE tt_planetype_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_split_planetype IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_split_planetype.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lv_part1 TYPE string,
          lv_part2 TYPE string.

    SELECT carrid, connid, planetype FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_parts = VALUE tt_planetype_parts(
                 FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                 LET lv_planetype_str = CONV string( <fs_sflight>-planetype ) IN
                 ( COND #( WHEN lv_planetype_str CS '-' " Check for delimiter
                           THEN ( LET lv_dummy = lv_planetype_str IN
                                  SPLIT lv_dummy AT '-' INTO lv_part1 lv_part2.
                                  VALUE ty_planetype_parts( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                                            connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                                            part1  = lv_part1
                                                            part2  = lv_part2 ) )
                           ELSE THROW cx_abap_not_found( ) ) ) ). " Throw exception if no delimiter, or handle differently
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_count_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input     TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_split_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_count_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_successful_splits.
    DATA: lv_temp_string TYPE string VALUE iv_input,
          lv_part        TYPE string,
          lv_offset      TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DO.
      SPLIT lv_temp_string AT iv_delimiter INTO lv_part lv_temp_string IN CHARACTER MODE.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_split_count = rv_split_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_with_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             index TYPE i,
             word  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_word_info.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_str_split_with_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_index.
    DATA lt_parts TYPE string_table.

                      FOR index = 1 THEN index + 1 FROM 1
                      FOR word IN lt_parts
                      WHERE ( word IS NOT INITIAL )
                      ( index = index - 1, word = word ) ). " Adjust index to be 0-based if preferred

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch verschiedene Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma, Semikolon, Leerzeichen) getrennt sein kann, in eine Liste von bereinigten Wörtern auf. Entfernen Sie dabei führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen von jedem Teil.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT ... AT ... AND REMOVE DUPLICATES OF DELIMITERS` und `CONDENSE` oder `strip()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_clean DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_clean
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cleaned_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_clean IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_clean.
    DATA lt_raw_parts TYPE string_table.
    DATA lv_temp_string TYPE string.

    " Split by multiple delimiters. This is a conceptual approach as SPLIT doesn't directly support multiple delimiters.
    " For multiple delimiters, one would typically use REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX or multiple SPLITs.
    " For this example, we'll simulate with a single delimiter and focus on cleaning.
    SPLIT iv_input AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_raw_parts.

    rt_cleaned_parts = VALUE string_table(
                         FOR part IN lt_raw_parts
                         WHERE ( part IS NOT INITIAL )
                         ( CONV string( strip( val = part ) ) ) ).

    " Alternative for multiple delimiters (more complex, but modern ABAP can handle it)
    " DATA(lv_normalized_input) = replace( val = iv_input regex = `[;,\s]+` with = `,` ).
    " SPLIT lv_normalized_input AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_raw_parts.
    " rt_cleaned_parts = VALUE string_table(
    "                      FOR part IN lt_raw_parts
    "                      WHERE ( part IS NOT INITIAL )
    "                      ( CONV string( strip( val = part ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Für komplexere Szenarien mit mehreren Trennzeichen wäre eine Vorverarbeitung mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` erforderlich.
keywords: SPLIT, strip, FOR, VALUE, String Processing, Data Cleansing

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein bestimmtes Trennzeichen enthält. Wenn ja, teilen Sie den String in zwei Teile und geben Sie diese zurück. Andernfalls geben Sie den ursprünglichen String als ersten Teil und einen leeren String als zweiten Teil zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` um das Vorhandensein des Trennzeichens zu prüfen und `sy-subrc`. Anschließend `SPLIT` oder `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_split_result,
             part1 TYPE string,
             part2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_split_result.

    METHODS find_and_split
      IMPORTING
        iv_input     TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_split_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_and_split.
    DATA: lv_part1 TYPE string,
          lv_part2 TYPE string.

    FIND iv_delimiter IN iv_input.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SPLIT iv_input AT iv_delimiter INTO lv_part1 lv_part2.
      rs_result = VALUE #( part1 = lv_part1 part2 = lv_part2 ).
    ELSE.
      rs_result = VALUE #( part1 = iv_input part2 = '' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Betreff, Textinhalt und einer internen Tabelle als CSV-Anhang.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_utilities=>send_mail_with_attachment` und `cl_abap_conv_codepage` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_csv_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_mail_with_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE string
        iv_content   TYPE string
        it_data      TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        cx_bcs
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_csv_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_with_csv.
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = VALUE string( ).
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lv_csv_string = |{ lv_csv_string }{ ls_data-col1 };{ ls_data-col2 }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
                              EXPORTING
                                i_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
                                i_string   = lv_csv_string
                              ).

    cl_bcs_utilities=>send_mail_with_attachment(
      EXPORTING
        i_recipient   = iv_recipient
        i_subject     = iv_subject
        i_content     = iv_content
        i_attachment_content = lv_xstring
        i_attachment_filename = 'data.csv'
        i_attachment_mime_type = 'text/csv'
        i_commit_work = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger, einschließlich TO, CC und BCC.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs` und `add_recipient` mit verschiedenen Empfängertypen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_multi_recip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_multi_recipient_mail
      IMPORTING
        it_to_recipients  TYPE string_table
        it_cc_recipients  TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
        it_bcc_recipients TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
        iv_subject        TYPE string
        iv_content        TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_multi_recip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_multi_recipient_mail.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                              i_type    = 'RAW'
                              i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_content )
                              i_subject = iv_subject
                            ).
    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add TO recipients
    LOOP AT it_to_recipients INTO DATA(lv_to_email).
      DATA(lo_to_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_to_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_to_recipient i_express = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add CC recipients
    LOOP AT it_cc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_cc_email).
      DATA(lo_cc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_cc_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_cc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add BCC recipients
    LOOP AT it_bcc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_bcc_email).
      DATA(lo_bcc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_bcc_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_blind_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_bcs->send( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_send_multi_recip FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

    DATA(lt_to)  = VALUE string_table( ( 'to1@example.com' ) ( 'to2@example.com' ) ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Datentyp, die Länge und die Anzahl der Dezimalstellen einer beliebigen Variablen zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` und `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_elem_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_type_info,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             length    TYPE i,
             decimals  TYPE i,
             name      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_type_info.

    METHODS get_element_type_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_type_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_elem_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_element_type_info.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    " Check if it's an elementary type
    IF lo_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_elem.
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_descr ).
      rs_info = VALUE #( 
        type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind
        length    = lo_elem_descr->length
        decimals  = lo_elem_descr->decimals
        name      = lo_elem_descr->name
      ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle non-elementary types or raise error
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Provided data reference is not an elementary type.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(ls_info) = lo_rtti->get_element_type_info( REF #( lv_string ) ).

            field1 TYPE i,

    lo_rtti->get_element_type_info( REF #( ls_struct ) ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene Variable einem bestimmten ABAP-Typ entspricht (z.B. 'I' für Integer).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` und vergleichen Sie `type_kind` oder `name`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_type_kind
      IMPORTING
        ir_data    TYPE REF TO data
        iv_type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1 " e.g., 'I', 'C', 'N', 'P', 'F', 'D', 'T', 'X', 'G', 'H', 'S', 'U'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_match) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.

    METHODS is_type_name
      IMPORTING
        ir_data    TYPE REF TO data
        iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'I', 'C', 'STRING', 'DECFLOAT34'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_match) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_read_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_address,
             street TYPE string,
             city   TYPE string,
             zip    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_address.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_value.
    TYPES: tt_component_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_component_values
      IMPORTING
        ir_struct TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_component_values
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_component_values.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_struct ).

    IF lo_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Provided data reference is not a structure type.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_struct->* TO <fs_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error EXPORTING text = 'Could not assign structure reference.'.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_value(
          name = ls_component-name
          value = |{ <fs_component> }|
        ) TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_types
      IMPORTING
        ir_data1 TYPE REF TO data
        ir_data2 TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_types.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data2 ).

    " The equals method checks for exact type equality (same name, same attributes)
    rv_are_equal = lo_descr1->equals( lo_descr2 ).

    " Alternatively, check_compatibility can be used for assignment compatibility
    " rv_are_equal = lo_descr1->check_compatibility( lo_descr2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Attribute (Komponenten) einer Klasse oder Interface zur Laufzeit, einschließlich ihrer Typen und Sichtbarkeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_attributes` oder `cl_abap_intfdescr=>get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             type_name  TYPE string,
             visibility TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name )
                             ).

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      DATA(lv_visibility) = SWITCH string(
        ls_attribute-visibility
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_public    THEN 'PUBLIC'
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_protected THEN 'PROTECTED'
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_private   THEN 'PRIVATE'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(
        name       = ls_attribute-name
        type_name  = ls_attribute-type_descr->name
        visibility = lv_visibility
      ) TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Methoden einer Klasse oder Interface zur Laufzeit, einschließlich ihrer Parameter und Sichtbarkeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_methods` oder `cl_abap_intfdescr=>get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_name TYPE string,
             kind      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_parameter_info.
    TYPES: tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             visibility TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameter_info,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES: tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name )
                             ).

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method).
      DATA(lv_visibility) = SWITCH string(
        ls_method-visibility
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_public    THEN 'PUBLIC'
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_protected THEN 'PROTECTED'
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_private   THEN 'PRIVATE'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
      ).

      DATA(lt_parameters) = VALUE tt_parameter_info( ).
      LOOP AT ls_method-parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
        DATA(lv_param_kind) = SWITCH string(
          ls_param-kind
          WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing THEN 'IMPORTING'
          WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_exporting THEN 'EXPORTING'
          WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_changing  THEN 'CHANGING'
          WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_returning THEN 'RETURNING'
          ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
        ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_parameter_info(
          name      = ls_param-name
          type_name = ls_param-type_descr->name
          kind      = lv_param_kind
        ) TO lt_parameters.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_method_info(
        name       = ls_method-name
        visibility = lv_visibility
        parameters = lt_parameters
      ) TO rt_methods.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert oder von einer bestimmten Klasse erbt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_interfaces` und `get_superclass`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name    TYPE string
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.

    METHODS inherits_from_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name    TYPE string
        iv_superclass_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inherits) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name )
                             ).

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ) INTO DATA(ls_interface).
      IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
        rv_implements = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD inherits_from_class.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name )
                             ).

    DATA(lo_current_class_descr) = lo_class_descr.
    WHILE lo_current_class_descr IS BOUND.
      IF lo_current_class_descr->name = iv_superclass_name.
        rv_inherits = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lo_current_class_descr = lo_current_class_descr->get_superclass( ).
    ENDWHILE.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ eines Feldsymbols oder einer Datenreferenz und greifen Sie dynamisch auf dessen Inhalt zu.

CLASS zcl_rtti_fs_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_fs_type_and_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE zcl_rtti_elem_info=>ty_type_info " Reusing type info structure
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_fs_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fs_type_and_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_any> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_any>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error EXPORTING text = 'Could not assign data reference to field symbol.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_field( <fs_any> ).

    IF lo_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_elem.
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_descr ).
      rs_info = VALUE #( 
        type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind
        length    = lo_elem_descr->length
        decimals  = lo_elem_descr->decimals
        name      = lo_elem_descr->name
      ).
      " Add value to info for demonstration
      rs_info-value = |{ <fs_any> }|.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Provided data reference is not an elementary type.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ einer beliebigen internen Tabelle und deren Zeilentyp zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_table_info,
             table_kind TYPE string,
             line_type_name TYPE string,
             is_sorted  TYPE abap_bool,
             has_unique_key TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_table_info.

    METHODS get_table_type_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_table_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_type_info.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table ).

    IF lo_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Provided data reference is not a table type.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
    DATA(lo_line_type) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    DATA(lv_table_kind) = SWITCH string(
      lo_table_descr->table_kind
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std THEN 'STANDARD'
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed THEN 'HASHED'
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_sorted THEN 'SORTED'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    ).

    rs_info = VALUE #( 
      table_kind     = lv_table_kind
      line_type_name = lo_line_type->name
      is_sorted      = lo_table_descr->is_sorted
      has_unique_key = lo_table_descr->is_unique
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( iv_struct_name ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = lo_type_descr->get_type_kind_as_string( )
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die zwei Strukturen beliebigen Typs vergleicht und `TRUE` zurückgibt, wenn alle Komponenten gleich sind, andernfalls `FALSE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_struct1 TYPE any STRUCTURE
        is_struct2 TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr1) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_struct1 ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr2) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_struct2 ).

    " Structures must have the same type for a meaningful comparison here
    IF lo_struct_descr1->get_relative_name( ) <> lo_struct_descr2->get_relative_name( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Structures have different types: { lo_struct_descr1->get_relative_name( ) } vs { lo_struct_descr2->get_relative_name( ) }|.
    ENDIF.

    rb_are_equal = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value1> TYPE any.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value2> TYPE any.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_struct1 TO <fs_value1>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_struct2 TO <fs_value2>.

      IF <fs_value1> <> <fs_value2>.
        rb_are_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight1-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight1-connid = '400'.
    ls_sflight1-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight2 = ls_sflight1.
    ls_sflight2-connid = '500'. "Different value

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_compare( ).
    DATA(lb_result) = lo_cut->compare_structures( is_struct1 = ls_sflight1 is_struct2 = ls_sflight2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lb_result msg = 'Structures should be unequal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_types.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight,
          ls_spfli TYPE spfli.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_compare( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->compare_structures( is_struct1 = ls_sflight is_struct2 = ls_spfli ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_descr_error expected for different structure types' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_descr_error caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von RTTI, um zwei beliebige Strukturen generisch zu vergleichen. Es nutzt `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` zur Typbeschreibung und iteriert dann über die Komponenten, um deren Werte dynamisch zu vergleichen. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist hierbei entscheidend. Die Prüfung auf gleiche Strukturtypen ist wichtig für eine sinnvolle Vergleichbarkeit.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, describe_by_data, generischer Vergleich, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT
