Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische WHERE-Klausel für eine interne Tabelle basierend auf RTTI und einem Feldnamen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und dynamische Token für die WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_tt_data
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_value        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE ty_tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name INTO DATA(ls_component).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_where_clause) = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_value }'|.
      TRY.
          rt_filtered_table = FILTER #( it_source_table WHERE (lv_where_clause) ).
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
          " Handle error if dynamic WHERE clause is invalid
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_where=>ty_tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Banana' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Apple' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_where( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamic(
      it_source_table = lt_data
      iv_field_name   = 'TEXT'
      iv_value        = 'Apple'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_id) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamic(
      it_source_table = lt_data
      iv_field_name   = 'ID'
      iv_value        = '2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_id ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_id[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Banana' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine dynamische WHERE-Klausel für interne Tabellen mit RTTI und der `FILTER` Operator-Syntax erstellt. Dies ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature für generische Suchfunktionen oder Berichte, bei denen die Filterkriterien zur Laufzeit definiert werden.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, FILTER, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, WHERE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FRIENDS` in Verbindung mit einer Factory-Methode, um private Instanzen zu erstellen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, wobei die Spalten dynamisch ausgewählt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` und `SELECT DYNAMICALLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_fields TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lv_field_list TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_fields INTO DATA(lv_field).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component( name = lv_field type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( |SFLIGHT-{lv_field}| ) ) TO lt_components.
      IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
        lv_field_list = lv_field.
      ELSE.
        lv_field_list = lv_field_list && `, ` && lv_field.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_dynamic_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_dynamic_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_dynamic_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA(lv_select_statement) = |SELECT { lv_field_list } FROM sflight INTO TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table>|.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parse einen CSV-String mit Komma als Trennzeichen in eine interne Tabelle. Die erste Zeile ist der Header. Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenverarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string` und `parse` für die CSV-Verarbeitung. Für die Transformation der geparsten Daten in eine strukturierte Tabelle kann der `FOR` Operator verwendet werden.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string( iv_csv_data ).
    lo_csv->set_field_delimiter( ',' ).
    lo_csv->set_first_row_is_header( abap_true ).

    DATA(lt_parsed_data) = lo_csv->parse( ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data
                           LET carrid = row-data[ 1 ],
                               connid = row-data[ 2 ],
                               fldate = row-data[ 3 ] IN
                           ( carrid = carrid
                             connid = conv s_conn_id( connid )
                             fldate = conv s_date( fldate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` an. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenvorbereitung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             key      TYPE string,
             text     TYPE string,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             level    TYPE i,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                             LET carrid_key = |CARR_{ lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1 }|
                             IN
                             ( key = carrid_key,
                               text = |Fluggesellschaft: { flight-carrid }|,
                               carrid = flight-carrid,
                               level = 0,
                               is_folder = abap_true )
                             ( FOR single_flight IN GROUP flight
                               LET flight_key = |FLIGHT_{ lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1 }|
                               IN
                               ( key = flight_key,
                                 text = |Flug { single_flight-connid } am { single_flight-fldate }|,
                                 carrid = single_flight-carrid,
                                 connid = single_flight-connid,
                                 fldate = single_flight-fldate,
                                 level = 1,
                                 is_folder = abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung eines Node-Selektionsereignisses eines `cl_gui_column_tree`. Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf dem ausgewählten Knoten (z.B. Fluggesellschaft oder Flugnummer) unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein simuliertes Node-Key empfängt und dann den `FILTER` Operator auf die `sflights` Tabelle anwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS handle_node_selection
      IMPORTING
        iv_selected_node_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    mt_all_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                 connid = flight-connid,
                                 fldate = flight-fldate,
                                 cityfrom = flight-cityfrom,
                                 cityto = flight-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_selection.
    IF iv_selected_node_key IS INITIAL.
      rt_filtered_flights = mt_all_flights.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_selected_node_key CS 'CARR_'. " Carrier node
      DATA(lv_carrid) = substring( val = iv_selected_node_key off = 5 ).
      rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( mt_all_flights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid ).
    ELSEIF iv_selected_node_key CS 'FLIGHT_'. " Flight node
      DATA(lv_connid) = substring( val = iv_selected_node_key off = 7 ).
      rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( mt_all_flights WHERE connid = conv s_conn_id( lv_connid ) ).
    ELSE.
      rt_filtered_flights = mt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen potenziell fehlerhaften CSV-String mit `cl_icf_csv` und implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: Die `parse` Methode von `cl_icf_csv` kann `cx_sy_conversion_error` auslösen, wenn Daten nicht in den erwarteten Typ konvertiert werden können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_safe.
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string( iv_csv_data ).
    lo_csv->set_field_delimiter( ',' ).
    lo_csv->set_first_row_is_header( abap_true ).

    DATA(lt_parsed_raw) = lo_csv->parse( ).

    TRY.
        rt_data = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_raw
                           LET id_str = row-data[ 1 ],
                               name_str = row-data[ 2 ] IN
                           ( id = conv i( id_str ),
                             name = name_str ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen des Fehlers oder erneutes Auslösen mit mehr Kontext
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler bei Datenkonvertierung: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_parse_invalid_csv FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_valid_csv.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = 'ID,Name\n1,Test1\n2,Test2'.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_csv_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_handler->parse_safe( lv_csv_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_invalid_csv.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = 'ID,Name\nABC,Test1'. " 'ABC' cannot be converted to I
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_csv_error_handler( ).

    TRY.
        lo_handler->parse_safe( lv_csv_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_conversion_error expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_conversion_error caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt, wie man mit `TRY...CATCH` Konvertierungsfehler abfängt, die beim Parsen von CSV-Daten mit `cl_icf_csv` auftreten können. Die explizite Konvertierung mit `conv` innerhalb des `VALUE #(...)` Ausdrucks kann solche Fehler auslösen. Die moderne Fehlerbehandlung stellt sicher, dass die Anwendung robust auf unerwartete Datenformate reagiert.
keywords: CSV, cl_icf_csv, TRY...CATCH, Exceptions, Error Handling

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie einen sehr großen CSV-String in kleineren Paketen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren. Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv` und den `LOOP AT ... INTO ... PACKAGE SIZE` Befehl.
hint: Simulieren Sie einen großen CSV-String und verarbeiten Sie ihn in Schleifen mit `PACKAGE SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_large_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             line_num TYPE i,
             content  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_record.
    TYPES tt_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_large_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_large_csv_data TYPE string
        iv_package_size   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_records.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_large_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_large_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string( iv_large_csv_data ).
    lo_csv->set_field_delimiter( ',' ).
    lo_csv->set_first_row_is_header( abap_false ). " No header for simplicity in this example

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_csv->parse( ).
    DATA(lv_line_counter) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_raw_row) PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      " Simulate processing of a package
      LOOP AT ls_raw_row-data INTO DATA(lv_field).
        lv_line_counter = lv_line_counter + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_record( line_num = lv_line_counter content = lv_field ) TO rt_processed_data.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie `sflights` Daten hierarchisch in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` an: zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft, dann nach Flugnummer. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax (`FOR` mit `GROUP BY`) für die Strukturierung der hierarchischen Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FOR` Schleifen mit `GROUP BY` um die Baumstruktur zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             key       TYPE string,
             parent_key TYPE string,
             text      TYPE string,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             level     TYPE i,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hierarchical_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hierarchical_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF carrier_group IN lt_sflights BY carrid = carrier_group-carrid
                             LET carrier_key = |CARR_{ lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 }|
                             IN
                             ( key = carrier_key,
                               parent_key = '',
                               text = |Fluggesellschaft: { carrier_group-carrid }|,
                               carrid = carrier_group-carrid,
                               level = 0,
                               is_folder = abap_true )
                             ( FOR GROUPS OF flight_group IN carrier_group BY connid = flight_group-connid
                               LET flight_key = |FLIGHT_{ lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 }|
                               IN
                               ( key = flight_key,
                                 parent_key = carrier_key,
                                 text = |Flug { flight_group-connid }|,
                                 carrid = flight_group-carrid,
                                 connid = flight_group-connid,
                                 level = 1,
                                 is_folder = abap_true )
                               ( FOR single_flight IN GROUP flight_group
                                 LET date_key = |DATE_{ lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 }|
                                 IN
                                 ( key = date_key,
                                   parent_key = flight_key,
                                   text = |Datum: { single_flight-fldate }|,
                                   carrid = single_flight-carrid,
                                   connid = single_flight-connid,
                                   fldate = single_flight-fldate,
                                   level = 2,
                                   is_folder = abap_false ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_hierarchical_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hierarchical_flights.
    DATA(lo_data_provider) = NEW zcl_flight_hierarchy( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_data_provider->get_hierarchical_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_tree_data ).

    " Check root nodes (carriers)
    DATA(lt_root_nodes) = FILTER #( lt_tree_data WHERE level = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_root_nodes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_root_nodes[ 1 ]-is_folder ).

    " Check second level nodes (connections)
    DATA(lt_second_level) = FILTER #( lt_tree_data WHERE level = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_second_level ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_second_level[ 1 ]-is_folder ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_second_level[ 1 ]-parent_key ).

    " Check third level nodes (dates)
    DATA(lt_third_level) = FILTER #( lt_tree_data WHERE level = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_third_level ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lt_third_level[ 1 ]-is_folder ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_third_level[ 1 ]-parent_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine CSV-Datei (simuliert als String) und extrahieren Sie nur bestimmte Spalten, wobei die Spaltennamen dynamisch angegeben werden. Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und den `MAP` Operator.

CLASS zcl_csv_column_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_extracted_data,
             column_name TYPE string,
             value       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_extracted_data.
    TYPES tt_extracted_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_columns
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_data    TYPE string
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extracted_data) TYPE tt_extracted_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_column_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_columns.
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string( iv_csv_data ).
    lo_csv->set_field_delimiter( ',' ).
    lo_csv->set_first_row_is_header( abap_true ).

    DATA(lt_parsed_data) = lo_csv->parse( ).
    DATA(lt_header) = lo_csv->get_header( ).

    rt_extracted_data = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data
                                 FOR column_name IN it_column_names
                                 LET index = line_index( lt_header[ table_line = column_name ] ) IN
                                 ( column_name = column_name,
                                   value = row-data[ index ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Objekten in eine für `cl_gui_column_tree` geeignete Struktur umwandelt. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Felder der Objekte dynamisch zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für RTTI und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_tree_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             key        TYPE string,
             parent_key TYPE string,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_tree_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_tree.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ) ).
    DATA(lr_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      DATA(lv_item_key) = |ITEM_{ lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node_data( key = lv_item_key
                                 parent_key = ''
                                 text = |Record { lv_node_counter }|
                                 level = 0
                                 is_folder = abap_true ) TO rt_tree_data.

      LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        DATA(lv_field_key) = |FIELD_{ lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 }|.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND VALUE ty_node_data( key = lv_field_key
                                     parent_key = lv_item_key
                                     text = |{ ls_component-name }: { <fs_field_value> }|
                                     level = 1
                                     is_folder = abap_false
                                     field_name = ls_component-name
                                     field_value = CONV string( <fs_field_value> ) ) TO rt_tree_data.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_rtti_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_conversion.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Entry One' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Entry Two' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_rtti_tree_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_converter->convert_table_to_tree( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_tree_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_tree_data ) exp = 6 ). " 2 records + 2 fields each * 2

    DATA(ls_first_record_node) = lt_tree_data[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_record_node-level exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_record_node-is_folder ).

    DATA(ls_first_field_node) = lt_tree_data[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_field_node-level exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_first_field_node-is_folder ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_field_node-field_name exp = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_field_node-field_value exp = '1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `cl_abap_typedescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`, um die Struktur einer beliebigen internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. Anschließend werden die Daten dynamisch in eine hierarchische Struktur umgewandelt, die für `cl_gui_column_tree` geeignet ist. Instructions: Filtern Sie die angezeigten Knoten eines `cl_gui_column_tree` basierend auf einem Suchkriterium. Simulieren Sie diesen Filterprozess auf der zugrunde liegenden Datenstruktur unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Suchbegriff empfängt und dann die hierarchische Datenstruktur mit `FILTER` reduziert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             key        TYPE string,
             parent_key TYPE string,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS filter_tree_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_search_term TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_nodes) TYPE tt_node_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_all_nodes TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_all_nodes = VALUE #( ( key = 'ROOT1' text = 'Category A' level = 0 is_folder = abap_true )
                            ( key = 'ITEM1' parent_key = 'ROOT1' text = 'Item A1' level = 1 is_folder = abap_false )
                            ( key = 'ITEM2' parent_key = 'ROOT1' text = 'Item B2' level = 1 is_folder = abap_false )
                            ( key = 'ROOT2' text = 'Category B' level = 0 is_folder = abap_true )
                            ( key = 'ITEM3' parent_key = 'ROOT2' text = 'Item A3' level = 1 is_folder = abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_tree_nodes.
    IF iv_search_term IS INITIAL.
      rt_filtered_nodes = mt_all_nodes.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_search_pattern) = |*{ iv_search_term }*|.

    rt_filtered_nodes = FILTER #( mt_all_nodes WHERE text CP lv_search_pattern ).

    " Ensure parent nodes of filtered items are also included
    DATA(lt_parent_keys) = VALUE string_table( FOR node IN rt_filtered_nodes WHERE node-parent_key IS NOT INITIAL ( node-parent_key ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_parent_keys INTO DATA(lv_parent_key).
      INSERT mt_all_nodes[ key = lv_parent_key ] INTO TABLE rt_filtered_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
    SORT rt_filtered_nodes BY key.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_filtered_nodes COMPARING key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen, und sammeln Sie die Flugnummern in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Syntax.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                   cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom
                                   cityto = ls_flight-cityto ) TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: 
      BEGIN OF gc_table,
        sflight TYPE tabname VALUE 'SFLIGHT',
        scarr   TYPE tabname VALUE 'SCARR',
      END OF gc_table,
      BEGIN OF gc_field,
        carrid  TYPE fieldname VALUE 'CARRID',

CLASS zcl_db_constants IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_table_name) = gc_table-sflight.
    DATA(lv_carrid_field) = gc_field-carrid.

    " Dynamische SELECT-Anweisung
    SELECT (lv_carrid_field), connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM (lv_table_name)
      WHERE (lv_carrid_field) = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflight_data.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie die moderne `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( key_field )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    count  = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDIF.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klasse mit Konstanten für die maximale Länge von Textfeldern (z.B. für Beschreibungen, Namen) und verwenden Sie diese Konstanten, um die Länge von Strings zu überprüfen.

CLASS zcl_text_lengths DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: 
      gc_max_name_len TYPE i VALUE 50,
      gc_max_desc_len TYPE i VALUE 255.

    METHODS is_name_valid
      IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS is_description_valid
      IMPORTING iv_description TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_lengths IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_name_valid.
    IF STRLEN( iv_name ) <= gc_max_name_len.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_description_valid.
    IF STRLEN( iv_description ) <= gc_max_desc_len.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `LOOP AT` um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus `sflights` enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Filtern Sie dabei direkt in der `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN itab WHERE ...` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_loop_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_future_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_future_flight.
    TYPES tt_future_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_future_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_future_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_loop_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_loop_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob alle zurückgegebenen Flüge ein zukünftiges Datum haben
    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_future_flight).
      " Hier können wir nur prüfen, ob die Tabelle nicht leer ist, da wir das fldate nicht zurückgeben.
      " Ein robusterer Test würde Testdaten mit bekannten zukünftigen Daten verwenden.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_future_flight-carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Wenn sflight keine zukünftigen Flüge enthält, sollte die Tabelle leer sein.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_future_flights ). " Dies wäre der Fall, wenn keine zukünftigen Flüge existieren.
  ENDMETHOD.

Sie ermöglicht es, interne Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile zu filtern und zu transformieren, was den Code extrem kompakt und lesbar macht. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der `FOR`-Expression bietet eine leistungsstarke Filterung direkt im Ausdruck.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `sflights` und verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für eine effiziente Bearbeitung der Zeilen. Aktualisieren Sie dabei ein Feld (z.B. `planetype`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs> WHERE condition`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_planetype_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-planetype = iv_planetype.
    ENDLOOP.

    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier ein UPDATE auf die DB erfolgen
    " MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE rt_sflight_data WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_loop_assigning FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_assigning.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assigning( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'AA'. " Beispiel-Fluggesellschaft
    DATA(lv_new_planetype) = 'A380'.

    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält Daten für 'AA'
    " Zuerst den aktuellen Zustand speichern (optional, für echten Rollback)
    DATA(lt_original_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( lv_test_carrid ).

    lo_cut->update_planetype_for_carrier( iv_carrid = lv_test_carrid iv_planetype = lv_new_planetype ).

    " Nach der Aktualisierung die Daten erneut abrufen und prüfen
    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( lv_test_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_updated_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_updated_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-planetype exp = lv_new_planetype ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Optional: Wiederherstellung des ursprünglichen Zustands, wenn auf echter DB getestet wird
    " MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_original_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Syntax ist die performanteste Art, interne Tabellen zu bearbeiten, da keine Arbeitsbereiche kopiert werden. Stattdessen wird ein Feldsymbol direkt auf die Tabellenzeile referenziert, was direkte Änderungen an der Zeile ermöglicht. Dies ist besonders vorteilhaft bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, Performance, sflights

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klasse mit Konstanten für die Namen von Methodenparametern, um diese in dynamischen Methodenaufrufen oder RTTI-Szenarien zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONSTANTS` für Parameternamen und `CALL METHOD` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE` oder RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_param_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: 
      gc_param_iv_value TYPE fieldname VALUE 'IV_VALUE',
      gc_param_rv_result TYPE fieldname VALUE 'RV_RESULT'.

    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS call_dynamic_process
      IMPORTING iv_dynamic_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_dynamic_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_param_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    rv_result = iv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_process.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = gc_param_iv_value.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_dynamic_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CLEAR ls_parameter.
    DATA(lv_result) = 0.
    ls_parameter-name = gc_param_rv_result.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_returning.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD me->process_value
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

    rv_dynamic_result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_param_constants( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 10.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 20.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_process( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Konstanten für Parameternamen in dynamischen Methodenaufrufen oder RTTI-Szenarien erhöht die Robustheit des Codes. Änderungen an Parameternamen in der Methodensignatur müssen dann nur an einer zentralen Stelle (der Konstanten-Definition) angepasst werden. Die `PARAMETER-TABLE` Syntax ist der moderne Weg, dynamische Methodenaufrufe zu realisieren.
keywords: CONSTANTS, RTTI, Dynamischer Aufruf, Methodenparameter, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` um Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle mit einer abweichenden Struktur zu kopieren, wobei nur übereinstimmende Feldnamen übertragen werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF wa`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             " Zusätzliches Feld, das nicht in sflight ist
             summary_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF DATA(ls_summary).
      ls_summary-summary_text = |Flight { ls_summary-carrid } { ls_summary-connid } from { ls_summary-cityfrom } to { ls_summary-cityto } on { ls_summary-fldate }|.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_flight_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_loop_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summaries ).

    LOOP AT lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-summary_text ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( CONTAINS( val = ls_summary-summary_text sub = ls_summary-carrid ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` Syntax ist ideal, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen zu übertragen, wenn viele Feldnamen übereinstimmen. Sie erspart das manuelle Zuweisen jedes einzelnen Feldes und ist somit wartungsfreundlicher und weniger fehleranfällig. String Templates (`|...|`) werden für die kompakte Erstellung von Texten verwendet.
keywords: LOOP AT, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Internal Tables, Datenübertragung, sflights, String Templates

      gc_max_quantity TYPE i VALUE 100.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression mit `LOOP AT` um den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` zu berechnen. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Flüge, deren Preis größer als Null ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN itab WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price > 0 )
                                NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_reduce_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'LH'. " Beispiel-Fluggesellschaft

    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält Daten für 'LH' mit Preisen > 0
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_for_carrier( lv_test_carrid ).

    " Überprüfen, ob der Gesamtpreis positiv ist (Annahme: LH hat Flüge mit Preisen > 0)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price >= 0 ).

    " Für einen präziseren Test müsste man Testdaten in sflight einfügen
    " und den erwarteten Wert manuell berechnen.
    " Beispiel: Wenn LH 2 Flüge mit Preisen 100 und 200 hat, wäre der erwartete Wert 300.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Aggregationslogik angewendet wird. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN itab WHERE ...` können Filterbedingungen direkt in den Ausdruck integriert werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... AT NEW` und `AT END OF` um Kontrollgruppen in der Tabelle `sflights` zu verarbeiten. Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität (`seatsmax`) pro Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`).
hint: Sortieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst nach dem Gruppierungsfeld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_control_break DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_carrier_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_capacities) TYPE tt_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_control_break IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid.

    DATA lv_current_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      AT NEW carrid.
        lv_current_capacity = 0.
      ENDAT.

      lv_current_capacity = lv_current_capacity + ls_flight-seatsmax.

      AT END OF carrid.
        APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_capacity( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                          total_capacity = lv_current_capacity ) TO rt_carrier_capacities.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle mit Materialdaten (Materialtyp und Wert). Berechnen Sie die Summe der Werte für alle Materialien, die als 'Rohmaterial' oder 'Handelsware' (gemäß `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS`) klassifiziert sind, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS` zur Filterung und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mmpur_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_data,
             material_type TYPE makt-mtart,
             value         TYPE i,
           END OF ty_material_data.
    TYPES: tt_material_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_purchasing_value
      IMPORTING
        it_material_data TYPE tt_material_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_purchasing_value.
    rv_total_value = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_material> IN it_material_data
      WHERE ( material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_raw_material OR
              material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_trading_goods )
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_material>-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 Zeitstempeln, die jeweils 10 Minuten auseinanderliegen, beginnend mit einem gegebenen Startzeitstempel. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `cl_abap_tstmp=>add` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_timestamps TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF timestampl WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_timestamp_series
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_count       TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_interval_min TYPE i DEFAULT 10 " Interval in minutes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_timestamps) TYPE tt_timestamps.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_timestamp_series.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = iv_start_tstmp.
    rt_timestamps = VALUE tt_timestamps(
      FOR i = 0 UNTIL i >= iv_count
      ( LET lo_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( lv_current_tstmp ) IN
        lo_tstmp->add( i * iv_interval_min * 60 )->get_timestampl( ) ) ). " Add minutes converted to seconds
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert einer Konstante aus `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS` dynamisch basierend auf einem übergebenen Konstantenamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und `GET_CONSTANTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mmpur_dyn_const DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_constant_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_constant_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_constant_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_dyn_const IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_constant_value_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_constants   TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_constants,
          ls_constant    TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>s_constant.

    lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS' ).
    lt_constants = lo_class_descr->get_constants( ).

    READ TABLE lt_constants INTO ls_constant WITH KEY name = iv_constant_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Dynamischer Zugriff auf den Wert der Konstante
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_value> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN ls_constant-value_ref->* TO <lv_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_constant_value = <lv_value>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Zeitstempel und geben Sie an, welcher der frühere ist.
hint: Zeitstempel können direkt mit Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`, `=`) verglichen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_comparison_result,
             is_tstmp1_earlier TYPE abap_bool,
             is_tstmp2_earlier TYPE abap_bool,
             are_equal         TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_comparison_result.

    METHODS compare_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_comparison_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_timestamps.
    IF iv_tstmp1 < iv_tstmp2.
      rs_result-is_tstmp1_earlier = abap_true.
    ELSEIF iv_tstmp2 < iv_tstmp1.
      rs_result-is_tstmp2_earlier = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rs_result-are_equal = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Materialdaten nach Materialtyp (aus `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Materialien pro Typ. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `FOR`-Schleife, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mmpur_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_entry,
             material_number TYPE matnr,
             material_type   TYPE makt-mtart,
           END OF ty_material_entry.
    TYPES: tt_material_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_type_count,
             material_type TYPE makt-mtart,
             count         TYPE i,
           END OF ty_material_type_count.
    TYPES: tt_material_type_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_type_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_materials_by_type
      IMPORTING
        it_materials TYPE tt_material_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_type_counts) TYPE tt_material_type_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_materials_by_type.
    rt_type_counts = VALUE tt_material_type_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN it_materials BY <fs_group>-material_type
      GROUP SIZE DATA(lv_count)
      ( material_type = <fs_group>-material_type
        count         = lv_count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_materials FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_materials.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_mmpur_group( ).
    DATA(lt_materials) = VALUE zcl_mmpur_group=>tt_material_entry(
      ( material_number = 'MAT1' material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_raw_material )
      ( material_number = 'MAT2' material_type = 'FERT' )
      ( material_number = 'MAT3' material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_raw_material )
      ( material_number = 'MAT4' material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_trading_goods )
      ( material_number = 'MAT5' material_type = 'FERT' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_grouper->group_materials_by_type( lt_materials ).

    DATA(lt_expected_counts) = VALUE zcl_mmpur_group=>tt_material_type_count(
      ( material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_raw_material count = 2 )
      ( material_type = 'FERT' count = 2 )
      ( material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_trading_goods count = 1 )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_counts )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should return 3 distinct material types' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_counts[ material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_raw_material ]-count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Raw material count should be 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_counts[ material_type = 'FERT' ]-count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'FERT count should be 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_mmpur_group( ).
    DATA(lt_materials) = VALUE zcl_mmpur_group=>tt_material_entry( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_grouper->group_materials_by_type( lt_materials ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_actual_counts
      msg = 'Should return an empty table for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen durch eine moderne, funktionale Syntax. Die Verwendung von `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS` als Gruppierungskriterium ist hier exemplarisch.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Materialtypen validiert und prüft, ob alle übergebenen Typen in `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS` als gültige Einkaufsmaterialtypen definiert sind. Nutzen Sie den `ALL` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `ALL` Operator in einer `COND` Expression, um alle Elemente einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mmpur_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_material_types TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF makt-mtart WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_material_types
      IMPORTING
        it_material_types TYPE tt_material_types
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_material_types.
    rv_all_valid = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN it_material_types IS INITIAL THEN abap_true " Empty list is considered valid
      WHEN ALL (
        FOR material_type IN it_material_types
        ( material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_raw_material OR
          material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_trading_goods OR
          material_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>material_type_operating_supplies ) )
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_types) = VALUE zcl_mmpur_validate=>tt_material_types(

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol dynamisch den Wert einer Komponente einer Struktur zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung anschließend auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS process_dynamic_field IMPORTING is_data TYPE ty_data
                                  CHANGING cv_result TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs> TYPE any.
    DATA(lv_component_name) = 'FIELD1'. " Dynamischer Komponentenname

    ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs>.

    IF <fs> IS ASSIGNED.
      cv_result = <fs>.
      UNASSIGN <fs>. " Zuweisung aufheben
    ELSE.
      cv_result = 'Component not found or not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    " Nach UNASSIGN ist <fs> nicht mehr zugewiesen
    IF <fs> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      cv_result = cv_result && ' (FS unassigned)'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_dynamic_unassign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_unassign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_fs_dynamic_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = ''.

    lo_cut->process_dynamic_field( EXPORTING is_data = ls_data CHANGING cv_result = lv_result ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello (FS unassigned)' ).

    " Testfall für nicht gefundene Komponente
    DATA(lv_result_not_found) = ''.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_test> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' OF STRUCTURE ls_data TO <fs_test>.
    IF <fs_test> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_test> ). " Should be unassigned
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, dynamisch auf eine nicht existierende Komponente einer Struktur zuzugreifen. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler mit `CL_BAL_LOG`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY-CATCH` für `CX_SY_ASSIGN_ILLEGAL_COMPONENT` und `CL_BAL_LOG` für die Fehlerprotokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_fs_bal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS access_and_log_error IMPORTING is_data TYPE ty_data
                                   CHANGING cv_status TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_fs_bal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_and_log_error.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    DATA(lv_component_name) = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
          cv_status = |Successfully accessed { lv_component_name }: { <fs_component> }|.
          UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Zuweisung aufheben nach erfolgreichem Zugriff
        ELSE.
          " Should not happen if ASSIGN COMPONENT raises exception for non-existent
          cv_status = |Component { lv_component_name } not assigned (unexpected)|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_illegal_component INTO DATA(lx_illegal_component).
        cv_status = |Error: { lx_illegal_component->get_text( ) }|.
        lo_log->add_message(
          EXPORTING
            i_msgty = 'E' " Error
            i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
            i_msgno = '003'
            i_msgv1 = |Fehler beim Zugriff auf Komponente '{ lv_component_name }'|
            i_msgv2 = lx_illegal_component->get_text( )
        ).
        lo_log->display_log( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_access_and_log_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_access_and_log_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_fs_bal( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_error_fs_bal=>ty_data( id = 1 name = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lv_status) = ''.

    lo_cut->access_and_log_error( EXPORTING is_data = ls_data CHANGING cv_status = lv_status ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'Fehler beim Zugriff auf Komponente'
      msg = 'Expected error message for illegal component access'
    ).
    " Further checks could involve mocking CL_BAL_LOG to verify message content
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY-CATCH` für die Ausnahmebehandlung ist Standard in modernem ABAP. Hier wird `CX_SY_ASSIGN_ILLEGAL_COMPONENT` abgefangen, die auftritt, wenn versucht wird, dynamisch auf eine nicht existierende Strukturkomponente zuzugreifen. `CL_BAL_LOG` wird verwendet, um den aufgetretenen Fehler strukturiert zu protokollieren, was die Fehleranalyse erleichtert. `UNASSIGN` wird hier auch gezeigt, um die Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols nach erfolgreichem Zugriff explizit aufzuheben.

Instructions: Suchen Sie einen Flug in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mittels Tabellenausdruck. Wenn gefunden, weisen Sie ihn einem Feldsymbol zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung anschließend auf. Wenn nicht gefunden, protokollieren Sie dies.

CLASS zcl_tabexp_fs_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tabexp_fs_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_and_unassign.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_flight> TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      ASSIGN lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] TO <fs_flight>.
      cv_status = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } gefunden. Preis: { <fs_flight>-price }|.
      UNASSIGN <fs_flight>. " Zuweisung aufheben
      cv_status = cv_status && ' (FS unassigned)'.
    ELSE.
      cv_status = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
      lo_log->add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_msgty = 'W' " Warning
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '007'
          i_msgv1 = cv_status
      ).
      lo_log->display_log( ).
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_unassign_itab.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    CREATE DATA cr_data_ref TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    ASSIGN cr_data_ref->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    IF <lt_sflights> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Füllen der dynamischen Tabelle mit Beispieldaten
      SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE <lt_sflights>.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und protokollieren Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis mit `CL_BAL_LOG`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights_bal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_and_log_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights_bal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_log_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_grouped_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ( count = count + 1 ) )
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ( sum = sum + <fs_member>-price ) )
      )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_group).
      lo_log->add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_msgty = 'I'
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '008'
          i_msgv1 = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_group-carrid }, Flüge: { ls_group-flight_count }, Gesamtpreis: { ls_group-price }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_log->display_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_bal_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_status TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 success TYPE ty_status VALUE 'S',
                 warning TYPE ty_status VALUE 'W',
                 error   TYPE ty_status VALUE 'E',
               END OF gc_status.
    METHODS log_status_message IMPORTING iv_status TYPE ty_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_bal_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_status_message.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).

    DATA(lv_message) = SWITCH string(
      iv_status
      WHEN gc_status-success THEN 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.'
      WHEN gc_status-warning THEN 'Operation mit Warnungen abgeschlossen.'
      WHEN gc_status-error   THEN 'Operation mit Fehlern abgebrochen.'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Status.'
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = iv_status
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '009'
        i_msgv1 = lv_message
    )->display_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem übergebenen Feld sortiert. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `SORT` mit `BY <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_dynamic_field IMPORTING it_data     TYPE tt_flight_data
                                         iv_field_name TYPE string
                               CHANGING ct_sorted_data TYPE tt_flight_data
                                        cv_status     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ty_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).

    ct_sorted_data = it_data.

    LOOP AT ct_sorted_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        cv_status = |Fehler: Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden. Sortierung nicht möglich.|.
        lo_log->add_message(
          EXPORTING
            i_msgty = 'E'
            i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
            i_msgno = '011'
            i_msgv1 = cv_status
        )->display_log( ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Zuweisung für nächste Iteration aufheben
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sortierung der Tabelle nach dem dynamisch zugewiesenen Feld
    SORT ct_sorted_data BY (iv_field_name).
    cv_status = |Tabelle erfolgreich nach Feld '{ iv_field_name }' sortiert.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Protokollieren Sie eine Reihe von Nachrichten mit `CL_BAL_LOG` und verwenden Sie dabei `MESSAGE` in Kombination mit String-Templates, um die Nachrichten zu formatieren.

CLASS zcl_message_into_bal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_messages_with_template IMPORTING iv_param1 TYPE string
                                             iv_param2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_into_bal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_messages_with_template.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    DATA lv_message_text TYPE string.

    " Beispiel: Nachricht aus einer Message-Klasse (z.B. ZMSG) mit Platzhaltern
    " MESSAGE i012(ZMSG) WITH iv_param1 iv_param2 INTO lv_message_text.
    " Da keine ZMSG-Klasse existiert, simulieren wir dies mit String-Templates

    lv_message_text = |Parameter 1: { iv_param1 }, Parameter 2: { iv_param2 } verarbeitet.|.
    lo_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'I'
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '012'
        i_msgv1 = lv_message_text
    ).

    lv_message_text = |Zweite Nachricht für { iv_param1 } mit Wert { iv_param2 * 2 }.|.
    lo_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '013'
        i_msgv1 = lv_message_text
    ).

    lo_log->display_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_with_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        it_data            TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filename        TYPE string DEFAULT 'data.csv'
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_csv.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_bcs_object( ).
    lo_bcs->set_subject( iv_subject ).

    DATA(lv_csv_header) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE`.
    DATA(lv_csv_body) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR <fs_line> IN it_data
      NEXT s = |
{ s }
{ <fs_line>-carrid };{ <fs_line>-connid };{ <fs_line>-fldate };{ <fs_line>-price }|
    ).

    cl_bcs_utilities=>add_attachment(
      io_bcs_object = lo_bcs
      iv_filename   = iv_filename
      iv_content    = lv_csv_body
      iv_file_type  = 'CSV'
    ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Hängen Sie ein einfaches Textdokument als GOS-Anhang an ein SAP-Geschäftsobjekt (z.B. einen Materialstamm `BUS1001`) an. Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation`.

CLASS zcl_gos_attach_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS attach_text_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
        iv_document_title TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_document_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_bo_not_found
        cx_binary_relation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attach_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD attach_text_document.
    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE borident,
          ls_object_b TYPE borident.

    ls_object_a-objtype = iv_object_type.
    ls_object_a-objkey  = iv_object_key.

    " Create document content
    DATA(lt_content) = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_document_content ).

    " Create document object
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = lt_content
      i_length  = xstrlen( iv_document_content )
      i_subject = iv_document_title
    ).

    " Get document ID
    DATA(lv_document_id) = lo_document->get_document_id( ).

    ls_object_b-objtype = 'MESSAGE'. " Generic type for documents
    ls_object_b-objkey  = lv_document_id.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          is_object_a = ls_object_a
          is_object_b = ls_object_b
          ip_reltype  = 'ATTA'
        ).
        COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
        rv_success = abap_true.
    CATCH cx_binary_relation INTO DATA(lx_binary_relation).
        MESSAGE lx_binary_relation->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle angehängten Dokumente für ein bestimmtes SAP-Geschäftsobjekt ab und geben Sie deren Titel aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>read_links` und iterieren Sie über die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_read_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             document_id TYPE so_obj_id,
             title       TYPE so_obj_des,
             created_by  TYPE syuname,
             created_at  TYPE timestamp,
           END OF ty_attachment_info,
           tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info
      RAISING
        cx_bo_not_found
        cx_binary_relation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_read_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments.
    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE borident,
          lt_links    TYPE obl_t_link,
          ls_link     TYPE obl_s_link.

    ls_object_a-objtype = iv_object_type.
    ls_object_a-objkey  = iv_object_key.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
          EXPORTING
            is_object           = ls_object_a
            ip_role             = 'OBJAP'
            ip_reltype          = 'ATTA'
          IMPORTING
            et_links            = lt_links
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_links INTO ls_link.
          DATA(lv_document_id) = ls_link-objkey_b.
          DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>get_document_by_key( lv_document_id ).

          APPEND VALUE #( document_id = lv_document_id
                          title       = lo_document->get_subject( )
                          created_by  = lo_document->get_creator( )
                          created_at  = lo_document->get_creation_time( ) ) TO rt_attachments.
        ENDLOOP.

    CATCH cx_binary_relation INTO DATA(lx_binary_relation).
        MESSAGE lx_binary_relation->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_binary_relation EXPORTING previous = lx_binary_relation.
    CATCH cx_bo_not_found INTO DATA(lx_bo_not_found).
        MESSAGE lx_bo_not_found->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bo_not_found EXPORTING previous = lx_bo_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
