Instructions: Rufen Sie alle GOS-Anhänge eines Geschäftsobjekts ab und filtern Sie diese nach einem bestimmten Erstellungsdatum oder -zeitraum mit modernen ABAP-Features.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>read_links` und anschließend `FILTER` für die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             document_id TYPE so_obj_id,
             title       TYPE so_obj_des,
             created_by  TYPE syuname,
             created_at  TYPE timestamp,
           END OF ty_attachment_info,
           tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
        iv_date_from   TYPE sy-datum OPTIONAL
        iv_date_to     TYPE sy-datum OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info
      RAISING
        cx_bo_not_found
        cx_binary_relation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_attachments.
    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE borident,
          lt_links    TYPE obl_t_link.

    ls_object_a-objtype = iv_object_type.
    ls_object_a-objkey  = iv_object_key.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
          EXPORTING
            is_object           = ls_object_a
            ip_role             = 'OBJAP'
            ip_reltype          = 'ATTA'
          IMPORTING
            et_links            = lt_links
        ).

        DATA(lt_all_attachments) = VALUE tt_attachment_info(
          FOR ls_link IN lt_links
            LET lv_document_id = ls_link-objkey_b
                lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>get_document_by_key( lv_document_id )
            IN
              ( document_id = lv_document_id
                title       = lo_document->get_subject( )
                created_by  = lo_document->get_creator( )
                created_at  = lo_document->get_creation_time( ) )
        ).

        rt_attachments = FILTER tt_attachment_info(
          lt_all_attachments
          WHERE ( iv_date_from IS INITIAL OR created_at >= |{ iv_date_from }000000|
                  AND iv_date_to IS INITIAL OR created_at <= |{ iv_date_to }235959| )
        ).

    CATCH cx_binary_relation INTO DATA(lx_binary_relation).
        MESSAGE lx_binary_relation->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_binary_relation EXPORTING previous = lx_binary_relation.
    CATCH cx_bo_not_found INTO DATA(lx_bo_not_found).
        MESSAGE lx_bo_not_found->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bo_not_found EXPORTING previous = lx_bo_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_attachments FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_attachments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_filter_attachments( ).
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS1001'. " Material
    DATA(lv_object_key)  = '000000000000000001'. " Dummy Material Number

    " For a robust unit test, you would mock cl_binary_relation=>read_links
    " and cl_document_bcs=>get_document_by_key to return predefined test data
    " with varying creation dates.
    TRY.
        " Test with no date filter
        DATA(lt_all_attachments) = lo_cut->get_filtered_attachments(
          iv_object_type = lv_object_type
          iv_object_key  = lv_object_key
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No error for unfiltered call' ).

        " Test with a specific date range (assuming some attachments exist for this range)
        DATA(lv_date_from) = sy-datum - 10.
        DATA(lv_date_to)   = sy-datum.
        DATA(lt_filtered_attachments) = lo_cut->get_filtered_attachments(
          iv_object_type = lv_object_type
          iv_object_key  = lv_object_key
          iv_date_from   = lv_date_from
          iv_date_to     = lv_date_to
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No error for filtered call' ).
        " Further assertions would check the count and content of lt_filtered_attachments
        " based on the mocked data.

    CATCH cx_bo_not_found INTO DATA(lx_bo_not_found).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bo_not_found->get_text( ) ).
    CATCH cx_binary_relation INTO DATA(lx_binary_relation).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_binary_relation->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert das Abrufen von GOS-Anhängen mit der modernen ABAP-Funktion `FILTER`. Zuerst werden alle Anhänge abgerufen und deren Details (inkl. Erstellungszeitpunkt) in eine interne Tabelle geladen. Anschließend wird diese Tabelle mit `FILTER` basierend auf einem Datumsbereich gefiltert. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `LET` ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Transformation der Link-Daten in eine lesbarere Struktur, bevor `FILTER` angewendet wird.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in eine neue interne Tabelle. Die neue Tabelle soll die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE` und ein neues Feld `FLIGHT_STATUS` enthalten. `FLIGHT_STATUS` soll 'On Time' sein, wenn `SEATSMAX` > `SEATSOCC`, sonst 'Full'. Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` Ausdrücke.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate        TYPE s_date,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (Summe von `SEATSOCC`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`LH`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_seats).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_seat IN lt_seats
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_seat-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen mit einem zusätzlichen Feld `OCCUPANCY_LEVEL`. Weisen Sie `OCCUPANCY_LEVEL` basierend auf der Auslastung (`SEATSOCC` / `SEATSMAX`) die Werte 'Low', 'Medium' oder 'High' zu. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `SWITCH` Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator innerhalb eines `FOR` Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid          TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate          TYPE s_date,
             occupancy_level TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_levels
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy_levels) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_levels.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_occupancy_levels = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_occupancy_percent = COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) IN
      ( carrid          = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid          = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate          = ls_sflight-fldate
        occupancy_level = SWITCH string(
                            WHEN lv_occupancy_percent < 50 THEN 'Low'
                            WHEN lv_occupancy_percent < 80 THEN 'Medium'
                            ELSE 'High'
                          )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_levels FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_levels.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_occupancy_levels( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_occ>).
      IF <fs_flight_occ>-occupancy_level <> 'Low' AND
         <fs_flight_occ>-occupancy_level <> 'Medium' AND
         <fs_flight_occ>-occupancy_level <> 'High'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Invalid occupancy level found' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `SWITCH` Operator innerhalb eines `FOR` Ausdrucks, um bedingte Zuweisungen basierend auf mehreren Kriterien durchzuführen. Die `LET` Expression wird verwendet, um eine temporäre Variable (`lv_occupancy_percent`) zu definieren, die die Lesbarkeit verbessert. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, komplexe bedingte Logik in einer Zeile auszudrücken.
keywords: SWITCH, COND, FOR, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, LET, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_3d_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index  TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Load some data

    ev_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) ).
    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = line_index( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 50 ROWS. " Limit for example

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Der `GROUP SIZE` Operator liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. Dies vereinfacht Aggregationen erheblich im Vergleich zu manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen hat, mit dem `CORRESPONDING` Operator. Demonstrieren Sie auch die Verwendung von `BASE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_struct_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE s_carr_id,
             extra_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE s_carr_id,
             new_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_struct_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    " Initialize target with some base values
    rs_target = VALUE ty_target_data( new_field = 'Default' ).

    " Map corresponding fields from source to target, keeping base values for non-matching fields
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( rs_target ) is_source MAPPING field3 = field3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_struct_mapper=>ty_source_data,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_struct_mapper=>ty_target_data.

    ls_source-field1 = 'Value A'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field3 = 'LH'.
    ls_source-extra_field = 'Not Mapped'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_struct_mapper( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_data( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 should be mapped' act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 should be mapped' act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field3 should be mapped' act = ls_target-field3 exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'New_field should retain base value' act = ls_target-new_field exp = 'Default' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ermöglicht eine einfache und effiziente Zuweisung von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit übereinstimmenden Feldnamen. Die `BASE` Klausel ist eine moderne Erweiterung, die es erlaubt, eine Zielstruktur mit Initialwerten zu versehen, die dann nur für die übereinstimmenden Felder überschrieben werden. Dies vermeidet redundanten Code für die Initialisierung und partielle Zuweisung.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transfer, BASE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne RTTI-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_datadescr` für RTTI und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_reader=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field_a = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field_b = 123.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD_A' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD_A should be Hello' act = lv_value exp = 'Hello' ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD_B should be 123' act = lv_value exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_reader=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field_a = 'Test'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Non-existent field should return error message' act = lv_value exp = 'Field not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch auf Felder einer Struktur zugreift, wenn der Feldname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>` Anweisung ist der moderne Weg, dies zu tun. In Kombination mit Field-Symbols ermöglicht dies flexible und generische Programmierlösungen, die oft in Frameworks oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten benötigt werden.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Field-Symbols, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die nur die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `DISTINCT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT ... IN ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_distinct_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_distinct_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 50 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_distinct_carriers = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN lt_sflights ( carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distinct_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_distinct_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    " Check for uniqueness (simple check, a more robust check would involve sorting and comparing)
    DATA(lv_first_carrier) = lt_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'First carrier should not be empty' act = lv_first_carrier ).

    " Verify that the number of distinct carriers is less than or equal to the original number of flights
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT carrid ) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count_db).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of distinct carriers should match DB count' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_count_db ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR DISTINCT` Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator bietet eine sehr elegante und effiziente Möglichkeit, eindeutige Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu extrahieren. Anstatt manuell eine Hash-Tabelle zu füllen oder zu sortieren und zu löschen, wird die Eindeutigkeit direkt im Ausdruck definiert, was den Code extrem kompakt und lesbar macht.
keywords: FOR DISTINCT, VALUE, Internal Tables, Unique Values, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei generischen Objekten (z.B. einem Flug und einem Kunden) unter Verwendung von `CL_BINARY_RELATION`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>CREATE_LINK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_object_key TYPE string.

    METHODS create_flight_customer_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_key TYPE ty_object_key
        iv_customer_key TYPE ty_object_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_customer_link.
    DATA: lo_relation TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation.
    DATA: lv_object_a TYPE borident,
          lv_object_b TYPE borident.

    " Simulate BOR objects or generic object keys
    lv_object_a-objtype = 'ZFLIGHT'. " Custom object type for flight
    lv_object_a-objkey  = iv_flight_key.

    lv_object_b-objtype = 'ZCUSTOMER'. " Custom object type for customer
    lv_object_b-objkey  = iv_customer_key.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = lv_object_a
            is_object_b = lv_object_b
            ip_reltype  = 'Z_FLIGHT_CUST' " Custom relation type
          IMPORTING
            ep_relation = lo_relation
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_link FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_create( ).
    DATA(lv_flight_key) = 'LH400_20251126'.
    DATA(lv_customer_key) = 'CUST123'.

    " Clean up any previous test data to ensure idempotency
    DATA: lv_object_a TYPE borident,
          lv_object_b TYPE borident.
    lv_object_a-objtype = 'ZFLIGHT'.
    lv_object_a-objkey  = lv_flight_key.
    lv_object_b-objtype = 'ZCUSTOMER'.
    lv_object_b-objkey  = lv_customer_key.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = lv_object_a
            is_object_b = lv_object_b
            ip_reltype  = 'Z_FLIGHT_CUST'
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        " Relation might not exist, ignore error
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_flight_customer_link( iv_flight_key = lv_flight_key iv_customer_key = lv_customer_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Verify creation (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(lt_relations) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = lv_object_a
        ip_reltype = 'Z_FLIGHT_CUST'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_relations ).

    " Clean up after test
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = lv_object_a
            is_object_b = lv_object_b
            ip_reltype  = 'Z_FLIGHT_CUST'
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Error during cleanup' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_BINARY_RELATION` ist eine zentrale Klasse zur Verwaltung von Verknüpfungen zwischen beliebigen Objekten im SAP-System. Die Methode `CREATE_LINK` ermöglicht das Anlegen einer neuen Beziehung, was für die Modellierung komplexer Geschäftsbeziehungen unerlässlich ist. keywords: CL_BINARY_RELATION, Object Orientation, Link, Relation, BORIDENT

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle binären Verknüpfungen eines bestimmten Typs für ein gegebenes Objekt ab.

solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_object_key TYPE string.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_relation_info,
             object_a_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_a_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             object_b_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_b_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             relation_type TYPE soblp-reltype,
           END OF ty_relation_info.
    TYPES: tt_relation_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_relation_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_customer_relations
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_key TYPE ty_object_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_relations) TYPE tt_relation_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_customer_relations.
    DATA: lv_object_a TYPE borident.
    DATA: lt_links TYPE sibl_t_relations.

    lv_object_a-objtype = 'ZFLIGHT'.
    lv_object_a-objkey  = iv_flight_key.

    lt_links = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object  = lv_object_a
        ip_reltype = 'Z_FLIGHT_CUST'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_links INTO DATA(ls_link).
      APPEND VALUE ty_relation_info(
        object_a_type = ls_link-obj_a-objtype
        object_a_key  = ls_link-obj_a-objkey
        object_b_type = ls_link-obj_b-objtype
        object_b_key  = ls_link-obj_b-objkey
        relation_type = ls_link-reltype
      ) TO rt_relations.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere (Feld `SEATSMAX`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Fluganbieters (`CARRID`), wobei das Ergebnis als String formatiert werden soll. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `CONV`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `INIT`-Parameter und `CONV` für die finale String-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_as_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_as_string.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_total_seats_int) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).

    rv_total_seats_str = CONV string( lv_total_seats_int ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result_str) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_as_string( lv_carrid ).

    DATA(lt_sflight_lh) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).

hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` für das Filtern und `CONV` innerhalb eines String-Templates für die Formatierung.

CLASS zcl_conv_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_dates) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_dates.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_formatted_dates = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                   ( |{ CONV string( ls_flight-fldate ) DATE = ISO }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` hierarchisch nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) gruppiert und als flache Liste von Baumknoten (mit Parent-Child-Beziehungen) für eine `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE` aufbereitet. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `GROUP BY` Klausel in einer `LOOP AT` Anweisung, um die Daten zu strukturieren, und `VALUE` für die Knotenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lv_carrid_key) = ''.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).

      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      lv_carrid_key = |CARR_{ lv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node(
        node_key   = lv_carrid_key
        parent_key = ''
        text       = group_ref->*-carrid
        level      = 0
        is_folder  = abap_true
      ) TO rt_nodes.

      LOOP AT GROUP group_ref INTO DATA(ls_flight_in_group).
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_node(
          node_key   = |FLT_{ lv_node_counter }|
          parent_key = lv_carrid_key
          text       = |{ ls_flight_in_group-connid } - { ls_flight_in_group-fldate } ({ ls_flight_in_group-seatsocc } seats)|
          level      = 1
          is_folder  = abap_false
        ) TO rt_nodes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->get_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_nodes
      msg = 'No flight data found in SFLIGHT, please ensure data exists.'
      cond = lines( lt_nodes ) > 0
    ).

    " Check if parent-child relationships are consistent
    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-parent_key IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(lv_parent_found) = abap_false.
        LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_parent_node) WHERE node_key = ls_node-parent_key.
          lv_parent_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDLOOP.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = lv_parent_found
          msg = |Parent node { ls_node-parent_key } for node { ls_node-node_key } not found.| 
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for at least one folder and one child
    DATA(lv_folders) = 0.
    DATA(lv_children) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO ls_node.
      IF ls_node-is_folder = abap_true.
        lv_folders = lv_folders + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_children = lv_children + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_folders > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_children > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt die `GROUP BY` Klausel in einer `LOOP AT` Anweisung, um die Flugdaten effizient nach Fluggesellschaften zu gruppieren. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lv_node_counter)`) und `VALUE` Konstruktoren für das Füllen der internen Tabelle `rt_nodes` sind Beispiele für modernen ABAP-Syntax, der den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. String-Templates (`|CARR_{ lv_node_counter }|`) werden für die dynamische Erstellung von Node-Keys verwendet.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie eine bestehende Liste von Baumknoten um neue Kindknoten für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Die neuen Knoten sollen Flüge für dieses CARRID darstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` Schleifen, um die neuen Knoten zu generieren und an die bestehende Liste anzuhängen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_add_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        io_nodes    TYPE REF TO tt_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_add_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = lines( io_nodes->* ) + 1.

    SELECT connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND LINES OF VALUE tt_nodes(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      INDEX INTO lv_idx
      ( node_key   = |FLT_{ lv_node_counter + lv_idx - 1 }|
        parent_key = iv_parent_key
        text       = |{ ls_flight-connid } - { ls_flight-fldate } ({ ls_flight-seatsocc } seats)|
        level      = 1
        is_folder  = abap_false )
    ) TO io_nodes->*.

    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flight_nodes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_add_nodes( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_nodes) = zcl_tree_group_flights=>get_flight_tree_data( ). " Reuse data from first example
    DATA(lr_nodes) = REF #( lt_initial_nodes ).

    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lr_nodes->* ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'. " Example carrier
    DATA(lv_parent_key) = 'CARR_1'. " Assuming 'CARR_1' exists from previous example

    " Ensure parent key exists
    IF NOT line_exists( lr_nodes->*[ node_key = lv_parent_key ] ).
      " If not, add a dummy parent for testing purposes
      APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_add_nodes=>ty_node(
        node_key = lv_parent_key
        text = lv_carrid
        is_folder = abap_true
      ) TO lr_nodes->*.
      lv_initial_lines = lines( lr_nodes->* ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_flight_nodes( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_parent_key = lv_parent_key io_nodes = lr_nodes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lr_nodes->* ) > lv_initial_lines ).

    " Verify new nodes have correct parent key
    LOOP AT lr_nodes->* INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE parent_key = lv_parent_key.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_node-parent_key exp = lv_parent_key ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ls_node-is_folder ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die dynamische Erweiterung einer Baumstruktur. Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR` Schleife wird verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle von Knoten zu erstellen, die dann effizient an die bestehende Knotentabelle angehängt wird. Die Übergabe der Knotentabelle als Referenz (`REF TO tt_nodes`) ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der übergebenen Daten, was in modernen ABAP-Programmen oft für Performance-Optimierungen genutzt wird. Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Text eines spezifischen Knotens in einer Liste von Baumknoten. Der neue Text soll aus einer Kombination von Flugdaten unter Verwendung von String-Templates bestehen.

CLASS zcl_tree_update_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_node_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes    TYPE tt_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_update_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_node_text.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    IF line_exists( ct_nodes[ node_key = iv_node_key ] ).
      DATA(lv_new_text) = |Flug { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } - Belegung: { iv_seatsocc }|.
      ct_nodes[ node_key = iv_node_key ]-text = lv_new_text.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine bestehende Liste von Baumknoten, sodass nur Knoten angezeigt werden, deren Text einen bestimmten Suchbegriff enthält. Die Hierarchie soll dabei erhalten bleiben (d.h., Eltern von gefundenen Knoten müssen ebenfalls angezeigt werden).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um die Knoten zu selektieren, und eine rekursive Logik, um die Elternknoten einzubeziehen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_tree_nodes
      IMPORTING
        it_all_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
        iv_search_term TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_parents_recursively
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        it_all_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
      CHANGING
        ct_parent_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lt_matching_nodes) = FILTER tt_nodes(
      it_all_nodes WHERE text CP |*{ iv_search_term }*|
    ).

    DATA(lt_keys_to_include) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT lt_matching_nodes INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-node_key TO lt_keys_to_include.
      me->get_parents_recursively(
        iv_node_key    = ls_match-node_key
        it_all_nodes   = it_all_nodes
        CHANGING ct_parent_keys = lt_keys_to_include
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_keys_to_include BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_keys_to_include.

    rt_filtered_nodes = FILTER tt_nodes(
      it_all_nodes WHERE node_key IN lt_keys_to_include
    ).

    " Ensure the order is preserved as much as possible for tree display
    SORT rt_filtered_nodes BY parent_key node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_parents_recursively.
    DATA(ls_node) = VALUE ty_node( ).
    READ TABLE it_all_nodes INTO ls_node WITH KEY node_key = iv_node_key.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_node-parent_key IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF NOT line_exists( ct_parent_keys[ table_line = ls_node-parent_key ] ).
        APPEND ls_node-parent_key TO ct_parent_keys.
        me->get_parents_recursively(
          iv_node_key    = ls_node-parent_key
          it_all_nodes   = it_all_nodes
          CHANGING ct_parent_keys = ct_parent_keys
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein elegantes Beispiel für die Kombination von funktionalen Operatoren und objektorientierten Prinzipien in modernem ABAP. `CP` für 'contains pattern' wird für die einfache Textsuche verwendet.

Instructions: Weisen Sie Baumknoten basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. Anzahl der belegten Sitze) unterschiedliche Icons zu. Knoten, die eine hohe Belegung haben, sollen ein 'Warn'-Icon erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator, um bedingt Icon-IDs zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_icons DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
        icon       TYPE lvc_value, " Icon field
        seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_icons_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_icons IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_icons_to_flights.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_nodes = VALUE tt_nodes(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      INDEX INTO lv_idx
      ( node_key   = |FLT_{ lv_idx }|
        parent_key = ''
        text       = |{ ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }|
        level      = 0
        is_folder  = abap_false
        seatsocc   = ls_flight-seatsocc
        icon       = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc > 200 THEN '@08@' " Warning icon
                             WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc > 100 THEN '@07@' " Info icon
                             ELSE '@06@' ) " Success icon
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_icons FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_icons.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_node_icons( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '1000' seatsocc = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '2000' seatsocc = 50 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->assign_icons_to_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nodes ) exp = 3 ).

hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `SWITCH` Ausdruck, um die D&D-Gruppen zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dnd_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
        dnd_group  TYPE lvc_value, " Drag & Drop Group
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_dnd_groups
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes_with_dnd) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dnd_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_dnd_groups.
    rt_nodes_with_dnd = VALUE tt_nodes(
      FOR ls_node IN it_raw_nodes
      ( ls_node WITH dnd_group = SWITCH lvc_value(
                                   ls_node-is_folder
                                   WHEN abap_true THEN 'CARRID_GROUP'
                                   WHEN abap_false THEN 'FLIGHT_GROUP'
                                   ELSE '' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die in einer Liste von Baumknoten nach Knoten sucht, deren Text einem regulären Ausdruck entspricht, und die Schlüssel dieser Knoten zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_REGEX` für die Regex-Suche und `FOR` mit `COND` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_regex_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS search_nodes_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        it_all_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
        iv_regex_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_matching_keys) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_regex_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_nodes_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_regex_pattern case_sensitive = abap_false ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( ).

    rt_matching_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_node IN it_all_nodes
                                 WHERE ( lo_matcher->match( text = ls_node-text ) = abap_true )
                                 ( ls_node-node_key ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flugknoten in einer gegebenen Baumstruktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe effizient zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
        seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_node IN it_nodes
      WHERE is_folder = abap_false " Only count for actual flight nodes
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_node-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( node_key = 'FLT_LH_002' parent_key = 'CARR_LH' text = 'Flug 0800' level = 1 is_folder = abap_false seatsocc = 200 )

    ).

Die `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb des `REDUCE` Operators stellt sicher, dass nur tatsächliche Flugknoten (nicht Ordner) in die Berechnung einbezogen werden. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die benutzerdefinierte Attribute (z.B. 'Flugstatus') zu einem Baumknoten hinzufügt und diese später wieder ausliest. Nutzen Sie eine generische Struktur für die Attribute.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `STRING_TABLE` für die Attribute und `LINE_EXISTS` mit `TABLE_LINE` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
        attributes TYPE string_table, " Custom attributes as key-value pairs
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_attribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_attr_name TYPE string
        iv_attr_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_attribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_attr_name TYPE string
        it_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_attr_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_attribute.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    IF line_exists( ct_nodes[ node_key = iv_node_key ] ).
      DATA(lv_attribute_entry) = |{ iv_attr_name }={ iv_attr_value }|.
      DATA(ls_node_ref) = REF TO ct_nodes[ node_key = iv_node_key ].
      APPEND lv_attribute_entry TO ls_node_ref->attributes.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_attribute.
    IF line_exists( it_nodes[ node_key = iv_node_key ] ).
      DATA(ls_node) = it_nodes[ node_key = iv_node_key ].
      DATA(lv_search_pattern) = |{ iv_attr_name }=*|.
      LOOP AT ls_node-attributes INTO DATA(lv_attribute_line) WHERE lv_attribute_line CP lv_search_pattern.
        rv_attr_value = lv_attribute_line+strlen( iv_attr_name )+1.
        RETURN.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_node_attributes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_node_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE zcl_tree_node_attributes=>tt_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'NODE_001' text = 'Test Node' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 'NODE_001'.
    DATA(lv_attr_name) = 'Flugstatus'.
    DATA(lv_attr_value) = 'Verspätet'.

    " Add attribute
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_attribute(
      iv_node_key   = lv_node_key
      iv_attr_name  = lv_attr_name
      iv_attr_value = lv_attr_value
      CHANGING ct_nodes = lt_nodes
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    " Get attribute
    DATA(lv_retrieved_value) = lo_cut->get_attribute(
      iv_node_key  = lv_node_key
      iv_attr_name = lv_attr_name
      it_nodes     = lt_nodes
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_retrieved_value exp = lv_attr_value ).

    " Test non-existent attribute
    lv_retrieved_value = lo_cut->get_attribute(
      iv_node_key  = lv_node_key
      iv_attr_name = 'NonExistentAttr'
      it_nodes     = lt_nodes
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_retrieved_value ).

    " Test non-existent node
    lv_retrieved_value = lo_cut->get_attribute(
      iv_node_key  = 'NON_EXISTENT'
      iv_attr_name = lv_attr_name
      it_nodes     = lt_nodes
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_retrieved_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt, wie man benutzerdefinierte Attribute flexibel an Baumknoten anhängen und wieder auslesen kann. Die Attribute werden als `STRING_TABLE` im Format 'Name=Wert' gespeichert. Die `add_attribute` Methode nutzt `LINE_EXISTS` und einen Referenz-Zugriff (`REF TO ct_nodes[ node_key = iv_node_key ]`) für die effiziente Aktualisierung. Die `get_attribute` Methode verwendet eine `LOOP AT ... WHERE CP` Schleife, um das gewünschte Attribut zu finden und den Wert mittels Offset-Zugriff (`+strlen(...)`) zu extrahieren. Dies ist eine flexible Methode, um zusätzliche Daten an GUI-Elemente zu binden, ohne die Basisstruktur ändern zu müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine dynamische Baumstruktur mit mehreren Hierarchieebenen aus Flugdaten (z.B. Fluggesellschaft -> Flugverbindung -> Flugdatum) generiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie rekursive Methoden und `VALUE` mit verschachtelten `FOR` Schleifen, um die Hierarchie aufzubauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
        parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
        text       TYPE lvc_value,
        level      TYPE i,
        is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flight_tree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_node_counter TYPE i.
    METHODS add_carrid_nodes
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes TYPE tt_nodes.

    METHODS add_connid_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes TYPE tt_nodes.

    METHODS add_fldate_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flight_tree.
    mv_node_counter = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    me->add_carrid_nodes( it_sflight = lt_sflight CHANGING ct_nodes = rt_nodes ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_carrid_nodes.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_carrid).

      mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_carrid_key) = |CARR_{ mv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node(
        node_key   = lv_carrid_key
        parent_key = ''
        text       = group_carrid->*-carrid
        level      = 0
        is_folder  = abap_true
      ) TO ct_nodes.

      me->add_connid_nodes(
        iv_carrid   = group_carrid->*-carrid
        iv_parent_key = lv_carrid_key
        it_sflight  = it_sflight
        CHANGING ct_nodes = ct_nodes
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_connid_nodes.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
         GROUP BY ls_sflight-connid
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_connid).

      mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_connid_key) = |CONN_{ mv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node(
        node_key   = lv_connid_key
        parent_key = iv_parent_key
        text       = group_connid->*-connid
        level      = 1
        is_folder  = abap_true
      ) TO ct_nodes.

      me->add_fldate_nodes(
        iv_carrid   = iv_carrid
        iv_connid   = group_connid->*-connid
        iv_parent_key = lv_connid_key
        it_sflight  = it_sflight
        CHANGING ct_nodes = ct_nodes
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_fldate_nodes.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid
         GROUP BY ls_sflight-fldate
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_fldate).

      mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node(
        node_key   = |DATE_{ mv_node_counter }|
        parent_key = iv_parent_key
        text       = |{ group_fldate->*-fldate DATE = USER } ({ group_fldate->*-seatsocc } seats)| " Assuming seatsocc is same for all flights on same date/connid
        level      = 2
        is_folder  = abap_false
      ) TO ct_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_tree.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_dynamic_hierarchy( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_flight_tree( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_nodes
      msg = 'No flight data found in SFLIGHT, please ensure data exists.'
      cond = lines( lt_nodes ) > 0
    ).

    " Check for correct hierarchy levels
    DATA(lv_level0_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_level1_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_level2_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      CASE ls_node-level.
        WHEN 0. lv_level0_count = lv_level0_count + 1.
        WHEN 1. lv_level1_count = lv_level1_count + 1.
        WHEN 2. lv_level2_count = lv_level2_count + 1.
      ENDCASE.

      IF ls_node-level = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_node-parent_key ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_node-is_folder ).
      ELSEIF ls_node-level = 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_node-parent_key ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_node-is_folder ).
      ELSEIF ls_node-level = 2.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_node-parent_key ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_node-is_folder ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_level0_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_level1_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_level2_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert den Aufbau einer dynamischen, mehrstufigen Baumhierarchie unter Verwendung von rekursiven Methoden und der `GROUP BY` Klausel in `LOOP AT` Anweisungen. Jede Methode (`add_carrid_nodes`, `add_connid_nodes`, `add_fldate_nodes`) ist für eine Hierarchieebene zuständig und ruft die nächste Ebene rekursiv auf. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und erweiterbare Struktur. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` Konstruktoren und String-Templates sorgt für kompakten und lesbaren Code. Inline-Deklarationen und der Referenz-Zugriff auf die Knotentabelle (`CHANGING ct_nodes`) sind weitere moderne ABAP-Merkmale.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTCLONG-Zeitstempel in ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit unter Berücksichtigung einer Zeitzone.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_utclong`.

CLASS zcl_utc_to_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utclong_to_dt
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_tzone   TYPE timezone DEFAULT 'CET'
      EXPORTING
        ev_date    TYPE d
        ev_time    TYPE t.

CLASS zcl_utc_to_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utclong_to_dt.
    cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_timestamp(
      EXPORTING
        utclong = iv_utclong
        tzone   = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        date    = ev_date
        time    = ev_time
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_to_datetime( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong) = '20230101120000.0000000'. " Jan 1, 2023 12:00:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_date) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_time) TYPE t.

    lo_cut->convert_utclong_to_dt(
      EXPORTING
        iv_utclong = lv_utclong

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und rufen Sie eine Methode auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>create_object` und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA: lv_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        lo_object = lo_classdescr->create_object( ).

        " Assuming the method has a simple string return value and no parameters
        CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULT rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        rv_result = 'Class or method not found'.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Dynamic call error'.
      CATCH cx_abap_class_not_found.
        rv_result = 'Class not found'.
      CATCH cx_abap_not_creatable.
        rv_result = 'Class not creatable'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_call(
                           iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TEST_CLASS'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dynamic class!' ).

explanation: Die dynamische Objekterzeugung und der Methodenaufruf mittels RTTI sind mächtige Werkzeuge für generische Frameworks. `cl_abap_classdescr=>create_object` erzeugt die Instanz, und `CALL METHOD (object_ref)->(method_name)` führt den dynamischen Aufruf aus.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Object Creation, CALL METHOD, cl_abap_classdescr

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei UTCLONG-Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, welcher früher oder später ist.
hint: UTCLONG-Werte können direkt mit Vergleichsoperatoren verglichen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utc_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_utclongs
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong1 TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong2 TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_comparison_result) TYPE string. " 'EQUAL', 'BEFORE', 'AFTER'
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utc_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_utclongs.
    IF iv_utclong1 = iv_utclong2.
      rv_comparison_result = 'EQUAL'.
    ELSEIF iv_utclong1 < iv_utclong2.
      rv_comparison_result = 'BEFORE'.
    ELSE.
      rv_comparison_result = 'AFTER'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_comparison.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong1) = '20230101120000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong2) = '20230101120100.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong3) = '20230101120000.0000000'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_utclongs( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong1 iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong2 ) exp = 'BEFORE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_utclongs( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong2 iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong1 ) exp = 'AFTER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_utclongs( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong1 iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong3 ) exp = 'EQUAL' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: UTCLONG-Zeitstempel sind interne numerische Darstellungen und können direkt mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren (`=`, `<`, `>`) verglichen werden, was eine einfache und performante Zeitstempel-Logik ermöglicht.
keywords: UTCLONG, Comparison, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine Klasse eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_interfaces`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_test_interface PUBLIC.
  METHODS dummy_method.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_implements_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_test_interface.
    METHODS check_implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name     TYPE string
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_implements_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_test_interface~dummy_method. ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_implements_interface.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_classdescr->get_interfaces( ).

        LOOP AT lt_interfaces INTO DATA(ls_interface).
          IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
            rv_implements = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_implements = abap_false.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        rv_implements = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_implements_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_implements_interface( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->check_implements_interface(
              iv_class_name     = 'ZCL_IMPLEMENTS_INTERFACE'
              iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE'
            )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->check_implements_interface(
              iv_class_name     = 'ZCL_IMPLEMENTS_INTERFACE'
              iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_NON_EXISTENT_INTERFACE'
            )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->check_implements_interface(
              iv_class_name     = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS'
              iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE'
            )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (Passagiere / Kapazität) für alle Flüge in einer SFLIGHT-Tabelle, die nach 'JFK' fliegen, und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`, `FOR` und `REDUCE` in einer Kette von Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_chain_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_avg_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE fltp.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_chain_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lt_jfk_flights) = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE airpto = 'JFK' ).

    IF lt_jfk_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_occupancy) = REDUCE fltp(
      INIT sum_occ = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_jfk_flights
      NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) ) ).

    rv_avg_occupancy = lv_total_occupancy / lines( lt_jfk_flights ).

    " Round to two decimal places
    rv_avg_occupancy = round( val = rv_avg_occupancy dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-airpto = 'JFK'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 300. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_calculator->calculate_avg_occupancy( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = '0.50' ). " (0.5 + 0.5) / 2 = 0.5
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Verkettung von Tabellenoperationen (`FILTER`, `REDUCE`) in modernen ABAP-Versionen. Es ermöglicht eine sehr funktionale und lesbare Datenverarbeitung, die komplexe Logik in wenigen Zeilen ausdrückt. Die `COND` Expression wird verwendet, um Division durch Null zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge in einer SFLIGHT-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, um die Aggregation pro Gruppe durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
                                               INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                       total_seats_occ = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 50.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 75.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-total_seats_occ exp = 225 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-total_seats_occ exp = 150 ).

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungslogik erheblich und macht den Code lesbarer und wartbarer.

solution:
CLASS zcl_email_attachment_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        is_flight_data     TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_attachment_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA: lv_attachment_content TYPE string,
          lo_document           TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs.

    lv_attachment_content = |Flugdetails:\n|
                          && |Fluggesellschaft: { is_flight_data-carrid }\n|
                          && |Flugnummer: { is_flight_data-connid }\n|
                          && |Abflugort: { is_flight_data-airpfrom }\n|
                          && |Zielort: { is_flight_data-airpto }\n|
                          && |Abflugdatum: { is_flight_data-fldate DATE = USER }|.

    TRY.
        lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_attachment_content )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        lo_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
          i_attachment_subject = |Flugdaten_{ is_flight_data-carrid }_{ is_flight_data-connid }.txt|
          i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( lv_attachment_content ) )
          i_att_content_text   = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_attachment_content )
        ).

        cl_bcs_utilities=>send(
          i_sender_address = 'sender@example.com' " Absenderadresse anpassen
          i_recipient_address = iv_recipient_email
          i_subject = iv_subject
          i_document = lo_document
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_send_email_with_attachment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-airpfrom = 'FRA'.
    ls_flight-airpto = 'JFK'.
    ls_flight-fldate = '20251126'.

    DATA(lo_sender) = NEW zcl_email_attachment_sender( ).

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft, ob ein Flug als 'Premium', 'Standard' oder 'Budget' eingestuft wird. Verwenden Sie 'LH' und 'SQ' als Premium, 'AA' und 'UA' als Standard, alle anderen als Budget.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl belegter Sitze in einer SFLIGHT-Tabelle. Wenn mehrere Flüge die gleiche maximale Anzahl haben, geben Sie den ersten gefundenen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Tabellenexpression mit `MAX` oder `SORT` und `READ TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_seats.
    DATA(lv_max_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_val = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT max_val = nmax( val1 = max_val val2 = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).

    rs_flight = it_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS seatsocc = lv_max_seats ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_seats_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_seats_empty_table EXPECTING CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND.
    METHODS test_max_seats_multiple_max FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_seats_found.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 100. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0020'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 75.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_sflight_max_seats( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_finder->get_flight_with_max_seats( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-seatsocc exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_seats_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_sflight_max_seats( ).
    lo_finder->get_flight_with_max_seats( lt_sflight ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_seats_multiple_max.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0020'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 75.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_sflight_max_seats( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_finder->get_flight_with_max_seats( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " Should return the first one
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-seatsocc exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `REDUCE` mit `NMAX` zum Finden des Maximalwerts und einer Tabellenexpression mit `KEY primary_key COMPONENTS` ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um einen bestimmten Eintrag basierend auf einem Maximalwert zu finden. Dies vermeidet explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, REDUCE, NMAX, SFLIGHT, Exception Handling

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob alle Flüge in einer SFLIGHT-Tabelle eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an belegten Sitzen überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `ALL` Operator in einer Tabellenexpression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_all_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_all_flights_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_ok) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_all_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_all_flights_occupancy.
    rv_all_ok = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN it_sflights IS INITIAL THEN abap_true " Leere Tabelle gilt als 'alle OK'
      ELSE ( it_sflights[ ALL WHERE seatsocc > iv_min_seats ] IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_all_ok FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_not_all_ok FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_all_ok.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 101. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_sflight_all_check( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_checker->check_all_flights_occupancy( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_min_seats = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result ).

  METHOD test_not_all_ok.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 101. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 99.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_sflight_all_check( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_checker->check_all_flights_occupancy( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_min_seats = 100 ).
