  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_sflight_all_check( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_checker->check_all_flights_occupancy( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_min_seats = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `ALL` Operator in Tabellenexpressionen (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante Überprüfung, ob alle Einträge einer internen Tabelle eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. In Kombination mit `COND` wird der Code extrem kompakt und lesbar für solche Prüfungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, ALL, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHT, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus der SFLIGHT-Tabelle und zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge jede Fluggesellschaft hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` mit `COUNT` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_unique_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers_with_count
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_unique_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_with_count.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
                            ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_carriers_count FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unique_carriers_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers_count.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_sflight_unique_count( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_counter->get_unique_carriers_with_count( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'BA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unique_carriers_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_sflight_unique_count( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_counter->get_unique_carriers_with_count( lt_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Syntax in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `GROUP SIZE` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Gruppierungen und Aggregationen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck durchzuführen. Dies ist wesentlich effizienter und lesbarer als manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, VALUE, GROUP SIZE, SFLIGHT, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus der SFLIGHT-Tabelle enthält, aber mit einer zusätzlichen Spalte, die angibt, ob der Flug voll (seatsocc = seatsmax) ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` um die neue Spalte zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_full_indicator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflight,
             is_full TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_full_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_full_indicator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_full_status.
    rt_flights_with_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                        ( ls_sflight
                                          is_full = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_full_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_full_status_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_full_status.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 100. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 100. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 200. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0020'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 75.  ls_sflight-seatsmax = 75.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_indicator) = NEW zcl_sflight_full_indicator( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_indicator->add_full_status( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[ 1 ]-is_full ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lt_result[ 2 ]-is_full ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[ 3 ]-is_full ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_full_status_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_indicator) = NEW zcl_sflight_full_indicator( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_indicator->add_full_status( lt_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht das einfache Hinzufügen oder Modifizieren von Spalten in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Die `COND` Expression wird verwendet, um die Logik für die neue Spalte `is_full` prägnant auszudrücken, was den Code sehr lesbar und funktional macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, COND, SFLIGHT, Transformation

Instructions: Lesen Sie spezifische Felder (carrid, connid, fldate, price) aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaften 'AA' und 'DL' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in eine interne Tabelle mit passender Struktur. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Range-Tabelle für die Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Nutzen Sie CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE und eine Range-Tabelle, die mit VALUE # erstellt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE sflight_carrid_tt(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'DL' )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_filtered( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_filtered_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'DL' )
        msg = |Unexpected carrid: { ls_flight-carrid }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von VALUE # zur Initialisierung einer Range-Tabelle und CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE vereinfacht das Lesen von Daten in eine intern definierte Struktur, ohne dass die Feldnamen explizit zugewiesen werden müssen.
keywords: SELECT, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, VALUE #, Range Table, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, für die es Einträge in der Tabelle SCARR gibt. Verwenden Sie dabei FOR ALL ENTRIES mit moderner Syntax.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die interne Tabelle für FOR ALL ENTRIES nicht leer ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid( ).
    SELECT carrid FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_carriers.

    IF lt_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_carriers

CLASS zcl_scarr_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.

CLASS zcl_scarr_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_union_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      WHERE carrid LIKE 'A%'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      WHERE carrid LIKE 'L%'
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Top 3 der teuersten Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie dabei die Fensterfunktion `ROW_NUMBER()` mit moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)` und `ROW_NUMBER()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_top_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             rank   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_top_flight.
    TYPES: tt_top_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_top_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_top_3_flights_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_top_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_3_flights_per_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY carrid ORDER BY price DESC ) AS rank
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_ranked_flights).

    rt_top_flights = FILTER #( lt_ranked_flights WHERE rank <= 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_3_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_3_flights.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_sflight_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_top_flights) = lo_analyzer->get_top_3_flights_per_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_top_flights ).
    " Verify that for each carrid, there are at most 3 entries and ranks are correct
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ).
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_carrids.

    LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lt_carrier_flights) = FILTER #( lt_top_flights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_carrier_flights ) exp = 3 ).
      IF lines( lt_carrier_flights ) > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrier_flights[ 1 ]-rank exp = 1 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Fensterfunktionen wie `ROW_NUMBER()` ermöglichen komplexe Rangierungen und Analysen direkt in der Datenbank. In Kombination mit `PARTITION BY` und `ORDER BY` können Daten innerhalb von Gruppen sortiert und nummeriert werden, was die Auswahl von Top-N-Einträgen pro Gruppe vereinfacht. `FILTER #` wird verwendet, um die Ergebnisse im ABAP-Code weiter zu verfeinern.
keywords: SELECT, Window Function, ROW_NUMBER, PARTITION BY, ORDER BY, SFLIGHTS, FILTER #

CLASS zcl_email_pdf_sender IMPLEMENTATION.

      i_text    = |{ iv_body_text }|

    " Dummy PDF content for demonstration. In a real scenario, this would be generated.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaften aus, die mehr als 10 Flüge haben. Verwenden Sie dabei `COUNT(*)` und `GROUP BY` mit moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COUNT(*)` in der `SELECT`-Liste und `HAVING` für die Filterung der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carriers_with_many_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_sflight_count( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_analyzer->get_carriers_with_many_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_count-flight_count > 10 )
        msg = |Carrier { ls_count-carrid } has only { ls_count-flight_count } flights, expected > 10|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `COUNT(*)` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in einem `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht es, Aggregationen direkt auf der Datenbank durchzuführen und die Ergebnisse basierend auf den aggregierten Werten zu filtern. Dies ist sehr effizient für statistische Auswertungen.
keywords: SELECT, COUNT, GROUP BY, HAVING, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_alv_hide_column IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lo_alv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lo_columns   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_columns_list,
          lo_column    TYPE REF TO cl_salv_column.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = it_data

        lo_columns = lo_alv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_visible( abap_false ).

        lo_alv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: lo_alv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lo_columns   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_columns_list,
          lo_column    TYPE REF TO cl_salv_column.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv_table
          CHANGING

        ).

        lo_columns = lo_alv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( iv_column_name ).
        rv_is_visible = lo_column->is_visible( ).

        rv_is_visible = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Wenn ein Flugziel 'FRANKFURT' ist, soll der Preis für diesen Flug verdoppelt werden, bevor er zur Summe addiert wird. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Ausdruck mit einer IF-ELSE-Bedingung innerhalb des NEXT-Teils.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_special_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_special_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                               NEXT sum = sum + ( IF flight-cityto = 'FRANKFURT' THEN flight-price * 2 ELSE flight-price ENDIF ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_special_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_special_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_special_sum( ).

    " To properly test, we need to know the expected sum. For a robust test, we'd mock SFLIGHT or calculate expected value.
    " Here, we'll just assert it's not initial and provide a basic check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_sum msg = 'Sum should not be initial' fail_if_initial = abap_false ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus einer Quelltabelle. Übertragen Sie alle Felder, die gleich benannt sind, und setzen Sie das Feld 'currency' auf 'EUR', wenn es in der Quelle leer ist, andernfalls übernehmen Sie den Wert aus der Quelle. Verwenden Sie eine Struktur ähnlich SFLIGHT.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit CORRESPONDING und COND für die bedingte Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corr_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status   TYPE string, " Additional field
           END OF ty_sflight_target.
    TYPES tt_sflight_source TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES tt_sflight_target TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_target.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_sflight_source
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_sflight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corr_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR wa_source IN it_source
                         ( CORRESPONDING ty_sflight_target( wa_source )
                           currency = COND #( WHEN wa_source-currency IS INITIAL THEN 'EUR' ELSE wa_source-currency )
                           status = 'PROCESSED' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API (z.B. 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1') durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_HTTP_CLIENT=>CREATE_BY_URL, SEND und RECEIVE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_data IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            kernel_error       = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rv_response_body = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          rv_response_body = |Error sending request: { lv_error_message }|.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          rv_response_body = |Error receiving response: { lv_error_message }|.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_response_body = |HTTP Exception: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und prüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort. Geben Sie 'OK' zurück, wenn der Status 200 ist, andernfalls den Statuscode und den Statustext.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_status_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_http_status IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_http_status.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            kernel_error       = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rv_status_info = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          rv_status_info = |Error sending request: { lv_error_message }|.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          rv_status_info = |Error receiving response: { lv_error_message }|.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        DATA(lv_status_text) = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).

        IF lv_status_code = 200.
          rv_status_info = 'OK'.
        ELSE.
          rv_status_info = |Status: { lv_status_code } - { lv_status_text }|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_status_info = |HTTP Exception: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_http_client_wrapper PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_data_from_url
    IMPORTING
      iv_url TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_http_client_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_http_client_wrapper.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client OPTIONAL.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    METHODS create_http_client
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_client) TYPE REF TO if_http_client
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_client_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_http_client IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_http_client = io_http_client.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_http_client_wrapper~get_data_from_url.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        IF mo_http_client IS NOT BOUND.
          mo_http_client = create_http_client( iv_url ).
        ENDIF.

        mo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        mo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = mo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          rv_response_body = |Error sending request: { lv_error_message }|.
          mo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        mo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = mo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          rv_response_body = |Error receiving response: { lv_error_message }|.
          mo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = mo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        mo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_response_body = |HTTP Exception: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_http_client.
    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = ro_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        kernel_error       = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to create HTTP client'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie die Daten einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch in einen JSON-String, indem Sie RTTI verwenden, um die Feldnamen und -werte zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` in Kombination mit `/UI2/CL_JSON`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_rtti_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_rtti_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ) ).
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA: ls_json_data TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA ls_json_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_json_data> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-string.
    ASSIGN ls_json_data->* TO <fs_json_data>.

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field_value> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        INSERT VALUE #( key = ls_component-name value = |{ <fs_field_value> }| ) INTO TABLE <fs_json_data>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_json_writer) = /ui2/cl_json=>create_writer( ).
    lo_json_writer->write( <fs_json_data> ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_writer->get_json( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA(ls_test) = VALUE ty_test_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 field3 = abap_true ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_rtti_serialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_dynamic( REF #( ls_test ) ).

Mittels `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` werden die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit ermittelt und deren Werte dynamisch extrahiert. Diese dynamisch erzeugte Datenstruktur wird dann von `/UI2/CL_JSON` in einen JSON-String umgewandelt. Dies ermöglicht eine generische Serialisierung beliebiger Strukturen.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String in eine dynamisch zur Laufzeit erzeugte ABAP-Struktur, deren Typ basierend auf den JSON-Schlüsseln definiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Typ- und Datenobjekterstellung, bevor Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` aufrufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_rtti_deserialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS deserialize_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_rtti_deserialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_json_map TYPE /ui2/cl_json=>json_map.
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = iv_json_string
      CHANGING
        data = lt_json_map
    ).

    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT lt_json_map INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      DATA(lv_name) = ls_entry-key.
      DATA(lv_value) = ls_entry-value.
      DATA(lv_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lv_value )->type_kind.
      CASE lv_type.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_name type = 'C' length = 255 ) TO lt_components.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_name type = 'I' ) TO lt_components.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_name type = 'F' ) TO lt_components.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_name type = 'g' ) TO lt_components.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_name type = 'g' ) TO lt_components.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = iv_json_string
      CHANGING
        data = rr_data->*
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst wird der JSON-String in eine generische Map deserialisiert, um die Feldnamen und deren grundlegende Typen zu ermitteln. Mit diesen Informationen wird dann dynamisch eine ABAP-Struktur zur Laufzeit erstellt (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE`), in die der JSON-String anschließend deserialisiert wird. Dies ist ideal für flexible Schnittstellen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Komponenten (Feldnamen und Typen) einer gegebenen ABAP-Struktur mittels RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>GET_COMPONENTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_inspect_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inspect_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).
    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      rt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_components.
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_inspect_structure=>ty_data(
      id = 1
      name = 'Test'
      date = sy-datum
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_inspect_structure( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( REF #( ls_test_data ) ).

Hier wird `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` verwendet, um eine Typbeschreibung zu erhalten, die dann zu `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` gecastet wird, um die einzelnen Komponenten der Struktur zu extrahieren. Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf Kriterien und serialisieren Sie die gefilterten Ergebnisse in einen JSON-String.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_sflights_json

CLASS zcl_json_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflights_json.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER tt_sflight_filtered FROM lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price.

    DATA(lo_json_writer) = /ui2/cl_json=>create_writer( ).
    lo_json_writer->write( lt_filtered_sflights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_writer->get_json( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die prüft, ob ein Objekt einer bestimmten Klasse oder einer ihrer Unterklassen angehört, unter Verwendung von RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und die Methode `IS_SUBCLASS_OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_inheritance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_instance_of_type
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_class_name TYPE cl_abap_objectdescr=>classname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_instance) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_inheritance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_instance_of_type.
    IF io_object IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_object_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( lo_object_descr ).

    IF lo_class_descr->get_name( ) = iv_class_name.
      rv_is_instance = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_target_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
    rv_is_instance = lo_class_descr->is_subclass_of( lo_target_class_descr ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS zcl_parent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_parent) = NEW zcl_parent( ).
    DATA(lo_child) = NEW zcl_child( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = zcl_rtti_check_inheritance=>is_instance_of_type( io_object = lo_parent iv_class_name = 'ZCL_PARENT' )
      msg = 'Parent sollte Instanz von ZCL_PARENT sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = zcl_rtti_check_inheritance=>is_instance_of_type( io_object = lo_child iv_class_name = 'ZCL_CHILD' )
      msg = 'Child sollte Instanz von ZCL_CHILD sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = zcl_rtti_check_inheritance=>is_instance_of_type( io_object = lo_child iv_class_name = 'ZCL_PARENT' )
      msg = 'Child sollte auch Instanz von ZCL_PARENT sein'
    ).

      msg = 'Parent sollte keine Instanz von ZCL_CHILD sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI, um die Vererbungshierarchie von Objekten zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen. `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_OBJECT` liefert die Typbeschreibung des Objekts, die dann zu `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` gecastet wird. Die Methode `IS_SUBCLASS_OF` ermöglicht die Überprüfung, ob eine Klasse von einer anderen erbt. Dies ist entscheidend für flexible und erweiterbare objektorientierte Architekturen.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler (z.B. ungültiges JSON-Format) ab.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data = rs_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen des Fehlers
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_json_parse_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken Ausnahmen abfängt, die von `/UI2/CL_JSON` bei ungültigem JSON-Input ausgelöst werden. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch setzt, basierend auf dem Feldnamen und dem neuen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_set_field_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_set_field_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Dynamische Zuweisung, Typkonvertierung kann notwendig sein
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Fehler bei Typkonvertierung behandeln
          MESSAGE 'Typkonvertierungsfehler beim Setzen des Feldes' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

           END OF ty_test_data.
    METHODS test_set_field_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_test_data( id = 1 name = 'Initial' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_set_field_dynamic( ).

    lo_cut->set_field_value( ir_structure = REF #( ls_data ) iv_field_name = 'NAME' iv_new_value = 'Updated Name' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-name exp = 'Updated Name' ).

    lo_cut->set_field_value( ir_structure = REF #( ls_data ) iv_field_name = 'ID' iv_new_value = '99' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 99 ).

    " Test mit nicht existierendem Feld
    lo_cut->set_field_value( ir_structure = REF #( ls_data ) iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_new_value = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-name exp = 'Updated Name' ). " Wert sollte unverändert bleiben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die dynamische Manipulation von Datenstrukturen mittels RTTI. Durch `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` kann auf ein Feld einer Struktur zur Laufzeit über seinen Namen zugegriffen werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Schnittstellen oder Tools, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Eine `TRY...CATCH` Block ist wichtig, um Konvertierungsfehler abzufangen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Funktion, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen in eine interne Tabelle von Hash-Maps (Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren) umwandelt, wobei die Feldnamen als Schlüssel dienen.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Feldnamen und Werte jeder Struktur dynamisch zu extrahieren und in eine Hash-Map zu übertragen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: tt_string_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_string_map WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS convert_table_to_map
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_map_table) TYPE tt_string_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_map.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA(ls_map) = VALUE ty_string_map( ).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field_value> TYPE any.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          INSERT VALUE #( key = ls_component-name value = |{ <fs_field_value> }| ) INTO TABLE ls_map.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_map TO rt_map_table.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von RTTI für generische Datenkonvertierungen. Es wandelt eine interne Tabelle beliebiger Strukturen in eine Tabelle von Hash-Maps um. Dabei werden die Feldnamen und -werte jeder Zeile dynamisch zur Laufzeit ermittelt (`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT`) und in eine `HASHED TABLE` (Map) eingefügt. Dies ist sehr flexibel für Szenarien, in denen die Struktur der Daten zur Entwicklungszeit nicht bekannt ist.
keywords: RTTI, Generic Programming, Internal Table, Hash Map, Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Daten in eine JSON-Struktur, die nach Fluggesellschaften gruppiert ist, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft eine Liste ihrer Flüge enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck und `/UI2/CL_JSON`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_detail,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_grouped_sflights_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_sflights_json.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_carrier_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( VALUE #( carrier = ls_flight-carrid
                 flights = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
                   FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
                   ( connid = ls_member-connid fldate = ls_member-fldate price = ls_member-price )
                 )
               )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_json_writer) = /ui2/cl_json=>create_writer( ).
    lo_json_writer->write( lt_grouped_flights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_writer->get_json( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_sflights_json FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_sflights_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_grouped_sflights_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination des `GROUP BY` Ausdrucks für interne Tabellen mit der JSON-Serialisierung. Der `GROUP BY` Ausdruck ermöglicht es, Daten in einer internen Tabelle nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und dabei neue Strukturen zu bilden. Die resultierende verschachtelte Datenstruktur wird dann nahtlos von `/UI2/CL_JSON` in einen komplexen JSON-String umgewandelt, der die Gruppierung widerspiegelt. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Eingabe validiert. Wenn die Validierung fehlschlägt (z.B. ein leerer String übergeben wird), soll eine benutzerdefinierte statische Ausnahme (CX_STATIC_CHECK) ausgelöst werden. Die Ausnahmeklasse soll ZCX_DEMO_ERROR heißen und eine T100-Nachricht verwenden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ausnahmeklasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und das Interface `IF_T100_MESSAGE` implementiert. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_demo_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        !textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        !previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_demo_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_input.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durchführt. Wenn der Divisor Null ist, soll die vordefinierte dynamische Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ausgelöst werden. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme im Unit Test ab und überprüfen Sie den Ausnahmetyp.
hint: Die Division durch Null löst `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` automatisch aus. Sie müssen sie nicht explizit mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` auslösen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arith_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arith_errors.
    METHODS test_valid_division FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    TRY.
        lo_math->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE caught as expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arith_errors.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ABAP vordefinierte dynamische Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` automatisch auslöst, wenn eine ungültige Operation (Division durch Null) auftritt. Der Aufrufer kann diese Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH` abfangen. Die Deklaration `RAISING cx_sy_arith_errors` in der Methodensignatur ist eine gute Praxis, um dem Aufrufer mitzuteilen, welche Ausnahmen auftreten können.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme mit einer dynamisch generierten Nachricht auslöst. Verwenden Sie die `MESSAGE` Ergänzung der `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MESSAGE ID <msg_class> TYPE <msg_type> NUMBER <msg_no> WITH <var1> ... INTO DATA(lv_message_text)` und dann `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error MESSAGE lv_message_text`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS raise_with_dynamic_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD raise_with_dynamic_message.
    " Angenommen, es gibt eine Nachrichtenkasse ZMSG_DEMO mit Nachricht 001: 'Wert &1 ist ungültig'.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir die Nachrichtenerstellung.
    DATA(lv_message_text) = |Wert { iv_value } ist ungültig.|.

    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error
      MESSAGE lv_message_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_message_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_message_exception.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_message_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_test_value) = 'XYZ'.
    TRY.
        lo_handler->raise_with_dynamic_message( lv_test_value ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception with dynamic message' ).
      CATCH zcx_demo_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        DATA(lv_expected_message) = |Wert { lv_test_value } ist ungültig.|.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = lv_expected_message msg = 'Dynamic message text mismatch' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MESSAGE` Ergänzung der `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisung (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, eine Ausnahme mit einem dynamisch erzeugten Nachrichtentext auszulösen. Dies ist nützlich, um detaillierte Fehlerinformationen direkt in der Ausnahme zu kapseln, ohne eine T100-Nachricht in der Ausnahmeklasse selbst definieren zu müssen. Der Nachrichtentext kann zur Laufzeit basierend auf Kontextinformationen erstellt werden.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, MESSAGE, Dynamic Message, Exception Text

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Abfrage von Mitarbeiterdaten über einen OData-Dienst, ähnlich der Verwendung eines generierten Client-Proxys wie `cl_hcmfab_employee_api`. Die Lösung soll eine Methode zum Abfragen von Mitarbeitern bereitstellen und moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenverarbeitung verwenden.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und eine Mock-Implementierung, die die Methoden eines OData-Client-Proxys nachbildet. Verwenden Sie `VALUE #(...)` für die Rückgabe von Daten.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_odata_employee_api.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
           employee_id TYPE string,
           first_name  TYPE string,
           last_name   TYPE string,
           email       TYPE string,
         END OF ty_employee_data.
  TYPES: tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS query_employees
    IMPORTING
      iv_filter TYPE string OPTIONAL
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employee_data
    RAISING
      zcx_demo_error.

  METHODS create_employee
    IMPORTING
      is_employee_data TYPE ty_employee_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_created_employee) TYPE ty_employee_data
    RAISING
      zcx_demo_error.

  METHODS delete_employee
    IMPORTING
      iv_employee_id TYPE string
    RAISING
      zcx_demo_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_mock_odata_employee_api DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_odata_employee_api.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_odata_employee_api IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_odata_employee_api~query_employees.
    " Simulieren der OData-Abfragelogik
    IF iv_filter = 'error'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key.
    ENDIF.
    rt_employees = VALUE #( ( employee_id = '001' first_name = 'John' last_name = 'Doe' email = 'john.doe@example.com' )
                            ( employee_id = '002' first_name = 'Jane' last_name = 'Smith' email = 'jane.smith@example.com' )
                            ( employee_id = '003' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Jones' email = 'peter.jones@example.com' ) ).

    IF iv_filter IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_filter <> 'error'.
      rt_employees = FILTER #( rt_employees WHERE first_name = iv_filter ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_odata_employee_api~create_employee.
    " Simulieren der OData-Erstellungslogik
    IF is_employee_data-employee_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key.
    ENDIF.
    rs_created_employee = is_employee_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_odata_employee_api~delete_employee.
    " Simulieren der OData-Löschlogik
    IF iv_employee_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulieren der erfolgreichen Löschung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_all_employees

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_odata_client TYPE REF TO zif_odata_employee_api.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_odata_client = NEW zcl_mock_odata_employee_api( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_employees.
    rt_employees = mo_odata_client->query_employees( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine Summe von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle zu berechnen. Wenn während der Aggregation ein Wert gefunden wird, der einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck kann eine `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisung enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_with_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_with_threshold
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers    TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_with_threshold.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR num IN it_numbers
                       NEXT
                         s = COND i( WHEN num > iv_threshold THEN RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error
                                                                 EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key
                                    ELSE s + num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_reduce_with_exception=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_reducer->sum_with_threshold( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_threshold = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 6 msg = 'Valid sum incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_exception.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_reduce_with_exception=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 10 ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_reducer->sum_with_threshold( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_threshold = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for value above threshold' ).
      CATCH zcx_demo_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE`-Ausdrücken mit integrierter Ausnahmebehandlung. Innerhalb des `COND`-Ausdrucks kann eine `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisung verwendet werden, um die Aggregation abzubrechen und einen Fehler zu signalisieren, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist. Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur gültige Einträge aus einer Quelltabelle enthält. Wenn ein ungültiger Eintrag gefunden wird, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, anstatt ihn zu überspringen.
hint: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck kann eine `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisung innerhalb eines `COND`-Ausdrucks enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_with_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_valid_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_with_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_valid_data.
    rt_filtered_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_source_data
                                 ( COND #( WHEN ls_data-value IS INITIAL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error
                                                                             EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key
                                          ELSE ls_data ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Ressource (simuliert durch eine Variable) allokiert und dann eine Ausnahme auslöst. Verwenden Sie einen `CLEANUP`-Block, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ressource auch im Fehlerfall ordnungsgemäß freigegeben wird.
hint: Strukturieren Sie den Code mit `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_with_cleanup
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleanup_executed) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_cleanup.
    DATA(lv_resource_allocated) = abap_false.
    rv_cleanup_executed = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Ressource allokieren
        lv_resource_allocated = abap_true.

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key.
        ENDIF.

        " Normale Verarbeitung

      CATCH zcx_demo_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key.

      CLEANUP.
        " Ressource freigeben, unabhängig davon, ob ein Fehler aufgetreten ist
        IF lv_resource_allocated = abap_true.
          rv_cleanup_executed = abap_true.
          " Hier würde die tatsächliche Freigabe der Ressource erfolgen
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_error FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_demo_error.
    METHODS test_cleanup_no_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_cleanup_executed) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lv_cleanup_executed = lo_demo->process_with_cleanup( abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_demo_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_cleanup_executed exp = abap_true msg = 'Cleanup not executed on error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_no_error.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_cleanup_executed) = lo_demo->process_with_cleanup( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_cleanup_executed exp = abap_true msg = 'Cleanup not executed without error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block in einem `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP`-Konstrukt ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Ressourcenfreigabe. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, unabhängig davon, ob dies durch eine Ausnahme oder durch normalen Programmfluss geschieht. Dies garantiert, dass allokierte Ressourcen (z.B. Datenbankverbindungen, Dateihandles) ordnungsgemäß geschlossen oder freigegeben werden, was die Robustheit und Stabilität der Anwendung erhöht.
keywords: CLEANUP, Exception Handling, TRY, CATCH, Resource Management

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Strings verarbeitet. Wenn ein String in der Liste länger als ein bestimmtes Maximum ist, soll eine Ausnahme vom Typ `CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `STRLEN` und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_length_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_string_lengths
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_max_length TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_length_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_string_lengths.
    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      IF strlen( lv_string ) > iv_max_length.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds=>out_of_bounds
            value  = lv_string.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Kette von Ausnahmen (Exception Chaining) demonstriert. Eine niedrigere Ebene soll eine spezifische Ausnahme auslösen, die von einer höheren Ebene abgefangen und in eine allgemeinere, benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme gekapselt wird, bevor sie weitergegeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `PREVIOUS` Parameter im Konstruktor der Ausnahmeklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS low_level_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arith_errors.

    METHODS high_level_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD low_level_operation.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulierte Operation
    DATA(result) = 100 / iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD high_level_operation.
    TRY.
        low_level_operation( iv_value ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arith_errors INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_demo_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_demo_error=>if_t100_message~t100key
            previous = lx_arith.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_exception_chaining FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_demo_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_chaining.
    DATA(lo_chain) = NEW zcl_exception_chaining( ).
    TRY.
        lo_chain->high_level_operation( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected high-level exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_demo_error INTO DATA(lx_demo).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'High-level exception caught as expected' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_demo->previous exp = abap_true msg = 'Previous exception not found' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_demo->previous->get_class_name( ) exp = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE' msg = 'Previous exception type mismatch' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Exception Chaining ist eine bewährte Methode, um die Ursache eines Fehlers über mehrere Schichten hinweg zu verfolgen. Eine spezifische Ausnahme auf einer niedrigeren Ebene wird von einer höheren Ebene abgefangen und in eine allgemeinere, kontextbezogene Ausnahme gekapselt, wobei die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' Ausnahme beibehalten wird. Dies ermöglicht es, detaillierte Fehlerinformationen zu bewahren, während die Schnittstelle der aufrufenden Schicht sauber bleibt. Der `PREVIOUS` Parameter im Konstruktor der Ausnahmeklasse ist hierfür entscheidend.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Exception Chaining, PREVIOUS, TRY, CATCH, Error Propagation

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für 'heiße' und 'kalte' Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`. 'Heiße' Flüge sind solche, die in der Zukunft liegen, 'kalte' Flüge sind in der Vergangenheit. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer Bedingung für das Flugdatum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_agg_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_summary,
             category TYPE string,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_summary.
    TYPES tt_passenger_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passenger_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_passenger_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_agg_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_summary.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lv_hot_passengers) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( fldate > iv_current_date )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).

    DATA(lv_cold_passengers) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( fldate <= iv_current_date )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).

    APPEND VALUE ty_passenger_summary( category = 'HOT' total_passengers = lv_hot_passengers ) TO rt_summary.
    APPEND VALUE ty_passenger_summary( category = 'COLD' total_passengers = lv_cold_passengers ) TO rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_passenger_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_agg_passengers( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_passenger_summary( lv_current_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 msg = 'Summary should have 2 categories' ).

    DATA(ls_hot_summary) = lt_summary[ category = 'HOT' ].
    DATA(ls_cold_summary) = lt_summary[ category = 'COLD' ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_hot_summary-total_passengers msg = 'Hot passengers should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_cold_summary-total_passengers msg = 'Cold passengers should not be initial' ).

    DATA lv_total_sflight_passengers TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_total_sflight_passengers.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_hot_summary-total_passengers + ls_cold_summary-total_passengers
                                        exp = lv_total_sflight_passengers
                                        msg = 'Sum of hot and cold passengers must match total' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. Durch die Kombination mit `FOR` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung können 'heiße' und 'kalte' Daten (simuliert durch das Flugdatum) getrennt summiert werden. `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für funktionale Aggregationen in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Identifizieren Sie 'heiße' Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` basierend auf einer Kombination aus Flugdatum (Zukunft) und einer hohen Auslastung (simuliert > 80% der Sitze belegt). Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung und einer `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_hot_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_hot_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_hot_flight.
    TYPES tt_hot_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_hot_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_demand_hot_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_date TYPE d
        iv_min_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hot_flights) TYPE tt_hot_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_hot_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_demand_hot_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_hot_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                               WHERE ( fldate > iv_current_date AND
                                       ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 / ls_flight-seatsmax ) > iv_min_occupancy )
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                 fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                 occupancy_rate = ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 / ls_flight-seatsmax ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_demand_hot_flights( iv_current_date = lv_current_date iv_min_occupancy = lv_min_occupancy ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Should find some high demand hot flights' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate > lv_current_date ) msg = 'Flight date must be in the future' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-occupancy_rate > lv_min_occupancy ) msg = 'Occupancy rate must be high' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Es kombiniert Filterbedingungen (Flugdatum in der Zukunft) mit einer komplexeren Logik (Auslastung über einem Schwellenwert), um 'heiße' Flüge mit hoher Nachfrage zu identifizieren. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch die Daten-Temperatur für ein Objekt abfragt, dessen Typ und Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.

CLASS zcl_dat_dynamic_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_object_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_name TYPE string
        iv_object_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_dynamic_temp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_object_temperature.
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string VALUE 'GET_TEMPERATURE_FOR_OBJECT'.
    DATA lt_parameters  TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter   TYPE abap_parmbind.
    DATA lr_result      TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE DATA lr_result TYPE string.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_OBJECT_NAME'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_object_name INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_OBJECT_TYPE'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_object_type INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD ('CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE')=>(lv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            RESULT lr_result.

        rv_temperature = lr_result->*.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        rv_temperature = |Dynamischer Aufruffehler: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_abap_data_aging_error INTO DATA(lx_aging_error).
        rv_temperature = |Datenalterungsfehler: { lx_aging_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_flight_hot_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flügen aus `SFLIGHT` und fügen Sie eine Spalte für die 'Temperaturkategorie' hinzu ('HOT' für zukünftige Flüge, 'COLD' für vergangene Flüge).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und einer `IF`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_flight_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_category,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_flight_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_category.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                            ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                              connid = ls_flight-connid,
                              fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                              category = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-fldate > iv_current_date THEN 'HOT' ELSE 'COLD' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_categories.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_flight_category( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_category( lv_current_date ).

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Betreff, einem Text und einem Text-Anhang (z.B. eine interne Tabelle als CSV-Inhalt) an einen Empfänger.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS` für den Haupttext und ein weiteres für den Anhang. Verwenden Sie `ADD_ATTACHMENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_with_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body      TYPE string
        it_attachment_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_attachment_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_with_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA(lv_attachment_name) = COND string( WHEN iv_attachment_name IS INITIAL THEN 'attachment.csv' ELSE iv_attachment_name ).

    " Haupt-Dokument erstellen
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                           i_type    = 'RAW'
                           i_text    = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( iv_body )
                           i_subject = iv_subject ).

    " Anhang-Inhalt erstellen (z.B. CSV aus interner Tabelle)
    DATA(lv_attachment_content) = VALUE string( FOR <fs> IN it_attachment_data SEPARATED BY cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
                                                ( |{ <fs>-field1 },{ <fs>-field2 }| ) ).
    DATA(lt_attachment_content_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_attachment_content ).

    " Anhang-Dokument erstellen
    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                             i_type    = 'RAW' " Oder 'BIN' für Binärdateien
                             i_text    = lt_attachment_content_x
                             i_length  = xstrlen( lt_attachment_content_x )
                             i_subject = lv_attachment_name ).

    " Anhang zum Haupt-Dokument hinzufügen
    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment = lo_attachment
      i_attachment_type = 'CSV' " Oder 'TXT', 'PDF', etc.
      i_attachment_size = xstrlen( lt_attachment_content_x )
      i_attachment_filename = lv_attachment_name ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).

    lo_send_request->send( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger (TO, CC, BCC).

CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ad_smtpadr WITH EMPTY KEY.
