      IMPORTING
        it_to_recipients  TYPE tt_recipients
        it_cc_recipients  TYPE tt_recipients OPTIONAL
        it_bcc_recipients TYPE tt_recipients OPTIONAL
        iv_subject        TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body           TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_multi_recipient.
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                           i_type    = 'RAW'
                           i_text    = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( iv_body )
                           i_subject = iv_subject ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " TO-Empfänger hinzufügen
    LOOP AT it_to_recipients INTO DATA(lv_to_recipient).
      DATA(lo_to_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_to_recipient ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_to_recipient i_express = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " CC-Empfänger hinzufügen
    LOOP AT it_cc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_cc_recipient).
      DATA(lo_cc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_cc_recipient ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_cc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " BCC-Empfänger hinzufügen
    LOOP AT it_bcc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_bcc_recipient).
      DATA(lo_bcc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_bcc_recipient ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_blind_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. `SFLIGHT`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG=>CREATE_DATA_TABLE` und Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_create_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    " Dynamische interne Tabelle erstellen
    ro_table_ref = cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data_table( iv_struct_name ).
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Beispiel: Daten hinzufügen (optional)
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ) =>*.
        DATA(lo_line_ref) = cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data_ref( iv_struct_name ).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO <fs_line>.

        " Nur für SFLIGHT-Beispiel
        IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur oder Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu und ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_access_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        io_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_access_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Referenz ist ungültig
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Wert dynamisch setzen
      <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      " Komponente nicht gefunden
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_component_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_access_component( ).
    DATA ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_access_component=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-id = 1.
    ls_test_data-name = 'Old Name'.
    ls_test_data-value = 'Old Value'.

    DATA(lo_data_ref) = REF #( ls_test_data ).

    " Test 1: Erfolgreiche Änderung
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_component_value(
      io_data_ref  = lo_data_ref
      iv_component = 'NAME'
      iv_new_value = 'New Name'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_test_data-name exp = 'New Name' ).

    " Test 2: Komponente nicht gefunden
    lv_success = lo_cut->set_component_value(
      io_data_ref  = lo_data_ref
      iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT_COMPONENT'
      iv_new_value = 'Any Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).

    " Test 3: Exception bei ungültiger Referenz (nicht direkt testbar ohne Mocking)
    DATA lo_invalid_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_component_value(
          io_data_ref  = lo_invalid_ref
          iv_component = 'NAME'
          iv_new_value = 'New Name'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for invalid reference' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` ist hierfür das Schlüsselwerkzeug. Dies ermöglicht es, generischen Code zu schreiben, der zur Laufzeit auf beliebige Felder zugreifen und diese manipulieren kann, ohne deren Namen oder Typen im Voraus zu kennen. Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_class_name)=>(lv_method_name)` oder `CALL METHOD lo_object->(lv_method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_call_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

    METHODS static_test_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS instance_test_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_call_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class_ref TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.

    IF iv_param_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
      ls_parameter-kind = abap_parm_input.
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
      INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        " Versuche, eine statische Methode aufzurufen
        CALL METHOD (iv_class_name)=>(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS
            FIELD rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Wenn statischer Aufruf fehlschlägt, versuche Instanzmethode
        CREATE OBJECT lo_class_ref TYPE (iv_class_name).
        CALL METHOD lo_class_ref->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS
            FIELD rv_result.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD static_test_method.
    rv_output = |Static: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD instance_test_method.
    rv_output = |Instance: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_call_method( ).
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    " Test 1: Statische Methode dynamisch aufrufen
    lv_result = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYN_CALL_METHOD'
      iv_method_name = 'STATIC_TEST_METHOD'
      iv_param_value = 'Hello Static'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Static: Hello Static' ).

    " Test 2: Instanzmethode dynamisch aufrufen
    lv_result = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYN_CALL_METHOD'
      iv_method_name = 'INSTANCE_TEST_METHOD'
      iv_param_value = 'Hello Instance'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Instance: Hello Instance' ).

    " Test 3: Nicht existierende Methode
    TRY.
        lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYN_CALL_METHOD'
          iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
          iv_param_value = 'Test'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_call_error for non-existent method' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Methoden dynamisch zur Laufzeit aufruft, sowohl statische als auch Instanzmethoden. Die Syntax `CALL METHOD (lv_class_name)=>(lv_method_name)` und `CALL METHOD lo_object->(lv_method_name)` ist hierfür entscheidend. Parameter werden über eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `abap_parmbind_tab` übergeben. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das in Frameworks oder bei der Implementierung von Plugins und Erweiterungen verwendet wird, wo die aufzurufende Logik erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Dynamic Call, CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG, Metaprogramming, RTTI

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feldnamen durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit dem Zusatz `BY (lv_field_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        io_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN io_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_dynamic FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_sort_table( ).
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE zcl_dyn_sort_table=>tt_sflight_data.

    " Testdaten
    lt_sflight = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250105' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_table_ref) = REF #( lt_sflight ).
    DATA lv_success TYPE abap_bool.

    " Test 1: Sortierung nach CARRID
    lv_success = lo_cut->sort_dynamic(
      io_table_ref = lo_table_ref
      iv_field_name = 'CARRID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Test 2: Sortierung nach PRICE (absteigend)
    lv_success = lo_cut->sort_dynamic(
      io_table_ref = lo_table_ref
      iv_field_name = 'PRICE DESCENDING'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-price exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 2 ]-price exp = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 3 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).

    " Test 3: Ungültiger Feldname
    lv_success = lo_cut->sort_dynamic(
      io_table_ref = lo_table_ref
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle. Der Zusatz `BY (lv_field_name)` in der `SORT`-Anweisung ermöglicht es, den Sortierkriterium (Feldname und optional die Sortierreihenfolge) zur Laufzeit zu übergeben. Dies ist ein sehr nützliches Feature für generische Berichte oder Tools, bei denen der Benutzer die Sortierung selbst definieren kann. Die Verwendung von `REF #()` für die Referenzübergabe ist moderne ABAP-Syntax.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG=>CREATE_DATA_TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_var_cols_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table_with_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_var_cols_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table_with_fields.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      " Standardtyp für Einfachheit, könnte auch dynamisch bestimmt werden
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    ro_table_ref = cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data_table( lo_table_descr ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table_with_fields FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table_with_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_var_cols_table( ).
    DATA lo_table_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE zcl_dyn_var_cols_table=>tt_field_names(
      ( 'FIELD_A' ) ( 'FIELD_B' ) ( 'FIELD_C' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_table_ref = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table_with_fields( lt_fields ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_table_ref ).

        ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_table> ).

        " Zeile hinzufügen und Felder setzen (Beispiel)
        CREATE DATA lo_data_ref LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_line>.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = 'Value A'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = 'Value B'. ENDIF.

        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 1 ).
        READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_component> exp = 'Value A' ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation INTO DATA(lx_struct_creation).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception: { lx_struct_creation->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung: die Erstellung einer internen Tabelle, deren Struktur (Anzahl und Namen der Spalten) zur Laufzeit definiert wird. Dies wird durch die Kombination von RTTI-Klassen (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) zur Definition des Typs und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data_table` zur Instanziierung der Tabelle erreicht. Dies ist extrem nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitung, z.B. beim Import von Dateien mit variablen Spalten oder bei der Erstellung von dynamischen Berichten.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, Dynamic Table, Variable Columns

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle, deren Name und die zu lesenden Felder zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit dynamischen Zusätzen `FROM (lv_table_name)` und `FIELDS (lt_field_names)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_dynamic_db_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name  TYPE tabname
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_db_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    " Dynamische interne Tabelle für die Ergebnisse erstellen
    DATA(lo_dyn_table_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_var_cols_table( ). " Wiederverwendung des vorherigen Beispiels
    ro_table_ref = lo_dyn_table_creator->create_dynamic_table_with_fields( it_field_names ).
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    DATA(lv_fields_string) = VALUE string( FOR <fs> IN it_field_names SEPARATED BY ',' ( <fs> ) ).

    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_fields_string)
          FROM (iv_table_name)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <fs_table>.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_read_dynamic_db_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_dynamic_db_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_db( ).
    DATA lo_table_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE zcl_dyn_select_db=>tt_field_names(
      ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_table_ref = lo_cut->read_dynamic_db_table(
          iv_table_name  = 'SFLIGHT'
          it_field_names = lt_fields
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_table_ref ).

        ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 0 ).

        READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_component> ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception: { lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das dynamische Lesen von Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle. Sowohl der Tabellenname als auch die auszuwählenden Felder werden zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben. Die `SELECT`-Anweisung verwendet die dynamischen Zusätze `FROM (lv_table_name)` und `(lv_fields_string)`. Die Ergebnisse werden in eine zuvor dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle geschrieben. Dies ist ein Kernstück vieler generischer Reporting- oder Datenmigrationswerkzeuge.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Dynamic SQL, SELECT, FROM (table), FIELDS (fields), CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG, RTTI, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine WHERE-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung basierend auf einer Liste von Bedingungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG=>CHECK_WHERE_CLAUSE` und `SELECT ... WHERE (lv_where_clause)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_where_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_dynamic_where
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        it_conditions TYPE tt_conditions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_where_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_where.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    " Dynamische interne Tabelle für die Ergebnisse erstellen (z.B. SFLIGHT-Struktur)
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ) =>*.
    ro_table_ref = cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data_table( lo_struct_descr ).
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    DATA(lv_where_clause) = VALUE string( FOR <fs> IN it_conditions SEPARATED BY ' AND ' ( <fs> ) ).

    " Optional: WHERE-Klausel auf Syntaxfehler prüfen
    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_where_clause(
      i_where_clause = lv_where_clause
      i_tab_name     = iv_table_name
    ).

    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <fs_table>
          WHERE (lv_where_clause).

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_dynamic_where FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_where_clause( ).
    DATA lo_table_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    DATA(lt_conditions) = VALUE zcl_dyn_where_clause=>tt_conditions(
      ( `CARRID = 'LH'` )
      ( `CONNID = '0400'` )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_table_ref = lo_cut->read_dynamic_where(
          iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'
          it_conditions = lt_conditions
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_table_ref ).

        ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 1 " Erwartet 1 Zeile für LH 0400" ).

        " Test 2: Ungültige Bedingung
        DATA(lt_invalid_conditions) = VALUE zcl_dyn_where_clause=>tt_conditions(
          ( `NON_EXISTENT_FIELD = 'X'` )
        ).
        TRY.
            lo_cut->read_dynamic_where(
              iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'
              it_conditions = lt_invalid_conditions
            ).
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error for invalid WHERE clause' ).
          CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception: { lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamische WHERE-Klauseln für `SELECT`-Anweisungen erstellt und verwendet. Die Bedingungen werden als Strings in einer internen Tabelle gesammelt und dann zu einem einzigen WHERE-String zusammengefügt. Die Methode `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_where_clause` kann verwendet werden, um die Syntax der dynamischen WHERE-Klausel vor der Ausführung zu validieren. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Abfragen, z.B. in Suchhilfen oder generischen Berichten.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Dynamic SQL, WHERE, CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG, CHECK_WHERE_CLAUSE, SELECT, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und bereiten Sie diese für eine Diagrammdarstellung vor.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Daten zu aggregieren, und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        count  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE ty_flight_data_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE ty_flight_data_tab(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_flight_data_tab( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(group)
      LET existing_entry = result[ carrid = group-carrid ] IN
      IF existing_entry IS INITIAL.
        result = VALUE #( result ( carrid = group-carrid count = 1 ) ).
      ELSE.
        result = VALUE #( FOR entry IN result
                          ( COND #( WHEN entry-carrid = group-carrid THEN VALUE #( entry-carrid = entry-carrid count = entry-count + 1 ) ELSE entry ) ) ).
      ENDIF
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_chart_data_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_aggregator->get_aggregated_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) IS INITIAL ).

    DATA(ls_lh_data) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_lh_data-count IS INITIAL ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit `GROUP BY` und dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Datenverarbeitung, die ideal für die Vorbereitung von Daten für UI-Elemente wie Diagramme ist.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Aggregation, sflights, cl_gui_chart_engine

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Fehlermeldung ab und wandeln Sie diese in eine Ausnahme um, die dann geworfen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MESSAGE ... INTO ...` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_to_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_to_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      MESSAGE E001(sy) WITH 'Input cannot be negative' INTO DATA(lv_error_message).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_static_check=>default_text
          previous = NEW cx_sy_message_in_a_no_display( textid = cx_sy_message_in_a_no_display=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        simulate_error( iv_input ).
      CATCH cx_sy_message_in_a_no_display.
        DATA(lv_message_text) = sy-msgv1 && sy-msgv2 && sy-msgv3 && sy-msgv4.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_static_check=>default_text
            previous = NEW cx_sy_message_in_a_no_display( textid = cx_sy_message_in_a_no_display=>default_text ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_error.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      MESSAGE E000(sy) WITH 'Simulated error: Input is zero' INTO DATA(lv_msg).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_message_in_a_no_display.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie den Preis jedes Fluges in `sflights` um 10% erhöhen und nur Flüge mit einem neuen Preis über 500 EUR berücksichtigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und einer Inline-Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transform_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        price  TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_price,
      ty_flight_price_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_increased_price_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE ty_flight_price_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_increased_price_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      LET new_price = flight-price * '1.10' IN
                                      WHERE ( new_price > 500 )
                                      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                        connid = flight-connid,
                                        price  = new_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` für die dynamische Typdefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " Example: all fields are string
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
          IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_field> = |Value for { lv_field_name }|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND 'FIELD_B' TO lt_fields.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_ref) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <lt_table> IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 1 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_a>).
      IF <fs_field_a> IS ASSIGNED.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_a> exp = 'Value for FIELD_A' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Summation und teilen Sie durch die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und fügen Sie jede Datei einzeln mit CL_ABAP_ZIP->ADD hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_multi_files DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_data,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_data.
    TYPES tt_file_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_zip_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_files IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_table.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( ls_file-content )->to_xstring( ).
      lo_zip->add(
        i_name = ls_file-name
        i_content = lv_xstring_content
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( name = 'file1.txt' content = 'Inhalt der ersten Datei.' )
      ( name = 'file2.txt' content = 'Zweiter Dateiinhalt hier.' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_zip_data ).

    DATA(lo_decompressor) = NEW zcl_zip_decompress_string( ).

    DATA(lv_content2) = lo_decompressor->decompress_string( lv_zip_data, 'file2.txt' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content1 exp = 'Inhalt der ersten Datei.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content2 exp = 'Zweiter Dateiinhalt hier.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verschieben Sie eine Zeichenkette nach links, bis ein bestimmtes Zeichen am Anfang steht, und geben Sie den Rest der Zeichenkette zurück. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie SHIFT LEFT UP TO und String-Funktionen wie SUBSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_up_to DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_substring_after_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_char  TYPE c
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_up_to IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_substring_after_char.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input.
    SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT UP TO iv_char.
    " After shifting, the character is at the beginning, so we take the rest
    IF lv_temp_string IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_temp_string(1) = iv_char.
      rv_result = lv_temp_string+1. " Take substring from second character
    ELSE.
      rv_result = lv_temp_string. " Character not found or empty string
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_substring_after_char FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_substring_after_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_up_to( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_substring_after_char( iv_input = 'ABC-DEF' iv_char = '-' ) exp = 'DEF' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_substring_after_char( iv_input = 'XYZ' iv_char = 'Y' ) exp = 'Z' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_substring_after_char( iv_input = '12345' iv_char = 'X' ) exp = '12345' ). " Char not found
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_substring_after_char( iv_input = '-START' iv_char = '-' ) exp = 'START' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_substring_after_char( iv_input = '' iv_char = '-' ) exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: SHIFT LEFT UP TO verschiebt eine Zeichenkette, bis das angegebene Zeichen an der ersten Position steht. In Kombination mit der Offset- und Längenangabe für Strings kann der gewünschte Teil extrahiert werden. Dies ist eine performante Alternative zu FIND und SUBSTRING für diesen spezifischen Anwendungsfall.
keywords: SHIFT, String Processing, UP TO, SUBSTRING

Instructions: Entfernen Sie die ersten N Zeichen einer Zeichenkette und ersetzen Sie diese durch einen neuen Präfix, alles in einem modernen Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie SHIFT LEFT BY N PLACES und String-Operatoren wie && oder String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_replace_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_input      TYPE string
        iv_num_chars  TYPE i
        iv_new_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_replace_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_prefix.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input.
    SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT BY iv_num_chars PLACES.
    rv_output = iv_new_prefix && lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_prefix.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_replace_prefix( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->replace_prefix( iv_input = 'OLD_PREFIX_VALUE' iv_num_chars = 9 iv_new_prefix = 'NEW_' ) exp = 'NEW_VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->replace_prefix( iv_input = 'ABC' iv_num_chars = 1 iv_new_prefix = 'X' ) exp = 'XBC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->replace_prefix( iv_input = 'ABC' iv_num_chars = 3 iv_new_prefix = 'XYZ' ) exp = 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->replace_prefix( iv_input = 'ABC' iv_num_chars = 5 iv_new_prefix = 'XYZ' ) exp = 'XYZ' ). " Shift beyond length

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie SHIFT verwendet werden kann, um einen Teil einer Zeichenkette zu entfernen, der dann mit einem neuen Präfix durch den String-Verkettungsoperator (&&) kombiniert wird. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, String-Manipulationen durchzuführen.
keywords: SHIFT, String Processing, Replace Prefix, String Concatenation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv aus Daten der Tabelle SFLIGHT, wobei jede Zeile als separate Textdatei im ZIP-Archiv gespeichert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_ZIP und iterieren Sie über SFLIGHT, um jede Zeile als String zu formatieren und hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_zip_from_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_content) = |CARRID: { ls_sflight-carrid }, CONNID: { ls_sflight-connid }, FLDATE: { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|.
      DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_content )->to_xstring( ).
      lo_zip->add(
        i_name = |sflight_{ lv_counter }.txt|
        i_content = lv_xstring_content
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_zip_from_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_zip_from_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_zip_data) = lo_cut->create_zip_from_sflight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_zip_data ).

    DATA(lo_decompressor) = NEW zcl_zip_list_files( ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_decompressor->list_zip_files( lv_zip_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_files ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_files[ 1 ] exp = 'sflight_1.txt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration von CL_ABAP_ZIP mit Datenbankzugriff und String-Templates. Daten aus der SFLIGHT-Tabelle werden gelesen, jede Zeile wird zu einem String formatiert und als separate Datei in einem ZIP-Archiv gespeichert. Dies zeigt eine praktische Anwendung für das Exportieren von Berichtsdaten.
keywords: CL_ABAP_ZIP, SFLIGHT, Internal Table, XSTRING, String Templates, Database Access

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens aus einer Zeichenkette, indem Sie SHIFT in einer Schleife verwenden und das Ergebnis mit String-Templates formatieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING und eine DO-Schleife oder FIND/REPLACE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_remove_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_char  TYPE c
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_remove_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_char.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_char_to_delete) = iv_char.

    DO.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_char_to_delete IN SECTION OFFSET 0 OF lv_temp_string.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT BY sy-fdpos + 1 PLACES.
        SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT DELETING LEADING lv_char_to_delete.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rv_output = |Bereinigter String: '{ lv_temp_string }'|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_char FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_remove_char( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_char( iv_input = 'A-B-C' iv_char = '-' ) exp = `Bereinigter String: 'ABC'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_char( iv_input = 'Hello World' iv_char = 'o' ) exp = `Bereinigter String: 'Hell Wrld'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_char( iv_input = '12345' iv_char = '0' ) exp = `Bereinigter String: '12345'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_char( iv_input = 'XXXXX' iv_char = 'X' ) exp = `Bereinigter String: ''` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_char( iv_input = '' iv_char = 'A' ) exp = `Bereinigter String: ''` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine manuelle Implementierung des Entfernens aller Vorkommen eines Zeichens mit SHIFT in einer DO-Schleife. Obwohl FIND/REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES effizienter wäre, demonstriert es die flexible Anwendung von SHIFT. Das Ergebnis wird mit einem String-Template formatiert.
keywords: SHIFT, String Processing, Remove Character, Loop, String Templates

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Zeichenkette um eine variable Anzahl von Positionen nach links verschiebt und dabei die verschobenen Zeichen am Ende wieder anhängt (zirkulär). Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-String-Funktionen und -Operatoren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie SHIFT LEFT BY mit String-Operatoren oder String-Funktionen wie SUBSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_circular_left DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_circular_left
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_places TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_circular_left IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_circular_left.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL OR iv_places <= 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    DATA(lv_actual_places) = iv_places MOD lv_length.

    IF lv_actual_places = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_shifted_part) = iv_input(lv_actual_places).
    DATA(lv_remaining_part) = iv_input+lv_actual_places.

    rv_output = lv_remaining_part && lv_shifted_part.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shift_circular_left FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_circular_left.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_circular_left( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_places = 1 ) exp = 'BCDEA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_places = 3 ) exp = 'DEABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_places = 5 ) exp = 'ABCDE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input = 'X' iv_places = 1 ) exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input = '' iv_places = 1 ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_places = 0 ) exp = 'ABCDE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_places = 6 ) exp = 'BCDEA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert eine zirkuläre Verschiebung nach links ohne das SHIFT CIRCULAR-Statement, indem es moderne String-Funktionen wie STRLEN und Offset-/Längenangaben sowie den String-Verkettungsoperator (&&) verwendet. Dies ist oft flexibler und lesbarer für komplexere String-Manipulationen.
keywords: SHIFT, String Processing, Circular Shift, Left Shift, STRLEN, SUBSTRING, String Concatenation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv, das eine interne Tabelle von strukturierten Daten (z.B. SFLIGHT) als JSON-Datei enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_ZIP und die Klasse CL_ABAP_CONV_JSON für die JSON-Serialisierung.

CLASS zcl_zip_json_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS create_zip_with_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_json_export IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_json=>create(
      pretty_printer = abap_true
    )->serialize( data = lt_sflight ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_json_string )->to_xstring( ).

    lo_zip->add(
      i_name = 'sflight_data.json'
      i_content = lv_xstring_content
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_create_zip_with_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_json_export( ).
    DATA(lv_zip_data) = lo_cut->create_zip_with_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_zip_data ).

    DATA(lo_decompressor) = NEW zcl_zip_decompress_string( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Erstellung eines ZIP-Archivs mit der JSON-Serialisierung von ABAP-Daten. Die Klasse CL_ABAP_CONV_JSON wird verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle (hier SFLIGHT) in einen JSON-String zu konvertieren, der dann als Datei in das ZIP-Archiv aufgenommen wird. Dies ist ideal für den Export strukturierter Daten in einem standardisierten Format.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei die Feldnamen identisch sind, unter Verwendung des modernen `CORRESPONDING` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für eine einfache Zuweisung von Strukturen oder internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_basic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
           END OF ty_sflight_target.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_t_sflight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_t_sflight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_basic_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING currency = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_sflights.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_cor_basic_mapping=>ty_t_sflight_source,
          ls_source LIKE LINE OF lt_source.

    ls_source = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_basic_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_sflights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und typsichere Zuweisung von Komponenten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen. Hier wird zusätzlich ein Feld (`currency`) mit einem konstanten Wert belegt, was die Flexibilität demonstriert.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Mapping, Zuweisung

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Feldzuweisung zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, bei der die zugeordneten Felder zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` und seine Methoden, um Mapping-Regeln dynamisch zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE string,
             value_x TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_a TYPE string,
             target_b TYPE string,
             value_y  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
        it_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = is_source
      destination = rs_target
      mapping     = it_mapping_rules
    ).
    lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = is_source IMPORTING destination = rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_mapping.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_cor_dynamic_mapping=>ty_source,
          lt_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_cor_dynamic_mapping=>ty_target.

    ls_source = VALUE #( field_a = 'Hello' field_b = 'World' value_x = 123 ).

    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'FIELD_A' destination_name = 'TARGET_A' ) TO lt_mapping_rules.
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'VALUE_X' destination_name = 'VALUE_Y' ) TO lt_mapping_rules.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_dynamic_mapping( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_dynamically( is_source = ls_source it_mapping_rules = lt_mapping_rules ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_a exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-value_y exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-target_b ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_corresponding` ermöglicht die Definition von Mapping-Regeln zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Feldzuordnung nicht fest codiert werden kann, z.B. bei generischen Programmen oder Schnittstellen, die dynamische Feldnamen verwenden. Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator selbst kann dies nicht dynamisch, aber die Klasse bietet die notwendige Funktionalität.
keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, Dynamic Programming, Mapping, Zuweisung von Komponenten mit dynamischem Mapping

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei bestimmte Felder vom Mapping ausgeschlossen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `EXCEPT` Klausel im `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_except_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES ty_t_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_t_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_with_except
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_t_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_t_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_except_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_except.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source EXCEPT status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_except_clause FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_except_clause.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_cor_except_clause=>ty_t_source,
          ls_source LIKE LINE OF lt_source.

    ls_source = VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item A' status = 'NEW' value = 100 ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_except_clause( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_with_except( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-status ). "Status should be initial
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `EXCEPT` Klausel im `CORRESPONDING` Operator bietet eine einfache Möglichkeit, bestimmte Felder vom automatischen Mapping auszuschließen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn Felder im Ziel eine andere Logik oder Initialisierung erfordern.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, EXCEPT, Internal Tables, Mapping

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Zuweisung zwischen Strukturen durch, wobei ein Feld im Ziel basierend auf einer Transformation des Quellfeldes befüllt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `USING` Klausel im `CORRESPONDING` Operator, um eine Methode für die Transformation aufzurufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_using_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             amount TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             total_amount TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_with_using
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS format_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount TYPE s_price
        iv_currency TYPE s_curr_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_amount) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_using_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_using.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source USING format_amount = total_amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_amount.
    rv_formatted_amount = |{ iv_amount } { iv_currency }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_using_clause FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_using_clause.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_cor_using_clause=>ty_source.
    ls_source = VALUE #( amount = '123.45' currency = 'USD' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_using_clause( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_with_using( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-total_amount exp = '123.45 USD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `USING` Klausel im `CORRESPONDING` Operator ermöglicht die Anwendung einer Methode zur Transformation von Quellfeldern, bevor sie dem Zielfeld zugewiesen werden. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion für komplexe Mapping-Szenarien und fördert sauberen, funktionalen Code.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, USING, Transformation, Mapping, String Templates

Instructions: Führen Sie ein Mapping zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, wobei die Quellfelder andere Namen als die Zielfelder haben und eine explizite Zuweisung erforderlich ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `MAPPING` Klausel im `CORRESPONDING` Operator, um Feldnamen explizit zuzuordnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_mapping_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_travel_info,
             airline_code TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             travel_date TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_travel_info.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_t_travel_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_travel_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_to_travel
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE ty_t_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_travel_info) TYPE ty_t_travel_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_mapping_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_to_travel.
    rt_travel_info = CORRESPONDING #( it_flight_data MAPPING airline_code = carrier_id
                                                      connection_id = flight_num
                                                      travel_date = flight_date
                                      MAPPING status = 'CONFIRMED' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mapping_clause FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping_clause.
    DATA: lt_flight_data TYPE zcl_cor_mapping_clause=>ty_t_flight_data,
          ls_flight_data LIKE LINE OF lt_flight_data.

    ls_flight_data = VALUE #( carrier_id = 'AA' flight_num = '0017' flight_date = sy-datum ).
    APPEND ls_flight_data TO lt_flight_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_mapping_clause( ).
    DATA(lt_travel_info) = lo_cut->map_flight_to_travel( lt_flight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_travel_info ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_travel_info[ 1 ]-airline_code exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_travel_info[ 1 ]-connection_id exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_travel_info[ 1 ]-travel_date exp = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_travel_info[ 1 ]-status exp = 'CONFIRMED' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MAPPING` Klausel im `CORRESPONDING` Operator erlaubt die explizite Zuordnung von Quell- und Zielfeldern, wenn deren Namen nicht übereinstimmen. Dies ist eine saubere und lesbare Alternative zu manuellen Feldzuweisungen und kann auch mit konstanten Werten kombiniert werden.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, Internal Tables, Zuweisung

Instructions: Führen Sie ein Mapping zwischen Strukturen mit verschachtelten Tabellen durch, wobei die verschachtelten Tabellen ebenfalls gemappt werden sollen.
hint: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator unterstützt auch verschachtelte Strukturen und Tabellen automatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_nested_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_source,
             item_id TYPE i,
             item_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_source.
    TYPES: ty_t_item_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_source,
             doc_id TYPE i,
             doc_date TYPE s_date,
             items TYPE ty_t_item_source,
           END OF ty_header_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_target,
             position TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_target.
    TYPES: ty_t_item_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_target WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_target,
             document_id TYPE i,
             creation_date TYPE s_date,
             positions TYPE ty_t_item_target,
           END OF ty_header_target.

    METHODS map_nested_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_header_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_header_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_nested_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_nested_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING document_id = doc_id
                                            creation_date = doc_date
                                  MAPPING positions = items
                                  USING ( positions = items
                                          MAPPING position = item_id
                                                  description = item_name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_nested_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_mapping.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_cor_nested_mapping=>ty_header_source,
          ls_item_source LIKE LINE OF ls_source-items.

    ls_item_source = VALUE #( item_id = 1 item_name = 'Laptop' ).
    APPEND ls_item_source TO ls_source-items.
    ls_item_source = VALUE #( item_id = 2 item_name = 'Mouse' ).
    APPEND ls_item_source TO ls_source-items.

    ls_source = VALUE #( doc_id = 1001 doc_date = sy-datum items = ls_source-items ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_nested_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_nested_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-document_id exp = 1001 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-creation_date exp = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_target-positions ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-positions[ 1 ]-position exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-positions[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Laptop' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-positions[ 2 ]-position exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-positions[ 2 ]-description exp = 'Mouse' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator kann auch für verschachtelte Strukturen und interne Tabellen verwendet werden. Durch die Angabe einer weiteren `USING` Klausel für die verschachtelte Tabelle kann das Mapping für die Unterkomponenten präzise gesteuert werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Nested Tables, Mapping, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Anwendungsprotokoll (Application Log) mit einem Header und mehreren Nachrichten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj` zum Erstellen und `cl_bal_log_db` zum Speichern des Protokolls.
solution:
CLASS zcl_applog_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_save_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_object TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d
        iv_text1 TYPE bal_t_msg1
        iv_text2 TYPE bal_t_msg1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_applog_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_save_log.
    DATA: lo_log_handle TYPE bal_s_logh.

    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object   = iv_object
      subobject = iv_subobject
      extnumber = |{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|
      aluser    = sy-uname
      alprog    = sy-repid
      altcode   = sy-tcode
      aldate    = sy-datum
      altime    = sy-uzeit
      altext    = 'Beispiel Application Log'
    ).

    cl_bal_logobj=>create_log( EXPORTING i_s_log = ls_log_header IMPORTING e_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).

    DATA(ls_message) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'SY'
      msgno = '001'
      msgv1 = iv_text1
    ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>add_message( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle i_s_msg = ls_message ).

    ls_message = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'W'
      msgid = 'SY'
      msgno = '002'
      msgv1 = iv_text2
    ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>add_message( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle i_s_msg = ls_message ).

    cl_bal_log_db=>save_log( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_applog_basic( ).
    lo_cut->create_and_save_log( iv_object = 'ZTEST' iv_subobject = 'BASIC' iv_text1 = 'Erste Nachricht' iv_text2 = 'Zweite Nachricht' ).

    " Da das Speichern in der DB erfolgt, ist ein direkter Unit-Test des gespeicherten Inhalts komplex.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die Methode ohne Dump durchläuft.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ). " Einfacher Check, dass Objekt erstellt wurde.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_bal_logobj` bietet eine objektorientierte Schnittstelle zur Erstellung und Verwaltung von Anwendungsprotokollen. Dies ist der moderne Weg, um strukturierte Meldungen zu protokollieren, anstatt `MESSAGE` Anweisungen direkt zu verwenden, was die Fehlerbehandlung und Analyse erheblich verbessert.
keywords: cl_bal_logobj, Application Log, BAL, Error Handling, Logging

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit Nachrichten, die Platzhalter für dynamische Werte verwenden.

Instructions: Lesen und Anzeigen eines Anwendungsprotokolls basierend auf Objekt und Unterobjekt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_log_db` zum Laden und `cl_bal_log_display` zum Anzeigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_applog_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_object TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_applog_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_log.
    DATA: lt_log_handles TYPE bal_t_logh,
          ls_log_filter  TYPE bal_s_lfil.

    ls_log_filter-object = iv_object.
    ls_log_filter-subobject = iv_subobject.

    cl_bal_log_db=>get_log_handles( EXPORTING i_s_log_filter = ls_log_filter
                                     IMPORTING e_t_log_handle = lt_log_handles ).

    IF lt_log_handles IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_log_display) = NEW cl_bal_log_display( ).
      lo_log_display->set_log_handles( lt_log_handles ).
      lo_log_display->display_log( ).
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE |Keine Protokolle für Objekt '{ iv_object }' und Unterobjekt '{ iv_subobject }' gefunden.| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_display_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_log.
    " Vorbereitung: Ein Log erstellen, das dann angezeigt werden kann
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_applog_basic( ).
    lo_creator->create_and_save_log( iv_object = 'ZTEST' iv_subobject = 'DISPLAY' iv_text1 = 'Testnachricht 1' iv_text2 = 'Testnachricht 2' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_applog_display( ).
    " Der Aufruf von display_log öffnet ein Popup, das im Unit-Test nicht direkt geprüft werden kann.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die Methode ohne Dump durchläuft.
    lo_cut->display_log( iv_object = 'ZTEST' iv_subobject = 'DISPLAY' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klassen `cl_bal_log_db` und `cl_bal_log_display` ermöglichen das Laden und die standardisierte Anzeige von Anwendungsprotokollen. Dies ist der empfohlene Weg, um Benutzern eine konsistente Oberfläche zur Überprüfung von Anwendungsprotokollen zu bieten, ohne eigene Anzeigelogik implementieren zu müssen.
keywords: cl_bal_log_db, cl_bal_log_display, Application Log, Display, SZAL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und fügen Sie Nachrichten mit Referenzen zu Datenobjekten hinzu, um eine detailliertere Analyse zu ermöglichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `I_S_CONTEXT` Parameter in `cl_bal_logobj=>add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_applog_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS create_log_with_context
      IMPORTING
        iv_object TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_applog_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_with_context.
    DATA: lo_log_handle TYPE bal_s_logh.

    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object   = iv_object
      subobject = iv_subobject
      extnumber = |{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|
      aluser    = sy-uname
      alprog    = sy-repid
      altcode   = sy-tcode
      aldate    = sy-datum
      altime    = sy-uzeit

    ).

    cl_bal_logobj=>create_log( EXPORTING i_s_log = ls_log_header IMPORTING e_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein generisches Mapping-Tool, das zur Laufzeit eine beliebige Quellstruktur in eine beliebige Zielstruktur mappt, basierend auf dynamisch übergebenen Mapping-Regeln. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding=>create` mit `ANY TABLE` oder `ANY STRUCTURE` und dynamischen Mapping-Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_any_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
        ir_destination_data TYPE REF TO data
        it_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_any_structure.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_source> TYPE any,
                   <ls_destination> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO <ls_source>.
    ASSIGN ir_destination_data->* TO <ls_destination>.

    IF <ls_source> IS ASSIGNED AND <ls_destination> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
        source      = <ls_source>
        destination = <ls_destination>
        mapping     = it_mapping_rules
      ).
      lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = <ls_source> IMPORTING destination = <ls_destination> ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_mapper.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_dyn,
             dyn_field1 TYPE string,
             dyn_field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_dyn.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_dyn,
             target_f1 TYPE string,
             target_f2 TYPE i,
             extra_f   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_dyn.

    DATA: ls_source TYPE ty_source_dyn,
          ls_target TYPE ty_target_dyn,
          lt_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table.

    ls_source = VALUE #( dyn_field1 = 'Dynamic Value' dyn_field2 = 999 ).

    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'DYN_FIELD1' destination_name = 'TARGET_F1' ) TO lt_mapping_rules.
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'DYN_FIELD2' destination_name = 'TARGET_F2' ) TO lt_mapping_rules.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_mapper( ).
    lo_cut->map_any_structure( ir_source_data = REF #( ls_source )
                                ir_destination_data = REF #( ls_target )
                                it_mapping_rules = lt_mapping_rules ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_f1 exp = 'Dynamic Value' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `cl_abap_corresponding` für generisches, dynamisches Mapping. Durch die Verwendung von `REF TO data` und Field-Symbols können beliebige Strukturen zur Laufzeit gemappt werden, was für Frameworks oder generische Datenverarbeitungsszenarien unerlässlich ist. keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field-Symbols, Generic Mapping, SABP_DYN_MAP

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein flexibles Mapping, das sowohl explizite Feldzuweisungen als auch Ausnahmen dynamisch verwalten kann, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_corresponding`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die dynamische Erstellung von Mapping-Regeln mit der `EXCEPT` Funktionalität der `cl_abap_corresponding` Klasse.

CLASS zcl_flexible_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_with_flex_rules
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
        ir_destination_data TYPE REF TO data

        it_except_fields TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_except_table OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flexible_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_flex_rules.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_source> TYPE any,
                   <ls_destination> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO <ls_source>.
    ASSIGN ir_destination_data->* TO <ls_destination>.

    IF <ls_source> IS ASSIGNED AND <ls_destination> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
        source      = <ls_source>
        destination = <ls_destination>
        mapping     = it_explicit_mapping
        except      = it_except_fields
      ).
      lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = <ls_source> IMPORTING destination = <ls_destination> ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flex_mapper_explicit.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_src, f1 TYPE string, f2 TYPE i, END OF ty_s_src.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_dst, t1 TYPE string, t2 TYPE i, t3 TYPE string, END OF ty_s_dst.

    DATA: lt_map TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table.

    ls_src = VALUE #( f1 = 'Val1' f2 = 100 ).
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'F1' destination_name = 'T1' ) TO lt_map.
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'F2' destination_name = 'T2' ) TO lt_map.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flexible_mapper( ).
    lo_cut->map_with_flex_rules( ir_source_data = REF #( ls_src )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dst-t1 exp = 'Val1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dst-t2 exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_dst-t3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flex_mapper_except.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_src, f1 TYPE string, f2 TYPE i, f3 TYPE string, END OF ty_s_src.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_dst, f1 TYPE string, f2 TYPE i, f3 TYPE string, END OF ty_s_dst.
    DATA: ls_src TYPE ty_s_src, ls_dst TYPE ty_s_dst.
    DATA: lt_except TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_except_table.

    ls_src = VALUE #( f1 = 'Val1' f2 = 100 f3 = 'ExcludeMe' ).
