    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flexible_mapper( ).
    lo_cut->map_with_flex_rules( ir_source_data = REF #( ls_src )
                                  ir_destination_data = REF #( ls_dst )
                                  it_except_fields = lt_except ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dst-f1 exp = 'Val1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dst-f2 exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_dst-f3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flex_mapper_combined.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_src, id TYPE i, name TYPE string, status TYPE string, END OF ty_s_src.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_dst, doc_id TYPE i, doc_name TYPE string, doc_status TYPE string, comment TYPE string, END OF ty_s_dst.
    DATA: ls_src TYPE ty_s_src, ls_dst TYPE ty_s_dst.
    DATA: lt_map TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table,
          lt_except TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_except_table.

    ls_src = VALUE #( id = 10 name = 'Report' status = 'NEW' ).
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'ID' destination_name = 'DOC_ID' ) TO lt_map.
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'NAME' destination_name = 'DOC_NAME' ) TO lt_map.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'DOC_STATUS' ) TO lt_except. " Exclude direct mapping for status

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flexible_mapper( ).
    lo_cut->map_with_flex_rules( ir_source_data = REF #( ls_src )
                                  ir_destination_data = REF #( ls_dst )
                                  it_explicit_mapping = lt_map
                                  it_except_fields = lt_except ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dst-doc_id exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dst-doc_name exp = 'Report' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_dst-doc_status ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_dst-comment ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Eintrag in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein, aber nur, wenn ein Eintrag mit demselben Schlüssel noch nicht existiert. Zeigen Sie das Ergebnis an.

CLASS zcl_tab_insert_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( iv_name = 'Tabelle vor/nach Insert' )->display( rt_result_table ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 Einträgen, wobei jeder Eintrag eine fortlaufende Nummer und einen generierten Text enthält. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression und `INSERT`. Zeigen Sie die Tabelle an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR i = 1 UNTIL 5` und `INSERT ... INTO TABLE`. Verwenden Sie `cl_demo_output`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_insert_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_insert
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_generated_table) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_insert_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_insert.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_items( ).

    LOOP AT ( FOR i = 1 UNTIL 5
               FROM 1
               ( VALUE ty_item( id = i name = |Item { i }| ) ) ) INTO DATA(ls_item).
      INSERT ls_item INTO TABLE lt_items.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_generated_table = lt_items.

    cl_demo_output=>display( iv_data = rt_generated_table iv_name = 'Generierte Tabelle mit FOR und INSERT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-name exp = 'Item 3' ).

CLASS zcl_tab_insert_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tab_insert_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_corresponding_data.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_source(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' unused = 'X' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' unused = 'Y' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_target(
      ( id = 3 name = 'Existing C' desc = 'Old' )
    ).

    INSERT CORRESPONDING #( lt_source ) INTO TABLE lt_target.

    rt_target_table = lt_target.

    cl_demo_output=>display( iv_data = rt_target_table iv_name = 'Zieltabelle nach CORRESPONDING INSERT' ).

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( iv_name = 'Hashed Table nach Insert' )->write( rt_result_table )

Instructions: Fügen Sie Einträge in eine interne Tabelle ein, basierend auf einer komplexen Bedingung, die mit `COND` formuliert wird. Zeigen Sie die eingefügten Einträge an.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_item.
    TYPES tt_status_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_input_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE tt_status_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    DATA(lt_result) = VALUE tt_status_items( ).

    LOOP AT it_input_ids INTO DATA(lv_id).
      DATA(ls_new_item) = VALUE ty_status_item(
        id = lv_id
        status = COND string(
          WHEN lv_id MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'EVEN'
          WHEN lv_id MOD 3 = 0 THEN 'DIVISIBLE_BY_3'
          ELSE 'ODD'
        )
        comment = COND string(
          WHEN lv_id > 5 THEN 'High ID'
          ELSE 'Low ID'
        )
      ).
      INSERT ls_new_item INTO TABLE lt_result.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_processed_items = lt_result.

    cl_demo_output=>display( iv_data = rt_processed_items iv_name = 'Verarbeitete Elemente mit COND' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 6 ) ( 7 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 1 ]-status exp = 'ODD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 2 ]-status exp = 'EVEN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 3 ]-status exp = 'DIVISIBLE_BY_3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 6 ]-status exp = 'EVEN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 6 ]-comment exp = 'High ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht die kompakte und lesbare Formulierung komplexer bedingter Zuweisungen. Hier wird er verwendet, um sowohl den Status als auch den Kommentar eines neuen Tabelleneintrags zu bestimmen, bevor dieser mit `INSERT` hinzugefügt wird. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von `IF`-Blöcken und macht den Code funktionaler. `cl_demo_output` visualisiert die Ergebnisse.
keywords: COND, INSERT, CONDITIONAL LOGIC, INTERNAL TABLES, VALUE, CL_DEMO_OUTPUT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise von Flügen für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie die Ergebnisse in eine neue interne Tabelle ein. Zeigen Sie die aggregierte Tabelle an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` zur Aggregation und `INSERT` für die Zieltabelle, dann `cl_demo_output`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_sum.
    TYPES tt_flight_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_sum WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_and_insert_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_prices) TYPE tt_flight_sums.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_insert_prices.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE tt_flight_sums(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                      NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = VALUE tt_flight_sums( ).
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_item).
      INSERT ls_agg_item INTO TABLE lt_result.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_aggregated_prices = lt_result.

    cl_demo_output=>display( iv_data = rt_aggregated_prices iv_name = 'Aggregierte Flugpreise' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_and_insert_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    " Assuming 'LH' exists and has flights, check if its total_price is greater than 0
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_sum) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_sum-total_price > 0 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No flights found for LH, cannot test aggregation.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle. Die Ergebnisse der Aggregation werden dann mit `INSERT` in eine neue Tabelle eingefügt. `cl_demo_output` wird verwendet, um die aggregierten Daten übersichtlich darzustellen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster in ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, AGGREGATION, INSERT, INTERNAL TABLES, SFLIGHTS, CL_DEMO_OUTPUT

CLASS zcl_tab_insert_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD insert_filtered_products.
    DATA(lt_source_products) = VALUE tt_products(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )

      ( id = 99 name = 'Existing Item' price = '10.00' )

                      WHERE price > iv_min_price ) INTO TABLE lt_target_products.

    rt_target_table = lt_target_products.

    cl_demo_output=>display( iv_data = rt_target_table iv_name = |Gefilterte Produkte (Preis > { iv_min_price })| ).

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf die Komponenten einer Struktur zu und geben Sie deren Werte aus. Verwenden Sie hierfür RTTI mit `cl_abap_structdescr`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        i_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        i_component TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT i_component OF STRUCTURE i_structure TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          r_value = |{ <fs_component> }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        r_value = 'Component not found or inaccessible'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Felder zur Laufzeit, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen unerlässlich ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, deren Struktur der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` entspricht, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` für die Struktur und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für die Tabelle, gefolgt von `CREATE DATA` mit `HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Get description of SFLIGHT structure
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " Create a table type description based on the structure
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                       p_line_type  = lr_struct_descr
                       p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                       p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA r_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN r_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Populate with some data (example)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <fs_table> UP TO 2 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für das Feld `CARRID` der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` mit den Werten 'LH' und 'AA' unter Verwendung der modernen `VALUE #` und `FOR` Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` um die Range-Tabelle kompakt zu initialisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_modern_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        i_carrids TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_modern_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_carrid_range.
    r_range = VALUE #( FOR <carrid_entry> IN i_carrids
                       ( sign   = 'I'
                         option = 'EQ'
                         low    = <carrid_entry>-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_carrid_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_carrid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_modern_create( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_ranges_modern_create=>tt_sflight_key(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = lo_cut->create_carrid_range( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrid_range ) exp = 2 msg = 'Range table should have 2 entries' ).

    DATA(ls_expected_range_entry) = VALUE zcl_ranges_modern_create=>r_range(
      sign   = 'I'
      option = 'EQ'
      low    = 'LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrid_range[ 1 ] exp = ls_expected_range_entry msg = 'First range entry mismatch' ).

    ls_expected_range_entry-low = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrid_range[ 2 ] exp = ls_expected_range_entry msg = 'Second range entry mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #` Syntax in Kombination mit `FOR` Schleifen ist eine moderne und sehr kompakte Art, interne Tabellen und Ranges zu initialisieren und zu füllen. Sie ersetzt die traditionelle `LOOP AT ... APPEND` Syntax und macht den Code lesbarer und kürzer.
keywords: RANGES, VALUE, FOR, internal tables, modern ABAP, compact syntax

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` Daten, um nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaften 'LH' und 'AA' zu erhalten, unter Verwendung einer Range-Tabelle und des `FILTER` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck mit dem `IN` Operator, um die interne Tabelle basierend auf der Range zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        i_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        i_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrid.
    r_filtered_flights = FILTER #( i_all_flights WHERE carrid IN i_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_ranges_filter=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = sy-datum )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_carrid(
                                  i_all_flights  = lt_all_flights
                                  i_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Filtered table should have 3 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First entry CARID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second entry CARID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Third entry CARID mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. In Kombination mit Range-Tabellen (`WHERE ... IN ...`) ermöglicht er eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Filterung von Daten, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `DELETE` Anweisungen.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, internal tables, conditional logic, modern ABAP

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die zwei Strukturen desselben Typs Feld für Feld vergleicht und `TRUE` zurückgibt, wenn sie identisch sind, ansonsten `FALSE`. Verwenden Sie RTTI.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Komponenten der Struktur mit `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und vergleichen Sie die Werte über Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        i_structure1 TYPE any STRUCTURE
        i_structure2 TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_comp_descr> TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
                   <fs_value1>     TYPE any,
                   <fs_value2>     TYPE any.

    r_are_equal = abap_true. " Assume equal initially

    " Check if types are compatible (simplified check)
    IF cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_structure1 )->get_relative_name( ) NE
       cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_structure2 )->get_relative_name( ).
      r_are_equal = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_structure1 ).
    lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING <fs_comp_descr>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp_descr>-name OF STRUCTURE i_structure1 TO <fs_value1>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp_descr>-name OF STRUCTURE i_structure2 TO <fs_value2>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_value1> NE <fs_value2>.
          r_are_equal = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if types are compatible and components exist
        r_are_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_structures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_compare( ).

    DATA: ls_sflight1 TYPE sflight,
          ls_sflight2 TYPE sflight,
          ls_sflight3 TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight1-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight1-connid = '400'.
    ls_sflight1-fldate = sy-datum.

    ls_sflight2 = ls_sflight1. " Identical
    ls_sflight3 = ls_sflight1.
    ls_sflight3-connid = '500'. " Different

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->compare_structures( i_structure1 = ls_sflight1 i_structure2 = ls_sflight2 ) msg = 'Identical structures should be equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->compare_structures( i_structure1 = ls_sflight1 i_structure2 = ls_sflight3 ) msg = 'Different structures should not be equal' ).

    " Test with different types (should return false)
    DATA: ls_spfli TYPE spfli.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->compare_structures( i_structure1 = ls_sflight1 i_structure2 = ls_spfli ) msg = 'Different types should not be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode nutzt RTTI, um zwei Strukturen generisch zu vergleichen. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` liefert die Typbeschreibung, und `get_components` gibt eine Liste der Felder zurück. Durch Iteration über diese Komponenten und dynamischen Zugriff über Feld-Symbole können die Werte Feld für Feld verglichen werden. Dies ist extrem nützlich für generische Validierungen oder Datenabgleiche.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, generic comparison, FIELD-SYMBOLS, dynamic programming

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für das Feld `CONNID` basierend auf den Werten einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` Daten, die nur bestimmte Verbindungen enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP AT` Schleife über die Quelltabelle und `APPEND` Sie die Einträge in die Range-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_dynamic_populate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_connid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_connid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS populate_connid_range
      IMPORTING
        i_connids TYPE tt_sflight_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_dynamic_populate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD populate_connid_range.
    DATA: ls_range_line TYPE LINE OF RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    LOOP AT i_connids INTO DATA(ls_connid_entry).
      ls_range_line-sign   = 'I'.
      ls_range_line-option = 'EQ'.
      ls_range_line-low    = ls_connid_entry-connid.
      APPEND ls_range_line TO r_range.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_connids_input) = VALUE zcl_ranges_dynamic_populate=>tt_sflight_connid(
      ( connid = '0017' )
      ( connid = '0400' )
      ( connid = '0055' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connid_range ) exp = 3 msg = 'Range table should have 3 entries' ).

    DATA(ls_expected_range_entry) = VALUE zcl_ranges_dynamic_populate=>r_range(
      sign   = 'I'
      option = 'EQ'
      low    = '0017'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connid_range[ 1 ] exp = ls_expected_range_entry msg = 'First range entry mismatch' ).

    ls_expected_range_entry-low = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connid_range[ 2 ] exp = ls_expected_range_entry msg = 'Second range entry mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die klassische Methode, eine Range-Tabelle dynamisch zu füllen, indem man über eine Quelltabelle iteriert und jeden Eintrag einzeln in die Range-Tabelle einfügt. Obwohl `VALUE #( FOR ... )` oft kompakter ist, ist diese Methode flexibler für komplexere Logik beim Füllen der Range.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Datentyp und die Länge spezifischer Felder der `SFLIGHTS`-Struktur mithilfe von RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und iterieren Sie über die Komponenten, um deren Typbeschreibung zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_properties DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_field_info
      IMPORTING
        i_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_field_info) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_properties IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_field_info.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_comp_descr> TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
                   <fs_type_descr> TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT i_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      READ TABLE lt_components ASSIGNING <fs_comp_descr> WITH KEY name = lv_field_name.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_type_descr> ?= <fs_comp_descr>-type.
        APPEND VALUE ty_field_info(
          name   = lv_field_name
          type   = <fs_type_descr>->get_relative_name( )
          length = <fs_type_descr>->length
        ) TO r_field_info.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_field_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_field_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_properties( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lt_field_info) = lo_cut->get_sflight_field_info( lt_field_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_field_info ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should return info for 3 fields' ).

CLASS zcl_ranges_reduce_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        i_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_reduce_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    " Fetch data from DB (or use a mock table for testing)
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid IN @i_carrid_range.

    r_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                              FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                              NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen in eine interne Tabelle von Name-Value-Paaren umwandelt, wobei die Feldnamen und -werte dynamisch über RTTI ermittelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und Feld-Symbole, um die Feldnamen und -werte jeder Zeile zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_to_nvp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name_value_pair,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name_value_pair.
    TYPES: tt_name_value_pair TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_name_value_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_nvp_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_name_value_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_struct_table_to_nvp
      IMPORTING
        i_struct_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_nvp_table) TYPE tt_nvp_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_to_nvp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_struct_table_to_nvp.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>       TYPE any,
                   <fs_component>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp_descr> TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.
    DATA: lt_current_nvp TYPE tt_name_value_pair.

    IF i_struct_table IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN i_struct_table[ 1 ] TO <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_line> ).
      lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT i_struct_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      CLEAR lt_current_nvp.
      LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING <fs_comp_descr>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp_descr>-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND VALUE ty_name_value_pair(
            name  = <fs_comp_descr>-name
            value = |{ <fs_component> }|
          ) TO lt_current_nvp.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lt_current_nvp TO r_nvp_table.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_nvp_table) = lo_cut->convert_struct_table_to_nvp( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nvp_table ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 rows of NVP' ).

    DATA(lt_first_row_nvp) = lt_nvp_table[ 1 ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_first_row_nvp[ name = 'CONNID' ]-value exp = '400' msg = 'First row CONNID mismatch' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die prüft, ob eine gegebene Struktur alle Felder einer anderen (Sub-)Struktur enthält und deren Typen kompatibel sind. Verwenden Sie RTTI.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Komponenten beider Strukturen mithilfe von `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>check_compatibility`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_substructure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_substructure
      IMPORTING
        i_super_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        i_sub_structure   TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_is_compatible) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_substructure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_substructure.
    DATA: lr_super_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_sub_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_super_comps TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_sub_comps   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sub_comp> TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
                   <fs_super_comp> TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    r_is_compatible = abap_true. " Assume compatible initially

    lr_super_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_super_structure ).
    lr_sub_descr   ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_sub_structure ).

    lt_super_comps = lr_super_descr->get_components( ).
    lt_sub_comps   = lr_sub_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_sub_comps ASSIGNING <fs_sub_comp>.
      READ TABLE lt_super_comps ASSIGNING <fs_super_comp> WITH KEY name = <fs_sub_comp>-name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Sub-component not found in super structure
        r_is_compatible = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      " Check type compatibility
      IF cl_abap_typedescr=>check_compatibility( p_type1 = <fs_super_comp>-type
                                                p_type2 = <fs_sub_comp>-type ) = abap_false.
        r_is_compatible = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_super,

           END OF ty_super.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub,

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_incompatible_type,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sub_incompatible_type.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_missing_field,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field4 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sub_missing_field.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_contains_substructure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_substructure( ).

    DATA: ls_super TYPE ty_super,
          ls_sub   TYPE ty_sub,
          ls_sub_incomp_type TYPE ty_sub_incompatible_type,
          ls_sub_missing_field TYPE ty_sub_missing_field.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_substructure( i_super_structure = ls_super i_sub_structure = ls_sub ) msg = 'Compatible substructure should return true' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_substructure( i_super_structure = ls_super i_sub_structure = ls_sub_incomp_type ) msg = 'Incompatible type should return false' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese generische Methode nutzt RTTI, um die Kompatibilität von Strukturen zu überprüfen, indem sie feststellt, ob eine 'Super-Struktur' alle Felder einer 'Sub-Struktur' mit kompatiblen Typen enthält. `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` liefert die Feldlisten, und `cl_abap_typedescr=>check_compatibility` prüft die Typgleichheit. Dies ist nützlich für dynamische Zuweisungen oder Validierungen, bei denen die genaue Struktur zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine Range-Tabelle, um eine `CASE`-Anweisung dynamisch zu steuern, indem Sie prüfen, ob ein Wert in der Range enthalten ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `IN` Operator in der `WHEN` Klausel der `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_case_statement DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_category
      IMPORTING
        i_price TYPE sflight-price
        i_low_price_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-price
        i_mid_price_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_case_statement IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_category.
    CASE i_price.
      WHEN IN i_low_price_range.
        r_category = 'Low Price'.
      WHEN IN i_mid_price_range.
        r_category = 'Mid Price'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        r_category = 'High Price'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_category.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_case_statement( ).

    DATA(lt_low_price) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-price(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'LE' low = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_mid_price) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-price(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '100.01' high = '500.00' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_category( i_price = '50.00' i_low_price_range = lt_low_price i_mid_price_range = lt_mid_price ) exp = 'Low Price' msg = '50.00 should be Low' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_category( i_price = '300.00' i_low_price_range = lt_low_price i_mid_price_range = lt_mid_price ) exp = 'Mid Price' msg = '300.00 should be Mid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_category( i_price = '600.00' i_low_price_range = lt_low_price i_mid_price_range = lt_mid_price ) exp = 'High Price' msg = '600.00 should be High' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr elegante und lesbare Methode, um komplexe bedingte Logik zu steuern, die auf variablen Selektionskriterien basiert, ohne lange `IF-ELSE IF`-Ketten oder manuelle Schleifen zur Prüfung der Range.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine große Menge von Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit einem expliziten Cursor und schließen Sie diesen nach der Verarbeitung. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD` für die Deklaration, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in einer Schleife und `CLOSE CURSOR` am Ende. Nutzen Sie Inline-Deklarationen für Hostvariablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_explicit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_explicit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE CURSOR.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_cursor_explicit( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->process_flights( ).
    " In a real test, you would insert known data into SFLIGHT first.
    " For demonstration, we just check if it's not initial if data exists.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die explizite Cursor-Verarbeitung, die in Szenarien mit sehr großen Datenmengen oder speziellen Datenbankinteraktionen nützlich sein kann. Obwohl `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` oft einfacher ist, bietet die explizite Cursor-Steuerung mehr Granularität. Die Verwendung von `@DATA(ls_sflight)` zeigt moderne Inline-Deklaration und Hostvariablen-Syntax.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, Database, SFLIGHT, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus `SFLIGHTS`) in ein CSV-Format konvertiert und über die ICF-Schnittstelle `cl_icf_csv` für den Download bereitstellt. Die Lösung soll die Verwendung von `cl_icf_csv` demonstrieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv=>create_instance`, `add_table` und `get_csv_string`. Verwenden Sie `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` für die Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_icf_csv_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_csv,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             plane_type TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_csv.
    TYPES tt_sflight_csv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_csv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_sflight_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_icf_csv_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    " Map SFLIGHT to CSV structure (optional, but good practice for specific headers)
    DATA(lt_sflight_csv) = VALUE tt_sflight_csv( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                  ( carrier_id = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                    connection_id = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                    flight_date = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                                    plane_type = <fs_sflight>-planetype ) ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_instance( ).
        lo_csv->add_table(
          EXPORTING
            i_table = lt_sflight_csv
            i_field_names_as_header = abap_true
        ).
        rv_csv_string = lo_csv->get_csv_string( ).
      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        rv_csv_string = |Error generating CSV: { lx_icf_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_icf_csv_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = lo_cut->generate_sflight_csv( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_csv ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_csv
      exp = 'CARRIER_ID,CONNECTION_ID,FLIGHT_DATE,PLANE_TYPE'
      msg = 'CSV header should be present'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_csv
      exp = ','
      msg = 'CSV should contain comma delimiters'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Erzeugung von CSV-Daten aus einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_icf_csv`. Dies ist eine moderne und standardisierte Methode, um CSV-Daten für Web-Anwendungen oder Downloads zu generieren. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` zeigt eine moderne Art der Tabellenkonstruktion und -transformation.
keywords: cl_icf_csv, CSV, ICF, Web, File Generation, VALUE, FOR, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Flugzeugtyps aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung moderner interner Tabellenoperationen (`FOR`, `REDUCE`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` um die relevanten Flüge zu filtern und `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity_by_plane
      IMPORTING
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_plane.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( planetype = iv_planetype )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_for( ).

    " Assuming 'BOEING747' has some flights with seatsmax in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lv_capacity_b747) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity_by_plane( 'BOEING747' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lv_capacity_b747 exp = 0 msg = 'Capacity for BOEING747 should be greater than 0' ).

    " Test for a non-existent plane type
    DATA(lv_capacity_none) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity_by_plane( 'NONEXIST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_capacity_none exp = 0 msg = 'Capacity for non-existent plane should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die modernen Tabellenoperationen `FOR` und `REDUCE`. `FOR` ermöglicht das Filtern und Iterieren über interne Tabellen in einer deklarativen Weise, während `REDUCE` eine Aggregation (hier eine Summe) über die gefilterten Elemente durchführt. Dies führt zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code im Vergleich zu klassischen `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die verkettet aufgerufen werden können, um eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Objekt durchzuführen. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer einfachen 'Builder'-Pattern-ähnlichen Implementierung.
hint: Jede verkettbare Methode sollte `ME` zurückgeben, um den Objektkontext beizubehalten. Verwenden Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      set_value1 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining,
      set_value2 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining,
      get_sum    RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_value1 TYPE i,
          mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lv_sum) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( )->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Die Verwendung von `NEW zcl_method_chaining( )` demonstriert die moderne Inline-Objektinstanziierung.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, NEW, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf einer Bedingung, wobei der `COND`-Ausdruck verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND type( WHEN condition1 THEN result1 WHEN condition2 THEN result2 ELSE default_result )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
        iv_is_cancelled  TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Abgesagt'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0      THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 0 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false )
      exp = 'Pünktlich'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 30 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false )
      exp = 'Verspätet'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 0 iv_is_cancelled = abap_true )
      exp = 'Abgesagt'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 60 iv_is_cancelled = abap_true )
      exp = 'Abgesagt' " Cancelled takes precedence
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Ausdrücken, wenn ein Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er macht den Code kompakter und funktionaler, da er direkt einen Wert zurückgibt.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden und eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER type( itab WHERE ( condition ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                    AND   fldate > iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter( ).

    " Insert some test data into SFLIGHT if it's empty or unpredictable
    " Example: INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = '20251201' ).
    "          INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20251125' ).
    "          INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' fldate = '20251202' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_fldate = '20251126' ).

    " Assuming at least one LH flight after 20251126 exists in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20251126' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT itab WHERE ...` und führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code, insbesondere wenn mehrere Filterkriterien angewendet werden.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FINAL` für Methoden und Klassen, um die Vererbung oder das Überschreiben zu verhindern. Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse und eine abgeleitete Klasse, wobei eine Methode in der Basisklasse als `FINAL` deklariert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` in der Methodendefinition und optional in der Klassendefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_type ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_base_info FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_base_info.
    rv_info = 'Dies ist eine finale Basismethode.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_flight DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_flight PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_type.
    rv_type = 'Passagierflug'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_final_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_final_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_final_method.
    DATA(lo_derived) = NEW zcl_derived_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_derived->get_base_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Dies ist eine finale Basismethode.' ).
    DATA(lv_type) = lo_derived->get_flight_type( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type exp = 'Passagierflug' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_final_class.
    " This test primarily checks compilation. A class declared FINAL cannot be inherited from.
    " If you try to define CLASS zcl_another_derived DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_derived_flight, it will be a syntax error.
    " No runtime assertion needed here, as the concept is compile-time enforced.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Placeholder assertion
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` kann für Klassen und Methoden verwendet werden. Eine `FINAL` Methode kann in Unterklassen nicht überschrieben werden, was die Konsistenz des Verhaltens in einer Vererbungshierarchie sicherstellt. Eine `FINAL` Klasse kann nicht als Basis für weitere Vererbung dienen, was die Architektur klarer definiert und unerwünschte Erweiterungen verhindert.
keywords: FINAL, Object Orientation, Inheritance, Methods, Classes

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei Flugdaten unter Verwendung der modernen Datumsarithmetik.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `-` Operator für Datumsfelder, um die Differenz in Tagen zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_arithmetic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE sy-datum
        iv_date2 TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_arithmetic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between_dates.
    rv_days = iv_date2 - iv_date1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_days_between FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_days_between.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_arithmetic( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_days_between_dates( iv_date1 = '20251101' iv_date2 = '20251110' )
      exp = 9
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_days_between_dates( iv_date1 = '20251110' iv_date2 = '20251101' )
      exp = -9
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `GROUP BY` Klausel in einer `LOOP AT` Anweisung und `GROUP SIZE` für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ASCENDING.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_groups.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_groups) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_group( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_groups ).

    " Assuming some known data for 'LH' '0400'
    DATA(ls_group) = lt_flight_groups[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' DEFAULT VALUE ty_flight_group( ) ].
    IF ls_group IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = ls_group-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'Flight count for LH 0400 should be > 0' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Funktion, um interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt die Notwendigkeit, manuelle Schleifen und `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukte zu verwenden, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY ... CATCH ... ENDTRY` für die Ausnahmebehandlung, wenn ein ungültiger Index für eine interne Tabelle verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY ... CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ... ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_value_at_index
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_at_index.
    TRY.
        rv_value = it_data[ iv_index ]-value.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_value = 'Index nicht gefunden oder Tabelle leer'.
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
        rv_value = 'Index außerhalb des gültigen Bereichs'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Sie ermöglicht es, spezifische Ausnahmen (wie `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` für den Zugriff auf nicht existierende Zeilen in internen Tabellen) abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt mit `SY-SUBRC` zu arbeiten. Dies führt zu robusterem und wartbarerem Code.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Konstanten, um Feldnamen für die dynamische Zuweisung von Feld-Symbolen zu definieren, um Tippfehler zu vermeiden und die Robustheit zu erhöhen. Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer `sflights`-Struktur zu.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_field_carrid TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID',
      gc_field_connid TYPE string VALUE 'CONNID'.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE sflights
        iv_field_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Konstanten, um verschiedene Statuswerte in einer `CASE`-Anweisung zu definieren und zu verarbeiten, um eine lesbare Statusbeschreibung zurückzugeben.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_status_new      TYPE char1 VALUE 'N',
      gc_status_in_work  TYPE char1 VALUE 'W',
      gc_status_completed TYPE char1 VALUE 'C',
      gc_status_cancelled TYPE char1 VALUE 'X'.

      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN gc_status_new.
        rv_description = 'Neu erstellt'.
      WHEN gc_status_in_work.
        rv_description = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN gc_status_completed.
        rv_description = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN gc_status_cancelled.
        rv_description = 'Storniert'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannter Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie ein Feld-Symbol innerhalb einer Schleife zu und geben Sie es nach Beendigung der Schleife explizit frei, um Ressourcen zu schonen und unbeabsichtigten Zugriff zu verhindern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_unassign_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_unassign_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflights.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      " Beispiel: Zugriff auf Flugdaten
      " WRITE: / <fs_flight>-carrid, <fs_flight>-connid.
      " ... weitere Verarbeitung ...
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_flight>.

    " Hier ist <fs_flight> nicht mehr zugewiesen.
    " IF <fs_flight> IS ASSIGNED. " Dies wäre FALSE
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unassign_after_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unassign_after_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_unassign_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_test> TYPE sflights.

    " Vor dem Aufruf: <fs_test> ist nicht zugewiesen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_test> ).

    lo_cut->process_flights( lt_flights ).

    " Nach dem Aufruf: Das Feld-Symbol in der Methode sollte unassigned sein.
    " Wir können dies hier nicht direkt prüfen, da es ein lokales FS der Methode ist.
    " Der Test konzentriert sich darauf, dass die Methode ohne Fehler durchläuft.
    " Ein indirekter Test wäre, zu versuchen, auf ein FS zuzugreifen, das unassigned sein sollte.
    " Für diesen Test reicht es, die Methode aufzurufen und sicherzustellen, dass kein Dump auftritt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Methode erfolgreich durchlaufen " ).

    " Um die Wirkung von UNASSIGN zu demonstrieren, könnte man ein globales FS verwenden
    " oder ein FS, das als Parameter übergeben wird.
    " Hier simulieren wir, dass ein FS, das in der Methode verwendet wurde, korrekt freigegeben wird.

CLASS zcl_fs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_with_fs
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_with_fs.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ir_data->* TO <fs_any>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_error.
        ENDIF.

        " Beispiel: Wert lesen und verarbeiten
        lv_value = <fs_any>.
        " ... weitere Verarbeitung ...
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Log-Eintrag
      FINALLY.
        IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
          UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_functional_mod IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_status.
    rt_modified_flights = it_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflights.

    LOOP AT rt_modified_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      " Beispiel: Statusfeld hinzufügen und setzen
      " Angenommen, sflights hätte ein Feld 'STATUS'
      " ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STATUS' OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_status>).
      " IF <fs_status> IS ASSIGNED.

      " ENDIF.
      " Für dieses Beispiel modifizieren wir ein vorhandenes Feld
      <fs_flight>-planetype = 'MODIFIED'. " Nur zu Demonstrationszwecken
    ENDLOOP.

    " Explizite Freigabe des Feld-Symbols
    IF <fs_flight> IS ASSIGNED.
      UNASSIGN <fs_flight>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_const_unassign_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_field_carrid TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID',
      gc_field_connid TYPE string VALUE 'CONNID'.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_const_unassign_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flight_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight_line> TYPE sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_component> }| TO rt_field_values.
      ELSE.
        APPEND 'Feld nicht gefunden' TO rt_field_values.
      ENDIF.
      " <fs_component> wird am Ende des Loops implizit unassigned, aber explizit ist auch möglich.
      " UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Optional hier
    ENDLOOP.

    " Explizite Freigabe des Zeilen-Feld-Symbols nach der Schleife
    IF <fs_flight_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      UNASSIGN <fs_flight_line>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tax_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_tax_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.19'. " 19% Mehrwertsteuer

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tax_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR price IN it_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + ( price * ( 1 + gc_tax_rate ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_day_monday    TYPE i VALUE 1,
      gc_day_tuesday   TYPE i VALUE 2,
      gc_day_wednesday TYPE i VALUE 3,
      gc_day_thursday  TYPE i VALUE 4,
      gc_day_friday    TYPE i VALUE 5,
      gc_day_saturday  TYPE i VALUE 6,
      gc_day_sunday    TYPE i VALUE 7.

    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_day_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    CASE iv_day_number.
      WHEN gc_day_monday    THEN rv_day_name = 'Montag'.
      WHEN gc_day_tuesday   THEN rv_day_name = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN gc_day_wednesday THEN rv_day_name = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN gc_day_thursday  THEN rv_day_name = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN gc_day_friday    THEN rv_day_name = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN gc_day_saturday  THEN rv_day_name = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN gc_day_sunday    THEN rv_day_name = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN OTHERS           THEN rv_day_name = 'Ungültiger Tag'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge zurück. Verwenden Sie eine Konstante für den Feldnamen, nach dem gruppiert wird, und stellen Sie sicher, dass temporäre Feld-Symbole freigegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` für den Feldnamen, `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_group_field TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID'.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_key> TYPE s_carr_id.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight_line> TYPE sflights.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight_line> GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight_line>-carrid ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Explizite Freigabe der Feld-Symbole (falls sie noch zugewiesen wären)
    IF <fs_group_key> IS ASSIGNED.
      UNASSIGN <fs_group_key>.
    ENDIF.
    IF <fs_flight_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      UNASSIGN <fs_flight_line>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbank.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (lv_struct_name)` und Feld-Symbolen für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_itab
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
        iv_max_rows    TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_itab.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamically create an internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_struct_name).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: type not found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamically create a work area for the table
    CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_struct_name) INTO DATA(lr_line).
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: type not found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamically select data into the internal table
    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM (iv_struct_name) UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        " Handle error: table not found or other SQL error
        CLEAR rr_data. " Clear reference to indicate error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` aus, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... WHERE (lv_where_clause)`. Achten Sie auf SQL-Injections.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_keys) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_sflight_dynamic.
    " For security, dynamic WHERE clauses should be constructed carefully
    " or validated to prevent SQL injection.
    " This example assumes a trusted source for iv_where_clause.
    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
          FROM sflight
          WHERE (iv_where_clause)
          INTO TABLE @rt_sflight_keys.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        " Handle error: invalid WHERE clause or table
        CLEAR rt_sflight_keys.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    " Ensure some data exists for testing
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum ).

    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_where( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_selector->select_sflight_dynamic( `CARRID = 'AA'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Results for CARRID = AA should not be empty' act = lt_results ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 2 entries for CARRID = AA' act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).

    lt_results = lo_selector->select_sflight_dynamic( `CARRID = 'BB' AND CONNID = '002'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Results for CARRID = BB and CONNID = 002 should not be empty' act = lt_results ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 1 entry' act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 1 ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('AA', 'BB'). " Clean up test data
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_where.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_where( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_selector->select_sflight_dynamic( `NON_EXISTENT_FIELD = 'X'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Results should be empty for invalid WHERE clause' act = lt_results ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer unbekannten Struktur in eine interne Tabelle mit einer anderen, ebenfalls dynamisch definierten Struktur, indem Sie Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen zuordnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA`, Feld-Symbole und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder manuelle Zuweisung mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_itab_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data " Reference to source internal table
        iv_target_struct_name TYPE string " Name of the target structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_data) TYPE REF TO data. " Reference to target internal table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_itab_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_source> TYPE any,
                   <lt_target> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_target> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO <lt_source>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <lt_source> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamically create target internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_target_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_target_struct_name).
    ASSIGN rr_target_data->* TO <lt_target>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamically create target work area
    CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_target_struct_name) INTO DATA(lr_target_line).
    ASSIGN lr_target_line->* TO <ls_target>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_source> ASSIGNING <ls_source>.
      CLEAR <ls_target>.
      " Move corresponding fields by name
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING <ls_source> TO <ls_target>.
      INSERT <ls_target> INTO TABLE <lt_target>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Systemprofilparameter nach ihrem Präfix (z.B. 'rdisp/', 'login/') und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Parameter pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_profile_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_group,
             prefix TYPE string,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_param_group.
    TYPES tt_param_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_parameters_by_prefix
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_param_groups) TYPE tt_param_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_profile_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_parameters_by_prefix.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters( ).

        rt_param_groups = REDUCE tt_param_groups(
          INIT groups = VALUE tt_param_groups( )
          FOR GROUPS OF param IN lt_all_params
          GROUP BY substring( val = param-name len = find( val = param-name sub = '/' ) + 1 ) AS prefix
          ( LET current_prefix = prefix IN
            groups = VALUE #( groups ( prefix = current_prefix count = GROUP SIZE ) ) )
        ).

      CATCH cx_spfl_error.
        " Handle error
        CLEAR rt_param_groups.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten (Felder) einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_descr_ref TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_descr_ref = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_descr_ref.

        IF lo_struct_descr IS BOUND.
          LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
            APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
              name = ls_component-name
              type = ls_component-type_descr_ref->get_relative_name( )
            ) TO rt_components.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle RTTI error (e.g., not a structure)
        CLEAR rt_components.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure  TYPE REF TO data " Reference to the structure
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_structure> TYPE any,
                   <lv_field>     TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <ls_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_structure> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <lv_field> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error (e.g., string to int)
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
