Instructions: Suchen Sie nach Systemprofilparametern, die einen bestimmten Wert haben (z.B. alle Parameter, deren Wert '1' ist).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters` und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_search_param_by_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_profile_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_profile_param.
    TYPES tt_profile_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_profile_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS search_parameters_by_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_search_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_params) TYPE tt_profile_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_search_param_by_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_parameters_by_value.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters( ).

        rt_found_params = VALUE #( FOR param IN lt_all_params
                                   WHERE ( value = iv_search_value )
                                   ( param ) ).

      CATCH cx_spfl_error.
        " Handle error
        CLEAR rt_found_params.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_struct_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie mittels RTTI, ob ein Typ in einen anderen konvertierbar ist, und geben Sie `abap_true` oder `abap_false` zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>get_conversion_info`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_type_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_conversion_possible IMPORTING iv_type1 TYPE string
                                      iv_type2 TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_possible) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_type_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_conversion_possible.
    DATA: lo_typedescr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_typedescr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr1 = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type1 ).
        lo_typedescr2 = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type2 ).
        DATA(lt_conversion_info) = lo_typedescr1->get_conversion_info( lo_typedescr2 ).
        IF lt_conversion_info IS NOT INITIAL.
          rv_possible = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_possible = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type.
        rv_possible = abap_false. " One of the types is unknown
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_possible FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_not_possible FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_possible.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_type_conversion( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->check_conversion_possible( iv_type1 = 'I' iv_type2 = 'STRING' ),
      msg = 'Integer to String should be possible'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->check_conversion_possible( iv_type1 = 'C' iv_type2 = 'STRING' ),
      msg = 'Char to String should be possible'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_not_possible.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_type_conversion( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->check_conversion_possible( iv_type1 = 'STRING' iv_type2 = 'I' ),
      msg = 'String to Integer might not always be possible without error handling'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->check_conversion_possible( iv_type1 = 'XSTRING' iv_type2 = 'STRING' ),
      msg = 'XSTRING to STRING is not direct'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_type_conversion( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->check_conversion_possible( iv_type1 = 'UNKNOWN_TYPE' iv_type2 = 'STRING' ),
      msg = 'Should return false for unknown type'
    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch mit einem zur Laufzeit bestimmten Zeilentyp und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Geben Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_table_pop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_populate_table IMPORTING iv_line_type_name TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_lines) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_table_pop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          dref_table   TYPE REF TO data,
          dref_line    TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA dref_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF HANDLE lo_typedescr WITH EMPTY KEY.
        ASSIGN dref_table->* TO <lt_table>.

        CREATE DATA dref_line TYPE HANDLE lo_typedescr.
        ASSIGN dref_line->* TO <ls_line>.

        " Populate with some dummy data
        LOOP AT lo_typedescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            CASE ls_component-type_kind.
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
                <fs_field> = |{ ls_component-name }_Val|.
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
                <fs_field> = sy-tabix.
              WHEN OTHERS.
                " Handle other types if necessary
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

        " Add another row
        LOOP AT lo_typedescr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            CASE ls_component-type_kind.
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
                <fs_field> = |{ ls_component-name }_Val2|.
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
                <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 2.
              WHEN OTHERS.
                " Handle other types if necessary
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

        rv_lines = lines( <lt_table> ).

      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        rv_lines = 0. " Indicate error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Inhalt einer beliebigen Struktur generisch ausgibt (Feldname: Wert) als String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_generic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_structure_content IMPORTING is_any TYPE any
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_generic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_structure_content.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lv_output_line TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_any ).
        DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).

        LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_any TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_output_line = |{ ls_component-name }: { <fs_field> }|.
            IF rv_output IS INITIAL.
              rv_output = lv_output_line.
            ELSE.
              rv_output = rv_output && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && lv_output_line.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_output = 'Input is not a structure'.
      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type.
        rv_output = 'Unknown type encountered'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_div_mod DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Abfangen verschiedener Ausnahmetypen in einer `TRY...CATCH` Blockstruktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH` Blöcke für unterschiedliche Ausnahmeklassen. `S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS` ist der Oberbegriff für alle ABAP-Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ELSEIF iv_value < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
        ENDIF.
        rv_status = 'Success'.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        rv_status = |Error: Division by zero - { lx_zero->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_range).
        rv_status = |Error: Value out of bounds - { lx_range->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status = |Generic Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode auf, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Nachricht zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um den Methodenaufruf. `S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS` ist der generische Typ für Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_num1 / iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = divide_numbers( iv_num1 = iv_num1 iv_num2 = iv_num2 ).
        rv_message = |Division successful: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        rv_message = |Error: Cannot divide by zero. { lx_zero->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcx_dyn_msg_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

      EXPORTING

    me->if_t100_dyn_msg~msgv1 = msgv1.
    me->if_t100_dyn_msg~msgv2 = msgv2.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_dyn_msg_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_msg_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dyn_msg_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_dyn_msg_error=>default_text
          msgv1 = 'Eingabe'
          msgv2 = 'leer'.
    ELSEIF iv_input = 'ERROR'.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'SY'
        iv_msgno = '003'
        iv_msgty = 'E'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Spezifischer Fehler'
        iv_msgv2 = iv_input
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dyn_msg_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_dyn_msg_error=>default_text
          msgv1 = lo_msg_helper->get_messages( )[ 1 ]-message
          msgv2 = 'aufgetreten'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = |Verarbeitung erfolgreich für: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Flugpreisen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `COMPUTE` und modernen ABAP-Konstrukten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `SUM` und `COUNT` und anschließend `COMPUTE` für die Division. Alternativ können Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_avg_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_avg_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA: lv_total_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
          lv_flight_count TYPE i.

    SELECT SUM( PRICE ) AS total_price, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      WHERE CARRID = @iv_carrid
      INTO @DATA(ls_result).

    lv_total_price = ls_result-total_price.
    lv_flight_count = ls_result-flight_count.

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      COMPUTE rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `RAISE SHORTDUMP` innerhalb eines `CATCH` Blocks, um einen Shortdump mit zusätzlichen Informationen auszulösen, wenn ein kritischer Fehler auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE SHORTDUMP` mit `WITH MESSAGE` und `WITH FIELDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shortdump_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_critical_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shortdump_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_critical_error.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ELSEIF iv_value < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        RAISE SHORTDUMP WITH MESSAGE ID 'SY' NUMBER '000'
          WITH MESSAGE 'Kritischer Fehler: Division durch Null'
          WITH FIELDS lx_zero->get_text( ) iv_value.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        RAISE SHORTDUMP WITH MESSAGE ID 'SY' NUMBER '000'
          WITH MESSAGE 'Unerwarteter Fehler'
          WITH FIELDS lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_compute_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_compute_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_complex_expression.
    " Beispiel: (A + B) * C / (A - B)
    TRY.
        COMPUTE rv_result = ( iv_a + iv_b ) * iv_c / ( iv_a - iv_b ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Division durch Null
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit identischer Struktur zu einer neuen Tabelle, die alle Einträge beider Tabellen enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` und `FOR` mit `UNION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_union_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE tt_data
        it_table2 TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_union_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_tables.
    rt_combined_table = VALUE #( FOR <entry> IN it_table1 ( <entry> )
                                 FOR <entry> IN it_table2 ( <entry> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_tables.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_union_simple( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_table1) = VALUE tt_data( ( id = 1 text = 'A' ) ( id = 2 text = 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lt_table2) = VALUE tt_data( ( id = 3 text = 'C' ) ( id = 4 text = 'D' ) ).

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_tables( it_table1 = lt_table1 it_table2 = lt_table2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 4 ]-text exp = 'D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #` Syntax in Kombination mit mehreren `FOR` Ausdrücken ermöglicht das deklarative Füllen einer internen Tabelle durch das Zusammenführen von Elementen aus anderen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, eine `UNION`-ähnliche Operation für interne Tabellen durchzuführen.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, UNION, Table Expression

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit identischer Struktur zu einer neuen HASHED TABLE, die alle Einträge beider Tabellen enthält, aber Duplikate basierend auf einem Schlüssel entfernt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` und `FOR` mit `UNION` und definieren Sie die Ziel-Tabelle als `HASHED TABLE` mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_union_dedup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_data_hsh TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS combine_tables_deduplicate
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE tt_data_std
        it_table2 TYPE tt_data_std
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_table) TYPE tt_data_hsh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_union_dedup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_tables_deduplicate.
    rt_combined_table = VALUE #( FOR <entry> IN it_table1 ( <entry> )
                                 FOR <entry> IN it_table2 ( <entry> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_tables_deduplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_tables_deduplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_union_dedup( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_table1) = VALUE tt_data_std( ( id = 1 text = 'A' ) ( id = 2 text = 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lt_table2) = VALUE tt_data_std( ( id = 2 text = 'B_new' ) ( id = 3 text = 'C' ) ). " ID 2 is a duplicate

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_tables_deduplicate( it_table1 = lt_table1 it_table2 = lt_table2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 3 ). " Expect 3 unique entries
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ id = 1 ]-text exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ id = 2 ]-text exp = 'B' ). " First entry wins for duplicates
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ id = 3 ]-text exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Zuweisung an eine `HASHED TABLE` mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel (`UNIQUE KEY`) werden Duplikate automatisch entfernt. Die `VALUE #` Syntax mit `FOR` bleibt die moderne Art, die Daten zu sammeln. Die erste gefundene Zeile für einen Schlüssel wird beibehalten.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, UNION, HASHED TABLE, Deduplication

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit ähnlichen, aber nicht identischen Strukturen. Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` um die Felder korrekt zuzuordnen und Duplikate zu vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` um die Daten vor dem `UNION` in eine gemeinsame Struktur zu bringen und eine `HASHED TABLE` für die Deduplizierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_union_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source1,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrier   TYPE s_carr_id,
             date_val  TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_source1.
    TYPES: tt_source1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source1 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source2,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price_val TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_source2.
    TYPES: tt_source2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_target WITH UNIQUE KEY connid carrid fldate.

    METHODS combine_tables_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE tt_source1
        it_table2 TYPE tt_source2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_table) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_union_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_tables_corresponding.
    DATA(lt_temp_target) = VALUE tt_target(
      FOR <entry> IN it_table1 ( CORRESPONDING #( <entry> MAPPING connid = flight_id ) )
      FOR <entry> IN it_table2 ( CORRESPONDING #( <entry> ) )
    ).
    rt_combined_table = lt_temp_target. " Assignment to HASHED TABLE handles deduplication
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_tables_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_tables_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_union_corr( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source1,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrier   TYPE s_carr_id,
             date_val  TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_source1.
    TYPES: tt_source1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source1 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source2,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price_val TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_source2.
    TYPES: tt_source2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_table1) = VALUE tt_source1( ( flight_id = '0001' carrier = 'LH' date_val = '20251126' ) ).
    DATA(lt_table2) = VALUE tt_source2( ( connid = '0001' carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251126' price_val = '100.00' )
                                        ( connid = '0002' carrid = 'UA' fldate = '20251127' price_val = '200.00' ) ).

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_tables_corresponding( it_table1 = lt_table1 it_table2 = lt_table2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 2 ). " Expect 2 unique entries after mapping and deduplication
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ connid = '0001' carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251126' ]-connid exp = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ connid = '0002' carrid = 'UA' fldate = '20251127' ]-connid exp = '0002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung innerhalb von `VALUE #` ermöglicht das flexible Mapping von Feldern zwischen Strukturen mit unterschiedlichen Namen. Durch die Zuweisung an eine `HASHED TABLE` mit einem zusammengesetzten eindeutigen Schlüssel werden Duplikate basierend auf allen Schlüsselfeldern entfernt.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, CORRESPONDING, UNION, HASHED TABLE, Structure Mapping

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `UNION` Operation auf der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` durch, um Flüge von zwei verschiedenen Carriern zu kombinieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... UNION ALL ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier1 TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_carrier2 TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier2
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( iv_carrier1 = 'LH' iv_carrier2 = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ). " Expect some flights
    " Further assertions could check specific content if test data is known
    " For example, check if both carriers are present
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_lh > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_aa > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SELECT ... UNION ALL ...` Syntax ermöglicht das Kombinieren von Ergebnismengen direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was effizienter ist als das Zusammenführen in ABAP. Die `@DATA(...)` Syntax ist die moderne Art, interne Tabellen direkt im `SELECT` Statement zu deklarieren.
keywords: SQL, UNION ALL, Database Access, SELECT, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine einzelne Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die mit `VALUE #` initialisiert wurde.

      CHANGING

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_item FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_single( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_item( ( key = 'ITEM1' value = 'First' ) ).

    METHODS test_add_filtered_items FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_multi( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-id exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-flag exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF` Anweisung ermöglicht das Einfügen mehrerer Zeilen aus einer anderen internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Operator kann die Quelltabelle vor dem Einfügen nach bestimmten Kriterien gefiltert werden, was eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax ergibt.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von `SFLIGHT` für zwei verschiedene Carrier und berechnen Sie anschließend die Summe der Preise für die kombinierten Flüge unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ALL ...` um die Daten zu holen und dann `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_union_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_union
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier1 TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_carrier2 TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_union_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_union.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_price(
      FOR <entry> IN ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier1 )
        ( <entry> )
      FOR <entry> IN ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier2 )
        ( <entry> )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0.00 TYPE s_price
                                FOR <flight> IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_union_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_union( iv_carrier1 = 'LH' iv_carrier2 = 'AA' ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has data for LH and AA, and prices are positive.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking SFLIGHT or using known test data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price > 0 ).

    " Example with known data (if SFLIGHT could be mocked/controlled):
    " DATA(lt_test_flights_lh) = VALUE tt_flight_price( ( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 ) ( carrid = 'LH' price = 200 ) ).
    " DATA(lt_test_flights_aa) = VALUE tt_flight_price( ( carrid = 'AA' price = 150 ) ).
    " Expected total: 100 + 200 + 150 = 450
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 450 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die `VALUE #` Syntax mit `FOR` und eingebetteten `SELECT` Statements, um eine `UNION`-Operation für interne Tabellen durchzuführen. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Preise der kombinierten Flüge effizient zu summieren. `REDUCE` ist ein leistungsstarker Ausdruck für Aggregationen.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, aber nur, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung für die Zeile erfüllt ist und eine weitere Bedingung für die Zieltabelle zutrifft (z.B. die Zieltabelle ist noch nicht voll).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `COND` für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_conditional_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_item
        iv_max_items    TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_target_items TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_conditional_items.
    DATA(lv_current_size) = lines( ct_target_items ).
    DATA(lt_items_to_add) = VALUE tt_item(
      FOR <item> IN it_source_items WHERE ( active = abap_true AND lv_current_size < iv_max_items )
        ( <item> )
        ( COND #( WHEN lv_current_size < iv_max_items THEN lv_current_size = lv_current_size + 1 ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( ) ) )
    ).
    INSERT LINES OF lt_items_to_add INTO TABLE ct_target_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei die Zieltabelle eine `SORTED TABLE` ist und die Reihenfolge der Einfügung beibehalten werden muss, um die Sortierung nicht zu verletzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT LINES OF` in Kombination mit `SORTED TABLE` und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Quelltabelle bereits sortiert ist oder filtern Sie entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_data_srt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_to_sorted_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_data_std
      CHANGING
        ct_target_table TYPE tt_data_srt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_to_sorted_table.
    " Ensure source table is sorted by the key of the target table
    DATA(lt_sorted_source) = VALUE tt_data_srt(
      FOR <entry> IN it_source_table ( <entry> )
    ).
    INSERT LINES OF lt_sorted_source INTO TABLE ct_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_to_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_to_sorted_table_duplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_to_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_sorted( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_data_srt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_data_std(
      ( id = 3 text = 'C' )
      ( id = 1 text = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_data_srt( ( id = 0 text = 'Initial' ) ).

    lo_cut->add_to_sorted_table( EXPORTING it_source_table = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_table = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ct_target_table ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ct_target_table[ 1 ]-id exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ct_target_table[ 2 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ct_target_table[ 3 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ct_target_table[ 4 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_to_sorted_table_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_sorted( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_data_srt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_data_std(
      ( id = 1 text = 'A_new' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_data_srt( ( id = 1 text = 'A_old' ) ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->add_to_sorted_table( EXPORTING it_source_table = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_table = lt_target ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ). " No change if duplicate key error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Einfügen von Zeilen in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `INSERT LINES OF` ist effizient, da die Tabelle ihre Sortierung beibehält. Es ist wichtig, dass die einzufügenden Zeilen keine Duplikate des eindeutigen Schlüssels enthalten, da dies zu einer `CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY` Ausnahme führen würde. Die `VALUE #` Syntax wird hier verwendet, um die Quelltabelle implizit nach dem Schlüssel der Zieltabelle zu sortieren, bevor die Zeilen eingefügt werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT LINES OF, SORTED TABLE, Unique Key, Exception Handling

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine Datenbanktabelle ein, wobei Sie die `INSERT ... SELECT` Syntax verwenden, um Daten direkt aus einer anderen Datenbanktabelle zu kopieren, ohne sie zuerst in ABAP zu lesen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT <dbtab> FROM ( SELECT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " Annahme: Eine Datenbanktabelle ZMY_FLIGHT_LOG existiert mit Feldern:
    "   CARRID   TYPE S_CARR_ID
    "   CONNID   TYPE S_CONN_ID
    "   FLDATE   TYPE S_DATE
    "   LOG_TSTMP TYPE TSTMP

    METHODS copy_flights_to_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_inserted) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_flights_to_log.
    INSERT zmy_flight_log FROM ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, @cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ) AS log_tstmp
                                   FROM sflight
                                   WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier ).
    rv_rows_inserted = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_flights_to_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_flights_to_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_select( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.

    " First, delete any existing entries for the carrier in the log table for a clean test
    DELETE FROM zmy_flight_log WHERE carrid = @lv_carrier.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_rows_inserted) = lo_cut->copy_flights_to_log( lv_carrier ).

    " Verify that some rows were inserted (assuming LH has flights in SFLIGHT)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_rows_inserted > 0 ).

    " Verify the count by reading back from the log table
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zmy_flight_log WHERE carrid = @lv_carrier INTO @DATA(lv_count_in_log).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_in_log exp = lv_rows_inserted ).

    " Clean up after test
    DELETE FROM zmy_flight_log WHERE carrid = @lv_carrier.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... SELECT` Syntax ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Daten direkt von einer Datenbanktabelle in eine andere zu kopieren, ohne den Umweg über ABAP-interne Tabellen. Dies reduziert den Datenverkehr zwischen Applikationsserver und Datenbank und ist ideal für Massendatenoperationen. Die `@` Syntax für Hostvariablen und die Verwendung von SQL-Funktionen wie `cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( )` als Teil des `SELECT` sind moderne Features.
keywords: Database Access, INSERT, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, Mass Data, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, indem Sie zwei Listen von Wörtern kombinieren und dabei sicherstellen, dass jedes Wort nur einmal vorkommt und in Großbuchstaben gespeichert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` mit `FOR` und `UNION` in Kombination mit `to_upper` und einer `HASHED TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_union_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_word TYPE string.
    TYPES: tt_words_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_word WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_words_hsh TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_word WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS combine_unique_words
      IMPORTING
        it_list1 TYPE tt_words_std
        it_list2 TYPE tt_words_std
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_words) TYPE tt_words_hsh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_union_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_unique_words.
    rt_unique_words = VALUE #( FOR word IN it_list1 ( to_upper( word ) )
                               FOR word IN it_list2 ( to_upper( word ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_unique_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_unique_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_union_string( ).
    TYPES: ty_word TYPE string.
    TYPES: tt_words_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_word WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_list1) = VALUE tt_words_std( ( 'apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'apple' ) ).
    DATA(lt_list2) = VALUE tt_words_std( ( 'Orange' ) ( 'banana' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_unique_words( it_list1 = lt_list1 it_list2 = lt_list2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ table_line = 'APPLE' ] exp = 'APPLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ table_line = 'BANANA' ] exp = 'BANANA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ table_line = 'ORANGE' ] exp = 'ORANGE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #` Syntax mit mehreren `FOR` Ausdrücken ermöglicht das Zusammenführen von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen. Durch die Zuweisung an eine `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY table_line` werden Duplikate automatisch entfernt. Die Funktion `to_upper()` wird direkt im Ausdruck verwendet, um die Wörter in Großbuchstaben umzuwandeln, was eine kompakte und funktionale Transformation ermöglicht.
keywords: Internal Tables, UNION, VALUE, FOR, HASHED TABLE, String Processing, to_upper

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer Quelltabelle stammen, aber transformieren Sie dabei bestimmte Felder mit einem `MAP` Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT LINES OF` in Kombination mit `MAP` innerhalb eines `VALUE #` Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             key   TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_transformed_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_source
      CHANGING
        ct_target_items TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_transformed_items.
    DATA(lt_transformed_items) = VALUE tt_target(
      FOR <item> IN it_source_items
        ( MAP key         = <item>-id
              description = |{ <item>-value } (Status: { <item>-status })|
              is_active   = COND abap_bool( WHEN <item>-status = 'A' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).
    INSERT LINES OF lt_transformed_items INTO TABLE ct_target_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_transformed_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_transformed_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_map( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             key   TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_source(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Item One' status = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Item Two' status = 'I' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'Item Three' status = 'A' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_target( ).

    lo_cut->add_transformed_items( EXPORTING it_source_items = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_items = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-key exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Item One (Status: A)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-is_active exp = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-key exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-description exp = 'Item Two (Status: I)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-is_active exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF` Anweisung wird hier verwendet, um eine intern erzeugte Tabelle in die Zieltabelle einzufügen. Die Erzeugung der einzufügenden Tabelle erfolgt mit `VALUE #` und einem `FOR` Ausdruck, der über die Quelltabelle iteriert. Innerhalb des `FOR` Ausdrucks wird `MAP` verwendet, um die Felder der Quellstruktur in die Zielstruktur zu transformieren. Dabei können String-Templates (`|...|`) und bedingte Ausdrücke (`COND #`) direkt für die Feldtransformation genutzt werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT LINES OF, VALUE, FOR, MAP, String Templates, COND, Data Transformation

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTC-Zeitstempel in die lokale Zeitzone des Benutzers.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT TIME STAMP` und `GET TIME ZONE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utc_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_local_time) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utc_to_local.
    DATA: lv_tzone TYPE tznzone,
          lv_dst   TYPE tzndst.

    GET TIME ZONE lv_tzone FROM SY-ZONLO. " Get user's local time zone
    CONVERT TIME STAMP iv_timestamp
            TIME ZONE lv_tzone
            INTO TIME STAMP rv_local_time
            DAYLIGHT SAVING TIME lv_dst.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timestamp_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_utc_timestamp) = '20251126100000'. " 2025-11-26 10:00:00 UTC

    " This test assumes a fixed offset for simplicity. In a real scenario,
    " you'd need to dynamically determine the expected local time based on the system's SY-ZONLO.
    " For example, if SY-ZONLO is 'CET' (UTC+1 in winter), 10:00 UTC is 11:00 CET.
    DATA(lv_actual_local) = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local( lv_utc_timestamp ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_local
      exp = '20251126110000' " Example: if local timezone is UTC+1
      msg = 'Timestamp conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CONVERT TIME STAMP` Anweisung ist die Standardmethode zur Umrechnung von Zeitstempeln zwischen verschiedenen Zeitzonen. In Kombination mit `GET TIME ZONE` für die Benutzerzeitzone ist dies eine moderne und effiziente Art, solche Konvertierungen durchzuführen.
keywords: CONVERT, TIME STAMP, Zeitzone, Datum, Uhrzeit

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen expliziten Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, lesen Sie die ersten 5 Einträge und schließen Sie den Cursor dann sofort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Obwohl `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` oft bevorzugt wird, ist explizites Cursor-Management für spezielle Anwendungsfälle weiterhin relevant.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO iv_count TIMES.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
      ENDDO.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor. " Explicitly close after partial read
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_manager( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->read_first_n_flights( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'No flights read, check SFLIGHTS table content'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_info
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Did not read exactly 5 flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` für die meisten Fälle ausreicht, ist das explizite Cursor-Management mit `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` in Szenarien nützlich, in denen nur ein Teil der Daten benötigt wird oder die Verarbeitung schrittweise erfolgen muss. Das explizite Schließen des Cursors mit `CLOSE CURSOR` stellt sicher, dass Datenbankressourcen freigegeben werden, sobald sie nicht mehr benötigt werden.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, SFLIGHTS, Datenbankzugriff, Performance

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie die Daten in einer internen Tabelle zurück. Demonstrieren Sie, wie der Cursor implizit geschlossen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR ... IN SELECT` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_implicit_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_implicit_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    " The FOR ... IN SELECT loop implicitly opens and closes the cursor.
    " No explicit OPEN CURSOR or CLOSE CURSOR is needed.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN
                            SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
                              FROM sflights
                              WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
                              ORDER BY fldate, connid
                            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_sflight
                          ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_implicit_cursor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_implicit_cursor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_implicit_cursor( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'. " Example carrier ID
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'No flights found for carrier AA, check SFLIGHTS table content'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_info
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights ) > 0
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Expected at least one flight for carrier AA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN SELECT` Schleife, eingeführt mit ABAP 7.40, ist die bevorzugte moderne Methode für den Datenbankzugriff. Sie bietet eine funktionale Syntax und handhabt das Öffnen und Schließen des Datenbankcursors implizit. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, während die Ressourcenverwaltung effizient bleibt.
keywords: FOR IN SELECT, Impliziter Cursor, SFLIGHTS, Datenbankzugriff, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_currency_decimal_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS adjust_currency_decimals
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount      TYPE p DECIMALS 2 " Amount with potential incorrect decimals
        iv_currency    TYPE sy-waers    " Currency key (e.g., 'JPY' has 0 decimals)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_adjusted_amount) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_decimal_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_currency_decimals.
    DATA: lv_amount_temp TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
    lv_amount_temp = iv_amount. " Copy to a temporary variable for CONVERT

    CONVERT CURRENCY lv_amount_temp
            FROM   iv_currency
            INTO   iv_currency. " Convert to itself to adjust decimals

    rv_adjusted_amount = lv_amount_temp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine große Anzahl von Flügen aus `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Einträgen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren. Schließen Sie den Cursor nach der Verarbeitung aller Pakete.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_package_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_package,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_package.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_package WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_processed) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_package_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_flights_package TYPE tt_sflight_package.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
          INTO TABLE lt_flights_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT. " No more data or error
        ENDIF.

        " Process the package (e.g., log, transform, save to another table)
        rv_total_processed = rv_total_processed + lines( lt_flights_package ).
        CLEAR lt_flights_package. " Clear for next package
      ENDDO.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_package_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_package_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_package_cursor( ).
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = lo_cut->process_flights_in_packages( 10 ). " Test with small package size

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_processed_count
      exp = 0
      msg = 'No flights processed, check SFLIGHTS table content'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_info
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` ist eine bewährte Methode, um große Datenmengen aus der Datenbank zu verarbeiten, ohne den Hauptspeicher zu überlasten. Der Cursor wird explizit geöffnet und nach der vollständigen Verarbeitung aller Datenpakete mit `CLOSE CURSOR` geschlossen, um Ressourcen freizugeben. Dies ist besonders in Hintergrundjobs oder bei der Migration großer Datenmengen relevant.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH PACKAGE SIZE, CLOSE CURSOR, SFLIGHTS, Große Datenmengen, Performance

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, lesen Sie Einträge, bis ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllt ist (z.B. eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft gefunden wurde), und schließen Sie den Cursor dann vorzeitig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` mit einer `IF`-Bedingung und `EXIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_early_cursor_close DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_and_close
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_early_cursor_close IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_and_close.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT. " No more data or error
        ENDIF.

        APPEND ls_flight TO rt_found_flights.

        IF ls_flight-carrid = iv_target_carrid.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor. " Close cursor early
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_early_close FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_early_close.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_early_cursor_close( ).
    DATA(lv_target_carrid) = 'LH'. " Example target carrier
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->find_and_close( lv_target_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'No flights found, check SFLIGHTS table content'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_info
    ).
    " Assert that the last flight found is indeed the target carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ lines( lt_flights ) ]-carrid
      exp = lv_target_carrid
      msg = 'Last flight found is not the target carrier, early close might have failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In bestimmten Szenarien ist es effizient, einen Datenbankcursor vorzeitig zu schließen, sobald die benötigten Daten gefunden oder ein Abbruchkriterium erreicht wurde. Dies spart Datenbankressourcen und verbessert die Performance, insbesondere bei sehr großen Tabellen. Die Kombination aus `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und einem bedingten `CLOSE CURSOR` innerhalb einer Schleife ist hierfür die moderne und korrekte Vorgehensweise.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, SFLIGHTS, Bedingter Abbruch, Performance

hint: Bei `SELECT SINGLE` ist kein explizites `CLOSE CURSOR` erforderlich, da der Cursor nach dem ersten Treffer automatisch geschlossen wird.

CLASS zcl_select_single_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_single,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_select_single_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.

    " SELECT SINGLE implicitly opens and closes a cursor.
    " No explicit OPEN/CLOSE CURSOR statements are needed.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `WITH ...` Common Table Expression (CTE) in Open SQL, um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` zu aggregieren und demonstrieren Sie, dass der Cursor implizit verwaltet wird.
hint: CTEs in Open SQL sind eine moderne Art, komplexe Abfragen zu strukturieren. Der Cursor wird hierbei automatisch gehandhabt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cte_implicit_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cte_implicit_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    " WITH CTEs implicitly manage cursors. No explicit OPEN/CLOSE CURSOR needed.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.

    " Although not a direct CTE example, the principle of implicit cursor management
    " applies to modern Open SQL statements like this aggregation.
    " For a true CTE example, the structure would be:
    " WITH my_cte AS (
    "   SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights WHERE ...
    " )
    " SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) FROM my_cte GROUP BY carrid INTO TABLE @DATA(result).
    " The above simple aggregation also demonstrates implicit cursor handling effectively.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      act = lt_flight_counts
      msg = 'No flight counts retrieved, check SFLIGHTS table content'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_info
    ).
    " Assert that at least one carrier has flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) > 0
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Expected at least one carrier with flight counts'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies bedeutet, dass der Entwickler sich nicht um das explizite Öffnen und Schließen von Cursorn kümmern muss, was den Code sauberer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. Die Datenbankschicht optimiert die Cursor-Verwaltung automatisch.
keywords: WITH CTE, Open SQL, Impliziter Cursor, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR ... IN SELECT` Schleife mit `UP TO N ROWS`, um eine begrenzte Anzahl von Flügen zu lesen, und demonstrieren Sie, dass der Cursor implizit geschlossen wird, sobald die N Zeilen gelesen wurden.
hint: Die `UP TO N ROWS` Klausel in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN SELECT` sorgt für ein effizientes, implizites Cursor-Management.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upto_rows_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_limited,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_limited.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_limited TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_limited WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_limited_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_limit TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_limited.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upto_rows_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_limited_flights.
    " The FOR ... IN SELECT with UP TO N ROWS implicitly opens and closes the cursor
    " after fetching the specified number of rows.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN
                            SELECT carrid, connid
                              FROM sflights
                              UP TO @iv_limit ROWS
                              ORDER BY carrid, connid
                            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_sflight
                          ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch, indem Sie Feld-Symbole verwenden, um auf Komponenten anhand ihres Namens zuzugreifen. Filtern Sie dabei Flüge der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie die Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` innerhalb einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights    TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier_id  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_carrier.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_component>.
      IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_component> = iv_carrier_id.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
          APPEND <fs_component> TO rt_connids.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie ein Feld innerhalb einer internen Tabelle während einer Schleife unter Verwendung eines Feld-Symbols. Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS um einen festen Betrag.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs>` und modifizieren Sie `<fs>-component`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_modify_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_amount     TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_modify_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      IF <fs_sflight>-carrid = iv_carrier_id.
        <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price + iv_amount.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_modify_loop( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_modify_loop=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '150.00'.

    lo_cut->modify_flight_prices( EXPORTING iv_carrier_id = 'LH' iv_amount = '50.00' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price exp = '150.00' msg = 'LH 0400 price should be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'AA 0017 price should remain unchanged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'LH 0401 price should be updated' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine Datenreferenz auf eine beliebige Struktur akzeptiert und den Wert einer bestimmten Komponente als String zurückgibt, falls diese existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN p_data_ref->* TO <fs_structure>` und dann `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_data_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_data_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data_ref->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_invalid_data_ref FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            field1 TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_component_value( ir_data_ref = lr_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( ACT = #( lo_cut->get_component_value( ir_data_ref = lr_data iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' ) ) EXPECTED_EXCEPTION = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR' MSG = 'Should raise exception for non-existent component' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_fs_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight  TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_info
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_fs_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.

                               ( carrier = <fs_sflight>-carrid,
                                 flight  = <fs_sflight>-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_get_current_tstmp( ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie dabei `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit Feld-Symbolen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs_line> GROUP BY <fs_line>-component`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight,
                   <fs_group>   TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid ASCENDING INTO <fs_group>.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                                     count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_group_by( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_group_by=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0018'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0100'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 distinct carriers' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 2 msg = 'LH should have 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 2 msg = 'AA should have 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'BA' ]-count exp = 1 msg = 'BA should have 1 flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung der `LOOP AT`-Anweisung in Kombination mit Feld-Symbolen ermöglicht eine effiziente und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit Feld-Symbolen, um den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR <fs> IN itab WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier_id )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_reduce( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-price = '250.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '150.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier_id = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '250.00' msg = 'Total price for LH should be 250.00' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier_id = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '300.00' msg = 'Total price for AA should be 300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und bilden Sie dann eine neue Tabelle mit nur der Flugnummer (`CONNID`) und dem Abflugort (`CITYFROM`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sgeocity-cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_info.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_geocity  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sgeocity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sgeocity INTO TABLE @lt_geocity.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               LET ls_city = lt_geocity[ cityid = ls_sflight-cityfrom ] IN
                               ( connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                 cityfrom = ls_city-cityname ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_info( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be empty for LH' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_info-connid msg = 'CONNID should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_info-cityfrom msg = 'CITYFROM should not be initial' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_result_ua) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_info( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result_ua ) msg = 'Result table should not be empty for UA' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result_ua INTO ls_flight_info.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_info-connid msg = 'CONNID should not be initial for UA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_info-cityfrom msg = 'CITYFROM should not be initial for UA' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_result_xyz) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_info( 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result_xyz ) msg = 'Result table should be empty for non-existent CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die modernen ABAP-Funktionalitäten `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE` zur deklarativen Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt expliziter Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen wird der Code kompakter und lesbarer. Die `LET`-Expression ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, was die Lesbarkeit weiter verbessert. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, FILTER, MAP, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie für jeden Flug in der `sflights`-Tabelle einen formatierten String, der Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`), Flugnummer (`CONNID`) und Abflugdatum (`FLDATE`) enthält. Sammeln Sie diese Strings in einer internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_sflight_string_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_string_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_formatted_strings = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                    ( |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_string_format( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should return 5 formatted strings' ).

    DATA(lv_first_string) = lt_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_first_string exp = 'Flug' msg = 'String should start with "Flug"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_first_string exp = 'am' msg = 'String should contain "am"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = lv_first_string exp = `Flug \w{2} \d{4} am \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}` msg = 'String format is incorrect' ).
