explanation: Obwohl in modernem ABAP der `-` Operator in Ausdrücken bevorzugt wird, existiert die `SUBTRACT` Anweisung weiterhin und kann für einfache Dekrementierungen verwendet werden. Dieses Beispiel zeigt ihre direkte Anwendung.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, deren Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und subtrahieren Sie einen Rabatt von diesen Preisen. Verwenden Sie dabei `FILTER` und `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` für die Selektion und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Preisreduzierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES ty_sflights_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS apply_discount
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_price
            iv_threshold TYPE s_price
            iv_discount  TYPE s_price
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_price.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD apply_discount.
        rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER ty_sflights_price( it_flights WHERE price < iv_threshold )
                                         ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                           connid = flight-connid
                                           price  = flight-price - iv_discount ) ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_sflights_price(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ]-price exp = '80.00' ).

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen XML-String und extrahieren Sie den Wert aus dem <Name>-Knoten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document`, um das XML zu laden, und `get_elements_by_tag_name`, um den Knoten zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_name_from_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_name_from_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_xml_node     TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lt_nodes        TYPE if_xml_document=>t_node_list.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_string ).

    lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name(
      EXPORTING
        name = 'Name'
      IMPORTING
        nodes = lt_nodes
    ).

    IF lt_nodes IS NOT INITIAL.
      lo_xml_node = lt_nodes[ 1 ].
      rv_name = lo_xml_node->get_text( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das ein einfaches Buch mit Titel und Autor darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document`, um das Dokument und die Elemente zu erstellen, und dann `render_2_xstring`, um den XML-String zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_book_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_title  TYPE string
        iv_author TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_book_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_element TYPE REF TO if_xml_element,
          lo_title_element TYPE REF TO if_xml_element,
          lo_author_element TYPE REF TO if_xml_element.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_root_element = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Book' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_element ).

    lo_title_element = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Title' ).
    lo_title_element->set_text_cdata( iv_title ).
    lo_root_element->append_child( lo_title_element ).

    lo_author_element = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Author' ).
    lo_author_element->set_text_cdata( iv_author ).
    lo_root_element->append_child( lo_author_element ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        pretty_print = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        stream       = rv_xml_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_book_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `render_2_xstring` konvertiert die In-Memory-XML-Struktur in eine String-Darstellung. `REF TO` wird für alle XML-Objektreferenzen verwendet.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine einfache XML-Eingabe in eine Klartextausgabe mithilfe eines XSLT-Stylesheets.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` für XML und `cl_xslt_processor` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_input TYPE string
        iv_xslt_stylesheet TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_transformed_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_xslt_processor TYPE REF TO cl_xslt_processor,
          lx_error          TYPE REF TO cx_xslt_error.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_input ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xslt_processor.
    TRY.
        lo_xslt_processor->create_stylesheet_xstring( iv_xslt_stylesheet ).
        lo_xslt_processor->transform(
          EXPORTING
            xml_document = lo_xml_document
          IMPORTING
            result_xstring = rv_transformed_output
        ).
      CATCH cx_xslt_error INTO lx_error.
        " Fehler bei der XSLT-Transformation behandeln, z.B. protokollieren
        rv_transformed_output = |Fehler bei der XSLT-Transformation: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_xml_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_xslt_transformer( ).
    DATA(lv_xml_input) = `<Data><Item>Value1</Item><Item>Value2</Item></Data>`.
    DATA(lv_xslt_stylesheet) =
      `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>` &&
      `<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">` &&
      `<xsl:output method="text"/>` &&
      `<xsl:template match="/">` &&
      `Items: ` &&
      `<xsl:for-each select="Data/Item">` &&
      `<xsl:value-of select="."/> ` &&
      `</xsl:for-each>` &&
      `</xsl:template>` &&
      `</xsl:stylesheet>`.
    DATA(lv_expected_output) = `Items: Value1 Value2 `.
    DATA(lv_actual_output) = lo_cut->transform_xml(
                                   iv_xml_input = lv_xml_input
                                   iv_xslt_stylesheet = lv_xslt_stylesheet
                                 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_output
      exp = lv_expected_output
      msg = 'XML sollte korrekt transformiert werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_xml_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_xslt_transformer( ).
    DATA(lv_xml_input) = `<Data><Item>Value1</Item></Data>`.
    DATA(lv_xslt_stylesheet) = `<InvalidXSLT>`. " Ungültiges XSLT
    DATA(lv_actual_output) = lo_cut->transform_xml(
                                   iv_xml_input = lv_xml_input
                                   iv_xslt_stylesheet = lv_xslt_stylesheet
                                 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_actual_output
      exp = `Fehler bei der XSLT-Transformation`
      msg = 'Sollte XSLT-Fehler abfangen.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die XML-Transformation mit `cl_xslt_processor`. Die XML-Eingabe wird in `cl_xml_document` geladen, und das XSLT-Stylesheet wird als String bereitgestellt. Die Methode `transform` wendet das Stylesheet an. Die Fehlerbehandlung für XSLT wird ebenfalls gezeigt. `REF TO` ist entscheidend für die Verwaltung der XML-Dokument- und XSLT-Prozessorobjekte.
keywords: XML, XSLT, cl_xml_document, cl_xslt_processor, REF TO, Exception Handling

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Funktion, die eine Referenz auf eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT` entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur Flüge von 'LH' (Lufthansa) enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>` und `FOR ... IN <fs_table>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        ir_sflight_table TYPE REF TO data " Referenz auf eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT
        iv_carrier_id    TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight_table> TYPE tt_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight_line>  TYPE ty_sflight.

    ASSIGN ir_sflight_table->* TO <fs_sflight_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
        FOR <fs_sflight_line> IN <fs_sflight_table>
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier_id )
        ( <fs_sflight_line> )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA lt_sflight_data TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.
    lt_sflight_data = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_sflight_ref) = REF TO lt_sflight_data.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( 
                           ir_sflight_table = lr_sflight_ref
                           iv_carrier_id = 'LH'

Instructions: Laden Sie ein XML-Dokument, fügen Sie einen neuen Kindknoten zu einem vorhandenen Element hinzu und ändern Sie ein Attribut.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document`-Methoden wie `get_elements_by_tag_name`, `create_element`, `append_child`, `set_attribute`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_node_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS manipulate_xml_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_node_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_xml_nodes.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_element TYPE REF TO if_xml_element,
          lo_new_node     TYPE REF TO if_xml_element,
          lt_nodes        TYPE if_xml_document=>t_node_list.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_string ).

    " Root-Element holen
    lo_root_element = lo_xml_document->get_root( ).

    " Vorhandenes Element finden (z.B. <Item id='1'>)
    lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name(
      EXPORTING
        name = 'Item'
      IMPORTING
        nodes = lt_nodes
    ).

    IF lt_nodes IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_item_node) = CAST if_xml_element( lt_nodes[ 1 ] ).

      " Attribut ändern
      lo_item_node->set_attribute( name = 'status' value = 'processed' ).

      " Neuen Kindknoten hinzufügen
      lo_new_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Comment' ).
      lo_new_node->set_text_cdata( 'Added by ABAP' ).
      lo_item_node->append_child( lo_new_node ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        pretty_print = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        stream       = rv_modified_xml
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_cut->manipulate_xml_nodes( lv_xml_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(

Die Verwendung von `REF TO` ist hierbei grundlegend, da alle XML-Elemente und Knoten als Objektreferenzen behandelt werden. `CAST` wird verwendet, um eine generische `if_xml_node`-Referenz in eine spezifischere `if_xml_element`-Referenz umzuwandeln.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname als String bereitgestellt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    " Eine Beispielmethode, die dynamisch aufgerufen werden kann
    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_number
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_param_name TYPE string VALUE 'IV_NAME',
          lv_param_value TYPE string VALUE 'World'.

    TRY.
        CASE iv_method_name.
          WHEN 'GET_GREETING'.
            CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
              EXPORTING
                (lv_param_name) = lv_param_value
              RECEIVING
                rv_greeting = rv_result.
          WHEN 'GET_NUMBER'.
            CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
              RECEIVING
                rv_number = DATA(lv_num_result).
            rv_result = |{ lv_num_result }|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_result = 'Method not supported for dynamic call'.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        rv_result = |Dynamischer Aufruffehler: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_no_handler_for_lref INTO DATA(lx_no_handler).
        rv_result = |Kein Handler für Referenz: { lx_no_handler->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |Hello, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_number.
    rv_number = 123.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_greeting FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_invalid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_greeting.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_method_dynamically(
                         io_object = lo_target
                         iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING'
                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Hello, World!'
      msg = 'Dynamischer Aufruf von GET_GREETING sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_number.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_method_dynamically(
                         io_object = lo_target
                         iv_method_name = 'GET_NUMBER'
                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = '123'
      msg = 'Dynamischer Aufruf von GET_NUMBER sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_invalid.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_method_dynamically(
                         io_object = lo_target
                         iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Method not supported for dynamic call'
      msg = 'Sollte Fehler für nicht unterstützte Methode zurückgeben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf in ABAP mit `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference)`. Der Methodenname wird zur Laufzeit als String bereitgestellt. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für hochflexible und erweiterbare Anwendungen, die oft in Frameworks oder zur Implementierung von Plugins verwendet wird. Die Verwendung von `REF TO object` ermöglicht den Aufruf von Methoden auf beliebigen Objekten.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, REF TO object, Exception Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Schnittstelle und zwei Klassen, die diese implementieren. Demonstrieren Sie die Polymorphie, indem Sie eine Liste von Objektreferenzen auf die Schnittstelle verarbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING`, `REF TO` und `FOR`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC IMPLEMENTING zif_shape.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.

    METHODS zif_shape~get_area.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Circle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC IMPLEMENTING zif_shape.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.

    METHODS zif_shape~get_area.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Square'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE tt_shapes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    rt_results = VALUE #( 
      FOR <ls_shape_ref> IN it_shapes
      ( |Type: { <ls_shape_ref>->get_type() }, Area: { <ls_shape_ref>->get_area() }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Attribute eines bestimmten XML-Elements und geben Sie sie als Hash-Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und `if_xml_element->get_attributes()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_attributes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH UNIQUE KEY name.

    METHODS get_element_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_element_attributes.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lt_nodes        TYPE if_xml_document=>t_node_list,
          lo_element      TYPE REF TO if_xml_element,
          lt_xml_attributes TYPE if_xml_element=>t_attribute_list.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_string ).

    lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name(
      EXPORTING
        name = iv_tag_name
      IMPORTING
        nodes = lt_nodes
    ).

    IF lt_nodes IS NOT INITIAL.
      lo_element = CAST if_xml_element( lt_nodes[ 1 ] ).
      lt_xml_attributes = lo_element->get_attributes( ).

      rt_attributes = VALUE #( 
        FOR <ls_attr> IN lt_xml_attributes
        ( name = <ls_attr>-name value = <ls_attr>-value )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory-Muster, um Objekte verschiedener Typen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zu erstellen. Verwenden Sie `REF TO` für die Rückgabe des generischen Objekts.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schnittstelle für den gemeinsamen Typ und `CREATE OBJECT TYPE (class_name)` in der Factory-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC IMPLEMENTING zif_product.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC IMPLEMENTING zif_product.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA lv_class_name TYPE string.

    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_A'.
      WHEN 'B'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_B'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fehlerbehandlung oder leere Referenz zurückgeben
        CLEAR ro_product.
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_product TYPE (lv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        CLEAR ro_product.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem XML-Dokument nach allen Elementen mit einem bestimmten Attributwert und geben Sie deren Textinhalte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document`, `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `get_attribute()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_search_by_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_elements_by_attribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
        iv_attr_name  TYPE string
        iv_attr_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_contents) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_search_by_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_elements_by_attribute.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lt_nodes        TYPE if_xml_document=>t_node_list,
          lo_element      TYPE REF TO if_xml_element.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_string ).

    lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name(
      EXPORTING
        name = iv_tag_name
      IMPORTING
        nodes = lt_nodes
    ).

    rt_contents = VALUE #( 
      FOR <ls_node_ref> IN lt_nodes
      LET lo_element = CAST if_xml_element( <ls_node_ref> ) IN
      WHERE ( lo_element->get_attribute( iv_attr_name ) = iv_attr_value )
      ( lo_element->get_text() )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine anonyme Datenreferenz (`NEW data(...)`) und eine anonyme interne Tabelle (`NEW tt_...(...)`) in einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine komplexe Aggregation durchzuführen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE`, `NEW data(...)` und `NEW tt_...(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_with_anon_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE decfloat16,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS summarize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_anon_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights.
    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_carrier_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary( )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      LET lv_carrid = ls_flight-carrid IN
      DATA(ls_current_entry) = VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
                                  carrid = lv_carrid
                                  total_price = ls_flight-price
                                  flight_count = 1
                                )
      IF result IS NOT INITIAL AND result-carrid = lv_carrid.
        result-total_price = result-total_price + ls_flight-price.
        result-flight_count = result-flight_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        INSERT ls_current_entry INTO TABLE result.
      ENDIF.
      " Modern approach using table expressions for update/insert
      result = REDUCE tt_carrier_summary(
        INIT r = result
        FOR existing_entry IN r
        WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrid )
        NEXT
          r = VALUE tt_carrier_summary(
            FOR entry IN r
            ( COND #( WHEN entry-carrid = lv_carrid
                      THEN VALUE ty_carrier_summary( entry
                                                     total_price = entry-total_price + ls_flight-price
                                                     flight_count = entry-flight_count + 1 )
                      ELSE entry ) )
          )
        FINALLY
          IF NOT line_exists( r[ carrid = lv_carrid ] ).
            INSERT VALUE ty_carrier_summary( carrid = lv_carrid
                                             total_price = ls_flight-price
                                             flight_count = 1 ) INTO TABLE r.
          ENDIF.
      ).
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count exp = 3 msg = 'Fluganzahl für LH sollte 3 sein.' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ].

Es aggregiert Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft, berechnet den Gesamtpreis und die Fluganzahl. Die Verwendung von `LET` und verschachtelten `REDUCE`-Ausdrücken mit Tabellenausdrücken (`FOR ... IN r WHERE ...`) zeigt eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung in ABAP 7.55+, die zu prägnantem und lesbarem Code führt. Obwohl `REF TO` hier nicht explizit als Typ angegeben ist, sind die internen Mechanismen von `REDUCE` und Tabellenausdrücken stark auf Referenzen und die effiziente Manipulation von Datenstrukturen angewiesen.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf `carrid` und `connid` und geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück. Nutzen Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO` und Inline-Deklaration für die Zielstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_info
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @rs_flight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Flight not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit einem Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{ iv_component }' not found|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_component>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature, das das manuelle Mapping von Datenbankfeldern auf Strukturkomponenten mit unterschiedlichen Namen überflüssig macht. Es erhöht die Lesbarkeit und reduziert den Boilerplate-Code, insbesondere wenn nur eine Teilmenge der Felder benötigt wird oder die Namen leicht abweichen (hier durch `AS` Aliasse demonstriert).
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Data Mapping, Structures, sflights

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und aktualisieren Sie dynamisch ein bestimmtes numerisches Feld (z.B. `price`) in jeder Zeile, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, indem Sie einen Aufschlag hinzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_flights    TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_surcharge  TYPE s_price
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_numeric_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_numeric_field>.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found or not accessible|.
      ENDIF.

      IF <fs_numeric_field> IS NOT BOUND OR NOT <fs_numeric_field> IS NUMERIC.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' is not numeric or not bound|.
      ENDIF.

      <fs_numeric_field> = <fs_numeric_field> + iv_surcharge.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_update( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-price exp = 250 ).

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_update( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_invalid_parameter' ).

  METHOD test_update_non_existent_field.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_update=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und performante dynamische Bearbeitung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt Zeilen zu kopieren und zurückzuschreiben, wird direkt auf die Speicheradresse der Zeile und des Feldes zugegriffen, was besonders bei großen Tabellen effizient ist. Die Überprüfung auf numerischen Typ ist wichtig für die Robustheit.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, LOOP AT, Dynamic Update, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in der Tabelle `sflights` existiert, ohne alle Daten zu lesen. Geben Sie `true` oder `false` zurück.

CLASS zcl_flight_existence_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_existence_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true AS dummy

      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.

Es wird lediglich geprüft, ob die `WHERE`-Bedingung erfüllt ist. Die Verwendung von `@abap_true AS dummy` ist eine gängige Konvention, um die Syntax zu erfüllen, wenn keine Felder benötigt werden.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf den Wert einer lokalen Variablen zu, deren Name als String übergeben wird, und ändern Sie diesen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (variable_name) TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_variable_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS manipulate_variable
      IMPORTING
        iv_variable_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cv_var1          TYPE string
        cv_var2          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_variable_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_variable.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_variable> TYPE any.

    CASE iv_variable_name.
      WHEN 'CV_VAR1'.
        ASSIGN cv_var1 TO <fs_variable>.
      WHEN 'CV_VAR2'.
        ASSIGN cv_var2 TO <fs_variable>.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = |Variable '{ iv_variable_name }' not found or not allowed for dynamic access|.
    ENDCASE.

    IF <fs_variable> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <fs_variable> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
            EXPORTING
              text = |Conversion error for variable '{ iv_variable_name }' with value '{ iv_new_value }'|.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_manipulate_string_var FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_manipulate_int_var FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_manipulate_non_existent_var RAISING cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
    METHODS test_manipulate_int_with_invalid_value RAISING cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_manipulate_string_var.
    DATA: lv_var1 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.
    DATA: lv_var2 TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_variable_access( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_manipulator->manipulate_variable( iv_variable_name = 'CV_VAR1'
                                                            iv_new_value = 'Changed String'
                                                            CHANGING cv_var1 = lv_var1
                                                                     cv_var2 = lv_var2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_var1 exp = 'Changed String' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_manipulate_int_var.
    DATA: lv_var1 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.
    DATA: lv_var2 TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_variable_access( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_manipulator->manipulate_variable( iv_variable_name = 'CV_VAR2'
                                                            iv_new_value = '42'
                                                            CHANGING cv_var1 = lv_var1
                                                                     cv_var2 = lv_var2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_var2 exp = 42 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_manipulate_non_existent_var.
    DATA: lv_var1 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.
    DATA: lv_var2 TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_variable_access( ).
    lo_manipulator->manipulate_variable( iv_variable_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
                                         iv_new_value = 'Value'
                                         CHANGING cv_var1 = lv_var1
                                                  cv_var2 = lv_var2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_invalid_parameter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_manipulate_int_with_invalid_value.
    DATA: lv_var1 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.
    DATA: lv_var2 TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_variable_access( ).
    lo_manipulator->manipulate_variable( iv_variable_name = 'CV_VAR2'
                                         iv_new_value = 'Not a number'
                                         CHANGING cv_var1 = lv_var1
                                                  cv_var2 = lv_var2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_invalid_parameter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN (variable_name) TO <fs>` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Variablen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Metaprogrammierung, sollte aber mit Vorsicht eingesetzt werden, da es die statische Code-Analyse erschwert. Die `CASE`-Anweisung dient hier als Sicherheitsmechanismus, um nur explizit erlaubte Variablen dynamisch zu manipulieren.
keywords: ASSIGN, Dynamic Variable, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Metaprogramming

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus `sflights` und bestimmen Sie basierend auf dem Preis, ob es sich um einen 'günstigen', 'normalen' oder 'teuren' Flug handelt. Nutzen Sie eine ABAP `CASE`-Expression nach der Selektion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und anschließend eine `CASE`-Expression auf das gelesene `price`-Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    METHODS analyze_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price_category) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flight_price.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_detail.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @ls_flight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Flight not found'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_price_category = CASE ls_flight-price
                          WHEN BETWEEN 0 AND 200 THEN 'Günstig'
                          WHEN BETWEEN 201 AND 500 THEN 'Normal'
                          WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Teuer'
                        END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cheap_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_normal_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_expensive_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found RAISING cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cheap_flight.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_price_analyzer( ).
    " Assuming a flight with price <= 200 exists, e.g., LH 0400 price 100
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_analyzer->analyze_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Günstig' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_normal_flight.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_price_analyzer( ).
    " Assuming a flight with price between 201 and 500 exists, e.g., AA 0017 price 400
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_analyzer->analyze_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Normal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_expensive_flight.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_price_analyzer( ).
    " Assuming a flight with price > 500 exists, e.g., AZ 0001 price 600
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_analyzer->analyze_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'AZ' iv_connid = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Teuer' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_price_analyzer( ).
    lo_analyzer->analyze_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_not_found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Expression in ABAP ist ein modernes und lesbares Konstrukt für bedingte Logik, das die alte `IF-ELSIF-ENDIF`-Struktur oft ersetzen kann. In Kombination mit `SELECT SINGLE` ermöglicht dies eine klare Trennung von Datenbeschaffung und Geschäftslogik. Die Verwendung von `BETWEEN` in der `WHEN`-Klausel ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature, das den Code prägnanter macht.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CASE, Conditional Logic, sflights, Price Analysis

Instructions: Ändern Sie direkt den Preis einer spezifischen Zeile in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die über ihren Index identifiziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN itab[index] TO <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_row_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_price_by_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_index    TYPE i
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_row_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_by_index.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_data.

    ASSIGN ct_flights[ iv_index ] TO <fs_flight>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = |Line with index { iv_index } not found|.
    ENDIF.

    <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die direkte Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einer Zeile einer internen Tabelle mittels `ASSIGN itab[index] TO <fs_line>` ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um einzelne Zeilen zu modifizieren. Es vermeidet das Kopieren von Daten und ermöglicht die In-Place-Änderung. Die Tabellenexpression `itab[index]` ist ein modernes Feature, das den Zugriff auf Zeilen vereinfacht und lesbarer macht.
keywords: ASSIGN, Internal Tables, Table Index, Field Symbols, Direct Modification

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... ORDER BY ... UP TO 1 ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_highest_price_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    METHODS get_highest_price_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_detail
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_highest_price_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO @rs_flight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = |No flights found for airline '{ iv_carrid }'|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Obwohl `SELECT SINGLE` für Primärschlüsselzugriffe gedacht ist, ist `SELECT ... ORDER BY ... UP TO 1 ROWS` die korrekte und effiziente Methode, um einen einzelnen Datensatz basierend auf einer Sortierreihenfolge zu erhalten. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um z.B. den neuesten, ältesten, höchsten oder niedrigsten Wert zu finden. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist hier ebenfalls Standard.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. `sflights`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbank. Greifen Sie dann dynamisch auf die Zeilen zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHTS'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.

    METHODS get_first_row_carrid
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not create table of type '{ iv_table_type }'|.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamically fill the table (example for sflights)
    IF iv_table_type = 'SFLIGHTS'.
      SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ELSE.
      " Handle other types or raise error if not supported
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = |Filling for table type '{ iv_table_type }' not implemented|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_first_row_carrid.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Dynamic table is not assigned or empty'.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Could not read first row of dynamic table'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Component CARRID not found in dynamic table row'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_carrid = <fs_carrid>.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur basierend auf einem Typnamen und weisen Sie einem ihrer Felder einen Wert zu, dessen Name ebenfalls dynamisch ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_structure_manip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_set_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_type TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHTS'
        iv_field_name     TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID'
        iv_field_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data)    TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_structure_manip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE (iv_structure_type).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <ls_dynamic_structure>.

    IF <ls_dynamic_structure> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not create structure of type '{ iv_structure_type }'|.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_structure> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure '{ iv_structure_type }'|.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        <fs_dynamic_field> = iv_field_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = |Conversion error for field '{ iv_field_name }' with value '{ iv_field_value }'|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus `sflights` und verwenden Sie eine Tabellenexpression, um den Preis zu validieren, bevor Sie ihn zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und eine Tabellenexpression auf eine temporäre interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_valid_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price OPTIONAL
        iv_max_price TYPE s_price OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_valid_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Flight not found'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].

        IF iv_min_price IS SUPPLIED AND ls_flight-price < iv_min_price.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
            EXPORTING
              text = |Price { ls_flight-price } is below minimum { iv_min_price }|.
        ENDIF.

        IF iv_max_price IS SUPPLIED AND ls_flight-price > iv_max_price.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
            EXPORTING
              text = |Price { ls_flight-price } is above maximum { iv_max_price }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_price = ls_flight-price.

      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Internal error: Flight not found in temporary table'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `sflights` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Filtern Sie dann diese Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA`, `ASSIGN` und den `FILTER`-Operator mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_field_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " 1. Dynamisch Tabelle füllen (hier fest SFLIGHTS für Demo)
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No flights available to filter'.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Dynamischen Filter anwenden
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_field_value }'|.

    TRY.
        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE (lv_where_clause) ).
        " Note: FILTER with dynamic WHERE clause requires a secondary key or primary key.
        " For a generic solution, one might need to create a dynamic secondary key or loop.
        " The above line is a simplification for demonstration with a known table structure.

        " A more robust dynamic filter without relying on predefined keys for arbitrary fields:
        DATA(lt_temp_filtered) = VALUE tt_sflight_data( ).
        LOOP AT lt_all_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_flight>).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_flight> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> = iv_field_value.
            APPEND <ls_flight> TO lt_temp_filtered.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        rt_filtered_flights = lt_temp_filtered.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = |Dynamic filter failed for field '{ iv_field_name }' with value '{ iv_field_value }'|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Während der `FILTER`-Operator selbst sehr modern ist, erfordert die dynamische Angabe der `WHERE`-Klausel bei generischen Feldern oft einen Workaround mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, um den Feldzugriff zur Laufzeit zu realisieren. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität von Feldsymbolen und `ASSIGN` bei der Handhabung dynamischer Anforderungen.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus `sflights` und verwenden Sie eine `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression, um eine neue Struktur mit ausgewählten Feldern zu erstellen, falls der Flug gefunden wird, ansonsten eine leere Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und anschließend `VALUE #(...)` mit einer `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_value_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_value_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_cond.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    rs_summary = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN VALUE ty_flight_summary(
                                                    carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                    connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                                    price  = ls_sflight-price )
                         ELSE VALUE ty_flight_summary( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch ausliest und als String zurückgibt. Die Struktur und der Feldname sind zur Laufzeit bekannt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` mit einem Datenreferenzparameter und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure  TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any_field> TYPE any.

    IF ir_structure IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input structure reference is not bound'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <ls_any_structure>.

    IF <ls_any_structure> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Could not assign data reference to field symbol'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_structure> TO <fs_any_field>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_any_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_response_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_http_response_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_json_response_header.
    " In a real scenario, you would interact with an HTTP response object,
    " e.g., from CL_HTTP_SERVER=>GET_CURRENT_SERVER_REQUEST( )->GET_RESPONSE( ).
    " For demonstration, we simulate the header setting.
    DATA(lv_content_type) = cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_json.
    DATA(lv_charset) = 'UTF-8'.

    CREATE DATA rs_header_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_headers> TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    ASSIGN rs_header_info->* TO <lt_headers>.
    APPEND |Content-Type: { lv_content_type }; charset={ lv_charset }| TO <lt_headers>.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie erhalten Binärdaten (XSTRING) und einen MIME-Typ. Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die basierend auf dem MIME-Typ eine einfache Verarbeitung oder Speicherung simuliert (z.B. 'application/pdf' oder 'image/png').
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` für den Vergleich der MIME-Typen und `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES` für die Konvertierung, falls nötig.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             file_size TYPE i,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_info.

    METHODS process_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring  TYPE xstring
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_file_info) TYPE ty_file_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_file.
    rs_file_info-mime_type = iv_mime_type.
    rs_file_info-file_size = xstrlen( iv_xstring ).

    CASE iv_mime_type.
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_pdf.
        rs_file_info-message = |PDF-Datei ({ rs_file_info-file_size } Bytes) verarbeitet.|
        " Simulate PDF processing, e.g., store to GOS or convert to text

      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_png.
        rs_file_info-message = |PNG-Bild ({ rs_file_info-file_size } Bytes) verarbeitet.|
        " Simulate image processing, e.g., display or resize

      WHEN OTHERS.
        rs_file_info-message = |Unbekannter Dateityp '{ iv_mime_type }' ({ rs_file_info-file_size } Bytes) ignoriert.|
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) in eine CSV-Zeichenkette, dann in einen XSTRING und identifizieren Sie den MIME-Typ für CSV.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES` für die String-XSTRING-Konvertierung und `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` für den MIME-Typ. Für CSV-Erstellung können Sie String-Templates und `REDUCE` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_output) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS get_csv_mime_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY`.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
               |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid };{ <fs_sflight>-connid };{ <fs_sflight>-fldate };{ <fs_sflight>-price };{ <fs_sflight>-currency }|
    ).
    rs_output = cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring( lv_csv_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_csv_mime_type.
    rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_csv.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_table_to_csv=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251126' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251127' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )

    DATA(lv_csv_string) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>xstring_to_string( lv_csv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv_string exp = lv_expected_csv msg = 'CSV conversion failed' ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String einem bekannten MIME-Typ (z.B. 'image/jpeg' oder 'text/plain') entspricht, indem Sie die Konstanten von `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` verwenden.
hint: Vergleichen Sie den Eingabestring mit den Konstanten der Klasse `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_known_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_known) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_known_mime_type.
    CASE iv_mime_type.
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_jpeg OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_png OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_gif OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_pdf OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_json OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_xml OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_html OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_text OR
           cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mimetype_csv.
        rv_is_known = abap_true.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_is_known = abap_false.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine Tabelle von XSTRINGs und umgekehrt, wobei die Kodierung beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `MAP` für die Transformation von Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_strings_to_xstrings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_xstrings) TYPE xstring_table.

    METHODS convert_xstrings_to_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_xstrings TYPE xstring_table
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_xstrings.
    rt_xstrings = VALUE xstring_table(
      FOR lv_string IN it_strings
      ( cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring( iv_string = lv_string iv_encoding = iv_encoding ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_xstrings_to_strings.
    rt_strings = VALUE string_table(
      FOR lv_xstring IN it_xstrings
      ( cl_abap_container_utilities=>xstring_to_string( iv_xstring = lv_xstring iv_encoding = iv_encoding ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine sichere Konvertierung eines XSTRING in einen STRING durch, wobei potenzielle Kodierungsfehler abgefangen und gemeldet werden, anstatt einen Dump zu verursachen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>XSTRING_TO_STRING` mit Fehlerbehandlung (z.B. `TRY...CATCH`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_xstring_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring  TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_error_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_error_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_xstring_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_xstring_to_string.
    CLEAR mv_error_message.
    TRY.
        rs_result = cl_abap_container_utilities=>xstring_to_string(
          iv_xstring   = iv_xstring
          iv_encoding  = iv_encoding
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        mv_error_message = lx_error->get_text( ).
        rs_result = 'ERROR: ' && mv_error_message.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_error_message = mv_error_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_safe_xstring_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_xstring) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring( `Valid Text` ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->safe_xstring_to_string( lv_valid_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `Valid Text` msg = 'Valid conversion failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_converter->get_error_message( ) msg = 'No error expected for valid conversion' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_safe_xstring_converter( ).
    " Simulate invalid UTF-8 sequence (e.g., a single byte that's part of a multi-byte char)
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) = 'FF'X.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->safe_xstring_to_string( lv_invalid_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_converter->get_error_message( ) msg = 'Error message expected for invalid conversion' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'ERROR:' msg = 'Result should indicate error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die sichere Konvertierung von XSTRING zu STRING ist entscheidend, wenn die Herkunft der Binärdaten unsicher ist. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit der spezifischen Exception `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR` ermöglicht es, Kodierungsfehler elegant abzufangen und zu behandeln, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies ist ein Best Practice für robuste Anwendungen in ABAP 7.55+.
keywords: XSTRING, STRING, Data Conversion, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR, CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES

CLASS zcl_http_client_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_client_for_url.
    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob Nachrichten eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. 'E' für Fehler) im Nachrichtenprotokoll vorhanden sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER=>GET_MESSAGES` in Kombination mit `FILTER` oder `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_check_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_messages_of_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_msgty TYPE sy-msgty
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_messages) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_check_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_messages_of_type.
    DATA(lt_all_messages) = cl_message_helper=>get_messages( ).

    rv_has_messages = xsdbool(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Client und senden Sie eine POST-Anfrage mit JSON-Payload, wobei Sie `CL_HTTP_UTILITY` für die URL-Kodierung verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT`, `IF_HTTP_CLIENT`, `IF_HTTP_ENTITY` und `CL_HTTP_UTILITY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_json_post_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        iv_json_payload TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_json_post_request.
    DATA lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA lo_http_request TYPE REF TO if_http_entity.
    DATA lo_http_response TYPE REF TO if_http_entity.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_request = lo_http_client->request.
        lo_http_request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_post ).
        lo_http_request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_request->set_cdata( iv_json_payload ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_response = lo_http_client->response.
        rv_response_body = lo_http_response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Exception-Klasse, die `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` verwendet, um Nachrichten zu verwalten und anzuzeigen.
hint: Leiten Sie von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` ab und integrieren Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_message_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        !textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        !previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        !i_msgid TYPE sy-msgid OPTIONAL
        !i_msgno TYPE sy-msgno OPTIONAL
        !i_msgty TYPE sy-msgty OPTIONAL
        !i_msgv1 TYPE sy-msgv1 OPTIONAL
        !i_msgv2 TYPE sy-msgv2 OPTIONAL
        !i_msgv3 TYPE sy-msgv3 OPTIONAL
        !i_msgv4 TYPE sy-msgv4 OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_message_helper_instance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_helper) TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_custom_message_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.

    IF i_msgid IS NOT INITIAL AND i_msgno IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_message_helper = cl_message_helper=>create_message(
        i_msgid = i_msgid,
        i_msgno = i_msgno,
        i_msgty = i_msgty,
        i_msgv1 = i_msgv1,
        i_msgv2 = i_msgv2,
        i_msgv3 = i_msgv3,
        i_msgv4 = i_msgv4
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message_helper_instance.
    ro_message_helper = mo_message_helper.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_message_text.
    IF mo_message_helper IS BOUND.
      result = mo_message_helper->get_message_text( ).
    ELSE.
      result = super->get_text( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_t100_message~get_t100_key.
    IF mo_message_helper IS BOUND.
      result-msgid = mo_message_helper->get_message_id( ).
      result-msgno = mo_message_helper->get_message_number( ).
      result-attr1 = mo_message_helper->get_message_v1( ).
      result-attr2 = mo_message_helper->get_message_v2( ).
      result-attr3 = mo_message_helper->get_message_v3( ).
      result-attr4 = mo_message_helper->get_message_v4( ).
    ELSE.
      result = super->if_t100_message~get_t100_key( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS raise_custom_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_message_error.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_message_error
        EXPORTING
          i_msgid = 'SY'
          i_msgno = '000'
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgv1 = 'Ein Pflichtfeld ist leer'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(

CLASS zcl_zip_multiple_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rv_zipped_data = lo_zip->save( ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_by_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_by_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    IF <lt_any_table> IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT <lt_any_table> BY (iv_field).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_structure> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any_field>     TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <ls_any_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_structure> TO <lv_any_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <lv_any_field>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Datenreferenzen akzeptiert und den Inhalt der referenzierten Datenobjekte in einer neuen internen Tabelle sammelt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_table_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS collect_referenced_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data_refs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_collected_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_table_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_referenced_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lr_data> TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_data> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_data_refs ASSIGN <lr_data>.
      IF <lr_data> IS BOUND.
        ASSIGN <lr_data>->* TO <lv_data>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND |{ <lv_data> }| TO rt_collected_data.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
