Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und formatieren Sie den Preis und das Datum für die Anzeige.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und anschließend `cl_abap_format` in einer `LOOP` oder `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
        carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate     TYPE string, " Formatted date
        price      TYPE string, " Formatted price
        currency   TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_formatted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                    ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                      connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                      fldate   = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( )->format_date(
                                                     val    = ls_sflight-fldate
                                                     format = cl_abap_format=>date_format_ddmmyyyy )
                                      price    = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( )->format_currency(
                                                     val      = ls_sflight-price
                                                     currency = ls_sflight-currency )
                                      currency = ls_sflight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_formatted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_flights.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_sflights_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_formatter->get_formatted_flights( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_match_regex(
        act = ls_flight-fldate
        exp = '\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}'
        msg = 'Date format is incorrect' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-price msg = 'Price should be formatted' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-currency msg = 'Currency should be present' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_formatter->get_formatted_flights( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_all_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_format` innerhalb einer `FOR`-Schleife für die Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten aus der Datenbank zu lesen und direkt für die Anzeige zu formatieren.
keywords: cl_abap_format, SFLIGHTS, Internal Tables, FOR, Data Formatting, SELECT

CLASS zcl_process_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      WHEN gc_status-completed.
        rv_description = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN gc_status-cancelled.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält.
hint: Selektieren Sie Daten in eine interne Tabelle und iterieren Sie diese, um Zellen zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflights_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights_report.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_xlsx.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_sheet( 'Flight Data' ).

    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei, deren Spaltenüberschriften dynamisch zur Laufzeit aus den Feldnamen einer internen Tabelle ermittelt werden (mittels RTTI).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_rtti_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_rtti_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        it_data          TYPE tt_data
        iv_filename      TYPE string DEFAULT 'rtti_report.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_rtti_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_rtti_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_sheet( 'Dynamic Data' ).

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_data[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lv_col = 1.
      DATA(lr_data_ref) = REF TO ls_data.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_value> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE lr_data_ref->* TO <lv_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( <lv_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

Die Datenzeilen werden dann ebenfalls dynamisch mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` gefüllt. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für flexible Berichte.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).

        lo_sheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_format = lo_format_green ).

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) in ein Format, das für die XLSX-Ausgabe geeignet ist, und schreiben Sie diese dann in eine XLSX-Datei. Nutzen Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Daten zu aggregieren oder umzuwandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_reduce_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_reduced_sflights_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'reduced_sflights.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_reduce_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_reduced_sflights_xlsx.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_summary) = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                             INIT sum = 0
                             FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP <group>
                             NEXT sum = sum + ls_grouped_flight-price )
          lv_num_flights = lines( GROUP <group> )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                              ( carrid = <group>-key
                                total_price = lv_total_price
                                num_flights = lv_num_flights ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_sheet( 'Flight Summary' ).

    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Total Price' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Number of Flights' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_summary-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_summary-total_price ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_summary-num_flights ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD create_xlsx_with_error_handling.

    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_sheet( 'Test Sheet' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Data' ).

    TRY.
        rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
      CATCH cx_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_xlsx_error).
        " In a real scenario, log the error or provide user feedback
        MESSAGE lx_xlsx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xlsx_error( previous = lx_xlsx_error ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

INTERFACE zif_report_data_source PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_report_row,
           col_id TYPE string,
           col_value TYPE string,
         END OF ty_report_row.
  TYPES: tt_report_rows TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_report_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_report_data
    RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_report_data_source~get_report_data.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und schreiben Sie jede Gruppe in ein separates Blatt einer XLSX-Datei.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` um Daten zu gruppieren und dann `add_new_sheet` für jede Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_grouping_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_grouped_sflights_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'grouped_sflights.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_grouping_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_grouped_sflights_xlsx.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).

    FOR GROUPS <group> OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_sheet( <group>-key ).

      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Price' ).

      DATA(lv_row) = 2.
      LOOP AT GROUP <group> INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_grouped_flight-connid ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_grouped_flight-fldate ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_grouped_flight-price ).
        lv_row = lv_row + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDFOR.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax zur Datenaggregation.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_bar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flight_count_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_count_by_carrier.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    " Datenaggregation mit moderner ABAP-Syntax
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_data).

    " Container erstellen oder verwenden
    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ELSE.
      lo_container = cl_gui_container=>screen_0->get_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    " Diagrammtyp setzen
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).

    " Daten für das Diagramm vorbereiten mit VALUE # FOR
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flight_data
      ( category = ls_flight-carrid, value = ls_flight-flight_count )
    ).

    " Daten zum Diagramm hinzufügen
    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Anzahl Flüge'
        data_table  = lt_chart_data
    ).

    " Titel setzen
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).

    " Diagramm zeichnen
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    " Container anzeigen (falls intern erstellt)
    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CALL SCREEN 100. " Dummy-Bildschirm zum Anzeigen des Diagramms
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Liniendiagramm, das die durchschnittliche Belegung von Flügen (aus `sflights`) über einen bestimmten Zeitraum darstellt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` und `MAP` oder `FOR` für die Datenumwandlung nach der Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_occupancy_line_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL
        iv_from_date      TYPE s_date
        iv_to_date        TYPE s_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_occupancy_line_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    " Datenaggregation: Durchschnittliche Belegung pro Datum
    SELECT fldate, AVG( seatsocc / seatsmax ) AS avg_occupancy
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @iv_from_date AND @iv_to_date
      GROUP BY fldate
      ORDER BY fldate
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_occupancy_data).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ELSE.
      lo_container = cl_gui_container=>screen_0->get_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).

    " Daten für das Diagramm vorbereiten
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_occupancy IN lt_occupancy_data
      ( category = |{ ls_occupancy-fldate DATE = USER }|, value = ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy * 100 )
    ).

    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Durchschnittliche Belegung (%)'
        data_table  = lt_chart_data
    ).

    lo_chart->set_title( |Flugbelegung von { iv_from_date DATE = USER } bis { iv_to_date DATE = USER }| ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Datum' ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Belegung (%)' ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_occupancy_data_calc FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_data_calc.
    DATA(lv_from_date) = sy-datum - 30.
    DATA(lv_to_date) = sy-datum.

    SELECT fldate, AVG( seatsocc / seatsmax ) AS avg_occupancy
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @lv_from_date AND @lv_to_date
      GROUP BY fldate
      ORDER BY fldate
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_occupancy_data).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_occupancy_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_occupancy_data ) ).

    IF lines( lt_occupancy_data ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_between( act = lt_occupancy_data[ 1 ]-avg_occupancy exp1 = 0 exp2 = 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_chart_revenue_pie DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_revenue_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_revenue_pie IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_revenue_by_currency.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    " Daten aus sflights lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    " Aggregation des Umsatzes pro Währung mit REDUCE
    DATA(lt_revenue_by_currency) = REDUCE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      INIT l_result = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET l_currency = ls_flight-loccurkey IN
      DATA(l_index) = line_index( l_result[ category = l_currency ] ) IN
      IF l_index IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_table(
          category = l_currency
          value    = ls_flight-price
        ) TO l_result.
      ELSE.
        l_result[ l_index ]-value = l_result[ l_index ]-value + ls_flight-price.
      ENDIF.
      FINALLY = l_result
    ).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ELSE.
      lo_container = cl_gui_container=>screen_0->get_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_pie ).

    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Gesamtumsatz'
        data_table  = lt_revenue_by_currency
    ).

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Gesamtumsatz pro Währung' ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_capacity_stack IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_capacity_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    " Daten aus sflights lesen und filtern
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN it_carrids
    ).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ELSE.
      lo_container = cl_gui_container=>screen_0->get_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_stacked_bar ).

    " Daten für Kapazitätsserie vorbereiten
    DATA(lt_capacity_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      ( category = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|,
        value    = ls_flight-seatsmax )
    ).

    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Max. Kapazität'
        data_table  = lt_capacity_data
    ).

    " Daten für Belegungsserie vorbereiten
    DATA(lt_occupancy_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      ( category = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|,
        value    = ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).

    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Belegte Sitze'
        data_table  = lt_occupancy_data
    ).

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flugkapazität vs. Belegung' ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Flug' ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Anzahl Sitze' ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue ArchiveLink-Verbindung für einen Flugplan-Eintrag aus `sflights` und verknüpfen Sie ein Dummy-Dokument. Die Objekt-ID soll dynamisch aus den Schlüsselfeldern generiert werden.

CLASS zcl_alink_create_doc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS create_dummy_link
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_alink_create_doc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dummy_link.
    DATA: lv_object_id  TYPE toav0-object_id,
          lv_arc_doc_id TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
          lv_doc_type   TYPE toav0-ar_object,
          lv_comp_id    TYPE toav0-comp_id.

    " Annahme: Ein benutzerdefinierter Objekttyp für sflights
    CONSTANTS: lc_object_type TYPE toav0-sap_object VALUE 'Z_SFLIGHT',
               lc_doc_type    TYPE toav0-ar_object VALUE 'PDF'.

    " Objekt-ID aus Schlüsselfeldern mit String-Templates generieren
    lv_object_id = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    TRY.
        " Simulieren einer Archivdokument-ID
        lv_arc_doc_id = 'DUMMY_ARCHIVE_DOC_ID_123'.
        lv_comp_id = '1'.

        " ArchiveLink-Verbindung erstellen
        cl_alink_connection=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            i_sap_object  = lc_object_type
            i_object_id   = lv_object_id
            i_ar_object   = lc_doc_type
            i_arc_doc_id  = lv_arc_doc_id
            i_comp_id     = lv_comp_id
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS        = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle verknüpften Dokumente für ein gegebenes SAP-Business-Objekt ab und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse nach einem bestimmten Dokumenttyp. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Verarbeitung der Liste.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alink_connection=>get_links` und `FOR` mit `FILTER` für die Ergebnisverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_get_docs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_link_info,
             arc_doc_id TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
             ar_object  TYPE toav0-ar_object,
             comp_id    TYPE toav0-comp_id,
           END OF ty_link_info,
           tt_link_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_link_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_links
      IMPORTING
        i_sap_object  TYPE toav0-sap_object
        i_object_id   TYPE toav0-object_id
        i_filter_ar_object TYPE toav0-ar_object OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_links) TYPE tt_link_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_get_docs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_links.
    DATA: lt_links TYPE cl_alink_connection=>tt_links.

    TRY.
        cl_alink_connection=>get_links(
          EXPORTING
            i_sap_object = i_sap_object
            i_object_id  = i_object_id
          IMPORTING
            et_links     = lt_links
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS       = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Ergebnisse filtern und mappen mit FOR und COND
          rt_links = VALUE tt_link_info(
            FOR ls_link IN lt_links
            WHERE ( i_filter_ar_object IS INITIAL OR ls_link-ar_object = i_filter_ar_object )
            ( arc_doc_id = ls_link-arc_doc_id,
              ar_object  = ls_link-ar_object,
              comp_id    = ls_link-comp_id )
          ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Dokumenttyp mit einem SAP-Business-Objekt verknüpft ist. Nutzen Sie eine moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Bedingungsprüfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alink_connection=>get_links` und `LINE_EXISTS` oder eine `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_check_doc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_document_exists
      IMPORTING
        i_sap_object  TYPE toav0-sap_object
        i_object_id   TYPE toav0-object_id
        i_ar_object   TYPE toav0-ar_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_check_doc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_document_exists.
    DATA: lt_links TYPE cl_alink_connection=>tt_links.

    TRY.
        cl_alink_connection=>get_links(
          EXPORTING
            i_sap_object = i_sap_object
            i_object_id  = i_object_id
          IMPORTING
            et_links     = lt_links
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS       = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Prüfen, ob ein Link mit dem gesuchten Dokumenttyp existiert
          rv_exists = COND abap_bool(
            WHEN line_exists( lt_links[ ar_object = i_ar_object ] ) THEN abap_true
            ELSE abap_false
          ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie die Attribute aller verknüpften Dokumente für ein SAP-Business-Objekt ab und extrahieren Sie spezifische Attribute in eine neue interne Tabelle. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alink_connection=>get_links` und `FOR` mit `MAP` für die Attributextraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_get_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_doc_attribute,
             arc_doc_id TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
             attribute_name TYPE string,
             attribute_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_doc_attribute,
           tt_doc_attribute TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_doc_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_document_attributes
      IMPORTING
        i_sap_object  TYPE toav0-sap_object
        i_object_id   TYPE toav0-object_id
        it_attribute_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_doc_attribute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_get_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_document_attributes.
    DATA: lt_links TYPE cl_alink_connection=>tt_links,
          lt_doc_attributes TYPE cl_alink_connection=>tt_doc_attributes.

    TRY.
        cl_alink_connection=>get_links(
          EXPORTING
            i_sap_object = i_sap_object
            i_object_id  = i_object_id
          IMPORTING
            et_links     = lt_links
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS       = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Für jeden Link die Attribute abrufen
          LOOP AT lt_links INTO DATA(ls_link).
            cl_alink_connection=>get_document_attributes(
              EXPORTING
                i_arc_doc_id = ls_link-arc_doc_id
              IMPORTING
                et_doc_attributes = lt_doc_attributes
              EXCEPTIONS
                OTHERS            = 1
            ).

            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              " Attribute filtern und mappen mit FOR und COND
              APPEND LINES OF VALUE tt_doc_attribute(
                FOR ls_attr IN lt_doc_attributes
                WHERE ( it_attribute_names IS INITIAL OR line_exists( it_attribute_names[ table_line = ls_attr-attribute_name ] ) )
                ( arc_doc_id = ls_link-arc_doc_id,
                  attribute_name = ls_attr-attribute_name,
                  attribute_value = ls_attr-attribute_value )
              ) TO rt_attributes.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` und `GROUP BY` mit `CASE` oder `COND` für die Preisbereiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_price_histogram DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_price_histogram
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_price_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_price_histogram.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    " Datenaggregation: Flüge pro Preisbereich
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS flight_count,
           CASE
             WHEN price < 100 THEN '0-99'
             WHEN price >= 100 AND price < 200 THEN '100-199'
             WHEN price >= 200 AND price < 300 THEN '200-299'
             ELSE '300+'
           END AS price_range
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY price_range
      ORDER BY price_range
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_price_distribution).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ELSE.
      lo_container = cl_gui_container=>screen_0->get_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_dist IN lt_price_distribution
      ( category = ls_dist-price_range, value = ls_dist-flight_count )
    ).

    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Anzahl Flüge'
        data_table  = lt_chart_data
    ).

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Verteilung der Flugpreise' ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Preisbereich' ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_combo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_chart_combo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_combo_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    " Datenaggregation: Anzahl Flüge und Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    ELSE.
      lo_container = cl_gui_container=>screen_0->get_container( iv_container_name ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    " Diagrammtyp setzen (kombiniert)
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_combo ).

    " Datenserie für Fluganzahl (Balken)
    DATA(lt_flight_count_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_aggregated_data
      ( category = ls_data-carrid, value = ls_data-flight_count )
    ).

    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Anzahl Flüge'
        data_table  = lt_flight_count_data
        chart_type  = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar
        axis_index  = 0 " Primäre Achse
    ).

    " Datenserie für Durchschnittspreis (Linie)
    DATA(lt_avg_price_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_aggregated_data
      ( category = ls_data-carrid, value = ls_data-avg_price )
    ).

    lo_chart->add_data_series(
      EXPORTING
        description = 'Durchschnittspreis'
        data_table  = lt_avg_price_data
        chart_type  = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line
        axis_index  = 1 " Sekundäre Achse
    ).

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flüge und Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Anzahl Flüge' axis_index = 0 ).
    lo_chart->set_axis_title( axis = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_axis_value title = 'Durchschnittspreis' axis_index = 1 ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_generic_link DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_generic_link
      IMPORTING
        i_sap_object  TYPE toav0-sap_object
        i_business_key TYPE any STRUCTURE
        i_ar_object   TYPE toav0-ar_object
        i_arc_doc_id  TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_generic_link IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_generic_link.
    DATA: lv_object_id TYPE toav0-object_id,
          lv_comp_id   TYPE toav0-comp_id VALUE '1'.

    " Dynamische Generierung der Objekt-ID aus der übergebenen Struktur
    " Dies ist eine vereinfachte Darstellung. In der Realität müsste die Logik
    " zur ID-Generierung spezifisch für den Objekttyp sein.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA(lv_temp_object_id) = ``.

    DO.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE i_business_key TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_temp_object_id = lv_temp_object_id && <fs_component>.
    ENDDO.
    lv_object_id = lv_temp_object_id.

    TRY.
        cl_alink_connection=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            i_sap_object  = i_sap_object
            i_object_id   = lv_object_id
            i_ar_object   = i_ar_object
            i_arc_doc_id  = i_arc_doc_id
            i_comp_id     = lv_comp_id
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS        = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine Liste aller Geschäftsperioden zwischen einem Start- und Enddatum.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` mit einer Schleife und modernen ABAP-Konstrukten wie `DO` und `line_exists`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_info,
             fiscal_year TYPE gjahr,
             fiscal_period TYPE poper,
           END OF ty_period_info,
           ty_period_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_periods_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE ty_period_info_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_periods_in_range.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( iv_fiscal_year_variant = 'K4' ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(ls_period) TYPE ty_period_info.

    DO.
      lo_period_toolset->get_period_for_date(
        EXPORTING
          iv_date         = lv_current_date
        IMPORTING
          ev_fiscal_year  = ls_period-fiscal_year
          ev_fiscal_period = ls_period-fiscal_period
      ).

      IF NOT line_exists( rt_periods[ fiscal_year = ls_period-fiscal_year fiscal_period = ls_period-fiscal_period ] ).
        APPEND ls_period TO rt_periods.
      ENDIF.

      lo_period_toolset->get_date_n_periods_offset(
        EXPORTING
          iv_date         = lv_current_date
          iv_offset       = 1 " Move to next period
        IMPORTING
          ev_result_date  = lv_current_date
      ).

      IF lv_current_date > iv_end_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_periods_in_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_periods_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_iterator( ).
    DATA(lt_periods) = lo_cut->get_periods_in_range( iv_start_date = '20251015' iv_end_date = '20260110' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_periods ),
      exp = 4, " Oct 2025, Nov 2025, Dec 2025, Jan 2026
      msg = 'Should return 4 periods'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_periods[ 1 ]-fiscal_year,
      exp = 2025,
      msg = 'First period year should be 2025'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_periods[ 1 ]-fiscal_period,
      exp = 10,
      msg = 'First period should be 10'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_periods[ 4 ]-fiscal_year,
      exp = 2026,
      msg = 'Last period year should be 2026'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_periods[ 4 ]-fiscal_period,
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'Last period should be 1'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die iterative Nutzung des Perioden-Toolsets, um eine Reihe von Geschäftsperioden zu generieren. Die `DO`-Schleife in Kombination mit `get_date_n_periods_offset` ermöglicht eine effiziente Navigation durch die Perioden. `line_exists` wird verwendet, um Duplikate zu vermeiden, falls das Startdatum mitten in einer Periode liegt.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_http_utility=>decode_base64` mit `cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_c`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_container_base64_to_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS deserialize_base64_to_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_base64_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_base64_to_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_base64_to_sflights.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( iv_str = iv_base64_string ).

    cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_c(
      EXPORTING
        im_container = lv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ex_value     = rt_sflights
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize_from_base64 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_from_base64.
    " First, serialize and encode to get a valid Base64 string
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_container_tab_to_base64( ).
    DATA(lv_base64_string) = lo_serializer->serialize_sflights_to_base64( ).

    " Then, decode and deserialize it
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_container_base64_to_tab( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_deserialized) = lo_deserializer->deserialize_base64_to_sflights( lv_base64_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_sflights_deserialized,
      msg = 'Deserialized table should not be initial'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lines( lt_sflights_deserialized ) > 0,
      msg = 'Deserialized table should contain entries'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel ist das Gegenstück zum vorherigen und demonstriert den vollständigen Zyklus: Dekodierung eines Base64-Strings mittels `cl_http_utility=>decode_base64` und anschließende Deserialisierung des resultierenden XSTRINGs zurück in eine interne Tabelle mit `cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_c`.
keywords: cl_abap_container_utilities, Base64, Deserialization, XSTRING, cl_http_utility

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED TABLE vom Typ SFLIGHT und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT. Greifen Sie dann effizient auf einen Eintrag mittels des Schlüssels zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORTED TABLE` mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel und `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_basic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_basic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_basic_access( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-planetype ). " Assuming this flight might not exist or is initial for test

    " Find an existing flight for a more robust test
    DATA(lv_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) TYPE sflight-fldate.
    SELECT SINGLE fldate FROM sflight INTO @lv_fldate WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-planetype ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SORTED TABLE` bietet durch ihren definierten Schlüssel einen sehr effizienten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen, da die Tabelle intern sortiert ist und binäre Suchalgorithmen verwendet werden können. Die `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY` Syntax ist hierfür optimiert.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, Internal Tables, Performance, Key Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` aus `sflights` und gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft zu ermitteln. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `GROUP BY` in einer `VALUE` Anweisung, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).

    " Check if a specific carrier exists and has a count
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check uniqueness of carrid (guaranteed by SORTED TABLE with UNIQUE KEY)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = REDUCE i( INIT x = 0 FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid WITHOUT MEMBERS x = x + 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`, `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Die `SORTED TABLE` stellt sicher, dass die Ergebnisse nach dem Schlüssel sortiert sind und effizient weiterverarbeitet werden können.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. eine Auswahl aus `sflights`) in einen JSON-String unter Verwendung von `/ui2/cl_json`.
hint: Die `serialize`-Methode von `/ui2/cl_json` kann auch interne Tabellen verarbeiten, die dann als JSON-Array von Objekten dargestellt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_flights pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_serialize_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_itab( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_flights( iv_max_rows = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '[' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = ']' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"carrid":' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"connid":' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"fldate":' ).

    " Test with multiple rows
    lv_json = lo_cut->serialize_flights( iv_max_rows = 2 ).
    DATA(lt_check) TYPE zcl_json_serialize_itab=>tt_flight_data.
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json IMPORTING data = lt_check ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `serialize`-Methode von `/ui2/cl_json` ist intelligent genug, um interne Tabellen automatisch als JSON-Arrays von Objekten zu serialisieren, wobei jede Zeile der Tabelle einem JSON-Objekt entspricht. Dies vereinfacht die Datenübertragung erheblich.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von Flügen (aus `sflights`) nach einem bestimmten Zielort ('NEW YORK').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen, um eine neue gefilterte Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights_to_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityto TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_to_city.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( mt_all_flights WHERE cityto = iv_cityto ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_to_city FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_to_city.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_city) = 'NEW YORK'.
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_to_city( lv_city ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = lv_city ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a city that likely has no flights
    DATA(lt_empty_filter) = lo_cut->get_flights_to_city( 'NONEXISTENTCITY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_empty_filter ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die der angegebenen Bedingung entsprechen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für `SORTED TABLE`s, da die Sortierung beibehalten wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Operations, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer `SORTED TABLE` (aus `sflights`).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe der Passagiere zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats > 0 ).

    " Manually calculate expected sum for comparison (or use a known subset)
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_sum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` mit einem zusammengesetzten Schlüssel (z.B. `carrid` und `connid`) und fügen Sie Daten aus `sflights` hinzu. Demonstrieren Sie den Zugriff über diesen Schlüssel.

solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_compound_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_compound_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    rt_flights = FILTER #( mt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von Flügen und verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit dem Tabellenschlüssel, um die Existenz und Position eines Eintrags zu prüfen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die funktionalen Ausdrücke `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit der `KEY` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( mt_flights[ KEY primary_key
                                                                 carrid = iv_carrid
                                                                 connid = iv_connid
                                                                 fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_index.
    rv_index = LINE_INDEX( mt_flights[ KEY primary_key
                                        carrid = iv_carrid
                                        connid = iv_connid
                                        fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_checks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_checks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_line_exists( ).

    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) TYPE sflight-fldate.
    SELECT SINGLE fldate FROM sflight INTO @lv_fldate WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Test existing flight
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_flight_existence( lv_carrid lv_connid lv_fldate ) exp = abap_true ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->get_flight_index( lv_carrid lv_connid lv_fldate ) > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test non-existent flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_flight_existence( 'XX' '9999' '20250101' ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_index( 'XX' '9999' '20250101' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Angabe des Schlüssels (`KEY primary_key`) stellt sicher, dass die Suche optimiert wird.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage. Fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen ab.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE=>CONVERT_FROM` oder `CONVERT_TO` und `TRY...CATCH` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp    TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp    TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        " Convert string to xstring using source codepage
        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
          EXPORTING
            source      = iv_input_string
            codepage    = iv_source_cp
          IMPORTING
            buffer_xstr = lv_xstring
        ).

        " Convert xstring back to string using target codepage
        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
          EXPORTING
            buffer_xstr = lv_xstring
            codepage    = iv_target_cp
          IMPORTING
            buffer_str  = rv_converted_string
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        " Re-raise specific exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_codepage_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        " Log or handle generic error
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_codepage EXPECTING EXCEPTION cx_sy_codepage_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜß'.
    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_converter->convert_string(
                            iv_input_string = lv_input
                            iv_source_cp    = '1100' " UTF-8
                            iv_target_cp    = '4103' " ISO-8859-1
                          ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted
      exp = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜß'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_codepage.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Test'.
    " This should raise an exception as '9999' is an invalid codepage
    lo_converter->convert_string(
      iv_input_string = lv_input
      iv_source_cp    = '1100'
      iv_target_cp    = '9999'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` bietet statische Methoden zur Konvertierung von Strings zwischen verschiedenen Codepages. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung, wobei `WHEN OTHERS` generische Ausnahmen abfängt, während spezifische Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER` gezielt behandelt werden können.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, CONVERT_TO, CONVERT_FROM, TRY...CATCH, WHEN OTHERS, Codepage Conversion, Exception Handling

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazitäten aller Flüge einer Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flight_capacity.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_aggregator->get_total_capacity( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_all_flights = lt_test_flights ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge anzuzeigen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzplätzen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_seats
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      it_all_flights
      WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc >= iv_min_free_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100. " 50 free

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum und die Uhrzeit, die 3 Stunden und 30 Minuten nach einem gegebenen Zeitstempel liegen, unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden `ADD` oder `SUBTRACT` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_time_to_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_hours     TYPE i
        iv_minutes   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_timestamp) TYPE timestampl
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_time_to_timestamp.
    DATA: lv_seconds TYPE i.

    lv_seconds = ( iv_hours * 3600 ) + ( iv_minutes * 60 ).

    TRY.
        cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
          EXPORTING
            tstmp = iv_timestamp
            secs  = lv_seconds
          IMPORTING
            r_tstmp = rv_new_timestamp
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " Re-raise specific exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_arith_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        " Log or handle generic error
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_time FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_overflow EXPECTING EXCEPTION cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_time.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_timestamp_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = '20231026100000.0000000'. " 26.10.2023 10:00:00
    DATA(lv_expected_tstmp) = '20231026133000.0000000'. " 26.10.2023 13:30:00

    DATA(lv_new_tstmp) = lo_calculator->add_time_to_timestamp(
                           iv_timestamp = lv_start_tstmp
                           iv_hours     = 3
                           iv_minutes   = 30
                         ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_tstmp exp = lv_expected_tstmp ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overflow.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_timestamp_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = '99991231235959.0000000'. " Max timestamp
    " Adding even 1 second should cause an overflow
    lo_calculator->add_time_to_timestamp(
      iv_timestamp = lv_start_tstmp
      iv_hours     = 0
      iv_minutes   = 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` bietet statische Methoden zur einfachen und sicheren Manipulation von Zeitstempeln. Die Methoden `ADD` und `SUBTRACT` ermöglichen das Hinzufügen oder Abziehen von Sekunden. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ist hier wichtig, um Überläufe oder andere arithmetische Fehler abzufangen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Timestamp, Date, Time, ADD, Exception Handling, WHEN OTHERS

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf einer Status-ID, unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Operators.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_status_id TYPE c LENGTH 1

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string(
      iv_status_id
      WHEN 'A' THEN 'Annulliert'
      WHEN 'D' THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN 'O' THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannter Status'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status_text( 'D' ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status_text( 'A' ) exp = 'Annulliert' ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit und geben Sie den Namen des Typs zurück.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

explanation: Die RTTI-Klassen (Run-Time Type Information) wie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` ermöglichen die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme oder Frameworks, die mit unbekannten Datentypen umgehen müssen. `DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` liefert eine Typbeschreibung, von der der Typname abgerufen werden kann. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hier essenziell.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, unter Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_field_value = <fs_value>.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur gefunden.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_assign_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Klassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt, unter Verwendung von `NEW` mit Typangabe.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler ab.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_patt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.

    TRY.
        " Remove leading/trailing spaces
        rv_cleaned_string = |{ rv_cleaned_string ALPHA = OUT }|.

        " Replace multiple spaces with single space
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s{2,}' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.

      CATCH cx_sy_strg_patt INTO DATA(lx_regex_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_regex_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_strg_patt.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitzplätze (`seatsocc`) für eine Liste von Flügen und fangen Sie eine mögliche Division durch Null ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DIVIDE` oder den `/` Operator und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_math DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_math IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( it_flights ).

    IF lv_flight_count = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division durch Null: Keine Flüge zum Berechnen des Durchschnitts vorhanden.'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_average = lv_total_seats / lv_flight_count.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_arith_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten eines bestimmten Interface-Typs akzeptiert und eine Methode dieses Interfaces auf jedem Objekt aufruft, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `CAST`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `CAST` um Objekte zu verarbeiten, die ein bestimmtes Interface implementieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_actionable.
  METHODS perform_action IMPORTING iv_context TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS clear_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD clear_log.
    CLEAR gt_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~perform_action.
    APPEND |Action A performed with context: { iv_context }| TO zcl_action_log=>gt_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~perform_action.
    APPEND |Action B performed with context: { iv_context }| TO zcl_action_log=>gt_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_actionable TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_actions
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_actionable
        iv_context TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_actions.
    DATA(lt_actionables) = VALUE zcl_action_processor=>tt_actionable(
      FOR <fs_object> IN it_objects
      LET lo_actionable = CAST zif_actionable( <fs_object> )
      IN
        ( lo_actionable )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_actionables INTO DATA(lo_actionable).
      TRY.
          lo_actionable->perform_action( iv_context ).
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_cast_error).
          " Handle case where cast failed (should not happen if logic is correct)
          APPEND |Error: Cast failed for object. { lx_cast_error->get_text( ) }| TO zcl_action_log=>gt_log.
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
          APPEND |Error: Generic exception during action. { lx_root->get_text( ) }| TO zcl_action_log=>gt_log.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_actions FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_actions_with_non_actionable FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_actions.
    zcl_action_log=>clear_log( ).
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE zcl_action_processor=>tt_actionable.
    APPEND NEW zcl_concrete_action_a( ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_concrete_action_b( ) TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_action_processor( ).
    lo_processor->process_actions( it_objects = lt_objects iv_context = 'Test Context' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( zcl_action_log=>gt_log ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_action_log=>gt_log[ 1 ] exp = 'Action A performed with context: Test Context' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_action_log=>gt_log[ 2 ] exp = 'Action B performed with context: Test Context' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_actions_with_non_actionable.
    zcl_action_log=>clear_log( ).
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE zcl_action_processor=>tt_actionable.
    APPEND NEW zcl_concrete_action_a( ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_action_log( ) TO lt_objects. " This object does not implement zif_actionable

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_action_processor( ).
    lo_processor->process_actions( it_objects = lt_objects iv_context = 'Another Context' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( zcl_action_log=>gt_log ) exp = 1 ). " Only Action A should be logged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_action_log=>gt_log[ 1 ] exp = 'Action A performed with context: Another Context' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Schleife und `CAST`-Operator ermöglicht die elegante Verarbeitung von Objekten in einer Liste, die ein bestimmtes Interface implementieren. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der Polymorphie und fördert flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und `WHEN OTHERS` ist wichtig, um unerwartete Cast-Fehler oder andere Ausnahmen während der dynamischen Objektinteraktion abzufangen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Polymorphism, FOR, CAST, WHEN OTHERS, Exception Handling

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem String, der Text und Zahlen gemischt enthält, und geben Sie sie als Liste von Strings zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden Muster für Zahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_patt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    TRY.
        FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_input_string RESULTS lt_match_results.

        rt_numbers = VALUE #(
          FOR ls_match IN lt_match_results
          ( substring( val = iv_input_string off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) )
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_strg_patt INTO DATA(lx_regex_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_regex_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_strg_patt.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Anzahl von leeren Zeilen unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und `FOR` mit `FROM 1 TO n`.

CLASS zcl_table_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_empty_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_empty_table) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_empty_table.
    IF iv_number_of_rows < 0.
      " Handle invalid input, e.g., raise exception or return empty table
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_empty_table = VALUE #(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_number_of_rows
      ( id = i name = '' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
