Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (simuliert SFLIGHT).
hint: Nutze den REDUCE Operator mit einer INIT-Variable für die Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight       TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-price = 100.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-price = 200.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-price = 50.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_price( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price should be 350' act = lv_total exp = 350 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Die INIT-Klausel initialisiert die Akkumulatorvariable, und die NEXT-Klausel definiert die Iterationslogik.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle eine kommaseparierte Liste aller eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs (CARRID) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwende REDUCE in Kombination mit einer HASHED TABLE für die Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids.
    DATA(lt_unique_carrids) = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT unique_carrids = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL )
      LET lv_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT unique_carrids = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( unique_carrids[ table_line = lv_carrid ] ) THEN
                                      VALUE string_table( BASE unique_carrids ( lv_carrid ) )
                                    ELSE
                                      unique_carrids ) ).

    rv_carrid_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR carrid IN lt_unique_carrids
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN carrid ELSE result && `, ` && carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carrids.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight       TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_unique_carrid( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid_list) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrids( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Unique CARRIDs should be LH, AA, UA (order might vary)'
                                        act = lv_carrid_list
                                        exp = 'LH, AA, UA' ). " Order depends on internal table iteration, but for this test, we assume a stable order or adjust expected.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verkettung von zwei REDUCE-Operationen. Zuerst werden eindeutige CARRIDs gesammelt, indem geprüft wird, ob ein Element bereits in der Akkumulator-Tabelle existiert. Anschließend werden diese eindeutigen IDs zu einem String zusammengefügt. Die Verwendung von COND #(...) innerhalb von REDUCE ermöglicht eine bedingte Logik.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Processing, COND, Unique Values

Instructions: Gruppiere Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechne für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Flugdauer (FLTIME).
hint: Nutze REDUCE mit GROUP BY und einer lokalen Struktur für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_avg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_fltime TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_avg,
           ty_flight_avgs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_flight_time_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_times) TYPE ty_flight_avgs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_flight_time_by_carrid.
    rt_avg_times = REDUCE ty_flight_avgs(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_flight_avgs( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      LET total_fltime = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + member-fltime )
          count_flights = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_flight_avgs( BASE result
                                          ( carrid     = carrid
                                            avg_fltime = COND #( WHEN count_flights > 0 THEN total_fltime / count_flights ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_avg FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_avg.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight       TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-fltime = 120. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-fltime = 180. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-fltime = 240. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-fltime = 300. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-fltime = 180. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_times) = lo_cut->get_avg_flight_time_by_carrid( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of groups should be 2' act = lines( lt_avg_times ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_avg_times WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_avg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH average should be 150' act = ls_lh_avg-avg_fltime exp = 150 ).

    READ TABLE lt_avg_times WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_avg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA average should be 240' act = ls_aa_avg-avg_fltime exp = 240 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von REDUCE mit der GROUP BY-Klausel. Es ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb von Gruppen, wobei für jede Gruppe eine separate REDUCE-Operation (hier zur Summenbildung) durchgeführt werden kann. Die LET-Klausel verbessert die Lesbarkeit durch die Definition temporärer Variablen.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, LET

Instructions: Finde den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Nutze REDUCE, um iterativ den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    rs_max_flight = REDUCE #( INIT max_flight = VALUE sflight( price = 0 )
                              FOR flight IN it_flights
                              WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                              NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN flight ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight       TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-price = 100. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. ls_flight-price = 300. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. ls_flight-price = 250. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0402'. ls_flight-price = 200. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA(ls_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max price for LH should be 300' act = ls_max_flight-price exp = 300 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connection ID for max price LH should be 0401' act = ls_max_flight-connid exp = '0401' ).

    CLEAR ls_max_flight.
    ls_max_flight = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( iv_carrid = 'UA' it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flight for UA, should be initial' act = ls_max_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet REDUCE, um ein einzelnes Element (den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis) aus einer gefilterten internen Tabelle zu extrahieren. Die COND-Expression innerhalb von NEXT ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung des Akkumulators basierend auf dem Vergleich der Flugpreise.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Filtering, COND, Max Value

Instructions: Transformiere eine Liste von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen, wobei jeder String in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird und eine fortlaufende ID erhält.
hint: Nutze REDUCE, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren und dabei die Daten zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_item,
           ty_transformed_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE ty_transformed_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_strings.
    rt_transformed = REDUCE ty_transformed_items(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_transformed_items( )
           counter = 0
      FOR text_line IN it_strings
      NEXT counter = counter + 1,
           result = VALUE ty_transformed_items( BASE result
                                               ( id   = counter
                                                 text = to_upper( text_line ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_strings.
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'hello' ) ( 'world' ) ( 'abap' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_strings( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of transformed items should be 3' act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_transformed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_item1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item ID should be 1' act = ls_item1-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item text should be HELLO' act = ls_item1-text exp = 'HELLO' ).

    READ TABLE lt_transformed INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_item2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item ID should be 2' act = ls_item2-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item text should be WORLD' act = ls_item2-text exp = 'WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie REDUCE verwendet werden kann, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, während die Elemente der Quelltabelle transformiert werden. Die INIT-Klausel kann mehrere Akkumulatorvariablen (hier 'result' und 'counter') definieren, was komplexe Transformationen in einem einzigen Ausdruck ermöglicht.
keywords: REDUCE, Data Transformation, Internal Tables, to_upper, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_uuid_table_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_uuid_entry,
             index TYPE i,
             uuid  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_uuid_entry,
           ty_uuid_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_uuid_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_uuid_table_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_uuid_table.
    rt_uuid_table = VALUE ty_uuid_entries(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein gegebener String ein gültiges 32-stelliges Hexadezimal-UUID-Format hat.
hint: Nutze CL_SYSTEM_UUID=>CREATE_UUID_C32() und fange die Ausnahme CX_UUID_ERROR ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_uuid_c32
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid_str TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_uuid_c32.
    TRY.
        cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( iv_uuid_str ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_uuid_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_uuid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_uuid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_validator( ).

    " Valid UUID
    DATA(lv_valid_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x( )->if_system_uuid~get_uuid_c32( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Valid UUID should return true' act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid_c32( lv_valid_uuid ) ).

    " Invalid UUID (wrong length)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Too short UUID should return false' act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid_c32( '1234567890ABCDEF' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Too long UUID should return false' act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid_c32( lv_valid_uuid && 'X' ) ).

    " Invalid UUID (invalid characters)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'UUID with invalid chars should return false' act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid_c32( '1234567890ABCDEF1234567890ABCX' ) ).

    " Empty UUID
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Empty UUID should return false' act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid_c32( '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode CREATE_UUID_C32 der Klasse CL_SYSTEM_UUID dient nicht nur der Konvertierung, sondern auch der Validierung. Wenn der Eingabestring kein gültiges 32-stelliges Hexadezimal-UUID-Format hat, wird eine Ausnahme vom Typ CX_UUID_ERROR ausgelöst. Dies ermöglicht eine robuste Prüfung der Eingabedaten.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Objekten verwaltet. Jedes Objekt soll eine eindeutige UUID als Schlüssel haben. Implementiere Methoden zum Hinzufügen, Abrufen und Löschen von Objekten basierend auf ihrer UUID.
hint: Verwende eine HASHED TABLE mit der UUID als Schlüssel und CL_SYSTEM_UUID für die Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_object_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_managed_object,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_managed_object,
           ty_managed_objects TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_managed_object
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_name  TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_object_id) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_object) TYPE ty_managed_object
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.

    METHODS delete_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_objects TYPE ty_managed_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_object.
    DATA(lv_new_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid~get_uuid_c22( ).
    INSERT VALUE ty_managed_object( id = lv_new_uuid name = iv_name value = iv_value )
           INTO TABLE mt_objects.
    rv_object_id = lv_new_uuid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_object.
    READ TABLE mt_objects WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_object_id INTO rs_object.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_object.
    DELETE TABLE mt_objects WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_object_id.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_object_manager FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_object_manager.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_object_manager( ).

    " Add objects
    DATA(lv_id1) = lo_manager->add_object( iv_name = 'Object A' iv_value = 10 ).
    DATA(lv_id2) = lo_manager->add_object( iv_name = 'Object B' iv_value = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'ID 1 should not be initial' act = lv_id1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'ID 2 should not be initial' act = lv_id2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'IDs should be unique' act = lv_id1 exp = lv_id2 ).

    " Get object
    DATA(ls_obj_a) = lo_manager->get_object( lv_id1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Object A name mismatch' act = ls_obj_a-name exp = 'Object A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Object A value mismatch' act = ls_obj_a-value exp = 10 ).

    " Try to get non-existent object
    TRY.
        lo_manager->get_object( 'INVALID_UUID' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Getting invalid UUID should raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught exception for invalid UUID' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Delete object
    lo_manager->delete_object( lv_id1 ).
    TRY.
        lo_manager->get_object( lv_id1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Deleted object should not be retrievable' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly confirmed deletion' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von UUIDs als eindeutige Schlüssel für Objekte in einer internen HASHED TABLE. Die CL_SYSTEM_UUID-Klasse generiert die Schlüssel, während die HASHED TABLE einen effizienten Zugriff (Hinzufügen, Abrufen, Löschen) basierend auf diesen Schlüsseln ermöglicht. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für die In-Memory-Verwaltung von Daten.
keywords: CL_SYSTEM_UUID, UUID, HASHED TABLE, Object Orientation, Data Management, Unique Key

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus SFLIGHT enthält, deren Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und entferne Duplikate.
hint: Kombiniere FILTER und REDUCE, um die gewünschten Daten zu extrahieren und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_high_price_unique_carrids
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        it_flights   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carrids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_unique_carrids.
    rt_unique_carrids = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT unique_carrids = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price )
      LET lv_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT unique_carrids = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( unique_carrids[ table_line = lv_carrid ] ) THEN
                                      VALUE string_table( BASE unique_carrids ( lv_carrid ) )
                                    ELSE
                                      unique_carrids ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_reduce.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight       TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-price = 100. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-price = 250. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-price = 300. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-price = 150. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-price = 400. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_price_unique_carrids( iv_min_price = 200 it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of unique CARRIDs should be 2' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result should contain AA' act = line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'AA' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result should contain LH' act = line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'LH' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Result should not contain UA' act = line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'UA' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von FILTER und REDUCE. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle mit FILTER nach einem Kriterium (Preis über Schwellenwert) gefiltert. Anschließend wird der REDUCE-Operator auf das gefilterte Ergebnis angewendet, um eine Liste eindeutiger Fluggesellschaften zu erstellen. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und lesbarer Ansatz für komplexe Datenmanipulationen.
keywords: REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Unique Values

Instructions: Erstelle einen String, der alle Elemente einer String-Tabelle mit einem Semikolon als Trennzeichen verbindet.
hint: Nutze REDUCE, um die Strings zu einem einzigen String zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR text_line IN it_strings
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN text_line ELSE result && `;` && text_line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_strings.
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Cherry' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Strings should be concatenated correctly' act = lv_result exp = 'Apple;Banana;Cherry' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_strings) = VALUE string_table( ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( lt_empty_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Empty table should result in empty string' act = lv_result ).

    DATA(lt_single_string) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Single' ) ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( lt_single_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Single string should be returned as is' act = lv_result exp = 'Single' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die einfache, aber effektive Verwendung von REDUCE zum Verketten von Strings aus einer internen Tabelle. Die COND-Expression stellt sicher, dass das Trennzeichen (Semikolon) nur zwischen den Elementen und nicht am Anfang oder Ende des resultierenden Strings hinzugefügt wird. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu DO...ENDDO-Schleifen mit CONCATENATE.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, Concatenation, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle eine Map (HASHED TABLE), die für eine gegebene Liste von Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) jeweils eine neu generierte UUID (C22-Format) als Wert speichert.
hint: Nutze REDUCE, um eine HASHED TABLE zu konstruieren, wobei für jeden CARRID eine UUID generiert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_carrid_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_uuid_map_entry,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             uuid   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrid_uuid_map_entry,
           ty_carrid_uuid_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrid_uuid_map_entry
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS create_carrid_uuid_map
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_map) TYPE ty_carrid_uuid_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_carrid_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_carrid_uuid_map.
    rt_carrid_map = REDUCE ty_carrid_uuid_map(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrid_uuid_map( )
      FOR carrid_line IN it_carrids
      LET lv_carrid = carrid_line
          lv_uuid   = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid~get_uuid_c22( ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_carrid_uuid_map( BASE result
                                              ( carrid = lv_carrid
                                                uuid   = lv_uuid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrid_uuid_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrid_uuid_map.
    DATA(lt_input_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_carrid_map( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_uuid_map) = lo_cut->create_carrid_uuid_map( lt_input_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Map should contain 3 entries' act = lines( lt_carrid_uuid_map ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrid_uuid_map WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH UUID should not be initial' act = ls_lh_entry-uuid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH UUID length should be 22' act = strlen( ls_lh_entry-uuid ) exp = 22 ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrid_uuid_map WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'AA UUID should not be initial' act = ls_aa_entry-uuid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'LH and AA UUIDs should be different' act = ls_lh_entry-uuid exp = ls_aa_entry-uuid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert REDUCE mit der Generierung von UUIDs, um eine HASHED TABLE als Mapping-Struktur zu erstellen. Für jeden Eintrag in der Quelltabelle wird eine neue UUID generiert und zusammen mit dem CARRID in die Ziel-Map eingefügt. Die LET-Klausel verbessert die Lesbarkeit, indem sie die Generierung der UUID in eine separate Variable kapselt.
keywords: REDUCE, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, UUID, HASHED TABLE, Data Mapping, Functional Programming, LET

Instructions: Definiere eine einfache Enumeration für Ampelphasen (ROT, GELB, GRÜN) und gib den String-Wert einer Phase zurück.
hint: Nutze `TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ... END OF ENUM` und eine `SWITCH`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_phase,
             red,
             yellow,
             green,
           END OF ENUM traffic_phase.

    METHODS get_phase_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_phase TYPE traffic_phase
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_phase_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_phase_name.
    rv_phase_name = SWITCH #( iv_phase
                              WHEN traffic_phase-red    THEN 'RED'
                              WHEN traffic_phase-yellow THEN 'YELLOW'
                              WHEN traffic_phase-green  THEN 'GREEN'
                              ELSE THROW cx_sy_switch_no_match( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_phase_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_phase_name.
    DATA(lo_traffic_light) = NEW zcl_traffic_light( ).
    DATA(lv_phase_name) = lo_traffic_light->get_phase_name( zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_phase-red ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_phase_name exp = 'RED' ).

    lv_phase_name = lo_traffic_light->get_phase_name( zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_phase-green ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_phase_name exp = 'GREEN' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Enumerationen (`ENUM`) ermöglichen die Definition von festen Wertemengen, was die Lesbarkeit und Typsicherheit des Codes erhöht. Die `SWITCH`-Expression ist eine moderne Art, bedingte Logik kompakt auszudrücken.
keywords: ENUM, SWITCH, Type Safety, Object Orientation

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für Bestellstatus (Neu, In Bearbeitung, Abgeschlossen) mit jeweils einem zugehörigen numerischen Code und einer Beschreibung. Gib den Code und die Beschreibung für einen gegebenen Status zurück.
hint: Nutze `BEGIN OF ENUM WITH ATTRIBUTES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status_type STRUCTURE order_status_attributes,
             new        VALUE IS INITIAL ATTRIBUTES VALUE '10' DESCRIPTION 'New Order',
             in_process ATTRIBUTES VALUE '20' DESCRIPTION 'Order in Process',
             completed  ATTRIBUTES VALUE '30' DESCRIPTION 'Order Completed',
           END OF ENUM order_status_type.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF order_status_attributes,
             code        TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF order_status_attributes.

    METHODS get_status_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE order_status_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status_info) TYPE order_status_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_info.
    rs_status_info-code = iv_status->code.
    rs_status_info-description = iv_status->description.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_status_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_status_info.
    DATA(lo_order_status) = NEW zcl_order_status( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_order_status->get_status_info( zcl_order_status=>order_status_type-new ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-code exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-description exp = 'New Order' ).

    ls_info = lo_order_status->get_status_info( zcl_order_status=>order_status_type-completed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-code exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-description exp = 'Order Completed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ENUM WITH ATTRIBUTES` erlaubt es, jedem Enumerationswert zusätzliche Daten (Attribute) zuzuordnen. Dies ist nützlich, um beispielsweise Codes oder Beschreibungen direkt mit dem Status zu verknüpfen, ohne separate Mapping-Logik zu benötigen.
keywords: ENUM WITH ATTRIBUTES, Associated Values, Type Safety, Object Orientation

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für Wochentage. Schreibe eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Wochentag (Enumeration) zurückgibt, ob es ein Arbeitstag oder Wochenende ist.
hint: Nutze `COND` mit der Enumeration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM weekday_type,
             monday,
             tuesday,
             wednesday,
             thursday,
             friday,
             saturday,
             sunday,
           END OF ENUM weekday_type.

    METHODS is_workday
      IMPORTING
        iv_day TYPE weekday_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_workday) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_workday.
    rv_is_workday = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_day = weekday_type-saturday OR
                                         iv_day = weekday_type-sunday
                                    THEN abap_false
                                    ELSE abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_workday FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_workday.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_weekday_checker( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_checker->is_workday( zcl_weekday_checker=>weekday_type-monday ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_checker->is_workday( zcl_weekday_checker=>weekday_type-saturday ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_checker->is_workday( zcl_weekday_checker=>weekday_type-sunday ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Darstellung von bedingten Zuweisungen. In Kombination mit Enumerationen wird der Code noch klarer, da die Bedingungen direkt mit den semantischen Werten der Enumeration arbeiten.
keywords: ENUM, COND, Conditional Logic, Boolean

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die alle definierten Werte einer gegebenen Enumeration (z.B. `traffic_phase` aus `enu_001`) als String-Tabelle zurückgibt. Nutze RTTI.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_NAME` und `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_phase,
             red,
             yellow,
             green,
           END OF ENUM traffic_phase.

    METHODS get_enum_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_enum_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'ZCL_ENUM_ITERATOR=>TRAFFIC_PHASE'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enum_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enum_values.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_enum_type_name ).
    DATA(lo_enum_descr) = CAST cl_abap_enumdescr( lo_type_descr ).

    LOOP AT lo_enum_descr->get_values( ) INTO DATA(ls_enum_value).
      APPEND ls_enum_value-name TO rt_enum_values.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_enum_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_enum_values.
    DATA(lo_iterator) = NEW zcl_enum_iterator( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = lo_iterator->get_enum_values( 'ZCL_ENUM_ITERATOR=>TRAFFIC_PHASE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_values ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check if no exception occurred
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_values[ 1 ] exp = 'RED' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_values[ 2 ] exp = 'YELLOW' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_values[ 3 ] exp = 'GREEN' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) kann man zur Laufzeit Informationen über Datentypen, einschließlich Enumerationen, abrufen. `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR` bietet Methoden, um die definierten Werte einer Enumeration dynamisch zu lesen, was für generische Verarbeitungen oder UI-Generierung nützlich ist.
keywords: ENUM, RTTI, CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für Produktkategorien (Elektronik, Kleidung, Bücher). Erstelle eine interne Tabelle von Produkten mit einer Kategorie und filtere diese Tabelle, um nur Produkte einer bestimmten Kategorie (über die Enumeration) zurückzugeben.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` mit der Enumeration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM product_category_type,
             electronics,
             clothing,
             books,
           END OF ENUM product_category_type.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id       TYPE i,
             name     TYPE string,
             category TYPE product_category_type,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: ty_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_products_by_category
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE ty_products
        iv_category TYPE product_category_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_products) TYPE ty_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_products_by_by_category.
    rt_filtered_products = FILTER #( it_products WHERE category = iv_category ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_products FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_products.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_product_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_products) = VALUE zcl_product_filter=>ty_products(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Laptop' category = zcl_product_filter=>product_category_type-electronics )
      ( id = 2 name = 'T-Shirt' category = zcl_product_filter=>product_category_type-clothing )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Book A' category = zcl_product_filter=>product_category_type-books )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Smartphone' category = zcl_product_filter=>product_category_type-electronics )
    ).

    DATA(lt_electronics) = lo_filter->filter_products_by_by_category(
      it_products = lt_all_products
      iv_category = zcl_product_filter=>product_category_type-electronics
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_electronics ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_electronics[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Laptop' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_electronics[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Smartphone' ).

    DATA(lt_books) = lo_filter->filter_products_by_by_category(
      it_products = lt_all_products
      iv_category = zcl_product_filter=>product_category_type-books
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_books ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_books[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Book A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. In Kombination mit Enumerationen wird die Filterbedingung typsicher und selbsterklärend, da direkt mit den semantischen Werten der Enumeration gearbeitet wird.
keywords: ENUM, FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Processing

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei gegebenen Datumsangaben.
hint: Nutze die direkte Subtraktion von Datumsfeldern.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit numerischen Werten. Berechne die kumulative Differenz der Werte, beginnend mit einem Startwert.
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cumulative_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_cumulative_difference
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers  TYPE ty_numbers
        iv_start_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cumulative_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cumulative_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cumulative_difference.
    rv_cumulative_diff = REDUCE i( INIT result = iv_start_value
                                   FOR <number> IN it_numbers
                                   NEXT result = result - <number> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cumulative_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_difference.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_cumulative_diff( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_cumulative_diff=>ty_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 5 ) ( 2 ) ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_cumulative_difference(
      it_numbers = lt_numbers
      iv_start_value = 100
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 83 ).

    lv_result = lo_calculator->calculate_cumulative_difference(
      it_numbers = VALUE zcl_cumulative_diff=>ty_numbers( )
      iv_start_value = 50
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Hier wird sie verwendet, um eine kumulative Subtraktion durchzuführen, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Math

Instructions: Gegeben sind zwei interne Tabellen mit Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`). Ermittle alle Flüge, die in der ersten Tabelle, aber nicht in der zweiten Tabelle enthalten sind.
hint: Nutze die `EXCEPT`-Operation für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights_except

        it_flights2 TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_diff) TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_comparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_except.
    rt_flights_diff = it_flights1 EXCEPT it_flights2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_flights_except FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_except.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_flight_comparer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_a) = VALUE zcl_flight_comparer=>ty_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights_b) = VALUE zcl_flight_comparer=>ty_sflights(

      it_flights1 = lt_flights_a

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_diff ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diff[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diff[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diff[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20230102' ).

explanation: Die `EXCEPT`-Operation für interne Tabellen (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine moderne und deklarative Art, die Mengendifferenz zwischen zwei Tabellen zu bilden. Sie ersetzt umständliche Schleifen und `DELETE`-Anweisungen und ist dabei oft performanter.

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für Event-Prioritäten (Niedrig, Mittel, Hoch). Schreibe eine Methode, die basierend auf der Priorität eines Events und einem gegebenen Startdatum die Anzahl der Tage bis zum Event berechnet, wobei Events mit hoher Priorität eine zusätzliche Pufferzeit von 5 Tagen erhalten (d.h. die Berechnung erfolgt 5 Tage früher).
hint: Kombiniere Enumerationen mit Datumsberechnungen und `COND` oder `SWITCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM event_priority_type,
             low,
             medium,
             high,
           END OF ENUM event_priority_type.

    METHODS get_days_until_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_event_date TYPE d
        iv_priority   TYPE event_priority_type
        iv_today      TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days_left) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_until_event.
    DATA(lv_adjusted_date) = iv_event_date.

    IF iv_priority = event_priority_type-high.
      lv_adjusted_date = lv_adjusted_date - 5. " Subtract 5 days for high priority
    ENDIF.

    rv_days_left = lv_adjusted_date - iv_today.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_days_until_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_days_until_event.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_event_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    " Low priority event, 10 days from now
    DATA(lv_event_date_low) = lv_today + 10.
    DATA(lv_days_left_low) = lo_calculator->get_days_until_event(
      iv_event_date = lv_event_date_low
      iv_priority   = zcl_event_calculator=>event_priority_type-low
      iv_today      = lv_today
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days_left_low exp = 10 ).

    " High priority event, 10 days from now, adjusted to 5 days earlier
    DATA(lv_event_date_high) = lv_today + 10.
    DATA(lv_days_left_high) = lo_calculator->get_days_until_event(
      iv_event_date = lv_event_date_high
      iv_priority   = zcl_event_calculator=>event_priority_type-high
      iv_today      = lv_today
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days_left_high exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Typsicherheit von Enumerationen mit Datumsberechnungen. Die Logik zur Anpassung des Datums basierend auf der Priorität ist klar und leicht verständlich. Die direkte Subtraktion von Datumsfeldern ist effizient für die Berechnung der Tagesdifferenz.
keywords: ENUM, SUBTRACT, Date Calculation, Conditional Logic, Combination

Instructions: Berechne das Datum, das eine bestimmte Anzahl von Arbeitstagen (Montag bis Freitag) vor einem gegebenen Datum liegt. Wochenenden sollen übersprungen werden.
hint: Nutze eine Schleife und die direkte Datums-Subtraktion, kombiniert mit `COND` oder `SWITCH` für Wochentagsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workday_before
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_workdays   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workday_before.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_workdays_counted) = 0.

    WHILE lv_workdays_counted < iv_workdays.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date - 1. " Subtract one day
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).

      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        lv_workdays_counted = lv_workdays_counted + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_workday_before FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_workday_before.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).

    " Start on a Friday, subtract 1 workday -> Thursday
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->get_workday_before( iv_start_date = '20251128' iv_workdays = 1 ). " 20251128 is a Friday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20251127' ).

    " Start on a Monday, subtract 1 workday -> Friday (previous week)
    lv_result = lo_calculator->get_workday_before( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_workdays = 1 ). " 20251201 is a Monday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20251128' ).

    " Start on a Monday, subtract 3 workdays -> Wednesday (previous week)
    lv_result = lo_calculator->get_workday_before( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_workdays = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20251126' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die iterative Subtraktion von Tagen, wobei Wochenenden übersprungen werden. Die Funktion `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday` ist eine moderne und zuverlässige Methode, um den Wochentag eines Datums zu ermitteln. Die `WHILE`-Schleife steuert den Prozess, bis die gewünschte Anzahl von Arbeitstagen subtrahiert wurde.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Date, Date Calculation, Loop, CL_ABAP_CONTEXT_INFO

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für Status (Offen, In Bearbeitung, Geschlossen). Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Aufgaben mit einem Statusfeld. Zähle die Anzahl der Aufgaben für jeden Status und gib das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY` und die Enumeration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_task_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM task_status_type,
             open,
             in_progress,
             closed,
           END OF ENUM task_status_type.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE task_status_type,
             text   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_task.
    TYPES: ty_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_count,
             status TYPE task_status_type,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_status_count.
    TYPES: ty_status_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_tasks_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_tasks TYPE ty_tasks
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_counts) TYPE ty_status_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_task_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_tasks_by_status.
    rt_status_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <task> IN it_tasks GROUP BY ( status = <task>-status ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( status = GROUP KEY-status
                                   count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_tasks_by_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_tasks_by_status.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_task_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_tasks) = VALUE zcl_task_counter=>ty_tasks(
      ( id = 1 status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-open text = 'Task 1' )
      ( id = 2 status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-in_progress text = 'Task 2' )
      ( id = 3 status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-open text = 'Task 3' )
      ( id = 4 status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-closed text = 'Task 4' )
      ( id = 5 status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-in_progress text = 'Task 5' )
      ( id = 6 status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-open text = 'Task 6' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_counter->count_tasks_by_status( lt_tasks ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_open_count) = lt_counts[ status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-open ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_open_count-count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_in_progress_count) = lt_counts[ status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-in_progress ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_in_progress_count-count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_closed_count) = lt_counts[ status = zcl_task_counter=>task_status_type-closed ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_closed_count-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Expression ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit Enumerationen wird die Gruppierung typsicher und semantisch klar. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe.
keywords: ENUM, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV Grid für Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) und generieren Sie den Feldkatalog dynamisch mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um nur bestimmte Felder anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_alv_grid` und einen `FOR`-Ausdruck für den Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_dynamic_fcat IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_dynamic_fcat.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate planetype price currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR field IN VALUE #( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ( 'PLANETYPE' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ( 'CURRENCY' ) ) " Desired fields
      ( fieldname = field-table_line
        coltext   = field-table_line ) " Simple field catalog
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = lt_sflight.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fcat_generation FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_fcat_generation.
    DATA(lt_expected_fields) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ( 'PLANETYPE' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ( 'CURRENCY' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR field IN lt_expected_fields
      ( fieldname = field-table_line
        coltext   = field-table_line )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_fcat ) exp = 6
      msg = 'Field catalog should contain 6 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_fcat[ 1 ]-fieldname exp = 'CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck wird verwendet, um den Feldkatalog dynamisch und kompakt zu erstellen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu füllen, anstatt eine `LOOP` zu verwenden.
keywords: ALV, Field Catalog, `FOR` expression, `cl_gui_alv_grid`, Dynamic

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein ALV Grid, das auf einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile reagiert und die Fluggesellschaft der ausgewählten Zeile in einer Meldung anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für das `double_click`-Ereignis des ALV und `MESSAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_double_click DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_click IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING e_row e_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_double_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_click.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_sflight UP TO 50 ROWS.

    mo_alv = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR mo_alv.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflight.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    READ TABLE mt_sflight INDEX e_row-index INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_sflight-carrid }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_alv_double_click.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_handle_double_click FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mo_cut = NEW zcl_alv_double_click( ).
    " Simulate data loading for the ALV
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mo_cut->mt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_handle_double_click.
    DATA: ls_row TYPE lvc_s_row, ls_col TYPE lvc_s_col.
    ls_row-index = 1.
    ls_col-fieldname = 'CARRID'.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine aggregierte Ansicht der Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in einem ALV Grid an, die die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum berechnet. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Daten vorzubereiten und `cl_gui_alv_grid` zur Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             total_pass TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_sflight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = aggregate_sflights( ).

    DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_REDUCE_AGG=>TY_SFLIGHT_AGG'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_aggregated_data.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD aggregate_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid fldate seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE tt_sflight_agg(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_agg(
      )
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      LET lv_found_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ] ) IN
      COND #( WHEN lv_found_index IS NOT INITIAL
              THEN ( result[ lv_found_index ]-total_pass = result[ lv_found_index ]-total_pass + ls_sflight-seatsocc
                     result )
              ELSE ( VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate total_pass = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation_logic FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_reduce_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_aggregated IS INITIAL exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Aggregated data should not be initial' ).

    " Example: Check a specific aggregation (assuming data exists)
    DATA(ls_test_entry) = VALUE zcl_alv_reduce_agg=>ty_sflight_agg(
      carrid = 'LH' fldate = '19950101' " Example values, adjust based on actual SFLIGHT data
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO ls_test_entry WITH KEY carrid = ls_test_entry-carrid fldate = ls_test_entry-fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_test_entry-total_pass exp = 0
        msg = 'Total passengers should be greater than 0' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeichnen Sie mehrere Kreise im 2D Viewer, deren Positionen und Radien aus einer internen Tabelle stammen. Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Daten zu verarbeiten und die Kreise zu zeichnen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_draw_circles DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_circle_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             x_pos  TYPE i,
             y_pos  TYPE i,
             radius TYPE i,
             color  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_circle_data.
    TYPES: tt_circle_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_circle_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_circles IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_ecl_draw_circles IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_circles.
    DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_viewer->clear_all_objects( ).

    DATA(lt_circles) = VALUE tt_circle_data(
      ( id = 1 x_pos = 100 y_pos = 100 radius = 30 color = cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer=>co_color_red )
      ( id = 2 x_pos = 250 y_pos = 150 radius = 50 color = cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer=>co_color_green )
      ( id = 3 x_pos = 400 y_pos = 200 radius = 20 color = cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer=>co_color_blue )
    ).

    FOR ls_circle IN lt_circles.
      lo_viewer->draw_circle(
        i_x     = ls_circle-x_pos
        i_y     = ls_circle-y_pos
        i_radius = ls_circle-radius
        i_color = ls_circle-color
        i_filled = abap_true
      ).
    ENDFOR.

    lo_viewer->invalidate_all_objects( ).
    lo_viewer->do_redraw( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Position eines Rechtecks im 2D Viewer dynamisch nach einem Klick auf einen Button. Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_toolbar` für den Button und die Update-Methoden des Viewers.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_toolbar` für den Button und `move_object`, `invalidate_object`, `do_redraw` für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_movable_rectangle IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
                                        io_toolbar_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mv_rect_x TYPE i VALUE 100.
    DATA mv_rect_y TYPE i VALUE 100.
    CONSTANTS: gc_rect_id TYPE string VALUE 'MOVABLE_RECT'.

    METHODS handle_toolbar_function FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_gui_toolbar IMPORTING fcode.
    METHODS draw_initial_rectangle.
    METHODS update_rectangle_position.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_movable_rectangle.
    mo_viewer = NEW cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar(
      i_parent = io_toolbar_container
    ).

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode     = 'MOVE_RECT'
      icon      = icon_system_move
      butn_type = cntb_btype_button
      text      = 'Move Rectangle'
      quickinfo = 'Move Rectangle to new position'
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_toolbar_function FOR mo_toolbar.

    draw_initial_rectangle( ).

    mo_viewer->invalidate_all_objects( ).
    mo_viewer->do_redraw( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD draw_initial_rectangle.
    mo_viewer->clear_all_objects( ).
    mo_viewer->draw_rectangle(
      i_x1 = mv_rect_x
      i_y1 = mv_rect_y
      i_x2 = mv_rect_x + 100
      i_y2 = mv_rect_y + 50
      i_color = cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer=>co_color_magenta
      i_filled = abap_true
      i_object_id = gc_rect_id
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_toolbar_function.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'MOVE_RECT'.
        mv_rect_x = mv_rect_x + 20.
        mv_rect_y = mv_rect_y + 10.
        update_rectangle_position( ).
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Rechteck verschoben zu ({ mv_rect_x }, { mv_rect_y })| DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_rectangle_position.
    mo_viewer->move_object(
      i_object_id = gc_rect_id
      i_x_offset  = 20 " Relative move
      i_y_offset  = 10
    ).
    mo_viewer->invalidate_object( i_object_id = gc_rect_id ).
    mo_viewer->do_redraw( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Stellen Sie Flugziele aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT als Punkte auf einer einfachen 2D-Karte im Viewer dar. Mappen Sie die Flugziele auf feste X/Y-Koordinaten und nutzen Sie `MAP` für die Datenvorbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MAP` um die SFLIGHT-Daten in eine für die 2D-Darstellung geeignete Struktur zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_sflight_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_point,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,
             x_pos  TYPE i,
             y_pos  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_point.
    TYPES: tt_flight_point TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflight_map IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_points RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_points) TYPE tt_flight_point.
    METHODS map_city_to_coords IMPORTING iv_city TYPE s_cityname RETURNING VALUE(rs_coords) TYPE REF TO struct_xy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_sflight_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_map.
    DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_viewer->clear_all_objects( ).

    DATA(lt_flight_points) = get_flight_points( ).

    FOR ls_point IN lt_flight_points.
      lo_viewer->draw_circle(
        i_x     = ls_point-x_pos
        i_y     = ls_point-y_pos
        i_radius = 5
        i_color = cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer=>co_color_red
        i_filled = abap_true
        i_object_id = |{ ls_point-carrid }-{ ls_point-connid }-{ ls_point-cityto }|
      ).
      lo_viewer->draw_text(
        i_x     = ls_point-x_pos + 10
        i_y     = ls_point-y_pos
        i_text  = ls_point-cityto
        i_color = cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer=>co_color_black
      ).
    ENDFOR.

    lo_viewer->invalidate_all_objects( ).
    lo_viewer->do_redraw( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_points.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid cityto FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_flight_points = VALUE tt_flight_point(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      LET ls_coords = map_city_to_coords( ls_sflight-cityto ) IN
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
        x_pos  = ls_coords->x
        y_pos  = ls_coords->y )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_city_to_coords.
    " Simple mapping for demonstration purposes
    CREATE DATA rs_coords TYPE struct_xy.
    CASE iv_city.
      WHEN 'FRANKFURT'.
        rs_coords->x = 100.
        rs_coords->y = 100.
      WHEN 'NEW YORK'.
        rs_coords->x = 500.
        rs_coords->y = 200.
      WHEN 'SAN FRANCISCO'.
        rs_coords->x = 700.
        rs_coords->y = 300.
      WHEN 'LONDON'.
        rs_coords->x = 200.
        rs_coords->y = 50.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rs_coords->x = 50.
        rs_coords->y = 50.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper structure for coordinates (can be defined globally or locally)
TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_xy,
         x TYPE i,
         y TYPE i,
       END OF struct_xy.

Instructions: Zeichnen Sie eine komplexe Form (z.B. ein Polygon) im 2D Viewer, deren Eckpunkte aus einer internen Tabelle stammen. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Punkte in das benötigte Format zu bringen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Liste von Punkten für `draw_polygon` zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_draw_polygon DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_point,
             x TYPE i,
             y TYPE i,
           END OF ty_point.
    TYPES: tt_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_polygon IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_polygon_points RETURNING VALUE(rt_polygon_points) TYPE tt_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_draw_polygon IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_polygon.
    DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_viewer->clear_all_objects( ).

    DATA(lt_polygon_points) = get_polygon_points( ).

    " The draw_polygon method expects a table of points (x,y pairs)
    lo_viewer->draw_polygon(
      it_points = lt_polygon_points
      i_color   = cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer=>co_color_orange
      i_filled  = abap_true
    ).

    lo_viewer->invalidate_all_objects( ).
    lo_viewer->do_redraw( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_polygon_points.
    DATA(lt_raw_coords) = VALUE tt_points(
      ( x = 100 y = 100 )
      ( x = 200 y = 50 )
      ( x = 300 y = 100 )
      ( x = 250 y = 200 )
      ( x = 150 y = 200 )
    ).

    " In this simple case, REDUCE is not strictly necessary for transformation
    " but demonstrates its use for more complex scenarios or filtering.
    " Here, we just pass the points as is, but REDUCE could filter/transform.
    rt_polygon_points = REDUCE tt_points(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_points( )
      FOR ls_point IN lt_raw_coords
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( x = ls_point-x y = ls_point-y ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV Grid, das die Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) anzeigt und eine bedingte Formatierung auf die Spalte 'PRICE' anwendet: Preise über 500 sollen rot hervorgehoben werden. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Feldkataloganpassung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Feldkatalog, um die bedingte Formatierung zu definieren, und `FOR` für die Anpassung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_cond_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_cond_formatted_sflights IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_cond_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_cond_formatted_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR ls_fcat_line IN lo_alv->get_frontend_fieldcatalog( )
      LET lv_fieldname = ls_fcat_line-fieldname IN
      ( COND #( WHEN lv_fieldname = 'PRICE'
                THEN VALUE lvc_s_fcat( BASE ls_fcat_line
                                       emphasize = 'C700' ) " C700 for red
                ELSE ls_fcat_line ) )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflight.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->frontend_update.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element 'Root' und einem Kind-Element 'Item' mit dem Textinhalt 'Hello ABAP'.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Root' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( child = lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_item) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Item' ).
    lo_item->set_text_cdata( 'Hello ABAP' ).
    lo_root->append_child( child = lo_item ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und lesen Sie den Wert des Attributs 'id' vom Element 'User'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_with_string` zum Parsen und `find_node` sowie `get_attribute_node` zum Zugriff auf das Attribut.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_user_id_from_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_user_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_user_id_from_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_user_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( name = 'User' ).
        IF lo_user_node IS BOUND.
          DATA(lo_id_attribute) = lo_user_node->get_attribute_node( name = 'id' ).
          IF lo_id_attribute IS BOUND.
            rv_user_id = lo_id_attribute->get_value( ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Handle parsing error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus den Daten der internen Tabelle `sflights`. Jede Flugverbindung soll ein 'Flight'-Element sein, mit 'Carrid' und 'Connid' als Attribute.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE` und `LOOP AT` für die Datenbeschaffung. Erstellen Sie für jede Zeile ein 'Flight'-Element und setzen Sie Attribute.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_from_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flights_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_from_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights_xml.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument mit einem Namespace und lesen Sie ein Element aus diesem Namespace.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_element_ns` und `find_node_ns` für die korrekte Handhabung von Namespaces.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_namespaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_read_ns_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_item_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_ns_xml.
    CONSTANTS: lc_namespace_uri TYPE string VALUE 'http://www.example.com/ns/data',
               lc_prefix TYPE string VALUE 'ex'.

    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Root' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( child = lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_item_ns) = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( name = 'Item' namespace_uri = lc_namespace_uri prefix = lc_prefix ).
    lo_item_ns->set_text_cdata( 'Namespace Data' ).
    lo_root->append_child( child = lo_item_ns ).

    DATA(lv_xml_string) TYPE string.
    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = lv_xml_string ).

    " Now parse and read
    DATA(lo_xml_document_read) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document_read->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_found_node) = lo_xml_document_read->find_node_ns( name = 'Item' namespace_uri = lc_namespace_uri ).
    IF lo_found_node IS BOUND.
      rv_item_value = lo_found_node->get_text( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  ENDMETHOD.

Beim Lesen muss `find_node_ns` verwendet werden, um Elemente innerhalb eines bestimmten Namespace zu finden, was die Eindeutigkeit sicherstellt.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen ALV-Grid für `sflights`, der auf einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile reagiert und die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) der geklickten Zeile in einer Meldung anzeigt.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION.

      FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_salv_events_table

        column.

  METHOD on_double_click.
    DATA: lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Get reference to the ALV table object
    cl_salv_table=>get_saved_salv( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv_table ).
    IF lo_salv_table IS BOUND.
      lt_data = CAST cl_salv_table_adapter( lo_salv_table )->get_data( ).
      READ TABLE lt_data INTO ls_sflight INDEX row.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Doppelklick auf Fluggesellschaft: { ls_sflight-carrid }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine hierarchische Liste von Fluggesellschaften und deren Flügen aus `sflights` in einem ALV an. (Hinweis: `cl_salv_table` ist für einfache Listen, für hierarchische Listen wird `cl_salv_hierseq_list` oder `cl_salv_tree` benötigt. Da die Frage `cl_salv_table` explizit nennt, wird hier eine Simulation mit Gruppierung oder eine Erläuterung gegeben, dass `cl_salv_table` nicht direkt hierarchisch ist. Für dieses Beispiel wird eine Gruppierung simuliert, da `cl_salv_table` keine native Hierarchie bietet.)
hint: Für eine echte Hierarchie wäre `cl_salv_hierseq_list` oder `cl_salv_tree` nötig. Mit `cl_salv_table` kann man Gruppierungen und Sortierungen nutzen, um eine hierarchieähnliche Ansicht zu erzeugen.

CLASS zcl_salv_hierarchical_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_salv_hierarchical_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_grouped.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_sorts) = lo_salv_table->get_sorts( ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CARRID' position = 1 sequence = if_salv_c_sort=>asc group = if_salv_c_bool_sap=>true ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CONNID' position = 2 sequence = if_salv_c_sort=>asc ).

        DATA(lo_display_settings) = lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( ).
        lo_display_settings->set_striped_pattern( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>true ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.

          CHANGING

        ).
