explanation: Obwohl `cl_salv_table` keine echte hierarchische Darstellung bietet, kann man durch geschickte Kombination von Sortierung und Gruppierung eine hierarchieähnliche Ansicht erzeugen. `add_sort` mit dem Parameter `group = if_salv_c_bool_sap=>true` bewirkt, dass die Zeilen nach dieser Spalte gruppiert werden, was visuell eine Hierarchie andeutet. Für echte Hierarchien wären `cl_salv_hierseq_list` oder `cl_salv_tree` die richtigen Klassen.
keywords: ALV, cl_salv_table, grouping, sort, hierarchical (simulated), sflights

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die Tabelle `sflights` in einem ALV an. Färben Sie die Zeilen rot ein, bei denen der 'PRICE' über 500 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_data_ref` um auf die Datenreferenz zuzugreifen und die interne Tabelle mit einer Feldkatalog-Struktur für das Styling zu erweitern. Oder nutzen Sie `cl_salv_column_list` und `set_cell_type` für bedingte Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_cell_styling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_styled.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_cell_styling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_styled.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_styled,
             table_line TYPE sflight,
             cell_style TYPE lvc_t_styl,
           END OF ty_sflight_styled.

    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_sflights_styled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_styled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      DATA(ls_sflight_styled) = VALUE ty_sflight_styled( table_line = ls_sflight_raw ).
      IF ls_sflight_raw-price > 500.
        APPEND VALUE lvc_s_styl( fieldname = 'PRICE' style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_critical ) TO ls_sflight_styled-cell_style.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_styled TO lt_sflights_styled.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights_styled
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_price) = lo_columns->get_column( 'TABLE_LINE-PRICE' ).
        lo_column_price->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ). " Example: make it a hotspot

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle ALV error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) und füllen Sie diese direkt bei der Deklaration mit drei Einträgen. Filtern Sie anschließend alle Flüge, die von 'FRA' abfliegen.
hint: Nutzen Sie Inline-Deklaration und den VALUE-Operator für die Initialisierung und den FILTER-Operator für die Selektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_frankfurt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_frankfurt.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'JFK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'ORD' cityto = 'FRA' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0900' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'LHR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0450' cityfrom = 'MUC' cityto = 'LAX' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_frankfurt( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge von FRA gefunden werden.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Erster Flug sollte LH sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Nehmen Sie einen gegebenen String und verschieben Sie alle Zeichen um 3 Positionen nach links. Füllen Sie die entstandenen Leerzeichen am Ende mit dem Zeichen '#'. Verwenden Sie String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
hint: Nutzen Sie den SHIFT-Befehl mit der Option 'LEFT CIRCULAR' oder 'LEFT BY' und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_and_fill
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_and_fill.
    DATA(lv_shifted_string) = iv_input.
    SHIFT lv_shifted_string LEFT BY 3 PLACES.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ` ` IN lv_shifted_string WITH `#`.
    rv_output = |Original: { iv_input }, Shifted: { lv_shifted_string }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shift_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_shift( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->shift_and_fill( 'ABCDEFGHI' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Original: ABCDEFGHI, Shifted: DEFGHII##'
      msg = 'String sollte korrekt verschoben und gefüllt sein.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->shift_and_fill( '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Original: 123, Shifted: 3###'
      msg = 'Kurzer String sollte korrekt behandelt werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SHIFT`-Befehl ist zwar älter, kann aber in modernen Kontexten weiterhin nützlich sein. In Kombination mit `REPLACE` und String-Templates (`|...|`) lassen sich String-Manipulationen lesbar und effizient gestalten. String-Templates sind die bevorzugte Methode zur String-Formatierung seit ABAP 7.40.
keywords: String Processing, SHIFT, String Templates, REPLACE

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Flugverbindungen (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und den Zielort enthält, wobei der Zielort in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird. Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Schleife mit Inline-Deklaration.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_destination,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             cityto_uc TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_destination.
    TYPES tt_destinations TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_destination WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_destinations) TYPE tt_destinations.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_destinations = VALUE tt_destinations(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, cityto_uc = to_upper( ls_flight-cityto ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Functions, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugdauern (in Minuten) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugsegmenten. Jedes Segment hat eine Start- und Endzeit. Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit einem lokalen Hilfsvariable für die Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_segment,
             segment_id TYPE i,
             start_time TYPE tims,
             end_time   TYPE tims,
           END OF ty_segment.
    TYPES tt_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_duration
      IMPORTING it_segments TYPE tt_segments
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_duration.
    rv_total_minutes = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_minutes = 0
      FOR ls_segment IN it_segments
      NEXT total_minutes = total_minutes + ( ( ls_segment-end_time - ls_segment-start_time ) / 60 ) " Duration in seconds, convert to minutes
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_duration.
    DATA(lt_input_segments) = VALUE zcl_flight_duration=>tt_segments(
      ( segment_id = 1 start_time = '100000' end_time = '103000' ) " 30 minutes
      ( segment_id = 2 start_time = '110000' end_time = '120000' ) " 60 minutes
      ( segment_id = 3 start_time = '130000' end_time = '131500' ) " 15 minutes
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_duration( lt_input_segments ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 105
      msg = 'Gesamtdauer sollte 105 Minuten betragen.' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_segments) = VALUE zcl_flight_duration=>tt_segments( ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_total_duration( lt_empty_segments ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0
      msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte 0 Minuten ergeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife und die Akkumulation eines Ergebnisses in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf seiner Verspätung. Wenn die Verspätung 0 ist, ist der Status 'Pünktlich'. Wenn sie zwischen 1 und 30 Minuten liegt, ist der Status 'Leicht verspätet'. Andernfalls ist der Status 'Stark verspätet'. Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den COND-Operator für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes = 0 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 'Leicht verspätet'
      ELSE 'Stark verspätet'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 0 ) exp = 'Pünktlich'
      msg = 'Status sollte Pünktlich sein bei 0 Minuten Verspätung.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 15 ) exp = 'Leicht verspätet'
      msg = 'Status sollte Leicht verspätet sein bei 15 Minuten Verspätung.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 30 ) exp = 'Leicht verspätet'
      msg = 'Status sollte Leicht verspätet sein bei 30 Minuten Verspätung.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 31 ) exp = 'Stark verspätet'
      msg = 'Status sollte Stark verspätet sein bei 31 Minuten Verspätung.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( -5 ) exp = 'Stark verspätet'
      msg = 'Negative Verspätung sollte als Stark verspätet behandelt werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator bietet eine prägnante Syntax für bedingte Zuweisungen, die traditionelle `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF`-Konstrukte ersetzen kann. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Codezeilen für einfache Fallunterscheidungen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Expressions

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flugzeugtyp eine maximale Passagierkapazität zu. Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Operator für die Zuweisung basierend auf dem Flugzeugtyp (z.B. 'A320', 'B747', 'A380').
hint: Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Operator für die Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_aircraft_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_passengers
      IMPORTING iv_aircraft_type TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_passengers.
    rv_capacity = SWITCH i(
      iv_aircraft_type
      WHEN 'A320' THEN 180
      WHEN 'B747' THEN 416
      WHEN 'A380' THEN 853
      ELSE 0 " Unknown type
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aircraft_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aircraft_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_aircraft_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_max_passengers( 'A320' ) exp = 180
      msg = 'A320 Kapazität sollte 180 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_max_passengers( 'B747' ) exp = 416
      msg = 'B747 Kapazität sollte 416 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_max_passengers( 'A380' ) exp = 853
      msg = 'A380 Kapazität sollte 853 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_max_passengers( 'UNKNOWN' ) exp = 0
      msg = 'Unbekannter Typ sollte 0 Kapazität haben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF...ELSE IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Statements, wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er ist besonders nützlich für die Implementierung von Lookup-Logik und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: Conditional Logic, SWITCH, Expressions

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Beide Strukturen haben einige Komponenten mit identischen Namen, aber unterschiedlichen Typen oder Reihenfolgen. Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator, um die passenden Felder zu kopieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator mit der Option 'BASE' für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value  TYPE decfloat34,
             guid   TYPE sysuuid_c32,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_data_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_mapping.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapping=>ty_source(
      id = 1
      name = 'Test Item'
      value = '123.45'
      status = 'A'
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Test Item'
      msg = 'Name sollte korrekt gemappt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'A'
      msg = 'Status sollte korrekt gemappt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-value exp = '123.45'
      msg = 'Value sollte korrekt gemappt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ls_target-guid IS INITIAL
      msg = 'GUID sollte initial bleiben, da nicht in Quelle vorhanden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu verschieben, die gleichnamige Komponenten haben. Er ersetzt manuelle Zuweisungen Feld für Feld und ist besonders nützlich bei der Arbeit mit komplexen Datenstrukturen.
keywords: Data Operations, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine einfache Logik zur Berechnung eines Rabatts enthält. Instanziieren Sie die Klasse mit dem NEW-Operator und rufen Sie die Methode zur Rabattberechnung direkt in einer Kette auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie den NEW-Operator und Methodenketten (Method Chaining).
solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discount
      IMPORTING iv_price TYPE decfloat16
                iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_price = iv_price * ( 1 - iv_percentage / 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_discount_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discount_calculation.
    DATA(lv_final_price) = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( )->calculate_discount( iv_price = '100.00' iv_percentage = '10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = '90.00'
      msg = 'Preis sollte 90.00 sein nach 10% Rabatt.' ).

    lv_final_price = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( )->calculate_discount( iv_price = '250.00' iv_percentage = '20' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = '200.00'
      msg = 'Preis sollte 200.00 sein nach 20% Rabatt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `NEW`-Operator ermöglicht die Instanziierung von Objekten direkt an der Verwendungsstelle, oft in Kombination mit Methodenketten. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und flüssigem Code, da keine separate `CREATE OBJECT` Anweisung und temporäre Referenzvariable benötigt wird.
keywords: Object Orientation, NEW, Method Chaining, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der eine Zahl darstellt, in einen Integer-Typ. Behandeln Sie dabei mögliche Fehler, falls der String keine gültige Zahl ist. Verwenden Sie den CONV-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CONV-Operator und fangen Sie die Ausnahme CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_type_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS string_to_int
      IMPORTING iv_string_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_int_value) TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_type_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD string_to_int.
    TRY.
        rv_int_value = CONV i( iv_string_value ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |'{ iv_string_value }' ist keine gültige Zahl.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_string_to_int_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_string_to_int_invalid RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_to_int_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_type_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->string_to_int( '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 123
      msg = 'Gültiger String sollte korrekt konvertiert werden.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->string_to_int( '-45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -45
      msg = 'Negativer String sollte korrekt konvertiert werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_string_to_int_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_type_converter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->string_to_int( 'ABC' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Es sollte eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Ausnahme korrekt abgefangen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht eine direkte und typsichere Konvertierung zwischen kompatiblen Datentypen. In Kombination mit der Ausnahmebehandlung (`TRY...CATCH`) bietet er eine robuste Methode zur Datenkonvertierung, die Fehlerfälle elegant abfängt.
keywords: Data Operations, CONV, Type Conversion, Exceptions

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und abschließenden Leerzeichen aus einem String und ersetzen Sie mehrere aufeinanderfolgende Leerzeichen im Inneren des Strings durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen. Verwenden Sie String-Funktionen und den REPLACE-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONDENSE` oder `STRIP` und den `REPLACE`-Operator mit REGEX.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    lv_temp = |{ lv_temp ALPHA = OUT }|.
    " Replace multiple spaces with single space
    rv_output = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp WITH ` `.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleanup( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->clean_string( `  Hello   World  ` ) exp = 'Hello World'
      msg = 'Führende/abschließende und mehrfache Leerzeichen sollten entfernt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->clean_string( `SingleSpace` ) exp = 'SingleSpace'
      msg = 'String ohne extra Leerzeichen sollte unverändert bleiben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->clean_string( `   Only   Spaces   ` ) exp = 'Only Spaces'
      msg = 'Nur Leerzeichen und Text.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->clean_string( ` ` ) exp = ''
      msg = 'Nur Leerzeichen sollte zu leerem String führen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von String-Templates mit der Option `ALPHA = OUT` (für `STRIP` Funktionalität) und dem `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` Operator bietet eine sehr leistungsstarke und kompakte Methode zur String-Bereinigung. Reguläre Ausdrücke (`\s+`) sind ideal, um Muster wie mehrere Leerzeichen zu finden und zu ersetzen.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, REGEX, String Templates, STRIP

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (Buchungsnummer, Flugnummer, Passagiername). Gruppieren Sie die Buchungen nach Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Passagiere pro Flug. Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             booking_id TYPE i,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             passenger  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES tt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             passenger_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_bookings
      IMPORTING it_bookings TYPE tt_bookings
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_bookings.
    LOOP AT it_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking) GROUP BY ls_booking-connid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_member>).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        passenger_count = lv_count
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_bookings.
    DATA(lt_input_bookings) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouping=>tt_bookings(
      ( booking_id = 1 connid = '0400' passenger = 'Alice' )
      ( booking_id = 2 connid = '0010' passenger = 'Bob' )
      ( booking_id = 3 connid = '0400' passenger = 'Charlie' )
      ( booking_id = 4 connid = '0900' passenger = 'David' )
      ( booking_id = 5 connid = '0400' passenger = 'Eve' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->summarize_bookings( lt_input_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Gruppen gebildet werden.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ connid = '0400' ]-passenger_count exp = 3
      msg = 'Flug 0400 sollte 3 Passagiere haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ connid = '0010' ]-passenger_count exp = 1
      msg = 'Flug 0010 sollte 1 Passagier haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ connid = '0900' ]-passenger_count exp = 1
      msg = 'Flug 0900 sollte 1 Passagier haben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke Erweiterung für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen, die es ermöglicht, Daten direkt in der Schleife zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungslogik erheblich und macht den Code effizienter und lesbarer als manuelle Gruppierungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, Aggregation, LOOP AT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum. Verwenden Sie moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP oder CL_ABAP_DATE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_age_in_years) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rv_age_in_years = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    IF lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( lv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND lv_current_date(4) < iv_birth_date(4) ).
      rv_age_in_years = rv_age_in_years - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_age FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_age.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).

    " Test case: Birthday already passed this year
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age( '19900101' ) exp = sy-datum(4) - 1990
      msg = 'Alter sollte korrekt berechnet werden (Geburtstag vorbei).' ).

    " Test case: Birthday not yet passed this year
    DATA(lv_birth_date_future) = |{ sy-datum(4) - 1 }1231|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age( lv_birth_date_future ) exp = sy-datum(4) - ( sy-datum(4) - 1 ) - 1
      msg = 'Alter sollte korrekt berechnet werden (Geburtstag noch nicht vorbei).' ).

    " Test case: Birthday today
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age( sy-datum ) exp = 0
      msg = 'Alter sollte 0 sein bei Geburtstag heute.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP keine direkte Funktion für die Altersberechnung hat, kann man dies mit einfachen Datumsoperationen und String-Slicing (`sy-datum(4)`) erreichen. Die Logik berücksichtigt, ob der Geburtstag im aktuellen Jahr bereits stattgefunden hat, um das genaue Alter zu ermitteln. Für komplexere Datumsberechnungen wären `CL_ABAP_DATE` oder `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` die modernen Klassen der Wahl.
keywords: Date/Time, Date Calculation, String Slicing

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und den ASSIGN COMPONENT-Befehl.
hint: Nutzen Sie Field-Symbols und ASSIGN COMPONENT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING is_data      TYPE ty_data
                iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_field_value_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_valid.
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_reader=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Hello'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = '45.67'
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_reader( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ) exp = 'Hello'
      msg = 'Wert von FIELD1 sollte korrekt gelesen werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ) exp = '123'
      msg = 'Wert von FIELD2 sollte korrekt gelesen werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD3' ) exp = '45.67'
      msg = 'Wert von FIELD3 sollte korrekt gelesen werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_field_value_invalid.
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_reader=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Hello'
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_reader( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ) exp = 'Field not found'
      msg = 'Nicht existierendes Feld sollte abgefangen werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist ein mächtiges Feature in ABAP, um zur Laufzeit auf Komponenten von Strukturen zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten. Die Ausgabe über String-Templates (`|{ <fs_value> }|`) ist die moderne Art, den Inhalt eines Field-Symbols in einen String zu konvertieren.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne Inline-Deklaration für die Ergebnisstruktur.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den ersten verfügbaren Flugdatensatz für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft in eine interne Tabelle mit einer Zeile. Verwenden Sie UP TO 1 ROWS und INTO TABLE.
hint: Kombinieren Sie SELECT ... UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(...)
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_up_to_1 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_key) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_up_to_1 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight_key.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflight_key
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate ASC. " Ensure a consistent 'first' row
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_flight_key FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Obwohl `SELECT SINGLE` für einen einzelnen Datensatz gedacht ist, kann `SELECT ... UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE` verwendet werden, um den ersten Datensatz einer Abfrage in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen. Dies ist flexibler, wenn man z.B. eine `ORDER BY`-Klausel benötigt, um den "ersten" Datensatz zu definieren.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz und bestimmen Sie in der SELECT-Anweisung, ob der Flug "Full" (seatsocc >= seatsmax) oder "Available" ist, unter Verwendung eines CASE-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SQL-CASE-Ausdruck direkt in der SELECT-Liste.

CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE WHEN seatsocc >= seatsmax THEN 'Full' ELSE 'Available' END AS status
      FROM sflights
      INTO @rs_flight_status
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_get_flight_status_full.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `CASE` Ausdrücken direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste ermöglicht es, Daten bereits auf Datenbankebene zu transformieren oder zu kategorisieren, was die Datenübertragung und die nachfolgende Verarbeitung im ABAP-Programm reduziert. keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CASE, SQL Expressions, Database Access

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz. Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass die Datenbankverbindung fehlschlägt oder ein anderer Datenbankfehler auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS get_sflight_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight_key) TYPE ty_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_safely.
    TRY.
        SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
          FROM sflights
          INTO @rs_sflight_key
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          ev_error_message = |Flight { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } on { iv_fldate } not found.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        ev_error_message = |Database error: { lx_db_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_error_handling( ).
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_existing_flight) UP TO 1 ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_error_msg) = ``.
      DATA(ls_sflight_key) = lo_cut->get_sflight_safely( iv_carrid = ls_existing_flight-carrid
                                                          iv_connid = ls_existing_flight-connid
                                                          iv_fldate = ls_existing_flight-fldate
                                                          EXPORTING ev_error_message = lv_error_msg ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_error_msg ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_key-carrid exp = ls_existing_flight-carrid ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No test data found in SFLIGHTS table.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_sflight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_error_msg) = ``.
    DATA(ls_sflight_key) = lo_cut->get_sflight_safely( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '19000101'
                                                        EXPORTING ev_error_message = lv_error_msg ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_error_msg ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_sflight_key-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = lv_error_msg pattern = 'not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken zur Behandlung von Open SQL-Ausnahmen (z.B. `CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB`) ist ein moderner Ansatz zur robusten Fehlerbehandlung bei Datenbankzugriffen. Dies verhindert Programmabbrüche und ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf Probleme.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, TRY CATCH, Exception Handling, Database Access

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdatensätzen, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' planetype = '737' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_filter=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_empty_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine prägnante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ist Teil der modernen Tabellenausdrücke und ersetzt oft explizite Schleifen mit `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Processing

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz. Falls kein Datensatz gefunden wird, initialisieren Sie die Ergebnisstruktur mit Standardwerten unter Verwendung des VALUE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit `COND` oder `DEFAULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_value_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    METHODS get_sflight_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.

      FROM sflights
      INTO @ls_sflight_db
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die an einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_prices TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_prices
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_price> IN lt_prices
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_price>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).

    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251225' price = 200 ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' fldate = '20251226' price = 50 ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_fldate = '20251225' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 300 ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND fldate = '20251225'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND fldate = '20251226'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'ZZ' iv_fldate = '19000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Akkumulationen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht.

Instructions: Suchen Sie einen Code Inspector-Check, dessen Beschreibung einen bestimmten Text enthält, und rufen Sie dann dessen Attribute ab. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` für die Suche und `CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES` für die Attribute.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_search_and_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ci_attribute,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_ci_attribute.
    TYPES tt_ci_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ci_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS search_and_get_ci_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_search_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_ci_attributes
      RAISING
        cx_ci_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_search_and_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_and_get_ci_attributes.
    DATA lv_check_name TYPE string.

    SELECT SINGLE check_name
      FROM ci_check_t
      INTO @lv_check_name
      WHERE description LIKE @( '%' && iv_search_text && '%' ) UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
      DATA(lt_attributes_raw) = lo_ci_query->get_attributes( lv_check_name ).

      rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR <fs_attr> IN lt_attributes_raw
                                  ( name = <fs_attr>-attribute_name
                                    value = <fs_attr>-attribute_value ) ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ci_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |No Code Inspector check found with description containing '{ iv_search_text }'.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_search_and_get_attributes FOR TESTING RAISING cx_ci_error.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_attributes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attributes[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CHECK_ABAP_DOCU' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = lx_ci_error->get_text( ) pattern = 'No Code Inspector check found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `SELECT SINGLE` mit einem `LIKE`-Operator für die Suche in der Datenbanktabelle `CI_CHECK_T` und nutzt dann `CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES`, um detaillierte Informationen abzurufen. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`&&`) für die `LIKE`-Bedingung und die Ausnahmebehandlung (`RAISING CX_CI_ERROR`) sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.

CLASS zcl_flight_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_flight_object IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.

        AND connid = @mv_connid

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE` für die Aggregation auf Datenbankebene (falls nur ein Flug gefunden wird) oder `REDUCE` für mehrere Flüge.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `AVG` oder `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_prices
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_prices ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0 TYPE sflight-price FOR p IN lt_prices NEXT s = s + p ).
      rv_average_price = lv_sum / lines( lt_prices ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_next_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_next_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_next_flight.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdatensätze nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis in jeder Gruppe. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `GROUP BY` und `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_for_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_max_price_per_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_for_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_flight.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN lt_all_flights
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid, connid = <fs_flight>-connid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                  ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                    connid = <fs_flight>-connid
                                    max_price = REDUCE #( INIT m = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                                          FOR member IN GROUP <fs_flight>
                                                          NEXT m = nmax( m, member-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_xx0001) = lt_summary[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_xx0001-max_price exp = 150 ).

Instructions: Extrahiere alle E-Mail-Adressen aus einem Text, wobei der Benutzername und die Domain separat erfasst werden sollen.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit der `SUBMATCHES` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_email_part,
             username TYPE string,
             domain   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_email_part.
    TYPES: tt_email_parts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_email_part WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_emails IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                           RETURNING VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE tt_email_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA: lv_regex TYPE string VALUE '\b([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+)@([A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})\b'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text
         RESULTS DATA(lt_results)
         RESPECTING CASE.

    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      IF lines( ls_result-submatches ) >= 2. " Ensure both groups are found
        APPEND VALUE ty_email_part(
          username = ls_result-submatches[1]-string
          domain   = ls_result-submatches[2]-string
        ) TO rt_emails.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` alle Flüge heraus, deren `CARRID` den Buchstaben 'LH' enthält, und gib die `CARRID` und `CONNID` dieser Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwende eine `FOR` Schleife mit `FILTER` und `FIND` in einer `COND` oder `SWITCH` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_find_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrid_pattern
      IMPORTING iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_find_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrid_pattern.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( FIND( val = ls_flight-carrid sub = iv_pattern ) IS NOT INITIAL )
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                            connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Vorkommen eines Schlüsselworts in einem langen Text und gib für jedes Vorkommen den Schlüsselwort selbst sowie 20 Zeichen Kontext davor und danach zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit `RESULTS` und `substring` für den Kontext. Verwende `VALUE #(` und `LET` für kompakten Code.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_match_context,
             offset  TYPE i,
             keyword TYPE string,
             context TYPE string,
           END OF ty_match_context.
    TYPES: tt_match_context TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_match_context WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_keyword_with_context
      IMPORTING iv_text    TYPE string
                iv_keyword TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_contexts) TYPE tt_match_context.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_keyword_with_context.
    DATA(lv_context_length) = 20.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_keyword IN iv_text
         RESULTS DATA(lt_results)
         RESPECTING CASE.

    rt_contexts = VALUE #( FOR ls_result IN lt_results
                           LET lv_start_offset = COND i( WHEN ls_result-offset < lv_context_length
                                                          THEN 0
                                                          ELSE ls_result-offset - lv_context_length )
                               lv_end_offset   = ls_result-offset + ls_result-length + lv_context_length
                               lv_actual_length = lv_end_offset - lv_start_offset
                           IN
                           ( offset  = ls_result-offset
                             keyword = ls_result-string
                             context = substring( val = iv_text off = lv_start_offset len = lv_actual_length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_to_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_utf8
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_to_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_utf8.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        lo_conv_out->convert( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string
                              IMPORTING buffer = rv_utf8_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_init_error cx_abap_conv_codepage_error cx_abap_conv_illegal_character.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Im Produktivsystem sollte hier eine spezifischere Behandlung erfolgen.
        " Für dieses Beispiel geben wir eine leere XSTRING zurück.
        CLEAR rv_utf8_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstriere die Fehlerbehandlung bei der Konvertierung eines Strings in eine XSTRING, wenn die Ziel-Codepage ein Zeichen nicht darstellen kann.
hint: Fange die Exception `cx_abap_conv_illegal_character` ab und gib eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
                iv_encoding     TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_ce=>ty_result.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             xstring_data TYPE xstring,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_result.

    METHODS convert_string_robust
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
                iv_encoding     TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_output) TYPE ty_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lv_error_text TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = iv_encoding ).
        lo_conv_out->convert( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string
                              IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring ).
        rs_result = NEW cl_abap_conv_ce=>ty_result( xstring_data = lv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_init_error INTO DATA(lx_init).
        lv_error_text = lx_init->get_text( ).
        rs_result = NEW cl_abap_conv_ce=>ty_result( error_message = lv_error_text ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_codepage_error INTO DATA(lx_codepage).
        lv_error_text = lx_codepage->get_text( ).
        rs_result = NEW cl_abap_conv_ce=>ty_result( error_message = lv_error_text ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_illegal_character INTO DATA(lx_illegal).
        lv_error_text = lx_illegal->get_text( ).
        rs_result = NEW cl_abap_conv_ce=>ty_result( error_message = lv_error_text ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_string_robust.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = iv_encoding ).
        lo_conv_out->convert( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string
                              IMPORTING buffer = rs_output-xstring_data ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_init_error cx_abap_conv_codepage_error cx_abap_conv_illegal_character INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        rs_output-error_message = lx_conv->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt, und gib den Rest des Strings zurück, falls das Präfix gefunden wurde.
hint: Verwende `FIND` mit der `STARTING AT` Klausel und `substring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_check_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_string_after_prefix
      IMPORTING iv_full_string TYPE string
                iv_prefix      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_remaining_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_check_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_string_after_prefix.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_prefix IN iv_full_string
         STARTING AT 0
         MATCH OFFSET lv_offset
         RESPECTING CASE.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_offset = 0. " Prefix found at the beginning
      rv_remaining_string = substring( val = iv_full_string off = strlen( iv_prefix ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde die Position des letzten Vorkommens eines Teilstrings in einem gegebenen Text.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_last DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_last_occurrence
      IMPORTING iv_text       TYPE string
                iv_substring  TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_offset) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_str_find_last IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_last_occurrence.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_substring IN iv_text
         IN REVERSE
         MATCH OFFSET rv_offset
         RESPECTING CASE.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_offset = -1. " Indicate not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von XSTRINGS, wobei jeder String in UTF-8 konvertiert wird. Nutze dabei funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Verwende `FOR` und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` in einer `VALUE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_it_to_utf8_it DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_utf8
      IMPORTING it_input_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_utf8_xstrings) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_it_to_utf8_it IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_utf8.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

        rt_utf8_xstrings = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_input_strings
                                    LET lv_xstring = VALUE xstring( )
                                    IN
                                    ( COND xstring( WHEN lv_string IS NOT INITIAL
                                                    THEN lo_conv_out->convert( EXPORTING data = lv_string
                                                                                IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring ) ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_init_error cx_abap_conv_codepage_error cx_abap_conv_illegal_character.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Im Produktivsystem sollte hier eine spezifischere Behandlung erfolgen.
        " Für dieses Beispiel geben wir eine leere Tabelle zurück.
        CLEAR rt_utf8_xstrings.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von XSTRINGS (UTF-8) zurück in eine interne Tabelle von Strings (System-Codepage). Nutze dabei funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Verwende `FOR` und `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` in einer `VALUE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_it_from_utf8_it DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_table_to_string
      IMPORTING it_utf8_xstrings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_output_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_it_from_utf8_it IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_table_to_string.
    DATA: lo_conv_in TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_in = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

        rt_output_strings = VALUE #( FOR lv_xstring IN it_utf8_xstrings
                                     LET lv_string = VALUE string( )
                                     IN
                                     ( COND string( WHEN lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL
                                                     THEN lo_conv_in->convert( EXPORTING input = lv_xstring
                                                                                 IMPORTING data = lv_string ) ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_init_error cx_abap_conv_codepage_error cx_abap_conv_illegal_character.
        CLEAR rt_output_strings.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein String ein bestimmtes Muster (Regex) enthält und gib 'true' oder 'false' zurück.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_regex_pattern
      IMPORTING iv_text   TYPE string
                iv_regex  TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rb_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_regex_pattern.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX iv_regex IN iv_text
         RESPECTING CASE.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_contains = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_contains = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field,
           ty_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        it_fields TYPE ty_fields
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_fields INTO DATA(ls_field).
      ls_component-name = ls_field-name.
      CASE ls_field-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT4'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int4( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default to string or handle error
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill with some example data
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'Value A'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 100. ENDIF.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line2>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line2> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'Value B'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line2> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 200. ENDIF.
    INSERT <fs_line2> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_fields TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>ty_fields,
          ls_field  TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>ty_field.

    ls_field-name = 'FIELD1'. ls_field-type = 'STRING'. APPEND ls_field TO lt_fields.
    ls_field-name = 'FIELD2'. ls_field-type = 'INT4'.   APPEND ls_field TO lt_fields.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_table( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_table> ). " Should not be initial, but filled with 2 entries
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 'Value A' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 100 ).

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Dateinamen und geben Sie deren MIME-Typen zurück. Wenn der MIME-Typ 'application/octet-stream' ist, kennzeichnen Sie ihn als 'Unbekannt'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES=>GET_MIME_TYPE_FOR_EXTENSION` und eine `FOR`-Expression mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
             filename  TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_info,
           ty_file_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_files
      IMPORTING
        it_filenames TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_infos) TYPE ty_file_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_files.
    rt_file_infos = VALUE #( FOR filename IN it_filenames
                                LET lv_extension = substring_after( val = filename sep = '.' )
                                    lv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_for_extension( lv_extension )
                                IN ( filename  = filename,
                                     mime_type = COND #( WHEN lv_mime_type = 'application/octet-stream' THEN 'Unbekannt'
                                                         ELSE lv_mime_type ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_files( lt_filenames ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von MIME-Typen, die als 'Text' oder 'Bild' klassifiziert werden können, basierend auf den von `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` bereitgestellten Informationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES=>GET_ALL_MIME_TYPES` und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FILTER` und String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_classifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_mime_type_category TYPE string VALUE 'Text' |
                                 'Image' |
                                 'Other'.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_classified_mime,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             category  TYPE ty_mime_type_category,
           END OF ty_classified_mime,
           ty_classified_mimes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_classified_mime WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS classify_mime_types
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_classified_mimes) TYPE ty_classified_mimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_classifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_mime_types.
    DATA(lt_all_mime_types) = cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_all_mime_types( ).

    rt_classified_mimes = VALUE #( FOR mime_type IN lt_all_mime_types
                                   LET category = COND ty_mime_type_category(
                                                      WHEN mime_type CS 'text/' THEN 'Text'
                                                      WHEN mime_type CS 'image/' THEN 'Image'
                                                      ELSE 'Other' )
                                   IN ( mime_type = mime_type, category = category ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_classify_mime_types FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_classify_mime_types.
    DATA(lo_classifier) = NEW zcl_mime_type_classifier( ).
    DATA(lt_classified) = lo_classifier->classify_mime_types( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_classified ).

    DATA(lv_text_count)  = 0.
    DATA(lv_image_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_other_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_classified INTO DATA(ls_mime).
      CASE ls_mime-category.
        WHEN 'Text'.  lv_text_count = lv_text_count + 1.
        WHEN 'Image'. lv_image_count = lv_image_count + 1.
        WHEN 'Other'. lv_other_count = lv_other_count + 1.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_text_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_image_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_other_count > 0 ).

    " Check a specific known MIME type
    DATA(ls_pdf_entry) = lt_classified[ mime_type = 'application/pdf' DEFAULT 'NOT_FOUND' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_pdf_entry-category exp = 'Other' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` dynamisch nach einem beliebigen Feld aggregiert und die Summe eines anderen Feldes berechnet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit dynamischem Feldzugriff und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregation_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             total_sum TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_aggregation_result,
           ty_aggregation_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregation_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE ty_sflights
        iv_group_field  TYPE string
        iv_sum_field    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE ty_aggregation_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_sflights.
    DATA: lt_grouped_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_aggregation_result WITH UNIQUE KEY group_key.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group_value> TYPE any,
                     <fs_sum_value>   TYPE any.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_group_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sum_field OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_sum_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_group_key) = |{ <fs_group_value> }|.
      DATA(lv_sum_value) = CONV decfloat16( <fs_sum_value> ).

      READ TABLE lt_grouped_data INTO DATA(ls_result) WITH TABLE KEY group_key = lv_group_key.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_result-total_sum = ls_result-total_sum + lv_sum_value.
        MODIFY TABLE lt_grouped_data FROM ls_result.
      ELSE.
        ls_result-group_key = lv_group_key.
        ls_result-total_sum = lv_sum_value.
        INSERT ls_result INTO TABLE lt_grouped_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_results = VALUE #( lt_grouped_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` in eine andere interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch definierten Struktur umwandelt, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` mit einer `FOR`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_field_name TYPE string.
    TYPES: ty_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS project_sflights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE ty_sflights
        it_project_fields TYPE ty_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_projected_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_project_fields INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      CASE lv_field_name.
        WHEN 'CARRID'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( 3 ).
        WHEN 'CONNID'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_n( 4 ).
        WHEN 'FLDATE'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
        WHEN 'PRICE'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p( p_length = 15 p_decimals = 2 ).
        WHEN 'CURRENCY'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( 5 ).
        WHEN OTHERS. CONTINUE. " Skip unknown fields
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_projected_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_target_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_projected_data->* TO <lt_target_table>.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_source_line).
      CREATE DATA <ls_target_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_target_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_target_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_line_struct>).

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_source_line TO <fs_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line_struct> TO <fs_target_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_target_line_struct> INTO TABLE <lt_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
