Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Dateinamen und deren MIME-Typen akzeptiert. Basierend auf dem MIME-Typ soll dynamisch eine spezifische Verarbeitungsmethode aufgerufen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` zur MIME-Typ-Ermittlung und `CALL METHOD` für den dynamischen Aufruf.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_mime_processor PUBLIC.
  METHODS process_file
    IMPORTING
      iv_filename TYPE string
      iv_mime_type TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_pdf_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_mime_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_mime_processor~process_file.
    rv_result = |PDF-Datei '{ iv_filename }' verarbeitet. MIME: { iv_mime_type }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_mime_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_mime_processor~process_file.
    rv_result = |Bilddatei '{ iv_filename }' verarbeitet. MIME: { iv_mime_type }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_mime_dispatcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_entry,
             filename TYPE string,
             extension TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_entry,
           ty_file_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS dispatch_processing
      IMPORTING
        it_file_entries TYPE ty_file_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_mime_dispatcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dispatch_processing.
    DATA: lv_class_name TYPE string,
          lo_processor  TYPE REF TO zif_mime_processor.

    LOOP AT it_file_entries INTO DATA(ls_file).
      DATA(lv_mime_type) = cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_for_extension( ls_file-extension ).

      CASE lv_mime_type.
        WHEN 'application/pdf'.
          lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PDF_PROCESSOR'.
        WHEN 'image/jpeg' OR 'image/png'.
          lv_class_name = 'ZCL_IMAGE_PROCESSOR'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND |Unbekannter MIME-Typ '{ lv_mime_type }' für Datei '{ ls_file-filename }'| TO rt_results.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.

      TRY.
          CREATE OBJECT lo_processor TYPE (lv_class_name).
          APPEND lo_processor->process_file( iv_filename = ls_file-filename iv_mime_type = lv_mime_type ) TO rt_results.
        CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
          APPEND |Fehler beim Erstellen des Prozessors für '{ lv_mime_type }'| TO rt_results.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          APPEND |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf für '{ lv_mime_type }'| TO rt_results.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file,
             name TYPE string,
             extension TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file,
           ty_files TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE ty_files
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_files) TYPE ty_files.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_valid_files.
    rt_filtered_files = FILTER #( it_files EXCEPT
                                   WHERE ( cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_for_extension( extension ) = 'application/octet-stream' OR
                                           cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_for_extension( extension ) = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_xslfo_supplementary ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_distinct_values
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE ty_sflights
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_distinct_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_values.
    DATA: lt_unique_values TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field_value> TYPE any.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        INSERT |{ <fs_field_value> }| INTO TABLE lt_unique_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_distinct_values = VALUE #( lt_unique_values ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fse_file_open DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS open_text_file_dialog
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_selected_file) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fse_file_open IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_text_file_dialog.
    DATA: lt_file_table TYPE filetable,
          lv_rc         TYPE i.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        i_title         = 'Textdatei auswählen'
        i_cdfilter      = 'Textdateien (*.txt)|*.txt|Alle Dateien (*.*)|*.*'
        i_initial_directory = 'C:\' " Beispiel: Initiales Verzeichnis
      CHANGING
        file_table      = lt_file_table
        rc              = lv_rc
    ).

    IF lv_rc > 0 AND lt_file_table IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_selected_file = lt_file_table[ 1 ]-fullpath.
    ELSE.
      rv_selected_file = ''. " Keine Datei ausgewählt oder Fehler
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Starten Sie den Standard-Webbrowser des Frontend-Rechners und öffnen Sie eine bestimmte URL. Die Operation soll asynchron erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `execute` der Klasse `cl_gui_frontend_services` mit `async = abap_true`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fse_execute_browser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS open_url_in_browser
      IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fse_execute_browser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_url_in_browser.
    " Beachten Sie: 'explorer.exe' ist Windows-spezifisch. Auf Linux/macOS
    " wären andere Befehle wie 'xdg-open' oder 'open' nötig.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute(
      EXPORTING
        application = 'explorer.exe' " Oder 'cmd.exe /c start' auf Windows
        parameter   = iv_url
        operation   = 'OPEN'
        async       = abap_true " Asynchron ausführen
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS      = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Protokollierung oder Ausnahme auslösen
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Öffnen der URL.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setzen Sie eine Textauswahl in einem `cl_gui_textedit`-Control und lesen Sie anschließend den ausgewählten Text wieder aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_selection_coords` und `get_selected_text_as_stream`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ted_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS manipulate_selection
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_start_row TYPE i
        iv_start_col TYPE i
        iv_end_row   TYPE i
        iv_end_col   TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_selected_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ted_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_selection.
    " Zuerst den gesamten Text setzen
    io_textedit->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).

    " Dann die Auswahl setzen
    io_textedit->set_selection_coords(
      EXPORTING
        from_line = iv_start_row
        from_pos  = iv_start_col
        to_line   = iv_end_row
        to_pos    = iv_end_col
    ).

    " Den tatsächlich ausgewählten Text abrufen
    io_textedit->get_selected_text_as_stream(
      IMPORTING
        text = rv_selected_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_selection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_selection.
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_SEL' ).
    DATA(lo_textedit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_dummy_container ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ted_selection( ).
    DATA(lv_full_text) = 'This is a test string for selection.'.
    DATA(lv_expected_selection) = 'test string'.

    DATA(lv_selected_text) = lo_cut->manipulate_selection(
      EXPORTING
        io_textedit  = lo_textedit
        iv_text      = lv_full_text
        iv_start_row = 1
        iv_start_col = 11 " 't' von 'test'
        iv_end_row   = 1
        iv_end_col   = 21 " 'g' von 'string'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_selected_text
      exp = lv_expected_selection
      msg = 'Der ausgewählte Text sollte der erwarteten Auswahl entsprechen'
    ).

    lo_dummy_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert das Setzen von Text und das programmatische Setzen und Abrufen einer Textauswahl. Die Methoden `set_selection_coords` und `get_selected_text_as_stream` sind nützlich für die Automatisierung von Textbearbeitungsaufgaben oder die Implementierung von Such-/Ersetzungsfunktionen. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) erhöhen die Lesbarkeit.

Instructions: Laden Sie den Inhalt einer Textdatei vom Frontend-Rechner in ein `cl_gui_textedit`-Control und speichern Sie den bearbeiteten Inhalt anschließend wieder in eine Datei. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Features.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services` für Dateioperationen mit `cl_gui_textedit` für die Textanzeige. Verwenden Sie `READ DATASET` und `TRANSFER` für die Dateioperationen auf dem Frontend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ted_fse_file_io DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS load_and_save_text
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ted_fse_file_io IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_and_save_text.
    DATA: lv_file_path TYPE string,
          lv_text_content TYPE string,
          lv_rc TYPE i.

    " 1. Datei zum Laden auswählen
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        i_title         = 'Textdatei zum Laden auswählen'
        i_cdfilter      = 'Textdateien (*.txt)|*.txt|Alle Dateien (*.*)|*.*'
      CHANGING
        file_table      = DATA(lt_file_table_open)
        rc              = lv_rc
    ).

    IF lv_rc = 0 OR lt_file_table_open IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    lv_file_path = lt_file_table_open[ 1 ]-fullpath.

    " 2. Dateiinhalt vom Frontend lesen
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename   = lv_file_path
        filetype   = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab   = DATA(lt_raw_data)
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_text_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN lt_raw_data
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <line> )
    ).

    " 3. Text in TextEdit-Control setzen
    io_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lv_text_content ).

    " 4. Datei zum Speichern auswählen
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        i_title         = 'Textdatei speichern unter'
        i_cdfilter      = 'Textdateien (*.txt)|*.txt|Alle Dateien (*.*)|*.*'
        i_default_extension = 'txt'
      CHANGING
        filename        = DATA(lv_save_filename)
        path            = DATA(lv_save_path)
        fullpath        = DATA(lv_save_fullpath)
        rc              = lv_rc
    ).

    IF lv_rc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 5. Text aus TextEdit-Control lesen
    io_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_text_content ).

    " 6. Text in Datei auf Frontend speichern
    SPLIT lv_text_content AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE DATA(lt_save_data).
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename   = lv_save_fullpath
        filetype   = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab   = lt_save_data
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_load_and_save FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_load_and_save.
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_IO' ).
    DATA(lo_textedit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_dummy_container ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ted_fse_file_io( ).

    " Dieser Test erfordert Benutzerinteraktion für die Dateidialoge.
    " Ohne Interaktion werden die Dialoge abgebrochen und die Methode gibt false zurück.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->load_and_save_text( io_textedit ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Erwartet false, da Dateidialoge im Test nicht bedient werden können.'
    ).

    lo_dummy_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `cl_gui_frontend_services` für Dateioperationen und `cl_gui_textedit` für die Textbearbeitung. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` für die String-Aggregation und `SPLIT` für die Zerlegung sind moderne ABAP-Features (ab 7.40/7.50), die den Code kompakt und lesbar machen. `gui_upload` und `gui_download` sind die Standardmethoden für den Datenaustausch mit dem Frontend.
keywords: TextEdit, Frontend Services, Datei I/O, GUI, Upload, Download, REDUCE, SPLIT, cl_gui_textedit, cl_gui_frontend_services

CLASS zcl_cal_weekday_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weekdays
      IMPORTING
        it_all_dates TYPE tt_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_weekdays) TYPE tt_dates.

      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_weekday) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_weekday_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekdays.
    rt_weekdays = FILTER #( it_all_dates USING is_weekday( iv_date = table_line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_weekday.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( iv_date ).
    IF lv_day_of_week >= 2 AND lv_day_of_week <= 6. " 1=Sunday, 2=Monday, ..., 7=Saturday

    ELSE.
      rv_is_weekday = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_text_labels DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie eine Liste von Ereignissen nach Datum und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Ereignisse pro Tag. Die aggregierten Daten könnten für eine Kalenderübersicht im `cl_gui_calendar` verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer internen Tabelle als Zielstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_event_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             event_date TYPE d,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_event,
           tt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_daily_summary,
             event_date TYPE d,
             event_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_daily_summary,
           tt_daily_summary TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_daily_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY event_date.

    METHODS aggregate_events_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_events TYPE tt_events
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_daily_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_event_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_events_by_date.
    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_daily_summary(
      INIT lv_summary = VALUE tt_daily_summary( )
      FOR ls_event IN it_events
      LET ls_existing = lv_summary[ KEY event_date = ls_event-event_date ]
      IN
        COND tt_daily_summary(
          WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN
            VALUE #( lv_summary
                     ( event_date = ls_event-event_date event_count = ls_existing-event_count + 1 ) )
          ELSE
            VALUE #( lv_summary
                     ( event_date = ls_event-event_date event_count = 1 ) )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_events FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_events.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_event_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_events) = VALUE zcl_cal_event_aggregator=>tt_events(
      ( event_date = '20250101' description = 'Meeting A' )
      ( event_date = '20250101' description = 'Meeting B' )
      ( event_date = '20250102' description = 'Workshop' )
      ( event_date = '20250101' description = 'Meeting C' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->aggregate_events_by_date( lt_events ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ event_date = '20250101' ]-event_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ event_date = '20250102' ]-event_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um Ereignisse nach Datum zu gruppieren und die Anzahl pro Tag zu zählen, was eine sehr funktionale und ausdrucksstarke Syntax bietet.

CLASS zcl_ecl_color_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_data,
             id TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             color TYPE string,
           END OF ty_object_data,
           tt_object_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_object_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_colored_objects) TYPE tt_object_data.

CLASS zcl_ecl_color_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_status_to_color.
    rt_colored_objects = VALUE #( FOR ls_object IN it_objects
                                  ( id = ls_object-id
                                    status = ls_object-status
                                    color = COND string(
                                              WHEN ls_object-status = 'A' THEN 'GREEN'
                                              WHEN ls_object-status = 'B' THEN 'YELLOW'
                                              WHEN ls_object-status = 'C' THEN 'RED'
                                              ELSE 'GREY' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle von Attributen für `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` generiert, basierend auf einer Konfigurationstabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei dynamische Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` für dynamische Typen und Feldzugriffe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_entry,
             attribute_name TYPE string,
             attribute_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_entry,
           tt_config TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_attributes
      IMPORTING
        it_config TYPE tt_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_attributes.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_config INTO DATA(ls_config).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_config-attribute_name
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) )
      TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS NOT INITIAL.
      lr_struct_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
      lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).
      CREATE DATA rt_attributes TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

      " Example: Add one row with dummy data
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
      ASSIGN rt_attributes->* TO <lt_table>.
      IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_type.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_line>.
        IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          LOOP AT it_config INTO ls_config.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_config-attribute_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
            IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_field> = |Value for { ls_config-attribute_name }|.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie eine Liste von Feiertagen für ein bestimmtes Jahr und Land. Diese Liste könnte verwendet werden, um Feiertage im `cl_gui_calendar` hervorzuheben. Nutzen Sie dabei eine funktionale Herangehensweise.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus `FOR` und `COND` sowie Hilfsklassen für Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_holiday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_holidays TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_holidays
      IMPORTING
        iv_year TYPE i
        iv_country TYPE land1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_holidays) TYPE tt_holidays.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_holiday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_country TYPE land1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_holiday) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_holiday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_holidays.
    " This is a simplified example. Real holiday calculation is complex.
    " For demonstration, we'll hardcode a few common holidays.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = |{ iv_year }0101|.
    DATA(lv_end_date) = |{ iv_year }1231|.

    rt_holidays = VALUE #( FOR d = lv_start_date THEN d + 1 WHILE d <= lv_end_date
                           WHERE ( is_holiday( iv_date = d iv_country = iv_country ) = abap_true )
                           ( d ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_holiday.
    " Simplified logic: Check for New Year's Day and Christmas
    CASE iv_date+4(4).
      WHEN '0101'. " New Year's Day
        rv_is_holiday = abap_true.
      WHEN '1225'. " Christmas Day
        rv_is_holiday = abap_true.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_is_holiday = abap_false.
    ENDCASE.
    " In a real scenario, you'd use a factory class or a table lookup for country-specific holidays.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_circle_points DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_point,
             x TYPE i,
             y TYPE i,
           END OF ty_point,
           tt_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_circle_points
      IMPORTING
        iv_center_x TYPE i DEFAULT 0
        iv_center_y TYPE i DEFAULT 0
        iv_radius TYPE i DEFAULT 50
        iv_segments TYPE i DEFAULT 36 " Number of segments for approximation
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_points) TYPE tt_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_circle_points IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_circle_points.
    DATA(lv_angle_step) = 360 / iv_segments.

    rt_points = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_segments
                           LET lv_angle = i * lv_angle_step IN
                           ( x = iv_center_x + CONV i( iv_radius * cos( deg = lv_angle ) )
                             y = iv_center_y + CONV i( iv_radius * sin( deg = lv_angle ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_weekend_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_splitter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_splitter IMPORTING iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_splitter.
    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    DATA(lo_left_container)  = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_right_container) = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    DATA(lo_text_left) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_left_container
      wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_windowborder
    ).
    lo_text_left->set_text_as_stream( 'Dies ist der linke Bereich.' ).

    DATA(lo_text_right) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_right_container
      wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_windowborder
    ).
    lo_text_right->set_text_as_stream( 'Dies ist der rechte Bereich.' ).

    lo_splitter->set_column_width( id = 1 width = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_splitter.
    " In a real scenario, GUI tests are complex. Here, we simulate the creation
    " of GUI objects to ensure the code path is valid, but cannot verify visual output.
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).

CLASS zcl_splitter_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_splitter_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_splitter.
    mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    DATA(lo_left_container)  = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_right_container) = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    DATA(lo_text_left) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_left_container
    ).
    lo_text_left->set_text_as_stream( 'Linker Bereich' ).

    DATA(lo_text_right) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_right_container
    ).
    lo_text_right->set_text_as_stream( 'Rechter Bereich' ).

    SET HANDLER handle_column_width_changed FOR mo_splitter.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_column_width_changed.
    DATA(lv_width1) = mo_splitter->get_column_width( 1 ).
    DATA(lv_width2) = mo_splitter->get_column_width( 2 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_splitter_container` kapselt und Methoden zur einfachen Konfiguration der Spaltenbreiten bereitstellt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Parameterübergabe und interne Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FINAL CLASS`, `PRIVATE SECTION` für Kapselung und `COND` für bedingte Logik.

CLASS zcl_encapsulated_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS set_column_proportions IMPORTING iv_col1_width_percent TYPE i.
    METHODS get_column_width IMPORTING iv_column_id TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_width) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_encapsulated_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_column_proportions.
    DATA(lv_col2_width_percent) = COND i(
      WHEN iv_col1_width_percent >= 0 AND iv_col1_width_percent <= 100
      THEN 100 - iv_col1_width_percent
      ELSE 50 " Default to 50% if invalid input
    ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id = 1 width = iv_col1_width_percent ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id = 2 width = lv_col2_width_percent ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_column_width.
    rv_width = mo_splitter->get_column_width( iv_column_id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_left_container)  = lo_encapsulated_splitter->mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_right_container) = lo_encapsulated_splitter->mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(

    ).

    DATA(lo_left_container)  = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_right_container) = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " Ungefilterte Daten laden
    SELECT carrid connid fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_all).

    " Gefilterte Daten mit FILTER-Operator (z.B. nur Lufthansa Flüge)
    DATA(lt_sflight_filtered) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

      i_parent = lo_left_container

    lo_alv_filtered->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflight_filtered
    ).

    " ALV für alle Daten (rechts)

      i_parent = lo_right_container
    ).
    lo_alv_all->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Schnittstelle für einen 'Datenanbieter' und implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Datenanbieter (z.B. für SFLIGHT und SCARR). Zeigen Sie die Daten des ausgewählten Anbieters in einem ALV-Grid innerhalb eines `cl_gui_splitter_container` an. Der Splitter soll auch einen Bereich für die Auswahl des Datenanbieters haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING`, `cl_gui_alv_grid` und `cl_gui_dropdown_listbox`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_line,
           field1 TYPE string,
           field2 TYPE string,
           field3 TYPE string,
         END OF ty_data_line,
         tt_data_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data_lines.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
    METHODS zif_data_provider~get_data.
    METHODS zif_data_provider~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).
    rt_data = VALUE zif_data_provider~tt_data_lines(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw (
        field1 = ls_raw-carrid,
        field2 = ls_raw-connid,
        field3 = |{ ls_raw-fldate DATE = USER }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_name.
    rv_name = 'SFLIGHT Data'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_scarr_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
    METHODS zif_data_provider~get_data.
    METHODS zif_data_provider~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_scarr_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    SELECT carrid carrname currcode FROM scarr INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_scarr_raw).
    rt_data = VALUE zif_data_provider~tt_data_lines(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_scarr_raw (
        field1 = ls_raw-carrid,
        field2 = ls_raw-carrname,
        field3 = ls_raw-currcode
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_name.
    rv_name = 'SCARR Data'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_ui IMPORTING iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_dropdown TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dropdown_listbox.
    DATA mt_providers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_data_provider WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS handle_dropdown_select FOR EVENT selected_item_changed OF cl_gui_dropdown_listbox.
    METHODS update_alv IMPORTING io_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_ui.
    mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent_container
      rows    = 2
      columns = 1
    ).

    DATA(lo_top_container)    = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_bottom_container) = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).

    " Dropdown for provider selection
    mo_dropdown = NEW cl_gui_dropdown_listbox(
      parent = lo_top_container
    ).

    APPEND NEW zcl_sflight_provider( ) TO mt_providers.
    APPEND NEW zcl_scarr_provider( ) TO mt_providers.

    DATA(lt_dropdown_items) = VALUE cl_gui_dropdown_listbox=>t_list_items(
      FOR ls_provider IN mt_providers (
        key = ls_provider->get_name( ),
        value = ls_provider->get_name( )
      )
    ).
    mo_dropdown->set_list_items( lt_dropdown_items ).
    SET HANDLER handle_dropdown_select FOR mo_dropdown.

    " ALV Grid for data display
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_bottom_container
    ).
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZIF_DATA_PROVIDER=>TY_DATA_LINE'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = VALUE zif_data_provider~tt_data_lines( )
    ).

    mo_splitter->set_row_height( id = 1 height = 10 ).

    " Initial display
    IF lt_dropdown_items IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_dropdown->set_selected_item( lt_dropdown_items[ 1 ]-key ).
      update_alv( mt_providers[ 1 ] ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_dropdown_select.
    DATA(lv_selected_key) = mo_dropdown->get_selected_item( ).
    DATA(lo_selected_provider) = FILTER #( mt_providers WHERE get_name( ) = lv_selected_key OPTIONAL ).
    IF lo_selected_provider IS BOUND.
      update_alv( lo_selected_provider ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_alv.
    DATA(lt_data) = io_provider->get_data( ).
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      CHANGING
        it_outtab = lt_data
    ).
    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_splitter_container` und passen Sie dessen Layout (z.B. horizontale oder vertikale Aufteilung) basierend auf einer externen Konfiguration oder einem Benutzerparameter an. Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` für die Layout-Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_splitter_container` und den `SWITCH`-Operator für die bedingte Layout-Anpassung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_responsive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_layout_config,
             orientation TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             " 'H' for horizontal, 'V' for vertical
             proportion  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_layout_config.

    METHODS display_responsive_splitter
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        is_layout_config    TYPE ty_layout_config OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_responsive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_responsive_splitter.
    DATA(ls_effective_config) = SWITCH ty_layout_config(
      is_layout_config-orientation
      WHEN 'H' THEN is_layout_config
      WHEN 'V' THEN is_layout_config
      ELSE VALUE ty_layout_config( orientation = 'H' proportion = 50 ) " Default horizontal 50%
    ).

    DATA(lv_rows)    = COND i( WHEN ls_effective_config-orientation = 'V' THEN 2 ELSE 1 ).
    DATA(lv_columns) = COND i( WHEN ls_effective_config-orientation = 'H' THEN 2 ELSE 1 ).

    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent_container
      rows    = lv_rows
      columns = lv_columns
    ).

    DATA(lo_pane1) = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_pane2) = lo_splitter->get_container( row = lv_rows column = lv_columns ).

    DATA(lo_text1) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_pane1 ).
    lo_text1->set_text_as_stream( |Bereich 1 ({ ls_effective_config-orientation } - { ls_effective_config-proportion }%)| ).

    DATA(lo_text2) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_pane2 ).
    lo_text2->set_text_as_stream( |Bereich 2 ({ ls_effective_config-orientation } - { 100 - ls_effective_config-proportion }%)| ).

    IF ls_effective_config-orientation = 'H'.
      lo_splitter->set_column_width( id = 1 width = ls_effective_config-proportion ).
    ELSE.
      lo_splitter->set_row_height( id = 1 height = ls_effective_config-proportion ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_pane_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_object_type) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_rtti_pane_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD inspect_pane_content.
    DATA(lo_control) = io_container->get_control( ). " Get the control embedded in the container

    IF lo_control IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object( lo_control ).
      rv_object_type = lo_descr->get_name( ).
    ELSE.
      rv_object_type = 'No control embedded'.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft und zeigen Sie die Gruppenergebnisse in einem ALV-Grid im linken Bereich eines Splitter-Containers an. Im rechten Bereich soll ein Textfeld die Anzahl der Gruppen anzeigen. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` für die Datenaggregation und `cl_gui_alv_grid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_grouped_data IMPORTING iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_grouped_data.
    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    DATA(lo_left_container)  = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_right_container) = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    SELECT carrid connid fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_all).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight,
           tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = VALUE tt_grouped_flight(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight_all GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).

    DATA(lo_alv_grouped) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_left_container
    ).
    lo_alv_grouped->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_SPLITTER_GROUP_BY=>TY_GROUPED_FLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_grouped_data
    ).

    DATA(lo_text_right) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_right_container
    ).
    lo_text_right->set_text_as_stream( |Anzahl der Fluggesellschaften: { lines( lt_grouped_data ) }| ).

    lo_splitter->set_column_width( id = 1 width = 70 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_splitter_manager DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_logobj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_logobj_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh
        iv_object_ext TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE bal_t_msg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_logobj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_logobj_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_db_load=>load_log( iv_log_handle ).
    IF lo_log IS BOUND.
      DATA(lt_log_objects) = lo_log->get_log_objects( ).
      LOOP AT lt_log_objects INTO DATA(ls_log_object).
        IF ls_log_object-extnumber = iv_object_ext.
          DATA(lo_log_obj) = lo_log->get_log_object( ls_log_object-log_obj_handle ).
          IF lo_log_obj IS BOUND.
            rt_messages = lo_log_obj->get_messages( ).
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_loop_logobj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_log_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

CLASS zcl_bal_loop_logobj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_log_items.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    lo_log->set_log_header(
      EXPORTING
        i_almode = 'A'
        i_object = 'Z_LOOP_PROC'
        i_subobj = 'Z_ITEM_STAT'
        i_extnumber = 'BATCH_001'
        i_aluser = sy-uname
        i_alprog = sy-repid
    ).

    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      DATA(lo_log_obj) = lo_log->create_log_object(
        i_object = 'Z_ITEM'
        i_extnumber = ls_item-id
      ).
      IF ls_item-value MOD 2 = 0.
        lo_log_obj->add_message( i_msgty = 'S' i_msgid = 'SY' i_msgno = '000' i_msgv1 = |Item { ls_item-id } processed successfully.| ).
      ELSE.
        lo_log_obj->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'SY' i_msgno = '000' i_msgv1 = |Error processing item { ls_item-id }. Value is odd.| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_bal_log=>save_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `UPDATE`-Operation auf `SFLIGHTS` durch und protokollieren Sie den Erfolg oder Misserfolg der Operation in einem `cl_bal_logobj`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `UPDATE` mit `sy-subrc`-Prüfung und `cl_bal_logobj->add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_log_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_and_log_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_log_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_and_log_flight.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    lo_log->set_log_header(
      EXPORTING
        i_almode = 'A'
        i_object = 'Z_SFLIGHT_UPD'
        i_subobj = 'Z_SINGLE_UPD'
        i_extnumber = |{ iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid }|
        i_aluser = sy-uname
        i_alprog = sy-repid
    ).

    DATA(lo_log_obj) = lo_log->create_log_object(
      i_object = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_extnumber = |{ iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid }|
    ).

    UPDATE sflights
       SET price = @iv_new_price
     WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
       AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lo_log_obj->add_message( i_msgty = 'S' i_msgid = 'SY' i_msgno = '000' i_msgv1 = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } updated successfully. New price: { iv_new_price }| ).
    ELSE.
      lo_log_obj->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'SY' i_msgno = '000' i_msgv1 = |Error updating flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid }. SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }| ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_bal_log=>save_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von String-Templates für die Log-Nachrichten und die objektorientierte Kapselung sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken, die eine saubere Trennung von Logik und Protokollierung ermöglichen.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung von Flügen in `SFLIGHTS` durch und protokollieren Sie den Status jeder einzelnen Aktualisierung in einem separaten `cl_bal_logobj` innerhalb eines übergeordneten Anwendungslogs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE` und protokollieren Sie den Status jedes Eintrags in der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_log_mass DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES: tt_flight_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mass_update_and_log_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_update TYPE tt_flight_updates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_log_mass IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_and_log_flights.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    lo_log->set_log_header(
      EXPORTING
        i_almode = 'A'
        i_object = 'Z_SFLIGHT_UPD'
        i_subobj = 'Z_MASS_UPD'
        i_extnumber = 'BATCH_MASS_001'
        i_aluser = sy-uname
        i_alprog = sy-repid
    ).

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_log_obj) = lo_log->create_log_object(
        i_object = 'SFLIGHT'
        i_extnumber = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|
      ).

      UPDATE sflights
         SET price = @ls_flight-price
       WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid
         AND connid = @ls_flight-connid.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lo_log_obj->add_message( i_msgty = 'S' i_msgid = 'SY' i_msgno = '000' i_msgv1 = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } updated. New price: { ls_flight-price }| ).
      ELSE.
        lo_log_obj->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'SY' i_msgno = '000' i_msgv1 = |Error updating flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }. SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_bal_log=>save_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

FROM TABLE`-Syntax für die Massenaktualisierung effizienter wäre, wird hier eine Schleife verwendet, um den individuellen `sy-subrc` jedes Updates zu erfassen und präzise zu protokollieren. Dies ist ein Kompromiss zwischen Performance und detaillierter Fehlerprotokollierung, der oft in komplexen Geschäftsprozessen erforderlich ist. Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flugdatensatz aus der `sflights`-Tabelle aus. Die Lösung soll robust sein, auch wenn die Tabelle leer ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und den Tabellenausdruck `itab[index]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Keine Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1, iv_max = lv_table_size ).

    rs_flight = lt_sflights[ lv_random_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_flight_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_selection.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE zcl_random_flight_selector=>ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        ls_flight = lo_selector->get_random_flight( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid, msg = 'Fluggesellschaft darf nicht initial sein' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-connid, msg = 'Flugnummer darf nicht initial sein' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Test kann fehlschlagen, wenn SFLIGHT leer ist. Dies ist ein Akzeptanzfall.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Keine Flüge in SFLIGHT gefunden, kann Test nicht ausführen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table_exception.
    " Um diesen Test zu ermöglichen, müsste man SFLIGHT leeren oder mocken.
    " Hier wird nur die Exception-Signatur getestet.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    EXPECTED EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    " Um die Exception auszulösen, müsste SFLIGHT leer sein.
    " Für einen echten Unit-Test müsste man die Abhängigkeit zu SFLIGHT mocken.
    " Hier wird angenommen, dass SFLIGHT Daten enthält, daher wird die Exception nicht ausgelöst.
    " Der Test dient primär der Demonstration der Exception-Behandlung.
    lo_selector->get_random_flight( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert die Zufallszahlengenerierung mit dem modernen Tabellenausdruck `itab[index]` zur direkten Adressierung eines Tabelleneintrags. Die Anzahl der Zeilen wird mit `lines()` ermittelt. Eine Ausnahmebehandlung mit `RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` stellt sicher, dass der Aufrufer über eine leere Tabelle informiert wird. Die `SELECT UP TO 100 ROWS` ist hier nur zur Begrenzung der Datenmenge für das Beispiel.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLES, CLASS, SFLIGHTS, TABLE EXPRESSION, EXCEPTION HANDLING

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge, der nur Großbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und String-Templates in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_alphanum_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_alphanum_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = ``.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0, iv_max = lv_chars_len - 1 ).
      lv_result = lv_result && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.

    rv_random_string = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_content FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_string_length.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 15.
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_generator->get_random_alphanum_string( lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ), exp = lv_length
                                       msg = 'Generierter String hat falsche Länge' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

INTERFACE zif_random_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_strategy_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_random_strategy
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_strategy_context IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Mischen (Shuffle) Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen zufällig. Die ursprüngliche Reihenfolge soll nicht beibehalten werden, aber alle Elemente müssen vorhanden bleiben.
hint: Fügen Sie eine temporäre Spalte mit Zufallszahlen hinzu und sortieren Sie danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers      TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shuffler_entry,
             random_key TYPE i,
             number     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_shuffler_entry.
    TYPES tt_shuffler_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shuffler_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_shuffler_entries) = VALUE tt_shuffler_entries(
      FOR <number> IN it_numbers
        ( random_key = cl_abap_random_int=>create( )->get_next( iv_min = 1, iv_max = 1000000 )
          number     = <number> )
    ).

    SORT lt_shuffler_entries BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_numbers = VALUE tt_numbers(
      FOR <entry> IN lt_shuffler_entries
        ( <entry>-number )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ), exp = lines( lt_original )
                                       msg = 'Anzahl der Elemente nach dem Mischen falsch' ).

    " Prüfen, ob alle Elemente noch vorhanden sind (aber nicht unbedingt in der gleichen Reihenfolge)
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_original_sorted ASCENDING.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted ASCENDING.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted, exp = lt_original_sorted
                                       msg = 'Elemente nach dem Mischen nicht identisch' ).

    " Es ist unwahrscheinlich, dass die Reihenfolge gleich bleibt, aber nicht unmöglich.
    " Ein statistischer Test wäre genauer, aber für einen Unit-Test reicht dies.
    IF lt_shuffled = lt_original.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Tabelle wurde nicht gemischt (unwahrscheinlich, aber möglich)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_empty) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_empty) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_table( lt_empty ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shuffled_empty, msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leer bleiben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode mischt eine interne Tabelle, indem sie eine temporäre Struktur mit einer Zufallszahl und dem ursprünglichen Wert erstellt. Anschließend wird diese temporäre Tabelle nach der Zufallszahl sortiert. Schließlich werden die ursprünglichen Werte aus der sortierten temporären Tabelle in eine neue Tabelle übertragen. Dies ist eine gängige und effiziente Methode zum Mischen von Tabellen in ABAP, die moderne Constructor Expressions (`VALUE FOR`) nutzt.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLES, SORT, SHUFFLE, CLASS, VALUE, FOR, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Untermenge von Flügen aus der `sflights`-Tabelle aus, basierend auf einer Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 50% der Flüge).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_subset_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability TYPE f " Wahrscheinlichkeit zwischen 0.0 und 1.0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_subset_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 1000 ROWS.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY default
                                    WHERE ( lo_random_float->get_next( ) < iv_probability ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_subset_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_subset_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_subset_filter.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_random_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_probability) = 0.5.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_filter->get_random_subset_flights( lv_probability ).

    " Da es sich um Zufall handelt, können wir keine exakte Anzahl erwarten.
    " Aber die Anzahl sollte im Bereich der Wahrscheinlichkeit liegen.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_random_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 1000 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_original_count) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    DATA(lv_filtered_count) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).

    IF lv_original_count > 0.
      " Erwarten, dass die gefilterte Anzahl kleiner oder gleich der Originalanzahl ist
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_filtered_count <= lv_original_count )
                                         msg = 'Gefilterte Anzahl ist größer als Original' ).
      " Erwarten, dass die gefilterte Anzahl nicht 0 ist, wenn die Wahrscheinlichkeit > 0 ist (statistisch)
      IF lv_probability > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_filtered_count > 0 ),
                                           msg = 'Gefilterte Anzahl ist 0 bei Wahrscheinlichkeit > 0' ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights, msg = 'Leere Eingabe sollte leere Ausgabe ergeben' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_subset_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_random_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_probability) = 0.5.
    " Mocken oder sicherstellen, dass SFLIGHT leer ist, um diesen Fall zu testen.
    " Für dieses Beispiel wird angenommen, dass SFLIGHT Daten enthält.
    " Wenn SFLIGHT leer ist, sollte die Methode eine leere Tabelle zurückgeben.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_filter->get_random_subset_flights( lv_probability ).
    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights, msg = 'Leere Eingabe sollte leere Ausgabe ergeben' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt den `FILTER`-Ausdruck, um eine Untermenge einer internen Tabelle zu erstellen. Für jeden Eintrag wird eine Zufalls-Gleitkommazahl mit `cl_abap_random_float` generiert. Wenn diese Zahl kleiner ist als die angegebene Wahrscheinlichkeit, wird der Eintrag in die Ergebnisliste aufgenommen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, zufällige Stichproben aus Tabellen zu ziehen.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLES, FILTER, CLASS, SFLIGHTS, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT

CLASS zcl_random_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode mit optionalen Parametern hat. Die Methode soll eine zufällige Operation basierend auf diesen Parametern ausführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPTIONAL` für Methodenparameter und `cl_abap_random_int` für die Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optional_param_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_random_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_factor TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_param_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_random_operation.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_operation_choice) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1, iv_max = 3 ).

    DATA(lv_current_value) = iv_value1.

    IF iv_value2 IS SUPPLIED.
      lv_current_value = lv_current_value + iv_value2.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_factor IS SUPPLIED.
      lv_current_value = lv_current_value * iv_factor.
    ENDIF.

    CASE lv_operation_choice.
      WHEN 1. " Add random number
        rv_result = lv_current_value + lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1, iv_max = 10 ).
      WHEN 2. " Subtract random number
        rv_result = lv_current_value - lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1, iv_max = 10 ).
      WHEN 3. " Multiply by random factor
        rv_result = lv_current_value * lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1, iv_max = 3 ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` abruft, diese mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxelementen (z.B. `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) in eine interne Tabelle lädt und diese Daten für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` vorbereitet. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die die anzuzeigenden Daten enthält.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights (
      carrid   = flight-carrid,
      connid   = flight-connid,
      fldate   = flight-fldate,

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (wie in COL_001) in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` anzeigt und einen Event-Handler für das `NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK`-Ereignis registriert. Der Event-Handler soll die `carrid` des doppelt geklickten Knotens in einer Instanzvariable speichern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für das Ereignis und die Methode `GET_SELECTED_NODES` des Column Tree im Event-Handler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mv_selected_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS display_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
    SET HANDLER handle_node_double_click FOR mo_column_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA(lt_outtab) = VALUE tt_flights( FOR flight IN it_flights (
      node_key = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|,
      carrid   = flight-carrid,
      connid   = flight-connid,
      fldate   = flight-fldate
    ) ).

    mo_column_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_by_key = abap_true
        i_table_structure_name = 'ZCL_FLIGHT_TREE_EVENTS=>TY_FLIGHT'
        i_table = lt_outtab
    ).
    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    DATA(lt_selected_nodes) = mo_column_tree->get_selected_nodes( ).
    IF lt_selected_nodes IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_node) = lt_selected_nodes[ 1 ].
      DATA(lv_carrid) = SUBSTRING( val = ls_node-node_key off = 0 len = 2 ). " Assuming carrid is first 2 chars
      mv_selected_carrid = lv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_price,
             month TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_monthly_price.
    TYPES tt_monthly_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_chart IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHERE SUBSTRING( fldate, 1, 4 ) = @iv_year
      GROUP BY SUBSTRING( fldate, 5, 2 )
      ORDER BY month
      INTO TABLE @rt_prices.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten aus `sflights` hierarchisch nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Verbindungsnummer strukturiert. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die für die Anzeige in einem hierarchischen `cl_gui_column_tree` geeignet ist (d.h. mit Parent-Child-Beziehungen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `GROUP BY` um die hierarchische Struktur zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_hier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hierarchical_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_hier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hierarchical_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_t(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_nodes = VALUE tt_nodes(
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( " Carrier Node
        node_key   = <carrier_group>-carrid
        parent_key = ''
        text       = |Carrier: { <carrier_group>-carrid }|
        level      = 0
        is_folder  = abap_true
      )
      FOR GROUPS <connid_group> OF flight IN <carrier_group> " Nested group for connections
      GROUP BY flight-connid ASCENDING
      ( " Connection Node
        node_key   = |{ <carrier_group>-carrid }-{ <connid_group>-connid }|
        parent_key = <carrier_group>-carrid
        text       = |Connection: { <connid_group>-connid }|
        level      = 1
        is_folder  = abap_true
      )
      FOR flight IN <connid_group> " Flight Leaf Node
      ( node_key   = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
        parent_key = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
        text       = |Flight: { flight-fldate DATE = ISO } - { flight-price } { flight-currency }|
        level      = 2
        is_folder  = abap_false
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_hierarchical_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_hierarchical_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_hier( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->get_hierarchical_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No hierarchical data found' act = lines( lt_nodes ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    " Check for at least one carrier node
    DATA(ls_carrier_node) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ level = 0 ] OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No carrier node found' act = ls_carrier_node IS SUPPLIED exp = abap_true ).

    " Check for at least one connection node
    DATA(ls_conn_node) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ level = 1 ] OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No connection node found' act = ls_conn_node IS SUPPLIED exp = abap_true ).

    " Check for at least one flight node
    DATA(ls_flight_node) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ level = 2 ] OPTIONAL ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt die leistungsstarke `FOR GROUPS` Expression, um hierarchische Datenstrukturen direkt aus einer flachen Tabelle zu erstellen. Durch verschachtelte `FOR GROUPS`-Anweisungen werden zuerst Fluggesellschaften, dann Verbindungen und schließlich einzelne Flüge als Knoten mit korrekten `node_key` und `parent_key` Beziehungen generiert. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, hierarchische Daten für GUI-Controls wie den `cl_gui_column_tree` vorzubereiten.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_currency_booking_sums.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_currency_chart( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` anzeigt und eine spezifische Spalte (z.B. 'price') als editierbar konfiguriert. Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `DATA_CHANGED`-Ereignis, der die Änderungen in einer Instanzvariable speichert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree->set_column_editable` und registrieren Sie einen Handler für `DATA_CHANGED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_editable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mt_changed_data TYPE tt_flights.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS display_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING er_data_changed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_editable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
    SET HANDLER handle_data_changed FOR mo_column_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA(lt_outtab) = VALUE tt_flights( FOR flight IN it_flights (
      node_key = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|,
      carrid   = flight-carrid,
      connid   = flight-connid,
      fldate   = flight-fldate,
      price    = flight-price
    ) ).

    mo_column_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_by_key = abap_true
        i_table_structure_name = 'ZCL_FLIGHT_TREE_EDITABLE=>TY_FLIGHT'
        i_table = lt_outtab
    ).

    " Configure 'price' column as editable
    DATA(ls_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_s_fcat(
      fieldname = 'PRICE'
      edit      = abap_true
    ).
    mo_column_tree->set_column_editable( ls_fieldcat ).
    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    DATA(lt_modified_cells) = er_data_changed->get_modified_cells( ).
    LOOP AT lt_modified_cells ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_cell>).
      DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_flight(
        node_key = <fs_cell>-node_key
        price    = <fs_cell>-value
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight TO mt_changed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_multi_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_metrics,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_duration TYPE i,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_metrics.
    TYPES tt_carrier_metrics TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_metrics WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_metrics
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_metrics) TYPE tt_carrier_metrics.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_multi_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_metrics.
    SELECT s~carrid, AVG( p~fltime ) AS avg_duration, AVG( s~price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      GROUP BY s~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_metrics.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft und Fluganzahl) aus `sflights` abruft und diese in einem `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` anzeigt. Die Methode soll einen Parameter `iv_chart_type` akzeptieren, der dynamisch den Diagrammtyp (z.B. Balken, Linie, Kreis) festlegt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_dynamic_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS display_dynamic_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_chart_type TYPE string " e.g., 'BAR', 'LINE', 'PIE'
        it_data       TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_dynamic_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_dynamic_chart.
    DATA(lv_chart_type_const) TYPE i.

    CASE iv_chart_type.
      WHEN 'BAR'.
        lv_chart_type_const = mo_chart_engine->co_type_bar.
      WHEN 'LINE'.
        lv_chart_type_const = mo_chart_engine->co_type_line.
      WHEN 'PIE'.
        lv_chart_type_const = mo_chart_engine->co_type_pie.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_chart_type_const = mo_chart_engine->co_type_bar. " Default
    ENDCASE.

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( lv_chart_type_const ).

    DATA(lt_labels) = VALUE string_table( FOR item IN it_data ( item-label ) ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE i_table( FOR item IN it_data ( item-value ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        labels = lt_labels
        values = lt_values
    ).
    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_city_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_city_flights,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_city_flights.
    TYPES tt_city_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_city_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_city_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_city_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_city_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_flight_counts.
    SELECT p~cityfrom, COUNT(s~carrid) AS count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      GROUP BY p~cityfrom
      ORDER BY p~cityfrom
      INTO TABLE @rt_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_display(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( node_key = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|,
        carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        fldate   = flight-fldate,
        price    = flight-price
      )
    ).

    mo_column_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_by_key = abap_true
        i_table_structure_name = 'ZCL_FLIGHT_TREE_FILTER=>TY_FLIGHT_DISPLAY'
        i_table = lt_filtered_flights
    ).

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.

    DATA mo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

      IMPORTING iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_conditional_chart.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_t(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    DATA(lt_high_price_flights) = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF flight IN lt_all_flights
      WHERE ( flight-price > iv_price_threshold )
      GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( label = |{ <carrier_group>-carrid } (High Price)|,
        value = lines( <carrier_group> )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lt_normal_price_flights) = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF flight IN lt_all_flights
      WHERE ( flight-price <= iv_price_threshold )
      GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( label = |{ <carrier_group>-carrid } (Normal Price)|,
        value = lines( <carrier_group> )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lt_labels) = VALUE string_table( FOR item IN lt_high_price_flights ( item-label ) FOR item IN lt_normal_price_flights ( item-label ) ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE i_table( FOR item IN lt_high_price_flights ( item-value ) FOR item IN lt_normal_price_flights ( item-value ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( mo_chart_engine->co_type_bar ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        labels = lt_labels
        values = lt_values
    ).
    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_dyn_vis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_all,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

      IMPORTING it_visible_columns TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_dyn_vis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights_dynamic_vis.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    mo_column_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_by_key = abap_true
        i_table_structure_name = 'ZCL_FLIGHT_TREE_DYN_VIS=>TY_FLIGHT_ALL'
        i_table = lt_all_flights
    ).

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_FLIGHT_TREE_DYN_VIS=>TY_FLIGHT_ALL' ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
      DATA(lv_is_visible) = abap_false.
      IF line_exists( it_visible_columns[ table_line = <fs_component>-name ] ).
        lv_is_visible = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      DATA(ls_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_s_fcat(
        fieldname = <fs_component>-name
        no_out    = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_is_visible = abap_true THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true )
      ).
      mo_column_tree->set_column_visible( ls_fieldcat ).
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
