Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine vereinfachte Version des Observer Patterns. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `ZCL_OBSERVER_ABS` mit einer abstrakten Methode `handle_event`. Erstellen Sie eine Subjekt-Klasse `ZCL_SUBJECT` mit Methoden zum Registrieren/Deregistrieren von Observern und zum Benachrichtigen. Implementieren Sie konkrete Observer, die auf Ereignisse reagieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle für die Observer im Subjekt. Die abstrakte Methode `handle_event` wird von den konkreten Observern implementiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_observer_abs DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_event ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_event_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS attach IMPORTING io_observer TYPE REF TO zcl_observer_abs.
    METHODS detach IMPORTING io_observer TYPE REF TO zcl_observer_abs.
    METHODS notify IMPORTING iv_event_data TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_observers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_observer_abs WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_observers TYPE ty_observers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD attach.
    INSERT io_observer INTO TABLE mt_observers.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD detach.
    DELETE mt_observers WHERE table_line = io_observer.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD notify.
    LOOP AT mt_observers INTO DATA(lo_observer).
      lo_observer->handle_event( iv_event_data ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_observer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_observer_abs PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_event REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_observer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_event.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Logger: Event received - { iv_event_data }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alert_observer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_observer_abs PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_event REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alert_observer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_event.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Alert: Critical event - { iv_event_data }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_observer_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_observer_pattern.
    DATA(lo_subject) = NEW zcl_subject( ).
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_logger_observer( ).
    DATA(lo_alert) = NEW zcl_alert_observer( ).

    lo_subject->attach( lo_logger ).
    lo_subject->attach( lo_alert ).

    lo_subject->notify( 'System Startup' ).
    lo_subject->detach( lo_logger ).
    lo_subject->notify( 'Critical Error' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'No direct assertion for output, assuming event handling is correct.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Observer Pattern definiert eine Eins-zu-Viele-Abhängigkeit zwischen Objekten, sodass bei einer Zustandsänderung eines Objekts alle seine Abhängigen automatisch benachrichtigt und aktualisiert werden. Eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Observer erzwingt die Implementierung der `handle_event`-Methode in allen konkreten Observern.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Observer Pattern, Design Patterns, Event Handling, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR_ABS` mit einer abstrakten Methode `process_record` und einer konkreten Methode `process_all_records`, die eine Tabelle von Daten durchläuft und `process_record` für jeden Eintrag aufruft. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Unterklasse, die `process_record` für eine spezifische Datenverarbeitung implementiert (z.B. String-Transformation).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` oder `LOOP AT` in `process_all_records` und rufen Sie `process_record` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_processor_abs DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_record ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string CHANGING cv_output TYPE string.
    METHODS process_all_records IMPORTING it_input TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor_abs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_all_records.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR <fs_input> IN it_input
                         LET lv_output = <fs_input> IN
                         ( process_record( iv_input = <fs_input> CHANGING cv_output = lv_output ) THEN lv_output ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uppercase_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_processor_abs PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_record REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uppercase_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_record.
    cv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reverse_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_processor_abs PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_record REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reverse_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_record.
    cv_output = reverse( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_uppercase_processor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reverse_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uppercase_processor.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'hello' ) ( 'world' ) ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_uppercase_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_processor->process_all_records( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[1] exp = 'HELLO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[2] exp = 'WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reverse_processor.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'hello' ) ( 'world' ) ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_reverse_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_processor->process_all_records( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[1] exp = 'olleh' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[2] exp = 'dlrow' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Struktur ermöglicht es, einen allgemeinen Datenverarbeitungsablauf in der abstrakten Basisklasse zu definieren, während die spezifische Logik für die Verarbeitung einzelner Datensätze den Unterklassen überlassen wird. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` in `process_all_records` demonstriert moderne ABAP-Syntax für kompakte Schleifen und Transformationen.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Data Processing, Object Orientation, FOR, VALUE

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS`, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und einem Preis über 100 enthält. Füge eine neue Spalte für den doppelten Preis hinzu.
hint: Nutze `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             double_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( flight-carrid = 'LH' AND flight-price > 100 )
        ( carrid       = flight-carrid,
          connid       = flight-connid,
          fldate       = flight-fldate,
          price        = flight-price,
          currency     = flight-currency,
          double_price = flight-price * 2 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Price should be greater than 100' act = ls_flight-price > 100 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Double price calculation incorrect' act = ls_flight-double_price exp = ls_flight-price * 2 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und kompakter als traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `APPEND`. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb von `FOR` bietet eine integrierte Filterung.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Declarative Programming

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Sitze aller Flüge in `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('AA').
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
        NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe, ob ein bestimmter Flug (Fluggesellschaft 'LH', Flugnummer '0400', Datum '20250101') in `SFLIGHTS` existiert und gib dessen Zeilenindex zurück. Wenn nicht, gib 0 zurück.
hint: Nutze Tabellenausdrücke mit `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_index.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      rv_index = line_index( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
    ELSE.
      rv_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_index_non_existing) = lo_cut->get_flight_index( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Existing flight should have an index > 0' act = lv_index_existing > 0 ).

Instructions: Exportiere eine interne Tabelle (`SFLIGHTS`) als CSV, aber wähle die zu exportierenden Spalten dynamisch aus (z.B. nur `CARRID` und `CONNID`).
hint: Nutze die Methoden von `cl_salv_ex_util` in Kombination mit dynamischer Feldkatalog-Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_name,
             fieldname TYPE fieldname,
           END OF ty_field_name.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_dynamic_columns_to_csv
      IMPORTING it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_columns_to_csv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL AND it_field_names IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_salv_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( r_data = REF #( lt_sflights ) ).

      DATA lt_field_catalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(ls_field_name).
        APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = ls_field_name-fieldname ) TO lt_field_catalog.
      ENDLOOP.

      lo_salv_util->set_field_catalog( lt_field_catalog ).
      rv_csv_string = lo_salv_util->create_csv_string( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur Zeilen hinzugefügt werden, die noch nicht in der Zieltabelle vorhanden sind (basierend auf einem Schlüssel). Nutze den `INSERT ... FROM TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` Zusatz.
hint: Verwende `INSERT ... FROM TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` für effizientes Einfügen ohne Duplikate.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_insert_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS merge_tables
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_data
      CHANGING  ct_target TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_insert_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.
    INSERT it_source INTO TABLE ct_target ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_merge_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_tables.
    DATA lt_target TYPE zcl_tab_insert_unique=>tt_data.
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_tab_insert_unique=>tt_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Value A' ) TO lt_target.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'Value B' ) TO lt_target.

    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'New Value B' ) TO lt_source. " Duplicate key
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'C' value_field = 'Value C' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_insert_unique( ).
    lo_cut->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source = lt_source CHANGING ct_target = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should be 3' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value for key B should be original' act = lt_target[ key_field = 'B' ]-value_field exp = 'Value B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value for key C should be new' act = lt_target[ key_field = 'C' ]-value_field exp = 'Value C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zusatz `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` bei der `INSERT ... FROM TABLE`-Anweisung ermöglicht das effiziente Einfügen von Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle. Doppelte Schlüssel werden dabei ignoriert, was den Code für das Zusammenführen von Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht und performanter macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS, Merge, Unique Keys

CLASS zcx_no_flights_found DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( flight ) ).

    IF rt_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price,
           tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_for_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_for_sum
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    ENDTRY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_action_dispatcher IMPLEMENTATION.

    CASE iv_action_type.

        " Logik für 'UPDATE'

hint: Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck in einem FOR-Loop und RAISE EXCEPTION.
solution:
CLASS zcx_no_group_data DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summaries
      RAISING
        zcx_no_group_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_group_data
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.

    rt_summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summaries(
        FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) 
        ( carrid = flight-carrid,
          avg_occupancy = REDUCE p( INIT sum_occ = 0 sum_max = 0
                                    FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                    NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + member-seatsocc,
                                         sum_max = sum_max + member-seatsmax
                                    FINALLY: COND #( WHEN sum_max > 0 THEN ( sum_occ / sum_max ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).

    IF rt_summaries IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_group_data
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_interface_not_implemented.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_rtti_checker( ).
    DATA(lo_processor_b) = NEW zcl_processor_b( ).
    TRY.
        lo_checker->check_interface_implementation( io_object = lo_processor_b iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_PROCESSABLE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception ZCX_INTERFACE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_interface_not_implemented INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->mv_class_name exp = 'ZCL_PROCESSOR_B' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->mv_interface_name exp = 'ZIF_PROCESSABLE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Exception ZCX_INTERFACE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.

CLASS zcl_safe_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid IS INITIAL OR ls_flight-connid IS INITIAL.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
          MESSAGE E003(zmsg_demo) WITH ls_flight-carrid ls_flight-connid

CLASS zcx_carrier_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_carrier_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id
      RAISING
        zcx_carrier_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_carriers.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs> IN sflights ( <fs> ) ). " Get all flights

    DATA(lv_missing_carrier) = REDUCE s_carr_id(
      INIT missing_carrier = ''
      FOR carrier_id IN it_carrier_ids
      WHERE missing_carrier IS INITIAL
      LET found = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = carrier_id ] ) ) IN
      NEXT missing_carrier = COND #( WHEN NOT found THEN carrier_id ELSE '' ) ).

    IF lv_missing_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_carrier_not_found
        MESSAGE E004(zmsg_demo) WITH lv_missing_carrier
        EXPORTING
          i_carrier_id = lv_missing_carrier.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate further processing for valid carriers
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_critical_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_critical_process( ).
    " Expecting a shortdump, which cannot be caught by ABAP Unit directly.
    " This test will likely fail in a standard ABAP Unit run because a shortdump terminates the program.
    " For a real test, one might need to run this in a separate process and check for dump logs.
    " For demonstration purposes, we just call it and acknowledge it will dump.
    " In a real scenario, you would test for the *absence* of a dump for valid cases,
    " and for the *presence* of a dump for invalid cases (e.g., via external monitoring).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception is not suitable for SHORTDUMP.
    " The purpose here is to demonstrate the syntax and intent.
    lo_cut->execute_critical_step( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Program should have shortdumped, this line should not be reached.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_multi_carrier_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs> IN sflights ( <fs> ) ).
    DATA: lt_missing_carriers TYPE zcx_multiple_carriers_not_found=>tt_carrier_ids.

    LOOP AT it_carrier_ids INTO DATA(lv_carrier_id).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = lv_carrier_id ] ).
        APPEND lv_carrier_id TO lt_missing_carriers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_missing_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_missing_list) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR carrier IN lt_missing_carriers
        NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrier ELSE s && ', ' && carrier ) ).

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_multiple_carriers_not_found
        MESSAGE E007(zmsg_demo) WITH lv_missing_list
        EXPORTING
          i_missing_carrier_ids = lt_missing_carriers.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate further processing for valid carriers

      RAISING

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _divide_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE decfloat34
        iv_val2 TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_res) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        zcx_calculation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    DATA(lv_intermediate_result) = iv_input1 + iv_input2.

    TRY.
        rv_result = _divide_values( iv_val1 = lv_intermediate_result iv_val2 = iv_input2 ).
      CATCH zcx_calculation_error INTO DATA(lx_calc_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_calculation_error
          MESSAGE E009(zmsg_demo) WITH 'perform_calculation' lv_intermediate_result iv_input2
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_calc_error
            i_step_name = 'perform_calculation'
            i_value1 = lv_intermediate_result
            i_value2 = iv_input2.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _divide_values.
    TRY.
        rv_res = iv_val1 / iv_val2.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_calculation_error
          MESSAGE E009(zmsg_demo) WITH '_divide_values' iv_val1 iv_val2
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_zerodivide
            i_step_name = '_divide_values'
            i_value1 = iv_val1
            i_value2 = iv_val2.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Auslastung (gebuchte Sitze im Verhältnis zur maximalen Kapazität) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um den Flug mit dem maximalen Wert zu finden, und `LET` für Zwischenberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
        carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate         TYPE s_date,
        occupancy_rate TYPE f,
      END OF ty_flight_occupancy.

    METHODS get_highest_occupancy_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_occupancy) TYPE ty_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_occupancy_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rs_flight_occupancy = REDUCE ty_flight_occupancy(
        INIT max_occupancy_flight = VALUE ty_flight_occupancy( occupancy_rate = -1 )
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        LET current_occupancy_rate = COND f( WHEN flight-maxfL > 0 THEN CONV f( flight-booked ) / flight-maxfL ELSE 0 ) IN
        NEXT max_occupancy_flight = COND #( 
            WHEN current_occupancy_rate > max_occupancy_flight-occupancy_rate
            THEN VALUE ty_flight_occupancy(
                     carrid = flight-carrid
                     connid = flight-connid
                     fldate = flight-fldate
                     occupancy_rate = current_occupancy_rate
                 )
            ELSE max_occupancy_flight
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-occupancy_rate >= 0 AND ls_flight-occupancy_rate <= 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid,
        carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
        avg_price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid,
      ty_avg_price_by_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE ty_avg_price_by_carrid_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_avg_prices = REDUCE #( 
        INIT result = VALUE ty_avg_price_by_carrid_tab( )
        FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
        LET group_sum_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + member-price )
            group_count = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
        NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                             avg_price = COND s_price( WHEN group_count > 0 THEN group_sum_price / group_count ELSE 0 ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FILTER`-Expression, um die zu aggregierenden Elemente vorab auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE s_maxfL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE maxfL > iv_min_capacity )
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_sum_filtered_flights( 150 ). " Assuming some flights have maxfL > 150

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_total_price >= 0 ) msg = 'Total price should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die elegante Kombination von `REDUCE` mit der `FILTER`-Expression. Zuerst werden die relevanten Flüge gefiltert, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten, und anschließend wird deren Preis summiert. Dies ist eine sehr deklarative und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie den `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` in einem Container. Dies ist ein konzeptionelles Beispiel, da die tatsächliche UI-Anzeige eine Dynpro-Umgebung erfordert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` für `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_viewer
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_viewer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_viewer.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error     = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error   = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_dynpro_dynpro_link = 5
        OTHERS         = 6.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_create_viewer_success FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ecl_viewer_init( ).
    DATA(lo_viewer) = lo_cut->create_viewer( 'MY_CONTAINER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_viewer ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_viewer ).

Die Verwendung von `CREATE OBJECT` und die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` sind Standard in modernem ABAP. Die Freigabe der Objekte ist in Unit Tests für UI-Elemente entscheidend.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und fügen Sie das Ergebnis in eine neue interne Tabelle ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Summe zu berechnen, und `INSERT` für das Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_and_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_and_insert_total
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_and_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_insert_total.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).

    DATA(ls_carrier_total) = VALUE ty_carrier_total(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      total_price = lv_total_price
    ).

    INSERT ls_carrier_total INTO TABLE rt_totals.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total.
    " Setup test data
    DATA: ls_flight1 TYPE sflight, ls_flight2 TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight1-mandt = sy-mandt; ls_flight1-carrid = 'XX'; ls_flight1-connid = '0001'; ls_flight1-fldate = sy-datum; ls_flight1-price = '100.00'.
    ls_flight2-mandt = sy-mandt; ls_flight2-carrid = 'XX'; ls_flight2-connid = '0002'; ls_flight2-fldate = sy-datum; ls_flight2-price = '200.00'.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight1.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_and_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->calculate_and_insert_total( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[ 1 ]-total_price exp = '300.00' ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_and_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->calculate_and_insert_total( 'YY' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[ 1 ]-total_price exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `REDUCE`-Expression, um eine Aggregation (hier eine Summe) über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. Das Ergebnis wird dann in eine neue interne Tabelle eingefügt. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und moderner Ansatz für Datenaggregationen.
keywords: REDUCE, INSERT, Internal Tables, Math, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur Zeilen übernommen werden, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF` in Kombination mit einer `FILTER`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_with_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_insert
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_min_value    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_with_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_insert.
    INSERT LINES OF
      VALUE tt_items(
        FOR ls_item IN it_source_items WHERE ( value >= iv_min_value )
        ( ls_item )
      )
      INTO TABLE rt_target_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_insert_some FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_and_insert_none FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_and_insert_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_insert_some.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_with_filter=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 )
      ( id = 3 value = 5 )
      ( id = 4 value = 30 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_with_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->filter_and_insert( it_source_items = lt_source iv_min_value = 15 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_and_insert_none.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_with_filter=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_with_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->filter_and_insert( it_source_items = lt_source iv_min_value = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_and_insert_all.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_with_filter=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_with_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->filter_and_insert( it_source_items = lt_source iv_min_value = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: INSERT, LINES OF, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Konvertiere einen UTF-8 String in einen Legacy-Codepage-String (z.B. CP1103) und umgekehrt. Demonstriere die Konvertierung in beide Richtungen.
hint: Nutze die statische Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` und gib die Quell- und Zielcodepage an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
        iv_legacy_cp   TYPE cpact
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_legacy_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS convert_legacy_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_legacy_string TYPE string
        iv_legacy_cp     TYPE cpact
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_legacy.
    rv_legacy_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      source_string   = iv_utf8_string
      target_codepage = iv_legacy_cp
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_legacy_to_utf8.
    rv_utf8_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = iv_legacy_cp
      source_string   = iv_legacy_string
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_original_utf8) = 'Hallo Welt mit Umlauten: äöüß'.
    DATA(lv_legacy_cp) = '1103'. "Example: Latin-1

    DATA(lv_converted_legacy) = lo_converter->convert_utf8_to_legacy(
      iv_utf8_string = lv_original_utf8
      iv_legacy_cp   = lv_legacy_cp
    ).

    DATA(lv_converted_back_utf8) = lo_converter->convert_legacy_to_utf8(
      iv_legacy_string = lv_converted_legacy
      iv_legacy_cp     = lv_legacy_cp
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_back_utf8
      exp = lv_original_utf8
      msg = 'UTF-8 to Legacy and back to UTF-8 should be identical'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt die statische Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` für die Codepage-Konvertierung. Die moderne Syntax `DATA(...) = NEW ...` und `DATA(...) = method_call(...)` vereinfacht die Deklaration und Zuweisung. Die Methode ist direkt und effizient für String-Konvertierungen.
keywords: Codepage, Konvertierung, UTF-8, Legacy, String, cl_abap_codepage

Instructions: Ermittle die Codepage eines gegebenen Binärstrings. Der Binärstring könnte z.B. aus einer Datei gelesen worden sein.
hint: Nutze die statische Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>detect`.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings von einer Codepage in eine andere, wobei nur Zeilen konvertiert werden sollen, die ein bestimmtes Präfix haben. Nutze `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücke.
hint: Kombiniere `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` mit `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücken für die Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_table_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_string_line,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_string_line,
           tt_string_line TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_string_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_filtered_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_string_line
        iv_source_cp    TYPE cpact
        iv_target_cp    TYPE cpact
        iv_prefix       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_table) TYPE tt_string_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_table_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_filtered_table.
    rt_converted_table = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN FILTER #( it_source_table WHERE ( text CS iv_prefix ) )
                                  ( text = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
                                              source_codepage = iv_source_cp
                                              source_string   = <fs>-text
                                              target_codepage = iv_target_cp ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_table_conv( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_codepage_table_conv=>tt_string_line(
      ( text = 'UTF-8-Zeile 1' )
      ( text = 'PREFIX: UTF-8-Zeile 2' )
      ( text = 'Eine andere Zeile' )
      ( text = 'PREFIX: UTF-8-Zeile 3' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_source_cp) = '4103'. "UTF-8
    DATA(lv_target_cp) = '1103'. "Latin-1
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'PREFIX:'.

    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_converter->convert_filtered_table(
      it_source_table = lt_source
      iv_source_cp    = lv_source_cp
      iv_target_cp    = lv_target_cp
      iv_prefix       = lv_prefix
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_converted )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Only two lines should be converted'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_converted[ 1 ]-text
      exp = cl_abap_codepage=>convert( source_codepage = lv_source_cp source_string = 'PREFIX: UTF-8-Zeile 2' target_codepage = lv_target_cp )
      msg = 'First converted line incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücken für die effiziente Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Nur die Zeilen, die dem Filterkriterium entsprechen, werden konvertiert, was den Code sehr deklarativ und performant macht. Die Codepage-Konvertierung erfolgt inline für jede gefilterte Zeile.

Instructions: Führe eine Codepage-Konvertierung durch und fange mögliche Ausnahmen (z.B. bei ungültiger Codepage) ab, um eine robuste Anwendung zu gewährleisten.
hint: Nutze `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen vom Typ `cx_sy_codepage_conversion` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp     TYPE cpact
        iv_target_cp     TYPE cpact
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        rv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
          source_codepage = iv_source_cp
          source_string   = iv_source_string
          target_codepage = iv_target_cp
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        MESSAGE lx_conversion_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_conversion
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conversion_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeuge einen Feldkatalog für eine interne Tabelle dynamisch und nutze diesen, um eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur bestimmte Spalten enthält. Nutze `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog` zur Feldkatalogerzeugung und dann `FOR` mit `FILTER` für die Datenmanipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full,
           tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_data_with_fcat
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_sflight_full
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
        iv_filter_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_data_with_fcat.
    DATA(lt_fcat) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog(
      EXPORTING
        i_t_data = it_source_data
    ).

    " Filter field catalog to include only desired fields
    DELETE lt_fcat WHERE fieldname NOT IN it_field_names.

    " Create dynamic internal table based on filtered field catalog
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      p_components = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>t_component_descr(
        FOR <fs> IN lt_fcat (
          name = <fs>-fieldname
          type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( <fs>-rollname ) ) )
    ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
    ).
    CREATE DATA rt_filtered_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_filtered_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_filtered_data->* TO <fs_filtered_table>.

    " Populate the dynamic table using FOR and FILTER
    LOOP AT it_source_data INTO DATA(ls_source) WHERE carrid = iv_filter_carrid.
      DATA(ls_dynamic_line) = VALUE #( ).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE ANY.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_component> TYPE ANY.

      LOOP AT lt_fcat INTO DATA(ls_fcat_line).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_line-fieldname OF STRUCTURE ls_source TO <fs_source_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_line-fieldname OF STRUCTURE ls_dynamic_line TO <fs_component>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_component> = <fs_source_component>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_dynamic_line TO <fs_filtered_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_fcat_filter.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat( ).
    DATA(lt_source_data) = VALUE zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat=>tt_sflight_full(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251126' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251127' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251126' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_fields_to_include) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'CARRID' )
      ( 'CONNID' )
      ( 'PRICE' )
    ).

    DATA(lr_filtered_data) = lo_processor->get_filtered_data_with_fcat(
      it_source_data   = lt_source_data
      it_field_names   = lt_fields_to_include
      iv_filter_carrid = 'LH'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_filtered_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = <fs_table>
      msg = 'Filtered table should not be empty'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <fs_table> )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should contain 2 filtered entries'
    ).

    " Check structure of dynamic table (simplified check)
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lo_line_descr->get_components( ) )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Dynamic table should have 3 components'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermittle die Summe einer numerischen Spalte ('PRICE') in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks. Die Daten sollen dabei aus einer mit `cl_salv_ex_util` erzeugten Struktur stammen.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog` (implizit) und dann den `REDUCE` Ausdruck für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    " Although cl_salv_ex_util is not directly used for the sum, it's implied
    " that the table structure might have been derived or validated by it.
    " The focus here is on REDUCE with a table that could be ALV-related.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs> IN it_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den Inhalt einer Datei als Binärstring ein und konvertiere ihn dann in einen String mit einer bestimmten Codepage. Fange dabei Fehler ab.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_xstring` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_file_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_convert_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_target_cp TYPE cpact
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_file_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_convert_file.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_xstring(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_xstring  = lv_xstring
        ).

        rv_converted_content = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
          source_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>detect( lv_xstring ) " Dynamische Erkennung
          source_xstring  = lv_xstring
          target_codepage = iv_target_cp
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_file_access_error INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        MESSAGE lx_file_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_file_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_cp_error).
        MESSAGE lx_cp_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_cp_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine Liste von Strings, die unterschiedliche Codepages haben könnten, in eine einheitliche Zielcodepage. Nutze dabei `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_codepage=>detect`.
hint: Kombiniere `REDUCE` mit `cl_abap_codepage=>detect` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_reduce_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_raw_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_mixed_codepages
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_strings TYPE tt_raw_strings
        iv_target_cp   TYPE cpact
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_reduce_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_mixed_codepages.
    rt_converted_strings = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE string_table( )
                                     FOR raw_string IN it_raw_strings
                                     LET source_cp = cl_abap_codepage=>detect( raw_string )
                                     IN NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                                                               ( cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
                                                                   source_codepage = source_cp
                                                                   source_xstring  = raw_string
                                                                   target_codepage = iv_target_cp ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mixed_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mixed_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_reduce_conv( ).

    DATA(lv_utf8_string) = 'UTF-8 Text mit ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_latin1_string) = 'Latin-1 Text mit äöü'.

    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      source_string   = lv_utf8_string
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    DATA(lv_latin1_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      source_string   = lv_latin1_string
      target_codepage = '1103'
    ).

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE zcl_codepage_reduce_conv=>tt_raw_strings(
      ( lv_utf8_xstring )
      ( lv_latin1_xstring )
    ).

    DATA(lv_target_cp) = '4103'. "UTF-8

    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_converter->convert_mixed_codepages(
      it_raw_strings = lt_raw_data
      iv_target_cp   = lv_target_cp
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_converted )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should convert two strings'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_converted[ 1 ]
      exp = lv_utf8_string
      msg = 'First string should be correctly converted to UTF-8'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_converted[ 2 ]
      exp = cl_abap_codepage=>convert( source_codepage = '1103' source_string = lv_latin1_string target_codepage = '4103' )
      msg = 'Second string should be correctly converted to UTF-8'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Für jeden String wird zuerst die Codepage mit `cl_abap_codepage=>detect` ermittelt und dann der String in die Zielcodepage konvertiert. Die `LET` Anweisung innerhalb von `REDUCE` verbessert die Lesbarkeit, indem sie temporäre Variablen definiert. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und moderner Ansatz zur Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit dynamischer Struktur basierend auf einem Feldkatalog, der von `cl_salv_ex_util` generiert wurde. Befülle diese Tabelle dann mit Daten aus einer Quelltabelle, wobei nur die im Feldkatalog definierten Spalten übernommen werden.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog` und RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) für die dynamische Tabellenerzeugung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full,
           tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_sflight_full
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lt_fcat) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog(
      EXPORTING
        i_t_data = it_source_data
    ).

    " Filter field catalog to include only desired fields
    DELETE lt_fcat WHERE fieldname NOT IN it_field_names.

    " Create dynamic internal table based on filtered field catalog
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      p_components = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>t_component_descr(
        FOR <fs> IN lt_fcat (
          name = <fs>-fieldname
          type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( <fs>-rollname ) ) )
    ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
    ).
    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    " Populate the dynamic table
    LOOP AT it_source_data INTO DATA(ls_source).
      DATA(ls_dynamic_line) = VALUE #( ).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE ANY.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_component> TYPE ANY.

      LOOP AT lt_fcat INTO DATA(ls_fcat_line).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_line-fieldname OF STRUCTURE ls_source TO <fs_source_component>.
        IF sy->subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_line-fieldname OF STRUCTURE ls_dynamic_line TO <fs_component>.
          IF sy->subrc = 0.
            <fs_component> = <fs_source_component>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_dynamic_line TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Es nutzt `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog` zur Generierung eines Feldkatalogs, der dann mit `DELETE WHERE` gefiltert wird. Anschließend wird mit RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) eine interne Tabelle mit exakt dieser Struktur zur Laufzeit erzeugt. Die Befüllung erfolgt über `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, was eine flexible Datenübernahme ermöglicht. Dies ist ein mächtiges Muster für generische Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Erzeuge einen Feldkatalog für eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) und gib die Feldnamen als String-Tabelle zurück. Nutze dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.

solution:

CLASS zcl_i18n_collation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_con_compare_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,

             fldate TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_con_compare_itab IMPLEMENTATION.

            im_container2 = it_table2

        rb_are_equal = abap_false.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deep_copy.

    DATA(ls_original) = VALUE zcl_con_deep_copy=>ty_header(

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Festwerte einer bestimmten DDIC-Domäne dynamisch aus und geben Sie diese zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR` und `CL_DD_DDIC_TYPE_INFO` um auf Domäneninformationen zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low  TYPE ddtext,
             text TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.
    TYPES: tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_domain_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_domain_fixed_values.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( iv_domain_name ).
    DATA(lo_ddic_type_info) = cl_dd_ddic_type_info=>get_for_domain( lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_name( ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_ddic_type_info->get_fixed_values( ) INTO DATA(ls_fixed_value).
      APPEND VALUE #( low = ls_fixed_value-low text = ls_fixed_value-ddtext ) TO rt_fixed_values.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_fixed_values FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_domain FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_fixed_values.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_ddic_domain_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_fixed_values) = lo_reader->get_domain_fixed_values( 'ABAP_BOOL' ). " Example domain

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_fixed_values[ low = 'X' ]-text ). " Check for 'X' value
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_fixed_values[ low = '' ]-text ).  " Check for '' value
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_fixed_values ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_domain.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_ddic_domain_reader( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_DESCR_ERROR'
    ).
    lo_reader->get_domain_fixed_values( 'NON_EXISTENT_DOMAIN' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) basierend auf einem Wert, der in einer DDIC-Domäne als Festwert definiert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency_domain TYPE ddobjname
        iv_min_price       TYPE sflight-price OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_currency.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( iv_currency_domain ).
    DATA(lo_ddic_type_info) = cl_dd_ddic_type_info=>get_for_domain( lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_name( ) ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
      )
    ).

    DATA(lt_valid_currencies) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_fixed_value IN lo_ddic_type_info->get_fixed_values( )
        WHERE ( ls_fixed_value-low IS NOT INITIAL )
        ( ls_fixed_value-low )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
        WHERE ( line_exists( lt_valid_currencies[ table_line = ls_flight-currency ] ) AND
                ( iv_min_price IS INITIAL OR ls_flight-price >= iv_min_price ) )
        ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

      " This test is more about the filtering mechanism than specific data.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und dem `VALUE` Operator zur dynamischen Filterung interner Tabellen. Die Filterkriterien werden zur Laufzeit aus den Festwerten einer DDIC-Domäne (`S_CURR`) abgeleitet. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster, um Daten kompakt und deklarativ zu verarbeiten, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Währung aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, wobei nur Währungen berücksichtigt werden, die in einer bestimmten DDIC-Domäne als Festwerte definiert sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit `CL_DD_DDIC_TYPE_INFO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_count,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_currency_count.
    TYPES: tt_currency_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_currency_count WITH UNIQUE KEY currency.

    METHODS aggregate_flights_by_domain_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency_domain TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_currency_counts) TYPE tt_currency_counts
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flights_by_domain_currency.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( iv_currency_domain ).
    DATA(lo_ddic_type_info) = cl_dd_ddic_type_info=>get_for_domain( lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_name( ) ).

    DATA(lt_valid_currencies) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_fixed_value IN lo_ddic_type_info->get_fixed_values( )
        WHERE ( ls_fixed_value-low IS NOT INITIAL )
        ( ls_fixed_value-low )
    ).

    rt_currency_counts = REDUCE tt_currency_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_currency_counts( )
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
        WHERE ( line_exists( lt_valid_currencies[ table_line = ls_sflight-currency ] ) )
      LET lv_index = counts[ KEY currency_key currency = ls_sflight-currency ]-count IN
      counts = COND #(
        WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL
          THEN VALUE #( BASE counts ( currency = ls_sflight-currency count = 1 ) )
        ELSE VALUE #( BASE counts ( currency = ls_sflight-currency count = lv_index + 1 ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_currencies FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_domain FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_currencies.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflights_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_flights_by_domain_currency( 'S_CURR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).
    " Check if EUR exists and has a count > 0
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_eur_count) = lt_counts[ currency = 'EUR' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_eur_count-count > 0 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Currency EUR not found in aggregated results.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_domain.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflights_aggregator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_DESCR_ERROR'
    ).
    lo_aggregator->aggregate_flights_by_domain_currency( 'NON_EXISTENT_DOMAIN' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen. Es zählt die Flüge pro Währung, wobei nur Währungen berücksichtigt werden, die als Festwerte in der Domäne `S_CURR` definiert sind. `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation, die den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle Schleifen mit `COLLECT` oder `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`. Die Verwendung von `COND #(...)` innerhalb von `REDUCE` ist ebenfalls ein modernes Muster für bedingte Zuweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, DDIC, SFLIGHTS, COND

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Währungscode (der einem Festwert einer DDIC-Domäne entspricht) eine länderspezifische Bezeichnung zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `SWITCH` Ausdruck.

solution:
CLASS zcl_currency_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_country_for_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_country_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_currency_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_country_for_currency.
    rv_country_name = SWITCH #( iv_currency
                                    WHEN 'EUR' THEN 'Europa'
                                    WHEN 'USD' THEN 'USA'
                                    WHEN 'JPY' THEN 'Japan'
                                    WHEN 'GBP' THEN 'Großbritannien'
                                    ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `SWITCH` Ausdruck bietet eine prägnante und moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF ... ELSE IF` Anweisungen für bedingte Zuweisungen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um länderspezifische Bezeichnungen basierend auf Währungscodes zuzuweisen, die typischerweise als Festwerte in einer DDIC-Domäne (wie `S_CURR`) definiert sind.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Fluent Interface für eine Klasse, die Konvertierungsoperationen kapselt, um mehrere Operationen in einer Kette auszuführen.
hint: Designen Sie Methoden so, dass sie `ME->` zurückgeben, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_converter.

    METHODS to_upper
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_converter.

    METHODS to_lower
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_converter.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_input.
    mv_current_value = iv_input.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_current_value = to_upper( mv_current_value ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_lower.
    mv_current_value = to_lower( mv_current_value ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_chain FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_operation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_chain.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_fluent_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->set_input( 'Hello World' )->to_upper( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLO WORLD' ).

    lv_result = lo_converter->set_input( 'ABAP' )->to_lower( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'abap' ).

    lv_result = lo_converter->set_input( 'MiXeD cAsE' )->to_lower( )->to_upper( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'MIXED CASE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_operation.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_fluent_converter( ).
    lo_converter->set_input( 'test' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein Fluent Interface ermöglicht das Verketten von Methodenaufrufen, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht. Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, gibt eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME->`) zurück. Dies ist ein modernes Designmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung, das die Ausdruckskraft des Codes erhöht und die Wartung vereinfacht.
keywords: Fluent Interface, Objektorientierung, Method Chaining, ME->

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu und lesen Sie dessen Wert. Die Feldnamen können zur Laufzeit variieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Test String'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = sy-datum
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Test String' ).

  METHOD test_non_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Test String'
    ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_accessor->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_fieldname = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_types.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'ABC'
      field2 = 456
      field3 = '20231126'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_int exp = '456' ).
    DATA(lv_value_date) = lo_accessor->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_fieldname = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_date exp = '20231126' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der dynamische Feldzugriff mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme, bei denen Feldnamen zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt sind. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Verarbeitung von Daten aus flexiblen Schnittstellen oder Konfigurationen. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen ist ein etabliertes, aber weiterhin modernes Muster für dynamische Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck, um einen Status basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu bestimmen, die auch die Existenz eines Festwerts in einer DDIC-Domäne prüfen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Ausdruck für komplexe bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_evaluator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS evaluate_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_value         TYPE string
        iv_is_active     TYPE abap_bool
        iv_domain_name   TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_evaluator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD evaluate_status.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( iv_domain_name ).
    DATA(lo_ddic_type_info) = cl_dd_ddic_type_info=>get_for_domain( lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_name( ) ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid_domain_value) = lo_ddic_type_info->has_fixed_value( iv_value ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_is_active = abap_true AND lv_is_valid_domain_value = abap_true
        THEN 'Aktiv und gültig'
      WHEN iv_is_active = abap_true AND lv_is_valid_domain_value = abap_false
        THEN 'Aktiv, aber ungültiger Wert'
      WHEN iv_is_active = abap_false AND lv_is_valid_domain_value = abap_true
        THEN 'Inaktiv, aber gültiger Wert'
      ELSE 'Inaktiv und ungültig'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_active_valid FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_active_invalid.

                         iv_domain_name = 'ABAP_BOOL'
                       ).

  METHOD test_inactive_invalid.

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_evaluator->evaluate_status(

explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ist eine moderne und flexible Möglichkeit, bedingte Zuweisungen durchzuführen, insbesondere wenn die Logik komplexer ist als bei `SWITCH`. Er ermöglicht die Definition mehrerer `WHEN`-Bedingungen, die zu unterschiedlichen Ergebnissen führen können. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um einen Status basierend auf einer Kombination aus einem booleschen Wert und der Gültigkeit eines Wertes innerhalb einer DDIC-Domäne zu bestimmen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, DDIC, ABAP_BOOL
