solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = iv_carrid
                                        connid = iv_connid
                                        fldate = iv_fldate
                                        price  = iv_new_price ).
    MODIFY TABLE mt_flights FROM ls_flight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_price.
    READ TABLE mt_flights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                                     connid = iv_connid
                                     fldate = iv_fldate
             INTO DATA(ls_flight_read).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = ls_flight_read-price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine HASHED TABLE nach einem Kriterium, das nicht Teil des Primärschlüssels ist, und sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` Schleife oder `FILTER`.

CLASS zcl_htb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_standard.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_currency.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN mt_flights WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_existing_currency FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_currency( 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should find flights for EUR' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer HASHED TABLE, z.B. die Summe der Preise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.

CLASS zcl_htb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR flight IN mt_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue HASHED TABLE, indem Sie Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle transformieren und dabei Duplikate basierend auf dem Schlüssel vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR ... IN ...` Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und `GROUP BY` oder `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_simple_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple
                                     WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_unique_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_simple_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    rt_unique_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN mt_flights
                                 ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lo_cut->get_unique_flights( ).

    " Check if the count of unique flights is less than or equal to the original count
    " (assuming original sflight might have multiple entries for same carrid/connid but different fldate)
    DATA(lv_original_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_original_count.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_unique_flights ) exp = lv_original_count msg = 'Unique flights count should be less than or equal to original' ).

    " Verify uniqueness by trying to insert into a new hashed table
    DATA(lt_check_uniqueness) TYPE zcl_htb_transform=>tt_sflight_simple_hashed.
    LOOP AT lt_unique_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_check_uniqueness.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( sy-subrc = 0 msg = 'All entries should be unique' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Zuweisung von Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zu einer HASHED TABLE mit UNIQUE KEY mittels `VALUE #( FOR ... ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) ) )` werden Duplikate automatisch vermieden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Erstellung von eindeutigen Datensätzen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, CORRESPONDING, UNIQUE KEY, Transformation

CLASS zcl_htb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_count
                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN mt_flights
                                 GROUP BY flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
                                 ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie die Flugverbindungsnummern (`connid`) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einem String, getrennt durch Kommas, unter Verwendung einer HASHED TABLE.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS concatenate_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connids_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD concatenate_connids.
    rv_connids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN mt_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid ELSE |{ s }, { flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_carrids IMPORTING it_carrids TYPE string_table
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_shuffled_carrids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_carrids.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_with_random,
             carrid TYPE string,
             random TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_with_random.

    DATA lt_carrids_with_random TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_with_random WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 1000000 ). " Großer Bereich für gute Verteilung

    lt_carrids_with_random = VALUE #( FOR <carrid> IN it_carrids
                                       ( carrid = <carrid> random = lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).

    SORT lt_carrids_with_random BY random.

    rt_shuffled_carrids = VALUE #( FOR <entry> IN lt_carrids_with_random ( <entry>-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_original_carrids) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'DL' ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_carrids) = lo_cut->shuffle_carrids( lt_original_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_carrids ) exp = lines( lt_original_carrids ) ).
    " Es ist schwierig, die Zufälligkeit direkt zu testen, aber wir können prüfen, ob alle Elemente noch vorhanden sind.
    LOOP AT lt_original_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_shuffled_carrids[ table_line = lv_carrid ] ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert eine moderne Methode zum Mischen einer internen Tabelle. Jedem Element wird eine Zufallszahl zugewiesen, und die Tabelle wird dann nach diesen Zufallszahlen sortiert. Dies nutzt den `FOR`-Operator für die Transformation und `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Zufallszahlen.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Flug (CARRID und CONNID) in einer komplexen Range-Tabelle enthalten ist, die sowohl Inklusions- als auch Exklusionsbedingungen enthält.

solution:
CLASS zcl_range_check_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_flight_in_range IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                       iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_check_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_flight_in_range.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) ).

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-connid (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0500' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = '007' ) ).

    IF iv_carrid IN lt_carrid_range AND iv_connid IN lt_connid_range.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_flight_in_range( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0100' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_flight_in_range( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0100' ) ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie 5 zufällige, eindeutige Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Kombination aus `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und einer Schleife, um eindeutige Elemente zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_carrids RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_carrids.
    DATA lt_all_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_carrids.

    IF lines( lt_all_carrids ) < 5.
      rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR <carrid> IN lt_all_carrids ( <carrid> ) ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lines( lt_all_carrids ) ).
    DATA ls_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    WHILE lv_count < 5.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      ls_carrid = lt_all_carrids[ lv_random_index ].
      IF NOT line_exists( rt_carrids[ table_line = ls_carrid ] ).
        APPEND ls_carrid TO rt_carrids.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_random_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_carrids ) <= 5 ) ).
    " Prüfen, ob alle Elemente eindeutig sind (durch Sortieren und Prüfen auf Duplikate)
    DATA(lt_sorted_carrids) = lt_carrids.
    SORT lt_sorted_carrids ASCENDING.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid) FROM 1.
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_carrid <> lt_sorted_carrids[ sy-tabix - 1 ] ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine bestimmte Anzahl eindeutiger Zufallselemente aus einer Tabelle auswählt. Es kombiniert `SELECT DISTINCT` zur Vorbereitung der Daten, `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` zur Indexgenerierung und eine Schleife mit `LINE_EXISTS` zur Sicherstellung der Eindeutigkeit. Dies ist eine robuste Methode für solche Anforderungen.
keywords: RANDOM, Unique, SFLIGHT, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Schleife

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) mit einer 50/50-Chance.
hint: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl und prüfen Sie, ob sie größer oder kleiner als ein Schwellenwert ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_coin_flip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flip_coin RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_coin_flip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_value < 0.5.
      rv_result = 'Kopf'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Zahl'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_coin_flip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_coin_flip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_coin_flip( ).
    DATA(lv_kopf_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_zahl_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).
      IF lv_result = 'Kopf'.
        lv_kopf_count = lv_kopf_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_result = 'Zahl'.
        lv_zahl_count = lv_zahl_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_kopf_count > 30 AND lv_kopf_count < 70 ) ). " Statistische Prüfung
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_zahl_count > 30 AND lv_zahl_count < 70 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ( lv_kopf_count + lv_zahl_count ) exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Simulation eines Münzwurfs ist ein klassisches Beispiel für die Anwendung von Zufallszahlen. Durch die Generierung einer Gleitkommazahl zwischen 0 und 1 und den Vergleich mit 0.5 lässt sich eine faire 50/50-Chance abbilden. Der Unit-Test prüft die statistische Verteilung über mehrere Durchläufe.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT, Münzwurf, Simulation, Bedingung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für ein generisches Feld (z.B. 'VALUE') und füllen Sie diese mit Werten aus einer dynamisch übergebenen String-Tabelle. Die Range soll 'EQ'-Einträge für jeden String enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine generische Range-Struktur und den FOR-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_range IMPORTING it_values TYPE string_table
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_range) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF rsdsselopt WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( FOR <value> IN it_values
                        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <value> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_test_dynamic_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_input_values) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Wert1' ) ( 'Wert2' ) ( 'Wert3' ) ).
    DATA(lt_dynamic_range) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_range( lt_input_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_dynamic_range ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_dynamic_range[ 1 ]-low exp = 'Wert1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_dynamic_range[ 3 ]-low exp = 'Wert3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Flexibilität von Ranges in Kombination mit modernen ABAP-Operatoren. Eine generische Range-Tabelle (`RSDSELOPT`) kann dynamisch aus einer beliebigen Liste von Werten erstellt werden, was für dynamische Selektionsbildschirme oder Berichte sehr nützlich ist.
keywords: RANGE, Dynamic, RSDSELOPT, FOR, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_secret_data` mit einem privaten Attribut `mv_secret_value`. Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Klasse `zcl_secret_factory`, die Instanzen von `zcl_secret_data` erzeugen und deren privates Attribut initialisieren kann. Nutzen Sie das `FRIENDS`-Konzept, um der Factory-Klasse den Zugriff auf den privaten Konstruktor oder eine private Setter-Methode zu ermöglichen.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Factory-Klasse als 'FRIENDS' in der Definition von `zcl_secret_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secret_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE. " Nur die Factory darf Instanzen erzeugen
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_secret_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_secret_value TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.

    " Die Factory-Klasse ist ein Freund und darf auf private Komponenten zugreifen
    FRIENDS zcl_secret_factory.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secret_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_secret_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_secret_value.
    rv_value = mv_secret_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secret_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_secret_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_secret_data) TYPE REF TO zcl_secret_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secret_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_secret_data.
    ro_secret_data = NEW zcl_secret_data( iv_value = iv_initial_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_secret_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_secret) = lo_factory->create_secret_data( 'MyHiddenSecret' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_secret ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_secret->get_secret_value( ) exp = 'MyHiddenSecret' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `FRIENDS`-Konzept ermöglicht einer spezifischen Klasse (hier `zcl_secret_factory`) den Zugriff auf private oder protected Komponenten einer anderen Klasse (`zcl_secret_data`), ohne die Kapselung für andere Klassen aufzubrechen. Dies ist nützlich für Design-Patterns wie das Factory-Pattern, bei dem die Factory die volle Kontrolle über die Instanziierung und Initialisierung der Objekte hat.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Kapselung, Private Constructor

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Klasse `zcl_complex_calculator`, die eine private Methode `calculate_internal` besitzt. Erstellen Sie eine separate Test-Hilfsklasse `zcl_calculator_tester`, die als 'FRIENDS' von `zcl_complex_calculator` deklariert ist, um die private Methode direkt testen zu können. Demonstrieren Sie, wie `zcl_calculator_tester` die private Methode aufruft.
hint: Die Test-Hilfsklasse muss in der 'FRIENDS'-Liste der zu testenden Klasse aufgeführt sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_a TYPE i iv_b TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_internal IMPORTING iv_x TYPE i iv_y TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

    FRIENDS zcl_calculator_tester. " Test-Hilfsklasse ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_result = calculate_internal( iv_x = iv_a iv_y = iv_b ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_internal.
    rv_sum = iv_x + iv_y.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_tester DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS test_private_calculation
      IMPORTING
        io_calculator TYPE REF TO zcl_complex_calculator
        iv_val1       TYPE i
        iv_val2       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_tester IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_private_calculation.
    " Direkter Aufruf der privaten Methode dank FRIENDS-Deklaration
    rv_result = io_calculator->calculate_internal( iv_x = iv_val1 iv_y = iv_val2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_private_method_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_private_method_access.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_complex_calculator( ).
    DATA(lo_tester) = NEW zcl_calculator_tester( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_tester->test_private_calculation( io_calculator = lo_calculator iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `FRIENDS` verwendet werden kann, um einer spezifischen Test-Hilfsklasse den Zugriff auf private Methoden einer anderen Klasse zu ermöglichen. Dies kann in bestimmten Szenarien für White-Box-Tests nützlich sein, obwohl in modernem ABAP für Unit-Tests oft die `FOR TESTING`-Erweiterung für Methoden bevorzugt wird, um private Methoden zu testen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Unit Test, Private Method, White-Box Testing

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse `zcl_data_store` mit einem privaten internen Attribut `mt_data` (Tabelle). Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_data_analyzer`, die Daten aus `zcl_data_store` lesen und analysieren soll. Gewähren Sie `zcl_data_analyzer` über das `FRIENDS`-Konzept Zugriff auf das private Attribut `mt_data` von `zcl_data_store`, um eine direkte und effiziente Datenanalyse zu ermöglichen.
hint: Die `zcl_data_analyzer` muss als 'FRIENDS' in der Definition von `zcl_data_store` deklariert werden.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_line,
         id   TYPE i,
         value TYPE string,
       END OF ty_data_line,
       ty_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_data_store DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_data IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS get_data_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE ty_data_table.

    FRIENDS zcl_data_analyzer. " Analyzer-Klasse ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_store IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data_line( id = iv_id value = iv_value ) TO mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data_count.
    rv_count = lines( mt_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_store
      IMPORTING
        io_data_store TYPE REF TO zcl_data_store
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_analysis_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_store.
    " Direkter Zugriff auf das private Attribut mt_data dank FRIENDS
    DATA(lt_data) = io_data_store->mt_data.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_data ).
    rv_analysis_result = |Analyse: { lv_count } Datensätze gefunden.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_analyzer_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyzer_access.
    DATA(lo_store) = NEW zcl_data_store( ).
    lo_store->add_data( iv_id = 1 iv_value = 'Alpha' ).
    lo_store->add_data( iv_id = 2 iv_value = 'Beta' ).

    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_data_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_analyzer->analyze_store( io_data_store = lo_store ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Analyse: 2 Datensätze gefunden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `FRIENDS` für einen kontrollierten Zugriff auf private Datenattribute. Die `zcl_data_store` schützt ihre internen Daten, erlaubt aber der `zcl_data_analyzer` als 'Freund', direkt auf diese Daten zuzugreifen, was die Implementierung von spezifischen Analysefunktionen vereinfachen kann, ohne öffentliche Getter für die gesamte Datenstruktur bereitstellen zu müssen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Datenzugriff, Kapselung, Inter-Class Communication

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie ein Builder-Pattern für eine komplexe Konfigurationsobjekt `zcl_config_object`. Die Builder-Klasse `zcl_config_builder` soll die `zcl_config_object` schrittweise aufbauen und benötigt dafür Zugriff auf private Setter-Methoden der Konfigurationsklasse. Nutzen Sie `FRIENDS`, um diesen Zugriff zu ermöglichen und die Kapselung der `zcl_config_object` zu wahren.
hint: Die Builder-Klasse muss als 'FRIENDS' in der Definition der Konfigurationsklasse deklariert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_config_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE. " Nur der Builder darf Instanzen erzeugen und initialisieren
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_setting_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_a) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_setting_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_b) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_setting_a TYPE string.
    DATA mv_setting_b TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS set_setting_a IMPORTING iv_a TYPE string.
    METHODS set_setting_b IMPORTING iv_b TYPE i.

    FRIENDS zcl_config_builder. " Builder-Klasse ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Default-Werte oder leere Initialisierung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_setting_a.
    rv_a = mv_setting_a.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_setting_b.
    rv_b = mv_setting_b.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_setting_a.
    mv_setting_a = iv_a.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_setting_b.
    mv_setting_b = iv_b.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_setting_a IMPORTING iv_a TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder.
    METHODS set_setting_b IMPORTING iv_b TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder.
    METHODS build RETURNING VALUE(ro_config) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_object.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_config TYPE REF TO zcl_config_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_setting_a.
    IF mo_config IS INITIAL.
      mo_config = NEW zcl_config_object( ).
    ENDIF.
    mo_config->set_setting_a( iv_a ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_setting_b.
    IF mo_config IS INITIAL.
      mo_config = NEW zcl_config_object( ).
    ENDIF.
    mo_config->set_setting_b( iv_b ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    ro_config = mo_config.
    CLEAR mo_config. " Builder ist bereit für neue Konfiguration
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_builder_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_builder_pattern.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_config_builder( ).
    DATA(lo_config) = lo_builder->set_setting_a( 'ValueA' )->set_setting_b( 123 )->build( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_config->get_setting_a( ) exp = 'ValueA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_config->get_setting_b( ) exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Builder-Pattern ermöglicht den schrittweisen Aufbau komplexer Objekte. Durch die Deklaration der Builder-Klasse als `FRIENDS` der Konfigurationsklasse kann der Builder auf private Setter-Methoden zugreifen, um das Objekt zu initialisieren, während die Konfigurationsklasse selbst ihre internen Zustände vor externem, unkontrolliertem Zugriff schützt.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Builder Pattern, Design Pattern, Kapselung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_data_processor` mit einer privaten Methode `_process_raw_data`. Implementieren Sie eine 'Strategie'-Klasse `zcl_processing_strategy`, die diese private Methode von `zcl_data_processor` aufrufen muss, um eine spezifische Verarbeitungslogik auszuführen. Nutzen Sie `FRIENDS`, um der Strategie-Klasse den notwendigen Zugriff zu gewähren.
hint: Die Strategie-Klasse muss als 'FRIENDS' in der Definition der `zcl_data_processor` deklariert werden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processing_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS execute IMPORTING io_processor TYPE REF TO zcl_data_processor.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_processing_strategy.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_processing_strategy.
    DATA mv_current_input TYPE string.
    DATA mv_processed_output TYPE string.

    METHODS _process_raw_data IMPORTING iv_raw TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed) TYPE string.

    FRIENDS zcl_processing_strategy. " Strategie-Klasse ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    mv_current_input = iv_input.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      mo_strategy->execute( me ). " Strategie ruft private Methode des Prozessors auf
    ELSE.
      mv_processed_output = |No strategy set for '{ iv_input }'|.
    ENDIF.
    rv_output = mv_processed_output.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _process_raw_data.
    " Beispielhafte private Verarbeitungslogik
    rv_processed = |Processed: { iv_raw } ({ sy-uzeit })|.
    mv_processed_output = rv_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processing_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processing_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processing_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processing_strategy~execute.
    " Die Strategie ruft die private Methode des Prozessors auf
    io_processor->_process_raw_data( io_processor->mv_current_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_with_friends FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_with_friends.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_strategy) = NEW zcl_processing_strategy( ).

    lo_processor->set_strategy( lo_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_processor->process_data( 'Initial Data' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with( act = lv_output exp = 'Processed: Initial Data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von `FRIENDS` im Kontext des Strategie-Patterns. Die Strategie-Klasse (`zcl_processing_strategy`) benötigt Zugriff auf eine private Verarbeitungslogik (`_process_raw_data`) der Kontext-Klasse (`zcl_data_processor`). Durch `FRIENDS` kann dieser Zugriff gewährt werden, ohne die Methode öffentlich zu machen, was die Kapselung und die Trennung von Belangen aufrechterhält.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Strategy Pattern, Design Pattern, Private Method Access

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine grafische Darstellung mit `cl_gui_chart_engine` vor. Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer internen Tabelle, die für die Chart-Engine geeignet ist. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` oder `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` um die Daten zu aggregieren.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid TYPE sflight-connid,
       END OF ty_sflight_data,
       BEGIN OF ty_chart_data_line,
         x_axis TYPE string, " Fluggesellschaft
         y_axis TYPE i,      " Anzahl Flüge
       END OF ty_chart_data_line,
       ty_chart_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_for_chart RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE ty_chart_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_for_chart.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Aggregation der Fluganzahl pro Fluggesellschaft mit FOR und REDUCE
    rt_chart_data = VALUE ty_chart_data_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE DATA(lv_count)
      ( x_axis = ls_flight-carrid
        y_axis = lv_count ) ).

    " In einem echten Szenario würde man hier cl_gui_chart_engine instanziieren und SET_DATA aufrufen.
    " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    " lo_chart->set_data( rt_chart_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_data_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_data_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_prep) = NEW zcl_chart_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_prep->get_flight_counts_for_chart( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_chart_data ).
    " Überprüfen, ob die Daten korrekt aggregiert wurden (Beispiel: mindestens 1 Eintrag)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_chart_data ) > 0 ).
    " Optional: Spezifische Prüfung für bekannte Daten, falls sflight-Daten stabil sind
    " DATA(ls_data) = lt_chart_data[ x_axis = 'LH' ].
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-y_axis exp = <expected_count> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die effiziente Datenaggregation mit modernen ABAP-Features wie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE`-Operator. Die Flugdaten aus `sflight` werden nach Fluggesellschaften gruppiert und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft ermittelt. Das Ergebnis wird direkt in eine interne Tabelle im Format für die `cl_gui_chart_engine` überführt. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art der Datenaufbereitung.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, REDUCE, GROUP BY, sflight, cl_gui_chart_engine, Data Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamische Titel und Beschriftungen für eine `cl_gui_chart_engine` unter Verwendung von String-Templates. Der Titel soll Informationen wie das aktuelle Datum und einen benutzerdefinierten Text enthalten.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_chart_data_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE ty_chart_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER ty_sflight_table(
      lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).

    " Transformation in das Chart-Format
    rt_chart_data = VALUE ty_chart_data_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      ( x_axis = |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
        y_axis = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).

    " In einem echten Szenario würde man hier cl_gui_chart_engine instanziieren und SET_DATA aufrufen.
    " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    " lo_chart->set_data( rt_chart_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
         fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
         seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data_line,
         x_axis TYPE string, " Flug-ID (Carrid-Connid-Fldate)

       END OF ty_chart_data_line,
       ty_chart_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_occupancy_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE ty_chart_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_raw_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Transformation und Berechnung der Auslastung mit FOR und VALUE
    rt_chart_data = VALUE ty_chart_data_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_occupancy_percent = COND decfloat16(
                                   WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_flight-seatsmax
                                   ELSE 0 )
      IN
      ( x_axis = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
        y_axis = lv_occupancy_percent ) ).

    " In einem echten Szenario würde man hier cl_gui_chart_engine instanziieren und SET_DATA aufrufen.
    " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    " lo_chart->set_data( rt_chart_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_transform->get_flight_occupancy_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_chart_data ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Stellen Sie die Ergebnisse in einem Format bereit, das für die `cl_gui_chart_engine` geeignet ist. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und Inline-Berechnungen.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` kann für komplexe Aggregationen verwendet werden.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
         seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
       END OF ty_sflight_seats,
       ty_sflight_seats_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data_line,
         x_axis TYPE string, " Fluggesellschaft
         y_axis TYPE decfloat16, " Durchschnitt belegte Sitze
       END OF ty_chart_data_line,
       ty_chart_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_seats_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE ty_chart_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_seats_table.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    " Berechnung des Durchschnitts mit REDUCE und GROUP BY
    rt_chart_data = VALUE ty_chart_data_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
          lv_count_flights = lines( GROUP ls_flight )
          lv_average = COND decfloat16(
                         WHEN lv_count_flights > 0 THEN lv_total_seats / lv_count_flights
                         ELSE 0 )
      IN
      ( x_axis = ls_flight-carrid
        y_axis = lv_average ) ).

    " In einem echten Szenario würde man hier cl_gui_chart_engine instanziieren und SET_DATA aufrufen.
    " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    " lo_chart->set_data( rt_chart_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Rangliste der Fluggesellschaften basierend auf der Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze aus `sflights`. Die Top N Fluggesellschaften sollen für die `cl_gui_chart_engine` vorbereitet werden. Nutzen Sie `SORT`, `FOR` und `UP TO N ROWS`.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats_total,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

       END OF ty_sflight_seats_total,

CLASS zcl_chart_ranking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_top_n_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE ty_chart_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_ranking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 500 ROWS.

    " Aggregation der Gesamtsitze pro Fluggesellschaft
    DATA(lt_aggregated_seats) = VALUE ty_sflight_seats_total_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ) ).

    " Sortieren und Top N auswählen
    SORT lt_aggregated_seats BY total_seats DESCENDING.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE ty_chart_data_table(
      FOR ls_entry IN lt_aggregated_seats UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
      ( x_axis = ls_entry-carrid
        y_axis = ls_entry-total_seats ) ).

    " In einem echten Szenario würde man hier cl_gui_chart_engine instanziieren und SET_DATA aufrufen.
    " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    " lo_chart->set_data( rt_chart_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_n_ranking.
    DATA(lo_ranking) = NEW zcl_chart_ranking( ).
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_ranking->get_top_n_carriers( iv_top_n = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chart_data ) exp = 3 ).
    " Überprüfen, ob die Rangliste korrekt sortiert ist (absteigend)
    IF lines( lt_chart_data ) = 3.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-y_axis >= lt_chart_data[ 2 ]-y_axis ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_chart_data[ 2 ]-y_axis >= lt_chart_data[ 3 ]-y_axis ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

UP TO N ROWS` für die Begrenzung der Ergebnisse. Es demonstriert, wie man eine Top-N-Rangliste von Fluggesellschaften basierend auf belegten Sitzen erstellt und diese Daten für die `cl_gui_chart_engine` aufbereitet. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse `zcl_chart_renderer` die eine Instanz von `cl_gui_chart_engine` kapselt. Die Klasse soll eine Methode `render_chart` haben, die Daten entgegennimmt und die `cl_gui_chart_engine` entsprechend konfiguriert und anzeigt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenübergabe und Konfiguration.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data_point,
         x_value TYPE string,
         y_value TYPE i,
       END OF ty_chart_data_point,
       ty_chart_data_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_chart_renderer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.
    METHODS render_chart
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_chart_data_points
        iv_title TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_chart_type TYPE i DEFAULT cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_chart_type_column.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

CLASS zcl_chart_renderer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_chart_engine = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( parent = mo_container ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD render_chart.
    IF mo_chart_engine IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN. " Keine Chart-Engine verfügbar
    ENDIF.

    " Daten für die Chart-Engine vorbereiten (Annahme: ty_chart_data_points passt)
    " cl_gui_chart_engine erwartet eine Tabelle vom Typ CHART_DATA_TAB
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_engine_data,
             series_id TYPE string,
             x_axis    TYPE string,
             y_axis    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_engine_data,
           ty_chart_engine_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_engine_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_engine_data) = VALUE ty_chart_engine_data_tab(
      FOR ls_data IN it_data
      ( series_id = 'Series 1' " Beispiel-Series-ID
        x_axis = ls_data-x_value
        y_axis = ls_data-y_value ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_data( lt_engine_data ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( iv_chart_type ).
    IF iv_title IS SUPPLIED.
      DATA(ls_title_config) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_chart_title(
        title = iv_title
        font_size = 10 ).
      mo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( ls_title_config ).
    ENDIF.

    " mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ). " Im echten GUI-Kontext aufrufen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält, deren maximale Sitzplatzkapazität größer als 200 ist. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FOR`-Operator und den `VALUE`-Operator.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES:
      tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( seatsmax > 200 )
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazitäten aller Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem initialen Wert und einer Aggregationslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die interne Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' durchgeführt werden und deren Flugnummer mit '0' beginnt. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #(...)` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES:
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid CS '0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lt_ua_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_lh_flights
      msg = 'LH flights should not be initial'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error
    ).
    " Assuming 'UA' might not have flights starting with '0' or might not exist in test data
    " This assertion might need adjustment based on actual SFLIGHTS data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_ua_flights
      msg = 'UA flights should be initial or very few'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_warning
    ).
    " Check if all filtered flights match criteria
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-connid CS '0' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Service zur Datenbeschaffung) über den Konstruktor injiziert bekommt. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einem Interface und der `NEW`-Syntax.

INTERFACE zif_data_provider.
  METHODS get_flight_count
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_flight_count.
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO @rv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider. " For demonstration, not strictly DI
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
    METHODS analyze_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_provider = io_data_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD analyze_carrier.
    DATA(lv_count) = mo_data_provider->get_flight_count( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).
    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_message = |Fluggesellschaft { iv_carrid } hat { lv_count } Flüge.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Fluggesellschaft { iv_carrid } hat keine Flüge.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus `SFLIGHTS` und geben Sie dessen Details aus. Verwenden Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen für alle Variablen.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_details) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight). " Inline declaration for structure

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_details = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } | &
                   |mit { ls_flight-seatsmax } maximalen Sitzen und { ls_flight-seatsocc } belegten Sitzen.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_details = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` zur Behandlung einer statisch prüfbaren Ausnahme, die durch eine ungültige mathematische Operation ausgelöst wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW` oder `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` und fangen Sie diese in einem `CATCH`-Block ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_raw_result) = divide_numbers(
                                 iv_numerator   = iv_numerator
                                 iv_denominator = iv_denominator
                               ).
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { lv_raw_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Arithmetischer Überlauf.'.
      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Ein unbekannter Fehler ist aufgetreten.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_safe_divide FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_by_zero_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_divide.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).

    DATA(lv_result_ok) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_ok exp = 'Ergebnis: 5.0000000000000000E+00' ).

    DATA(lv_result_zero) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_zero exp = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt.' ).

    " Test for overflow (e.g., very large numbers if 'f' type can overflow) - might need specific values
    " For simplicity, focusing on zero-divide here.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_by_zero_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ). " This should raise cx_sy_zerodivide
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ist der moderne und empfohlene Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen (Exceptions) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt dass das Programm abstürzt. Statisch prüfbare Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` müssen deklariert (`RAISING`) und behandelt werden, was zu robusterem Code führt.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, RAISING, METHOD

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie dabei den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES:
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        connid = ls_group-connid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_group( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result table should not be initial'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error
    ).

    " Example: Check if a specific group exists and has a count > 0
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary_lh400) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_summary_lh400-flight_count > 0
        msg = 'Flight count for LH 400 should be greater than 0'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check for uniqueness of groups
    DATA(lv_unique_groups) = lines( lt_result ).
    SORT lt_result BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_result COMPARING carrid connid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_unique_groups
      exp = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'All entries in result should represent unique groups'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und bietet eine verbesserte Performance und Lesbarkeit für Aggregationsaufgaben.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, VALUE, DATA, SELECT, BEGIN OF, METHOD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit verschachtelten Strukturen, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Liste ihrer Flüge enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und einer verschachtelten internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und im inneren `FOR` den `GROUP` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_nested_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES:
      tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flights  TYPE tt_flight_detail,
      END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES:
      tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_nested
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_nested_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_nested.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY carrid = ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
            ( connid = ls_flight-connid
              fldate = ls_flight-fldate
              seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax ) )
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation auf einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie für jeden Flug in `SFLIGHTS` ein neues Feld 'occupancy_rate' (belegte Sitze / maximale Sitze) hinzufügen. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und berechnen Sie das neue Feld direkt im `VALUE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_occupancy,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsmax      TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
        seatsocc      TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
      END OF ty_flight_with_occupancy.
    TYPES:
      tt_flight_with_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_occupancy.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate
          seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax
          seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc
          occupancy_rate = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_rate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_rate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result table should not be initial'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-seatsmax > 0.
        DATA(lv_expected_rate) = ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) * 100.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-occupancy_rate
          exp = lv_expected_rate
          delta = '0.01' " Allow for floating point inaccuracies
          msg = |Occupancy rate for { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } is incorrect|
        ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-occupancy_rate
          exp = 0
          msg = |Occupancy rate for { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } with zero seatsmax should be 0|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Transformation von internen Tabellen mit dem `FOR`-Operator und `VALUE` ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um neue Tabellen zu erstellen, die auf den Daten einer bestehenden Tabelle basieren, aber zusätzliche oder modifizierte Felder enthalten. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen und ist besonders nützlich für die Datenaufbereitung.
keywords: Internal Tables, Transformation, FOR, VALUE, COND, DATA, SELECT, BEGIN OF, METHOD

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Verwenden Sie dabei die neuen String-Funktionen `STRIP` und `REPLACE` mit `REGEX`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `STRIP` für führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` für doppelte Leerzeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_clean DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_clean IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_spaced_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\s(\d+)\s`.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines Regex-Musters (z.B. Komma oder Semikolon, optional mit Leerzeichen) in eine Tabelle auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` in einer Schleife, um die Trennzeichen zu finden und die Substrings zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_split_by_pattern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_string_by_regex IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                                            iv_delimiter_pattern TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_split_by_pattern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_string_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_delimiter_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND substring( val = iv_text off = lv_offset len = lo_matcher->offset - lv_offset ) TO rt_parts.
      lv_offset = lo_matcher->offset + lo_matcher->length.
      lo_matcher->set_offset( lv_offset ).
    ENDWHILE.
    APPEND substring( val = iv_text off = lv_offset ) TO rt_parts.

    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL. "Entfernt leere Teile, z.B. bei führenden/nachfolgenden Trennzeichen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter, die unmittelbar von einem Doppelpunkt gefolgt werden, aber ohne den Doppelpunkt selbst in das Ergebnis aufzunehmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen positiven Lookahead `(?=...)` im Regex-Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_lookahead_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_words_before_colon IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_lookahead_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_words_before_colon.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\b(\w+)(?=:)\b`.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_pattern IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).
    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-submatch_str[1] TO rt_words.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_single FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_colon_after FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_lookahead_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_words_before_colon( 'Wort: Text' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Wort' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_lookahead_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_words_before_colon( 'Erstes: Zweites: Drittes: Ende.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Erstes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Zweites' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'Drittes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_lookahead_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_words_before_colon( 'Kein Doppelpunkt hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_colon_after.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_lookahead_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_words_before_colon( 'Wort ohne Doppelpunkt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der positive Lookahead `(?=...)` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Regex-Feature, das prüft, ob ein Muster folgt, ohne es selbst zu konsumieren oder in die Übereinstimmung aufzunehmen. Hier `\b(\w+)(?=:)\b` findet ein Wort (`\w+`), das von einem Doppelpunkt (`:`) gefolgt wird, aber nur das Wort wird extrahiert.
keywords: REGEX, LOOKAHEAD, ADVANCED, Extrahieren, Wörter

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die aktuelle ABAP-Aufrufhierarchie (Call Stack) und geben Sie die Namen der aufrufenden Programme/Methoden zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_call_stack()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_get_call_stack DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_call_stack_entry,
             program_name TYPE sy-repid,
             event_type   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             event_name   TYPE c LENGTH 30,
             method_name  TYPE seocmpname,
           END OF ty_call_stack_entry.
    TYPES: tt_call_stack_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_call_stack_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_current_call_stack RETURNING VALUE(rt_call_stack) TYPE tt_call_stack_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_get_call_stack IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_call_stack.
    DATA(lt_stack) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_call_stack( ).
    LOOP AT lt_stack INTO DATA(ls_stack_entry).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_call_stack ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>).
      <fs_entry>-program_name = ls_stack_entry-program_name.
      <fs_entry>-event_type   = ls_stack_entry-event_type.
      <fs_entry>-event_name   = ls_stack_entry-event_name.
      <fs_entry>-method_name  = ls_stack_entry-method_name.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_call_stack FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_call_stack.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_get_call_stack( ).
    DATA(lt_call_stack) = lo_cut->get_current_call_stack( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_call_stack ).
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_call_stack INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-method_name = 'TEST_GET_CALL_STACK'.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_context_info=>get_call_stack()` liefert eine detaillierte Aufrufhierarchie, die für die Analyse des Programmflusses und die Fehlerbehebung unerlässlich ist. Die moderne Schleifenverarbeitung mit `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` und `APPEND INITIAL LINE TO ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` ist effizient.
keywords: cl_abap_context_info, Call Stack, Introspection, Debugging

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_picture_config_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    gt_config_data = VALUE #( 
      ( key = 'LOGO'    url = '/sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/z_images/company_logo.png' )
      ( key = 'BANNER'  url = '/sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/z_images/banner_ad.jpg' )
      ( key = 'DEFAULT' url = '/sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/z_images/placeholder.png' )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf der Originalgröße eines Bildes und der Größe des Anzeigebereichs den optimalen Skalierungsmodus für `cl_gui_picture` zurückgibt. Die Modi sind `cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch`, `cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_fit` oder `cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_center`.
hint: Vergleichen Sie Seitenverhältnisse und Größen, um den besten Modus zu bestimmen. Nutzen Sie `IF` oder `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_picture_scale_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_display_mode
      IMPORTING
        iv_orig_width  TYPE i
        iv_orig_height TYPE i
        iv_target_width  TYPE i
        iv_target_height TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_display_mode) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_picture_scale_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_display_mode.
    IF iv_orig_width <= 0 OR iv_orig_height <= 0 OR iv_target_width <= 0 OR iv_target_height <= 0.
      rv_display_mode = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_center. " Default for invalid input
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_orig_aspect) = CAST decfloat34( iv_orig_width ) / iv_orig_height.
    DATA(lv_target_aspect) = CAST decfloat34( iv_target_width ) / iv_target_height.

    IF iv_orig_width <= iv_target_width AND iv_orig_height <= iv_target_height.
      " Picture is smaller than target, center it
      rv_display_mode = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_center.
    ELSEIF lv_orig_aspect = lv_target_aspect.
      " Aspect ratios match, stretch to fit
      rv_display_mode = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch.
    ELSE.
      " Aspect ratios differ, fit within bounds
      rv_display_mode = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_fit.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_display_mode FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_display_mode.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_picture_scale_calc( ).

    " Test case 1: Picture smaller than target
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_display_mode( iv_orig_width = 100 iv_orig_height = 50 iv_target_width = 200 iv_target_height = 100 )
      exp = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_center
      msg = 'Test case 1 failed: Smaller picture should be centered'
    ).

    " Test case 2: Picture larger, aspect ratios match
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_display_mode( iv_orig_width = 200 iv_orig_height = 100 iv_target_width = 100 iv_target_height = 50 )
      exp = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch
      msg = 'Test case 2 failed: Matching aspect ratio should stretch'
    ).

    " Test case 3: Picture larger, aspect ratios differ
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_display_mode( iv_orig_width = 200 iv_orig_height = 100 iv_target_width = 50 iv_target_height = 50 )
      exp = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_fit
      msg = 'Test case 3 failed: Differing aspect ratio should fit'
    ).

    " Test case 4: Invalid input
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_display_mode( iv_orig_width = 0 iv_orig_height = 100 iv_target_width = 50 iv_target_height = 50 )
      exp = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_center
      msg = 'Test case 4 failed: Invalid input should default to center'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
