Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine hierarchische Struktur für `cl_gui_simple_tree` umwandelt. Die Hierarchie soll 'Fluggesellschaft' -> 'Flugverbindung' -> 'Flugdatum' darstellen. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `GROUP BY` um die Daten zu gruppieren und die Baumknoten zu erstellen. Die Knotentabelle ist vom Typ `LVC_T_NODS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             col_image TYPE lvc_image,
           END OF ty_s_sflight_node.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_sflight_tree_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE ty_t_sflight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sflight_tree_nodes.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR <carrid_group> IN GROUP BY carrid OF lt_sflights GROUP AS carrid_group
      ( LET lv_carrid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
        VALUE #( 
          ( key = lv_carrid_key
            text = |Fluggesellschaft: { <carrid_group>-carrid }|
            tlevel = 0
            exp_image = '@08@' " Folder icon
            col_image = '@08@' )
          FOR <connid_group> IN GROUP BY connid OF carrid_group GROUP AS connid_group
          ( LET lv_connid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
            VALUE #( 
              ( key = lv_connid_key
                relatkey = lv_carrid_key
                text = |Verbindung: { <connid_group>-connid }|
                tlevel = 1
                exp_image = '@08@'
                col_image = '@08@' )
              FOR <fldate_entry> IN connid_group
              ( key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key )
                relatkey = lv_connid_key
                text = |Datum: { <fldate_entry>-fldate DATE = USER } (Sitze belegt: { <fldate_entry>-seatsocc }/{ <fldate_entry>-max_seats })|
                tlevel = 2
                exp_image = '@09@' " Document icon
                col_image = '@09@' )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine bestehende Baumstruktur (repräsentiert durch eine Knotentabelle) um neue Kindknoten unter einem bestimmten Elternknoten erweitert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #` und `INSERT LINES OF` oder `APPEND` um neue Knoten hinzuzufügen. Achten Sie auf die `relatkey` der neuen Knoten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             col_image TYPE lvc_image,
           END OF ty_s_node.
    TYPES: ty_t_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_child_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        it_new_data   TYPE string_table
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes      TYPE ty_t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_child_nodes.
    DATA(lv_max_key) = 0.
    LOOP AT ct_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-key IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_max_key = MAX( lv_max_key, CONV i( ls_node-key ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_parent_level) = 0.
    READ TABLE ct_nodes INTO DATA(ls_parent_node) WITH KEY key = iv_parent_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_parent_level = ls_parent_node-tlevel.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_new_nodes) = VALUE ty_t_nodes(
      FOR <text> IN it_new_data
      ( key = CONV string( ++lv_max_key )
        relatkey = iv_parent_key
        text = <text>
        tlevel = lv_parent_level + 1
        exp_image = '@09@'
        col_image = '@09@' )
    ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_new_nodes TO ct_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_child_nodes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_node_adder( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE zcl_tree_node_adder=>ty_t_nodes(
      ( key = '1' text = 'Root 1' tlevel = 0 exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
      ( key = '2' relatkey = '1' text = 'Child 1.1' tlevel = 1 exp_image = '@09@' col_image = '@09@' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_new_data) = VALUE string_table(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_nodes )

      msg = 'Total number of nodes should be 4'

    READ TABLE lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node) WITH KEY text = 'New Child 1.2'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'New child node should have correct parent key'

solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_remover DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             col_image TYPE lvc_image,
           END OF ty_s_node.
    TYPES: ty_t_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_nodes_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_keys_to_remove TYPE lvc_t_nkey
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes          TYPE ty_t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_remover IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_nodes_by_key.
    DATA(lt_nodes_to_keep) = FILTER ty_t_nodes(
      ct_nodes
      EXCEPT IN it_keys_to_remove WHERE key = key
    ).
    ct_nodes = lt_nodes_to_keep.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,

      CHANGING
        ct_nodes       TYPE ty_t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_tree_icon_assigner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,

             col_image TYPE lvc_image,

      CHANGING

CLASS zcl_tree_icon_assigner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_status_icons.
    LOOP AT ct_nodes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_node>).
      <fs_node>-exp_image = COND lvc_image(
        WHEN <fs_node>-text CP '*OK*'    THEN icon_led_green
        WHEN <fs_node>-text CP '*Error*' THEN icon_led_red
        WHEN <fs_node>-text CP '*Warning*' THEN icon_led_yellow
        ELSE                                   icon_led_inactive
      ).
      <fs_node>-col_image = <fs_node>-exp_image.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Baumstruktur aus einer komplexeren Datenquelle (verschachtelte interne Tabellen, die Fluggesellschaften, Flugverbindungen und einzelne Flüge repräsentieren) erstellt. Die Daten sollen aus `sflights` stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Iteratoren mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE #` um die hierarchische Struktur aufzubauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_sflight_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             col_image TYPE lvc_image,
           END OF ty_s_node.
    TYPES: ty_t_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_complex_sflights_tree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE ty_t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_sflight_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_complex_sflights_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR <carrid_group> IN GROUP BY carrid OF lt_sflights GROUP AS carrid_group
      ( LET lv_carrid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
        VALUE #( 
          ( key = lv_carrid_key
            text = |Airline: { <carrid_group>-carrid }|
            tlevel = 0
            exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
          FOR <connid_group> IN GROUP BY connid OF carrid_group GROUP AS connid_group
          ( LET lv_connid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
            VALUE #( 
              ( key = lv_connid_key
                relatkey = lv_carrid_key
                text = |Connection: { <connid_group>-connid }|
                tlevel = 1
                exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
              FOR <fldate_entry> IN GROUP BY fldate OF connid_group GROUP AS fldate_group
              ( LET lv_fldate_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
                VALUE #( 
                  ( key = lv_fldate_key
                    relatkey = lv_connid_key
                    text = |Date: { <fldate_entry>-fldate DATE = USER }|
                    tlevel = 2
                    exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
                  FOR <flight_detail> IN fldate_group
                  ( key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key )
                    relatkey = lv_fldate_key
                    text = |Flight: { <flight_detail>-carrid }-{ <flight_detail>-connid }-{ <flight_detail>-fldate DATE = USER } (Price: { <flight_detail>-price } { <flight_detail>-currency })|
                    tlevel = 3
                    exp_image = '@09@' col_image = '@09@' )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_build_complex_sflights_tree.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_sflight_tree( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen XSTRING-Wert (binäre Bilddaten) aus einem gegebenen URL abruft. Dies simuliert das Laden eines Bildes von einer externen Quelle, wobei der Fokus auf der Datenbeschaffung liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für HTTP-Anfragen. Für den Unit-Test kann ein Mock-Objekt oder eine simulierte Antwort verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_picture_url_fetcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_image_data_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_image_data) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_picture_url_fetcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_image_data_from_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_reason      TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP client creation failed'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP send failed'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP receive failed'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    lv_reason = lo_http_client->response->get_reason( ).

    IF lv_status_code = 200.
      rv_image_data = lo_http_client->response->get_data( ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fetch_image_data_from_url FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_image_data_from_url.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_picture_url_fetcher( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_url) = 'http://example.com/dummy_image.png'. " Dummy URL for test

    " This test will fail if a real HTTP call is made and the URL is invalid/unreachable.
    " In a real scenario, you would mock cl_http_client for unit testing.
    " For this example, we assert that an exception is raised for a non-existent URL
    " or that a non-initial XSTRING is returned for a valid (mocked) URL.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_image_data) = lo_cut->fetch_image_data_from_url( lv_dummy_url ).
        " If it reaches here, it means a call was made, and we expect data or an error.
        " For a true unit test, cl_http_client would be mocked.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = lv_image_data
          msg = 'Expected initial data for dummy URL or an exception'
          _is_not_initial = abap_true " This assertion is tricky without mocking
        ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = lx_error->get_text( )
          msg = 'Expected an exception for dummy URL'
          _is_not_initial = abap_true
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es demonstriert die grundlegenden Schritte einer HTTP-GET-Anfrage und die Fehlerbehandlung. hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `WHERE` sowie `COND` um die Filterung und Knotenerstellung zu kombinieren.

CLASS zcl_active_flights_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             col_image TYPE lvc_image,
           END OF ty_s_node.
    TYPES: ty_t_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_active_flights_tree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE ty_t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_active_flights_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_active_flights_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR <carrid_group> IN GROUP BY carrid OF lt_sflights GROUP AS carrid_group
      ( LET lv_carrid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
        VALUE #( 
          ( key = lv_carrid_key
            text = |Airline: { <carrid_group>-carrid }|
            tlevel = 0
            exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
          FOR <connid_group> IN GROUP BY connid OF carrid_group GROUP AS connid_group
          ( LET lv_connid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
            VALUE #( 
              ( key = lv_connid_key
                relatkey = lv_carrid_key
                text = |Connection: { <connid_group>-connid }|
                tlevel = 1
                exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
              FOR <flight_entry> IN connid_group WHERE ( fldate >= lv_today )
              ( key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key )
                relatkey = lv_connid_key
                text = |Flight: { <flight_entry>-fldate DATE = USER } (Price: { <flight_entry>-price } { <flight_entry>-currency })|
                tlevel = 2
                exp_image = '@09@' col_image = '@09@' )
            )
            WHERE lines( table = ( FILTER #( <connid_group> WHERE fldate >= lv_today ) ) ) > 0 " Only add connection if it has active flights
          )
        )
        WHERE lines( table = ( FILTER #( <carrid_group> WHERE fldate >= lv_today ) ) ) > 0 " Only add airline if it has active flights
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Baumstruktur (Knotentabelle) aus `sflights` generiert und für jeden Flug die Anzahl der belegten Sitze als zusätzlichen Informationstext zum Knotentext hinzufügt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und String-Templates, um den Knotentext dynamisch zu erweitern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_seats_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             col_image TYPE lvc_image,
           END OF ty_s_node.
    TYPES: ty_t_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_sflight_seats_tree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE ty_t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_seats_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sflight_seats_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR <carrid_group> IN GROUP BY carrid OF lt_sflights GROUP AS carrid_group
      ( LET lv_carrid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
        VALUE #( 
          ( key = lv_carrid_key
            text = |Airline: { <carrid_group>-carrid }|
            tlevel = 0
            exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
          FOR <connid_group> IN GROUP BY connid OF carrid_group GROUP AS connid_group
          ( LET lv_connid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key ) IN
            VALUE #( 
              ( key = lv_connid_key
                relatkey = lv_carrid_key
                text = |Connection: { <connid_group>-connid }|
                tlevel = 1
                exp_image = '@08@' col_image = '@08@' )
              FOR <flight_entry> IN connid_group
              ( key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key )
                relatkey = lv_connid_key
                text = |Flight: { <flight_entry>-fldate DATE = USER } (Seats: { <flight_entry>-seatsocc }/{ <flight_entry>-max_seats })|
                tlevel = 2
                exp_image = '@09@' col_image = '@09@' )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Baumstruktur (Knotentabelle) aus `sflights` generiert und die Knoten für Fluggesellschaften und Verbindungen basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge, die sie enthalten, mit unterschiedlichen Icons versieht (z.B. mehr als 10 Flüge -> spezielles Icon).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `COND` um die Icon-Zuweisung basierend auf aggregierten Werten vorzunehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_icon_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_node,
             key       TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey  TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             tlevel    TYPE lvc_level,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             col_image TYPE lvc_image,
           END OF ty_s_node.
    TYPES: ty_t_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_sflight_icon_tree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE ty_t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_icon_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sflight_icon_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR <carrid_group> IN GROUP BY carrid OF lt_sflights GROUP AS carrid_group
      ( LET lv_carrid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key )
            lv_carrid_flights = lines( <carrid_group> ) IN
        VALUE #( 
          ( key = lv_carrid_key
            text = |Airline: { <carrid_group>-carrid } ({ lv_carrid_flights } Flüge)|
            tlevel = 0
            exp_image = COND lvc_image( WHEN lv_carrid_flights > 10 THEN '@11@' ELSE '@08@' ) " Special icon for many flights
            col_image = COND lvc_image( WHEN lv_carrid_flights > 10 THEN '@11@' ELSE '@08@' ) )
          FOR <connid_group> IN GROUP BY connid OF <carrid_group> GROUP AS connid_group
          ( LET lv_connid_key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key )
                lv_connid_flights = lines( <connid_group> ) IN
            VALUE #( 
              ( key = lv_connid_key
                relatkey = lv_carrid_key
                text = |Connection: { <connid_group>-connid } ({ lv_connid_flights } Flüge)|
                tlevel = 1
                exp_image = COND lvc_image( WHEN lv_connid_flights > 5 THEN '@11@' ELSE '@08@' )
                col_image = COND lvc_image( WHEN lv_connid_flights > 5 THEN '@11@' ELSE '@08@' ) )
              FOR <flight_entry> IN <connid_group>
              ( key = CONV string( ++lv_node_key )
                relatkey = lv_connid_key
                text = |Flight: { <flight_entry>-fldate DATE = USER }|
                tlevel = 2
                exp_image = '@09@' col_image = '@09@' )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_build_sflight_icon_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_sflight_icon_tree.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_icon_tree( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->build_sflight_icon_tree( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_nodes
      msg = 'Node table should not be empty if sflights data exists'
      _is_not_initial = abap_true
    ).

    " Check for a level 0 node (Airline) and verify its icon based on flight count
    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_airline_node) WHERE tlevel = 0.
      DATA(lv_flight_count_str) = substring( val = ls_airline_node-text off = find( val = ls_airline_node-text sub = '(' ) + 1 len = find( val = ls_airline_node-text sub = ' ' off = find( val = ls_airline_node-text sub = '(' ) + 1 ) - find( val = ls_airline_node-text sub = '(' ) - 1 ).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = CONV i( lv_flight_count_str ).

      IF lv_flight_count > 10.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_airline_node-exp_image
          exp = '@11@'
          msg = |Airline { ls_airline_node-text } should have special icon for >10 flights|
        ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_airline_node-exp_image
          exp = '@08@'
          msg = |Airline { ls_airline_node-text } should have default icon for <=10 flights|
        ).
      ENDIF.
      EXIT. " Test only one airline for icon logic
    ENDLOOP.

    " Similar checks could be added for level 1 nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Zuweisung von Icons zu Baumknoten basierend auf aggregierten Daten. Mittels `LET`-Expression innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife wird die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Verbindung ermittelt. Die `COND`-Expression wird dann verwendet, um basierend auf dieser Anzahl unterschiedliche Icons zuzuweisen. Dies zeigt eine leistungsstarke Kombination moderner ABAP-Features zur Datenverarbeitung und GUI-Konfiguration. Der Unit-Test überprüft, ob die Icons für Fluggesellschaftsknoten korrekt basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge zugewiesen werden.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und eine maximale Kapazität von mehr als 200 Passagieren haben. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( flight-seatsmax > 200 )
                           ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                             connid   = flight-connid
                             fldate   = flight-fldate
                             seatsmax = flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats IMPORTING iv_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityfrom = @iv_city
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_seats( 'NEW YORK' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von NEW YORK mit seatsmax > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total seats should not be zero' act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
    " Zusätzlicher Test mit einer Stadt, die keine Flüge hat (oder keine mit seatsmax > 0)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats for unknown city should be zero' act = lo_cut->get_total_seats( 'UNKNOWN' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung. Er ist eine funktionale Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... SUM` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_berlin_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_berlin_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityfrom = 'BERLIN'
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

unit_test:

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) in einer ABAP-Klasse. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Setter-Methoden, die jeweils die Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben.
hint: Jede Setter-Methode sollte `ME` zurückgeben, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chain_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS set_value1 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chain_builder.
    METHODS set_value2 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chain_builder.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chain_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_chain_builder( ).

    lo_builder->set_value1( 'Hello' )->set_value2( 123 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_builder->mv_value1 exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_builder->mv_value2 exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile kombiniert werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode die Instanz des Objekts (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Preisbereich eines Fluges basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator für mehrere Bedingungen.
hint: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price_range) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_range.
    rv_price_range = SWITCH string( iv_carrid
                                     WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Hochpreisig'
                                     WHEN 'AA' THEN 'Mittelpreisig'
                                     WHEN 'UA' THEN 'Mittelpreisig'
                                     ELSE 'Standard' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_range( 'LH' ) exp = 'Hochpreisig' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_range( 'AA' ) exp = 'Mittelpreisig' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_range( 'UA' ) exp = 'Mittelpreisig' ).

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Möglichkeit, einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zuzuweisen. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `CASE`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Klarheit des Codes, insbesondere bei vielen Verzweigungen.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Operator, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, wobei die Flugnummern um 100 erhöht werden. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und einer Transformation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... ( field = expression ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_original_flights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_original_flights
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             connid = flight-connid + 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transformed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_transformed_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connid should be greater than 100' act = ( ls_flight-connid > 100 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht nicht nur das Filtern, sondern auch das Transformieren von Daten beim Erstellen einer neuen internen Tabelle. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode, um Daten zu manipulieren.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine Methode, um eine Konstante aus `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS` zu validieren. Die Methode soll `true` zurückgeben, wenn der übergebene Wert der Konstante für den Dokumententyp 'Bestellung' entspricht.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_const_valid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

  METHOD is_po_document_type.
    IF iv_doc_type = cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_document_type-purchase_order.

    ELSE.
      rb_is_po = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Standardmethode (Default-Methode), die eine generische Funktionalität bereitstellt. Implementieren Sie das Interface in zwei Klassen, wobei eine Klasse die Standardimplementierung überschreibt und die andere sie verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Syntax 'DEFAULT METHODS' im Interface und 'REDEFINITION' in der Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.

  METHODS get_log_prefix
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_prefix) TYPE string
    DEFAULT 'DEFAULT_LOG'. " ABAP 7.50+
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = zif_logger~get_log_prefix( ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |{ lv_prefix }: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = zif_logger~get_log_prefix( ).
    " Simulate writing to a file
    cl_demo_output=>display( |FILE_LOG: { lv_prefix }: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_logger~get_log_prefix.
    rv_prefix = 'FILE_PREFIX'. " Override default
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_override_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_method.
    DATA(lo_logger) = CAST zif_logger( NEW zcl_console_logger( ) ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for console' ).
    " No direct assert for cl_demo_output, but we can check the prefix logic
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_logger->get_log_prefix( )
      exp = 'DEFAULT_LOG'
      msg = 'Default prefix should be used'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_override_method.
    DATA(lo_logger) = CAST zif_logger( NEW zcl_file_logger( ) ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for file' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_logger->get_log_prefix( )
      exp = 'FILE_PREFIX'
      msg = 'Overridden prefix should be used'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Default-Methoden in Interfaces (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglichen es, eine Standardimplementierung für Methoden direkt im Interface zu definieren. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code in implementierenden Klassen und erleichtert die Erweiterung von Interfaces, ohne bestehende Implementierungen brechen zu müssen.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT METHODS, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Strategie-Muster, um verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien für eine Liste von Zahlen zu ermöglichen. Nutzen Sie ein Interface und verarbeiten Sie die Zahlenliste mit einer modernen FOR-Iteration.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für die Strategie und verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator für die Listenverarbeitung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculation_strategy.
  METHODS calculate
    IMPORTING
      it_numbers TYPE i_table
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sum_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ). " ABAP 7.40+
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    rv_result = lv_sum / lines( it_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE i_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_calculation.
    rv_result = mo_strategy->calculate( it_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_strategy FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_strategy FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_strategy.
    DATA(lo_sum_strategy) = NEW zcl_sum_strategy( ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( lo_sum_strategy ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 6 msg = 'Sum calculation failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_strategy.
    DATA(lo_avg_strategy) = NEW zcl_avg_strategy( ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( lo_avg_strategy ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 20 msg = 'Average calculation failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_avg_strategy) = NEW zcl_avg_strategy( ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( lo_avg_strategy ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Average of empty list should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster nutzt Interfaces, um austauschbare Algorithmen zu definieren. In Kombination mit modernen ABAP-Features wie dem REDUCE-Operator für die interne Tabellenverarbeitung wird der Code kompakt, lesbar und wartbar.
keywords: INTERFACE, Strategy Pattern, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Dependency Injection mittels Constructor Injection unter Verwendung eines Interfaces, um eine Service-Klasse von ihrer Implementierung zu entkoppeln. Die Service-Klasse soll eine einfache Datenbeschaffung simulieren.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für den Service und übergeben Sie die Implementierung im Konstruktor der abhängigen Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider.
  METHODS get_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_db_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    " Simulate data retrieval from DB (e.g., SFLIGHTS)
    SELECT FROM sflight FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).
    rt_data = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight ( |{ sflight_line-carrid }-{ sflight_line-connid }-{ sflight_line-fldate }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    rt_data = VALUE string_table( ( 'Mock Data 1' ) ( 'Mock Data 2' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
    METHODS process_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_provider = io_data_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = mo_data_provider->get_data( ).
    " Simulate some processing, e.g., converting to uppercase
    rt_processed_data = VALUE string_table( FOR raw_line IN lt_raw_data ( to_upper( raw_line ) ) ). " ABAP 7.40+
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_with_db_provider FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_mock_provider FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_db_provider.
    DATA(lo_db_provider) = NEW zcl_db_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_app_service) = NEW zcl_application_service( lo_db_provider ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_app_service->process_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should not be initial with DB provider' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 lines from SFLIGHT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_mock_provider.
    DATA(lo_mock_provider) = NEW zcl_mock_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_app_service) = NEW zcl_application_service( lo_mock_provider ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_app_service->process_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 lines from Mock provider' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'MOCK DATA 1' msg = 'First mock data line incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dependency Injection (DI) durch Interfaces fördert lose Kopplung und Testbarkeit. Die abhängige Klasse (zcl_application_service) kennt nur das Interface (zif_data_provider), nicht die konkrete Implementierung. Dies ermöglicht den einfachen Austausch von Implementierungen, z.B. für Unit Tests mit Mock-Objekten. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie VALUE und to_upper() verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: INTERFACE, Dependency Injection, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, ABAP 7.40, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem HTML-formatierten Body und einem einfachen Text-Anhang. Nutzen Sie CL_BCS_CONVERT, um den HTML-Body und den Anhang vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_BCS für die E-Mail-Erstellung und CL_BCS_CONVERT für die Konvertierung von STRING zu SOLIX für Body und Anhang.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_html_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_html_body       TYPE string
        iv_attachment_name TYPE so_obj_nam
        iv_attachment_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_html_email_with_attachment.
    DATA: lo_bcs         TYPE REF TO cl_bcs,
          lo_document    TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs,
          lo_recipient   TYPE REF TO if_recipient_bcs,
          lo_send_request TYPE REF TO cl_bcs_send_request.

    TRY.
        " Create send request
        lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        " Create document with HTML body
        DATA(lt_html_content) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
          i_string = iv_html_body
          i_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        ).
        lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'HTM'
          i_text    = 'HTML Email'
          i_subject = iv_subject
          i_length  = xstrlen( lt_html_content )
          i_contents_hex = lt_html_content
        ).

        " Add attachment
        DATA(lt_attachment_content) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
          i_string = iv_attachment_text
          i_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        ).
        lo_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
          i_attachment_subject = iv_attachment_name
          i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lt_attachment_content )
          i_att_content_hex    = lt_attachment_content
        ).

        " Add document to send request
        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        " Add recipient
        lo_recipient = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        " Set send options
        lo_send_request = lo_bcs->get_send_request( ).
        lo_send_request->set_status_attributes(
          i_requested_status = 'N' " No status mail
          i_status_mail      = 'N'
        ).

        " Send email
        lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
        COMMIT WORK.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Error sending email: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface, das Typdefinitionen und Konstanten enthält. Zeigen Sie, wie diese Typen und Konstanten in einer implementierenden Klasse verwendet werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Anweisungen TYPES und CONSTANTS innerhalb des INTERFACE-Blocks.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_app_constants.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status,
           code TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           text TYPE string,
         END OF ty_status.

  CONSTANTS: gc_status_active  TYPE ty_status VALUE 'A' && 'Active',
             gc_status_inactive TYPE ty_status VALUE 'I' && 'Inactive'.

  CONSTANTS: gc_max_retries TYPE i VALUE 3.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_app_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_app_constants.

    METHODS process_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_item_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_item.
    IF iv_item_id IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_status_text = zif_app_constants~gc_status_active-text.
      cl_demo_output=>display( |Processing item { iv_item_id } with max retries: { zif_app_constants~gc_max_retries }| ).
    ELSE.
      rv_status_text = zif_app_constants~gc_status_inactive-text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit mehreren Anhängen unterschiedlichen Typs (z.B. Text und HTML). Nutzen Sie CL_BCS_CONVERT, um die Inhalte der Anhänge vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode ADD_ATTACHMENT des Dokumentobjekts für jeden Anhang und CL_BCS_CONVERT für die Konvertierung der Inhalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_attach_email_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_multiple_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_body_text       TYPE string
        it_attachments     TYPE zif_multi_attach_email_sender=>ty_attachments.

  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment,
           name    TYPE so_obj_nam,
           type    TYPE so_obj_tp,
           content TYPE string,
         END OF ty_attachment,
         ty_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_attach_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_multiple_attachments.
    DATA: lo_bcs         TYPE REF TO cl_bcs,
          lo_document    TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs,
          lo_recipient   TYPE REF TO if_recipient_bcs,
          lo_send_request TYPE REF TO cl_bcs_send_request.

    TRY.
        lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        " Create main document (plain text body)
        DATA(lt_body_content) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
          i_string = iv_body_text
          i_codepage = '4103'
        ).
        lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = 'Email Body'
          i_subject = iv_subject
          i_length  = xstrlen( lt_body_content )
          i_contents_hex = lt_body_content
        ).

        " Add multiple attachments
        LOOP AT it_attachments INTO DATA(ls_attachment).
          DATA(lt_attach_content) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
            i_string = ls_attachment-content
            i_codepage = '4103'
          ).
          lo_document->add_attachment(
            i_attachment_type    = ls_attachment-type
            i_attachment_subject = ls_attachment-name
            i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lt_attach_content )
            i_att_content_hex    = lt_attach_content
          ).
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        lo_recipient = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_send_request = lo_bcs->get_send_request( ).
        lo_send_request->set_status_attributes(
          i_requested_status = 'N'
          i_status_mail      = 'N'
        ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
        COMMIT WORK.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Error sending email: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie in ABAP, indem Sie ein Interface verwenden, das von mehreren Klassen implementiert wird. Erstellen Sie Objekte dieser Klassen und rufen Sie eine gemeinsame Methode über eine Interface-Referenz auf. Nutzen Sie den NEW-Operator für die Objekterzeugung.
hint: Deklarieren Sie eine Referenzvariable vom Typ des Interfaces und weisen Sie ihr Instanzen der implementierenden Klassen zu.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS calculate_area
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE decfloat16
        iv_width  TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width  = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_areas) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    rt_areas = VALUE #( FOR shape IN it_shapes ( shape->calculate_area( ) ) ). " ABAP 7.40+
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_circle)    = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '7.0' ).
    DATA(lo_rectangle) = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '5.0' iv_width = '10.0' ).

    DATA(lt_shapes) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( lo_circle )
      ( lo_rectangle )
    ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_areas) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_areas ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 areas' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_areas[ 1 ] exp = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * '49.0' msg = 'Circle area incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_areas[ 2 ] exp = '50.0' msg = 'Rectangle area incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_shapes.
    DATA(lt_shapes) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_areas) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_areas msg = 'Areas should be initial for empty shape list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Polymorphie, ermöglicht durch Interfaces, erlaubt es, Objekte verschiedener Klassen über eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle zu behandeln. Dies fördert flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen. Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail und implementieren Sie eine grundlegende Fehlerbehandlung für mögliche Ausnahmen, die während des E-Mail-Versands auftreten können. Nutzen Sie CL_BCS und CL_BCS_CONVERT.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Fehlerbehandlung und fangen Sie die Ausnahme CX_BCS ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_sender_with_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_simple_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_body_text       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_sender_with_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_simple_email.
    DATA: lo_bcs         TYPE REF TO cl_bcs,
          lo_document    TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs,
          lo_recipient   TYPE REF TO if_recipient_bcs.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        DATA(lt_body_content) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
          i_string = iv_body_text
          i_codepage = '4103'
        ).
        lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = 'Simple Email'
          i_subject = iv_subject
          i_length  = xstrlen( lt_body_content )
          i_contents_hex = lt_body_content
        ).

        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        lo_recipient = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Error sending email: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_send FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_send FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_send.
    DATA(lo_sender) = NEW zcl_email_sender_with_error( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'success@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Successful Test Email'.
    DATA(lv_body_text) = 'This email should be sent successfully.'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_sender->send_simple_email(
      iv_recipient_email = lv_recipient
      iv_subject         = lv_subject
      iv_body_text       = lv_body_text
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Email send should be successful' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_send.
    " To simulate a failed send, we would typically need to mock the BCS classes
    " or configure the system to intentionally fail. For a simple unit test,
    " we can't easily trigger a CX_BCS without system-level changes.
    " However, we can test the error handling path if an exception *were* to occur.
    " For this example, we'll assume a valid recipient for now.
    DATA(lo_sender) = NEW zcl_email_sender_with_error( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'invalid-email-address'. " This might trigger an error in a real system
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Failed Test Email'.
    DATA(lv_body_text) = 'This email might fail.'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_sender->send_simple_email(
      iv_recipient_email = lv_recipient
      iv_subject         = lv_subject
      iv_body_text       = lv_body_text
    ).
    " Depending on system config, this might still return true if the error is async.
    " A robust test would involve mocking CL_BCS to throw CX_BCS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Error handling path executed (result depends on system config)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine robuste Anwendung erfordert eine angemessene Fehlerbehandlung. Beim E-Mail-Versand mit CL_BCS können verschiedene Ausnahmen (CX_BCS) auftreten. Die Verwendung von TRY...CATCH-Blöcken ermöglicht es, diese Fehler abzufangen, zu protokollieren und angemessen darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. ROLLBACK WORK ist wichtig, um inkonsistente Zustände zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Factory-Muster unter Verwendung eines Interfaces, um die Erzeugung von Objekten zu entkoppeln. Die Factory-Methode soll verschiedene Implementierungen eines Produkts basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zurückgeben. Nutzen Sie den NEW-Operator mit Typinferenz.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Produkt-Interface und eine Factory-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die Instanzen der konkreten Produkte zurückgibt.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_static_check=>default_message
            text   = |Unknown product type: { iv_product_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' msg = 'Product A name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine globale Variable für die Andockposition und `COND` oder `SWITCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dock_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_dynamic_docking IMPORTING iv_side TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA mv_side TYPE i.
    CLASS-DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    CLASS-DATA mo_textedit        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    CLASS-METHODS handle_pbo EVENT HANDLER for cl_gui_container=>pbo.
    CLASS-METHODS handle_pai EVENT HANDLER for cl_gui_container=>pai.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_docking.
    mv_side = iv_side.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_dock_side) = COND i(
        WHEN mv_side = 1 THEN cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        WHEN mv_side = 2 THEN cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_right
        ELSE cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
      ).

      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = lv_dock_side
          extension = 200.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container.

      mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( |Docked at { SWITCH string( lv_dock_side )
                                          WHEN cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left THEN 'Left'
                                          WHEN cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_right THEN 'Right'
                                          ELSE 'Unknown' }| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANC'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_read_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_and_read_text.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.

    DATA mo_button_read     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS handle_read_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_read_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_and_read_text.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 300.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container.
      mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( 'Dies ist ein Beispieltext.' ).

      CREATE OBJECT mo_button_read
        EXPORTING
          parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0
          left   = 10
          top    = 10
          width  = 20
          height = 2.
      mo_button_read->set_text( 'Text auslesen' ).
      SET HANDLER handle_read_click FOR mo_button_read.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANC'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_read_click.
    DATA(lt_text_lines) = mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( ).
    DATA(lv_full_text) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN lt_text_lines
      NEXT s = s && <line> && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).
    MESSAGE lv_full_text TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container und versuchen Sie, ein Control mit einem ungültigen Parent zu instanziieren, um die Exception-Behandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` zu demonstrieren.
hint: Instanziieren Sie ein Control mit einem `INITIAL` Parent und fangen Sie die `CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dock_error_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_error_handling.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    METHODS handle_pbo EVENT HANDLER for cl_gui_container=>pbo.
    METHODS handle_pai EVENT HANDLER for cl_gui_container=>pai.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_error_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_error_handling.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 200.

      TRY.
          " Versuch, ein TextEdit-Control mit einem INITIAL Parent zu erstellen
          DATA(lo_faulty_textedit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
            parent = CAST cl_gui_container( INITIAL )
          ).
          " Diese Zeile sollte nicht erreicht werden
          MESSAGE 'Fehler: Control unerwartet erstellt.' TYPE 'E'.
        CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          " Fehler erfolgreich abgefangen
          DATA(lv_error_message) = lx_error->get_text( ).
          mo_docking_container->set_caption( |Fehler abgefangen: { lv_error_message }| ).
          mo_docking_container->flush( ).
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
          " Andere unerwartete Fehler

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_picture_mode DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_picture_mode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_picture_mode.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 400.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_picture
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container.

      mo_picture->load_picture_from_url( 'SAP_AG/MIMES/SAP_UI/sap_logo.gif' ).
      mo_picture->set_display_mode( mv_current_mode ).

      CREATE OBJECT mo_button_mode
        EXPORTING
          parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0
          left   = 10
          top    = 10
          width  = 25
          height = 2.
      mo_button_mode->set_text( 'Anzeigemodus umschalten' ).
      SET HANDLER handle_mode_click FOR mo_button_mode.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANC'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_mode_click.
    mv_current_mode = COND #( WHEN mv_current_mode = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_normal THEN cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch
                               WHEN mv_current_mode = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch THEN cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_tile
                               ELSE cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_normal ).
    mo_picture->set_display_mode( mv_current_mode ).
    mo_picture->flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dock_word_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_and_count_words.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_textedit        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_button_count    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS handle_pai EVENT HANDLER for cl_gui_container=>pai.
    METHODS handle_count_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_word_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_and_count_words.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 300.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container.
      mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( 'Dies ist ein kurzer Text zum Zählen der Wörter.' ).

      CREATE OBJECT mo_button_count
        EXPORTING
          parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0
          left   = 10
          top    = 10
          width  = 25
          height = 2.
      mo_button_count->set_text( 'Wörter zählen' ).
      SET HANDLER handle_count_click FOR mo_button_count.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANC'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_count_click.
    DATA(lt_text_lines) = mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( ).
    DATA(lv_full_text) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN lt_text_lines
      NEXT s = s && <line> && ` ` " Wörter durch Leerzeichen trennen
    ).

    DATA(lv_word_count) = 0.
    IF lv_full_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      SPLIT lv_full_text AT ` ` INTO TABLE DATA(lt_words).
      DELETE lt_words WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
      lv_word_count = lines( lt_words ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_docking_container->set_caption( |Wortanzahl: { lv_word_count }| ).
    mo_docking_container->flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_available_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_available_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carr_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carr_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carr_flight_count( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                         flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um periodisch eine Methode aufzurufen. Diese Methode soll eine Liste von Flugnummern aus `sflights` in Großbuchstaben umwandeln und zurückgeben. Der Unit-Test soll die Logik der getriggerten Methode direkt testen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und eine `FOR` Expression. Testen Sie die Logik separat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_for_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_processed_carrids TYPE tt_carrid.

    METHODS process_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_upper_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_for_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 5. " 5 seconds
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    " In a real scenario, this would update a global attribute or trigger further processing
    mt_processed_carrids = process_flight_data( ).
    " For demonstration, we just process and store. In a GUI, this would update the screen.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_upper_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                ( CONV s_carr_id( to_upper( ls_flight-carrid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um periodisch eine Methode aufzurufen. Diese Methode soll die Summe der Flugdauern (FLTIME) aller Flüge aus `sflights` berechnen. Der Unit-Test soll die Logik der getriggerten Methode direkt testen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und eine `REDUCE` Expression. Testen Sie die Logik separat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_reduce_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_total_flight_time TYPE i.

    METHODS calculate_total_flight_time RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_time) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_reduce_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 10. " 10 seconds
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_total_flight_time = calculate_total_flight_time( ).
    " In a GUI, this would typically update a display element.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_flight_time.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_time = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-fltime ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Directly call the logic method that the timer would trigger

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ). " Expecting 0 for empty sflights in unit test
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `calculate_total_flight_time` nutzt die `REDUCE` Expression, um die Summe der Flugdauern effizient zu berechnen. Der Unit-Test testet die Kernlogik unabhängig vom GUI-Timer.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die verkettet werden können, um Flüge nach Abflugort zu filtern und dann deren Flugnummern zu extrahieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ME->` und `RETURN VALUE(ME)` für Method Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflights.
    METHODS filter_by_departure IMPORTING iv_airpfrom TYPE s_airpfrom
                                  RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_processor.
    METHODS get_carrids RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_current_sflights TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_current_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_departure.
    ro_me = me.
    mt_current_sflights = FILTER #( mt_current_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE airpfrom = iv_airpfrom ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrids.
    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_current_sflights
                          ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_processor=>tt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' airpfrom = 'FRA' airpto = 'JFK' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' airpfrom = 'JFK' airpto = 'LAX' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' airpfrom = 'FRA' airpto = 'MUC' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lt_result_carrids) = lo_processor->filter_by_departure( 'FRA' )->get_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_carrids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_carrids[1] exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe hintereinander ausgeführt werden können. Dies wird durch das Zurückgeben einer Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`RETURN VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_processor`) in den Methoden erreicht. `FILTER` und `VALUE` Expressions werden für die Datenmanipulation verwendet.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Internal Tables, Fluent Interface, FILTER, VALUE

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie für jeden Flug eine formatierte Zeile aus, die die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Abflugort enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei `LOOP AT` und String Templates.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT` mit `INTO DATA()` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_string_tmpl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flight_list RETURNING VALUE(rt_output_lines) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_string_tmpl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_list.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } von { ls_flight-airpfrom }| TO rt_output_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
