Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, die unterschiedliche Feldnamen, aber logisch korrespondierende Inhalte haben. Verwenden Sie hierfür `cl_abap_corresponding`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding=>create` und die Methode `map` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             item_id     TYPE i,
             item_name   TYPE string,
             item_value  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structures.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = is_source
      destination = rs_target
      mapping     = VALUE cl_abap_corresponding=>mapping_table_type(
        ( source = 'ID'     destination = 'ITEM_ID' )
        ( source = 'NAME'   destination = 'ITEM_NAME' )
        ( source = 'AMOUNT' destination = 'ITEM_VALUE' )
      )
    ).
    lo_corresponding->map( EXPORTING source = is_source CHANGING destination = rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structures.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_corr_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_dyn_corr_struct=>ty_source( id = 1 name = 'Test Item' amount = '123.45' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structures( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-item_id    exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-item_name  exp = 'Test Item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-item_value exp = '123.45' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_corresponding` ermöglicht eine flexible und dynamische Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen. Durch die explizite `mapping`-Tabelle können Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen einfach zugeordnet werden, was den Code wartbarer und lesbarer macht als manuelle Zuweisungen.
keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, dynamic mapping, structure, mapping

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, wobei spezifische Feldnamen explizit gemappt werden müssen. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights` als Quelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` mit der `MAPPING` Option und der Methode `map_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             airline_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date  TYPE s_date,
             price_value  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_reduced) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = NEW sflight( )
      destination = NEW ty_sflight_reduced( )
      mapping     = VALUE cl_abap_corresponding=>mapping_table_type(
        ( source = 'CARRID'   destination = 'AIRLINE_ID' )
        ( source = 'CONNID'   destination = 'CONNECTION_ID' )
        ( source = 'FLDATE'   destination = 'FLIGHT_DATE' )
        ( source = 'PRICE'    destination = 'PRICE_VALUE' )
      )
    ).
    lo_corresponding->map_table( EXPORTING source = it_sflights CHANGING destination = rt_sflights_reduced ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_corr_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_reduced) = lo_cut->map_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_reduced ) exp = lines( lt_sflights ) ).
    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_reduced[ 1 ]-airline_id    exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_reduced[ 1 ]-connection_id exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `map_table` von `cl_abap_corresponding` ermöglicht die effiziente Zuweisung von Daten zwischen internen Tabellen, selbst wenn die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind. Dies ist besonders nützlich beim Umstrukturieren von Daten oder beim Anpassen an Schnittstellen. Die explizite `MAPPING`-Option sorgt für Klarheit bei der Feldzuordnung.
keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, dynamic mapping, internal table, mapping, sflights

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, wobei sowohl `MAPPING` als auch `EXCEPT` gleichzeitig verwendet werden, um eine präzise Kontrolle über die Feldzuweisung zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle `sflights` als Quelle.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die Optionen `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` in der `create`-Methode von `cl_abap_corresponding`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_map_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_custom,
             airline_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num   TYPE s_conn_id,
             departure_date TYPE s_date,
             currency_code TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_custom.
    TYPES tt_sflight_custom TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_custom WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights_custom
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_custom) TYPE tt_sflight_custom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_map_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights_custom.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = NEW sflight( )
      destination = NEW ty_sflight_custom( )
      mapping     = VALUE cl_abap_corresponding=>mapping_table_type(
        ( source = 'CARRID'   destination = 'AIRLINE_ID' )
        ( source = 'CONNID'   destination = 'FLIGHT_NUM' )
        ( source = 'FLDATE'   destination = 'DEPARTURE_DATE' )
      )
      except      = VALUE cl_abap_corresponding=>except_table_type(
        ( 'PRICE' ) " Exclude price, as it's not in target or mapped differently
        ( 'PLANETYPE' ) " Exclude planetype
      )
    ).
    lo_corresponding->map_table( EXPORTING source = it_sflights CHANGING destination = rt_sflights_custom ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_sflights_custom.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_corr_map_except( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_custom) = lo_cut->map_sflights_custom( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_custom ) exp = lines( lt_sflights ) ).
    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_custom[ 1 ]-airline_id     exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_custom[ 1 ]-flight_num     exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_custom[ 1 ]-departure_date exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sflights_custom[ 1 ]-currency_code ). " Not mapped, should be initial
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_dynamic_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA lt_mapping TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>mapping_table_type.

    IF lines( it_source_fields ) >= 2.
      APPEND VALUE #( source = it_source_fields[ 1 ] destination = 'FIELD_A' ) TO lt_mapping.
      APPEND VALUE #( source = it_source_fields[ 2 ] destination = 'FIELD_B' ) TO lt_mapping.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = NEW sflight( )
      destination = NEW ty_dynamic_target( )
      mapping     = lt_mapping
    ).
    lo_corresponding->map_table( EXPORTING source = it_sflights CHANGING destination = rt_dynamic_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den niedrigsten Flugpreis (PRICE) in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_min_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT min_price TYPE sflight-price = lt_sflights[1]-price " Initialize with first flight's price
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT min_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price )
      ).
    ELSE.
      rv_min_price = 0. " Return 0 or handle error if table is empty
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_min_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_price.
    " Setup: Ensure sflight has data for the test
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      " Insert dummy data if sflight is empty for testing purposes
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'BB' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = lo_cut->get_min_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_min_price >= 0 ).
    " A stronger test would involve mocking sflight data or knowing expected min
    IF lv_min_price = 50.00.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min_price exp = '50.00' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Zufallszahlen und sortieren Sie die Tabelle danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shuffle_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shuffled_sflight,
             random_key TYPE i,
             flight     TYPE sflight,
           END OF ty_shuffled_sflight.
    DATA lt_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shuffled_sflight.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 1000000 ). " Large range for better randomness

    LOOP AT ct_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND VALUE ty_shuffled_sflight(
        random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
        flight     = ls_flight
      ) TO lt_shuffled.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_shuffled BY random_key.

    CLEAR ct_sflights.
    LOOP AT lt_shuffled INTO DATA(ls_shuffled_entry).
      APPEND ls_shuffled_entry-flight TO ct_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA lt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0403' fldate = sy-datum price = '90.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    DATA lt_shuffled_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    lt_shuffled_flights = lt_original_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shuffle_table( ).
    lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_shuffled_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_flights ) exp = lines( lt_original_flights ) ).
    " It's hard to assert true randomness, but we can check if it's likely shuffled
    " by comparing the first entry, which should be different most of the time.
    " This is a weak assertion for randomness but confirms the process ran.
    IF lines( lt_original_flights ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled_flights[1] exp = lt_original_flights[1] ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Mischen einer Tabelle erfolgt, indem jedem Eintrag ein zufälliger Schlüssel zugewiesen und die Tabelle dann nach diesem Schlüssel sortiert wird. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um eine zufällige Reihenfolge zu erzielen.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Shuffle, Sort

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lv_date_from) = CONV d( |{ iv_year_from }0101| ).
    DATA(lv_date_to)   = CONV d( |{ iv_year_to }1231| ).

    DATA(lv_days_from) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between(

      iv_date2 = lv_date_from
    ).
    DATA(lv_days_to) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between(
      iv_date1 = '00000000'
      iv_date2 = lv_date_to

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = lv_days_from
      max = lv_days_to
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days(
      iv_date = '00000000'
      iv_days = lv_random_days
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_chars_len - 1 ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Wählen Sie N zufällige, eindeutige Einträge aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Mischen Sie die Tabelle und nehmen Sie die ersten N Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_n_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_n_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_n_random_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_shuffle_table( ). " Reusing the shuffle logic
      lo_shuffler->shuffle_sflights( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) UP TO iv_count ROWS.
        APPEND ls_flight TO rt_random_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_n_random_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_n_random_flights.
    " Setup: Ensure sflight has enough data
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    IF lines( lt_sflights ) < 5.
      " Insert dummy data if sflight has less than 5 entries
      DO 5 TIMES.
        INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = sy-index fldate = sy-datum price = ( sy-index * 100 ) currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_n_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_n_random_flights( iv_count = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    " Check for uniqueness (weak assertion, but better than nothing)
    DATA(lv_unique_lines) = lines( NEW HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate FOR lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_lines exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um N zufällige, eindeutige Einträge zu erhalten, wird die gesamte Tabelle zuerst zufällig gemischt und dann die ersten N Einträge entnommen. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, wenn die Anzahl der benötigten Einträge im Verhältnis zur Gesamtgröße der Tabelle klein ist.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Selection, Shuffle, Unique

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den kleineren von zwei Werten und geben Sie einen entsprechenden Text zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `MIN`-Operator in Kombination mit einem String-Template und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_value_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_value_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_value_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_value_text.
    DATA(lv_min) = MIN( iv_val1, iv_val2 ).
    rv_result_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_val1 = iv_val2 THEN |Beide Werte sind gleich: { lv_min }|
      WHEN lv_min = iv_val1 THEN |Der erste Wert ({ iv_val1 }) ist kleiner als der zweite Wert ({ iv_val2 }).|
      ELSE |Der zweite Wert ({ iv_val2 }) ist kleiner als der erste Wert ({ iv_val1 }).|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_min_value_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_value_text( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_min_value_text( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 5 ) exp = 'Der zweite Wert (5) ist kleiner als der erste Wert (10).').
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_min_value_text( iv_val1 = 2 iv_val2 = 7 ) exp = 'Der erste Wert (2) ist kleiner als der zweite Wert (7).').

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 10 Einträgen, die simulierte Temperaturmessungen enthalten. Jede Messung soll eine zufällige FLOAT-Temperatur zwischen einem konstanten Minimum und Maximum haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion, `VALUE` für die Initialisierung und `cl_abap_random_float`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_temp_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_temperature_reading,
        id          TYPE i,
        temperature TYPE f,
      END OF ty_temperature_reading,
      tt_temperature_readings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_temperature_reading WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_min_temp TYPE f VALUE 15.0,
      gc_max_temp TYPE f VALUE 30.0,
      gc_num_readings TYPE i VALUE 10.

    METHODS generate_readings RETURNING VALUE(rt_readings) TYPE tt_temperature_readings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_temp_data_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_readings.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_range) = gc_max_temp - gc_min_temp.

    rt_readings = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO gc_num_readings
                           ( id          = i
                             temperature = ( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_range ) + gc_min_temp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_readings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_readings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_temp_data_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_readings) = lo_cut->generate_readings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_readings ) exp = zcl_temp_data_gen=>gc_num_readings ).

    LOOP AT lt_readings INTO DATA(ls_reading).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( ls_reading-temperature >= zcl_temp_data_gen=>gc_min_temp AND
                                                  ls_reading-temperature < zcl_temp_data_gen=>gc_max_temp )
                                        iv_msg = |Temperature { ls_reading-temperature } out of range for ID { ls_reading-id }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Ausdrücken und dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung interner Tabellen. `cl_abap_random_float` wird verwendet, um realistische Zufallswerte innerhalb der durch `CLASS-CONSTANTS` definierten Grenzen zu erzeugen.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, VALUE, RANDOM, CONSTANTS, DATA GENERATION

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge (z.B. 10 Zeichen) unter Verwendung einer konstanten Menge erlaubter Zeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates, `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_random_float`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_allowed_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.

    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( gc_allowed_chars ).

    rv_random_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 TO iv_length
      NEXT s = s && gc_allowed_chars+floor( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_chars_len )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_random_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 15.
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = lv_length ).
    LOOP AT lv_random_string INTO DATA(lc_char).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( find( val = zcl_random_string_gen=>gc_allowed_chars sub = lc_char ) IS NOT INITIAL )
                                        iv_msg = |Character '{ lc_char }' not in allowed set.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit String-Templates ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Erzeugung des Zufallsstrings. `cl_abap_random_float` wählt zufällig Zeichen aus der konstanten Zeichenmenge aus, die in `gc_allowed_chars` definiert ist.
keywords: STRING TEMPLATES, REDUCE, RANDOM, CONSTANTS, STRING GENERATION

Instructions: Simulieren Sie ein Ereignis, das mit einer bestimmten Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 30%) eintritt. Die Wahrscheinlichkeit soll als Konstante definiert sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und eine `CLASS-CONSTANT` für die Wahrscheinlichkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_probability_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_success_probability TYPE f VALUE 0.3. " 30% chance of success

    METHODS simulate_event RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_probability_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_event.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    IF lo_random->get_next( ) < gc_success_probability.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simulate_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_probability_sim( ).
    DATA(lv_success_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 10000. " Run many iterations to approximate probability

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->simulate_event( ) = abap_true.
        lv_success_count = lv_success_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_actual_probability) = lv_success_count / lv_iterations.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( abs( lv_actual_probability - zcl_probability_sim=>gc_success_probability ) < 0.05 )
                                      iv_msg = |Actual probability { lv_actual_probability } not close to expected { zcl_probability_sim=>gc_success_probability }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_float` und einer `CLASS-CONSTANT` für die Wahrscheinlichkeit lässt sich die Simulation von zufälligen Ereignissen einfach und verständlich implementieren. Der Unit-Test führt eine große Anzahl von Simulationen durch, um die Annäherung an die erwartete Wahrscheinlichkeit zu überprüfen.
keywords: CONDITIONAL LOGIC, RANDOM, CONSTANTS, PROBABILITY, SIMULATION

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Singleton-Klasse, deren Instanzname durch eine Klassenkonstante definiert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS-METHODS` für die Singleton-Implementierung und `CLASS-CONSTANTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton_with_const DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_instance_name TYPE string VALUE 'SINGLETON_INSTANCE'.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_with_const.
    METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_with_const.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton_with_const IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Private constructor to prevent direct instantiation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      go_instance = NEW #( ).
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message.
    rv_message = |Hello from { gc_instance_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_singleton_instance FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_singleton_instance.
    DATA(lo_instance1) = zcl_singleton_with_const=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_instance2) = zcl_singleton_with_const=>get_instance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance1 exp = lo_instance2
                                      iv_msg = 'Instances are not the same (Singleton violation)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_message.
    DATA(lo_instance) = zcl_singleton_with_const=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_message) = |Hello from { zcl_singleton_with_const=>gc_instance_name }!|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance->get_message( ) exp = lv_expected_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Singleton-Pattern stellt sicher, dass eine Klasse nur eine Instanz hat. Hier wird der Name der Instanz über eine `CLASS-CONSTANT` definiert, was die Konfiguration zentralisiert. Die `CLASS-METHODS` und der private Konstruktor sind essenziell für die korrekte Implementierung des Patterns.
keywords: OBJECT ORIENTATION, SINGLETON, CONSTANTS, CLASS-METHODS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von N zufälligen Gleitkommazahlen, die zwischen 0.0 und 1.0 liegen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summation und `cl_abap_random_float`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_avg_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_avg_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF iv_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE f(
      INIT s = 0.0
      FOR i = 1 TO iv_count
      NEXT s = s + lo_random->get_next( ) ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / iv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_average_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_avg_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 10000.
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average( lv_count ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( abs( lv_average - 0.5 ) < 0.05 )
                                      iv_msg = |Calculated average { lv_average } not close to expected 0.5| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_average_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_avg_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal, um eine Summe über eine Schleife zu bilden, was hier für die Berechnung des Durchschnitts von Zufallszahlen genutzt wird. `cl_abap_random_float` liefert die notwendigen Zufallswerte. Dies ist eine funktionale und effiziente Art, solche Berechnungen durchzuführen.
keywords: MATH, REDUCE, RANDOM, AVERAGE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum, das zwischen einem konstanten Start- und Enddatum liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und Datum-Arithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_start_date TYPE d VALUE '20200101',
      gc_end_date   TYPE d VALUE '20251231'.

    METHODS generate_random_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_date.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_days_diff) = gc_end_date - gc_start_date.
    DATA(lv_random_days) = floor( lo_random->get_next( ) * ( lv_days_diff + 1 ) ).
    rv_random_date = gc_start_date + lv_random_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_random_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->generate_random_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( lv_random_date >= zcl_random_date_gen=>gc_start_date AND
                                                  lv_random_date <= zcl_random_date_gen=>gc_end_date )
                                      iv_msg = |Random date { lv_random_date } out of range.| ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme-Klasse, die Fehlercodes als Klassenkonstanten verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` für Fehlercodes und `cx_static_check` als Basisklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcx_app_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.

    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF gc_error_codes,
        invalid_input TYPE string VALUE 'INVALID_INPUT',
        data_not_found TYPE string VALUE 'DATA_NOT_FOUND',
      END OF gc_error_codes.

    DATA mv_error_code TYPE string.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        iv_error_code TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_app_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_error_code = iv_error_code.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_app_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_app_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_app_error=>gc_error_codes-invalid_input
          iv_error_code = zcx_app_error=>gc_error_codes-invalid_input.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate data not found
    IF iv_input = 'NOT_FOUND'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_app_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_app_error=>gc_error_codes-data_not_found
          iv_error_code = zcx_app_error=>gc_error_codes-data_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_app_error.
    METHODS test_data_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_app_error.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_app_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_app_error for invalid input' ).
      CATCH zcx_app_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->mv_error_code exp = zcx_app_error=>gc_error_codes-invalid_input ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_data_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( 'NOT_FOUND' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_app_error for data not found' ).
      CATCH zcx_app_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->mv_error_code exp = zcx_app_error=>gc_error_codes-data_not_found ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( 'VALID_DATA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'No exception expected for valid input' ).
      CATCH zcx_app_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception for valid input' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CLASS-CONSTANTS` innerhalb einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme-Klasse (`zcx_app_error`) ermöglicht die Definition von typsicheren und zentral verwalteten Fehlercodes. Dies verbessert die Konsistenz und Wartbarkeit der Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP-Anwendungen. Die Vererbung von `cx_static_check` stellt sicher, dass die Ausnahme zur Kompilierzeit geprüft wird.
keywords: ERROR HANDLING, EXCEPTIONS, CONSTANTS, CUSTOM EXCEPTION

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl vom Typ INTEGER innerhalb eines konstanten Bereichs (z.B. 1 bis 100).

CLASS zcl_random_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_random_int_gen IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, welcher früher oder später ist.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_tstmp1_earlier
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_earlier) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS is_tstmp1_later
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_later) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_tstmp1_earlier.
    IF iv_tstmp1 < iv_tstmp2.
      rv_earlier = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_earlier = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_tstmp1_later.
    IF iv_tstmp1 > iv_tstmp2.
      rv_later = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_later = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_tstmp1_earlier( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_early iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_late ) ).

Instructions: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler, um auf das `document_completed` Event des HTML-Viewers zu reagieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für das `document_completed` Event.
solution:
CLASS zcl_html_viewer_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS document_completed EXPORTING VALUE(e_url) TYPE string.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS display_html_and_register_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_html_content TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_html_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_html_viewer.
    METHODS handle_document_completed FOR EVENT document_completed OF cl_gui_html_viewer
      IMPORTING
        url.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_html_viewer = NEW cl_gui_html_viewer( parent = io_container ).
    SET HANDLER handle_document_completed FOR mo_html_viewer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_html_and_register_event.
    mo_html_viewer->load_data(
      EXPORTING
        url          = 'about:blank'
        type         = 'text'
        subtype      = 'html'
        size         = strlen( iv_html_content )
        data_table   = VALUE cl_gui_html_viewer=>html_table( ( iv_html_content ) )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error loading HTML content' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne, ob ein Zeitstempel in der Zukunft oder Vergangenheit liegt, relativ zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` und direkte Zeitstempel-Vergleiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_future_past DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_future
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS is_past
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_past) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_future_past IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_future.
    DATA lv_current_tstmp TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_tstmp.
    IF iv_tstmp > lv_current_tstmp.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_past.
    DATA lv_current_tstmp TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_tstmp.
    IF iv_tstmp < lv_current_tstmp.
      rv_is_past = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_past = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_past FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_past.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_future_past( ).
    DATA lv_current_tstmp TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_tstmp.

    DATA(lv_future_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = lv_current_tstmp amount = 10 unit = cl_abap_tstmp=>unit_seconds ).
    DATA(lv_past_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = lv_current_tstmp amount = -10 unit = cl_abap_tstmp=>unit_seconds ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_future( lv_future_tstmp ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_future( lv_past_tstmp ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_future( lv_current_tstmp ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_past( lv_past_tstmp ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_past( lv_future_tstmp ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_past( lv_current_tstmp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch den Vergleich eines Zeitstempels mit dem aktuellen Systemzeitstempel (`GET TIME STAMP FIELD`) können Sie einfach feststellen, ob ein Ereignis in der Zukunft oder Vergangenheit liegt. Dies nutzt die direkte Vergleichbarkeit von `TIMESTAMPL`-Typen.
keywords: TIMESTAMP, FUTURE, PAST, GET TIME STAMP, CONDITIONAL LOGIC, DATE/TIME

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro CARRID aus einer SORTED TABLE in eine neue interne Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit dem `REDUCE` Operator, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( BASE rt_carrier_counts
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    mt_test_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
                               ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
                               ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
                               ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' )
                               ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250105' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( mt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have 3 distinct carriers' act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH should have 2 flights' act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA should have 2 flights' act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE` Operator ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Methode zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP BY` fasst Zeilen mit gleichen Schlüsseln zusammen, und `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, über die Elemente jeder Gruppe zu iterieren und einen einzelnen Wert (hier die Anzahl der Flüge) zu berechnen. Dies ist deutlich lesbarer und oft performanter als traditionelle `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukte.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ct_flights.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_create_conn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_archivelink_connection
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE toav0-objtp
        iv_object_id   TYPE toav0-objid
        iv_doc_type    TYPE toav0-doctp
        iv_archive_id  TYPE toav0-archiv_id OPTIONAL
        iv_doc_id      TYPE toav0-docid OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_alink_create_conn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_archivelink_connection.
    DATA: lv_archive_id TYPE toav0-archiv_id VALUE 'A1',
          lv_doc_id     TYPE toav0-docid     VALUE 'TESTDOC123'.

    IF iv_archive_id IS SUPPLIED.
      lv_archive_id = iv_archive_id.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_doc_id IS SUPPLIED.
      lv_doc_id = iv_doc_id.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_alink_connection=>create_connection(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_type = iv_object_type
            i_object_id   = iv_object_id
            i_doc_type    = iv_doc_type
            i_archive_id  = lv_archive_id
            i_doc_id      = lv_doc_id
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        MESSAGE lx_alink_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_alink_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_read_conn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alink_connection,
             object_type TYPE toav0-objtp,
             object_id   TYPE toav0-objid,
             doc_type    TYPE toav0-doctp,
             archive_id  TYPE toav0-archiv_id,
             doc_id      TYPE toav0-docid,
           END OF ty_alink_connection.
    TYPES tt_alink_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alink_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connections
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE toav0-objtp
        iv_object_id   TYPE toav0-objid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE tt_alink_connections
      RAISING cx_alink_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_read_conn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections.
    DATA: lt_toav0 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF toav0.

    TRY.
        cl_alink_connection=>get_connections_for_object(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_type = iv_object_type
            i_object_id   = iv_object_id
          IMPORTING
            e_connections = lt_toav0
        ).

        rt_connections = VALUE #( FOR ls_toav0 IN lt_toav0
                                  ( object_type = ls_toav0-objtp,
                                    object_id   = ls_toav0-objid,
                                    doc_type    = ls_toav0-doctp,
                                    archive_id  = ls_toav0-archiv_id,
                                    doc_id      = ls_toav0-docid ) ).

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        MESSAGE lx_alink_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_alink_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_check_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS mit einem Cursor, um große Datenmengen effizient zu verarbeiten. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie Inline-Deklarationen und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` in Kombination mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
       WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_package) PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie ein komplexes ABAP-Objekt in ein XML-Format und deserialisieren Sie es anschließend zurück in ein Objekt. Nutzen Sie die Klassen `CL_ABAP_SERIALIZER` und `CL_ABAP_DESERIALIZER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT cl_abap_serializer` und `cl_abap_deserializer` mit der Methode `serialize` bzw. `deserialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mv_header TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mt_items  TYPE tt_items READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_header TYPE string
        it_items  TYPE tt_items.

    METHODS serialize_to_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.

    CLASS METHODS deserialize_from_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_complex_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_header = iv_header.
    mt_items  = it_items.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD serialize_to_xml.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = cl_abap_serializer=>create( ).
    TRY.
        lo_serializer->serialize( EXPORTING data = me IMPORTING xml_xstring = DATA(lx_xml) ).
        rv_xml_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lx_xml ).
      CATCH cx_sy_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_from_xml.
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = cl_abap_deserializer=>create( ).
    DATA(lx_xml) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ).
    CREATE OBJECT ro_instance.
    TRY.
        lo_deserializer->deserialize( EXPORTING xml_xstring = lx_xml IMPORTING data = ro_instance ).
      CATCH cx_sy_deserializer_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_serialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialization.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_complex_data=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item B' ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_original) = NEW zcl_complex_data( iv_header = 'Test Header' it_items = lt_items ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_original->serialize_to_xml( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'XML string should not be empty' act = lv_xml ).

    DATA(lo_deserialized) = zcl_complex_data=>deserialize_from_xml( lv_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Header mismatch' act = lo_deserialized->mv_header exp = lo_original->mv_header ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Item count mismatch' act = lines( lo_deserialized->mt_items ) exp = lines( lo_original->mt_items ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_original->mt_items INTO DATA(ls_orig_item).
      READ TABLE lo_deserialized->mt_items INTO DATA(ls_des_item) WITH KEY id = ls_orig_item-id.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( msg = 'Item not found after deserialization' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Item name mismatch' act = ls_des_item-name exp = ls_orig_item-name ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_SERIALIZER` und `CL_ABAP_DESERIALIZER` bieten eine standardisierte und typsichere Möglichkeit, ABAP-Objekte in XML zu serialisieren und zu deserialisieren. Dies ist ideal für die Persistenz von Objekten oder den Datenaustausch. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung ist ebenfalls eine moderne Best Practice.
keywords: SERIALIZATION, DESERIALIZATION, XML, OBJECTS, CL_ABAP_SERIALIZER, CL_ABAP_DESERIALIZER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder und gefilterte Zeilen einer bestehenden internen Tabelle enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` Operatoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             text   TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_original_data.
    TYPES tt_original_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_filtered_data.
    TYPES tt_filtered_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_original TYPE tt_original_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_filtered_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_original WHERE ( active = abap_true )
                             ( id = ls_data-id, text = ls_data-text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_data.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_table_processor=>tt_original_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Active Item 1' active = abap_true ) TO lt_original.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Inactive Item 1' active = abap_false ) TO lt_original.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 text = 'Active Item 2' active = abap_true ) TO lt_original.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_table_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_processor->process_data( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered items' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_item1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item ID mismatch' act = ls_item1-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item text mismatch' act = ls_item1-text exp = 'Active Item 1' ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_item2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item ID mismatch' act = ls_item2-id exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item text mismatch' act = ls_item2-text exp = 'Active Item 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Operators bietet eine elegante Möglichkeit zur Filterung, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT WHERE` oder `DELETE` Anweisungen.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, VALUE, FILTER, DECLARATIVE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einem Eingabewert verschiedene Aktionen ausführt. Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck für eine kompakte und moderne Fallunterscheidung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_status_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_status TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 new        TYPE ty_status VALUE 'N',
                 in_process TYPE ty_status VALUE 'P',
                 completed  TYPE ty_status VALUE 'C',
                 cancelled  TYPE ty_status VALUE 'X',
               END OF gc_status.

      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE ty_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_status
                               WHEN gc_status-new        THEN 'New Order'
                               WHEN gc_status-in_process THEN 'Order in Process'
                               WHEN gc_status-completed  THEN 'Order Completed'
                               WHEN gc_status-cancelled  THEN 'Order Cancelled'
                               ELSE 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Werte in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für eine funktionale Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_value IN it_values
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_value-amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA: lt_values TYPE zcl_calculator=>tt_values.
    APPEND VALUE #( amount = '10.50' ) TO lt_values.
    APPEND VALUE #( amount = '20.00' ) TO lt_values.
    APPEND VALUE #( amount = '5.50' ) TO lt_values.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum mismatch' act = lv_sum exp = '36.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_values TYPE zcl_calculator=>tt_values.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of empty table should be 0' act = lv_sum exp = '0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die funktionale Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen oder anderen Iteratoren. Er ist eine moderne und sehr ausdrucksstarke Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`s mit Akkumulatorvariablen, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: REDUCE, AGGREGATION, INTERNAL TABLES, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, MATH

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Strategie mit Interfaces und nutzen Sie die Constructor Injection, um die Abhängigkeiten zu verwalten. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und mehrere implementierende Klassen. Übergeben Sie die Implementierung im Konstruktor.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to console/sy-list
    " For unit test, we just simulate.
    " WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a file
    " For unit test, we just simulate.
    " OPEN DATASET ... TRANSFER ... CLOSE DATASET.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.

    METHODS perform_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_action.
    mo_logger->log_message( |Processing data: { iv_data }| ).
    " ... actual application logic ...
    mo_logger->log_message( |Data { iv_data } processed successfully.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_mock_logger DEFINITION FOR TESTING.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
    DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_mock_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    mv_last_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    DATA(lo_mock_logger) = NEW ltcl_mock_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_application_service( io_logger = lo_mock_logger ).

    lo_service->perform_action( 'Sample Data' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Logger should have received a message' act = lo_mock_logger->mv_last_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Log message should contain processed data' substr = 'Sample Data' act = lo_mock_logger->mv_last_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein Designprinzip, bei dem Abhängigkeiten (hier: der Logger) über den Konstruktor einer Klasse bereitgestellt werden. In Kombination mit Interfaces (`zif_logger`) fördert dies lose Kopplung, Testbarkeit (durch Mocking) und Polymorphie, da die `zcl_application_service`-Klasse nicht wissen muss, welche konkrete Logger-Implementierung sie verwendet. Dies ist ein Eckpfeiler moderner, wartbarer und erweiterbarer objektorientierter Architekturen.
keywords: OBJECT ORIENTATION, INTERFACE, CONSTRUCTOR INJECTION, DEPENDENCY INJECTION, POLYMORPHISM

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und dynamische Method Calls.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_object      TYPE REF TO object,
          lt_parameters  TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter   TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        ls_parameter-name  = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming method has an IV_INPUT parameter
        ls_parameter-kind  = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_importing.
        GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
        INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

        CLEAR ls_parameter.
        ls_parameter-name  = 'RV_OUTPUT'. " Assuming method has an RV_OUTPUT returning parameter
        ls_parameter-kind  = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_returning.
        GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
        INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

        CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_class_not_found INTO DATA(lx_class_not_found).
        rv_result = |Error: Class { iv_class_name } not found.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_illegal_method INTO DATA(lx_illegal_method).
        rv_result = |Error: Method { iv_method_name } not found or illegal.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for dynamic call demonstration
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_input.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input } - { sy-datum }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_class FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic call result mismatch' act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_class.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Klassen und Methoden zur Laufzeit zu identifizieren und aufzurufen. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks, generische Handler oder Pluginsysteme. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_classdescr` und `CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters` ist der moderne Weg, dies in ABAP zu erreichen, ergänzt durch robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln und formatieren Sie das Ergebnis. Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE` und die Methoden zur Differenzberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_time_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_difference_seconds) TYPE i.

    METHODS format_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_seconds TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_time_difference.
    DATA(lo_tstmp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create( iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create( iv_timestamp2 ).

    rv_difference_seconds = lo_tstmp2->get_diff( lo_tstmp1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_difference.
    DATA: lv_days    TYPE i,
          lv_hours   TYPE i,
          lv_minutes TYPE i,
          lv_seconds TYPE i.

    lv_days    = iv_seconds DIV ( 24 * 3600 ).
    lv_seconds = iv_seconds MOD ( 24 * 3600 ).
    lv_hours   = lv_seconds DIV 3600.
    lv_seconds = lv_seconds MOD 3600.
    lv_minutes = lv_seconds DIV 60.
    lv_seconds = lv_seconds MOD 60.

    rv_formatted_string = |{ lv_days } days, { lv_hours } hours, { lv_minutes } minutes, { lv_seconds } seconds|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_time_difference FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_time_difference.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_timestamp_calculator( ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = '20231026100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = '20231026100130.0000000'. " 90 seconds later

    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_calculator->calculate_time_difference( iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp1 iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Difference mismatch' act = lv_diff exp = 90 ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp3) = '20231026100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp4) = '20231027100000.0000000'. " 24 hours later
    lv_diff = lo_calculator->calculate_time_difference( iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp3 iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '24 hour difference mismatch' act = lv_diff exp = 86400 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_format_difference.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_timestamp_calculator( ).

    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_calculator->format_difference( 90 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted 90s mismatch' act = lv_formatted exp = '0 days, 0 hours, 1 minutes, 30 seconds' ).

    lv_formatted = lo_calculator->format_difference( 3661 ). " 1 hour, 1 minute, 1 second
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted 3661s mismatch' act = lv_formatted exp = '0 days, 1 hours, 1 minutes, 1 seconds' ).

    lv_formatted = lo_calculator->format_difference( 86400 + 3600 + 60 + 1 ). " 1 day, 1 hour, 1 minute, 1 second
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted 1d1h1m1s mismatch' act = lv_formatted exp = '1 days, 1 hours, 1 minutes, 1 seconds' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` bietet eine robuste und objektorientierte Möglichkeit zur Handhabung von Zeitstempeln. Sie vereinfacht die Berechnung von Differenzen und die Konvertierung zwischen verschiedenen Zeitstempelformaten, was zu saubererem und weniger fehleranfälligem Code führt als manuelle Berechnungen mit `TIMESTAMP` Feldern. String-Templates werden für die Formatierung verwendet.
keywords: DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, DIFFERENCE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Elementen. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             price  TYPE decfloat16,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_active_products
      IMPORTING
        it_all_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle in eine andere ein, wobei Duplikate basierend auf einem Schlüssel ignoriert werden. Nutzen Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF source_table INTO TABLE target_table ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_merger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS merge_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_data
      CHANGING
        ct_target TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_merger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source INTO TABLE ct_target ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_tables FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_merge_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_merge_empty_source FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_merge_empty_target FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_tables.
    DATA: lt_target TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data,
          lt_source TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_target.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 2 value = 'B' ) TO lt_target.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 3 value = 'C' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 4 value = 'D' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_merger) = NEW zcl_table_merger( ).
    lo_merger->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source = lt_source CHANGING ct_target = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total lines mismatch after merge' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target WITH KEY key = 3 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( msg = 'Key 3 not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_merge_with_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_target TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data,
          lt_source TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 value = 'Original A' ) TO lt_target.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 2 value = 'Original B' ) TO lt_target.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 value = 'Duplicate A' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 3 value = 'New C' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_merger) = NEW zcl_table_merger( ).
    lo_merger->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source = lt_source CHANGING ct_target = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total lines mismatch with duplicates' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_item) WITH KEY key = 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Original value for key 1 should be kept' act = ls_item-value exp = 'Original A' ).
    READ TABLE lt_target WITH KEY key = 3 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( msg = 'New key 3 not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_merge_empty_source.
    DATA: lt_target TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data,
          lt_source TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_target.

    DATA(lo_merger) = NEW zcl_table_merger( ).
    lo_merger->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source = lt_source CHANGING ct_target = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Target size should not change with empty source' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_merge_empty_target.
    DATA: lt_target TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data,
          lt_source TYPE zcl_table_merger=>tt_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_merger) = NEW zcl_table_merger( ).
    lo_merger->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source = lt_source CHANGING ct_target = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Target should contain source items' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` ist eine effiziente und deklarative Methode, um Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle einzufügen, wobei Duplikate (basierend auf dem Tabellenschlüssel) automatisch ignoriert werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für das Zusammenführen von Daten und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit manueller Duplikatsprüfungen mit `LOOP` und `READ TABLE`.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, MERGE, DUPLICATE KEYS, INSERT LINES

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur oder internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` oder `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und casten Sie zu `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` oder `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA: lo_typedescr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_tabledescr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_elemdescr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    CASE lo_typedescr->kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
        lo_structdescr ?= lo_typedescr.
        LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          lo_elemdescr ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_name( ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ).
          APPEND |Component: { ls_component-name }, Type: { lo_elemdescr->get_ddic_type_name( ) }| TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
        lo_tabledescr ?= lo_typedescr.
        lo_structdescr ?= lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ).
        LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
          lo_elemdescr ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_name( ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ).
          APPEND |Table Component: { ls_component-name }, Type: { lo_elemdescr->get_ddic_type_name( ) }| TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        APPEND |Unsupported type: { lo_typedescr->get_kind_as_string( ) }| TO rt_components.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
