Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR` sind zentrale Bestandteile dafür. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Programme, Frameworks oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen, und bietet eine typsichere Alternative zu Feld-Symbolen und dynamischen Zuweisungen.
keywords: RTTI, REFLECTION, DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Zeilen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem oder mehreren Schlüsselfeldern und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(ls_line) GROUP BY ( key1 = ls_line-field1 key2 = ls_line-field2 )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_data,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_data.
    TYPES tt_sales_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_region_summary,
             region TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
             product_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_region_summary.
    TYPES tt_region_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_region_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_region
      IMPORTING
        it_sales TYPE tt_sales_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_region_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_region.
    LOOP AT it_sales INTO DATA(ls_sale)
         GROUP BY ( region = ls_sale-region )
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-amount ).
      DATA(lv_product_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                         FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).

      APPEND VALUE #( region = ls_group_key-region
                      total_amount = lv_total_amount
                      product_count = lv_product_count ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_region FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_region.
    DATA: lt_sales TYPE zcl_data_grouper=>tt_sales_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'East' product = 'A' amount = '100.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'West' product = 'B' amount = '150.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'East' product = 'C' amount = '200.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'West' product = 'D' amount = '50.00' ) TO lt_sales.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_data_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_grouper->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of regions mismatch' act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_east) WITH KEY region = 'East'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'East total amount mismatch' act = ls_east-total_amount exp = '300.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'East product count mismatch' act = ls_east-product_count exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_west) WITH KEY region = 'West'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'West total amount mismatch' act = ls_west-total_amount exp = '200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'West product count mismatch' act = ls_west-product_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sales TYPE zcl_data_grouper=>tt_sales_data.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_data_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_grouper->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summary should be empty for empty sales data' act = lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY`-Ausdruck in `LOOP AT` (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. Er ersetzt komplexe manuelle Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und bietet eine klare Syntax zur Aggregation von Daten innerhalb jeder Gruppe, oft in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
keywords: GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, LOOP, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Passagiere pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und einer inneren Schleife für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_loop_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid         TYPE sflight-connid,
             num_flights    TYPE i,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_loop_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) 
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA ls_result LIKE LINE OF rt_result.
      ls_result-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_result-connid = ls_group_key-connid.
      ls_result-num_flights = GROUP SIZE.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        ls_result-total_passengers = ls_result-total_passengers + ls_member-seatsocc.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der belegten Sitze und der Gesamtkapazität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_avg_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_avg_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_avg_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_avg_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lv_total_occupied) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP lv_carrid NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsocc ).
      DATA(lv_total_capacity) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP lv_carrid NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsmax ).
      DATA ls_occupancy LIKE LINE OF rt_occupancy.
      ls_occupancy-carrid = lv_carrid.
      IF lv_total_capacity > 0.
        ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy = lv_total_occupied / lv_total_capacity.
      ELSE.
        ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy = 0.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_occupancy TO rt_occupancy.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_occupancy ) > 0 ).
    " Überprüfen, ob die durchschnittliche Auslastung im gültigen Bereich (0 bis 1) liegt
    LOOP AT lt_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_occ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_occ-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_occ-avg_occupancy <= 1 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Berechnungen innerhalb von Gruppen direkt im ABAP-Code, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit den Feldern `CARRID` und `CONNID` aus `sflight` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` mit einem manuell erstellten Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_subset RETURNING VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_subset.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat LIKE LINE OF lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'CHAR'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'NUMC'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data_ref
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_carrid> = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_connid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_connid> = ls_sflight-connid.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_basic( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->create_sflight_subset( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_line).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE ls_first_line TO <lv_component>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` ermöglicht die Erstellung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem Feldkatalog. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei generischen ALV-Berichten. Die Daten werden dann über Field-Symbols zugewiesen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_custom DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_custom_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_custom IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_custom_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat LIKE LINE OF lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRIER_ID'.
    ls_fieldcat-ref_table = 'SFLIGHT'.
    ls_fieldcat-ref_field = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNECTION_ID'.
    ls_fieldcat-ref_table = 'SFLIGHT'.
    ls_fieldcat-ref_field = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Flugnummer'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'DESCRIPTION'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'CHAR'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 50.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Beschreibung'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data_ref
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRIER_ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrier_id>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_carrier_id> = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNECTION_ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_connection_id>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_connection_id> = ls_sflight-connid.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DESCRIPTION' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_description>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_description> = |Flight { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer existierenden Struktur (`sflight`) und fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte hinzu.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_extend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_extend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_extended_sflight_table.
    DATA: lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat   TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat   LIKE LINE OF lt_fieldcat.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING

          CHANGING

        ).
        lt_fieldcat = lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->get_fcat( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.

    " Zusätzliche Spalte hinzufügen
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'STATUS_TEXT'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'CHAR'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 20.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Flugstatus'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data_ref
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_sflight TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STATUS_TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_status_text>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF ls_sflight-seatsocc > ls_sflight-seatsmax / 2.
          <lv_status_text> = 'Gut gebucht'.
        ELSE.
          <lv_status_text> = 'Weniger gebucht'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten, basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen.
hint: Bauen Sie den Feldkatalog iterativ aus einer übergebenen Liste von Feldnamen auf und verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_variable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_variable_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_variable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_variable_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat LIKE LINE OF lt_fieldcat.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
      ls_fieldcat-fieldname = lv_field_name.
      " Annahme: Alle Felder sind CHAR(10) für dieses Beispiel
      ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'CHAR'.
      ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 10.
      ls_fieldcat-coltext   = lv_field_name.
      APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data_ref
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Beispiel: Füllen mit Dummy-Daten
    DO 3 TIMES.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_current_field).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_component> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_current_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <lv_component> = |{ lv_current_field }-{ sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Tag und Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit mehreren Schlüsselfeldern und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_multi_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_daily_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_multi_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_daily_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) 
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA ls_summary LIKE LINE OF rt_summary.
      ls_summary-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_summary-fldate = ls_group_key-fldate.
      ls_summary-num_flights = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, die aus einer dynamisch erzeugten `SELECT`-Anweisung stammen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_alv_table_create` mit dynamischem SQL (`SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @(DATA(...))`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_sql_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        it_field_names TYPE zcl_dyn_table_variable=>tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_sql_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat LIKE LINE OF lt_fieldcat.
    DATA: lv_select_list TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
      ls_fieldcat-fieldname = lv_field_name.
      ls_fieldcat-ref_table = iv_table_name.
      ls_fieldcat-ref_field = lv_field_name.
      ls_fieldcat-coltext   = lv_field_name.
      APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
      APPEND lv_field_name TO lv_select_list SEPARATED BY ', '.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data_ref
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF lv_select_list IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          SELECT (lv_select_list) FROM (iv_table_name) UP TO 10 ROWS INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table>.
        CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
          " Fehlerbehandlung für dynamisches SQL
          CLEAR <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `SELECT`-Anweisung wird zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und einem Tabellennamen konstruiert. Dies ist extrem flexibel für generische Berichte oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die Datenquelle und die benötigten Felder variieren können.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Flugnummern als kommaseparierten String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit `STRING_AGG` (oder String-Templates für ältere Versionen) für die String-Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_string_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_conns,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_conns.
    TYPES tt_flight_conns TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_conns WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carrier_connections RETURNING VALUE(rt_conns) TYPE tt_flight_conns.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_string_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_connections.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA ls_conns LIKE LINE OF rt_conns.
      ls_conns-carrid = lv_carrid.
      ls_conns-connids = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ``
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP lv_carrid
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_member>-connid ELSE s && `,` && <fs_member>-connid )
      ).
      APPEND ls_conns TO rt_conns.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_string_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_conns) = lo_cut->get_carrier_connections( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_conns ) > 0 ).
    " Überprüfen, ob die Connids nicht leer sind und Kommas enthalten können
    LOOP AT lt_conns INTO DATA(ls_conn).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_conn-connids ).
      " Optional: Prüfen auf spezifische Formate
      " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( contains( val = ls_conn-connids sub = ',' ) OR not contains( val = ls_conn-connids sub = ',' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator und String-Templates, um eine String-Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe durchzuführen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, gruppierte Daten zu verketten, ohne manuelle Schleifen und temporäre Variablen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer generischen Struktur (z.B. nur CHAR-Felder) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` mit einem Feldkatalog, der nur generische Typen definiert, und konvertieren Sie die Daten entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_generic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_generic_sflight_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_generic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_generic_sflight_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fieldcat LIKE LINE OF lt_fieldcat.

    " Dynamisch Feldkatalog für SFLIGHT erstellen, aber alles als CHAR
    DATA: lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            container_name = 'DUMMY'
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table  = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table       = VALUE sflight_tab( )
        ).
        DATA(lt_original_fcat) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->get_fcat( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lt_original_fcat INTO DATA(ls_original_fcat).
      CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
      ls_fieldcat-fieldname = ls_original_fcat-fieldname.
      ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'CHAR'. " Alle Felder als CHAR definieren
      ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 60.    " Eine großzügige Länge
      ls_fieldcat-coltext   = ls_original_fcat-coltext.
      APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data_ref
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
      lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflight ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_source_comp> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_source_comp>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_target_comp> TYPE any.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_target_comp>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Konvertierung zu CHAR
            <lv_target_comp> = |{ <lv_source_comp> }|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_generic( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->create_generic_sflight_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) > 0 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_line).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_component> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE ls_first_line TO <lv_component>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lv_component> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lv_component> )->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung einer dynamischen Tabelle, deren Felder alle einen generischen Typ (CHAR) haben, auch wenn die Quelldaten unterschiedliche Typen besitzen. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen Daten unabhängig von ihrem ursprünglichen Typ einheitlich als Text behandelt werden sollen, z.B. für generische Exportfunktionen. Die Konvertierung erfolgt über String-Templates und RTTI.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an belegten Sitzen überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel im `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high_occupancy_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_filtered_flights.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_high_occupancy_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_filtered_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_counts.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA ls_result LIKE LINE OF rt_counts.
      ls_result-carrid = lv_carrid.
      ls_result-high_occupancy_flights = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP lv_carrid WHERE ( seatsocc > iv_min_seats )
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_high_occupancy_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_occupancy_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_high_occupancy_counts( iv_min_seats = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_counts ) > 0 ).
    " Überprüfen, ob die Zählungen nicht negativ sind
    LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-high_occupancy_flights >= 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, der eine `WHERE`-Klausel enthält. Dies ermöglicht es, Elemente innerhalb einer Gruppe zu filtern, bevor eine Aggregation durchgeführt wird, was zu sehr präzisen und effizienten Gruppierungs- und Zähloperationen führt.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, REDUCE, WHERE, Filtering, Aggregation, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Anwendungsprotokoll mit einer Erfolgs- und einer Fehlermeldung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_simple_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_simple_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    " Erfolgsmeldung hinzufügen
    lo_log->add_message(
      iv_msgty = 'S'
      iv_msgid = 'SY'
      iv_msgno = '000'
      iv_msgv1 = 'Operation erfolgreich'
    ).

    " Fehlermeldung hinzufügen
    lo_log->add_message(
      iv_msgty = 'E'
      iv_msgid = 'SY'
      iv_msgno = '000'
      iv_msgv1 = 'Operation fehlgeschlagen'
    ).

    " Protokoll speichern (optional, aber gute Praxis für Persistenz)
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man es typischerweise in der Datenbank speichern.
    " Für dieses Beispiel demonstrieren wir nur die Erstellung.
    " lo_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_simple_log( ).
    " Die Methode selbst gibt nichts zurück, daher können wir nur auf Ausnahmen prüfen
    " oder ob sie fehlerfrei läuft. Für einen echten Test würde man das Protokoll auslesen.
    " Hier stellen wir nur sicher, dass es ohne Laufzeitfehler ausgeführt wird.
    lo_cut->create_log( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Methode sollte fehlerfrei ausgeführt werden' ). " Platzhalter-Assertion
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_uuid_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_uuid.
    " UUID-Objekt aus C32-String erstellen
    DATA(lo_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_static( iv_uuid_c32 = iv_uuid_c32 ).

    " X16-Darstellung abrufen
    ev_uuid_x16 = lo_uuid->if_system_uuid_x~get_uuid_x16( ).

    " Neues UUID-Objekt aus X16-Darstellung erstellen
    DATA(lo_uuid_from_x16) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_static( iv_uuid_x16 = ev_uuid_x16 ).

    " C32-Darstellung zurückerhalten
    ev_uuid_c32 = lo_uuid_from_x16->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_c32( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_converter( ).
    DATA(lo_uuid_gen) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid( ).
    DATA(lv_original_uuid_c32) = lo_uuid_gen->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_c32( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll, fügen Sie Nachrichten hinzu und lesen Sie diese anschließend wieder aus.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
        msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
        msgv2 TYPE bal_msgv,
        msgv3 TYPE bal_msgv,
        msgv4 TYPE bal_msgv,
      END OF ty_message,
      tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_read_log
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Erfolg' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler' ).

    " Nachrichten aus dem Protokoll lesen
    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).

    " Auf lokale Struktur mappen
    rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR message IN lt_bal_messages ( 
      msgty = message->get_msgty( )
      msgid = message->get_msgid( )
      msgno = message->get_msgno( )
      msgv1 = message->get_msgv1( )
      msgv2 = message->get_msgv2( )
      msgv3 = message->get_msgv3( )
      msgv4 = message->get_msgv4( )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit verschiedenen Nachrichtentypen und filtern Sie anschließend nur die Fehlermeldungen heraus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_MESSAGES` und den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_filter_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
        msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
      END OF ty_message,
      tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_error_messages
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_filter_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Erfolg' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler 1' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'A' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Abbruch' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler 2' ).

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).

    " Nach Fehlermeldungen ('E' oder 'A') filtern
    rt_error_messages = VALUE #( FOR message IN lt_all_messages
                                 WHERE ( message->get_msgty( ) = 'E' OR message->get_msgty( ) = 'A' )
                                 ( msgty = message->get_msgty( )
                                   msgid = message->get_msgid( )
                                   msgno = message->get_msgno( )
                                   msgv1 = message->get_msgv1( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_error_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_filter_log( ).
    DATA(lt_error_messages) = lo_cut->get_error_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_error_messages ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es wurden 3 Fehler-/Abbruchmeldungen erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Fehler 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_messages[ 2 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Abbruch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_messages[ 3 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Fehler 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...) FOR ... WHERE (...)` um Nachrichten aus einem Anwendungsprotokoll basierend auf ihrem Typ zu selektieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten und zu filtern.
keywords: Application Log, BAL, Filter, Internal Tables, VALUE operator, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei separate Anwendungsprotokolle und konsolidieren Sie deren Nachrichten in einem dritten Protokoll.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG=>CREATE_LOG` und `ADD_MESSAGES_FROM_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_consolidate_logs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
      END OF ty_message,
      tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS consolidate_logs
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_consolidated_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_consolidate_logs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD consolidate_logs.
    " Protokoll 1
    DATA(lo_log1) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_log1->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Nachricht von Protokoll 1' ).

    " Protokoll 2
    DATA(lo_log2) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_log2->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler von Protokoll 2' ).
    lo_log2->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung von Protokoll 2' ).

    " Konsolidiertes Protokoll
    DATA(lo_consolidated_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_consolidated_log->add_messages_from_log( io_log = lo_log1 ).
    lo_consolidated_log->add_messages_from_log( io_log = lo_log2 ).

    " Konsolidierte Nachrichten lesen
    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_consolidated_log->get_messages( ).

    rt_consolidated_messages = VALUE #( FOR message IN lt_bal_messages ( 
      msgty = message->get_msgty( )
      msgv1 = message->get_msgv1( )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_consolidate_logs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_consolidate_logs.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_consolidate_logs( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->consolidate_logs( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es wurden 3 konsolidierte Nachrichten erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Nachricht von Protokoll 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Fehler von Protokoll 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 3 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Warnung von Protokoll 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen verschiedene Komponenten oder Prozesse ihre eigenen Protokolle führen und diese am Ende konsolidiert werden sollen.
keywords: Application Log, BAL, Consolidation, Object Orientation, Message Handling

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei UUIDs auf Gleichheit.

solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_comparator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_uuids
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid1 TYPE sysuuid_c32
        iv_uuid2 TYPE sysuuid_c32
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_uuids.
    IF iv_uuid1 = iv_uuid2.
      rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_equal_uuids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_compare_unequal_uuids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_equal_uuids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_comparator( ).
    DATA(lo_uuid_gen) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid) = lo_uuid_gen->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_c32( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->compare_uuids( iv_uuid1 = lv_uuid iv_uuid2 = lv_uuid ) msg = 'Gleiche UUIDs sollten als gleich erkannt werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_compare_unequal_uuids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_comparator( ).
    DATA(lo_uuid_gen1) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid1) = lo_uuid_gen1->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lo_uuid_gen2) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid2) = lo_uuid_gen2->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_c32( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->compare_uuids( iv_uuid1 = lv_uuid1 iv_uuid2 = lv_uuid2 ) msg = 'Ungleiche UUIDs sollten als ungleich erkannt werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: UUIDs, die als `SYSUUID_C32` oder `SYSUUID_X16` deklariert sind, können direkt mit dem Gleichheitsoperator (`=`) verglichen werden. Dies ist eine einfache und effiziente Methode, um die Identität von zwei UUIDs zu überprüfen.
keywords: UUID, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, Comparison, Data Comparison, Boolean Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und speichern Sie es persistent in der Datenbank. Laden Sie es anschließend wieder.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG=>SAVE_LOG` und `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG=>LOAD_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_persistence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
      END OF ty_message,
      tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS save_and_load_log
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_loaded_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_persistence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_and_load_log.
    DATA(lo_log_to_save) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_log_to_save->add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Nachricht zum Speichern' ).

    " Protokoll speichern und die Protokollnummer abrufen
    DATA(lv_log_number) = lo_log_to_save->save_log( ).

    " Protokoll erneut laden
    DATA(lo_loaded_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>load_log( iv_log_number = lv_log_number ).

    " Nachrichten aus dem geladenen Protokoll lesen
    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_loaded_log->get_messages( ).

    rt_loaded_messages = VALUE #( FOR message IN lt_bal_messages ( 
      msgty = message->get_msgty( )
      msgv1 = message->get_msgv1( )
    ) ).

    " Optional: Protokoll löschen, um Testdaten zu bereinigen
    " lo_loaded_log->delete_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_save_and_load_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_save_and_load_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_persistence( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->save_and_load_log( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 msg = 'Es wurde 1 geladene Nachricht erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Nachricht zum Speichern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `SAVE_LOG` und `LOAD_LOG` von `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` ermöglichen die Persistenz von Anwendungsprotokollen in der Datenbank. `SAVE_LOG` gibt eine eindeutige Protokollnummer zurück, die dann verwendet werden kann, um das Protokoll mit `LOAD_LOG` wiederherzustellen. Dies ist entscheidend für die langfristige Speicherung und Analyse von Protokolldaten.
keywords: Application Log, BAL, Persistence, Save, Load, Database

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine UUID und verwenden Sie diese als Schlüssel für eine Hash-Tabelle (Hashed Table).
hint: Deklarieren Sie eine Hashed Table mit `UNIQUE HASHED KEY` und dem UUID-Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id   TYPE sysuuid_c32,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_uuid) TYPE sysuuid_c32.

    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid TYPE sysuuid_c32
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_data.
    DATA(lv_new_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid( )->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_c32( ).
    INSERT VALUE #( id = lv_new_uuid value = iv_value ) INTO TABLE mt_data.
    rv_uuid = lv_new_uuid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    READ TABLE mt_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_uuid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = ls_data-value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Hashed Tables sind für den schnellen Zugriff auf Daten über einen eindeutigen Schlüssel optimiert. Die Verwendung einer UUID als Schlüssel gewährleistet globale Eindeutigkeit. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine Hashed Table deklariert und mit UUID-basierten Einträgen gefüllt und ausgelesen wird, was für performante Datenzugriffe unerlässlich ist.
keywords: UUID, Hashed Table, Internal Tables, Data Structures, Performance, CL_SYSTEM_UUID

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit Nachrichten, die sich auf verschiedene Objekte beziehen, und lesen Sie dann nur Nachrichten für ein bestimmtes Objekt aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_MESSAGE` mit `IV_OBJECT` und `IV_SUBOBJECT` und filtern Sie die Nachrichten entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_object_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
        object TYPE bal_object,
        subobject TYPE bal_subobj,
      END OF ty_message,
      tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_messages_for_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE bal_object
        iv_subobject TYPE bal_subobj OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_object_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_messages_for_object.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Nachricht für Objekt A' iv_object = 'OBJ_A' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler für Objekt B' iv_object = 'OBJ_B' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung für Objekt A, Subobjekt X' iv_object = 'OBJ_A' iv_subobject = 'SUB_X' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SY' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Erfolg für Objekt A, Subobjekt Y' iv_object = 'OBJ_A' iv_subobject = 'SUB_Y' ).

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).

    rt_filtered_messages = VALUE #( FOR message IN lt_all_messages
                                     WHERE ( message->get_object( ) = iv_object AND
                                             ( iv_subobject IS INITIAL OR message->get_subobject( ) = iv_subobject ) )
                                     ( msgty = message->get_msgty( )
                                       msgv1 = message->get_msgv1( )
                                       object = message->get_object( )
                                       subobject = message->get_subobject( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_object FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_by_object_and_subobject FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_object_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_messages_for_object( iv_object = 'OBJ_A' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es wurden 3 Nachrichten für OBJ_A erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Nachricht für Objekt A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Warnung für Objekt A, Subobjekt X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 3 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Erfolg für Objekt A, Subobjekt Y' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_by_object_and_subobject.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_object_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_messages_for_object( iv_object = 'OBJ_A' iv_subobject = 'SUB_X' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 msg = 'Es wurde 1 Nachricht für OBJ_A/SUB_X erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Warnung für Objekt A, Subobjekt X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Anwendungsprotokolle können Nachrichten mit Bezug zu bestimmten Objekten und Unterobjekten speichern. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man diese Felder beim Hinzufügen von Nachrichten verwendet und wie man anschließend mit dem `FILTER`-Operator gezielt Nachrichten für ein bestimmtes Objekt oder eine Kombination aus Objekt und Unterobjekt ausliest. Dies ist entscheidend für die Strukturierung und gezielte Analyse großer Protokolle.
keywords: Application Log, BAL, Filtering, Object, Subobject, Internal Tables, Data Selection

CLASS zcl_update_single_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_update_single_flight IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und deren Fluggesellschaftsnamen. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` als Alternative zu einem `JOIN`.
hint: Führen Sie zuerst eine `SELECT` auf `spfli` durch, um die relevanten Verbindungen zu erhalten, und nutzen Sie dann `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für `sflights` und `scarr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_all_entries_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_city
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_all_entries_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM spfli
      WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom
      INTO TABLE @lt_spfli.

    IF lt_spfli IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_spfli
        WHERE carrid = @lt_spfli-carrid
          AND connid = @lt_spfli-connid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

      SELECT carrid, carrname
        FROM scarr
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_spfli
        WHERE carrid = @lt_spfli-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = iv_cityfrom
      ).
      READ TABLE lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr) WITH KEY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_summary-carrname = ls_scarr-carrname.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_flight_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittliche Flugzeit (`FLTIME`) pro Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort für alle Flüge, die mehr als 2 Verbindungen haben. Zeigen Sie auch den Namen der Fluggesellschaft an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` sowie `scarr` für den Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_flight_time,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             avg_fltime TYPE spfli-fltime,
             num_connections TYPE i,
           END OF ty_avg_flight_time.
    TYPES tt_avg_flight_time TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_flight_time WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_flight_time_grouped
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_times) TYPE tt_avg_flight_time.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_flight_time_grouped.
    SELECT p~carrid, c~carrname, p~cityfrom, AVG( p~fltime ) AS avg_fltime, COUNT( p~connid ) AS num_connections
      FROM spfli AS p
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON p~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY p~carrid, c~carrname, p~cityfrom
      HAVING COUNT( p~connid ) > 2
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_times.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_join_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Arbeitstage in einem gegebenen Monat unter Verwendung des Period Toolsets. Ein Arbeitstag ist hierbei jeder Tag außer Samstag und Sonntag.
hint: Verwende `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` um den Monatsbereich zu erhalten, generiere dann eine Liste von Daten mit `FOR` und zähle mit `REDUCE` unter Zuhilfenahme von `cl_abap_context_info` für den Wochentag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days_in_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS date_is_working_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_working_day) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days_in_month.
    DATA(lo_period_api) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_month_period) = lo_period_api->get_period_for_date(
                               iv_date        = iv_date
                               iv_period_type = if_bs_period_type=>gc_calendar_month ).

    DATA(lv_start_date) = lo_month_period->get_start_date( ).
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = lo_month_period->get_end_date( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_rec,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_date_rec.
    TYPES tt_date_rec TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_rec WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_dates) = VALUE tt_date_rec(
      FOR d = lv_start_date THEN d + 1 UNTIL d > lv_end_date
      ( date = d )
    ).

    rv_working_days = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                FOR date_rec IN lt_dates
                                WHERE ( date_is_working_day( date_rec-date ) = abap_true )
                                NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD date_is_working_day.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_day_of_week( iv_date ).
    IF lv_day_of_week = 6 OR lv_day_of_week = 7. "6=Saturday, 7=Sunday
      rv_is_working_day = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_working_day = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_months_in_year DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_month_period,
             month_name  TYPE string,
             start_date  TYPE d,
             end_date    TYPE d,
           END OF ty_month_period.
    TYPES tt_month_period TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_month_period WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_months_of_year
      IMPORTING
        iv_year TYPE gjaer\      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_months) TYPE tt_month_period.

CLASS zcl_period_months_in_year IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_months_of_year.
    DATA(lo_period_api) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = iv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = iv_year && '1231'.

    DATA(lt_periods) = lo_period_api->get_periods_in_range(
                           iv_start_date  = lv_start_date
                           iv_end_date    = lv_end_date
                           iv_period_type = if_bs_period_type=>gc_calendar_month ).

    rt_months = VALUE tt_month_period(
      FOR period IN lt_periods
      ( month_name = period->get_description( )
        start_date = period->get_start_date( )
        end_date   = period->get_end_date( ) ) "INTO TABLE is implicitly used by VALUE operator
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflight`, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die im aktuellen Kalendermonat stattfinden.
hint: Verwende `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` zur Bestimmung des Monatsbereichs und den `FILTER`-Operator für die interne Tabelle. Die Daten können mit `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` gelesen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_current_month
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_current_month.
    DATA(lo_period_api) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_current_month) = lo_period_api->get_period_for_date(
                                 iv_date        = lv_current_date
                                 iv_period_type = if_bs_period_type=>gc_calendar_month ).

    DATA(lv_start_date) = lo_current_month->get_start_date( ).
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = lo_current_month->get_end_date( ).

    " Alle Flüge lesen (oder eine Teilmenge für Performance)
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    " Filtern mit moderner ABAP-Syntax
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE fldate GE lv_start_date AND fldate LE lv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_month( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_current_month( ).

    " Prüfen, ob alle Flüge im aktuellen Monat liegen
    DATA(lo_period_api) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_current_month) = lo_period_api->get_period_for_date(
                                 iv_date        = sy-datum
                                 iv_period_type = if_bs_period_type=>gc_calendar_month ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = lo_current_month->get_start_date( ).
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = lo_current_month->get_end_date( ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate GE lv_start_date AND ls_flight-fldate LE lv_end_date ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Dieser Test kann fehlschlagen, wenn sflight keine Daten für den aktuellen Monat enthält.
    " Für einen robusten Test müsste man Testdaten einfügen oder sflight mocken.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). "Platzhalter für erfolgreiche Prüfung
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Keine Flüge für den aktuellen Monat gefunden. Testdaten fehlen möglicherweise.' ).
    END IF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` nach dem Geschäftsjahresquartal des Flugdatums und zähle die Flüge pro Quartal.
hint: Verwende `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` zur Bestimmung des Quartals und den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_quarter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             fiscal_year_quarter TYPE string,
             flight_count        TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_fiscal_quarter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_quarter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_fiscal_quarter.
    DATA(lo_period_api) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      GROUP BY lo_period_api->get_period_for_date(
                   iv_date        = ls_flight-fldate
                   iv_period_type = if_bs_period_type=>gc_fiscal_quarter )->get_description( ) AS fiscal_quarter
      ( fiscal_year_quarter = fiscal_quarter
        flight_count        = GROUP SIZE ) "INTO TABLE is implicitly used by VALUE operator
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_quarter( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_fiscal_quarter( ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Gruppierung funktioniert hat (mindestens ein Eintrag, wenn Daten vorhanden)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob die Summe der Flüge der Gesamtanzahl der Flüge entspricht
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    DATA(lv_sum_grouped_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_entry IN lt_summary NEXT sum = sum + ls_entry-flight_count ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_grouped_flights exp = lv_total_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `GROUP BY`-Funktionalität in Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Operator und dem Period Toolset. Flüge werden nach ihrem Geschäftsjahresquartal gruppiert, das dynamisch über `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` ermittelt wird. Dies ermöglicht eine kompakte und effiziente Aggregation von Daten.

    DATA(lo_period_api) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).

                           iv_start_date  = iv_start_date
                           iv_end_date    = iv_end_date
                           iv_period_type = if_bs_period_type=>gc_calendar_quarter ).

    rt_quarters = VALUE tt_quarter_data(
      FOR period IN lt_periods
      ( description = period->get_description( )
        start_date  = period->get_start_date( )
        end_date    = period->get_end_date( ) ) "INTO TABLE is implicitly used by VALUE operator
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Tabellentyp und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Greifen Sie anschließend dynamisch auf die Daten zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und Feld-Symbols für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA lo_table_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lo_struct_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.

    " Get description for structure TY_SFLIGHT
    lo_struct_type_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE=>TY_SFLIGHT' ).

    " Create table type description
    lo_table_type_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_type_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Fill with data (example using SFLIGHT)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @<fs_table> UP TO 3 ROWS.

    ro_data = lo_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_table( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 rows' act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `cl_abap_typedescr` und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` dynamisch interne Tabellen zur Laufzeit erstellt. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Struktur der Tabelle erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. beim Verarbeiten von generischen Daten oder bei der Implementierung von generischen Daten-Layern. Der Zugriff erfolgt über Feld-Symbols, was eine typlose Bearbeitung ermöglicht.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Datenreferenz auf ein beliebiges Datenobjekt und weisen Sie ihr einen Wert zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` und `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_assign_data IMPORTING iv_type TYPE string
                                            iv_value TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_assign_data.
    DATA lo_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE (iv_type).
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_data> = iv_value.
    ENDIF.

    ro_data_ref = lo_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_data_ref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_data_ref.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_data_ref( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_creator->create_and_assign_data( iv_type = 'STRING' iv_value = 'Dynamic String' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_string> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_string>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_string> exp = 'Dynamic String' ).

    DATA(lo_data_ref_int) = lo_creator->create_and_assign_data( iv_type = 'I' iv_value = '123' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_int> TYPE i.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref_int->* TO <fs_int>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_int> exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Erstellung von Datenreferenzen für beliebige Datentypen. Dies ist fundamental für generische Datenverarbeitung und Metaprogrammierung in ABAP. Die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA TYPE (name)` und Feld-Symbols `<fs_data> = iv_value` ermöglicht es, Datenobjekte zur Laufzeit zu manipulieren, ohne deren Typ zur Kompilierzeit kennen zu müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Data Reference, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische SQL-Abfrage auf der Tabelle SFLIGHT aus, bei der die WHERE-Klausel dynamisch aufgebaut wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE (dynamic_where_clause)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_result.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_select IMPORTING iv_where_clause TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = iv_where_clause.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_result
      WHERE (lv_where_clause).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sql FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sql.
    DATA(lo_executor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sql( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_executor->execute_dynamic_select( `CARRID = 'LH' AND CONNID = '0400'` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Results should not be initial' act = lt_results ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected CARRID' act = lt_results[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Ausführung von dynamischem SQL, bei dem die WHERE-Klausel zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für flexible Abfragen, birgt aber auch Sicherheitsrisiken (SQL-Injection), wenn die Eingabe nicht sorgfältig validiert wird. Die Syntax `WHERE (lv_where_clause)` ist seit ABAP 7.40 verfügbar und ermöglicht es, komplexe Abfragebedingungen dynamisch zu formulieren.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Dynamic SQL, SELECT, WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Excel-Datei mit einem Arbeitsblatt und schreiben Sie einige Kopfzeilen und Daten hinein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Erstellen und `if_fdt_xl_sheet~set_cell` zum Schreiben.

CLASS zcl_excel_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_excel.
    DATA lo_spreadsheet TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
    DATA lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_spreadsheet.
    lo_sheet = lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_name( 'Sheet1' ).

    " Write header
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Name' ).

    " Write data
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = '001' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Item A' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 1 ip_value = '002' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Item B' ).

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_package_as_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'XSTRING should have content' act = xstrlen( lv_xstring ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Erstellen einer Excel-Datei. Es wird ein Spreadsheet-Objekt instanziiert, ein Arbeitsblatt abgerufen und Zellen mit Werten gefüllt. Die Methode `get_package_as_xstring` liefert den binären Inhalt der Excel-Datei, der dann z.B. heruntergeladen oder per E-Mail versendet werden kann. Dies ist der moderne Weg, Excel-Dateien in ABAP zu generieren.
keywords: Excel, Spreadsheet, cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet, XSTRING

Instructions: Wenden Sie grundlegende Formatierungen (z.B. Fettdruck für Kopfzeilen) auf Zellen in einer Excel-Datei an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_style` und `set_cell_style`.

CLASS zcl_excel_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_formatted_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_excel_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_excel.
    DATA lo_spreadsheet TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
    DATA lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.
    DATA lo_style TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_style.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_spreadsheet.
    lo_sheet = lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_name( 'Formatted Data' ).

    " Create a bold style
    lo_style = lo_spreadsheet->create_style( ).
    lo_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    " Write header with bold style
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style = lo_style ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Description' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_style = lo_style ).

    " Write data
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = '001' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Formatted Item' ).

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_package_as_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHT) in eine Excel-Datei, wobei die Spaltenüberschriften automatisch aus den Feldnamen generiert werden.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie `set_cell`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_table_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_sflight_to_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_table_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflight_to_excel.
    DATA lo_spreadsheet TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
    DATA lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    DATA lv_row TYPE i VALUE 1.
    DATA lv_col TYPE i VALUE 1.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_spreadsheet.
    lo_sheet = lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_name( 'SFLIGHT Data' ).

    " Fetch data from SFLIGHT
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Write header row dynamically
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflight[1] ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Write data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight>).
      lv_col = 1.
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = <fs_value> ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_package_as_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_export FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_export.
    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_excel_table_export( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_exporter->export_sflight_to_excel( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'XSTRING should have content' act = xstrlen( lv_xstring ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Excel-Generierung mit dynamischer Programmierung, um Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine Excel-Datei zu exportieren. Die Spaltenüberschriften werden dynamisch aus den Komponenten der Struktur der internen Tabelle ermittelt. Dies ist eine sehr flexible Lösung für generische Datenexporte, bei denen die Struktur der Daten zur Kompilierzeit nicht fest vorgegeben ist.
