Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table IMPORTING it_column_names TYPE string_table
                                 RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " Define components dynamically
    LOOP AT it_column_names INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_column_name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'STRING' ). " All columns as string for simplicity
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create dynamic structure and table type
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Fill with some example data
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_line>.

    LOOP AT 1 TO 3 INTO DATA(idx).
      LOOP AT it_column_names INTO lv_column_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = |{ lv_column_name } Value { idx }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_data = lo_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_columns FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_columns.
    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE string_table( ( 'COL1' ) ( 'COL2' ) ( 'COL3' ) ).
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_columns( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_creator->create_dynamic_table( lt_columns ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 rows' act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field> exp = 'COL1 Value 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten. Die Struktur der Tabelle wird zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Spaltennamen definiert. Dies ist extrem flexibel für Szenarien, in denen die Datenstruktur nicht im Voraus bekannt ist, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von CSV-Dateien oder generischen Schnittstellen. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` ist hierbei zentral.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Dynamic Table, Dynamic Structure, Field-Symbols

CLASS zcl_codepage_generic_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_with_error_handling.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to_xstring(
          iv_string   = iv_input_string
          iv_codepage = iv_source_codepage ).

        rv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_xstring(
          iv_xstring  = lv_xstring
          iv_codepage = iv_target_codepage ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes XSTRING eine gültige UTF-8-Kodierung darstellt, ohne es vollständig zu konvertieren. (Hinweis: `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` bietet keine direkte Validierung, aber man kann eine Konvertierung versuchen und Fehler abfangen).
hint: Versuchen Sie, das XSTRING in einen String zu konvertieren und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR` ab.

CLASS zcl_codepage_validate_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_utf8
      IMPORTING
        ix_input_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_validate_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_utf8.
    DATA lv_dummy_string TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lv_dummy_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_xstring( ix_input_xstring ).
        rb_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lv_valid_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to_xstring( 'Valid UTF-8 String' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Strings, die jeweils in einer spezifischen Codepage vorliegen, in eine Liste von UTF-8 kodierten Strings. Die Quell-Codepage ist für jeden String in einer separaten Liste gegeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_list_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_string_with_codepage,
             text      TYPE string,
             codepage  TYPE abap_codepage,
           END OF ty_string_with_codepage.
    TYPES: tt_string_with_codepage TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_string_with_codepage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_list_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        it_input_list TYPE tt_string_with_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_utf8_list) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_list_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_list_to_utf8.
    rt_utf8_list = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_input_list (
      LET lv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to_xstring(
                           iv_string   = ls_item-text
                           iv_codepage = ls_item-codepage ) IN
      cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_xstring( lv_xstring )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_codepage_list_conv=>tt_string_with_codepage(
      ( text = 'Hallo Welt' codepage = '4103' ) " UTF-8
      ( text = 'Grüße' codepage = '1100' ) " Latin-1
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hallo Welt' ) ( 'Grüße' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_list_to_utf8( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'List conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` mit dem `LET` Ausdruck, um eine Liste von Strings dynamisch zu konvertieren. Für jedes Element der Eingabeliste wird eine Codepage-Konvertierung durchgeführt und das Ergebnis in eine neue Liste gesammelt. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster für die Listenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, codepage, conversion, FOR, VALUE, LET, Functional Programming, List Processing

  METHOD display_sflights_custom.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_functions) = lo_salv_table->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->set_all( abap_true ). " Enable all standard functions

        DATA(lo_display_settings) = lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( ).
        lo_display_settings->set_list_header( 'Flugdaten SFLIGHTS - Benutzerdefinierter Titel' ).

        DATA(lo_selections) = lo_salv_table->get_selections( ).
        lo_selections->set_selection_mode( if_salv_c_selection_mode=>single ). " Enable single row selection

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_employee_bonus_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS calculate_bonus IMPORTING iv_performance_cat TYPE char1
                                      iv_years_of_service TYPE i
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_bonus) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_bonus_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    rv_bonus = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN iv_performance_cat = 'A' THEN 1000 + ( iv_years_of_service * 50 )
      WHEN iv_performance_cat = 'B' THEN 500 + ( iv_years_of_service * 20 )
      WHEN iv_performance_cat = 'C' THEN 100
      ELSE 0 " Default for unknown categories
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_column_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_column_config.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).

        " Change heading for CARRID
        DATA(lo_column_carrid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column_carrid->set_long_text( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).

        " Hide PLANETYPE column
        DATA(lo_column_planetype) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PLANETYPE' ).
        lo_column_planetype->set_visible( abap_false ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus SFLIGHTS, die für jeden Flug eine 'Reisekategorie' (Kurzstrecke, Mittelstrecke, Langstrecke) basierend auf der Flugdauer (FLTIME) enthält. Kurzstrecke (< 120 Min), Mittelstrecke (120-360 Min), Langstrecke (> 360 Min).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` und einem `CASE`-Ausdruck, um die neue Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_category_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fltime      TYPE s_fltime,
             category    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_categories IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_categories) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_category_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_categories.
    rt_flight_categories = VALUE tt_flight_category(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
        ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid   = ls_sflight-connid
          fltime   = ls_sflight-fltime
          category = SWITCH string(
                       WHEN ls_sflight-fltime < 120 THEN 'Kurzstrecke'
                       WHEN ls_sflight-fltime >= 120 AND ls_sflight-fltime <= 360 THEN 'Mittelstrecke'
                       ELSE 'Langstrecke'
                     )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie SFLIGHTS-Daten an. Wenn der Benutzer auf eine Zeile doppelklickt, soll eine Meldung mit der Flugnummer (CARRID und CONNID) der doppelgeklickten Zeile angezeigt werden.
hint: Implementieren Sie das Interface `if_salv_events_table` in einer lokalen Klasse und registrieren Sie diese beim ALV-Objekt, um das `double_click`-Event zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_event.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF if_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING
        row
        column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_event.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR lo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    " Get the data of the clicked row
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_sflights[ row ] INTO DATA(lr_sflight).
    IF lr_sflight IS BOUND.
      ls_sflight = lr_sflight->*.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } wurde doppelgeklickt.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS, aber zählen Sie nur Flüge, die eine Mindestauslastung von 70% überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `CASE` für die bedingte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                          WHERE occ_perc > 70 ).

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
      IF lv_index IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = 1 ) TO result.
      ELSE.
        result[ lv_index ]-flight_count = result[ lv_index ]-flight_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
      FINALLY = result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer existiert und geben Sie 'Flug gefunden' oder 'Flug nicht gefunden' zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in einem `IF`- oder `CASE`-Konstrukt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_existence_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_existence_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } gefunden.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lt_sflights_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    lt_sflights_ext = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                ( ls_sflight
                                  status = get_flight_status( ls_sflight-occ_perc ) ) ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights_ext
        ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      WHEN iv_occupancy > 90 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
      WHEN iv_occupancy >= 50 AND iv_occupancy <= 90 THEN 'Normal'
      ELSE 'Gering'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen Text basierend auf einem numerischen Wert formatiert. Wenn der Wert negativ ist, soll er in Klammern stehen; wenn er null ist, soll 'N/A' angezeigt werden; ansonsten der Wert selbst.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck mit `WHEN` für die verschiedenen Bedingungen und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_numeric_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_number IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_number.
    rv_formatted_text = CASE iv_number
                          WHEN 0 THEN 'N/A'
                          WHEN OTHERS THEN COND string(
                                            WHEN iv_number < 0 THEN |({ iv_number })|
                                            ELSE |{ iv_number }|
                                          )
                        END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie SFLIGHTS-Daten in einem ALV an. Fügen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Schaltfläche in der ALV-Toolbar hinzu, die beim Klicken eine einfache Meldung ausgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_toolbar_interface` und implementieren Sie das Event `button_click` des Interfaces `if_salv_events_toolbar`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_toolbar_button DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_toolbar.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF if_salv_events_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        e_salv_function.

CLASS zcl_salv_toolbar_button IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_toolbar.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    CONSTANTS lc_function TYPE salv_de_function VALUE 'MY_BUTTON'.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_toolbar) = lo_salv_table->get_toolbar_interface( ).
        lo_toolbar->add_button(
          EXPORTING
            id      = lc_function
            text    = 'Meine Aktion'
            tooltip = 'Klicken für eine Meldung'
            icon    = icon_information
        ).

        SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR lo_toolbar.

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CONSTANTS lc_function TYPE salv_de_function VALUE 'MY_BUTTON'.
    IF e_salv_function = lc_function.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Meine benutzerdefinierte Aktion wurde ausgelöst!' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE tt_flight_group(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ( count = count + 1 ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE tt_test_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_sflights_test.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( CAST sflights_tab( lt_sflights_test ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_res_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_res_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' INTO DATA(ls_res_ua).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_ua-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( CAST sflights_tab( lt_sflights_test ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE tt_test_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflights_test.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( CAST sflights_tab( lt_sflights_test ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_res_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` (ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode, um interne Tabellen zu gruppieren. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife können Aggregationen wie das Zählen von Elementen pro Gruppe direkt durchgeführt werden. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END` oder Hash-Tabellen für die Aggregation.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie einen numerischen Wert und geben Sie 'Positiv', 'Negativ' oder 'Null' zurück. Verwenden Sie hierfür einen `CASE`-Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_number_sign_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_sign) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_number_sign_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_number_sign.
    CASE iv_number.
      WHEN 0.
        rv_sign = 'Null'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IF iv_number > 0.
          rv_sign = 'Positiv'.
        ELSE.
          rv_sign = 'Negativ'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Skalierungsmodus für ein `cl_gui_picture`-Control basierend auf der Bildgröße und einem gewünschten Anzeigemodus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für die Auswahl der Skalierungskonstante (z.B. `cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_stretch`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_scale_mode DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_dim,
             width  TYPE i,
             height TYPE i,
           END OF ty_image_dim.

    METHODS get_scale_mode
      IMPORTING
        is_dimensions TYPE ty_image_dim
        iv_display_hint TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_scale_mode) TYPE i. " Represents cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_* constants
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_scale_mode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_scale_mode.
    rv_scale_mode = SWITCH #( iv_display_hint
                              WHEN 'FIT_TO_WIDTH' THEN cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_fit_width
                              WHEN 'FIT_TO_HEIGHT' THEN cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_fit_height
                              WHEN 'STRETCH' THEN cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_stretch
                              WHEN 'CENTER' THEN cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_center
                              ELSE
                                IF is_dimensions-width > 1000 OR is_dimensions-height > 800
                                  THEN cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_fit_size
                                  ELSE cl_gui_picture=>scale_mode_none
                                ENDIF ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung verschiedener Ereignisse eines `cl_gui_picture`-Controls und geben Sie eine entsprechende Aktion zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine klassische `CASE`-Anweisung, um auf verschiedene Event-IDs zu reagieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF gc_events,
        click        TYPE i VALUE 1,
        double_click TYPE i VALUE 2,
        right_click  TYPE i VALUE 3,
      END OF gc_events.

    METHODS handle_picture_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_event_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_picture_event.
    CASE iv_event_id.
      WHEN gc_events-click.
        rv_action_description = 'Bild wurde einfach angeklickt.'.
      WHEN gc_events-double_click.
        rv_action_description = 'Bild wurde doppelt angeklickt. Detailansicht öffnen.'.
      WHEN gc_events-right_click.
        rv_action_description = 'Rechtsklick auf Bild. Kontextmenü anzeigen.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_action_description = 'Unbekanntes Bildereignis.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_path_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_image_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_path TYPE string
        iv_image_name TYPE string
        iv_image_type TYPE string " e.g., 'ICON', 'PHOTO', 'LOGO'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_path_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_image_path.
    DATA(lv_extension) = SWITCH #( iv_image_type
                                   WHEN 'ICON' THEN 'GIF'
                                   WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN 'JPG'
                                   WHEN 'LOGO' THEN 'PNG'
                                   ELSE 'BMP' ).

    rv_full_path = |{ iv_base_path }/{ iv_image_name }.{ lv_extension }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_mime_type_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_mime_type_for_extension

        iv_file_extension TYPE string " e.g., 'JPG', 'PNG', 'GIF'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_mime_type_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type_for_extension.
    rv_mime_type = SWITCH #( to_upper( iv_file_extension )
                              WHEN 'JPG' THEN 'image/jpeg'
                              WHEN 'JPEG' THEN 'image/jpeg'
                              WHEN 'PNG' THEN 'image/png'
                              WHEN 'GIF' THEN 'image/gif'
                              WHEN 'BMP' THEN 'image/bmp'
                              WHEN 'SVG' THEN 'image/svg+xml'
                              ELSE 'application/octet-stream' ). " Default for unknown types
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_visibility_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_picture_visible
      IMPORTING
        iv_user_role TYPE string
        ib_data_available TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_visible) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_visibility_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_picture_visible.
    rb_is_visible = SWITCH #( iv_user_role
                              WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN abap_true
                              WHEN 'MANAGER' THEN ib_data_available
                              WHEN 'USER' THEN
                                IF ib_data_available = abap_true AND sy-uname IS NOT INITIAL
                                  THEN abap_true
                                  ELSE abap_false
                                ENDIF
                              ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_hotspot_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_click_coordinates
      IMPORTING
        iv_x_coord TYPE i
        iv_y_coord TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_hotspot_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_click_coordinates.
    CASE abap_true.
      WHEN iv_x_coord BETWEEN 10 AND 100 AND iv_y_coord BETWEEN 10 AND 50.
        rv_action = 'Hotspot A geklickt: Bereich 1 (10,10)-(100,50)'.
      WHEN iv_x_coord BETWEEN 150 AND 250 AND iv_y_coord BETWEEN 70 AND 120.
        rv_action = 'Hotspot B geklickt: Bereich 2 (150,70)-(250,120)'.
      WHEN iv_x_coord BETWEEN 5 AND 15 AND iv_y_coord BETWEEN 5 AND 15.
        rv_action = 'Kleiner Hotspot C geklickt: Bereich 3 (5,5)-(15,15)'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_action = 'Kein Hotspot getroffen'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Laden von Bilddaten (XSTRING) in ein `cl_gui_picture`-Control, wobei die Vorverarbeitung der Daten je nach Bildformat variiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck, um formatabhängige Logik zu implementieren. Für die Simulation wird eine einfache String-Manipulation verwendet.

CLASS zcl_pic_data_loader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_image_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_data TYPE xstring
        iv_image_format TYPE string " e.g., 'BMP', 'JPG', 'PNG'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_data_loader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_image_data.
    DATA(lv_data_string) = xstring_to_string( iv_image_data ).

    CASE to_upper( iv_image_format ).
      WHEN 'BMP'.
        " Simulate BMP specific processing (e.g., header parsing)
        rv_processed_data = string_to_xstring( |BMP_PROCESSED_{ lv_data_string }| ).
      WHEN 'JPG'.
        " Simulate JPG specific processing (e.g., compression check)
        rv_processed_data = string_to_xstring( |JPG_PROCESSED_{ lv_data_string }| ).
      WHEN 'PNG'.
        " Simulate PNG specific processing (e.g., transparency handling)
        rv_processed_data = string_to_xstring( |PNG_PROCESSED_{ lv_data_string }| ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default: no specific processing
        rv_processed_data = iv_image_data.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_data_loader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD xstring_to_string.
    CALL FUNCTION 'HR_KR_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
      EXPORTING
        in_xstring = iv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        out_string = rv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_xstring.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text   = iv_string
      IMPORTING
        buffer = rv_xstring.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_picture_wrapper PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_picture_wrapper_simple IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_type = iv_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_picture_wrapper~get_type.
    rv_type = mv_type.

CLASS zcl_picture_wrapper_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_picture_wrapper.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_picture_wrapper_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_type = iv_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_picture_wrapper~get_type.
    rv_type = mv_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_picture_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_picture_wrapper
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_picture_wrapper) TYPE REF TO zif_picture_wrapper.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_picture_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_picture_wrapper.
    CASE iv_config_type.
      WHEN 'SIMPLE'.
        ro_picture_wrapper = NEW zcl_picture_wrapper_simple( iv_type = iv_config_type ).
      WHEN 'COMPLEX'.
        ro_picture_wrapper = NEW zcl_picture_wrapper_complex( iv_type = iv_config_type ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fallback or error handling
        ro_picture_wrapper = NEW zcl_picture_wrapper_simple( iv_type = 'DEFAULT' ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Dynamische Auswahl einer Methode zur Bildverarbeitung basierend auf einem Konfigurationsparameter, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_classdescr` und `CASE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_classdescr`) und `CASE` zur dynamischen Methodenauswahl und -ausführung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_pic_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_image_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_data TYPE xstring
        iv_processing_mode TYPE string " e.g., 'GRAYSCALE', 'WATERMARK'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_data) TYPE xstring.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS grayscale_image
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE xstring.
    METHODS watermark_image
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_pic_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_image_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_method_name) = SWITCH #( to_upper( iv_processing_mode )
                                     WHEN 'GRAYSCALE' THEN 'GRAYSCALE_IMAGE'
                                     WHEN 'WATERMARK' THEN 'WATERMARK_IMAGE'
                                     ELSE '' ).

    IF lv_method_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD (me)->(lv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              iv_data = iv_image_data
            RECEIVING
              rv_data = rv_result_data.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
          " Handle error if method not found or signature mismatch
          rv_result_data = iv_image_data. " Return original data on error
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_result_data = iv_image_data. " No specific processing mode, return original
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD grayscale_image.
    " Simulate grayscale conversion
    rv_data = string_to_xstring( |GRAYSCALE_{ xstring_to_string( iv_data ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD watermark_image.
    " Simulate watermark application
    rv_data = string_to_xstring( |WATERMARK_{ xstring_to_string( iv_data ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS xstring_to_string FOR zcl_pic_data_loader=>xstring_to_string.
    METHODS string_to_xstring FOR zcl_pic_data_loader=>string_to_xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_status_evaluator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS evaluate_picture_status
      IMPORTING
        ib_is_active TYPE abap_bool
        ib_has_error TYPE abap_bool
        ib_is_loading TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_status_evaluator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD evaluate_picture_status.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( COND #( WHEN ib_has_error = abap_true THEN 'ERROR'
                                       WHEN ib_is_loading = abap_true THEN 'LOADING'
                                       WHEN ib_is_active = abap_true THEN 'ACTIVE'
                                       ELSE 'INACTIVE' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_pic_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_pic,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             image_path TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_pic.
    TYPES tt_sflight_pic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_pic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_pic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_pics) TYPE tt_sflight_pic.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_image_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_image_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_pic_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_pic.
    rt_sflight_pics = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                LET lv_image_path = get_carrier_image_path( ls_flight-carrid ) IN
                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                  connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                  fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                  image_path = lv_image_path ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrier_image_path.
    rv_image_path = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                              WHEN 'AA' THEN '/SAP/PUBLIC/BC/ABAP/ICONS/ICON_AIRLINE_AA.GIF'
                              WHEN 'LH' THEN '/SAP/PUBLIC/BC/ABAP/ICONS/ICON_AIRLINE_LH.GIF'
                              WHEN 'UA' THEN '/SAP/PUBLIC/BC/ABAP/ICONS/ICON_AIRLINE_UA.GIF'
                              ELSE           '/SAP/PUBLIC/BC/ABAP/ICONS/ICON_AIRLINE_DEFAULT.GIF' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_url_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_image_url_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_url_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_url_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_image_url_type.
    rv_url_type = SWITCH #( iv_image_url
                            WHEN CONTAINS( substring = '/SAP/PUBLIC/' ) THEN 'MIME-Repository'
                            WHEN CONTAINS( substring = 'http://' ) OR
                                 CONTAINS( substring = 'https://' ) THEN 'Extern'

                            ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise (Feld `PRICE`) für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit der `SUM`-Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
        NEXT total_price = total_price + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total price should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data' act = lv_total_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Total price should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle eindeutigen Flugverbindungen (Carrier ID und Connection ID) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` im Format "AA-001, LH-002, ..." kommasepariert auflistet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `COND` oder `FILTER` für die Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_connections RETURNING VALUE(rv_connections_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connections.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_unique_connections) = REDUCE string_table(
        INIT connections = VALUE string_table( )
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
        NEXT connections = VALUE string_table( BASE connections ( |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }-{ <fs_sflight>-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ) ).

    rv_connections_string = REDUCE string(
        INIT result = ``
        FOR connection IN lt_unique_connections
        NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN connection ELSE result && `, ` && connection ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_concat_connections FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_connections) = lo_cut->get_unique_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Connections string should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data' act = lv_connections ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_connections CP '*AA-*' OR lv_connections CP '*LH-*' ) msg = 'Connections string should contain expected format' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `REDUCE` zweimal. Zuerst, um eine interne Tabelle von Strings mit eindeutigen Verbindungen zu erstellen (durch die Verwendung einer `SORTED TABLE` und `VALUE` mit `BASE`). Dann wird ein zweiter `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um diese String-Tabelle in einen einzelnen, kommaseparierten String zu überführen. Dies demonstriert die Verkettung und bedingte Logik innerhalb von `REDUCE`.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, Concatenation, SORTED TABLE, VALUE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft (Carrier ID) und speichern Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und einer `HASHED TABLE` als Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_counts TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE ty_carrier_counts(
        INIT counts = VALUE ty_carrier_counts( )
        FOR GROUPS <group> OF carrid IN lt_sflight
        GROUP BY carrid
        NEXT counts = VALUE ty_carrier_counts( BASE counts ( carrid = <group>-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Carrier counts should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data' act = lt_carrier_counts ).
    READ TABLE lt_carrier_counts WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_aa_count-count > 0 ) msg = 'AA should have flights' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS` und `GROUP BY`, um Daten nach einem Feld zu gruppieren. Der `GROUP SIZE`-Ausdruck liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Aggregationen und Gruppierungen direkt im ABAP-Code durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, HASHED TABLE, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und geben Sie dessen Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und vergleichen Sie den aktuellen Preis mit dem bisher höchsten Preis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_highest_price_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rs_flight = REDUCE ty_flight_info(
        INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_flight_info( price = 0 )
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
        NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > max_flight-price
                                  THEN VALUE ty_flight_info( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                                             connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                                             price  = <fs_sflight>-price )
                                  ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA(ls_highest_flight) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Highest price flight should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data' act = ls_highest_flight-price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_highest_flight-price > 0 ) msg = 'Highest price should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur iterativen Suche nach dem Element mit dem höchsten Wert. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `NEXT` ermöglicht eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung, die den Akkumulator (`max_flight`) basierend auf dem Vergleich des aktuellen Flugpreises aktualisiert.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, MAX, SFLIGHT, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von 'LH' (Lufthansa) enthält und für jeden dieser Flüge nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` in einer neuen Struktur speichert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die Filterung und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_lh_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_lh_flight.
    TYPES: ty_lh_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_lh_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE ty_lh_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_lh_flights = REDUCE ty_lh_flights(
        INIT lh_flights = VALUE ty_lh_flights( )
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
        NEXT lh_flights = VALUE ty_lh_flights( BASE lh_flights
                                                ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                                  connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                                  fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH flights table should not be initial if SFLIGHT has LH data' act = lt_lh_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_lh_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_lh_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Filterung und Transformation innerhalb eines einzigen `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks. Die `FOR ... IN ... WHERE`-Syntax filtert die Quelltabelle, und die `VALUE`-Expression mit `BASE` fügt die transformierten Zeilen zur Ergebnistabelle hinzu. Dies ist eine sehr deklarative und leistungsstarke Methode zur Datenmanipulation.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Transformation, VALUE, WHERE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle eindeutigen Städtenamen (Felder `CITYFROM` und `CITYTO`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` enthält, alphabetisch sortiert und durch Semikolons getrennt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR`, `VALUE` und `SORTED TABLE` für Eindeutigkeit und Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_cities_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_cities_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_cities_string.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT cityfrom, cityto FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_unique_cities) = REDUCE string_table(
        INIT cities = VALUE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
        NEXT cities = VALUE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line( BASE cities ( <fs_sflight>-cityfrom ) ( <fs_sflight>-cityto ) ) ).

    rv_cities_string = REDUCE string(
        INIT result = ``
        FOR city IN lt_unique_cities
        NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE result && `;` && city ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Cities string should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data' act = lv_cities ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_cities CP '*FRANKFURT*' OR lv_cities CP '*NEW YORK*' ) msg = 'Cities string should contain expected cities' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_cities CS 'A;B' OR lv_cities CS 'B;C' OR lv_cities CS 'C;D' ) msg = 'Cities string should be sorted' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise einer Liste von Flügen unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge zu erhalten, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate > iv_min_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes (z.B. `sflight-carrid`) zur Laufzeit und geben Sie den Datentypnamen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_type_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_name.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ).
      rv_type_name = lo_type_descr->get_type_kind_name( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_textedit_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_textedit_display.
    " Da GUI-Controls nicht direkt in Unit-Tests instanziiert werden können,
    " testen wir hier die Logik, die den Text setzt, indem wir die Methode direkt aufrufen.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier Mocking-Frameworks verwenden.

    DATA(lo_app) = NEW lcl_app( ).
    DATA(lv_test_text) = 'Testtext für TextEdit'.

    " Die Methode display_text instanziiert intern das Control.
    " Wir können hier nicht direkt auf das GUI-Control zugreifen,
    " aber wir können prüfen, ob die Methode ohne Fehler durchläuft.
    " Für eine tiefere Prüfung müsste man ein Test-Framework nutzen,
    " das GUI-Interaktionen simulieren kann, oder die GUI-Logik von der
    " Business-Logik trennen und nur letztere testen.
    TRY.
        lo_app->display_text( lv_test_text ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'display_text Methode erfolgreich ausgeführt.' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Fehler beim Ausführen von display_text: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Eine direkte Überprüfung des Textes im CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Control
    " ist in einem reinen ABAP Unit Test ohne GUI-Kontext nicht möglich.
    " Man könnte hier aber z.B. prüfen, ob ein internes Attribut gesetzt wurde,
    " falls die Klasse den Text intern speichern würde.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der Unit Test ist hier eingeschränkt, da GUI-Controls nicht direkt in einer nicht-GUI-Umgebung getestet werden können. In der Praxis würde man hier auf fortgeschrittene Teststrategien wie Mocking oder Trennung von UI- und Business-Logik setzen. Die `ASSERT` Anweisungen prüfen die erfolgreiche Ausführung der Logik.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des letzten Tages des Vormonats, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder die neuen Datumsfunktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_last_day_of_prev_month
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_prev_month.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_first_day_current_month) = lv_current_date - ( sy-datum+6(2) - 1 ).
    rv_date = lv_first_day_current_month - 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_last_day_prev_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_last_day_prev_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result_date) = lo_cut->get_last_day_of_prev_month( ).

    " Annahme: Test wird im November 2025 ausgeführt.
    " Letzter Tag des Vormonats (Oktober 2025) wäre 31.10.2025.
    " Da sy-datum dynamisch ist, muss der Test flexibel sein.
    DATA(lv_expected_year) = sy-datum+0(4).
    DATA(lv_expected_month) = sy-datum+4(2) - 1.
    IF lv_expected_month = 0.
      lv_expected_month = 12.
      lv_expected_year = lv_expected_year - 1.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_expected_date_str) = |{ lv_expected_year ALPHA = OUT }{ lv_expected_month ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 2 }01|.
    DATA(lv_first_day_prev_month) = lv_expected_date_str.
    DATA(lv_last_day_prev_month) = lv_first_day_prev_month + ( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_in_month( iv_year = lv_expected_year iv_month = lv_expected_month ) - 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_date exp = lv_last_day_prev_month msg = 'Datum des letzten Tages des Vormonats ist falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des letzten Tages des Vormonats kann durch einfache Datumsarithmetik erfolgen: Zuerst wird der erste Tag des aktuellen Monats ermittelt, indem die Tage des aktuellen Datums subtrahiert werden, und dann ein Tag abgezogen, um den letzten Tag des Vormonats zu erhalten. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode ohne komplexe Klassen.
keywords: Date, Time, Calculation, SY-DATUM

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Carrier ID und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Carrier.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                     count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_and_count FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250105' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Carrier gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 2 msg = 'LH Flüge falsch gezählt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 2 msg = 'AA Flüge falsch gezählt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ]-count exp = 1 msg = 'UA Flüge falsch gezählt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by=>tt_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_counts msg = 'Ergebnis für leere Tabelle sollte leer sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie vereinfacht Aggregationen und die Verarbeitung von Gruppen erheblich, indem sie die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen reduziert.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in einen JSON-String. Wählen Sie nur die Felder CARRID, CONNID und FLDATE.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize` und den `VALUE` Operator, um die interne Tabelle zu filtern und zu projizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid, connid = ls_sflight-connid, fldate = ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflights pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain CARRID' substring = 'CARRID' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain FLDATE' substring = 'FLDATE' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Anschließend wird `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize` verwendet, um diese Tabelle effizient in einen formatierten JSON-String umzuwandeln. Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine komplexe, verschachtelte Struktur (z.B. Flug mit zugehörigen Buchungen) in einen JSON-String.

solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             bookid TYPE s_book_id,
             custtype TYPE s_cust_ty,
           END OF ty_booking,
           tt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             bookings TYPE tt_bookings,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    METHODS serialize_nested_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_nested IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_flight_detail) = VALUE ty_flight_detail(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = sy-datum

        ( bookid = '00000001' custtype = 'B' )
        ( bookid = '00000002' custtype = 'E' )
      )
    ).

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_flight_detail pretty_print = abap_true ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Wiederholungsmechanismus mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife und exponentiellem Backoff für eine simulierte fehlgeschlagene Operation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Zähler, `WAIT UP TO` und einer Bedingung für den Erfolg.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_retry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_retries
      IMPORTING iv_max_retries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_attempt_count TYPE i.
    METHODS simulate_failed_operation RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_retry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_retries.
    DATA(lv_retry_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_wait_time) = 1.
    mv_attempt_count = 0.

    WHILE lv_retry_count < iv_max_retries.
      mv_attempt_count = mv_attempt_count + 1.
      IF simulate_failed_operation( ) = abap_true.
        rv_success = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_retry_count = lv_retry_count + 1.
      IF lv_retry_count < iv_max_retries.
        WAIT UP TO lv_wait_time SECONDS.
        lv_wait_time = lv_wait_time * 2. " Exponential backoff
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_success = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_failed_operation.
    " Simulate failure for first 2 attempts, success on 3rd
    IF mv_attempt_count < 3.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_retry_mechanism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_retry_mechanism.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_retries( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Operation should succeed after retries' act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(lo_cut_fail) = NEW zcl_while_retry( ).
    DATA(lv_fail_success) = lo_cut_fail->perform_retries( 2 ). " Max retries 2, but operation succeeds on 3rd attempt
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Operation should fail with insufficient retries' act = lv_fail_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine praktische Anwendung der `WHILE`-Schleife für einen Wiederholungsmechanismus mit exponentiellem Backoff. Die Schleife wird fortgesetzt, solange die maximale Anzahl von Wiederholungen nicht erreicht ist und die Operation fehlschlägt. `WAIT UP TO` ist eine moderne Art, eine Pause einzulegen.
keywords: WHILE, retry, exponential backoff, error handling, WAIT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fibonacci-Sequenz mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, bis ein bestimmter Grenzwert überschritten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit zwei Variablen, die die vorherigen Fibonacci-Zahlen speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_fibonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_fibonacci
      IMPORTING iv_limit TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fib_sequence) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_fibonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_fibonacci.
    DATA(lv_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_b) = 1.

    APPEND lv_a TO rt_fib_sequence.
    IF iv_limit = 0. RETURN. ENDIF.
    APPEND lv_b TO rt_fib_sequence.

    WHILE ( lv_a + lv_b ) <= iv_limit.
      DATA(lv_next) = lv_a + lv_b.
      APPEND lv_next TO rt_fib_sequence.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Elemente aus einer dynamisch wachsenden Arbeitsliste (interne Tabelle) mithilfe einer `WHILE`-Schleife, die Elemente nacheinander entfernt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE NOT worklist IS INITIAL` und `READ TABLE ... INDEX 1` mit `DELETE TABLE ... INDEX 1`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_worklist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_worklist
      IMPORTING it_initial_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_worklist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_worklist.
    DATA(lt_worklist) = it_initial_items.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.

    WHILE lt_worklist IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
      READ TABLE lt_worklist INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_current_item).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |Processed: { lv_current_item } (Iteration { lv_counter })| TO rt_processed_items.
        DELETE TABLE lt_worklist INDEX 1.

        " Simulate adding new items dynamically
        IF lv_current_item = 'Item B' AND lv_counter = 2.
          APPEND 'New Item X' TO lt_worklist.
          APPEND 'New Item Y' TO lt_worklist.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_worklist FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_worklist.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_worklist( ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string(
      ( 'Item A' )
      ( 'Item B' )
      ( 'Item C' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_worklist( lt_initial ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 6 processed items' act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item processed correctly' act = lt_processed[1] exp = 'Processed: Item A (Iteration 1)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'New Item X should be processed' act = lt_processed[4] exp = 'Processed: New Item X (Iteration 4)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine `WHILE`-Schleife verwendet werden kann, um eine dynamische Arbeitsliste zu verarbeiten, die sich während der Ausführung ändern kann (Elemente werden hinzugefügt und entfernt). Die Bedingung `IS NOT INITIAL` ist ideal für solche Szenarien, da die Schleife fortgesetzt wird, solange Elemente in der Liste vorhanden sind.
keywords: WHILE, worklist, queue, internal table, dynamic

Instructions: Fangen Sie Ausnahmen ab, die bei der Deserialisierung eines ungültigen JSON-Strings auftreten können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme `/ui2/cl_json=>json_parse_error` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_simple_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_simple_data.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string
                                   IMPORTING data = ls_data ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json=>json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).

CLASS zcl_red_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_red_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Konkateniere alle Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.

CLASS zcl_red_concat_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrids_as_string
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights

CLASS zcl_red_concat_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_as_string.
    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_flight>-carrid ELSE s && `, ` && <fs_flight>-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den höchsten Flugpreis in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` und die eingebaute Funktion `nmax`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_p TYPE sflights-price = it_sflights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = <fs_flight>-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `REDUCE` ist ideal, um Aggregationen wie das Finden des Maximums durchzuführen. Der `INIT`-Parameter initialisiert den Akkumulator mit dem Preis des ersten Elements (oder einem Standardwert, wenn die Tabelle leer ist), und in jedem `NEXT`-Schritt wird der Akkumulator mit dem größeren Wert zwischen dem aktuellen Akkumulator und dem Preis des aktuellen Fluges aktualisiert, unter Verwendung der eingebauten Funktion `nmax`.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Maximum, nmax

CLASS zcl_red_distinct_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge, die nach dem 01.01.2023 stattfinden.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_after_date
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_date     TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_after_date.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab FROM it_sflights
                                 WHERE fldate > iv_date.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflights-price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_map_carrid_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_total_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_carr_total_price.
    TYPES: tt_carr_total_price TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carr_total_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_total_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE tt_carr_total_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_map_carrid_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_total_prices.
    rt_carrier_prices = REDUCE tt_carr_total_price(
      INIT result TYPE tt_carr_total_price
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE #( result
        ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
          total_price = REDUCE sflights-price(
            INIT group_sum TYPE sflights-price = 0
            FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP <fs_flight>
            NEXT group_sum = group_sum + <fs_group_flight>-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights

CLASS zcl_red_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_price_above_threshold.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflights-price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + COND sflights-price( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > iv_threshold THEN <fs_flight>-price ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_group_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_connids_string,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids_string TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carr_connids_string.
    TYPES: tt_carr_connids_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_connids_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_connids_string
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carr_connids_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_group_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_connids_string.
    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
        connids_string = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP <fs_flight>
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_group_flight>-connid ELSE s && `, ` && <fs_group_flight>-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der äußere `FOR GROUPS` gruppiert die Daten, und der innere `REDUCE` aggregiert die `connid`-Werte der jeweiligen Gruppe zu einem String, wobei `COND` verwendet wird, um das anfängliche Komma zu vermeiden. Instructions: Erstelle eine Hash-Tabelle, die die Fluggesellschafts-ID als Schlüssel und das Flugobjekt mit dem höchsten Preis als Wert enthält.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und einem inneren `REDUCE` zum Finden des Maximums.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_max_flight_per_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_max_price_flight_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_price_flights) TYPE tt_sflights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_max_flight_per_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flight_per_carrier.
    rt_max_price_flights = REDUCE tt_sflights_hashed(
      INIT result TYPE tt_sflights_hashed
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE #( result
        ( REDUCE sflights(
            INIT max_flight TYPE sflights
            FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP <fs_flight>
            NEXT max_flight = COND sflights( WHEN <fs_group_flight>-price > max_flight-price OR max_flight-carrid IS INITIAL THEN <fs_group_flight> ELSE max_flight ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der äußere `REDUCE` iteriert über die Gruppen von Flügen pro Fluggesellschaft. Für jede Gruppe wird ein innerer `REDUCE` verwendet, um den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis innerhalb dieser Gruppe zu ermitteln. CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name    TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_multiple_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

        name    = ls_zip_file-name
        content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_file_xstring )
      ) TO rt_files.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_zip_file_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS file_exists_in_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_file_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD file_exists_in_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        DATA(lt_files) = lo_zip->get_files( ).
        IF line_exists( lt_files[ name = iv_filename ] ).
          rv_exists = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_exists = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid zip format
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
