CLASS zcl_simple_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_static_tree.
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    " Root Node
    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_node_key = 'ROOT'
      i_relat_node_key = ''
      i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
      i_text = 'Root Item'
    ).

    " Child 1
    lo_tree->add_node(

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT hierarchisch in einem Baum an, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Flugnummer. Die Anzeige erfolgt in einem übergebenen Custom Container.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE` und `ADD_NODE` in einer Schleife über die sortierten SFLIGHT-Daten. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Knotentexte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflight_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflight_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS.
    SORT lt_sflight BY carrid connid.

    DATA: lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    " Add root node for SFLIGHT
    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_node_key = 'SFLIGHT_ROOT'
      i_relat_node_key = ''
      i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
      i_text = 'Flight Data (SFLIGHT)'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF ls_sflight-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        " Add Carrier Node
        lo_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = ls_sflight-carrid
          i_relat_node_key = 'SFLIGHT_ROOT'
          i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_text = |Carrier: { ls_sflight-carrid }|
        ).
        lv_prev_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      " Add Flight Node
      lo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
        i_relat_node_key = ls_sflight-carrid
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_text = |Flight: { ls_sflight-connid } - { ls_sflight-fldate }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->set_table_for_first_display( ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( 'SFLIGHT_ROOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Differenzen zwischen zwei Spalten einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `SUBTRACT`-Operation innerhalb des Loops.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_diff
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_diff) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_diff.
    rv_total_diff = REDUCE #( INIT diff TYPE s_price VALUE 0
                              FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                              NEXT diff = diff + ( <fs_flight>-price - 100 ) ). " Beispiel: Preis - 100
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_with_subtract FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_with_subtract.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_subtract_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 200 planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 150 planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = 120 planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_diff( lt_sflights ).

    " Erwartet: (200-100) + (150-100) + (120-100) = 100 + 50 + 20 = 170
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 170 msg = 'REDUCE mit SUBTRACT falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_subtract_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_diff( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte 0 ergeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiger Ausdruck, um Werte aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren. Hier wird es verwendet, um die Summe von Differenzen zu berechnen, was eine funktionale und prägnante Alternative zu expliziten Loops mit `SUBTRACT` darstellt.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie zwei Dezimalzahlen mit hoher Präzision und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Ergebnis korrekt gerundet wird. Verwenden Sie `DECFLOAT34` für die Berechnung.

CLASS zcl_subtract_decfloat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_subtract_decfloat IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Eintrag die Differenz zwischen zwei Werten einer Quelltabelle enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und eine `SUBTRACT`-Operation innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_for_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             val1  TYPE i,
             val2  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             id    TYPE i,
             diff  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_differences
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_differences) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_for_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_differences.
    rt_differences = VALUE #( FOR <fs_data> IN it_source_data
                               ( id = <fs_data>-id
                                 diff = <fs_data>-val1 - <fs_data>-val2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_for_expression_subtract FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_for_expression_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression_subtract.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_subtract_for_expr=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 val1 = 10 val2 = 3 ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 val1 = 5 val2 = 8 ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 val1 = 100 val2 = 50 ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_for_expr( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_differences( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-diff exp = 7 msg = 'Differenz für ID 1 falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-diff exp = -3 msg = 'Differenz für ID 2 falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-diff exp = 50 msg = 'Differenz für ID 3 falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_for_expression_empty.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_subtract_for_expr=>tt_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_for_expr( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_differences( lt_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leeres Ergebnis liefern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird die Subtraktion direkt im Ausdruck durchgeführt, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und funktionaler macht als ein traditioneller `LOOP` mit `APPEND`.
keywords: SUBTRACT, FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Transformation

hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID` und registrieren Sie den `MENU_BUTTON` Event-Handler, um das Kontextmenü zu erstellen.
solution:
REPORT z_alv_context_menu.

DATA: ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION DEFERRED.
DATA: go_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_menu_button FOR EVENT menu_button OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_object
        e_salv_menu.
    METHODS handle_menu_select FOR EVENT menu_select OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_menu_button.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'DELETE_ROW' text = 'Zeile löschen' ).
    e_salv_menu = lo_menu.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_select.
    CASE e_fcode.
      WHEN 'DELETE_ROW'.
        DATA: ls_row_id TYPE lvc_s_row.
        CALL METHOD go_alv_grid->get_selected_rows
          IMPORTING
            et_row_id = DATA(lt_selected_rows).

        IF lt_selected_rows IS NOT INITIAL.
          READ TABLE lt_selected_rows INDEX 1 INTO ls_row_id.
          DELETE gt_sflight INDEX ls_row_id-row_id.
          go_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
          MESSAGE 'Zeile gelöscht!' TYPE 'S'.
        ELSE.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle transformieren. Wandeln Sie beispielsweise alle Fluggesellschafts-IDs in Kleinbuchstaben um und fügen Sie ein neues Feld für die Flugbeschreibung hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES ty_flights_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid_lc TYPE string,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES ty_flights_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_in TYPE ty_flights_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_out) TYPE ty_flights_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flights_out = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_in
                                  ( carrid_lc = to_lower( ls_flight-carrid )
                                    connid = ls_flight-connid
                                    description = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } from { ls_flight-cityfrom } to { ls_flight-cityto }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für eine Liste von Flügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flight_datas TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_datas
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_data IN it_flight_data
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_data-passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_agg_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = VALUE zcl_agg_reduce=>ty_flight_datas(
      ( carrid = 'LH' passengers = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' passengers = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' passengers = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_flight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = 450
      msg = 'Incorrect total passengers'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_data) = VALUE zcl_agg_reduce=>ty_flight_datas( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_empty_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_empty
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Incorrect total passengers for empty table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und funktionale Art der Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen durch einen einzigen, lesbaren Ausdruck.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Sum

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flights
        iv_carrier     TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'SAN FRANCISCO' )

    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

      act = lines( lt_lh_flights )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights for LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_lh_flights[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = '0400'
      msg = 'First LH flight incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_lh_flights[ 2 ]-connid
      exp = '0401'
      msg = 'Second LH flight incorrect'

    DATA(lt_xx_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrier = 'XX' ).

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,

             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS copy_data_by_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_data_by_corresponding.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_operator=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 'Value A'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = 'Value C'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->copy_data_by_corresponding( ls_source ).

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob eine Zeile in einer internen Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie deren Index, ohne eine explizite Schleife zu verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit Tabellenausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_items
        iv_id    TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    ev_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( it_items[ id = iv_id ] ) ).
    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = line_index( it_items[ id = iv_id ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_line FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_line FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_line.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_line_ops( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_tab_line_ops=>ty_items(
      ( id = 1 description = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 description = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 3 description = 'Item C' )
    ).

    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_index  TYPE i.

    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_items = lt_items iv_id = 2
                                  IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Line with ID 2 should exist'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_index
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect index for ID 2'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_line.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_line_ops( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_tab_line_ops=>ty_items(
      ( id = 1 description = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 3 description = 'Item C' )
    ).

    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_index  TYPE i.

    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_items = lt_items iv_id = 99
                                  IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Line with ID 99 should not exist'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_index
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Index should be 0 for non-existing line'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktionen `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken (`it_items[ id = iv_id ]`) ermöglichen eine sehr effiziente und prägnante Überprüfung der Existenz und Ermittlung des Index einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist performanter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleifen.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Performance

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine lokale Variable inline und weisen Sie ihr direkt das Ergebnis einer Funktion zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_data_func DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_current_date_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_date_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_data_func IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_date_string.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    rv_date_str = |Current Date: { lv_current_date DATE = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_current_date_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_current_date_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_data_func( ).
    DATA(lv_date_str) = lo_cut->get_current_date_string( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_expected_str) = |Current Date: { lv_expected_date DATE = USER }|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_date_str
      exp = lv_expected_str
      msg = 'Generated date string does not match current date'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(...)` ermöglicht es, Variablen genau dort zu deklarieren, wo sie zum ersten Mal verwendet werden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Variablen am Anfang einer Methode oder eines Blocks zu deklarieren, was zu kompakterem und fokussierterem Code führt.
keywords: DATA, Inline Declaration, Variables, Conciseness

Instructions: Finden Sie die erste Zeile in einer internen Tabelle, die einer bestimmten Bedingung entspricht, und geben Sie ein Feld dieser Zeile zurück. Wenn keine Zeile gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Tabellenausdruck `itab[ ... ]-field` in Kombination mit `DEFAULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES ty_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_product_name
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE ty_products
        iv_id       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_product_name.
    rv_product_name = VALUE string(
      DEFAULT 'Product Not Found'
      FOR ls_product IN it_products WHERE ( id = iv_id )
      ( ls_product-name )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_product FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_product FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_table_read( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_min_table_read=>ty_products(
      ( id = 100 name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )
      ( id = 101 name = 'Mouse' price = '25.50' )
      ( id = 102 name = 'Keyboard' price = '75.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->get_product_name( it_products = lt_products iv_id = 101 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_name
      exp = 'Mouse'
      msg = 'Incorrect product name for existing ID'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_table_read( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_min_table_read=>ty_products(
      ( id = 100 name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->get_product_name( it_products = lt_products iv_id = 999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_name
      exp = 'Product Not Found'
      msg = 'Incorrect product name for non-existing ID'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` mit `DEFAULT` und einem `FOR` Ausdruck mit `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine minimale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Syntax, um eine Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu suchen und einen Wert zurückzugeben, inklusive eines Fallback-Wertes. Dies ersetzt `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` Prüfungen und verbessert die Code-Klarheit.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Read Table, Default Value, Minimum

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für geometrische Formen mit einer abstrakten Methode zur Berechnung des Flächeninhalts. Implementieren Sie dann eine konkrete Unterklasse für ein Rechteck, die diese Methode implementiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS` in der Basisklasse und `REDEFINITION` in der Unterklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string,
      calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Generic Shape'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor IMPORTING iv_width TYPE decfloat34 iv_length TYPE decfloat34,
      calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA:
      mv_width  TYPE decfloat34,
      mv_length TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    mv_width  = iv_width.
    mv_length = iv_length.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_length.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rectangle_area FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rectangle_area.
    DATA(lo_rectangle) = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_width = '10.0' iv_length = '5.0' ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_rectangle->calculate_area( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_area,
      exp = '50.0',
      msg = 'Flächeninhalt des Rechtecks ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_rectangle->get_name( ),
      exp = 'Generic Shape',
      msg = 'Name der Form ist falsch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von abstrakten Klassen und Methoden. Die abstrakte Methode `calculate_area` muss von jeder konkreten Unterklasse implementiert werden, was Polymorphie fördert und eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle für verschiedene Formen bietet. Die `REDEFINITION` Syntax ist Standard für die Implementierung von geerbten Methoden.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHOD, REDEFINITION, OBJECT ORIENTATION, POLYMORPHISM

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Standardimplementierung für eine Methode. Erstellen Sie dann eine Klasse, die dieses Interface implementiert und die Standardmethode verwendet, ohne sie neu zu implementieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DEFAULT` bei der Methoden-Definition im Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
    DEFAULT VIA zcl_default_logger=>log_message_default.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_default_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS log_message_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_default_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message_default.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log file or system log.
    " For demo purposes, we just simulate it.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Default Log: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
    METHODS process_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    zif_logger~log_message( 'Processing started...' ).
    " ... some processing logic ...
    zif_logger~log_message( 'Processing finished.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_log_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_log_message.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_app_processor( ).
    " The default implementation will be called.
    " We can't directly assert the output of cl_demo_output,
    " so we'll assert that the method can be called without error.
    " In a real test, you'd mock the logger or check system logs.
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_data( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = '' " No exception means success for this simple test
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail(
          msg = |Exception caught: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.55 ermöglicht Standardimplementierungen für Interface-Methoden. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code in implementierenden Klassen, wenn die Standardlogik ausreichend ist, und erlaubt die Erweiterung von Interfaces, ohne bestehende Implementierungen anpassen zu müssen. Die Implementierung erfolgt über eine statische Methode einer Hilfsklasse.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT METHOD, ABAP 7.55, OBJECT ORIENTATION, CODE REUSE

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen entgegennimmt und eine neue Liste zurückgibt, in der jede Zahl verdoppelt wurde. Nutzen Sie dabei den `VALUE` Operator und eine funktionale Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RETURNING VALUE` für die Methode und den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` für die Transformation der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS double_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_doubled_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD double_numbers.
    rt_doubled_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers ( number * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_double_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_double_numbers.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_number_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_number_processor=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_number_processor=>tt_numbers( ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->double_numbers( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = lines( lt_expected ),
      msg = 'Anzahl der Elemente ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ],
      exp = lt_expected[ 1 ],
      msg = 'Erstes Element ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ],
      exp = lt_expected[ 2 ],
      msg = 'Zweites Element ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ],
      exp = lt_expected[ 3 ],
      msg = 'Drittes Element ist falsch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `double_numbers` ist eine funktionale Methode, die einen Wert zurückgibt (`RETURNING VALUE`). Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen, indem er eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den Elementen einer anderen Tabelle erstellt. Dies ist ein idiomatisch moderner ABAP-Ansatz.
keywords: FUNCTIONAL METHOD, VALUE, FOR, INTERNAL TABLES, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine 'fluent API' durch Methodenverkettung ermöglicht, um eine Konfiguration schrittweise aufzubauen. Jede Methode soll die Instanz der Klasse selbst zurückgeben.
hint: Lassen Sie jede Methode `ME` zurückgeben, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_config_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      set_param1 IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder,
      set_param2 IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder,
      build_config RETURNING VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_config.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config,
             param1 TYPE string,
             param2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_config.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: ms_config TYPE ty_config.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    ms_config-param1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    ms_config-param2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_config.
    rs_config = ms_config.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_config_builder( ).
    DATA(ls_config) = lo_builder->set_param1( 'TestValue' )
                               ->set_param2( 123 )
                               ->build_config( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_config-param1,
      exp = 'TestValue',
      msg = 'Param1 ist falsch gesetzt'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_config-param2,
      exp = 123,
      msg = 'Param2 ist falsch gesetzt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) ermöglicht eine flüssigere und lesbarere API, indem jede Setter-Methode eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies erlaubt es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was den Code kompakter macht und dem 'Fluent Interface'-Designmuster folgt.
keywords: METHOD CHAINING, FLUENT API, OBJECT ORIENTATION, ME, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Service) über ihren Konstruktor injiziert bekommt. Demonstrieren Sie, wie die injizierte Abhängigkeit in einer Methode verwendet wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `IMPORTING` Parameter im `CONSTRUCTOR` und speichern Sie die Referenz in einem privaten Attribut.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_service PUBLIC.
  METHODS perform_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_concrete_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_service~perform_action.
    rv_result = 'Action performed by Concrete Service'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor IMPORTING io_service TYPE REF TO zif_service,
      execute_logic RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_service TYPE REF TO zif_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_service = io_service.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_logic.
    rv_output = mo_service->perform_action( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    " Create the dependency
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_concrete_service( ).
    " Inject the dependency into the consumer
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_consumer( io_service = lo_service ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_consumer->execute_logic( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Action performed by Concrete Service',
      msg = 'Service-Methode wurde nicht korrekt aufgerufen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein Designmuster, bei dem Abhängigkeiten einer Klasse über ihren Konstruktor bereitgestellt werden. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert das Testen, da verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces (hier `zif_service`) einfach ausgetauscht werden können. Die Klasse `zcl_consumer` ist nicht direkt an `zcl_concrete_service` gebunden, sondern nur an das Interface.
keywords: CONSTRUCTOR INJECTION, DEPENDENCY INJECTION, INTERFACE, OBJECT ORIENTATION, LOOSE COUPLING

Instructions: In einer globalen Klasse soll eine komplexe Berechnung durchgeführt werden. Kapseln Sie die Hilfslogik für diese Berechnung in einer lokalen Klasse, die nur innerhalb der Methode der globalen Klasse sichtbar und nutzbar ist.
hint: Definieren Sie die lokale Klasse (`CLASS LCL_...`) und ihre Implementierung direkt innerhalb der `IMPLEMENTATION` Sektion der globalen Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.

    " Local class definition and implementation, only visible within this method
    CLASS lcl_square_helper DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        CLASS METHODS get_square IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_square) TYPE i.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_square_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_square.
        rv_square = iv_number * iv_number.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + lcl_square_helper=>get_square( number )
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_complex_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_input ).

    " Expected: 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 14,
      msg = 'Summe der Quadrate ist falsch'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_empty_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_empty_result,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Summe der Quadrate für leere Tabelle sollte 0 sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Lokale Klassen können direkt innerhalb der Implementierung einer globalen Klasse oder Methode definiert werden. Dies ist nützlich, um Hilfslogik zu kapseln, die nur in einem spezifischen Kontext benötigt wird, ohne den globalen Namensraum zu belasten. Hier wird eine lokale Klasse `lcl_square_helper` verwendet, um die Quadratberechnung zu abstrahieren, die dann im `REDUCE`-Ausdruck genutzt wird, um die Summe der Quadrate zu berechnen.
keywords: LOCAL CLASS, CODE STRUCTURE, REDUCE, ABAP 7.40, ENCAPSULATION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden. Implementieren Sie dann eine weitere Methode, die dynamisch eine der Methoden der Klasse basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen aufruft. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Existenz der Methode zu prüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF lo_instance` und `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string,
      method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string,
      call_dynamic_method
        IMPORTING
          iv_method_name TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
        RAISING
          cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_result = 'Result from Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_result = 'Result from Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.

    TRY.
        " Get RTTI description for the current class
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( me->get_class_name( ) ).
        " Check if the method exists
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

        " Dynamic method call
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF me RECEIVING rv_output = rv_output.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Dynamischer Aufruf fehlgeschlagen: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Methode '{ iv_method_name }' existiert nicht oder ist nicht öffentlich: { lx_rtti_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS:
      test_dynamic_call_method_a FOR TESTING,
      test_dynamic_call_method_b FOR TESTING,
      test_dynamic_call_non_existent FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_method_a.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( 'METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Result from Method A',
      msg = 'Dynamischer Aufruf von METHOD_A fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_method_b.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( 'METHOD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Result from Method B',
      msg = 'Dynamischer Aufruf von METHOD_B fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    TRY.
        lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Erwartete Ausnahme für nicht existierende Methode wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = '' " Exception caught, test passed
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe (`CALL METHOD (name) OF object`) ermöglichen es, zur Laufzeit zu entscheiden, welche Methode aufgerufen werden soll. In Kombination mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) über Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` kann die Existenz und Signatur von Methoden vor dem Aufruf überprüft werden, was die Robustheit erhöht. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Verarbeitungslogiken.
keywords: DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, RTTI, CALL METHOD, CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen obligatorischen Parameter und einen optionalen Parameter mit einem Standardwert hat. Demonstrieren Sie den Aufruf der Methode sowohl mit als auch ohne den optionalen Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DEFAULT` in der Methoden-Definition für optionale Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_param_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_required_value TYPE string
        iv_optional_value TYPE string DEFAULT 'Default Value'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_combined_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_param_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rv_combined_string = |Required: { iv_required_value }, Optional: { iv_optional_value }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS:
      test_with_optional_param FOR TESTING,
      test_without_optional_param FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_optional_param.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_param_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->process_data(
      iv_required_value = 'Mandatory'
      iv_optional_value = 'Custom Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Required: Mandatory, Optional: Custom Value',
      msg = 'Aufruf mit optionalem Parameter fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_without_optional_param.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_param_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->process_data(
      iv_required_value = 'Mandatory'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Required: Mandatory, Optional: Default Value',
      msg = 'Aufruf ohne optionalen Parameter (Standardwert) fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Seit ABAP 7.40 können Methodenparameter mit dem `DEFAULT`-Zusatz als optional definiert werden. Dies verbessert die Flexibilität von Methoden, da nicht immer alle Parameter explizit übergeben werden müssen. Wenn ein optionaler Parameter nicht übergeben wird, wird automatisch sein Standardwert verwendet.
keywords: OPTIONAL PARAMETER, DEFAULT, METHOD, ABAP 7.40, OBJECT ORIENTATION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft enthält, wobei die Daten in einer neuen Struktur gemappt werden. Nutzen Sie dabei Tabellenausdrücke und den `FOR` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und den `VALUE` Operator für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrier  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fldate = flight-fldate,
                                     price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result_lh) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lt_result_aa) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier = 'AA' ).
    DATA(lt_result_ua) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier = 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result_lh ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Anzahl der LH-Flüge ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result_lh[ 1 ]-carrid,
      exp = 'LH',
      msg = 'Erster LH-Flug ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result_aa ),
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'Anzahl der AA-Flüge ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result_aa[ 1 ]-carrid,
      exp = 'AA',
      msg = 'Erster AA-Flug ist falsch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result_ua ),
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Anzahl der UA-Flüge ist falsch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke mit dem `FOR` Operator und der `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglichen eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizite Schleifen zu verwenden, wird hier in einer einzigen Anweisung eine neue Tabelle erstellt, die nur die gewünschten Elemente enthält und diese gleichzeitig in eine neue Struktur mappt. Dies ist ein sehr effizienter und moderner Weg, mit internen Tabellen zu arbeiten.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, TABLE EXPRESSIONS, FOR, WHERE, VALUE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die eine einfache Berechnung durchführt (z.B. Addition von zwei Zahlen). Demonstrieren Sie den Aufruf dieser statischen Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS METHODS` für die Definition und `=>` für den Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_static_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS add_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_static_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_numbers.
    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_static_calculator=>add_numbers(
      iv_num1 = 5
      iv_num2 = 3
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 8,
      msg = 'Addition ist falsch'
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_negative) = zcl_static_calculator=>add_numbers(
      iv_num1 = -5
      iv_num2 = 3
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_negative,
      exp = -2,
      msg = 'Addition mit negativer Zahl ist falsch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Statische Methoden (`CLASS METHODS`) gehören zur Klasse selbst und nicht zu einer Instanz der Klasse. Sie können direkt über den Klassennamen und den `=>`-Operator aufgerufen werden, ohne dass ein Objekt instanziiert werden muss. Dies ist ideal für Hilfsfunktionen oder Berechnungen, die keinen Zugriff auf Instanzattribute benötigen.
keywords: STATIC METHOD, CLASS METHODS, OBJECT ORIENTATION, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer konkreten Methode und einer abstrakten Methode. Implementieren Sie dann zwei verschiedene Unterklassen, die die abstrakte Methode unterschiedlich implementieren, um Polymorphie zu demonstrieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `ABSTRACT METHODS` und `REDEFINITION` in den Unterklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      print_header,
      print_content ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD print_header.
    cl_demo_output=>display( '--- Document Header ---' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_printer FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS print_content REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD print_content.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Simple Print: { iv_text }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fancy_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_printer FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS print_content REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fancy_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD print_content.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |*** FANCY PRINT *** { iv_text } *** FANCY PRINT ***| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS:
      test_simple_printer FOR TESTING,
      test_fancy_printer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simple_printer.
    DATA(lo_printer) = CAST zcl_abstract_printer( NEW zcl_simple_printer( ) ).
    " We can't directly assert cl_demo_output, so we assert no dump.
    TRY.
        lo_printer->print_header( ).
        lo_printer->print_content( 'Hello Simple' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception: { lx_ex->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fancy_printer.
    DATA(lo_printer) = CAST zcl_abstract_printer( NEW zcl_fancy_printer( ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_printer->print_header( ).
        lo_printer->print_content( 'Hello Fancy' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception: { lx_ex->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert das Konzept der abstrakten Klassen, indem es eine konkrete Methode (`print_header`) in der abstrakten Basisklasse definiert, die von allen Unterklassen geerbt wird, und eine abstrakte Methode (`print_content`), die von jeder Unterklasse spezifisch implementiert werden muss. Dies demonstriert Polymorphie: Obwohl `lo_printer` vom Typ `zcl_abstract_printer` ist, wird zur Laufzeit die korrekte `print_content`-Implementierung der jeweiligen Unterklasse aufgerufen.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHOD, POLYMORPHISM, REDEFINITION, OBJECT ORIENTATION, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory Method Pattern, um verschiedene Arten von 'Produkten' (z.B. verschiedene Arten von Dokumenten) zu erstellen. Nutzen Sie eine abstrakte Creator-Klasse mit einer abstrakten Factory-Methode und konkreten Creator-Klassen, die diese Methode implementieren.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Produkt-Interface, eine abstrakte Creator-Klasse mit einer abstrakten `factory_method` und konkrete Creator-Klassen, die diese Methode implementieren, um konkrete Produkte zu erzeugen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_type.
    rv_type = 'PDF Document'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Word Document'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      create_document ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document,
      get_document_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_document_type.
    DATA(lo_document) = create_document( ).
    rv_type = lo_document->get_type( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_document_creator FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_document REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    ro_document = NEW zcl_pdf_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_document_creator FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_document REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    ro_document = NEW zcl_word_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS:
      test_pdf_creator FOR TESTING,
      test_word_creator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pdf_creator.
    DATA(lo_creator) = CAST zcl_document_creator( NEW zcl_pdf_creator( ) ).
    DATA(lv_doc_type) = lo_creator->get_document_type( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_doc_type,
      exp = 'PDF Document',
      msg = 'PDF Creator erzeugt falschen Dokumenttyp'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_word_creator.
    DATA(lo_creator) = CAST zcl_document_creator( NEW zcl_word_creator( ) ).
    DATA(lv_doc_type) = lo_creator->get_document_type( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_doc_type,
      exp = 'Word Document',
      msg = 'Word Creator erzeugt falschen Dokumenttyp'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern ist ein kreationelles Entwurfsmuster, das eine Schnittstelle zum Erstellen eines Objekts bereitstellt, aber Unterklassen entscheiden lässt, welche Klasse instanziiert wird. Hier wird eine abstrakte `zcl_document_creator` mit einer abstrakten `create_document`-Methode definiert. Konkrete Creator-Klassen (z.B. `zcl_pdf_creator`) implementieren diese Methode, um spezifische Produkt-Objekte (z.B. `zcl_pdf_document`) zu erzeugen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems.
keywords: FACTORY METHOD, DESIGN PATTERN, ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHOD, OBJECT ORIENTATION, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den MIME-Typ für eine gegebene Dateierweiterung (z.B. 'pdf', 'jpg').
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_MIME_TYPE_FROM_EXTENSION` der Klasse `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type.
    rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_from_extension( iv_extension ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_pdf_mime FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_jpg_mime FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_mime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pdf_mime.
    DATA(lo_resolver) = NEW zcl_mime_type_resolver( ).
    DATA(lv_mime) = lo_resolver->get_mime_type( 'pdf' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_mime exp = 'application/pdf' msg = 'PDF MIME type incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_jpg_mime.
    DATA(lo_resolver) = NEW zcl_mime_type_resolver( ).
    DATA(lv_mime) = lo_resolver->get_mime_type( 'jpg' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_mime exp = 'image/jpeg' msg = 'JPG MIME type incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_mime.
    DATA(lo_resolver) = NEW zcl_mime_type_resolver( ).
    DATA(lv_mime) = lo_resolver->get_mime_type( 'xyz' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_mime exp = 'application/octet-stream' msg = 'Unknown MIME type incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `GET_MIME_TYPE_FROM_EXTENSION` der Klasse `cl_fxs_mime_types` bietet eine einfache und standardisierte Möglichkeit, MIME-Typen basierend auf Dateierweiterungen zu ermitteln, was die manuelle Verwaltung von MIME-Typ-Mappings überflüssig macht.
keywords: MIME, Dateierweiterung, cl_fxs_mime_types, Utility

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener MIME-Typ zu einer Textdatei gehört (z.B. 'text/plain', 'application/json').
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Operationen und die Konstanten von `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_text_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_text) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_text_mime_type.
    rv_is_text = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_mime_type CP 'text/*' OR
           iv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_json OR
           iv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_xml
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_text_plain FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_application_json FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_image_jpeg FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_application_pdf FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_text_plain.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_mime_type_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->is_text_mime_type( 'text/plain' ) msg = 'text/plain should be text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_application_json.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_mime_type_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->is_text_mime_type( cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_json ) msg = 'application/json should be text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_image_jpeg.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_mime_type_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->is_text_mime_type( 'image/jpeg' ) msg = 'image/jpeg should not be text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_application_pdf.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_mime_type_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->is_text_mime_type( 'application/pdf' ) msg = 'application/pdf should not be text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `COND abap_bool` in Kombination mit String-Pattern-Matching (`CP`) und den vordefinierten Konstanten von `cl_fxs_mime_types` ermöglicht eine prägnante und lesbare Überprüfung von MIME-Typen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für moderne, funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: MIME, Text, cl_fxs_mime_types, Conditional Logic, String Processing

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Dateinamen, um nur diejenigen zu erhalten, die einem bestimmten MIME-Typ entsprechen (z.B. alle Bilder).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_from_extension` mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file,
             name TYPE string,
             path TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file,
           tt_files TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        it_files      TYPE tt_files
        iv_target_mime TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_files) TYPE tt_files.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_mime_type.
    rt_filtered_files = FILTER #( it_files USING KEY primary_key WHERE
      cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_from_extension(
        substring_after( val = name sep = '.' ) ) = iv_target_mime
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_images FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_documents FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_images.
    DATA: lt_files TYPE zcl_file_filter=>tt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'image1.jpg' path = '/tmp' ) TO lt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'document.pdf' path = '/tmp' ) TO lt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'image2.png' path = '/tmp' ) TO lt_files.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_file_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_by_mime_type( it_files = lt_files iv_target_mime = 'image/jpeg' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should find 1 JPEG image' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-name exp = 'image1.jpg' msg = 'Incorrect JPEG file' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_documents.
    DATA: lt_files TYPE zcl_file_filter=>tt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'report.docx' path = '/docs' ) TO lt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'presentation.pptx' path = '/docs' ) TO lt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'image.gif' path = '/docs' ) TO lt_files.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_file_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_by_mime_type( it_files = lt_files iv_target_mime = cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_vnd_openxmlformats_officedocument_wordprocessingml_document ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should find 1 DOCX document' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-name exp = 'report.docx' msg = 'Incorrect DOCX file' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA: lt_files TYPE zcl_file_filter=>tt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'file.txt' path = '/data' ) TO lt_files.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_file_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_by_mime_type( it_files = lt_files iv_target_mime = 'application/zip' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should find no files' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Geben Sie eine Liste aller bekannten MIME-Typ-Konstanten aus der Klasse `cl_fxs_mime_types` zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Konstanten einer Klasse zu lesen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mime_constant,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mime_constant,
           tt_mime_constants TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mime_constant WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_mime_constants
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_constants) TYPE tt_mime_constants.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_mime_constants.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_attributes  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_attribute_descr.

    lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES' ).
    lt_attributes = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute) WHERE is_constant = abap_true.
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_value) = lo_class_descr->get_attribute_value( name = ls_attribute-name ).
          APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_attribute-name value = lv_value ) TO rt_constants.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
          " Handle error if attribute value cannot be read (e.g., not a simple type)
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_editor_syntax DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_abap_editor_syntax IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_editor_syntax.
    IF io_abap_editor IS BOUND.
      TRY.
          io_abap_editor->check_syntax( ).
          rv_has_errors = abap_false.
        CATCH cx_gui_error.
          " Syntax errors are typically reported via events or specific methods,
          " not necessarily by an exception from check_syntax itself.
          " This catch block is more for general GUI errors.
          rv_has_errors = abap_true.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_has_errors = abap_true. " Cannot check syntax if editor is not bound
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lo_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit,
          lt_code   TYPE cl_gui_abapedit=>t_text_table.

    APPEND 'REPORT Z_VALID_CODE.' TO lt_code.

    DATA(lo_syntax_checker) = NEW zcl_abap_editor_syntax( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_has_errors msg = 'Valid code should not have errors' ).

          lt_code   TYPE cl_gui_abapedit=>t_text_table.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_editor.

    APPEND 'REPORT Z_INVALID_CODE.' TO lt_code.
    APPEND 'WRITEE: / ''ERROR''.' TO lt_code. " Typo
    lo_editor->set_text_as_r3table( lt_code ).

    DATA(lo_syntax_checker) = NEW zcl_abap_editor_syntax( ).
    DATA(lv_has_errors) = lo_syntax_checker->check_editor_syntax( io_abap_editor = lo_editor ).

    " Note: check_syntax itself might not raise an exception for syntax errors,
    " but rather trigger events or update internal error tables. For unit test,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in der Tabelle `sflight` den Gesamtumsatz, indem Sie den Preis (`PRICE`) mit der Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`SEATSCC`) multiplizieren. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und führen Sie die Berechnung direkt im `VALUE`-Operator durch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_flight_revenue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_revenue,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             revenue  TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_revenue.
    TYPES tt_flight_revenue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_revenue WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_revenue
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_revenue) TYPE tt_flight_revenue.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_flight_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_revenue.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_revenue = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          ( carrid  = flight-carrid
                            connid  = flight-connid
                            fldate  = flight-fldate
                            revenue = flight-price * flight-seatscc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_revenue FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_revenue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_flight_revenue( ).
    DATA(lt_revenue) = lo_cut->calculate_revenue( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_revenue ).

    " Check a specific entry if possible, or just check structure/types
    LOOP AT lt_revenue INTO DATA(ls_revenue) WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
      " Assuming some test data exists in sflight for LH 0400 on 20250101
      " For a real test, you'd mock sflight or ensure specific data.
      " Here, we just check if the revenue is calculated and not zero.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Revenue should not be zero' act = ls_revenue-revenue exp = 0 ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt eine `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu füllen. Die Berechnung des Umsatzes (`flight-price * flight-seatscc`) erfolgt direkt und kompakt innerhalb der Expression, was den Code sehr lesbar und modern macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `sflight` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Expression, um die Preise zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen rabattierten Flugpreis: Wenn der ursprüngliche Preis über 500 EUR liegt, gewähren Sie 10% Rabatt; andernfalls bleibt der Preis gleich.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator innerhalb einer `COMPUTE`-ähnlichen Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_discount_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_discount_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    rv_discounted_price = COND #( WHEN iv_original_price > 500 THEN iv_original_price * '0.9'
                                  ELSE iv_original_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_discount_price( ).

    " Test case 1: Price above threshold
    DATA(lv_price_high) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '600.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Discount not applied correctly for high price' act = lv_price_high exp = '540.00' ).

    " Test case 2: Price below threshold
    DATA(lv_price_low) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '400.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price changed for low price' act = lv_price_low exp = '400.00' ).

    " Test case 3: Price at threshold
    DATA(lv_price_at_threshold) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price changed for threshold price' act = lv_price_at_threshold exp = '500.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
