Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis jedes Fluges in einer internen Tabelle um 5% und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen. Verwenden Sie dabei Feld-Symbole für den direkten Zugriff und die Modifikation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und führen Sie die Berechnung direkt im Schleifenkörper durch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_price_increase DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increase_flight_prices
      IMPORTING CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_price_increase IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      " Increase price by 5% and round to 2 decimal places
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.05'.
      " Explicit rounding if needed, otherwise type P handles it
      " <fs_sflight>-price = round( val = <fs_sflight>-price dec = 2 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_price_increase( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Prepare test data
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'BOEING747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'AIRBUS380' seatsmax = 500 seatsocc = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    lo_cut->increase_flight_prices( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    " Check first flight
    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for AA 0001 incorrect' act = ls_flight_1-price exp = '105.00' ).

    " Check second flight
    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_2) INDEX 2.
    " 250.50 * 1.05 = 263.025 -> 263.03 (type P rounds automatically)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for LH 0400 incorrect' act = ls_flight_2-price exp = '263.03' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Feld-Symbolen (`FIELD-SYMBOL`) in einer `LOOP`-Anweisung ermöglicht den direkten und performanten Zugriff auf die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. Die Berechnung (`<fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.05'`) erfolgt in-place, was die Notwendigkeit einer separaten Arbeitsbereichsvariablen und einer `MODIFY`-Anweisung überflüssig macht. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode zur Massenaktualisierung von Tabellenzeilen.
keywords: COMPUTE, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, Data Modification, LOOP

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine leere Zeile (Initialzeile) am Anfang einer internen Tabelle von Flugdatensätzen ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT INITIAL LINE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_initial_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_initial_flight
      IMPORTING it_initial_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_initial_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_initial_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    lt_sflights = it_initial_flights. " Copy initial flights

    " Insert an initial line at the beginning (index 1)
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO lt_sflights INDEX 1.

    rt_sflights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_initial_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_initial_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_initial_line( ).
    DATA lt_initial_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Prepare initial flights
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.

    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_cut->add_initial_flight( it_initial_flights = lt_initial_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    " Check the first entry (should be initial)
    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_first_flight) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'First entry should be initial' act = ls_first_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'First entry should be initial' act = ls_first_flight-connid ).

    " Check the original first entry (now at index 2)
    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_shifted_flight) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Original first entry shifted incorrectly' act = ls_shifted_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT INITIAL LINE`-Anweisung ist eine einfache und klare Methode, um eine Zeile mit Initialwerten in eine interne Tabelle einzufügen. Dies ist oft nützlich, um Platzhalter zu schaffen oder wenn eine leere Zeile für bestimmte Verarbeitungslogiken benötigt wird. Die Angabe von `INDEX 1` sorgt dafür, dass die Zeile am Anfang der Tabelle platziert wird.
keywords: INSERT, INITIAL LINE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen 'Premium-Preis' für einen Flug, der sich aus dem Basispreis, einem Zuschlag für die Flugdauer (angenommen 2 Stunden pro 1000 km) und einem festen Servicezuschlag zusammensetzt. Verwenden Sie den `LET`-Ausdruck, um Zwischenergebnisse zu speichern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COMPUTE` in Verbindung mit `LET` für lokale Variablen innerhalb der Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_premium_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_premium_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_distance   TYPE i " Assuming distance in km
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_premium_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_premium_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_premium_price.
    rv_premium_price = COMPUTE #( 
      LET
        l_duration_factor = iv_distance / 1000 * 2 " 2 hours per 1000 km
        l_duration_surcharge = l_duration_factor * 50 " 50 EUR per hour
        l_service_surcharge = 25 " Fixed service surcharge
      IN
        iv_base_price + l_duration_surcharge + l_service_surcharge
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_premium_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_premium_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_premium_price( ).

    " Test case 1: Base price 100, distance 1000km
    " Duration factor: 1000/1000 * 2 = 2
    " Duration surcharge: 2 * 50 = 100
    " Premium price: 100 + 100 + 25 = 225
    DATA(lv_price_1) = lo_cut->calculate_premium_price( iv_base_price = '100.00' iv_distance = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Premium price 1 incorrect' act = lv_price_1 exp = '225.00' ).

    " Test case 2: Base price 200, distance 2500km
    " Duration factor: 2500/1000 * 2 = 5
    " Duration surcharge: 5 * 50 = 250
    " Premium price: 200 + 250 + 25 = 475
    DATA(lv_price_2) = lo_cut->calculate_premium_price( iv_base_price = '200.00' iv_distance = 2500 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Premium price 2 incorrect' act = lv_price_2 exp = '475.00' ).

    " Test case 3: Base price 50, distance 0km
    " Duration factor: 0
    " Duration surcharge: 0
    " Premium price: 50 + 0 + 25 = 75
    DATA(lv_price_3) = lo_cut->calculate_premium_price( iv_base_price = '50.00' iv_distance = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Premium price 3 incorrect' act = lv_price_3 exp = '75.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb einer Expression. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Berechnungen, indem Zwischenergebnisse benannt und wiederverwendet werden können, ohne separate Variablen außerhalb der Expression deklarieren zu müssen. In Kombination mit `COMPUTE` ist dies eine sehr leistungsstarke funktionale Erweiterung.
keywords: COMPUTE, LET, Expressions, Arithmetic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine Zieltabelle (`tt_target_flights`) ein, indem Sie Daten aus einer Quellstruktur (`ts_source_flight_data`) verwenden. Die Felder sollen dabei automatisch anhand ihrer Namen zugeordnet werden, auch wenn die Strukturen nicht identisch sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT TABLE LINE` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight_data,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             base_price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_unit TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_source_flight_data.

    METHODS add_flight_corresponding
      IMPORTING is_source_data TYPE ty_source_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_corresponding.
    DATA lt_target_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Insert a new line into the target table, mapping fields by name
    INSERT CORRESPONDING #( is_source_data ) INTO TABLE lt_target_flights.

    rt_target_flights = lt_target_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flight_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flight_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_corresponding( ).
    DATA ls_source_data TYPE zcl_insert_corresponding=>ty_source_flight_data.

    " Prepare source data
    ls_source_data-airline_id    = 'DL'.
    ls_source_data-flight_num    = '1234'.
    ls_source_data-flight_date   = '20250701'.
    ls_source_data-base_price    = '350.75'.
    ls_source_data-currency_unit = 'USD'.

    DATA(lt_target_flights) = lo_cut->add_flight_corresponding( is_source_data = ls_source_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 1 entry' act = lines( lt_target_flights ) exp = 1 ).

    READ TABLE lt_target_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect CARRID' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'DL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect CONNID' act = ls_flight-connid exp = '1234' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect FLDATE' act = ls_flight-fldate exp = '20250701' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect PRICE' act = ls_flight-price exp = '350.75' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect CURRENCY' act = ls_flight-currency exp = 'USD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator in Verbindung mit `INSERT` ermöglicht das automatische Zuordnen von Feldern zwischen Strukturen oder Tabellen, auch wenn diese unterschiedliche Namen haben, aber die gleichen technischen Attribute (Typ, Länge) oder semantisch ähnliche Namen aufweisen. Dies reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand und macht den Code flexibler und wartungsfreundlicher, insbesondere bei der Arbeit mit komplexen Datenstrukturen.
keywords: INSERT, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Structures, Data Mapping

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Informationsstring für einen Flug, der die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und den um 10% erhöhten Preis enthält. Verwenden Sie String-Templates und führen Sie die Preiskalkulation direkt im Template durch.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) und `COMPUTE`-ähnliche Ausdrücke darin.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_template_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_info_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_info.
    rv_info_string = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid }: Neuer Preis { is_flight-price * '1.10' } { is_flight-currency }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_flight_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_flight_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_template_calc( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight-carrid   = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid   = '0400'.
    ls_flight-price    = '100.00'.
    ls_flight-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->create_flight_info( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect info string' act = lv_info exp = 'Flug LH 0400: Neuer Preis 110.00 EUR' ).

    ls_flight-price = '250.50'.
    DATA(lv_info_2) = lo_cut->create_flight_info( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect info string with decimal' act = lv_info_2 exp = 'Flug LH 0400: Neuer Preis 275.55 EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates ermöglichen die einfache und lesbare Konstruktion von Strings, wobei Variablen und sogar einfache Berechnungen direkt eingebettet werden können. Die Berechnung des erhöhten Preises (`is_flight-price * '1.10'`) erfolgt inline, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: COMPUTE, String Processing, String Templates, Arithmetic

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein. Die Tabelle soll nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer sortiert sein, und der `INSERT`-Befehl soll die Sortierung automatisch beibehalten.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die interne Tabelle als `SORTED TABLE` und verwenden Sie `INSERT TABLE LINE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_flight_to_sorted_table
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid
        is_new_flight      TYPE sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_to_sorted_table.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    lt_sflights = it_initial_flights. " Copy initial flights

    " Insert a new line into the sorted table.
    " The system automatically finds the correct position.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_sflights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flight_to_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flight_to_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sorted_table( ).
    DATA lt_initial_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    " Prepare initial flights (already sorted by key)
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.

    DATA ls_new_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_new_flight-carrid = 'BA'. " British Airways, should be inserted between AA and LH
    ls_new_flight-connid = '0100'.
    ls_new_flight-fldate = '20250501'.

    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table(
                                 it_initial_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                 is_new_flight      = ls_new_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 4 entries' act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 4 ).

    " Check the order
    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry incorrect' act = ls_flight_1-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry incorrect (should be BA)' act = ls_flight_2-carrid exp = 'BA' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_3) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Third entry incorrect (should be LH)' act = ls_flight_3-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wenn eine interne Tabelle als `SORTED TABLE` deklariert ist, sorgt die `INSERT`-Anweisung automatisch dafür, dass neue Zeilen an der korrekten Position eingefügt werden, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Dies ist effizienter als das manuelle Sortieren nach jedem Einfügevorgang und stellt die Datenkonsistenz sicher.
keywords: INSERT, SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight`, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit diesen Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `COMPUTE`-ähnlichen Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_expensive_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_price_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_by_price( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Prepare mock data
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = '100.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_mock.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '600.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_mock.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '450.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_mock.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'DL' connid = '1234' price = '800.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_mock.

    " Mock the SELECT statement for testing purposes
    " In a real scenario, you'd use test doubles or inject data.
    " For simplicity, we'll rely on the actual DB table for now.

    DATA(lt_expensive) = lo_cut->filter_expensive_flights( iv_price_threshold = '500.00' ).

    " Check count
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of expensive flights' act = lines( lt_expensive ) exp = 2 ). " Assuming LH and DL are in sflight and match

    " Check content
    READ TABLE lt_expensive INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH 0400 not found' act = sy-subrc ).

    READ TABLE lt_expensive INTO DATA(ls_flight_dl) WITH KEY carrid = 'DL'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'DL 1234 not found' act = sy-subrc ).

    READ TABLE lt_expensive INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'AA 0001 should not be found' act = sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, Zeilen aus internen Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu selektieren. Die Bedingung (`price > iv_price_threshold`) wird direkt im Operator ausgedrückt, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND`.
keywords: COMPUTE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Flugdatensätze in eine Hashed Table ein. Stellen Sie sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge basierend auf dem Primärschlüssel (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) vorhanden sind.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die interne Tabelle als `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` und verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_flights_to_hashed_table
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_hashed_flights) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flights_to_hashed_table.
    DATA lt_hashed_flights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    " Insert new flights. Duplicates based on key will cause a runtime error
    " if not handled (e.g., with TRY...CATCH or checking sy-subrc after single insert).
    " For multiple inserts, INSERT LINES OF handles duplicates by ignoring them if UNIQUE KEY is specified.
    INSERT LINES OF it_new_flights INTO TABLE lt_hashed_flights.

    rt_hashed_flights = lt_hashed_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flights_to_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flights_to_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_hashed_table( ).
    DATA lt_new_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Prepare new flights, including a duplicate
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) INTO TABLE lt_new_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) INTO TABLE lt_new_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' ) INTO TABLE lt_new_flights. " Duplicate key
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250104' ) INTO TABLE lt_new_flights.

    DATA(lt_hashed_result) = lo_cut->add_flights_to_hashed_table( it_new_flights = lt_new_flights ).

    " Expected: 3 unique entries (AA 0001, LH 0400, UA 0010)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Hashed table should contain 3 unique entries' act = lines( lt_hashed_result ) exp = 3 ).

    " Check if the first AA 0001 entry was kept (or the last, depending on implementation, but usually first)
    READ TABLE lt_hashed_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'AA 0001 not found in hashed table' act = sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect FLDATE for AA 0001 (should be first inserted)' act = ls_flight_aa-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `HASHED TABLE` ist für den schnellen Zugriff auf Zeilen über ihren Primärschlüssel optimiert. Wenn eine `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` deklariert ist, stellt das System sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge für den Schlüssel existieren. Beim `INSERT LINES OF` werden Duplikate automatisch ignoriert, was eine effiziente Methode zum Füllen einer eindeutigen Tabelle darstellt.
keywords: INSERT, HASHED TABLE, Internal Tables, Unique Key, Performance

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonusfaktor für einen Flug basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft: 'LH' erhält 1.2, 'AA' erhält 1.1, alle anderen 1.0. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COMPUTE` in Verbindung mit dem `SWITCH`-Operator für mehrstufige bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_bonus_factor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_bonus_factor
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_bonus_factor) TYPE f. " Floating point for factor
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_bonus_factor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_bonus_factor.
    rv_bonus_factor = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                                WHEN 'LH' THEN 1.2
                                WHEN 'AA' THEN 1.1
                                ELSE 1.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_bonus_factor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_bonus_factor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_bonus_factor( ).

    " Test case 1: LH
    DATA(lv_factor_lh) = lo_cut->get_bonus_factor( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Factor for LH incorrect' act = lv_factor_lh exp = 1.2 ).

    " Test case 2: AA
    DATA(lv_factor_aa) = lo_cut->get_bonus_factor( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Factor for AA incorrect' act = lv_factor_aa exp = 1.1 ).

    " Test case 3: Other airline
    DATA(lv_factor_ua) = lo_cut->get_bonus_factor( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Factor for UA incorrect' act = lv_factor_ua exp = 1.0 ).

    " Test case 4: Non-existent airline
    DATA(lv_factor_xx) = lo_cut->get_bonus_factor( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Factor for XX incorrect' act = lv_factor_xx exp = 1.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine moderne und elegante Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für mehrstufige bedingte Zuweisungen. Er ermöglicht es, einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen in einer einzigen Expression zu bestimmen, was den Code sehr kompakt, lesbar und wartungsfreundlich macht.
keywords: COMPUTE, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei die Feldnamen teilweise übereinstimmen, aber die Zielstruktur zusätzliche Felder hat. Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE`.

CLASS zcl_cor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.

    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( cityfrom = 'Frankfurt' ) is_source ).

explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung mit `BASE` ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Zuweisung von Komponenten zwischen Strukturen. `BASE` initialisiert die Zielstruktur mit Standardwerten oder expliziten Werten, bevor die Quellfelder zugewiesen werden. Dies ist effizienter als manuelle Feldzuweisungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, BASE, Structure Assignment, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit definierten Mapping-Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` mit einer Mapping-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             target_b TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             target_c TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapping_rule,
             source_name TYPE string,
             target_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapping_rule.
    TYPES tt_mapping_rules TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapping_rule WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_source      TYPE ty_source
        it_map_rules   TYPE tt_mapping_rules
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = is_source
      destination = rs_target
      mapping     = it_map_rules
    ).
    lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = is_source IMPORTING destination = rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_map.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_dynamic=>ty_source( field_a = 'Value A' field_b = 'Value B' ).
    DATA(lt_map_rules) = VALUE zcl_cor_dynamic=>tt_mapping_rules(
      ( source_name = 'FIELD_A' target_name = 'TARGET_A' )
      ( source_name = 'FIELD_B' target_name = 'TARGET_B' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_dynamic( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_dynamically( is_source = ls_source it_map_rules = lt_map_rules ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_a exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_b exp = 'Value B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-target_c ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_corresponding` bietet eine flexible Möglichkeit, Feldzuweisungen zur Laufzeit über eine Mapping-Tabelle zu steuern. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Schnittstellen oder Konfigurationsszenarien, bei denen die Feldnamen nicht fest codiert werden können.
keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, Dynamic Mapping, RTTI, Reflection

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_not.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_filter_not=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = 300 )
    ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und projizieren Sie die Ergebnisse in eine neue Tabelle mit nur ausgewählten Feldern, alles in einer einzigen Tabellenexpression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_project DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             airline TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_number TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_project
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_project IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_project.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                               ( airline = flight-carrid
                                 flight_number = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_project FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_project.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_filter_project=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = 150 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_project( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_info) = lo_cut->filter_and_project( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_info ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_info[ 1 ]-airline exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_info[ 1 ]-flight_number exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_info[ 2 ]-airline exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_info[ 2 ]-flight_number exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von Tabellenexpressionen, indem `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `VALUE` kombiniert wird. Dies ermöglicht das Filtern einer Tabelle und die gleichzeitige Projektion der Ergebnisse in eine neue Struktur, alles in einer einzigen, hochkompakten und lesbaren Anweisung. Dies ist ein Muster für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Projection, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_CALCULATOR` mit einer Methode `ADD` und implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse `ZCL_SIMPLE_CALCULATOR`. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie, indem Sie die Methode über einen Referenztyp auf die Schnittstelle aufrufen.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculator PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von Interfaces zur Definition eines Vertrags und dessen Implementierung in einer Klasse. Der Aufruf über den Interface-Referenztyp demonstriert Polymorphie, ein Kernkonzept der objektorientierten Programmierung.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_LOGGER` mit einer Methode `LOG_MESSAGE`. Fügen Sie eine `DEFAULT` Implementierung für diese Methode hinzu, die eine Nachricht in die Konsole schreibt. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die diese Schnittstelle implementiert, aber die `LOG_MESSAGE` Methode nicht überschreibt, um die Standardimplementierung zu nutzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DEFAULT` bei der Methodendefinition in der Schnittstelle.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  METHODS log_message DEFAULT VIA zif_logger~log_message_default.
  METHODS log_message_default IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zif_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message_default.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Default Log: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_default_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_default_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_log.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_default_logger( ).
    " The default implementation will be called
    lo_logger->zif_logger~log_message( 'Test message with default implementation' ).
    " No direct assert for console output, but verifies compilation and call.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception should occur' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50 führte `DEFAULT` Implementierungen für Interface-Methoden ein. Dies ermöglicht es, eine Standardlogik direkt in der Schnittstelle zu definieren, die von implementierenden Klassen übernommen wird, wenn sie die Methode nicht explizit überschreiben. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT, ABAP 7.50, OBJECT ORIENTATION

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster mithilfe von Interfaces. Erstellen Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_SORT_STRATEGY` mit einer Methode `SORT_TABLE`. Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_BUBBLE_SORT` und `ZCL_QUICK_SORT`, die diese Schnittstelle implementieren. Eine Kontextklasse `ZCL_SORTER` soll die Sortierstrategie dynamisch zur Laufzeit wechseln können.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Interface-Referenz in der Kontextklasse, um die Strategie zu speichern und aufzurufen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_sort_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS sort_table CHANGING ct_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_bubble_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_sort_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bubble_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_sort_strategy~sort_table.
    " Simplified Bubble Sort for demonstration
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE i.
    DO lines( ct_data ) - 1 TIMES.
      DO lines( ct_data ) - sy-index TIMES.
        IF ct_data[ sy-index ] > ct_data[ sy-index + 1 ].
          lv_temp = ct_data[ sy-index ].
          ct_data[ sy-index ] = ct_data[ sy-index + 1 ].
          ct_data[ sy-index + 1 ] = lv_temp.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_quick_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_sort_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_quick_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_sort_strategy~sort_table.
    " In a real scenario, this would be a proper Quick Sort implementation.
    " For demo, we'll just use ABAP's built-in sort.
    SORT ct_data ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_sort_strategy.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_sort_strategy.
    METHODS execute_sort CHANGING ct_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_sort_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD execute_sort.
    mo_strategy->sort_table( CHANGING ct_data = ct_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY, 
          lt_expected TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_numbers = VALUE #( ( 3 ) ( 1 ) ( 4 ) ( 1 ) ( 5 ) ).
    lt_expected = VALUE #( ( 1 ) ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).

    " Test Bubble Sort
    DATA(lo_bubble_sorter) = NEW zcl_sorter( NEW zcl_bubble_sort( ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_bubble) = lt_numbers.
    lo_bubble_sorter->execute_sort( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data_bubble ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data_bubble exp = lt_expected msg = 'Bubble Sort failed' ).

    " Test Quick Sort
    DATA(lo_quick_sorter) = NEW zcl_sorter( NEW zcl_quick_sort( ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_quick) = lt_numbers.
    lo_quick_sorter->execute_sort( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data_quick ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data_quick exp = lt_expected msg = 'Quick Sort failed' ).

    " Change strategy at runtime
    lo_quick_sorter->set_strategy( NEW zcl_bubble_sort( ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_changed) = lt_numbers.
    lo_quick_sorter->execute_sort( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data_changed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data_changed exp = lt_expected msg = 'Strategy change failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster ermöglicht es, Algorithmen in separate Klassen zu kapseln und sie zur Laufzeit austauschbar zu machen. Interfaces sind hierfür essenziell, da sie den Vertrag für die Strategien definieren und Polymorphie ermöglichen. Die Kontextklasse `ZCL_SORTER` arbeitet mit dem Interface, nicht mit konkreten Implementierungen.
keywords: INTERFACE, STRATEGY PATTERN, OBJECT ORIENTATION, DESIGN PATTERNS, POLYMORPHISM

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_DATA_PROVIDER` mit einer Methode `GET_DATA`, die eine Tabelle von Flugdaten zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie diese Schnittstelle in einer Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA_PROVIDER`, die Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` liest. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des Data Providers.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` und `INTO TABLE` in der Implementierung der `GET_DATA` Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           price    TYPE sflight-price,
         END OF ty_flight_data.
  TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_data_provider) = NEW zcl_flight_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_data_provider->zif_data_provider~get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flight data returned' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Interfaces verwendet werden können, um einen Datenzugriffsdienst zu abstrahieren. Die `ZIF_DATA_PROVIDER` definiert, wie Daten abgerufen werden, während `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA_PROVIDER` die konkrete Implementierung für Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` bereitstellt. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_EVENT_HANDLER` mit einer Methode `HANDLE_EVENT`. Implementieren Sie diese Schnittstelle in einer Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_EVENT_HANDLER`. Demonstrieren Sie, wie ein Event-Sender (z.B. eine Klasse, die Flüge verarbeitet) einen Event-Handler über das Interface aufrufen kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Tabelle von Interface-Referenzen, um mehrere Handler zu unterstützen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_event_handler PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event_data,
           event_type TYPE string,
           message    TYPE string,
         END OF ty_event_data.

  METHODS handle_event IMPORTING is_event TYPE ty_event_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_event_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_event_handler~handle_event.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Event handled: { is_event-event_type } - { is_event-message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_handler IMPORTING io_handler TYPE REF TO zif_event_handler.
    METHODS publish_event IMPORTING is_event TYPE zif_event_handler=>ty_event_data.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES tt_event_handlers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_event_handler WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_handlers TYPE tt_event_handlers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_handler.
    INSERT io_handler INTO TABLE mt_handlers.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD publish_event.
    LOOP AT mt_handlers INTO DATA(lo_handler).
      lo_handler->handle_event( is_event = is_event ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).
    DATA(lo_handler1) = NEW zcl_flight_event_handler( ).
    DATA(lo_handler2) = NEW zcl_flight_event_handler( ).

    lo_publisher->register_handler( lo_handler1 ).
    lo_publisher->register_handler( lo_handler2 ).

    DATA(ls_event) = VALUE zif_event_handler=>ty_event_data( event_type = 'FLIGHT_DELAY' message = 'LH400 delayed by 2 hours' ).
    lo_publisher->publish_event( ls_event ).

    " No direct assert for console output, but verifies compilation and call.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception should occur' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert ein einfaches Event-Handling-Muster unter Verwendung von Interfaces. Der `ZCL_EVENT_PUBLISHER` kennt nur das Interface `ZIF_EVENT_HANDLER`, nicht die konkreten Handler-Klassen. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Erweiterung des Systems, da neue Handler hinzugefügt werden können, ohne den Publisher zu ändern.
keywords: INTERFACE, EVENT HANDLING, OBJECT ORIENTATION, DESIGN PATTERNS

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen den Tabellen `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` durch, um Flugdaten zusammen mit den entsprechenden Flugverbindungsdetails abzurufen. Wählen Sie die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`, `CITYFROM`, `CITYTO` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN` in Ihrer `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_details,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_details.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_details WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details RETURNING VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inner_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    DATA(lo_flight_join) = NEW zcl_flight_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_flight_join->get_flight_details( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_details msg = 'No flight details returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_details ) > 0 msg = 'Expected more than 0 flight details' ).
    " Check if a specific entry exists (example)
    DATA(ls_check) = VALUE zcl_flight_join=>ty_flight_details( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    READ TABLE lt_details WITH KEY carrid = ls_check-carrid connid = ls_check-connid TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 msg = 'Expected entry not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `INNER JOIN` kombiniert Zeilen aus zwei oder mehr Tabellen, wenn es in allen Tabellen übereinstimmende Werte gibt. Hier werden Flüge (`SFLIGHT`) nur dann angezeigt, wenn eine entsprechende Flugverbindung (`SPFLI`) existiert. Die Alias-Vergabe (`AS s`, `AS p`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, SELECT, SFLIGHT, SPFLI, DATABASE

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK` durch, um alle Flüge und deren Buchungsdetails abzurufen. Flüge ohne Buchungen sollen ebenfalls angezeigt werden. Wählen Sie `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`, `BOOKID` und `CUSTOMID` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` in Ihrer `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_booking_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_details,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_details.
    TYPES: tt_flight_booking_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking_details WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_bookings RETURNING VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_flight_booking_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_flight_booking_join) = NEW zcl_flight_booking_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_flight_booking_join->get_flight_bookings( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_details msg = 'No flight booking details returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_details ) > 0 msg = 'Expected more than 0 flight booking details' ).

    " Check for flights without bookings (BOOKID should be initial)
    DATA(lv_initial_bookings) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_details INTO DATA(ls_detail) WHERE bookid IS INITIAL.
      lv_initial_bookings = lv_initial_bookings + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_initial_bookings > 0 msg = 'Expected flights without bookings' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` gibt alle Zeilen aus der linken Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`) zurück und die übereinstimmenden Zeilen aus der rechten Tabelle (`SBOOK`). Wenn es keine Übereinstimmung gibt, werden `NULL`-Werte für die Spalten der rechten Tabelle zurückgegeben. Dies ist nützlich, um alle Flüge anzuzeigen, unabhängig davon, ob sie Buchungen haben.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, SFLIGHT, SBOOK, DATABASE

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR`, um Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft abzurufen. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_carrier_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier_details,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier_details.
    TYPES: tt_flight_carrier_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier_details WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK` durch. Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung im `SELECT`-Statement, um den Buchungsstatus ('Booked' oder 'Not Booked') basierend auf dem Vorhandensein einer `BOOKID` zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END` direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_booking_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             booking_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_booking_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_booking_status.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate,
           CASE WHEN b~bookid IS NOT NULL THEN 'Booked' ELSE 'Not Booked' END AS booking_status
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_with_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_with_case.
    DATA(lo_flight_status) = NEW zcl_flight_booking_status( ).
    DATA(lt_status) = lo_flight_status->get_flight_booking_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_status msg = 'No flight status returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_status ) > 0 msg = 'Expected more than 0 flight statuses' ).

    " Check for both 'Booked' and 'Not Booked' statuses
    DATA(lv_booked_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_not_booked_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    LOOP AT lt_status INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-booking_status = 'Booked'.
        lv_booked_count = lv_booked_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_entry-booking_status = 'Not Booked'.
        lv_not_booked_count = lv_not_booked_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_booked_count > 0 msg = 'Expected some booked flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_not_booked_count > 0 msg = 'Expected some not booked flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht die Verwendung von `CASE`-Ausdrücken direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste von Open SQL. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um bedingte Logik direkt in der Datenbank auszuführen und die Daten bereits vor dem Transport in das ABAP-Programm zu transformieren. In Kombination mit `LEFT OUTER JOIN` können so Statusinformationen abgeleitet werden.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, CASE, ABAP 7.50, DATABASE

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT`, `SPFLI` und `SCARR` durch, um Flugdaten, Verbindungsdetails und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft in einer einzigen Abfrage abzurufen. Gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge.

solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_table_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_table_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_counts.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, p~cityfrom, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname, p~cityfrom
      INTO TABLE @rt_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit von Open SQL, um Daten aus mehreren Tabellen zu verknüpfen und gleichzeitig Aggregationen durchzuführen. Durch die Kombination von `INNER JOIN`s mit `GROUP BY` und `COUNT(*)` können komplexe Berichte direkt in der Datenbank generiert werden, was die Datenverarbeitung im ABAP-Programm minimiert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_DATA_PROCESSOR` mit einer Methode `PROCESS_DATA`, die eine Tabelle von Strings entgegennimmt und eine veränderte Tabelle zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie diese Schnittstelle in einer Klasse `ZCL_UPPERCASE_PROCESSOR`, die alle Strings in Großbuchstaben umwandelt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation der Tabelle.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_processor PUBLIC.
  TYPES: tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
  METHODS process_data IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_string RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_uppercase_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uppercase_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_processor~process_data.
    rt_processed_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_string> IN it_data ( CONV string( to_upper( <fs_string> ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zif_data_processor=>tt_string( ( 'hello' ) ( 'world' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zif_data_processor=>tt_string( ( 'HELLO' ) ( 'WORLD' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->zif_data_processor~process_data( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Uppercase processing failed' ).

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK` durch, um Flüge mit mindestens einer Buchung zu finden. Verwenden Sie `EXISTS` in der `WHERE`-Klausel, um die Performance zu optimieren, anstatt alle Buchungsdetails abzurufen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `EXISTS` mit einer Subquery, die einen `INNER JOIN` impliziert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_exists_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_with_booking.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_exists_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight AS s
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sbook AS b
                       WHERE b~carrid = s~carrid
                         AND b~connid = s~connid
                         AND b~fldate = s~fldate )
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exists_with_join_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exists_with_join_logic.
    DATA(lo_flight_exists) = NEW zcl_flight_exists_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_flight_exists->get_flights_with_bookings( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flights with bookings returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 msg = 'Expected more than 0 flights with bookings' ).

    " Verify that these flights actually have bookings (manual check for a few)
    DATA(lv_has_booking) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sbook WHERE carrid = lt_flights[1]-carrid AND connid = lt_flights[1]-connid AND fldate = lt_flights[1]-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_has_booking = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_booking = abap_true msg = 'First returned flight should have a booking' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl kein expliziter `JOIN` im `FROM`-Teil verwendet wird, implementiert die `EXISTS`-Klausel mit einer Subquery die Logik eines `INNER JOIN`s. Dies ist oft performanter, wenn man nur prüfen möchte, ob eine Übereinstimmung existiert, anstatt die Daten der verknüpften Tabelle abzurufen.
keywords: JOIN, EXISTS, SUBQUERY, SELECT, SFLIGHT, SBOOK, DATABASE, PERFORMANCE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_CONFIG_READER` mit einer Methode `GET_VALUE` und einer `DEFAULT` Implementierung, die einen Standardwert zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DB_CONFIG_READER`, die `GET_VALUE` überschreibt, um Werte aus einer (simulierten) Datenbanktabelle zu lesen. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung und das Überschreiben der Standardimplementierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DEFAULT` für die Schnittstellenmethode und überschreiben Sie diese in der implementierenden Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_config_reader PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_value IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_value DEFAULT VIA zif_config_reader~get_value_default.
  METHODS get_value_default IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zif_config_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_default.
    rv_value = |Default value for { iv_key }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_config_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_config_reader.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_config_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_config_reader~get_value.
    " Simulate reading from a database table
    CASE iv_key.
      WHEN 'APP_NAME'.
        rv_value = 'Flight Management System'.
      WHEN 'VERSION'.
        rv_value = '1.0.0'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_value = |Value from DB for { iv_key } not found|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_config_reader FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_config_reader.
    " Test default implementation
    DATA(lo_default_reader) = NEW zif_config_reader( ). " Can instantiate interface directly with default methods (ABAP 7.55+)
    DATA(lv_default_value) = lo_default_reader->get_value( 'UNKNOWN_KEY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_default_value exp = 'Default value for UNKNOWN_KEY' msg = 'Default value incorrect' ).

    " Test overridden implementation
    DATA(lo_db_reader) = NEW zcl_db_config_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_app_name) = lo_db_reader->zif_config_reader~get_value( 'APP_NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_app_name exp = 'Flight Management System' msg = 'DB value for APP_NAME incorrect' ).
    DATA(lv_version) = lo_db_reader->zif_config_reader~get_value( 'VERSION' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_version exp = '1.0.0' msg = 'DB value for VERSION incorrect' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `DEFAULT` Methoden in Interfaces (ABAP 7.50+) und deren Überschreibung in implementierenden Klassen. Es demonstriert, wie eine Basisfunktionalität im Interface bereitgestellt und bei Bedarf durch spezifischere Implementierungen ersetzt werden kann, was Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit erhöht. Ab ABAP 7.55 können Interfaces mit Default-Methoden direkt instanziiert werden.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK` durch. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die mehr als 5 Buchungen haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN`, `GROUP BY`, `COUNT(*)` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_bookings_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             booking_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_min_bookings IMPORTING iv_min_bookings TYPE i DEFAULT 5 RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bookings_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_min_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, COUNT( b~bookid ) AS booking_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      GROUP BY s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate
      HAVING COUNT( b~bookid ) > @iv_min_bookings
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_group_having FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_group_having.
    DATA(lo_flight_summary) = NEW zcl_flight_bookings_having( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_flight_summary->get_flights_with_min_bookings( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary msg = 'No flights with >5 bookings returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_summary ) > 0 msg = 'Expected more than 0 flights with >5 bookings' ).

    " Verify all returned flights have more than 5 bookings
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-booking_count > 5 msg = 'Flight with insufficient bookings found' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `HAVING` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` und `LEFT OUTER JOIN`. `HAVING` wird verwendet, um Gruppen zu filtern, nachdem die Aggregatfunktionen angewendet wurden, im Gegensatz zu `WHERE`, das einzelne Zeilen vor der Gruppierung filtert. Dies ist ideal, um Flüge basierend auf der Anzahl ihrer Buchungen zu selektieren.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, COUNT, SELECT, SFLIGHT, SBOOK, DATABASE

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK` durch. Verwenden Sie eine `UNION` Operation, um die Ergebnisse mit einer Liste von Flügen zu kombinieren, die keine Buchungen haben und deren `CARRID` 'AA' ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` mit `UNION` und einer `WHERE` Klausel für die zweite `SELECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_union_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             has_booking TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_union_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_union_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_union_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_union_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_union_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_union_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, CASE WHEN b~bookid IS NOT NULL THEN @abap_true ELSE @abap_false END AS has_booking
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, @abap_false AS has_booking
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
        AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sbook
                           WHERE carrid = sflight~carrid
                             AND connid = sflight~connid
                             AND fldate = sflight~fldate )
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_with_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_with_join.
    DATA(lo_union_join) = NEW zcl_flight_union_join( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_union_join->get_union_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_data msg = 'No union flight data returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_data ) > 0 msg = 'Expected more than 0 union flights' ).

    " Check for 'AA' flights without bookings
    DATA(lv_aa_no_booking_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND has_booking = abap_false.
      lv_aa_no_booking_count = lv_aa_no_booking_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_aa_no_booking_count > 0 msg = 'Expected AA flights without bookings' ).

    " Check for flights with bookings (should exist)
    DATA(lv_has_booking_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE has_booking = abap_true.
      lv_has_booking_count = lv_has_booking_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_booking_count > 0 msg = 'Expected flights with bookings' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` mit einer `UNION ALL` Operation. `UNION ALL` fügt die Ergebnisse von zwei oder mehr `SELECT`-Anweisungen zusammen, wobei Duplikate beibehalten werden. Dies ist nützlich, um verschiedene Datensätze, die unterschiedliche Kriterien erfüllen, in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste zu vereinen. Die `CASE`-Anweisung und `EXISTS` in der Subquery sind moderne Open SQL Features.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, UNION, SELECT, CASE, EXISTS, SFLIGHT, SBOOK, DATABASE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit einem Cursor und geben Sie die ersten 10 Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH'. Lesen Sie die Flüge, bis ein Flug mit der Verbindungsnummer '0400' gefunden wird, und schließen Sie den Cursor dann sofort. Geben Sie alle bis dahin gelesenen Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in einer Schleife mit `CHECK` oder `IF` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_until_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_until_connid.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT. " No more records
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
      IF ls_sflight-connid = iv_connid.
        EXIT. " Found the target connid, exit loop and close cursor
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_close.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_conditional( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist in SFLIGHTS and '0400' is not the first.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_until_connid( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    " Check if the last entry is indeed '0400'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ lines( lt_flights ) ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das vorzeitige Schließen eines Cursors basierend auf einer bestimmten Bedingung. Dies ist nützlich, wenn nur ein Teil der Daten benötigt wird und die weitere Verarbeitung der Datenbankressourcen vermieden werden soll. Die Verwendung von `DO...ENDDO` mit `EXIT` ist eine gängige Methode für solche Szenarien.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, Conditional Logic, Database Access

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor und simulieren Sie einen Fehler (z.B. durch einen ungültigen Tabellennamen in einem dynamischen SELECT). Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Cursor im Fehlerfall ordnungsgemäß geschlossen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit dynamischem SQL und `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_DYNAMIC_SQL_ERROR`. `CLOSE CURSOR` muss im `FINALLY` Block stehen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.
    DATA: lv_sql_statement TYPE string.

    lv_sql_statement = |SELECT carrid, connid FROM { iv_table_name }|.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_sql_statement).

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Log error or handle it
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_unit_assert.
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    " Test with an invalid table name
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flights_with_error_handling( 'INVALID_TABLE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->get_flights_with_error_handling( 'SFLIGHTS' ) ). " Ensure cursor is closed
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    " Test with a valid table name
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_error_handling( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die robuste Verwendung von Cursorn in Verbindung mit der Ausnahmebehandlung. Der `FINALLY`-Block stellt sicher, dass der Cursor auch dann geschlossen wird, wenn während des `FETCH`-Vorgangs ein Fehler auftritt. Dies ist entscheidend, um Datenbankressourcen freizugeben und Deadlocks zu vermeiden. Die Verwendung von dynamischem SQL (`(lv_sql_statement)`) erfordert besondere Vorsicht und ist hier zur Demonstration des Fehlerfalls eingesetzt.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, CLOSE CURSOR, Error Handling, TRY-CATCH-FINALLY, Dynamic SQL

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen. Sammeln Sie alle Pakete in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_all_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
      CLEAR lt_package. " Clear package table for next fetch
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_package_size FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_package_size.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_package_size( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_flights_in_packages( 50 ). " Test with a package size of 50

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has at least some entries
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    " Verify that the number of fetched records is reasonable (e.g., not 0)
    " More precise check would require knowing total SFLIGHTS count, which is not ideal for unit test.
    " Just check if some data is returned.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `PACKAGE SIZE`-Option bei `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` ist entscheidend für die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten in verwaltbaren Blöcken zu lesen, was den Speicherverbrauch reduziert und die Performance bei der Übertragung zwischen Datenbank und Anwendungsserver optimieren kann. `CLOSE CURSOR` ist hier ebenfalls unerlässlich, um die Datenbankverbindung nach Abschluss der Verarbeitung freizugeben.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, PACKAGE SIZE, CLOSE CURSOR, Performance, Database Access

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) manuell mit einem Cursor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und eine Variable für die Summe. `CLOSE CURSOR` nicht vergessen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_manual_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_manual_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_seats.
    rv_total_seats = 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, seatsmax
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      rv_total_seats = rv_total_seats + ls_sflight-seatsmax. " Manual addition
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_manual_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_manual_agg( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' has flights in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_total_seats_cursor) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Compare with a direct SELECT SUM for verification
    SELECT SUM( seatsmax ) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_total_seats_direct) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats_cursor exp = lv_total_seats_direct ).
  ENDMETHOD.
