Obwohl `SELECT SUM(...)` in den meisten Fällen effizienter ist, kann ein Cursor für komplexere Aggregationslogiken oder wenn Zwischenergebnisse zeilenweise verarbeitet werden müssen, nützlich sein. Die `ADD`-Operation wird hier explizit verwendet, um die Summe zu akkumulieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit zwei Spalten (Zahl1, Zahl2) und einer dritten Spalte (Summe), die die Summe der ersten beiden Spalten enthält. Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und den `+` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... FOR ... )` und den `+` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_value_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_numbers,
             number1 TYPE i,
             number2 TYPE i,
             sum     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_numbers.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_numbers WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sums
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_value_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sums.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR <fs_num> IN it_input
                             ( number1 = <fs_num>-number1
                               number2 = <fs_num>-number2
                               sum      = <fs_num>-number1 + <fs_num>-number2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sums FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sums.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_math_value_add=>tt_numbers(
      ( number1 = 10 number2 = 5 )
      ( number1 = 20 number2 = 8 )
      ( number1 = 3 number2 = 7 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_value_add( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->calculate_sums( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ]-sum exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 2 ]-sum exp = 28 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 3 ]-sum exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Initialisierung und Transformation interner Tabellen mit dem `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration. Die Addition (`+`) wird direkt im Ausdruck verwendet, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt, der die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen reduziert.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Math, ADD, Operator

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller `seatsmax`-Werte aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`-Daten. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `+` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_math_reduce_add=>tt_sflight_seats(
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_add( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 450 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug im modernen ABAP, um Werte aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um eine Summe zu bilden, wobei der `+` Operator die Addition in einer funktionalen Weise durchführt. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, die den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht als traditionelle Schleifen.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Math, ADD, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle vorhanden sind. Demonstrieren Sie sowohl die klassische `ADD 1 TO` Syntax als auch die moderne `+` Operator Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP` und inkrementieren Sie einen Zähler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_increment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_carrid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_flights_classic
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_carrid
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
    METHODS count_flights_modern
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_carrid
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_increment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_classic.
    rv_count = 0.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      ADD 1 TO rv_count. " Classic ADD statement
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_flights_modern.
    rv_count = 0.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      rv_count = rv_count + 1. " Modern + operator
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increment_counter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increment_counter.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_math_increment=>tt_sflight_carrid(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_increment( ).

    DATA(lv_count_classic) = lo_cut->count_flights_classic( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_count_modern) = lo_cut->count_flights_modern( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_classic exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_modern exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die klassische `ADD 1 TO`-Anweisung mit der moderneren Verwendung des `+`-Operators zum Inkrementieren eines Zählers innerhalb einer Schleife. Während `ADD 1 TO` weiterhin gültig ist, wird der `+`-Operator in modernen ABAP-Kontexten oft bevorzugt, da er flexibler in Ausdrücken und funktionalen Konstrukten eingesetzt werden kann.
keywords: ADD, Math, Loops, Counter, Operator

Instructions: Berechnen Sie eine laufende Summe (`running_sum`) für eine Liste von Zahlen. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `NEXT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... NEXT ... )` mit dem `+` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_running_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sum_result,
             value       TYPE i,
             running_sum TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sum_result.
    TYPES tt_sum_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sum_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_running_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_sum_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_running_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_running_sum.
    rt_results = VALUE #( INIT lv_current_sum = 0
                          FOR lv_value IN it_input
                          NEXT lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lv_value
                          ( value = lv_value running_sum = lv_current_sum ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_running_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_running_sum.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_math_running_sum=>tt_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 5 ) ( 20 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_running_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->calculate_running_sum( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-running_sum exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-running_sum exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ]-running_sum exp = 35 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und dem `NEXT`-Zusatz, um eine laufende Summe zu berechnen. Dies ist ein sehr elegantes und funktionales Muster im modernen ABAP, um Transformationen und Aggregationen in einem einzigen Ausdruck durchzuführen, ohne explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen außerhalb des Ausdrucks zu benötigen. Der `+` Operator ist integraler Bestandteil dieser Berechnung.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, NEXT, Running Sum, Math, ADD, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der `seatsmax`-Werte für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` mit dem `+` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_filtered_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_filtered_sum.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR <fs_flight> IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                                   NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_math_filter_reduce=>tt_sflight_seats(
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsmax = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_filtered_sum( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 200 ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` im modernen ABAP. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle mit `FILTER` nach der gewünschten Fluggesellschaft gefiltert, und anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Summe der `seatsmax`-Werte der gefilterten Einträge zu berechnen. Der `+` Operator führt die Addition innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks durch. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und effizienter Ansatz für Datenaggregationen.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor dynamisch für eine beliebige Tabelle und lesen Sie die ersten N Zeilen. Die Struktur der gelesenen Daten soll dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit dynamischem SQL und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Struktur. `CLOSE CURSOR` ist essentiell.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_count      TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_data) TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lr_data   TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lv_sql_statement TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    lv_sql_statement = |SELECT * FROM { iv_table_name }|.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_sql_statement).

        " Dynamically create data reference based on cursor structure
        CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF lv_cursor.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

        DO iv_count TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO <fs_data>.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lr_data TO rt_dynamic_data.
          CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF lv_cursor. " Create new data object for next row
          ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_cursor FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_cursor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_dynamic_data( ).
    DATA(lt_data_refs) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_data( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS' iv_count = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data_refs ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_data_refs[ 1 ] ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN lt_data_refs[ 1 ]->* TO <fs_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_sflight>-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von Cursorn in Verbindung mit dynamischer Programmierung. Die Struktur der gelesenen Daten wird zur Laufzeit mit `CREATE DATA LIKE LINE OF lv_cursor` bestimmt, was maximale Flexibilität beim Umgang mit unbekannten Tabellenstrukturen bietet. `CLOSE CURSOR` im `FINALLY`-Block ist hier besonders wichtig, um Ressourcen freizugeben, da dynamische Operationen fehleranfälliger sein können.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, CLOSE CURSOR, Dynamic SQL, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten enthält und eine zusätzliche Spalte für den Status des Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf der Flugzeit und dem Statuscode.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und SWITCH für die bedingte Spaltenzuweisung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
         carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
         fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
         deptime    TYPE sflight-deptime,
         arrtime    TYPE sflight-arrtime,
         status_code TYPE i, " Custom status code for demo
         flight_status TYPE string,
       END OF ty_sflight_status.
TYPES tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_flights
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flights.
    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
                                  connid      = ls_sflight-connid
                                  fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate
                                  deptime     = ls_sflight-deptime
                                  arrtime     = ls_sflight-arrtime
                                  status_code = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-deptime IS INITIAL THEN 3 " Canceled
                                                        WHEN ls_sflight-arrtime IS INITIAL THEN 2 " Delayed
                                                        ELSE 1 ) " On Time
                                  flight_status = SWITCH #( COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-deptime IS INITIAL THEN 3
                                                                    WHEN ls_sflight-arrtime IS INITIAL THEN 2
                                                                    ELSE 1 )
                                                            WHEN 1 THEN 'Pünktlich'
                                                            WHEN 2 THEN 'Verspätet'
                                                            WHEN 3 THEN 'Annulliert'
                                                            WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_analyze_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_status_analyzer( ).

    " Test data: On-time flight
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251126' deptime = '100000' arrtime = '120000' ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Test data: Delayed flight (missing arrival time)
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20251126' deptime = '140000' ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Test data: Canceled flight (missing departure time)
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '402' fldate = '20251126' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_analyzer->analyze_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-flight_status exp = 'Pünktlich' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-flight_status exp = 'Verspätet' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_flight3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-flight_status exp = 'Annulliert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und dem SWITCH-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code, der die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen und IF-Anweisungen reduziert.
keywords: SWITCH, VALUE, Internal Table, FOR, Conditional

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie verschiedene Datentypen (Integer, String, Datum) basierend auf einem Typindikator und geben Sie eine formatierte Ausgabe zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie die CASE-Anweisung mit Inline-Deklarationen für die Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_input,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " I for Integer, S for String, D for Date
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_input.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING is_input TYPE ty_data_input
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    CASE is_input-type.
      WHEN 'I'.
        DATA(lv_int_value) = CONV i( is_input-value ).
        rv_output = |Integer: { lv_int_value * 2 }|.
      WHEN 'S'.
        DATA(lv_string_value) = is_input-value.
        rv_output = |String (Upper): { to_upper( lv_string_value ) }|.
      WHEN 'D'.
        DATA(lv_date_value) = CONV d( is_input-value ).
        rv_output = |Date (Formatted): { lv_date_value DATE = USER }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_output = 'Unbekannter Typ'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_process_unknown FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_integer.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(ls_input) = VALUE zcl_data_processor=>ty_data_input( type = 'I' value = '10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->process_data( ls_input ) exp = 'Integer: 20' ).

  METHOD test_process_string.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(ls_input) = VALUE zcl_data_processor=>ty_data_input( type = 'S' value = 'hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->process_data( ls_input ) exp = 'String (Upper): HELLO' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_date.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(ls_input) = VALUE zcl_data_processor=>ty_data_input( type = 'D' value = '20231231' ).
    " The exact output depends on user's date format, so we check for a part of it.
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_processor->process_data( ls_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_output exp = 'Date (Formatted):' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_output exp = '2023' ).

  METHOD test_process_unknown.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(ls_input) = VALUE zcl_data_processor=>ty_data_input( type = 'X' value = 'abc' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->process_data( ls_input ) exp = 'Unbekannter Typ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (DATA(...)) innerhalb der CASE-Anweisung ermöglicht es, Variablen genau dort zu deklarieren, wo sie benötigt werden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert den Boilerplate-Code, da keine separaten Deklarationsblöcke mehr erforderlich sind.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie einen Betrag von einer Quellwährung in eine Zielwährung um, basierend auf festen Umrechnungskursen. Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck für die Kursfindung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck, um den korrekten Umrechnungsfaktor zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_currency_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount      TYPE decfloat16
        iv_from_currency TYPE sy-waers
        iv_to_currency   TYPE sy-waers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_converted_amount) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_amount.
    DATA(lv_exchange_rate) = SWITCH #( iv_from_currency
                                       WHEN 'EUR' THEN SWITCH #( iv_to_currency
                                                                 WHEN 'USD' THEN '1.08'
                                                                 WHEN 'GBP' THEN '0.85'
                                                                 WHEN 'JPY' THEN '160.00'
                                                                 WHEN OTHERS THEN '0' )
                                       WHEN 'USD' THEN SWITCH #( iv_to_currency
                                                                 WHEN 'EUR' THEN '0.92'
                                                                 WHEN 'GBP' THEN '0.79'
                                                                 WHEN 'JPY' THEN '148.00'
                                                                 WHEN OTHERS THEN '0' )
                                       WHEN OTHERS THEN '0' ).

    IF lv_exchange_rate = '0'.
      " Handle unsupported currency or conversion
      rv_converted_amount = iv_amount. " Or raise exception
    ELSE.
      rv_converted_amount = iv_amount * CONV decfloat16( lv_exchange_rate ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Berechnungen durchführt und das Ergebnis direkt zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck im RETURN-Statement.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand1 TYPE i
        iv_operand2 TYPE i
        iv_operator TYPE c LENGTH 1 " '+', '-', '*', '/'
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = SWITCH #( iv_operator
                          WHEN '+' THEN iv_operand1 + iv_operand2
                          WHEN '-' THEN iv_operand1 - iv_operand2
                          WHEN '*' THEN iv_operand1 * iv_operand2
                          WHEN '/' THEN COND #( WHEN iv_operand2 <> 0 THEN iv_operand1 / iv_operand2 ELSE 0 ) " Avoid division by zero
                          WHEN OTHERS THEN 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität für Flüge, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit einer CASE-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und bedingt zu aggregieren.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         capacity TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flight_capacity.
TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_capacity_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_capacity TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_capacity) TYPE tt_flight_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_capacity_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_capacity.
    rt_aggregated_capacity = REDUCE tt_flight_capacity(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_capacity( )
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( seatsocc > iv_min_capacity )
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ] ) IN
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL
                            THEN VALUE tt_flight_capacity( BASE result ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid capacity = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) )
                            ELSE VALUE tt_flight_capacity( BASE result ( index = lv_index capacity = result[ lv_index ]-capacity + ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_capacity FOR TESTING.

  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_capacity_aggregator( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_sflights.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '004' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '005' seatsocc = 40 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_capacity( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_capacity = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_capacity).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' INTO DATA(ls_ua_capacity).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_target_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum

        iv_offset TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_target_date) TYPE sy-datum.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_target_date.
    rv_target_date = SWITCH #( iv_period_type
                               WHEN 'W' THEN cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_start_date, iv_offset * 7 )
                               WHEN 'M' THEN cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_start_date, iv_offset )
                               WHEN 'Y' THEN cl_abap_date_helper=>add_years( iv_start_date, iv_offset )
                               WHEN OTHERS THEN iv_start_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen bestimmten Wert aus einer Konfigurationstabelle ab, basierend auf einem Schlüssel und einem Kontext. Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck, um den Kontext zu verarbeiten und den korrekten Wert zu finden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck, um verschiedene Logikpfade für die Datenbeschaffung zu definieren.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_entry,
         key     TYPE string,
         context TYPE string,
         value   TYPE string,
       END OF ty_config_entry.
TYPES tt_config_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_config_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_config_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_key     TYPE string
        iv_context TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_config_data TYPE tt_config_table READ-ONLY.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    gt_config_data = VALUE tt_config_table(
      ( key = 'MAX_ITEMS' context = 'DEFAULT' value = '10' )
      ( key = 'MAX_ITEMS' context = 'ADMIN'   value = '100' )
      ( key = 'TIMEOUT'   context = 'DEFAULT' value = '30' )
      ( key = 'TIMEOUT'   context = 'HIGH_PRIO' value = '60' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config_value.
    rv_value = SWITCH #( iv_context
                          WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN
                            VALUE #( gt_config_data[ key = iv_key context = 'ADMIN' ]-value OPTIONAL )
                          WHEN 'HIGH_PRIO' THEN
                            VALUE #( gt_config_data[ key = iv_key context = 'HIGH_PRIO' ]-value OPTIONAL )
                          WHEN OTHERS THEN
                            VALUE #( gt_config_data[ key = iv_key context = 'DEFAULT' ]-value OPTIONAL ) ).

    IF rv_value IS INITIAL.
      rv_value = 'NOT_FOUND'. " Fallback if no value found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Aktion basierend auf einem Aktionscode aus. Die Aktion kann das Erstellen eines Objekts, das Aufrufen einer Methode oder eine andere bedingte Logik sein. Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck, um die Aktionen zu steuern.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck, um verschiedene Codeblöcke oder Objektinstanziierungen zu steuern.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_action.
  METHODS execute RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_action~execute.
    rv_result = 'Action A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_action~execute.
    rv_result = 'Action B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_action
      IMPORTING iv_action_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_action_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action.
    DATA(lo_action) = SWITCH #( iv_action_code
                                WHEN 'A' THEN NEW zcl_action_a( )
                                WHEN 'B' THEN NEW zcl_action_b( )
                                WHEN OTHERS THEN THROW cx_sy_dyn_call_error( textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>dyn_call_error ) ).
    rv_action_result = lo_action->zif_action~execute( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Klasse dynamisch und weisen Sie diese einer Referenzvariablen zu, unter Verwendung des `NEW`-Operators und `CAST`.

CLASS zif_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_object IMPLEMENTATION.

    ro_shape = CAST zif_shape( NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = iv_radius ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge, unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( carrid = wa-carrid )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ts_flight_count(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_count
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_test_group_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_group_by) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_group_by->get_flight_counts_by_carrid( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE ts_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO ls_lh_count WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_count) = VALUE ts_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO ls_ua_count WITH KEY carrid = 'UA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = VALUE ts_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO ls_aa_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_group_by) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_group_by->get_flight_counts_by_carrid( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flight_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen, was komplexe Aggregationen vereinfacht und den Code lesbarer macht.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten (Flugnummer, Datum) und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus den Tabellen `sflights` und `scarr` mittels eines `INNER JOIN`. Verwenden Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` für eine interne Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_join_sflights_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_carrier_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_sflights_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_carrier_data.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_sflights_scarr( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_carrier_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected at least one entry' exp = abap_true act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `INNER JOIN` ermöglicht das effiziente Verknüpfen von Daten aus mehreren Tabellen direkt auf der Datenbankebene. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)` ist eine moderne Syntax, die eine interne Tabelle mit passenden Feldnamen automatisch deklariert und füllt, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht, da keine explizite Feldzuweisung erforderlich ist.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, SELECT, sflights, scarr, Database Access

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Fluggesellschaften und, falls vorhanden, deren Flugnummern und Flugdaten mittels eines `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `scarr` und `sflights`. Verwenden Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und beachten Sie, dass Felder der rechten Tabelle `NULL` sein können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id, " Can be initial if no flight
             fldate   TYPE s_date,    " Can be initial if no flight
           END OF ty_carrier_flight.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_carriers_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_carrier_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_left_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_carriers_flights.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM scarr AS c
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflights AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_data
      UP TO 20 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_all_carriers_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected at least one entry' exp = abap_true act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).

    DATA(lv_found_initial_flight) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_data>-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_data>-carrname ).
      IF <fs_data>-connid IS INITIAL AND <fs_data>-fldate IS INITIAL.
        lv_found_initial_flight = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LEFT OUTER JOIN` ist entscheidend, wenn Sie alle Einträge der linken Tabelle (hier `scarr`) beibehalten möchten, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der rechten Tabelle (`sflights`) gefunden werden. In solchen Fällen werden die Felder der rechten Tabelle in der Ergebnismenge initialisiert. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS` vereinfacht die Datenübernahme in die interne Tabelle.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, SELECT, scarr, sflights, Database Access

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten (Flugnummer, Datum) und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') und innerhalb eines spezifischen Datumsbereichs. Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel mit mehreren Bedingungen. Nutzen Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `AND` in der `WHERE`-Klausel, um mehrere Bedingungen zu verknüpfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_where_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_flight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'LH'
        iv_date_from TYPE s_date    DEFAULT '20000101'
        iv_date_to  TYPE s_date    DEFAULT '20251231'
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_where_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND s~fldate BETWEEN @iv_date_from AND @iv_date_to
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_data_no_result FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_where_clause( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_date_from = '20000101' iv_date_to = '20251231' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected at least one entry' exp = abap_true act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' exp = 'LH' act = <fs_data>-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_data>-carrname ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date within range' act = ( <fs_data>-fldate GE '20000101' AND <fs_data>-fldate LE '20251231' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_data_no_result.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_where_clause( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_date_from = '19000101' iv_date_to = '19000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be empty' act = lt_result ).

CLASS zcl_join_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_join_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE tt_flight_raw( ).

    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_raw_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_formatted_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_raw_data
                                 ( formatted_info = |Flug { ls_flight-connid } von { ls_flight-carrname } ({ ls_flight-carrid }) am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_join_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,

           END AS flight_type
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben (z.B. > 5 Flüge). CLASS zcl_join_having_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_filtered_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname    TYPE s_carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_filtered_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_filtered_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_filtered_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_carrier_filtered_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_having_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( * ) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) und erhöhen Sie den Preis jedes Fluges um 10%, indem Sie Feldsymbole verwenden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    rt_flights = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_update.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_price_update=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_update( ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'Price for flight 2 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_sum.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_sum_price = lv_sum_price + ls_group_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid total_price = lv_sum_price ) TO rt_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = VALUE sflight-price( )
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie Flugdaten (sflights) mit Fluggesellschaftsdaten (scarr) und geben Sie nur Flüge zurück, für die eine entsprechende Fluggesellschaft existiert. Verwenden Sie verschachtelte Schleifen und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine äußere Schleife für sflights und eine innere Schleife (oder `LINE_EXISTS`) für scarr. `LINE_EXISTS` ist effizienter als eine volle innere Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_joined_flight.
    TYPES tt_joined_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_joined_flights
      IMPORTING it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
                it_carriers     TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_joined) TYPE tt_joined_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_joined_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF LINE_EXISTS( it_carriers[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ).
        DATA(ls_carrier) = it_carriers[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ].
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                        carrname = ls_carrier-carrname
                        connid = ls_flight-connid
                        price = ls_flight-price ) TO rt_joined.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_join_flights=>tt_sflight,

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' ) TO lt_test_carriers.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' ) TO lt_test_carriers.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->get_joined_flights( it_flights = lt_test_flights it_carriers = lt_test_carriers ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den Namen und eine Liste aller Flugnummern (connid) enthält. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppenschleife `CORRESPONDING` oder `FOR` um die Daten zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_and_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_and_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lt_connids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid (
                           FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                           ( ls_group_member-connid ) ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connids = lt_connids ) TO rt_grouped.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus sflights, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft und eine 'Status'-Spalte enthält. Der Status soll 'Expensive' sein, wenn der Preis über 500 liegt, ansonsten 'Normal'. Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `COND`.

CLASS zcl_cond_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) und zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge von jeder Fluggesellschaft existieren. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer Aggregatfunktion.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und die Aggregatfunktion `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) und brechen Sie die Schleife ab, sobald ein Flug mit der Fluggesellschaft 'UA' gefunden wird. Geben Sie die bis dahin gefundenen Flüge zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_exit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

      IMPORTING it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_exit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_until_ua.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_exit.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_loop_exit=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '400.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_exit( ).
    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_until_ua( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights after EXIT' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `EXIT`-Anweisung ist ein klassisches und weiterhin gültiges Mittel, um eine Schleife vorzeitig zu beenden, sobald eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist. Dies ist nützlich, wenn nur die ersten passenden Einträge oder eine bestimmte Anzahl von Einträgen verarbeitet werden sollen, um unnötige Iterationen zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) und überspringen Sie alle Flüge, deren Währung nicht 'EUR' ist. Geben Sie nur die EUR-Flüge zurück.

CLASS zcl_loop_continue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, aber nur für die ersten 2 Flüge. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... UP TO`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` und bereiten Sie diese für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` vor. Fügen Sie eine Spalte für den Flugstatus hinzu, die basierend auf dem Status (z.B. 'X' für bestätigt, ' ' für geplant) ein Icon anzeigt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Icons.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             icon       TYPE icon_d,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS
                                            ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_flight_nodes(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      INDEX INTO idx
      ( node_key    = |{ idx }|
        parent_key  = ''
        text        = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }|
        icon        = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-planetype IS NOT INITIAL THEN icon_flight_confirmed ELSE icon_flight_scheduled )
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        connid      = ls_flight-connid
        fldate      = ls_flight-fldate
        status_text = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-planetype IS NOT INITIAL THEN 'Bestätigt' ELSE 'Geplant' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte Root-Node sein' act = lt_tree_data[ 1 ]-parent_key exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Icon sollte gesetzt sein' act = lt_tree_data[ 1 ]-icon ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung eines Klicks auf einen Knoten in einem `cl_gui_column_tree`. Basierend auf dem `node_key` soll eine unterschiedliche Aktion (simuliert durch eine Nachricht) ausgelöst werden. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für die bedingte Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck, um verschiedene Aktionen basierend auf dem `node_key` zu wählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_node_click
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_node_click.
    rv_message = SWITCH string(
      iv_node_key
      WHEN '1' THEN 'Details für Flug 1 angezeigt.'
      WHEN '2' THEN 'Details für Flug 2 angezeigt.'
      WHEN '3' THEN 'Details für Flug 3 angezeigt.'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Knoten geklickt.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_handle_node_click FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_handle_node_click.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_event_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->handle_node_click( '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Nachricht für Knoten 1 falsch' act = lv_message exp = 'Details für Flug 1 angezeigt.' ).

    lv_message = lo_cut->handle_node_click( '99' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Nachricht für unbekannten Knoten falsch' act = lv_message exp = 'Unbekannter Knoten geklickt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie GOS-Anhänge für ein simuliertes Business-Objekt ab und filtern Sie diese, um nur PDF-Dokumente anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für die Selektion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` zum Abrufen der Anhänge und anschließend `FILTER` auf die Dateiendung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_pdf_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename TYPE string,
             filetype TYPE string,
             created_by TYPE syuname,
             created_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_pdf_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_attachments.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = mock_get_attachments( iv_object_type = iv_object_type iv_object_key = iv_object_key ).

    rt_filtered_attachments = FILTER tt_attachment_infos(
      lt_all_attachments
      WHERE filetype = 'PDF'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_attachments.
*   Simuliert den Aufruf von cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachments
*   In einem echten Szenario würde hier der GOS-Aufruf erfolgen.
    rt_attachments = VALUE tt_attachment_infos(
      ( filename = 'Dokument1.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USER1' created_at = '20231026100000' )
      ( filename = 'Bild.jpg'      filetype = 'JPG' created_by = 'USER2' created_at = '20231025090000' )
      ( filename = 'Bericht.pdf'   filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USER1' created_at = '20231027113000' )
      ( filename = 'Tabelle.xlsx'  filetype = 'XLSX' created_by = 'USER3' created_at = '20231024140000' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie für ein simuliertes Business-Objekt die Anzahl der GOS-Anhänge pro Dateityp. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` zum Abrufen der Anhänge und anschließend `REDUCE` zur Zählung pro Dateityp in einer Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename TYPE string,
             filetype TYPE string,
             created_by TYPE syuname,
             created_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_filetype_counts TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS count_attachments_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filetype_counts) TYPE ty_filetype_counts.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_attachments_by_type.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = mock_get_attachments( iv_object_type = iv_object_type iv_object_key = iv_object_key ).

    rt_filetype_counts = REDUCE ty_filetype_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_filetype_counts( )
      FOR ls_attachment IN lt_all_attachments
      LET file_extension = ls_attachment-filetype IN
      NEXT counts = VALUE ty_filetype_counts(
        counts
        ( file_extension = counts[ file_extension ] + 1 OPTIONAL )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_attachments.
    rt_attachments = VALUE tt_attachment_infos(
      ( filename = 'Dokument1.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USER1' created_at = '20231026100000' )
      ( filename = 'Bild.jpg'      filetype = 'JPG' created_by = 'USER2' created_at = '20231025090000' )
      ( filename = 'Bericht.pdf'   filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USER1' created_at = '20231027113000' )
      ( filename = 'Tabelle.xlsx'  filetype = 'XLSX' created_by = 'USER3' created_at = '20231024140000' )
      ( filename = 'Foto.jpg'      filetype = 'JPG' created_by = 'USER2' created_at = '20231025100000' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_attachments_by_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_attachment_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS2000116'.
    DATA(lv_object_key)  = '0000000001'.

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_attachments_by_type(
      iv_object_type = lv_object_type
      iv_object_key  = lv_object_key
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl PDF falsch' act = lt_counts[ 'PDF' ] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl JPG falsch' act = lt_counts[ 'JPG' ] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl XLSX falsch' act = lt_counts[ 'XLSX' ] exp = 1 ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (seit ABAP 7.50) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert oder eine neue Tabelle zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und einen Akkumulator aktualisiert. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Dateitypen zu zählen, was zu einem sehr kompakten und funktionalen Code führt, der eine explizite Schleife und manuelle Zählung ersetzt.

Instructions: Rufen Sie GOS-Anhänge für ein simuliertes Business-Objekt ab und mappen Sie die relevanten Informationen (Dateiname, Ersteller, Erstellungsdatum) in eine neue, vereinfachte interne Tabelle. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` zum Abrufen der Anhänge und anschließend `FOR` zur Transformation in die Zielstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_attachment,
             filename TYPE string,
             filetype TYPE string,
             created_by TYPE syuname,
             created_at TYPE timestampl,
             size_kb    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_attachment.
    TYPES tt_raw_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simplified_attachment,
             document_name TYPE string,
             uploaded_by   TYPE syuname,
             upload_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_simplified_attachment.
    TYPES tt_simplified_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simplified_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_simplified_attachments) TYPE tt_simplified_attachments.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_raw_attachments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_attachments.
    DATA(lt_raw_attachments) = mock_get_attachments( iv_object_type = iv_object_type iv_object_key = iv_object_key ).

    rt_simplified_attachments = VALUE tt_simplified_attachments(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_attachments
      ( document_name = ls_raw-filename,
        uploaded_by   = ls_raw-created_by,
        upload_date   = CONV d( ls_raw-created_at(8) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_attachments.
    rt_attachments = VALUE tt_raw_attachments(
      ( filename = 'Vertrag.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USERA' created_at = '20231101100000' size_kb = 500 )
      ( filename = 'Angebot.docx' filetype = 'DOCX' created_by = 'USERB' created_at = '20231029143000' size_kb = 200 )
      ( filename = 'Log.txt' filetype = 'TXT' created_by = 'USERA' created_at = '20231102081500' size_kb = 50 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_attachment_mapper( ).
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS2000116'.

    DATA(lt_simplified) = lo_cut->map_attachments(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Es sollten 3 vereinfachte Anhänge gemappt werden' act = lines( lt_simplified ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erster Dateiname falsch' act = lt_simplified[ 1 ]-document_name exp = 'Vertrag.pdf' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erster Uploader falsch' act = lt_simplified[ 1 ]-uploaded_by exp = 'USERA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erstes Upload-Datum falsch' act = lt_simplified[ 1 ]-upload_date exp = '20231101' ).

explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator (seit ABAP 7.40) ist nicht nur für die Initialisierung, sondern auch für die Transformation von internen Tabellen hervorragend geeignet. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Für jeden Flug soll die Anzahl der simulierten GOS-Anhänge ermittelt und in einer neuen Spalte der Flugtabelle hinzugefügt werden. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenanreicherung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um die Flugdaten zu iterieren und gleichzeitig die GOS-Anzahl hinzuzufügen. Simulieren Sie die GOS-Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_gos_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_gos,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             attachments_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_with_gos.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_gos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_gos WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_gos.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_gos_count
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_key TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_gos_enricher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS
                                            ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE tt_flight_with_gos(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        attachments_count = mock_get_gos_count( |{ ls_flight-carrid }{ ls_flight-connid }| ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_gos_count.
*   Simuliert die Abfrage der GOS-Anzahl basierend auf dem Business-Objekt-Schlüssel
*   In einem echten Szenario würde hier cl_gos_attachment_query verwendet werden.
    rv_count = SWITCH i(
      iv_object_key
      WHEN 'LH0400' THEN 3
      WHEN 'AA0017' THEN 1
      WHEN 'UA0014' THEN 0
      ELSE 2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_enriched_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_enriched_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_gos_enricher( ).
    DATA(lt_enriched_flights) = lo_cut->get_enriched_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_enriched_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl Anhänge für LH0400 falsch' act = lt_enriched_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-attachments_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl Anhänge für UA0014 falsch' act = lt_enriched_flights[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0014' ]-attachments_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen (`sflights` und simulierte GOS-Anhänge) und deren Anreicherung mit dem `FOR`-Operator. Die Fähigkeit, innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks Methoden aufzurufen (hier `mock_get_gos_count`), ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und deklarative Datenverarbeitung. Dies ist ein Muster für die Vorbereitung komplexer Daten für UI-Elemente wie den `cl_gui_column_tree`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Zusammenfassung der GOS-Anhänge für ein Business-Objekt als String zurückgibt. Die Zusammenfassung soll die Anzahl der Anhänge und deren Dateitypen auflisten. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Formatierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` (simuliert) und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation der Dateitypen, dann String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_summary_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename TYPE string,
             filetype TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_filetype_counts TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS generate_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_summary_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_summary.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = mock_get_attachments( iv_object_type = iv_object_type iv_object_key = iv_object_key ).
    DATA(lv_total_count) = lines( lt_all_attachments ).

    DATA(lt_filetype_counts) = REDUCE ty_filetype_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_filetype_counts( )
      FOR ls_attachment IN lt_all_attachments
      LET file_extension = ls_attachment-filetype IN
      NEXT counts = VALUE ty_filetype_counts(
        counts
        ( file_extension = counts[ file_extension ] + 1 OPTIONAL )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lv_type_summary) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_count IN lt_filetype_counts
      NEXT s = |
{ s }{ ls_count-table_line }: { ls_count-i }|
    ).

    rv_summary = |
      Für Business-Objekt { iv_object_type }/{ iv_object_key } gibt es { lv_total_count } Anhänge.
      Details nach Dateityp:{ lv_type_summary }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_attachments.
    rt_attachments = VALUE tt_attachment_infos(
      ( filename = 'Vertrag.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' )
      ( filename = 'Angebot.docx' filetype = 'DOCX' )
      ( filename = 'Log.txt' filetype = 'TXT' )
      ( filename = 'Bild.jpg' filetype = 'JPG' )
      ( filename = 'Bericht.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_summary_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS2000116'.
    DATA(lv_object_key)  = '0000000003'.

    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_cut->generate_summary(
      iv_object_type = lv_object_type

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Gesamtzahl fehlt' sub = '5 Anhänge' act = lv_summary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'PDF-Anzahl fehlt' sub = 'PDF: 2' act = lv_summary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JPG-Anzahl fehlt' sub = 'JPG: 1' act = lv_summary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'DOCX-Anzahl fehlt' sub = 'DOCX: 1' act = lv_summary ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE`-Operator zur Aggregation von Daten (Zählung der Dateitypen) mit String-Templates (seit ABAP 7.40) zur Erstellung einer formatierten Ausgabe. String-Templates bieten eine sehr intuitive und lesbare Syntax für die String-Konkatenation und -Formatierung, indem Variablen und Ausdrücke direkt in den String eingebettet werden können.
