Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` und bereiten Sie diese für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` vor. Fügen Sie eine Spalte für die Zeilenfarbe hinzu, die basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH' für Lufthansa) eine bestimmte Farbe (z.B. 'C6' für blau) zuweist. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die bedingte Zuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung der Zeilenfarbe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_colors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node_colored,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             row_color  TYPE lvc_t_sclr,
           END OF ty_flight_node_colored.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_colored_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_flight_nodes_colored.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_colors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_colored_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS
                                            ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_flight_nodes_colored(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      INDEX INTO idx
      ( node_key    = |{ idx }|
        parent_key  = ''
        text        = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }|
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        connid      = ls_flight-connid
        fldate      = ls_flight-fldate
        row_color   = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN VALUE lvc_t_sclr( ( fname = '' color = 'C6' ) ) ELSE VALUE lvc_t_sclr( ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_colored_tree_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_colored_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_colors( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_cut->get_colored_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_tree_data ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_tree_data[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH-Flug sollte Farbe C6 haben' act = ls_lh_flight-row_color[ 1 ]-color exp = 'C6' ).

    DATA(ls_non_lh_flight) = lt_tree_data[ carrid <> 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Nicht-LH-Flug sollte keine Farbe haben' act = lines( ls_non_lh_flight-row_color ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Datenstruktur für einen `cl_gui_column_tree`, die Flüge und deren zugehörige Buchungen (aus `sbook`) darstellt. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit verschachtelten Schleifen für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FOR ... IN ...` für die Hauptknoten (Flüge) und eine weitere `FOR`-Schleife für die Kindknoten (Buchungen).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_booking_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             icon       TYPE icon_d,
             detail_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hierarchical_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hierarchical_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 3 ROWS
                                            ( <fs_flight> ) ).
    DATA(lt_sbook) = VALUE sbook_tab( FOR <fs_book> IN SELECT * FROM sbook UP TO 10 ROWS
                                      ( <fs_book> ) ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_tree_nodes(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      INDEX INTO flight_idx
      LET flight_node_key = |F{ flight_idx }| IN
      ( node_key    = flight_node_key,
        parent_key  = '',
        text        = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER })|,
        icon        = icon_flight_confirmed,
        detail_text = |Freie Plätze: { ls_flight-seatsocc }/{ ls_flight-seatsmax }| )

      FOR ls_booking IN lt_sbook WHERE ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
      INDEX INTO booking_idx
      ( node_key    = |B{ flight_idx }_{ booking_idx }|,
        parent_key  = flight_node_key,
        text        = |Buchung { ls_booking-bookid } ({ ls_booking-customid })|,
        icon        = icon_booking_confirmed,
        detail_text = |Passagier: { ls_booking-passname }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_hierarchical_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_hierarchical_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_booking_tree( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_cut->get_hierarchical_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_tree_data ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    DATA(lv_flight_nodes) = 0.
    DATA(lv_booking_nodes) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_tree_data INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-node_key CS 'F'.
        lv_flight_nodes = lv_flight_nodes + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_node-node_key CS 'B'.
        lv_booking_nodes = lv_booking_nodes + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Es sollten Flugknoten vorhanden sein' act = lv_flight_nodes exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Es sollten Buchungsknoten vorhanden sein' act = lv_booking_nodes exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung komplexer hierarchischer Datenstrukturen für den `cl_gui_column_tree` unter Verwendung von verschachtelten `FOR`-Operatoren (seit ABAP 7.50). Die äußere `FOR`-Schleife iteriert über Flüge, während die innere `FOR`-Schleife die zugehörigen Buchungen filtert und als Kindknoten hinzufügt. Die `LET`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um temporäre Variablen wie `flight_node_key` zu definieren, was den Code sauberer und lesbarer macht. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die GOS-Anhänge für verschiedene Business-Objekttypen abrufen kann. Die Methode soll eine generische Schnittstelle bieten und intern `CASE TYPE OF` verwenden, um objektspezifische Logik (z.B. Schlüsselformatierung) zu handhaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und `CASE TYPE OF` für die dynamische Typbehandlung des Business-Objektschlüssels.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename TYPE string,
             filetype TYPE string,
             object_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachments_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE string " Generischer Schlüssel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_attachments_for_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_formatted_key TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments_dynamic.
    DATA lv_formatted_key TYPE borident-objkey.

    CASE iv_object_type.
      WHEN 'BUS2000116'. " Sales Order
        lv_formatted_key = |{ iv_object_key ALPHA = IN }|. " Konvertierung z.B. '123' -> '0000000123'
      WHEN 'BUS1001006'. " Material
        lv_formatted_key = to_upper( iv_object_key ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_formatted_key = iv_object_key.
    ENDCASE.

    rt_attachments = mock_get_attachments_for_type(
      iv_object_type = iv_object_type
      iv_formatted_key = lv_formatted_key
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_attachments_for_type.
*   Simuliert cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachments mit objektspezifischen Daten
    IF iv_object_type = 'BUS2000116' AND iv_formatted_key = '0000000123'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE tt_attachment_infos(
        ( filename = 'SO_123.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' object_type = iv_object_type object_key = iv_formatted_key )
        ( filename = 'SO_123_Log.txt' filetype = 'TXT' object_type = iv_object_type object_key = iv_formatted_key )
      ).
    ELSEIF iv_object_type = 'BUS1001006' AND iv_formatted_key = 'MATERIAL_A'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE tt_attachment_infos(
        ( filename = 'MAT_A_Spec.docx' filetype = 'DOCX' object_type = iv_object_type object_key = iv_formatted_key )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Daten für einen `cl_gui_column_tree` aus `sflights` vorbereitet. Die Methode soll die Fluggesellschaften gruppieren und die Flüge als Kindknoten anzeigen. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` auf `carrid`, um die hierarchische Struktur zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             icon       TYPE icon_d,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS
                                            ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_tree_nodes(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid_group = ls_flight-carrid
      INDEX INTO group_idx
      LET group_node_key = |G{ group_idx }| IN
      (
        ( node_key    = group_node_key,
          parent_key  = '',
          text        = |Fluggesellschaft: { carrid_group }|,
          icon        = icon_folder,
          carrid      = carrid_group,
          connid      = '' )

        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
        INDEX INTO member_idx
        ( node_key    = |F{ group_idx }_{ member_idx }|,
          parent_key  = group_node_key,
          text        = |Flug { ls_member-connid } ({ ls_member-fldate DATE = USER })|,
          icon        = icon_flight_scheduled,
          carrid      = ls_member-carrid,
          connid      = ls_member-connid )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename TYPE string,
             filetype TYPE string,
             created_by TYPE syuname,
             created_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_recent_pdf_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_recent_pdf_attachments.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = mock_get_attachments( iv_object_type = iv_object_type iv_object_key = iv_object_key ).
    DATA(lv_30_days_ago) = sy-datum - 30.

    rt_filtered_attachments = FILTER tt_attachment_infos(
      lt_all_attachments
      WHERE filetype = 'PDF'
      AND   CONV d( created_at(8) ) >= lv_30_days_ago
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_attachments.
*   Simuliert den Aufruf von cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachments
    rt_attachments = VALUE tt_attachment_infos(
      ( filename = 'Aktuell.pdf'   filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USER1' created_at = |{ sy-datum }100000| )
      ( filename = 'Alt.pdf'       filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USER2' created_at = |{ sy-datum - 40 }090000| )
      ( filename = 'Bild.jpg'      filetype = 'JPG' created_by = 'USER3' created_at = |{ sy-datum - 5 }113000| )
      ( filename = 'LetzteWoche.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_by = 'USER1' created_at = |{ sy-datum - 7 }140000| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Daten für einen `cl_gui_column_tree` aus `sflights` vorbereitet. Die Methode soll die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft gruppieren und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge anzeigen. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` zur Aggregation und `FOR` zur Strukturierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft zu ermitteln, und dann `FOR` um die Baumstruktur zu bauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_count_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             icon       TYPE icon_d,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             count      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_count_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS
                                            ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_counts) = REDUCE tt_tree_nodes(
      INIT nodes = VALUE tt_tree_nodes( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid_group = ls_flight-carrid
      INDEX INTO group_idx
      LET group_node_key = |G{ group_idx }| IN
      NEXT nodes = VALUE tt_tree_nodes(
        nodes
        ( node_key    = group_node_key,
          parent_key  = '',
          text        = |Fluggesellschaft: { carrid_group } ({ GROUP SIZE } Flüge)|,
          icon        = icon_folder,
          carrid      = carrid_group,
          count       = GROUP SIZE )
      )
    ).

    rt_tree_data = lt_carrid_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von GOS-Anhängen abruft und für jeden Anhang eine URL generiert. Die URL soll den Dateinamen und den Objektschlüssel enthalten. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` zur Iteration über die Anhänge und String-Templates zur URL-Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_url_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename TYPE string,
             filetype TYPE string,
             object_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_url,
             filename TYPE string,
             url      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attachment_url.
    TYPES tt_attachment_urls TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_url WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_attachment_urls
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachment_urls) TYPE tt_attachment_urls.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS mock_get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_url_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_attachment_urls.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = mock_get_attachments( iv_object_type = iv_object_type iv_object_key = iv_object_key ).

    rt_attachment_urls = VALUE tt_attachment_urls(
      FOR ls_attachment IN lt_all_attachments
      ( filename = ls_attachment-filename,
        url      = |/sap/bc/bsp/sap/zgos_viewer?objtype={ ls_attachment-object_type }&objkey={ ls_attachment-object_key }&filename={ ls_attachment-filename }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mock_get_attachments.
    rt_attachments = VALUE tt_attachment_infos(
      ( filename = 'Dokument_A.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' object_type = iv_object_type object_key = iv_object_key )
      ( filename = 'Bild_B.jpg' filetype = 'JPG' object_type = iv_object_type object_key = iv_object_key )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Daten für einen `cl_gui_column_tree` aus `sflights` vorbereitet. Die Methode soll nur Flüge anzeigen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Plätzen haben. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf die `sflights`-Tabelle, um die relevanten Flüge auszuwählen, und dann `FOR` zur Strukturierung der Baumdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             icon       TYPE icon_d,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             seats_free TYPE i,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_tree_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS
                                            ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_sflights
      WHERE seatsmax - seatsocc >= iv_min_free_seats
    ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_tree_nodes(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      INDEX INTO idx
      ( node_key    = |F{ idx }|,
        parent_key  = '',
        text        = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER })|,
        icon        = icon_flight_scheduled,
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid      = ls_flight-connid,
        seats_free  = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_tree( ).

    DATA(lt_tree_data_high_seats) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_tree_data( 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein für 50 freie Plätze' act = lines( lt_tree_data_high_seats ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    LOOP AT lt_tree_data_high_seats INTO DATA(ls_node_high).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flug sollte mindestens 50 freie Plätze haben' act = ls_node_high-seats_free exp = 49 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_tree_data_low_seats) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_tree_data( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein für 1 freien Platz' act = lines( lt_tree_data_low_seats ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FILTER`-Operator (seit ABAP 7.40) zur Vorselektion von Daten mit dem `FOR`-Operator (seit ABAP 7.50) zur Transformation in die Baumstruktur. Zuerst werden die Flüge basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Plätze gefiltert, dann werden die gefilterten Flüge in die für den `cl_gui_column_tree` benötigte Struktur gemappt. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Differenz einer Liste von Zahlen. Beginnen Sie mit 0 und subtrahieren Sie jede Zahl nacheinander.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_cumulative_diff
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cumulative_diff.
    rv_result = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT sum = sum - num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cumulative_diff FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_diff.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 5 ) ( 2 ) ). " 0 - 10 - 5 - 2 = -17
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_diff( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -17 ).

    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    APPEND 10 TO lt_numbers. " 0 - 10 = -10
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_diff( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -10 ).

    CLEAR lt_numbers. " 0
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_diff( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Hier wird eine kumulative Subtraktion durchgeführt, beginnend mit einem Initialwert von 0.
keywords: REDUCE, SUBTRACT, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_for_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_numbers,
             num1 TYPE i,
             num2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_numbers,
           ty_t_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_numbers WITH EMPTY KEY,
           ty_t_diffs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_t_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_diffs) TYPE ty_t_diffs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_differences.
    rt_diffs = VALUE #( FOR ls_num IN it_source ( ls_num-num1 - ls_num-num2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_subtract=>ty_t_numbers(
      ( num1 = 10 num2 = 3 )
      ( num1 = 5 num2 = 8 )
      ( num1 = 100 num2 = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected_diffs) = VALUE zcl_for_subtract=>ty_t_diffs( ( 7 ) ( -3 ) ( 50 ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual_diffs) = lo_cut->calculate_differences( lt_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_diffs exp = lt_expected_diffs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_actual_diffs ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen basierend auf einer Schleife über eine andere Tabelle, wobei hier direkt die Subtraktion in der Schleife erfolgt.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Subtraktion zweier Integer-Werte durch und fangen Sie einen möglichen arithmetischen Überlauf oder Unterlauf ab. Geben Sie bei einem Fehler den minimalen Integer-Wert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_subtract_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_subtract_int.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
        " Bei Überlauf/Unterlauf den minimalen Integer-Wert zurückgeben.
        rv_result = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_int.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_safe_subtract_overflow FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_subtract_normal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_subtract( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_subtract_int( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_safe_subtract_underflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_subtract( ).
    DATA(lv_min_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_int.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_subtract_int( iv_num1 = lv_min_int iv_num2 = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_min_int ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_safe_subtract_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_subtract( ).
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_val_int.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_subtract_int( iv_num1 = lv_max_int iv_num2 = -1 ). " max_int - (-1) = max_int + 1 (Überlauf)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_int ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Differenz zwischen der maximalen und der belegten Sitzplatzkapazität.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             capacity_diff TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_flight_capacity,
           ty_t_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY,
           ty_t_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_grouped_capacity_diff
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_diffs) TYPE ty_t_flight_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_grouped_capacity_diff.
    rt_grouped_diffs = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                   connid = GROUP KEY-connid
                                   capacity_diff = REDUCE i( INIT diff = 0
                                                             FOR member IN GROUP
                                                             NEXT diff = diff + ( member-seatsmax - member-seatsocc ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_capacity_diff FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_capacity_diff.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_group_subtract=>ty_t_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 50 ) " Diff 150
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 60 ) " Diff 120 -> Total 270 for LH 0400
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 60 ) " Diff 90
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 20 ) " Diff 80 -> Total 170 for AA 0017
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected_diffs) = VALUE zcl_group_subtract=>ty_t_flight_capacity(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' capacity_diff = 270 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' capacity_diff = 170 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_actual_diffs) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_capacity_diff( lt_sflights ).

    " Sortieren für den Vergleich, da die Reihenfolge der Gruppen nicht garantiert ist
    SORT lt_actual_diffs BY carrid connid.
    SORT lt_expected_diffs BY carrid connid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_diffs exp = lt_expected_diffs ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lt_actual_diffs = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_capacity_diff( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_actual_diffs ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr mächtige und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird die Differenz der Kapazitäten pro Fluggruppe summiert.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR, VALUE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, SUBTRACT, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Integer-Wert innerhalb des gültigen Bereichs für den Typ `i` liegt. Falls nicht, geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück, die die minimalen und maximalen Grenzwerte enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_int` und `max_val_int` für die Grenzwerte und String-Templates für die Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_range_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_int_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      EXCEPTIONS
        out_of_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_range_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_int_range.
    DATA(lv_min_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_int.
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_val_int.

    IF iv_value < lv_min_int OR iv_value > lv_max_int.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_static_check=>default_message
          text   = |
            Value { iv_value } is out of range for type I.
            Valid range: { lv_min_int } to { lv_max_int }.
          |.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_int_in_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_int_out_of_range_min FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_int_out_of_range_max FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_int_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_range_check( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_int_range( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_int_out_of_range_min.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_range_check( ).
    DATA(lv_min_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_val_int.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_int_range( lv_min_int - 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_static_check expected for value below min_int' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Assert success
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_int_out_of_range_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_range_check( ).
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_val_int.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_int_range( lv_max_int + 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_static_check expected for value above max_int' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Assert success
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Validierung von Eingabewerten ist entscheidend. Durch die Verwendung von `cl_abap_exceptional_values` für die Grenzwerte und String-Templates für dynamische Fehlermeldungen wird der Code robust und die Fehlerausgabe informativ. Die Ausnahmebehandlung mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` ist der moderne Weg, Fehler zu signalisieren.
keywords: cl_abap_exceptional_values, Data Types, Validation, Error Handling, String Templates, Exception, Integer, Limits

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge der Airline 'AA' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und geben Sie die Flugnummern und Daten zurück.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_for_airline
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fldates) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_airline.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate
           WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-connid } - { ls_sflight-fldate }| TO rt_fldates.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_char_cp( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '* - *', msg = 'Expected flight number and date format' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität aller Flüge einer bestimmten Airline aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS seatsmax
           WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_data
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_capacity) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_capacity >= 0, msg = 'Capacity should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Filterkriterien zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_capacity TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251203' seatsmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' seatsmax = 120 )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax >= iv_min_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_capacity = 120 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsmax exp = 150 ).

    DATA(lt_result_none) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_capacity = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result_none ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                               WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen kopiert werden sollen und ein Feld mit einem konstanten Wert belegt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder Tabellen mit gleichen Feldnamen zu kopieren, und die MAPPING-Klausel für zusätzliche Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights
      IMPORTING it_source_flights TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING currency = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_operator=>tt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 150 price = '100.00' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' seatsmax = 200 price = '200.00' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_flights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING-Operator ermöglicht das effiziente Kopieren von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, wobei Felder mit gleichen Namen automatisch zugeordnet werden. Mit der MAPPING-Klausel können zusätzlich Felder umbenannt oder mit Konstanten belegt werden, was den Code für Datenübertragungen stark vereinfacht.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Structure, Data Transfer, MAPPING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Klasse und rufen Sie direkt eine Methode auf, die eine weitere Methode zurückgibt, um eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen zu demonstrieren (Method Chaining).

CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_message_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_final_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.

In Kombination mit Method Chaining, bei dem Methoden die Instanz des Objekts selbst zurückgeben, können komplexe Operationen in einer flüssigen, lesbaren Kette ausgedrückt werden, was den Code kompakter und eleganter macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzbelegung für Flüge einer Airline, indem Sie Zwischenergebnisse mit dem LET-Ausdruck in einem REDUCE-Operator definieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie den LET-Ausdruck innerhalb eines REDUCE-Operators, um lokale Hilfsvariablen zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_let_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_avg_occupancy
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_let_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_occupancy.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS seatsocc, seatsmax
           WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rv_avg_occupancy = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT total_occupied = 0.0, total_max = 0.0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_data
      LET current_occupied = CONV decfloat16( ls_sflight-seatsocc )
          current_max = CONV decfloat16( ls_sflight-seatsmax ) IN
      NEXT total_occupied = total_occupied + current_occupied,
           total_max = total_max + current_max
      FINALLY:
        IF total_max > 0 THEN total_occupied / total_max * 100 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_let_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_occupancy( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_avg >= 0 AND lv_avg <= 100, msg = 'Average occupancy should be between 0 and 100' ).

    DATA(lv_avg_no_flights) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_occupancy( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_no_flights exp = 0.0, msg = 'Expected 0 for non-existent airline' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der LET-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen innerhalb von Konstruktorausdrücken wie REDUCE. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Ausdrücke, indem Zwischenberechnungen benannt und wiederverwendet werden können, ohne separate Variablen deklarieren zu müssen.
keywords: LET, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Constructor Expression, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Werfen Sie eine Ausnahme mit dem NEW-Operator, wenn ein ungültiger Flugstatus übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie RAISE EXCEPTION NEW, um eine Ausnahme direkt zu instanziieren und zu werfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_new DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_status
      IMPORTING iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_new IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_status.
    IF iv_status_code IS NOT SUPPLIED OR iv_status_code IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_invalid_value( textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.

    CASE iv_status_code.
      WHEN 'A' OR 'B' OR 'C'.
        " Valid status, do something
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_invalid_value(
          textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>default_text,
          value  = iv_status_code
        ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_status FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert=>error_in_test.
    METHODS test_initial_status FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert=>error_in_test.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_new( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_flight_status( 'A' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true, msg = 'Valid status should not raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected exception for valid status' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_new( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_flight_status( 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for invalid status' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true, msg = 'Exception caught for invalid status' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_new( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_flight_status( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for initial status' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true, msg = 'Exception caught for initial status' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Syntax RAISE EXCEPTION NEW ermöglicht das direkte Instanziieren und Werfen von Ausnahmen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art der Fehlerbehandlung, die die Lesbarkeit verbessert und die Notwendigkeit einer separaten CREATE OBJECT-Anweisung eliminiert.
keywords: Exception Handling, RAISE EXCEPTION NEW, CX_ABAP_INVALID_VALUE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_capacity TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_airline
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_airline.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_max_capacity) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        IF ls_group_member-seatsmax > lv_max_capacity.
          lv_max_capacity = ls_group_member-seatsmax.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_flight_count
                      max_capacity = lv_max_capacity ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_group_by=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 180 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 250 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_airline( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-max_capacity exp = 150 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-max_capacity exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Anweisung ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie vereinfacht komplexe Aggregationen und Gruppierungslogik erheblich, indem sie die Notwendigkeit manueller Sortierungen und Schleifen über sortierte Daten eliminiert.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Table, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer übergebenen Struktur und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR für die dynamische Typisierung und Feldzugriffe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_field,
             name  TYPE fieldname,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_field.
    TYPES tt_data_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING it_field_definitions TYPE tt_data_fields
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    DATA(lo_line_type) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    DATA(lo_struct_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_type ).

    CREATE DATA DATA(lo_new_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_line_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_new_line->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    " Fill with some dummy data
    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = ls_field_def-value && '_val'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

    CLEAR <fs_line>.
    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = ls_field_def-value && '_val2'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_dynamic_table=>tt_data_fields.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD1' value = 'Value1' ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD2' value = 'Value2' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    ASSIGN <fs_table>[ 1 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_line> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Value1_val' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field2> exp = 'Value2_val' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen und Strukturen zur Laufzeit ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das mit den Klassen CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR realisiert wird. Dies ermöglicht hochflexible Anwendungen, die sich an variable Datenstrukturen anpassen können, was besonders in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Integration mit externen Systemen nützlich ist.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, Field Symbols

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt, unter Verwendung der modernen Datumsklassen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP für Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_days_to_date
      IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE d
                iv_days       TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_end_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_days_to_date.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date(
      iv_date = iv_start_date
    ).

    DATA(lv_new_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
      iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp,
      iv_seconds   = iv_days * 86400 " 86400 seconds in a day
    ).

    rv_end_date = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_timestamp(
      iv_timestamp = lv_new_timestamp
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calculation( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20251126'.
    DATA(lv_end_date) = lo_cut->add_days_to_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_days = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_end_date exp = '20251226' ).

    DATA(lv_end_date_zero) = lo_cut->add_days_to_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_days = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_end_date_zero exp = lv_start_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP bietet eine robuste und moderne Möglichkeit zur Durchführung von Datums- und Zeitberechnungen. Durch die Umwandlung von Daten in Zeitstempel können Additionen und Subtraktionen von Tagen, Stunden oder Sekunden präzise durchgeführt werden, was die Fehleranfälligkeit gegenüber manuellen Berechnungen reduziert.
keywords: Date, Time, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Date Calculation

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8-kodierten String in einen String, der mit der Codepage ISO-8859-1 kodiert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ` und die Methode `CREATE_FOR_CODEPAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_iso DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_iso IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_for_codepage(
      codepage = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
      endian   = 'L'
    ).

    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        in    = iv_utf8_string
      IMPORTING
        out   = rv_iso_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_utf8_to_iso( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_input) = 'Grüße aus München'.
    DATA(lv_expected_iso) = 'Grüße aus München'. " Assuming the system's default is compatible or it handles it.

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_string( lv_utf8_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = lv_expected_iso
      msg = 'String sollte korrekt nach ISO-8859-1 konvertiert werden.'
    ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen binären XSTRING, der eine unbekannte Codepage haben könnte, in einen String. Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass die Konvertierung fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ=>CREATE_IN` und fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_to_str DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage TYPE cpsequence OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_to_str IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.

    TRY.
        IF iv_codepage IS SUPPLIED.
          lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
            codepage = iv_codepage
            endian   = 'L'
          ).
        ELSE.
          " Try to guess codepage or use default (e.g., UTF-8)
          lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
            codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
            endian   = 'L'
          ).
        ENDIF.

        lo_conv->read(
          EXPORTING
            input  = iv_xstring
          IMPORTING
            data   = rv_string
        ).

    CATCH cx_abap_conv_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_json_array_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xco_json_array_create IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten enthält, und extrahieren Sie die 'item'- und 'quantity'-Werte in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `XCO_CP_JSON=>parse( )`, `as_array( )` und iterieren Sie über die Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_json_array_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item     TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_json_array
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items
      RAISING
        cx_xco_json_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_json_array_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_json_array.
    DATA(lo_json_document) = xco_cp_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_json_array) = lo_json_document->as_array( ).

    LOOP AT lo_json_array->get_elements( ) INTO DATA(lo_element).
      DATA(lo_json_object) = lo_element->as_object( ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_item(
        item     = lo_json_object->get_property( 'item' )->as_string( )
        quantity = lo_json_object->get_property( 'quantity' )->as_integer( )
      ) TO rt_items.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit Basic Authentication an eine externe URL durch und geben Sie den Statuscode der Antwort zurück. Verwenden Sie die XCO-HTTP-Client-Bibliothek.

CLASS zcl_xco_http_auth_get IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und fügen Sie einen benutzerdefinierten Header hinzu. Geben Sie den Wert eines spezifischen Antwort-Headers zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `XCO_CP_HTTP_CLIENT=>request( )`, `add_header( )` und `get_header( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_http_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_get_with_headers
      IMPORTING
        iv_url        TYPE string
        iv_req_header_name  TYPE string
        iv_req_header_value TYPE string
        iv_res_header_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_res_header_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xco_http_client_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_http_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_get_with_headers.
    DATA(lo_request) = xco_cp_http_client=>request(
      )->for_url( iv_url
      )->get(
      )->add_header( xco_cp_http_client=>header(
        )->set_name( iv_req_header_name
        )->set_value( iv_req_header_value
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_response) = lo_request->execute( ).

    TRY.
        rv_res_header_value = lo_response->get_header( iv_res_header_name )->get_value( ).
    CATCH cx_xco_http_client_exception.
        " Header not found or other error
        rv_res_header_value = 'Header not found'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Feldkatalog, der die Felder `CARRID` und `CONNID` aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` enthält. Füllen Sie diese dynamische Tabelle mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_key_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'N'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data
    ).

    " Assign dynamic table to field symbol
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Populate dynamic table with data from SFLIGHT
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE ty_sflight_key_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight_entry).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_dynamic_line>).
      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid>).
        IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_carrid> = ls_sflight_entry-carrid.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_connid>).
        IF <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_connid> = ls_sflight_entry-connid.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_create( ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    DATA(lv_sflight_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_sflight_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Row count mismatch' act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = lv_sflight_count ).

    IF lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) > 0.
      READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_first_row>).
      IF <ls_first_row> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_connid>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' act = <lv_carrid> ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CONNID should not be initial' act = <lv_connid> ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

IN ...` für die Datenbeschaffung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Field-Symbols für den Zugriff auf dynamische Felder wird genutzt, um Flexibilität und Lesbarkeit zu gewährleisten.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in einer Zielwährung (z.B. EUR), wobei die ursprünglichen Währungen unterschiedlich sein können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT CURRENCY` und die `REDUCE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_currency_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_and_sum_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_currency TYPE sflight-curr_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_amount) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_sum_sflight.
    DATA: lv_converted_amount TYPE sflight-price.

    rv_total_amount = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
      NEXT
        " Convert each flight price to the target currency
        CONVERT AMOUNT ls_sflight-price
        CURRENCY ls_sflight-currency
        DATE sy-datum
        INTO lv_converted_amount
        TARGET CURRENCY iv_target_currency.
        total_sum = total_sum + lv_converted_amount
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_currency_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_total_eur) = lo_cut->convert_and_sum_sflight( 'EUR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total amount in EUR should be positive' act = ( lv_total_eur > 0 ) ).

    DATA(lv_total_usd) = lo_cut->convert_and_sum_sflight( 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total amount in USD should be positive' act = ( lv_total_usd > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'EUR and USD totals should differ (unless rates are 1:1)' act = lv_total_eur exp = lv_total_usd ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer kompakten und funktionalen Weise. Innerhalb der Schleife wird `CONVERT AMOUNT` verwendet, um jeden Flugpreis in die Zielwährung umzurechnen, bevor er zur Gesamtsumme addiert wird. Dies demonstriert die Kombination von modernen Schleifenkonstrukten mit Währungsumrechnungsfunktionen.
keywords: CONVERT, CURRENCY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`) aus `SFLIGHT` und zeigen Sie diese in einem ALV-Grid an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und `cl_salv_table=>factory`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS display_sflight_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_alv.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lo_data     TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Define field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'N'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'D'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 8.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lo_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Populate dynamic table with data from SFLIGHT
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( 
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
      connid = ls_sflight-connid
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
    ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight_entry).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_dynamic_line>).
      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid>).
        IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_carrid> = ls_sflight_entry-carrid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_connid>).
        IF <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_connid> = ls_sflight_entry-connid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_fldate>).
        IF <lv_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_fldate> = ls_sflight_entry-fldate. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Display ALV
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
                            EXPORTING
                              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                            CHANGING
                              t_table     = <lt_dynamic_table>
                          ).
        lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->set_optimize( abap_true ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alv_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_display.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_display( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_sflight_alv( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true exp = abap_true msg = 'ALV display method executed without exception' ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit `CARRID` und `CONNID`. Fügen Sie dann dynamisch ein neues Feld `NEW_FIELD` hinzu und füllen Sie es mit einem Standardwert.
hint: Erstellen Sie den Feldkatalog, dann die Tabelle, und erweitern Sie den Feldkatalog für das neue Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_extend_table
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_extend_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lo_data_initial TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table_initial> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Initial field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'N'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create initial dynamic internal table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lo_data_initial
    ).
    ASSIGN lo_data_initial->* TO <lt_dynamic_table_initial>.

    " Add data to initial table (e.g., from SFLIGHT)
    DATA(lt_sflight_keys) = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_keys INTO DATA(ls_sflight_entry).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table_initial> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_dynamic_line>).
      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid>).
        IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_carrid> = ls_sflight_entry-carrid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_connid>).
        IF <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_connid> = ls_sflight_entry-connid. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add new field to field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'NEW_FIELD'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 20.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create new dynamic internal table with extended field catalog
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data
    ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table_extended> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table_extended>.

    " Copy data from initial table to extended table and fill new field
    LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table_initial> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_initial_line>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table_extended> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_extended_line>).
      IF <ls_extended_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Use CORRESPONDING for easy copy of common fields
        <ls_extended_line> = CORRESPONDING #( <ls_initial_line> ).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NEW_FIELD' OF STRUCTURE <ls_extended_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_new_field>).
        IF <lv_new_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_new_field> = 'Default Value'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_addition FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_addition.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_add( ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->create_and_extend_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    IF lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) > 0.
      READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_first_row>).
      IF <ls_first_row> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NEW_FIELD' OF STRUCTURE <ls_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_new_field>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'NEW_FIELD should exist and not be initial' act = <lv_new_field> ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'NEW_FIELD content mismatch' act = <lv_new_field> exp = 'Default Value' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Could not read first row of dynamic table' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine dynamische interne Tabelle erstellt, diese mit Daten füllt und anschließend ein neues Feld hinzufügt. Dies erfordert die Erstellung einer neuen dynamischen Tabelle mit dem erweiterten Feldkatalog und das Kopieren der Daten. Die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um Felder mit gleichem Namen effizient zu kopieren, was eine moderne und lesbare Syntax darstellt.
keywords: cl_alv_table_create, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Field-Symbols, CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Führen Sie einen dynamischen `SELECT`-Befehl auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` aus, um nur die Felder `CARRID` und `CONNID` abzurufen, und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer dynamisch erstellten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die Zieltabelle und `SELECT (field_list) FROM (table_name) INTO TABLE (dynamic_table)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define field catalog for dynamic table
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'N'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = ro_data
    ).

    " Assign dynamic table to field symbol
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Dynamic SELECT statement
    DATA(lv_field_list) = 'CARRID CONNID'.
    DATA(lv_table_name) = 'SFLIGHT'.

    SELECT (lv_field_list)
      FROM (lv_table_name)
      INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHT`, deren Flugdatum nach einem bestimmten Datum liegt, und konvertieren Sie das Flugdatum in ein externes Format (z.B. 'DD.MM.YYYY') für die Ausgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Tabellenoperation und `CONV` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate_ext TYPE char10, " External date format
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES: ty_flight_display_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flight_display_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER sflight WHERE ( fldate > iv_min_date )
      (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate_ext = CONV char10( ls_sflight-fldate ) " Implicit conversion to external format
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_and_convert FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_convert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_and_convert( ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHT has flights after 20230101
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( '20230101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find flights after 20230101' act = lt_flights ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( msg = 'Date format should be DD.MM.YYYY' act = ls_first_flight-fldate_ext exp = '\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}' ).
    ENDIF.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_and_convert( ).
