    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( '99991231' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should find no flights after 99991231' act = lt_flights ).

Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT`, wobei das `FLDATE` in ein externes Format (`DD.MM.YYYY`) konvertiert wird, und zeigen Sie die Daten in einem ALV-Grid an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die dynamische Tabelle und `CONV` für die Datumskonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_conv_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_alv_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_conv_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_alv_converted.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lo_data     TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Define field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'N'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE_EXT'. " Field for external date format
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 10.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lo_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Populate dynamic table with data from SFLIGHT and convert date
    LOOP AT sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight_entry).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_dynamic_line>).
      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid>).
        IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_carrid> = ls_sflight_entry-carrid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_connid>).
        IF <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_connid> = ls_sflight_entry-connid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE_EXT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_fldate_ext>).
        IF <lv_fldate_ext> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_fldate_ext> = CONV char10( ls_sflight_entry-fldate ). " Convert date
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Display ALV
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
                            EXPORTING
                              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                            CHANGING
                              t_table     = <lt_dynamic_table>
                          ).
        lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->set_optimize( abap_true ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtmenge aller Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` in einer Zielmengeneinheit (z.B. 'KG'), aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN FILTER ...` und `CONVERT QUANTITY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_unit_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_quantity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_target_unit    TYPE meins
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_quantity) TYPE p DECIMALS 3.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_unit_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_quantity.
    DATA: lv_converted_quantity TYPE p DECIMALS 3.

    rv_total_quantity = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_qty TYPE p DECIMALS 3 = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT
        " Assuming SFLIGHT has a quantity field, e.g., 'SEATSMAX'
        " For demonstration, let's use a dummy quantity or assume a field exists.
        DATA(lv_dummy_quantity) = '100.000'. " Example: 100 units per flight
        DATA(lv_dummy_unit) = 'PC'. " Example: Pieces

        CONVERT QUANTITY lv_dummy_quantity
        UNIT lv_dummy_unit
        INTO lv_converted_quantity
        TARGET UNIT iv_target_unit.
        total_qty = total_qty + lv_converted_quantity
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_unit_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_lh_flight_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_lh_flight_count.

    DATA(lv_total_kg) = lo_cut->calculate_total_quantity( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_target_unit = 'KG' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_kg) = lv_lh_flight_count * 100.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total quantity for LH in KG mismatch' act = lv_total_kg exp = lv_expected_kg ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Innerhalb der `REDUCE`-Schleife wird `CONVERT QUANTITY` verwendet, um eine angenommene Menge pro Flug in die Zielmengeneinheit umzurechnen. Dies demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von funktionalen Operatoren für bedingte Aggregation und Einheitenumrechnung.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_price IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie dessen Wert.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Assigning string to any type, conversion happens implicitly if possible
      <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error: component not found
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
    END IF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle, die selbst eine interne Tabelle als Komponente enthält, und greifen Sie auf die Elemente der inneren Tabelle zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_itabs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_inner_line,
             item_id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_inner_line.
    TYPES ty_t_inner TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_inner_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_outer_line,
             header_id TYPE i,
             items     TYPE ty_t_inner,
           END OF ty_outer_line.
    TYPES ty_t_outer TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_outer_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_quantity
      IMPORTING
        it_outer_table TYPE ty_t_outer
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_quantity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_itabs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_quantity.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_outer> TYPE ty_outer_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_inner> TYPE ty_inner_line.

    LOOP AT it_outer_table ASSIGNING <fs_outer>.
      LOOP AT <fs_outer>-items ASSIGNING <fs_inner>.
        rv_total_quantity = rv_total_quantity + <fs_inner>-quantity.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_quantity FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_quantity.
    DATA: lt_outer TYPE zcl_nested_itabs=>ty_t_outer,
          ls_outer TYPE zcl_nested_itabs=>ty_outer_line,
          ls_inner TYPE zcl_nested_itabs=>ty_inner_line.

    ls_outer-header_id = 1.
    ls_inner-item_id = 10. ls_inner-quantity = 5. APPEND ls_inner TO ls_outer-items.
    ls_inner-item_id = 20. ls_inner-quantity = 3. APPEND ls_inner TO ls_outer-items.
    APPEND ls_outer TO lt_outer.

    CLEAR ls_outer. CLEAR ls_outer-items.
    ls_outer-header_id = 2.
    ls_inner-item_id = 30. ls_inner-quantity = 2. APPEND ls_inner TO ls_outer-items.
    APPEND ls_outer TO lt_outer.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_itabs( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_quantity( lt_outer ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 10 ). " 5 + 3 + 2 = 10
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_outer TYPE zcl_nested_itabs=>ty_t_outer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_itabs( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_quantity( lt_outer ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol>`-Anweisungen sind der effizienteste Weg, um auf Daten in geschachtelten internen Tabellen zuzugreifen und diese zu verarbeiten, da sie direkte Referenzen auf die Zeilen bieten.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `sflights` und erhöhen Sie deren Preise um 5%, alles in einem modernen Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` mit `ASSIGNING` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_increase_prices.
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                            ( <fs_sflight> WITH price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.05' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` und aktualisieren Sie dessen Währung, falls gefunden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol> WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_read_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_read_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_currency.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-currency = iv_new_currency.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen von einem String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING` und `SHIFT RIGHT DELETING TRAILING` oder `CONDENSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_trim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_trim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string.
    rv_trimmed_string = iv_input.
    " Modern ABAP offers CONDENSE, but for specific character trimming, WHILE is useful.
    " For general whitespace, CONDENSE is simpler.
    " Here, demonstrating WHILE for more complex trimming scenarios.
    WHILE rv_trimmed_string IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_trimmed_string(1) = ` `.
      SHIFT rv_trimmed_string LEFT DELETING LEADING ` `.
    ENDWHILE.

    WHILE rv_trimmed_string IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_trimmed_string+strlen( rv_trimmed_string ) - 1(1) = ` `.
      SHIFT rv_trimmed_string RIGHT DELETING TRAILING ` `.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer gegebenen positiven Ganzzahl iterativ mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die einen Zähler herunterzählt und das Ergebnis multipliziert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input must be a non-negative integer.'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_counter) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_counter > 0.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_counter.
      lv_counter = lv_counter - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen einfachen Tokenizer, der einen String in Wörter zerlegt, wobei Leerzeichen als Trennzeichen dienen. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `FIND` und `SUBSTRING` oder `SHIFT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_tokenizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS tokenize_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tokens) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_tokenizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tokenize_string.
    DATA(lv_remaining_string) = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_length) TYPE i.

    WHILE lv_remaining_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Remove leading spaces
      SHIFT lv_remaining_string LEFT DELETING LEADING ` `.
      IF lv_remaining_string IS INITIAL. " All spaces removed
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Find next space or end of string
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF ` ` IN SECTION OFFSET 0 OF lv_remaining_string MATCH LENGTH lv_length.

      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Space found
        APPEND lv_remaining_string(lv_length) TO rt_tokens.
        lv_remaining_string = lv_remaining_string+lv_length.
      ELSE. " No more spaces, rest is the last token
        APPEND lv_remaining_string TO rt_tokens.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_string.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Prozess, der Daten aus einer Quelle liest, bis ein bestimmter Endmarker gefunden wird oder eine maximale Anzahl von Iterationen erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einer Bedingung, die sowohl den Endmarker als auch einen Iterationszähler berücksichtigt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_data_until_marker
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_end_marker  TYPE string
        iv_max_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_read_data) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_data_until_marker.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_found_marker) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_source_data ) AND lv_index <= iv_max_iterations AND lv_found_marker = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_current_line) = it_source_data[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_line = iv_end_marker.
        lv_found_marker = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        APPEND lv_current_line TO rt_read_data.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Hash-Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `COLLECT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` für die Iteration und `COLLECT` für die Aggregation in einer Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES ty_h_flight_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rh_flight_counts) TYPE ty_h_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    DATA: ls_flight_count TYPE ty_flight_count.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ls_flight_count-carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid.
      ls_flight_count-count = 1.
      COLLECT ls_flight_count INTO rh_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über alle Komponenten einer Struktur und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte aus. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Index für `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `DESCRIBE FIELD` für den Komponentennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_iterate_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_info
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_info) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_iterate_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_component_name) TYPE string.

    WHILE lv_index <= 100. " Max components to avoid infinite loop for unknown structures
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_index OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT. " No more components
      ENDIF.

      DESCRIBE FIELD <fs_component> NAME lv_component_name.
      APPEND |{ lv_component_name }: { <fs_component> }| TO rt_component_info.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Teilstrings aus einem Eingabestring. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und `REPLACE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `FIND` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` oder `REPLACE SECTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_remove_substring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_substring    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_remove_substring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_substring.
    rv_result_string = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i.

    IF iv_substring IS INITIAL.
      rv_result_string = iv_input_string.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE sy-subrc = 0.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_substring IN rv_result_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        REPLACE SECTION OFFSET lv_offset LENGTH strlen( iv_substring ) OF rv_result_string WITH ``.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der ersten N geraden Zahlen iterativ mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die einen Zähler und eine Summe verwaltet, und prüfen Sie auf gerade Zahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_sum_even DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_first_n_even
      IMPORTING
        iv_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_even IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_first_n_even.
    IF iv_n < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input N must be a non-negative integer.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = 0.
    rv_sum = 0.

    WHILE lv_count < iv_n.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number + 2. " Next even number
      rv_sum = rv_sum + lv_current_number.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `ASSIGNING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... ASSIGNING <group_key>` und eine innere Schleife mit `ASSIGNING <member>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_date_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_date_carrier.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_key> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_member> TYPE ty_sflight.
    DATA: ls_grouped_flight TYPE ty_flight_group.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight_sorted) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight_sorted-carrid fldate = ls_sflight_sorted-fldate ) ASSIGNING <fs_group_key>.
      ls_grouped_flight-carrid = <fs_group_key>-carrid.
      ls_grouped_flight-fldate = <fs_group_key>-fldate.
      ls_grouped_flight-flight_count = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group_key> ASSIGNING <fs_member>.
        ls_grouped_flight-flight_count = ls_grouped_flight-flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_grouped_flight TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die eine Liste von Aufgaben verarbeitet. Jede Aufgabe kann eine Folgeaufgabe generieren, die der Liste hinzugefügt wird. Die Schleife soll fortgesetzt werden, solange Aufgaben in der Liste sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die eine interne Tabelle als Aufgaben-Queue verwendet und neue Aufgaben hinzufügt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_task_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_tasks
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_tasks TYPE ty_t_tasks
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE ty_t_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_task_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_tasks.
    DATA(lt_task_queue) = it_initial_tasks.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_task_queue ).
      DATA(lv_current_task) = lt_task_queue[ lv_index ].
      APPEND lv_current_task TO rt_processed_tasks.

      " Simulate task processing and potential new tasks
      IF lv_current_task = 'Task A'.
        APPEND 'Subtask A1' TO lt_task_queue.
        APPEND 'Subtask A2' TO lt_task_queue.
      ELSEIF lv_current_task = 'Task B'.
        APPEND 'Subtask B1' TO lt_task_queue.
      ENDIF.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_task_processing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_initial_tasks FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_subtasks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_task_processing.
    DATA: lt_initial_tasks TYPE zcl_while_task_processor=>ty_t_tasks.
    APPEND 'Task A' TO lt_initial_tasks.
    APPEND 'Task B' TO lt_initial_tasks.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_task_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_tasks( lt_initial_tasks ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ). " Task A, Task B, Subtask A1, Subtask A2, Subtask B1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = `Task A` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = `Task B` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = `Subtask A1` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ] exp = `Subtask A2` ).
    " Note: Subtask B1 would be at index 5 if it was processed after A1/A2, but it's added to the end of the queue.
    " The order of processing depends on how the queue is managed. Here, it's a simple append.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_initial_tasks.
    DATA: lt_initial_tasks TYPE zcl_while_task_processor=>ty_t_tasks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_task_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_tasks( lt_initial_tasks ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_subtasks.
    DATA: lt_initial_tasks TYPE zcl_while_task_processor=>ty_t_tasks.
    APPEND 'Task C' TO lt_initial_tasks.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_task_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_tasks( lt_initial_tasks ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = `Task C` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese `WHILE`-Schleife simuliert eine Aufgabenverarbeitung, bei der neue Aufgaben dynamisch zur Warteschlange hinzugefügt werden können. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für die Implementierung von Workflows oder rekursiven Prozessen, bei denen die Gesamtanzahl der Schritte nicht im Voraus bekannt ist.
keywords: WHILE, Conditional Logic, Task Processing, Queue

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen nach einem Kriterium (z.B. gerade/ungerade) und berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate jeder Zahl in der Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_sum_sq DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_number TYPE i.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_sum_sq,
             group_key TYPE string,
             sum_of_squares TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_sum_sq.
    TYPES tt_grouped_sum_sq TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_sum_sq WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING it_numbers          TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sum_squares) TYPE tt_grouped_sum_sq.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_sum_sq IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number) GROUP BY ( group_key = COND string( WHEN lv_number MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'EVEN' ELSE 'ODD' ) ) INTO DATA(group_data).
      DATA(lv_current_sum_sq) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_sq = 0
        FOR number IN GROUP group_data
        NEXT sum_sq = sum_sq + ( number * number )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_sum_sq(
        group_key = group_data-group_key
        sum_of_squares = lv_current_sum_sq
      ) TO rt_sum_squares.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce_sum_sq( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_grp_reduce_sum_sq=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_test_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_even) WITH KEY group_key = 'EVEN'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_even ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_even-sum_of_squares exp = 2*2 + 4*4 ). " 4 + 16 = 20

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_odd) WITH KEY group_key = 'ODD'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_odd ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_odd-sum_of_squares exp = 1*1 + 3*3 ). " 1 + 9 = 10
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen innerhalb jeder Gruppe, indem es über die Elemente der Gruppe iteriert und einen einzelnen Wert berechnet. Die `GROUP BY`-Klausel kann auch dynamisch einen Gruppierungsschlüssel (hier 'EVEN'/'ODD') erzeugen.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache XLSX-Datei mit zwei Spalten (Name, Wert) und einigen Beispieldaten. Speichern Sie die Datei im Anwendungsverzeichnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_xlsx_document` und deren Methoden zum Hinzufügen von Blättern und Zellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_xlsx_file
      IMPORTING iv_filename TYPE string
                it_data     TYPE tt_data
      RAISING   cx_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xlsx_file.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Sheet1' ).

    " Add header
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_column = 1 ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'Name' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_column = 2 ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'Value' ).

    " Add data
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_column = 1 ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_data-name ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_column = 2 ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_data-value ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Save file
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        bin_filesize = xstrlen( lv_xstring )
        filename     = iv_filename
        filetype     = 'BIN'
        changing
        data_tab     = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_xlsx_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error downloading XLSX file'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_xlsx_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_xlsx_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_xlsx_creator=>tt_data(
      ( name = 'Item A' value = 100 )
      ( name = 'Item B' value = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'test_output.xlsx'. " Dies würde versuchen, die Datei auf das Frontend herunterzuladen.
    " In einem echten Unit-Test würde man cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download mocken
    " oder die Datei auf dem Applikationsserver speichern und den Inhalt prüfen.
    " Zur Vereinfachung wird hier nur geprüft, ob keine Ausnahme ausgelöst wird.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_xlsx_file(
          iv_filename = lv_filename
          it_data     = lt_test_data
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( true = abap_true ). " Wenn keine Ausnahme, Erfolg annehmen
      CATCH cx_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_xlsx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_xlsx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Produkten (ID, Name, Preis) nach ID und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede ID den Namen und den Durchschnittspreis enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ...` und den `VALUE` Operator mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_value_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_avg,
             id          TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
             avg_price   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product_avg.
    TYPES tt_product_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_product
      IMPORTING it_products         TYPE tt_product
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_product_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_value_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_product.
    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( " VALUE Operator für direkte Tabellenkonstruktion
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_products GROUP BY ls_group-id " Gruppierung
      ( id        = ls_group-id
        name      = ls_group-name " Annahme: Name ist innerhalb der Gruppe konsistent
        avg_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
                      INIT sum_price = 0
                      FOR product IN GROUP ls_group
                      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + product-price ) / GROUP SIZE " Durchschnitt mit REDUCE und GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Bestellpositionen nach einem bestimmten Status und gruppieren Sie die gefilterten Positionen dann nach Material, um die Gesamtmenge pro Material zu ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` vor der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_order_item.
    TYPES tt_order_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_quantity,
             material TYPE string,
             total_quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_material_quantity.
    TYPES tt_material_quantity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_quantity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_grouped_quantity
      IMPORTING it_order_items        TYPE tt_order_item
                iv_filter_status      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_material_qty) TYPE tt_material_quantity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_filter_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_grouped_quantity.
    DATA(lt_filtered_items) = FILTER tt_order_item FROM it_order_items
                               WHERE status = iv_filter_status.

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_items INTO DATA(ls_item) GROUP BY ls_item-material INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_material_quantity(
        material = group_key-material
        total_quantity = REDUCE i(
                           INIT sum_qty = 0
                           FOR item IN GROUP group_key
                           NEXT sum_qty = sum_qty + item-quantity )
      ) TO rt_material_qty.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Mitarbeitern (ID, Abteilung, Gehalt) nach Abteilung und finden Sie den Mitarbeiter mit dem höchsten Gehalt in jeder Abteilung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ...` und `REDUCE` mit einer Vergleichslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_max_salary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id        TYPE string,
             department TYPE string,
             salary    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES tt_employee TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dept_top_earner,
             department TYPE string,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             max_salary  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_dept_top_earner.
    TYPES tt_dept_top_earner TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dept_top_earner WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_earner_by_department
      IMPORTING it_employees          TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_top_earners) TYPE tt_dept_top_earner.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_max_salary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_earner_by_department.
    rt_top_earners = VALUE #( " VALUE Operator für direkte Tabellenkonstruktion
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_employees GROUP BY ls_group-department " Gruppierung nach Abteilung
      ( department = ls_group-department
        " Finde den Mitarbeiter mit dem höchsten Gehalt in der Gruppe
        DATA(ls_top_earner) = REDUCE ty_employee(
                                INIT top_emp = VALUE ty_employee( salary = -1 )
                                FOR employee IN GROUP ls_group
                                NEXT top_emp = COND #( WHEN employee-salary > top_emp-salary THEN employee ELSE top_emp ) )
        employee_id = ls_top_earner-id
        max_salary  = ls_top_earner-salary
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_earner.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_max_salary( ).
    DATA(lt_test_employees) = VALUE zcl_grp_max_salary=>tt_employee(
      ( id = 'E1' department = 'HR' salary = '50000.00' )
      ( id = 'E2' department = 'IT' salary = '70000.00' )
      ( id = 'E3' department = 'HR' salary = '60000.00' )
      ( id = 'E4' department = 'IT' salary = '75000.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_earner_by_department( lt_test_employees ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_hr) WITH KEY department = 'HR'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_hr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_hr-employee_id exp = 'E3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_hr-max_salary exp = '60000.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_it) WITH KEY department = 'IT'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_it ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_it-employee_id exp = 'E4' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_it-max_salary exp = '75000.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE`, um nicht nur einen aggregierten Wert, sondern ein spezifisches Element (hier: den Mitarbeiter mit dem höchsten Gehalt) innerhalb jeder Gruppe zu finden. Die `COND`-Ausdrücke innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglichen eine prägnante bedingte Logik.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Namen aller Felder der internen Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `get_components`.

CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_field_names.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_table_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_field_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_sflights_field.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_table_descr->get_component( iv_field_name ).
        rv_has_field = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_component_not_found.
        rv_has_field = abap_false.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert des Feldes 'CARRID' aus der ersten Zeile der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_field_value IMPORTING iv_field_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_field_value.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_value> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_field_value = |{ <lv_value> }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, die nur die Felder 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' aus der Struktur von `sflights` enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_sflights_subset RETURNING VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtts_table_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_sflights_subset.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_sflights_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights )->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'CARRID' type = lo_sflights_struct_descr->get_component( 'CARRID' )->type_descr ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'CONNID' type = lo_sflights_struct_descr->get_component( 'CONNID' )->type_descr ) TO lt_components.

    DATA(lo_dynamic_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_dynamic_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_dynamic_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_table_create FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_create.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtts_table_util( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_sflights_subset( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_table_descr->get_components( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'CONNID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mit `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` wird eine neue Struktur basierend auf ausgewählten Komponenten erstellt. Diese Struktur wird dann als Zeilentyp für `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` verwendet, um eine neue dynamische Tabelle zu definieren. `CREATE DATA` instanziiert die Tabelle.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA, sflights

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Speichern von bearbeitetem ABAP-Code, indem Sie eine `string_table` (die den Code repräsentiert) in einen einzelnen String umwandeln, wie er z.B. in einer Datenbanktabelle gespeichert werden könnte.

solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_source_to_string IMPORTING it_source_code TYPE string_table
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rv_single_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_source_to_string.
    rv_single_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR line IN it_source_code
      NEXT s = s && line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_convert_source_to_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_util( ).
    DATA(lt_test_source) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LINE 1' ) ( 'LINE 2' ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'LINE 1' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'LINE 2' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_source_to_string( lt_test_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer `string_table` (die ABAP-Code repräsentiert) alle Vorkommen eines alten Strings durch einen neuen String.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_string_in_code IMPORTING it_source_code TYPE string_table
                                               iv_old_string    TYPE string
                                               iv_new_string    TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_code) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_string_in_code.
    rt_modified_code = VALUE #( FOR line IN it_source_code
                                    ( REPLACE( val = line old = iv_old_string new = iv_new_string occ = 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_util( ).
    DATA(lt_test_source) = VALUE string_table( ( 'DATA: lv_var TYPE i.' ) ( 'lv_var = 1.' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'DATA: lv_new_var TYPE i.' ) ( 'lv_new_var = 1.' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_string_in_code( it_source_code = lt_test_source

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Anwendungsprotokoll mit einer Erfolgs- und einer Fehlermeldung und speichern Sie es.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log`, `add_message` und `save_log`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_basic_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_save_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE balobj_d DEFAULT 'ZTEST'
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d DEFAULT 'BASIC'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_basic_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_save_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      iv_object    = iv_object
      iv_subobject = iv_subobject
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      iv_msgty = 'S' " Success
      iv_msgid = 'SY'
      iv_msgno = '000'
      iv_msgv1 = 'Operation successful.'
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      iv_msgty = 'E' " Error
      iv_msgid = 'SY'
      iv_msgno = '001'
      iv_msgv1 = 'An error occurred.'
    ).

    lo_log->save_log(

Instructions: Lesen Sie ein zuvor erstelltes Anwendungsprotokoll anhand seiner externen Nummer aus und geben Sie die enthaltenen Meldungen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance_by_external_number` und `get_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
        msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
      END OF ty_message,
      tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_log_by_ext_num
      IMPORTING
        iv_ext_number TYPE bal_extnum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages
      RAISING
        cx_bal_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_log_by_ext_num.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance_by_external_number( iv_ext_number ).
    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).

    rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_bal_msg IN lt_bal_messages
                           ( msgty = ls_bal_msg-msgty
                             msgid = ls_bal_msg-msgid
                             msgno = ls_bal_msg-msgno
                             msgv1 = ls_bal_msg-msgv1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.

    " Add header row
    lv_csv_string = 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PLANETYPE' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Add data rows using string templates and FOR
    lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string &&
                    VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_sflight_data
                             ( |{ ls_data-carrid },{ ls_data-connid },{ ls_data-fldate },{ ls_data-planetype }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }| ) ).

    rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string  = lv_csv_string
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Daten nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität und berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Sitze für die gefilterten Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für die Filterung und den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_free_seats_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_free_seats_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_seats_sum.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE seatsmax >= iv_min_capacity ).

    rv_free_seats_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_reduce=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) " Free: 100
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 300 seatsmax = 400 ) " Free: 100
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 80  ) " Free: 30 (below min_capacity if 100)
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 250 ) " Free: 100
    ).

    " Test 1: Filter for min_capacity 100
    DATA(lv_sum_100) = lo_cut->get_free_seats_sum(
      it_flights      = lt_test_flights
      iv_min_capacity = 100
    ).
    " Expected: (200-100) + (400-300) + (250-150) = 100 + 100 + 100 = 300
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum_100
      exp = 300
      msg = 'Sum of free seats for min_capacity 100 is incorrect'
    ).

    " Test 2: Filter for min_capacity 300
    DATA(lv_sum_300) = lo_cut->get_free_seats_sum(
      it_flights      = lt_test_flights
      iv_min_capacity = 300
    ).
    " Expected: (400-300) = 100
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum_300
      exp = 100
      msg = 'Sum of free seats for min_capacity 300 is incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarken funktionalen Operatoren `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für die Manipulation interner Tabellen. `FILTER` ermöglicht eine prägnante Filterung von Tabellenzeilen, während `REDUCE` eine flexible Aggregation von Werten über die gefilterten Zeilen hinweg erlaubt. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, REDUCE, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation

hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( ( ... ) ( ... ) )` zum Initialisieren der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_constructor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sample_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sample_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_constructor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sample_flights.
    rt_sample_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' planetype = '737' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_value_constructor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_value_constructor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_constructor( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sample_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Expected 3 flight entries'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'First flight carrier ID incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-planetype
      exp = '737'
      msg = 'Third flight planetype incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Konstrukt, um interne Tabellen und Strukturen prägnant zu initialisieren und zu füllen. Er ersetzt die Notwendigkeit vieler `APPEND`- oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`-Anweisungen und führt zu deutlich kürzerem und lesbarerem Code, insbesondere bei der Erstellung von Testdaten oder Konstanten.
keywords: VALUE, Constructor Expressions, Internal Tables, Initialization, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) eine neue Zeile hinzu, indem Sie den `INSERT`-Operator mit einem Inline-Strukturkonstruktor verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT VALUE #( ... ) INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight_data
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_entry.
    INSERT VALUE #( is_new_flight ) INTO TABLE ct_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_insert_value=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_itab_insert_value=>ty_sflight_data(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' 
    ).

    lo_cut->add_flight_entry(
      EXPORTING
        is_new_flight = ls_new_flight
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    = lt_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 flight entries after insert'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Second flight carrier ID incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Art, Zeilen in interne Tabellen einzufügen, indem der `INSERT`-Operator direkt mit einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor für die neue Zeile kombiniert wird. Dies ist prägnanter und oft effizienter als die klassische `APPEND`- oder `INSERT`-Syntax mit separaten Arbeitsbereichen.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, VALUE, Constructor Expressions, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten. (Hinweis: Für die Füllung wird hier eine vereinfachte Methode verwendet, da dynamische Datenfüllung komplexer ist).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` für die dynamische Typisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = lv_field_name
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " Simplified data filling for demonstration
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any structure.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Fill first row
        ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 1 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
        IF <lv_field1> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field1> = 'Value1_Row1'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 2 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
        IF <lv_field2> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field2> = 'Value2_Row1'. ENDIF.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Fill second row
        ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 1 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field1>.
        IF <lv_field1> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field1> = 'Value1_Row2'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 2 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field2>.
        IF <lv_field2> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field2> = 'Value2_Row2'. ENDIF.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table=>tt_field_names(
      ( 'FIELD_A' )
      ( 'FIELD_B' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_field_names ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = <lt_dynamic_table>
      msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 rows in dynamic table'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any structure.
    ASSIGN <lt_dynamic_table>[ 1 ] TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = <ls_dynamic_line>
      msg = 'First row should be assigned'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <lv_field_value>
      exp = 'Value1_Row1'
      msg = 'Value of FIELD_A in first row incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch interne Tabellen zur Laufzeit erstellt, indem man die RTTI-Klassen (`cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr`) verwendet. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das in Szenarien nützlich ist, in denen die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Datenfüllung erfolgt hier vereinfacht mit Field-Symbols.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der freien Sitze für eine Liste von Flügen unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_sflight_seats,
      tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_free_seats.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_free_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).

    DATA(lv_number_of_flights) = lines( it_flights ).

    rv_average = lv_total_free_seats / lv_number_of_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_math_average=>tt_sflight_seats(
      ( seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) " Free: 100
      ( seatsocc = 300 seatsmax = 400 ) " Free: 100
      ( seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 80  ) " Free: 30
    ).

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_free_seats( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average
      exp = '76.66666666666667'
      msg = 'Average free seats calculation is incorrect'
      delta = '0.00000000000001'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_math_average=>tt_sflight_seats( ).

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_free_seats( lt_empty_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Average for empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung eines Durchschnitts unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators zur Summenbildung und der Funktion `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Elemente. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: Math, Average, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle E-Mail-Adressen aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit der `RESULTS` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_emails FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_emails FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_emails FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_emails.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_email_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Kontaktieren Sie uns unter info@example.com oder support@domain.de.`.
    DATA(lt_emails) = lo_extractor->extract_emails( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_emails ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 1 ] exp = `info@example.com` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 2 ] exp = `support@domain.de` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_emails.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_email_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Dies ist ein Text ohne E-Mail-Adressen.`.
    DATA(lt_emails) = lo_extractor->extract_emails( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_emails ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_emails.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_email_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `a@b.com c@d.org e@f.net`.
    DATA(lt_emails) = lo_extractor->extract_emails( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_emails ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 1 ] exp = `a@b.com` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 2 ] exp = `c@d.org` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 3 ] exp = `e@f.net` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit der `RESULTS` Klausel ermöglicht das effiziente Extrahieren aller Treffer eines regulären Ausdrucks in einem String, ohne manuelle Schleifen und Offset-Berechnungen. Die `DATA()`-Inline-Deklaration und `substring()` sind moderne Syntaxelemente.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String Processing, DATA, substring

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` hinzu, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, zu einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights that are after or on the given date
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate >= iv_min_date ).

    " Append lines of the filtered table to the result table
    APPEND LINES OF lt_filtered_flights TO rt_future_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_min_date) = sy-datum + 1. " Tomorrow

    " Assuming sflight has some data for testing. For robust tests, mock or insert data.
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_filter->get_future_flights( lv_min_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_future_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_min_date ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_min_date) = sy-datum + 9999. " Far in the future

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_filter->get_future_flights( lv_min_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_future_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FILTER` ist eine moderne Tabellenexpression, die es erlaubt, interne Tabellen deklarativ zu filtern. `APPEND LINES OF` ist die effiziente Methode, um alle Zeilen einer Tabelle zu einer anderen hinzuzufügen, ohne eine explizite Schleife. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als ältere Ansätze.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, FILTER, Internal Tables, sflight, DATA

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug (Carrier und Connection ID) in einer internen Tabelle von Flügen existiert, indem Sie eine textbasierte Suche über die Felder durchführen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND IN TABLE` mit `IGNORING CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS flight_exists_by_text_search
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        is_key     TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists_by_text_search.
    DATA(lv_search_pattern) = is_key-carrid && is_key-connid.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_search_pattern IN TABLE it_flights
      IGNORING CASE.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_checker=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0017'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).
    DATA(ls_search_key) TYPE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_search_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_search_key-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_checker->flight_exists_by_text_search( it_flights = lt_flights is_key = ls_search_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_checker=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).
    DATA(ls_search_key) TYPE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_search_key-carrid = 'UA'.
    ls_search_key-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_checker->flight_exists_by_text_search( it_flights = lt_flights is_key = ls_search_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND IN TABLE` ermöglicht die Suche nach String-Mustern innerhalb der Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. Hier wird eine textbasierte Suche über die konkatenierten Schlüsselwerte demonstriert. Die `DATA()`-Inline-Deklaration ist ein modernes Feature.
keywords: FIND IN TABLE, Internal Tables, DATA, sflight, IGNORING CASE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugverbindungen (ConnID) aus `sflight` enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_connid_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_lh_connids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_connid_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_lh_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Use FOR to iterate and filter, then collect the connid
    DATA(lt_filtered_connids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid (
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( fldate >= sy-datum AND carrid = 'LH' )
        ( ls_flight-connid )
    ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_filtered_connids TO rt_connids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_lh_connids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflight` die Gesamtzahl der Passagierkapazität und fügen Sie diese Ergebnisse einer neuen Tabelle hinzu.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_capacity_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_capacity_result.
    TYPES tt_capacity_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_capacity_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_capacity_results) TYPE tt_capacity_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Aggregate using REDUCE and GROUP BY
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_capacity_result(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_capacity_result( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      LET total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_capacity_result( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_capacity = total_seats ) )
    ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_aggregated_data TO rt_capacity_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_table_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_text_table_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fügen Sie die Ergebnisse einer dynamischen SQL-Abfrage zu einer internen Tabelle hinzu.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_appender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_dynamic_result.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_dynamic_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_appender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights.
    DATA: lt_temp_flights TYPE tt_dynamic_result.

    DATA(lv_sql) = `SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight WHERE ` && iv_where_clause.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid
          FROM sflight
          WHERE (iv_where_clause)
          INTO TABLE @lt_temp_flights.

        APPEND LINES OF lt_temp_flights TO rt_flights.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_top_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.
    TYPES tt_sflight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_short.

CLASS zcl_top_n_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight UP TO iv_n ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_selected_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_short(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_selected_flights TO rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
