Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in einen einzelnen XSTRING, wobei jeder String durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt ist, und umgekehrt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_xstring_from_string_table` und `read_xstring_as_string_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_table_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_line, text TYPE string, END OF ty_line,
           tt_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_string_table TYPE tt_string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.

    METHODS convert_xstring_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_string_table) TYPE tt_string_table
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_table_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lt_string_plain) TYPE string_table.
    LOOP AT it_string_table INTO DATA(ls_line).
      APPEND ls_line-text TO lt_string_plain.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_xstring_from_string_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_string_table = lt_string_plain
        iv_encoding     = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        ev_xstring      = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_xstring_to_table.
    DATA(lt_string_plain) TYPE string_table.
    lt_string_plain = cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_xstring_as_string_table(
      iv_xstring  = iv_xstring
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    rt_string_table = VALUE #( FOR line IN lt_string_plain ( text = line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS` in einen XSTRING im CSV-Format und umgekehrt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_xstring_from_string_table` und `read_xstring_as_string_table` in Kombination mit String-Templates für CSV-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_csv_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_csv,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_csv,
           tt_sflight_csv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_csv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring_csv) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.

    METHODS csv_xstring_to_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring_csv TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_csv
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_csv_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lt_csv_lines) TYPE string_table.
    APPEND `CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE,CURRENCY` TO lt_csv_lines. " Header

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid },{ ls_sflight-connid },{ ls_sflight-fldate },{ ls_sflight-price },{ ls_sflight-currency }| TO lt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_xstring_from_string_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_string_table = lt_csv_lines
        iv_encoding     = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        ev_xstring      = rv_xstring_csv
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD csv_xstring_to_sflight.
    DATA(lt_csv_lines) TYPE string_table.
    lt_csv_lines = cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_xstring_as_string_table(
      iv_xstring  = iv_xstring_csv
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    DELETE lt_csv_lines INDEX 1. " Remove header

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR line IN lt_csv_lines
                             LET parts = cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = line sep = ',' )
                             IN ( carrid   = parts[1]
                                  connid   = parts[2]
                                  fldate   = parts[3]
                                  price    = parts[4]
                                  currency = parts[5] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sflights_csv_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_csv_xstring( ).
    DATA(lt_original_sflights) TYPE zcl_sflights_csv_xstring=>tt_sflight_csv.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS laden (Beispiel)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_original_sflights
      UP TO 2 ROWS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_original_sflights msg = 'Vorbereitung: SFLIGHTS-Daten geladen' ).

    " Konvertierung SFLIGHTS-Tabelle zu CSV-XSTRING
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = lo_cut->sflight_to_csv_xstring( lt_original_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_csv_xstring msg = 'Test 1: CSV-XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Konvertierung CSV-XSTRING zurück zu SFLIGHTS-Tabelle
    DATA(lt_recovered_sflights) = lo_cut->csv_xstring_to_sflight( lv_csv_xstring ).

    " Vergleich der ursprünglichen und wiederhergestellten Tabelle
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_recovered_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Test 2: Anzahl SFLIGHTS-Zeilen muss übereinstimmen' ).
    LOOP AT lt_original_sflights INTO DATA(ls_orig).
      READ TABLE lt_recovered_sflights INTO DATA(ls_rec) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_rec-carrid exp = ls_orig-carrid msg = |Test 3: CARRID Zeile { sy-tabix }| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_rec-connid exp = ls_orig-connid msg = |Test 4: CONNID Zeile { sy-tabix }| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_rec-fldate exp = ls_orig-fldate msg = |Test 5: FLDATE Zeile { sy-tabix }| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_rec-price exp = ls_orig-price msg = |Test 6: PRICE Zeile { sy-tabix }| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_rec-currency exp = ls_orig-currency msg = |Test 7: CURRENCY Zeile { sy-tabix }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Es ist ein häufiges Szenario, Daten aus internen Tabellen in ein Dateiformat zu exportieren oder zu importieren, und diese Lösung ist kompakt, effizient und gut lesbar.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit `SORT` und einem temporären Zufallsfeld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_random,
             random_key TYPE i,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_random.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_with_random TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_random WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 1000000 ). " Großer Bereich für gute Verteilung

    DATA(lt_temp_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_with_random(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
        carrid     = <fs_sflight>-carrid
        connid     = <fs_sflight>-connid
        fldate     = <fs_sflight>-fldate )
    ).

    SORT lt_temp_sflights BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_sflights = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_temp> IN lt_temp_sflights
      ( carrid = <fs_temp>-carrid
        connid = <fs_temp>-connid
        fldate = <fs_temp>-fldate ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA: lt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight           TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250101'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250102'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0010'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250103'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sflights) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflight_table( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_shuffled_sflights )
      exp = lines( lt_original_sflights )
      msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich bleiben.'
    ).
    " Es ist schwierig, eine zufällige Sortierung direkt zu testen.
    " Wir können jedoch prüfen, ob die Inhalte noch vorhanden sind und die Reihenfolge sich geändert hat.
    DATA(lv_original_hash) = cl_abap_hasher=>hash_table( lt_original_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_shuffled_hash) = cl_abap_hasher=>hash_table( lt_shuffled_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_shuffled_hash
      exp = lv_original_hash
      msg = 'Die Reihenfolge sollte sich geändert haben (Hash-Vergleich).' 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung eines Zufallsschlüssels für jede Zeile einer internen Tabelle. Durch das Sortieren nach diesem Zufallsschlüssel wird die Tabelle effektiv gemischt. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung und Transformation der Tabelle ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster.

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl (N) zufälliger Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random_int` mit `FOR` und `COND` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_random_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_random_entries.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR it_data IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lines( it_data ) - 1 ).
    DATA(lt_indices) = NEW cl_abap_int_table( ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Sicherstellen, dass jeder Index nur einmal ausgewählt wird
      IF lt_indices->contains( lv_random_index ) = abap_true.
        CONTINUE. " Erneut versuchen, wenn Index schon vorhanden
      ENDIF.
      lt_indices->add( lv_random_index ).
    ENDDO.

    " Sortieren der Indizes, um effizient auf die Tabelle zugreifen zu können
    lt_indices->sort( ).

    rt_selected_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_index IN lt_indices->get_table( )
      ( it_data[ lv_index + 1 ] ) " +1 da Tabellenindizes 1-basiert sind
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_random_entries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_random_entries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    DO 10 TIMES.
      ls_sflight-carrid = |C{ sy-index }|.
      ls_sflight-connid = sy-index.
      ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_selected) = lo_cut->select_random_entries( it_data = lt_sflights iv_count = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_selected )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Einträge ausgewählt werden.'
    ).

    " Prüfen, ob die ausgewählten Einträge tatsächlich aus der Originaltabelle stammen
    LOOP AT lt_selected INTO DATA(ls_selected_entry).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_original_entry).
        IF ls_selected_entry = ls_original_entry.
          lv_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_found msg = 'Ausgewählter Eintrag muss in Originaltabelle sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Auswahl einer bestimmten Anzahl zufälliger Einträge. Es verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung von Indizes und `cl_abap_int_table` zur Verwaltung der ausgewählten Indizes, um Duplikate zu vermeiden. Die finale Transformation erfolgt mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
keywords: Internal Tables, Random, Selection, FOR, VALUE, cl_abap_random_int

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_file_properties.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frontend_file_info( ).
    " Test mit einem gängigen Systemfile (z.B. notepad.exe)

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen String (z.B. ein Passwort) einer bestimmten Länge, bestehend aus Großbuchstaben und Ziffern.

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_chars_len - 1 ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      act = strlen( lv_password )

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Stichprobe von N eindeutigen Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, ohne die ursprüngliche Reihenfolge zu ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `REDUCE` mit einer Hilfstabelle für bereits ausgewählte Indizes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sample DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_sample
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_sample_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sample) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sample IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sample.
    IF iv_sample_size <= 0 OR it_data IS INITIAL OR iv_sample_size > lines( it_data ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lines( it_data ) ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = VALUE cl_abap_int_table( ).

    DO iv_sample_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Sicherstellen, dass jeder Index nur einmal ausgewählt wird
      WHILE lt_selected_indices->contains( lv_random_index ) = abap_true.
        lv_random_index = lo_random->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      lt_selected_indices->add( lv_random_index ).
    ENDDO.

    rt_sample = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_index IN lt_selected_indices->get_table( )
      ( it_data[ lv_index ] ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_sample FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sample.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    DO 20 TIMES.
      ls_sflight-carrid = |C{ sy-index }|.
      ls_sflight-connid = sy-index.
      ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sample( ).
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_data = lt_sflights iv_sample_size = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sample )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Es sollten 5 eindeutige Einträge ausgewählt werden.'
    ).

    " Prüfen, ob alle ausgewählten Einträge eindeutig sind
    DATA(lt_unique_sample) = lt_sample.
    SORT lt_unique_sample BY carrid connid fldate.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_sample COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_sample )
      exp = lines( lt_sample )
      msg = 'Alle Einträge in der Stichprobe sollten eindeutig sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Auswahl einer zufälligen Stichprobe von eindeutigen Zeilen. Es verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung von Indizes und `cl_abap_int_table` zur effizienten Überprüfung auf Duplikate. Der `VALUE`-Operator wird für die finale Konstruktion der Ergebnistabelle verwendet.
keywords: Internal Tables, Random, Sample, UNIQUE, REDUCE, cl_abap_random_int

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string, " Different type
             field3 TYPE i,      " Different type
             field4 TYPE string, " Additional field
           END OF ty_target.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flight_data.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE string, " Price as string
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total = REDUCE #( INIT total TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 = 0
                             FOR ls_item IN it_items
                             NEXT total = total + CONV p( ls_item-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches ALV Grid mit Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, die mit modernen ABAP-Methoden (z.B. `FOR`, `VALUE`) vorbereitet wurden. Das ALV soll in einem Custom Container angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_gui_alv_grid`. Bereiten Sie die Daten mit `SELECT` und `VALUE #( FOR ... )` vor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_modern_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS display_sflight_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_modern_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_alv.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             status   TYPE string, " Derived field
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES: tt_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA: lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA: lt_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_display.

    " Prepare data using modern ABAP
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    lt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                              ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                price    = ls_sflight-price
                                currency = ls_sflight-curr
                                status   = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price > 500 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Standard' ) ) ).

    " Create screen and custom container (simplified for demo)
    " In a real scenario, this would be done in a PBO of a screen
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " This name must match a custom control on a screen

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Display data
    lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_FLIGHT_DISPLAY' " Use the structure name for field catalog derivation
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_flight_data ).

    " Set ALV title (optional)
    lo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( i_ready_for_input = 0 ). " Read-only

    " To ensure ALV is displayed, typically call cl_gui_cfw=>flush()
    " and then leave to screen. For this snippet, we just show the setup.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    " CALL SCREEN 100. " Example screen call
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,

    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '600.00' curr = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

Die ALV-Anzeige selbst nutzt die klassischen `cl_gui_alv_grid` und `cl_gui_custom_container` (die auf `cl_gui_cfw` basieren), aber die Datenmanipulation ist modern.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und der Flugnummer, sortiert nach Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` und Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_top_n  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      ORDER BY fldate ASC
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_n_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fetch( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_top_n = 2 ).

    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 flights' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight carrid' act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ELSE.
      " If no data for LH 0400, assert that the result is initial.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights expected for LH 0400 if no data' act = lt_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` ist die moderne und effiziente Art, eine begrenzte Anzahl von Datensätzen direkt in Open SQL abzurufen, anstatt alle Datensätze zu lesen und dann zu filtern. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_cut)`) und Hostvariablen-Markierungen (`@`) sind weitere moderne Syntaxelemente.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO N ROWS, Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Database Access, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie alle Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` in Paketen von 100 Datensätzen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE` und eine interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lt_sflights_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    rv_processed_count = 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights_package
      PACKAGE SIZE @iv_package_size.

      " Process the current package
      LOOP AT lt_sflights_package ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
        " Example processing: just count

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' und geben Sie deren Flugnummern aus, indem Sie die Ergebnisse direkt in einer Schleife verarbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN SELECT` für die direkte Verarbeitung von Datenbankergebnissen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_for_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_numbers_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_for_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_numbers_for_carrier.
    " Using FOR ... IN SELECT for direct iteration over database results
    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT connid FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid )
                          ( ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_flight_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_for_in( ).

    IF lt_connids IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find flight numbers for AA' act = lt_connids ).
      SELECT SINGLE connid FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_test_connid) WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.

Es eliminiert die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `SELECT ... ENDSELECT`-Schleife und fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil. Dies ist eine effiziente Art, Daten zu 'FETCH NEXT' in einer Schleife.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen horizontalen Splitter-Container und passen Sie die Größe der oberen und unteren Bereiche dynamisch an.

CLASS zcl_splitter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_splitter
      IMPORTING
        io_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_splitter) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.

    METHODS set_row_height
      IMPORTING
        iv_row    TYPE i
        iv_height TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_splitter.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent            = io_parent_container
        orientation       = cl_gui_splitter_container=>orientation_horizontal
        rows              = 2
        columns           = 1
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS            = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Set row mode to proportional or fixed
    mo_splitter->set_row_mode( row = 1 mode = cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_proportional ).
    mo_splitter->set_row_mode( row = 2 mode = cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_proportional ).

    " Initial sash position (e.g., 50% for row 1)
    mo_splitter->set_row_sash( row = 1 sash = 50 ).

    ro_splitter = mo_splitter.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_row_height.
    IF mo_splitter IS BOUND.
      " Set sash position for the given row (percentage)
      mo_splitter->set_row_sash( row = iv_row sash = iv_height ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verbinden Sie die Tabellen `sflights` und `sairport` (für Abflug- und Ankunftsflughafen) und lesen Sie die ersten 10 Ergebnisse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... JOIN ... UP TO N ROWS` und Aliasnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_details,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sairport-city,
             cityto   TYPE sairport-city,
           END OF ty_flight_details.
    TYPES tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_details WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details_with_cities
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details_with_cities.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate,
           a1~city AS cityfrom, a2~city AS cityto
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN sairport AS a1 ON s~airpfrom = a1~id
      INNER JOIN sairport AS a2 ON s~airpto = a2~id
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_cut->get_flight_details_with_cities( iv_top_n = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 5 flight details' act = lines( lt_details ) exp = 5 ).
    IF lt_details IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'City From should not be initial' act = lt_details[ 1 ]-cityfrom ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'City To should not be initial' act = lt_details[ 1 ]-cityto ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `UP TO N ROWS` und Aliasnamen (`AS s`, `AS a1`) ist dies eine moderne und lesbare Art, komplexe Abfragen durchzuführen und nur die benötigten Datensätze zu 'FETCH NEXT'.
keywords: SELECT, JOIN, UP TO N ROWS, Open SQL, Database Access, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge, deren Flugdatum nach dem frühesten Flugdatum der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' liegt, und lesen Sie die ersten 5 davon.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Subquery in der `WHERE`-Klausel und `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_basic,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_basic.
    TYPES tt_sflight_basic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_basic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_after_lh_earliest
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_basic.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_after_lh_earliest.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate > ( SELECT MIN( fldate ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      ORDER BY fldate ASC
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_after_lh FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_after_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_subquery( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_after_lh_earliest( iv_top_n = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 flights' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    SELECT MIN( fldate ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @DATA(lv_min_lh_fldate).
    IF lv_min_lh_fldate IS NOT INITIAL AND lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'First flight date should be after LH earliest' act = ( lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate > lv_min_lh_fldate ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Subqueries in der `WHERE`-Klausel sind ein mächtiges Feature von Open SQL, um komplexe Filterbedingungen zu definieren. In Kombination mit Aggregationsfunktionen (`MIN`) und `UP TO N ROWS` ermöglicht dies effiziente und präzise Datenabfragen, die nur die relevanten Datensätze 'FETCH NEXT'.
keywords: SELECT, Subquery, WHERE, MIN, UP TO N ROWS, Open SQL, Database Access, FETCH NEXT

CLASS zcl_cds_view_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_cds_view_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_from_cds.
    " Assuming a CDS View 'Z_I_FLIGHT_DETAILS' exists with fields:
    " Carrid, Connid, Fldate, CityFrom, CityTo
    " Example CDS DDL (not part of solution, just for context):
    " @AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZIFLIGHTDET'
    " @AbapCatalog.compiler.compareFilter: true
    " @AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
    " @EndUserText.label: 'Flight Details with Cities'
    " define view Z_I_FLIGHT_DETAILS as select from sflight
    "   association [0..1] to sairport as _AirportFrom on $projection.AirpFrom = _AirportFrom.Id
    "   association [0..1] to sairport as _AirportTo on $projection.AirpTo = _AirportTo.Id
    " {
    "     key carrid,
    "     key connid,
    "     key fldate,
    "     airpfrom,
    "     airpto,
    "     _AirportFrom.City as CityFrom,
    "     _AirportTo.City as CityTo
    " }

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM z_i_flight_details " Replace with actual CDS View name if different
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container, der in einem seiner Bereiche einen weiteren Splitter-Container enthält (Nested Splitter).

CLASS zcl_splitter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_splitter_nested IMPLEMENTATION.

        columns           = 1
      EXCEPTIONS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT AVG(...) GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_avg_prices ).

    " Check for a specific carrier, e.g., 'AA'
    SELECT AVG( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @DATA(lv_expected_aa_avg).
    DATA(ls_aa_entry) = VALUE zcl_sflight_avg_price=>ty_carrier_avg_price( ).
    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices INTO ls_aa_entry WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price for AA should match' act = ls_aa_entry-avg_price exp = lv_expected_aa_avg ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA entry not found, expected avg 0' act = 0 exp = lv_expected_aa_avg ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `AVG`-Aggregationsfunktion in Open SQL ermöglicht die Berechnung von Durchschnittswerten direkt auf der Datenbank. In Kombination mit `GROUP BY` ist dies eine effiziente Methode zur Datenanalyse. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und die Zuweisung in eine interne Tabelle sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.
keywords: SELECT, AVG, GROUP BY, Open SQL, Aggregation, Database Access, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container und steuern Sie die Sichtbarkeit eines seiner Bereiche dynamisch.

CLASS zcl_splitter_visibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft das Wort 'ABAP' (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorierend) in einem gegebenen Satz vorkommt, und geben Sie die Anzahl zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Operator mit der Option `IGNORING CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_word_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
        iv_word     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_word_occurrences.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_word IN SECTION LENGTH 0 OF iv_sentence
      IGNORING CASE
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).
    rv_count = lines( lt_matches ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_word.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_find_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_word_occurrences( iv_sentence = 'ABAP ist eine Programmiersprache. Modernes ABAP ist toll.' iv_word = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 Vorkommen finden' ).

    lv_count = lo_cut->count_word_occurrences( iv_sentence = 'Kein Treffer hier.' iv_word = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte 0 Vorkommen finden' ).

explanation: Die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem String zu finden. Die `RESULTS` Option füllt eine interne Tabelle mit den Fundstellen, deren Anzahl dann einfach mit `lines()` ermittelt werden kann. `IGNORING CASE` macht die Suche flexibler.
keywords: FIND, String, Count, Occurrences, Ignoring Case

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression, um die Summe zu bilden und dann durch die Anzahl der Zeilen zu teilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mat_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mat_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <flight> IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <flight>-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( it_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer Tabelle von Flugdaten und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Durchschnittspreis zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_avg_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_avg_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_group_sum) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <member>-price
      ).

      DATA(lv_group_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_price_by_carrid(
        carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
        average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_group_count > 0 THEN lv_group_sum / lv_group_count ELSE 0 )
      ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mat_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_seats_by_origin
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_origin  TYPE sflight-planetype " Using planetype as a proxy for origin for simplicity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mat_avg_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_seats_by_origin.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE planetype = iv_origin ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR <flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + <flight>-seatsmax
    ).

    rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.

    " For a real unit test, one would mock the database access.
    " Here, we simulate by inserting/deleting, which is not ideal for unit tests but demonstrates the SELECT.

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE sflight_tab(

    ).

    lv_avg_price = lo_cut->get_average_flight_price( 'ZZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '0.00' msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für ZZ sollte 0 sein' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SELECT AVG(...)` Aggregatfunktion ist die direkteste und performanteste Methode, um einen Durchschnittswert direkt auf der Datenbank zu berechnen. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist Teil der modernen Open SQL Syntax (ABAP 7.40+), die SQL Injection verhindert und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: AVERAGE, SELECT, Database, SQL, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer Tabelle, die einen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert (z.B. 250) haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FILTER` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mat_avg_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_conditional_average
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mat_avg_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_conditional_average.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE price > iv_price_threshold ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <flight>-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '200' price = '400.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_average( it_flights = lt_flights iv_price_threshold = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '350.00' msg = 'Durchschnitt für Flüge über 250 sollte 350 sein' ).

    lv_avg_price = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_average( it_flights = lt_flights iv_price_threshold = '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '0.00' msg = 'Durchschnitt für Flüge über 500 sollte 0 sein' ).

    lv_avg_price = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_average( it_flights = lt_flights iv_price_threshold = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'Durchschnitt für Flüge über 50 sollte 250 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine bedingte Aggregation. Zuerst werden die relevanten Daten mit `FILTER` selektiert, dann wird der Durchschnitt über diese gefilterte Menge mit `REDUCE` berechnet. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Methode, um komplexe Datenanalysen in modernem ABAP durchzuführen.
keywords: AVERAGE, REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Table, Conditional Logic, Aggregation

Instructions: Finden Sie die Position des ersten Vorkommens des Wortes 'SAP' (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorierend) in einem gegebenen Satz. Geben Sie den Offset zurück, oder -1, wenn nicht gefunden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FIND` Operator mit `IGNORING CASE` und `MATCH OFFSET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_pos DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_word_position
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
        iv_word     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_offset) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_pos IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_word_position.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_word IN iv_sentence
      IGNORING CASE
      MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_match_offset).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_offset = lv_match_offset.
    ELSE.
      rv_offset = -1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_position.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_find_pos( ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = lo_cut->find_word_position( iv_sentence = 'Willkommen bei SAP SE.' iv_word = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_offset exp = 15 msg = 'Sollte Offset 15 finden' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_offset exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte Offset 0 finden (ignoring case)' ).

explanation: Der `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF` Operator ist die grundlegende Methode, um die Position eines Substrings zu finden. Die `IGNORING CASE` Option macht die Suche flexibler, und `MATCH OFFSET` liefert direkt den Startindex des Treffers. Dies ist eine einfache, aber wichtige Funktion in der String-Verarbeitung.
keywords: FIND, String, Position, Offset, Ignoring Case

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') in einer Tabelle von Flügen. Geben Sie die gesamte Flugzeile zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `READ TABLE` oder eine `FOR` Expression mit `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_find_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_highest_price_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_find_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight.
    DATA(lt_carrier_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_carrier_flights IS INITIAL.
      CLEAR rs_flight.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SORT lt_carrier_flights BY price DESCENDING.
    READ TABLE lt_carrier_flights INDEX 1 INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl es auch mit `REDUCE` und `MAX` möglich wäre, ist diese Methode oft intuitiver für das Auffinden der gesamten Zeile. `FILTER` ist seit ABAP 7.40 verfügbar und `SORT` ist eine Standardfunktion.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Sitzplatzbelegung (SEATSOCC) für alle Flüge in einer Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression, um die Summe zu bilden und dann durch die Anzahl der Zeilen zu teilen.

CLASS zcl_mat_avg_seatsocc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mat_avg_seatsocc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_seats_occupied.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_occupied) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_occ = 0
      FOR <flight> IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + <flight>-seatsocc
    ).

    rv_average_seats = lv_total_occupied / lines( it_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` und geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT AVG(...) GROUP BY` in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dba_avg_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_result.
    TYPES: tt_avg_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_carrid_db
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dba_avg_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_carrid_db.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS average_price
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_price_by_carrid_db FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('DB1', 'DB2').
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'DB1' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'DB1' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'DB2' connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'B737' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 120 )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'DB2' connid = '004' fldate = '20250104' price = '400.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'B737' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 120 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('DB1', 'DB2').
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_price_by_carrid_db.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dba_avg_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_by_carrid_db( ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_dba_avg_group_by=>tt_avg_result(
      ( carrid = 'DB1' average_price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'DB2' average_price = '350.00' )
    ).

    " Sort both tables for reliable comparison, as order from DB is not guaranteed without ORDER BY
    SORT lt_avg_prices BY carrid.
    SORT lt_expected BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 Einträge haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_avg_prices exp = lt_expected msg = 'Durchschnittspreise pro Fluggesellschaft stimmen nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `SELECT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung in Open SQL ist die effizienteste Methode, um Aggregationen direkt auf der Datenbank durchzuführen. Die Datenbank ist für solche Operationen optimiert. Die moderne Syntax mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und Hostvariablen (`@`) ist seit ABAP 7.40/7.50 Standard und verbessert die Sicherheit und Lesbarkeit.
keywords: AVERAGE, SELECT, Database, SQL, GROUP BY, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = 300 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( lt_flights ).

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Summe einer leeren Tabelle sollte 0 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Hier wird `INIT sum = 0` als Startwert definiert und in jedem Schleifendurchlauf (`FOR flight IN it_flights`) der Preis zum `sum` akkumuliert. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als eine klassische `LOOP` Anweisung.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Verbinde alle Wörter einer Liste von Strings zu einem einzigen Satz, getrennt durch Leerzeichen.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_words
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE tt_words
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_words.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string_type(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string_type( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word ELSE |{ s } { word }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_words FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_words.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE zcl_reduce_concat=>tt_words( ( `Hello` ) ( `World` ) ( `ABAP` ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_cut->concatenate_words( lt_words ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sentence,
      exp = `Hello World ABAP`,
      msg = 'Satz sollte korrekt zusammengesetzt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE zcl_reduce_concat=>tt_words( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_cut->concatenate_words( lt_words ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sentence,
      exp = ``,
      msg = 'Leere Liste sollte leeren String ergeben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_word.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE zcl_reduce_concat=>tt_words( ( `Single` ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_cut->concatenate_words( lt_words ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sentence,
      exp = `Single`,
      msg = 'Einzelnes Wort sollte korrekt zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser `REDUCE` Ausdruck verkettet Strings effizient. Der `INIT s = `` initialisiert den Akkumulator. `COND string_type( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word ELSE |{ s } { word }| )` behandelt den ersten Eintrag ohne vorangehendes Leerzeichen und fügt danach Leerzeichen hinzu. String-Templates (`|...|`) machen die Verkettung sehr lesbar.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, String Templates, COND

Instructions: Finde den höchsten Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator und vergleiche den aktuellen Wert mit dem Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0. " Or raise exception, depending on requirement
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_price = it_flights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT max_price = nmax( val1 = max_price val2 = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Finde den niedrigsten Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator und `nmin`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_price = 0. " Or raise exception
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT min_price = it_flights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT min_price = nmin( val1 = min_price val2 = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Kombiniere `REDUCE` mit einer `COND` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_count_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_expensive_flights.
    rv_count = REDUCE #( 
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT count = COND #( WHEN flight-price > iv_threshold THEN count + 1 ELSE count )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente. Beachte die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_flights ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und sammle die Flugpreise für jede Gesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle. Das Ergebnis soll eine Hash-Tabelle sein, deren Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft und deren Wert eine Tabelle von Preisen ist.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einem Hash-Tabellen-Akkumulator und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_carrid_prices_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_prices WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line. " Key is carrid, value is tt_prices

    METHODS group_prices_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_prices) TYPE ty_carrid_prices_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_prices_by_carrier.
    rt_carrid_prices = REDUCE ty_carrid_prices_map(
      INIT map = VALUE ty_carrid_prices_map( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT map = VALUE ty_carrid_prices_map(
        map
        ( key = flight-carrid value = VALUE tt_prices( map[ flight-carrid ] OPTIONAL ( ) flight-price ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `VALUE` Operator mit `OPTIONAL` ist entscheidend, um auf nicht-existierende Einträge in der Map zuzugreifen, ohne einen Fehler zu verursachen.

Instructions: Transformiere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und den doppelten Preis enthält, und filtere dabei Flüge mit einem Preis unter 100 heraus.
hint: Kombiniere `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             doubled_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_filter
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_filter.
    rt_transformed_flights = REDUCE tt_transformed_flights(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_transformed_flights( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( price >= 100 )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_transformed_flights(
        result
        ( carrid = flight-carrid doubled_price = flight-price * 2 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `VALUE` Operator wird verwendet, um die neue Struktur für jedes Element zu erstellen und zur Akkumulator-Tabelle hinzuzufügen. Instructions: Berechne den gewichteten Durchschnitt der Flugpreise, wobei jeder Preis mit einem festen Gewicht multipliziert wird. Ignoriere Flüge mit einem Preis von 0.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Summe der gewichteten Preise und die Summe der Gewichte. Beachte die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_weighted_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             weight TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_weighted_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_average_price.
    DATA: lv_total_weighted_price TYPE decfloat16,
          lv_total_weight       TYPE decfloat16.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT s_weighted_price = 0.0 TYPE decfloat16
           s_weight = 0.0 TYPE decfloat16
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( price > 0 )
      NEXT s_weighted_price = s_weighted_price + ( flight-price * flight-weight ),
           s_weight = s_weight + flight-weight
    ).

    lv_total_weighted_price = ls_result-s_weighted_price.
    lv_total_weight = ls_result-s_weight.

    IF lv_total_weight = 0.
      rv_weighted_average = 0.0.
    ELSE.
      rv_weighted_average = lv_total_weighted_price / lv_total_weight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle einen formatierten Berichtstring aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, der für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis anzeigt. Verwende String-Templates für die Formatierung.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` um die Daten pro Fluggesellschaft zu aggregieren und dann einen weiteren `REDUCE` oder eine Schleife, um den finalen String zu erstellen.

CLASS zcl_reduce_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS generate_flight_report
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_report.
    DATA(lt_summary) = REDUCE tt_carrier_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary(
        result
        ( carrid = flight-carrid
          flight_count = result[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ]-flight_count OPTIONAL + 1
          total_price = result[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ]-total_price OPTIONAL + flight-price
        )
      )
    ).

    rv_report_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = `Flugbericht:
`
      FOR summary IN lt_summary
      NEXT s = s && |Fluggesellschaft: { summary-carrid }, Flüge: { summary-flight_count }, Gesamtpreis: { summary-total_price } EUR
|
    ).

    IF lt_summary IS INITIAL.
      rv_report_string = `Keine Flugdaten verfügbar.`.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtflugzeit (in Minuten) für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, die an einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Die Flugzeiten sind als Start- und Endzeitpunkte gegeben.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und die Funktionen für Datums- und Zeitberechnungen (`cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract`).

CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             deptime TYPE s_time,
             arrtime TYPE s_time,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_flight_minutes
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_date    TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_flight_minutes.
    rv_total_minutes = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_minutes = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( fldate = iv_date )
      NEXT total_minutes = total_minutes + 
        ( cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
            tstmp1 = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp( date = flight-fldate time = flight-arrtime ),
            tstmp2 = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp( date = flight-fldate time = flight-deptime )
          ) / 60 ) " Differenz in Sekunden, umrechnen in Minuten
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_reduce_object_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES tt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flight_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_raw TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_objects) TYPE tt_flight_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_object_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_objects.
    rt_flight_objects = REDUCE tt_flight_objects(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_objects( )
      FOR raw_flight IN it_flight_raw
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_objects(
        result
        ( NEW zcl_flight_data(
            iv_carrid = raw_flight-carrid,
            iv_connid = raw_flight-connid,
            iv_price  = raw_flight-price
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische WHERE-Klausel für eine SELECT-Anweisung basierend auf einer Liste von Filterkriterien. Die Kriterien können Felder und Werte enthalten.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um die WHERE-Klausel zusammenzusetzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filter_criterion,
             field_name TYPE string,
             operator   TYPE string, " e.g., '=', '>', '<', 'LIKE'
             value      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_filter_criterion.
    TYPES tt_filter_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filter_criterion WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_dynamic_where_clause
      IMPORTING
        it_criteria TYPE tt_filter_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_dynamic_where_clause.
    rv_where_clause = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR criterion IN it_criteria
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL
        THEN |{ criterion-field_name } { criterion-operator } '{ criterion-value }'|
        ELSE |{ s } AND { criterion-field_name } { criterion-operator } '{ criterion-value }'|
      )
    ).

    IF rv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = |WHERE { rv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_single_criterion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_criteria FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_criteria FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_criterion.
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_reduce_dynamic_where=>tt_filter_criteria(
      ( field_name = 'CARRID' operator = '=' value = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_where,
      exp = `WHERE CARRID = 'LH'`,
      msg = 'Einzelnes Kriterium sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_criteria.
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_reduce_dynamic_where=>tt_filter_criteria(
      ( field_name = 'CARRID' operator = '=' value = 'LH' )
      ( field_name = 'PRICE' operator = '>' value = '100' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_where,
      exp = `WHERE CARRID = 'LH' AND PRICE > '100'`,
      msg = 'Mehrere Kriterien sollten korrekt verknüpft sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_criteria.
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_reduce_dynamic_where=>tt_filter_criteria( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_where,
      msg = 'Leere Kriterien sollten leeren String ergeben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um dynamisch eine `WHERE`-Klausel für eine SQL-Anweisung zu konstruieren. Der Akkumulator `s` wird schrittweise mit den einzelnen Kriterien erweitert, wobei `COND` verwendet wird, um das `AND` korrekt zwischen den Kriterien zu platzieren. Am Ende wird das Schlüsselwort `WHERE` vorangestellt, falls Kriterien vorhanden sind. Dies ist eine elegante und sichere Methode, um dynamische SQL-Filter zu erstellen, ohne auf String-Verkettungen in Schleifen zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: REDUCE, Dynamic Programming, SQL, WHERE Clause, String Templates, COND

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_number.
TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers IMPORTING it_input_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_output_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rt_output_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_number IN it_input_numbers

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum.
hint: Subtrahieren Sie die Jahreszahlen und berücksichtigen Sie den Monat/Tag für die genaue Altersberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age IMPORTING iv_birth_date TYPE d
                                        iv_current_date TYPE d
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_age_in_years) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_year_diff) = iv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).
    IF iv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( iv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND iv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) ).
      rv_age_in_years = lv_year_diff - 1.
    ELSE.
      rv_age_in_years = lv_year_diff.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
