Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die aus einer Quelltabelle abgeleitet ist, wobei jeder String-Eintrag um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeichen nach links "verschoben" (gekürzt) wird, falls er eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die 'FOR' Expression in Kombination mit String-Funktionen wie 'substring'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_shift_simulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_shift_length  TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_shift_simulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_strings.
    rt_processed_strings = VALUE #( FOR <fs_string> IN it_input_strings
                                    WHERE ( <fs_string> IS NOT INITIAL )
                                    ( COND #( WHEN strlen( <fs_string> ) > iv_shift_length
                                              THEN substring( val = <fs_string> off = iv_shift_length )
                                              ELSE <fs_string> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_shift_simulation( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_it_for_shift_simulation=>tt_strings(
      ( `ABCDEF` )
      ( `XY` )
      ( `GHIJKL` )
      ( `` )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_it_for_shift_simulation=>tt_strings(
      ( `CDEF` )
      ( `XY` )
      ( `IJKL` )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_strings( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = lines( lt_expected ),
      msg = 'Number of lines should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ],
      exp = lt_expected[ 1 ],
      msg = 'First string should be shifted'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ],
      exp = lt_expected[ 2 ],
      msg = 'Second string should not be shifted'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ],
      exp = lt_expected[ 3 ],
      msg = 'Third string should be shifted'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR` Expression ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit `WHERE` wird gefiltert und mit `COND` und `substring` wird die "Shift"-Logik funktional angewendet, was eine moderne Alternative zur prozeduralen `SHIFT` Anweisung darstellt.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, substring, COND, SHIFT, functional

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle 'sflights' für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie die 'REDUCE' Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_lh_price,
      msg = 'Total price for LH should not be initial (assuming data exists)'

    " Test with a non-existent carrier
    DATA(lv_xx_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen an einem Mock-Objekt, das 'cl_fxs_image_processor' simuliert, um verschiedene Bildbearbeitungsschritte in einem einzigen Ausdruck auszuführen. Nutzen Sie dabei die Konstante 'S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE'.
hint: Entwerfen Sie Methoden, die 'ME' zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen. Nutzen Sie die Konstante 'S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE'.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_chainable_image_proc_mock.
  CONSTANTS:
    BEGIN OF s_xslfo_supplementary_image,
      type TYPE string VALUE 'SUPPLEMENTARY',
      format TYPE string VALUE 'XSLFO',
    END OF s_xslfo_supplementary_image.

  METHODS set_image_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_image_data TYPE xstring
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zif_chainable_image_proc_mock.

  METHODS apply_filter
    IMPORTING
      iv_filter_type TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zif_chainable_image_proc_mock.

  METHODS resize_image
    IMPORTING
      iv_width TYPE i
      iv_height TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zif_chainable_image_proc_mock.

  METHODS get_processed_image
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_chainable_image_proc_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES zif_chainable_image_proc_mock.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_current_image_data TYPE xstring.
    DATA mv_processing_log TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_image_proc_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_chainable_image_proc_mock~set_image_data.
    mv_current_image_data = iv_image_data.
    APPEND |Image data set: { iv_image_data }| TO mv_processing_log.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_chainable_image_proc_mock~apply_filter.
    " Simulate filter application
    mv_current_image_data = mv_current_image_data && | (Filter: { iv_filter_type })|.
    APPEND |Filter applied: { iv_filter_type }| TO mv_processing_log.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_chainable_image_proc_mock~resize_image.
    " Simulate resize
    mv_current_image_data = mv_current_image_data && | (Resized: { iv_width }x{ iv_height })|.
    APPEND |Resized to: { iv_width }x{ iv_height }| TO mv_processing_log.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_chainable_image_proc_mock~get_processed_image.
    rv_processed_data = mv_current_image_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chained_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chainable_image_proc_mock( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_data) = 'RAW_IMAGE_DATA'X.
    DATA(lv_processed_image) = lo_processor->zif_chainable_image_proc_mock~set_image_data( lv_initial_data )->
                                     apply_filter( 'Grayscale' )->
                                     resize_image( iv_width = 100 iv_height = 150 )->
                                     get_processed_image( ).

    DATA(lv_expected) = 'RAW_IMAGE_DATA (Filter: Grayscale) (Resized: 100x150)'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_processed_image,
      exp = lv_expected,
      msg = 'Chained processing should produce expected output'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) wird durch Methoden ermöglicht, die eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben. Dies erlaubt es, mehrere Operationen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile zu verketten, was den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker macht. Die Konstante `S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE` wird hier im Kontext der simulierten Bildverarbeitung mit einer Klasse wie `cl_fxs_image_processor` verwendet.
keywords: cl_fxs_image_processor, S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE, Image Processor, Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, NEW

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus der Tabelle 'sflights' basierend auf einem Schlüssel. Falls der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Table Expression 'itab[ key = value ]' in Kombination mit 'DEFAULT'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_table_expr_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_flight_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_table_expr_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_default.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rs_flight = VALUE #( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] DEFAULT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' cityfrom = 'UNKNOWN' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_default FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_with_default.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_table_expr_default( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' '0400' exists
    DATA(ls_existing_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_default(
                                      iv_carrid = 'LH',
                                      iv_connid = '0400'
                                    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_existing_flight-carrid,
      exp = 'LH',
      msg = 'Existing flight should be found'
    ).

    " Test with non-existent flight
    DATA(ls_non_existent_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_default(
                                          iv_carrid = 'XX',
                                          iv_connid = '9999'
                                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_non_existent_flight-carrid,
      exp = 'XX',
      msg = 'Non-existent flight should return default carrier'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_non_existent_flight-cityfrom,
      exp = 'UNKNOWN',
      msg = 'Non-existent flight should return default cityfrom'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Table Expressions (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. Mit dem Zusatz `DEFAULT` kann ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden, falls der gesuchte Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, was den Code robuster und kürzer macht als die Verwendung von `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` Prüfung.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expression, DEFAULT, sflights, functional

Instructions: Führen Sie eine simulierte Bildverarbeitungsoperation mit einer Mock-Klasse, die 'cl_fxs_image_processor' simuliert, durch und fangen Sie dabei mögliche Ausnahmen ab, um das Programm stabil zu halten. Nutzen Sie dabei die Konstante 'S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE'.
hint: Umschließen Sie den Methodenaufruf mit 'TRY...CATCH' und definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcx_image_processing_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_image_processing_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_robust_image_processor_mock.
  CONSTANTS:
    BEGIN OF s_xslfo_supplementary_image,
      type TYPE string VALUE 'SUPPLEMENTARY',
      format TYPE string VALUE 'XSLFO',
    END OF s_xslfo_supplementary_image.

  METHODS process_image_robustly
    IMPORTING
      iv_image_data TYPE xstring
      iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE xstring
    RAISING
      zcx_image_processing_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_robust_image_processor_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES zif_robust_image_processor_mock.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_image_processor_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_robust_image_processor_mock~process_image_robustly.
    IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_image_processing_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_image_processing_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate image processing
    rv_processed_data = iv_image_data && ' (processed)'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_image_processor_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS handle_image_processing
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_data TYPE xstring
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_image_processor_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_image_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_robust_image_processor_mock( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_processed_data) = lo_processor->zif_robust_image_processor_mock~process_image_robustly(
                                     iv_image_data = iv_image_data,
                                     iv_simulate_error = iv_simulate_error
                                   ).
        rv_status_message = |Image successfully processed. Result: { lv_processed_data }|.
      CATCH zcx_image_processing_error.
        rv_status_message = 'Error during image processing: A custom error occurred.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_processing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_robust_image_processor_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_image_data) = 'TEST_IMAGE'X.
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->handle_image_processing( lv_image_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_message,
      exp = 'successfully processed',
      msg = 'Successful processing message expected'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_robust_image_processor_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_image_data) = 'ERROR_IMAGE'X.
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->handle_image_processing(
                               iv_image_data = lv_image_data,
                               iv_simulate_error = abap_true
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_message,
      exp = 'Error during image processing',
      msg = 'Error handling message expected'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken mit eigenen Ausnahme-Klassen (`zcx_image_processing_error`) ist der moderne Weg, um Fehler in ABAP-Programmen robust zu behandeln. Dies verhindert Programmabbrüche und ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf unerwartete Situationen, wie sie bei der Bildverarbeitung mit einer Klasse wie `cl_fxs_image_processor` auftreten können. Die Konstante `S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE` wird hier im Kontext der simulierten Bildverarbeitung verwendet.
keywords: cl_fxs_image_processor, S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE, Image Processor, Exception Handling, TRY...CATCH, Custom Exception

Instructions: Weisen Sie Felder mit gleichen Namen von einer Quellstruktur zu einer Zielstruktur zu, ohne jedes Feld einzeln zu nennen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die 'CORRESPONDING' Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             some_other_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_corresponding=>ty_source_data(
      carrid         = 'LH'
      connid         = '0400'
      cityfrom       = 'FRANKFURT'
      some_other_field = 'Extra Info'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-carrid,
      exp = 'LH',
      msg = 'Carrier ID should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-cityfrom,
      exp = 'FRANKFURT',
      msg = 'City From should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_target-price,
      msg = 'Price should be initial as it is not in source'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung ermöglicht die Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, die gleiche Namen haben, ohne jedes Feld einzeln auflisten zu müssen. Dies ist besonders nützlich bei der Arbeit mit komplexen Datenstrukturen und reduziert den Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: Data Assignment, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle 'sflights' nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY' mit 'COUNT'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flight_counts ),
      msg = 'Should find at least one carrier (assuming sflights data)'
    ).
    " Check if LH exists and has a count
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE #( lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ] DEFAULT sy-initial ).
    IF ls_lh_count IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
        act = ls_lh_count-flight_count,
        exp = 0,
        msg = 'LH should have more than 0 flights'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt in der Schleife. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion für Aggregationen und Analysen, die den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn der Flugpreis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, soll 'High' zugewiesen werden, ansonsten 'Low'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die 'COND' Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_price_level
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE s_price
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_level) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_level.
    rv_level = COND #( WHEN iv_price > iv_threshold THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_price_level FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_price_level.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_price_level( 1200 ),
      exp = 'High',
      msg = 'Price 1200 should be High'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_price_level( 800 ),
      exp = 'Low',
      msg = 'Price 800 should be Low'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_price_level( iv_price = 1000 iv_threshold = 1000 ),
      exp = 'Low',
      msg = 'Price 1000 with threshold 1000 should be Low'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer Bedingung in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine kompakte und funktionale Alternative zu einem `IF...ENDIF` Block für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, functional

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA256-Hashwert eines gegebenen Strings.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` mit dem Algorithmus `SHA256` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_X2X_CE` zur Hex-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_sha256 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_sha256 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256_hash.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    lo_digest->update( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sha256 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sha256.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_sha256( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lo_digest_exp) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    lo_digest_exp->update( lv_input ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_xstring) = lo_digest_exp->get_digest( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_expected_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_sha256_hash( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hash
      exp = lv_expected_hash
      msg = 'SHA256 hash should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` bietet eine standardisierte Schnittstelle zur Berechnung kryptografischer Hashwerte. Die Verwendung von `create` und `update` ist eine moderne, objektorientierte Herangehensweise. `CL_ABAP_CONV_X2X_CE` wird für die Umwandlung des XSTRING-Hashwerts in eine lesbare Hex-Darstellung genutzt.
keywords: Hashing, SHA256, Security, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, XSTRING

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den MD5-Hashwert einer internen Tabelle, um deren Integrität zu prüfen.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die interne Tabelle in ein XSTRING mit `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_TO_XSTR` und hashen Sie dieses.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_table_md5 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_md5_hash_for_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_table_md5 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_md5_hash_for_table.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_obj_to_xstr=>create( )->convert( it_data ).
    lo_digest->update( lv_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_md5_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_md5_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_hash_table_md5=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20251126'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20251127'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_table_md5( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_md5_hash_for_table( lt_sflight ).

    DATA(lo_digest_exp) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_exp) = cl_abap_conv_obj_to_xstr=>create( )->convert( lt_sflight ).
    lo_digest_exp->update( lv_xstring_exp ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_xstring) = lo_digest_exp->get_digest( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_expected_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hash
      exp = lv_expected_hash
      msg = 'MD5 hash of internal table should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_verify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_string_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_expected_hash TYPE string
        iv_algorithm TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_string_hash.
    DATA(lv_algorithm) = COND string( WHEN iv_algorithm IS SUPPLIED AND iv_algorithm IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_algorithm ELSE cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( lv_algorithm ).
    lo_digest->update( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_actual_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
    rv_is_valid = xsdbool( lv_actual_hash_hex = iv_expected_hash ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String mit einem dynamisch übergebenen Hash-Algorithmus (z.B. MD5, SHA256) hashen kann.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Konstanten von `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` für die Algorithmen und übergeben Sie diese dynamisch an die `create`-Methode. Implementieren Sie Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_hash_result,
             algorithm TYPE string,
             hash_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_hash_result.
    TYPES tt_hash_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_hash_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_dynamic_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        it_algorithms   TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hash_results) TYPE tt_hash_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_hash.
    LOOP AT it_algorithms INTO DATA(lv_algorithm).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( lv_algorithm ).
          lo_digest->update( iv_input_string ).
          DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
          DATA(lv_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).

          APPEND VALUE ty_hash_result(
            algorithm = lv_algorithm
            hash_value = lv_hash_hex
          ) TO rt_hash_results.
        CATCH cx_abap_message_digest_error.
          APPEND VALUE ty_hash_result(
            algorithm = lv_algorithm
            hash_value = 'ERROR: Invalid algorithm or hashing failed'
          ) TO rt_hash_results.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_hash FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_hash_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_hash.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Dynamic Hashing'.
    DATA(lt_algorithms) = VALUE string_table( ( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ) ( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_hash( iv_input_string = lv_input it_algorithms = lt_algorithms ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 hash results' ).

    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY algorithm = cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 INTO DATA(ls_md5_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_md5_result msg = 'MD5 result should be found' ).
    DATA(lo_digest_md5) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ).
    lo_digest_md5->update( lv_input ).
    DATA(lv_expected_md5_xstring) = lo_digest_md5->get_digest( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_md5) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_expected_md5_xstring )->get_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_md5_result-hash_value exp = lv_expected_md5 msg = 'MD5 hash should match' ).

    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY algorithm = cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 INTO DATA(ls_sha256_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_sha256_result msg = 'SHA256 result should be found' ).
    DATA(lo_digest_sha256) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    lo_digest_sha256->update( lv_input ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sha256_xstring) = lo_digest_sha256->get_digest( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sha256) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_expected_sha256_xstring )->get_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sha256_result-hash_value exp = lv_expected_sha256 msg = 'SHA256 hash should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_hash_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Invalid Algo'.
    DATA(lt_algorithms) = VALUE string_table( ( 'UNKNOWN_ALGO' ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_hash( iv_input_string = lv_input it_algorithms = lt_algorithms ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should return 1 result for invalid algo' ).
    READ TABLE lt_results INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'ERROR' act = ls_result-hash_value msg = 'Error message expected for invalid algorithm' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` flexibel mit verschiedenen Algorithmen nutzen kann, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei wichtig, um auf ungültige Algorithmen reagieren zu können. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Algorithmen-Tabelle ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Hashing, Dynamic, Algorithms, Security, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, TRY...CATCH, VALUE

solution:
CLASS zcl_3dviewer_load_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_line_segment,
             x1 TYPE f, y1 TYPE f, z1 TYPE f,
             x2 TYPE f, y2 TYPE f, z2 TYPE f,
           END OF ty_line_segment.
    TYPES tt_line_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS load_lines_to_viewer
      IMPORTING
        io_viewer        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer
        it_line_segments TYPE tt_line_segments
        iv_color         TYPE i DEFAULT cl_ecl_color=>blue.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_load_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_lines_to_viewer.
    DATA: lt_ecl_points TYPE ecl_t_point,
          lt_ecl_lines  TYPE ecl_t_line.

    DATA(lv_point_idx) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_line_segments INTO DATA(ls_segment).
      lv_point_idx = lv_point_idx + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ecl_s_point( x = ls_segment-x1 y = ls_segment-y1 z = ls_segment-z1 ) TO lt_ecl_points.
      DATA(lv_start_idx) = lv_point_idx.

      lv_point_idx = lv_point_idx + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ecl_s_point( x = ls_segment-x2 y = ls_segment-y2 z = ls_segment-z2 ) TO lt_ecl_points.
      DATA(lv_end_idx) = lv_point_idx.

      APPEND VALUE ecl_s_line(
        point1_index = lv_start_idx
        point2_index = lv_end_idx
      ) TO lt_ecl_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_geometry) = NEW cl_ecl_geometry( ).
    lo_geometry->set_points( lt_ecl_points ).
    lo_geometry->set_lines( lt_ecl_lines ).

    io_viewer->load_geometry(
      i_geometry = lo_geometry
      i_name     = 'MyLines'
      i_type     = cl_ecl_geometry=>type_lines
    ).
    io_viewer->set_display_mode( cl_ecl_3d_object=>display_mode_lines ).
    io_viewer->set_object_color( i_name = 'MyLines' i_color = iv_color ).
    io_viewer->set_object_visible( i_name = 'MyLines' i_visible = abap_true ).
    io_viewer->do_redraw( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS simulate_object_selection

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA512-Hashwert eines Strings und geben Sie ihn als Base64-kodierten String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` mit `ALG_SHA512` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_X2X_CE` für die Base64-Kodierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_sha512_base64 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha512_base64
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_base64) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_sha512_base64 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha512_base64.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha512 ).
    lo_digest->update( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
    rv_hash_base64 = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_base64( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sha512_base64 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sha512_base64.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_sha512_base64( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Another Test String'.
    DATA(lo_digest_exp) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha512 ).
    lo_digest_exp->update( lv_input ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_xstring) = lo_digest_exp->get_digest( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_base64) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_base64( lv_expected_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hash_base64) = lo_cut->calculate_sha512_base64( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hash_base64
      exp = lv_expected_hash_base64
      msg = 'SHA512 hash (Base64) should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des SHA512-Algorithmus für das Hashing und die anschließende Kodierung des Hashwerts in Base64. Dies ist nützlich, wenn Hashwerte in Textformaten übertragen oder gespeichert werden müssen, die keine Binärdaten unterstützen. `CL_ABAP_CONV_X2X_CE` bietet hierfür eine einfache Schnittstelle.
keywords: Hashing, SHA512, Base64, Security, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, XSTRING, CL_ABAP_CONV_X2X_CE

Instructions: Laden Sie ein einfaches 3D-Modell (z.B. ein Dreieck) in den Viewer und setzen Sie dessen Transparenz.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ECL_GEOMETRY` für Flächen (`type_faces`) und `SET_OBJECT_TRANSPARENCY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dviewer_load_faces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS load_triangle_to_viewer
      IMPORTING
        io_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer
        iv_alpha  TYPE f DEFAULT 0.5. " Transparenz (0.0 - 1.0)

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_load_faces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_triangle_to_viewer.
    DATA(lt_ecl_points) = VALUE ecl_t_point(
      ( x = 0.0 y = 0.0 z = 0.0 )
      ( x = 1.0 y = 0.0 z = 0.0 )
      ( x = 0.5 y = 1.0 z = 0.0 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_ecl_faces) = VALUE ecl_t_face(
      ( point1_index = 1 point2_index = 2 point3_index = 3 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_geometry) = NEW cl_ecl_geometry( ).
    lo_geometry->set_points( lt_ecl_points ).
    lo_geometry->set_faces( lt_ecl_faces ).

    io_viewer->load_geometry(
      i_geometry = lo_geometry
      i_name     = 'MyTriangle'
      i_type     = cl_ecl_geometry=>type_faces
    ).
    io_viewer->set_display_mode( cl_ecl_3d_object=>display_mode_faces ).
    io_viewer->set_object_color( i_name = 'MyTriangle' i_color = cl_ecl_color=>green ).
    io_viewer->set_object_transparency( i_name = 'MyTriangle' i_alpha = iv_alpha ).
    io_viewer->set_object_visible( i_name = 'MyTriangle' i_visible = abap_true ).
    io_viewer->do_redraw( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des N-ten Wochentags in einem bestimmten Monat und Jahr (z.B. den dritten Dienstag im Januar 2024).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_reca_date` Methoden wie `get_first_day_of_month`, `add_days` und `get_weekday` mit Schleifenlogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_nth_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_nth_weekday_of_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_year    TYPE gjahr
        iv_month   TYPE monat
        iv_weekday TYPE i "1=Mon, 7=Sun
        iv_n       TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_nth_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nth_weekday_of_month.
    IF iv_weekday < 1 OR iv_weekday > 7 OR iv_n < 1.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = cl_reca_date=>get_first_day_of_month( iv_year && iv_month && '01' ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = lv_first_day_of_month.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    DO.
      IF cl_reca_date=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ) = iv_weekday.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_count = iv_n.
        rv_date = lv_current_date.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = cl_reca_date=>add_days( iv_date = lv_current_date iv_days = 1 ).

      IF cl_reca_date=>get_month( lv_current_date ) <> iv_month.
        " If we crossed into the next month and haven't found it, it doesn't exist
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_nth_weekday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_nth_weekday_invalid RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert_not_expected FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nth_weekday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_nth_weekday( ).

    " Third Tuesday in January 2024 (20240116)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_nth_weekday_of_month( iv_year = 2024 iv_month = '01' iv_weekday = 2 iv_n = 3 ),
      exp = '20240116',
      msg = 'Dritter Dienstag im Januar 2024 sollte 20240116 sein.'
    ).

    " First Sunday in December 2023 (20231203)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_nth_weekday_of_month( iv_year = 2023 iv_month = '12' iv_weekday = 7 iv_n = 1 ),
      exp = '20231203',
      msg = 'Erster Sonntag im Dezember 2023 sollte 20231203 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_nth_weekday_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_nth_weekday( ).
    TRY.
        " 5th Friday in February 2023 (does not exist)
        lo_cut->get_nth_weekday_of_month( iv_year = 2023 iv_month = '02' iv_weekday = 5 iv_n = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Es sollte eine Ausnahme für ein nicht existierendes Datum ausgelöst werden.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Ausnahme für ungültiges Datum korrekt ausgelöst.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination mehrerer `cl_reca_date`-Methoden (`get_first_day_of_month`, `add_days`, `get_weekday`) in einer Schleife, um komplexe Datumsberechnungen durchzuführen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `cx_abap_invalid_value` ist ebenfalls eine moderne Praxis.
keywords: Date, Calculation, Nth Weekday, cl_reca_date, Loop, Exception

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und das Datum enthält, wobei Sie den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_orig,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_orig.
    TYPES tt_sflight_orig TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_orig WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_orig
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( flight_id = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
        flight_date = ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_val_for_transform=>tt_sflight_orig.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_info) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_info ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_flight_info INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_info).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_info-flight_id exp = 'LH-400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_info-flight_date exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und ausdrucksstärker als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... INTO ... APPEND` Konstrukte.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Table, Transformation, String Templates, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster unter Verwendung einer abstrakten Klasse, um verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien für einen Kontext zu ermöglichen. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `CalculationStrategy` mit einer abstrakten Methode `calculate` und zwei konkreten Implementierungen (`AddStrategy`, `MultiplyStrategy`).

CLASS zcl_abs_calc_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE i iv_val2 TYPE i
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abs_calc_strategy.
    METHODS execute_calculation IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE i iv_val2 TYPE i
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abs_calc_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD execute_calculation.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_result = mo_strategy->calculate( iv_val1 = iv_val1 iv_val2 = iv_val2 ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle error or default strategy
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_abs_calculator( ).

    " Test Addition Strategy
    lo_calculator->set_strategy( NEW zcl_abs_add_strategy( ) ).
    DATA(lv_result_add) = lo_calculator->execute_calculation( iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_add exp = 8 ).

    " Test Multiplication Strategy
    lo_calculator->set_strategy( NEW zcl_abs_multiply_strategy( ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_mult exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template-Methoden-Muster unter Verwendung einer abstrakten Klasse. CLASS zcl_abs_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

    METHODS generate_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_output) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.

                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_data) TYPE string.

    METHODS footer_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_footer) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_abs_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = get_data( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_content) = format_data( lt_raw_data ).
    rv_report_output = |{ header_data( ) }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ lv_formatted_content }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ footer_data( ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD header_data.
    rv_header = '--- Report Header ---'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD footer_data.
    rv_footer = '--- Report Footer ---'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_simple_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abs_report_generator.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_simple_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    APPEND 'Line 1: Sample Data' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Line 2: More Data' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_data.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(lv_line).
      rv_formatted_data = |{ rv_formatted_data }{ lv_line }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Ausnahme-Klasse `CX_ABSTRACT_ERROR` und leiten Sie davon zwei konkrete Ausnahme-Klassen ab (`CX_BUSINESS_ERROR`, `CX_TECHNICAL_ERROR`). Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung in einem `TRY...CATCH` Block.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... DEFINITION INHERITING FROM CX_STATIC_CHECK` für die Basis-Ausnahme und `ABSTRACT` für die abstrakte Klasse.
solution:
CLASS cx_abstract_error DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_abstract_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_business_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM cx_abstract_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_business_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_technical_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM cx_abstract_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_technical_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i.
    METHODS get_last_error_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_type) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_error_type TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    CLEAR mv_last_error_type.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_business_error EXPORTING textid = cx_business_error=>default_text.
        ELSEIF iv_value < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_technical_error EXPORTING textid = cx_technical_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_business_error.
        mv_last_error_type = 'Business Error Caught'.
      CATCH cx_technical_error.
        mv_last_error_type = 'Technical Error Caught'.
      CATCH cx_abstract_error.
        " This block will not be reached if specific catches are above
        mv_last_error_type = 'Abstract Error Caught (should not happen with specific catches)'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_error_type.
    rv_error_type = mv_last_error_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_abs_error_handler( ).

    lo_handler->process_data( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_handler->get_last_error_type( ) exp = 'Business Error Caught' ).

    lo_handler->process_data( -1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_handler->get_last_error_type( ) exp = 'Technical Error Caught' ).

    lo_handler->process_data( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_handler->get_last_error_type( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_flights.
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"carrid":"LH","connid":"0400","fldate":"20250101","price":"100.00","currency":"EUR"},{"carrid":"AA","connid":"0017","fldate":"20250102","price":"250.50","currency":"USD"}]`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` und zeigen Sie eine einfache Hierarchie von Fluggesellschaften und deren Flügen (aus `sflights`) an. Die Fluggesellschaften sollen als Hauptknoten und die Flüge als Unterknoten dargestellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_node` für Haupt- und Unterknoten und `add_item` für die Anzeige von Daten. Denken Sie daran, `flush` und `set_first_display` aufzurufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_display_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_display_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    " Create a custom container (assuming a screen with a custom control area 'CONTAINER')
    IF mo_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CONTAINER'. " Replace with actual container name on screen
    ENDIF.

    " Create the simple tree control
    IF mo_tree IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_container.
    ENDIF.

    " Clear existing nodes
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING WITHOUT MEMBERS ( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lv_node_key_carrier) = lv_carrid.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_node_key_carrier
        i_parent_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>root_node
        i_text = |Airline: { lv_carrid }|
      ).

      LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        DATA(lv_node_key_flight) = |{ lv_carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_node_key_flight
          i_parent_key = lv_node_key_carrier
          i_text = |Flight: { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate })|
        ).
        mo_tree->add_item(
          i_node_key = lv_node_key_flight
          i_item_name = 'PRICE'
          i_text = |Price: { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_first_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_display_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_tree.
    " This unit test cannot fully simulate GUI interaction or visual output.
    " It primarily checks if the tree building logic executes without syntax errors
    " and if the core methods are called. A real test would require a test framework
    " for GUI controls or manual inspection.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_display_sflights( ).

    " The method requires a custom container to be present on a screen.
    " For a unit test, we can only ensure the code runs without dump.
    " In a real scenario, this would be called from a report with a screen.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_sflight_tree( lt_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " If no dump, assume basic success ").
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception caught: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den grundlegenden Aufbau eines `cl_gui_simple_tree`. Es werden Hauptknoten für Fluggesellschaften und Unterknoten für deren Flüge erstellt. `add_node` fügt hierarchische Elemente hinzu, während `add_item` zusätzliche Informationen zu einem Knoten anzeigt. `set_first_display` und `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` sind notwendig, um die Anzeige zu aktualisieren.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Reaktion auf das Doppelklicken eines Knotens im `cl_gui_simple_tree`. Beim Doppelklick soll eine Meldung mit dem Text des geklickten Knotens angezeigt werden.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS display_tree_with_events
      IMPORTING

          mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree_with_events.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING WITHOUT MEMBERS ( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lv_node_key_carrier) = lv_carrid.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_node_key_carrier
        i_parent_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>root_node
        i_text = |Airline: { lv_carrid }|
      ).

      LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        DATA(lv_node_key_flight) = |{ lv_carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_node_key_flight
          i_parent_key = lv_node_key_carrier
          i_text = |Flight: { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate })|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_first_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    DATA(lv_node_text) = mo_tree->get_node_text( node_key ).
    MESSAGE |Node '{ lv_node_text }' ({ node_key }) doppelt geklickt!| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    " This test verifies the event handler registration, not the actual GUI event.
    " A real GUI test would involve simulating user interaction.

    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    " In a real scenario, lo_container would be created from a screen element.
    " For unit testing, we can mock or create a dummy container if needed,
    " but for this example, we're just checking the handler setup.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_event_handler( lo_container ).

    " Check if the event handler method exists and is correctly defined.
    " This is a conceptual check as direct verification of SET HANDLER is complex in unit tests.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_tree ).
    " Further checks would involve inspecting the event table of the tree object,
    " which is usually not directly exposed for testing.
    " For simplicity, we assume if the constructor runs, the handler is set.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `SET HANDLER` registriert eine lokale Methode (`handle_node_double_click`) für das `node_double_click`-Event des Baum-Controls.     METHODS display_initial_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    METHODS add_flight_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        is_new_flight TYPE sflight.

    METHODS delete_flight_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_initial_tree.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING WITHOUT MEMBERS ( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lv_node_key_carrier) = lv_carrid.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_node_key_carrier
        i_parent_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>root_node
        i_text = |Airline: { lv_carrid }|
      ).

      LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        DATA(lv_node_key_flight) = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_node_key_flight
          i_parent_key = lv_node_key_carrier
          i_text = |Flight: { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate })|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_first_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight_node.
    DATA(lv_node_key_carrier) = iv_carrid.
    DATA(lv_node_key_new_flight) = |{ is_new_flight-carrid }-{ is_new_flight-connid }-{ is_new_flight-fldate }|.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_node_key = lv_node_key_new_flight
      i_parent_key = lv_node_key_carrier
      i_text = |New Flight: { is_new_flight-connid } ({ is_new_flight-fldate })|
    ).
    mo_tree->update_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flight_node.
    DATA(lv_node_key_to_delete) = |{ iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid }-{ iv_fldate }|.
    mo_tree->delete_node( i_node_key = lv_node_key_to_delete ).
    mo_tree->update_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_update.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_dynamic_update( lo_container ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_initial_tree( lt_sflights ).

        DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE sflight(
          carrid   = 'LH'
          connid   = '9999'
          fldate   = '20251231'
          price    = '123.45'
          currency = 'EUR'
        ).
        lo_cut->add_flight_node( iv_carrid = 'LH' is_new_flight = ls_new_flight ).

        " Assuming 'LH-0400-20250101' exists from initial data
        lo_cut->delete_flight_node( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception caught: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Mit `add_node` können neue Knoten hinzugefügt und mit `delete_node` bestehende entfernt werden. Nach jeder Änderung ist `update_display` und `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` aufzurufen, um die Änderungen im Frontend sichtbar zu machen.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in einen JSON-String, wobei bestimmte Felder umbenannt und andere ignoriert werden sollen. Nutzen Sie die `MAPPING` Option von `cl_fdt_json=>serialize`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Mapping-Tabelle für `cl_fdt_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_source,
           tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_with_mapping
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_with_mapping.
    DATA: lt_mapping TYPE cl_fdt_json=>tt_mapping_table.

    " Map ABAP field 'carrid' to JSON field 'airlineId'
    APPEND VALUE #( abap_name = 'CARRID' json_name = 'airlineId' ) TO lt_mapping.
    " Map ABAP field 'connid' to JSON field 'flightNumber'
    APPEND VALUE #( abap_name = 'CONNID' json_name = 'flightNumber' ) TO lt_mapping.
    " Ignore 'planetype'
    APPEND VALUE #( abap_name = 'PLANETYPE' json_name = '' ) TO lt_mapping.

    rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        iv_data    = it_flights
        it_mapping = lt_mapping
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_serialize_with_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_with_mapping.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_json_serialize_mapping=>tt_sflight_source.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_json_serialize_mapping=>ty_sflight_source(
      carrid    = 'LH'
      connid    = '0400'
      fldate    = '20250101'
      price     = '100.00'
      currency  = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'A320'
    ).
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_mapping( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_with_mapping( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"airlineId":"LH"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"flightNumber":"0400"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = 'planetype' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MAPPING`-Option der `cl_fdt_json=>serialize`-Methode erlaubt eine feingranulare Kontrolle über die JSON-Ausgabe. Durch die Übergabe einer internen Tabelle mit `abap_name` und `json_name` Paaren können Felder umbenannt werden. Wird `json_name` leer gelassen, wird das entsprechende ABAP-Feld ignoriert und nicht in den JSON-String aufgenommen. Dies ist flexibler als die `@abap.name` Annotation, wenn das Mapping dynamisch sein muss oder nur für die Serialisierung gilt.
keywords: JSON, Serialize, Mapping, `cl_fdt_json`, `it_mapping`

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der verschachtelte Objekte enthält, in eine entsprechend verschachtelte ABAP-Struktur.

CLASS zcl_json_nested_struct IMPLEMENTATION.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_json) = `{"carrid":"LH","details":{"connid":"0400","fldate":"20250101","price":"100.00","currency":"EUR"}}`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` und füllen Sie ihn mit Daten aus einer internen Tabelle, die bereits eine hierarchische Struktur (Parent-Child-Beziehung) definiert. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Features zur Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Bereiten Sie die Daten in einer internen Tabelle mit Parent-Child-Beziehungen vor und iterieren Sie diese, um die Knoten hinzuzufügen. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_hierarchical_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             id       TYPE string,
             parent_id TYPE string,
             text     TYPE string,
             level    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_node_data,
           tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS display_hierarchical_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_node_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    METHODS add_nodes_recursively
      IMPORTING
        it_nodes   TYPE tt_node_data
        iv_parent_key TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_hierarchical_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_hierarchical_tree.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    add_nodes_recursively( it_nodes = it_data iv_parent_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>root_node ).
    mo_tree->set_first_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_nodes_recursively.
    LOOP AT it_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE parent_id = iv_parent_key OR ( iv_parent_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>root_node AND ls_node-level = 1 ).
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = ls_node-id
        i_parent_key = iv_parent_key
        i_text = ls_node-text
      ).
      " Recursively add children
      add_nodes_recursively( it_nodes = it_nodes iv_parent_key = ls_node-id ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_hierarchical_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hierarchical_display.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_tree_hierarchical_data=>tt_node_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'ROOT1' parent_id = '' text = 'Category A' level = 1 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'ITEM1A' parent_id = 'ROOT1' text = 'Item A1' level = 2 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'ITEM1B' parent_id = 'ROOT1' text = 'Item A2' level = 2 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'ROOT2' parent_id = '' text = 'Category B' level = 1 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'ITEM2A' parent_id = 'ROOT2' text = 'Item B1' level = 2 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'SUBITEM2A1' parent_id = 'ITEM2A' text = 'Sub Item B1.1' level = 3 ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_hierarchical_data( lo_container ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_hierarchical_tree( lt_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception caught: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man eine hierarchische Datenstruktur, die in einer internen Tabelle mit Parent-Child-Beziehungen vorliegt, in einem `cl_gui_simple_tree` darstellt. Eine rekursive Methode (`add_nodes_recursively`) wird verwendet, um die Knoten basierend auf ihren `parent_id`s korrekt einzufügen. Dies ist eine flexible Methode zur Visualisierung komplexer Hierarchien.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Suchfunktion für den `cl_gui_simple_tree`, die Knoten basierend auf einem Suchbegriff hervorhebt oder filtert. Nutzen Sie die `set_node_color` Methode.
hint: Iterieren Sie über alle Knoten, prüfen Sie den Text und setzen Sie die Farbe für Treffer. `update_display` nicht vergessen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_search_highlight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS display_initial_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    METHODS search_and_highlight
      IMPORTING
        iv_search_term TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA: mt_all_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outtab.

    CONSTANTS: gc_highlight_color TYPE i VALUE 6. " Yellow
    CONSTANTS: gc_default_color   TYPE i VALUE 0.  " Default
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_search_highlight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_initial_tree.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    CLEAR mt_all_nodes.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING WITHOUT MEMBERS ( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lv_node_key_carrier) = lv_carrid.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_node_key_carrier
        i_parent_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>root_node
        i_text = |Airline: { lv_carrid }|
      ).

      LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        DATA(lv_node_key_flight) = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_node_key_flight
          i_parent_key = lv_node_key_carrier
          i_text = |Flight: { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate })|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->get_all_nodes( IMPORTING et_outtab = mt_all_nodes ).
    mo_tree->set_first_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD search_and_highlight.
    LOOP AT mt_all_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-text CP |*{ iv_search_term }*|.
        mo_tree->set_node_color( i_node_key = ls_node-node_key i_color = gc_highlight_color ).
      ELSE.
        mo_tree->set_node_color( i_node_key = ls_node-node_key i_color = gc_default_color ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    mo_tree->update_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_search_highlight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_search_highlight.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_search_highlight( lo_container ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_initial_tree( lt_sflights ).
        lo_cut->search_and_highlight( 'LH' ).
        " Direct assertion of node color is not possible in unit tests.
        " We verify that the method executes without error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).

        lo_cut->search_and_highlight( '0400' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).

        lo_cut->search_and_highlight( '' ). " Reset colors
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception caught: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine Suchfunktion im `cl_gui_simple_tree` kann durch Iteration über alle Knoten und die Verwendung von `set_node_color` implementiert werden. Zuerst werden alle Knoten mit `get_all_nodes` abgerufen. Dann wird für jeden Knoten geprüft, ob der Suchbegriff im Text enthalten ist. Bei einem Treffer wird die Farbe des Knotens geändert, ansonsten auf die Standardfarbe zurückgesetzt. `update_display` aktualisiert die Anzeige.
keywords: Tree, GUI, Search, Highlight, `cl_gui_simple_tree`, `set_node_color`, `get_all_nodes`

Instructions: Zeigen Sie einen einfachen ABAP-Code in einem `CL_GUI_ABAPEDIT`-Control an.

solution:

  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_display IMPLEMENTATION.

    lo_editor->set_text_as_stream(
      EXPORTING
        text_as_stream = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_code )
    ).
    " In a real application, lo_editor would be linked to a screen container
    " and the screen would be displayed. For this example, we focus on the API call.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_simple_code FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_simple_code.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_display( ).
    DATA(lv_code) = |REPORT z_test_program. \n WRITE 'Hello ABAPEdit!'.|.
    " The method call itself is the test here, ensuring no exceptions.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Suchen-und-Ersetzen-Operation in einem `CL_GUI_ABAPEDIT`-Control durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `FIND_STRING` und `REPLACE_STRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_find_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_find_replace
      IMPORTING
        iv_find_string    TYPE string
        iv_replace_string TYPE string
        iv_all_occurrences TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_replacements) TYPE i.
    METHODS set_initial_content IMPORTING iv_code TYPE string.
    METHODS get_current_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_find_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_initial_content.
    IF mo_editor IS INITIAL.
      mo_editor = NEW cl_gui_abapedit( ).
    ENDIF.
    mo_editor->set_text_as_stream(
      EXPORTING
        text_as_stream = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_code )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_content.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    IF mo_editor IS INITIAL.
      rv_content = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    mo_editor->get_text_as_stream(
      IMPORTING
        text_as_stream = lv_xstring
    ).
    rv_content = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_find_replace.
    DATA: ls_position TYPE cl_gui_textedit=>s_textpos,
          lv_found    TYPE abap_bool.

    IF mo_editor IS INITIAL.
      mo_editor = NEW cl_gui_abapedit( ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_replacements = 0.
    ls_position-row = 1.
    ls_position-col = 1.

    DO.
      TRY.
          mo_editor->find_string(
            EXPORTING
              string = iv_find_string
              in_selection = abap_false
              case_sensitive = abap_false
              down = abap_true
              start_position = ls_position
            IMPORTING
              found = lv_found
              position = ls_position
          ).
          IF lv_found = abap_true.
            mo_editor->replace_string(
              EXPORTING
                string = iv_replace_string
                position = ls_position
            ).
            rv_replacements = rv_replacements + 1.
            IF iv_all_occurrences = abap_false.
              EXIT. " Replace only first occurrence
            ENDIF.
            " Move past the replaced string to find next occurrence
            ls_position-col = ls_position-col + strlen( iv_replace_string ).
          ELSE.
            EXIT. " No more occurrences
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_gui_error.
          EXIT. " Error during find/replace
      ENDTRY.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_replace_first FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_replace_all FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_replace_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_replace_first.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_find_replace( ).
    lo_cut->set_initial_content( |DATA: lv_text TYPE string. lv_text = 'Hello'. lv_text = 'World'.| ).
    DATA(lv_replacements) = lo_cut->perform_find_replace(
                                  iv_find_string = 'lv_text'
                                  iv_replace_string = 'DATA(ls_data)'
                                  iv_all_occurrences = abap_false
                                ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = |DATA: ls_data TYPE string. lv_text = 'Hello'. lv_text = 'World'.|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_replacements exp = 1 msg = 'Only one replacement expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_content( ) exp = lv_expected msg = 'Content after first replace incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_replace_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_find_replace( ).
    lo_cut->set_initial_content( |DATA: lv_text TYPE string. lv_text = 'Hello'. lv_text = 'World'.| ).
    DATA(lv_replacements) = lo_cut->perform_find_replace(
                                  iv_find_string = 'lv_text'
                                  iv_replace_string = 'DATA(ls_data)'
                                  iv_all_occurrences = abap_true
                                ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = |DATA: ls_data TYPE string. DATA(ls_data) = 'Hello'. DATA(ls_data) = 'World'.|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_replacements exp = 3 msg = 'Three replacements expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_content( ) exp = lv_expected msg = 'Content after all replace incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_replace_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_find_replace( ).
    lo_cut->set_initial_content( |DATA: lv_text TYPE string. lv_text = 'Hello'.| ).
    DATA(lv_replacements) = lo_cut->perform_find_replace(
                                  iv_find_string = 'not_found'
                                  iv_replace_string = 'found'
                                  iv_all_occurrences = abap_true
                                ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_replacements exp = 0 msg = 'No replacements expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_content( ) exp = |DATA: lv_text TYPE string. lv_text = 'Hello'.| msg = 'Content should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_syntax_highlight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_abap_code.
    IF mo_editor IS INITIAL.
      mo_editor = NEW cl_gui_abapedit( ).
