    " For ABAP code, syntax highlighting is typically automatic.
    " No explicit method call is usually needed for standard ABAP highlighting.
    " The control itself recognizes the content type.
    mo_editor->set_text_as_stream(
      EXPORTING
        text_as_stream = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_code )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_http_parse_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_query_param,
           tt_query_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_query_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

        VALUE(rt_query_params) TYPE tt_query_params.

CLASS zcl_http_parse_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_query_string.
    DATA: lt_params TYPE cl_http_utility=>t_parameters.

    cl_http_utility=>parse_url_query_string(
      EXPORTING
        i_query_string = iv_query_string
      IMPORTING
        e_parameters   = lt_params
    ).

    rt_query_params = VALUE #( FOR <fs_param> IN lt_params (
                                  name = <fs_param>-name
                                  value = <fs_param>-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>SET_HEADER_FIELD` oder manuelle String-Verkettung mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_header_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_field,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header_field,
           tt_header_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS build_header_string
      IMPORTING
        it_header_fields TYPE tt_header_fields
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_header_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_header_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_header_string.
    rv_header_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <fs_field> IN it_header_fields
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <fs_field>-name }: { <fs_field>-value }|
                 ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ <fs_field>-name }: { <fs_field>-value }|
               )
    ).
    " CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>SET_HEADER_FIELD is for setting a single header in a request/response object.
    " For building a raw string from multiple fields, REDUCE with string templates is more modern and flexible.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_query_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_query_param,
           tt_query_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_query_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS build_query_string
      IMPORTING
        it_query_params TYPE tt_query_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_query_string.
    rv_query_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <fs_param> IN it_query_params
      LET lv_encoded_name  = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( i_data = <fs_param>-name i_len = strlen( <fs_param>-name ) )
          lv_encoded_value = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( i_data = <fs_param>-value i_len = strlen( <fs_param>-value ) )
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ lv_encoded_name }={ lv_encoded_value }|
                 ELSE |{ s }&{ lv_encoded_name }={ lv_encoded_value }|
               )
    ).
    " While IF_HTTP_UTILITY~CONVERT_PARAMETER_TABLE_TO_STRING exists, it's an interface method.
    " Using REDUCE with CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_ENCODE is a more direct and modern functional approach.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Hostnamen aus einer vollständigen URL.
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>SPLIT_URL` und greifen Sie auf die Komponente `host` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_extract_host DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_hostname_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hostname) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_extract_host IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hostname_from_url.
    DATA: ls_url_components TYPE cl_http_utility=>s_url_components.

    TRY.
        cl_http_utility=>split_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_components = ls_url_components
        ).
        rv_hostname = ls_url_components-host.
      CATCH cx_http_utility_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid URL format
        rv_hostname = ''.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und zeigen Sie den Inhalt einer spezifischen Zeile mit `cl_demo_output` und dem `LINE_EXISTS` Operator an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` zum Füllen der Tabelle, `LINE_EXISTS` zum Prüfen und `cl_demo_output=>display` mit Method Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_demo_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_info.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' )
    ).

    IF line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ].
      cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Gefundener Flug: { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } Preis: { ls_flight-price }| )->display( ).
    ELSE.
      cl_demo_output=>display( |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } am { iv_fldate } nicht gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der `sflights`-Tabelle enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie dafür einen `FOR`-Ausdruck und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_demo_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_price_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

    METHODS display_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_high_price_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_high_price_flights.
    DATA(lt_result) = get_high_price_flights( iv_min_price = iv_min_price ).
    cl_demo_output=>display_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = lt_result
        name  = |Flüge über { iv_min_price } EUR:|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_price_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_demo_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_price_flights( iv_min_price = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Should find some flights' ).
    lo_cut->display_high_price_flights( iv_min_price = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Filterbedingung (`WHERE`) und einer Feldzuordnung erstellt. `cl_demo_output=>display_data` ist nützlich, um strukturierte Daten wie interne Tabellen übersichtlich auszugeben.
keywords: cl_demo_output, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der `sflights`-Tabelle für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_demo_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    METHODS display_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_total_price.
    DATA(lv_total) = calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Gesamtpreis für Fluggesellschaft { iv_carrid }: { lv_total }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_demo_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total msg = 'Total price should not be initial' ).
    lo_cut->display_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (z.B. Summe, Maximum, Minimum). Er bietet eine funktionale und kompakte Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen. `cl_demo_output` wird hier verwendet, um das Ergebnis einfach anzuzeigen.
keywords: cl_demo_output, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit mehreren Nachrichten und lesen Sie diese Nachrichten anschließend aus, um sie mit `cl_demo_output` anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_messages` nach dem Hinzufügen von Nachrichten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_read_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'S_AUT' i_msgno = '000' i_msgv1 = 'First message' ).
    lo_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'S_AUT' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Flight 007' i_msgv2 = 'CANCELLED' ).
    lo_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'S_AUT' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Critical Error' ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Anzahl der Nachrichten im Log: { lines( lt_messages ) }| )->line( ).
    LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Typ: { ls_message-msgty }, Text: { ls_message-msgv1 } { ls_message-msgv2 } { ls_message-msgv3 } { ls_message-msgv4 }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und fügen Sie eine Nachricht mit einem Kontextobjekt hinzu, um zusätzliche Informationen zu speichern. Zeigen Sie die Log-Nachrichten und den Kontext mit `cl_demo_output` an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_message_with_context` und `get_message_context`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_context_data,
             user_id TYPE sy-uname,
             tcode   TYPE sy-tcode,
           END OF ty_context_data.

    METHODS add_message_with_context.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_message_with_context.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    DATA(ls_context) = VALUE ty_context_data(
      user_id = sy-uname
      tcode   = sy-tcode
    ).

    lo_log->add_message_with_context(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'S_AUT'
      i_msgno = '003'
      i_msgv1 = 'Contextual Message'
      i_context = ls_context
    ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).
    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Log-Nachrichten mit Kontext:| )->line( ).
    LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Typ: { ls_message-msgty }, Text: { ls_message-msgv1 }| ).
      DATA(ls_read_context) = lo_log->get_message_context( i_msg_handle = ls_message-msg_handle ).
      IF ls_read_context IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(ls_context_data) = CAST ty_context_data( ls_read_context ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( |  Kontext: User={ ls_context_data-user_id }, TCode={ ls_context_data-tcode }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_add_message_with_context FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_context( ).
    lo_cut->add_message_with_context( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Adding message with context should execute without error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `add_message_with_context` erlaubt das Hinzufügen eines beliebigen Datenobjekts als Kontext zu einer Log-Nachricht. Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster für die Berechnung von Preisen. Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_PRICE_STRATEGY` und zwei Implementierungen (`CL_STANDARD_PRICE` und `CL_DISCOUNT_PRICE`). Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression, um die Strategie dynamisch anzuwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` Expressions für die dynamische Objekterzeugung oder -auswahl basierend auf der Strategie.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_price_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_price IMPORTING iv_base_price TYPE decfloat16 RETURNING VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_standard_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_price_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_standard_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_price_strategy~calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_price_strategy.
    DATA mv_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_discount_rate = iv_discount_rate.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_price_strategy~calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price * ( 1 - mv_discount_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_final_price 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_base_price TYPE decfloat16 
        iv_is_discount TYPE abap_bool 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_final_price.
    DATA(lo_strategy) = 
      FOR strategy_type = COND string( WHEN iv_is_discount = abap_true THEN 'DISCOUNT' ELSE 'STANDARD' ) 
      OF VALUE #( ( 'STANDARD' ) ( 'DISCOUNT' ) ) 
      WHERE ( strategy_type = strategy_type ) 
      ( 
        CASE strategy_type 
          WHEN 'STANDARD' THEN NEW zcl_standard_price( ) 
          WHEN 'DISCOUNT' THEN NEW zcl_discount_price( iv_discount_rate = '0.1' ) 
        END 
      ).
    rv_price = lo_strategy->calculate_price( iv_base_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_price_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_base_price) = '100.00'.

    DATA(lv_standard_price) = lo_calculator->get_final_price( iv_base_price = lv_base_price iv_is_discount = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_standard_price exp = '100.00' ).

    DATA(lv_discount_price) = lo_calculator->get_final_price( iv_base_price = lv_base_price iv_is_discount = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discount_price exp = '90.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `FOR` Expression ermöglicht die dynamische Erzeugung des Strategie-Objekts basierend auf einer Bedingung, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht. Der `NEW` Operator und Inline-Deklarationen tragen zur Modernität bei.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Event-Handling-System. Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_EVENT_HANDLER` und eine Klasse `CL_EVENT_PUBLISHER`, die Events auslöst. Eine andere Klasse `CL_LOG_HANDLER` soll das Interface implementieren und auf Events reagieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `EVENTS` und `FOR EVENT` Syntax.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_event_handler PUBLIC.
  METHODS handle_event IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(ev_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS trigger_event IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_event.
    RAISE EVENT data_changed EXPORTING ev_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_event_handler.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_publisher TYPE REF TO zcl_event_publisher.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_log_entry TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_publisher_event FOR EVENT data_changed OF zcl_event_publisher IMPORTING ev_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_publisher_event FOR io_publisher.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_publisher_event.
    mv_log_entry = |Event received: { ev_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_event_handler~handle_event.
    " This method is not directly called by the event, but demonstrates the interface
    " For event handling, the FOR EVENT syntax is used.
    mv_log_entry = |Interface method called: { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).
    DATA(lo_log_handler) = NEW zcl_log_handler( io_publisher = lo_publisher ).

    lo_publisher->trigger_event( 'Test Message 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_log_handler->mv_log_entry exp = 'Event received: Test Message 1' ).

    lo_publisher->trigger_event( 'Another Message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_log_handler->mv_log_entry exp = 'Event received: Another Message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert modernes Event-Handling in ABAP. Die `EVENTS` Deklaration in der Publisher-Klasse und die `FOR EVENT` Syntax in der Handler-Klasse ermöglichen eine lose Kopplung zwischen den Komponenten. Der `SET HANDLER` Befehl registriert den Event-Handler. String Templates werden für die Nachrichtenformatierung verwendet.
keywords: INTERFACE, Event Handling, Object Orientation, EVENTS, FOR EVENT, RAISE EVENT, String Templates

Instructions: Sammeln Sie alle verfügbaren Kontextinformationen (Benutzer, System, Programm, Session, etc.) in einer einzigen Methode und geben Sie diese als strukturierte Daten zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie alle relevanten statischen Methoden von `CL_ABAP_CONTEXT_INFO` und moderne Datenstrukturen (`STRUCTURE`, `VALUE`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctx_all_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_all_context_info,
             user_name       TYPE syuname,
             system_id       TYPE sysysid,
             client          TYPE syc_mandt,
             language        TYPE sylangu,
             program_name    TYPE syrepid,
             transaction_code TYPE systact,
             server_name     TYPE syhost,
             instance_number TYPE syinstno,
             is_dialog       TYPE abap_bool,
             is_batch        TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_all_context_info.

    METHODS get_all_context_info RETURNING VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_all_context_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctx_all_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_context_info.
    rs_info = VALUE #( 
      user_name        = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name( )
      system_id        = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_id( )
      client           = cl_abap_context_info=>get_client( )
      language         = cl_abap_context_info=>get_language( )
      program_name     = cl_abap_context_info=>get_program_name( )
      transaction_code = cl_abap_context_info=>get_transaction_code( )
      server_name      = cl_abap_context_info=>get_server_name( )
      instance_number  = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance_number( )
      is_dialog        = COND abap_bool( WHEN cl_abap_context_info=>is_dialog_process( ) = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) 
      is_batch         = COND abap_bool( WHEN cl_abap_context_info=>is_batch_process( ) = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_VALIDATOR` mit einer Methode `IS_VALID`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `CL_STRING_VALIDATOR`, die prüft, ob ein String nicht leer ist. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um eine Liste von Strings zu validieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für die Validierung einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_validator PUBLIC.
  METHODS is_valid IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_string_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validator~is_valid.
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_valid_strings 
      IMPORTING 
        it_strings TYPE string_table 
        io_validator TYPE REF TO zif_validator 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rt_valid_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_valid_strings.
    rt_valid_strings = FILTER string_table( it_strings USING io_validator->is_valid( table_line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_validation.
    DATA(lt_test_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( '' ) ( 'World' ) ( ' ' ) ).
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_string_validator( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_list_processor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Hello' ).

Der `FILTER` Operator ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature, das es erlaubt, Einträge einer Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung (hier die Interface-Methode `is_valid`) zu filtern. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und expressivem Code.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_CALCULATOR` mit Methoden für Addition und Subtraktion. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `CL_MATH_OPERATIONS`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Liste von Zahlen zu summieren oder zu subtrahieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für aggregierte Berechnungen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculator PUBLIC.
  METHODS add IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~add.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_calculator~subtract.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum 
      IMPORTING 
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY 
        io_calculator TYPE REF TO zif_calculator 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
    METHODS calculate_difference 
      IMPORTING 
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY 
        io_calculator TYPE REF TO zif_calculator 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rv_difference) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT result = 0 
                       FOR number IN it_numbers 
                       NEXT result = io_calculator->add( iv_num1 = result iv_num2 = number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_difference.
    rv_difference = REDUCE i( INIT result = 0 
                              FOR number IN it_numbers 
                              NEXT result = io_calculator->subtract( iv_num1 = result iv_num2 = number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_operations.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lo_calculator_impl) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lo_list_calculator) = NEW zcl_list_calculator( ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_list_calculator->calculate_sum( 
      it_numbers = lt_numbers 
      io_calculator = lo_calculator_impl 
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 10 ).

    DATA(lv_difference) = lo_list_calculator->calculate_difference( 
      it_numbers = lt_numbers 
      io_calculator = lo_calculator_impl 
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_difference exp = -10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt Interfaces, um mathematische Operationen zu definieren, und den `REDUCE` Operator, um diese Operationen auf eine Liste von Zahlen anzuwenden. Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Feature in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine Tabelle zu aggregieren und dabei Zwischenergebnisse zu verwenden. Dies führt zu sehr elegantem und effizientem Code für komplexe Berechnungen.
keywords: INTERFACE, REDUCE Operator, Object Orientation, Math, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer einfachen Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             paymentsum TYPE sflight-paymentsum,
             seatsfre TYPE sflight-seatsfre,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_frankfurt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_frankfurt.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate data retrieval from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, deptime, arrtime, price, currency, seatsocc, seatsmax, paymentsum, seatsfre, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    " Modern ABAP: Filter internal table
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_frankfurt FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_frankfurt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_frankfurt( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if all entries are from FRANKFURT
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-cityfrom
        exp = 'FRANKFURT'
        msg = 'All filtered flights must be from FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und prägnante Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife mit `IF` Bedingungen zu schreiben, wird die Filterlogik direkt im Ausdruck definiert, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(lt_sflights)` und `DATA(lo_cut)` sind ebenfalls moderne ABAP-Features.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Declarative, sflight

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_multi IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (connid) und das Abflugdatum (fldate) enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die gefilterten Daten zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_map_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_flight_summaries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_map_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_map_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_ny_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if the structure is correct and data is present
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_summary-connid
        msg = 'CONNID should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_summary-fldate
        msg = 'FLDATE should not be initial' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck. Zuerst wird die Tabelle gefiltert, und dann wird für jede gefilterte Zeile ein neues Struktur-Literal erstellt, das nur die benötigten Felder enthält. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler Ansatz, der die Datenverarbeitung in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung zusammenfasst.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Mapping, Functional Programming

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle von Strings ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `INSERT` Anweisung mit `VALUE` für die neue Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_single_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_single_line( ).

explanation: Die `INSERT` Anweisung ist die Standardmethode zum Hinzufügen einzelner Zeilen zu internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit der Inline-Deklaration und dem `VALUE` Operator (implizit hier, da `iv_new_string` direkt zugewiesen wird) bleibt der Code klar und prägnant. Für Tabellen mit Standard-Schlüssel wird die Zeile am Ende angefügt.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Tables, Single Line

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Zeilen einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `INSERT` Anweisung mit `LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_lines_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING it_source_strings TYPE tt_strings
      CHANGING  ct_target_table TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_lines_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_multiple_strings.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source_strings INTO TABLE ct_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_multiple_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_multiple_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_lines_of( ).
    DATA lt_target_strings TYPE zcl_insert_lines_of=>tt_strings.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_target_strings ).

    DATA(lt_source_strings) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_of=>tt_strings(
      ( 'String 1' )
      ( 'String 2' )
      ( 'String 3' )
    ).

      act = lt_target_strings[ 1 ]
      exp = 'String 1'
      msg = 'First added string should be correct' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target_strings[ 3 ]
      exp = 'String 3'
      msg = 'Last added string should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF` Anweisung ist die effizienteste Methode, um den gesamten Inhalt einer internen Tabelle in eine andere einzufügen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn Sie Teilergebnisse konsolidieren oder Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zusammenführen möchten, ohne explizit über die Quelltabelle zu iterieren.
keywords: INSERT, LINES OF, Internal Tables, Bulk Insert

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Zahlen, um nur die geraden Zahlen zu erhalten, unter Verwendung einer lokalen Prädikatsmethode.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit `WHERE ( ... )` und rufen Sie eine Methode auf, die einen booleschen Wert zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_predicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_even_numbers
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_even_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_even
      IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_even) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_predicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_even_numbers.
    rt_even_numbers = FILTER #( it_numbers WHERE ( is_even( table_line ) = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_even.
    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0.
      rv_is_even = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_even = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_even_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_even_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_predicate( ).
    DATA(lt_input_numbers) = VALUE zcl_filter_predicate=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected_numbers) = VALUE zcl_filter_predicate=>tt_numbers( ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ( 6 ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_even_numbers( lt_input_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_numbers )
      msg = 'Number of even numbers should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result
      exp = lt_expected_numbers
      msg = 'Filtered even numbers should match expected list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung einer Prädikatsmethode innerhalb des `FILTER` Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung der Filterlogik und erhöht die Wiederverwendbarkeit. Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionalen Programmierstil in ABAP, der die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit komplexer Filterbedingungen verbessert. `table_line` referenziert die aktuelle Zeile der internen Tabelle.
keywords: FILTER, Predicate, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Methods

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugdaten in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein, sodass die Sortierreihenfolge erhalten bleibt.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Zieltabelle als `SORTED TABLE` und verwenden Sie `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                              WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_flight_to_sorted_table
      IMPORTING is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight_key
      CHANGING  ct_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_to_sorted_table.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ct_sorted_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_sorted FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_sorted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sorted_table( ).
    DATA lt_sorted_flights TYPE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>tt_sflight_sorted.

    DATA(ls_flight1) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ).
    DATA(ls_flight2) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).
    DATA(ls_flight3) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ).

    lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table( ls_flight2 CHANGING ct_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights ).
    lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table( ls_flight1 CHANGING ct_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights ).
    lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table( ls_flight3 CHANGING ct_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sorted_flights )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Table should contain 3 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'First entry carrid should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_flights[ 2 ]-fldate
      exp = '20250102'
      msg = 'Second entry fldate should be 20250102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_flights[ 3 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Third entry carrid should be LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `INSERT` wird die neue Zeile automatisch an der korrekten Position eingefügt, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Dies ist effizienter als das Einfügen in eine Standardtabelle und anschließendes Sortieren, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen und vielen Einfügevorgängen.
keywords: INSERT, Sorted Table, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie die Anzahl der gefundenen Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `LINES` in einem Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_count = lines( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_count_xx) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_count_lh > 0
      msg = 'Should find flights for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_count_aa > 0
      msg = 'Should find flights for AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count_xx
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Should find 0 flights for non-existent carrier XX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der `FILTER` Operator direkt in einem Ausdruck verwendet werden kann, um eine temporäre gefilterte Tabelle zu erzeugen, deren Zeilenanzahl dann mit `LINES` ermittelt wird. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Art, Filterung und Zählung in einem Schritt durchzuführen.
keywords: FILTER, LINES, Internal Tables, Count, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Objekten (z.B. Instanzen einer Klasse) basierend auf einem Attributwert.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator auf einer Tabelle von Referenzen und greifen Sie auf Attribute zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA carrid TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY.
    DATA connid TYPE sflight-connid READ-ONLY.
    DATA cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->carrid   = iv_carrid.
    me->connid   = iv_connid.
    me->cityfrom = iv_cityfrom.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_objects
        iv_city        TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE table_line->cityfrom = iv_city ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_objects FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_objects.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_objects=>tt_flight_objects(
      ( NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) )
      ( NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) )

      exp = 'FRANKFURT'

explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator kann auch auf internen Tabellen von Objektreferenzen angewendet werden. Durch die Verwendung von `table_line->attribute` kann direkt auf Attribute der Objekte zugegriffen und diese für die Filterung verwendet werden. Dies ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature für die objektorientierte Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, Object Orientation, Internal Tables, References

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, eine Zeile in eine interne Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel einzufügen und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Schlüssel bereits existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` oder fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_duplicate_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data_unique TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_data_entry
      IMPORTING is_new_entry TYPE ty_data
      CHANGING  ct_data_table TYPE tt_data_unique
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_duplicate_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_data_entry.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_new_entry INTO TABLE ct_data_table.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key. " Exception for unique key violation
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_unique_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_unique_duplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_unique_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_duplicate_key( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_insert_duplicate_key=>tt_data_unique.

    DATA(ls_entry1) = VALUE zcl_insert_duplicate_key=>ty_data( id = 1 text = 'First' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_data_entry( is_new_entry = ls_entry1 CHANGING ct_data_table = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Insert should be successful' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_data )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Table should contain one entry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_unique_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_duplicate_key( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_insert_duplicate_key=>tt_data_unique.

    DATA(ls_entry1) = VALUE zcl_insert_duplicate_key=>ty_data( id = 1 text = 'First' ).
    DATA(ls_entry2) = VALUE zcl_insert_duplicate_key=>ty_data( id = 1 text = 'Duplicate' ).

    lo_cut->add_data_entry( is_new_entry = ls_entry1 CHANGING ct_data_table = lt_data ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_data_entry( is_new_entry = ls_entry2 CHANGING ct_data_table = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Insert of duplicate key should fail' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_data )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Table should still contain one entry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 1 ]-text
      exp = 'First'
      msg = 'Original entry should remain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel (`UNIQUE KEY`) kann es zu einer Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key` kommen, wenn eine Zeile mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel eingefügt wird. Die moderne ABAP-Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht es, solche Situationen elegant abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen.
keywords: INSERT, Unique Key, Exception Handling, Internal Tables, TRY CATCH

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Strings, um nur diejenigen zu erhalten, die ein bestimmtes Substring enthalten (case-insensitive).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `CP` (Contains Pattern) oder `CS` (Contains String) Bedingung, eventuell in Kombination mit `to_upper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_string_contains DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_strings_by_substring
      IMPORTING
        it_source_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_substring      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_string_contains IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_strings_by_substring.
    DATA(lv_search_pattern) = |*{ to_upper( iv_substring ) }*|.

    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_source_strings WHERE to_upper( table_line ) CP lv_search_pattern ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_case_insensitive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_case_insensitive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_string_contains( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_filter_string_contains=>tt_strings(
      ( 'Hello World' )
      ( 'ABAP Programming' )
      ( 'Modern Abap' )
      ( 'SAP System' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_strings_by_substring( it_source_strings = lt_input iv_substring = 'abap' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should find 2 strings containing "abap" (case-insensitive)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]
      exp = 'ABAP Programming'
      msg = 'First match should be ABAP Programming' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_string_contains( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_filter_string_contains=>tt_strings(
      ( 'Hello World' )
      ( 'SAP System' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_strings_by_substring( it_source_strings = lt_input iv_substring = 'xyz' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

Instructions: Simulieren Sie zufällige Flugverspätungen für Einträge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 und skalieren Sie diese dann auf eine Verspätung zwischen 0 und 120 Minuten. Fügen Sie diese Verspätung einem neuen Feld in einer internen Tabelle hinzu.

CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_delay,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             delay_min TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_delay.

    METHODS simulate_delays RETURNING VALUE(rt_delays) TYPE tt_sflight_delay.

CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_delays.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_delays = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           LET lv_random_float = lo_random->get_next( )
                               lv_delay_min    = 0
                           IN (
                             COMPUTE lv_delay_min = lv_random_float * 120 " Scale to 0-120 minutes
                             carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid    = ls_sflight-connid,
                             fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate,
                             delay_min = lv_delay_min
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Passen Sie Preise in einer internen Tabelle um einen zufälligen Prozentsatz zwischen -5% und +10% an. Die ursprünglichen Preise sind vom Typ `p` mit 2 Dezimalstellen.

CLASS zcl_price_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_price,
             product_id TYPE string,
             price      TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             adjusted_price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product_price.
    TYPES tt_product_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_prices IMPORTING it_prices TYPE tt_product_price
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_adjusted_prices) TYPE tt_product_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rt_adjusted_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_price IN it_prices
                                   LET lv_random_factor = lo_random->get_next( ) " 0 to 1
                                       lv_percentage_change = 0.0
                                       lv_adjusted_price = ls_price-price
                                   IN (
                                     COMPUTE lv_percentage_change = ( lv_random_factor * 15 ) - 5.0. " Scale to -5% to +10%
                                     COMPUTE lv_adjusted_price = ls_price-price * ( 1 + ( lv_percentage_change / 100 ) ).
                                     product_id     = ls_price-product_id,
                                     price          = ls_price-price,
                                     adjusted_price = lv_adjusted_price
                                   ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_adjust_prices.
    DATA(lt_test_prices) = VALUE zcl_price_adjust=>tt_product_price(
      ( product_id = 'P001' price = '100.00' )
      ( product_id = 'P002' price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_price_adjust( ).
    DATA(lt_adjusted) = lo_cut->adjust_prices( lt_test_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of entries should match' act = lines( lt_adjusted ) exp = 2 ).

    LOOP AT lt_adjusted INTO DATA(ls_adjusted).
      DATA(lv_original_price) = ls_adjusted-price.
      DATA(lv_adjusted_price) = ls_adjusted-adjusted_price.

      " Check if adjusted price is within expected range (-5% to +10%)
      DATA(lv_min_expected) = lv_original_price * '0.95'.
      DATA(lv_max_expected) = lv_original_price * '1.10'.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Adjusted price too low' act = lv_adjusted_price exp = lv_min_expected operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ge ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Adjusted price too high' act = lv_adjusted_price exp = lv_max_expected operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-le ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie 100 Zufallszahlen zwischen 0 und 1 und berechnen Sie deren Durchschnitt. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_float` für die Zahlen und `REDUCE` für die Summe, dann `COMPUTE` für den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_random_numbers) = VALUE decfloat16_table( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 100
                                                      ( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0
                                      FOR num IN lt_random_numbers
                                      NEXT s = s + num ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_random_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      COMPUTE rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Average should be > 0' act = lv_average exp = 0.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Average should be < 1' act = lv_average exp = 1.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-lt ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lv_result_string) = ``.

    DO 10 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_float) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_char_index) = 0.
      COMPUTE lv_char_index = trunc( lv_random_float * lv_chars_len ). " Scale to 0-based index
      lv_result_string = lv_result_string && lc_chars+lv_char_index(1).
    ENDDO.

    rv_random_string = lv_result_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_sel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_item,
             item_name TYPE string,
             weight    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_weighted_item.
    TYPES tt_weighted_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_weighted_item IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_weighted_item
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_selected_item) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_sel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_weighted_item.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_total_weight) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0
                                                FOR item IN it_items
                                                NEXT s = s + item-weight ).

    IF lv_total_weight = 0 OR lines( it_items ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ). " 0 to 1
    DATA(lv_scaled_random) = 0.0.
    COMPUTE lv_scaled_random = lv_random_value * lv_total_weight. " Scale to total weight range

    DATA(lv_cumulative_weight) = 0.0.
    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      COMPUTE lv_cumulative_weight = lv_cumulative_weight + ls_item-weight.
      IF lv_scaled_random <= lv_cumulative_weight.
        rv_selected_item = ls_item-item_name.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_integer.
    IF iv_min > iv_max.
      DATA(lv_temp) = iv_min.
      iv_min = iv_max.
      iv_max = lv_temp.

    COMPUTE lv_offset = trunc( lv_random_float * lv_range_size ). " Scale to 0-based offset within range

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche zufällige Verspätung (zwischen 0 und 60 Minuten).

CLASS zcl_flight_delay_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_delay_avg,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_delay_min TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_delay_avg.
    TYPES tt_carrier_delay_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_delay_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_grouped_delays RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_delays) TYPE tt_carrier_delay_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_delay_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_grouped_delays.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_flights_with_delay) = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                            LET lv_random_float = lo_random->get_next( )
                                                lv_delay_min    = 0
                                            IN (
                                              COMPUTE lv_delay_min = lv_random_float * 60. " Scale to 0-60 minutes
                                              carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                              connid    = ls_sflight-connid,
                                              fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                              delay_min = lv_delay_min
                                            ) ).

    rt_grouped_delays = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_flights_with_delay GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 LET lv_sum_delay = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0
                                                                       FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                                       NEXT s = s + member-delay_min )
                                     lv_count     = lines( GROUP ls_flight )
                                     lv_avg_delay = 0.0
                                 IN (
                                   COMPUTE lv_avg_delay = lv_sum_delay / lv_count. " Calculate average
                                   carrid        = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   avg_delay_min = lv_avg_delay
                                 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Average delay should be < 60' act = ls_grouped_delay-avg_delay_min exp = 60.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-le ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_id_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
    METHODS calculate_id_hash IMPORTING iv_id TYPE string
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_hash) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_id_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_id.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lv_result_string) = ``.

    DO 12 TIMES. " Generate a 12-character ID
      DATA(lv_random_float) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_char_index) = 0.
      COMPUTE lv_char_index = trunc( lv_random_float * lv_chars_len ).
      lv_result_string = lv_result_string && lc_chars+lv_char_index(1).
    ENDDO.
    rv_id = lv_result_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_id_hash.
    DATA(lv_hash_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_char_code) = 0.
    DATA(lv_modulo) = 10000. " A simple modulo for hash range

    DO strlen( iv_id ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = iv_id+sy-index-1(1).
      CALL FUNCTION 'CHAR_CODE_GET'
        EXPORTING
          i_char = lv_char
        IMPORTING
          e_code = lv_char_code.
      COMPUTE lv_hash_sum = lv_hash_sum + lv_char_code.
    ENDDO.

    COMPUTE rv_hash = lv_hash_sum MOD lv_modulo.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'ID should only contain A-Z and 0-9' act = COND string( WHEN lv_id CP '[^A-Z0-9]' THEN 'X' ELSE '' ) ).

    DATA(lv_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_id_hash( lv_id ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Standardabweichung einer Reihe von 20 zufällig generierten Gleitkommazahlen zwischen 0 und 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` für die Zahlen, `COMPUTE` für die Summen und Quadrate, und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_std_dev DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_std_dev RETURNING VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_std_dev IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_std_dev.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE decfloat16_table( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 20
                                                LET lv_rand_float = lo_random->get_next( )
                                                    lv_scaled_num = 0.0
                                                IN (
                                                  COMPUTE lv_scaled_num = lv_rand_float * 100.0. " Scale to 0-100
                                                  lv_scaled_num
                                                ) ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_numbers ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_std_dev = 0.0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0
                                      FOR num IN lt_numbers
                                      NEXT s = s + num ).

    DATA(lv_mean) = 0.0.
    COMPUTE lv_mean = lv_sum / lv_count.

    DATA(lv_sum_sq_diff) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT ssd = 0.0
                                              FOR num IN lt_numbers
                                              LET lv_diff = 0.0
                                                  lv_sq_diff = 0.0
                                              IN (
                                                COMPUTE lv_diff = num - lv_mean.
                                                COMPUTE lv_sq_diff = lv_diff * lv_diff.
                                                ssd = ssd + lv_sq_diff
                                              ) ).

    DATA(lv_variance) = 0.0.
    COMPUTE lv_variance = lv_sum_sq_diff / lv_count.

    rv_std_dev = sqrt( lv_variance ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Standard deviation should be non-negative' act = lv_std_dev exp = 0.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ge ).
    " Due to randomness, exact value cannot be asserted, but a reasonable range can be checked.
    " For numbers 0-100, std dev is typically between 20-30 for 20 samples.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Standard deviation too low' act = lv_std_dev exp = 10.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ge ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_decfloat( ).
    DATA(lt_decfloats) = lo_cut->generate_random_decfloats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should generate 5 numbers' act = lines( lt_decfloats ) exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_decfloats INTO DATA(lv_decfloat).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Number too low' act = lv_decfloat exp = '100.00' operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ge ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Number too high' act = lv_decfloat exp = '999.99' operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-le ).

      " Check for two decimal places (simple check: multiply by 100, check if integer)
      DATA(lv_multiplied) = 0.
      COMPUTE lv_multiplied = lv_decfloat * 100.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have two decimal places' act = lv_multiplied exp = trunc( lv_multiplied ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung von zufälligen Dezimalzahlen im Typ `DECFLOAT16` innerhalb eines spezifischen Bereichs und mit einer bestimmten Präzision. `cl_abap_random_float` erzeugt die Basis-Zufallszahl, die dann mit `COMPUTE` skaliert wird, um in den gewünschten Bereich zu fallen. Anschließend wird `COMPUTE` in Verbindung mit der Funktion `round()` verwendet, um die Zahl auf zwei Dezimalstellen zu runden. Die `FOR`-Expression in `VALUE` ermöglicht eine kompakte Generierung der Liste.
keywords: cl_abap_random_float, COMPUTE, Math, DECFLOAT16, Rounding, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge aus `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`), aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Nutzen Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_fldate )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " LH, 002, 20250102, 1500
    " UA, 003, 20250103, 2000
    " LH, 004, 20250103, 2500

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Aufgaben (Strings) nacheinander, bis die Liste leer ist. Geben Sie die verarbeiteten Aufgaben in der Reihenfolge ihrer Verarbeitung zurück. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und `READ TABLE ... INDEX 1`.
hint: Entfernen Sie Elemente aus der internen Tabelle, während Sie sie verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_queue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_queue IMPORTING it_initial_queue TYPE tt_tasks RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE tt_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_queue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA lt_current_queue TYPE tt_tasks.
    lt_current_queue = it_initial_queue.

    WHILE lt_current_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_task) = lt_current_queue[ 1 ].
      APPEND lv_task TO rt_processed_tasks.
      DELETE lt_current_queue INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND 'Task B' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'Task C' TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_queue( ).

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einer Liste von Zahlen die erste Zahl, die größer als 10 ist, und geben Sie diese zurück. Beenden Sie die Schleife, sobald die Zahl gefunden wurde. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit `EXIT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einer Bedingung, die immer wahr ist, und `EXIT`, um die Schleife zu verlassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_exit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_first_greater_than
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_exit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_greater_than.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( it_numbers ).

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_size.
      DATA(lv_current_number) = it_numbers[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_number > iv_threshold.
        rv_found_number = lv_current_number.
        EXIT. " Exit the loop once the number is found
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen, aber überspringen Sie alle negativen Zahlen. Geben Sie nur die positiven Zahlen in einer neuen internen Tabelle zurück. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit `CONTINUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `CONTINUE`, um bestimmte Iterationen zu überspringen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_continue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_positive_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_positive_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_continue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_positive_numbers.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( it_numbers ).

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_size.
      DATA(lv_current_number) = it_numbers[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_number < 0.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
        CONTINUE. " Skip negative numbers
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_current_number TO rt_positive_numbers.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Prozess, der eine Ressource (z.B. einen Zähler) schrittweise erhöht, bis ein Maximalwert erreicht ist. CLASS zcl_while_complex_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_process
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_value TYPE i
        iv_max_steps TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_complex_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_process.
    DATA(lv_current_value) = 0.
    DATA(lv_steps_taken) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_value < iv_max_value AND lv_steps_taken < iv_max_steps.
      lv_current_value = lv_current_value + 1.
      lv_steps_taken = lv_steps_taken + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_final_value = lv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter aus einem Satz, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen, und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Beenden Sie die Verarbeitung, wenn ein Wort gefunden wird, das nur aus Kleinbuchstaben besteht. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und String-Funktionen wie `to_upper` und `to_lower` zur Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_word_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_capitalized_words) TYPE tt_words.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_word_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_capitalized_words.
    DATA: lt_words TYPE tt_words,
          lv_index TYPE i VALUE 1.

    SPLIT iv_sentence AT ' ' INTO TABLE lt_words.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_words ).
      DATA(lv_current_word) = lt_words[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_word IS INITIAL. " Handle multiple spaces
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_word = to_upper( lv_current_word ) AND lv_current_word <> to_lower( lv_current_word ). " Check if it's all caps and not all lower
        APPEND lv_current_word TO rt_capitalized_words.
      ELSEIF lv_current_word = to_lower( lv_current_word ). " If it's all lower, stop
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach `carrid` und `connid` und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Flugpreis. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_flight_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ) 
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        avg_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0 TYPE sflight-price FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) / lines( GROUP ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von Daten, beginnend mit einem Startdatum, bis ein Enddatum erreicht oder überschritten wird. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.

CLASS zcl_while_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dates) TYPE tt_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_date_range.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      APPEND lv_current_date TO rt_dates.
      lv_current_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = lv_current_date iv_days = 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_adjusted,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_adjusted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_adjusted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_adjusted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_adjusted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        fldate = flight-fldate
        price = COND #( WHEN flight-carrid = 'AA' THEN flight-price * '1.10' ELSE flight-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
