Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen externen String, der Datum und Zeit im Format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" enthält, in separate interne ABAP-Datum- und Zeitfelder.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_DATFM` für die Konvertierung und `SPLIT` oder String-Operationen, um Datum und Zeit zu trennen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_datetime_parts,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
             time TYPE sy-uzeit,
           END OF ty_datetime_parts.

    METHODS convert_external_datetime
      IMPORTING
        iv_external_datetime TYPE string " e.g., '2023-11-26 14:30:05'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_datetime_parts) TYPE ty_datetime_parts
      RAISING
        cx_abap_datfm_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_external_datetime.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_date_string) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_time_string) TYPE string.

    SPLIT iv_external_datetime AT ' ' INTO lv_date_string lv_time_string.

    rs_datetime_parts-date = lo_datfm->date_convert(
      iv_date_string = lv_date_string
      iv_format = cl_abap_datfm=>co_format_date_yyyy_mm_dd
    ).

    rs_datetime_parts-time = lo_datfm->time_convert(
      iv_time_string = lv_time_string
      iv_format = cl_abap_datfm=>co_format_time_hh_mm_ss
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      act = lv_result
      exp = 'KG'
      msg = 'Output sollte die Mengeneinheit enthalten'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result
      exp = '123'
      msg = 'Output sollte den Mengenwert enthalten'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie bei der Währungsformatierung sorgt `QUANTITY_FORMAT` für eine korrekte, lokalisierte Darstellung von Mengen, was für globale Anwendungen unerlässlich ist.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein Datum dynamisch basierend auf einem übergebenen Format-Key, der einem `CL_ABAP_DATFM` Konstantenwert entspricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_DATFM` und die Methode `DATE_FORMAT` mit einem dynamisch ermittelten Format.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_date_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_date       TYPE sy-datum
        iv_format_key TYPE string " e.g., 'DD_MM_YYYY'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_datfm_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_format_constant) TYPE string.

    CASE iv_format_key.
      WHEN 'DD_MM_YYYY'.
        lv_format_constant = cl_abap_datfm=>co_format_date_dd_mm_yyyy.
      WHEN 'MM_DD_YYYY'.
        lv_format_constant = cl_abap_datfm=>co_format_date_mm_dd_yyyy.
      WHEN 'YYYY_MM_DD'.
        lv_format_constant = cl_abap_datfm=>co_format_date_yyyy_mm_dd.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_datfm_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Ungültiger Format-Key: { iv_format_key }|.
    ENDCASE.

    rv_formatted_date = lo_datfm->date_format(
      iv_date = iv_date
      iv_format = lv_format_constant
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_format FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_format_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_date_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20231126'.

    DATA(lv_result_ddmmyyyy) = lo_cut->format_date_dynamic( iv_date = lv_date iv_format_key = 'DD_MM_YYYY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_ddmmyyyy exp = '26.11.2023' msg = 'DD.MM.YYYY Format falsch' ).

    DATA(lv_result_mmddyyyy) = lo_cut->format_date_dynamic( iv_date = lv_date iv_format_key = 'MM_DD_YYYY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_mmddyyyy exp = '11/26/2023' msg = 'MM/DD/YYYY Format falsch' ).

    DATA(lv_result_yyyymmdd) = lo_cut->format_date_dynamic( iv_date = lv_date iv_format_key = 'YYYY_MM_DD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_yyyymmdd exp = '2023-11-26' msg = 'YYYY-MM-DD Format falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_format_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_date_formatter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->format_date_dynamic( iv_date = '20231126' iv_format_key = 'INVALID_FORMAT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwartete Ausnahme für ungültiges Format wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Korrekte Ausnahme für ungültiges Format wurde ausgelöst' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).

        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( )

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_interfaces`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_test_interface.
  METHODS dummy_method.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_if DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING

        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_if IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
        LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_interfaces( ) INTO DATA(ls_interface).
          IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
            rv_implements = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        " Class or interface not found
        rv_implements = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_test_interface.
ENDCLASS.

    " Implementation
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_if( ).

    " Test class that implements the interface
    DATA(lv_implements_true) = lo_cut->implements_interface(
                                 iv_class_name     = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS_IMPL'
                                 iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE'
                               ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_implements_true exp = abap_true ).

    " Test class that does not implement the interface
    DATA(lv_implements_false) = lo_cut->implements_interface(
                                  iv_class_name     = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS_NO_IMPL'
                                  iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE'
                                ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_implements_false exp = abap_false ).

    " Test non-existent class
    DATA(lv_implements_non_existent) = lo_cut->implements_interface(
                                         iv_class_name     = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
                                         iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE'
                                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_implements_non_existent exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene RTTI-Anwendung, um die Implementierung eines Interfaces durch eine Klasse zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` wird verwendet, um ein Typbeschreibungsobjekt anhand des Namens zu erhalten, das dann zu `cl_abap_classdescr` gecastet wird. Die Methode `get_interfaces` liefert eine Liste aller implementierten Interfaces, die dann durchsucht werden kann. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist wichtig, da die Klasse oder das Interface möglicherweise nicht existiert.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Parameter (Name, Typ, Art) einer Methode einer Klasse zur Laufzeit.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string, " e.g., 'IMPORTING', 'EXPORTING', 'CHANGING', 'RETURNING'
           END OF ty_param_info.
    TYPES tt_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).

        LOOP AT lo_methoddescr->get_parameters( ) INTO DATA(ls_param).

            name = ls_param-name
            type = ls_param-type_descr->get_name( )
            kind = ls_param-parameter_kind
          ) TO rt_parameters.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        " Class or method not found
      CATCH cx_sy_invalid_descr_param.
        " Method not found in class
    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Zeilentypnamen und füllen Sie sie mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_create_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_line_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type = lo_line_descr
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                  p_unique = abap_false
                                ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Example: Fill with some dummy data if line type is SFLIGHT
          IF iv_line_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight.
            APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
            IF <ls_sflight> IS ASSIGNED.
              <ls_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
              <ls_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
              <ls_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
            ENDIF.
            APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
            IF <ls_sflight> IS ASSIGNED.
              <ls_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
              <ls_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
              <ls_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        " Type not found
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Error creating data
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_create_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_dynamic_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE <lt_sflight> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight>-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight>-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle. Zuerst wird mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` ein Typbeschreibungsobjekt für den Zeilentyp abgerufen. Dann wird `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` verwendet, um ein Tabellenbeschreibungsobjekt zu erstellen. Schließlich wird `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` verwendet, um die interne Tabelle dynamisch zu instanziieren. Die Zuweisung zu einem Feldsymbol (`ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>`) ist notwendig, um auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle zugreifen und sie füllen zu können.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_data.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_data TYPE HANDLE lo_typedescr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_dynamic_data> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_data->* TO <lv_dynamic_data>.

        IF <lv_dynamic_data> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Attempt to assign value, handling potential type mismatches
          TRY.
              <lv_dynamic_data> = iv_value.
            CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
              " Handle type mismatch, e.g., log error or set default
              CLEAR <lv_dynamic_data>.
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        " Type not found
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Error creating data
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf und übergeben Sie Parameter.

CLASS zcl_dyn_call_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param1      TYPE any OPTIONAL
        iv_param2      TYPE any OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_call_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_parameters,
          ls_parameter  TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>s_parameter.

    IF iv_param1 IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM1'. " Assuming method has IV_NUM1
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param1 INTO ls_parameter-value.
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_param2 IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM2'. " Assuming method has IV_NUM2
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param2 INTO ls_parameter-value.
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lr_result TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO lr_result.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method(
          EXPORTING
            ii_object   = io_object
            iv_method   = iv_method_name
            it_parameters = lt_parameters
          IMPORTING
            er_result   = lr_result " For RETURNING parameter
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feld dynamisch einen Wert in einer Struktur oder internen Tabelle zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und das zugewiesene Feldsymbol.

CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_dynamic_field_value
      CHANGING
        cs_data      TYPE any
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Attempt to assign value, handling potential type mismatches
          TRY.
              <fs_field> = iv_value.
              rv_success = abap_true.
            CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
              " Type mismatch
              rv_success = abap_false.
          ENDTRY.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Component not found or data is not a structure
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur zur Laufzeit und füllen Sie diese.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_create_custom_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_custom_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_custom_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_custom_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      TRY.
          ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
          ls_component-type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
          " Handle unknown type
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                  p_unique = abap_false
                                ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
          IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
            " Fill first line dynamically
            LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
              FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_field>.
              IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                TRY.
                    IF ls_field_def-name = 'ID'.
                      <fs_field> = 1.
                    ELSEIF ls_field_def-name = 'TEXT'.
                      <fs_field> = 'Dynamic Entry 1'.
                    ELSE.
                      <fs_field> = 'Default'.
                    ENDIF.
                  CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
                    " Type mismatch during assignment
                ENDTRY.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer internen Tabelle mit einer vollständig dynamisch definierten Struktur. Zuerst werden die Komponenten der Struktur aus einer Liste von Felddefinitionen (`tt_field_def`) erstellt. Dann wird `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` verwendet, um ein Struktur-Beschreibungsobjekt zu erhalten, gefolgt von `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für die Tabelle. Schließlich wird die Tabelle mit `CREATE DATA` instanziiert und dynamisch gefüllt. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario für hochflexible Anwendungen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Attribute (Feldnamen, Typen, Sichtbarkeit) einer Klasse zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             type       TYPE string,
             visibility TYPE string, " e.g., 'PUBLIC', 'PROTECTED', 'PRIVATE'
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).

        LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
          DATA(lv_visibility) = SWITCH string(
            ls_attribute-visibility
            WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_public    THEN 'PUBLIC'
            WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_protected THEN 'PROTECTED'
            WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_private   THEN 'PRIVATE'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
          ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(
            name       = ls_attribute-name
            type       = ls_attribute-type_descr->get_name( )
            visibility = lv_visibility
          ) TO rt_attributes.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        " Class not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_method.
    DATA: lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO object.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        DATA: lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_parameters,
              ls_parameter  TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>s_parameter.

          ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming method has IV_INPUT
          GET REFERENCE OF iv_param INTO ls_parameter-value.

        DATA: lr_method_result TYPE REF TO data.
        GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO lr_method_result.

        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method(
          EXPORTING
            ii_object   = lo_dynamic_object
            iv_method   = iv_method_name
            it_parameters = lt_parameters
          IMPORTING
            er_result   = lr_method_result
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        rv_result = |Error creating object: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Vererbungshierarchie einer Klasse bis zur Wurzelklasse `OBJECT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_superclass` rekursiv.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_inheritance_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_inheritance_hierarchy.
    DATA: lo_classdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lv_current_class_name TYPE string.

    lv_current_class_name = iv_class_name.

    WHILE lv_current_class_name IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_current_class_name <> 'OBJECT'.
      APPEND lv_current_class_name TO rt_hierarchy.
      TRY.
          lo_classdescr = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( lv_current_class_name ) ).
          DATA(lo_superclass_descr) = lo_classdescr->get_superclass( ).
          IF lo_superclass_descr IS BOUND.
            lv_current_class_name = lo_superclass_descr->get_name( ).
          ELSE.
            CLEAR lv_current_class_name.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
          CLEAR lv_current_class_name.
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          " Not a class, or other cast error
          CLEAR lv_current_class_name.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.
    IF lv_current_class_name = 'OBJECT'.
      APPEND 'OBJECT' TO rt_hierarchy.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT` Abfrage auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` aus, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel und die angeforderten Felder dynamisch sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit dynamischen Token für Felder und `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_fields_string TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE'
        iv_where_string  TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID = ''AA'' AND CONNID = ''0017'''
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lv_select_statement TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    " Construct dynamic SELECT statement
    lv_select_statement = |SELECT { iv_fields_string } FROM SFLIGHT WHERE { iv_where_string } INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_dynamic_result)|.

    TRY.
        " Execute dynamic SELECT
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.

        " The result is in lt_dynamic_result, which is a local data declaration.
        " We need to copy it to a dynamically created table to return.
        " This part is complex as the structure of lt_dynamic_result is unknown at design time.
        " For simplicity, we'll assume a fixed structure for demonstration or use RTTI to build a new table.

        " --- Simplified approach for demonstration (requires knowing the structure of lt_dynamic_result) ---
        " In a real scenario, you'd use RTTI to describe lt_dynamic_result and then create a new table.
        " For this example, we'll just return a reference to a generic table if possible.

        " To make this truly dynamic and return a REF TO data, we need to use RTTI to describe the result
        " of the dynamic SELECT and then create a new internal table of that type.
        " This is a significant amount of code, so for this example, we'll simulate the return.

        " Simulate dynamic table creation and filling
        DATA: lt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
        SELECT (iv_fields_string) FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflight_subset WHERE (iv_where_string).

        GET REFERENCE OF lt_sflight_subset INTO rt_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle dynamic SQL error
        CLEAR rt_result.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select( ).

    " Prepare some test data in SFLIGHT if not already present
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) ) ).

    DATA(lr_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_select(
                          iv_fields_string = 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE'
                          iv_where_string  = |CARRID = 'AA' AND CONNID = '0017'|
                        ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_result ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflight_result> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_result->* TO <lt_sflight_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_sflight_result> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight_result> ) exp = 1 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight_line> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE <lt_sflight_result> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_sflight_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight_line>-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight_line>-connid exp = '0017' ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine dynamische `SELECT` Abfrage, bei der sowohl die Feldliste als auch die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden. Die `SELECT (iv_fields_string) FROM ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_dynamic_result WHERE (iv_where_string)` Syntax ermöglicht diese Flexibilität. Beachten Sie, dass die Rückgabe eines `REF TO data` bei dynamischen `SELECT`-Ergebnissen komplex ist, da der Zeilentyp der Ergebnistabelle zur Designzeit unbekannt ist. Im Beispiel wird eine vereinfachte Rückgabe über eine bekannte Struktur verwendet, in einem realen Szenario müsste hier RTTI eingesetzt werden, um die Struktur der Ergebnistabelle zu ermitteln und eine passende dynamische Tabelle zu erstellen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SELECT, Dynamic SQL, WHERE Clause, Field List, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Ereignisse (Events) einer Klasse zur Laufzeit, einschließlich ihrer Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_events`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event_param_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_event_param_info.
    TYPES tt_event_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             visibility TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_event_param_info,
           END OF ty_event_info.
    TYPES tt_event_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_events
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_events) TYPE tt_event_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_events.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).

        LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_events( ) INTO DATA(ls_event).
          DATA(lv_visibility) = SWITCH string(
            ls_event-visibility
            WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_public    THEN 'PUBLIC'
            WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_protected THEN 'PROTECTED'
            WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_private   THEN 'PRIVATE'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
          ).

          DATA(lt_event_params) TYPE tt_event_param_info.
          LOOP AT ls_event-parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
            APPEND VALUE ty_event_param_info(
              name = ls_param-name
              type = ls_param-type_descr->get_name( )
            ) TO lt_event_params.
          ENDLOOP.

          APPEND VALUE ty_event_info(
            name       = ls_event-name
            visibility = lv_visibility
            parameters = lt_event_params
          ) TO rt_events.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        " Class not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_event1-parameters ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE ls_event1-parameters WITH KEY name = 'I_OLD_VALUE' INTO DATA(ls_param1).

    READ TABLE lt_events WITH KEY name = 'INTERNAL_EVENT' INTO DATA(ls_event2).

Nach dem Abrufen des `cl_abap_classdescr`-Objekts wird `get_events` aufgerufen, um eine Tabelle mit Ereignisbeschreibungen zu erhalten. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer reduzierten Struktur und umbenannten Feldern, unter Verwendung des `VALUE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             ticket_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_target.
    TYPES tt_sflight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_sflight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_sflight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights.
    rt_target_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source_data
                               ( airline_id   = ls_source-carrid
                                 flight_num   = ls_source-connid
                                 flight_date  = ls_source-fldate
                                 ticket_price = ls_source-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_sflights.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_sflight_transformer=>tt_sflight_source.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231201' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231202' price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_transformer->transform_sflights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of lines should be 2' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry airline_id' act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry ticket_price' act = lt_target[ 2 ]-ticket_price exp = '500.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Syntax, um interne Tabellen zu transformieren und zu füllen. Er ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Schreibweise, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert, indem Schleifen und manuelle Zuweisungen vermieden werden.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, INTERNAL TABLE, CONVERT, TRANSFORMATION

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Menge von einer Einheit in eine andere (z.B. Kilogramm in Gramm) unter Berücksichtigung von Umrechnungsfaktoren.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_QUANTITY_UNIT_CONVERSION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unit_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_quantity
      IMPORTING
        iv_quantity    TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 3
        iv_source_unit TYPE meins
        iv_target_unit TYPE meins
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_quantity) TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 3
      RAISING
        cx_sy_unit_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unit_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_quantity.
    rv_converted_quantity = cl_quantity_unit_conversion=>convert(
      EXPORTING
        iv_quantity    = iv_quantity
        iv_source_unit = iv_source_unit
        iv_target_unit = iv_target_unit
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unit_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unit_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_unit_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->convert_quantity(
      iv_quantity    = '1.500'
      iv_source_unit = 'KG'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '1.5 KG should be 1500 G' act = lv_result exp = '1500.000' ).

      iv_source_unit = 'G'

explanation: Die Klasse `CL_QUANTITY_UNIT_CONVERSION` bietet eine zuverlässige und systemweite Methode zur Umrechnung von Mengeneinheiten. Sie berücksichtigt die im Customizing hinterlegten Umrechnungsfaktoren und ist somit die bevorzugte Lösung für solche Aufgaben, anstatt manuelle Berechnungen durchzuführen.
keywords: UNIT, CONVERT, CL_QUANTITY_UNIT_CONVERSION, MATH

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_SHAPE` mit einer abstrakten Methode `CALCULATE_AREA`. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Unterklassen, `ZCL_CIRCLE` und `ZCL_RECTANGLE`, die diese Methode spezifisch implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS` in der Basisklasse und `REDEFINITION` in den Unterklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string,
             get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string,
             calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( 'Circle' ).
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 iv_width TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
    DATA mv_width TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( 'Rectangle' ).
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shapes.
    DATA: lo_circle    TYPE REF TO zcl_shape,
          lo_rectangle TYPE REF TO zcl_shape.

    lo_circle = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Circle area check' act = lo_circle->calculate_area( ) exp = '78.54' ). " PI * 5^2 approx
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Circle name check' act = lo_circle->get_name( ) exp = 'Circle' ).

    lo_rectangle = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '10.00' iv_width = '4.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Rectangle area check' act = lo_rectangle->calculate_area( ) exp = '40.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Rectangle name check' act = lo_rectangle->get_name( ) exp = 'Rectangle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Abstrakte Klassen definieren eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle und ein Grundgerüst für eine Hierarchie von Klassen, ohne selbst instanziiert werden zu können. Abstrakte Methoden erzwingen, dass Unterklassen eine spezifische Implementierung bereitstellen, was die Konsistenz und Erweiterbarkeit des Designs fördert. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der objektorientierten Programmierung und ermöglicht Polymorphie.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHOD, OBJECT ORIENTATION, POLYMORPHISM, REDEFINITION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_DOCUMENT_PROCESSOR`, die eine konkrete Methode `LOG_PROCESSING_START` und eine abstrakte Methode `PROCESS_CONTENT` enthält. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Unterklasse `ZCL_TEXT_DOCUMENT_PROCESSOR`.
hint: Eine abstrakte Klasse kann sowohl implementierte als auch abstrakte Methoden haben. Die konkreten Methoden können von Unterklassen direkt genutzt oder redefiniert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_document_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: log_processing_start,
             process_content ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_processing_start.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier ein Log-Eintrag erfolgen
    WRITE: / 'Document processing started at', sy-uzeit.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_document_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_document_processor FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: process_content REDEFINITION,
             get_processed_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_content) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_processed_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_document_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_content.
    " Einfache Verarbeitung: Inhalt in Großbuchstaben umwandeln
    mv_processed_content = to_upper( iv_content ).
    WRITE: / 'Text document processed: ', mv_processed_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_processed_content.
    rv_processed_content = mv_processed_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_document_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_document_processor.
    DATA(lo_text_processor) = NEW zcl_text_document_processor( ).

    " Die konkrete Methode der abstrakten Klasse aufrufen
    lo_text_processor->log_processing_start( ).

    " Die abstrakte Methode der Unterklasse aufrufen
    lo_text_processor->process_content( 'Hello World' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Content should be uppercase' act = lo_text_processor->get_processed_content( ) exp = 'HELLO WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, dass abstrakte Klassen nicht nur abstrakte Methoden definieren, sondern auch konkrete Implementierungen bereitstellen können. Dies ist nützlich, um gemeinsame Funktionalitäten in der Basisklasse zu kapseln, während spezifische, variierende Schritte den Unterklassen überlassen werden. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code und die Einhaltung des DRY-Prinzips (Don't Repeat Yourself).
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, CONCRETE METHOD, ABSTRACT METHOD, OBJECT ORIENTATION, INHERITANCE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory Method Pattern, bei dem eine abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT` die Schnittstelle für Produkte definiert und eine Factory-Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` konkrete Produktinstanzen erzeugt.
hint: Die Factory-Methode ist oft eine statische Methode, die eine Instanz einer konkreten Unterklasse der abstrakten Produktklasse zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_product_a DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_product FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = 'This is Concrete Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_product_b DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_product FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = 'This is Concrete Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zcl_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_concrete_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_concrete_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Unknown product type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_factory_method FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_method.
    DATA: lo_product_a TYPE REF TO zcl_product,
          lo_product_b TYPE REF TO zcl_product.

    lo_product_a = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product A description' act = lo_product_a->get_description( ) exp = 'This is Concrete Product A' ).

    lo_product_b = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product B description' act = lo_product_b->get_description( ) exp = 'This is Concrete Product B' ).

    TRY.
        zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'C' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for unknown product type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught exception for unknown product type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern entkoppelt die Erstellung von Objekten von ihrer Verwendung. Die abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT` definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle, während die Factory-Methode in `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` entscheidet, welche konkrete Unterklasse instanziiert wird. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes, da neue Produkttypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne den Client-Code zu ändern.
keywords: FACTORY PATTERN, ABSTRACT CLASS, DESIGN PATTERNS, OBJECT ORIENTATION, POLYMORPHISM

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern, bei dem eine abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_REPORT_GENERATOR` das Skelett eines Algorithmus definiert und Unterklassen bestimmte Schritte implementieren.
hint: Die Template-Methode ist eine konkrete Methode in der abstrakten Klasse, die abstrakte (oder hook-) Methoden aufruft, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report FINAL. " Template Method
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
    METHODS format_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_report) TYPE string.
    METHODS save_report OPTIONAL IMPORTING iv_report_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = fetch_data( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_report) = format_data( lt_raw_data ).
    save_report( lv_formatted_report ).
    WRITE: / 'Report generation completed.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD save_report.
    " Default implementation: do nothing or log
    WRITE: / 'Report saved (default):', iv_report_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report_generator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: fetch_data REDEFINITION,
             format_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_data.
    APPEND 'Sales Data Line 1' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Sales Data Line 2' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD format_data.
    rv_formatted_report = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = 'Sales Report:\n'
      FOR line IN it_data
      NEXT s = s && line && '\n' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hr_report_generator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: fetch_data REDEFINITION,
             format_data REDEFINITION,
             save_report REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hr_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_data.
    APPEND 'HR Data Line A' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'HR Data Line B' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD format_data.
    rv_formatted_report = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = 'HR Report (Confidential):\n'
      FOR line IN it_data
      NEXT s = s && '  - ' && line && '\n' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD save_report.
    " Custom save logic for HR reports (e.g., to secure storage)
    WRITE: / 'HR Report saved securely:', iv_report_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_template_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_template_method.
    DATA: lo_sales_report TYPE REF TO zcl_report_generator,
          lo_hr_report    TYPE REF TO zcl_report_generator.

    lo_sales_report = NEW zcl_sales_report_generator( ).
    lo_sales_report->generate_report( ). " This will call fetch_data, format_data, save_report of sales report

    lo_hr_report = NEW zcl_hr_report_generator( ).
    lo_hr_report->generate_report( ). " This will call fetch_data, format_data, save_report of HR report

    " Assertions would typically involve checking system logs or mock objects
    " For simplicity, we just ensure no dumps and methods are called.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump expected for sales report' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump expected for HR report' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template Method Pattern definiert das Skelett eines Algorithmus in einer Operation und überlässt es den Unterklassen, bestimmte Schritte des Algorithmus zu implementieren, ohne dessen Struktur zu ändern. Die `generate_report` Methode ist die Template-Methode, die die Reihenfolge der Schritte festlegt. `fetch_data` und `format_data` sind abstrakte Methoden, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden müssen, während `save_report` eine optionale Hook-Methode mit einer Standardimplementierung ist. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendung des Algorithmus-Skeletts und ermöglicht gleichzeitig die Anpassung einzelner Schritte.
keywords: TEMPLATE METHOD PATTERN, ABSTRACT CLASS, DESIGN PATTERNS, OBJECT ORIENTATION, REDUCE

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen XML-String, der Flugdaten enthält, in eine ABAP-Datenstruktur (interne Tabelle).
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit einer einfachen Transformation oder die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONV_XLT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_xml_deserializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_xml_to_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_st_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_xml_deserializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_xml_to_sflights.
    DATA(lv_xml_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
    )->convert(
      iv_string = iv_xml_string
    ).

    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE XML lv_xml_xstring RESULT sflight_data = rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_deserialize_xml FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_xml.
    DATA(lv_xml_string) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<asx:abap xmlns:asx="http://www.sap.com/abapxml" version="1.0">
  <asx:values>
    <SFLIGHT_DATA>
      <item>
        <CARRID>LH</CARRID>
        <CONNID>0400</CONNID>
        <FLDATE>20231201</FLDATE>
        <PRICE>123.45</PRICE>
        <CURRENCY>EUR</CURRENCY>
      </item>
      <item>
        <CARRID>AA</CARRID>
        <CONNID>0017</CONNID>
        <FLDATE>20231202</FLDATE>
        <PRICE>500.00</PRICE>
        <CURRENCY>USD</CURRENCY>
      </item>
    </SFLIGHT_DATA>
  </asx:values>
</asx:abap>`.

    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_sflight_xml_deserializer( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_deserializer->deserialize_xml_to_sflights( lv_xml_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of lines should be 2' act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry carrid' act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry price' act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-price exp = '500.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` Anweisung ist der Standardweg, um ABAP-Datenstrukturen in XML zu serialisieren und zu deserialisieren. Die `ID` Transformation ist eine vordefinierte, generische Transformation, die für die meisten einfachen Fälle ausreicht. Für komplexere XML-Strukturen können eigene XSLT-Transformationen erstellt werden. Die Konvertierung des Strings in XSTRING ist notwendig, da `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit `XML` einen binären Input erwartet.
keywords: XML, DESERIALIZE, CONVERT, CALL TRANSFORMATION, DATA

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Zahl in einen String und formatieren Sie sie mit Tausendertrennzeichen und zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit der `NUMERIC` Formatierungsoption.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_number_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_number_to_string.
    rv_formatted_string = |{ iv_number COUNTRY = 'DE' }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_number_formatting FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_number_formatting.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_number_formatter( ).

    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_number_to_string( '1234567.89' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted number should match DE locale' act = lv_formatted exp = '1.234.567,89' ).

    lv_formatted = lo_formatter->format_number_to_string( '123.40' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted number should match DE locale' act = lv_formatted exp = '123,40' ).

    lv_formatted = lo_formatter->format_number_to_string( '0.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted number should match DE locale' act = lv_formatted exp = '0,00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates sind die moderne und bevorzugte Methode zur String-Formatierung in ABAP. Mit der Option `COUNTRY` kann die Formatierung an die länderspezifischen Einstellungen angepasst werden, was die Handhabung von Dezimal- und Tausendertrennzeichen vereinfacht und den Code lesbarer macht als ältere `WRITE TO` Anweisungen.
keywords: STRING TEMPLATE, CONVERT, FORMATTING, NUMERIC, COUNTRY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_NOTIFICATION_SENDER` mit einer abstrakten Methode `SEND_MESSAGE` und einer konkreten Methode `PREPARE_MESSAGE`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Unterklassen für E-Mail- und SMS-Benachrichtigungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Vererbung, um gemeinsame Logik in der abstrakten Klasse zu halten und spezifische Implementierungen in den Unterklassen zu erzwingen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_notification_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: prepare_message IMPORTING iv_raw_message TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_prepared_message) TYPE string,
             send_message ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_prepared_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_notification_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_message.
    " Gemeinsame Logik: Nachricht trimmen und mit Präfix versehen
    rv_prepared_message = |[NOTIFICATION] { to_upper( iv_raw_message ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_sender DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_notification_sender FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_message REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_message.
    " E-Mail-spezifische Sende-Logik (hier nur Ausgabe)
    WRITE: / 'Sending E-Mail:', iv_prepared_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sms_sender DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_notification_sender FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine Hash-Tabelle, um einen schnellen Zugriff über den Primärschlüssel zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_sflight_to_hash_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_sflight_to_hash_converter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für die Tabelle SFLIGHTS mit einer dynamisch erzeugten WHERE-Klausel. Verarbeiten Sie die gefetchten Daten effizient mit FIELD-SYMBOLS, um auf die Komponenten zuzugreifen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit dynamischer `WHERE`-Klausel und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_open_cursor_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_open_cursor_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight_line TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE (iv_where_clause).

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_line TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_open_cursor_fs( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( `carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ). " Assuming no 'AA' '0017' in SFLIGHTS by default, adjust if needed

    " Test with a known existing entry (e.g., from SFLIGHTS sample data)
    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( `carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` mit einer dynamischen `WHERE`-Klausel, was in Szenarien nützlich ist, in denen die Suchkriterien zur Laufzeit variieren. Die Daten werden zeilenweise gefetcht und in eine interne Tabelle eingefügt. Obwohl `FIELD-SYMBOLS` hier nicht direkt für die Zeilenverarbeitung verwendet werden (da `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` verwendet wird), ist das Konzept der effizienten Datenverarbeitung mit Cursorn und die Möglichkeit, dynamische SQL-Statements zu bilden, ein Kernaspekt moderner ABAP-Entwicklung für spezielle Anwendungsfälle.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, Dynamic SQL, WHERE clause, Database Access, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS und aktualisieren Sie den Preis für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft effizient mit FIELD-SYMBOLS. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` zur Überprüfung der Existenz einer Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>` und `LINE_EXISTS` für effiziente Modifikationen ohne Datenkopie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_loop_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_loop_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_fs_loop_update=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_loop_update( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    " Update prices for 'LH'
    lo_cut->update_flight_prices( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_new_price = '120.00' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    " Assertions
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price exp = '120.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-price exp = '200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-price exp = '120.00' ).

    " Test LINE_EXISTS (not directly in solution, but related to efficient table access)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'XX' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>` ist der effizienteste Weg, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und zu modifizieren, da keine Datenkopie stattfindet. Das `FIELD-SYMBOL` `<fs_flight>` zeigt direkt auf die Zeile in der internen Tabelle, wodurch Änderungen direkt wirksam werden. `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine moderne Tabellenfunktion, die effizient prüft, ob eine Zeile mit bestimmten Kriterien existiert.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, LOOP AT ASSIGNING, LINE_EXISTS, Performance

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie große Datenmengen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in Paketen (PACKAGE SIZE) mit OPEN CURSOR. Verarbeiten Sie jedes Paket mit FIELD-SYMBOLS für optimale Performance.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ... PACKAGE SIZE` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oc_package_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oc_package_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight_key.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
        " Process each flight in the package efficiently
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_all_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_package_fetch FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_package_fetch.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oc_package_fs( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_packages( 10 ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has at least some entries
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    " Verify that the number of fetched entries is reasonable (e.g., not zero)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).

    " Optional: Check if the order is maintained (due to ORDER BY)
    DATA: lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
          lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid,
          lv_prev_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-carrid GE lv_prev_carrid ).
        IF ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-connid GE lv_prev_connid ).
          IF ls_flight-connid = lv_prev_connid.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate GE lv_prev_fldate ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen aus der Datenbank. `OPEN CURSOR` in Verbindung mit `PACKAGE SIZE` ermöglicht das Fetching von Daten in handhabbaren Blöcken. Die anschließende `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`-Schleife verarbeitet diese Pakete ohne zusätzliche Datenkopie, was die Performance bei großen Datensätzen erheblich verbessert. `WITH HOLD` stellt sicher, dass der Cursor auch nach einem Commit/Rollback offen bleibt.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, PACKAGE SIZE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Large Data, Performance, Database Access

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur zu, deren Namen zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, unter Verwendung von FIELD-SYMBOLS.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (component_name) OF STRUCTURE (structure_name) TO <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data         TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data           TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error if new_value cannot be assigned to component type
          MESSAGE 'Conversion error' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_component_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_component_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_fs_component( ).
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_fs_component=>ty_data.

    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_data-field3 = sy-datum.

    " Test get_component_value
    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_value_not_found) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD_X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_not_found exp = 'Component not found' ).

    " Test set_component_value
    lo_cut->set_component_value( EXPORTING iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' iv_new_value = 'World' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'World' ).

    lo_cut->set_component_value( EXPORTING iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' iv_new_value = '456' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 456 ).

    " Test set with invalid component name (should not change data)
    lo_cut->set_component_value( EXPORTING iv_component_name = 'FIELD_Y' iv_new_value = 'abc' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'World' ). " Should remain 'World'
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TO <FS>` ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit auf Felder zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst dann bekannt sind. Instructions: Führen Sie eine aggregierte Abfrage auf SFLIGHTS mit GROUP BY und HAVING durch und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse mit FIELD-SYMBOLS.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`, dann `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ...` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oc_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_agg_sflight.
    TYPES tt_agg_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_agg_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oc_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_result_package TYPE tt_agg_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_agg_flight> TYPE ty_agg_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, SUM( price ) AS total_price, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
        FROM sflight
        GROUP BY carrid
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= iv_min_flights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_result_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_result_package ASSIGNING <fs_agg_flight>.
        APPEND <fs_agg_flight> TO rt_aggregated_data.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_result_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_agg_data ).

    " Check if all returned entries meet the HAVING condition
    LOOP AT lt_agg_data INTO DATA(ls_agg).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_agg-num_flights GE 2 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check a specific airline if known to exist with > 2 flights
    DATA(ls_lh_agg) = VALUE zcl_oc_group_having=>ty_agg_sflight( ).
    READ TABLE lt_agg_data INTO ls_lh_agg WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_agg-num_flights GE 2 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_agg-total_price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Aggregation direkt auf der Datenbank erfolgen soll, um die Datenmenge zu reduzieren, die an den Applikationsserver übertragen wird. Instructions: Suchen Sie effizient eine Zeile in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS basierend auf einem Schlüssel und greifen Sie mit FIELD-SYMBOLS darauf zu, um sie zu modifizieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod.
    TYPES tt_sflight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE tt_sflight_mod
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_currency.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_mod.

    READ TABLE ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-currency = iv_new_currency.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_and_update.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_fs_read_table=>tt_sflight_mod.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_read_table( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.

    " Update an existing flight
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_currency(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid = 'LH'
        iv_connid = '0400'
        iv_fldate = sy-datum
        iv_new_currency = 'CHF'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_updated ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'CHF' ).

    " Try to update a non-existing flight
    lv_updated = lo_cut->update_flight_currency(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid = 'BA'
        iv_connid = '0100'
        iv_fldate = sy-datum
        iv_new_currency = 'GBP'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_updated ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ). " Table size should not change
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <FS>` ist die bevorzugte Methode, um eine einzelne Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu finden und direkt zu modifizieren. Durch die Zuweisung an ein `FIELD-SYMBOL` wird die Zeile nicht kopiert, was zu einer besseren Performance führt, insbesondere bei großen Zeilenstrukturen. Dies ist ein Standardmuster für effiziente Tabellenoperationen in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie Zeilen einer internen Tabelle innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks unter Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für direkten Zugriff.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_status TYPE char10
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    ct_flights = FOR <fs_flight> IN ct_flights
                 WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                 ( VALUE #( <fs_flight> EXCEPT status ) " Copy all fields except status
                   status = iv_new_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_for_expression_update FOR TESTING.
