CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression_update.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_fs_for_expression=>tt_sflight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_for_expression( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum status = 'Planned' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum status = 'Delayed' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum status = 'Planned' ) TO lt_flights.

    " Update status for 'LH' flights
    lo_cut->update_flight_status( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_new_status = 'Confirmed' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    " Assertions
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Confirmed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Delayed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-status exp = 'Confirmed' ).

    " Verify count of updated items
    DATA(lv_confirmed_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE status = 'Confirmed'.
      lv_confirmed_count = lv_confirmed_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_confirmed_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` (`ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>)`) ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren oder zu modifizieren. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` zu schreiben, wird die Transformation direkt im Ausdruck vorgenommen. Das `FIELD-SYMBOL` erlaubt den direkten Zugriff auf die Zeilenkomponenten, während `VALUE #( <fs_flight> EXCEPT status )` eine elegante Möglichkeit bietet, alle Felder außer 'status' zu kopieren und 'status' neu zu setzen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, FOR expression, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, VALUE, EXCEPT

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie dynamisch Datenobjekte und Typen zur Laufzeit und weisen Sie diese FIELD-SYMBOLS zu, um generische Datenverarbeitung zu ermöglichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` oder `TYPE (type_name)` und `ASSIGN (name) TO <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_assign_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS create_and_assign_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_name TYPE string
        iv_num_lines      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_assign_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_data> = iv_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_assign_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_line_type_name) WITH EMPTY KEY.
        ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DO iv_num_lines TIMES.
            APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              " Optionally fill with some data
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp1>).
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <fs_comp1> = |Line { sy-index }|.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDDO.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Zuweisung an `FIELD-SYMBOLS` (`ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <FS>`) ist der Schlüssel, um mit diesen dynamisch erzeugten Objekten zu arbeiten. Instructions: Führen Sie zwei separate SELECT-Anweisungen auf SFLIGHTS aus und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse sequenziell mit OPEN CURSOR und FIELD-SYMBOLS, um eine UNION ALL-ähnliche Operation zu simulieren.
hint: Öffnen Sie zwei Cursor, fetchen Sie nacheinander alle Daten aus dem ersten, dann aus dem zweiten Cursor. Nutzen Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ...` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oc_union_all_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_union,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_union.
    TYPES tt_sflight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_union_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid1 TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrid2 TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oc_union_all_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_union_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor1 TYPE cursor,
          lv_cursor2 TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight_union.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_union.

    " Open first cursor
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor1 FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = iv_carrid1.

    " Fetch all from first cursor
    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor1 INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_combined_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor1.

    " Open second cursor
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor2 FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = iv_carrid2.

    " Fetch all from second cursor
    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor2 INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_combined_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oc_union_all_fs( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->get_union_flights( iv_carrid1 = 'LH' iv_carrid2 = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_combined ).

    " Count flights for LH and AA
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_combined INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has entries for LH and AA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_lh_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_aa_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = lv_lh_count + lv_aa_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert eine `UNION ALL`-Operation, indem es zwei separate `OPEN CURSOR`-Statements verwendet und deren Ergebnisse sequenziell in einer einzigen internen Tabelle sammelt. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Datenbank keine direkte `UNION`-Operation in einem `OPEN CURSOR` unterstützt oder wenn komplexere Logik zwischen den Fetch-Operationen erforderlich ist. Die Verwendung von `PACKAGE SIZE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` stellt sicher, dass auch hier große Datenmengen effizient verarbeitet werden.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, UNION ALL, Database Access, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Data Merging, Performance

CLASS zcl_oc_dyn_order_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ordered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_ordered.

    METHODS get_flights_ordered
      IMPORTING
        iv_order_by_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_ordered.

CLASS zcl_oc_dyn_order_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_ordered.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight_ordered.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_ordered.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY (iv_order_by_clause).

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_package.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_order_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_order_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oc_dyn_order_by( ).

    " Test order by carrid ascending
    DATA(lt_flights_carrid) = lo_cut->get_flights_ordered( 'carrid ASCENDING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_carrid ).
    IF lines( lt_flights_carrid ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights_carrid[ 1 ]-carrid LE lt_flights_carrid[ 2 ]-carrid ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test order by price descending
    DATA(lt_flights_price) = lo_cut->get_flights_ordered( 'price DESCENDING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_price ).
    IF lines( lt_flights_price ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights_price[ 1 ]-price GE lt_flights_price[ 2 ]-price ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test with an invalid order by clause (should still return data, but order might be undefined or error)
    " Note: The database might handle invalid ORDER BY differently, often ignoring it or causing an error.
    " For this test, we assume it either works or returns data without specific order.
    DATA(lt_flights_invalid) = lo_cut->get_flights_ordered( 'INVALID_COLUMN ASCENDING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_invalid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Flexibilität von `OPEN CURSOR` in Kombination mit dynamischen `ORDER BY`-Klauseln. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Sortierreihenfolge der Daten zur Laufzeit vom Benutzer oder von der Anwendung bestimmt wird. Instructions: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in einer `REDUCE`-Expression, um einen aggregierten Wert aus einer internen Tabelle zu berechnen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
      NEXT total = total + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_reduce_expression( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '450.00' ).

    " Test with empty table
    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_fs_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

      IMPORTING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_filtered_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_filtered.

    LOOP AT it_filtered_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      " Example processing: just count them
      rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
      " In a real scenario, <fs_flight> could be used to read/modify data
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT` mit `JOIN` über `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` aus, indem Sie `OPEN CURSOR` verwenden, und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `JOIN` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ...` mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oc_join_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oc_join_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_flight_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_info.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
        FROM sflight AS s
        INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
        WHERE s~carrid = iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_flight_details.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_detail-cityfrom ).

Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Ergebnisse eines Joins in Paketen verarbeitet werden müssen oder wenn dynamische Elemente in der `JOIN`-Klausel oder `WHERE`-Klausel vorhanden sind. Die Kombination mit `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ... PACKAGE SIZE` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>` gewährleistet eine effiziente und performante Verarbeitung der verbundenen Daten.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in einer `GROUP BY`-Expression für interne Tabellen, um Daten zu gruppieren und aggregierte Werte zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_GROUP>)` und `LOOP AT GROUP <FS_GROUP> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_MEMBER>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_group_by_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_group.
    TYPES tt_sflight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_group_by_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group> TYPE ty_sflight_group.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_member> TYPE ty_sflight_group.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO <fs_group> GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid ASCENDING
                                       ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_header>).
      DATA(ls_grouped_entry) = VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid = <fs_group_header>-carrid
        num_flights = lines( GROUP <fs_group_header> )
      ).

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group_header> ASSIGNING <fs_member>.
        ls_grouped_entry-total_price = ls_grouped_entry-total_price + <fs_member>-price.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '120.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    " Check LH group
    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-num_flights exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-total_price exp = '250.00' ).

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ist eine der mächtigsten Neuerungen in ABAP 7.40+ für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` (`ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_GROUP>)` und `LOOP AT GROUP <FS_GROUP> ASSIGNING <FS_MEMBER>`) ist hierbei entscheidend, um effizient auf die Gruppenköpfe und die einzelnen Mitglieder einer Gruppe zuzugreifen, ohne unnötige Datenkopien zu verursachen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CREATE DATA` für die Zeilenstruktur, dann `ASSIGN` und `APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <FS_TABLE> ASSIGNING <FS_LINE>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
        it_data_rows         TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lr_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_dynamic_line  TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component>     TYPE any.

    " 1. Create dynamic structure components
    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_field_def-name
                      type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( ls_field_def-type ) )
        TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic structure type
    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_table_descr.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 3. Create dynamic table type
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr
                                                 p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                                 p_unique = abap_false ).

    " 4. Create dynamic table data object
    CREATE DATA lr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 5. Fill dynamic table with data
    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_row_data).
      CREATE DATA lr_dynamic_line LIKE LINE OF <fs_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_dynamic_line->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( FOR <s_val> IN split( val = lv_row_data sep = ',' ) ( <s_val> ) ).
      DATA(lv_comp_idx) = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_comp_idx OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          TRY.
              <fs_component> = lt_values[ lv_comp_idx ].
            CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
              " Handle conversion error
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.
        lv_comp_idx = lv_comp_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario, das oft in generischen Datenverarbeitungsprogrammen oder bei der Integration mit externen Systemen benötigt wird. Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit einer dynamischen `FROM`-Klausel (Tabellenname) und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit dynamischem Tabellennamen und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ...` mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oc_dyn_from DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_table_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        it_fields     TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_dynamic_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oc_dyn_from IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_data.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_dynamic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ty_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lv_field_list TYPE string.

    " Construct dynamic field list
    lv_field_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR field IN it_fields
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && ',' && field )
    ).

    IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
      " Handle error: no fields specified
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Open cursor with dynamic table name and field list
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT (lv_field_list)
        FROM (iv_table_name).

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING <fs_data>.
        APPEND <fs_data> TO rt_data.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_from FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_from.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oc_dyn_from( ).

    DATA: lt_fields TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_fields.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_fields.

    " Test with SFLIGHT table
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_data(
      iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      it_fields     = lt_fields
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflight_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_sflight_data ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflight_data[ 1 ]-field1 ). " Check if first field is filled
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflight_data[ 1 ]-field2 ). " Check if second field is filled

    " Test with a non-existent table
    DATA(lt_empty_data) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_data(
      iv_table_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE'
      it_fields     = lt_fields
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_empty_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in einer `VALUE`-Expression, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer bestehenden zu erstellen und dabei Zeilen zu transformieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR <fs_source> IN it_source ... ( VALUE #( ... ) ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_value_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id  TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_target.
    TYPES tt_sflight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight_source
        iv_price_factor   TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_value_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_source> IN it_source_flights
                                 ( VALUE #( airline_id     = <fs_source>-carrid
                                            flight_id      = <fs_source>-connid
                                            flight_date    = <fs_source>-fldate
                                            adjusted_price = <fs_source>-price * iv_price_factor ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_value_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_value_transformation.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_fs_value_expression=>tt_sflight_source.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_value_expression( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_flights( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_price_factor = '1.1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).

    " Check first transformed flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-adjusted_price exp = '110.00' ).

    " Check second transformed flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-airline_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-adjusted_price exp = '220.00' ).

    " Test with empty source table
    CLEAR lt_source.
    lt_target = lo_cut->transform_flights( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_price_factor = '1.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE`-Expression mit `FOR` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist ein Eckpfeiler der funktionalen Programmierung in modernem ABAP. Sie ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Durch die Verwendung von `FOR <fs_source> IN it_source_flights` wird jede Zeile der Quelltabelle über ein `FIELD-SYMBOL` referenziert, was einen direkten und effizienten Zugriff auf die Daten ermöglicht, ohne dass eine explizite `LOOP` oder temporäre Arbeitsbereiche erforderlich sind. Dies führt zu sehr prägnantem und leistungsstarkem Code für Tabellentransformationen.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT` mit `CLIENT SPECIFIED` und `OPEN CURSOR` aus, um mandantenübergreifende Daten aus `SFLIGHT` abzurufen, und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `CLIENT SPECIFIED` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ...` mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oc_client_specified DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_client,
             mandt    TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_client.
    TYPES tt_sflight_client TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_client WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_client_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_client.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oc_client_specified IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_client_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight_client.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_client.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT mandt, carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight CLIENT SPECIFIED.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_client_specified FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_client_specified.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oc_client_specified( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_client_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    " Check if at least one entry has a client (mandt) value
    DATA(lv_found_mandt) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-mandt IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_found_mandt = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_mandt ).

    " Verify that the current client's data is also included
    DATA(lv_current_client_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO ls_flight WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.
      lv_current_client_found = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_current_client_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CLIENT SPECIFIED`-Klausel in `SELECT`-Anweisungen ist entscheidend, wenn mandantenübergreifende Daten aus einer mandantenabhängigen Tabelle abgerufen werden müssen. In Kombination mit `OPEN CURSOR` ermöglicht dies die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Mengen solcher Daten in Paketen. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` beim Iterieren über die gefetchten Pakete stellt sicher, dass die Daten ohne unnötige Kopien verarbeitet werden, was die Performance bei der Analyse mandantenübergreifender Datensätze verbessert.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, CLIENT SPECIFIED, Database Access, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Cross-Client

CLASS zcl_sflight_binary_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_sflight_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_sflight_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    lt_sorted_flights = it_sflights.

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN line_exists( lt_sorted_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] )
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_loop_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_loop_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    lt_sorted_flights = it_all_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregiere Flugdaten (z.B. Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) in einer sortierten internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `COLLECT`.

CLASS zcl_sflight_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS summarize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights.
    LOOP AT it_raw_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        count  = 1
      ) INTO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND ls_raw TO lt_raw.

Wenn die Zieltabelle eine `SORTED TABLE` mit einem passenden eindeutigen Schlüssel ist, kann die interne Implementierung von `COLLECT` von der Sortierung profitieren, ähnlich wie bei einer binären Suche für die Einfügeposition, was die Performance bei großen Datenmengen verbessert.

CLASS zcl_sflight_value_for_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_detail.
    TYPES tt_sflight_detail TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_detail WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_enriched,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_enriched.
    TYPES tt_sflight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS enrich_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_keys    TYPE tt_sflight_key
        it_details TYPE tt_sflight_detail
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_value_for_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD enrich_flights.
    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_key IN it_keys
      LET ls_detail = VALUE ty_sflight_detail(
                          it_details[ carrid = ls_key-carrid connid = ls_key-connid ]
                        )
      IN
        ( COND #( WHEN ls_detail IS NOT INITIAL
                   THEN VALUE ty_sflight_enriched(
                          carrid    = ls_key-carrid
                          connid    = ls_key-connid
                          fldate    = ls_detail-fldate
                          planetype = ls_detail-planetype
                        )
                   ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value ) " Oder leeren Eintrag zurückgeben
                 )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Index eines Eintrags in einer sortierten internen Tabelle mit `GET REFERENCE` und Tabellen-Expressions.
hint: Verwende `GET REFERENCE OF` mit einer Tabellen-Expression, um einen Zeiger auf den Eintrag zu erhalten und dann den Index zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_get_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_get_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_index.
    DATA lt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    lt_sorted_flights = it_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid connid.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        GET REFERENCE OF lt_sorted_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] INTO DATA(lr_flight).
        ASSIGN lr_flight->* TO <fs_flight>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_index = sy-tabix.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_index = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ).
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING it_carrid_range WHERE carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_filter_table( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).

explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Kriterien, einschließlich Range-Tabellen, zu filtern. Er ist deklarativ und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

CLASS zcl_rng_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD is_carrid_in_range.
    rv_is_in_range = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_carrid_range WHERE low = iv_carrid ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_line_exists( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierzahlen für alle Flüge, die in einer gegebenen Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_range,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid_range.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_passengers_in_range
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        it_carrid_range TYPE tt_carrid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_passengers_in_range.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR <fs> IN FILTER #( it_sflights USING it_carrid_range WHERE carrid )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + <fs>-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_rng_dynamic_create=>tt_carrid_range(
                               ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
                               ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->sum_passengers_in_range(
                           it_sflights     = lt_sflights
                           it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = 300 " 100 (AA) + 150 (LH) + 50 (AA)
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `REDUCE` und `FILTER` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und funktionale Art, Daten zu aggregieren. `REDUCE` iteriert über die gefilterte Tabelle und akkumuliert einen Wert, was den Code prägnant und effizient macht.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen und Typen aller Komponenten einer gegebenen Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_info) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_info.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(ls_info) = VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( )
      ).
      APPEND ls_info TO rt_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp1-type exp = 'STRING' ).
    READ TABLE lt_info INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp2-name exp = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp2-type exp = 'I' ).

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_component IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, deren Zeilentyp der Struktur einer vorhandenen Variablen entspricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO <fs_source_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get structure description of the source data
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_data> ).

    " Create a table type description based on the structure
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                       p_line_type  = lr_struct_descr
                       p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                       p_unique     = abap_false
                     ).

    " Create data reference for the new dynamic table
    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strukturen dynamisch Komponente für Komponente und identifizieren Sie Unterschiede. Die Strukturen können unterschiedliche Typen haben, aber Komponenten mit gleichem Namen und kompatiblem Typ sollen verglichen werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` für beide Strukturen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Vergleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_diff,
             component_name TYPE string,
             value1         TYPE string,
             value2         TYPE string,
           END OF ty_diff.
    TYPES tt_diff TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_diff WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare
      IMPORTING
        ir_struct1 TYPE REF TO data
        ir_struct2 TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_differences) TYPE tt_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct1> TYPE any,
                   <fs_struct2> TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp1>   TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp2>   TYPE any.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_struct_descr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    ASSIGN ir_struct1->* TO <fs_struct1>.
    ASSIGN ir_struct2->* TO <fs_struct2>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lr_struct_descr1 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_struct1> ).
    lr_struct_descr2 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_struct2> ).

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr1->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp_info1).
      " Try to assign component from struct1
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_info1-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct1> TO <fs_comp1>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CONTINUE. " Should not happen if RTTI is correct
      ENDIF.

      " Try to assign component from struct2 with the same name
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_info1-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct2> TO <fs_comp2>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Component exists in both structures
        " Compare values (type compatibility is assumed by ASSIGN)
        IF <fs_comp1> <> <fs_comp2>.
          APPEND VALUE ty_diff(
            component_name = ls_comp_info1-name
            value1         = <fs_comp1>
            value2         = <fs_comp2>
          ) TO rt_differences.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_equal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_compare_diff FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_compare_different_structs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_equal.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct.
    DATA(ls_s1) = VALUE ty_struct( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 ).
    DATA(ls_s2) = VALUE ty_struct( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_structs( ).
    DATA(lt_diff) = lo_cut->compare( ir_struct1 = REF #( ls_s1 ) ir_struct2 = REF #( ls_s2 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_diff ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_compare_diff.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct.
    DATA(ls_s1) = VALUE ty_struct( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 ).
    DATA(ls_s2) = VALUE ty_struct( field1 = 'B' field2 = 2 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_structs( ).
    DATA(lt_diff) = lo_cut->compare( ir_struct1 = REF #( ls_s1 ) ir_struct2 = REF #( ls_s2 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_diff ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_diff WITH KEY component_name = 'FIELD1' INTO DATA(ls_diff1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff1-value1 exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff1-value2 exp = 'B' ).
    READ TABLE lt_diff WITH KEY component_name = 'FIELD2' INTO DATA(ls_diff2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff2-value1 exp = '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff2-value2 exp = '2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_compare_different_structs.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_a,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_a.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_b,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_struct_b.
    DATA(ls_s1) = VALUE ty_struct_a( field1 = 'X' field2 = 10 ).
    DATA(ls_s2) = VALUE ty_struct_b( field1 = 'Y' field3 = 'ABC' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_structs( ).
    DATA(lt_diff) = lo_cut->compare( ir_struct1 = REF #( ls_s1 ) ir_struct2 = REF #( ls_s2 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_diff ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_diff INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_diff).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff-component_name exp = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff-value1 exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff-value2 exp = 'Y' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine WHERE-Klausel für eine SELECT-Anweisung basierend auf den nicht-initialen Feldern einer Eingabestruktur. Die Feldnamen der Struktur müssen den Spaltennamen der Datenbanktabelle entsprechen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in Kombination mit `CONDENSE` und `REDUCE` für die WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_where_clause
      IMPORTING
        ir_selection_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_where_clause.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_selection_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component_value> TYPE any.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_where_parts  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    ASSIGN ir_selection_data->* TO <fs_selection_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_selection_data> ).

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_selection_data> TO <fs_component_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_component_value> IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(lv_value_string) = |'{ <fs_component_value> }'|. " Quote string values
        APPEND |{ ls_component-name } = { lv_value_string }| TO lt_where_parts.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_where_parts IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR w IN lt_where_parts NEXT s = CONDENSE( |{ s } AND { w }| ) ).
      " Remove leading 'AND' if present
      IF rv_where_clause CS 'AND'.
        rv_where_clause = rv_where_clause+4.
      ENDIF.
      CONDENSE rv_where_clause.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name als String übergeben wird, und ändern Sie deren Wert.

CLASS zcl_fsym_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data        TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Assigning a string to <fs_component> will cause implicit type conversion
      " This might lead to runtime errors if types are incompatible (e.g., string to date)
      " For robust solutions, RTTI should be used to check type compatibility first.
      <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über alle Komponenten einer Struktur und sammeln Sie deren Werte in einer internen Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_loop_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name_value.
    TYPES tt_name_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_name_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_component_values
      IMPORTING
        ir_data        TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_name_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_loop_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_component_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_structure> ).

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component_info).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component_info-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_name_value(
          name  = ls_component_info-name
          value = <fs_component>
        ) TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten zwischen zwei Strukturen, die unterschiedliche Feldnamen, aber kompatible Datentypen haben. Verwenden Sie eine Mapping-Tabelle für die Feldnamen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für Quell- und Zielstruktur basierend auf einer Mapping-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_generic_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapping,
             source_field TYPE string,
             target_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapping.
    TYPES tt_mapping TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapping WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
        ir_target_data TYPE REF TO data
        it_mapping     TYPE tt_mapping.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_generic_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO <fs_source_struct>.
    ASSIGN ir_target_data->* TO <fs_target_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_mapping INTO DATA(ls_map).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_map-source_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_struct> TO <fs_source_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_map-target_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_struct> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Transfer value (implicit type conversion if compatible)
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsym_generic_transfer( ).
    lo_cut->transfer_data(
      ir_source_data = REF #( ls_source )

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_field1 exp = 'Value1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_field3 exp = 'Old' ). " Unmapped field unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen, die in einem String vorkommen, und geben Sie sie als Liste zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit `FIND_ALL` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_all_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\d+' ). " Matches one or more digits
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_match( ) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `Text with 123 and 45 numbers. Also 678.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( '123' ) ( '45' ) ( '678' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_numbers( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `No numbers here.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_numbers( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FIND_NEXT`-Methode des `CL_ABAP_MATCHER`-Objekts iteriert durch alle Vorkommen des Musters im String. `GET_MATCH` liefert den gefundenen Teilstring. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um alle Treffer zu extrahieren, ohne den String mehrfach durchsuchen zu müssen.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, CL_ABAP_MATCHER, FIND_NEXT, GET_MATCH, Extraction

CLASS zcl_find_regex_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number_info,
             value    TYPE string,
             offset   TYPE i,
             length   TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_find_regex_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_number.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(ls_match).

      rs_number_info-offset = ls_match-offset.

  ENDMETHOD.

    TYPES: ty_time_relation TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_time_relation,
                 past    TYPE ty_time_relation VALUE 'PAST',
                 present TYPE ty_time_relation VALUE 'PRESENT',
                 future  TYPE ty_time_relation VALUE 'FUTURE',
               END OF gc_time_relation.

    METHODS get_time_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_relation) TYPE ty_time_relation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_time_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_time_relation.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_system_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lo_given_tstmp) = NEW cl_abap_tstmp( iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_current_tstmp) = NEW cl_abap_tstmp( lv_current_tstmp ).

    DATA(lv_difference_seconds) = lo_given_tstmp->difference( lo_current_tstmp ).

    IF lv_difference_seconds < 0.
      rv_relation = gc_time_relation-past.
    ELSE IF lv_difference_seconds > 0.
      rv_relation = gc_time_relation-future.
    ELSE.
      rv_relation = gc_time_relation-present.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Hashtags (Wörter, die mit '#' beginnen) aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` mit einer Schleife, um alle Treffer zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_hashtags DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_hashtags
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashtags) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_hashtags IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_hashtags.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '#\w+' ). " Matches # followed by one or more word characters
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_match( ) TO rt_hashtags.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Wochentag (z.B. Montag, Dienstag) für einen gegebenen Zeitstempel in einer bestimmten Zeitzone.
hint: Konvertieren Sie den Zeitstempel zuerst in ein lokales Datum und verwenden Sie dann `CL_ABAP_DATE_TIME_UTILITIES` oder eine ähnliche Funktion für den Wochentag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_weekday_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_weekday TYPE c LENGTH 10.

    METHODS get_weekday_from_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        iv_utc_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_tzone         TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday) TYPE ty_weekday.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_weekday_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_from_tstmp.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_local_time(
      EXPORTING
        utclong = iv_utc_timestamp
        tzone   = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        date    = lv_date
        time    = lv_time
    ).

    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_weekday( lv_date ).

    CASE lv_day_of_week.
      WHEN 1. rv_weekday = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN 2. rv_weekday = 'Montag'.
      WHEN 3. rv_weekday = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN 4. rv_weekday = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN 5. rv_weekday = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN 6. rv_weekday = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN 7. rv_weekday = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN OTHERS. rv_weekday = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_weekday_est FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday_cet.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_weekday_calc( ).
    " UTC: 2023-11-26 10:00:00 (Sunday in UTC)
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20231126100000.0000000'.
    " CET is UTC+1, so 2023-11-26 11:00:00 (Sunday in CET)
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_weekday_from_tstmp( iv_utc_timestamp = lv_utc_tstmp iv_tzone = 'CET' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Sonntag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_weekday_est.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_weekday_calc( ).
    " UTC: 2023-11-26 10:00:00 (Sunday in UTC)

    " EST is UTC-5, so 2023-11-26 05:00:00 (Sunday in EST)
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_weekday_from_tstmp( iv_utc_timestamp = lv_utc_tstmp iv_tzone = 'EST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Sonntag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Zeitstempelkonvertierung von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` mit der Datumsfunktionalität von `CL_ABAP_DATE_TIME_UTILITIES`. Zuerst wird der UTC-Zeitstempel in ein lokales Datum umgewandelt, und dann wird der Wochentag dieses Datums bestimmt. Dies ist ein moderner Ansatz zur Handhabung komplexer Datums- und Zeitberechnungen.
keywords: TIMESTAMP, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Weekday, Date/Time, Conversion, Time Zone

Instructions: Überprüfe zur Laufzeit, ob eine Variable einen numerischen Typ hat.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data()` und vergleiche `type_kind` mit den Konstanten für numerische Typen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_is_numeric DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_numeric
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_numeric IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_numeric.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).

    rv_is_numeric = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int1 OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int2 OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int4 OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int8 OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_packed OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_float OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_decfloat16 OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_decfloat34
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutze `cl_abap_elemdescr` für Typinformationen und `CASE` oder `COND` für typspezifische String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_string.
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).

    CASE lo_elem_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_date.
        rv_string = |{ iv_data DATE = USER }|. " Format date according to user settings
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_time.
        rv_string = |{ iv_data TIME = USER }|. " Format time according to user settings
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_packed OR cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_float OR cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_decfloat16 OR cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_decfloat34.
        rv_string = |{ iv_data CURRENCY = 'EUR' DECIMALS = 2 }|. " Example: format as currency with 2 decimals
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_string = |{ iv_data }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine zirkuläre Verschiebung (Rotation) der Zeichen in einem String um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen durch.
hint: Kombiniere `SUBSTRING` und String-Templates, da `SHIFT` keine direkte Rotationsfunktion bietet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_rotate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS rotate_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_offset       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rotated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_rotate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD rotate_string.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    IF lv_length = 0 OR iv_offset = 0.
      rv_rotated_string = iv_input_string.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_offset) = iv_offset MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_actual_offset < 0.
      lv_actual_offset = lv_length + lv_actual_offset.
    ENDIF.

    " Split the string into two parts and concatenate them in reverse order
    DATA(lv_part1) = substring( val = iv_input_string off = lv_actual_offset len = lv_length - lv_actual_offset ).
    DATA(lv_part2) = substring( val = iv_input_string off = 0 len = lv_actual_offset ).

    rv_rotated_string = |{ lv_part1 }{ lv_part2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetze alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in einem String durch ein anderes Zeichen, indem du `SHIFT` in einer Schleife verwendest.
hint: Nutze `FIND` in einer Schleife, um die Positionen des Zeichens zu finden, und `SHIFT` um das Zeichen zu ersetzen. Moderner wäre `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_replace_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_char_with_shift
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_char     TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_char     TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_replace_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_char_with_shift.
    rv_modified_string = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    DO.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_old_char IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF rv_modified_string.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_modified_string+lv_offset(1) = iv_new_char.
        lv_offset = lv_offset + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verschiebe einen String so, dass ein bestimmtes Muster am Anfang steht, und fülle den Rest mit einem Füllzeichen auf.
hint: Kombiniere `FIND` und `SHIFT` mit `FILLING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_pattern_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS align_to_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_pattern      TYPE string
        iv_fill_char    TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_aligned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_pattern_start IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD align_to_pattern.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_pattern IN iv_input_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_aligned_string = iv_input_string.
      SHIFT rv_aligned_string LEFT BY lv_offset PLACES.
      " Now the pattern is at the beginning, fill the rest if needed
      DATA(lv_current_length) = strlen( rv_aligned_string ).
      DATA(lv_original_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
      IF lv_current_length < lv_original_length.
        DATA(lv_fill_count) = lv_original_length - lv_current_length.
        rv_aligned_string = |{ rv_aligned_string }{ repeat( val = iv_fill_char occ = lv_fill_count ) }|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Pattern not found, return original string or handle error
      rv_aligned_string = iv_input_string.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_db.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight_db WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_city_from AND cityto = iv_city_to AND connid > iv_connid_min ) ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen und Typen aller Felder einer gegebenen Struktur.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_fields
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_fields.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    CHECK lo_descr IS INSTANCE OF cl_abap_structdescr.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_field_info( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) TO rt_field_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_struct> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Invalid data reference
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_any>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_any>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die ersten N Zeilen einer bestehenden Tabelle enthält.

CLASS zcl_itb_take_n_rows DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_n_rows
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_n      TYPE i

        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.

CLASS zcl_itb_take_n_rows IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_rows.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_n FROM 1 THEN i + 1
                           WHILE i <= lines( it_source ) ( it_source[ i ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
