Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED TABLE mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel und fügen Sie Daten ein. Greifen Sie anschließend effizient auf einen Eintrag zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ... SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` für die Definition und `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ...` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sorted_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_and_read
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE ty_sorted_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO rs_sflight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_existing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_access( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->create_and_read( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Price should match for existing entry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_access( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->create_and_read( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: SORTED TABLES bieten eine performante Möglichkeit, Daten zu speichern und über ihren Schlüssel zuzugreifen. Der `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY` Zugriff ist bei SORTED TABLES binär und daher sehr effizient. Die `VALUE` Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte Initialisierung der Tabelle.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Table, READ TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, VALUE Expression

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine SORTED TABLE basierend auf einer Bedingung und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `FOR` expressions.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` um die Filterung und Transformation in einem Schritt durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sorted_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sorted_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sorted_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE ty_sorted_sflights(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( price >= iv_min_price )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_price( '150.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should return 3 flights with price >= 150' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Second flight should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Third flight should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR` Expression in Kombination mit `WHERE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP` Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR Expression, Internal Table, Filtering, VALUE Expression

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8-String in eine Legacy-Codepage (z.B. '1100' für Latin-1) und behandeln Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_codepage_converter_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_to_legacy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
        iv_codepage    TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_legacy_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_to_legacy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_legacy.
    TRY.
        rv_legacy_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
          text      = iv_utf8_string
          codepage  = iv_codepage
          endian    = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder erneutes Werfen der Ausnahme
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_to_legacy( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_string) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜäöüß'.
    DATA(lv_codepage) = '1100'. " Latin-1
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = X'48656C6C6F20576F726C642120C4D6DC64F6FCDF'. " Expected Latin-1 hex representation

    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_legacy( iv_utf8_string = lv_utf8_string iv_codepage = lv_codepage ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring msg = 'Conversion to Latin-1 should be successful' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_to_legacy( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_string) = 'String with invalid character for codepage 4103: 🚀'. " Rocket emoji is not in 4103
    DATA(lv_codepage) = '4103'. " Some specific legacy codepage

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_codepage_converter_error ).
    lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_legacy( iv_utf8_string = lv_utf8_string iv_codepage = lv_codepage ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_codepage` bietet eine standardisierte und robuste Möglichkeit zur Konvertierung zwischen verschiedenen Zeichensätzen. CLASS zcl_codepage_from_legacy IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: ty_item_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_total_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                             FOR ls_item IN it_items

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit gleichen Feldnamen unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `target_structure = CORRESPONDING #( source_structure )` oder `target_table = CORRESPONDING #( source_table )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
             flag   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING flag = status ).
    IF is_source-status = 'X'.
      rs_target-flag = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rs_target-flag = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING flag = status ).
    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      READ TABLE it_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF <fs_source>-status = 'X'.
        <fs_target>-flag = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        <fs_target>-flag = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>ty_source_data(
      id = 1 name = 'Test Item' amount = '123.45' status = 'X'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 1 msg = 'ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Test Item' msg = 'Name should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-amount exp = '123.45' msg = 'Amount should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-flag exp = abap_true msg = 'Flag should be true for status X' ).

    ls_source-status = ' '.
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-flag exp = abap_false msg = 'Flag should be false for status space' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item 1' amount = '10.00' status = 'X' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item 2' amount = '20.00' status = ' ' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item 3' amount = '30.00' status = 'X' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-flag exp = abap_true msg = 'Item 1 flag should be true' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[2]-flag exp = abap_false msg = 'Item 2 flag should be false' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[3]-flag exp = abap_true msg = 'Item 3 flag should be true' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ermöglicht eine einfache und effiziente Zuweisung von Werten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, deren Komponenten gleiche Namen haben. Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel können Feldnamen explizit zugeordnet oder umbenannt werden. Dies reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand erheblich und ist eine moderne Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structure Assignment, Internal Table, Data Transfer, MAPPING

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen von Unterklassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter dynamisch erzeugt. Nutzen Sie dabei `NEW` mit Typ-Referenz.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (lv_class_name)` oder moderner `NEW #( )` mit dynamischer Typbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zif_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_shape_type TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_shape_type,
                 circle TYPE ty_shape_type VALUE 'CIRCLE',
                 square TYPE ty_shape_type VALUE 'SQUARE',
               END OF gc_shape_type.

    CLASS-METHODS create_shape
      IMPORTING
        iv_shape_type TYPE ty_shape_type
        iv_param      TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_shape) TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_shape.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = |ZCL_{ iv_shape_type }|.

    TRY.
        CASE iv_shape_type.
          WHEN gc_shape_type-circle.
            ro_shape = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = iv_param ).
          WHEN gc_shape_type-square.
            ro_shape = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = iv_param ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Einträge einer internen Tabelle nach einem Feld und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen mit `LOOP AT GROUP`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( field1 field2 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_data,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_data.
    TYPES: ty_sales_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_region
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE ty_sales_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_sales_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_region.
    DATA: ls_summary_line TYPE ty_sales_data.

    LOOP AT it_sales_data INTO DATA(ls_sales)
         GROUP BY ls_sales-region
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      ls_summary_line-region = ls_group_key-region.
      ls_summary_line-product = 'Total'.
      ls_summary_line-amount = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0
                                                  FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_sales
                                                  NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-amount ).
      APPEND ls_summary_line TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_region FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_region.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sales) = VALUE zcl_group_by_table=>ty_sales_table(
      ( region = 'North' product = 'A' amount = '100.00' )
      ( region = 'South' product = 'B' amount = '150.00' )
      ( region = 'North' product = 'C' amount = '200.00' )
      ( region = 'East'  product = 'A' amount = '50.00' )
      ( region = 'South' product = 'D' amount = '75.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 summary lines (one per region)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[1]-region exp = 'North' msg = 'First region should be North' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[1]-amount exp = '300.00' msg = 'North total should be 300' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[2]-region exp = 'South' msg = 'Second region should be South' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[2]-amount exp = '225.00' msg = 'South total should be 225' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_table( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_sales) = VALUE zcl_group_by_table=>ty_sales_table( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_empty_sales ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary IS INITIAL exp = abap_true msg = 'Summary of empty table should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50, ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion zur Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten nach einem oder mehreren Kriterien zu gruppieren und dann innerhalb jeder Gruppe weitere Operationen (wie hier die Summenbildung mit `REDUCE`) durchzuführen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Alternative zu manuellen Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`.
keywords: Internal Table, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP, REDUCE, Aggregation

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Feldes einer Struktur dynamisch zur Laufzeit, dessen Name als String übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie Field-Symbols mit der `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_field_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein String eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse enthält. Eine E-Mail-Adresse muss mindestens ein '@' und einen '.' nach dem '@' enthalten.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem String, der das Format 'Name: [Vorname] [Nachname], Alter: [Alter]' hat, den Vornamen, Nachnamen und das Alter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und die Methode `match` mit `get_submatches`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person_data,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
             age        TYPE i,
           END OF ty_person_data.

    METHODS extract_person_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_person) TYPE ty_person_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_person_data.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_instance(
      pattern = 'Name: (\w+) (\w+), Alter: (\d+)' ).

    IF lo_regex->match( iv_text ).
      DATA(lt_submatches) = lo_regex->get_submatches( ).
      IF lines( lt_submatches ) >= 3.
        rs_person-first_name = lt_submatches[ 1 ]-offset.
        rs_person-last_name  = lt_submatches[ 2 ]-offset.
        rs_person-age        = CONV i( lt_submatches[ 3 ]-offset ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Telefonnummern im Format '+XX YYYY ZZZZZZ' (wobei X, Y, Z Ziffern sind) in einem längeren Text und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` und die Methode `find_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_find_phones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_phone_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_phone_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find_phones IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_phone_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_instance( pattern = '\+\d{2} \d{4} \d{6}' ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_regex->find_all( iv_text ).

    rt_phone_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( '+49 176 123456' ) ( '+41 79 987654' ) ( '+49 89 112233' ) ).

CLASS zcl_format_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE string,
             price      TYPE string,
             currency   TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_display) TYPE tt_sflight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_sflights.
    rt_sflights_display = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                   ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                     fldate   = cl_abap_format=>date_2_ext( ls_sflight-fldate )
                                     price    = cl_abap_format=>currency_2_ext( amount = ls_sflight-price currency = ls_sflight-currency )
                                     currency = ls_sflight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_empty_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid   = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid   = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate   = '20231225'.
    ls_sflight-price    = '1234.56'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid   = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid   = '0017'.
    ls_sflight-fldate   = '20240101'.
    ls_sflight-price    = '987.65'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_formatted) = lo_cut->format_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_formatted ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two entries should be formatted' ).

    DATA(ls_expected_eur) = VALUE zcl_format_sflights=>ty_sflight_display(
      carrid   = 'LH'
      connid   = '0400'
      fldate   = '25.12.2023'
      price    = '1.234,56'
      currency = 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 1 ] exp = ls_expected_eur msg = 'First flight formatted incorrectly' ).

    DATA(ls_expected_usd) = VALUE zcl_format_sflights=>ty_sflight_display(
      carrid   = 'AA'
      connid   = '0017'
      fldate   = '01.01.2024'
      price    = '987.65'
      currency = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 2 ] exp = ls_expected_usd msg = 'Second flight formatted incorrectly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_format_empty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_formatted) = lo_cut->format_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_formatted msg = 'Empty table should result in empty formatted table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks in Kombination mit `VALUE` können die Daten der internen Tabelle effizient iteriert und die Felder `fldate` und `price` mit den entsprechenden `cl_abap_format`-Methoden formatiert werden. Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen, aus einem gegebenen Satz und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_capital_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_capital_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_capitalized_words.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_instance( pattern = '\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b' ). " \b for word boundary, [A-Z] for capital start, [a-zA-Z]* for rest of word
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_regex->find_all( iv_sentence ).

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( substring( val = iv_sentence off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Wortgrenzen (`\b`) stellen sicher, dass nur ganze Wörter erfasst werden. Die Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, die Ergebnisse zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges IPv4-Adressformat hat (z.B. '192.168.1.1').
hint: Erstellen Sie ein präzises Regex-Muster für IPv4 und verwenden Sie `match`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_ipv4
      IMPORTING
        iv_ip_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_ipv4.
    " Regex for IPv4: Each octet 0-255
    DATA(lv_octet) = '(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_instance(
      pattern = |^{ lv_octet }\.{ lv_octet }\.{ lv_octet }\.{ lv_octet }$| ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_regex->match( iv_ip_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_validate( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1' ) msg = 'Valid IPv4 should be true' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '0.0.0.0' ) msg = 'Valid IPv4 (zero) should be true' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '255.255.255.255' ) msg = 'Valid IPv4 (max) should be true' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '10.0.0.1' ) msg = 'Valid IPv4 (private) should be true' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_validate( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '256.0.0.0' ) msg = 'Invalid octet (too high)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1' ) msg = 'Too few octets' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1.1' ) msg = 'Too many octets' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1a' ) msg = 'Invalid character' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168..1' ) msg = 'Double dot' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_validate( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( ' 192.168.1.1' ) msg = 'Leading space' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1 ' ) msg = 'Trailing space' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung eines komplexeren Regex-Musters zur Validierung von IPv4-Adressen. Durch die Definition eines Teilmusters für ein Oktett (`lv_octet`) und dessen Wiederverwendung in einem String-Template wird das Muster lesbarer und wartbarer. Die `match`-Methode von `cl_abap_regex` führt die Validierung durch. Dies ist eine sehr präzise und robuste Methode zur Formatprüfung.

CLASS zcl_format_sflights_adv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display_adv,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_format_sflights_adv IMPLEMENTATION.

                                     price_curr  = |{ cl_abap_format=>currency_2_ext( amount = ls_sflight-price currency = ls_sflight-currency ) } { ls_sflight-currency }| ) ).

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über Flugdaten (`sflights`), filtern Sie nach einer Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und prüfen Sie innerhalb der Schleife, ob ein spezifischer Flug (`CONNID`) existiert, indem Sie `READ TABLE` verwenden und `sy-subrc` auswerten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab WHERE ...` und `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` gefolgt von einer `IF sy-subrc EQ 0` Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_sy_subrc_it DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_connid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_sy_subrc_it IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      " Check if a specific connection exists within the filtered flights
      READ TABLE lt_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        rv_found_connid = abap_true.
        RETURN. " Found, exit method
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_found_connid = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugnummer (`CONNID`) und berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis für jede Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ...` und den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                 INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                 NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-price ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                                      total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summaries IS INITIAL msg = 'Summaries should not be initial' ).
    " Further assertions could check specific group totals if test data is controlled
    " For example, if we know 'AA' '0017' has a specific total price:
    DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE zcl_loop_group_by=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO ls_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-total_price exp = 471.00 msg = 'Total price for AA 0017 incorrect' ). " Example value
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, die eine effiziente Gruppierung von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle ermöglicht. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE` Operator können Aggregationen wie Summen direkt und deklarativ berechnet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. `sy-subrc` wird hier nicht direkt verwendet, da die `GROUP BY` Operation selbst keine explizite Fehlerbehandlung über `sy-subrc` erfordert; die Existenz von Gruppen wird implizit durch die Schleife gehandhabt.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) und führen Sie Aktionen bei jedem Wechsel der Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) durch (`AT NEW`, `AT END`). Löschen Sie innerhalb der Schleife bedingt Einträge und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
hint: Sortieren Sie die Tabelle vor der Schleife. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab AT NEW/END ...` und `DELETE itab WHERE ...` mit `IF sy-subrc EQ 0`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_end DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_clean_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_to_delete TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_end IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_clean_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid. " Essential for AT NEW/END

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      AT NEW carrid.
        " Action at new airline
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = 'NEW_CARRIER' ) TO rt_processed_flights.
      ENDAT.

      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_processed_flights.

      IF ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid_to_delete.
        DELETE rt_processed_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid_to_delete.
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          " Successfully deleted
        ELSE.
          " Deletion failed (e.g., no entries found)
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      AT END carrid.
        " Action at end of airline group
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = 'END_CARRIER' ) TO rt_processed_flights.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_control_breaks FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_deletion_sy_subrc FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_control_breaks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_new_end( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_and_clean_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL msg = 'Result should not be initial' ).
    " Check for 'NEW_CARRIER' and 'END_CARRIER' entries
    DATA(lv_new_carrier_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE connid = 'NEW_CARRIER'.
      lv_new_carrier_count = lv_new_carrier_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_new_carrier_count exp = 0 msg = 'NEW_CARRIER entries expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deletion_sy_subrc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_new_end( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = lo_cut->process_and_clean_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_count) = lines( lt_initial_flights ).

    " Delete a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    DATA(lt_after_deletion) = lo_cut->process_and_clean_flights( iv_carrid_to_delete = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_after_deletion_count) = lines( lt_after_deletion ).

    " Assert that the count has changed, implying deletion occurred and sy-subrc was likely 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_initial_count exp = lv_after_deletion_count msg = 'Table size should change after deletion' ).
    " Assert that 'LH' entries are no longer present
    READ TABLE lt_after_deletion TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'LH entries should be deleted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die traditionelle Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END` für die Verarbeitung von Daten mit Kontrollgruppenwechseln. Die Tabelle muss vor der Schleife nach den Kontrollfeldern sortiert werden. Zusätzlich wird die Auswertung von `sy-subrc` nach einem `DELETE` Befehl gezeigt, um den Erfolg der Löschoperation zu überprüfen.
keywords: LOOP, AT NEW, AT END, DELETE, sy-subrc, Internal Tables, Control Break, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über Flugdaten (`sflights`) mit einem Feldsymbol, um Einträge direkt zu modifizieren. Führen Sie anschließend eine `MODIFY` Operation auf der Tabelle durch und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs_line>` für direkte Modifikation und `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa` mit `IF sy-subrc EQ 0`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

    " Direct modification using field symbol
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Example of MODIFY TABLE with sy-subrc check
    DATA ls_single_flight TYPE ty_sflight.
    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO ls_single_flight INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      ls_single_flight-price = ls_single_flight-price + 10. " Increase price
      MODIFY TABLE lt_sflights FROM ls_single_flight.
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        " Modification successful
      ELSE.
        " Modification failed
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rt_modified_flights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_direct_modification FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_sy_subrc FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_direct_modification.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assigning( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = 500.00.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->modify_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).

    " Check if prices for 'AA' are updated
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = lv_new_price msg = 'Price for AA should be updated' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_sy_subrc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assigning( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->modify_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_new_price = 600.00 ).

    " Check if the first entry's price was increased by 10 (from the MODIFY TABLE example)
    DATA ls_first_flight TYPE zcl_loop_assigning=>ty_sflight.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_first_flight INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight msg = 'First flight should exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_first_flight-price exp = 0 msg = 'Price should be modified' ). " Just a placeholder
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die effiziente In-Place-Modifikation von internen Tabellenzeilen mittels Feldsymbolen (`ASSIGNING`) innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Schleife. Zusätzlich wird die Verwendung des `MODIFY TABLE` Befehls demonstriert, gefolgt von einer `sy-subrc`-Prüfung, um den Erfolg der Modifikation zu bestätigen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugnummer (`CONNID`) von Flügen aus `sflights` enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_id.
    TYPES tt_flight_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_flight_ids
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE tt_flight_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_flight_ids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller `PRICE`-Werte in `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Schleife eine feste Anzahl von Malen aus. Rufen Sie innerhalb der Schleife eine Methode auf, die `sy-subrc` setzt (z.B. durch eine interne `READ TABLE` Operation), und werten Sie `sy-subrc` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DO N TIMES` und eine Methode, die `sy-subrc` beeinflusst.
solution:
CLASS zcl_do_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_do_loop
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
    METHODS check_data_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_do_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_do_loop.
    " Initialize some data
    mt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 1 value = 'A' ) ( id = 3 value = 'C' ) ( id = 5 value = 'E' ) ).

    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_id) = sy-index * 2 - 1. " 1, 3, 5, ...
      IF check_data_entry( lv_current_id ) = abap_true.
        rv_found_count = rv_found_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_data_entry.
    READ TABLE mt_data TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_do_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_do_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_do_sy_subrc( ).
    DATA(lv_found_count) = lo_cut->process_do_loop( iv_iterations = 5 ). " Checks for IDs 1, 3, 5, 7, 9

    " Expected: IDs 1, 3, 5 are found. So 3 entries.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found_count exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect count of found entries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DO ... ENDDO`-Schleife führt einen Codeblock eine feste Anzahl von Malen aus. In diesem Beispiel wird innerhalb der Schleife eine private Methode aufgerufen, die intern eine `READ TABLE`-Operation durchführt und deren Ergebnis `sy-subrc` setzt. Die Auswertung von `sy-subrc` in der aufrufenden Methode zeigt, wie der Status einer Operation geprüft werden kann.
keywords: DO, LOOP, sy-subrc, READ TABLE, Basic Loop, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Schleife aus, solange eine Bedingung erfüllt ist. Modifizieren Sie innerhalb der Schleife Einträge in einer internen Tabelle und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach der `MODIFY`-Operation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE ... ENDWHILE` und `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa` mit `IF sy-subrc EQ 0`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_counter,
             id TYPE i,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_counter.
    TYPES tt_counter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_counter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increment_until_limit
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
        iv_limit TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_final_state) TYPE tt_counter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increment_until_limit.
    DATA lt_counters TYPE tt_counter.
    APPEND VALUE ty_counter( id = iv_id count = 0 ) TO lt_counters.

    DATA ls_current_counter TYPE ty_counter.
    READ TABLE lt_counters INTO ls_current_counter WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    " sy-subrc will be 0 here as we just added it.

    WHILE ls_current_counter-count < iv_limit.
      ls_current_counter-count = ls_current_counter-count + 1.
      MODIFY TABLE lt_counters FROM ls_current_counter.
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        " Modification successful
      ELSE.
        " Modification failed - this should not happen here
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_final_state = lt_counters.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_while_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_while_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_sy_subrc( ).
    DATA(lv_id) = 1.
    DATA(lv_limit) = 5.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->increment_until_limit( iv_id = lv_id iv_limit = lv_limit ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_final_counter) WITH KEY id = lv_id.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Counter entry not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_final_counter-count exp = lv_limit msg = 'Counter did not reach limit' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHILE ... ENDWHILE`-Schleife wird ausgeführt, solange eine angegebene Bedingung wahr ist. In diesem Beispiel wird ein Zähler in einer internen Tabelle inkrementiert, bis ein Limit erreicht ist. Nach jeder `MODIFY TABLE`-Operation wird `sy-subrc` geprüft, um den Erfolg der Aktualisierung zu bestätigen. Dies zeigt die Verwendung von `sy-subrc` in einem dynamischen Schleifenkontext.
keywords: WHILE, LOOP, sy-subrc, MODIFY, Conditional Loop, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf `sflights`. Für jeden Flug soll ein Statusfeld gesetzt werden: 'Expensive' wenn der Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, 'Normal' sonst. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` Ausdrücke.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `COND` für die inline-bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                            connid = ls_flight-connid
                                            status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Normal' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_statuses.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 450.00.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses( iv_price_threshold = lv_threshold ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL msg = 'Result should not be initial' ).

    " Check some known flights
    DATA lt_original_sflights TYPE zcl_for_cond=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_status).
      READ TABLE lt_original_sflights INTO DATA(ls_original) WITH KEY carrid = ls_status-carrid connid = ls_status-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Original flight not found' ).

      IF ls_original-price > lv_threshold.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'Expensive' msg = 'Status should be Expensive' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'Normal' msg = 'Status should be Normal' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken mit `COND`-Ausdrücken, um komplexe bedingte Logik direkt bei der Konstruktion einer neuen internen Tabelle anzuwenden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, Daten zu transformieren, die den Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht. `sy-subrc` ist in diesem funktionalen Kontext nicht anwendbar.
keywords: FOR, COND, Functional Programming, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über Flugdaten (`sflights`). Für jeden Flug, prüfen Sie, ob die Fluggesellschaft in einer externen Tabelle (`scarr`) existiert. Wenn nicht, überspringen Sie den Eintrag. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ...`, `SELECT SINGLE ...` und `IF sy-subrc NE 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_continue_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_valid_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_continue_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_valid_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE FROM scarr FIELDS carrid INTO @DATA(lv_dummy) WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      IF sy-subrc NE 0.
        CONTINUE. " Skip if carrier does not exist in scarr
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_valid_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_continue_sy_subrc( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_valid_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL msg = 'Result should not be initial' ).

    " Verify that all carriers in the result exist in scarr
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE FROM scarr FIELDS carrid INTO @DATA(lv_dummy) WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Carrier should exist in SCARR' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `LOOP AT` in Kombination mit `SELECT SINGLE` und der Auswertung von `sy-subrc`. Wenn `SELECT SINGLE` keinen Eintrag findet (`sy-subrc NE 0`), wird die aktuelle Schleifeniteration mit `CONTINUE` übersprungen. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um nur gültige oder vorhandene Daten weiterzuverarbeiten.
keywords: LOOP, SELECT SINGLE, sy-subrc, CONTINUE, Database Access, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_component_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_values.
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'A1' field2 = 'B1' field3 = 'C1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'A2' field2 = 'B2' field3 = 'C2' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'A3' field2 = 'B3' field3 = 'C3' ) TO lt_data.

    LOOP AT lt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        APPEND <fs_field> TO rt_values.
      ELSE.
        " Component not found, handle error or skip
        APPEND |Component '{ iv_component_name }' not found in line| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_component FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_component FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assign_comp( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_component_values( iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 values' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'B1' msg = 'First value incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'B2' msg = 'Second value incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_invalid_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assign_comp( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_component_values( iv_component_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 error messages' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'not found' msg = 'Error message expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Schleife mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Die Auswertung von `sy-subrc` nach `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist entscheidend, um zu prüfen, ob die angeforderte Komponente tatsächlich existiert. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, bei denen Feldnamen zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und fügen Sie bedingt neue Einträge an einer bestimmten Position ein. Prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach der `INSERT`-Operation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO wa` und `INSERT wa INTO TABLE itab INDEX sy-tabix + 1`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_insert_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_items_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_items TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_final_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_insert_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_items_conditionally.
    rt_final_items = it_initial_items. " Start with initial items

    LOOP AT rt_final_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      IF ls_item-key MOD 2 EQ 0. " If key is even
        DATA(ls_new_item) = VALUE ty_item( key = ls_item-key + 10 value = |Inserted after { ls_item-key }| ).
        INSERT ls_new_item INTO TABLE rt_final_items INDEX sy-tabix + 1.
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          " Insertion successful
        ELSE.
          " Insertion failed (e.g., index out of bounds, though unlikely here)

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit neuen Werten für `PRICE` und `CURRENCY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY` mit einer Host-Struktur und `WHERE` Klausel. Denken Sie an `COMMIT WORK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid     TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price  TYPE sflight-price
        iv_new_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_sflight-price    = iv_new_price.
      ls_sflight-currency = iv_new_currency.

      MODIFY sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false. " Flug nicht gefunden
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdatensätze nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Flug.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` oder `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_occupancy_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy_summary.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats_occ) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <member> IN group_key NEXT s = s + <member>-seatsocc ).
      DATA(lv_total_seats_max) = REDUCE i( INIT m = 0 FOR <member> IN group_key NEXT m = m + <member>-seatsmax ).

      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        connid = group_key-connid
      ).
      IF lv_total_seats_max > 0.
        ls_summary-avg_occupancy = ( lv_total_seats_occ * 100 ) / lv_total_seats_max.
      ELSE.
        ls_summary-avg_occupancy = 0.
      END IF.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_occupancy_summary FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_occupancy_summary.
    DATA(lt_sflights_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251101' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251102' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251101' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251102' seatsocc = 170 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251101' seatsocc = 75 seatsmax = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_occupancy_summary( lt_sflights_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_summary_aa0017) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa0017-avg_occupancy exp = '55.00' ). " (50+60)/(100+100) = 110/200 = 0.55

    DATA(ls_summary_lh0400) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh0400-avg_occupancy exp = '80.00' ). " (150+170)/(200+200) = 320/400 = 0.80

    DATA(ls_summary_aa0018) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa0018-avg_occupancy exp = '50.00' ). " 75/150 = 0.50
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_occupancy_summary( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Funktion, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung ermöglicht dies eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Datenverarbeitung, die komplexe manuelle Gruppierungslogik ersetzt.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Flugzeugtypen (z.B. 'BOEING', 'AIRBUS') basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse und konkrete Unterklassen. Die Factory-Methode sollte `NEW` verwenden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_aircraft.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_base DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_aircraft.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_aircraft~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Unknown Aircraft'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_boeing DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_aircraft_base FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_aircraft~get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_boeing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_aircraft~get_type.
    rv_type = 'BOEING'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airbus DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_aircraft_base FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_aircraft~get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airbus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_aircraft~get_type.
    rv_type = 'AIRBUS'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_aircraft
      IMPORTING
        iv_aircraft_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_aircraft) TYPE REF TO zif_aircraft.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_aircraft.
    CASE iv_aircraft_type.
      WHEN 'BOEING'.
        ro_aircraft = NEW zcl_boeing( ).
      WHEN 'AIRBUS'.
        ro_aircraft = NEW zcl_airbus( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fallback oder Fehlerbehandlung
        ro_aircraft = NEW zcl_aircraft_base( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_boeing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_airbus FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_boeing.
    DATA(lo_boeing) = zcl_aircraft_factory=>create_aircraft( 'BOEING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_boeing->get_type( ) exp = 'BOEING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_airbus.
    DATA(lo_airbus) = zcl_aircraft_factory=>create_aircraft( 'AIRBUS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_airbus->get_type( ) exp = 'AIRBUS' ).

explanation: Das Factory-Pattern ist ein grundlegendes Entwurfsmuster in der Objektorientierung. Die `CLASS-METHODS` Factory-Methode `create_aircraft` kapselt die Instanziierungslogik und gibt eine Instanz über eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle (`zif_aircraft`) zurück. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems, da neue Flugzeugtypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne die Client-Code zu ändern.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Interface, Inheritance, Polymorphism, NEW

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Enddatum eines Fluges, indem Sie eine gegebene Flugdauer (in Stunden) zu einem Startdatum und einer Startzeit hinzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` oder `cl_abap_timestamp_util` für Datums-/Zeitberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_end_datetime
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_start_time TYPE sy-uzeit
        iv_duration_hours TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_end_datetime) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_end_datetime.
    DATA(lv_timestamp_start) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time(
      iv_date = iv_start_date
      iv_time = iv_start_time
    ).

    DATA(lv_duration_seconds) = iv_duration_hours * 3600.

    rs_end_datetime = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_seconds(
      iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp_start
      iv_seconds   = lv_duration_seconds
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `create_timestamp_from_date_time` und `add_seconds` ist der empfohlene Weg, um Datums- und Zeitberechnungen durchzuführen, da sie Zeitzonen und Schaltsekunden korrekt handhabt und die Lesbarkeit des Codes verbessert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` für die dynamische Typisierung und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_defs TYPE tt_field_defs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'C'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = ls_field_def-length ).
        WHEN 'N'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_n( p_length = ls_field_def-length ).
        WHEN 'I'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default to string or raise exception
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

      " Beispiel: Füllen mit Daten
      LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO ls_field_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_field_def-type.
            WHEN 'C' OR 'STRING'.
              <fs_field> = |Value for { ls_field_def-name }|.
            WHEN 'I'.
              <fs_field> = sy-tabix.
            WHEN 'N'.
              <fs_field> = |{ sy-tabix ALPHA = OUT }|.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

      " Zweiter Datensatz
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO ls_field_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_field_def-type.
            WHEN 'C' OR 'STRING'.
              <fs_field> = |Another value for { ls_field_def-name }|.
            WHEN 'I'.
              <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 10.
            WHEN 'N'.
              <fs_field> = |{ sy-tabix * 10 ALPHA = OUT }|.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_creation=>tt_field_defs(
      ( name = 'FIELD1' type = 'STRING' length = 0 )
      ( name = 'FIELD2' type = 'I' length = 0 )
      ( name = 'FIELD3' type = 'C' length = 10 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creation( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <ls_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field1> TYPE any, <fs_field2> TYPE any, <fs_field3> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field1>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field2>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD3' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field3>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Value for FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field2> exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field3> exp = 'Value for F' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Tabellenerstellung zur Laufzeit ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das mit den Klassen `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` realisiert wird. Dies ermöglicht es, flexible Datenstrukturen zu handhaben, deren Layout erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und Feldsymbolen ist hierbei essentiell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, unter Verwendung von String-Templates und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carriers.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrier IN it_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrier ELSE |{ s }, { carrier }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
