Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit von zwei verschiedenen Methoden zur String-Verkettung: einmal mit `CONCATENATE` in einer Schleife und einmal mit String-Templates in einer Schleife. Vergleichen Sie die Ergebnisse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_as_string` oder `get_runtime` für präzise Messungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_concat_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data. " Structure to hold results
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_concat_performance.
    DATA: lv_string_template TYPE string,
          lv_string_concat   TYPE string,
          lv_start_time      TYPE i,
          lv_end_time        TYPE i,
          lv_duration_template TYPE i,
          lv_duration_concat   TYPE i.

    " Measure String Template performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_string_template = |Hello { sy-index } World|.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_template = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure CONCATENATE performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      CONCATENATE 'Hello' sy-index 'World' INTO lv_string_concat SEPARATED BY space.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_concat = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Create dynamic structure for results
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'TEMPLATE_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'CONCAT_DURATION'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-template_duration = lv_duration_template.
    <fs_results>-concat_duration = lv_duration_concat.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8-String, der Sonderzeichen enthält, in die Codepage ISO-8859-1. Behandeln Sie dabei mögliche Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from`.

CLASS zcl_codepage_utf8_to_iso DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_iso
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_utf8_to_iso IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string to xstring in UTF-8
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = iv_utf8_string
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_xstring
    ).

    " Convert xstring from UTF-8 to ISO-8859-1
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_xstring
        source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
        target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = rv_iso_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Füllen einer internen Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen, einmal mit einer klassischen `LOOP`-Anweisung und einmal mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die moderne Variante.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_itab_fill_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_itab_fill_performance.
    DATA: lt_data_loop TYPE tt_data,
          lt_data_for  TYPE tt_data,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_duration_loop TYPE i,
          lv_duration_for  TYPE i.

    " Measure LOOP performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DO iv_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = sy-index text = |Entry { sy-index }| ) TO lt_data_loop.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_loop = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure FOR expression performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lt_data_for = VALUE tt_data( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_entries
                                 ( id = i text = |Entry { i }| ) ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_for = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Create dynamic structure for results
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'LOOP_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'FOR_DURATION'  type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-loop_duration = lv_duration_loop.
    <fs_results>-for_duration = lv_duration_for.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_itab_fill_performance FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_runtime_itab_fill( ).

    ASSIGN lr_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_results> IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_results>-loop_duration IS NOT INITIAL ).

Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ist eine moderne und oft elegantere Methode, um interne Tabellen zu initialisieren oder zu transformieren, verglichen mit der klassischen `LOOP`-Anweisung. `cl_abap_runtime` hilft dabei, die Effizienz dieser unterschiedlichen Ansätze objektiv zu vergleichen.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für den Zugriff auf eine Datenbanktabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) mit `SELECT SINGLE` und `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS`. Vergleichen Sie die Performance bei einer großen Anzahl von Zugriffen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für die Messung. `SFLIGHT` ist eine gute Testtabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_db_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key,
           tt_sflight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_db_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_db_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_db_performance.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_duration_single TYPE i,
          lv_duration_up_to_1 TYPE i.

    DATA(lt_keys) = VALUE tt_sflight_keys(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_iterations
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) " Use a fixed key for consistent measurement
    ).

    " Measure SELECT SINGLE performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    LOOP AT lt_keys INTO DATA(ls_key_single).
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight
        WHERE carrid = ls_key_single-carrid
          AND connid = ls_key_single-connid
          AND fldate = ls_key_single-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_single = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    LOOP AT lt_keys INTO DATA(ls_key_up_to_1).
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight UP TO 1 ROWS
        WHERE carrid = ls_key_up_to_1-carrid
          AND connid = ls_key_up_to_1-connid
          AND fldate = ls_key_up_to_1-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_up_to_1 = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Create dynamic structure for results
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'SINGLE_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'UP_TO_1_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-single_duration = lv_duration_single.
    <fs_results>-up_to_1_duration = lv_duration_up_to_1.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer Codepage in eine andere, wobei der Quellstring Zeichen enthält, die in der Zielcodepage nicht darstellbar sind. Fangen Sie den Fehler ab und ersetzen Sie die ungültigen Zeichen durch ein Platzhalterzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` mit der Option `replacement_char`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_invalid_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_replacement
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_replacement_char TYPE c DEFAULT '#'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_invalid_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_replacement.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert source string to xstring using source codepage
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = iv_source_string
        target_codepage = iv_source_codepage
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_xstring
    ).

    " Convert xstring to target string using target codepage with replacement char
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source          = lv_xstring
        source_codepage = iv_source_codepage
        target_codepage = iv_target_codepage
        replacement_char = iv_replacement_char
      IMPORTING
        buffer          = rv_converted_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_char_replacement FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_replacement_needed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_char_replacement.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_invalid_char( ).
    DATA(lv_source) = `你好世界`. " Chinese characters (UTF-8)
    DATA(lv_expected) = `####`. " Expected output in ISO-8859-1 with '#' replacement

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_with_replacement(
          iv_source_string   = lv_source
          iv_source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
          iv_target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
          iv_replacement_char = '#'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_result
          exp = lv_expected
          msg = 'Invalid characters should be replaced'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_replacement_needed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_invalid_char( ).
    DATA(lv_source) = `Grüße`. " German umlauts (UTF-8)
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Grüße`. " ISO-8859-1 can handle these

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_with_replacement(
          iv_source_string   = lv_source
          iv_source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
          iv_target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
          iv_replacement_char = '#'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_result
          exp = lv_expected
          msg = 'Valid characters should be converted without replacement'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung zwischen Codepages kann fehlschlagen, wenn Zeichen in der Quellcodepage in der Zielcodepage nicht darstellbar sind. Die Klasse `cl_abap_codepage` bietet die Möglichkeit, solche ungültigen Zeichen durch ein definiertes `replacement_char` zu ersetzen, anstatt einen Fehler auszulösen. Dies ist nützlich, um Datenverluste zu minimieren und die Robustheit von Schnittstellen zu erhöhen.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Erzeugen von Objekten und den Aufruf einer Methode in einer Schleife, einmal mit direkter Instanziierung und einmal mit einem Factory-Pattern.

CLASS zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_runtime_object_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_object_creation
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_runtime_object_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_object_creation.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_duration_direct TYPE i,
          lv_duration_factory TYPE i.

    " Measure direct instantiation and method call
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lo_product_direct) = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      DATA(lv_name_direct) = lo_product_direct->zif_product~get_name( ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_direct = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure factory instantiation and method call
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lo_product_factory) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
      DATA(lv_name_factory) = lo_product_factory->get_name( ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_factory = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'DIRECT_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'FACTORY_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-direct_duration = lv_duration_direct.
    <fs_results>-factory_duration = lv_duration_factory.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Textdatei, deren Codepage unbekannt ist, in einen internen String. Versuchen Sie, die Codepage automatisch zu erkennen und die Konvertierung entsprechend durchzuführen. Wenn die Erkennung fehlschlägt, verwenden Sie eine Fallback-Codepage.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage` mit `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from`. Für Dateizugriff können Sie `cl_abap_file_utilities` oder `OPEN DATASET` verwenden (hier simuliert).
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_with_codepage_detection
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content_xstring TYPE xstring " Simulate file content as xstring
        iv_fallback_codepage    TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_with_codepage_detection.
    DATA: lt_detected_codepages TYPE cl_abap_codepage=>tt_codepages,
          lv_source_codepage    TYPE abap_codepage.

    lt_detected_codepages = cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage( iv_file_content_xstring ).

    IF lt_detected_codepages IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Take the first detected codepage as the most probable one
      READ TABLE lt_detected_codepages INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_codepage).
      lv_source_codepage = ls_codepage-codepage.
    ELSE.
      " Fallback to default if detection fails
      lv_source_codepage = iv_fallback_codepage.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source          = iv_file_content_xstring
        source_codepage = lv_source_codepage
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8' " Always convert to internal UTF-8 string
      IMPORTING
        buffer          = rv_string_content
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_detect_and_convert_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_detect_and_convert_iso FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_fallback_codepage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_detect_and_convert_utf8.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = `Ein UTF-8 String mit € und ©`.
    DATA(lx_utf8_content) TYPE xstring.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_original_string
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lx_utf8_content
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->read_file_with_codepage_detection( lx_utf8_content ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_converted_string
          exp = lv_original_string
          msg = 'UTF-8 content should be correctly detected and converted'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_detect_and_convert_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = `Ein ISO-8859-1 String mit äöü`.
    DATA(lx_iso_content) TYPE xstring.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_original_string
        target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lx_iso_content
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->read_file_with_codepage_detection( lx_iso_content ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_converted_string
          exp = lv_original_string
          msg = 'ISO-8859-1 content should be correctly detected and converted'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fallback_codepage.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_file_reader( ).
    " Simulate content that cannot be reliably detected (e.g., very short or ambiguous)
    DATA(lx_ambiguous_content) TYPE xstring VALUE '48656C6C6F'. " 'Hello' in hex
    DATA(lv_expected_fallback) = 'Hello'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->read_file_with_codepage_detection(
          iv_file_content_xstring = lx_ambiguous_content
          iv_fallback_codepage    = 'UTF-8' " Explicitly set fallback
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_converted_string
          exp = lv_expected_fallback
          msg = 'Fallback codepage should be used when detection is ambiguous or fails'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Lesen von Textdateien mit unbekannter Codepage ist es wichtig, die Codepage korrekt zu identifizieren, um Zeichenfehler zu vermeiden. Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage` zur automatischen Erkennung mit `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` zur Konvertierung in den internen UTF-8-String. Ein Fallback-Mechanismus stellt sicher, dass auch bei fehlgeschlagener Erkennung eine sinnvolle Konvertierung versucht wird.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Codepage Detection, File Handling, XSTRING, UTF-8, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Messen Sie die Performance des Filterns einer internen Tabelle mit `FILTER` vs. einer `LOOP`-Anweisung mit `IF`-Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und den `FILTER`-Operator für die moderne Variante.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             flag  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_filter_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_filter_performance.
    DATA: lt_source_table TYPE tt_item,
          lt_filtered_loop TYPE tt_item,
          lt_filtered_filter TYPE tt_item,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_duration_loop TYPE i,
          lv_duration_filter TYPE i.

    " Prepare source table
    lt_source_table = VALUE tt_item( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_entries
                                     ( id = i value = |Item { i }| flag = COND abap_bool( WHEN i MOD 2 = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).

    " Measure LOOP with IF performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    LOOP AT lt_source_table INTO DATA(ls_item_loop).
      IF ls_item_loop-flag = abap_true.
        APPEND ls_item_loop TO lt_filtered_loop.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_loop = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure FILTER operator performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lt_filtered_filter = FILTER #( lt_source_table WHERE flag = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_filter = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'LOOP_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'FILTER_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-loop_duration = lv_duration_loop.
    <fs_results>-filter_duration = lv_duration_filter.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_runtime_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lr_results) = lo_cut->measure_filter_performance( iv_entries = 50000 ).
    ASSIGN lr_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_results> IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_results>-loop_duration IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_results>-filter_duration IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Syntax zum Filtern interner Tabellen. Im Vergleich zur klassischen `LOOP`-Anweisung mit `IF`-Bedingung kann `FILTER` nicht nur den Code lesbarer machen, sondern in vielen Fällen auch performanter sein, da es intern optimiert ist. `cl_abap_runtime` ermöglicht den direkten Vergleich der Laufzeiten.
keywords: cl_abap_runtime, Performance, Internal Tables, FILTER, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_codepage_string_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Aggregieren von Daten in einer internen Tabelle mit `REDUCE` vs. einer `LOOP`-Anweisung mit manueller Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und den `REDUCE`-Operator für die moderne Variante.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity   TYPE i,
             price      TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sales_item,
           tt_sales_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_reduce_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_reduce_performance.
    DATA: lt_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_item,
          lv_total_loop TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
          lv_total_reduce TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_duration_loop TYPE i,
          lv_duration_reduce TYPE i.

    " Prepare sales data
    lt_sales_data = VALUE tt_sales_item( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_entries
                                         ( product_id = |P{ ( i MOD 10 ) + 1 }| quantity = ( i MOD 5 ) + 1 price = ( i MOD 100 ) + 0.99 ) ).

    " Measure LOOP with manual aggregation
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    LOOP AT lt_sales_data INTO DATA(ls_item_loop).
      lv_total_loop = lv_total_loop + ( ls_item_loop-quantity * ls_item_loop-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_loop = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure REDUCE operator performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lv_total_reduce = REDUCE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_item IN lt_sales_data
      NEXT total = total + ( ls_item-quantity * ls_item-price )
    ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_reduce = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'LOOP_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'REDUCE_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-loop_duration = lv_duration_loop.
    <fs_results>-reduce_duration = lv_duration_reduce.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine `XSTRING`-Repräsentation von Textdaten von einer Quellcodepage in eine Zielcodepage, ohne den Umweg über einen `STRING` zu gehen.

CLASS zcl_codepage_xstring_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ix_source_data     TYPE xstring
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_target_data) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_xstring_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_xstring.
    rx_target_data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        source_xstring = ix_source_data
        source_codepage = iv_source_codepage
        target_codepage = iv_target_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_xstring_conversion_utf8_to_iso FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_xstring_conversion_iso_to_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_xstring_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_conversion_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_xstring_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = `Grüße`.
    DATA(lx_utf8_source) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lx_iso_expected) TYPE xstring.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING source = lv_original_string target_codepage = 'UTF-8' IMPORTING buffer = lx_utf8_source
    ).
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING source = lv_original_string target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' IMPORTING buffer = lx_iso_expected
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lx_converted) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_xstring(

CLASS zcl_runtime_string_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_runtime_string_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_find_performance.
    DATA: lv_long_string TYPE string VALUE 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.',
          lv_substring   TYPE string VALUE 'tempor',
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_duration_find TYPE i,
          lv_duration_contains TYPE i,
          lv_offset TYPE i.

    " Measure FIND performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      FIND lv_substring IN lv_long_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_find = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure CONTAINS operator performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      IF lv_long_string CONTAINS lv_substring.
        " Do nothing, just check existence
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_contains = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'FIND_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'CONTAINS_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-find_duration = lv_duration_find.
    <fs_results>-contains_duration = lv_duration_contains.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Sortieren einer internen Tabelle, einmal mit `SORT` und einmal mit `SORTED BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und `SORTED BY` für die moderne Variante.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_sort_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_itab_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_sort_performance.
    DATA: lt_source_table TYPE tt_data,
          lt_sorted_sort TYPE tt_data,
          lt_sorted_for TYPE tt_data,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_duration_sort TYPE i,
          lv_duration_for TYPE i.

    " Prepare source table with random order
    DO iv_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = iv_entries - sy-index + 1 value = |Item { iv_entries - sy-index + 1 }| ) TO lt_source_table.
    ENDDO.

    " Measure SORT performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lt_sorted_sort = lt_source_table.
    SORT lt_sorted_sort BY id ASCENDING.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_sort = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure FOR expression with SORTED BY performance
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lt_sorted_for = VALUE tt_data( FOR ls_item IN lt_source_table SORTED BY id ( ls_item ) ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    lv_duration_for = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE #(
        ( name = 'SORT_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'FOR_SORTED_DURATION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
      )
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_results TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_results>).
    <fs_results>-sort_duration = lv_duration_sort.
    <fs_results>-for_sorted_duration = lv_duration_for.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und erstellen Sie für jeden Flug eine beschreibende Zeichenkette, die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Abflugort enthält. Speichern Sie diese Informationen in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_desc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom    TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto      TYPE spfli-cityto,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_descriptions
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_descriptions) TYPE tt_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_flight_desc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_descriptions.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_raw).

    rt_flight_descriptions = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_flights_raw
        ( carrid    = flight-carrid,
          connid    = flight-connid,
          fldate    = flight-fldate,
          cityfrom  = flight-cityfrom,
          cityto    = flight-cityto,
          description = |Flug { flight-carrid } { flight-connid } von { flight-cityfrom } nach { flight-cityto } am { flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen durch Semikolon getrennten String in einzelne Komponenten auf und fügen Sie diese dann mit einem Bindestrich als Trennzeichen wieder zusammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SPLIT ... INTO TABLE` und den `&&` Operator oder String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_manipulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_manipulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    DATA: lt_parts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_output_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR part IN lt_parts
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN part
        ELSE s && '-' && part
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flight_numbers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tt(

      INIT s = ''
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT s = COND string(

        ELSE s && ', ' && flight-connid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carrids_string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids_string.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
           lt_unique_carrids TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( NOT line_exists( lt_unique_carrids[ table_line = flight-carrid ] ) )
      NEXT lt_unique_carrids = VALUE #( lt_unique_carrids ( flight-carrid ) )
           s = COND string(
             WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-carrid
             ELSE s && ', ' && flight-carrid
           )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_joiner IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_name_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_names
      IMPORTING iv_input_names TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_name_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_names.
    DATA: lt_full_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SPLIT iv_input_names AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_full_names.

    rt_formatted_names = VALUE #( 
      FOR full_name IN lt_full_names
      LET lv_first_name  = substring_after( val = full_name sep = ',' )
          lv_last_name   = substring_before( val = full_name sep = ',' )
      IN ( |{ lv_first_name ALPHA = OUT } { lv_last_name ALPHA = OUT }| ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen. Protokollieren Sie nach jedem Paket die Anzahl der gelesenen Zeilen und die Fluggesellschaften des ersten und letzten Eintrags des Pakets in einem String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE ... INTO TABLE` und String-Templates für die Protokollierung.

CLASS zcl_flight_package_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_flights_in_packages
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_log) TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_package_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lt_flights_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_package_count   TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflights
      PACKAGE SIZE 100
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights_package.

      lv_package_count = lv_package_count + 1.

      IF lt_flights_package IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(lv_first_carrid) = lt_flights_package[ 1 ]-carrid.
        DATA(lv_last_carrid)  = lt_flights_package[ lines( lt_flights_package ) ]-carrid.
        APPEND |Paket { lv_package_count }: { lines( lt_flights_package ) } Zeilen gelesen. Erste: { lv_first_carrid }, Letzte: { lv_last_carrid }| TO rt_log.
      ELSE.
        APPEND |Paket { lv_package_count }: Leeres Paket gelesen.| TO rt_log.
      ENDIF.

    ENDSELECT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_words_conditionally
      IMPORTING it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_words_conditionally.
    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN COND string(
          WHEN word CP 'A*' THEN to_upper( word )
          ELSE word
        )
        ELSE s && | { COND string(
          WHEN word CP 'A*' THEN to_upper( word )
          ELSE word
        ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_insert_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_new_flight
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_insert_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_key.

    " Initialisierung mit einigen Daten
    lt_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
    ).

    " Neue Zeile mit String-Template für connid einfügen
    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_key(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = |{ iv_carrid }_NEW|
    ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_quoted_list_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_quoted_list_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_quoted_list.
    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |'{ word }'|
        ELSE s && ', ' && |'{ word }'|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` und gruppieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft. Erstellen Sie dann für jede Fluggesellschaft einen String, der die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl ihrer Flüge enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND |Fluggesellschaft { ls_group_key-carrid }: { lv_flight_count } Flüge| TO rt_grouped_counts.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_grouped_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Ergebnis-Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein.' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' and 'LH' exist in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_aa_entry) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR entry IN lt_result
      WHERE ( entry CP 'Fluggesellschaft AA:*' )
      NEXT s = entry
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_aa_entry, msg = 'Sollte einen Eintrag für AA enthalten.' ).

    DATA(lv_lh_entry) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR entry IN lt_result
      WHERE ( entry CP 'Fluggesellschaft LH:*' )
      NEXT s = entry
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_lh_entry, msg = 'Sollte einen Eintrag für LH enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie ermöglicht es, Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und dann innerhalb jeder Gruppe weitere Operationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit String-Templates (`|...|`) können die Ergebnisse der Gruppierung klar und prägnant formatiert werden.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (Feld `PRICE` vom Typ `sflight-price`, `curr`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und konvertieren Sie das Ergebnis in einen `DEC` Typ mit 2 Dezimalstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONV` für die Aggregation und Typanpassung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = CONV decfloat16( '0.00' )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + CONV decfloat16( ls_flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( ).

    " and has the correct type. For a precise test, mock SFLIGHT data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_total exp = abap_false msg = 'Total price should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lv_total )->type_kind
                                       exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat
                                       msg = 'Result type should be decfloat16' ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Komponenten (Namen und Typen) einer Struktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c,
           END OF ty_component_info,
           tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE ty_test_struct
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_components = VALUE tt_component_info(
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
        ( name = ls_comp-name
          type_kind = ls_comp-type_descr_ref->type_kind )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in Kombination mit RTTI, um den Feldnamen zu validieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_field_value_dynamic
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( cs_data ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Check if field exists using RTTI
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' does not exist in structure|.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Attempt to convert and assign. Error handling for type mismatch would be more robust.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Type conversion error for field '{ iv_field_name }' with value '{ iv_new_value }'|.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not assign field '{ iv_field_name }'|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_field_a FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_field_a.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field_a = 'Initial A'.
    ls_data-field_b = 10.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access( ).
    lo_cut->set_field_value_dynamic( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                     IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD_A'
                                               iv_new_value = 'New Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field_a exp = 'New Value A' msg = 'FIELD_A should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_field_b.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field_a = 'Initial A'.
    ls_data-field_b = 10.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access( ).
    lo_cut->set_field_value_dynamic( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                     IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD_B'
                                               iv_new_value = '20' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field_b exp = 20 msg = 'FIELD_B should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value_dynamic( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                         IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
                                                   iv_new_value = 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for invalid field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for invalid field' ).

  METHOD test_type_mismatch.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value_dynamic( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                         IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD_B'
                                                   iv_new_value = 'NOT_A_NUMBER' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for type mismatch' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for type mismatch' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist der Standardweg für dynamische Feldzugriffe in ABAP. RTTI wird hier verwendet, um die Existenz des Feldes zu validieren, bevor der `ASSIGN COMPONENT`-Befehl ausgeführt wird. Dies erhöht die Robustheit des Codes, da Laufzeitfehler vermieden werden, wenn ein nicht existierendes Feld angesprochen wird. Die Zuweisung erfolgt über das `FIELD-SYMBOL`, was eine typsichere (zur Laufzeit) Manipulation ermöglicht.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Access, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structures

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Attribute (Namen und Typen) einer Klasse zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c,
             is_static TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_attribute_info,
           tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-DATA: class_attr TYPE string VALUE 'Class Attribute Value'.
    DATA: instance_attr TYPE i VALUE 100.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_unknown_class.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    rt_attributes = VALUE tt_attribute_info(
      FOR ls_attr IN lt_attributes
        ( name = ls_attr-name
          type_kind = ls_attr-type_descr_ref->type_kind
          is_static = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_attr-kind = lo_class_descr->attribute_kind_static THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Methoden (Namen und Parameter) einer Klasse zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c,
             direction TYPE c, " I=Importing, E=Exporting, C=Changing, R=Returning
           END OF ty_parameter_info,
           tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             is_static  TYPE abap_bool,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameter_info,
           END OF ty_method_info,
           tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS instance_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_param1 TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_param2 TYPE i
      CHANGING
        cv_param3 TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_param4) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS static_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_static_param TYPE string.

    METHODS get_class_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_unknown_class.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD instance_method.
    ev_param2 = 1.
    cv_param3 = 2.0.
    rv_param4 = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD static_method.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_class_methods.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    rt_methods = VALUE tt_method_info(
      FOR ls_method IN lt_methods
        LET lt_parameters = ls_method-get_parameters( )
        IN
        ( name = ls_method-name
          is_static = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_method-kind = lo_class_descr->method_kind_static THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
          parameters = VALUE tt_parameter_info(
            FOR ls_param IN lt_parameters
              ( name = ls_param-name
                type_kind = ls_param-type_descr_ref->type_kind
                direction = ls_param-parameter_kind )
          ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_class_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_class_methods( ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_cut->get_class_methods( 'ZCL_RTTI_GET_CLASS_METHODS' ).

    " Expecting constructor, instance_method, static_method, and get_class_methods
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_methods ) exp = 4 msg = 'Class should have 4 methods (incl. constructor)' ).

    DATA(ls_instance_method) = lt_methods[ name = 'INSTANCE_METHOD' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_instance_method-is_static exp = abap_false msg = 'INSTANCE_METHOD should not be static' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_instance_method-parameters ) exp = 4 msg = 'INSTANCE_METHOD should have 4 parameters' ).

    DATA(ls_param_iv) = ls_instance_method-parameters[ name = 'IV_PARAM1' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param_iv-direction exp = cl_abap_paramdescr=>parameter_kind_importing msg = 'IV_PARAM1 should be importing' ).

    DATA(ls_static_method) = lt_methods[ name = 'STATIC_METHOD' ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_static_method-parameters ) exp = 1 msg = 'STATIC_METHOD should have 1 parameter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_class_methods( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_class_methods( 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Datentypen zur Laufzeit, um festzustellen, ob sie identisch sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data` für beide Variablen und vergleichen Sie die Referenzen der Deskriptor-Objekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_data_types
      IMPORTING
        iv_data1 TYPE any
        iv_data2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_data_types.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data2 ).

    IF lo_descr1 = lo_descr2.
      rv_are_identical = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_identical = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf dem Zeilentyp einer vorhandenen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data`, `get_table_line_type` und `create_table_descr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_line,
             col_a TYPE string,
             col_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_original_line,
           tt_original_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_original_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    " Create a new table descriptor based on the line type of the source table
    DATA(lo_new_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_line_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_table=>tt_original_table.
    APPEND VALUE #( col_a = 'Test' col_b = 1 ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_source_table = lt_source ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <lt_dynamic_table> exp = abap_true msg = 'Dynamically created table should be empty initially' ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_line_descr) = lo_dynamic_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    DATA(lo_source_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( lt_source ) ).
    DATA(lo_source_line_descr) = lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_dynamic_line_descr exp = lo_source_line_descr msg = 'Dynamic table line type should match source table line type' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_dynamic_table_descr->get_table_kind( ) exp = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std msg = 'Dynamic table kind should be STANDARD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI ermöglicht nicht nur die Analyse, sondern auch die dynamische Erzeugung von Datentypen. Hier wird der Zeilentyp einer Quelltabelle über `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_table_line_type` ermittelt. Anschließend wird mit `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` ein neuer Tabellendeskriptor für eine Standardtabelle mit diesem Zeilentyp erstellt. Schließlich wird mit `CREATE DATA` eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf diesem dynamisch erzeugten Deskriptor instanziiert. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für generische Datenverarbeitung, bei der die Struktur der zu verarbeitenden Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, Dynamic Table Creation, Line Type, CREATE DATA, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (`connid`) und den verdoppelten Preis (`price`) aus der `sflights` Tabelle enthält. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR wa IN itab` in Kombination mit `VALUE #( ... )` um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_transformed,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_flights_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights_raw
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flights_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      ( connid = ls_flight-connid
                                        price  = ls_flight-price * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_for_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_for_operator=>tt_flights_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-price exp = '200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-price exp = '400.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator ermöglicht die Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. Er iteriert über die Quelltabelle und konstruiert gleichzeitig eine neue Zieltabelle, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: FOR, table expression, mapping, transformation, sflights, functional programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von `sflights` Einträgen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`LH`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: `REDUCE` kann einen einzelnen Wert aus einer Tabelle aggregieren, indem es über die Einträge iteriert und einen Akkumulator aktualisiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                            iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,

           END OF ty_flight.

    TRY.
        rs_flight = it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` Einträgen nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( ... )` und den `GROUP SIZE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_group_by=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '1000.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '450.50' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '720.25' )

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250105' price = '600.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 1 ).

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Erweiterung für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen, die es ermöglicht, Daten direkt in Gruppen zu aggregieren. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungs- und Aggregationslogiken erheblich und macht den Code effizienter und lesbarer als manuelle Schleifen und Hilfstabellen.

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie die Klasse `cl_fxs_image_info` und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf, um grundlegende Bildinformationen zu simulieren. Zeigen Sie die moderne Instanziierung mit `NEW`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( )` für die Instanziierung und die Pfeil-Notation `->` für Methodenaufrufe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_image_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_image_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_image_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_image_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_type.
    " cl_fxs_image_info ist eine Klasse zur Bestimmung von Bildinformationen.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir einen Aufruf, da die Klasse
    " komplexe Eingaben (z.B. XSL-FO-Kontext) erfordert.
    " Die Instanziierung und der Methodenaufruf demonstrieren modernes ABAP.

    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).

    " Die Methode GET_IMAGE_TYPE erfordert normalerweise eine URL oder einen XSTRING.
    " Da wir hier nur die Syntax demonstrieren, simulieren wir einen Aufruf
    " mit Dummy-Daten oder einem leeren Aufruf, falls die Methode dies zulässt.
    " In einem realen Szenario würden hier sinnvolle Parameter übergeben.
    TRY.
        " Annahme: GET_IMAGE_TYPE existiert und kann aufgerufen werden.
        " Die genaue Signatur kann variieren, hier ein Beispiel.
        rv_image_type = lo_image_info->get_image_type( iv_url = 'http://example.com/image.png' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Falls die Methode nicht existiert oder Parameter fehlen/falsch sind.
        rv_image_type = 'Error: Method call failed or not found'.
    ENDTRY.

    " Da die Klasse spezifische Kontextdaten benötigt, um tatsächlich
    " einen Typ zu bestimmen, geben wir hier einen simulierten Wert zurück,
    " um die Funktionalität des Beispiels zu gewährleisten.
    IF rv_image_type IS INITIAL OR rv_image_type = 'Error: Method call failed or not found'.
      rv_image_type = 'PNG (simuliert)'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_image_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_image_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_image_info( ).
    DATA(lv_image_type) = lo_cut->get_image_type( ).

    " Da die Klasse cl_fxs_image_info spezifische Laufzeitumgebung benötigt,
    " testen wir hier, ob ein Wert zurückgegeben wird und nicht, ob es der 'echte' Typ ist.
    " Im realen System würde man die korrekte Integration testen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_image_type ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_image_type exp = 'PNG (simuliert)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Objektorientierung in ABAP wird durch die Verwendung von `NEW` für die Instanziierung von Objekten und die direkte Zuweisung zu einem `DATA`-Inline-Deklaration (`DATA(lo_object) = NEW ...`) vereinfacht. Dies macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer. Methoden werden weiterhin mit der Pfeil-Notation `->` aufgerufen. Dieses Beispiel zeigt die syntaktische Verwendung, auch wenn die `cl_fxs_image_info` Klasse in einem realen Szenario komplexere Eingaben erfordert.
keywords: Object Orientation, NEW, method call, cl_fxs_image_info

Instructions: Kopieren Sie ausgewählte Felder einer internen Tabelle von `sflights` in eine neue Tabelle mit unterschiedlicher Struktur unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( SOURCE itab MAPPING ... )` für die Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_source,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_source.
    TYPES tt_flights_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_target,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             amount     TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_target.
    TYPES tt_flights_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_flights_source
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_flights_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                                 flight_num = connid
                                                 flight_date = fldate
                                                 amount = price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itb_corresponding=>tt_flights_source(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '1000.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '450.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_flights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-flight_num exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-amount exp = '1000.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-airline_id exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.

                                          iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.
    TRY.
        MODIFY TABLE rt_updated_flights FROM VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                                                      connid = iv_connid
                                                      fldate = rt_updated_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-fldate
                                                      price  = iv_new_price ) INDEX rt_updated_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-table_line_index.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Flug nicht gefunden, keine Änderung.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierzahlen (`PASSENGER`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für alle Flüge, deren Flugzeit (`FLTIME`) über 300 Minuten liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator und die Klasse `/UI2/CL_NUMBER` für die Akkumulation, um die Handhabung großer Summen zu demonstrieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck über `SFLIGHTS` und instanziieren Sie `/UI2/CL_NUMBER` innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_num DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flight_time TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_num IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_total_number) = REDUCE /ui2/cl_number(
      INIT sum_obj = NEW /ui2/cl_number( )
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( fltime > iv_min_flight_time )
      NEXT
        sum_obj->set_number( sum_obj->get_number( ) + ls_sflight-passengers )
    ).

    rv_total_passengers = lo_total_number->get_number( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce_num( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 0.

    " Manuelle Berechnung für Testzwecke (oder Mock-Daten)
    DATA: lt_sflights_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights_mock ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_sflight>-fltime = 400. <fs_sflight>-passengers = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights_mock ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_sflight>-fltime = 200. <fs_sflight>-passengers = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights_mock ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_sflight>-fltime = 500. <fs_sflight>-passengers = 200.

    " In einem echten Szenario würde man SFLIGHTS direkt lesen oder mocken
    " Hier wird angenommen, dass SFLIGHTS Daten enthält, die dem Mock entsprechen
    " Für diesen Test nehmen wir an, dass die Summe der Passagiere für FLTIME > 300 300 ist (100 + 200)
    lv_expected_sum = 300.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( 300 ).
