Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob zwei `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekte sich zeitlich überschneiden. Die Methode soll `true` zurückgeben, wenn eine Überschneidung vorliegt, ansonsten `false`.
hint: Zwei Intervalle [A, B] und [C, D] überschneiden sich, wenn A <= D und C <= B. Nutzen Sie die `GET_START_DATE_TIME` und `GET_END_DATE_TIME` Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_overlap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_overlap
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment1 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
        io_appointment2 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_overlaps) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_overlap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_overlap.
    DATA: lv_start_date1 TYPE d, lv_start_time1 TYPE t,
          lv_end_date1   TYPE d, lv_end_time1   TYPE t,
          lv_start_date2 TYPE d, lv_start_time2 TYPE t,
          lv_end_date2   TYPE d, lv_end_time2   TYPE t.

    io_appointment1->get_start_date_time( IMPORTING e_date = lv_start_date1 e_time = lv_start_time1 ).
    io_appointment1->get_end_date_time( IMPORTING e_date = lv_end_date1 e_time = lv_end_time1 ).
    io_appointment2->get_start_date_time( IMPORTING e_date = lv_start_date2 e_time = lv_start_time2 ).
    io_appointment2->get_end_date_time( IMPORTING e_date = lv_end_date2 e_time = lv_end_time2 ).

    " Convert to combined timestamp for easier comparison
    DATA(lv_ts_start1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>combine_date_time( iv_date = lv_start_date1 iv_time = lv_start_time1 ).
    DATA(lv_ts_end1)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>combine_date_time( iv_date = lv_end_date1   iv_time = lv_end_time1   ).
    DATA(lv_ts_start2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>combine_date_time( iv_date = lv_start_date2 iv_time = lv_start_time2 ).
    DATA(lv_ts_end2)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>combine_date_time( iv_date = lv_end_date2   iv_time = lv_end_time2   ).

    IF lv_ts_start1 < lv_ts_end2 AND lv_ts_start2 < lv_ts_end1.
      rb_overlaps = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_overlaps = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_overlap_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_false FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_edge_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overlap_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_overlap( ).
    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '090000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '110000' ).
    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '100000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '120000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app2 ) msg = 'Appointments should overlap' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlap_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_overlap( ).
    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '090000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '100000' ).
    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '110000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '120000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app2 ) msg = 'Appointments should not overlap' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlap_edge_case.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_overlap( ).
    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '090000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '100000' ).
    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '100000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '110000' ).

Die Logik `start1 < end2 AND start2 < end1` ist die Standardmethode zur Erkennung von Überschneidungen.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode eines `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekts auf (z.B. `GET_START_DATE_TIME`) basierend auf einem String-Parameter, der den Methodennamen enthält. Geben Sie das Ergebnis der Methode zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(lv_method_name)` und `RECEIVING` für den Rückgabewert. Beachten Sie, dass `GET_START_DATE_TIME` zwei Parameter zurückgibt, die separat behandelt werden müssen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_datetime_result,
             date_val TYPE d,
             time_val TYPE t,
           END OF ty_datetime_result.

    METHODS call_appointment_method
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_datetime_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_appointment_method.
    TRY.
        IF iv_method_name = 'GET_START_DATE_TIME' OR iv_method_name = 'GET_END_DATE_TIME'.
          CALL METHOD io_appointment->(iv_method_name)
            IMPORTING
              e_date = rs_result-date_val
              e_time = rs_result-time_val.
        ELSE.
          " Handle other methods or raise error if method not supported
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Method { iv_method_name } not supported or has different signature.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von `/UI2/CL_NUMBER`-Objekten, die die Zahlen 10, 20, 30, 40 repräsentieren, unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR` für die Initialisierung und `NEW /UI2/CL_NUMBER()` für jedes Objekt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO /ui2/cl_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_number_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_number_table.
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE i_tab( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ( 40 ) ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE tt_numbers(
      FOR lv_value IN lt_values
      ( LET lo_number = NEW /ui2/cl_number( ) IN
          lo_number->set_number( lv_value ) ;
          lo_number
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 4 msg = 'Table should contain 4 entries' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_value) = 10.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lo_number).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekt erstellt und optional einen Betreff (`SHORT_TEXT`) und eine Beschreibung (`LONG_TEXT`) setzt. Wenn kein Betreff oder keine Beschreibung angegeben wird, sollen diese leer bleiben.

CLASS zcl_appointment_optional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_appointment_optional IMPLEMENTATION.

    ro_appointment->set_end_date_time(

        i_time = iv_end_time ).

    IF iv_subject IS SUPPLIED.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck, ob ein Flug aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` als 'Langstrecke' (Flugzeit > 400 Minuten) oder 'Kurzstrecke' (Flugzeit <= 400 Minuten) gilt. Erstellen Sie dann ein `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekt, dessen Betreff diese Klassifizierung widerspiegelt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung des Flugtyps und die `SET_SHORT_TEXT`-Methode von `CL_APPOINTMENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_app DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_appointment_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_appointment) TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointment_for_flight.
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } { iv_fldate } not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_flight_type) = COND string(
      WHEN ls_sflight-fltime > 400 THEN 'Langstrecke'
      ELSE 'Kurzstrecke'
    ).

    ro_appointment = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    ro_appointment->set_start_date_time( i_date = ls_sflight-fldate i_time = '000000' ). " Dummy time
    ro_appointment->set_end_date_time( i_date = ls_sflight-fldate i_time = '235959' ).   " Dummy time
    ro_appointment->set_short_text( |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }: { lv_flight_type }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum fltime = 450 ) ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = sy-datum.

explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile. Er ersetzt komplexe `IF`-Strukturen und trägt zur Funktionalität und Kompaktheit des Codes bei. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine Flugklassifizierung vorzunehmen, die dann im Betreff eines `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekts genutzt wird.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekten nach ihrem Startdatum. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die für jedes Datum eine Liste der Termine enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` in einem `VALUE`- oder `FOR`-Ausdruck. Eine Hilfsmethode zum Extrahieren des Startdatums ist nützlich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_appointments,
             start_date TYPE d,
             appointments TYPE tt_appointments,
           END OF ty_grouped_appointments.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_appointments WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_appointments) TYPE tt_grouped_appointments.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_start_date
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    rt_grouped_appointments = VALUE tt_grouped_appointments(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_appointment IN it_appointments
      GROUP BY ( start_date = get_start_date( ls_appointment ) ) ASCENDING
      ( start_date = CORRESPONDING #( start_date )
        appointments = VALUE tt_appointments( FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_appointment ( ls_member ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_start_date.
    io_appointment->get_start_date_time(
      IMPORTING
        e_date = rv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_group( ).
    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_group=>tt_appointments(
      ( NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '090000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '100000' ) )
      ( NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251226' i_time = '110000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251226' i_time = '120000' ) )
      ( NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '130000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251225' i_time = '140000' ) )
      ( NEW cl_appointment( )->set_start_date_time( i_date = '20251227' i_time = '150000' )->set_end_date_time( i_date = '20251227' i_time = '160000' ) )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Wrapper-Klasse für `CL_APPOINTMENT`, die eine Methode `set_duration_in_minutes` anbietet. Diese Methode soll Start- und Endzeit des Termins basierend auf einem Startdatum, einer Startzeit und einer Dauer in Minuten setzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden `SET_START_DATE_TIME` und `SET_END_DATE_TIME` von `CL_APPOINTMENT` und `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für die Zeitberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_wrapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.
    METHODS set_duration_in_minutes
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_start_time TYPE t
        iv_duration_min TYPE i.

    METHODS get_wrapped_appointment RETURNING VALUE(ro_appointment) TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_appointment IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_appointment = io_appointment.
    ELSE.
      mo_appointment = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_duration_in_minutes.
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>combine_date_time( iv_date = iv_start_date iv_time = iv_start_time ).
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_seconds( iv_tstmp = lv_start_tstmp iv_seconds = iv_duration_min * 60 ).

    DATA: lv_end_date TYPE d, lv_end_time TYPE t.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>separate_date_time( EXPORTING iv_tstmp = lv_end_tstmp IMPORTING ev_date = lv_end_date ev_time = lv_end_time ).

    mo_appointment->set_start_date_time( i_date = iv_start_date i_time = iv_start_time ).
    mo_appointment->set_end_date_time( i_date = lv_end_date i_time = lv_end_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_wrapped_appointment.
    ro_appointment = mo_appointment.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights` als Beispiel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random=>create()` und eine Schleife zum Tauschen von Elementen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    rt_shuffled_sflights = it_sflights. " Copy table
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( rt_shuffled_sflights ).

    IF lv_size <= 1. " Nothing to shuffle
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO lv_size - 1 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-index - 1. " 0-based index
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = lv_current_index iv_max = lv_size - 1 ).

      " Swap elements
      DATA(ls_temp) = rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_current_index + 1 ]. " ABAP tables are 1-based
      rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_current_index + 1 ] = rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_random_index + 1 ].
      rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_random_index + 1 ] = ls_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' price = '200' ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'CC' connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' price = '300' ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'DD' connid = '004' fldate = '20250104' price = '400' ). APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    DATA(lv_original_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN lt_original NEXT s = s + <fs>-price ).
    DATA(lv_shuffled_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN lt_shuffled NEXT s = s + <fs>-price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_shuffled_sum exp = lv_original_sum ).

    DATA(lv_is_sorted) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_shuffled INTO DATA(ls_current).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        DATA(ls_previous) = lt_shuffled[ sy-tabix - 1 ].
        IF ls_current-carrid < ls_previous-carrid.
          lv_is_sorted = abap_false.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lines( lt_original ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_sorted exp = abap_false ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode implementiert den Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus, um die Elemente einer internen Tabelle zufällig neu anzuordnen. `cl_abap_random` wird verwendet, um die Indizes für den Tausch zu generieren. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE #(...)` für die Tabelleninitialisierung und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung wird im Test verwendet.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLES, SHUFFLE, FISHER-YATES

CLASS zcl_random_table_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_random_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_count        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_entries) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_random_entries.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_source_table ).
    IF lv_table_size = 0 OR iv_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_indices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_actual_count) = COND #( WHEN iv_count > lv_table_size THEN lv_table_size ELSE iv_count ).

    DO lv_actual_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = lv_table_size ).
      WHILE line_exists( lt_indices[ table_line = lv_random_index ] ).
        lv_random_index = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = lv_table_size ).
      ENDWHILE.
      INSERT lv_random_index INTO TABLE lt_indices.
    ENDDO.

    rt_selected_entries = VALUE #( FOR index IN lt_indices ( it_source_table[ index ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_random_entries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_random_entries.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_random_table_select=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_random_table_select=>ty_sflight.

    DO 10 TIMES.
      ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = |C{ sy-index }| connid = |{ sy-index }| fldate = '20250101' price = ( sy-index * 100 ) ).
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_select( ).
    DATA(lt_selected) = lo_cut->select_random_entries( it_source_table = lt_original iv_count = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_selected ) exp = 3 ).

    LOOP AT lt_selected INTO DATA(ls_selected_entry).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_original INTO DATA(ls_original_entry).
        IF ls_selected_entry = ls_original_entry.
          lv_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_selected_all) = lo_cut->select_random_entries( it_source_table = lt_original iv_count = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_selected_all ) exp = 10 ).

    DATA(lt_empty_table) TYPE zcl_random_table_select=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lt_selected_empty) = lo_cut->select_random_entries( it_source_table = lt_empty_table iv_count = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_selected_empty ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode wählt eine angegebene Anzahl eindeutiger zufälliger Einträge aus einer Quelltabelle aus. `cl_abap_random` wird verwendet, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren. Eine `WHILE` Schleife stellt sicher, dass nur eindeutige Indizes gesammelt werden. Die Ergebnis-Tabelle wird effizient mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck erstellt.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines angegebenen Datumsbereichs (Start- und Enddatum).
hint: Konvertieren Sie Daten in Tage seit 00010101, generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl und konvertieren Sie zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_days) = iv_start_date - '00010101'.
    DATA(lv_end_days)   = iv_end_date - '00010101'.

    IF lv_start_days > lv_end_days.
      DATA(lv_temp) = lv_start_days.
      lv_start_days = lv_end_days.
      lv_end_days = lv_temp.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = lv_start_days iv_max = lv_end_days ).

    rv_random_date = '00010101' + lv_random_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strings unter Berücksichtigung der sprachspezifischen Sortierregeln eines IETF BCP 47 Sprach-Tags.

solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_string_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_strings_by_locale
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1   TYPE string
        iv_string2   TYPE string
        iv_locale    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i. " -1 if s1 < s2, 0 if s1 = s2, 1 if s1 > s2

CLASS zcl_i18n_string_comparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_strings_by_locale.
    TRY.
        rv_result = cl_i18n_utils=>compare_strings(
                          string1 = iv_string1
                          string2 = iv_string2
                          locale  = iv_locale ).
      CATCH cx_i18n_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " In a real scenario, you might raise an exception or log the error
        rv_result = -99. " Indicate error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_locale FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_string_comparer( ).

    " German collation: ä sorts like ae
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_strings_by_locale( iv_string1 = 'Müller' iv_string2 = 'Muller' iv_locale = 'de-DE' ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_strings_by_locale( iv_string1 = 'Muller' iv_string2 = 'Müller' iv_locale = 'de-DE' ) exp = -1 ).

    " English collation: ä sorts like a
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_strings_by_locale( iv_string1 = 'Müller' iv_string2 = 'Muller' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_strings_by_locale( iv_string1 = 'Muller' iv_string2 = 'Müller' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = -1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_strings_by_locale( iv_string1 = 'Test' iv_string2 = 'Test' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_locale.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_string_comparer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->compare_strings_by_locale( iv_string1 = 'a' iv_string2 = 'b' iv_locale = 'xx-YY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -99 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_i18n_utils=>compare_strings()` ist entscheidend für die korrekte Sortierung und den Vergleich von Texten in mehrsprachigen Anwendungen, da es die komplexen sprachspezifischen Kollationsregeln berücksichtigt, die über einen einfachen binären Vergleich hinausgehen.
keywords: I18N, STRING, COMPARISON, SORTING, LOCALE

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_locale FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_string_length( ).

    " Standard characters
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_locale_aware_length( iv_text = 'Hello' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = 5 ).

    " Grapheme clusters (e.g., emoji with skin tone modifier)
    " Note: The exact behavior for complex graphemes might depend on the underlying Unicode version/implementation.
    " This example assumes a basic grapheme count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_locale_aware_length( iv_text = '👨‍👩‍👧‍👦' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = 1 ). " Family emoji is one grapheme
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_locale_aware_length( iv_text = 'é' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = 1 ). " e + combining acute accent is one grapheme

    " String with combining characters (e.g., 'e' + acute accent)
    DATA(lv_text_combining) = 'e' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_acute_accent.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_locale_aware_length( iv_text = lv_text_combining iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = 1 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_locale.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_string_length( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = lo_cut->get_locale_aware_length( iv_text = 'test' iv_locale = 'xx-YY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_length exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_i18n_utils=>get_string_length()` ist wichtig, um die 'gefühlte' Länge eines Strings zu erhalten, insbesondere bei Sprachen mit komplexen Graphem-Clustern (z.B. kombinierende Zeichen, Emojis). Eine einfache `strlen()`-Funktion würde hier oft falsche Ergebnisse liefern, da sie die Byte- oder Codepunkt-Länge misst, nicht die Anzahl der sichtbaren Zeichen.
keywords: I18N, STRING, LENGTH, GRAPHEME, LOCALE

CLASS zcl_i18n_alphanum_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_alphanumeric_by_locale
      IMPORTING
        iv_text      TYPE string
        iv_locale    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_alphanumeric) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_i18n_alphanum_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_alphanumeric_by_locale.
    TRY.
        rv_is_alphanumeric = cl_i18n_utils=>is_alphanumeric(
                                text   = iv_text
                                locale = iv_locale ).
      CATCH cx_i18n_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_is_alphanumeric = abap_false. " Indicate error or handle differently
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_alphanumeric FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_locale FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_alphanumeric.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_alphanum_checker( ).

    " English locale
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_alphanumeric_by_locale( iv_text = 'HelloWorld123' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_alphanumeric_by_locale( iv_text = 'Hello World!' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_alphanumeric_by_locale( iv_text = 'Straße' iv_locale = 'en-US' ) exp = abap_false ).

    " German locale (ß is not alphanumeric, but 'ä' might be considered letter)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_alphanumeric_by_locale( iv_text = 'Straße' iv_locale = 'de-DE' ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_alphanumeric_by_locale( iv_text = 'Müller' iv_locale = 'de-DE' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_alphanumeric_by_locale( iv_text = 'Müller123' iv_locale = 'de-DE' ) exp = abap_true ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_locale.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_alphanum_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_is_alphanum_invalid) = lo_cut->check_alphanumeric_by_locale( iv_text = 'test' iv_locale = 'xx-YY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_alphanum_invalid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_i18n_utils=>is_alphanumeric()` bietet eine lokalisierte Überprüfung, ob ein String ausschließlich aus alphanumerischen Zeichen besteht. Dies ist wichtig, da die Definition von 'alphanumerisch' je nach Sprache und Zeichensatz variieren kann (z.B. ob Umlaute als Buchstaben gelten).

Instructions: Erstelle ein ZIP-Archiv im Speicher, das mehrere Textdateien (repräsentiert durch Strings) enthält.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_abap_zip` und verwenden Sie die Methode `add` für jede Datei.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_create_archive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_content,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_content,
           tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_content WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_zip_archive
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_create_archive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_archive.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      DATA(lv_file_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( ls_file-content ).
      lo_zip->add(
        EXPORTING
          i_name    = ls_file-name
          i_content = lv_file_xstring
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_zip->save(
      EXPORTING
        i_compression_level = 9 " Max compression
      IMPORTING
        e_zip               = rv_zip_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_archive FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_archive.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_zip_create_archive( ).
    DATA(lt_files) = VALUE zcl_zip_create_archive=>tt_file_content(
      ( name = `file1.txt` content = `Inhalt der ersten Datei.` )
      ( name = `file2.log` content = `Log-Eintrag 1\nLog-Eintrag 2.` )
    ).

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_creator->create_zip_archive( lt_files ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_zip_xstring msg = `ZIP-XSTRING sollte nicht initial sein.` ).

    DATA(lo_zip_reader) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_reader->load( EXPORTING i_zip = lv_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_zip_files) = lo_zip_reader->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_zip_files ) exp = 2 msg = `Es sollten 2 Dateien im Archiv sein.` ).

    DATA(lv_content_file1) TYPE xstring.
    lo_zip_reader->get(
      EXPORTING
        i_name    = `file1.txt`
      IMPORTING
        e_content = lv_content_file1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_content_file1 ) exp = `Inhalt der ersten Datei.` msg = `Inhalt von file1.txt stimmt nicht überein.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_zip` wird instanziiert, um ein ZIP-Archiv im Speicher zu erstellen. Mit der Methode `add` können einzelne Dateien (als XSTRING) mit ihrem Namen hinzugefügt werden. `save` finalisiert das Archiv und gibt es als XSTRING zurück. Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Art, Archive programmatisch zu erstellen.
keywords: ZIP, Archiv, Mehrere Dateien, cl_abap_zip, XSTRING, add, save

CLASS zcl_zip_extract_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_file.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_zip_extract_file( ).
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_zip_create_archive( ).
    DATA(lt_files) = VALUE zcl_zip_create_archive=>tt_file_content(
      ( name = `data.txt` content = `Wichtige Daten.` )
      ( name = `config.ini` content = `[Settings]\nKey=Value` )
    ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_creator->create_zip_archive( lt_files ).

    DATA(lv_extracted_content) = lo_extractor->extract_single_file( iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring iv_file_name = `config.ini` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_extracted_content exp = `[Settings]\nKey=Value` msg = `Inhalt von config.ini stimmt nicht überein.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_non_existent_file.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_zip_extract_file( ).
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_zip_create_archive( ).
    DATA(lt_files) = VALUE zcl_zip_create_archive=>tt_file_content(
      ( name = `data.txt` content = `Wichtige Daten.` )
    ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_creator->create_zip_archive( lt_files ).

    TRY.
        lo_extractor->extract_single_file( iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring iv_file_name = `non_existent.txt` ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = `Es sollte eine Ausnahme für nicht existierende Datei ausgelöst werden.` ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = `Ausnahme für nicht existierende Datei korrekt ausgelöst.` ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ändern Sie das Intervall eines GUI-Timers dynamisch während der Laufzeit.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic_interval DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_new_interval
      IMPORTING
        io_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer
        iv_new_interval_seconds TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic_interval IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_new_interval.
    IF io_timer IS BOUND.
      io_timer->interval = iv_new_interval_seconds.
      " Wenn der Timer bereits läuft, wird das neue Intervall sofort wirksam.
      " Wenn er gestoppt ist, wird es beim nächsten Start verwendet.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_new_interval.
    DATA(lo_timer) = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
    lo_timer->interval = 10.

    DATA(lo_interval_setter) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_dynamic_interval( ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timer_running FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timer_not_running FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timer_unbound FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_running.
    DATA(lo_timer) = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
    lo_timer->interval = 1.
    lo_timer->start( ).

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lb_running) = lo_checker->is_timer_running( lo_timer ).

    " In einem echten GUI-Kontext wäre dies TRUE.
    " Für den Unit-Test prüfen wir, dass die Methode aufgerufen werden kann.
    " Das Attribut 'running' ist schreibgeschützt und wird vom GUI-Framework gesetzt.
    " Eine direkte Assertion auf TRUE/FALSE ist hier ohne GUI-Kontext nicht zuverlässig.
    " Wir können aber prüfen, dass kein Dump auftritt und das Attribut gelesen wird.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_timer msg = `Timer-Objekt sollte existieren.` ).
    " Da 'running' ein READ-ONLY Attribut ist, können wir es nicht direkt im Test setzen.
    " Der Test bestätigt, dass der Zugriff auf das Attribut funktioniert.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_not_running.
    DATA(lo_timer) = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
    lo_timer->interval = 1.
    " Timer wird nicht gestartet

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lb_running) = lo_checker->is_timer_running( lo_timer ).

    " Gleiche Einschränkung wie oben. Der Wert von 'running' ist vom GUI-Kontext abhängig.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_timer msg = `Timer-Objekt sollte existieren.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_unbound.
    DATA(lo_timer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lb_running) = lo_checker->is_timer_running( lo_timer ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_running exp = abap_false msg = `Für ungebundenen Timer sollte FALSE zurückgegeben werden.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Attribut `running` des `cl_gui_timer`-Objekts gibt den aktuellen Status des Timers zurück (`abap_true`, wenn er läuft, `abap_false` sonst). Dies ist eine einfache und direkte Möglichkeit, den Zustand des Timers abzufragen. Die Prüfung auf `IS BOUND` verhindert Fehler bei der Dereferenzierung eines nicht-instanziierten Objekts.
keywords: GUI, Timer, Status, Laufen, cl_gui_timer, Running, abap_bool

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv mit einer Datei, deren Inhalt aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten generiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip`, `cl_abap_conv_codepage` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für XML-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_zip
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_zip.
    DATA(lv_xml_string) TYPE string.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE it_sflight = it_sflight RESULT XML lv_xml_string.

    DATA(lv_xml_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( lv_xml_string ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      EXPORTING
        i_name    = `sflight_data.xml`
        i_content = lv_xml_xstring
    ).

    lo_zip->save(
      EXPORTING
        i_compression_level = 9
      IMPORTING
        e_zip               = rv_zip_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_sflight_zip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_sflight_zip.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_data UP TO 2 ROWS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_sflight_data msg = `SFLIGHT-Daten sollten vorhanden sein.` ).

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_zip_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_creator->create_sflight_zip( lt_sflight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_zip_xstring msg = `ZIP-XSTRING sollte nicht initial sein.` ).

    DATA(lo_zip_reader) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_reader->load( EXPORTING i_zip = lv_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_extracted_xml_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    lo_zip_reader->get(
      EXPORTING
        i_name    = `sflight_data.xml`
      IMPORTING
        e_content = lv_extracted_xml_xstring
    ).
    DATA(lv_extracted_xml_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_extracted_xml_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_sflight_deserialized) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE XML lv_extracted_xml_string RESULT it_sflight = lt_sflight_deserialized.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight_deserialized ) exp = lines( lt_sflight_data ) msg = `Anzahl der deserialisierten SFLIGHT-Zeilen stimmt nicht überein.` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight_deserialized exp = lt_sflight_data msg = `Deserialisierte SFLIGHT-Daten stimmen mit Original überein.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die ZIP-Funktionalität mit der XML-Serialisierung von internen Tabellen (`CALL TRANSFORMATION ID`). Die SFLIGHT-Daten werden in XML umgewandelt, als XSTRING komprimiert und in ein ZIP-Archiv gepackt. Dies demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Datenverarbeitung und -archivierung in ABAP.
keywords: ZIP, SFLIGHT, XML, Serialisierung, cl_abap_zip, CALL TRANSFORMATION, XSTRING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen GUI-Timer, der sich nach einer bestimmten Anzahl von Ausführungen selbst deaktiviert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `run_mode_multiple_events` und zählen Sie die Ereignisse im Handler, um den Timer dann zu stoppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_auto_deactivate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_max_runs TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_current_runs TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_runs TYPE i.
    METHODS start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_auto_deactivate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
    mv_max_runs = iv_max_runs.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_multiple_events.
    mo_timer->start( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mv_current_runs = mv_current_runs + 1.
    IF mv_current_runs >= mv_max_runs.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_zip_reader->load( EXPORTING i_zip = lv_zip_xstring ).

    lo_zip_reader->get(
      EXPORTING
        i_name    = `sflight_data.json`
      IMPORTING
        e_content = lv_extracted_json_xstring
    ).
    DATA(lv_extracted_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_extracted_json_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_sflight_deserialized) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    cl_abap_json_deserializer=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = lv_extracted_json_string
      CHANGING
        data = lt_sflight_deserialized
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight_deserialized ) exp = lines( lt_sflight_data ) msg = `Anzahl der deserialisierten SFLIGHT-Zeilen stimmt nicht überein.` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight_deserialized exp = lt_sflight_data msg = `Deserialisierte SFLIGHT-Daten stimmen mit Original überein.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung eines ZIP-Archivs, das eine JSON-Datei enthält. Die interne Tabelle mit SFLIGHT-Daten wird mittels `cl_abap_json_serializer` in einen JSON-String umgewandelt, dann in XSTRING konvertiert und dem ZIP-Archiv hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine moderne Methode zur Datenexport und -archivierung, die weit verbreitete Formate nutzt.
keywords: ZIP, SFLIGHT, JSON, Serialisierung, cl_abap_zip, cl_abap_json_serializer, XSTRING

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis in der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT max_p = 0
                                             FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                             NEXT max_p = nmax( max_p, flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den gesamten Flugdatensatz mit dem höchsten Flugpreis aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rs_flight = REDUCE #( INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( )
                              FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                              NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price_row FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_row.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_row( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( ).

    " Assuming sflight contains data and a max price can be found.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result flight should not be initial' act = ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Price should be greater than 0' act = ( ls_result-price > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser `REDUCE`-Ausdruck iteriert über die Tabelle und behält den Datensatz mit dem bisher höchsten Preis bei. `COND` wird verwendet, um die Bedingung zu prüfen, und `CORRESPONDING` kopiert die Felder des aktuellen Fluges in die Ergebnisstruktur.
keywords: REDUCE, MAXIMUM, COND, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und finden Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft den höchsten Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `REDUCE` und `MAXIMUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_max_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                                 GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid    = carrid
                                   max_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT max_p = 0
                                                                     FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                                     NEXT max_p = nmax( max_p, member-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_max_price( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    " Further assertions would require controlled test data to check specific max prices per carrier.
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = <fs_entry>-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be positive' act = ( <fs_entry>-max_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR GROUPS` ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` kann für jede Gruppe eine Aggregation (hier das Maximum) berechnet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Grouping, Internal Tables, Aggregation

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_30_days_later) = lv_today + 30.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate BETWEEN lv_today AND lv_30_days_later ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Assuming sflight contains some flights in the next 30 days.
    " This test might be flaky depending on the actual data in sflight.
    " For robust testing, one would mock the sflight data with specific dates.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find some future flights' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
      LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date must be in the future' act = ( <fs_flight>-fldate >= sy-datum ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date must be within 30 days' act = ( <fs_flight>-fldate <= sy-datum + 30 ) ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator kann auch mit Datumsberechnungen verwendet werden, um Zeilen basierend auf Zeiträumen zu filtern. Dies ist eine flexible und moderne Art, Datumsfilterungen durchzuführen.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = VALUE tt_carrier_avg_price( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                                                      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
                                                      ( carrid    = carrid,
                                                        avg_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum_p = 0.0, count = 0
                                                                                          FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                                                          NEXT sum_p = sum_p + member-price,
                                                                                               count = count + 1
                                                                                          FINAL = COND #( count > 0, sum_p / count, 0 ) ) ) ).

    rs_carrier_avg = REDUCE #( INIT max_avg_carr = VALUE ty_carrier_avg_price( )
                                FOR avg_carr IN lt_avg_prices
                                NEXT max_avg_carr = COND #( WHEN avg_carr-avg_price > max_avg_carr-avg_price THEN CORRESPONDING #( avg_carr ) ELSE max_avg_carr ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_with_max_avg_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result carrier should not be initial' act = ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average price should be positive' act = ( ls_result-avg_price > 0 ) ).

Anschließend wird aus dieser Ergebnismenge der Eintrag mit dem höchsten Durchschnittspreis ebenfalls mit `REDUCE` und `MAXIMUM` ermittelt.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                             WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                               AND connid = iv_connid
                               AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der längsten Flugdauer für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'DL').
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` mit `MAXIMUM` auf ein berechnetes Feld (z.B. `fldate` und `arrtime` - `deptime`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_duration.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rs_flight = REDUCE #( INIT max_duration_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( )
                              FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                              LET lv_duration = ( flight-arrtime - flight-deptime ) IN
                              NEXT max_duration_flight = COND #( WHEN lv_duration > ( max_duration_flight-arrtime - max_duration_flight-deptime ) THEN CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ELSE max_duration_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_flight_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_duration( ).
    " Assuming DL flights exist and have valid deptime/arrtime
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_duration( iv_carrid = 'DL' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result flight should not be initial' act = ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier must be DL' act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'DL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Duration should be positive' act = ( ls_result-arrtime - ls_result-deptime > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_flight_duration_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_duration( ).
    " Assuming carrier 'XX' does not exist
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_duration( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for non-existent carrier' act = ls_result-carrid ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FILTER` zur Vorselektion und `REDUCE` zur Ermittlung des Maximums basierend auf einer berechneten Eigenschaft (Flugdauer). Die `LET`-Anweisung innerhalb von `REDUCE` verbessert die Lesbarkeit der Berechnung.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, LET, Date/Time, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_filter_allowed_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Finde den niedrigsten Flugpreis in einer Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHTS-Struktur).
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE`-Expression mit dem `MIN`-Operator, um den Minimalwert zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price.
    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( INIT min_price = 9999999999.00 " Initial high value
                             FOR flight IN it_flights
                             NEXT min_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_min_flight_price=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_flight_price( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_min) = lo_cut->get_min_price( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min exp = '50.00' msg = 'Incorrect minimum price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_min_flight_price=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_flight_price( ).

    DATA(lv_min) = lo_cut->get_min_price( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min exp = '9999999999.00' msg = 'Incorrect minimum price for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Hier wird der niedrigste Preis durch Iteration und bedingte Zuweisung (`COND`) ermittelt, was zu deutlich weniger Code führt als eine klassische Schleife.
keywords: REDUCE, MIN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_below_price( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_max_price = '50.00' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Sie erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den passenden Einträgen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren, und ist deutlich lesbarer als eine Schleife mit `DELETE` oder `COLLECT`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die den kleineren von zwei übergebenen Zahlenwerten zurückgibt, und rufe diese Methode funktional in einem Ausdruck auf.
hint: Definiere eine `STATIC` Methode mit `RETURNING` Parameter und rufe sie direkt im Ausdruck auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_minimum
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minimum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_minimum.
    rv_minimum = COND #( WHEN iv_value1 < iv_value2 THEN iv_value1 ELSE iv_value2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_minimum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_equal_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_minimum.
    DATA(lv_result1) = zcl_math_operations=>get_minimum( iv_value1 = 10 iv_value2 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 5 msg = 'Incorrect minimum for 10, 5' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = zcl_math_operations=>get_minimum( iv_value1 = 20 iv_value2 = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 20 msg = 'Incorrect minimum for 20, 30' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_equal_values.
    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_math_operations=>get_minimum( iv_value1 = 7 iv_value2 = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 7 msg = 'Incorrect minimum for equal values' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Statische Methoden mit `RETURNING` Parametern können funktional in Ausdrücken aufgerufen werden, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. In Kombination mit der `COND`-Expression für bedingte Zuweisungen entsteht eine sehr prägnante Lösung.
keywords: Functional Method, Object Orientation, COND, MINIMUM

Instructions: Ermittle das früheste Flugdatum aus einer Liste von Flügen (SFLIGHTS-Struktur).
hint: Nutze eine `FOR`-Expression, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und das minimale Datum zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_flight_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_earliest_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_earliest_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_flight_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_earliest_flight_date.
    rv_earliest_date = REDUCE #( INIT min_date = sy-datum " Initialize with current date or a very late date
                             FOR flight IN it_flights
                             NEXT min_date = COND #( WHEN flight-fldate < min_date THEN flight-fldate ELSE min_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_earliest_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_earliest_date.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_min_flight_date=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_flight_date( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250315' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250120' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250210' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_earliest) = lo_cut->get_earliest_flight_date( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_earliest exp = '20250120' msg = 'Incorrect earliest date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_min_flight_date=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_flight_date( ).

    DATA(lv_earliest) = lo_cut->get_earliest_flight_date( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_earliest exp = sy-datum msg = 'Incorrect earliest date for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie bei numerischen Werten kann die `REDUCE`-Expression auch für Datumsfelder verwendet werden, um das minimale (früheste) Datum zu finden. Die Initialisierung mit `sy-datum` (oder einem sehr späten Datum) stellt sicher, dass der erste Vergleich korrekt funktioniert. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art der Datumsaggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, Date, MINIMUM, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die dynamisch einen Statusbericht für ein `cl_gui_textedit` Control generiert, basierend auf verschiedenen Eingabeparametern. Nutze `SWITCH`-Expression für die dynamische Textauswahl.
hint: Verwende die `SWITCH`-Expression, um basierend auf einem Wert unterschiedliche Textbausteine zu wählen und diese mit String Templates zu kombinieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_text_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_status_level TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I'. " I=Info, W=Warning, E=Error

    METHODS generate_status_report
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_level TYPE ty_status_level
        iv_message      TYPE string
        iv_timestamp    TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_text_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_status_report.
    DATA(lv_status_prefix) = SWITCH ty_status_level(
      iv_status_level
      WHEN 'I' THEN 'INFO: '
      WHEN 'W' THEN 'WARN: '
      WHEN 'E' THEN 'ERROR: '
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN: '
    ).

    rv_report_text = |{ lv_status_prefix }{ iv_message } (Zeitstempel: { iv_timestamp TIMESTAMP = ISO } )\n|
                   && |Dieser Bericht ist für die Anzeige in einem cl_gui_textedit Control gedacht.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_info_report FOR TESTING.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '2025-11-26T10:00:00' act = lv_report msg = 'Timestamp incorrect' ).

  METHOD test_warning_report.

    DATA(lv_report) = lo_cut->generate_status_report( iv_status_level = 'W' iv_message = 'Geringe Speicherauslastung.' iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'WARN: Geringe Speicherauslastung.' act = lv_report msg = 'Warning report incorrect' ).

explanation: Die `SWITCH`-Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von bedingten Zuweisungen, die zuvor oft mit `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF` realisiert wurden. In Kombination mit String Templates können so dynamisch formatierte Texte für Controls wie `cl_gui_textedit` effizient erstellt werden.
keywords: SWITCH, Dynamic Programming, String Templates, cl_gui_textedit, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Transformiere eine Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHTS-Struktur) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und eine Preis-Kategorie ('Günstig', 'Standard', 'Teuer') basierend auf dem Flugpreis enthält. Nutze `FOR`-Expression für die Transformation.
hint: Verwende die `FOR`-Expression, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen und dabei die Daten zu transformieren. Nutze `COND` für die Preis-Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_flights.
    rt_categorized_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                      ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                        connid = flight-connid
                                        category = COND string(
                                          WHEN flight-price < 70 THEN 'Günstig'
                                          WHEN flight-price < 150 THEN 'Standard'
                                          ELSE 'Teuer' )
                                      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_categorization FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorization.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_category=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_category( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '120.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_categorized) = lo_cut->categorize_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_categorized ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of categorized flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_categorized[ 1 ]-category exp = 'Günstig' msg = 'Category for flight 1 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_categorized[ 2 ]-category exp = 'Standard' msg = 'Category for flight 2 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_categorized[ 3 ]-category exp = 'Teuer' msg = 'Category for flight 3 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_category=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_category( ).

    DATA(lt_categorized) = lo_cut->categorize_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_categorized msg = 'Categorized table should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben und manuell Zeilen zu füllen, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus der alten abgeleitet, wobei `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung der Kategorie sorgt. Dies ist ein Kernstück des modernen ABAP für die Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Mapping, Transformation, COND, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Bestimme den Status eines Fluges ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf einem Statuscode. Nutze die `CASE`-Expression für die Zuweisung.
