Instructions: Ersetze alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes in einem Text, der für ein `cl_gui_textedit` Control bestimmt ist.
hint: Nutze die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Anweisung für effizientes Ersetzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_text_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_old_word      TYPE string
        iv_new_word      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_word.
    rv_modified_text = iv_original_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_word IN rv_modified_text WITH iv_new_word.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_single FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_replace FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_case_sensitive FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_word( iv_original_text = 'Dies ist ein Test.' iv_old_word = 'Test' iv_new_word = 'Beispiel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Dies ist ein Beispiel.' msg = 'Single replacement failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_word( iv_original_text = 'Der Text enthält Text und noch mehr Text.' iv_old_word = 'Text' iv_new_word = 'Inhalt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Der Inhalt enthält Inhalt und noch mehr Inhalt.' msg = 'Multiple replacement failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = 'Kein Wort zum Ersetzen hier.'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_word( iv_original_text = lv_original iv_old_word = 'NichtVorhanden' iv_new_word = 'Neu' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_original msg = 'No replacement should occur' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_case_sensitive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_word( iv_original_text = 'Test test TEST' iv_old_word = 'test' iv_new_word = 'abc' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Test abc TEST' msg = 'Case-sensitive replacement failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Anweisung ist die moderne und effiziente Methode, um alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem String zu ersetzen. Sie ist leistungsfähiger und lesbarer als ältere Ansätze mit `FIND` und `REPLACE` in Schleifen und ideal für die Vorbereitung von Textinhalten, z.B. für `cl_gui_textedit`.
keywords: REPLACE, String Processing, cl_gui_textedit, Text Manipulation

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine Zahl validiert und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn der Wert unter einem definierten Minimum liegt.
hint: Erstelle eine globale Ausnahme-Klasse und verwende `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_min_value_violation DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA min_allowed_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid            LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous          LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL
        min_allowed_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_min_value_violation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->min_allowed_value = min_allowed_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS validate_minimum
      IMPORTING
        iv_value          TYPE i
        iv_minimum_allowed TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_min_value_violation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_minimum.
    IF iv_value < iv_minimum_allowed.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_min_value_violation
        EXPORTING
          min_allowed_value = iv_minimum_allowed.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_value FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_min_value_violation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_value.
    TRY.
        zcl_value_validator=>validate_minimum( iv_value = 10 iv_minimum_allowed = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( true msg = 'Exception should not be raised for valid value' ).
      CATCH zcx_min_value_violation.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected exception for valid value' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_value.
    DATA(lv_expected_min) = 10.
    TRY.
        zcl_value_validator=>validate_minimum( iv_value = 5 iv_minimum_allowed = lv_expected_min ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception zcx_min_value_violation expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_min_value_violation INTO DATA(lx_min_violation).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_min_violation->min_allowed_value exp = lv_expected_min msg = 'Incorrect minimum allowed value in exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme-Klassen, die von `cx_static_check` erben, ist der moderne Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen eine typsichere und strukturierte Reaktion auf Fehlerzustände. Die `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` Anweisung ist die präferierte Syntax zum Auslösen von Ausnahmen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: Exceptions, Error Handling, Custom Exception, RAISE EXCEPTION, MINIMUM

Instructions: Finde den Flug mit dem niedrigsten Preis für jede Fluggesellschaft in einer Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHTS-Struktur).
hint: Nutze die `GROUP BY` Klausel in einer `FOR`-Expression, um Daten zu gruppieren und dann den Minimalwert pro Gruppe zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_price_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_min_price_result,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             min_price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_min_price_result.
    TYPES tt_min_price_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_min_price_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_min_prices) TYPE tt_min_price_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_by_carrier.
    rt_min_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights BY carrid
                             ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                               min_price = REDUCE #( INIT mp = 9999999999.00
                                                     FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                     NEXT mp = COND #( WHEN member-price < mp THEN member-price ELSE mp ) )
                               currency  = flight-currency " Assuming currency is consistent per carrier/flight
                             ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_min_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_min_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_per_carrier=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_per_carrier( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '80.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' price = '60.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_min_prices) = lo_cut->get_min_price_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_min_prices ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of carriers' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_min) = lt_min_prices[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_min-min_price exp = '80.00' msg = 'Min price for LH incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_min) = lt_min_prices[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_min-min_price exp = '50.00' msg = 'Min price for AA incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_per_carrier=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_per_carrier( ).

    DATA(lt_min_prices) = lo_cut->get_min_price_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_min_prices msg = 'Result table should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY` Expression ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Funktion (ab 7.50), die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchzuführen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Ermittlung des Minimalwerts pro Gruppe wird eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Lösung für komplexe Aggregationsaufgaben geboten, die zuvor aufwendige Schleifen und Hilfstabellen erforderten.

Instructions: Entferne führende und abschließende Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Textes, der für ein `cl_gui_textedit` Control vorbereitet wird. Nutze `CONDENSE` mit `NO-GAPS` und `REPLACE`.
hint: Verwende `CONDENSE` für führende/abschließende Leerzeichen und `REPLACE` mit `REGEX` für doppelte Leerzeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_text_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_text_for_display
      IMPORTING
        iv_dirty_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_clean_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_text_for_display.
    rv_clean_text = iv_dirty_text.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces and replace multiple spaces with single space
    " CONDENSE NO-GAPS is for char-like, for string we use regex
    " For modern ABAP, regex is preferred for internal gaps
    rv_clean_text = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern( pattern = '\s+' case_sensitive = abap_false )->replace( text = rv_clean_text replacement = ' ' ).
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    rv_clean_text = CONV string( |{ rv_clean_text ALPHA = OUT }| ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_text FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_change FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_text_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_dirty) = `  Dies   ist  ein   sehr   unordentlicher    Text.  `.
    DATA(lv_clean) = lo_cut->clean_text_for_display( lv_dirty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_clean exp = 'Dies ist ein sehr unordentlicher Text.' msg = 'Text cleaning failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_change.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_text_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_clean_input) = 'Ein sauberer Text.'.
    DATA(lv_clean_output) = lo_cut->clean_text_for_display( lv_clean_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_clean_output exp = lv_clean_input msg = 'Clean text should not be changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_text_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_clean_output) = lo_cut->clean_text_for_display( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_clean_output exp = '' msg = 'Empty string should remain empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für die Bereinigung von Strings in modernem ABAP ist die Kombination aus `cl_abap_regex` und der `ALPHA = OUT` Formatierungsoption in String Templates sehr effizient. `cl_abap_regex` ermöglicht das Ersetzen beliebiger Muster (hier: mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes), während `ALPHA = OUT` führende und abschließende Leerzeichen entfernt. Dies ist flexibler und leistungsfähiger als das veraltete `CONDENSE NO-GAPS` für String-Typen und ideal für die Aufbereitung von Text für Controls wie `cl_gui_textedit`.
keywords: String Processing, REGEX, cl_abap_regex, String Templates, ALPHA, cl_gui_textedit, Text Cleaning

Instructions: Finde den ersten Flug in einer Tabelle (SFLIGHTS-Struktur), der einen Preis über einem bestimmten Minimum hat.
hint: Nutze die `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE` und `FIRST` für eine kompakte Suche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_first_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_flight_above_min
      IMPORTING
        it_flights     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_found_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_first_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight_above_min.
    rs_found_flight = VALUE #( it_flights[ KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price ] OPTIONAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_find_first.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_find_first_flight=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_find_first_flight( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '80.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(ls_found) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_above_min( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Incorrect carrier found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found-price exp = '120.00' msg = 'Incorrect price found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_found.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(ls_found) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_above_min( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_found-carrid msg = 'No flight should be found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_find_first_flight=>tt_sflight.

    DATA(ls_found) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_above_min( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_found-carrid msg = 'No flight should be found for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der direkte Zugriff auf interne Tabellen mit `[ KEY primary_key WHERE ... ]` in Kombination mit `VALUE #( ... OPTIONAL )` ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Methode, um einzelne Zeilen basierend auf Bedingungen zu lesen. `OPTIONAL` verhindert einen Dump, wenn keine Zeile gefunden wird, und gibt stattdessen den Initialwert zurück. Dies ist deutlich prägnanter als `READ TABLE` mit `TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und anschließender `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfung.
keywords: Internal Tables, Read Table, WHERE, OPTIONAL, SFLIGHTS, MINIMUM

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Objekten verwaltet und den Zugriff auf das Objekt mit dem niedrigsten ID-Wert ermöglicht. Nutze `FINAL` und `READ-ONLY` für moderne Kapselung.
hint: Verwende `SORT` und `READ TABLE` mit Index oder `MIN` in einer `REDUCE`-Expression, um das Objekt mit der niedrigsten ID zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_object_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_managed_object,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_managed_object.
    TYPES tt_managed_object TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_managed_object WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_managed_object.

    METHODS get_object_with_min_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_object) TYPE ty_managed_object.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_objects TYPE tt_managed_object READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_objects = it_objects.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_object_with_min_id.
    IF mt_objects IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_object = mt_objects[ 1 ]. " Sorted table, first entry has min ID
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Eine `SORTED TABLE` stellt sicher, dass die Elemente immer nach dem Schlüssel sortiert sind, was den Zugriff auf das Element mit dem minimalen Schlüsselwert (hier: ID) extrem effizient macht, da es immer das erste Element ist (`[ 1 ]`). Dies ist eine moderne und performante Art, Daten in Objekten zu verwalten.

Instructions: Berechne die minimale Anzahl von Tagen zwischen dem aktuellen Datum und einer Liste von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS-Struktur).
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE`-Expression mit `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` oder direkter Datumsarithmetik und `MIN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_days_to_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_days_to_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_current_date TYPE sy-datum DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_days_to_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_days_to_flight.
    rv_min_days = REDUCE #( INIT min_diff = 999999 " Initial high value
                             FOR flight IN it_flights
                             LET diff = flight-fldate - iv_current_date IN
                             NEXT min_diff = COND #( WHEN diff < min_diff THEN diff ELSE min_diff ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach einer dynamisch erstellten Liste von Fluggesellschaften (Carrier IDs) unter Verwendung eines Ranges und der `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` Syntax. Die Filterung soll nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaften 'AA' und 'LH' berücksichtigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` und den `IN` Operator mit einem Range-Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter_it_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter_it_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrid.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid IN it_carrid_range ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_filter_it_carrid( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 fltime = 60 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 150 fltime = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 fltime = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '004' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 120 fltime = 70 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrid( it_sflights = lt_sflights it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) aus der Datenbank, wobei die Auswahl der Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) durch einen dynamisch erstellten Range bestimmt wird. Selektieren Sie alle Flüge, die nicht von 'AZ' oder 'BA' durchgeführt werden.

CLASS zcl_rng_select_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_select_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrid_range.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `COUNT(*)` für die Aggregation.

CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine Liste der Flugnummern (`CONNID`) enthält, die mit '0' beginnen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `FOR` für die Aggregation der `CONNID`s.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_connids,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids  TYPE tt_connid,
           END OF ty_carrid_connids.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_connids) TYPE tt_carrid_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING.
      DATA(lt_connids_for_group) = REDUCE tt_connid(
        INIT connids = VALUE tt_connid( )
        FOR GROUP ls_flight OF it_sflights IN GROUP ( WHERE ( connid CP '0*' ) )
        NEXT connids = VALUE tt_connid( BASE connids ( ls_flight-connid ) )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_connids(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connids = lt_connids_for_group
      ) TO rt_carrid_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0040' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 fltime = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 120 fltime = 70 )

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '3000' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 110 fltime = 65 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_connids) = lo_cut->get_connids_by_carrid( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrid_connids ) exp = 3 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Range, der alle Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) ausschließt, die mit 'S' beginnen, und alle Flugnummern (CONNID) einschließt, die zwischen '0001' und '0100' liegen. Wenden Sie diesen Range auf eine interne Tabelle an.
hint: Erstellen Sie separate Ranges für `CARRID` und `CONNID` und kombinieren Sie die Filterlogik mit `FILTER` oder `FOR ... WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_complex_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_complex_ranges.
    DATA(lt_carrid_exclude_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'CP' low = 'S*' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_connid_include_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-connid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0100' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE
                                      ( carrid IN lt_carrid_exclude_range AND
                                        connid IN lt_connid_include_range ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 fltime = 60 ) " Included
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0150' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 150 fltime = 90 ) " Excluded (connid out of range)
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 fltime = 120 ) " Excluded (carrid starts with S)
      ( carrid = 'SA' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 120 fltime = 70 ) " Excluded (carrid starts with S)
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0099' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 130 fltime = 80 ) " Included
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0101' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 110 fltime = 65 ) " Excluded (connid out of range)
    ).

CLASS zcl_rng_cond_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle (Map), deren Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft ist und deren Wert die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) für diese Fluggesellschaft ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und in eine Hash-Tabelle einzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_carrid_seatsmax_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_sum_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             sum_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_sum_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_sum_seats TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrid_sum_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_sum_seats_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_sum_map) TYPE tt_carrid_sum_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_seats_by_carrid.
    rt_carrid_sum_map = REDUCE tt_carrid_sum_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid_sum_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET sum_seats_for_group = REDUCE i(
        INIT s = 0
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT s = s + ls_member-seatsmax
      ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrid_sum_seats( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid sum_seats = sum_seats_for_group ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_max_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_max_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_max_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_max_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_seats_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_seats) TYPE tt_carrid_max_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING.
      DATA(lv_max_seats_for_group) = REDUCE i(
        INIT m = 0
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT m = nmax( val1 = m val2 = ls_member-seatsmax )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_max_seats(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        max_seats = lv_max_seats_for_group
      ) TO rt_max_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Filtern Sie diese Tabelle dynamisch, indem Sie einen Range für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) und einen weiteren Range für Flugzeiten (FLTIME) kombinieren. Der CARRID-Range soll 'AA' und 'LH' einschließen, der FLTIME-Range soll Flüge unter 90 Minuten ausschließen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit verschachtelten Bedingungen und Ranges.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_nested_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_nested_ranges.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_fltime_exclude_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-fltime(
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'LT' low = 90 ) " Exclude less than 90
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE
                                      ( carrid IN lt_carrid_range AND
                                        fltime IN lt_fltime_exclude_range ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_range_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_nested_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 fltime = 60 )  " Excluded (fltime < 90)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 150 fltime = 90 )  " Included
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 fltime = 120 ) " Excluded (carrid not AA/LH)
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '004' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 120 fltime = 100 ) " Included
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '005' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 130 fltime = 80 )  " Excluded (fltime < 90)
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_nested_ranges( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-fltime exp = 90 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-fltime exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination mehrerer Range-Tabellen mit logischen Operatoren (`AND`) innerhalb des `FILTER` Operators ermöglicht die Implementierung komplexer, mehrdimensionaler Filterbedingungen auf interne Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und ausdrucksstarke Methode, um dynamische Selektionslogik zu kapseln.
keywords: RANGES, Internal Tables, FILTER, Logical Operators, Dynamic, Nested Conditions

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine kommagetrennte Liste aller Flugnummern (`CONNID`) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um die Flugnummern zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_connid_list,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_list TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrid_connid_list.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_connid_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_connid_list WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connid_list_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_connid_list) TYPE tt_carrid_connid_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_list_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING.
      DATA(lv_connid_string) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ``
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_member-connid
          ELSE |{ s }, { ls_member-connid }|
        )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_connid_list(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid_list = lv_connid_string
      ) TO rt_carrid_connid_list.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_string_concat.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce_string( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 fltime = 60 )

      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 fltime = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '004' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 120 fltime = 70 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '005' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 130 fltime = 80 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_connid_list) = lo_cut->get_connid_list_by_carrid( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrid_connid_list ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_list) = lt_carrid_connid_list[ carrid = 'AA' ].

    DATA(ls_ua_list) = lt_carrid_connid_list[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_list-connid_list exp = '003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie für jeden Flug die Passagierkapazität und die belegten Sitze in einer neuen verschachtelten Struktur zusammenfassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine verschachtelte `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             capacity_info TYPE BEGIN OF STRUCTURE,
               max_seats TYPE s_seatsmax,
               occupied_seats TYPE s_seatsocc,
             END OF STRUCTURE,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_nested_for_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS transform_flights
          IMPORTING
            it_flights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_nested_for_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD transform_flights.
        rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights_raw
                                     ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                       connid = flight-connid
                                       fldate = flight-fldate
                                       capacity_info = VALUE #( max_seats = flight-seatsmax
                                                                occupied_seats = flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             capacity_info TYPE BEGIN OF STRUCTURE,
               max_seats TYPE s_seatsmax,
               occupied_seats TYPE s_seatsocc,
             END OF STRUCTURE,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_transform FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_transform.
        DATA lt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_raw( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_raw_flights.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_raw( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251202' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 180 ) TO lt_raw_flights.

        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_for_flights( ).
        DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_raw_flights ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-capacity_info-max_seats exp = 100 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-capacity_info-occupied_seats exp = 50 ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die verschachtelte `VALUE`-Expression wird verwendet, um eine Struktur (`capacity_info`) direkt während der Iteration zu füllen, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus einer Tabelle von Flügen und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_total_price
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
        METHODS display_total_price IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD calculate_total_price.
        rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE s_price VALUE 0
                                   FOR flight IN it_flights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_total_price.
        DATA(lv_total) = calculate_total_price( it_flights ).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Gesamtpreis aller Flüge: { lv_total } EUR| ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

        DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_price( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_price( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_flight_price( ).
        DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).

explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Werte aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Sie ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen durch eine deklarative Syntax, die den Code kürzer und fehlerresistenter macht. `cl_demo_output` zeigt das Ergebnis.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen, die verschachtelt geprüft werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine verschachtelte `COND`-Expression.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status_data,
             delay_minutes TYPE i,
             is_cancelled  TYPE abap_bool,
             weather_issue TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_status_data.

    CLASS zcl_nested_cond_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_flight_status
          IMPORTING
            is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_status_data
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_nested_cond_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_flight_status.
        rv_status = COND string(
                      WHEN is_flight_data-is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Abgesagt'
                      WHEN is_flight_data-delay_minutes > 60 THEN
                        COND string(
                          WHEN is_flight_data-weather_issue = abap_true THEN 'Verspätet (Wetter)'
                          ELSE 'Verspätet (Technisch)'
                        )
                      WHEN is_flight_data-delay_minutes > 0 THEN 'Leicht verspätet'
                      ELSE 'Pünktlich'
                    ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status_data,
             delay_minutes TYPE i,
             is_cancelled  TYPE abap_bool,
             weather_issue TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_status_data.

    CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_flight_status.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_cond_flight( ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( VALUE ty_flight_status_data( is_cancelled = abap_true ) ) exp = 'Abgesagt' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( VALUE ty_flight_status_data( delay_minutes = 90 weather_issue = abap_true ) ) exp = 'Verspätet (Wetter)' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( VALUE ty_flight_status_data( delay_minutes = 90 weather_issue = abap_false ) ) exp = 'Verspätet (Technisch)' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( VALUE ty_flight_status_data( delay_minutes = 30 ) ) exp = 'Leicht verspätet' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( VALUE ty_flight_status_data( delay_minutes = 0 ) ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht die deklarative Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen, ähnlich einem `CASE`-Statement oder verschachtelten `IF`-Statements, aber in einem Ausdruckskontext. Verschachtelung macht komplexe Logik kompakt.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Nesting

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, und geben Sie die gefilterte Tabelle mit `cl_demo_output` aus.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_date,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_date.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS filter_flights_by_date
          IMPORTING
            it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_date
            iv_min_date    TYPE s_date
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_date.

          IMPORTING
            it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_date
            iv_min_date    TYPE s_date.

      METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE fldate > iv_min_date ).

      METHOD display_filtered_flights.
        DATA(lt_filtered) = filter_flights_by_date( it_all_flights = it_all_flights iv_min_date = iv_min_date ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Gefilterte Flüge nach { iv_min_date }:| ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum und geben Sie für bestimmte Tage spezielle Nachrichten aus, wobei Sie eine verschachtelte `SWITCH`-Expression verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine verschachtelte `SWITCH`-Expression und die Funktion `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_switch_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_weekday_message
          IMPORTING
            iv_date TYPE d
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_nested_switch_date IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_weekday_message.
        DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( iv_date ). " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday

        rv_message = SWITCH string( lv_weekday
                       WHEN 6 THEN "Saturday
                         SWITCH string( iv_date
                           WHEN sy-datum THEN 'Heute ist Samstag! Wochenende!'
                           ELSE 'Es war ein Samstag. Wochenende!'
                         )
                       WHEN 7 THEN "Sunday
                         SWITCH string( iv_date
                           WHEN sy-datum THEN 'Heute ist Sonntag! Entspannung!'
                           ELSE 'Es war ein Sonntag. Entspannung!'
                         )
                       WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag. Neuer Wochenstart.'
                       WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag. Fast Wochenende!'
                       ELSE 'Wochentag.'
                     ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_weekday_message FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_weekday_message.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_switch_date( ).

        " Assuming sy-datum is not Saturday or Sunday for these tests
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_message( '20251129' ) exp = 'Es war ein Samstag. Wochenende!' ). " Saturday
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_message( '20251130' ) exp = 'Es war ein Sonntag. Entspannung!' ). " Sunday
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_message( '20251201' ) exp = 'Montag. Neuer Wochenstart.' ). " Monday
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_message( '20251205' ) exp = 'Freitag. Fast Wochenende!' ). " Friday
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_message( '20251203' ) exp = 'Wochentag.' ). " Wednesday
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH`-Expression ermöglicht die deklarative Auswahl eines Wertes basierend auf verschiedenen Fällen. Die Verschachtelung von `SWITCH`-Expressions erlaubt die Implementierung komplexer Entscheidungsbäume in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Nesting, Date/Time

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer Tabelle existiert und geben Sie dessen Index aus, falls vorhanden. Nutzen Sie `cl_demo_output` für die Ausgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    CLASS zcl_line_exists_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS find_flight_index
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
            is_search_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i. " 0 if not found, >0 if found
        METHODS display_flight_info
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
            is_search_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_line_exists_index IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD find_flight_index.
        IF LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_search_key-carrid
                                                      connid = is_search_key-connid
                                                      fldate = is_search_key-fldate ] ) .
          rv_index = LINE_INDEX( it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_search_key-carrid
                                                              connid = is_search_key-connid
                                                              fldate = is_search_key-fldate ] ).
        ELSE.
          rv_index = 0.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_flight_info.
        DATA(lv_index) = find_flight_index( it_flights = it_flights is_search_key = is_search_key ).
        IF lv_index > 0.
          cl_demo_output=>display( |Flug { is_search_key-carrid } { is_search_key-connid } am { is_search_key-fldate } gefunden an Index: { lv_index }| ).
        ELSE.
          cl_demo_output=>display( |Flug { is_search_key-carrid } { is_search_key-connid } am { is_search_key-fldate } nicht gefunden.| ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_find_flight FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_find_flight.
        DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251205' ) TO lt_flights.

        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_index( ).

        DATA(ls_search_found) = VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ).
        DATA(lv_index_found) = lo_cut->find_flight_index( it_flights = lt_flights is_search_key = ls_search_found ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index_found exp = 1 ).

        DATA(ls_search_not_found) = VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251201' ).
        DATA(lv_index_not_found) = lo_cut->find_flight_index( it_flights = lt_flights is_search_key = ls_search_not_found ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index_not_found exp = 0 ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` bieten eine performante und lesbare Möglichkeit, das Vorhandensein von Zeilen und deren Index in internen Tabellen zu prüfen, insbesondere bei Verwendung von Tabellenschlüsseln. `cl_demo_output` visualisiert das Ergebnis.
keywords: Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere String-Operationen (z.B. Trimmen, Großschreibung, Ersetzen) in einer einzigen Anweisung und geben Sie das Ergebnis aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methodenketten (Method Chaining).
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS display_processed_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    rv_output = cl_abap_string_util=>to_upper(
                  cl_abap_string_util=>replace(
                    val = cl_abap_string_util=>trim(
                            val = iv_input
                          )
                    occ = ' '
                    with = '_'
                  )
                ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_processed_string.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Original: '{ iv_input }' -> Verarbeitet: '{ process_string( iv_input ) }'| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_chain.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = '  Hello World ABAP  '.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'HELLO_WORLD_ABAP'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->process_string( lv_input ) exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenketten ermöglichen es, mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Anweisung auszuführen, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Hier werden statische Methoden der Klasse `cl_abap_string_util` verkettet.
keywords: Method Chaining, String Processing, Nesting, cl_abap_string_util

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen kopiert werden. Geben Sie die Zieltabelle mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
             extra_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             another_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS map_data
          IMPORTING
            it_source TYPE tt_source_data
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
        METHODS display_mapped_data IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source_data.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD map_data.
        rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING field3 = another_field ).
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_mapped_data.
        DATA(lt_target) = map_data( it_source ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( 'Original Source Data:' ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( it_source ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( 'Mapped Target Data:' ).
        cl_demo_output=>display( lt_target ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
             extra_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             another_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_map_data.
        DATA lt_source TYPE tt_source_data.
        APPEND VALUE ty_source_data( field1 = 'A' field2 = 10 field3 = 'X' extra_field = 'Extra1' ) TO lt_source.
        APPEND VALUE ty_source_data( field1 = 'B' field2 = 20 field3 = 'Y' extra_field = 'Extra2' ) TO lt_source.

        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_demo( ).
        DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_data( lt_source ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 'A' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field2 exp = 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-another_field exp = 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-another_field ). " This is incorrect, should be 'X' if mapping is used
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-another_field exp = 'X' ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung ermöglicht das einfache Kopieren von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, wobei Felder mit gleichen Namen automatisch zugeordnet werden. Mit `MAPPING` können Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zugeordnet werden. `cl_demo_output` zeigt die transformierten Daten.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine komplexe verschachtelte Datenstruktur (Tabelle von Strukturen mit weiteren Tabellen) mit einer einzigen `VALUE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `VALUE`-Expressions.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id TYPE i,

           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_detail,

        DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->create_complex_data( ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: Verschachtelte `VALUE`-Expressions ermöglichen die deklarative und kompakte Erstellung komplexer Datenstrukturen, einschließlich Tabellen von Strukturen, die wiederum Tabellen enthalten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

Instructions: Lese die ersten 5 Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichere sie in einer internen Tabelle. Verwende dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutze `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` und Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5
      msg = 'Es sollten genau 5 Flüge gelesen werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      msg = 'Erster Flug sollte nicht initial sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` um die Anzahl der gelesenen Datensätze direkt in der Datenbankabfrage zu begrenzen, was effizienter ist als das Lesen aller Daten und anschließendes Kürzen. Die Inline-Deklaration `@rt_flights` für die interne Tabelle ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature (ab 7.40) und reduziert den Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO N ROWS, Inline Declaration, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Lese die 3 teuersten Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` (sortiert nach Preis absteigend) und speichere sie in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Kombiniere `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` mit `ORDER BY DESCENDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_top_expensive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_expensive_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_top_expensive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 3 ROWS
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_top_expensive( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_expensive_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten genau 3 Flüge gelesen werden.' ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) = 3.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price >= lt_flights[ 2 ]-price
        msg = 'Flüge sollten absteigend nach Preis sortiert sein.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lt_flights[ 2 ]-price >= lt_flights[ 3 ]-price
        msg = 'Flüge sollten absteigend nach Preis sortiert sein.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` mit `ORDER BY DESCENDING`, um die teuersten Flüge direkt aus der Datenbank zu selektieren. Dies ist performanter, da die Sortierung und Begrenzung der Datenmenge auf der Datenbankebene erfolgt, bevor die Daten an das ABAP-Programm übertragen werden. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen ist ebenfalls ein Merkmal modernen ABAP-Codes.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO N ROWS, ORDER BY, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, Performance, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Zeige alle Flüge aus `sflights` in einem einfachen ALV Grid an. Die Lösung soll in einer Klasse gekapselt sein, die die Daten vorbereitet und die ALV-Anzeige initiiert.
hint: Verwende `cl_gui_alv_grid` und `set_table_for_first_display`. Für den Test konzentriere dich auf die Datenbeschaffung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_simple_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname OPTIONAL " Name des Custom Containers
      RAISING
        cx_salv_msg.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_all_flights( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name.
    ELSE.
      " In a real scenario, this would be linked to a screen element.
      " For demonstration, we create a dummy container. It won't render without a screen.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_custom_container.

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_flights
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->display_grid( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_simple_display( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gelesen werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      msg = 'Erster Flug sollte nicht initial sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermittle für jede Fluggesellschaft die 2 neuesten Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung moderner SQL-Funktionen.
hint: Nutze SQL `WINDOW` Funktionen wie `ROW_NUMBER()` mit `PARTITION BY` und `ORDER BY` direkt im `SELECT` Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_window_function DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ranked,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             rank     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_ranked.
    TYPES tt_sflight_ranked TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ranked WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_ranked.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_window_function IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights_per_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY carrid ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING ) AS rank
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_ranked_flights).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_ranked_flights WHERE rank <= iv_top_n ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_n_flights_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_flights_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_window_function( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights_per_carrier( iv_top_n = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gelesen werden.' ).

    " Verify that for each carrier, only one flight is returned and its rank is 1
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_ranked_tt(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( ls_flight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_grouped_flight-rank exp = 1
        msg = |Flug für { ls_grouped_flight-carrid } sollte Rang 1 haben.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die leistungsstarken SQL `WINDOW` Funktionen, die ab ABAP 7.51 verfügbar sind. `ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY carrid ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING )` weist jedem Flug innerhalb einer Fluggesellschaft (partitioniert nach `carrid`) eine Rangnummer zu, basierend auf dem Flugdatum absteigend. Anschließend wird mit `FILTER` die interne Tabelle auf die Top N Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft reduziert. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um 'Top N pro Gruppe'-Probleme direkt auf der Datenbank zu lösen.
keywords: SELECT, WINDOW Function, ROW_NUMBER, PARTITION BY, ORDER BY, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, FILTER, FETCH NEXT

    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_event.
    mt_flights = get_all_flights( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name.
    ELSE.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_custom_container.

    SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_flights
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->display_grid( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INDEX e_row INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Doppelklick auf Flug: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermittle die Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights`, die mehr als 10 Flüge haben, und zähle die Anzahl ihrer Flüge.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` für Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_carrier_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_carriers_with_many_flights FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_group_having( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_carrier_counts )
      msg = 'Es sollten Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_carrier_counts INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ls_carrier-flight_count >= 1
        msg = 'Fluganzahl sollte mindestens 1 sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_carriers_with_zero_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_group_having( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_counts) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_many_flights( 99999 ). " Test with very high min

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_carrier_counts )
      msg = 'Es sollten keine Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in einem `SELECT`-Statement, um Aggregationen auf der Datenbankebene durchzuführen. `GROUP BY carrid` gruppiert die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft, und `COUNT(*)` zählt die Flüge pro Gruppe. Die `HAVING`-Klausel filtert diese Gruppen basierend auf dem Ergebnis der Aggregationsfunktion (`COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights`). Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um aggregierte Daten zu filtern, ohne alle Details ins ABAP-Programm zu laden.

CLASS zcl_alv_editable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_editable_flights.
    mt_flights = get_all_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_fcat) = create_field_catalog( ).

    IF iv_container_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name.
    ELSE.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_custom_container.

    SET HANDLER handle_data_changed FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
        i_grid_settings  = VALUE lvc_s_glay( edit = 'X' )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_flights
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->display_grid( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS " Limit for editable demo
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_field_catalog.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' no_input = 'X' ) TO rt_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flugnummer'       no_input = 'X' ) TO rt_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flugdatum'        no_input = 'X' ) TO rt_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'PRICE'    coltext = 'Preis'    edit = 'X' datatype = 'CURR' currency_field = 'CURRENCY' ) TO rt_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' coltext = 'Währung'  no_out = 'X' ) TO rt_fcat.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    DATA: ls_mod_cell TYPE lvc_s_modc.

    LOOP AT e_mod_cells INTO ls_mod_cell.
      READ TABLE mt_flights INDEX ls_mod_cell-row_id INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE ls_mod_cell-fieldname.
          WHEN 'PRICE'.
            ls_flight-price = ls_mod_cell-value.
            MODIFY mt_flights FROM ls_flight INDEX ls_mod_cell-row_id.
            " In a real application, you would update the database here
            " UPDATE sflights SET price = @ls_flight-price WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight-fldate.
            MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Preis für Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } auf { ls_flight-price } geändert.|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Handle other editable fields
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Refresh ALV to reflect changes (optional, often done after DB update)
    mo_alv_grid->check_changed_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittswert der Flugdauer (FLTIME) aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, die der Struktur von SFLIGHTS entspricht.
hint: Verwende die `REDUCE` Operator für die Summenbildung und `LINES` für die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_fltime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
             distance TYPE sflight-distance,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_fltime
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_fltime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_fltime.
    DATA(lv_sum_fltime) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-fltime
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = LINES( it_flights ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum_fltime / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_fltime_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
