CLASS zcl_avg_fltime_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_fltime.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER zcl_avg_fltime_filtered=>tt_sflight
      FROM it_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_sum_fltime) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-fltime
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = LINES( lt_filtered_flights ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum_fltime / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittswert der Flugdauer (FLTIME) pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus einer internen Tabelle und gib das Ergebnis in einer neuen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um die Daten zu gruppieren und `REDUCE` innerhalb jeder Gruppe, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_fltime_grouped DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
             distance TYPE sflight-distance,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_average_by_carrid,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_fltime TYPE f,
           END OF ty_average_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_average_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_average_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_grouped_average
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_averages) TYPE tt_average_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_fltime_grouped IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_grouped_average.
    rt_averages = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                           ( carrid     = flight-carrid
                             avg_fltime = REDUCE f(
                                            INIT sum = 0.0
                                            count = 0
                                            FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                            NEXT sum = sum + member-fltime,
                                                 count = count + 1
                                            FINALLY: IF count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0 ENDIF
                                          )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittswert einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle, deren Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Die Spalte muss vom Typ `i` oder `f` sein.
hint: Verwende RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) und Feldsymbole, um dynamisch auf die Spalte zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_dynamic_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             value1 TYPE i,
             value2 TYPE f,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_data
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_dynamic_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_sum    TYPE f,
          lv_count  TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any,
                   <fs_table_line> TYPE any.

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe( it_data ).
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_column_name INTO DATA(ls_component).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type
            EXPORTING
              text = |Column '{ iv_column_name }' not found.|.
        ENDIF.

        IF ls_component-type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int AND
           ls_component-type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type
            EXPORTING
              text = |Column '{ iv_column_name }' is not numeric.|.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_table_line>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_line> TO <fs_component>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_sum = lv_sum + <fs_component>.
            lv_count = lv_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_count > 0.
          rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
        ELSE.
          rv_average = 0.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
        rv_average = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt einer Zahlenreihe, die von einem Startwert bis zu einem Endwert reicht (inklusive beider Werte).
hint: Erzeuge die Zahlenreihe mit dem `FOR` Operator und summiere die Werte mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_number_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start TYPE i
        iv_end   TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_number_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_range.
    IF iv_start > iv_end.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table(
      FOR i = iv_start THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_end
      ( i )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR num IN lt_numbers
      NEXT s = s + num
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = LINES( lt_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie mehrere Zeilen in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Ändern Sie für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft den Preis um einen festen Betrag.
hint: Verwenden Sie die moderne ABAP SQL Syntax `UPDATE ... FROM @(itab)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_from_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price_increase TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_from_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights_to_update TYPE tt_sflight_update.

    " 1. Select flights to be updated
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_original_flights).

    " 2. Prepare internal table with new prices
    lt_flights_to_update = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_original_flights
                                    ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid
                                      fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                      price  = ls_flight-price + iv_price_increase ) ).

    " 3. Update SFLIGHTS table using the internal table
    UPDATE sflight FROM @(lt_flights_to_update).
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure test data exists and is in a known state
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 1200 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_from_itab( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_rows) = lo_cut->update_flight_prices( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price_increase = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_rows exp = 2 ).

    " Verify updated prices
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101' INTO @DATA(lv_price_0400).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_0400 exp = 1100 ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101' INTO @DATA(lv_price_0401).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_0401 exp = 1300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE ... FROM @(itab)` Syntax ermöglicht das Aktualisieren mehrerer Datenbankzeilen in einem einzigen Statement, wobei die neuen Werte aus einer internen Tabelle stammen. Dies ist effizienter als zeilenweises Aktualisieren und nutzt die modernen ABAP SQL Features.
keywords: UPDATE, ABAP SQL, Internal Table, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und bereiten Sie diese für eine Anzeige in einem GUI-Control vor. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert und fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Status-Spalte hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und den `FOR` Operator für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             status   TYPE string, " New status field
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES tt_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " 1. Select data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE price > @iv_min_price.

    " 2. Transform and add status using FOR operator
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight )
                                status = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price > 1500 THEN 'High Price' ELSE 'Standard Price' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ) ).

  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und fügen Sie diesen in die Tabelle SFLIGHTS ein. Anschließend aktualisieren Sie einen bestehenden Datensatz mit einem neuen Preis, der ebenfalls mit `VALUE` erzeugt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... )` zur direkten Erzeugung von Strukturen für `INSERT` und `UPDATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_update_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_update_flight.
    " 1. Create a new flight record using VALUE and INSERT
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = 500 " Initial price
      currency = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'BOEING'
      seatsmax = 300
      seatsocc = 100
    ) ).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " 2. Update the newly created flight with a new price using VALUE
      UPDATE sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid   = iv_carrid
        connid   = iv_connid
        fldate   = iv_fldate
        price    = iv_new_price
      ) ).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und aktualisieren Sie dann einen 'Standardflug' dieser Gesellschaft mit diesem Durchschnittspreis. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen und anschließend `UPDATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_with_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid_target TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate_target TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_with_average_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lv_total_price TYPE sflight-price,
          lv_count       TYPE i.

    " 1. Select all flights for the given airline
    SELECT price FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    " 2. Calculate average price using REDUCE
    DATA(lv_average_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0.0
           num_flights = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      NEXT
        sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
        num_flights = num_flights + 1
      FINALLY
        IF num_flights > 0 THEN sum_price / num_flights ELSE 0.0
    ).

    " 3. Update the target flight with the calculated average price
    UPDATE sflight
      SET price = @lv_average_price
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid_target
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate_target.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges in SFLIGHTS. Wenn der aktuelle Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, erhöhen Sie ihn um 10%; andernfalls reduzieren Sie ihn um 5%. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Logik direkt im `UPDATE`-Statement.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` im `SET`-Teil des `UPDATE`-Statements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price_conditionally.
    DATA: lv_current_price TYPE sflight-price.

    " 1. Get current price
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @lv_current_price.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " 2. Update price conditionally using COND operator
      UPDATE sflight
        SET price = COND #( WHEN lv_current_price < iv_price_threshold THEN lv_current_price * '1.10'
                            ELSE lv_current_price * '0.95' )
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
          AND connid = @iv_connid
          AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
      rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzplätzen haben, und aktualisieren Sie dann nur diese gefilterten Flüge in der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS, indem Sie deren Status ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die zu aktualisierenden Datensätze vorzubereiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        iv_new_status     TYPE sflight-status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " 1. Select all flights
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    " 2. Filter flights with enough free seats
    DATA(lt_flights_to_update) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                            WHERE seatsmax - seatsocc >= iv_min_free_seats ).

    " 3. Update only the filtered flights in the database
    LOOP AT lt_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-status = iv_new_status.
    ENDLOOP.

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie ein spezifisches Feld eines Flugdatensatzes in SFLIGHTS dynamisch, wobei der Feldname zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Setzen Sie den Wert des Feldes auf einen neuen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und `UPDATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_dynamic_field.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " 1. Read the flight record
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " 2. Dynamically assign the field and update its value
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle conversion error if new_value cannot be assigned to field type
            RETURN.
        ENDTRY.

        " 3. Update the database table with the modified structure
        UPDATE sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
        rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie ein optimistisches Sperrkonzept, indem Sie versuchen, einen Flugdatensatz zu aktualisieren. Überprüfen Sie, ob genau eine Zeile aktualisiert wurde, um sicherzustellen, dass der Datensatz nicht zwischen dem Lesen und dem Aktualisieren von einem anderen Prozess geändert wurde. Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... UP TO 1 ROWS` und `sy-dbcnt`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE ... UP TO 1 ROWS` und prüfen Sie `sy-dbcnt` auf den Wert 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optimistic_lock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_optimistic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_old_price TYPE sflight-price " For optimistic check
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optimistic_lock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_optimistic.
    " Attempt to update the flight only if the price is still the old price
    " This simulates an optimistic lock: update only if no one else changed it
    UPDATE sflight
      SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
        AND price  = @iv_old_price " Optimistic check
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-dbcnt = 1.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Das optimistische Sperrkonzept wird hier durch die zusätzliche Bedingung `AND price = @iv_old_price` im `WHERE`-Teil des `UPDATE`-Statements simuliert. Nur wenn der aktuelle Preis in der Datenbank noch dem erwarteten alten Preis entspricht, wird die Aktualisierung durchgeführt. `UP TO 1 ROWS` stellt sicher, dass maximal ein Datensatz aktualisiert wird, und `sy-dbcnt` wird verwendet, um zu überprüfen, ob die Aktualisierung erfolgreich war (d.h., genau eine Zeile betroffen war).

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges in SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer komplexeren Logik, die direkt im `SET`-Teil des `UPDATE`-Statements mit einem `CASE`-Ausdruck implementiert wird. Erhöhen Sie den Preis für Flüge mit hoher Auslastung und reduzieren Sie ihn für Flüge mit geringer Auslastung.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck direkt im `SET`-Teil des `UPDATE`-Statements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_price_by_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_by_occupancy.
    " Update price based on occupancy using CASE expression in SET clause
    UPDATE sflight
      SET price = CASE WHEN seatsocc / seatsmax > 0.8 THEN price * '1.15' " High occupancy: +15%
                       WHEN seatsocc / seatsmax < 0.5 THEN price * '0.90' " Low occupancy: -10%
                       ELSE price END
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_ref_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_via_ref RETURNING VALUE(rr_sflights) TYPE REF TO tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_ref_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_via_ref.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 3 ROWS.

    CREATE DATA rr_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    rr_sflights->* = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ASSIGN lr_sflights->* TO <fs_sflights>.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lr_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lr_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).
        lr_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Liste, deren Spalten dynamisch zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen ausgewählt werden. Nutzen Sie RTTI und Datenreferenzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Struktur, sowie `cl_salv_table=>factory`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_alv IMPORTING it_fieldnames TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_table        TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_table>   TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " 1. Dynamische Struktur basierend auf Feldnamen erstellen
    LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      ls_component-name = lv_fieldname.
      DESCRIBE FIELD sflight-(lv_fieldname) TYPE ls_component-type.
      ls_component-type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( lv_fieldname ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lr_struct_descr) WITH EMPTY KEY.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 2. Daten aus SFLIGHT lesen und in dynamische Tabelle füllen
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_all) UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_all ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_source_field>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target_field>).
        IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 3. ALV anzeigen
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lr_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <fs_table>
        ).
        lr_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein ALV-Ereignis für Doppelklick auf eine Zeile. Zeigen Sie eine Meldung mit den Daten der geklickten Zeile an. Nutzen Sie `SET HANDLER` mit `REF TO`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine lokale Klasse als Event-Handler und registrieren Sie diese mit `SET HANDLER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_event.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lr_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Lokale Event-Handler-Klasse
    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_salv_events_table
          IMPORTING
            row
            column.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_double_click.
        DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
        READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX row INTO ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Fluggesellschaft:' ls_sflight-carrid 'Flugnummer:' ls_sflight-connid DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_event_handler) = NEW lcl_event_handler( ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lr_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_events) = lr_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
        SET HANDLER lo_event_handler->on_double_click FOR lo_events.

        lr_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info,
           tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               ( connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate ) ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit den Typ eines übergebenen Datenobjekts (z.B. einer internen Tabelle) und geben Sie dessen Komponenten aus. Nutzen Sie RTTI mit `cl_abap_typedescr`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `CAST` auf `cl_abap_structdescr` oder `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_describe_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS describe_data_object IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_describe_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD describe_data_object.
    DATA: lr_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lr_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_tabledescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lr_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data->* ).

    CASE lr_typedescr->kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
        lr_structdescr ?= lr_typedescr.
        LOOP AT lr_structdescr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
        lr_tabledescr ?= lr_typedescr.
        lr_structdescr ?= lr_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ).
        LOOP AT lr_structdescr->components INTO ls_component.
          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        APPEND |Typ: { lr_typedescr->get_name( ) }| TO rt_components.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME->`) zurückgibt, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
hint: Die Methode sollte `RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO <Klassenname>` deklarieren und `ro_me = me` zuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_mult TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( 5 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ). " (5 + 3) * 2 = 16
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name in einer Variablen gespeichert ist. Nutzen Sie Objekt-Referenzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF lo_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS _method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA: lo_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_dynamic_method_call.
    lo_instance = me.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF lo_instance RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Methode nicht gefunden oder ungültiger Aufruf.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_a.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_b.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setzen Sie ein Standard-Layout für eine ALV-Liste, die `sflights` anzeigt. Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table` und die Layout-Funktionalität.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table->get_layout()` und `set_key()` sowie `set_default_layout()`.

CLASS zcl_alv_layout_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_layout.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_layout_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_layout.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lr_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lr_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_layout) = lr_salv_table->get_layout( ).

Instructions: Fangen Sie spezifische BCS-Fehler beim E-Mail-Versand ab und protokollieren Sie diese.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Ausnahmebehandlung und fangen Sie CX_BCS_ERROR ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_email_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE bcs_text
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_safely.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
        lo_send_request->send( ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        " Fehler protokollieren (z.B. in SLG1 oder einer eigenen Log-Tabelle)
        cl_demo_output=>display( |BCS Error: { lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) } for recipient { iv_recipient_email }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Allgemeiner BCS-Fehler
        cl_demo_output=>display( |General BCS Error: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) } for recipient { iv_recipient_email }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    ).

    " Simulate a failure, e.g., by providing an invalid email format
    " Note: CL_CAM_ADDRESS_BCS=>CREATE_INTERNET_ADDRESS might raise CX_ADDRESS_BCS if format is invalid
    " For a true BCS error, mocking or specific configuration would be needed.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Empfängern basierend auf einer Bedingung und erstellen Sie daraus eine Liste für den E-Mail-Versand mit CL_BCS_MESSAGE.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit FILTER, um die Empfängerliste zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_recipients DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_recipient,
             email TYPE ad_smtpadr,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_recipient,
           tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_filtered_emails
      IMPORTING
        it_all_recipients TYPE tt_recipients
        iv_subject        TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body           TYPE bcs_text
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count)   TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_recipients IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_filtered_emails.
    DATA(lt_active_emails) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_rec IN it_all_recipients WHERE ( active = abap_true )
      ( ls_rec-email )
    ).

    IF lt_active_emails IS INITIAL.
      rv_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine E-Mail-Betreffzeile und einen dynamischen E-Mail-Text unter Verwendung von COND- und SWITCH-Ausdrücken basierend auf Eingabeparametern.
hint: Nutzen Sie COND und SWITCH für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_email_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_document_type TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    METHODS create_email_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_document_type TYPE ty_document_type
        iv_document_id   TYPE string
        iv_status        TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_subject       TYPE bcs_subject
        ev_body          TYPE bcs_text.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_email_content IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_email_content.
    ev_subject = SWITCH bcs_subject(
      iv_document_type
      WHEN 'I' THEN |Information zu Rechnung { iv_document_id }|
      WHEN 'O' THEN |Bestellbestätigung { iv_document_id }|
      WHEN 'R' THEN |Erinnerung: { iv_document_id }|
      ELSE |Allgemeine Benachrichtigung { iv_document_id }|
    ).

    DATA(lv_status_text) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = 'NEW' THEN 'neu erstellt'
      WHEN iv_status = 'UPD' THEN 'aktualisiert'
      WHEN iv_status = 'ERR' THEN 'mit Fehlern'
      ELSE 'unbekannter Status'
    ).

    ev_body = |Sehr geehrte/r Empfänger/in,

Ihr Dokument { iv_document_id } vom Typ { iv_document_type } wurde { lv_status_text }.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Ihr System|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung von BCS-Objekten mit dem NEW-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den NEW-Operator für CL_BCS, CL_DOCUMENT_BCS und CL_CAM_ADDRESS_BCS.

CLASS zcl_new_operator_bcs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_bcs_objects
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE bcs_text
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_new_operator_bcs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_bcs_objects.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_send_request) = NEW cl_bcs( ). " Using NEW for CL_BCS
        lo_send_request->set_persistent( abap_true ).

        DATA(lo_document) = NEW cl_document_bcs(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ). " Using NEW for CL_DOCUMENT_BCS
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = NEW cl_cam_address_bcs(
          i_address_string = iv_recipient_email
          i_address_type   = 'INT'
        ). " Using NEW for CL_CAM_ADDRESS_BCS
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
        lo_send_request->send( ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Error: { lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_flights         TYPE tt_flights
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_flight_summary.
    DATA(lv_summary_body) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = |Flugübersicht:
|
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = s && |  Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } - Preis: { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = 'EUR' } EUR
|
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_summary_body )
      i_subject = 'Zusammenfassung Ihrer Flüge'
    ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator mit FOR-Ausdrücken, um eine interne Tabelle von Empfängerobjekten zu erstellen, die dann für den E-Mail-Versand verwendet wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_value_for_recipients DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_recipient_data,
             email TYPE ad_smtpadr,
             name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_recipient_data,
           tt_recipient_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_emails_from_data
      IMPORTING
        it_recipient_data  TYPE tt_recipient_data
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE bcs_text.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_recipients IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_emails_from_data.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lt_bcs_recipients) = VALUE cl_bcs=>recipients_t(
      FOR ls_data IN it_recipient_data
      ( cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( ls_data-email ) )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_bcs_recipients INTO DATA(lo_recipient).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das 'zif_message_sender'-Interface um eine Methode zum Senden von Nachrichten mit Priorität und implementieren Sie diese in der BCS-Sender-Klasse.
hint: Fügen Sie eine neue Methode zum Interface hinzu und verwenden Sie SET_PRIORITY in CL_BCS.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_sender PUBLIC.
  METHODS send_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
      iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
      iv_body            TYPE bcs_text.

  METHODS send_message_with_priority
    IMPORTING
      iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
      iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
      iv_body            TYPE bcs_text
      iv_priority        TYPE bcs_priority.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_sender~send_message.
    " Delegiert an die Methode mit Priorität, Standard-Priorität '1' (Normal)
    me->zif_message_sender~send_message_with_priority(
      iv_recipient_email = iv_recipient_email
      iv_subject         = iv_subject
      iv_body            = iv_body
      iv_priority        = '1'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_sender~send_message_with_priority.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_send_request->set_priority( iv_priority ).
    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_normal_priority FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_send_high_priority FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_normal_priority.
    DATA(lo_sender) = CAST zif_message_sender( NEW zcl_bcs_email_sender( ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_sender->send_message(
          iv_recipient_email = 'normal_prio@example.com'

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_send_high_priority.
    DATA(lo_sender) = CAST zif_message_sender( NEW zcl_bcs_email_sender( ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_sender->send_message_with_priority(
          iv_recipient_email = 'high_prio@example.com'
          iv_subject         = 'Hohe Priorität'

          iv_priority        = '5' " 5 = höchste Priorität

explanation: Interfaces sind erweiterbar. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein bestehendes Interface um eine neue Funktionalität (Senden mit Priorität) erweitert und in der implementierenden Klasse umgesetzt wird. Die Methode SET_PRIORITY von CL_BCS ermöglicht die Steuerung der E-Mail-Priorität. Die Standard-Sendemethode delegiert an die neue Methode, um Code-Duplizierung zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine lokale Klasse, die ein Interface implementiert, um eine spezifische E-Mail-Versandlogik zu kapseln.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse innerhalb einer globalen Klasse oder eines Reports und implementieren Sie das Interface.
solution:
CLASS zcl_local_sender_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_specific_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_data            TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_local_sender_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_specific_email.
    " Lokales Interface
    INTERFACE lcl_if_specific_sender PUBLIC.
      METHODS send_specific
        IMPORTING
          iv_to   TYPE ad_smtpadr
          iv_text TYPE string.
    ENDINTERFACE.

    " Lokale Klasse, die das Interface implementiert
    CLASS lcl_specific_bcs_sender DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES lcl_if_specific_sender.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_specific_bcs_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD lcl_if_specific_sender~send_specific.
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_text )
          i_subject = |Spezifische Nachricht an { iv_to }|
        ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_to ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
        lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
        lo_send_request->send( ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    " Instanziierung und Nutzung der lokalen Klasse
    DATA(lo_specific_sender) = CAST lcl_if_specific_sender( NEW lcl_specific_bcs_sender( ) ).
    lo_specific_sender->send_specific(
      iv_to   = iv_recipient_email
      iv_text = |Ihre spezifischen Daten: { iv_data }|
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_specific_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_specific_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_local_sender_consumer( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_specific_email(
          iv_recipient_email = 'local_class@example.com'
          iv_data            = 'Geheime Daten'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'E-Mail mit lokaler Klasse sollte gesendet werden' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Lokale Klassen und Interfaces ermöglichen es, spezifische Logik direkt dort zu definieren, wo sie benötigt wird, ohne globale Objekte anlegen zu müssen. Dies fördert die Kapselung und kann die Übersichtlichkeit in bestimmten Kontexten verbessern. Hier wird eine lokale Klasse verwendet, um eine spezifische E-Mail-Versandlogik zu implementieren, die nur innerhalb der Methode 'send_specific_email' relevant ist.
keywords: Local Class, Local Interface, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, CL_BCS_MESSAGE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten (Felder) einer Struktur und deren Typnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components IMPORTING is_structure TYPE any
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( )
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_components.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA ls_test_struct TYPE ty_test_struct.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_comp( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( ls_test_struct ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD1' INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp1-type exp = '\TYPE=STRING' ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD2' INTO DATA(ls_comp2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp2-type exp = '\TYPE=I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_structdescr` ermöglicht die Analyse von Strukturen zur Laufzeit, was für die Implementierung von generischen Datenverarbeitungsroutinen oder Serialisierungsmechanismen nützlich ist. Der `CAST` ist notwendig, da `describe_by_data` einen generischen `cl_abap_typedescr` zurückgibt.
keywords: RTTI, STRUCTURE, COMPONENTS, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, DYNAMIC

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_line,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_line.
    DATA ls_test_line TYPE ty_test_line.

    DATA(lo_structdescr_for_test) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_test_line ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_structdescr_for_test->get_components( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 0 ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Datenobjekt einen numerischen Typ hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `is_numeric`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_is_numeric DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_data_numeric IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_numeric IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_data_numeric.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_elem.
      DATA(lo_elemdescr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      rb_is_numeric = lo_elemdescr->is_numeric( ).
    ELSE.
      rb_is_numeric = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_numeric FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_numeric.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_is_numeric( ).

    DATA lv_int TYPE i VALUE 10.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_data_numeric( lv_int ) ).

    DATA lv_float TYPE f VALUE '1.23'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_data_numeric( lv_float ) ).

    DATA lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'abc'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_data_numeric( lv_char ) ).

    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE '123'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_data_numeric( lv_string ) ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct, field TYPE i, END OF ty_struct.
    DATA ls_struct TYPE ty_struct.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_data_numeric( ls_struct ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `is_numeric`-Methode von `cl_abap_elemdescr` bietet eine präzise Möglichkeit, elementare Datentypen auf ihre numerische Eigenschaft zu prüfen, was für Validierungen oder generische Rechenoperationen wichtig ist.
keywords: RTTI, NUMERIC, TYPE CHECK, CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_length IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any RETURNING VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_length.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_elem.
      DATA(lo_elemdescr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      rv_length = lo_elemdescr->length.
    ELSE.
      rv_length = -1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_length( ).

    DATA lv_char10 TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'abc'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_data_length( lv_char10 ) exp = 10 ).

    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello World'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_data_length( lv_string ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA lv_int TYPE i VALUE 123.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_data_length( lv_int ) exp = 4 ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct, field TYPE i, END OF ty_struct.
    DATA ls_struct TYPE ty_struct.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_data_length( ls_struct ) exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `length`-Attribut von `cl_abap_elemdescr` liefert die physikalische Länge eines elementaren Datentyps, was für Speicherallokation oder die Interaktion mit externen Systemen relevant sein kann.
keywords: RTTI, LENGTH, ELEMENTARY TYPE, CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element und einem Kind-Element.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_document` oder `NEW cl_xml_document()` und `create_element`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'RootElement' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( child = lo_root ).
    DATA(lo_child) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'ChildElement' ).
    lo_root->append_child( child = lo_child ).
    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( EXPORTING pretty_print = abap_true IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_create_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_create_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_simple_xml( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<RootElement>' ).

explanation: `cl_xml_document` bietet eine objektorientierte API zur Erstellung und Manipulation von XML-Dokumenten. Die Methoden `create_element` und `append_child` ermöglichen den strukturierten Aufbau, während `render_2_string` die Ausgabe als String generiert.
keywords: XML, CL_XML_DOCUMENT, CREATE, ELEMENT

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen gegebenen XML-String und lesen Sie den Wert eines Elements aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_with_data` und `find_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_get_value IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_get_value.
    DATA(lv_xml_data) = iv_xml_string.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( lv_xml_data ).
    DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( name = 'ValueElement' ).
    IF lo_node IS BOUND.
      rv_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_xml.
    DATA(lv_xml_input) = `<Root><ValueElement>TestValue</ValueElement></Root>`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parse_string( ).
    DATA(lv_extracted_value) = lo_cut->parse_and_get_value( lv_xml_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_extracted_value exp = 'TestValue' ).

    DATA(lv_xml_input_no_node) = `<Root><OtherElement>NoValue</OtherElement></Root>`. 
    lv_extracted_value = lo_cut->parse_and_get_value( lv_xml_input_no_node ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_extracted_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `create_with_data` initialisiert das XML-Dokument aus einem String. `find_node` ermöglicht das Auffinden spezifischer Elemente, und `get_value` extrahiert deren Inhalt, was für die Verarbeitung externer XML-Datenströme unerlässlich ist.
keywords: XML, PARSE, CL_XML_DOCUMENT, FIND_NODE, GET_VALUE

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und lesen Sie die Attribute eines bestimmten Elements aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `find_node` und `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_read_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_attributes IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_read_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_attributes.
    DATA(lv_xml_data) = iv_xml_string.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( lv_xml_data ).
    DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( name = 'Item' ).
    IF lo_node IS BOUND.
      LOOP AT lo_node->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attr).
        APPEND VALUE ty_attribute( name = ls_attr-name value = ls_attr-value ) TO rt_attributes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_attributes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_attributes.
    DATA(lv_xml_input) = `<Root><Item id="456" type="product"/></Root>`. 
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_read_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attrs) = lo_cut->read_attributes( lv_xml_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_attrs ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_attrs WITH KEY name = 'id' INTO DATA(ls_attr_id).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_attr_id-value exp = '456' ).

    READ TABLE lt_attrs WITH KEY name = 'type' INTO DATA(ls_attr_type).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_attr_type-value exp = 'product' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Nach dem Parsen eines XML-Strings können Attribute eines Elements über die Methode `get_attributes` ausgelesen werden, was für die Konfiguration oder Metadaten-Extraktion aus XML-Dokumenten nützlich ist.
keywords: XML, ATTRIBUTE, READ, CL_XML_DOCUMENT, GET_ATTRIBUTES

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und iterieren Sie durch alle direkten Kind-Elemente eines bestimmten Knotens, um deren Namen zu sammeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `find_node` und `get_children`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_iterate_children DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_child_names IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_child_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_iterate_children IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_child_names.
    DATA(lv_xml_data) = iv_xml_string.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( lv_xml_data ).
    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( name = 'Parent' ).
    IF lo_root_node IS BOUND.
      LOOP AT lo_root_node->get_children( ) INTO DATA(lo_child_node).
        IF lo_child_node->get_type( ) = cl_xml_node=>co_node_type_element.
          APPEND lo_child_node->get_name( ) TO rt_child_names.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_child_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_child_names.
    DATA(lv_xml_input) = `<Root><Parent><ChildA/><ChildB/><ChildC/></Parent></Root>`. 
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_iterate_children( ).
    DATA(lt_names) = lo_cut->get_child_names( lv_xml_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_names ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_names[ 1 ] exp = 'ChildA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_names[ 2 ] exp = 'ChildB' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_names[ 3 ] exp = 'ChildC' ).

    DATA(lv_xml_input_no_children) = `<Root><Parent/></Root>`. 
    lt_names = lo_cut->get_child_names( lv_xml_input_no_children ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lines( lt_names ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_children` eines XML-Knotens ermöglicht die Iteration über seine direkten Kind-Knoten. In Kombination mit einer Typprüfung (`get_type`) können so gezielt Elementnamen gesammelt werden, was für die Navigation in komplexen XML-Strukturen nützlich ist.
keywords: XML, ITERATE, CHILDREN, CL_XML_DOCUMENT, GET_CHILDREN

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen ungültigen XML-String und fangen Sie die dabei auftretende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_with_data` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH` Blocks für `cx_xml_parse_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_invalid_xml IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rb_parse_successful) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_invalid_xml.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( iv_xml_string ).
        rb_parse_successful = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        " cl_demo_output=>display( lx_parse_error->get_text( ) ).
        rb_parse_successful = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_xml.
    DATA(lv_invalid_xml) = `<Root><Child></Root>`. " Ungültiges XML
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lb_success) = lo_cut->parse_invalid_xml( lv_invalid_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lb_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_xml.
    DATA(lv_valid_xml) = `<Root><Child/></Root>`. " Gültiges XML
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lb_success) = lo_cut->parse_invalid_xml( lv_valid_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lb_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verarbeitung externer XML-Daten erfordert robuste Fehlerbehandlung. Das Abfangen von `cx_xml_parse_error` im `TRY...CATCH`-Block ermöglicht es, ungültige XML-Strukturen elegant zu behandeln und die Anwendung vor Abstürzen zu schützen.
keywords: XML, ERROR HANDLING, EXCEPTION, CX_XML_PARSE_ERROR, CL_XML_DOCUMENT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einem übergebenen `RANGE` für die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) selektiert. Nutzen Sie dabei Konstanten aus `IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE` zur Definition des Range-Typs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE=>SIGN_INCLUDE` und `IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE=>OPTION_EQUAL` für den Range-Aufbau und `SELECT ... WHERE (itab_cond)` für die dynamische Selektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS select_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_flights_by_carrid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_single_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_multiple_carrids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_no_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_single_carrid.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_sflight_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id(
      ( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
        option = if_fsbp_const_range=>option_equal
        low    = 'AA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->select_flights_by_carrid( lt_carrid_range ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_multiple_carrids.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_sflight_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id(
      ( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
        option = if_fsbp_const_range=>option_equal
        low    = 'AA' )
      ( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
        option = if_fsbp_const_range=>option_equal
        low    = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->select_flights_by_carrid( lt_carrid_range ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_found_aa) = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
          lv_found_aa = abap_true.
        ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
          lv_found_lh = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_aa ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_lh ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_no_carrid.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_sflight_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->select_flights_by_carrid( lt_carrid_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung des Ranges und die direkte Übergabe an die `WHERE`-Klausel (`WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range`) sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxelemente, die den Code kompakter und lesbarer machen. Die Konstanten aus `IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE` stellen eine standardisierte und typsichere Methode zur Definition von Range-Einträgen dar.
keywords: RANGE, SELECT, IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE, VALUE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach bestimmten Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) unter Verwendung eines `RANGE` und des `FILTER`-Operators. Die Range-Definition soll Konstanten von `IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE` nutzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einem `RANGE`-Objekt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights  TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen String-Operator (z.B. 'EQ', 'BT', 'CP') in die entsprechende `OPTION`-Konstante von `IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE` umwandelt. Falls der Operator unbekannt ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung oder einen `COND`-Ausdruck für die Zuordnung und `RAISE EXCEPTION` bei unbekanntem Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_option_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS map_operator_to_option
      IMPORTING
        iv_operator TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_option) TYPE ddoption
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_option_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_operator_to_option.
    rv_option = SWITCH #( iv_operator
      WHEN 'EQ' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_equal
      WHEN 'BT' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_between
      WHEN 'CP' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_pattern
      WHEN 'GE' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_greater_equal
      WHEN 'LE' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_less_equal
      WHEN 'GT' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_greater
      WHEN 'LT' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_less
      WHEN 'NE' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_not_equal
      WHEN 'NB' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_not_between
      WHEN 'NP' THEN if_fsbp_const_range=>option_not_pattern
      ELSE THROW cx_sy_dyn_sql_error( textid = cx_sy_dyn_sql_error=>invalid_operator )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sind zwei `RANGE`-Tabellen für Fluggesellschaften. Kombinieren Sie diese zu einer einzigen `RANGE`-Tabelle, die alle Einträge beider Ranges enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator.

solution:
CLASS zcl_range_combiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS combine_carrid_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_range1 TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
        it_range2 TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_combiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_carrid_ranges.
    rt_combined_range = REDUCE #( 
      INIT r = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( )
      FOR entry IN it_range1 APPEND r = entry
      FOR entry IN it_range2 APPEND r = entry
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält. Jede Flugverbindung soll als ein `<Flight>`-Element mit `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` als Kind-Elemente dargestellt werden. Nutzen Sie `CL_SEC_SXML_WRITER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife über die `SFLIGHTS`-Daten und erstellen Sie für jeden Eintrag ein `<Flight>`-Element mit entsprechenden Kind-Elementen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_xml_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_sflight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_xml_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create(
      if_sxml_output=>co_xt_string
    ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Carrid' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-carrid ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ).

        lo_writer->open_element( 'Connid' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-connid ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ).

        lo_writer->open_element( 'Fldate' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-fldate ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_sflight_xml_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_xml_generator=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251126' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20251127' )

    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_generator->generate_sflight_xml( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flights>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight><Carrid>AA</Carrid><Connid>001</Connid><Fldate>20251126</Fldate></Flight>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight><Carrid>LH</Carrid><Connid>002</Connid><Fldate>20251127</Fldate></Flight>' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_xml_generator=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_generator->generate_sflight_xml( lt_test_flights ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zählen Sie von 1 bis 5 mit einer WHILE-Schleife und geben Sie jeden Wert aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und eine Zählvariable.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_to_five RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_to_five.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 1.
    WHILE lv_counter <= 5.
      APPEND |Current count: { lv_counter }| TO rv_result.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, um alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers zu finden und deren Preise zu verdoppeln, bis ein Gesamtpreislimit erreicht ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit `READ TABLE` und `MODIFY TABLE` oder `LOOP AT` mit `WHERE` und `WHILE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sflight_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_price_limit TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sflight_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lv_current_total_price) = 0.

    " Simulate fetching data (e.g., from DB or API)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_sflights ) AND lv_current_total_price < iv_price_limit.
      READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_sflight-carrid = iv_carrier.
        ls_sflight-price = ls_sflight-price * 2.
        MODIFY TABLE lt_sflights FROM ls_sflight INDEX lv_index.
        lv_current_total_price = lv_current_total_price + ls_sflight-price.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_processed_flights.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_sflight_process( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_price_limit = 10000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Depends on SFLIGHT data, might need to mock
    " For a real test, you'd need to ensure SFLIGHT has data or mock it.
    " Example: Assert that prices are doubled and total price is within limit.
    " This test is very basic due to SFLIGHT dependency.
    " A more robust test would involve injecting test data.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[1]-price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
