Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Abrufen von Mitarbeiterdaten von einem OData-Dienst, der Paginierung verwendet. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um alle Seiten abzurufen, bis keine weiteren Daten verfügbar sind.
hint: Implementieren Sie eine Mock-Klasse für den OData-Dienst, die `next_page_token` oder ähnliches zurückgibt, und verwenden Sie `WHILE` zur Iteration.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_mock_odata_employee_api.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
           id   TYPE string,
           name TYPE string,
           email TYPE string,
         END OF ty_employee.
  TYPES: tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_odata_response,
           employees TYPE tt_employees,
           has_next_page TYPE abap_bool,
           next_page_token TYPE string,
         END OF ty_odata_response.

  METHODS get_employees
    IMPORTING
      iv_page_token TYPE string OPTIONAL
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_odata_response.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_mock_odata_employee_api IMPLEMENTATION.
  DATA: mt_all_employees TYPE zif_mock_odata_employee_api=>tt_employees.

  METHODS constructor.
  METHODS get_employees FOR IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_odata_employee_api IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DO 25 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE zif_mock_odata_employee_api=>ty_employee(
        id = |EMP{ sy-index ALPHA = IN }|
        name = |Employee { sy-index }|
        email = |emp{ sy-index }@example.com|
      ) TO mt_all_employees.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_employees.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    IF iv_page_token IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          lv_offset = iv_page_token.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_page_size) = 5.
    DATA(lv_start_index) = lv_offset.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere für Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers aus der Tabelle `sflights` mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, bis eine maximale Passagierzahl erreicht ist oder alle relevanten Flüge verarbeitet wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `LOOP AT` oder `READ TABLE` und einer Zählvariable.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_agg_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_max_passengers TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_agg_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_agg.
    DATA(lv_current_passengers) = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING.

    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_sflights ) AND lv_current_passengers < iv_max_passengers.
      READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_current_passengers = lv_current_passengers + ls_sflight-seatsocc.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_total_passengers = lv_current_passengers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden Nullen aus einem numerischen String mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'` oder `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_string_trim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_leading_zeros
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_string_trim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_leading_zeros.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    WHILE rv_output IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_output(1) = '0'.
      SHIFT rv_output LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'.
    ENDWHILE.
    IF iv_input IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_output IS INITIAL.
      rv_output = '0'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_trim_leading_zeros.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_string_trim( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_zeros( '00123' ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_zeros( '123' ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_zeros( '000' ) exp = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_zeros( '0' ) exp = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_zeros( '' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_zeros( '01010' ) exp = '1010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Schleife wird fortgesetzt, solange der String nicht leer ist und mit einer Null beginnt. Dies ist eine einfache, aber effektive Methode für bestimmte String-Manipulationen. Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen OData-API-Aufruf, der fehlschlagen kann, und verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einer Wiederholungslogik, um den Aufruf bis zu einer maximalen Anzahl von Versuchen zu wiederholen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Zähler und einer Bedingung für den Erfolg des API-Aufrufs. Fügen Sie eine künstliche Verzögerung ein.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_mock_odata_employee_api_err.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
           id   TYPE string,
           name TYPE string,
           email TYPE string,
         END OF ty_employee.
  TYPES: tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_employee_details_with_error
    IMPORTING
      iv_employee_id TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_employee) TYPE ty_employee
    RAISING
      cx_static_check.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_mock_odata_employee_api_err IMPLEMENTATION.

  DATA: mt_all_employees TYPE zif_mock_odata_employee_api_err=>tt_employees.

  METHODS constructor.
  METHODS get_employee_details_with_error FOR IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_mock_odata_employee_api_err IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DO 5 TIMES.

        name = |Employee { sy-index }|
        email = |emp{ sy-index }@example.com|
      ) TO mt_all_employees.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_employee_details_with_error.
    mv_fail_count = mv_fail_count + 1.
    IF mv_fail_count < 3. " Simulate failure for first 2 calls
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Simulated API error'.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE mt_all_employees INTO rs_employee WITH KEY id = iv_employee_id.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_employee.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Employee not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_odata_retry_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_employee_with_retry
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string
        io_odata_client TYPE REF TO zif_mock_odata_employee_api_err
        iv_max_retries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_employee) TYPE zif_mock_odata_employee_api_err=>ty_employee
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_retry_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_employee_with_retry.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < iv_max_retries AND lv_success = abap_false.
      TRY.
          rs_employee = io_odata_client->get_employee_details_with_error( iv_employee_id ).
          lv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_static_check.
          lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
          IF lv_retries < iv_max_retries.
            WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Simulate delay before retry
          ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_success = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'API call failed after multiple retries'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_hierarchy_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             id       TYPE string,
             parent_id TYPE string,
             name     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component.
    TYPES: tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_subcomponents
      IMPORTING
        iv_root_component_id TYPE string
        it_all_components TYPE tt_components
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_subcomponents) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_hierarchy_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_subcomponents.
    DATA: lt_stack TYPE tt_components.
    DATA: ls_current_component TYPE ty_component.

    " Add root component to stack
    READ TABLE it_all_components INTO ls_current_component WITH KEY id = iv_root_component_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      APPEND ls_current_component TO lt_stack.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Pop from stack
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ) INTO ls_current_component.
      DELETE TABLE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ).

      " Add to result if not root itself
      IF ls_current_component-id <> iv_root_component_id.
        APPEND ls_current_component TO rt_subcomponents.
      ENDIF.

      " Find children and push to stack
      LOOP AT it_all_components INTO DATA(ls_child) WHERE parent_id = ls_current_component-id.
        APPEND ls_child TO lt_stack.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_subcomponents FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_subcomponents.
    DATA: lt_test_components TYPE zcl_while_hierarchy_process=>tt_components.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_while_hierarchy_process=>ty_component( id = 'A' parent_id = '' name = 'Root' ) TO lt_test_components.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_while_hierarchy_process=>ty_component( id = 'B' parent_id = 'A' name = 'Child B' ) TO lt_test_components.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_while_hierarchy_process=>ty_component( id = 'C' parent_id = 'A' name = 'Child C' ) TO lt_test_components.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_while_hierarchy_process=>ty_component( id = 'D' parent_id = 'B' name = 'Grandchild D' ) TO lt_test_components.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_while_hierarchy_process=>ty_component( id = 'E' parent_id = 'B' name = 'Grandchild E' ) TO lt_test_components.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_while_hierarchy_process=>ty_component( id = 'F' parent_id = 'C' name = 'Grandchild F' ) TO lt_test_components.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_hierarchy_process( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_all_subcomponents( iv_root_component_id = 'A' it_all_components = lt_test_components ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ id = 'D' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( line_exists( lt_result[ id = 'A' ] ) ).

    CLEAR lt_result.
    lt_result = lo_cut->get_all_subcomponents( iv_root_component_id = 'B' it_all_components = lt_test_components ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ id = 'D' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein klassisches Muster für Tiefensuche (DFS) in Graphen oder Bäumen. Die moderne Syntax für interne Tabellen (`VALUE`, `LINE_EXISTS`) wird verwendet.

CLASS zcl_while_dynamic_condition DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 5.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_loop
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

    CLASS-METHODS set_max_iterations
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_max TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_dynamic_condition IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_loop.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.
    WHILE lv_counter < gv_max_iterations.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
    rv_count = lv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_max_iterations.
    gv_max_iterations = iv_new_max.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Input must be non-negative'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 0.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache lineare Suche in einer sortierten internen Tabelle mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, bis das gesuchte Element gefunden oder das Ende der Tabelle erreicht ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_while_linear_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_value TYPE i.
    TYPES: tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS linear_search
      IMPORTING
        it_sorted_values TYPE tt_values
        iv_target_value TYPE ty_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_index) TYPE i. " 0 if not found, 1-based index if found
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_linear_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD linear_search.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_sorted_values ) AND lv_found = abap_false.
      READ TABLE it_sorted_values INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lv_current_value).
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_current_value = iv_target_value.
        lv_found = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_found = abap_true.
      rv_found_index = lv_index.
    ELSE.
      rv_found_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, wobei Wochenenden übersprungen werden, mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und die Funktionen zur Datumsberechnung, um Tage zu inkrementieren und Wochentage zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_workdays.
    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Start date must be before or equal to end date'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    rv_workdays = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_workdays_no_weekend FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_workdays_same_day FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_date_range RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_workdays_no_weekend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_workdays( ).
    " 2025-11-24 (Mon) to 2025-11-28 (Fri) = 5 workdays
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251124' iv_end_date = '20251128' ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_workdays_with_weekend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_workdays( ).
    " 2025-11-21 (Fri) to 2025-11-24 (Mon) = 2 workdays (Fri, Mon)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251121' iv_end_date = '20251124' ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_workdays_same_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_workdays( ).
    " 2025-11-24 (Mon) to 2025-11-24 (Mon) = 1 workday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251124' iv_end_date = '20251124' ) exp = 1 ).
    " 2025-11-23 (Sun) to 2025-11-23 (Sun) = 0 workdays
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251123' iv_end_date = '20251123' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_date_range RAISING cx_static_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_workdays( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251128' iv_end_date = '20251124' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for invalid date range' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, wobei das numerische Feld `price` in einen String umgewandelt wird und nur Flüge mit `carrid = 'LH'` berücksichtigt werden.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_target.

      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_sflight_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_sflight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flight_table.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( it_source WHERE carrid = 'LH' ) " Filter for 'LH' flights
                         ( carrier_id    = ls_sflight-carrid
                           connection_id = ls_sflight-connid
                           flight_date   = ls_sflight-fldate
                           price_text    = CONV string( ls_sflight-price ) ) ). " Convert price to string
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings, die numerische Werte enthalten können, in eine Tabelle von Integern. Ungültige String-Einträge sollen dabei ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `CONV` mit `DEFAULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_itab_string_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_int
      IMPORTING it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_integers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_string_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_int.
    rt_integers = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_strings
                           WHERE ( COND #( WHEN lv_string IS NOT INITIAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) = 1 AND
                                   COND #( WHEN lv_string CO '0123456789-+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) = 1 ) " Basic check for numeric characters
                           ( CONV i( DEFAULT 0 lv_string ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_itab_string_int( ).
    DATA: lt_strings TYPE string_table,
          lt_integers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND '100' TO lt_strings.
    APPEND 'abc' TO lt_strings.
    APPEND '-50' TO lt_strings.
    APPEND '' TO lt_strings.
    APPEND '200' TO lt_strings.
    APPEND '1.5' TO lt_strings. " This will be treated as invalid by the simple CO check

    lt_integers = lo_cut->convert_string_table_to_int( lt_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_integers ) exp = 3 msg = 'Only 3 valid integers should be converted' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_integers[ 1 ] exp = 100 msg = 'First element should be 100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_integers[ 2 ] exp = -50 msg = 'Second element should be -50' ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Zahlen mit modernen ABAP-Features.
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe zu bilden, und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE i_table
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den größten Wert in einer internen Tabelle von Zahlen.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer Vergleichslogik, um den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_max_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_max_value IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE i_table
                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_max_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_max_value.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_max = 0. " Oder eine geeignete Fehlerbehandlung/Initialwert
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max = REDUCE i( INIT m = it_numbers[ 1 ] FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT m = COND i( WHEN num > m THEN num ELSE m ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String, der eine Zahl darstellt, in einen numerischen Typ und behandle mögliche Fehler, falls der String keine gültige Zahl ist.
hint: Verwende den `CONV` Operator für die Konvertierung und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_string_to_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_number) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_string_to_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_int.
    TRY.
        rv_number = CONV i( iv_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Quadrate aller geraden Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR` mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE` in einer einzigen Ausdruckskette.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_sum_even_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE i_table
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum_squares) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_sum_even_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum_squares = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR num IN it_numbers
      WHERE ( num MOD 2 = 0 ) " Filter für gerade Zahlen
      NEXT s = s + ( num * num )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_even_squares FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_even_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_even_squares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sum_even_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).
    " Gerade Zahlen: 2, 4, 6
    " Quadrate: 4, 16, 36
    " Summe: 4 + 16 + 36 = 56
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 56 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_even_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sum_even_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sum_even_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Kombination von `FOR` und `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel. Die `WHERE`-Klausel fungiert als Filter, der nur die geraden Zahlen berücksichtigt. Anschließend werden die Quadrate dieser gefilterten Zahlen summiert. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Datenmanipulationen in einer sehr deklarativen und funktionalen Weise, die deutlich lesbarer und wartbarer ist als traditionelle `LOOP`-Konstrukte mit `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, FILTER, Math, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Implementiere eine Funktion zur Berechnung der Fakultät einer Zahl rekursiv unter Verwendung von `COND` für die Basisfälle.
hint: Definiere eine rekursive Methode und nutze `COND` für die Bedingung des Basisfalls (Fakultät von 0 oder 1 ist 1).
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
                                RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Fakultät ist nur für nicht-negative Zahlen definiert.'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = COND i(
      WHEN iv_number = 0 OR iv_number = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE iv_number * calculate_factorial( iv_number - 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht es, bedingte Ausdrücke in einer einzigen Zeile zu formulieren, was besonders nützlich für rekursive Funktionen ist, um Basisfälle kompakt zu definieren. Anstatt einer `IF...ENDIF`-Struktur wird die Logik für den Basisfall (Zahl ist 0 oder 1) und den rekursiven Schritt direkt im Ausdruck abgebildet. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sqrt_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sqrt( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
    lo_cut->calculate_square_root( -9.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `sqrt()` ist eine eingebaute arithmetische Funktion in ABAP, die die Quadratwurzel einer Gleitkommazahl berechnet. Sie ist Teil der modernen ABAP-Syntax, die mathematische Operationen direkt und effizient unterstützt. Die Fehlerbehandlung für negative Eingaben ist hier ebenfalls integriert, um robuste Berechnungen zu gewährleisten.
keywords: Math, Square Root, sqrt, Number, Arithmetic

Dynamic Pie Chart from ABAP

{ lv_svg_content } |. cl_abap_browser=>show_html( html_string = lv_html ). ENDMETHOD. METHOD get_pie_chart_svg. DATA: lv_total_value TYPE i, lv_current_angle TYPE f VALUE 0, lv_svg_paths TYPE string, lv_colors TYPE string_table VALUE VALUE #( ( 'red' ) ( 'green' ) ( 'blue' ) ( 'yellow' ) ( 'purple' ) ( 'orange' ) ). lv_total_value = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN it_data NEXT s = s + item-value ). IF lv_total_value = 0. rv_svg = ``. RETURN. ENDIF. DATA(lv_color_index) = 0. LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_item). DATA(lv_slice_angle) = ( ls_item-value / lv_total_value ) * 360. DATA(lv_start_x) = 100 + ( 90 * cos( lv_current_angle * pi( ) / 180 ) ). DATA(lv_start_y) = 100 + ( 90 * sin( lv_current_angle * pi( ) / 180 ) ). DATA(lv_end_angle) = lv_current_angle + lv_slice_angle. DATA(lv_end_x) = 100 + ( 90 * cos( lv_end_angle * pi( ) / 180 ) ). DATA(lv_end_y) = 100 + ( 90 * sin( lv_end_angle * pi( ) / 180 ) ). DATA(lv_large_arc_flag) = COND string( WHEN lv_slice_angle > 180 THEN '1' ELSE '0' ). DATA(lv_color) = lv_colors[ ( lv_color_index MOD lines( lv_colors ) ) + 1 ]. lv_color_index = lv_color_index + 1. lv_svg_paths = lv_svg_paths && | { ls_item-label } ({ ls_item-value }) |. lv_current_angle = lv_end_angle. ENDLOOP. rv_svg = | |. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine Hashed Table und fügen Sie Daten ein. Greifen Sie dann effizient auf einen Eintrag zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES HASHED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_and_read_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_and_read_data.
    DATA(lt_hashed_table) = VALUE ty_hashed_table(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Eintrag B' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Eintrag C' )
    ).

    INSERT VALUE #( id = iv_id text = iv_text ) INTO TABLE lt_hashed_table.

    READ TABLE lt_hashed_table WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_id INTO rs_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` in einer Hashed Table, um die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln, unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und einer Hashed Table als Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_carrier_flights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_hashed_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Select only carrid for aggregation

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE ty_hashed_carrier_flights(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_hashed_carrier_flights( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      NEXT result = INSERT ty_carrier_flights( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) INTO TABLE result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flight_counts )
      msg = 'Hashed Table sollte nicht leer sein'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    DATA ls_lh_flights TYPE zcl_hsh_reduce_sflights=>ty_carrier_flights.
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO ls_lh_flights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater(
        act = ls_lh_flights-flight_count
        exp = 0
        msg = 'LH sollte Flüge haben'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA ls_aa_flights TYPE zcl_hsh_reduce_sflights=>ty_carrier_flights.
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO ls_aa_flights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater(
        act = ls_aa_flights-flight_count
        exp = 0
        msg = 'AA sollte Flüge haben'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Syntax, um Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Hier wird die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft in einer Hashed Table gesammelt, wobei `GROUP SIZE` die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe liefert.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, GROUP BY, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Eintrag in einer Hashed Table existiert, ohne ihn zu lesen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS check_entry_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_entry_exists.
    DATA(lt_hashed_table) = VALUE ty_hashed_table(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Eintrag B' )
    ).

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_hashed_table[ id = iv_id ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Einträge aus einer Hashed Table basierend auf einer Bedingung unter Verwendung eines `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS filter_by_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE ty_hashed_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_value.
    DATA(lt_original_table) = VALUE ty_hashed_table(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag A' value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Eintrag B' value = 25 )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Eintrag C' value = 5 )
      ( id = 4 text = 'Eintrag D' value = 30 )
    ).

    rt_filtered_table = FILTER #( lt_original_table WHERE value >= iv_min_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_entries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_value( 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge gefiltert werden'
    ).

    DATA ls_entry TYPE zcl_hsh_filter=>ty_data.
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH TABLE KEY id = 2 INTO ls_entry.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry-value
      exp = 25
      msg = 'Eintrag mit ID 2 sollte vorhanden sein'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH TABLE KEY id = 4 INTO ls_entry.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry-value
      exp = 30
      msg = 'Eintrag mit ID 4 sollte vorhanden sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Einträge der Quelltabelle enthält, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Dies ist effizient und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FILTER, WHERE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element und einem Kind-Element unter Verwendung von `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.

CLASS zcl_xml_basic_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_basic_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xml.
    DATA lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sec_sxml_writer.
    DATA lo_xwriter TYPE REF TO if_sxml_writer.

    TRY.
        lo_writer = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
        lo_xwriter = lo_writer.

        lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'RootElement' ).
          lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'ChildElement' ).
            lo_xwriter->write_value( 'Hello XML' ).
          lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
        lo_xwriter->close_element( ).

        rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).

      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        rv_xml_string = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_attr_ns_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xml_attr_ns_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_attr_ns.

    TRY.

          lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'Data' ns_uri = 'http://example.com/ns/data' ).
            lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'id' value = '123' ).
            lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'status' value = 'active' ).
            lo_xwriter->write_value( 'Some data value' ).
          lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
        lo_xwriter->close_element( ).

        rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).

      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        rv_xml_string = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` als XML-Dokument, wobei jeder Flug ein eigenes Element darstellt.
hint: Iterieren Sie über `sflights` und verwenden Sie `OPEN_ELEMENT`, `WRITE_VALUE` und `CLOSE_ELEMENT` für jedes Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_sflights_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflights_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sflights_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_xml.
    DATA lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sec_sxml_writer.
    DATA lo_xwriter TYPE REF TO if_sxml_writer.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS. " Limit for example

    TRY.
        lo_writer = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
        lo_xwriter = lo_writer.

        lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'Flights' ).
          LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
            lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'Flight' ).
              lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'CarrierID' ).
                lo_xwriter->write_value( ls_flight-carrid ).
              lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
              lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'ConnectionID' ).
                lo_xwriter->write_value( ls_flight-connid ).
              lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
              lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'FlightDate' ).
                lo_xwriter->write_value( ls_flight-fldate ).
              lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
              lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'Price' ).
                lo_xwriter->write_value( ls_flight-price ).
              lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
            lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
          ENDLOOP.
        lo_xwriter->close_element( ).

        rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).

      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        rv_xml_string = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Text mit Sonderzeichen (z.B. `<`, `>`, `&`) enthält, und stellen Sie sicher, dass diese korrekt escaped werden.
hint: Der `cl_sec_sxml_writer` übernimmt das Escaping automatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_special_chars DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_xml_with_special_chars
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_special_chars IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_special_chars.
    DATA lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sec_sxml_writer.
    DATA lo_xwriter TYPE REF TO if_sxml_writer.

    TRY.
        lo_writer = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
        lo_xwriter = lo_writer.

        lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'Document' ).
          lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'TextContent' ).
            lo_xwriter->write_value( 'This text contains <, >, &, ", and '' characters.' ).
          lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
          lo_xwriter->open_element( name = 'AttributeValue' ).
            lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'data' value = 'Value with < and >' ).
          lo_xwriter->close_element( ).
        lo_xwriter->close_element( ).

        rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).

      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        rv_xml_string = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Der `cl_sec_sxml_writer` ist so konzipiert, dass er XML-Sonderzeichen (wie `<`, `>`, `&`, `'`, `"`) automatisch in ihre entsprechenden Entitäten umwandelt, wenn sie als Wert oder Attribut geschrieben werden. Dies gewährleistet die Gültigkeit des generierten XML-Dokuments und verhindert Parsing-Fehler.
keywords: cl_sec_sxml_writer, XML, Special Characters, Escaping, Security

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen basierend auf einem numerischen Wert einen Status zu. Wenn der Wert kleiner als 10 ist, ist der Status 'Niedrig', zwischen 10 und 20 'Mittel', sonst 'Hoch'.

CLASS zcl_cond_example IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_status = COND string(

      ELSE 'Hoch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller maximalen Sitzplätze (MAX_SEATS) für Flüge, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_lufthansa_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_lufthansa_seats.
    SELECT carrid, max_seats FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_data WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-max_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (MAX_SEATS) für einen bestimmten Flug (CARRID und CONNID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie 0 zurück.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS get_max_seats IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                    iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_seats) TYPE sflight-max_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, max_seats FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_data.

    TRY.
        rv_max_seats = lt_sflight_data[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-max_seats.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_max_seats = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` kann ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden, wenn kein Eintrag gefunden wird, was den Code sehr prägnant macht.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit Aggregatfunktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    SELECT carrid, max_seats FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_seats  = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP NEXT s = s + <fs_group_member>-max_seats )
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings und konvertieren Sie den String in Großbuchstaben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_clean_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_string_clean_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_and_upper_string.
    DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '^\s+|\s+$' IN lv_temp WITH ''. " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s{2,}' IN lv_temp WITH ' '. " Replace multiple spaces with single
    rv_output = TO_UPPER( lv_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->clean_and_upper_string( 'ABAP' ) exp = 'ABAP' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'STATUS' hinzu, die 'ACTIVE' ist, wenn der Flug in der Zukunft liegt, und 'PAST' sonst. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `COND` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_cond_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_cond_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                             connid = ls_flight-connid
                             fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                             status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-fldate > lv_current_date THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'PAST' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_cond_example( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ) ##NO_TEXT.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate > lv_current_date.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'ACTIVE' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'PAST' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `COND` innerhalb eines `VALUE` Konstruktorausdrucks ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle, wobei jede Zeile dynamisch basierend auf Bedingungen berechnet wird. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FOR, COND, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Inline Declaration

CLASS zcl_format_flight_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_format_flight_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flights.
    rt_formatted_list = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                 ( |Flug: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT PAD = LEFT WIDTH = 4 FILL = '0' } am { cl_abap_format=>date_out( ls_flight-fldate ) }| ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller geraden Zahlen bis zu einem gegebenen Limit unter Verwendung einer WHILE-Schleife und Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` für die Schleife und `DATA(lv_sum)` für die Inline-Deklaration der Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sum_even DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_even
      IMPORTING
        iv_limit TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sum_even IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_even.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = 0.
    DATA(lv_sum) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_number <= iv_limit.
      IF lv_current_number MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_current_number.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_sum = lv_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Einträge einer internen Tabelle `sflights` sequenziell, bis ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gefunden wird oder die Tabelle vollständig durchlaufen wurde. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Indexzähler und `READ TABLE ... INDEX ... INTO DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_read_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flight_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_found_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_read_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_by_carrier.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_sflights ).

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_lines.
      READ TABLE it_sflights INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrier.
        rs_found_flight = ls_flight.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle durch Kommas getrennten Wörter aus einem String, bis ein leeres Wort gefunden wird oder der String vollständig verarbeitet ist. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `FIND` oder `SUBSTRING` in Kombination mit `SHIFT` oder `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_extract_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_words_until_empty
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_extract_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_words_until_empty.
    DATA(lv_remaining_text) = iv_text.
    DATA(lv_delimiter) = `,`.

    WHILE lv_remaining_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_pos) = find( val = lv_remaining_text sub = lv_delimiter ).
      DATA(lv_word) = COND string( WHEN lv_pos = -1 THEN lv_remaining_text ELSE lv_remaining_text(lv_pos) ).
      lv_word = to_upper( lv_word ). " Beispiel: Normalisierung
      lv_word = condense( lv_word ). " Leerzeichen entfernen

      IF lv_word IS INITIAL.
        EXIT. " Abbruch bei leerem Wort
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_word TO rt_words.

      IF lv_pos = -1.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_text.
      ELSE.
        lv_remaining_text = lv_remaining_text+lv_pos+1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Retry-Logik mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, die versucht, eine potenziell fehlerhafte Operation bis zu einer maximalen Anzahl von Versuchen auszuführen. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `WAIT UP TO`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` für die Wiederholung, `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung und `WAIT UP TO` für eine Verzögerung zwischen den Versuchen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_retry_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_retriable_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _simulated_failing_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_attempt TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_retry_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_retriable_operation.
    DATA(lv_attempt) = 0.
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_attempt < iv_max_retries AND lv_success = abap_false.
      lv_attempt = lv_attempt + 1.
      WRITE: / |Attempt { lv_attempt } of { iv_max_retries }...|.
      TRY.
          _simulated_failing_operation( lv_attempt ).
          lv_success = abap_true.
          WRITE: / |Operation successful on attempt { lv_attempt }.|.
        CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
          WRITE: / |Operation failed: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
          IF lv_attempt < iv_max_retries.
            WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Wait before retrying
          ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_success = lv_success.
    IF rv_success = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulated_failing_operation.
    IF iv_attempt < 3. " Simulate failure for first 2 attempts
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_retry_failure FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_retry_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lv_success = lo_cut->perform_retriable_operation( 3 ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        " Should not happen
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_retry_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_true.
    TRY.
        lv_success = lo_cut->perform_retriable_operation( 2 ). " Max retries 2, but operation needs 3 to succeed
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine robuste Retry-Logik unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife. `TRY...CATCH` ist der moderne Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung, und `WAIT UP TO` ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Verzögerung. Dies ist entscheidend für die Stabilität von Integrationen oder bei der Interaktion mit externen Systemen.
keywords: WHILE, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, WAIT UP TO, Retry Logic

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen dynamischen Cache-Check, indem Sie eine Methode basierend auf einem dynamisch ermittelten Zustand wiederholt aufrufen, bis ein 'Cache-Hit' simuliert wird oder eine maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht ist. Dies demonstriert die Konzepte, die hinter einem `cl_esh_ca_check` stehen könnten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` für die Wiederholung und eine dynamische Methode, die einen 'Cache-Hit' simuliert. Beachten Sie die Keywords `cl_esh_ca_check` und `S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` im Kontext der Problemstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_cache_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_cache_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_attempts TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cache_hit) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_cache_state TYPE i VALUE 0.
    METHODS _simulate_check_method
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hit) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cache_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_cache_check.
    DATA(lv_attempt) = 0.
    DATA(lv_hit) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_attempt < iv_max_attempts AND lv_hit = abap_false.
      lv_attempt = lv_attempt + 1.
      WRITE: / |Simulating cache check, attempt { lv_attempt }...|.
      lv_hit = _simulate_check_method( ).
      IF lv_hit = abap_true.
        WRITE: / |Cache hit on attempt { lv_attempt }!|.
      ELSE.
        WRITE: / |Cache miss. Retrying...|.
        WAIT UP TO 100 MILLISECONDS. " Simulate some processing time
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_cache_hit = lv_hit.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulate_check_method.
    " Simulate that the cache 'warms up' or the check eventually succeeds
    mv_cache_state = mv_cache_state + 1.
    IF mv_cache_state >= 3. " Simulate a hit after 3 attempts
      rv_hit = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_hit = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cache_miss.

Die Keywords `cl_esh_ca_check` und `S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` sind hier im Kontext der Problemstellung relevant, da sie auf die Art von Systemprüfung hinweisen, die hier simuliert wird.

Instructions: Durchsuchen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die als einfacher Cache dient, nach einem Eintrag. Brechen Sie die Suche ab, sobald der Eintrag gefunden wurde oder das Ende der Tabelle erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `LINE_EXISTS`.

CLASS zcl_while_cache_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    TYPES tt_cache_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS find_in_cache
      IMPORTING
        it_cache_table TYPE tt_cache_table
        iv_key         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_cache_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_in_cache.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_cache_table ).

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_lines.
      IF line_exists( it_cache_table[ key = iv_key ] ). " Modern check for existence
        rv_value = it_cache_table[ key = iv_key ]-value.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife.

solution:
CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      rv_factorial = 0. " Fakultät für negative Zahlen nicht definiert
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_result) = 1.
    DATA(lv_current) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current > 0.
      lv_result = lv_result * lv_current.
      lv_current = lv_current - 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_factorial = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_stack_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_stack TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_stack
      IMPORTING
        io_stack TYPE tt_stack
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_elements) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_stack_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_stack.
    DATA(lt_current_stack) = io_stack.

    WHILE lt_current_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_element) = lt_current_stack[ lines( lt_current_stack ) ]. " Get last element
      APPEND lv_element TO rt_processed_elements.
      DELETE TABLE lt_current_stack INDEX lines( lt_current_stack ). " Remove last element
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um eine Reihe von Bedingungen zu prüfen und einen Wert zu ermitteln, wobei die Schleife abbricht, sobald eine Bedingung erfüllt ist. Nutzen Sie `COND` für die Zuweisung.

CLASS zcl_while_cond_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_matching_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i
        iv_limit       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_cond_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_matching_value.
    DATA(lv_current_value) = iv_start_value.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_current_value <= iv_limit AND lv_found = abap_false.
      IF lv_current_value MOD 7 = 0. " Beispielbedingung: durch 7 teilbar
        rv_found_value = lv_current_value.
        lv_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lv_current_value MOD 11 = 0. " Beispielbedingung: durch 11 teilbar
        rv_found_value = lv_current_value.
        lv_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_value = lv_current_value + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Alternative mit COND, falls rv_found_value nicht direkt gesetzt wird
    " rv_found_value = COND #( WHEN lv_found = abap_true THEN rv_found_value ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen, indem Sie wiederholt die größte Zahl entfernen und zur Summe hinzufügen, bis die Summe einen Zielwert überschreitet oder die Liste leer ist. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `SORT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE`, um die Liste zu verarbeiten, `SORT` für die Sortierung und `DELETE` für das Entfernen von Elementen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sum_largest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_largest_until_target
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_target_sum TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_current_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sum_largest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_largest_until_target.
    DATA(lt_numbers_copy) = it_numbers.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_sum <= iv_target_sum AND lt_numbers_copy IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT lt_numbers_copy DESCENDING. " Sort descending to get largest at top
      DATA(lv_largest_number) = lt_numbers_copy[ 1 ].
      lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lv_largest_number.
      DELETE TABLE lt_numbers_copy INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_current_sum = lv_current_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Zeichen in einem String, bis ein bestimmtes Trennzeichen erreicht wird, unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `FIND` oder `CP` (Contains Pattern) für die Prüfung des Trennzeichens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_count_chars DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_chars_until_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_text      TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_count_chars IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_chars_until_delimiter.
    DATA(lv_current_pos) = 0.
    DATA(lv_text_length) = strlen( iv_text ).

    WHILE lv_current_pos < lv_text_length.
      IF iv_text+lv_current_pos(1) = iv_delimiter.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_pos = lv_current_pos + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_count = lv_current_pos.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, wobei die Schleife abbricht, wenn das Enddatum erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `cl_abap_date_helper`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und inkrementieren Sie das Datum. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_date_helper=>is_weekend`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_workdays.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_workdays) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      IF cl_abap_date_helper=>is_weekend( lv_current_date ) = abap_false.
        lv_workdays = lv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_workdays = lv_workdays.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Liste von Zahlen in eine neue Liste, indem Sie jede Zahl durch ihre Quadratwurzel ersetzen, bis eine Zahl negativ wird oder die Liste leer ist. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `SQRT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `SQRT` für die Berechnung. Beachten Sie, dass `SQRT` eine Gleitkommazahl zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sqrt_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_sqrt_until_negative
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sqrt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sqrt_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sqrt_until_negative.
    DATA(lt_numbers_copy) = it_numbers.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_numbers_copy ).
      DATA(lv_current_number) = lt_numbers_copy[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_number < 0.
        EXIT. " Abbruch bei negativer Zahl
      ENDIF.
      APPEND sqrt( lv_current_number ) TO rt_sqrt_numbers.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 2.0 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Transformation von Daten in einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Es verwendet die mathematische Funktion `SQRT` und bricht die Verarbeitung ab, sobald eine negative Zahl auftritt. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und Tabellenausdrücken (`lt_numbers_copy[ lv_index ]`) ist modern und effizient.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen aus einem String, bis keine weiteren Leerzeichen mehr entfernt werden können. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `CONDENSE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und vergleichen Sie den String vor und nach `CONDENSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_trim_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string_repeatedly
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_trim_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string_repeatedly.
    DATA(lv_current_text) = iv_text.
    DATA(lv_previous_text) = iv_text.

    WHILE abap_true.
      CONDENSE lv_current_text NO-GAPS. " Entfernt alle Leerzeichen, auch zwischen Wörtern
      " Für nur führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen:
      " lv_current_text = |{ lv_current_text ALPHA = IN }|.
      " Oder: lv_current_text = trim( lv_current_text ). (ab 7.51)

      IF lv_current_text = lv_previous_text.
        EXIT. " Keine weiteren Änderungen, Schleife beenden
      ENDIF.
      lv_previous_text = lv_current_text.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_trimmed_text = lv_current_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um einen String wiederholt zu bereinigen, bis keine Änderungen mehr auftreten. `CONDENSE NO-GAPS` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um alle Leerzeichen aus einem String zu entfernen. Die Schleife stellt sicher, dass alle möglichen Leerzeichen entfernt werden, auch wenn sie in mehreren Schritten erfolgen müssten (obwohl `CONDENSE NO-GAPS` dies in einem Schritt erledigt, demonstriert es das Prinzip der iterativen Bereinigung).
keywords: WHILE, String Processing, CONDENSE, Text Manipulation, Loop

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail mit einem statischen Betreff und Textinhalt an eine externe E-Mail-Adresse. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klassen `CL_BCS` und `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS` für das Senden und `CL_CAM_ADDRESS_BCS` für den Empfänger. Inline-Deklarationen sind hier hilfreich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_simple_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_st_subject
        iv_content         TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_simple_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_content )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient i_express = 'X' ).

        DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_error_screen = 'X' ).

        IF lv_sent = abap_true.
          COMMIT WORK.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_simple_email( ).
    " Da das Senden einer E-Mail externe Abhängigkeiten hat, wird hier nur die Ausführung getestet.
    " Eine echte Unit-Test-Prüfung würde Mocking erfordern.
    lo_cut->send_email( iv_recipient_email = 'test@example.com'
                        iv_subject         = 'Test E-Mail'
                        iv_content         = 'Dies ist ein Test.' ).
    " Keine direkte Assert-Anweisung für den Sendevorgang selbst, da dies ein Integrationstest wäre.
    " Man könnte hier prüfen, ob keine Exception geworfen wurde.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Prüft, ob kein SY-SUBRC gesetzt wurde (impliziert Erfolg)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne, objektorientierte Art, E-Mails in ABAP zu versenden. Es nutzt Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und die Klassen `CL_BCS` und `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS` für eine klare Struktur. `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>STRING_TO_SOLI_TAB` ist eine effiziente Methode zur Umwandlung von String-Inhalten.
keywords: BCS, E-Mail, CL_BCS, CL_DOCUMENT_BCS, CL_CAM_ADDRESS_BCS, Messaging, Object-Oriented

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Anhang, der aus Daten der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` generiert wurde. Der Anhang soll im CSV-Format sein.
hint: Erstellen Sie den Anhang als Binärinhalt (`XSTRING`) und verwenden Sie `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS=>ADD_ATTACHMENT`. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `REDUCE` für die CSV-Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_with_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_st_subject
        iv_content         TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_with_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        " 1. CSV-Inhalt aus SFLIGHTS generieren
        SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 10 ROWS.

        DATA(lv_csv_header) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;SEATSFREE`.
        DATA(lv_csv_content) = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = lv_csv_header
          FOR flight IN lt_sflights
          NEXT s = s && |
| && |
            { flight-carrid };{ flight-connid };{ flight-fldate };{ flight-price };{ flight-currency };{ flight-planetype };{ flight-seatsmax };{ flight-seatsocc };{ flight-seatsfree }|
        ).

        DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp(
          EXPORTING
            text = lv_csv_content
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
          RECEIVING
            buffer = DATA(lx_buffer)
        ).

        " 2. Dokument und Anhang erstellen
        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_content )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        lo_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment_type    = 'CSV'
          i_attachment_subject = 'SFLIGHTS_Data.csv'
          i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_xstring_content )
          i_att_content_hex    = lv_xstring_content
        ).

        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient i_express = 'X' ).

        DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_error_screen = 'X' ).

        IF lv_sent = abap_true.
          COMMIT WORK.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_bcs cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email_with_attachment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_with_attachment( ).
    lo_cut->send_email_with_attachment( iv_recipient_email = 'attachment@example.com'
                                        iv_subject         = 'E-Mail mit Anhang'
                                        iv_content         = 'Siehe Anhang für Flugdaten.' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert mehrere moderne ABAP-Features: `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration, den `REDUCE`-Operator zur effizienten Generierung des CSV-Strings, String-Templates (`|...|`) für lesbare String-Verkettung und `CL_ABAP_CONV_CE` zur Umwandlung in `XSTRING`. Der Anhang wird dann über `ADD_ATTACHMENT` zur E-Mail hinzugefügt.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, die teilweise gleiche Feldnamen haben, unter Verwendung von `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Anweisung `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` für eine effiziente Feldzuweisung basierend auf gleichen Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field4 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING is_source TO rs_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transfer_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transfer_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_move_corresponding=>ty_source(
      field1 = 'Value A'
      field2 = 100
      field3 = 'Value C'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->transfer_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-field4 ). " field4 in target should be initial as it's not in source
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` ist eine leistungsstarke Anweisung, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu verschieben, deren Komponenten gleiche Namen haben. Es ist effizienter und wartungsfreundlicher als die manuelle Zuweisung jedes Feldes, besonders bei vielen Feldern. In ABAP 7.40+ kann es auch mit `EXPANDING TABLES` oder `KEEPING TARGET LINES` verwendet werden.
keywords: MOVE-CORRESPONDING, Structure, Data Transfer, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und übertragen Sie die gefilterten Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine prägnante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    " Alternativ mit MOVE-CORRESPONDING für die Strukturkonvertierung, falls nötig:

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und kann eine Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariable ersetzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_raw
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.
