Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten und füllen Sie diese mit generischen Daten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` für die Zeilenstruktur und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` für die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_def,
           tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
        iv_num_rows          TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_def-name
        type = lo_type_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                       <fs_field> TYPE any.

        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

        DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
          CREATE DATA lo_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
          ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <ls_line>.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.

          LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              " Populate with generic data (e.g., row number, field name, etc.)
              CASE ls_component-type->type_kind.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
                  <fs_field> = |{ ls_component-name } { sy-index }|.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_numc.
                  <fs_field> = |{ sy-index }|.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
                  <fs_field> = sy-index.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
                  <fs_field> = sy-datum + sy-index.
                WHEN OTHERS.
                  " Default or specific handling
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        CLEAR ro_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        CLEAR ro_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario für generische Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Parse einen XML-String, der Flugdaten enthält, und extrahiere die Flugnummern und Abflugorte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und die Methoden zur Navigation im DOM.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-fli_id,
             departure  TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_node( )->get_first_child( ). " <Flights>
    DATA(lo_current_node) = lo_root_node->get_first_child( ). " First <Flight>

    WHILE lo_current_node IS BOUND.
      IF lo_current_node->get_name( ) = 'Flight'.
        DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_flight_data( ).
        DATA(lo_child_node) = lo_current_node->get_first_child( ).
        WHILE lo_child_node IS BOUND.
          CASE lo_child_node->get_name( ).
            WHEN 'FlightNumber'.
              ls_flight-flight_num = lo_child_node->get_value( ).
            WHEN 'DepartureCity'.
              ls_flight-departure = lo_child_node->get_value( ).
          ENDCASE.
          lo_child_node = lo_child_node->get_next_sibling( ).
        ENDWHILE.
        APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flight_data.
      ENDIF.
      lo_current_node = lo_current_node->get_next_sibling( ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen XML-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und die Methoden zum Erstellen von Knoten (`create_element`, `create_text_node`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-fli_id,
             departure  TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             arrival    TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_node ).

    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_root_node->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      DATA(lo_carrid_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'CarrierID' ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_carrid_node ).
      lo_carrid_node->create_text_node( ls_flight-carrid )->append_child( lo_carrid_node ).

      DATA(lo_connid_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'ConnectionID' ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_connid_node ).
      lo_connid_node->create_text_node( ls_flight-connid )->append_child( lo_connid_node ).

      DATA(lo_fliid_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'FlightNumber' ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_fliid_node ).
      lo_fliid_node->create_text_node( ls_flight-flight_num )->append_child( lo_fliid_node ).

      DATA(lo_dep_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'DepartureCity' ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_dep_node ).
      lo_dep_node->create_text_node( ls_flight-departure )->append_child( lo_dep_node ).

      DATA(lo_arr_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'ArrivalCity' ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_arr_node ).
      lo_arr_node->create_text_node( ls_flight-arrival )->append_child( lo_arr_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie das erste Vorkommen des Wortes "Flug" in einem gegebenen Text und geben Sie dessen Startposition und Länge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FIND` Anweisung mit den Zusätzen `MATCH OFFSET` und `MATCH LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_match_info,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_match_info.

    METHODS find_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_word TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_match_info) TYPE ty_match_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_word.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_word IN iv_text
      MATCH OFFSET rs_match_info-offset
      MATCH LENGTH rs_match_info-length.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_match_info. " Indicate not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle E-Mail-Adressen in einem gegebenen Text unter Verwendung eines regulären Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit dem Zusatz `RESULTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b`.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_emails = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches ( iv_text+<match>-offset( <match>-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie einen XML-String, ändern Sie den Abflugort eines bestimmten Fluges und fügen Sie ein neues Attribut zu einem Element hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen, `get_elements_by_tag_name` zum Suchen, `set_value` zum Ändern von Text und `set_attribute` zum Hinzufügen von Attributen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_modify_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_flight_num TYPE sflight-fli_id
        iv_new_departure TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_attribute_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_modify_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_nodes INTO DATA(lo_flight_node).
      DATA(lo_flight_num_node) = lo_flight_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'FlightNumber' )[ 1 ].
      IF lo_flight_num_node->get_value( ) = iv_flight_num.
        DATA(lo_departure_node) = lo_flight_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'DepartureCity' )[ 1 ].
        lo_departure_node->set_value( iv_new_departure ).
        lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = iv_attribute_name value = iv_attribute_value ).
        EXIT. " Flight found and modified
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_modify_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xml) =
      `<Flights>` &&
      `  <Flight>` &&
      `    <FlightNumber>LH400</FlightNumber>` &&
      `    <DepartureCity>FRANKFURT</DepartureCity>` &&
      `  </Flight>` &&
      `</Flights>`. 

    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_cut->modify_flight_xml(
      iv_xml_string      = lv_original_xml

      iv_attribute_value = 'updated'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<DepartureCity>MUNICH</DepartureCity>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Flight status="updated">' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_modify_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xml) =
      `<Flights>` &&
      `  <Flight>` &&
      `    <FlightNumber>LH400</FlightNumber>` &&
      `    <DepartureCity>FRANKFURT</DepartureCity>` &&
      `  </Flight>` &&
      `</Flights>`. 

    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_cut->modify_flight_xml(
      iv_xml_string      = lv_original_xml
      iv_flight_num      = 'UA920'
      iv_new_departure   = 'LONDON'
      iv_attribute_name  = 'status'
      iv_attribute_value = 'new'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<DepartureCity>FRANKFURT</DepartureCity>' ). " Should not be changed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = 'status="new"' ). " Attribute should not be added
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein bestehendes XML-Dokument modifiziert. Nach dem Parsen wird `get_elements_by_tag_name` verwendet, um spezifische Knoten zu finden. `set_value` ändert den Textinhalt eines Knotens, und `set_attribute` fügt einem Element ein neues Attribut hinzu. Die Verwendung von `render_xstring` mit `pretty_print` sorgt für eine lesbare Ausgabe.
keywords: cl_xml_document, XML, Modification, DOM, Attributes, set_value, set_attribute

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugbeschreibungen und geben Sie nur die Beschreibungen zurück, die das Wort "Direktflug" enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `FIND` Bedingung (implizit durch `CONTAINS`).

CLASS zcl_str_find_in_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_direct_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_descriptions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_descriptions) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_in_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_direct_flights.
    rt_filtered_descriptions = FILTER #( it_descriptions USING KEY default
                                         WHERE ( CONTAINS( table_line, 'Direktflug' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: FILTER, CONTAINS, Internal Tables, String Processing, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Validieren Sie einen XML-String gegen ein XSD-Schema. Geben Sie 'X' zurück, wenn die Validierung erfolgreich ist, ansonsten ' '.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und `cl_xml_schema` zur Validierung.

CLASS zcl_xml_validate_schema DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_xml_with_xsd
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xsd_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error,
        cx_xml_schema_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_validate_schema IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_xml_with_xsd.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_xml_schema) = NEW cl_xml_schema( ).
    lo_xml_schema->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xsd_string ) ).

    lo_xml_document->validate( lo_xml_schema ).
    rv_is_valid = abap_true.

  CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_schema_error.
    rv_is_valid = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Werte eines bestimmten Attributs (z.B. 'id') von allen 'Flight'-Elementen in einem XML-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und `get_elements_by_tag_name` in Kombination mit `get_attribute_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_extract_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_flight_ids
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attribute_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_extract_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_flight_ids.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

    rt_attribute_values = VALUE #( FOR lo_node IN lt_flight_nodes
                                   LET lo_attribute = lo_node->get_attribute_node( iv_attribute_name ) IN
                                   WHERE ( lo_attribute IS BOUND )
                                   ( lo_attribute->get_value( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks in einem Text und extrahieren Sie spezifische Untergruppen (Submatches).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit dem Zusatz `SUBMATCHES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_submatches DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_match,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_match.
    TYPES tt_flight_matches TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_match WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flight_codes
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_matches) TYPE tt_flight_matches.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_submatches IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_codes.
    " Regex to find patterns like 'LH400', 'UA920' where LH/UA is carrid and 400/920 is connid
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `([A-Z]{2})(\d{3})`.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches)
      SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

    LOOP AT lt_submatches INTO DATA(ls_submatch).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_match(
               carrid = ls_submatch[ 1 ]-submatch
               connid = ls_submatch[ 2 ]-submatch
             ) TO rt_flight_matches.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie ein neues 'Comment'-Element zu jedem 'Flight'-Element in einem XML-Dokument hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und `get_elements_by_tag_name` zum Suchen und `append_child` zum Hinzufügen neuer Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_add_comment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_comment_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_comment_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_comment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_comment_to_flights.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_nodes INTO DATA(lo_flight_node).
      DATA(lo_comment_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Comment' ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_comment_node ).
      lo_comment_node->create_text_node( iv_comment_text )->append_child( lo_comment_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String per Regex und geben Sie die einzelnen Teile zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `split` mit Regex-Objekt oder Workarounds in älteren Versionen, hier modern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE string
        iv_regex_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_val ).

    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    WHILE lo_matcher->match( offset = lv_offset ) IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF lo_matcher->get_offset( ) > lv_offset.
        APPEND iv_val+lv_offset( lo_matcher->get_offset( ) - lv_offset ) TO rt_res.
      ENDIF.
      lv_offset = lo_matcher->get_offset( ) + lo_matcher->get_length( ).
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_offset < strlen( iv_val ).
      APPEND iv_val+lv_offset TO rt_res.
    ENDIF.

    IF rt_res IS INITIAL AND iv_val IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND iv_val TO rt_res.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String einem bestimmten regulären Ausdruck entspricht (vollständiger Match).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` und `MATCH LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_full_match
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_regex_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_full_match.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX iv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset)
      MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_length).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_offset = 0 AND lv_length = strlen( iv_text ).
      rv_is_match = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_match = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle 'Comment'-Elemente aus einem XML-Dokument.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document`, `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `remove_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_delete_comments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_comments_from_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_delete_comments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_comments_from_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lt_comment_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Comment' ).

    LOOP AT lt_comment_nodes INTO DATA(lo_comment_node).
      DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_comment_node->get_parent( ).
      IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
        lo_parent_node->remove_child( lo_comment_node ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

      `  <Flight><FlightNumber>UA920</FlightNumber><Comment>Hinweis 2</Comment></Flight>` &&
      `</Flights>`.

Instructions: Finden Sie das erste Vorkommen eines Musters in einem String, beginnend ab einer bestimmten Startposition.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF` mit dem Zusatz `STARTING AT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_starting_at DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_match_info,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_match_info.

    METHODS find_word_from_position
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_word TYPE string
        iv_start_offset TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_match_info) TYPE ty_match_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_starting_at IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_word_from_position.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_word IN iv_text
      STARTING AT iv_start_offset
      MATCH OFFSET rs_match_info-offset
      MATCH LENGTH rs_match_info-length.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_match_info. " Indicate not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie den Wert eines Attributs in einem XML-Dokument.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document`, `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `set_attribute`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_replace_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_attribute_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_element_name TYPE string
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_old_value TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_replace_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_attribute_value.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lt_elements) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_element_name ).

    LOOP AT lt_elements INTO DATA(lo_element_node).
      DATA(lo_attribute_node) = lo_element_node->get_attribute_node( iv_attribute_name ).
      IF lo_attribute_node IS BOUND AND lo_attribute_node->get_value( ) = iv_old_value.
        lo_element_node->set_attribute( name = iv_attribute_name value = iv_new_value ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_replace_wrong_old_value FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_replace_existing_attribute.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_replace_attribute( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xml) =

    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_cut->replace_attribute_value(
      iv_xml_string   = lv_original_xml
      iv_element_name = 'Flight'

      iv_old_value    = 'delayed'
      iv_new_value    = 'cancelled'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Flight status="cancelled">' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Flight status="on-time">' ). " Other attribute should be unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.

      iv_element_name = 'Flight'

      iv_new_value    = 'new'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_modified_xml exp = lv_original_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_replace_attribute( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xml) = `<Flights><Flight status="delayed"><FlightNumber>LH400</FlightNumber></Flight></Flights>`.

    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_cut->replace_attribute_value(
      iv_xml_string   = lv_original_xml
      iv_element_name = 'Flight'

      iv_old_value    = 'on-time'
      iv_new_value    = 'cancelled'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Flight status="delayed">' ). " Should not be changed
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Das Ersetzen von Attributwerten in XML-Dokumenten ist eine häufige Anforderung. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `get_attribute_node` gezielt Attribute findet und deren Wert mit `set_attribute` aktualisiert. Die Prüfung des alten Wertes stellt sicher, dass nur die gewünschten Attribute geändert werden.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter aus einem Text, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen und mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden regulären Ausdruck und `SUBMATCHES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_extract_capital_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_capital_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_capitalized_words.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]{2,}\b`.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches ( iv_text+<match>-offset( <match>-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`), wobei jeder Eintrag ein `<Flight>`-Element mit `Carrid` und `Connid` als Attribute darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife, um die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und dynamisch XML-Elemente zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_from_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_xml_from_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_from_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_from_flights.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).
    lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Carrid' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Connid' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights
    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( )->get_output_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_xml_from_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_xml_from_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sxml_from_table( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sxml_from_table=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_xml_from_flights( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_xml,
      exp = '<Flights><Flight Carrid="LH" Connid="0400"></Flight><Flight Carrid="AA" Connid="0017"></Flight></Flights>',
      msg = 'XML should contain flight data from internal table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von XML-Strukturen basierend auf Daten aus einer internen Tabelle. Die `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)`-Syntax ist eine moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmtes Attribut (z.B. 'FALSE') in der Schnittstelle `IF_ABAP_CONSTANTS` existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` oder `CONDENSE` mit `WHERE` auf dem Ergebnis der Attributabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ciqa_attr_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_attribute_exists IMPORTING iv_object_name TYPE string
                                           iv_attribute_name TYPE string
                                           iv_object_type TYPE string " 'CLASS' or 'INTERFACE'
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ciqa_attr_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_attribute_exists.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
    DATA lt_ci_attributes TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>ci_t_attributes.

    IF iv_object_type = 'CLASS'.
      lt_ci_attributes = lo_ci_query->get_attributes_for_class( iv_object_name ).
    ELSE IF iv_object_type = 'INTERFACE'.
      lt_ci_attributes = lo_ci_query->get_attributes_for_interface( iv_object_name ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_ci_attributes[ cmp_name = iv_attribute_name AND cmp_kind = 'A' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_attribute_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_attribute_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ciqa_attr_exists( ).

    " Test for existing attribute in interface
    DATA(lv_exists_true) = lo_cut->check_attribute_exists( iv_object_name = 'IF_ABAP_CONSTANTS'
                                                          iv_attribute_name = 'FALSE'
                                                          iv_object_type = 'INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists_true,
      exp = abap_true,
      msg = 'Attribute FALSE should exist in IF_ABAP_CONSTANTS' ).

    " Test for non-existing attribute in interface
    DATA(lv_exists_false) = lo_cut->check_attribute_exists( iv_object_name = 'IF_ABAP_CONSTANTS'
                                                           iv_attribute_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_ATTR'
                                                           iv_object_type = 'INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists_false,
      exp = abap_false,
      msg = 'Attribute NON_EXISTENT_ATTR should not exist in IF_ABAP_CONSTANTS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit dem `COND`-Operator, um effizient zu prüfen, ob ein bestimmtes Attribut in der Liste der abgefragten Attribute vorhanden ist. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Art der Bedingungsprüfung.
keywords: Code Inspector, RTTI, Attributes, Existence, LINE_EXISTS, COND, cl_ci_query_attributes

CLASS zcl_sxml_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_error_handling RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).
    TRY.
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Root' ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Root
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Attempt to close non-existent element
        rv_error_message = 'No error occurred (unexpected)'.
      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Attribute einer Klasse (z.B. `CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT`) und gruppieren Sie diese nach ihrem Sichtbarkeitsbereich (Public, Protected, Private).
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` auf dem Ergebnis der Attributabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ciqa_group_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_grouped,
             visibility_text TYPE string,
             attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cl_ci_query_attributes=>ci_s_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_attribute_grouped.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_grouped WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_grouped_attributes IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_attrs) TYPE tt_attribute_grouped.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ciqa_group_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_attributes.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_all_attributes) = lo_ci_query->get_attributes_for_class( iv_class_name ).

    rt_grouped_attrs = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_attr IN lt_all_attributes
      GROUP BY ( visibility_text = COND string(
                                    WHEN ls_attr-visibility = '1' THEN 'Public'
                                    WHEN ls_attr-visibility = '2' THEN 'Protected'
                                    WHEN ls_attr-visibility = '3' THEN 'Private'
                                    ELSE 'Unknown' ) )
      ( visibility_text = CORRESPONDING #( GROUP KEY )
        attributes = VALUE #(
          FOR ls_grouped_attr IN GROUP ls_attr
          ( ls_grouped_attr ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Attribute einer Klasse und deren Typen, und verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um eine komprimierte Liste der eindeutigen Attributtypen zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `SET` für die eindeutigen Typen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ciqa_unique_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_attribute_types IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_types) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ciqa_unique_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_attribute_types.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_all_attributes) = lo_ci_query->get_attributes_for_class( iv_class_name ).

    rt_unique_types = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT types = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR ls_attr IN lt_all_attributes
      WHERE ( cmp_kind = 'A' )
      LET lv_type = ls_attr-type_name IN
      IF NOT line_exists( types[ table_line = lv_type ] ).
        APPEND lv_type TO types.
      ENDIF.
      RESULT types
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('AA') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_method_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS und SCARR, wobei Sie nur die Flüge von Fluggesellschaften berücksichtigen, deren Name mit 'A' beginnt, und die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS` speichern.

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_name RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_name.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE c~carrname LIKE 'A%'
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Struktur der internen Tabelle nicht exakt der Projektion des `SELECT` entspricht, aber Feldnamen übereinstimmen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) durchläuft und für jede Zeile die Zeilennummer ermittelt. Demonstrieren Sie dabei sowohl die Verwendung von `sy-tabix` als auch die modernere `LINE_INDEX` in einer `FOR`-Schleife. Die Methode soll eine neue Tabelle zurückgeben, die die ursprünglichen Flugdaten und die ermittelte Zeilennummer für beide Ansätze enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... INDEX INTO ...` für die moderne Variante und vergleichen Sie mit `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` und `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_vs_line_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_indexed,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             index_sy  TYPE i,
             index_for TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_indexed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_indexed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_indexed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_indexed_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_indexed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_indexed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_vs_line_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_flights.
    DATA(lt_sy_tabix_results) = VALUE tt_sflight_indexed( ).
    DATA(lt_for_index_results) = VALUE tt_sflight_indexed( ).

    " Using LOOP AT and sy-tabix (older style)
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight_loop).
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_indexed(
        carrid    = ls_sflight_loop-carrid
        connid    = ls_sflight_loop-connid
        fldate    = ls_sflight_loop-fldate
        index_sy  = sy-tabix
        index_for = 0 " Not applicable here for this part
      ) TO lt_sy_tabix_results.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Using FOR and LINE_INDEX (modern style)
    lt_for_index_results = VALUE tt_sflight_indexed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index)
      ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid    = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
        index_sy  = 0 " Not applicable here for this part
        index_for = lv_index ) " LINE_INDEX starts from 1
    ).

    " Combine results for demonstration, assuming tables have same number of entries
    LOOP AT lt_sy_tabix_results INTO DATA(ls_sy_result).
      READ TABLE lt_for_index_results INTO DATA(ls_for_result) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_indexed(
          carrid    = ls_sy_result-carrid
          connid    = ls_sy_result-connid
          fldate    = ls_sy_result-fldate
          index_sy  = ls_sy_result-index_sy
          index_for = ls_for_result-index_for
        ) TO rt_indexed_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_indexed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_indexed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251126' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251126' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '123' fldate = '20251126' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_vs_line_index( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_indexed_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-index_sy exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-index_for exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-index_sy exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-index_for exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_INDEX` in einer `FOR`-Schleife ist eine moderne und explizite Art, den aktuellen Zeilenindex zu erhalten. Im Gegensatz zu `sy-tabix`, das ein globales Systemfeld ist und in verschachtelten Schleifen oder Funktionsaufrufen zu unerwartetem Verhalten führen kann, ist `LINE_INDEX` lokal auf die Schleife beschränkt und somit sicherer und lesbarer. Die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte Initialisierung von Tabellen.
keywords: sy-tabix, FOR, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Passagiere (SUM(SEATSMAX)) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator. Demonstrieren Sie in einer separaten Methode, wie `sy-tabix` in einer traditionellen Schleife für eine ähnliche Aggregation verwendet werden könnte, um den Unterschied in der Syntax zu verdeutlichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `NEXT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_total_seats_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_total_seats_classic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_modern.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_seats_classic.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE i.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_flight-seatsmax.
      " sy-tabix could be used here for debugging or conditional logic,
      " but not directly for the aggregation itself.
      " For example: IF sy-tabix > 10. ... ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_total_seats = lv_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa_modern exp = 250 ).

CLASS zcl_filter_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_filtered_flights_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

CLASS zcl_filter_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_modern.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax >= iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_flights_classic.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax >= iv_min_seats.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
      " sy-tabix could be used here for logging or specific actions on filtered rows.
      " For example: IF sy-tabix = 1. " First filtered flight. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthält. Demonstrieren Sie, wie `sy-tabix` in einer traditionellen Schleife für eine ähnliche Transformation verwendet werden könnte.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corr_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_modern
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_classic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corr_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_modern.
    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_summary_classic.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(ls_summary_line) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary_line TO rt_summary.
      " sy-tabix could be used here for conditional processing based on row number.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Transformation von internen Tabellen. Im Gegensatz dazu erfordert die klassische Schleife eine explizite Zuweisung jedes Feldes. `sy-tabix` ist in diesem Kontext weniger relevant, da die Transformation auf Feldebene stattfindet.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax. Demonstrieren Sie, wie `sy-tabix` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife verwendet werden kann, um den Index der aktuellen Gruppe zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... GROUP WHERE ...` und `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_info,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             group_index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_info) TYPE tt_flight_group_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_counts.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_key>).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group_key> INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group_info(
        carrid      = <fs_group_key>-carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        group_index = sy-tabix " sy-tabix refers to the current group index
      ) TO rt_group_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_expr_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_flight_by_key_modern

        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

    IF sy-subrc = 0.

    ENDIF.

explanation: Table Expressions sind eine moderne und sehr effiziente Methode, um auf einzelne Zeilen interner Tabellen zuzugreifen. Sie sind kompakter und oft performanter als die klassische `READ TABLE`-Anweisung, insbesondere bei der Verwendung von Schlüsseln. Wenn eine Zeile nicht gefunden wird, löst die Table Expression eine Ausnahme (`cx_sy_itab_line_not_found`) aus, was eine explizite Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht. CLASS zcl_gui_dock_alv_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_alv_flight.
    TYPES tt_alv_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_alv_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_alv_data) TYPE tt_alv_flight.

    METHODS display_alv_in_docking
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_alv_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_alv_data.
    rt_alv_data = VALUE tt_alv_flight(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax
        seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc
        status   = SWITCH string(
                     WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc = 0 THEN 'Leer'
                     WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc < ls_flight-seatsmax THEN 'Verfügbar'

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen. Verwenden Sie die `DELETE` Anweisung mit einer `FOR`-Expression. Demonstrieren Sie, wie `sy-tabix` in einer traditionellen Schleife mit `DELETE` verwendet werden könnte, um den Index der gelöschten Zeile zu erhalten (obwohl dies in modernen ABAP-Versionen vermieden werden sollte).
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE itab FROM ( FOR ... )` für die moderne Variante und `DELETE itab INDEX sy-tabix` für die klassische.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_for_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS delete_old_flights_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_cut_off_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    METHODS delete_old_flights_classic
      IMPORTING
        iv_cut_off_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_for_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights_modern.
    DELETE ct_sflights FROM (
      FOR ls_flight IN ct_sflights WHERE ( fldate < iv_cut_off_date )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_old_flights_classic.
    DATA: lv_deleted_index TYPE i.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < iv_cut_off_date.
        lv_deleted_index = sy-tabix.
        DELETE ct_sflights INDEX lv_deleted_index.
        " After deletion, sy-tabix changes for subsequent iterations.
        " This is why direct use of sy-tabix in a modifying loop is problematic.
        " To avoid issues, process in reverse or collect indices first.
        " For demonstration, we show the problematic direct use.
        sy-tabix = sy-tabix - 1. " Adjust sy-tabix for next iteration after deletion
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

  METHOD test_delete_classic.

    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251126' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '123' fldate = '20251127' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    lo_cut->delete_old_flights_classic( iv_cut_off_date = '20251126' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

explanation: Die `DELETE` Anweisung in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression ist der moderne und empfohlene Weg, Zeilen aus internen Tabellen zu löschen. Sie ist deklarativ, effizient und vermeidet die Fallstricke der manuellen Schleifenbearbeitung, insbesondere wenn `sy-tabix` in einer Schleife verwendet wird, die die Tabelle modifiziert. Die direkte Verwendung von `sy-tabix` in einer `LOOP AT ... DELETE` Schleife ist fehleranfällig, da sich der Index nach jeder Löschung ändert.
keywords: DELETE, FOR, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation, sy-tabix

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die simulierte Mitarbeiterdaten, die typischerweise von einem OData-Dienst zurückgegeben werden, in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `ty_employee` umwandelt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `NEW` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_odata_employee_raw,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             status_code TYPE char1,
             salary_amt  TYPE dec(15,2),
           END OF ty_odata_employee_raw.
    TYPES: tt_odata_employee_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_odata_employee_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             status      TYPE char1,
             salary      TYPE dec(15,2),
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES: tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_odata_to_employees
      IMPORTING
        it_odata_data TYPE tt_odata_employee_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employees.

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_odata_to_employees.
    rt_employees = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_odata_data
                             ( employee_id = ls_raw-employee_id
                               first_name  = ls_raw-first_name
                               last_name   = ls_raw-last_name
                               status      = ls_raw-status_code
                               salary      = ls_raw-salary_amt ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Gehälter aller aktiven Mitarbeiter in einer gegebenen Mitarbeitertabelle. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.

solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             status      TYPE char1,
             salary      TYPE dec(15,2),
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES: tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_active_salary
      IMPORTING
        it_employees TYPE tt_employees
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_employee_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode auf, die eine bestimmte Mitarbeiterfunktion ausführt, basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen. Simulieren Sie dabei eine einfache Mitarbeiterfunktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dem `(method_name)` Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_employee_func DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_employee_function
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_employee_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
    METHODS update_employee_record
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_employee_func IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_employee_function.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' does not exist or cannot be called dynamically.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_employee_status.
    rv_status = 'Employee E001 is Active'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_employee_record.
    rv_message = 'Employee E001 record updated successfully'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_status.
    DATA(lo_dyn_func) = NEW zcl_dynamic_employee_func( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_dyn_func->execute_employee_function( 'GET_EMPLOYEE_STATUS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Employee E001 is Active' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_update.
    DATA(lo_dyn_func) = NEW zcl_dynamic_employee_func( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_dyn_func->execute_employee_function( 'UPDATE_EMPLOYEE_RECORD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Employee E001 record updated successfully' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_invalid.
    DATA(lo_dyn_func) = NEW zcl_dynamic_employee_func( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_dyn_func->execute_employee_function( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe mit `CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)` sind ein mächtiges Werkzeug für flexible Architekturen, bei denen die aufzurufende Logik zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Handler, die auf Konfigurationen reagieren müssen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Employee functions

Instructions: Filtern Sie Termine, die in einem bestimmten Datumsbereich liegen. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE`-Bedingung.
hint: Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE` ist eine moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_filter_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment,
             appointment_id TYPE string,
             employee_id    TYPE string,
             subject        TYPE string,
             app_date       TYPE d,
             app_time       TYPE t,
             status         TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_appointment.
    TYPES: tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_appointments_in_range
      IMPORTING
        it_all_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_start_date       TYPE d
        iv_end_date         TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_appointments_in_range.
    rt_filtered_appointments = VALUE #( FOR ls_app IN it_all_appointments
                                        WHERE ( app_date >= iv_start_date AND app_date <= iv_end_date )
                                        ( ls_app ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_date_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_date_range.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_appointment_filter_date( ).
    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_filter_date=>tt_appointments(
      ( appointment_id = 'A001' employee_id = 'E001' subject = 'Meeting' app_date = '20251120' app_time = '090000' status = 'P' )
      ( appointment_id = 'A002' employee_id = 'E002' subject = 'Review' app_date = '20251125' app_time = '100000' status = 'P' )
      ( appointment_id = 'A003' employee_id = 'E001' subject = 'Workshop' app_date = '20251201' app_time = '140000' status = 'C' )
      ( appointment_id = 'A004' employee_id = 'E003' subject = 'Call' app_date = '20251205' app_time = '110000' status = 'P' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20251125'.
    DATA(lv_end_date) = '20251203'.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_appointments_in_range(
      it_all_appointments = lt_appointments
      iv_start_date       = lv_start_date
      iv_end_date         = lv_end_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-appointment_id exp = 'A002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-appointment_id exp = 'A003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE`-Bedingung innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Operators ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren. Sie ist kompakter und oft performanter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte, insbesondere wenn das Ergebnis direkt zugewiesen wird.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, Date/Time, cl_appointment, Termin der R/3 Terminverwaltung

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Aktualisieren des Status eines Termins und das anschließende Abrufen der aktualisierten Details in einer einzigen Kette von Methodenaufrufen.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` aus den Methoden zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_detail,
             appointment_id TYPE string,
             subject        TYPE string,
             status         TYPE char1,
             last_updated   TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_appointment_detail.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_id TYPE string
        iv_subject        TYPE string.

    METHODS update_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_status TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_manager.

    METHODS get_details
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_details) TYPE ty_appointment_detail.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_appointment_id TYPE string.
    DATA mv_subject        TYPE string.
    DATA mv_status         TYPE char1 VALUE 'P'. " P: Planned, C: Confirmed, X: Cancelled
    DATA mv_last_updated   TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_appointment_id = iv_appointment_id.
    mv_subject        = iv_subject.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD mv_last_updated.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_status.
    mv_status = iv_new_status.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD mv_last_updated.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_details.
    rs_details-appointment_id = mv_appointment_id.
    rs_details-subject        = mv_subject.
    rs_details-status         = mv_status.
    rs_details-last_updated   = mv_last_updated.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_app_manager) = NEW zcl_appointment_manager(
      iv_appointment_id = 'APP_001'
      iv_subject        = 'Project Sync' ).

    DATA(ls_details) = lo_app_manager->update_status( 'C' )->get_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-appointment_id exp = 'APP_001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-status exp = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_details-last_updated IS INITIAL ).

    DATA(ls_details_cancelled) = lo_app_manager->update_status( 'X' )->get_details( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details_cancelled-status exp = 'X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) erhöht die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile aneinandergereiht werden können. Dies wird erreicht, indem die Methoden `ME` (eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Instanz) zurückgeben. Es ist ein idiomatisch modernes Muster in der objektorientierten Programmierung.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, cl_appointment

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Mitarbeiter mit einer bestimmten ID in einer Liste existiert, und geben Sie dessen vollständige Daten zurück, falls vorhanden. Verwenden Sie Inline-Deklarationen und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine performante Möglichkeit, das Vorhandensein einer Zeile zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             status      TYPE char1,
             salary      TYPE dec(15,2),
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES: tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_employee_by_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string
        it_employees   TYPE tt_employees
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_employee) TYPE ty_employee.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_by_id.
    IF line_exists( it_employees[ employee_id = iv_employee_id ] ).
      rs_employee = it_employees[ employee_id = iv_employee_id ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die Kombination aus Inline-Deklarationen, Tabellenausdrücken und `LINE_EXISTS` bietet eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, auf interne Tabellen zuzugreifen und deren Inhalt zu prüfen. `LINE_EXISTS` verhindert dabei einen Laufzeitfehler, falls der gesuchte Eintrag nicht existiert, und ist performanter als ein `READ TABLE` mit anschließender `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfung.
keywords: Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, Inline Declaration, Employee functions

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Termin in der Zukunft liegt. Nutzen Sie moderne Datums- und Zeitfunktionen.
hint: Vergleichen Sie das Termin-Datum mit dem aktuellen Systemdatum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_date_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_future_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_date_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_future_appointment.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    IF iv_appointment_date > lv_current_date.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
